author: Camille H
title: No Amenities or Service / Great Location & Roof
text: This hotel has pros and cons. It could be a good hotel choice if you are ok with the cons. Cons - -After closing the door to our room we discovered that it was unlocked for several minutes before automatically locking. This is a security flaw which we discovered. We waited in the hall until we heard the door lock before leaving. -One tiny quart sized ice maker on a counter in a common area for the entire hotel. This was always empty. -No room service, nobody will come to clean the room or pick up old towels. This is weird because in the room there is a sign that says to put towels on the floor if you want them replaced. -Upon check in, nobody was at the front desk and the front door was locked. It was check in time, but we were stuck on the street. -Front desk was unattended about 25% of the time. -Coffee maker amenities - there was no milk or sugar, just sacks of coffee for the maker -TV Channels were limited, very hard to get even local news for the Today Show which is filmed in NY -Noise, there is a club next door and a food truck that comes each night and people on the street are extremely loud which you can hear from the room. Pros- -This is one of the cheapest hotels that offers a rooftop viewing area. -Rooftop viewing was good for seeing the fireworks on the 4th which is what we wanted. -Room was clean upon check in and the bed was comfortable. -Good location, lots of restaurants and stores in the area.

author: Ethan X
title: it was a awesome experience lead by the ridge hotel
text:
everything is good here...
food quality is delicious..
and behaviour of the stuffs are way beyond imagination...
so in a nutshell at this price.. it is best of the best

author: William G
title: Worst room ever, and I have travelled all but 2 continents in my 73 years.
text: I don’t ever write negative reviews but the incredibly bad experience we just had at The Ridge demands that I spare other tourists the nightmare.  I checked in early and left our bags at front desk.  Returned at normal check in time and our bags were waiting for us in the tiniest room, adjacent to the entry lobby and side exterior exit door, which also housed a coffee machine for every guest to bang around as they gossiped outside the door to our room.   Every guest returning to hotel into the wee hours, and every guest checking out in the early morning had no idea that our room was right there, around the corner.  Had they known, I trust that some effort might have been made to moderate their festive volume.   My disappointment is that I was not informed in advance of this nightmare of claustrophobia, and as I mentioned, I arrived 3 hours before check in, so I definitely was not the last guest checking in.   Never again.   Spare yourself a similar experience.

author: Mason S
title: Don't do it............
text:
I passed by the hotel and there were junkies on the stoop. 
I would not feel safe staying here solo.
 There is no attendant. 
I canceled 2 days in advance and was still charged for the room.
THIS IS A CONTACTLESS HOTEL and no one will help you.
Would not recommend

author: Dylan T
title: The WORST hotel experience I have ever had
text:
The WORST hotel experience I have ever had. The Ridge hotel is an absolute scam. I booked and paid for a king-sized room, and after traveling 12 hours, they overbooked and tried to sneak me into a tiny, filthy double room without saying a word. The room was so cramped you could barely walk around the bed, it was dirty, and it looked nothing like the photos advertised. When I confronted the front desk that it clearly wasn’t the King room we purchased, they admitted the lie and promised a refund. We had no choice but to accept the tiny room, or sleep on the street. I showed them grace and trusted that the refund (at least for the difference in rooms) would come, but it didn’t.
For almost two months, the owner dodged my calls and refused to take responsibility. I was finally forced to go through Expedia just to claw back a partial refund, because the hotel itself did absolutely nothing.
This was no more than a bait and switch scam. The Ridge Hotel is dishonest, dirty, and run by people who have no respect for their guests. 
Shout out to Jasmine at the front desk who at least tried to be helpful.  Stay literally anywhere else <3

author: Sydney I
title: Clean hotel with all necessary amenities in a very strategic and convenient location
text:
Very nice structure directly on a busy main street both day and night with a wide choice of cafes supermarkets shops and restaurants, within walking distance of several metro lines.
Reception staff, friendly, of few words but try to accommodate all the needs of customers and meet them.
Small room, but with all the amenities including fridge and air conditioning, maybe a bit too noisy.
The room is never tidied up, but it's common in New York.
You can leave them in the luggage room both on arrival and return, but with hourly limitation, maximum until 15 because then until 18 there is no one left.
Apart from a few small negative notes, great value especially by New York standards and strategic location, in the middle of several meters to the various areas to visit in New York.

author: Alice I
title: Good location, low quality
text: the hotel is located in the Lower East Side, a young and funky part of New York.  The staff at the reception were friendly and helpful and we had a comfortable king-size bed.  I am afraid these are the only positive things I can write.  Our room was a broom closet where we could hardly move, let alone put our suitcases.  There was hardly any closet space, and it was positioned very inconveniently so that one had to perform acrobatics to hang some trousers.  One of the advertised attractions of the hotel is a roof deck with great view of New York, but it was closed for renovation - an odd time to do so at peak tourist season.  The foregoing is not uncommon in New York hotels, but what we found really questionable here is that the rooms are not serviced or cleaned for the whole duration of stay, and if we wanted the room to be cleaned we had to pay extra! I can understand one has to manage staff costs, but we found this very unhygienic  besides being unpleasant.

author: Taylor J
title: Great solution!
text: The Ridge Hotel is a great compromise between convenience, price and location. Well connected to various areas of Manhattan, it offers great amenities such as: cleaning, relaxation area in the basement, free water and coffee, towel exchange, rooftop with always accessible views and rooms with access code (no key). Fully virtual check-in may create some initial confusion, but following the info via email to the letter is quite feasible. Overall a great reference point for short trips to NYC. Recommended!

author: Ethan F
title: Cozy and clean for 1.
text: Room was comfortable, small,  but had a private restroom. A huge plus, for the price. Returning in June and booked a room here. It's convenient and good when your coming and going often. But perfect locale. Something is always open.  Didn't need customer service too much but the contact less check in was great. I much prefer less human contact 😂

author: William B
title: Dreadful Hotel
text:
Dreadful hotel. Unfortunately, I was given one of the only rooms located in the lobby—right next to the entrance and the coffee machine (see photo). This space should never have been turned into a guest room. Unsurprisingly, my converted broom cupboard was incredibly noisy, and I barely got any sleep. I could hear every guest entering the hotel, as well as the security guard talking on his phone in the middle of the night.

To make matters worse, the room was unbearably stuffy due to a faulty climate control system. Most of the staff were extremely rude, though I can almost forgive them—having to work in this place every day must be miserable.

That said, you get what you pay for, and this is certainly a cheap place to stay. But even at a low price, I wouldn’t recommend it.

author: Wyatt O
title: Disappointing experience with the room and staff
text: We have booked an 18sqm double bed room which turns out to be the size of a broom chamber. The bed is not the size of a standard double bedroom, it’s barely impossible for two adults to occupy the room together, let alone walk around the bed. There is damage across the room, the AC who doesn’t operate in “winter” (Mid March) we have to open the window every few hours to let cool air in. Cables hanging out, damaged furniture. Would not recommend this place. The night staff do simply not care and tell you to come back in the morning to speak to another staff. Very disappointing, also as we had to pre-pay for five nights and no choice other than to stay here.

author: Hannah J
title: Cool, boutique hotel in a great hood
text: Cool, hip hotel on the Lower East Side.  Great neighborhood.  Lot’s to do, see, eat, drink. Down the street from Katz Deli, striking distance to Soho, and close to public transportation.  The rooms are small (its NYC!), but comfortable.  There is a common kitchen area and a very sweet roof deck, although it was pretty cold during our stay so we did not utilize it except for taking a couple of photos.  There is also coffee and snacks in the lobby.  A nice touch!  The staff was super friendly and accommodating, too.  Oh! and the windows are soundproofed!  Great stay.

author: Elena T
title: Suspicious
text:
I recently booked a "reserve now, pay later" room via Hotels.com, but my card was charged immediately. Then I received a text:

"Hi xxxx, this is Samantha from The Ridge Hotel. Before we take payment via your credit card, we wanted to offer a cash discount. If you pay cash upon arrival, I can lower your rate from $352.00 to $300.00. Let us know!"

When I called right away to clarify, the woman I spoke with was rude and asked me for more information. I ended up canceling and disputing the charge.

It seemed like a scam.

author: Owen Y
title: the most fully automated check-in hotel I’ve experienced
text:
The hotel has a beautiful rooftop. It’s the most fully automated check-in hotel I’ve experienced—you’re required to register online before arrival to receive your entry code and stay details. While they do have front desk staff, they don’t seem to handle check-ins directly. If you arrive late without registering online, you may run into some issues since the front desk isn’t staffed 24/7.

The rooms are small but come with a fridge and microwave, facing a view of the East Village. The TV isn’t able to stream, so it’s more of a classic “movie night” experience with limited options. However, the real highlight is the rooftop, where you can get a distant view of the Empire State Building. The flooring is made of old wooden planks—somewhat decayed, creaky underfoot, and adding a unique charm. That said, be cautious with kids; my child was playing with a toy car on the floor and accidentally got scratched by an exposed nail from the old wood, leaving a mark that lasted about a week.

The first floor has 24-hour K-cup coffee available, and the hotel is close to iconic spots like Katz’s Deli and Russ & Daughters. But what I enjoyed the most was the rooftop—it adds a lot of value to the overall experience, making this a very cost-effective hotel choice.

author: Hugo U
title: Rotten Customer Service
text:
Booked this hotel in the past because it is a black away from where my son lives. Somehow, booked the wrong dates. Even though I have stayed at the hotel before and would have stayed at the hotel many times again, they would not refund my money. 
I come to New York at least six times a year. Do the math. Certainly, would have made the money back for a refund of a room they will rent out again. 
The only reason I stayed at the hotel is because of the convenience to my son’s apartment and the cost. Otherwise, the room is very small and uncomfortable.

author: Aiden Y
title: The Ridge staff is extraordinary.  We'll be back!
text: Everything about our week at The Ridge Hotel in March, 2024 was perfect.  A+ location steps from subway, spacious public spaces on the roof and in the basement, and FANTASTIC staff.  Jasmine and Brian at the desk were kind, cheerful, and more than happy to engage for a few minutes when we had questions.  We're already planning our return next Spring Break and The Ridge is one of the reasons we'll be back.  Top-notch operation from top to bottom.  Be sure to check out the Batsu! comedy show just a few blocks away.

author: Miguel Q
title: Buyer beware!
text:
I booked The Ridge via booking.com and will never go there again. We arrived late due to airline delays and when we arrived were not able to get into the room.
Their “contactless” check-in process was that they sent us a code to enter the building and one to enter the room. The front door code worked, the room code didn’t. We were stuck in the hallway. I called the number provided and a person answered but said she couldn’t get into the computer. I asked what she was going to do and she hung up and never answered again. Our repeated attempts to call and text were not successful and we spent all night in the basement community room. No access code for the bathroom. 
In the morning they gave us a new door code and promised a refund. We never got it. They claimed it was refunded but we never got it. 
My credit card company wouldn’t help because the hotel had required full payment upon booking, several months in advance. The bank said we had to dispute the charge within 60 days, but our arrival was 3 months after the booking date.
The room was impossibly small. And overall the hotel is substandard. And unethical. 
Don’t go there!

author: Zachary S
title: Lower East side location good, you get what you pay for ($500 for 3 nights).
text: Good clean bathroom and room. Double bed quite comfy tight against one wall, with TV, fridge, wardrobe, microwave, on the remaining side so room for one person at a time to move past. Iron and hairdryer in the room. We were at the side of the building and it was quiet enough with the window closed. Front rooms overlook a nightclub! No staff in the building, though occasionally someone would be sitting at the front desk. Check-in details received 24 hours by email as promised - all done by door codes. Coffee granules supplied but no tea, milk or robes (as promised) found. Communal room in basement with more coffee and TV , microwave etc.

author: Antoine S
title: Boiling hot room and the noisiest I have ever hear in Manhattan - drove home at 2am
text: Booked because it was cheap and close to the LES. Room was boiling hot and the air con wasn’t working. Guy at reception said something is wrong with it and others complained, but he already gave all the fans he had away. It was also insanely loud in the room even if window was closed. Psychotic car honking for hours and people on street were so loud. I used to live in nyc for 10 years and I don’t recall it ever being this horrible. It was impossible to sleep so my boyfriend and I left at 2am and I drove my car home in an awful rainstorm. I fridge and microwave could come in handy. But I only recommend staying here if you are under 25 and plan on being insanely wasted when you get back to the room and then maybe you’ll sleep and not care about anything else.

author: Poppy I
title: Glorified Hostel, Noisy & Falling Apart Already
text:
I stayed here for one night in January 2024. I was curious to see the inside after watching them build it not too long ago, when I still lived in the neighborhood. I was in total amazement to see how much it is already falling apart. 

I booked a room with a full sized bed. There's a lot of stuff (tv, mini fridge, microwave, luggage rack) which is helpful but the room was in very poor condition. Very poor lighting in both the bedroom and bathroom. The laminate on my single folding side table was peeling off. One of the two hooks on the back of the bathroom door was missing. The shelf over the toilet was missing (empty brackets still attached to the wall). The sconces next to the bed looked like they were about to fall off the wall. There were random wall anchors with nothing attached to them that I initially thought were bugs. (No bugs!) Beaten up cabinets. Some shady looking ceiling tiles in the bathroom. Two outlets next to the bed but three phone jacks?! The bed itself sounded like it might have collapsed underneath me. A little thing but to add to the mix, the art wasn't even centered over the bed. Lol. The inside of the safe was randomly on top of the freestanding closet. 

I could also hear every single person in the hall -- full conversations -- and quite a bit of traffic from Houston St. 

These owners clearly don't care whatsoever for this property and did things as cheaply as possible. The hotel is however safe, secure, and relatively clean.

If you get a stellar (under $100 per night including taxes) deal and are searching for an efficiency hotel, this is a great location. I'm in NYC for work weekly and I will not stay here again, despite that. It's basically a hostel with private rooms.

author: Isla O
title: Super stay
text:
B&B in a perfect location to reach the major points of interest.
Clean room with all the necessary comfort for a great stay.
Very important, windows with new frames, consequently you cannot hear the chaos outside and you can rest in peace. 
Manu, the hostess, is very nice and funny. Truly a pleasure to have met her.
We will definitely return next year!!!

author: Chloe D
title: Exceptional experience
text:
Beautiful property, the owner was incredibly kind and helpful, excellent location, we highly recommend it to anyone looking for a B&B in the Vatican area.
We will definitely return

author: Chloe W
title: Excellent accommodation just steps from St. Peter's.
text:
Great guest house ten minutes on foot from the Vatican. Very close to the metro line A for quickly reaching all the main monuments of Rome. 
Clean and welcoming room with all amenities and air conditioning. Common area with fridge and mini kitchen that are very useful. Elevator absolutely essential for carrying luggage.
Area rich in restaurants and bars for all tastes.
Staff available for any needs.
Highly recommended!

author: Poppy L
title: Beautiful Stay!!
text:
We stayed for 4 nights, and we truly enjoyed it a lot. The room is very nice, spacious, the place is charming, and it is in a perfect area. 
Very easy to get there, close to the Vatican. 
Thank you, Manuela, for your good vibes, for when we had an issue due to our mistake, you came right away to help us, for being attentive to how we were, and for your recommendations to places with a lot of information! 
We are happy to have decided to stay here and we would definitely come back!!

author: Connor U
title: Clean structure in a beautiful location
text: We stayed three nights in this establishment. What can I say? Everything was wonderful, from the room to the kitchen. Impeccable cleanliness, perfect location, close to all services. Manuela is a fantastic and caring person.

author: Katie M
title: Great
text: Ideal apartment for traveling in a group. Clean and well-located. The area is safe and perfect for visiting Rome without the need to use public transportation.

author: Adam E
title: Comfort and location.
text: Comfort and good location, ideal to take the January floor. The neighborhood is very good, close to the Vatican.

author: Louis M
title: Magnificent apartments to enjoy Rome.
text:
Magnificent apartments that are very complete with everything necessary in an excellent location near the Vatican to visit, enjoy, and get to know Rome.
Manuela is a magnificent host; she helped us with airport transfers, and she provided options for places to have dinner on the first day and breakfast.

author: Samuel D
title: Absolutely recommendable.
text: Great apartment, with 4 rooms, each with its own bathroom. Very close to the Vatican. The host, Manuela, is very attentive to everything and very approachable. Highly recommendable, would return. Thank you

author: Alice X
title: Great
text:
The location, attention to detail, and the care of the guest Manuela made this stay more than pleasant.

I am often in Rome for work, and I believe that after so much "wandering," I have found the ideal solution, and after having been there with my family, I think I can recommend Tinkerbell to everyone.

author: George V
title: Thank you❤️
text:
We spent four wonderful days! We had a great time! Excellent place. Emanuela is truly kind and hospitable. Cozy rooms and very comfortable beds. Excellent room cleanliness and a location just 10 minutes on foot from the Vatican Museums.
Thank you very much 
Samanta

author: Morgan I
title: Perfect stay in a awesome locality
text:
We stayed in Tinkerbell Roma in May
Initially me and my daughter and then later my husband joined us
The location is perfect,close to public transport, very quiet and safe 
Manuela is an amazing host, helpful at every step, very patiently answered our queries
We had a very pleasant and amazing stay
Would recommend to friends and family

author: Hannah P
title: Highly recommended
text: Great location, beautiful property. Excellent cleanliness but above all, the owner is professional, available, and very kind!

author: Aaron B
title: Fabulous - just flipping Fabulous.
text: What a find!  A few minutes walk from the Vatican - perfect if you book an early slot for the Vatican tour (definitely recommended as its crazy busy) and the perfect landlady.  We booked this via a booking site, but would recommend getting in touch directly with her - she is an absolute gem and she has created a lovely place to stay in Rome.  It's essentially two apartments on two floors with 4 en suite bedrooms in each.  She has also created a lovely kitchen area with everything you could need including an iron!  If you want to have breakfast, you can shop locally and store in the fridge.   You may be sharing with others, we met some really nice people who were also staying there.  It's Rome, so don't expect it to be big, space is a premium -  unless you want to spend much much more on a large hotel room..good luck finding that!  She got in touch most days to make sure everything was good, gave great suggestions for food and was really helpful. We could not have had a  better start to a 3 city trip than this.   Not far from the underground and buses galore.  Lots of really good places to eat and drink too and definitely head to Fabrica around the corner for a fantastic breakfast.

author: Noah Z
text: All the best !!! House, location , price and ... Manuella !!!

author: Marta K
title: Super
text: The place is  very clean and nice  . And the owner is very kind❤️

author: Jessica P
title: Pleasant stay at the accommodation.
text: My experience was quite good; everything was organized, clean, and without any difficulties. Grateful for the hospitality. Recommended.

author: Sydney I
title: I'll be back
text: Very convenient place, a few steps from the metro Ottaviano. Impeccable room, both from a point of view of cleanliness and services and from an aesthetic point of view. Staff available and attentive to every problem and need

author: Michael A
title: Stay Top!
text: Very cozy and spacious rooms, super strategic area a few minutes from Ottaviano and convenient to reach the Olympic Stadium on foot

author: Marta V
title: Warm, welcome and convenient
text: Obviously loved our stay!Massive thanks to Manuela for being such legend - she was so happy, welcoming and gave us the best local tips on where to eat and shop.Her knowledge of the city made us trip amazing! The place is spotless and in a prime spot. We’ll be back for sure! Cheers!

author: Ruby O
title: Avoid annexe rooms!!
text: The hotel needs to be more honest about the condition and environment of rooms in the annexe building. It’s a building site, habitable rooms only on floor 5, and they are of a basic standard with works incomplete in the rooms. Floors 0-4 are a building site, we had to navigate pallets of building materials to access and egress the building, stairs were blocked due to scaffolding, with an antiquated lift holding only 2 persons service the habitable floor. If the lift breaks down you’re knackered, how they get a certificate to confirm the building is safe and meets the standards is beyond me. If you intend booking this hotel establish beyond doubt if you’re in main hotel or annexe, if the annexe, I would encourage you to find elsewhere as it is a pretty poor offer at present.

author: Thomas G
title: Fantastic hotel, great location!
text:
Don't be alarmed by the negative reviews on here. We have just returned from a 3 night stay (July 2026) and the hotel was perfect. Location could not be better. Both Aircon and WiFi were really strong. The hotel staff were great, we forgot our travel adaptors and they provided us with 2, we also required an iron and strong hairdryer and both were brought to our room in minutes.
Our room was lovely, no sign of wear and tear, nice and modern, comfortable bed and we even had a small balcony and great views from the 5th floor 
The rooftop bar is a nice touch but the jacuzzi did look like it needed cleaning but we weren't really interested in this feature.
The breakfast was average, like any European hotel, it was sufficient for what you needed.
Overall we were extremely pleased with the hotel and if we went back to Rome we would almost certainly stay here again, location and value for money were fantastic.

author: Tyler O
title: DO NOT GO! WARNING! STAY AWAY!!!
text:
DO NOT BOOK HERE IF STAYING IN ANNEX !

Nowhere on the love holidays website does it state that the annex is under construction/ every floor derelict construction site . The room mouldy- exposed wires- walls with holes fillered and un painted- floor dusty and dirty where construction workers have come through. Complained to main hotel which is 100M walk away from main hotel - rude- smirk on his face and didn’t care- told us the main hotel was fully booked. No refund allowed- had to book alternative accommodation- when we returned to the hotel the following day after being advised that manager would be able to issue a refund he tells us he can’t do it either … but a room became available at 3AM in the morning- when we went to look at the room we were offered we asked the porter - when was this available he said “it has been available since yesterday” so we told the manager this he said “he’s just a porter he doesn’t know what he’s talking about” but the room had been cleaned at 7AM? (The cleaners don’t start until 8AM) as I asked. On the afternoon of our final day we asked the 3rd different manager “when did this room 404 become available “ he said “14:30 today” we looked confused because our room  was given to us at 9AM that morning and was told it was available at 3AM , everyone lies- don’t care- don’t help- and clearly don’t like tourists. Genuinely the WORST hotel experience we’ve ever had. Do not go here booking.com somewhere else.

author: Alexander V
title: Worst Experience!
text:
Without a doubt, this was the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had.

The biggest issue was the room itself. The air conditioning unit was leaking continuously onto the floor throughout our stay. It wasn’t just a few drops—it leaked enough that we had to keep towels on the floor to soak up the water to avoid slipping. This is completely unacceptable for any hotel, let alone one that claims to be a 4-star property.

The room also felt poorly maintained, with visible damage and unfinished repairs. There were holes in the wallpaper where fixtures had clearly been removed, and the overall condition of the room was tired and neglected. The ceiling light fitting was also incomplete, exposing what looked like part of the fixture rather than a properly finished installation.

For the price we paid, I expected a clean, well-maintained room and basic amenities to function properly. Instead, we spent our stay dealing with a leaking air conditioner and a room that felt like it had been patched together rather than properly maintained.

When first checked into hotel too, receptionist went through everything as usual when checking in, also said that we had breakfast included in the stay, so we came down to breakfast the next day and then got told we didn’t have breakfast included, after we basically sat down with our food. When speaking to the manager again he denied saying this. I would have not have gone down to buffet breakfast if he said we didn’t have breakfast included.

The cleaners also cleaned out room every day but one of the days they left our room open all day! we came back and tried to use our key card to find it was already open! anyone could have gone in our room and stolen anything. 

I would not stay here again and would not recommend Hotel 87 to anyone looking for a comfortable stay in Rome. There are far better options available.

author: Juan M
title: DO NOT STAY IF THEY PLACE YOU IN THE ANNEX
text: DO NOT STAY IF THEY PLACE YOU IN THE ANNEX.....Hotel 87 eighty-seven - Maison d'Art Collection is a 4 star, we paid premium prices and were placed in thier annex on the 5th floor, the rest of the building was under construction, the entry way was dusty the walls were marked up, the elevator was full of dust on top and inside. The rooms walls were painted with 2 different paints that didn't matched and looked spotty, the closet light would not turn off and shined all night I had to put a towel to block the light. At 7 in the morning construction workers started to hammer, grind tiles, and throw concrete bags on the floor, that could be heard throughout the building, for 2 days we had to walk down the 5 flights because the were using the elevater to move stuff up and down in the building. I tried 3 times to speak to the manager Fransico and he blow me off till 5 minutes before he went home I explained the issue and he said he spoke to the construction manager and that they would have thier workers would start at 9 am instead of 7 am, he also said to speak to you that he was not going to compensate me for any inconvenience with a I don't care attitude. The next morning construction started again at 7 am, so he basically lied to my face because he knew we were leaving the next morning. That stay was a 1.5 star, I am very disappointed in the experience we had.

author: Thomas L
title: Hands off as a FAMILY and no HALF BOARD!!!
text:
We booked a quadruple room for 4 people. This room was located in a separate building several houses away from the actual hotel. This building is a complete construction site, with renovation work taking place on every floor (except for the floor used by the hotel for the rooms we booked).
I have never experienced anything like this, and we really wonder how a hotel can accommodate guests in such a building – even from a regulatory or fire safety perspective (e.g., exposed insulation wool on several floors where construction/renovation is taking place, extreme dust development in the entrance area, construction debris everywhere, flickering light in the entrance area, etc.).

Regarding the room itself:
•	In the bathroom, there was mold on the ceiling (it was cleaned with chlorine cleaner during our absence on the 1st day, which additionally caused odor nuisance but certainly does not provide a permanent solution for mold). The showerhead was constantly dripping.
•	The toilet seat and the toilet paper holder were not properly mounted and wobbled during use.
•	Sticky and inadequately cleaned bathroom fixtures
•	The TV remote was secured with tape so that the batteries would not fall out of the holder, as the cover was missing.
•	There was no lighting in the closet, loose cables were hanging out, and only 5 hangers were provided for 4 people for a 4-day stay.
•	All USB charging ports at the beds were completely destroyed and thus unusable.
•	All USB charging ports at the beds were completely destroyed and thus unusable.
•	The instructions for the safe were no longer legible, and the safe alarm was triggered when entering a new code and could not be turned off. 

In response to our inquiry about whether we could get two double rooms in the main building, the hotel manager informed us that they were fully booked. However, we were previously informed about a fee for changing rooms. A shabby attempt at extortion to impose costs for changing rooms on us.

We left the hotel early in the morning of the 2nd night. (since we arrived late in the evening on the 1st day and needed 1 day for reorganization) at our own expense. It feels like coming home, very friendly and competent staff.

author: Thomas L
title: Hände weg als FAMILIE und keine HALBPENSION!!!
text:
4 Star Italian Standard???

My husband and me were guests in the hotel 87 as a couple 9 years ago. We were happy and satisfied with this hotel and this is why we chose the hotel again for our family holidays in Rome.

We booked a quadrodouble room for 4 persons. This room was located in a seperate building to the hotel. This building is a pure construction area where in every floor renovation works are ongoing (except the floor which is used by the hotel for rooms like the one we booked).

I have never seen anything like this and we are really wondering how it can be that a hotel is allowed to host guests in such a building  - even from a public authority or fire safety related perspective (e.g. insulation wool in several floors were construction / renovation works are ongoing, dust development in the vestibule, flickering exposure in the entry area etc.).

In the room itself:

-  there was mold in the bathroom on the ceiling, 

- The shower head is dripping

-  the toilet seat and the toilet paper holder were not assemled properly

- sticky and improperly cleaned bathroom fixtures are not up to four-star standards.

- the controller for the TV was fixed with a tape for ensuring that the batteries will not fall out of the bracket because the cover was missing

- No wardrobe lighting available, loose wires are sticking out, and only 5 hangers provided for 4 people for a 4-day stay

- All the USB charging ports on the beds are completely destroyed and therefore unusable.

- the safe instructions were not readable anymore and the safe alarm started when initiating a new code without any change to stop the alarm.

After requesting if it is possible to get two double bed rooms in the main hotel building, we were told by the hotel manager that they are fully booked and he doesn't undertand our complains at all because the whole hotel and its facilities is clearly 4 Star Italian standard. 

We have been in Italia over the last couple of decades at least 20 times, but we never experienced something like this.  THIS IS CLEARLY NOT 4 STAR ITALIAN STANDARD.

After senseless discussions with the hotel and also with TUI as our tour operator which was not able to organize an alternative accomodation in another hotel, we organized a new hotel by ourselfs and left the hotel 87 after two nigts. 

We are really sorry how this hotel developed. The breakfast is still good and a lot to choose for (e.g. fresh fruits like strawberries, melons etc). Also some employees in the hotel (bar / restaurant area) are really friendly and trying their best. 

But in the end, it is not acceptable to book a 4 star hotel where the room is located in an abandoned construction site.

From the very beginning, we tried to engage with the staff in a solution-oriented manner. However, this did not seem to be the management's goal. We have visually documented all the conditions in full to meet the burden of proof. I also assume that the Italian authorities—similar to the Austrian ones—have strict regulations in place.

All we had hoped for was a fulfilling, relaxing holiday with our children in Rome. The fact that we were relegated to a construction site and expected to accept this without comment was not a customer-oriented approach.

author: Lucy N
title: Horrible and uneducated
text: Horrible experience since the reception lack of attention from the reception, at the time of arrival they asked us for the passports and the very rude attendant did not take the copy of my daughter’s passport, when he was about to go up he asked us for the passport again, he was still rude and uneducated

author: Holly O
title: So disappointed
text:
This hotel is worth 2 stars 
1st bedroom broken bed and ridiculous bathroom (210)
2 nd bedroom a closet (201)
No more coffee machine or French chains 
So disappointed they explain that with booking it is the lower category 
Frankly at this price 1290 euros for 5 nights 
Passing your way...
In addition for the spa you must book 
To avoid

author: Katie R
title: Do not stay at this hotel!!!
text:
Rome is a lovely city and we had a great time exploring it but our experience with this hotel really let us down. When we arrived, we were taken to a separate building away from the main hotel which was under construction. As a woman, this made me feel extremely unsafe and uncomfortable — luckily I was travelling with my boyfriend because if I had been staying with a female friend instead, I honestly would have felt very uneasy.

Every morning we were woken up early by loud construction noise, which made it difficult to relax or enjoy the stay. The lift also looked like it was falling apart and didn’t feel safe to use.

The only positive was that the room itself was actually nice and clean. However, overall the experience did not live up to expectations and I wouldn’t choose to stay here again.

author: Lauren S
title: Hotel staff were so friendly & great location
text:
When I looked up reviews after booking this hotel I was very apprehensive about what our stay would be like. But I’m happy to say the awful horror stories on trip advisor were nowhere to be found. We stayed in the main building and a few reviews had mentioned about staff being rude, however our experience could not have been further from that. Staff were attentive, went above and beyond when we needed something, and were always happy to help. 
As far as rooms go they are clean and maybe ever so slightly suffering from a bit of wear and tear but I would expect that from just about every hotel.. who really cared about some scratches on a bed post really? 
Great location and would stay again! Rooftop bar was also lovely and gym was good for a city hotel based on other previous hotel gym experiences

author: Sofia C
title: Don't book!
text: Very customer unfriendly service! Never again, highly recommended!

author: Henry P
title: Super stay
text: We had a lovely stay at hotel 87. Fred at the front desk couldn't of been more helpful. Super customer service. We would happily return again

author: Pablo P
title: 2026 Easter Trip
text:
While the location of the hotel is excellent and very convenient for exploring Rome, the overall experience fell short of expectations.

Despite having a confirmed late check-out, the room key stopped working at 11:06am, which created unnecessary inconvenience. Communication on this matter could have been handled more effectively.

The room itself is in poor condition, with visible wear and tear throughout—scratched furniture, inadequate lighting, and a generally small, somewhat claustrophobic layout. While the bed is comfortable, the linens are too short and do not properly cover the mattress. Cleanliness is acceptable at a surface level, but attention to detail is lacking, with dust noticeable on frames and in the bathroom.

The shower is particularly small and restrictive, which may be uncomfortable for many guests. On a positive note, the bathroom amenities are of good quality.

The gym is unfortunately not usable: it is dirty, poorly maintained, and lacks basic essentials such as towels and water. The equipment is outdated, some of it not functioning, and the space itself feels neglected, with no air conditioning and an unpleasant environment.

In-room amenities are limited. The TV offers very few channels (no international options), and there is no complimentary water—minibar bottles are charged at approximately €2.50 each.

Breakfast was disappointing. Aside from some decent homemade cakes, most of the food was cold and unappealing. Despite breakfast being included, I chose to dine elsewhere after the first day.

The elevator is small, often busy, and has an unpleasant odor.

Service is inconsistent. Housekeeping staff were kind and courteous, but reception and service staff were at times unfriendly and lacking professionalism.

Overall, while the location is a strong advantage, the hotel does not offer good value for money. For a similar price—or slightly more—there are significantly better boutique hotel options in Rome. I would not recommend this property unless it undergoes a substantial refurbishment and improvement in service standards.

author: Manon T
title: Excellent empathetic service. It was a shame that I could stay just for one night.
text: I say: the night time receptionist here returned my faith in humanity. I say: the hotel won me over through empathy. I got somewhat careless at Termini Metro station after a long day and succumbed to the hospitality of what appeared to be pick pockets of Romanian origin. This resulted in a series of events that had me wondering the streets of Rome at about Might. This gentleman supported me sufficiently so that I could have some sleep, a shower, and breakfast in time to register for my marathon event. The hotel room and discounted price was not bad,either. I was even allowed to store my luggage  to enable me register.

author: Aiden L
title: Would avoid if you want a relaxing experience
text:
Very disappointing stay.

We were only here for a short two-day trip and unfortunately the start of the stay was completely disrupted. The Wi-Fi in the room did not work and I raised this with staff three separate times. Each time I was told it was working normally and the response felt dismissive and condescending rather than helpful. It later became clear that the Wi-Fi was not working because of the leak issue in the room.

The room temperature was also showing 26°C and we were told the air conditioning was not available and only ran in fan mode, which made the room extremely uncomfortable, especially overnight.

The biggest issue was a leak in the room. The following morning we were woken up by multiple members of staff entering the room to deal with the problem, which was not a pleasant way to start the day. We were then moved to another room located in a completely separate building across a very busy street, meaning we had to walk back and forth between buildings with our belongings.

For such a short stay this disruption had a significant impact on our trip.

What is most disappointing is that when the issue was raised afterwards, the hotel reported that no Wi-Fi complaints had been made, which is simply not true as the issue was raised multiple times during our stay.

Overall the situation was handled poorly and the response afterwards has been extremely frustrating.

author: Aaron C
title: Power is wanting
text:
After a mishap caused by the travel agency, the manager Roberto did everything to make us feel at home, nice person and above all competent....
Thank you.

author: Aiden O
title: Great weekend stay
text: Hotel is situated very well. Walking distance to the Spanish steps ect. The service was very good. There is a nice spa area and gym. They have a nice rooftop bar. Stayed in the superior room which was nicely decorated and clean. No complaints . Would recommend

author: Poppy M
title: Not a 4 star hotel!!!
text: We picked this hotel due to the photos online and the modern style of the hotel along with the cleanliness and the factor of the pool and spa. I booked the “annex” room in the hotel, upon arrival we were taken to completely different building a few minutes walk from the actual hotel. It could have been specified when booking it is an actual whole other building. As a young couple it was scary walking in as the building was very old and run down with the lights not working properly. Don’t get me wrong the hotel room was as described apart from the very mouldy bathroom window. Along with no wifi at all for the entire trip and having to use data roaming. We booked the spa the day before for 5pm, the hotel reception advised there is maintenance until 3pm and should not be an issue. We had come back early from site seeing, got changed into swim wear to go to the hotel pool to be told the spa is not in use, we were not made aware of this which is inconvenient as this was planned into our day and the staff had no sympathy regarding it.

author: Lucy E
title: Hotel with excellent location in Rome!
text: Perfect location, easy access to all touristy sites in Rome! We were the lucky ones who were able to get a room in the main building! Room was quite spacious for all our luggage. Bed was comfortable. Room was not noisy considering ours faced the avenue. The only drawbacks: terrible shower & tub, very hard to take baths in both. Also, shower & S&C pumps didn’t work and they were inconsistent with soaps so that was tricky! Aside from that, all good. I would stay here again in our next visit to Rome because the pros of the location exceeds any cons!

author: George N
title: Beautiful building, friendly staff, and a relaxing weeks stay!
text:
Found this hotel for our weeks stay in Rome and happy that we did. 

Arrived before the 3pm check-in time and our room was ready, so we could get freshened up after a day of travelling. We got the train from Fiumicino to Termini, and the hotel was a short 10 minute walk from the station. Tons of cafes, restaurants, gelatarias etc all within a short walking distance of the hotel. Most major sights were about a 30 minute walk away from us here including Trevi Fountain, Colloseum, Roman Forum, Pantheon etc. 

The room was ample in size, with a large blackout glass bathroom, equipped with shower, toilet, bidet, sink & amenties. Beds were comfy enough, no duvets provided, just a sheet and a blanket which is more than enough in the summer heat. The room is fully air conditioned, all controlled by the dial on the wall, as our all the lights in the room. We would have loved an extra pillow each, but it is a small preference. There is a mini bar in the room, all items individually priced on the card inside. Room was refreshed daily, and the only negative on this was although there is a sign in the bathroom stating the company try being environmentally friendly and don't wash towels everyday unless left on the sink, they would still wash them even when they weren't place on the sink. We had a small issue with our sink, but maintenance were in quickly to resolve it and did so very quickly and politely. 

Staff were friendly throughout our stay, always happy to help answer questions, and the service at breakfast was efficient and tables turned and cleaned quickly enough when it got busier. 

The pool was a great highlight! After or before busy days out in the scorching heat, it was great to get into the pool and refresh and cool down. There is a lovely upper terrace outside with cuddle sofas, and more sunloungers, so plenty of space to chill or suntan. Towels are available at reception, so just ask before you head out. Beds by the poolside fill up fast, but if you are fortunate you can grab one. I would have liked to have seen staff keeping an eye on the pool, as signs up to state no diving etc, but there were children constantly running, diving, wrestling on the pool edge, and being a little dangerous around other people, but nobody was there monitoring it. 

The food was good too. We ate at varying times of day, as breakfast was included. Breakfast had a good amount of options, and was good enough to set us up for the busy days we had planned. 

One added feature was the lobby. It was a beautiful setting to relax after a busy day, with a quiet drink, and some lovely piano playing every night. Was so comfortable, and honestly was such a nice way to end our days. 

Definitely recommend this hotel to anyone happy to stay a little further away from the sights. We would love to return to this beautiful hotel one day!! Thanks to all the team for a comfortable stay

author: Lucas Y
title: The Building Hotel in Rome was extremely disappointing
text:
A room in a state totally unworthy of what we expected

Our experience at The Building Hotel in Rome was extremely disappointing, mainly due to the state of cleanliness and maintenance of our room.

As soon as we settled in, we noticed numerous problems, which we took care to photograph.

The carpet was covered with numerous stains and dark marks. The wall coverings were also very stained, with large water marks, various traces, and even a torn section revealing the material behind it.

The bathroom was in an equally concerning state: shower drain heavily clogged and deteriorated, deposits around the metal elements, dirty and degraded shower seals and rails, damaged finishes, as well as very marked and worn faucets.

Even more concerning, we found and photographed a small arthropod on the bedroom carpet. We also discovered an item of undetermined origin stuck directly into a seam of the mattress. We do not claim to identify these items with certainty, but their presence, added to the general state of the room, seriously worried us regarding the level of hygiene and cleaning.

It is therefore not, in our opinion, a simple aesthetic defect or a few normal signs of wear. It is the accumulation of problems—heavily stained carpet, dirty and damaged walls, dirty and deteriorated bathroom, as well as the discovery of an arthropod in the room—that made this experience particularly unpleasant.

The photos attached to this review show the state in which we found the room and will allow everyone to form their own opinion.

For an establishment of this category, we expected a very different level of cleanliness, maintenance, and comfort.

An unfortunately very disappointing experience that we do not wish to repeat.

author: Aaron H
title: It was a ideal location. Close to metroand other transport
text:
Just returned this week. Had a great stay here. Good location to train station but used the metro to see the historical sites. Pool was adequate for a cool dip for its size. I found staff ok with me and helpful. Rooms adequate for our stay. Order another pillow due to only one each. Room cleaned daily with new towels. Air con was adjustable using the panel. 
Close to local restaurants. Buses are packed and over crowded use metro 10 min walk. Breakfast was OK. Can order a special coffee at breakfast.
Had lunch here and felt it was good value. Additional cost for the Spa at e25  for two hours not used.Hotel tax extra cost. A great terrace with sunbeds to relax. Nothing really to moan about as it did what we wanted

author: Sydney S
title: Not a bad choice at all
text:
I thought the Building Hotel was good overall. Staff were polite and accommodating. We had issues with the air con, so we had a mobile unit for 1 night delivered promptly, and moved rooms the next day. Breakfast was okay overall and had a good range of food availible.
Short walk to the Metro and in a nice, quiet location with a local shop and restaurants 1-2 minutes away. 
Overall, I would stay again.

author: Nora N
title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
text: The palace is impressive, certainly, but for a week at 1300 euros, pathetic services! Neglected cleaning, for a 4-star hotel, sink and shower not cleaned, toiletries (shower gel, body lotion and soaps, toilet paper, etc.) not restocked (not to mention the bouquet of flowers as announced in the listing), bedding changed once in a week instead of daily and even then, one sheet out of two without pillowcases, the terrace with garden furniture cushions without covers, the breakfast could not be more basic with an undrinkable Americano coffee served in a thermos (knowing that at the reception, we were told that we could ask for a cappuccino, espresso and others included in the price but no one is aware, you just have to ask the question). And the staff is haughty. On the last day, at 5 a.m., I was asked for 45 euros in taxes even though I had paid 105 euros for them upon my arrival; fortunately I had kept the proof, otherwise I would have missed my flight. And since I was leaving early and had paid for my breakfast, I asked for a breakfast to go; they provided it, but I threw it all away, as it had spent the night outside. Anyway! A total scam! A sucker trap! Fortunately, Rome is full of treasures (the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, the beach, the Basilica of Saint Paul, the Colosseum, etc.).

author: Aaron Y
title: Far better than other reviews would suggest
text:
This was our second stay at this hotel and we have already booked again for next year. Great location close to the train station and within walking distance of a-lot of the major sites. There are good restaurants, cafes and shops in the surrounding streets. 
The breakfast is good with plenty of options and the bar is a beautiful setting with friendly staff. We like the terrace for sitting with a drink in the sun and then would go in the outdoor pool to cool off again, yes it is cold when you first get in but is fine after a minute. 
The reception staff were friendly and allowed us to check in early on our first day there. On arrival we were warned about paying the city tax in cash and so we were prepared for this. 
 The beds are comfortable and clean and the shower was good. The AC worked and was easy to adjust.
 We think its a great hotel and look forward to staying again.

author: Lauren C
title: Disappointing
text: An arrival marked by a cold and very formal welcome. Disappointed to see the pool close at 8 p.m. and towels not provided. The room, initially booked with a double bed, included two twin beds pushed together. A simple sheet lined with a blanket serves as a duvet. The bed is hard and the pillows are flat and uncomfortable. The air conditioning is locked at 25 and does not seem to be working properly (as evidenced by the insomnia due to the stifling heat: unworthy of a 4-star hotel and paid so dearly). Aside from the kindness of the pianist, the bartender, and the server, such a beautiful place deserves an layout and operation much more worthy of its 4 stars. We are leaving the hotel disappointed and bitter about having spent so much for so little comfort.

author: Sofia D
title: Rudest staff ever at this hotel
text: Awful stay here, worst hotel I have ever stayed in and me and my family travel a lot. That dated rooms and lack of stuff for children would have been ok if the staff had been nice!! Every single person we spoke to had an attitude problem. The first room we were put in the air con was broken and none of us got a sleep on the first night. The man at reception told us to open window and we ended up all being bitten by mosquitos. The hotel manager came to speak with us and had a terrible attitude walking away swearing at us in Italians would never recommend this hotel to anyone.

author: Nathan F
title: Plenty of attitude.
text: This hotel has the potential to be an absolute hidden gem. Situated in amongst a number of embassies it’s in a nice quiet area not too far from the centre.  Arrived and allocated our two rooms which we’d upgraded to superior terrace. A little on the small side but no issue with that, clean and with really nice bathrooms. It was 40 degrees however and the aircon was broken in one of the rooms. No problem said I and we went to ask the fellow wearing a suit three sizes too big for him in reception to move us. You would think I’d insulted his mother. A hissy fit of epic proportions ensued where he said we’d have to wait to see if there was a room available as they were busy. Notwithstanding there was at least 10 available on a well known booking site. Absolutely dreadful customer service from a young man who should be nowhere near hospitality. Few quid spent on the place and a bit of staff training and it could be a gem but the staff don’t seem to give much of a hoot. Anyways great weekend had in spite of this and providing you can tolerate rudeness not a bad spot. Dreadful for coeliacs I might add. The only thing they could offer us was a chicken salad of sorts that they’d clearly confiscated from the hotel rabbit.

author: Olivia R
title: Bad Experience
text: Just returned from 4 nights at The Building. We had a triple superior room with balcony, room was nice but a bit tired looking, nice balcony but no lights working on it so couldn’t sit out at night . Breakfast was just ok had a lot better in lower star hotels. Found staff rude and unfriendly. We had our grandchildren with us and apart from the pool which was extremely cold so only used once , there was nothing else catered for children! Would not recommend especially for the money they charge . Lots of other nice hotels in Rome .

author: Chloe K
title: Avoid
text: Only reason it got one star is I can’t give none. Rooms dated air con poor but listening to other guests who had 28 degree rooms I think we were lucky. Staff at reception and management are probably amongst the worst I have ever came across rude doesn’t even begin to describe them, arrogant and abusive probably does, watching how they dealt with customers ( some with young children in rooms that weren’t fit for purpose) was shocking. To summarise this isn’t a four star hotel (maybe 2 at a push) and if you have any issues don’t expect any assistance from the staff. My advice book somewhere else.

author: Katie T
title: Bad experience at The Building Hotel
text: When me and my boyfriend arrived we were made to wait an hour before check in even tho they were no other guests there. This was at lunch time and there was three members of staff at the desk. They didn’t tell us the city tax at check in and when we went to check out she told us and said you have to pay in cash we replied sorry we only have card and she was extremely rude about it. I think the service at the hotel was unacceptable. The receptionist told my boyfriend the city tax rule was labelled on the lift. As if we are going to read signs on the lift 🙄😡😂😂

author: Juan Y
title: Good hotel
text: This hotel is already well located. Walking from Termini station, it is about 10 to 15 minutes. The hotel is clean, and the reception is professional. We took a room with a terrace on the first floor... the terrace is spacious and quiet. The room is stylish and clean. The hotel has a pool and a bar.  I recommend it.

author: Ella F
title: Great stay!
text: I really liked this hotel and the experience. I stayed with my mother in a spacious room with separate beds. Highlight for the bathroom very clean and wonderful, the comfortable beds, everything well arranged and organized. The breakfast was amazing, super varied and with fresh ingredients for all tastes. The staff was helpful and left us waiting on the couches while not giving the check-in time which is 15:00. Good location, close to metro stations. It has a great bathtub for use in the room. The hotel has the option of paying a fee to use the pool area, which is very beautiful. Cordial attention from the reception.

author: Chloe T
title: I would stay again
text: My husband booked this trip via Tui for a birthday trip, I must admit I read the reviews and it put me off as a lot of negative reviews,  my positives about the hotel are it was a 5 minute walk to the metro which was easy to use and could get you into Rome fairly quickly, the staff were friendly and although there was no kettle in the room it wasn’t to much of a problem but you had to keep asking for hot water at the bar,but the lovely bar staff didn’t  mind, the bed is firm but that wasn’t an issue and I did sleep well but was quite noisy at night, we ate in the hotel twice and are simple eaters and the  house burger was lovely, our room was cleaned daily with fresh towels, and main areas in hotel were nice, there is a lift to all floors as noticed someone said in a review there were only stairs, negatives were no kettle in room, shower had a bit of mould around the bottom and shower head could do with a clean nothing a bit of bleach wouldn’t sort, hotel per night I thought was expensive plus another £7.50 tourists tax per night at this price there should be no tax, i was told I could pay by card if needed for this, and think for what we paid it should have included spa as £25 per person is a lot, although there were negatives i would stay here again, as at the end of the day I just needed somewhere to sleep and shower with breakfast as wanted to see as much as Rome as I could , they let us leave our bags there all day for free as we had a night flight so could enjoy Rome for one last day

author: Laura B
title: Nice on the outside, very bad in practice.
text:
Attempts to be overly modern at its own expense. The rooms are painted grey and it feels dark and draining. 
The beds are hard as rocks. The pillows flat. The air-conditioning only has one setting: too cold.
Its far from the roma termini when your walking with bags and on the north side so its far from attractions.

author: Grace P
title: Poor for conferences, good for location and restaurant.
text:
Access is difficult for people with reduced mobility. Venue of a recent conference, with constant technical problems regarding microphones, presentations, and lighting. 
Restaurant with dishes that are neither remarkable nor terrible, with affordable prices and friendly, polite staff. The location is excellent.

author: Holly F
title: Spa injury caused by excessive technique — management response disappointing
text:
I stayed at The Building Roma from 23 to 26 May 2026. The hotel location is convenient and the rooms are comfortable.

However, I must report a serious incident at the Acqua Thermae di Roma spa on 24 May.
During the massage I did feel that the tapotement technique was excessive. I did not stop the session because feeling strong pressure during a massage does not automatically mean it will cause injury — that is a reasonable assumption for any client. What no client should ever experience is leaving a spa with a significant haematoma on their leg, which is exactly what happened to me, fully documented in photographs.

An experienced massotherapist has a professional obligation to know how much force can be applied without causing tissue damage. Adjusting technique to avoid injury is a fundamental requirement of the profession — not optional.

When I reported the incident, the hotel's response was to question why I hadn't complained during the session, and to suggest that because I appeared satisfied at checkout, the injury was somehow my responsibility. A haematoma develops in the hours after a session — not during it. This is basic anatomy.

I submitted two formal emails, spoke in person at reception, and sent a WhatsApp to the spa. The response I received did not include an apology, a refund, or any acknowledgement of professional responsibility.

This incident fell well below those standards — and the handling of the complaint fell even further.

Pedro Vasco — May 2026

author: Evan S
title: Would not go back
text:
Over all the hotel was okay. There was few problems that would mean I would not go again. We arrived about 10 mins before check in and the room was not ready as we expected however the room wasn't ready till about half an hour after check in time which isn't ideal after you have been traveling all day.

The bathroom had green mold in it, the shower heads where not very clean too and the hair dryer was not good either it blows very hot hair with little power. The beds are hard and the pillows are not particularly soft.There is also alot of noise from outside sirens cars ect and in the room there is a mini fridge that makes noise all day these can disturb your sleep if your sensitve to noise.

The breakfast foods are okay nothing really stood out.

The main reason I booked this hotel was the out door and indoor pools. The outdoor pool is ice cold so unusable for most people and the indoor pool which is part of the spa is £25pp plus you need to pay for a swim cap as the dont allow hair in the pool i felt this wasn't a very reasonable price for paying customers as the amenities do not reflect this as the pool itself looked as thought it needed cleaned as when I booked it was based of a picture of the spa I did feel it was miss leading to charge for it as it is not obviously where I booked from or on the website.

The food in the restaurant was okay nothing really stood out however the tiramisu was not good you get essentially cream with cocoa powder and a small bit of chocolate cake there is no coffee flavors in it at all.

Staff wise I dont have much to say as we did not really have much interaction with them other than checking in and out though those we did interact with were friendly. We did get new towels daily and out bed made. 
The building its self has very nice looking architecturally, there are plenty of restaurants, shops and pharmacies near by as well as the metro and train station being a short walk away. There is a piano player on each night which is a lovely addition to the hotel. I think i would recommend this for a very short trip as it seams to suit that more than anything above a week.

Also it is worth noting that the tourist tax is €7.50 per night per person which you have to pay in cash idk if other hotels make you pay cash too.

author: Adam F
title: Improveable but we will be back
text:
Hotel with good value for money, comfortable rooms despite a problem with the shower (head that has come off and shower not working).
Courteous service both at the reception and at the bar (including welcome cocktails), and in the breakfast room, pleasant and friendly the pianist.  
Breakfast not particularly rich but with good products and especially a great cappuccino.
We'll probably be back

author: Isla K
title: Front Desk Angels When I Got Sick
text:
I had admired the lovely front desk staff, as well as the staff that set up breakfast every morning.  They were friendly, knowledgeable and helpful.  In my 37 year career where I travelled most weeks, I had never encountered such wonderful & joyful folks.
I really tested my impressions when I got sick and had to go to the ER.  The front desk staff. along with the manager, became like family members.  They called 911 and had me sit in the lobby to wait so they could keep their eyes on me.  They brought me water, food, and continuously checked on me.  Eventually the ambulance arrived and I was swept off to the ER, where I was taken care of.  The staff even checked on me the next morning to see if I needed anything.  They were truly remarkable.
I want to highlight Adnan, Brian, Isha, Janeel, Johnnie, Tatayanna and Yan.  They will always have a special place in my heart.
God Bless You All,
Carolyn

author: Hannah D
title: A hotel with mediocre service quality
text: Disappointing experience. Room poorly insulated and letting in the cold through the window, an unworthy breakfast served in a room worse than a cafeteria with food that was not fresh and industrial. One does not expect luxury hotel service, but to this extent, it is unworthy of a chain hotel. Only positive point, an excellent location for discovering NYC on foot and by subway.

author: Abigail A
title: Great hot!
text: Great location, great staff, yummy breakfast, clean and safe…overall great experience! Can’t wait to come back!

author: Ryan Z
title: NCC with the Fam-A-Ly
text: My family and I had an amazing experience staying here. What left the best impression were the staff. Normally I wouldn't do a review but this particular staff deserve some serious recognition. Anytime I needed asked for help for anything, they went out of their way. Yan and Dianna were there to reopen the breakfast area after breakfast hours just so my two daughters could grab a breakfast snack for the road. Janelle and Francisco were my favorites. I had a ton of questions on places to go, and things to take the family to see. They also all took care providing us bottled waters, providing little treats for the kids, and booking us transportation to the airport and everything in between. And special thanks to Johnnie, Isha, the girl with the red hair and Sariq? for helping fix my son's travel bag because he kept riding on it around the airport and broke a wheel. I know I'm missing a couple others but much love to them too. Anywho...5 star ratings on customer service!

author: Anna K
title: 3 stars fully deserved, absolutely recommended
text: Great hotel! Very nice and helpful staff. Every morning, upon request, we were given a printout of how best to get from A to B by subway. The breakfast was very good and offered almost everything you could wish for: fruit, juices, cornflakes, muesli, bagels, bread, coffee, tea, warm milk, a hot food counter, etc. The rooms were very clean and sufficiently large. We stayed at this hotel for 1 week and would book there again at any time. The location is perfect for walking to the sights or reaching them by subway. On the last day, we had to drop off our luggage at the lobby. Here you get a number and all pieces of luggage are marked. We have never experienced that anywhere else. It ensures that no one else can take your luggage, as it is only handed out by the staff upon presentation of the number. Professional solution! An airport shuttle was also organized for us without any problems.

author: Noah U
text: Yinia from breakfast is so lovely and excellent service

author: Aiden H
title: Best bartenders around!!
text: I had a few drinks at the bar, and both Omar and Francis were very outgoing, personable, and super nice. The conversation was amazing. I highly recommend when going to this hotel, make a pit stop at the bar, even if it's for a Shirley temple. I've been here a couple times now and they always make my day better. 😁

author: Ethan P
title: Great staff, good atmosphere and amazing location in the city!
text: Johnnie at front desk and Olya in housekeeping were exceptionally helpful. Thank you so much!

author: Grace N
title: Nightmare stay: theft in the room.
text:
Embarrassing experience, hotel absolutely to avoid.

We stayed at this hotel for 5 nights during our trip to New York, and what was supposed to be a pleasant stay turned into an experience to forget.

Already during our stay, we encountered several problems: small rooms, extremely poor breakfast, very slow elevators, and overall service well below expectations. But the most serious and unacceptable problem occurred on the last evening, before our departure.

Upon returning to our room, we noticed that some low-value items were missing: a bag and a cup purchased the day before, but initially, we thought it might have been a mistake by the cleaning staff, perhaps mistaking the items for trash. 
However, shortly after, upon checking more carefully, we discovered something much more serious: $500 in cash had disappeared from my wallet, which was closed and stored in the pocket of my backpack. Additionally, my friend's AirPods were stolen.

We checked the location of the AirPods, and they were showing as located in a house outside New York, which confirmed that the items had been taken from our room.

The discovery occurred around one in the morning while we were preparing our suitcases for the next day's check-out; we immediately went down to the reception to ask for assistance and understand how to proceed, and also to contact the police. The response we received was incredible: we were told that they could not call for us, and we, with an Italian number and being in the middle of the night in a foreign city, were forced to leave the hotel and look for an open place to make the call to the authorities.

The report was filed, and investigations were opened, but the most absurd thing is that, weeks after my return, I have not received any updates, no solutions, and no form of reimbursement or concrete assistance from the hotel.

An incident like this should be considered extremely serious by any hotel establishment. Instead, the management of the situation was disappointing, leaving us without support precisely when we needed it most, and I repeat, without any reimbursement. 

Embarrassing is putting it mildly; a hotel should guarantee safety and assistance to its guests, but in this case, we received the exact opposite. After such an experience, I can only advise against this establishment: think carefully before booking.

author: Camille W
title: Awesome!
text: I have been to NYC multiple times, but there will never be a place that tops this place.   Best service, clean rooms,  and the best service ever!!!  Shout out to my new brothers Omar,  Frances,  and Francisco for making my stay above and beyond…I don’t know what they make but it should be more.   Honorable mention to Brian at the front desk.   My next trip to NYC I will stay at this location again!!!!

author: Lauren I
title: QUALITY, LOCATION, HOSPITALITY
text:
Stayed at this establishment for a week between May and June. Perfect location, 7 minutes on foot from the subway station 'Columbus Circle', 15 minutes on foot from Times Square. Breakfast featured mostly savory items but with plenty of choices and all excellent products. Bright, clean, and quiet rooms. The staff was extremely kind, led by the director Yan, who was very available and always smiling.
Highly recommended.

author: Mason Q
title: Hotel Breakfast
text: Yinia in food service for breakfast was amazing. The whole staff crew overall for breakfast were great.

author: Luke S
title: Awesome reception staff
text: Friendly, helpful front desk staff. Special thanks to Kenyatta and Brian for helping me!

author: Owen G
title: LS Graduation
text: From check in with Johnnie to drinks at the bar with Omar we had a great experience at the Fairfield Marriott Inn in Manhattan/Central Park!!  Front desk employees were always friendly and helpful.  Room was clean and neat the housekeeping team did a great job!!! Hotel was in a great location near several restaurants and had a CVS just two blocks away.

author: Liam Z
title: Great staff at Fairfield made a difference
text:
When I had difficulty with my booking through the third party booking site Trivago Deals the hotel staff, particularly Brian, was very helpful. Brian helped me get receipts and confirmation of my stay and was pleasant and polite. Thanks Brian!
The hotel was comfortable, rooms quiet, and breakfast was good. When the AC in our room was not running well we were switched to a new room without a problem.

author: Alexander F
title: Fantastic location and high quality services
text: Our stay was a delight from start to finish. The staff at the front desk with helpful, courteous, and friendly. I happened to interact with Johnie and he was the best! Our room was clean with a shower was both modern and immaculate. The morning breakfast is modeled on the European hotel experience and lived up to it! The food was delicious, hot, and plentiful. I highly recommend Fairfield Inn by Marriott at 538 West 58 Street near Central Park.

author: Morgan E
title: Graduation in the city!
text: Omar the bartender was the greatest! Make sure you visit him at Bar 58 when you stay st the Fairfield!

author: Gavin O
title: No Microwave
text:
This hotel was a bit disappointing.  The Pros are it was clean and service was good. The Cons are the room was smaller than the pictures displayed and it did not offer any furniture to place your cloths.  The biggest disappointment was NO Microwave in the room. You had to go to the middle of the lobby by the bar to heat up a cup of tea which made it a HUGE inconvenience.!  only 41 cable tv channels, 10 were sports. 
No movie channels. You would think these minor amenities would be offered with this hotel brand.  Unfortunately, I will not be returning or recommending.!

author: Leo W
title: Bartenders Francis and Omar
text: The two bartenders Francis and Omar were amazing. They anticipated our needs the three nights we were there. We had a group of people there on Saturday night, they were extremely hospitaliable. The front desk Manager Adnan was so helpful and kind. We will definitely stay there again!

author: Benjamin P
title: An awesome experience!
text: We had a wonderful experience and felt treated like family! Both Omar and Francis were very professional, knowledgeable with their management of the bar and the drinks they prepared were amazing! Will definitely return!

author: Mia H
title: I recommend it
text: Very good hotel near the bridge, friendly, everything clean and a big bed, we recommend it

author: Amelia R
title: Recommended
text:
Great location. Helpful, friendly staff. 
Great view if you stay at the Tower view room - definitely choose this room if you stay here. I spent 5 days waking up with the tower on my left, amazing view!
One thing to note - I would like the room to be cleaned more thoroughly. At the end of each day when I enter the room, I notice a lot of fine dust on the TV, table and the shelving unit.

author: Manon O
title: Fantastic, I will return
text: Excellent, kind, and super helpful staff

author: George X
title: Top experience
text:
Hotel located in an excellent position (near the Tower Hill underground station), this alone would be enough to make it excellent, let's add that the king superior rooms by London standards are truly very spacious and offer a spectacular view without even having to pay an extra charge. 
Very easygoing staff, there are also some Italians present who can help in case you don't know the language well. 
The surrounding area is also very quiet and patrolled, you are close to the Shard and Tower Bridge which are 2 fundamental points to visit in London.
For our 6-day and 5-night vacation it was perfect and above all not too expensive, I highly recommend it.

author: Katie S
title: Waste your ENTIRE TRIP waiting for elevators!
text:
The elevator situation at citizenM Tower of London is beyond unacceptable. There are four elevators, yet two are permanently blocked off for “priority service.” When I asked what that meant, I was told they were reserved for staff and housekeeping.
So guests are left fighting over just two elevators in a hotel of this size, while housekeeping still uses the guest elevators anyway. What exactly is the point of reserving half the elevators for staff if staff are also filling the only two available to paying guests?
The result is total dysfunction. The elevators stop at practically every floor going up and every floor coming down. They are so overcrowded that guests trying to leave with luggage cannot even get into an elevator travelling downward. I watched a woman on the second floor take the elevator all the way up to the eighth floor just so she could stay inside and ride it back down to the lobby. That is how absurd this situation is.
Guests are trying to reach taxis and Ubers, dragging luggage through packed elevators, while the staff appear completely indifferent. No urgency, no apology, no attempt to manage the situation—just a shrug while paying guests waste their time.
For a hotel of this size to dedicate half its elevator capacity to staff while guests are effectively trapped on their floors is appalling. This is not a small inconvenience or a busy moment. It is a glaring operational failure and a complete disregard for the people actually paying to stay here.

author: Marta K
title: Great hotel and it starts with location.
text:
