author: Harry J
title: Good location to Macy's Department Store
text: Good location near Macy's and lots of restaurants.  Very clean hotel. We had a view of the upper floors of the Empire State Building from our room on the 14th floor.  Good breakfast with hot and cold food selections along with tea, coffee, and juices.  Front desk personnel were pleasant.  The outdoor plaza area is small; the planters need a refresh as the shrubs were dead in all the planters.  The cleaning crew left their cart and supplies outside in the hallway right outside our door each day.  Not sure what is going on with that; that was the only grip I would have to give the hotel.  First time visit to NYC in many years, so the hotel rooms are small.  We plan to visit NYC in the Fall and plan to stay at this same hotel.  One thing to note is it will take at least 45-60 minutes depending on traffic to get to LaGuardia Airport.  It is not a short trip so plan accordingly.  I will not book a flight to arrive during rush hour traffic again on a Friday afternoon.

author: Ryan I
title: The staff is awesome! Raina, Luis and Sincere were all so friendly, accommodating, helpful and kind.
text: The staff is awesome! Raina, Luis and Sincere were all so friendly, accommodating, helpful and kind. The room was clean and comfortable. The free breakfast was delicious and fresh. There’s a small convenience store on site. Two elevators. You need your key card to gain access after hours. It was safe. And many restaurants and bars are near. And subways too. The room has a mini fridge but there’s a microwave in the lobby for you.

author: Luca Q
title: Standard.
text:
In general, a very standard Hilton that out of season cost just over $100 a night.
Breakfast is a waffle and an omelette, as elsewhere in the United States. 
Rooms are a little tired, but for a price like this, I think it's fine. But in season, paying $500+ for it is crazy.  There's actually no window view, no overpayment. It's better to just take a high floor.

author: Adam J
title: Highly recommend
text: Loved everything about this hotel. Great location  close to everything, comfortable rooms andvtge breakfast is excellent.  Highly recommend.

author: Megan X
title: Unbelievable staff and location
text: The staff is amazing!  There are truly no words that I can express how pleased I was at this hotel. It far outweighed my expectations.

author: Anna A
title: Perfect location!
text:
The location is perfect. We did almost everything on foot, the subway is 30 meters from the hotel. The rooms are spacious and with floor, no carpet. Normal bathroom, except the bath curtain is plastic. It has many amenities, several white towels, body cream, shampoo, hair cream and hair dryer. It has fridge and iron to pass as well. Breakfast is good, eggs, danone, fruits etc, nothing too much.  But what drew attention was that they offer coffee, water, hot chocolate and even cookes all day long. Tables are available if you bring something from the street, up to a microwave. This surprised us. 
The internet at all times has to connect. Educated employees. Comfortable beds, 2 pillows for each person. Our price was salted because it was the first week of December. This time is complicated in NY. 
Many options near restaurants, for all tastes. Keep your bags at no cost. I'll be back!

author: Maria C
title: Find somewhere else to stay!
text: We arrived on 3rd December to find our accomodation had been cancelled without notice.  Apparently an email was sent on the 1st December advising credit card declined but has never been received (a confirmation of booking email had been received on the 26th November).  No phone contact was made as apparently they can’t dial overseas numbers and can’t look up numbers on the Hilton Honours app.  The possibility of the credit card number changing was advised at the time of booking and we were told that wouldn’t matter as it would be rectified at check in.  They were unable to guarantee us a room for 7 nights (which is what we had booked for) but managed to find us a room for that night.  They eventually agreed to charge us at the price we had originally booked for but offered no apology and no assistance to find alternative accommodation.   Room was small and cold.  No carpet on floors.  Bathroom was tiny with shower over a very small bath.  Would not recommend this hotel to anyone!

author: Oscar H
title: Super hotel. Great staff
text: We stayed for 4 nights 20 - 24 nov. Everything about this hotel was perfect. The rooms were spotless. The breakfast was excellent with plenty of choices - healthy or not so healthy ( but tasty ! ) 24/7 coffee, tea or hot chocolate available with patio seating outside. We were always warmly greeted by staff whether on front desk , security or breakfast room. This place was busy and the staff work hard but are always cheerful. Listen up Hilton Group. You have some excellent employees here. Can't wait to return. I don't think I'd want to stay anywhere else. Super value too. As someone who works in a public facing role I know how hard it is to be cheerful and positive under pressure but you guys made it look easy. Well done everyone !

author: Mia I
title: 5 stars
text:
I stayed at this hotel for five nights, on the 19th floor, and wanted to share my honest impressions. Although I am a travel agent, I did not disclose this during my stay — so this review reflects a genuine guest experience.
From the moment I arrived, I was impressed. My room offered stunning views of the Empire State Building, which made for a beautiful backdrop both day and night. The room itself was spacious, the beds were extremely comfortable and generously sized, and the bathroom was clean and functional with a great shower and a reliable hairdryer. The air conditioning worked perfectly throughout my stay, which was a big plus.
Breakfast each morning was more than adequate, with a good variety of hot items available most days. It was hearty, filling, and a great start to the day. A particularly lovely touch was the freshly baked cookies available daily at reception — a small detail that made the hotel feel even more welcoming.
What really stood out to me, however, was the hospitality and thoughtfulness shown through the hotel’s amenities. Guests could help themselves to tea, coffee, fresh fruit, and water throughout the day, and there was even a microwave available for use. These conveniences made the stay feel easy and comfortable.
All the staff members I encountered were exceptionally friendly and accommodating. The facilities, combined with the hotel’s fantastic location, make it a solid 10 out of 10 in my book.
Overall, I would have absolutely no hesitation in recommending this hotel — both to my clients and for my own future stays.

author: Nora H
title: Great stay!
text: Stayed here one night for my daughters 18th birthday trip.  The front desk staff were amazing! They were so nice and friendly and even sent up a treat bag for my daughter.  We were on the 14th floor with a nice view of the Empire State Building. The room was clean and decent size for NYC. AC worked well, bathroom was clean with a good shower and the beds were comfy. Quiet too except for the street noise outside, which is to be expected in the city!  Great location within walking distance of everyplace we wanted to go.

author: Oliver C
title: If I return to NY I will return without hesitation!
text:
We stayed with my family for 12 nights and got a room on the 20th floor with a stunning view of the Empire State. The spacious room (sleeps 4) and the bathroom very comfortable.
We really enjoyed our stay. I found the location excellent/unbeatable, 1/2 block from 5th Avenue to go for a walk - 1/2 block from the subway/subway to go anywhere - around the Empire State - 1/2 block from Macys - 1 block from Target supermarket, etc. 
It’s very practical to offer free breakfast and you’ll go for a walk with something sorted (which not all NY hotels offer).  
Also the rest of the day, the breakfast/dining room remains open and with coffee, tea, hot and cold water and a microwave available. In our case, many times at night when we arrived we defrosted/heated something we bought in the super and dined there (in the room there is ice cream for the super purchases).
The staff was always VERY FRIENDLY, the cleanliness also perfect and very rich the cookies that invited us the high lord of breakfast (I never asked the name, for shame).
To get from the hotel to JFK airport we booked a transport through the hotel and it is the only thing that "maybe" I would not fully recommend because on arrival he charged us more than we had been told at the hotel when hiring him and as I knew we were going in time avoided the highway (saving the tolls but delaying longer). This is not the fault of the hotel, but I take the time to write it to get to your attention (if not the guest leaves and they will believe that the contracted trip was fine).
There is no doubt that if I return to NY I would choose the same hotel!.

author: Charlie Q
title: Hampton Inn 35th St/ great location and hotel
text:
We really enjoyed our stay at the Hampton Inn. The location was great, being within walking distance to many attractions and also close to the subway.

Our room was very clean, housekeeping was great,  and the front desk staff was overly friendly and always helpful. The hotel will hold your bags before and after checkout. 
We really enjoyed the daily breakfast, the front courtyard area, and the cold water, coffee, and hot chocolate that was always available. 

The elevators could be a bit slow at times, so we chose a lower level room and just used the stairs as needed. We were worried that with a lower floor we would hear a lot of street noise, but that turned out not to be the case at all- our room was very quiet. 

Overall a wonderful stay and would definitely stay there again when we visit NYC. For the price and location, we really feel this hotel was the perfect choice for our family trip!

author: Taylor Q
title: Good hotel, great location
text:
Great location because 1 minute from Herald station.
Check in very well (we arrived at 2am and I warned).
The family room is fine. It lacks hooks to hang the towels in the bathroom.
Well soundproofed street side.
Small terrace in front to snack in the evening.
Effective and useful air conditioning in summer. 
Good bedding.
Easy access thanks to 2 elevators.
Simple but efficient breakfast. 
The mr who looks after it is adorable (thanks to him!)
Fresh water , coffee and sometimes lemonade available during the day.
Rate correct, taken 6 months in advance (January for mid-July). $1,450 has 4 for 4 nights. For the situation and services, there was no better!
We recommend.

author: Lucy Q
title: A very good location in NY
text: I traveled the summer of 2025 with my wife and two teenage children to NY. I chose this hotel for its good ratings and because it is very close to Penn train station as part of the trip would be made in another city we arrived by train. The hotel is in a safe area, surrounded by many restaurants, cafes and shops such as Target and Macy's. You can also walk quickly to Times Square, but it’s far enough away so you won’t be overwhelmed by the crowds, noise and trash there. It has a subway station on the corner through which we could access virtually everywhere. It's not a complaint, because that's the way it is in Manhattan, but we found the room a little small. It is in good condition, but already all the furniture, pain and carpets, look a little worn. The staff is very friendly and although I read complaints about breakfast, the truth is that if you have stayed before in business class hotels like the Hampton, that is basically what you will find. The truth is that breakfast complies to give you a good push in the morning and you save a lot of money. For me the most important thing is the coffee and the one in this hotel is delicious. I recommend it and would stay here again.

author: Lucas D
title: Better than the chain hotels!
text: My first stay here and what a delight. Everyone super friendly. I used the gym which was quiet and well kitted. The details everywhere felt quite special. I hope to be back.

author: Jack G
title: Wonderful Stay and Exceptional Service
text:
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at your hotel. My husband stays with you frequently for business, and I can certainly see why. From start to finish, the experience was exceptional.
The food was fantastic, the accommodations were wonderful, and the laundry service with its quick turnaround was a huge plus. Every detail seemed thoughtfully managed, making my stay both comfortable and stress-free.
I would also like to recognize Jossy for providing one of the best massages I have ever had. It easily ranks among my top five massages of all time and was exactly what I needed.
Thank you for such an outstanding experience. I can’t wait to return.

author: Evie A
title: Excellent massage by Mukesh
text: Excellent by Mukesh. Would recommended for sure.

author: Aiden H
title: Wonderful Stay in Central London – Great Hospitality & Service
text:
I really loved my stay at The LaLiT London. The food was good, and the staff was very helpful and welcoming. The hotel’s central location was a major advantage, with the metro station conveniently close by, making it easy to get around London.

The room was a little on the smaller side, but overall, it was a very pleasant and comfortable experience. On top of that, Muskan was always there to help with any questions or requests, which made the stay even better.

Keep up the great work, Muskan! Overall, I had a wonderful stay and would definitely consider staying here again.

author: Claire T
title: Great Room & Service
text: Great room & service… Ishwar was fantastic!

author: Benjamin R
title: Nice hotel , great location, Aimed at Indian market. Not 5 star though!
text: This is a very nice hotel  but its not perfect and certainly not a  5 star. The staff were excellent and polite. The building and its location are superb. Whilst rooms are nice & large they lack character & luxury. Quite basic in fact. Bed very good tho. The Breakfast buffet part is not great. Cheap packaged cheese and hams etc. The cooked part is very good. Breakfast should not be closing up at 10am though , far too early and unnecessary.  Theres a lack of lounge areas. Finally, be aware this is an Indian owned and Indian themed/decorated hotel. Its well done & i liked most of it ( imo the great hall is decorated all wrong) , It is definitely aimed at the Indian tourist and business travel. Plus the only real food you can get outside breakfast is Indian & unfortunately I can't eat Indian food !!

author: Tyler K
title: Massage
text: Had an amazing massage with Mukesh. Highly recommended. Will be back. Live locally and a gem to have locally.

author: Katie D
title: Birthday week getaway
text:
Best experience ever! Staff are absolutely fantastic and so so lovely!! 
They even surprised me with a birthday cake on my birthday!! Made our trip so much more memorable!!

author: Daisy L
title: Great Massage shame about the rest!!
text: The massage with Jossy was TOP RATE!  One of the best massages and her customer care was special.  That’s the massage now moving down to the restaurant for our lunch was not so great. We asked for a couple of specific cocktails which considering it was a Monsanto and not at all busy took them absolutely ages to come back to us to say not possible to make!! Wasting so much time we just ordered the next best thing but asked them to bring our food as we were famished and I was getting a headache.  That relaxing feeling I got from my massage soon depleted! Very disappointing waiting time considering it was our 30th Wedding anniversary. Didn’t even get a special something from them to mark the occasion. Oh well! However Jossy the masseur was best thing about the entire package Food was good especially veggies options much preferred them to the non veg.

author: Ella M
title: Beautiful hotel and excellent receptionist.
text: The receptionist, Muskan, was very helpful and provided us with a lot of information about the hotel and the neighborhood.

author: Molly H
title: Excellent experience in a hotel that feels like history.
text: Nice accommodation, a few meters from London Bridge Station. Clean and well-kept.

author: Grace P
title: Excellent in all aspects
text: Spacious, top (!) Rooms, excellent, extremely accommodating staff, atmosphere of complete peace and relaxation, far above-average (Indian) restaurant in a spectacular setting, wonderful bar.

author: Holly C
title: Top spot in a top spot !
text: Lovely stay in an immaculate hotel, amazing value ( we didn’t have breakfast). Would definitely stay again , the shower and amenities were excellent.

author: Abigail R
title: Excellent
text: We good ambience and a very supportive staff i have surely enjoyed my 5 days stay over here

author: Sean L
title: A truly wonderful stay
text: A wonderful stay with truly excellent service before and during our stay from Muskan. We will definitely return!

author: Zachary G
title: An Exceptional Stay in the Heart of London
text:
Would highly recommend The Lalit to anyone staying in London. The location is fantastic — so central to everything, with fabulous restaurants, pubs and sightseeing all within easy reach.

Our room was beautifully comfortable and, importantly, incredibly quiet. The blackout curtains were fantastic and made the room completely dark at night, despite being right in the heart of the city.

On top of the fabulous location and beautifully appointed rooms, the service was exceptional. Every member of staff was friendly, attentive and genuinely welcoming, and the food was absolutely sensational.

We really couldn’t recommend The Lalit highly enough. A wonderful hotel that made our stay in London even more enjoyable, and somewhere we would happily stay again.

author: Julien D
title: Head massage
text: Mukesh did my head massage and I feel so relaxed after my 30min massage feel so chilled.

author: Noah A
title: Relaxing head massage
text:
Nice relaxing head massage.
Very chilled out afterwards.

author: Isla Z
title: Spa day
text: Mukesh  Provided excellent massage felt relaxed. The hospitality in great value. Mukesh take care us very well coming back again

author: Gavin O
title: Massage at the Lalit
text: Having a wonderful experience with a wonderful staff. Definitely, book a massage or session with Mukesh. Wonderful!!!

author: Dylan W
title: Slightly disappointed. Not as Good as it says it is!
text:
Check in was quick and smooth. The staff were all very friendly during my stay. Only issue I had was housekeeping opening the door to my room at 9am whilst I was laying in bed. I was shocked given that check out is at 11am. I'm just glad I was clothed. 

The room was very small with no space to do much or store the luggage. The bathroom is uncomfortably small too. Being on my own, it was just about manageable.

When entering the room, I noticed something on my bed and it waa a card with two small dolls. For personal reasons, I didnt like that at all. The rooms are all named after a child in Guatemala which is cute given the history, but I didn't like that they had a picture of the child in the room.

Upon arrival, I went up to the rooftop bar to have a cocktail which was really good. It's a shame it closes at 9pm.

Overall the stay was comfortable, just slightly underwhelming!

author: Elena M
title: Romantic weekend away
text: What a little gem of a hotel. We booked in for the weekend and what a surprise - not only is it a fantastic location with incredible views but it has a great outside terrace with sweeping views of the waterway and O2. We had a waterside room which was very quiet and private. Special mention goes to the lovely staff in the terrace bar and the super helpful night manage Raluca who really went above and beyond to make our stay so comfortable. Will definitely be back for another stay.

author: Amelia Z
title: Wouldn’t stay again
text:
Stayed one night as part of a ABBA Voyage break. The cheapest rooms are very small and the bathroom pokey with a glass frosted door which was not soundproof - not ideal when travelling with a friend.
Breakfast was very disorganised running out of food, plates and cutlery which caused a long queue.
Only 1 very slow small lift.
The best part of the hotel was the roof terrace but as it shut at 9pm we didn’t have time to use it which was a real shame.
Wouldn’t choose to stay here again.

author: Evan W
title: A great find in London.
text: Great location, and very comfortable stay. Rooms are compact but well designed with a good bed and shower. Everything you need. Staff are friendly and helpful. Good breakfast selection.

author: Matthew F
title: 2 days in Excel
text:
Excellent location if you attend event in Excel. It is very close and there are a lot of benefits nearby. For example a few kinds of fast food, supermarket, restaurants and of course cable car. 
Rooms are very small. It is really not comfortable to move inside. I was constantly hitting myself. 
The view can be amazing and it is very well located. Rooms are clean and nice. However they need some attention already. But if it is a business trip for 2 days, it is a value for money.
Breakfast is always the same, tasty but the same. Be ready. And it is cheaper to have breakfast outside. Atmosphere is really quiet. Personnel is amazing and really friendly.

author: Emma G
title: Super staff & great location
text: I stayed here for a conference at Excel. Staff were super friendly! Big shout out to Jessica & Zarah. Room was clean, comfortable and ac was a huge bonus in the heatwave. Location was great for the Excel centre and local restaurants/bars. I’d happily stay here again.

author: Harry L
title: Great location, slightly tired rooms
text:
I went to London to see Lily Allen at a work networking event. I wanted to stay quite close to the O2, and this hotel was quite expensive but seemed quite close. 
The communal spaces were nice- bar and restaurant seemed attractive but I didn't try them. There is also a roof bar. 
My room was on the water side, so the view was nice. The furniture seemed nice but I was a little disappointed by the decor as the wallpaper is splitting and peeling from the wall at the seams. The room was clean, and the tea and coffee were of a high standard, not just the cheap stuff. There was only body/hair wash, although for that price, I usually expect shampoo and conditioner.
The room was quite small- if I were sharing the bed, one of us would have had to climb over to the other side of the bed. There were handy charging points in the windowsill for that side of the bed, but no light switch on the close side which is an oversight. 
The air conditioner worked, but it was actually too cold, so I turned it off. The fan blew quite hard, which I find dries my eyes out, and in a small room it's quite noisy- although they do plug it in. There was no TV in the room but the signal and wifi was good enough for me to be able use my phone for watching TV. 
All in all the stay was pleasant, but it was very expensive for the quality.

author: Alice S
title: Great!
text: Lovely hotel in a great location. Staff were really friendly and room was really clean. Bed was comfortable and air con was a huge plus!

author: Isabella T
title: Good comfortable stay
text:
Good comfortable stay. Reasonably priced for London. Easy access. 
Unfortunate that the bins been emptied outside our window at 6.45 am woke us up. Overall it is as it's name indicates, a good hotel !

author: Michael S
title: Great, relaxed, everything we could ask for
text: Perfect location, friendly, helpful atmosphere, excellent room, great value, immaculate room, quiet and spot on service * * * * *

author: Camille V
title: Very expensive and spartan
text:
The hotel is an old prison, with very small rooms. The bed was across the window, covering the entire width of the room. There was no TV in the room, and it was very minimalist and then it started to get a little tired. Especially in the bathroom. My need for shampoo has been greatly reduced over time, but for ladies who are going to rinse shampoo off their hair, they probably have to calculate standing in the shower for a while. The breakfast was spartan and expensive, and the same goes for the room. We paid almost 4000NOK for the room per night. If I did not feel deceived then the price should be about 1000NOK per night. 
Positive things: Good bed, good view, close to Excel conference arena
Negative things: Poor room, very little bathroom, no TV, very expensive

author: Marta O
title: Fantastic experience
text:
Just home from a 2 night stay with my husband. Fantastic hotel, no noise even though they provide ear plugs and many reviews mention noise issues, we didn’t experience any! We stayed in small double the first night and slept so well then the second night we asked for an upgrade to a room with a tv which was accommodated for us with a small upgrade fee. We stayed in a much bigger room with a tv in it but there was no window (I didn’t mind at all as I just really wanted to watch tv that evening)  

Staff were so welcoming 

Rooms were spotless 

5 min walk to Custom House train station to bring you into main part of London, excellent location. Some restaurants beside hotel and a Tesco directly across from it. 

Cable car right beside it too, that can bring you to the 02 arena were there are so many restaurants like Nando’s, TGI Fridays etc shopping, cinema

Fantastic *****

author: Elena V
title: Modern and stunning location
text:
The hotel staff and concept of the hotel was most redeeming and excellent. Everyone working for the hotel were exceptional and my opening experience was with Kieran and Raluca and closing with Randa. There were many others too. The social impact values were embedded throughout the hotel. 

Stunning location and area. 

The rooms felt very basic and very small compared to the lobby area. It felt in the room quite claustrophobic.

author: Connor S
title: The Good Hotel / Hostel
text:
The good Hotel is an ex prison barge. The rooms are small and have no soundproofing. Company booked the room. 
Bed is comfortable, they provide ear plugs, but expect to be joining in with whatever your neighbours are doing.  No TV, or fridge. Planes at city airport start at 6:30am. More of a hostel experience.

author: Erin Q
title: Beautiful stay and people
text: Very comfortable stay, rooms are comfortable clean and beautiful amenities, also would like to say the staff especially Zahara, Ibrahim, Nanki and Oscar have made my stay really welcome and joyful

author: Poppy L
title: Lovely hotel
text: Was amazing, they upgraded our room free of charge! My mum loved her birthday, this was the first time she’s been to London and loved it so had been very memorable. Thank you for all the kindness on arrival and for the easy check out, it was very convenient and just a nice thing to do, as we were in a rush and had a lot of bags! Thank you again will definitely come back

author: Evie D
title: Great for O2 arena, amazing staff
text:
A gorgeous hotel with even better staff. From the minute we walking through the door, we knew we had picked well. The girls on reception (Zara and Nanki) were so kind, friendly and helpful. We needed to get to Emirates stadium that evening and they helped with a route. When we returned to our room, they had provided a printed map with direction alongside some complementary prosecco and flutes. They really did make our trip so special - they are an asset to the hotel.

Location - gorgeous and right on the river. 10 minute walk to the tube station and you could actually see the O2 arena from our room. 

Breakfast - delicious. Great selection of granolas, yogurts, fresh fruits and cooked breakfast. Again, great views over the river from the restaurant.

All in all, would not hesitate to stay there again, especially if seeing a show at the O2.

author: Lucy C
title: Brilliant
text: Great Hotel in fab location on the water front.Reception staff Zaea and Nanki were excellent, printed directions for us on the tube and really friendly. Would recommend

author: Rosie Z
title: Good experience!
text: Elena and Nanki were so kind and professional and the staff was so friendly. Thank you very much for a fun a lively staying.

author: Harper H
title: A caring and welcoming hub
text: This hotel is truly good: as a social business, its ethos resonates and is heartwarming. Staff are all warm and caring, so the whole experience is a welcoming one. I will gladly stay here again.

author: Sophia R
title: An amazing experience !!
text:
We stayed at the Crowne Plaza and had a wonderful experience, especially thanks to Gurmey. He was incredibly kind, professional, welcoming, and attentive throughout our stay. He always had a smile, was very helpful, and genuinely made sure that everything was going well for us.

Gurmey truly goes above and beyond to make guests feel comfortable and welcome. His kindness, positive attitude, and professionalism really made a difference and made our stay even more enjoyable.

A huge thank you to Gurmey for his outstanding service and kindness! We will definitely remember our stay thanks to him, and we hope to see him again on our next visit to New York.

Shayma ;)

author: Ian P
title: Excellent service!
text: Nice size room for NY! Beyond that excellent service, particularly by bellman extraordinaire Andrew!

author: Sydney P
title: Great hotel
text: Great hotel, great location, pleasant staff. The room was comfortable and clean. I especially liked the manager, Gurmey, and the bellman, Andrew. I sat in the lobby talking to both of them for half an hour. Definitely recommend this place if you find yourself in Manhattan.

author: Rosie T
title: Best Hotel stay of 2026!
text: I just want to commend the staff here! First of all from the time you enter the and every time I've cone in or out all weekend someone was asking how I was doing,  how I was enjoying my stay, and if there was anything they could do for me! It has been a pleasure and I will be back and recommending to friends and family. I would especially like to commend Mr. Andrew Gurmey for his superb customer service! He even made sure I had an umbrella for the rain!Thank you all for your hard work. It is TRULY appreciated ❤️❤️❤️

author: Andrea I
title: Perfect
text: The stay for this trip was fantastic—everything went so smoothly. I'll book here when I visit New York again.

author: Paolo S
title: Our recommendation for Manhattan
text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Crowne Plaza HY36 Midtown Manhattan and felt genuinely welcome from the very first moment.

Right outside the entrance, Kenny is there to greet you with a friendly smile and a warm welcome – exactly the kind of first impression you want when arriving at a hotel.

Once inside the lobby, Jennifer is always friendly, attentive, and genuinely committed to helping with any questions or needs. Her professionalism and positive attitude really stood out during our stay.

The location of the hotel is excellent – very central and convenient for exploring Manhattan, with many attractions, restaurants, and other key places within easy reach.

For dinner, we can also highly recommend the burger restaurant inside the hotel. The food was very good, and the value for money was excellent, especially considering the location in Manhattan.

During our stay, we unfortunately experienced an issue with the air conditioning. However, what impressed us was the way the situation was handled. Jennifer and her colleagues took the matter seriously and resolved it in the best possible way. For us, this is where the true quality of a hotel and its team really shows – not whether an issue occurs, but how professionally and thoughtfully it is handled.

We were also very pleased that, upon departure, we were specifically asked to provide constructive feedback, particularly in light of our status and the fact that we travel extensively and stay in many hotels. We really appreciated this, as it shows that the team is genuinely interested not only in receiving positive comments, but also in listening to experienced guests and continuously improving the guest experience. We will certainly be happy to provide that feedback as well.

A special thank you to Kenny, Jennifer, and the entire team for their warm hospitality and excellent service.

We truly enjoyed our stay and will definitely be happy to return on our next visit to New York!

author: Connor X
title: Great experience
text:
I had an excellent experience at the hotel and would especially like to thank Jose, Edris, and Jennifer for their outstanding service. They were consistently professional, welcoming, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout our stay. Their kindness and dedication made us feel truly well looked after and contributed greatly to making our stay so enjoyable.
Excellent service and a wonderful team.

author: Erin L
title: Welcoming staff!
text: I’ve stayed at this hotel twice now and I will continue to stay here. The rooms are clean and spacious, the staff are friendly, and the location can’t be beat. The restaurant Burgerology has a great breakfast, and even after two visits, the Irish manager remembered me from a previous visit, he was friendly and gave me some good recommendations for places around the city. He made me feel so welcome. Can’t wait for my next visit to NYC.

author: Erin H
title: Will be coming back!
text: Had a fantastic stay, with a great room, and easy access to Flatiron, Hudson Yards, and public transit to get over to Brooklyn. Jen, Edris, and Kenny were all wonderful to interact with during my stay. Will absolutely be staying here again!

author: Sean E
title: Warm and Memorable Stay
text:
As an IHG Diamond member, I’ve had the opportunity to stay at many IHG properties across the East Coast, West Coast, Japan, and Korea, and this hotel truly stands out for its exceptionally friendly staff and warm, family like atmosphere.

Although the hotel is not particularly large, it offers a cozy and comfortable environment, which made our five days stay a genuinely enjoyable experience. Every member of the staff was kind and welcoming, and we truly appreciated the hospitality throughout our stay.

I would especially like to thank Jay for going above and beyond to take care of my wife and me. He made us feel genuinely valued as guests and helped make our stay the best experience we could have hoped for.

Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so memorable. We would be very happy to return!

author: Mathis F
title: Amazing stay, looking forward to going back
text: Absolutely Amazing!  Starting at placing the reservation, I called to see about an early check in and Jay was extremely helpful in getting me that information and let us know the hotel can hold our bags should we want to drop and go. Prior to arriving we received an email that our room/floor had been upgraded for being diamond elite members! When we arrived we were met by a team of Crowne members. Jennifer who helped get us checked in seamlessly and caring. Jose and Scott who helped with securing our bags checking in and out. Jay, Jus, Edris, Kenny and every team member we encountered said hello and had welcoming smiles.  Before heading up to our room we were offered a  complimentary glass of champagne which we happily indulged. Now off to our room. The hotel is immaculate. Having several elevators offered makes the trip to the 26th floor quick. Our room was beautiful and very clean, The bathroom was bright and has a walk in shower and plenty of space for moving around. I personally loved the scent of the body soap. (I ordered some right away to the house) The bed  and pillows were very comfortable. The room had a closet with decent amount of space. It also had an iron and board. The view was beautiful even if it was looking at buildings it's a sight at night for sure! The window does open a crack from some fresh air, however the air conditioning was lovely. On our way out on the town our man Jose asked if we needed any suggestions for food and had he a ready to go list of restaurants by category, that was much appreciated!! We cannot recommend this hotel and the staff enough. We have already booked our room there for Christmas, See you soon guys and thank you for the exceptional experience🩷

author: Hannah Q
title: Good clean hotel with a good price
text:
We stayed from 14th  till the 18th of August in this hotel on the 18th floor (1807). Our bedroom had 2 large beds, we slept very well. The bathroom was big with a spacy shower, nice towels. The hotel room was very clean. You can store things in  a fridge. There’s a safe too which we didn’t use. Everybody was friendly and helpful, especially Juls J. and Matt K. helped us a lot. Three elevators worked properly. The clime was easy to handle.
They have an outsourced restaurant were you can have nice meals. The oatmeal with fruits in the morning is so lovely and tasty, a very good start into the morning.
So we can definetely recommend the hotel.

author: Brooke N
title: Customer Service
text: Top Notch Customer Service during my stay.

author: Miguel H
title: An Amazing first time trip to NYC
text: The Crowne Plaza Hy36 Midtown hotel made my first time to New York City very special. I felt very comfortable in this environment and the entire staff is very friendly. I will say the two that stand out to me the most were Rey and Scott. They always welcomed my girlfriend and I back from our late night adventures with warm welcoming smiles and great energy. I can definitely see myself becoming a regular whenever I come back to New York!

author: Miguel M
title: Great NYC stay!
text:
Everything about this hotel was excellent, especially the staff, Jose, Andrew, Edie’s! Exceptionally 
friendly and helpful.

author: Carlos F
title: 7 night stay
text: Loved my stay here - staff was so welcoming and helpful. Special shoutout to Andrew and Juls

author: Molly H
title: Second stay, just as great
text:
We had yet another amazing stay at HY36 in October. We are falling in love with NYC and also the staff at this hotel. We AWAYS feel welcome and safe and it’s such a fantastic base for anything we decide to do.
We’re thinking of another NYC trip this Christmas and are seriously considering our 3rd stay at this hotel. We always make such great connections with the reception am Burgerology staff x

author: Harry F
title: Faultless
text:
Short but sweet stay! 
We only stayed for 2 nights but couldn’t fault the service, amenities or location. 
The staff are very welcoming and helpful. The rooms are spacious and impeccably clean, I loved that I could smell the cleaning fluid used in the bathroom! Lifts are efficient (we had problems with lifts in other hotels!). Onsite restaurant and bar is reasonable with good service. 
Andrew and Jose took care of our luggage and arranged our airport transfer, during a period when much of manhattan was closed for a parade. 
Would recommend to anyone visiting Manhattan

author: Lucia R
title: Great Location Friendly Staff, member of  IHG Family
text: What a fantastic well located hotel for our week in NYC. Close to Maddison Square Garden Penn and Moynihan train stations. Onsite restaurant and bar a bonus great room on 7th floor that met our every need.  All the staff were very friendly helpful especially Ray Jose Edris Matt Kenny. This will be go to NYC hotel in future.

author: Oscar B
title: Awesome Anniversary Getaway
text: The staff during our stay was AMAZING! Eddie, Jose & Andrew made sure we had a seamless stay from start to finish. We were greeted every time we arrived or left. I was a little worried when we got a room by the elevator, but it was so quiet. Even though we were in the city the hotel atmosphere was peaceful. The rooms were spacious and clean. Our room was ready as soon as we arrived and they stored our luggage until our departure time. Even making sure we had transportation to where we were going. My husband & I are already planning our next visit and we will be staying here again! Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ ⭐️

author: Erin G
title: Beautiful Roman Experience
text: A truly beautiful B&B, excellent room cleanliness, fabulous breakfast, friendly and very kind staff, and satisfactory prices; I recommend it 👍🏼

author: Laura J
title: Very good
text: Beautiful Art Nouveau mansion, spacious rooms, very clean, comfortable, and great suggestion! The staff is impeccable, considerate and friendly, the service great!

author: Sofia B
title: Very good location!
text: Excelent! I would choose this location again!

author: Paige Y
title: It will become a fixed stage
text:
Available and courtesy from the booking. Above all always kind and also quick (it is not obvious) to respond to requests. 
Over-recommended!

P.s. too bad you can only put five stars :)

author: Evan Y
title: Recommend! Great staff and stay
text: Had a  great stay. Staff was very communicative and helpful. Gave many recommendations and small amenities. Appreciated local tips and suggestions on transportation and tourist sites

author: Lily P
title: No breakfast
text: The room was clean and the bed was comfortable and the reception was friendly. The location is close to bus and train station as well as easy walk to main sites. There was no breakfast provided or delivered. We did have coffee maker in the room as well as a mini bar for purchase. Overall it was nice stay but lack of any breakfast was disappointing. The pastry shop across the street was very good though.

author: Oliver O
title: Maravilhosa.
text:
Great service and reception. All attentive and helpful and ready to help us at any time with whatever we needed.
Cozy, clean accommodation and delicious breakfast.

author: Chloe E
title: Stay of 10!
text: Our stay was perfect in BB suites. The friendliness of the staff, the cleanliness, the location, the charm of the accommodation in general... has made our trip an unforgettable experience! We really recommend staying here, experience of 10.

author: Nora Q
title: Comfortable stay
text: We had small room which quite frankly is perfect for what needed. Very clean and comfortable.  Conveniently located up the street from the train, with bus and tram located a few steps away from the front door. Morning breakfast to the room was very nice as well. Thought it was a very good value for the area.

author: Elena M
title: Suites Trastevere was great
text: A great apartment in a convenient location in Trastevere. Room was quiet and comfortable. Public transit (bus and tram) was right outside the front door, which made exploring wonderful Rome so easy. We appreciated the air conditioning and the lift.

author: Giulia R
title: The BEST accommodation and value for your visit to ROMA!
text: The customer service from the B&B Suites group was absolutely 110%!  We had a large group of 20 and Marco was always so responsive to make sure all of our group was accommodated in a number of rooms at 2 of their properties in close relation to each other.  Everything that was arranged for us was top notch, from transfers to and from cruise port and airport, to group dinner reservations and a custom group tour of Rome and the Colosseum...  The breakfast and coffee service is amazing.  I have stayed with B&B Suites 2 times and will continue to return on my next visit to Roma.  Location in Trastevere is the best and very easy access to a short tram that takes you to the heart of the City.  Thank you Marco and Helena for everything!

author: Rosie P
title: My experience at "Suites Trastevere" in April 2025
text:
I just have to thank for the excellent reception, cleanliness, sympathy from Giselle and Max (impar) and not to mention, that the location is excellent, with affordable transport in front of Trastevere Suites.
Note 10 , Giselle, for her sympathy ❤️
Recommend ❤️

author: Luke O
title: Very good!
text:
Well located, it is very close to the train station of Trastevere!
Quick access to the buses.
Very cosy room with beautiful paintings!
Nice service!
Breakfast served in the room at the agreed time!
I recommend!

author: Evan W
title: Touch and run
text:
Everything impeccable, from start to finish, super breakfast, comfortable bed and manic cleanliness.
Kindness of Max and Marco as if I already knew them.
Location close enough to everything. Parking easy to find.
Super recommended.
A hug from Arnaldo

author: Freya B
title: Top location, top customer service, top accommodation!
text:
We are a family of four with an 18 yo and a 14 yo from Australia. We just spent 8 nights at the Trastevere Suites. Giselle and the team looked after us so well and the rooms were a great standard with super comfy beds. Trastevere is a bohemian part of town with many places to eat and easy access to the city via tram or overground train which is a 2 minute walk to the corner. If you like jazz the Luopolo pub Nextdoor has some fantastic live music and more than a few great beers to try. 
My top recommendation is the trip to Pompeii. You can go via Salerno or Naples. Make sure you do some research as the high speed train is expensive but there are alternatives. I wish we had more time.

author: Alice R
title: Great stay for our family (2 children 13y and 10y)
text:
We had a brilliant stay, Gisle and her colleagues couldn’t have done more to welcome us and make us feel at home. They were extremely responsive and helpful to any query we had and were very flexible by looking after our luggage before we checked out.  The b n b has a v convenient location - v easy to travel to/from
The airport and around central Rome while just a walk away from the heart of the Travastere district.  Our family stayed in two rooms and it worked very well.  Thank you Gisele for making us such an easy and memorable stay for us.

author: Ruby N
title: What we were looking for in Rome was a place that we could not feel at home!!! We were welcomed by Gisele!! We adore
text: We liked our accommodation. Comfortable bed, clean bedding and we were welcomed with a coffee, croissant and biscuits!!! We had coffee in the community space at will too!! The rooms were cleaned every day with great care!!! Gratitude for care

author: Miguel R
title: Thank you so much
text: Everything great: room, bed and especially pillows, shower and brightness. Very good cleaning. Ideal location also for the presence of convenient public transport. We will return but will ask for a room not located on Viale Trastevere. The staff is truly unique for friendliness and helpfulness

author: Maria R
title: Perfect stay!
text: It was my first time in a b&b I must say that everything was perfect from the room to the breakfast, very kind staff, impeccable cleanliness! The convenient location to reach the places of interest!! We will definitely be back! Rita Sardegna

author: Julien R
title: Stay in Rome in March 2025
text:
The rooms are really nice, nice and well decorated. Quality shower and toilet also. There is everything you need in the room: very comfortable bed, TV, Netflix, enough to drink eat.. 
The staff very responsive and very kind, whether Giselle for breakfast or text message, or the cleaning staff. 
We recommend 200%

author: Connor X
title: Not 4* hotel
text:
We recently stayed in room 113, the room was very noisy, as it was located right by the main road, bar and lift, so we could hear a lot of noise throughout our stay. There was also a slight damp smell in  the bathroom. The room itself could definitely use some TLC, with tiles coming away from the bathroom walls and some holes that needed attention. Overall, we wouldn’t say the room met the standard we would expect from a 4-star hotel.

On the positive note, the location was great and within walking distance of the main attractions. The surrounding area was a little run down, but we felt safe walking around. The staff were also very friendly and helpful throughout our stay, which we really appreciated.

author: Abigail J
title: Happily recommend
text:
Good hotel. Location was ok as was a 30 min walk from the colosseum. 

Hotel was clean and had everything we needed. Staff were all very nice and kind 

I would recommend and the previous comments on the area should not be taken into consideration as this was not an issue for us

author: Alexander P
title: Terrible rooms… not a 4 star
text:
The Rooms we were allocated were absolutely terrible, we had black mold on the cleaning, with a broken AC… and not even enough water pressure to flush the toilet, all with no windows. 
The noise level around our room was high, due to it being located right on a back alleyway, with people leaving bottles of something on the window.

The location is decent… with a reasonable way into Rome

author: Juan B
title: Well situated for ease of visiting key sites and really helpful
text: We stayed 2 nights pre going on a cruise so we could visit the sites in Rome. It wasn't in the nicest areas of Rome but it was actually very close to be able to get around. The staff were really helpful and guided us through what to do and how to get the Metro, which set us up well and gave us confidence to use it. On our second night there was the gay festival party going on directly outside our bedroom window, but they were great a moved us (we left all our stuff in the room) so we could have a peaceful nights sleep. While were were on the cruise my wife realised she had left her brand new shoes in the room. I emailed them and they found them and posted them back to us in the UK ! They arrived safely on return from our holiday. If I am honest the rooms were acceptable and clean, the shower was a bit of a dribble but all things said, they really did do a great job to make our stay good and put the extra in to get the shoes to us and get a good nights sleep. They offered us breakfast for a small charge each and I am pleased we did this as the pastries were lovely and a good range was provided. Value was good and proximity to the sites was also really good.

author: William Q
title: Standard hotel at accessible location
text:
It definitely is not a 4 star hotel but a decent standard hotel. The rooms and bathrooms are small but very neat and clean. The room was cleaned daily and towels replaced daily. Rohit at the reception was very polite helpful and guided us for the modes of transport to undertake sight seeing.
The breakfast is kind off ok and the same everyday similar to what you can find in other Italy hotels. 

The location though near by major transport options like tram, bus and metro  stations but does not seem very safe for late nights. But definitely convenient in terms of moving around the city for sight seeing.

author: George D
title: Do not expect a 4* hotel, more budget.
text: We were rebooked into this hotel by our tour operator and were immediately underwhelmed. There was no direct lift to our room 109. Suitcases had to be taken via stairs and ramps to a lift then taken up 1 floor. The room itself was clean and a good size. On entering the ensuite I immediately found the hair dryer held together with a hair bobble! The shower holder was broken off so you had to literally hold the shower head up as you showered and there was no plug in the sink! The breakfast room offers a basic section but no fresh fruit juices, just a machine that dispenses watered cordials. On a positive the gentleman who checked us in was so helpful and showed us routes on a map he provided for our sightseeing over the days we were there. On the whole the staff were very good.

author: Amelia E
title: A middle of the road old hotel in the middle of the city. A good choice.
text: A very central hotel, ideally suited for the budget traveler. Staff were helpful and friendly. Rooms are small but more than adequate. Rooms at the front are quite noisy, so ask for one at the back of the property. This is an old established hotel, so the lifts are rather slow and creaky. Breakfast was excellent, if a little limited. The hotel is very close to a selection of excellent restaurants within easy walking distance. Thank you, we enjoyed our stay.

author: Lauren T
title: Perfect
text:
Rome

Absolutely perfect for what you need and price.

1062750799

For starters yea the outside area is full of graffiti but so is the whole of Rome so don’t judge it by this.

The hotel is 20 mins walk from the colosseum and has easy access to the metro so perfectly situated and a fraction of the cost.

The hotel is nice, clean, and full of character didn’t have any issues with amenities the staff were very friendly and gave us a map of Rome and told us the places to walk.

The rooms are basic but this reflects the price have very good air conditioning beds are comfortable shower was small but no issues with hot water.

The best thing about this hotel is the actual area. We found 4 restaurants near by and had the best food in Rome, the breakfast at Djon is perfect The city is overpriced basic food but these places are the best.

Absolutely recommended for a good deal and a great stay.

author: Andrea T
title: Timbos Tours and 2.0
text: Stayed Sunday to Thursday at the Hotel Best Roma.Staff friendly and helpful close to Manzoni Metro can’t fault it.

author: Gavin O
title: Not a 4 Star and not safe area
text:
Avoid ! I would strongly advise against staying at this hotel, especially if you are a female traveller. My experience was extremely disappointing and felt very unsafe.

Basic safety measures that you would expect from a reputable hotel were either lacking or poorly enforced.

Secondly, this hotel does not live up to its claimed 4-star rating. The facilities are outdated, the cleanliness was below standard, the rooms/bathrooms very small and the whole hotel smelt of sewage.

The only positive experience was the nice young gentlemen that greeted me on arrival but the older gentleman that replaced him was rude, angry and dismissive.

There are far better and safer options available in Rome, and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone—especially solo female travellers.

author: Evan A
title: Friendly staff,  don’t be put off by the area.I wouldn’t say it’s not a  4 star but it was ok.
text: My friend and I stayed here at the beginning of March 2026, The hotel is located in a bit of a rougher area of the City, lots of Graffiti which is a shame, but is close to the Termini Train station, the trams and the Metro (underground). The staff were really lovely and helpful and advised us how to stay safe, probably as we were female. The room was small, quite dated but functional. The balcony faced onto the road which was quite noisy so take ear plugs if you want a good night’s sleep. The beds were ok, a bit hard, made every day and they provided clean towels and cleaned the room. The bar was not open, but they did put some items in the mini bar that you could buy. I think once this would have been a lovely hotel it’s just a little bit tired. I do think the price was good for the location. 20 mins from the Colosseum walking or 10 mins on the Tram. Do watch out for pickpockets on the Metro and Trams/buses etc. Have had a great few days.

author: Sophia D
title: Not a 4 star hotel
text:
We were made to wait at reception for around 10 minutes. The person on the desk was wearing tracksuit bottoms and sandels when he eventually served us. Not very professional.  There were many faults in the room, Dirty bedding, broken electric sockets, no plug in the basin, stained toilet, limescaled shower, bare wires on the hairdryer, the lift doors didn't work on the ground floor.  The breakfast area was not how you see it in the photos. It was in a outside room, probably due to the time of year. There was large amounts of laundry in bags blocking the fire escapes
There was no bar area set up so we couldn't get drinks in the evening, and the sun terrace was empty of furniture. There was so much noise in the hotel from large groups of students that kept us awake to late in the night. 
This is definitely not a 4 star hotel, we have stayed in Rome before in a 4 star hotel and this is not one of them

author: Diego C
title: Ideal location, small hidden gem at a good price.
text: Small hotel in an excellent location, don’t be put off by the outside and the road etc,  the inside is stunning.  Rooms small but very well decorated and high ceilings.  Only issue in the room was plug sockets,  only one available so take an extension lead.  Breakfast was continental but good variety and good quality.  Small bar facility and good prices.  Good outside space but as it was February, too cold to take advantage.  Hotel was spotless. Hotel reception could not be faulted, especially Rohit, he was a star, always there to help, direct and advise.  Couldn’t ask for anymore.

author: Isla F
title: Not 4 star, more like 2. Butter comfy warm plain hotel.
text:
This hotel is not 4 star, however it was clean. The area of Rome it's in is unkempt it's covered in graffiti and looks very tatty but we felt safe walking out of the hotel . The fridge in our room did not work . breakfast was basic. A 5 to 10 minute walk to the main train station that can take you into Rome all the airport or other destinations in Italy, and a five minute walk to the Metro ,again that can take you into Rome.
We had warm water in our room every day and clean bathroom ,and a comfy bed. No tea or coffee making facilities we're available in the room so you need to take your own.
Staff for pleasant and helpful. Is it value for money? I think that depends on what you paid on what you think of it personally I know it is not a four star hotel more like a two..

author: Diego Y
title: Best Roma not great
text:
Very noisy  very damp in room asked for a bath told no baths but the room next door had a bath no heating shower tiny
Won't come back

author: Luke V
title: Not recommended. Dirty room, unsafe location.
text: Floor in room was dirty and remained so for the 5 nights of our stay. Aircon wasn't working and, despite assurances from reception that it would be looked at, no one looked at it. If they had, they would have discovered all that was required was batteries for the remote. I replaced these, informed reception and they simply laughed at me. Food at breakfast ran out at 9am. It took over half an hour for things to be replaced. Staff sit and smoke right outside the breakfast room, The hotel is in an area that I, as a woman, would not feel safe to walk in alone after dark. People were openly selling drugs, using scales and all paraphernalia, from a backpack on the street at the back of the hotel. I would not recommend it, especially as it sees fit to rate itself 4*. If we'd booked expecting a 2*, I wouldn't complain.

author: Noah C
title: To small
text:
Not 4star hotel.not located in the best area  of Rome streets dirty and graffiti everywhere .tiny tiny room   ..no where to put clothes in the room living out of a suitcase difficult to move around room so cramped once suitcases are on floor..had just 3 coat hangers not even a wardrobe or chest of draws .
Fine if your backpacking but I would not recommend a long stay.

author: Henry G
title: Ok hotel good location but not 4 star
text:
On arrival we got in our Superior room and we were quite disappointed. The room was very small and the whole bathroom measured approx 5ft x 4ft. This wasn't what we expected from a Superior room in a 4* hotel. Size aside the room was clean, tidy, everything worked and the bed was very comfortable the staff were also very friendlyand helpful. We booked this hotel for location and on that front we were pleased you can easily walk into Rome centre. Each day when we got back to the hotel the room had been cleaned and air con was on which was amazing in 30+ degree heat. 
Overall a decent hotel not 4* but well located for the sites but a little dated

author: Holly K
title: It’s Ok but not 4*
text:
The room was clean and the bed comfy, but overall it’s feeling quite tiered. 

Unfortunately our room had no hot water and we had to use a different room to shower in, for the first morning. We then had to change room for our second night as still not fixed when we got back. This would have been fine, other than we weren’t informed and had to complain and ask to speak to the manager in order to get it changed. 

Location great about a 30min walk to the colosseum and 90min to the Vatican. 

In summary, ok for a short break, we were there 2 nights,  but wouldn’t liked to have stayed longer.

author: Claire B
title: Pleasant surprise
text: Stayed for a few days with friends.  The hotel is a bit dated but the beds are comfy, the staff are lovely and helpful.  The location was good with bars and restaurants in close distance. The only downside I found was the shower in our bathroom.  It wasn't the best and the cubicle was small.

author: Grace C
title: 10/10 Would stay here again
text: This hotel is fantastic! We brought our 4 month old and they were able to accommodate him with a pack and play as his crib. Location is excellent- you can easily walk to Times Square and numerous subway stations. Would definitely stay here again

author: Louis E

author: Evan L
title: Good location - bad services and extra fees
text:
Just returned from a weekend in NYC and very disappointed in this hotel. I am a Hilton Gold member and stayed 3 nights - one paid and two with points. 
First, the positives. The location is great. Convenient to the subway (5ish minute walk) and we were able to walk to the theaters for two Broadway shows. The king studio room was nice for 2 (but small for 3 adults) and it was quiet. 
With three people and the sofa bed out we could barely move around the room, couldn’t use the desk and had nowhere to put our luggage. 
But the hassles and false promises of this hotel outweighed the pros. 
Worst is the “lounge” used for the free evening reception and breakfast. I can’t imagine anyone could have designed this worse. It’s much too small for a hotel this size and the layout is makes it worse. Everyone is trying to move in the same small hallways including staff restocking food and clearing dishes. We ate breakfast the first morning but gave up on it after that. So don’t think you will save money on food. 
As other reviews have pointed out, the destination fee is a scam. They say you can get a $30 credit from the fee in the restaurant- but it is only good in The Heist, crammed next to the front desk, only open after 5 PM and seats maybe 20 people. There’s no way all the guests could use their credits. Not that you get much for $30 anyway. And if you saw the lovely photo of the Skylawn, you can’t use your credit there and it also only opens in the evening. 
The elevators are indeed slow - I picked a room on floor 6 so at least we could use the stairs.
I spent too much of my trip at the front desk getting our keys reactivated since apparently using points then money means every night is a separate reservation. And despite my efforts every day we had to get all of our keys fixed. 
If you want a quiet room in a good location, this hotel might work, but figure the additional fees into your total nightly cost and don’t expect to get any benefits or food. I will say the staff were trying and were patient but they are in an impossible situation.

author: Benjamin G
title: First time in the Big Apple
text: Very nice staff. Very reasonable rate and fantastic view

author: Jack S
title: Greeted by a friendly smile after a long day
text: Adam one of the concierge of the hotel was so happy to help my Sister in law during our stay. He always greeted us with a smile and was very helpful. He assisted us with our luggage checking in and out as well as giving us directions when needed to travel throughout the city . With customer service not being what it should be, Adam ensured we were getting the best possible during our stay at Embassy Suites.

author: Leo N
title: It is not an option if you want to rest.
text: If you want to rest this is not an option, check first if any room is under repair because it will be impossible for you to rest, at 7 am they start working on repairs and the noise is unbearable, you feel like they are drilling into your head, and at night the traffic noise makes it so you do not rest, otherwise it is an option since it has breakfast, snacks in the afternoon and small rooms like all in Manhattan but with the essentials, I would return if they assured me that there are no rooms under repair near mine.

author: Holly Y
title: Excellent front desk staff
text: Badr helped us get an upgrade to a better room and also gave us very helpful tips as we tried to navigate the area.

author: Hugo H
title: Great Customer Service
text: I stayed here for a few days on vacation. One night I dropped a glass cup on accident, I called the front desk and they promptly sent Jorge up to clean it. He even checked up on if I had any cuts/harm. Overall, my experience was great.

author: Chloe E
title: Advertised Rooms Don’t Exist
text:
I recently stayed at this Embassy Suites with two travel companions.  The hotel itself is fine, with clean public areas, multiple elevators, and the onsite staff who are personable and professional.  Housekeeping was offered daily and did an excellent job.  We didn't partake, but the onsite breakfast area seemed to have offerings typical of an Embassy Suites (albeit small and crowded) and the lobby bar area seemed to be offering reasonable service. 
 
Because we were looking for some level of privacy in the evenings and weren't able to find a 1-bedroom suite in our desired location, we booked the Junior Suite offered by the Embassy Suites because it was described as and had photos depicting a room divided by a high-backed sofa bed (see photos).  The room was booked several months prior to our stay but, upon arrival, we entered a room containing a king bed and a standard sofa bed against the wall next to it.  
 
Assuming we had been assigned the incorrect room type, I contacted guest services and was told that the advertised room I booked hasn't existed since a renovation some time ago.  I inquired why we weren't contacted and informed the room we booked wasn't available and she stated she didn't know.  I then inquired about a room with two beds since, if we weren't going to have the desired privacy provided by the sofa bed, a standard bed would have been preferable and was told there were none.  The next day I received a text from the hotel manager, Jot, inquiring about my stay and I explained how disappointing it was to discover the room I booked didn't exist, and in response I only received a canned apology for not meeting our expectations, yet offering no resolution. 
 
We completed our three-night stay but were very disappointed and frustrated to be in a room that was not as advertised.  Not only did it not meet the intended privacy needs, but the desk and counter surfaces were all on the side wall as a feature of the former Junior Suite layout, which made for minimal space across the room and nowhere to keep our bags except the floor in front of the bed and sofa bed, leaving us to climb over and around everything to navigate in the room. 
 
Had we known the room with the privacy barrier didn't exist, we could have booked any number of rooms with two standard beds and had a more comfortable and functional stay.   I contacted Hilton Honors guest services to share my frustration at the experience, and my message was forwarded to the hotel.  Jamela, the Operations Manager, contacted me offering another canned apology, attempted to gaslight me about my concerns, and offered a token amount of Hilton Honors points, without addressing the real issue of a non-existent room being advertised and available for booking.   After I responded more directly about the potential ramifications involved in falsely advertising an unavailable product, I received communication from Hilton and a reasonable resolution was reached.  HOWEVER, as of this writing, the Junior Suite is still being advertised and described as a divided room - nobody from Hilton has acknowledged this or made any statement to indicate that the website would be updated, so I'm posting here to save others the frustration of booking this room they advertise but are unable to provide.

author: Charlotte S
title: My NYC Trip
text: A big pleasant surprise for us.  Carlos and Allie were excellent. They know how to treat people.  Will always look for them when we come back

author: Aaron B
title: Polite and helpful
text: The receptionist Sam and Allie were very accommodating for and helped me into a room when my back was up again at the wall! Thanks for taking me in 🙂

author: Jack A
title: Great Family-Friendly Hotel in New York
text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Embassy Suites by Hilton. It is a great hotel for families and is conveniently located near Macy's and Primark, making shopping very easy. The hotel also has excellent access to public transportation, with both bus and subway stations nearby.

A special thank you to Yasmi at the front desk, who was always friendly and very helpful. Carlos Bueno in the restaurant provided excellent service and was very attentive throughout our stay. Karla S did a fantastic job keeping our room spotless and very clean every day.

The breakfast is excellent and a great value, especially in New York. The hot breakfast includes a made-to-order egg station where you can get freshly prepared eggs, which is a great way to save money while enjoying a delicious start to the day.

Highly recommended for families visiting New York!

author: Andrea A
title: Exceptional Customer Service by Sam at the Front Desk
text: Sam was truly a pleasure to work with! He answered all of my questions, was friendly and helpful!

author: Lauren R
title: Overall, a good value.
text: The staff was friendly and helpful. The location is convenient and the facilities were updated.

author: Lea F
text: The hotel is very well located, super clean, and the staff is very kind! Thank you Samantha!

author: Holly K
title: Clean hotel. Great location and staff.

author: Emma W
title: Excellent!!

author: Harry Z
title: Great stay with cookies on top
