author: Connor U
title: Above and beyond
text: Excelent service from all personnel. Shout out to Natalia R. She went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable. Our room was always clean with new towels and sheets. 20 out of 10.

author: Antoine H
title: Excellent 👍
text: Excellent service, thanks for everything Samantha e Ismael.

author: Sara K
title: Amazing stay
text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at this hotel. From the moment we arrived, the entire staff went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable, enjoyable, and truly special.

Samantha, Ismael, and the entire team were incredibly welcoming and attentive. A special thank you to Mark and Natasha, who were amazing in guiding and helping us as we prepared for our daughter’s move to college in the city. Their kindness, patience, and willingness to help made an important family moment so much easier and more memorable.

I highly recommend this property. This was not my first stay here, and after another exceptional experience, it definitely won’t be my last. I look forward to coming back again!

author: Lucy Q
title: Visit with our family and friends.
text: I love this experience here,the room is very clean and amenities but the all I really all appreciate is the attention for all personal here. Additionally, all activities for time square is close between 8 and 10 minutes if you enjoyed walking. Thank you very much for all people attended us.

author: Chloe U
title: Friendly staff...Romaine did great
text: Romaine and Team did a great job.

author: Erin V
title: Awesome
text: Room was great. Romaine was greater. Amazing service.

author: Ella T
title: Retuning Guest Review
text: The front desk staff is a HUGE part of why I keep booking at this location. Romaine is very welcoming and warm every time I have stayed here. He puts a smile on my face, and is very helpful in my every need. Julio is also exceptional in customer service. Only complaint is housekeeping seems to speak very loudly by the exit doors, sir here is no sleeping in. Other than that small detail, I enjoy coming here because I get a very family oriented feel as opposed to a business oriented hotel.

author: Maria C
title: Nice stay
text: Samantha and Ismael were very nice and helpful, they answered all of our questions and offered great service. The hotel is clean and it has everything you need for a nice NY stay! Thank you for everything!

author: Isla D
title: Come for the Balcony, Stay for the Cookies
text:
Absolutely loved our stay! The room was beautiful, clean, quiet, and had huge windows with views for days. The bed was super comfortable, and the balcony was TO DIE FOR! The pictures online truly don’t do it justice—it was almost the same size as the room itself, lol.

Diego and Osbalob were amazing and provided superb customer service. They made check-in easy, helped with our luggage, arranged a private taxi to the airport, and genuinely went above and beyond. Diego also would not stop offering me cookies, lol! 😂

Beautiful hotel, incredible balcony, and amazing service. I would absolutely stay here again!

author: Marta N
title: Awesome
text: Romain helped check us in early and is the best for that!

author: Charlotte D
title: Great service, not enough elevators
text:
The location of the DoubleTree Chelsea was excellent, and Romaine at the front desk was wonderful—extremely pleasant, helpful, and accommodating. Our room didn’t have a refrigerator, which we needed to store my husband’s insulin. Romaine took care of it right away and had one delivered to our room in under an hour. We really appreciated his help.

My only complaint, but unfortunately a significant one, was the elevator situation. There are only two elevators, and staying on the 6th floor meant that by the time an elevator reached us, it was almost always already full. On more than one occasion I waited while several completely full elevators stopped at our floor before finally giving up and taking the stairs down. One time, after four full elevators in a row, I just took the stairs.

Other than the elevator issue, we had a very good stay. The location and especially the excellent service from Romaine made a very positive impression. I would definitely recommend the hotel, but I’d suggest requesting a room on the highest floor available. You’ll have a much better chance of actually getting on an elevator on the way down.

author: Megan W
title: Good hotel with excellent staff.
text: Ismael at the front desk was very kind. He made many things easy for us from the moment we arrived until we left.

author: Gavin L
title: Excellent : great hotel
text:
An excellent stay at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel New York City – Chelsea.
I had a very pleasant stay at the Hilton Chelsea. The hotel is ideally located, making it easy to explore New York and its main neighborhoods and attractions.

I particularly appreciated the warm welcome and professionalism of the staff, who were always available and attentive. A special mention goes to the manager, who was extremely helpful, available, and always willing to assist. The room was comfortable, clean, and pleasant—perfect for relaxing after a busy day exploring New York.

Overall, it was a very positive experience that I would highly recommend without hesitation. I will be delighted to stay here again on my next trip to New York!

author: Sofia V
title: Amazing stay
text: Osbaldo was great! He helped us a lot!  Definitely we’ll stay here again

author: Antoine Y
title: Osbaldo made our stay!
text: Osbaldo was amazing! Took really good care of us and our luggage. Always attentive to our needs. Will return soon! Great hospitality.

author: Aiden Y
title: Being Taken care of on a Sunday
text: My experience as normal was excellent. There was no early check in for me but Romanie took very good care of me. His kindness and professionalism reminds me why The Doubletree is my favorite hotel in New York City.

author: Sydney N
title: Great location and stuff
text: Really great place to vacation at NYC. At the heart of the city and walking distance for best shops and restaurants. The staff was very helpful and helped us to get around and always with a smile. Any ask we had they quickly comply. I would love to come back !

author: Ruby F
title: Unexpectedly excellent stay.
text: To be honest, I was surprised at how very, very nice the hotel is. It is tucked into a location on a busy street and I confess my expectations were not terribly high. However, I found my stay to be just perfect. The staff is welcoming and helpful. The room, though on the small side, was clean and comfortably furnished. The bathroom was spotlessly clean and very well lit (saw all my wrinkles). One comment I would have is the same one I make at most hotels: why is the grab bar in the shower at the end of the tub under the shower itself instead of in the middle of the tub where you actually stand to wash? But - I'm used to that. A small thing. Anyway - breakfast in the dining area was fine. Not a ton of choices but quite adequate for the purpose. Again, staff was great. I would stay there again, certainly.

author: Mathis U
title: Over Charged
text:
We stayed in this hotel during July and booked 2 rooms for 6 nights.
The location is great. The rooms are OK but only partially clean (for example, the microwave in one room had food stains when we checked in, and it wasn't cleaned throughout our 6-night stay).
Most employees are friendly, except for one who was not welcoming during check-in.
The main reason for the 1-star review is the charge. We booked the room directly from the Hilton website. 3 days before the check-in, we saw 2 changes from the hotel (probably the first high as “guaranteed”). Once we checked in, we were charged the full amount for the rooms; however, the previous charge had not been cancelled yet. Once we checked out, the initial charge was cancelled; however, 2 new charges were made, without any explanation, consent or invoice, and they were above the amount of the reservation.
We emailed Hilton, and they told us the hotel would contact us within 48 hours, but no one from the hotel contacted us to explain the overcharge. 
Hotels should be more transparent about their charging mechanism and explain to customers each additional charge above the agreed amount in the reservation.

author: Poppy Z
title: Top-Tier Service At A Mid-Tier Price
text: This Hilton Garden provided an exemplary level of service and an outstanding hotel experience overall. Rooms and amenities are a cut above the price level. Special thanks to a Hilton rep named Mike, who helped me secure substantial savings on a stay I was already planned for 2027. Can't wait to come back!

author: Isla S
title: A+ overall and would stay again
text: Great location!  Easy walk to major attractions and convenient to subway.  Rooms are small, which is expected in NYC, but they were clean and well kept. Friendly staff!  No complaints. Would stay again.

author: Louis R
title: Look for Karen!
text: The hotel was the perfect location. Karen was so helpful and made our experience extra special! She helped us plan our next vacation and was so wonderful.   Highly recommend!

author: Ruby J
title: Best location
text: The staff are really good and friendly . Especially Candace. She is a sweetheart . About the location it’s the best you could ever ask for . Subway is just few steps . A lot of food options … enjoyed my stay 😍😍

author: Paige L
title: So so
text:
I stayed two nights here while I met up with family . My family had already checked in a night before I arrived. I arrived pretty early around 10 am and asked if I could be in the same floor as them and was told it was too early to check in. Which I said if they could put in a request for it. Fast forward later that day when I checked in and front desk just said we were full.
I just found the front desk staff not very friendly at all and quite dismissive of my request. I could understand yes you could not accommodate my request but didn’t even offer info how to get in the wifi, said anything about the room amenities or the hotel amenities.
The location is good. A lot of restaurants around. The hotel looks dated from the outside. Uber easy to get.
Not sure if I would return to this place. Maybe if the price is reasonable. Was pricey this time probably because close to the World Cup dates.

author: Ian J
title: Business
text: Excellent location (lots of shopping nearby) friendly staff and very helpful esp Mike the Hilton Ambassador!  As an avid Hilton member highly recommend this hotel!

author: Liam N
title: Dont get sucked into the parking add on trap
text: We were here for fleet week as my son in law is here with the Navy. We paid for a package with parking. It was $67? Extra a night.  When you park your car, thats it, you dont have access to it until you check out. Period. We spent so much money in lyfts. I will never fet sucked into that parking trap again. We actually had to book a room in the NJ for our last night so my daughter could see my son in law. I stayed at this hotel and she stayed in a hilton on the jersey side. We took my car out if the garage a day early so she could have it, and im currently trying to get my money back for the day of parking that we didnt use. Not a fun weekend.

author: David Q
title: The Knicks and I Both Won!
text:
I was traveling to attend a graduation and decided to extend my stay and spend a few days in Manhattan. Hotel rates were through the roof. I took advantage of the Hilton Honors sale and it helped lower the rates at several properties, but many didn't have good reviews. While this particular property didn't have the best rates, the recent reviews were positive so I selected this one. The room was slightly larger than typical NYC hotel rooms. It was well-appointed, comfortable, and clean. 

I was there on Game 5 when the Knicks won and even though the hotel is just a couple of blocks from MSG where multitudes gathered, I couldn't hear anything in my room. The property is convenient to the subway and to many attractions. The area was very safe. I didn't eat at the restaurant but enjoyed a nightly cocktail at the bar which was always well made. It was an overall good trip. I would return.

author: Noah N
title: Excellent stay!
text:
From check-in to check-out, everything went smoothly. The staffs were friendly and helpful, and the lobby was perfectly maintained and functional. I really liked how clean and cozy the room felt.  I appreciate for upgrade to higher floor to view the iconic Empire State Building especially decorative lighting at night to relax and chill out after walking for miles and explore new places in area.  Lastly, I thank for the two bottles water and comforting hospitality.  Very thoughtful of HGI-35th street New York, NY. Definitely, I will revisit if I am back in New York. 
KCC1224-PA/HLT06JUN2026

author: Manon B
title: Great time here
text: Candace was perfect!!!!!and friendly

author: Henry X
title: Great location! Spacious Room and Welcoming Staff!
text: A great location! An incredibly welcoming and helpful staff! The rooms are clean, fresh spacious, especially for midtown. Noise no issue at all but close the restaurants, bars and Herald Square. Fairly priced and a great value for the area. Could be more pleased with experience.

author: Holly O
title: Our NYC Vacation
text: This location at 63 W 35th St was perfect for us. We were greeted by a team of professionals that really set the tone for our stay. They provided us with information on directions to Times Square, Broadway, and restaurants in the vicinity. Our room was very comfortable and clean with a view of the Empire State Building out of our window. There was hardly any noise heard from the surrounding streets. The atmosphere was an escape from the crowd as we used the outdoor seating area to relax and enjoy the crowd without being in the crowd. We even enjoyed a takeout meal in that area. The value of the room was well worth the cost and some. There were amenities available in the lobby as well as a breakfast area. There was a cost for the breakfast but I think the coffee could have been at no cost to the residents. This was a great stay and we plan on planning another visit to NYC and this will be our hotel. GREAT JOB TO ALL!

author: Molly Y
title: Another amazing stay!
text:
I am a repeat customer and will
only stay here at the Hilton Garden Inn on 35th. The walk is easy from Penn Station on 33rd St.  I feel safe, the hot shower was amazing after walking NYC,  the Lyft drivers arrived 2 minutes or less in front of the hotel, the King bed was so comfy,  stayed 3 nights and opted for once for Housekeeping. Spotless.  Thank you for having the microwave and fridge in the room. Quick elevators.  The front desk and everyone so friendly. Thank you for your excellent communication and kindness. It goes a long way.  Looking forward to my next stay.

author: Maria L
title: Great Staff & Hotel
text: Tony and the staff were so great to our family! We had such a hospitable stay for our long weekend in the Big Apple. Would definitely return!

author: Lauren P
title: Great stay
text:
The location of the hotel is fantastic and the subway station is very close.
The room size was quite good with a nice view.
The staff- friendly, warm and welcoming.
The accommodation met our expectations and we had comfortable stay. 
Great value for money.

author: Morgan I
title: Great visit
text: Location is great for most of what you want to do.  The hotel was clean and well taken care of.  The staff were very attentive and friendly.

author: Marco D
title: Second Great Stay in Midtown Manhattan
text:
This was our second stay at the Hilton Garden Inn on W. 35th St., and we had another very good experience. The front desk staff were friendly and accommodating, even with our late arrival.

Our room, #2308, had a great view of the Empire State Building. The room was small, as expected in New York City, but comfortable and well-maintained. Housekeeping was prompt, the hotel was surprisingly quiet, and every staff member we interacted with was helpful.

We also enjoyed the café downstairs for breakfast, and it was nice to see the same staff working there as during our last stay. They were efficient and friendly. We would definitely stay here again and would recommend it for business travelers and couples visiting New York City.

author: Anna I
title: Great experience
text: We are a group of six and some of us came from abroad to visit. We came a little earlier than the chekin time and we have 8 luggages. The gentleman at the chekin waived our fee. We are really appreciative. The rooms are very clean and cozy. Great location as well!

author: Mason E
title: Convenient location and reasonable priced
text: Perfectly located on West Side near the Highline, Whitney, Chelsea Market and Hudson River Pathway. Definitely plan to stay there again. And the price was reasonable.

author: Isabella E
title: Hidden Gem in a Great Location.
text:
Staff is many the most friendly and accommodating anywhere! They are very attentive to guest situations before & after coming & going during the day. Location is convenient to West Village, Chelsea Market & Meatpacking areas, adjacent to major 14th Street subway hub for easy access to the rest of NYC. 
Room are average size for NYC and immaculately maintained.
Overall, a really good value.

author: Thomas F
title: Quick holiday trip to NYC
text:
The Chelsea Pines Inn had everything we needed for our two day Manhattan getaway. The location was perfect for the venues we were visiting.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The atmosphere and movie themed decor is unique.  The staff was friendly, courteous, and helpful. We have already recommended the Chelsea Pines to several friends, and we definitely plan on returning.  
Dan and Kathleen Tappen

author: Ian U
title: Great respite in NYC
text:
The Chelsea Pines Inn was perfect for our two day holiday trip to Manhattan.  The location was ideal for the venues we were visiting.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The atmosphere and movie themed decor is unique. The staff was friendly, courteous, and helpful.   We have been letting people know about this great option, and we plan on returning. 
Kathleen and Dan Tappen

author: Emma I
title: Old BUT Clean
text: We recently stayed here for 5 nights. It’s a very old building but our room was clean, warm and the beds really comfy. The rooms were big by New York standards. There is a kitchenette/Dining room you can make your self a drink or eat your food you’ve brought. It was surprisingly quiet. Really close to an underground station and Chelsea Market. The one thing you need to keep in mind is that there is no lift. After a days walking around the city it was hard to walk up the stairs but the staff are happy to take your luggage up and down on arrival and departure. Price was ok by New York standards too

author: Amelia T
title: Great Little Hotel in Awesome Location
text: Small converted apartment building.  Staff is fantastic.   Nice common areas on ground floor with outdoor area, indoor sitting area, kitchen with drinks and coffee, large fridge guests can use, microwave.  Rooms are very small as usual in NYC but nice bathroom.  Very good location near two major subway stops, Chelsea Market, High Line, Meat Packing District, West Greenwich Village, South Chelsea.  No elevator, but we stayed on ground floor, no issues with noise.  Very secure.  The only minor issue is you can't control heat in your room, it is whole building heat.  Each room has its own air conditioner.  Overall, a great place, highly recommended.

author: Paige U
title: NYC
text:
Excellent location for my visit, clean, comfortable & modest rooms, wonderful staff & an enviable courtyard that is fantastic for breakfast & breaks from the city.
Very good value.

author: Lucy G
title: Everything I needed
text: Great location! Staff was very friendly and also helpful, even offering to code me a new key moments after mine didn't seem to work (I was putting it in backwards). Good strong shower, comfy bed (2 Queens, which I didn't expect).

author: Isabella G
title: Perfect Chelsea/Manhattan stay
text: My daughter and I really enjoyed the property.  The staff was great and very courteous.  The property itself was dated in a good way. Too many places seem cookie cutter and this felt more like a traditional manhattan stay. The neighborhood felt safe and when you come out of the C and E line station you can see the awning to the hotel. It is also just a couple of blocks from The High Line and the Little Island.  All around exactly what I wanted for a Daddy/Daughter bonding trip

author: Anna D
title: A Chelsea gem
text:
My Chelsea Pines stay was fantastic. All the staff were helpful and wonderful hosts. I felt so comfortable and welcomed every minute of my stay. 
The location was perfect with walking distance to the Chelsea Market and great little restaurants and shops.
My room was very quiet, clean, and very comfortable. I will definitely return soon!

author: Katie H
title: Good experience with our family & hope to return!
text:
Very friendly and helpful staff!
Bed was comfortable & room was clean. 
Nice indoor & outdoor common areas with coffee & tea available. 
 Room was small, but it’s NYC!
Good location with easy access to the subway.

author: Poppy O
title: Our home away from home
text: We love the Chelsea Pines Inn. We have gone as a group there two times and are already planning our third trip. We love going to NYC for theater weekends and the Chelsea Pines is our favorite place. The subway to the  theater district is about 50 yards from the hotel and its 2 stops. Super convenient AND we don't have to stay in Time Square area. We love the Chelsea location there are tons of great shops, food and bars within blocks of the hotel. The Hotel is clean, welcoming,  and reasonably priced. The rooms are a great size for NYC and I love that its a walk up as I get some extra workout steps in. The staff at the front desk is super helpful and they have a little garden in the back. Its our little home away from home!

author: Poppy I
title: Great place at a great price!
text: The Chelsea Pines is a great, affordable place to stay in NYC. The staff is super nice and helpful. they will dispel any preconceived notions you may have about New Yorkers. The inn has a "Hollywood theme" with many many posters in the hallways and the rooms. There is a nice area with a sink and fridge where you can keep milk for morning cereal or coffee, etc. There's a cute little glassed in sitting area as well as cafe tables to sit at in the charming back yard. Fair warning, this is NYC and this place is affordable, so the rooms are a little squinchy. But I've found that to be true about high end places as well. It's also very close to all the key subway lines.  We loved it and are planning to stay again soon!

author: Gavin A
title: Great Summer stay in lower west side!
text: We needed a safe, comfortable and affordable stay for three people near 23rd street in order to visit family and Chelsea Pines was a great surprise! The staff helped bring all are belongings up to our room which was comfortable and decorated with fabulous pictures of old movies! We will be back next time we are in NYC!

author: Luke A
title: NO elevator - so be sure to book a lower floor.
text: OK, good and bad here.  KEY POINT:  make sure you can book a LOWER floor - this is an ancient building and has NO ELEVATOR.  Good - location is great - two blocks from Pier 56, one block from the subway, paid-for parking garage next door.  Reasonably priced (especially for NYC), convenient Chelsea location, lots of restaurants, etc., etc.  OK - hotel itself.  Friendly staff, redecorated in a retro movie theme (kind-of fun, amazing gallery of vintage memorabilia in each room!), rooms are clean but small and basic, though you DO have on-suite bathrooms and typical amenities.  Bad - no elevator.  In a 110+ year old building, those 11-foot ceilings mean that a 5th floor room is a HIKE, especially carrying luggage.

author: Ana G
title: For us, number one in Manhattan
text: Once again we spent our New York vacation at the Chelsea Pines Inn on 14. Street spent - definitely not for the last time. All the staff are incredibly friendly and helpful, the hotel itself scores with its excellent location with individually designed rooms and a great terrace with garden. A gem in the middle of Manhattan that makes us feel at home.

author: Chloe Z
title: Very nice - needs some improvement
text:
Chelsea pines in many ways is amazing.  There are some areas for improvement. 

Pros 
1.  Excellent location near Chelsea market. Subway just out the door. Can go anywhere in manhattan so easily. Nice safe street even at njght
2.  We stayed in the apartment which was huge - such a surprise in NYC
3.  Staff were very friendly and responsive 

Cons 
1.  Room could be cleaner and more updated.  We had many lights out in the room.   The extra beds in room need new mattresses. The basement apartment also quickly got humid if the AC was not run quite low.

author: Charlotte L
title: Scammers- do not book Chelsea Pines Inn
text: I was lied to and cheated when making a reservation. I called to book a room, wanted to ask what floor since other reviews suggested no elevator and steep stairs. Agent told me I could cancel before July 19 without any fees/ penalties, so I gave my credit card to hold. Immediately got emailed a confirmation that had a much higher rate than agreed and stated that I agreed on cancellation fee equal to one night. Even when booking online, I would not trust this business. Somethings very shady here.

author: Matthew K
title: Hotel Chelsea pines Inn New York
text: We spent a week in New York to experience the city. The hotel is very conveniently located on 14th Street and 8th Avenue, just a short walk from the subway. The hotel has four floors and no elevator. Being over 65 years old, and after walking more than 15 km through the city, it's unreasonable to climb another four floors. Moreover, the floors are 1.5 times higher than in Germany. However, the friendly staff gave us a room on the first floor after the first night. That was very pleasant. The young men were all very friendly and helpful; the only name I remember is Jimmy, but everyone was very competent; thank you for that. There's a kitchen on the ground floor that you can use. Coffee was always ready, and you can use the refrigerator with your own things. The rooms facing the street are very noisy; they face the back. The rooms were quite small, and the air conditioning didn't work very well. Best time to travel: spring or late September. Overall, we were satisfied.

author: Grace U
title: Fantastic staff. Good value.
text: The staff here are so polite, helpful and friendly and really seem to be bonded as a team. This is a fantastic budget hotel offering good value for money particularly for a family.. The location is great for exploring Central London.

author: Daisy J
title: Friendly and helpful
text:
Very kind and helpful staff 
Good variety breakfast and relaxing atmosphere
Hayot very friendly

author: Paige Y
title: 5 stars without hesitation
text:
We are currently staying in Travelodge London Tower Bridge and are really impressed. The location is fantastic, close to Tower Hill tube station and Towergate DLR. 

The reception team have been fantastic here and I would like to say thank you to Ferdost who is extremely professional and sorted out a small problem quickly and efficiently and made our stay great! 

Our room was clean with comfortable beds.
We stayed on the road side so there was less noise than the train side (I had read the reviews before my stay!) and we slept very well. 

Good value for money for a central London hotel. 

Excellent, we will be back.

author: Samuel D
title: A perfect cheeky night in Central London
text: As per the title:  A perfect cheeky night in Central London. This hotel was perfect for us.  We paid a little extra for the upgraded drinks facility and wifi.  The room was clean, positively furnished and the iron and ironing board was very much welcomed. Very comfortable! Also, the fan provided slight comfort from the heat as there wasn´t any aircon.  We were welcomed warmly by the staff, especially Ripa on reception, who explained everything.  Eventhough, our stay was short, all boxes of the customer experience journey were ticked!  Definitely, we will be coming back again to stay whenever we are in town!

author: Joseph D
title: Interesting stay
text:
Checked in Friday 21st August 2026 for 3 nights was checked in by Ripa who was very polite and helpful has a good stay.

One night I had accidentally pushed the assistance button behind my bed (we was in a disabled room) at 2am there was a knock at the door at first I thought it was someone else’s room then another knock on the door this time I looked through the spy hole to see a man standing outside it scared me especially after what had been on the news but he knocked again then saying reception so I opened the door to him asking me if all was ok which I said yes why then he explained what had happened I felt relief from that he reset it then left but it just shows they are actually there when needed so all in all a great experience I would definitely stay again

author: Evie J
title: Short stay very comfortable & convenient
text: The hotel was clean, comfortable, and in a really great location. Staff friendly and helpful. Ripa was very helpful and checked us in very quickly.

author: Tyler Q
title: Great customer service
text: Ripa was very helpful, great customer service - thank you!

author: Grace P
title: My experience
text: The experience was lovely, location fantastic, just a few minutes walk to the train station, bus station and the famous Tower bridgè. The atmosphere is lovely. The meals are okay. Generally it was a pleasant holiday for me and my family. As per the rooms , i stayed in a small family size room which served our purpose, though it was a bit hot when he arrived that evening and was expecting Air condition but had to do with the small fan and opened up the window, got cooler at night.

author: Erin H
title: Great service and hotel, thanks Gabby , Ripa and Miruna.
text: Great service, Gabby, Ripa and Miruna are amazing and very kind. Samad is a great chef. Roman was kind too.

author: Brooke T
title: Wonderful stay and a huge thank you from a recent guest!
text: Dear Travelodge London Central Tower Bridge Team, I am writing to send a heartfelt thank you to everyone at the hotel. My son and I stayed with you last month, and we had a truly wonderful time.A special thank you goes to Ripa at the reception desk. She was so cheerful, kind, and welcoming when we arrived. We also want to thank the wonderful members of the restaurant team for taking such good care of us during our meals—their warm hospitality meant a lot to both of us.Our room was clean and comfortable, and the hotel's fantastic location made exploring the city with my son so easy and fun. Thank you all for making our London trip special and stress-free on my birthday. Warmest regards, Hanna

author: Claire W
title: Overall experience
text: The location was very nice , the cleanliness was on top , the rooms were decently sized , breakfast was spectacular .However what stood at to me was the excellent customer service .A specific staff member Gabby Samad was always willing to help and would always check on us . Overall I had a  wonderful experience and I would definitely recconend  , it  is 100% worth the money

author: Abigail Q
title: Rupa at reception.
text:
Lovely Reception Service

We had a wonderful experience at Travelodge, especially thanks to Rupa at reception. She was incredibly kind, friendly and welcoming, and she helped us with everything we needed. She explained everything clearly and made us feel very comfortable and looked after.

Thank you so much, Rupa, for your lovely attitude and excellent customer service. You really made our stay more enjoyable. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Grace O
title: Exceptional team and outstanding service
text:
We had a very pleasant stay at Travelodge London Tower Bridge. The hotel was welcoming, comfortable and well located, but what really made our stay stand out was the excellent team.

We would also like to mention Gabby, Lucinda and Miruna, the hotel managers, who were all professional, welcoming and approachable, as well as Chef Samad, who also contributed to such a positive experience.

author: Alice D
title: A series of disappointments (sigh)
text:
One or two issues with a room are usually not a big deal. Unfortunately, my room had many more, making my stay disappointing, especially given this hotel’s relatively high ranking on TripAdvisor (which I’m now suspicious of). 

(1) See the attached photo for the disgusting clump of hair that was left in the shower. The photo shows what I disgustingly had to pull out of the drain by hand. (2) The sliding bathroom didn’t close all the way (see attached photo). Consequently, when I finished doing a #2, I wasn’t finished smelling it. (3) One of the reading lights next to the bed was broken. (4) The drain stopper in the sink was broken as well. (5) There was a black mold-looking substance in the creases of a picture frame in the bathroom (see attached photo). (6) The wall-mounted thermostat was unresponsive. (7) Housekeeping showed up one day at 3:45pm, as I was getting ready to meet friends for dinner, and asked if I wanted service. My answer: Yes, two hours ago (SMH).

Again, one or two issues are usually not a big deal. My room had more. Given the overall atmosphere of the hotel (high-traffic, well-worn, moderately priced facility catering to budget-conscious tourists), I didn’t have faith that switching rooms would make a difference.  

With NYC travel being so expensive, I’m sure this hotel will continue to receive guests if its rooms remain competitively priced. But based on my experience, its relatively high TripAdvisor ranking (which influenced my decision to stay there) is deceptive.

author: Alexander I
title: 3 Sleepless Nights
text:
I am extremely disappointed with my 3 night stay at The Moxy Times Square. My partner and I visit NYC regularly, and this particular trip got worse by the day due to HVAC issues and the non transparent communication of the staff. 

Day one we arrived to a room with the thermostat stuck on 50 degrees, yet was blowing hot air. This led to a room change which at first was satisfactory, until we realized there were issues even with this different room. 

The set point of the system is 68 degrees. It uses an eco setting which seemed to be permanent— we don’t know because no one would fully explain this to us. In any case, this led to our first of three sleepless nights. Continuously, the air would kick on for 10 minutes and cool the room down, but then turned off and wouldn’t reactivate until the room was already so hot that it woke us up (both with the temperature and the sound of it kicking on.) After giving up on a good night sleep we left for a busy day. Upon return the room seemed cool and we thought the issue was resolved. 

Unfortunately, that second night, we had the same issue. We went to sleep again this night hoping for the best—- but no: same issue, same sleepless night. We began to feel that maybe it was motion detection activated. We were made to feel like sleep deprived lunatics, waking up hot and waving around to see if the air would kick on to relieve the heat. At this point we had tried all settings (auto, manual, fan).

The next morning I brought the issue to the staff. I wanted to understand, at the very least, what was happening and why. They sent an engineer to investigate while we were out. We returned to a warm room blowing warm air. We laid in bed unwinding and hoping for it to kick on, which it did for 5 minutes every once in a while but not effectively cooling the room down. I was frustrated at this point and desperate for restful sleep, so I went down to the lobby. The offered to change our room, but at 1:00 am and already having done this, I had neither energy nor faith that this would resolve the issue. 

They sent an engineer, which resulted in the most rude and unprofessional experience I’ve ever had in a hotel. Stefan stomped in angrily, plugged in a grimy, disgusting oscillating fan and yelled, “it’s not broken.” I was in shock. I was hoping to gain clarification on how the system worked, at the very least, but there was no conversation, not an ounce of respect. 

I am usually a proud Bonvoy member, and I’m also a flight attendant. I stay in hotels very, very frequently and am no stranger to climate control. I have never stayed in a hotel with a set point of 68 degrees. Any logical person can understand that once the system registers the room is warm enough for it to kick back on, it’s already in the mid to high 70s. This is simply too hot and unacceptable for a hotel room. The measly 50,000 bonus point the added to my account does not make up for ruining our vacation.

People choose hotels for consistency. We typically feel safe with Marriott brand hotels and especially the Moxy. However, three days of suffering, contacting staff and still not having our problem resolved PLUS adding insult to injury by being berated by a member of the staff, ensures I will never stay here again and will warn others not to stay here.

author: Alice R
title: Miserable Experience
text:
We normally love The Moxy, having stayed at their properties internationally and have had many good experiences. 

But The Moxy Times Square was a MISERABLE experience. 

We booked a room for 3 nights. The first room had an AC that was completely broken and just blew warm air. We notified the front desk and eventually had to pack up and move rooms. The guy at the front desk didn’t say a word, just handed us another key and waved us away at 11pm.

The room we were moved to had an AC that seemed to be working.  We were relieved and went to sleep, only to be woken up several times throughout the night to the AC turning on and off and the room becoming uncomfortably warm. Like 80 degrees warm.  

Over the next few days we notified the front desk of our AC issues several times, only to be gaslit and lied to about their HVAC system by several employees and managers. We explained that the thermostat seemed to be controlled by a motion sensor and was shutting off when we went to sleep. The lowest it would go was 68 degrees (which it never even felt like it reached that temp) and as soon as the room got a little cool, the eco function on the AC would shut it off and keep the room from ever feeling comfortable. They sent up several “engineers”, none of whom accomplished anything.

On our final night, at 1am after several nights of no sleep, we made one last effort to contact the front desk and get some answers. They said they would send up an “engineer” again. Stefan got to our room moments later, stormed in trampling over our stuff. He yelled at us that it wasn’t broken and it won’t go below 68 degrees. Shocked at how mean and rude he was, we calmly asked if there was anything they could do to make sure it stayed on throughout the night. We explained that had we known the AC was never actually going to work, we would have found different accommodations that first night. He yelled at us again, plugged in a filthy tower fan (picture attached) and stormed out. We were literally shocked. 

At no point were we comfortable. At no point did anyone apologize. We didn’t leave because they kept promising they would fix it for us, but they knew there was nothing to fix. Their HVAC system purposely works this way. They kept stringing us along while they took our money. 

Our stay at The Moxy Times Square ruined our long planned trip. We both work in hospitality and travel, and at no point in our experience did we receive any customer service. We spent a lot of money at this property during our stay, we wanted to support their bars, all of which i deeply regret. At no point did anyone actually listen to us or care. 

If you want a comfortable nights stay in a room that is cool and dry, stay far away from this property. Also, if you see this thermostat (picture attached) in your hotel room anywhere, leave immediately.

author: Harry N
title: Bob's cooking? Stop it. 5-star experience.
text:
If you want a 5-star hotel, go stay in a 5-star hotel. If you want 5-star service, stay at 69TheGrove. Kanley and Bob will make you feel like family--like literally. Sure, the building has some character; it's old! Yeah, the carpet is a little threadbare in places, the walls a bit scuffed here and there. But everything is clean, comfortable, and cared for. Kanley was so gracious, allowing me to choose my room and even change my mind when I realized the basement room wasn’t for me. Bob was attentive to my every need, always ready with a “Beth, can I help?” literally if I put a toe outside my door.

Even the porters were delightful, first carrying my luggage down to the basement room, then all the way back up four flights of stairs (!) when I switched to the penthouse. The room itself was fresh, clean, and comfortable, and I truly felt looked after the entire time I was there. The windows in my room (on the roof) opened outward and gave me a spectacular view of… London: That bridge thingy and that big clock everyone seems obsessed with (Americans can do sarcasm too).

And the breakfast. The BREAKFAST! Oh my god, the breakfast! As an American, I was expecting the usual situation where they throw you a day-old bagel and some orange juice at you and you're well on your way to diabetes. But girl. Bob’s cooking? Stop it. He asked if I wanted eggs, bacon, sausage (um, yes please), yogurt, fruit, toast, and honestly I don’t even remember what else because that table was full of all the foods.

Ok, that was spectacular. But surely you only get ONE of those breakfasts during your stay? Girl, no. You get that breakfast Every. Day. Of your stay. I double-checked my bill to make sure I wasn't charged extra for it. Every day, I got to share breakfast with lovely people from around the world including a great conversation with some lovely Austrians where I pretended to be Canadian, because... well.

The location is perfect, within walking distance to the tube, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, and what not. The neighborhood is clean and safe. One night I walked by a neighbor who whispered, “ 'allo sweet’art, how are you tonight my lovely?” When I turned around ready to give him a piece of my feminist mind, I realized he was talking to a cat on his doorstep. My animal-loving heart melted. God, I love England.

This place isn’t about outward luxury, it’s about warmth, flexibility, and genuinely kind people who go out of their way to make your stay special.

Want a 5-star experience? 69TheGrove is your next destination.

author: Poppy Z
title: A clean, comfortable stay at a convenient location
text: I just finished a solo week at this lovely facility.  There are 2 properties associated with the listing and they are across the street from each other (I stayed in the #8 building).  Located in a quiet residential neighborhood with walkability to tube stations at Vauxhall (which is also a major bus depot and has other trains) or Oval, check-in was easy and my room was ready as promised.  The room was up a flight of stairs and contained a double bed, nightstand with lamp, small wardrobe, single chair with folding table, small shelving unit, dorm-size refrigerator with water and soft drinks for purchase, electric kettle and accoutrements for (free) tea/coffee/hot chocolate, hair dryer, bath towels, as well as travel-size shampoo, body wash, and dental kit.  A small fan was in the room as requested at time of booking.  The window overlooked the back of the property and was easy to open for air circulation.  Bathroom was spotless, but larger guests may find it cramped especially regarding commode/sink placement.  There are hooks on the back of the room door, but I would have appreciated some extra hooks on the bathroom door to hang towels for reuse.  Breakfast served starting at 08:00 was made-to-order (by one of the hosts) and filling.  Choices included sliced fresh fruit with optional yogurt to dollop on top, o.j., cereals, full English breakfast, porridge, omelette, tea or coffee.  The staff was warm and attentive.  Room was tidied daily with towels replaced as needed.  Many plants and fresh flowers in the room contribute to a homey atmosphere.  A small patio on the roof was a nice hideaway to eat my take-out meals (set up for smokers, but I never saw anyone up there).  Would be quite happy to stay here again!

Plenty of nearby places to eat.
Cereals and cooked brekky is just what you need to set you up for a day's sightseeing.
Shampoo/body wash/toothbrush and paste, tcmf (free), water and cans in the fridge (chargeable, but cheaper than any shop).
Hairdryer/slippers/big towels/heater/fan in the room.
We had a basement room, so no view , but still plenty of air and light let in.
Nothing is too much trouble for Kanley and David and you'll definitely have a laugh here.
It's a bargain....given the nice area you're in (the Oval is just up the road) and the close proximity of transport /attractions.
Many thanks to all staff here.🎾❤️

author: Noah J
title: Excellent B&B in the Vauxhall section of London
text: 69The Grove proved to be a truly excellent Bed and Breakfast for my four-night stay in the Vauxhall section of London. I had a comfortable bed and wonderful breakfast every morning. The hosts were all friendly and welcoming. FIVE STARS ALL THE WAY.

author: Zoe G
title: Lovely flat and lovely people
text:
We stayed at the Grove for two nights for New Year and it was really good. 
The hosts are lovely, continental and English breakfast are both extremely tasty, and location is really convenient! 
Will definitely stay again.

author: Chloe O
title: Great location and clean/comfy room
text: Quaint bed and breakfast that is owned and operated by a lovely couple. Excellent service and quick to respond to any messages I sent. Convenient location for public transportation (metro and bus station is 3 blocks away). Lovely and very filling English breakfast served at 0800, 0830 or 0900, with the option for a continental breakfast if leaving earlier in the morning.  Coffee, tea and hot chocolate in the room along with a fridge and water kettle. En suite bathroom, comfy bed, and clean room. Rooms were tidied up daily. Was able to store luggage before getting into the room and prior to our flight out. Lastly, there was a beautiful roof top garden which was a perfect hangout spot to drink a beer or glass of wine. My sister and I will be staying at this location again when visiting London. Highly recommend.

author: Louis F
title: Great stay in great location
text: We stayed three nights and were very comfortable. The bed was great. It was quiet at night. The breakfast was delicious- especially the fruit salad. And the location was excellent - walking distance to The Eye, for instance, and easy access to two tube stations.

author: Gavin N
title: Good location,  great Full English Breakfast
text: We stayed for 5 nights this visit.  The staff, location , price and general vibe is hard to match.  There’s 2 tube lines within 10 minutes,  also a central bus and train connection.   We also enjoyed the Vauxhall beer garden along with some French Tacos nearby.

author: Grace L
title: Ver happy staff
text:
Positioned not far from the station. An ideal location from which to explore London.

The rooms are clean and well appointed. Our room was downstairs and unfortunately was quite small.

The breakfast was delicious with the staff are very jovial

author: Katie I
title: A great little gem
text:
This is a great gem in Vauxhall, very close to London City Center and the tube. The location is cozy and quiet, which is great if you're looking for a nice sleep.

The owner and staff are very friendly and accommodating. The room we got was very nicely cleaned and sizably, but the bathroom was quite small which was the biggest negative. But fortunately you don't spend much time in there anyway, so not that big of deal. The bed is huge but somewhat soft, and we had two different pillows to choose from.

The B&B being an old Victorian house unfortunately also meant that a lot creaks in the house, the floors and stairs etc. so when people move about in the house, it could be quite loud. Just a minor nuisance though. 

The breakfast is great, especially if you love classic English Breakfast. There's sausage, eggs, beans, mushrooms, bacon and tomato. If you have special wishes for your order, they will also listen and take that into consideration. Then there's fresh fruit, toast, jam, coffee, tea and muesli/cereal. And if you have to leave early outside of normal breakfast hours, they will even prepare some breakfast for you if you ask them to.

Inside the room you also have an electronic kettle to boil water, and tea and coffee. There's also a minifridge with very reasonable prices. We had 4 colas from the fridge 1 pound each, and when we had to pay upon our leave, we didn't have any cash. But Kanley was very kind to let us have it on the house, talk about great service!

Great place that we can easily recommend!

author: Emma V
title: Great location.
text:
Great location and front of desk staff polite. 
Breakfast is a waste of money- make your own, Tesco is around the corner. Rooms were tidy. However they clearly don’t clean under the bunk, so looking up when in bed and seeing unidentified smudges was gross!

author: Oliver H
title: 100% RECOMMENDED ! Amazing Team & Athmosphere - Shout out to Jasser !
text:
I recommend Smart Russel Square 100%. I have to say that this chain of Hostels are the BEST ONES in London. Amazing price for a safe, secure and organized place to stay. I did my research and this one is THE ONE to choose, along with the Hyde Park Inn one. I felt great during the time i stayed in this one. One block away from the Russel Square Underground Station, which is in front of a 24 Hours Tesco (Life saver ! heh) and 2 blocks away from The Grym Group Bloomsbury, also 24 hours which for me is EVERYTHING - The storage included with the bed is spacious and secure, and there's extra for big bags outside the room, also very safe. Big common area, big kitchen, fully equipped. Place is kept clean permanently, which is appreciated. The team is very kind, friendly and always worried about making your stay even better. A special thanks to Jasser, who helped me on every request i had. Im extremely grateful to him. Thanks Jasser, keep up the amazing work ! And see you again soon !

PabloH.
Chile

author: Olivia K
text: I was my second time there i was really good. The staff and the place were great, is a good area to stay and also well conected to the whole city. I will be back for sure.

author: Lily T
title: The accommodation left much to be desired
text:
The room was not comfortable, I was disappointed. The bed was a triliche, and the bed above was very difficult to lift up. In addition, the space between the beds was very small, leaving the room tight. It was impossible to sit in his own bed and the curtain didn't close. There was also only one fan for the whole room, so it was very hot.

The bathroom also left to be desired. There was no room to support the products and the clothes and the shower water was cold.

The dining room was spacious and the breakfast was delicious but the rules of silence were not respected. Even in the early morning they had hosts speaking very loudly in the cohabitation area.

author: Mason I
title: EM
text: Very good, nice staff, big large kitchen, big large lounge, tv, AC everywhere, a big place,has a garden. Excellent...

author: Sydney T
title: Decent address for a short stay
text: Very good location (Euston and Saint Pancras stations, services nearby, tourist sites to visit). But the room is not very welcoming, narrow, in the basement, constant background noise. Bathroom decent and clean. Breakfast very decent and good value for money. The staff pleasant in the morning, a little less welcoming at check-in.

author: Anna L
title: It's okay for a week
text: The location was very accessible to different options of public transport. The rooms and beds are very small, and the bathroom isn't the most comfortable. The water was mostly cold and with extreamly strong pressure, not pleasent to take a shower. The atmosphere is fine, but sometimes very noisy in the common eating area, more space in the fridges and food storage could be nice, considering the capacity of rooms and people, the kitchen space doesn't seem enough.

author: Joseph Q
title: Not a place where you can sleep
text:
My partner and I stayed for four nights, and we couldn't sleep a wink on any of them because the staff didn't bother telling other guests about the "quiet time" policy (11 PM to 7 AM). People would check in at all hours, enter the room, turn on the lights, bang on lockers, shower, and watch TikToks at full volume. Keep in mind it was a six-person room; whenever we tried to tell people not to make noise or turn on the lights at 2 AM, things only got worse—and the staff, despite being informed, did absolutely nothing.

Also, even though the six-person room has a private bathroom and the guests change every night, it isn't cleaned daily; we had to deal with the smell of urine for two nights, and the bathroom was rendered unusable thanks to one guy.

The location is good, but that’s about it. If you’re actually looking for a place to sleep, it’s not worth the price. The staff has zero authority, and despite the place claiming to be a youth hostel, we encountered uncomfortable situations involving older men in our room. Don't come here.

author: Gavin R
title: Good location, uncomfortable and cramped
text: Good location and decent price, but the beds were uncomfortable and small, the rooms were tiny and cramped, and I got locked out of my room before. The check-in staff was also a bit dismissive and unfriendly.

author: Erin T
title: Excellent hostel experience
text: Very clean and organized. Well resourced facility that allows you to cook if you want, get updates on current news and all. I cant fault anything besides many steps to the third floor.

author: Megan F
title: Bad
text: Probably one of the worst hostels I’ve stayed at. Been at the Camden of the smart hostel departments and were happy with that so thought this stay would be similar but this were very different in the bad way

author: Katie D
title: Reasonably-priced rooms for short-stay
text: Stayed with a comrade for two nights, Friday 3rd-Saturday 4th July at Smart Hostel Russell Square. My comrade had an en-suite room, I had a room with access to shared toilets and showers. The room was clean and comfortable and the other guests abided by the rules to be quiet. The first keycard I was issued didn't work but the staff member at the front desk was able to issue a keycard that worked upon request. The hostel is a short distance from the nearest bus stop, so very accessible, and the rooms were reasonably priced for central London.

author: Louis V
title: I don't recommend it
text: Bathrooms inside the shared room are so small that you can hardly use it. Faced light issues in the washroom as sensor was set for only few secs. Light was turning off again and again within few secs. After making complaint, the manager set it for longer. That's good. But hand soap was filled after 2 days of complaint. Never go for the 9-bed shared room as 3rd bed is at the top and it's so hard to get there and even I fell down while coming down. When I was booking, it was showing only 9-bed room. I am never going to book this hostel again.

author: Zachary U
title: Fine hostel but uncomfortable at times!
text: Overall fine hostel, good location. The upstairs 3rd floor room was incredibly hot and stuffy with a few fans to circulate the air. Outlet didn’t work in the bunk. Shower/bathroom door didn’t close all the way and there was a weird gap at the top of the door.

author: Aaron E
title: Conveniently located. Clean. Small room but comfortable bunk beds. Needs educating about Guide dogs and the law. Would stay agai
text:
I'm sorry but this is a long one!! My husband (whom is deaf/blind and has a Guide dog) and I booked in June 2026. We stayed in a private room (Two Bunk beds, shower room etc) for one night.

There were two men on the check in desk, one of which was lovely and friendly, the other not so much. Just as we were about to head up to our room the other man stopped us and took issues with my husband's fully trained Guide dog. 

He didn't seem to understand that the dog was not a pet but a mobility aid/fully trained service dog.  My husband took out his and his guide dogs id/passport which on it states that refusal of entry is illegal/ against the law and that the guide dog is a recognised service dog. After trying to explain this several times, the man eventually rang the manager.

By this time, both of us were getting quite frustrated as we didn't know if we would have a room or not and we couldn't afford anything else.

He came back to us a while later and gave us another lecture on bringing a "pet dog" onto the premises. But thankfully he gave us the room that we had booked but upgraded us to a bigger one.

The room itself was nicely decorated, clean and the bunk beds were surprisingly comfortable. Plenty of plug sockets as well, which was a bonus.

The only couple of downsides were that the room itself and the shower room was very small but we managed. 

We would stay here again as it is conveniently located, but, the staff and the managers need to be educated about Guide dogs and the laws of them and their users so that if/when another stays there that there won't be subjected to the same problems.

author: Holly K
title: Good location, the facility is just adequate.
text: Hostel 5 minutes on foot from the British Museum and a short walk from Russell Square. Uncomfortable beds, too few bathrooms compared to the number of guests. Shared bathrooms and showers for men and women.

author: Molly P
title: Not the best
text: Stayed in 9bed female dorm. It was incredibly small for that many people, no where to put your bag, lockers are too small for bigger bags/suitcases and someone had taken mine, I confronted the person, they said someone took theirs. If you're on the third bunk it is impossible to sit up, I could barely bend over enough to fit in (I'm 5'8) you are expected to put your own sheets on, on this bunk it was genuinely impossible so just slept on the duvet they provide. The bathroom was tiny, shower was ok some hooks to hang your things. Didn't get to use the kitchen as unable to use in the morning but the staff did allow me to fill my drink bottle. I wouldn't recommend staying here for even one night, it is incredibly uncomfortable. No aircon, room was so stuffy but can't keep window people because of the noise. Definitely don't use as your base if you plan to explore London there are better hostels for similar prices.

author: Emma T
title: Good location but very small
text: Good location but the place is very small, the bedroom make a lot of noise when we are changing position or even laiding down.

author: Emma R
title: Very good hostel
text: I stayed in the four-bed room with a bathroom in the room. Everything was very good; the shared spaces of the hostel are large and well-equipped. The only suggestion for improvement would be that there could be at least shower gel in the shower.

author: Henry A
title: Uncomfortable and dirty
text: The tiny room, the very small bed, can not even sit without knocking the head very difficult and dangerous to get up and down the bed. I stayed in the female room with 9 beds and had a bathroom in the room but some rooms do not have a bathroom. The kitchen doesn't have ventilation and it smells awful.

author: Manon X
title: Super clean, great budget hotel
text:
Initially I was concerned about the booking made through Expedia.  I'd paid upfront for two single rooms months in advance. From the hotel I only got confirmation for one room and attempts to confirm the two rooms were conflicting.  As Expedia assured me that all was well I trusted them and rolled with it.  I needn't have worried as all was in order on arrival where my companion and I were greeted by a lovely young, well mannered receptionist. The area was  less salubrious than its neighbouring ones but it was lively and busy with people and travellers of all nations. Conveniently placed opposite was the Metro Barbes-Rouchechouart from where we were able to reach all parts of Paris. And even more conveniently placed was the Brasserie Barbes which was excellent. Downstairs was casual bar food and upstairs was more for dining with good French cuisine with a great ambience. The single rooms we'd booked were small, as expected, but the beds were double. The decor was a little dated with chipped paint on the corners but I have to say it was all incredibly clean. The pillows were plump and the bedding new, clean and brilliantly white. The shower and w.c. were separate and the sink was the smallest I'd ever seen, but cute.  I didn't have a wardrobe but I did have hangers and pegs with a couple of shelves which were perfectly adequate for the lighter traveller. There was a tv but no English channels.. not even BBC world news but that wasn't a problem as the wifi was strong and I used 
my phone to get what I wanted. As with the older hotels there was no lift so bear in mind that the spiral staircase could be a problem if you're not very mobile. Features like this are typically French which is what I love. Breakfasts were very good with a selection of baguette, croissant, pastry, cheese, ham, scrambled and boiled egg, Frankfurter, cereal, yoghurt, fruit, jams, teas and coffees... more choice than other Paris hotels I've stayed in and all for 12 euro, which is really good value.
Overall I would recommend this hotel as long as you manage your expectations.  It's 3 star so don't expect 5 star!  It's super clean, very friendly staff, run extremely efficiently with no waste whatsoever. Cost for a single room was £90.34/night staying in June.
I will be returning!

author: Pablo J
title: Correct
text: High price for a room small enough as for the bathroom

author: Abigail E
title: Avoid!!
text: Hotel is in the middle of a rough area, the metro station is opposite it which is good, however we are three young girls in our 20’s and there are just creepy men who will harass you and shout at you, outside the metro station and on the surrounding streets. These men are just constantly stood there all day and night? God knows why? Anyway, don’t bother bringing a 23kg suitcase here because there is no elevator, just tiny spiral stairs which the staff won’t help you with either. Beds are uncomfortable, they didn’t give us clean towels for 3 days, it’s absolutely freezing and the heating/ air con thing doesn’t work. Tv has no cable and doesn’t work either. Staff are pretty much useless too. They don’t give you water, but don’t bother with the vending machine because it only takes cash, lol who carries cash these days?. Weird dingy hotel. Avoid, especially if you’re a young girl.

title: To avoid

 He manipulates the numbers

author: Matthew H
title: DO NOT BOOK this hotel !
text:
Do not book , they ripped me of my money without authorisation and lied that I made the room messy and damaged towels . Not trustworthy at all . Get somewhere else . 
Not friendly at all , bad service

author: Elena C
title: Unauthorized charge after my stay — be careful
text: I stayed for 2 nights at the end of October. At check-in they took my credit card details for a €100 pre-authorization, which was later refunded. However, a few days after my stay, €500 were taken from my card without my authorization or explanation. I contacted them, but they now claim they cannot find my reservation, even though it was made through Booking.com. I had to block my card and report the incident to my bank. Very disappointing and untrustworthy experience — avoid this place.

author: Charlie W
title: DISGUSTING SERVICE
text: This hotel cancelled my booking while I was in Paris on the morning of my arrival as they said they were over booked. I then had to source another hotel while in Paris. I HAVE STILL NOT RECIEVED MY REFUND FROM THEM OR BOOKING.COM. This reservation was in September and it now the end of October. I will be taking this further to get my £310 back. DISGUSTING SERVICE DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL

author: Evie I
title: DO NOT BOOK IN THIS HOTEL
text: It should be possible not to assign even one dot. Bad hotel. Reception that does not speak English. Booking on their website my card was cloned and I had to block it and extinguish it with all that follows.

author: Sophia C
title: Nightmare of a Hotel
text:
STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!!
The hotel manager, Bruno is extremely rude and confrontational. When I told him there were cleanliness issues with the room, he got very defensive and lost his S#%!. Let the pictures speak for themselves. They will charge your CC without your authorization for their deposit and expect to know this policy. No other hotels in the city has ever done that. They consider themselves a 3 star hotel but it’s not at all close to what you pay for. You will only experience poor quality service from the person in charge (BRUNO) and poor sleep quality.  Reconsider your investment.

author: Carlos E
title: Horror
text:
Beware of this hotel.
The instructions say: City tax: 5.53 EUR per person per night. This tax is not charged to children under 18 years old. It was unfortunately charged to a 13 year old. Airport transfers only work away from the hotel. The price of the room was much more than whatever the maximum price was stated in the advertisement. The breakfast was miserable: croissants, rolls, one sausage and one ham. The pictures lie, the hotel is old and shabby. A child left a baseball cap at the hotel. They promised to post it. I tried to tell the child this, then they announced again in a message that it costs 100€. Is it really 100€ to post a small baseball cap from France to Finland? I tried to contact them about this, but they have no flexibility or sense of proportion. Having traveled a lot, I do not recommend it, it does not deserve 3 stars in any way. A classless hotel.

author: Henry A
title: This hotel has stolen over 500 Euros from me
text:
I booked a stay at this hotel on 21st April and was shocked when the hotel immediately charged my credit card for the full amount of my stay not once but twice, doubling the agreed cost. I immediately contacted the hotel but received no reply, so on the 28th and 30th April I contacted the hotel again via their own web site, but again received no response. Therefore I raised a formal complaint with the web site I booked with and they tried numerous times to contact this hotel but without success. On 13th May I contacted the hotel yet again and finally received the reply saying that a refund was already in progress.

Unfortunately, this turned out to be untrue. The money wrongly taken from my credit card has still not been returned, even though it is now over 7 weeks since the hotel claimed they would return the money and over 10 weeks since they took it. Whilst at the hotel I twice raised the issue with the manager who claimed repeatedly that the money had already been returned to my account and accused me of trying to get the money refunded twice. On return home I checked thoroughly both my credit card statements and with my bank that the money has not been returned to my account or any other account within my bank. I have had to cancel the credit card used to book this hotel as my bank deemed it had been subjected to fraudulent transactions by the management of this hotel. Since I returned home and made my view of the hotel management known I have received numerous emails refusing to even investigate the matter with the hotels bank and accusing me of trying to steal from him by getting a refund twice! I find it incomprehensible that the hotel management refuse to even pick up a telephone and ask their bank why the refund was never made to my credit card and to rectify this situation.

I can only conclude that the management of this hotel are THIEVES, LIARS and CREDIT CARD FRAUDSTERS. DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL!

author: Jack L
title: Simple but effective
text: 3* hotel in the lively Barbès district 50 m from the metro and the Barbès brasserie very clean hotel the staff is attentive and efficient. The rooms are comfortable and quite well equipped In short an address not to be neglected we had a good stay
