author: Sophia N
title: Lovely stay
text: Had a great stay here! The staff were so friendly and the night staff very helpful after my bag was solen containing our room key. The street was noisy but that didn't really bother us as its to be expected in the city! The aircon also wasn't the best however we were in a heatwave so it was of course hotter than normal. We would definitely stay again!

author: Michael U
title: Really really bad experience.
text:
During our stay at Hôtel Nation Montmartre from April 30 to May 4, we appreciated the friendliness of the staff. The service at the front desk was correct, and the employees were helpful and polite. Unfortunately, that was where the positive aspects ended.

Upon arrival, we were asked to choose in advance between a few types of bread and pastries for breakfast, which already seemed unusual. The breakfast itself was very disappointing: the selection was extremely limited, and most of the time there was not enough food available. What was offered was minimal and poorly presented. The scrambled eggs resembled chocolate mousse more than a proper hot dish.

The room did not match the photos shown online at all. It was outdated and looked very different from what was advertised. The shower was difficult to use—water temperature had to be constantly adjusted manually. The air conditioning couldn’t be controlled from the room and required a request at the front desk. On the last night, the air conditioning didn’t work at all.

A very important point: there is no elevator in the hotel. Guests with heavy luggage or limited mobility should be warned. We stayed on the third floor, but if you’re placed on the fifth, carrying your luggage upstairs can be quite exhausting.

Regarding the neighborhood, we found it to be rather rough and uncomfortable. Groups of young people were often hanging around, openly using drugs, and giving intimidating looks. As a woman, I would strongly advise against walking alone in this area, especially after dark.

On a positive note, the location is convenient in terms of public transportation—metro and bus connections are close and easily accessible.

Conclusion: despite the friendly staff, we cannot recommend this hotel due to the lack of comfort, misleading online presentation, and the unpleasant, unsafe feeling of the surrounding area.

author: Tyler M
title: Nice hotel, some issues re breakfast and stairs
text: Nice clean hotel, room good and extra pillows provided on request. It is in a noisy neighbourhood but it is Paris! Breakfast was 12 € which was basic but ok and less than you’d pay elsewhere- downside was that dishes were not replenished when they emptied so if you left it until 10 to have breakfast there wasn’t much left. Also there is no lift, we were on the third floor so 47 spiral steps to get there - this was ok for us but would be hard for someone with mobility problems, having said that I would not have liked to be on the 4th or 5th floor.

author: Rosie A
title: SCAMER!
text:
We booked this room, and what we found was shocking. The table was cracked, the bathroom door got stuck when closed from the inside, and there was black mold on the bathroom tiles. The doors were so thin that you could hear everything happening in the hallway.

To make matters worse, we were unfairly charged €100 for allegedly damaging the already broken table. When we tried to discuss this with the owner, he rudely told us that if we didn’t like it, we could leave—so we did. Instead of staying for three nights, we left after just one.

Booking.com refuses to take responsibility for the terrible conditions and issues we faced. The owner is a con artist who takes advantage of tourists, knowing they have no way to fight back. Avoid this place at all costs!

author: Zachary T
title: I do not recommend
text:
The positives: 

– Despite many negative comments I could see, I found the staff very friendly and helpful!
In addition, the hotel is not far from Montmartre and the center of Paris. 

The negatives: 

- The neighborhood is very uncrowded, we do not feel comfortable (people look sloppy, street dirty as abandoned ).  Moreover, the hotel is not located in Montmartre but next door.  
- The room has several defects, unacceptable if there were not the promotion offered by Booking! (Wallpaper that peels off from everywhere, plug that doesn’t work, air conditioner that smells weird when you turn it on,.. ) 
-NOISE!!! On my second night, I didn’t close my eyes from 1am to 4.40am because of the screaming neighbours. Very poor insulation and if you come across disrespectful people, impossible to close your eyes! 
WARNING, they ask to pay a tourist tax (normally included in the price offered by Booking ) but having read the comments warning of this, I did not let myself be done and they did not insist.

author: Taylor A
title: To flee absolutely!
text: We have made an online reservation on the hotel website. When entering our bank details, we have taken care to ensure that the total amount includes all taxes. We immediately received a booking confirmation, which clearly indicated that the balance payable was zero euros and that all taxes were included. Everything seemed perfectly clear, but what was not our disappointment, when we received a cancellation message the next morning! I immediately contacted the property by phone; the hotelier got lost in nebulous and unconvincing explanations, telling us that we had to pay an extra tax amounting to 62€! By the way, our room had already been rented to other people! This unscrupulous hotelier was truly unprofessional: not only did he not admit his mistake, but he was also haughty and very unpleasant on the phone. It was apparently not a trial run (other reviews can attest on the internet). I strongly advise against booking a room at this property! To flee absolutely!!!

author: Katie I
title: A pleasant stay despite some areas for improvement
text:
We had a pleasant stay thanks to the very welcoming staff and impeccable service. Special mention for flexibility on departure: they kept our bags the day we left, and we were able to enjoy the room until 11:45.

Some negative points, however:
	•	The towels should be checked more carefully (we found some hair, although it was minimal).
	•	Rooms lack soundproofing, which can disturb if you are sensitive to noise. The simple glazing also lets through the external sounds, but this remains bearable.

Overall, a good experience, especially thanks to the attentive and warm team.

author: Poppy S
title: Good for light travellers
text: The hotel is a great location, and right near the metro, however is expensive to access via taxi from the airport if you are flying into Paris at a busy time (evening etc.) the breakfast was also very good and filling - the rooms however like a lot in Paris are very very small, this was not really ideal as i had a lot of equipment with me for work, the staircase is very narrow and difficult to use with suitcases - something to bear in mind

author: Daniel N
title: Great hotel in a great city
text: Wonderful hotel. Great accommodations and super friendly and attentive staff.  The general manager Tomas was especially helpful, so friendly and great to deal with!  Will definitely stay again when next in the City.

author: Dylan W
title: Friendly staff
text: Staff(Tomas) was nice and courteous during my stay.  He was so friendly and we can have conversation every time I have to stop by.

author: Luca X
title: 5 Stars for Tomas for Hotel Manager
text: Had to cancel my business trip, and Tomas, the hotel manager was extremely gracious and understanding of the situation. The process was hassle free.

author: Zachary Y
title: Well located and comfortable.
text:
The location of the hotel is very good as you have two metro stations and many tourist and shopping places nearby.
There are nearby fast food and takeout options.
The friendliness of the gentleman who prepares breakfast makes you start the day with good music, smiles, and delicious food. The kindness of the entire team at any hour is a 10.

author: Aiden I
title: DO NOT STAY
text:
Hotel from the start was a massive disappointment. Booked a delux king and were told our room had been allocated to someone else as we didn’t check in early enough. 
Took. Was dirty,,toilet wouldn’t flush, t.v not working,,no hairdryer.osier cups form coffee, no water supplied. 
Air con hit and miss, windows wouldn’t open. 

This hotel is a disgrace. Please do not book if you expect any luxuries.

author: Nora N
title: Stay ANYWHERE ELSE!
text:
Our 11-night stay at Hotel Hayden was one of the worst hotel experiences we’ve ever had. We booked multiple rooms, and both were in unacceptable condition from the moment we arrived.
The wardrobes had no doors, just exposed hinges and screws where they used to be. The desk chair was completely unusable: unstable, unsafe, and constantly in the way because the room layout left no space to move around it. The shower clogged repeatedly, leaving us standing in a pool of backed‑up pipe water. Fresh towels arrived reeking of smoke, and the bathroom power outlet didn’t work at all.
The “included breakfast” was a joke: stale donuts, sad fruit that looked like it came from the throw‑out pile, and absolutely nothing else. No toast, no cereal, no condiments -  nothing resembling a proper breakfast.
Housekeeping was never done unless we specifically asked, and even then it felt like an inconvenience to the staff. One of the beds literally gave way on one side, forcing the person sleeping in it to teeter all night long.
And the gym? Filthy, dark, no airflow, and surrounded by mops and buckets filled with dirty water. It felt more like a storage closet than a fitness facility.
Hotel Hayden is not just disappointing -it’s negligent. Big warning: do not stay here

author: Ana T
title: Great location
text:
Disappointing place 
Terrible breakfast; it’s better not to have it.
Air conditioning in the room not working; reported multiple times, went up several times, but with no results.

Only the location is great

author: Maria S
title: DONT GIVE THEM THE 100$ DEPOSIT. ITS A SCAM
text: DONT GIVE THEM THE 100$ DEPOSIT ITS A SCAM TO GET MORE OF UOUR MONEY!!! They ask us during check in for 100$ safety deposit for the room and they told us that we are gonna get our money back 10 days after check out. 1,5 months later still nothing and they don’t respond to any of our emails. Also terrible beds too

author: Holly G
title: Excellent Hotel
text: Hotel with excellent location, only 3 stations from Time Square or 20 min walk, we stayed 5 days and every day cleaned and changed our towels in the room, have coffee maker in the room and recharge every day coffee, the room is spacious and with good views, the hotel staff very friendly, the price has breakfast included, they offer pastries, fruit, yogurt, coffee, which in my opinion is very good, plus the attention on the bar in the breakfast of Samuel and Francis who attended us always in good spirits!! I would definitely recommend it and repeat it.

author: Alice A
title: Pleasant Surprise..
text: Enjoyed our stay at the Hayden.  I look forward to staying there again!!

author: Adam R
title: Fantastic
text: We were allocated Hotel Hayden after our original booked hotel closed down indefinitely - after checking the reviews I was worried!!! On arrival the staff couldn’t have been friendlier, we had 3 rooms all spacious, clean with no smells and working air con so no complaints. Housekeeping came each day and replaced towels as needed and kept the room immaculate. Location wise I couldn’t fault it, perfect for the subway and our booked ice hockey game at Madison Square Gardens - overall minimal time spent in the room and the only thing I’d change is it would be amazing if a vending machine was available. Ignore the negative reviews though and make up your own mind

author: Marco D
title: Unprofessional and bad service.
text: Since the heater in our room doesn’t work, they move us into new rooms. However in next day, they deactivate our keys in the middle of the night without notice, and tell us to move back into another room. Truly unprofessional and bad service.

author: Ella T
title: Price Performance Ratio: POOR
text:
Location: very good
Reception/Lobby: very small.
Personell: OK
Room: We booked a Chelsea King Junior Suite. The Hotel Rooms are very outdated and cleaning was bad. Bathroom sink loose from the wall, like the room outdated.
Very dirty aircon and could not change it to prefered temperature. Connecting door to neighboring room made every noise audible.
The only positiv things: good mattress and every day clean towels.
Breakfast: very poor, we booked including breakfast but better to book without and have breakfast somewhere else!
Gym: very poor, small and not clean. Broken items have been reported but nothing was done about it. Entering very difficult due to broken door.

Conclusion: Price-Performance Ratio POOR

author: Lucy V
title: Not a god choice….
text: The only thing that is good in the hotel is the location… the rest is terrible… breakfast terrible, cleaning terrible , have to left a caution of 260 dollars at the end they told me that they will charge 60 dollars from that car but they have charge 220 dollars… so my experience with Hotel is terrible .. chose another hotel there’s a lot of hotels in the area… don’t recommend

author: Lucy G
title: Pleasantly Surprised!
text:
We were sceptical of staying here due to the reviews and looked at changing hotels last minute, however I’m glad we didn’t. Whilst the rooms are basic and can be a little bit worn in places, it was everything we needed for 5 nights in New York and especially for the price. The location is great, bed is comfy, bathroom and shower spacious.  

We didn’t spend much time in the room, more just for sleeping and was everything we needed!

author: Nora T
title: Cheap and basic
text: Far from 4 star! Broken and tatty furnishes in the room. Breakfast probably the worst I’ve had at any hotel worldwide, we skipped it most mornings, served in a cold room on paper plates with very basic/minimal choice. No rooftop bar (told it was under renovation). Comfy bed & decent shower, about it. Okay if cheap.

author: Lucia G
title: They're terror, watch out for reserve
text:
They canceled the reservation I had with the hotel a day before I arrived; because according to them they have to charge a night before check in
And since I didn't get the notice of that charge they canceled my reservation 
A mess, and I see from the comments that I wasn't the only person who happened to him something like this. 
On top of that they tell me to look for another hotel by booking 
I don't recommend it at all

author: Louis W
title: Without heating
text: In this hotel does not work the heating, I stayed with my family and friends a week ago, 3 rooms all with the same problem. With 20 degrees below zero the entire hotel welcomes you with the reception frosty, the receptionists are all stuffed in ski jackets with stoves on the counter. Breakfast you have to do everything dressed, heating everything in the microwave because ice cream and in the room we had to call the technician every day because cold air came out of a very old system. It only worked for a short time, then that's it. Terrible we asked for a full refund.

author: Oliver R
title: Not sure why people are giving this a positive rating.
text: This is barely a three star hotel. Broken toilet, bad smell in the room, lumpy mattress.  The gym is minimal, with a broken door. This place needs a serious upgrade.

author: Hugo K
title: 1-Star (and that’s generous!)
text:
Hotel Hayden is absolutely not a 4-star hotel. If I could give it 0 stars, I would.

From the moment we arrived, it was clear something was wrong. The lobby was freezing, and when we asked the front desk about it, we were told it was cold because the door was constantly opening—despite the fact that it was 23°F (-5°C) outside. That explanation alone should have been a red flag.

Our room was somehow even colder than the lobby. The thermostat was set to 81° on “auto,” but the air blowing into the room was cold to the touch. We switched it to heat and waited, assuming it needed time. Eight hours later, when we returned, the room was even colder. We called the front desk and were told the heat wasn’t working and that their “engineer” was unavailable. The only solution offered was a space heater, which we were not comfortable running overnight while sleeping. The best they could do was refund the $37 facility fee—no extra blankets were offered.

It somehow got worse.

When we sat on the bed, we heard a loud crinkling noise. The mattress was covered in plastic, making it unbelievably uncomfortable and noisy. The sheets were thin and rough, adding to an already miserable night. The bathroom shower was covered in calcium buildup, and half the shower head nozzles didn’t work, making it difficult to get even a quick shower.

We originally booked two nights, but after one night in a freezing room—which left us both feeling sick—we checked out early. When we explained the situation, we asked to speak with a manager and were told they were “out sick.” Ironically, the front desk itself had a large space heater on the counter, clearly indicating that the heating issue affected the entire hotel. We made it clear we would not be paying for the second night.

This place is poorly maintained, poorly managed, and completely misrepresented. Calling this a 4-star hotel is laughable. It felt less like a hotel and more like a property run by a slumlord cutting corners at every possible turn.

The most frustrating part? This hotel is located in an area surrounded by hundreds of far better options. Do yourself a favor and stay literally anywhere else. I would never recommend Hotel Hayden to anyone, and I’ve made sure to warn everyone who’s asked about our NYC trip just how inexplicably bad this place was.

author: Olivia Z
title: Clean, modern and well located
text: Central for a few days and arrival/departure from Gare de Lyon

author: Morgan A
title: Pleasant stay
text: Although the rooms were quite small, the hotel has a great living area and is very close to the metro and train station, in addition to having great restaurants and good commerce around. Requested and friendly staff, in our case especially the Brazilian girl at the reception. Air conditioning works very well. Our 8 day stay was very pleasant.

author: Sara T
title: Very good
text: Very decent for a short stay.

author: Erin A
title: Great hotel for a short stay
text:
Very nice and efficient hotel for a short stay or layover.  

The rooms are spacious and clean.  Despite being close to the planes the rooms are very quiet with minimal noise from upstairs guests. 
The bed was very comfortable and large.  

In the room there is a hanging area for clothes, hair dryer, mini fridge, safe, a desk and chair,  2 kinds of shampoo, body wash, hand soap, and body lotion. 

You can collect further items for free such as toothbrushes, shaving kits, comb, sewing kit, shower cap,  and more from the lobby next to the check in area. 

Travellers self-checkin using one of the multiple screens available and staff are on hand to help.  

The breakfast was great! With so many options.  There was gluten free bread and non-dairy milk options. Barista coffee is included in the breakfast option, or you can purchase coffee separately if you don't add the breakfast option. 

There are two downsides: The lights and Tv are controlled by the in-room ipad or an app.  A bit annoying if you quickly need to turn on a light at night.  

Secondly the shower tiles do not direct the flow of water well and the shower curtain doesn't stop the water from flooding the bathroom floor.  The floor is the bathroom gets easily flooded when you take a shower and it runs all around the toilet.  You need to dry the floor after every shower.

author: Lucy K
title: Unacceptable reservation
text: How is this possible??? 3 rooms reserved for the night of July 11 to 12, the 3 people stopped by in the early afternoon, the rooms were not ready which is understandable, they warned that they would arrive during the night... Arrived at 3 a.m. and there were no rooms available, they were redirected to Opéra, so no, this is not acceptable, they had worked all evening, were taking the train early at the Gare de Lyon... completely abnormal given the prestige of your establishment.... I will think twice before booking with you again!!!!

author: Alice F
title: Felt Like A Dormitory
text: Three clerks and no greeting!  We fumbled through the self-service registration process until a clerk told us we could toggle from French to English.  We walked through a pitch black hallway and elevator bank, not unlike a parking garage.  The room was TINY.  A square bed was shoved into one end of the room with no room on either side.  There was not enough room to easily accommodate two people and luggage.  The sink was in the walking space just inside the door.  The bathroom and shower had no real walls, only frosted glass.  I could see the blurred image of my husband on the toilet!  Egads!!  What idiot thought that was a good idea?!  Hey--the breakfast was good.

author: George J
title: Beautiful view of the Seine 😍 great location
text:
Always satisfied with this establishment. Last-minute reservation after 5 hours of train... to enjoy the air conditioning during this heatwave. 
8th floor with a view of the Seine and in the distance, the Eiffel Tower
 Hearty breakfast. 
Always a bit of gymnastics to access the bed by the window side, but that's the concept. Very good bedding.
And great location to catch the train the next day.

author: Nora L
title: Amazing stay thank you
text:
We had a lovely stay at CitizenM.  Very conveniently placed next to Gare de Lyon which gave us easy access for Euro Disney.  Bed was large and comfy, nice shower and plenty of places to put your things.  If you have a lot of luggage then you might want to choose a bigger room or hotel.

Checking in and out is fairly easy once you’ve got the knack of it.  

Loved the free refill bottles of water you can take to your room too.

We also loved the hidden gems to visit so close by as well instead of the more obvious and crowded places to visit in Paris.

Would definitely stay again

author: Mia O
title: BED BUG! OUTRAGEOUS
text:
BED BUG! OUTRAGEOUS
And exceptional response from customer service!

I spent a night in this hotel where the cleanliness seemed a bit questionable to me. I am, however, a long-time customer (New York, London, Paris with groups of more than 20 people). 
I was bitten and just spent a week with severe itching and bleeding with my wife. At 300 euros for the room, I received an apology on May 1st, then after my complaint, I was surprised to receive no gesture, just 100 euros refunded, and finally, following my last request, this extraordinary phrase: "To provide you with some clarifications, every merchant is legally bound to an obligation of means and not of results." 
I am publishing this review factually: bed bugs have been confirmed by the hotel itself, in writing. The business response proposed to date is, in my opinion, completely insufficient considering the damage suffered.

author: James V
title: Perfect place to land in Paris!
text: I landed at Charles de Gaulle at 11 am and I was already checked into my room and showered and ready for a quick nap by 1pm! The fact that they had a room ready for me was so helpful. The room was absolutely immaculate and super modern decor. The bed sheets and comforter were top notch. I loved the bath products as well. I was able to walk to the Jardin des Plants and onto Rue Mouffetard in like 22 minutes. Then onto the Pantheon and to Notre Dame. The next day I had a train to catch out of Gare de Lyon and it was so convenient. The common spaces and restaurant were an added bonus. Would definitely stay there again!

author: Jack K
title: Not great check in service
text: Lovely hotel, great location, staff lovely but… say we can check in from 2pm. We are only here for 2 days, one night so sightseeing as soon as we arrive, travel to hotel to check in - ‘no rooms available’ on system!!!! Sitting in bar til it is sorted out… 40 mins later we are still waiting, eating in to our limited time here, no apologies, no complimentary drinks/food etc desperate to check in, ditch stuff, get back out there exploring but instead here waiting waiting waiting 😢

author: Mia I
title: Small room without comfort.
text: We stayed one night after arriving in the evening at the Gare de Lyon, a great disappointment; I start with the only positive aspect we found, the complete soundproofing both externally and internally. Overall, everything was negative: the room was very small, with a bed next to the window that prevents a person from being able to get down independently, the sink was not in the bathroom but inside the room, closet space was practically zero, there was no blackout curtain with light filtering in completely, and there was a lack of a bottle of water, a kettle, and slippers. Additionally, the reception welcome was very cold, with few explanations and a lack of minimal knowledge of the Italian language. The experience was definitely negative.

author: Antoine L
title: Handy location
text: Our room on the 14th floor was clean and adequate for a one night stay before our early morning departure from Gare de Lyon which is a very short walk away. However, having the double bed squashed against the window so one person had no option but to climb over the other to get in and out of bed was really unnecessarily mean with space for a modern tower block - I'm used to tiny room in old Parisian buildings but this was really too tight for space!

author: George L
title: Budget Priced and Very Friendly Staff
text: I had never stayed at a CitizenM Hotel before so it came as a bit of a surprise as to how it all works. It is budget friendly with a bit of quality in some ways and cut price in others. I was taken back by the check-in process being all iPads with large table (no desk) but it works. The staff were really friendly and helpful. The room was comfortable, but very small. The hotels facilities as far as lounge/bar, computer/media area were fabulous. I can see how the concept works. The breakfast was very good, and they have proper trained baristas - winning!!! The location was awful. I chose it as I needed to get the train, but it was so far from anything else. Having said that, I had an easy walk to Gare de Lyon Station after checking out.

author: William K
title: Great location; "kitchy" cute atmosphere!
text: An adorable, "kitchy" kinda place! Very close to metro underground [which we easily learned to use daily, even with transferring lines!], conveniently located; felt very safe walking back to our hotel in the evenings once it was dark. Rooms clean, sparse, & quiet. Excellent room service twice during our 7-day stay. Great value @ significantly lower price compared to other nearby hotels. Breakfast delicious; canteen available for purchasing snacks. 1 minor setback: Though a small closet to hang some clothes, there was insufficient drawer space, so we needed to use our suitcases as a "drawer". That said, we still highly recommend citizenM Paris Gare de Lyon for all the other reasons we've noted here.

author: Caleb C
title: A great central place to stay that won't break the bank! With amazing customer service!!!
text: This is our fave place to stay when we come to Paris. This was our 3rd stay here and Lavinnia still remembered us! We really enjoy the lounge/bar after a long day walking around Paris. Some names need to be dropped here Lavinnia, Kika, Florian and Nassib for going out of their way and making us feel welcome and ensuring we had everything we needed. The breakfast buffet is worth every penny! The rooms are small but very very comfy! We will most def be back! Thank you!!!

author: Camille M
title: Great hotel with great prices, fantastic king size bed....:)
text:
Hubby and I booked this hotel as we had stayed in this hotel in London and loved their rooms etc.
The hotel is right beside the train station Gare de Lyon. There are restaurants and few suburbs if you dare to walk a bit from the hotel. There are also stores, like Carrefour express and others if you want to buy juice, coffee, tea elsewhere apart from the hotel.
The hotel is reasonably priced. We stayed on the 5th floor in a corner room with a view of the clock.
Check in is digital. There are people present to help you though. One enters from the street and takes the elevator to the 1st floor. The hotel is clean. Had a lobby, working space , a bar and restaurant. There are also machines where small foods can be purchased. Water is avilable too here.
The room was spacious with amneties needed for our stay. Shampoo, toilet paper, conditioner, lotion etc. All is controlled with an ipad. That is, the temperature of the room, the blinds, the curtains, the tv, the lights etc. Really nice. One can eve google cast from their phone to watch one prefers.
The bed was large and very comfortable.
All worked very well. There should be a charging station on the side of the bed toward the wall/window.
Secondly, although this is a fantastic hotel, it is a bit away from the sites- Louvre, Eiffel tower etc. So think about htis when booking. I do not regret my booking at all, however on the map the hotel looked closer to all the sites than expected.
Uber and Bolt are available. ;)
The staff were wonderful. One could store luggage if you happen to have to check out and your flight leaves later in the day.

Thank you sooo very much for your service. We WILL be back and staying with you ...again!! 
:)

author: Katie V
title: Great location, but overall not worth it
text:
I  stayed one night at CitizenM Gare de Lyon. The location is excellent, just steps from the train station, which makes it very convenient for short stays.

However, the overall experience was disappointing. The main issue was cleanliness, the floor was dirty, and there were crumbs and hairs around the bed. This is not acceptable at this price level.

The room is very compact, which I expected. It works for one person, but for two it becomes impractical, as the bed is positioned wall-to-wall and access is limited. The sink is in the room, and the bathroom is compact but functional—size itself was not the issue.

The check-in process is entirely self-service and overly complicated. It requires multiple steps with QR codes and phone interaction just to scan an ID. Many guests were struggling at the same time. There is limited staff presence, and overall very little explanation about the hotel or its facilities.

It was unclear what services were available. The rooftop bar mentioned in the elevator was closed during my stay.

At around €230 per night, I expected a significantly better experience. I would not return.

author: Emma R
title: Great people, a welcoming stay, and a home-from-home vibe. 5*!
text: I had a great stay at CitizenM Paris Gare de Lyon. My first time at a CitizenM but certainly not my last. It felt like a real home from home. Yes, the bedrooms are small, but they're very well appointed and comfortable. Enough space to relax (the huge bed was super-comfy) and to work. And if you need more space to work or relax, the public areas are perfect. On top of that, the mainly young staff are really friendly and go out of their way to make you feel welcome. Food and drink available 24/7 too. Deserving of a 5* review, and I'll certainly be trying CitizenM in other cities too.

author: Sydney G
title: Very good stay
text: A very good balance between comfort, calm and qualitative common areas!

author: Mason Q
title: Lovely staff
text:
Lovely clean room and hotel. 
Fantastic breakfast. 
Great location. 
Rita on the front desk is a credit to the place. Absolutely lovely person. I was queuing to collect my luggage. I watched her speak to everyone in front. She couldn’t do enough for people & then she was just the same with me. Can’t fault her at all.

author: Adam J
title: conveniently placed hub
text: location was great for Kings Cross & Eurostar. Room was spotless - comfy bed, all i needed for a good nights rest before an early start.

author: Zachary Y
title: Best Staff about
text:
I have been coming to the Hub at Kings Cross every week for over a year and wouldn't stay anywhere else. The rooms are clean and comfortable and location is great.

But the thing that brings me back each time is the staff, they are very attentive and nothing is to much trouble. 

Rita, Yasmin and Lauretta are the best as I'm always greated with smile and there are plenty of laughs making feel like a home from home. Can not rate them highly enough.

author: Lucy X
title: I'm not Arnold Swarzenegger!
text: Great location for Eurostar travel to and from Paris. Very convenient. I was surprised to be 2 levels down, but didn't spend enough time awake in the room to notice the lack of window/view. The room was small but well thought out once I'd organised myself. I really appreciated the good quality hand and body wash! A nice touch! Unbelievable breakfast the next day and the possibility to leave your bags until your train ride home. I'll be back :)

author: Marco B
title: Checkin process weaponised to extort an illegal surcharge.
text: I paid in full in advance for bed and breakfast but an illegal surcharge was levied for an increase in the breakfast price at the time of checkin. This is a breach of consumer law and of Premier Hubs own Terms and Conditions. I was threatened that I could not checkin and access my fully paid booking until I paid the illegally levied surcharge, essentially being blackmailed to pay. This is a wholly unacceptable practice and the silence from Guest Relations is deafening.

author: Miguel T
title: A great find!
text:
A great find in London. A short walk from King's Cross with loads of shops, pubs and restaurants nearby. The hotel staff were friendly, welcoming and very helpful and the room was spacious and spotless. Only niggle was the (frosted) glass door into the bathroom, i just don't like them! I like to use a bathroom in total, not frosted privacy!!
The bed was so comfy and the room was peaceful - no traffic noise, but I was on the lower floor under the ground, even so, cleverly built around a dug-out courtyard, natural daylight still came in through the window!
The bar area had a lovely atmosphere and drinks were decently priced. The breakfast wasn't luxury - but I wasn't expecting it to be. For the price, it was great - a good selection of hot & cold items. 
I would definitely stay here again.

author: Owen T
title: Very good
text: 2nd time staying in a hub, never disappoints. Paid £144 for the night which on a weekend is expected for pricing in London however breakfast would have been nice included in this price. Beds are super comfy and room was clean.

author: George S
title: Fabulous experience
text: My partner and I stayed here 29th July for 2 nights. We had never stayed in a hub hotel before and were pleasantly surprised. It was my partners 40th Birthday and once the hotel found out we were blown away with their kindness and generosity. A massive shout out to Rita who came to our room with a birthday card and lots of lovely goodies for my partner. It completely overwhelmed us and could not believe her kindness. She was an absolute gem and a credit to the hotel. As was the lovely man who checked us in (really sorry, we cannot remember his name!) and all of the staff there. We expected the room to be really small but it wasn't at all. The bed was a king size, the lighting controls were on the head board which made it really easy. The room and shower room were spotlessly clean, there was a rain shower as well which was a nice treat. Included in the room was a hair dyer, toiletries and hanging space for clothes. One thing we really noticed was how quiet it was, maybe the rooms are sound proofed! Had such a lovely sleep there and really welcomed the air con as it had been such a hot week! Downstairs there is a bar and spring area where we had a lovely breakfast. Included juices, tea and coffee, cereals and hot food. Also included in the rooms were free tea and coffee you could get from here and take to your room. The hotel is conveniently placed as only a 5 minute walk to Kings Cross and St Pancras train stations. There are numerous restaurants near by and a coffee shop opposite the hotel. All in all we had a fantastic stay at the hub by Premier Inn and will definitely return!

author: Caleb Z
title: Amazing!
text: Me and my partner stayed her for my 40th birthday and the hospitality was out of this world! Rita was especially accommodating by having a surprise tray with free drinks and birthday treats ready for myself. She organised us a complimentary breakfast in the morning and all the staff were unbelievable! I would highly recommend this hotel! Rita, you were amazing! Thank you all so much xxx

author: Jessica N
title: Everything you need for a short stay in London
text: A very comfortable and quiet stay at hub London Kings Cross.  The rooms are small but they have excellent space saving features (like a very clever pull out drawer under the bed to keep your suitcase).  The breakfast was lovely - and very reasonably priced, and all in all it suited my needs in terms of value, cleanliness, location and atmosphere.  However - the big plus for me was the wonderful team - and a big shout out to Rita in particular.  She is a great ambassador for the company and I really enjoyed speaking to her.  Thank you for a lovely stay.

author: Oliver E
title: Fabulous stay
text: Just had a brilliant 2 night stay . We booked two rooms and paid extra for the bigger rooms . The rooms were clean and big enough for what we needed with great air conditioning . Perfectly placed near to King’s Cross so we could get everywhere . We walked along the canal path to Camden which took around half an hour . The location to the coal drop yards was also really good . We will definitely stay here again .

author: Evie S
title: Rita on reception is superb!  We ❤️ Rita
text: We always enjoy our stay here and it’s mainly because of Rita.  She’s amazing! Rita is so warm and welcoming with her infectious smile. Nothing is too much trouble for her and she makes us feel cared for and valued and always remembers our names.  Thank you Rita xxx

author: Abigail Q
title: Last minute booking
text: Great location. Easy access to Kings Cross & St Pancras station plus Coal Drops Yard. Hotel staff were exemplary and we would definitely return.

author: Paolo J
title: Hurray for Hub Kings Cross
text: Second time staying here and it’s fabulous value if you are on a short stay in London. Located a short walk form King’s Cross n St Pancreas station very handily positioned. The room is compact, and we paid a little more for a slightly bigger room but it did the job. It’s a budget style hotel so don’t expect large spaces and bath robes yet there is everything you need. Bathroom with decent shower n soap (Ballis n Hardy’s) towels good. Two complimentary bottles of water. Comfy bed, sufficient hanging space and drawers for a couple of days. Decent large TV lots power sockets and lovely A/C which was a godsend due to the 36 C degrees when we stayed. The lack of a kettle may irk some people but there is a brew station located in the bar / breakfast area where you can drink as much tea / coffee as you like and the machine offers proper coffee. The only issue I had was our room located at -1 in the basement confused me as I’m not used to walking upstairs to reception but this wa sundered my bad. At £118 for a night when many places are more than double this for not much more it’s excellent value.

author: Katie L
text: The hotel was amazing for the price. It had all the necessities you may need and more. Staff were incredibly helpful and friendly and the seating area was perfect to eat in.

author: Noah B
title: KIngs X stay
text: Great location. Well designed room and reasonable price ( for London ). Thanks to Rita on reception for friendly advice /welcome

author: Freya K
title: Great team
text:
First off, a shout out for one of your team members Rita. I stay quite regularly when I am travelling for work and staying near to trains heading north and I have to say, when she is working, it is a delight she is - super helpful, super positive and super thoughtful - you have found a gem there.

The rooms are absolutely fine for a one night bolt hole as a solo traveller - I am a light sleeper and where possible the team and Rita in particular try and find me something quiet. I feel safe and secure and nothing is too much trouble.

author: Taylor K
title: Disappointing
text:
Regrettably, I am unable to provide a positive review for this hotel, with the sole exception of the friendly evening bar staff. The communication from the check-in team was exceptionally poor, as they failed to inform us that the water supply would be shut off for several hours that day. Furthermore, upon returning to our room to rest, we discovered large wet patches both directly outside our door and in the center of the floor, far from the bathroom. A staff member was actively vacuuming the wet areas outside our room, and we brought the interior patch to his attention, with him seeing it for himself. The patches inside the room appeared yellowly brown in colour when we dried our feet (seeing evidence from the state of our clothing after taking off our shoes). 

Unfortunately, the issue was neither properly resolved nor dried, resulting in the room feeling musty and damp for the duration of our stay. We attempted to follow official procedures to resolve this matter—providing our booking reference and details—in order to receive a response. However, after nearly three months, neither Premier Inn management nor any representative from the site has acknowledged our complaint.

It is disappointing that I have to escalate this matter to Trading Standards simply to obtain an apology.

author: Freya C
title: Great location
text: A great location, extremely close to underground and train station.  The hotel staff were friendly. The room was clean and bed comfortable. However our air conditioning unit only blew hot air. We reported this on our first day but it never got fixed. As we visited during August with extremely high temperatures outside our stay was very uncomfortable at night as our room was like a sauna.  We were eventually given a fan on our last night stay but too little too late

author: Sean E
title: Always a great stay! Highly recommend
text: I pretty much live at this hub - I work nearby and this is my home from home during the week. I’ve always had a wonderful experience here - including for the World Cup! (Although, I am disappointed England lost to Argentina 😉). In all seriousness, the team are great. I cannot thank Rita enough for her hospitality - she goes truly above and beyond and it’s always such a pleasure to see her. It’s not easy not being at home - she makes me feel like I’m there! Rooms are always spotless, noise levels are always minimal. I’ve always got everything I need. It’s a great location and decently priced! I’ve even recommended to friends who have stayed here now! Thanks team - you’re stars!

author: Harper H
title: Best hotel around Time Square for first time travelers in New York
text: Clean and comfortable rooms, friendly and accommodating hotel staff, worth every penny of the cost, quiet inside the hotel, secure hotel and room access, delicious food, happy hour drinks and meals, free flowing coffee in the morning to power your New York exploration!

author: Amelia B
title: Mold on vent and drain flies. Good location and price though
text: Had mold on the vent and drain flies in the room. Room also had dust in some corners. Other than that, good value, good location, and friendly staff.

author: Gavin G
title: Great value for the area. (Not a) Surprise- rooms are tiny
text: The rooms are half the size of a shoebox- this should come as no surprise to someone booking here! The room was extremely clean, and despite a busy, massive hotel during a major event weekend at Javits, you could have heard a pin drop in our room on the 14th floor the entire time we were there. The hotel was dead quiet during our stay. The location could not have been better for our needs, if it hadn’t rained one evening, we would not have taken a cab even once, you can walk anywhere you need to go in the area. It takes a little getting used to, the tiny room, and the tiny bed… I’m just under 6 feet tall, and laying on the bed my feet touched the tv, I had to curl up a bit awkwardly to sleep. However, it’s a small room, and this can’t be avoided. If you’re over 6 feet though, be warned, it’s gonna be rough to sleep in the bunk beds. That being said, for bunk beds, the beds were very comfortable, and I slept well despite the size restraints. Great view too. Check-in was simple and quick, check-out was even simpler and easier. We had to make some adjustments (we usually bring food and store in the mini fridge to save money), but for the value, you can’t beat this place. Would definitely stay again.

author: Ella K
title: Great first experience at the Pod Hotel
text: The staff were so friendly and helpful.  Requested extra washcloths and they were delivered exceptionally quickly. The room was clean, thoughtfully designed, and had all we needed. We had a great view! Good pillows helped with a comfortable restful sleep. The location was perfect for our trip centered on Radio City Music Hall. Will definitely come back!

author: Adam F
title: Good location and you get what you pay for! It's good for an affordable stay in NYC.
text: Good location and you get what you pay for! It's good for an affordable stay in NYC. Staff were friendly and helpful. It's nice that even though the rooms are small, they have extra bathrooms in the lobby area, plus a communal outdoor and indoor seating area where you can eat outside food.

author: Evie O
title: Pod hits the spot!
text: My favorite Euro-style hotel for quick NYC trips -- quiet, clean, efficient, and lovely staff! No need for en elaborate room when I'm gone for most of the day and evening -- but perfect for recharging and relaxing at the end of the day! Location is perfect and the rooms are perfectly and simply chic.

author: Zoe C
title: Great time
text: Great experience, will definitely return and recommend !!!! Staff were friendly ,Good location. !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

author: Manon T
title: Great stay in the city that never sleeps!
text: Can't beat this location at this price! The rooms are small but clean and comfortable, and are perfect for a trip in a city where you will be spending most of your time outside of the room. The staff was friendly and helpful. I can only say good things about my stay at Pod Times Square.

author: Elena U
title: Excellent
text: Excellent location, the room is somewhat small but the bathroom is very comfortable, the place is clean, the hotel staff is very friendly, highly recommended

author: William T
title: A jewel in the Times Square district
text:
I had stayed here a couple of times before and I can tell that the team has succeeded my expectations. 

The hotel is strategically located behind Port Authoruty buses terminal and very close to Broadway theaters. You can easily access New Jersey through the Ferry since the bus stops in front of the hotel. 

The three girls at the reception made us feel at home every time. Zahar has been recognizing us since our first stay. Thank you!!!

We love the views from the rooms and the design that allows the gust to have everything in place. And the gym is a great addition to the experience. 

We ❤️ everything and we would be back soon!!

author: Zoe A
title: Good
text: It was nice bed comfortable the location is very good but thre is no way to keep cold beverage in the room you shoujd think to put mini refrigerator in the rooms

author: Abigail O
title: Perfect NYC Home Base: Clean, Quiet and Great Location
text:
Great Location, Clean Room and Excellent Value for NYC

The location of Pod Times Square is fantastic. It is very easy to get to the subway and buses, and there is great walkability to Times Square, Rockefeller Center, restaurants, and so much of what you want to see in the city.

I was traveling with my teenage son, so we chose a bunk bed room, which worked really well for us. The room was very clean, the beds were comfortable, and we had no real issues with the room. It is small, but that is exactly what you are signing up for when you stay at the Pod. This isn't a hotel where you are going to spend the day lounging in your room. It is a great place to sleep, recharge, and head back out to explore the city.

One thing that really impressed me was how soundproof the windows were. You can actually open them slightly if you want to hear the sounds of NYC, but once you close them, the city noise practically disappears. That was amazing considering the location.

My one wish for the room would have been a second chair. We would occasionally come back between excursions to charge our phones and relax for a little while, and with only one chair, one of us always had to sit on the bed. I completely understand that space is limited, but even a small folding or compact chair would have been helpful.

There are no refrigerators in the rooms and no guest ice machines. Since we carry refillable water bottles, we needed ice fairly often. Each time, we had to go to the bar and ask the bartender for it. The staff provided it, but after several trips you start to feel like you are bothering them. An accessible ice machine somewhere in the hotel would be a simple improvement.

The hallways and even the lobby level bathrooms are surprisingly dark. I'm not sure what atmosphere they are going for with the lighting, but it was a little strange. That said, everything we used was very clean.

There was some construction happening during our stay, and one of the outdoor observation areas was closed. They also have a small gym, which was a nice bonus.

There is a market right around the corner where you can get absolutely anything you need and a delicious bagel place (Broad Nosh Bagels) across the street that was outstanding. The hotel has complimentary coffee from 7-11am and offers fresh baked goods and espresso drinks for purchase.

Overall, I would absolutely stay here again. For NYC, I thought the value was fantastic. The location is hard to beat, our room was clean and quiet, the beds were comfortable, and it gave us exactly what we needed: a convenient home base while we spent our days exploring the city.

author: Luca M
title: Best value
text:
Best price value, clean room with view.
Very quiet place, in the center of NY city.
Everything was perfect, staff and the room.

author: Evie O
title: Great location but room minimalist
text:
Unbeatable location, close to Time square, buses and train to airports. 
Room are very minimalists-double bed with 1 single metal chair… 
Felt very secure as room key are scan in the elevator which give you access to the specific floor so no stranger can walk around!!
Staff were friendly and very accommodating!!

author: Marco U
title: Very well
text: Juan Carlos Díaz assisted us in an excellent manner in the hotel lobby.

author: Zoe N
title: Good stay for solo travel
text: It was clean and they were running a promo through their website. Due to the promo, I found it to be a good value. I would stay there again for a short trip.

author: Louis Q
title: Nice hotel
text: Nice friendly staff , room spotless and cleaned every day . Nice bar . will def use again . Close to Subway and plenty of bars and eating places near by

author: Tyler G
title: Gem in the Apple
text:
A gem in the big city. Centrally located to anything in Manhattan, very accommodating staff. Rooms are tiny, but then again, what do you actually need when  in Manhattan?  Whimsically, I booked a room with a bunkbed. The rooms are probably somewhere around 500 ft.². I’m guessing. Full large size shower, bathroom area  big enough and when you walk into the room, basically a desk on one side with the safe and then the bed on the other side. All parts of the room were clean, beds were comfortable with charging stations at each bed and TVs at the foot of the beds. Notthat you had time to watch it any TV if you’re in Manhattan, but I used it almost just his background noise. I was up fairly high so  really hear any street noise but then again even if you do it’s Manhattan and rate wise. It was a steal. I would come back here without even a second thought. My only issue was that there was no light control at the top bunk, so I had to turn the light off and then climb up into the bunk, which was not a problem, but again because I was solo I had to sleep on the top bunk at least one night haha.  

Location was a big part of my choice. It’s so centrally located that I walked everywhere this time around though when I get lazy, I hop on the subway, but the weather was nice and again because of how central it is, I came back to kind of recharge for a half hour every now and then throughout my stay. 

It’s not the Ritz Carlton, but you’re not paying for it. You’re paying for a place to rest your head in a nice comfortable clean place. My whole day was less than one night at the Ritz and that’s including my train fare from DC lol

author: Samuel D
title: Great stay
text: We had an excellent stay at Pod Times Square! The staff was friendly, welcoming, and always willing to help. Our room was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The location is perfect just a short walk from Times Square and close to several subway stations, making it easy to explore the city. Check-in and check-out were quick. Everything exceeded our expectations, and we would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

author: Ruby A
title: Unfriendly
text: The hotel was adequate but the staff was not very helpful. I got charged for a night that I didn’t even use because my flight was so delayed.

author: Joseph U
title: Great location if you're going to the Gramercy Theater
text:
If you're going to a show at the Gramercy theater, this hotel is right across the street.

the public areas of this hotel are great--There's a cool rooftop lounge/restaurant,  a nice working/lounging area on the second floor, two additional on-site restaurants and an additional bar.

The room we had was small but clean, and the bathroom was very spacious. The hallway, though, was surprisingly grim--definitely due for some updating.
