We were simply told no (by a random staff member working the bar area - no signs, no communication). Again, no attention to smaller details that could make a big impact on a guests’ stay.

The following morning we woke up ready for yoga, but there were no signs indicating where it might be. Both my friend and I attempted to text the front desk (once we saw no one was working it), but never got a response. We walked around the entire campsite after a staff member vaguely pointed across the site and said she thinks it might be in one of the tents. As we started to head back, we noticed one of the tents had games outside of it. We trekked through the muddy grounds and finally found the yoga, although by this point we were late.

The yoga itself was run by Samantha and it was absolutely the highlight of our stay! It was a great relaxing session that worked in a few challenging moves so my friend and I could get some cool pictures. Samantha clearly cares deeply about her practice and is very good at what she does! 

The breakfast was very disappointing. The one cabinet holding a few pastries was broken, and there was a single large bowl of fruit, a few yogurts, and a bowl of hard boiled eggs that had run out before we got a chance to have any. It was super casual, disposable materials, and absolutely the bare minimum. 

Even check-out felt bumpy. We brought our stuff to the front desk at check-out time, and no one was there. A few other people were also standing around waiting. Again, no one responded to any of the texts we sent. Finally, someone did arrive to check us out, and then drive us back to the ferry.

Overall, this cost way more than it should have. The location is unique, and the yoga session was fantastic, but other than that this place was disappointing. A few small changes could make this place feel luxurious but instead it just felt like a kids summer camp.

author: Luke F
title: Amazing setting and nice details
text: You can’t beat the one-of-a-kind setting of a Governors Island stay. Also, I appreciated the little touches, like the Champaign and lavender scented towels, also the staff, especially the jolly guy with glasses. Thanks, Aleks!

author: James H
title: Not likely to return here
text:
This was our 4th time staying here and absolutely the worst. We got there and told us they had double-booked our room. So then we went to another room, which was a square box. The lovely GM did say he would reduce the price of the room and did.  The floor was pulling up and there was no hot water and the shower did not work. They sent someone to fix the floor and the shower. There was a private event this evening so the usual places for dinner and hanging out were occupied. They gave us free drinks. When we tried to enjoy them out of the hot sun, we asked for one of the sun umbrellas to be opened. The waiter there yelled at us that it was a private event. What did he want us to do. We asked where could we go to get out of the sun. They told us the yoga tent. We did that. There was only 1 log for 1 person to sit down. We left for dinner elsewhere and hoped they would fix the shower. When we returned later in the evening, the shower still did not work. There was now hot water. 
We felt the experience was not consistent with our previous stays and was lacking in hospitality for most of the time. The GM did try to help us and most of the staff was nice with the exception of the waiter.

author: Oscar U
title: No longer luxury, barely hanging on, avoid staying here
text:
My family has been visiting CR on Governors Island since 2018. What was once wonderful is now an unmitigated disaster - TLDR: Do not stay here.

The original operator has closed all of their locations; this is the last one standing and was sold to boutique hotel owner Dovetail + Co and is operated by Charlestowne Hotels using the Collective Retreats name.  

There has been no investment or renovation and all of the original tents are now worn, bent and beaten. The 8 yr old rattling air conditioners often have broken exhausts that are held together with duct tape and saran wrap.  The bathroom tent zippers are broken and the showers often lack hot water. Worst of all the staff are prone to telling you your reservation for a tent or dinner has been lost by unexplained computer issues.  

Oh and "breakfast" is now a few pastries you will have to fight over with other guests as there isn't enough food provided.  What was once true luxury (seat cushions, carafes, fans, rugs, breakfast on your tent porch etc.) is long gone and what is left borders on a Survivor episode at times.

The location remains unparalleled but there has been no landscaping or shade planted in 8 years and development has now encroached to the point where the site no longer has any nature feel remaining as tents are up against construction fencing and 6 story buildings.  Meanwhile the party boats offshore remain an aural menace at night.

It's a true shame as this was a really great place once, as past reviews will attest. It now needs to close until the permanent hotel facility is built here in a few years' time.

author: Zoe V
title: Did not live up to our expectations
text:
The location, tents and views are absolutely stunning. That’s what makes this even more disappointing. The operations don’t match the quality of the place. We couldn’t reach anyone by phone, our pickup never happened, we had trouble finding reception, and dinner arrived burnt after a long wait. The staff we eventually met were kind and clearly did their best, but the whole experience felt understaffed and disorganized. This place has incredible potential, but the service doesn’t live up to it.

A great location is not enough. This was amateur hour

author: Jessica Q
title: July 4th: Systemic Booking Nightmares, Listen to the Bad Reviews
text:
My partner and I just completed our stay here over the Fourth of July weekend, fortunately we were able to stay and see the fireworks and they were outstanding, but the rest of the weekend was not enjoyable. I am writing this review to warn others: please do yourself a favor and listen to the negative reviews here. There is a deep, systemic failure within this property's reservation management system, compounded by an absolute lack of compassion or willingness from management to correct their mistakes.

CRITICAL TIP IF YOU BOOK: If you choose to stay here make sure to book on their website, write down your confirmation number immediately and make sure you manually click the button to request an email. Their system does not auto-send a confirmation email. Having that manually requested email was vital, as it was the only proof I had to save our trip.

We booked directly on the hotel’s website a few weeks  in advance. A week before our holiday arrival, I emailed the property with a simple follow-up question, only to be informed that our reservation had been completely lost. After being forced to provide our manually requested email proof multiple times, and a screenshot of their system that still showed we had a confirmed booking, they finally agreed to accommodate us—but they still downgraded us from our confirmed room category.

This is an ongoing operational issue. While on-property, I spoke with another guest who had booked through Booking.com. They had received a sudden cancellation notice from the platform out of nowhere. The only reason they were able to force the hotel to honor and keep their reservation was because they had separate, active email correspondence with the General Manager about room preferences, where the GM had completely failed to mention any issues with the booking.

Worse, at check-in, I witnessed a family of six who had booked and confirmed two separate tents. Upon arrival, they were abruptly told their reservation was changed, and they were forced into a single suite with mattresses thrown on the floor for the kids.

Management has zero control over their inventory, and they show a complete disregard for the guests paying premium holiday prices to stay here. Save yourself the stress and the headache, stay somewhere else.

author: Ian P
title: Disappointing Glamping Weekend
text: This is my review of our very disappointing glamping experience on governors island NY.  We booked through Booking.com and they had 1 basecamp left and we booked for Friday July 3 & Saturday July 4th checking out Sunday July 5th.  We received confirmation of our reservation and paid $2600.00 in full for the trip.  My husband and I were not only celebrating the 250th July4th holiday but our 20th anniversary together so we booked the trip and paid for overnight parking in NYC at $140.00 and the ferry to Governors Island.  We were extremely excited about this trip even in the middle of a heat wave in NYC so it was literally 100 degrees by the time we got to the island.  We went to check in only to be told that our reservation couldn’t be found because their system didn’t sync with 3rd party vendors such as Booking.com.  The staff instructed me to call Collective Retreats directly which kept me on hold for like 20-30 minutes.  When I finally spoke to someone they stated the same they didn’t have our reservation and they didn’t sync with 3rd party vendor and since we had paid for the trip up front we would have to go through Booking.com for full refund. I asked why they have rooms advertised on 3rd party vendors if their system doesn’t sync with them to which they didn’t have an answer.  I went back to the staff who told us they only had a vacancy for Friday July 3 and they were already booked for the next day so we would have to check out the next day and we would have to leave the island before 2pm because of the 4th July holiday the ferry stops running so we would completely miss the fireworks.  I explained that I had booked the reservation for the 2 nights but the staff plainly stated that they were overbooked.  I agreed initially and they again had me call Collective Retreats only to be put on hold again.  So the staff checking us in said she would make a second reservation for us but it would not be the base camp we originally reserved but a tent, she stated it would be another 1900.00 for the night but I explained we paid for 2 nights in full but she stated we paid through Booking.com so they don’t have that money.  Finally after having paid $2600.00 that I would have to get back from Booking.com and knowing we would have to leave the island by 2pm and would miss the fireworks we decided not to spend anymore money or waste any more time in the scorching heat. The staff gave us 2 complimentary drinks at the bar before we left and I had actually sent my husband to the bar while I dealt with this entire issue and he stated that the staff at the bar was slow it took them forever to get two cocktails which I needed while handling everything.  For our complimentary drinks we grabbed 2 beers because we just didn’t want to wait another 30 minutes for cocktail.  I have to mention that the staff was nice enough but they seemed overwhelmed by the slow internet connection and this reservation chaos.  Interesting side note on the ferry back to Manhattan we ran into 2 women who had the same experience as us and also had to leave the island. It was truly a disappointing experience and especially since our nations 250th anniversary and our 20th anniversary only comes one.  We have a large number of people we told about our reservations and they are expecting our reviews on Collective Retreats and I will be sharing this very disappointing experience with all of them.  A final side note I contacted Booking.com and they apologized for our experience and issued us a full refund.  Next day we got a cancellation from Collective Retreats so I guess their system finally sync with Booking.com

author: Harry F
title: Inadequate breakfast service.
text:
Morning dining was a disappointment.
When we arrived for breakfast  at 8:15 there were bare scraps  of food that remained. No more eating utensils. 
Substandard coffee. Had to roam the kitchen prep area in search of spoons and other items . Coffee substandard.  Ending on a good note: The views of Manhattan were spectacular.

author: Marta B
title: Nobody in Charge
text:
Okay, we have not even gotten there yet and have to can this "Collective".  We were able to make reservations on Hotels.com, paid $1175 for 2 nights, but even before reserving the direct website has all tents/cabins "sold out".
So we have been trying to make contact with the Collective staff to confirm our reservation -- nobody answers phone or emails, there is an overseas booking biz where English is not understood and they cannot confirm bookings.
The Governor's Island Trust has given this Collective company a license to steal.  There should be basic customer service requirements .
Don't waste your time and money on a false promise.

author: Olivia M
title: Abysmal service - Avoid
text:
Unfortunately the food was excellent. I say that because the service was absolutely atrocious, to the point that the maître d’ did not know what time the last ferry was, and we would have got stuck on the island.

The evening started beautifully with an incredible sunset which felt fitting for my friend’s birthday. However it soon became apparent that we would have a long wait for our reserved table. 45 minutes and 4 conversations with the understaffed team later, we still could not get served as a single child was sat at the table that would fit our large party. The Maître d’ refused to ask the family to have their child join them on their table (which had available seats) and eventually our birthday girl had to ask them personally (they were very happy to oblige and made no issue with this request, and did remain at the table for another 30 minutes).

We ultimately sat ourselves (technically after the restaurant’s closing time at 9pm), got our own menu, and voluntarily put in the order. We also had to request knives for our silverware which was met with the question of whether we all wanted them.

This whole evening could have been saved if the staff was apologetic, but instead they offered excuses and tried to run up our bill by asking us if we wanted to have more cocktails (but were unable to provide us with water). At the end of our meal they offered to comp only our dessert, but this was already included as part of my friend’s birthday so it was an empty offer, and still with no apology.

The food is fantastic, and the setting is amazing but the staff needs a significant attitude check, and a lesson in hospitality. At the least they should know what time the public ferry leaves the island and should feel comfortable with providing a bottle of wine to a table who waited an hour for their birthday reservation.

author: Louis N
title: Avoid this place
text: Nice idea but beware!! No hot water for showers, club music party boats cruising by late at night blasting thumping beats past 2am. Camp provides ear plugs because of this and it's LOUD.  Also I had prepaid booking and they double charged me. No one to speak with that knows how to provide customer service to refund me. Absolutely NO customer service if you have a problem. Better to avoid this and stay in a proper hotel in NYC and ferry over during the day to enjoy the island.

author: Benjamin K
title: What is this!!!
text: We had en enjoyable one night stay in a Journey Tent.  Our first impression was/is still hard to describe, hence the review title.  The price and marketing of the property imply luxury, which is subjective.  Our impression is that management needs to give attention to the little details, things that would elevate the property beyond a mere campsite.  The real payoff was the unique location and unobstructed views of the New York skyline and the Statue of Liberty.  That’s priceless!

author: Antoine E
title: Negligence is part of the Collective Retreats business model.
text:
There should be a negative star rating - we've been unable to book a reservation use our CR gift card -- which I suppose happens -- but the phone listed on the website never, ever picks up. For weeks. Never. Ever.
According to google gemini the reason is this: 
"The catch is that even when you call exactly during business hours, they frequently let it roll straight to voicemail or leave people on hold indefinitely because their central office is so poorly staffed."
Negligence is part of their business model.
So we got on the ferry to Governors Island and walked to the facility and were told by the concierge, that they are unable to make a reservation. Any email address we were given don't work.

author: Matthew R
title: WARNING: Disastrous Experience - They didn't even notify me of the cancellation!
text:
I am writing this to warn anyone considering a stay at Collective Retreats Governors Island.

I had a reservation for my birthday tomorrow (April 22-23). The most shocking part is that they didn't even bother to notify me that my reservation was cancelled. I only found out because I had to call them myself after they ignored multiple emails I sent asking simple questions about the property.

To cancel a birthday trip—less than 24 hours before check-in—without a single word of notice is beyond unprofessional; it is deceptive and cruel. My entire birthday plan is now in ruins because they chose to stay silent while they knew my reservation was gone.

Their management clearly has no regard for their guests or basic customer service standards. Do not trust them with your important plans. They will ignore your emails and leave you stranded without a word. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

author: Lucy W
title: Unique Stay with Amazing Views, but a Few Tradeoffs
text:
Collective Retreats on Governors Island is a really unique experience and a great way to stay somewhere different in NYC. The tents are well designed, comfortable, and the waterfront views of Manhattan are incredible.

However, there are a few things to be aware of. It is fairly expensive for what you get, service at the restaurant was slow during our visit, and there was a party boat nearby that went late into the night which made it less quiet than expected.

Overall, still a memorable experience and worth doing once, especially if you are looking for something outside of a typical hotel stay.

author: Pierre P
title: Priceless memory
text: The open fire and the ride to the location on the island was definitely beautiful while seeing the city from the island took me and the family somewhere else the service was amazing and the staff was wonderful now I have somewhere to go with the family every year truly was an amazing place to be.

author: Amelia Y
title: Noise not worth any price
text: Great way to celebrate a family event. Dining on property was excellent. Tents were as we expected. RED FLAG: you are next to a huge construction site. Noise was ridiculous.  Yes, we knew there would be boat and airline noise but the construction crossed the line. At any price, not worth the trip.

author: Hannah W
title: Bday, Couples Retreat!
text:
Incredible stay!
The stay at Collective Retreats was a birthday surprise from my wife. Where are we going? Governors Island. All I could remember as a tri-state raised person of GI is “abandoned,” “creepy,” and “not a big deal.” Well, after our stay all of those notions were dropped! Since our stay I’ve praised the Collective Retreats experience. From the pickupat the ferry to the drop-off at the island’s fancy spa, OC… CR has created a brilliant brand. It’s evolving and could get better! Our July 30 week stay was scorching hot. Unbearable for my wife, but we made it work! Between Brennan and Rashun working their magic for hospitality and the ground team always available, it made the whole experience work… And to have the restaurant and bar steps away was a treat! Delicious food, incredible views of my beloved NYC, the Statue of Liberty, and of course Jerz, aka New Jersey! Our waitress, Pandora, was so accommodating and professional. Staying at CR was glamping at its best for city dwellers and people seeking something different for a night or two! The tent life was brilliant - a mix of “roughing it” with clean, modern camping. Stay here. For someone like me who loves all things NYC, this added to my adoration. Salute CR!

author: Luke D
title: Stay at the Aliz
text:
The hotel is in a good location and within walking distance of Broadway and Times Square. There are also plenty of coffee shops, food stops, money exchange places and other conveniences nearby. A 7-Eleven is just a stone’s throw from the hotel, which is very convenient.

The rooms are on the small side but come with a coffee machine and a steam iron for your clothes. The rooms are quite dark, and the lighting could definitely be better. The air conditioning is also very noisy and loud. Unfortunately, the beds are quite uncomfortable, as are the pillows, but if you are mainly using the hotel as somewhere to sleep, then it is manageable.

Breakfast is fairly standard and nothing too exciting. The hotel provides one $25 token per room, which can be spent on beverages or put towards breakfast or dinner. Breakfast costs $35, so you have to pay the difference, which isn’t too bad. Alternatively, you can buy drinks, snacks and other bits and pieces from the downstairs bar using your token. 

The hotel also has a good viewpoint on the 40th floor. However, if you are travelling with children, they cannot access the viewpoint because you have to be 21 or over due to the bar being located there.

You are provided with two complimentary bottles of water per day per room, with no extras included. If you need more water, you can fill up bottles from the fountain on the lower ground floor or buy your own.

Housekeeping was good throughout our stay. Overall, we had a good stay and the location is definitely one of the hotel’s biggest advantages.

One thing to mention is that some of the reception staff can be quite abrasive. However, there were also staff members who were very helpful. In particular, there was one guy at reception with blonde highlights in his hair who was extremely helpful, although unfortunately I can’t remember his name.

Overall, I would say this is a good hotel if location and convenience are your priorities. The rooms and beds could be more comfortable, and the lighting and air conditioning could certainly be improved, but overall it was a good stay.

author: Grace H
title: A great hotel in Times Square
text: Thanks to this hotel, the experience in New York was unbeatable. The views from the room were impressive. The hotel was centrally located without being in the noisiest area. Everything was super clean and the staff's service was fantastic. One night we had dinner there and everything we tried was really good. They made me feel at home; I find it incredible that in the heart of Manhattan there could be a hotel so attentive to its guests (at least that was the case with us at all times). I don't have a single complaint, totally recommended. If I were to return to NY, I would choose it again without hesitation.

author: Wyatt N
title: Convenient location & nice views!
text:
The location of this hotel is very convenient, with the subway literally down the road (42nd street). It is in the middle of Times Square. 
Staff were always polite, helpful and courteous - nothing was too much trouble. 
The room itself was not very spacious but it was very nicely decorated. We got moved and upgraded to a deluxe room on our 2nd day due to our air-con breaking, and the view was amazing!
We also got a 25$ chip to spend on food/drinks in the downstairs bar, as well as 2 free welcome drinks. The staff also do wellness checks if you stay with them for more than a couple of days, and they held our luggage for us after we checked out.
The only downside I would say is being over 40 floors and 3 lifts, they are slow - but you’d get that anywhere lol. 
A very nice hotel overall!

author: Adam S
title: Beautiful experience in New York
text:
Superb view and close to everything! 😁
The rooms are small for 4 but we manage and it works out. We enjoyed our stay as well as the staff, who were always pleasant. The food is good and the rooftop has a magnificent view of the city and its skyscrapers.

author: Sofia J
title: Excellent location
text: Excellent location, walking distance from Times Square, clean, courteous reception staff Lovely that they gave a double voucher for the hotel bar and $25 to use at the hotel

author: Miguel O
title: A top hotel near Times Square!
text:
Top location!
Very friendly, helpful and nice employees!
Nice showers with a lot of water.
Small room but sufficient.
Silence during the night.
The only disadvantage are the elevators as they have many stops which makes them slow sometimes depending on how many guests are using them.

author: Grace K
title: Lovely stay with great rooftop bar!
text: Overall, the hotel is great - in a good location with great proximity to Times Square, Madison Square Garden and other things.  The "Dear Irving" on the rooftop was spectacular and very upscale with amazing views.

author: Ian Q
title: Bad attention
text: TV without internet with nothing to see small room etc

author: Henry B
title: Aliz Hotel Times Square
text: Excellent location, excellent cleanliness, fully satisfied!

author: Anna M
title: Can't wait to stay here again
text: Perfect location, nice clean room, (can be noisy with window rooms over Times Square) people were very nice. Great drinks and views from Dear Irving, on Hudson on the 40th floor.

author: Ella Y
title: hotel aliz
text: Lovely hotel near time square next to.bus station easy access from airport  central in manhatten. Great roof top bar in it and bar on level below which had a night club feel. You can have a wee wait for elevators but not an issue. You also get a free drink and 25 dollars to spend in shop. Cleaners in every day rooms are immaculate

author: Amelia G
title: Dont expect the Room deposit back!
text:
I am afraid to say that I have experienced the same problem as the review before.
We stayed over a month ago and the deposit still has not arrived.
I have reported it to Barclaycard who are now doing it for me.
It is a same as the stay and Hotel were great and I would have recommended to friends but if you add the charge into the room price its makes it expensive.
I have also reported them to the travel company.

author: Chloe H
title: Exceptional service
text: I met Artes at the reception, and without a doubt, he was the best person I met in all of New York. His professionalism, attentiveness, and service were the highlights of my trip. He is an extraordinary, respectful, polite, and exceptional person. Congratulations to Human Resources for recognizing her talents. Thank you, Artes.

author: Adam W
title: Not recommended
text: 90$ to park the car an no in and out and the reception didn’t even mention it so i paid 400$ usd for 2 days

author: Sophia R
title: Good stay at The Aliz
text: We had a great experience at The Aliz. Staff was friendly. Rooms were clean and well appointed. Elevators were fast. Food and drinks (and city views) in the Rooftop Bar were very nice. We went for a quick girls' trip. We'd stay at The Aliz again.

author: Pierre D
title: Comfortable, attentive and friendly staff. Central location.
text:
Good location - central and easy to find. All staff very friendly and approachable. 
Food was good in the restaurant too. 
Hairdryer in the room was fantastic alongside the steamer in the wardrobe which was a lovely surprise. 
Guest services very helpful and helped to arrange transfer to the airport on leaving. 
Unfortunately due to a protest at another hotel on the same road we could hear this late at night and early in the morning - we are aware there was very little Aliz Hotel staff could have done during this time and we do not hold this against them. 
Room was clean and amenities present on arrival. Plugs above the bedside tables were appreciated along with alarm clock.

author: Lauren O
title: City break
text: Nice clean hotel  good location

author: Ian Y
title: Good hotel in NYC
text:
Excellent service and attention.
The location is ideal for getting around Manhattan.
The rooms are very comfortable.

author: Carlos X
title: great location not so great management
text:
I visited this hotel with my best friend in May 2026. We really enjoyed our stay with this hotel, the location was great. However, our issues started from the last night. On arriving to our room on the last night, we found a wet brown patch on the bed covering a new york exclusive jellycat that was bought during our trip. We immediately went down to reception and informed Brandon who very quickly got our bed changed and assured us that this issue would be sorted. He asked how much the jellycat was ($60) and said we would hear back about compensation. The (i’m guessing) manager of house keeping came up to see us in our room and instantly denied this was not the fault of the hotel. It was 100% done by the cleaner. We understand accidents happen and just wanted the bedding changed and ideally wanted compensation to buy another (expensive) jellycat it was not stained and the tag ruined (which is important if you are a collector like us). 
I had to chase this up after we were home even though we were assured we would be contacted by the hotel. They asked for proof of what happened and forwarded this on to a claims department. It has taken me weeks to get a response back from both the claims company and the hotel. They are now claiming they were not at fault so no compensation will be paid. Like i said, we understand accidents happen and this is not the issue. It is the complete dismissal of any liability, and we are struggling to understand how this patch on the bed was not seen when the room had been cleaned and bed made. 
To add insult to injury, my friend has still not had her security deposit refund. We checked out of this hotel on the 12th of May. 
Great hotel for location, but maybe book somewhere else with better reviews. It seems like many people struggle with their security deposit.

author: Maria F
title: Dog friendly but not Human friendly.
text: My Wife and I visited this Hotel with other Family members for 3 nights at the beginning of July. The Hotel is in a good location and check in was good with the added bonus of a couple of free cocktails and a token for the bar. The receptionist also explained the Resort Fees and I had to authorise my Credit Card to cover these and any other spending. The room was on the  small side particularly as it had 2 double beds it was it bit cramped for us as a couple despite it being designed for up to 4. It meant I didn't even have a bedroom cabinet for phone watch etc at my side of the bed. A small shelf would help. Anyway it was adequate for us and not the reason for my poor rating which was due to having had a long day travelling and not being able to sleep due to a barking dog. I decided to report this issue and I met a member of the security staff coming out of the lift on my floor who was already investigating the matter. He accompanied me to reception and I was told they are unable to contact the owners but will sort it out. Well a couple of hours later it was still going on so I telephoned reception who offered me a different room which is not what you need after a long day and at midnight. We also heard dog barking on the 2nd day at night but not as bad and heard nothing the 3rd night which was our last. I also contacted reception during my stay as 3 payments totaling £600 were on my credit card but didn't get a reason for it but was assured it would come off and it did. We also had Breakfast each morning which was disappointing mainly due to the fact that the hot stuff was cold even when eating first thing and worse still if you have it later as it's the same stuff. I think the fact Breakfast isn't popular is due to the quality.

author: Ethan V
title: Amazing hotel
text: Amazing hotel as usual, stay here every time im in town

author: Taylor I
title: Great location and staff!!!!
text: The location of Moxie is super convenient, and all the room was very small. It was brilliantly efficient. Perfect for one person. The facility has a couple of options for dining and drinks, unfortunately two of the three are only open a few days a week. But beautiful property really well done great location. Super friendly staff and nice and clean.

author: Matthew M
title: Supreme weekend!
text: Staycation is the city…Chelsea neighborhood! Streets filled with flowers, delicious eats, rooftop bars and the Moxy brings it all together for you to experience the best of the city. Rooms super mod, comfortable bed, rain shower and a view of the Empire State. Subway accessible. The staff is so friendly and helpful. I would recommend highly recommend and would visit again myself.

author: Holly F
title: Wonderful experience
text: Highly recommend Moxy in Chelsea. Great price, location, food, drinks and views. Definitely will be returning.

author: Katie F
title: Will book again !
text: Great hotel and great location ! Very clean and comfortable! The rooftop bar is amazing with a great view! Short wait time for elevators . The rooms are very small , and I do wish there had been a mini fridge , but the credit next door and free coffee was a nice option . Staff were very professional and helpful . Check in was smooth , and storage of bags was efficient. Loved having a mini clothes steamer . My room was missing a hairdryer , but the  housekeeping staff brought one immediately. Diana and Shanice at front desk were especially friendly and helpful . Live this street and location , and we will definitely book again !

author: Charlotte R
title: Perfect Spot for a Birthday Girls’ Weekend in NYC
text:
The girls had a great stay at Moxy NYC Chelsea for my daughter’s 26th birthday! The location was fantastic—convenient and easy for getting around the city. The view was amazing. The room was about what you’d expect for NYC: compact, with an especially small bathroom that didn’t offer much privacy for four friends sharing a room.

That said, what really stood out was the staff. They knew it was a birthday trip and went out of their way to make my daughter feel special, which I truly appreciated. The girls had an absolute blast, and that’s ultimately what mattered most. I’d definitely recommend the Moxy Chelsea for a fun NYC getaway, especially if location and atmosphere are priorities.

author: Ryan K
title: MISSING ITEM AND POOR RESPONSE
text:
I had a really disappointing experience at MOXY. After the room was cleaned, I noticed that my Louis Vuitton perfume was missing from my room. I immediately raised the issue, but the front desk did not provide the level of support I expected, and the situation was not properly addressed.

Someone entering my room and taking my personal belongings is completely unacceptable. I stayed at a hotel expecting basic security and respect for my property.

I’m sharing this so people are aware and take extra care with their valuables if they choose to stay here. For me, this experience has completely changed my view of MOXY, and I don’t think I’ll be staying here again.

author: Katie B
title: What a fantastic stay
text:
Our family’s first trip to New York City from Kazakhstan was made truly special by our stay at Moxy Chelsea!
We absolutely loved the hotel, the atmosphere and especially the beautiful view of the Empire State Building. But what really stood out was the incredible customer service.
A huge thank you to Genessy, who went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and cared for throughout our stay. Along with Liz, she arranged a wonderful room upgrade and a beautiful surprise that made our family’s first NYC experience even more memorable. Those thoughtful touches meant so much to us.
We truly felt the care and hospitality from the moment we arrived. Moxy Chelsea is now a very special part of our first New York memories.
Thank you, Genessy and Liz, for making our stay unforgettable! We absolutely loved it and will definitely be coming back!

author: Amelia V
title: Wonderful stay at the moxy
text: I really appreciate the hotel location! It was near some flower markets and it was always beautiful and smelled really good when leaving the hotel. I loved the vibes . We did opt for a smaller room as we were only staying a few nights. I wish there was a closet and traditional door on the bathroom rather than sliding door. The price was very fair for the amount we got and the experience of the hotel.

author: Paolo P
title: Loved Moxy-Chelsea 10/10
text: Excellent location!!! Chill vibes-friendly, beautiful rooms with a view of ESBNY highly  recommend!  The cafes on site change depending on the time of day from coffee and pastries to Italian at night but both were so good and you receive food credits per day! Missed the chance to check out the rooftop because they’re not open on Mondays FYI! Would stay again for sure! Awesome experience!

author: Aiden C
title: Recommend!
text: Upon arrival, I was quickly greeted by a gentleman that appeared to be a manager. He was exceptionally polite, courteous and efficient.  The young lady, I forgot her name, but she was so kind and patient. The hotel ran out of wash cloths but room service quickly arrived with hand towels and bath towels. The room was clean. The boutique hotel was super cute! I didn’t have an opportunity to experience the full hotel but it was situated in a great location in Chelsea. A short walkable commute to the subway, nearby dining options and 17 min walk to Times Square. I would return again!

author: Grace H
title: Fantastic stay with incredible rooftop views
text: I had a wonderful stay at the Moxy Chelsea. The rooftop club was absolutely incredible, with fantastic views of the Manhattan skyline, and my room offered beautiful skyline views as well. The staff were exceptionally friendly and welcoming throughout my stay, especially Marvin, the manager, who was incredibly helpful and made me feel very well taken care of. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend the Moxy Chelsea!

author: Leo E
title: For the more lively crowd!
text:
This hotel is very much for a younger crowd, or a party crowd. I knew from the photos it looked chic but walking through the lobby felt like a club vibe, and it didn’t feel too personal. Nobody really greets you, maybe one guy did who was super nice. Felt like overwhelming everytime coming in. In the actual room, it was quiet and nice so that was good! The view was awesome. I was frustrated because the toilet seat was broken the entire time and almost slid off every time I sat down, messaged the hotel multiple times to fix it and they said they wouldn’t and didn’t, so that made it kinda uncomfortable. The beds aren’t comfortable or the pillows either. 

The location, is definitely in a busy area but you are very central to try a lot in New York which was cool. A lot of food and coffee options around, and a subway stop really close. 

At the end of the trip the lady checking me out was the nicest one and asked if I needed a car and arranged it, that was probably the best part of the experience so I appreciate her! 

Other than that, didn’t really care for the amenities. I probably wouldn’t come back, just because it’s not the energy I want, I want a more restful and feels like home place, and with really welcoming staff. Just felt like I paid a lot to be in the city; but I think that’s the point. So it wasn’t terrible, but just not the best.

author: Evie J
title: Great stay
text: I absolutely loved the location. The flower district is such a vibe in the summer months. The location is walkable for downtown access. The full windows with a view was a great touch to the room.

author: Henry R
title: Deco skies forever friends of great design at Moxy
text:
Very pleasantly surprised to find the Moxy hotel listing in my United hotel mileage plus booking app after having visited the rooftop bar long ago for swing dancing events. The view from my room was absolutely perfect because I along with several million concerned individuals led by a group of musicians spent many hours on activism to save the 40 buildings from demolition on W.30th St. My visit was for business and the entire staff made it one of the most special hotel stays I've ever had. 
Also being in the flower district is a joyful experience and I look forward to exploring the other Manhattan locations but this one is really special. Thanks so much to everyone at the Chelsea Moxy!

author: Olivia Y
title: Visit NYC from Moxy
text: Moxy is a Nice place located in a central place of New York. So this makes it super easy for visits from that point. The staff is very Nice and skilled.

author: Charlotte A
title: Great for weekend with family
text: Perfect location and very nice hotel. Would definitely stay here again anytime.

author: Charlie T
title: Clean rooms, friendly staff
text: Clean, friendly, good location, daily credit at coffee shop. Had 2 rooms, each with double beds. Those rooms comfortably fit two adults; any more than that is a bit crowded.

author: Mia T
title: Love the Moxy!
text: I will definitely stay at the Moxy again! The prices were competitive, the location to the subways and busses were great, the atmosphere was wonderful!!

author: Camille C
title: Great service and location
text: I had problems with wireless and no washcloths; however, the staff were nothing short of exceptional.  Quickly solved and professional.  Greta location and a special shout out to Betty at reception.  She made the difference in the stay!  Thanks

author: Wyatt J
title: Weekend in NYC
text:
A great hotel in a prime location with superb staff. We booked a suite which was perfect for a family of 4 with the bonus of a balcony. 
Highly recommend . The bar downstairs is stunning with happy hour at 5 - perfect after a day shopping or sightseeing

author: Zoe K
title: 1000% satisfied
text: We LOVE this hotel. The staff is welcoming and friendly, the decor is elegant and thoughtful, it is clean and well run, and the location is wonderful—right by Times Square. Would recommend it to anybody

author: Louis L
title: Just perfect!
text: Just a wonderful hotel! Perfect location, friendly, helpful staff,delicious complimentary breakfast and immaculately clean rooms.

author: Freya T
title: Perfect hotel in a perfect location
text:
Wowww what a perfect hotel!
We loved this hotel so much.
We stayed at the penthouse (a family of 5). 
The stuff was amazing, super nice and helpful.
The room was beautiful, clean. With a balcony where you could see beautiful buildings all around - it was amazing! 
And the location- right in the middle of all the action. 
Perfect in every aspect!

author: George P
title: Excellent location with excellent service. Very big and comfortable rooms
text: Excellent location with excellent service, very big rooms , big bed and comfortable , next very nice bars and restaurants on the street

author: Evan I
title: No frills hotel close to Times Square.
text: It’s an ok, clean, no frills hotel. Decent sized rooms, and a great roof terrace, that you can relax on but no bar or service. The lobby is very poor and we did wonder where we had come to on arrival, but the rooms were ok. Plenty of local restaurants on the street outside, including excellent pizza next door. Not sure we would return as better options in the city.

author: Lucy I
title: Janet
text:
Hotel Scherman is a hidden gem. The location is excellent for Theartre District also time Square is about 15 minute walk and close to 5th Avenue.   The hotel staff were very helpful . Continental breakfast is served in the hotel also has a roof terrace. Our room had a terrace extra bonus to sit and have drinks. If I was ever back in New York this would be my first choice to stay would definitely recommend. 

.

author: Poppy D
title: Top, location and service
text: Amazing location, very nice B&B, highly recommend

author: Hugo I
title: Truly - Hotel Scherman DID Exceed my Expectations
text:
We're tourists from Australia in our mid-60s, and we were a bit apprehensive about staying in Manhattan almost 20 years since we were last here. I checked the 4 places we'd previously stayed in (including the Waldorf Astoria in 2003) and prices were through the roof.
I found Hotel Scherman on-line, and had to pay the full amount up-front some 8 months out, but I was prepared to do that to secure a room that I thought would be acceptable.
Communication with the Hotel leading up to our check-in was really good - and thus comforting.
When we got there (a little early - flying down from Canada), Jerry at the front desk was great. Our room wasn't quite ready (say 30-40 minutes out), but he offered to look after all of our luggage, hand-luggage too, and have it delivered to the room (and it was). Jerry also said that we could be upgraded, provided we were okay with 3 flights of stairs. Stairs are no problem for us, so we said "Yes, please!".
When we saw our room, it was far from the dark and pokey broom-closet I half expected. It took my breath away! We loved it. It was like a suite, not a room. Very large; bright and airy; good sized bathroom; well appointed. It was sensational. So much space - it even had a fire place and soo many windows! Comfy bed; strong wifi; TV; fridge; coffee-maker; chairs, desk, small table...
A continental breakfast was included. Now I've had a "continental breakfast" in US hotels before - and a cupcake plus an apple, this was not. It was a massive affair, with cereal, pastries, toast, yoghurt, hard-boiled eggs, fruit... a brilliant start to each day.
The staff were lovely too.
I can't say enough good things about the Hotel Scherman.
It really did exceed my expectations, and that rarely happens!
Highly recommended.

author: Rosie H
title: Hotel Scherman... Best place to stay in Manhattan!
text: My daughter and I just spent a few days in NYC at Hotel Scherman and we were delighted!  This boutique hotel is charming, the rooms are large and decorated beautifully, the staff is so helpful and friendly and the morning breakfast was fantastic!  But the very best thing about the hotel is the location!  It's located on restuarnt row within a couple blocks of all the theaters! And when I said the staff was friendly, they even left a package of fine chocolates for my daughter when they found out it was her birthday!  What a personal touch!  Both of us loved our stay and agree, we would love to go back!

author: William V
text: My stay at Hotel Scherman was even better than I expected it to be. I normally stay in one of the hotels on Times Square, but for this trip, I wanted to try something different. I was tired of being treated like just another guest. When I found Hotel Scherman online, I knew it was the place to try. Geisa at the front desk made my entire experience. She was helpful, kind, and genuinely brightened my day every time I left to explore the city. The room was a little smaller than what I'm used to, but it made up for it in charm. What I paid was worth it, especially for the distance from all of the restaurants. I am a huge foodie, and being on restaurant row was a dream! This was one of the most quiet hotels I've ever stayed at, which is crazy to say in NYC.  As a solo traveler, it is very important for me to feel safe, and I felt that way every time I was at the hotel. The room was clean, and I had everything I needed. I travel to the city once or twice a year, and I will absolutely be booking my next trip at Hotel Scherman!

author: Sophia D
title: Ideal for a New York trip. Super central, great staff, nice rooms and incredible roof terrace.
text: Central, clean, inexpensive, breakfast included.

author: Louis R
title: Super cute safe smaller hotel!
text: We have been to New York City several times, and have stayed in larger hotels. This was a very nice change, super cute room, great breakfast next door and a fun rooftop. We were on the first floor, and the bar below on Wednesday night was pretty loud until late that night.  I would probably try to stay on a different floor if we came back. We did feel safe and everything we wanted to do was in walking distance.

author: William E
title: A great hotel in NYC!
text: My daughters, granddaughters, and I had a great 4 night stay at Hotel Scherman. We stayed in a 2 bedroom suite which was perfect for us to enjoy one another’s company after full days of Broadway and sightseeing. The hotel’s Hell’s Kitchen location affords easy access to many restaurant options, Times Square, theaters, and other top NYC sights. The staff are very friendly and the room was well-appointed and much roomier than other NYC hotels I have stayed in. Continental breakfast is served at restaurant Bar Dough next door (hotel guests only) which provided a lovely start to the day. I would choose Hotel Scherman again without hesitation!

author: Leo L
title: The rooms and staff are as perfect as the location
text: My wife and I just enjoyed out 4th visit to the Scherman Hotel in the past two years and our only regret is that we didn't know about it earlier. The staff is friendly, helpful and competent. Our room has always been very comfortable, well maintained and spotless. There is not a proper lobby to "hang out" but the roof terrace is terrific and the breakfast room -- being remodeled this past week -- is a comfortable area for a simple start to the day. And, of course, the Restaurant Row location in the center of the theater district cannot be beat. Indeed, in good weather, we walked to and from  our play at Lincoln Center this week. This is now our address in the City.

author: Charlie W
title: The hotel feels like a capsule of good vibes in the heart of a city that is intense but often aggressive.
text: The hotel feels like a capsule of good vibes in the heart of a city that is intense but often aggressive. Everything works well: the rooms are much larger than the city’s average, the décor is tasteful, the atmosphere is quiet, and above all the staff show an excellent attitude—something that is not always common in the city. They are always ready to solve any problem or concern you might have. They also offer a breakfast with just the right dose of energy you need before heading out to walk the streets of the Big Apple.

author: Sophia Z
title: Great 3-Night Stay
text: We had a great 3-night stay at Hotel Scherman. The main point of the trip was to see Broadway shows and the location was perfect. Close enough to the Theatre District to walk to all our shows, but not right in the craziness of Times Square. It was also great being right on Restaurant Row to have a large selection of dinner options. Room was clean and a nice size for NYC. The hotel staff was friendly and helpful. Continental breakfast at the restaurant next door was convenient and had a nice selection. We would definitely return to this hotel!

author: Marta V
title: Great stay in NYC
text: We stayed for a friends weekend at this beautiful and amazing hotel! From entering into the small lobby to the end of our trip they were excellent. The roof top deck is open and an evening snow in February with the lights and city of NY was great. Close to many attractions and great food all around you can’t go wrong here. The beds and bathrooms were clean and they gave us a sweet note of welcome with sparkling champagne to celebrate my friend’s 55th birthday. Very cute boutique hotel and a nice surprise away from the mega chains. Glad we found them and would definitely return for another stay.

author: Oliver V
title: Perfect location
text: Hidden gem. Booked a regular room but was surprised with an upgrade to 2 bedroom / 2 bath with balcony overlooking city lights. Very beautiful. The room was extremely clean and had thoughtful touches: coffee/tea, fridge, bottled water. The included Continental breakfast was very good and served at a quaint restaurant next door. The hotel front desk and restaurant staff were all very pleasant and helpful. Added bonus - rooftop terrace.

author: Ryan L
title: Beautiful experience
text: 3 days to celebrate an important birthday, very kind staff, they even surprised our friend who turned 50 without us saying anything. Spotless facility.

author: Ethan Z
title: Excellent value for money!
text: Excellent location, hospitality, comfort, and high-level quality. Panoramic restaurant with excellent food and wines. I will return ✨

author: Chloe C
title: Lovely hotel
text:
We came to Rome for our 40 wedding anniversary. I chose Hotel 21. It did not disappoint. Friendly staff, from receptionist, cleaner, to waiting on staff.
Breakfast was lovely. From continental, to English. Eggs, bacon, toast, cakes, cereals. Even fresh pancakes.
Air con through out, which was a god send when it’s 40 outside.
We would highly recommend this hotel.

author: Mathis F
title: Great place to stay in Rome
text: Great hotel, b very convenient for Rome. Lovely staff, very good breakfast and comfortable and clean rooms

author: Luca C
title: Quiet and comfortable rooms
text:
Very good room albeit slightly harder beds than we are used to, wonderful with a working air conditioner in the room that made the night cold and comfortable when the temperature fluctuated around +36° during the day.

The breakfast was ok with the right mix of different types of food which suited our family perfectly.

author: Jack B
title: A stay of high quality.
text: Everything was perfect; the quiet (Rome) is generally noisy at night. Its proximity for visits.

author: Chloe L
title: Not everything that glitters is gold
text: Negative experience, aside from the friendliness of the staff and the large variety of products available at the breakfast buffet, the rest does not meet the standards of the stars (4). Very small room, mini bathroom without any countertop, electrical outlet not suitable for 220 volts, shower located inside the bathtub not suitable for elderly people.

author: Holly C
title: Great hotel. In a strategic location to visit the city.
text:
The friendliness, professionalism, and availability of all the staff, from the reception to the breakfast room. Kind and ready to meet every request.
Cleanliness of the room and bathroom.
We have been here before and always find the same courtesy.
We will definitely return.

author: Charlie S
title: Don’t book
text:
Misleading Room Description

We booked a deluxe room specifically because the hotel's website advertised a balcony with "stunning views" and showed images of glass-fronted balconies overlooking the city. 

As you can see from the images, this was completely misleading. The balcony was filthy. There was no view at all through the concrete (not glass as shown on the website). Not to mention our room was at the back of the hotel so there was no view of St. Peter's Basilica as shown on the website. We complained as soon as we arrived and asked to change to another room or downgrade as the balcony was the only reason we had booked this room. We were told the hotel was fully booked and to ask the next day to be told the same thing. 

This continued for the duration of our trip until check out where we raised this again before paying. We asked if there was anything that could be done about the price (the difference for the for a balcony view was €460) . We were told there is nothing they can do at reception apart from deducting the city tax (€60) but we could raise the issue via email. Obviously this nowhere near compensated the difference so as soon as returned home, we emailed. After chasing multiple times, I received one response telling me there was nothing more that they can do and have since been ignored. The customer service has been more shocking than the room. 

There are much better hotels in Rome. Don’t waste your money! We stayed at the Marcella Royal last year and can’t recommend it enough.

The rooms are extremely dark (it was difficult to get ready at night). Reception area is small and cramped. The only positive feedback I can give is the location and breakfast.

author: Caleb V
title: Good location, Tiny Bathroom, No Storage
text:
Double room: The hotel was clean and the beds were comfortable although the room was not huge.  Bathroom was minuscule with nowhere to put toiletry bags or other items.  No storage in room, no drawers etc, tiny wardrobe which resulted in us having to keep all items of clothing in our case. 
Breakfast was average with no fresh orange juice. 
Staff did not engage with guests most of the time but were helpful when approached.
Location was good.

author: David O
title: Very good location, bedding to review
text: The hotel is very well located, 20 minutes walk from the Vatican, 10 minutes from People’s Square.  Reception staff and nice and very available and speak English or French. The breakfast room is nicely located on the 6th floor with a beautiful view. The choice is varied but it remains very industrial, fruit salad in a can, orange juice cut with water. The room is quite large, functional, modern bathroom with everything needed. However, the bedding is a disaster, the mattress on spring is hard, as are the pillows, there is no duvet but a horribly rough blanket! I am not by far the first comment to mention it but it seems indifferent to the management of the hotel! The rooms are poorly soundproofed, you can hear the doors slamming in the hallway since 05:30, unbearable to sleep! If the management took a little trouble the hotel would be worthy of a 4 star because for the moment it sets the standard of a 3 star.

author: Taylor K
title: Very positive experience
text: Central location, well appointed modern rooms, top floor breakfast room with views, friendly staff, good value for money.

author: Pierre O
title: Great location, but disappointing bedroom
text:
The hotel is ideally situated if you want to walk to the Vatican and old Rome. 
Our bedroom (121) benefitted from a large balcony overlooking the main road, but was very small and dark with extremely limited storage space for a couple - there were not many hangars in the small and very high wardrobe and there were no drawers for smalls etc! The decor was black and grey and the room lights were ineffective. The bed was hard and not to our liking. If you want to make tea or coffee in your bedroom, you will need to take your own supplies and a travel kettle. 
The restaurant and bar on the top floor boasted quite a large terrace and the alcohol was reasonably-priced for a city centre hotel. We didn't take an evening meal at the hotel, but the breakfast buffet, with hot and cold choices offered something for most tastes. The coffee machine offered plenty of tasty options, using real coffee beans. 
The housekeeping staff were particularly warm and friendly, as were some of the reception team. 
We would recommend this hotel for its location, but the bedroom was disappointing for the reasons stated above.

author: Manon F
title: Nice stay in Rome
text: Hotel was conveniently located, staff was super helpful with all aspects of the stay. Room was comfortable and the price paid was appropriate for the room.

author: Samuel T
title: March in Rome
text: Great breakfast and clean rooms, very efficient staff and convenient location to get around the city.

author: Alice Y
title: Disappointing-I would avoid.
text:
I would rate this hotel around 2.5 to 3 stars at best.

During my stay, I experienced several issues and did raise them with reception. Unfortunately, I did not feel that my concerns were taken seriously. I requested a room change due to significant noise issues, but I was told the hotel was fully booked and that no alternative rooms were available. However, rooms were still available to book online at the time, which made this explanation difficult to understand.

I also couldn’t help but notice a difference in how guests were treated. My male colleagues attending the same conference were proactively offered quieter rooms and given options upon arrival. When I asked to move to a quieter room, I was told no, despite apparent availability. The inconsistency was disappointing.

The noise levels are extremely high — not because of inconsiderate guests, but because the walls (both between rooms and facing outside) are incredibly thin. You can hear everything. If you’re a light sleeper or need rest for work, this is far from ideal.

The bed was also very uncomfortable. There was no mattress topper, and you could clearly feel the springs. I had to request a topper just to make it bearable, and I am generally not a fussy sleeper.

I had read other reviews mentioning that staff did not engage when issues were raised. In my case, I did speak to reception, but unfortunately my requests were not resolved at all just a "no we are fully booked".

Finally, the Wi-Fi was extremely slow. If you’re planning to work during your stay, be aware that the connection may not be reliable — I had to hotspot from my phone to get anything done.

Overall, this was a disappointing experience and not one I would choose again.

author: Zoe I
title: Amazing stay!!!!!
text:
We just came back from a 4 night stay as we had a birthday celebration. You cannot fault this hotel. On arrival we were greeted by very professional and friendly reception staff. As we were a bit early they offered to put our luggage in a holding room while we started to explore the area until we were able to get to our room.
The room was amazing with stunning view from our massive balcony/terrace (Room 502). It had all you need. Coffee, tea etc.
The housekeeping staff was always smiling and did a great job.
If you are out for the day and come back to the hotel but want another glass of wine or anything else, I recommend to go up to the 6th floor where the bar is and enjoy the atmosphere.
The Hotel is very central located. It is just a 10 minute walk away from the famous shopping street "Via del corso". It is a great starting point to explore the city. 
On check-out we had again very professional and friendly reception staff.
We will definitely be back.
Thank you

author: James J
title: Exactly what we needed
text: Clean, comfy room with very helpful front desk. Would highly recommend to anybody visiting New York and not wanting to spend too much.

author: Ian Z
title: Comfortable time in Chinatown
text: Very helpful and friendly staff, great room and stay!

author: Isla V
title: Very nice hotel in the heart of the real Chinatown.
text: Kindeness and pulcritude. Very nice hotel in the heart of the real Chinatown.

author: Nathan O
title: Worked well for us...
text: Does what it says on the tin! Good location in chinatown, rooms are decent including a comfy bed, staff very pleasant and strong value for money. Overall a good stay

author: Lily C
title: Great!!
text: Great hotel! We had the twin beds and they were super comfortable. Everything was super clean; everyone was super friendly at the front desk. We were there over a heat wave and did notice our room was a bit warm. We asked them to turn down the air a bit which we could tell they did, but then in the middle of the night it seemed warm again. Easy to catch an Uber right from there to the train station to leave on the last day. Subway stations are about 6-10 minutes away, by walking, depending on where you're headed. We've stayed before and we will stay again! They also have an area with a full-size fridge and bathrooms and ice machine for me to refill my water container with ice on the way out.

author: Gavin D
title: Good Hotel
text: The location is very good, next to Broadway and Times Square, there is also a drinking machine and coffee, sound insulation is also good, but you can hear the speech and the closing of the door, overall I feel good.

author: Lauren B
title: Modern, clean, safe, and very friendly!
text: Solo in town for a specific event. Within three blocks of the subway, incredibly clean, nice, and communicative staff. My room was modern and clean, and everything worked perfectly. Outside of tourist area so less expensive. The neighborhood is very dark, but it's clearly a working neighborhood with lots of people out walking and doing their own business after hours. It's very close to the elevated train tracks but I could not even hear it from my room. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Henry Q
title: Happy
text: Cozy and clean! Would definitely stay again!

author: Evie K
title: 20/10 I would absolutely stay here again!
text:
From the moment we arrived, the service at Mimosa Hotel was exceptional. The front desk staff welcomed us with such kindness and made us feel at home right away.

Our stay started on a Monday, and we arrived several hours before check-in. We left our luggage and went to explore Chinatown. To our surprise, they texted us later to let us know our room was ready early. I really appreciated that because we were exhausted after our flight.

The next morning, my daughter went to get some water, and shortly after, the staff surprised us by bringing fresh watermelon to our room. It was such a thoughtful gesture! Throughout our stay, everyone was attentive, friendly, and genuinely cared about making us comfortable.

We stayed in a room with two twin beds, and it was very comfortable. The bathroom was well stocked with thoughtful amenities like toothbrushes, razors, and other essentials. And I have to mention the hair dryer—it worked better than the one I have at home! 😂

The room doesn’t have a mini fridge, but the hotel has a shared area with a refrigerator, microwave, and other conveniences, which worked perfectly for us. The TV had hundreds of channels, and although the air conditioner doesn’t have a thermostat control, the room stayed at a very comfortable temperature the entire time.

The hotel has quiet hours from 10 PM to 8 AM, which I actually appreciated because it helped everyone enjoy a peaceful night’s sleep. There is an elevated train line in front of the hotel, but honestly, the noise was minimal and never bothered us.

Subway stations are about a 7–15 minute walk away, depending on where you’re headed, making it easy to get around the city. If you don’t feel like going out one evening, you can order food delivery, and the staff will gladly receive it for you at the lobby.

Overall, this was one of the best hotel experiences I’ve had. The outstanding customer service made all the difference, and I would happily stay here again.

20/10. Highly recommended!

author: Emma F
title: Consistently good
text: Always clean and reliable hotel amidst NYC's Chinatown, and some of the most inexpensive and greatest food in the world.

author: Ryan Q
title: Great experience twice in 6 weeks!
text: I stayed here twice recently. Once in May and once in June. My friend and I had a great time both times. The rooms are super clean, bathrooms are great, staff is friendly, they let us drop our bags and use the restroom and enjoy some air conditioning well before our rooms were ready. Both times our room was ready earlier than expected. Location of the hotel is perfect. Everywhere we wanted to go was within walking distance. Also the cost is lower than a lot of hotels in New York. Perfect place for what we needed! Thank you Hotel Mimosa!

author: Lily N
title: Staying at Mimosa
text: Nice and clean hotel. Rooms are not big but so the price.Very good shower with strong water stream. Especially and big thank to William in the front desk that help us to chqnge dates without any charge.

author: Jack C
title: Outatanding service
text: Outstanding location and the service was the best I've had anywhere. They really want to please and gave me early check in and helped me with all restaurant recommendations transportation room was nice and clean with bathtub. Also very secure and safe. Will definitely return

author: Katie J
title: Pleasant hotel stay in NYC
text: We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Mimosa. The hotel is very quiet and safe. The bathtub was nice. I would stay here again.

author: Mia B
title: Great place to stay in Chinatown!
text: Great no-frills hotel for great price in great location in Chinatown. Very clean and very helpful staff. Subway is right across the street, but between the double pane windows and blackout curtains, we didn't hear or see a thing all night and slept great. Bathroom is full size, and there was decent space in the room by NYC standards.

author: Hannah C
title: A wonderful welcome to the city
text: Extremely comfortable and conveniently located. You will not find a more welcoming and friendly team anywhere in NYC. We particularly loved the lists of recommended cafes, restaurants and bars they provided.

author: Diego D
title: A good Buy and A Nice Vneue
text: Very tidy and clean. Very friendly staff. Perfect fo our trip.

author: Lauren N
title: Hotel Mimosa is great!
text: The view from our room was amazing, and the clothing rack was really helpful in the room. The staff was super nice and helpful and purchasing bottles of water at the desk is how we survived the New York heat. Best rates for a hotel!

author: Grace T
title: Great !
text: We stayed at the Mimosa Hotel for 4 nights and would definitely recommend it to budget travellers. The beds were comfortable, the bathroom was clean and those were the things we cared about most. The room was small but perfectly sufficient for our needs. The location is excellent – close to the Manhattan Bridge in the heart of Chinatown - with an easy walk to the subway and Little Italy. The staff were very kind and welcoming throughout our stay. Thank you for a great stay!

author: Claire M
title: Quiet Retreat in Bustling Neighborhood
text: My grandson and I loved the experience of being in the midst of the bustling activity and graffiti of Chinatown and across the street from the ear-splitting sound of trains going over the Manhattan Bridge (you literally cannot hear yourself talk), then coming "home" to our bright, clean, and surprisingly quiet room at the Mimosa.  The hotel provided an extensive list of nearby restaurants with spot-on commentary that was very helpful.  There are a couple of subway stops within five blocks.  I highly recommend this Chinatown hideaway.

author: Mia K
title: Happiest stays
text:
I loved the experience.  It was amazing.  Specially the assistance from Ahmed. He was lovely, politely and solved my reservation which didn't work. He is gonna be my friend certainly.  Besides that, I do liked the service from as well.
Thanks for all.

author: Emma M
title: A great place and a great location!
text:
My daughter and I were very warmly welcomed upon our arrival at the hotel. The rooms were well-maintained. As I am sensitive to noise, I requested a room change, and the staff handled it very quickly. The breakfast was perfect for starting the day well and set off to explore the city. The taxi service was excellent (our driver was lovely and quick).
Thank you to the entire hotel team for their warm welcome and hard work.
Keep up the good work, everyone!

Sébastien Simond

author: Henry U
title: Another great stay
text: I had another great stay at the Holiday Inn Express.  Miss Kim, Nikki, Tartila, Ana, and Ariel were so nice and helpful.   The ladies who managed the breakfast area were also friendly and welcoming.  Everyone who worked there was just so amazing.  The breakfast was varied, the rooms were clean, and I am going to stay there again soon.

author: Pablo G
title: Good hotel Wall Street area
text:
Quietly located hotel within walking distance of the subway and World Trade Center. Small but clean rooms, with private bathroom quite spacious.
We stayed overnight with breakfast included, plentiful and with a wide choice. 
I will definitely return, great value for money

author: Ruby Q
title: Place not recommended, undesirable place. dirty heating in bad condition, poor care. They don't even give water.
text: The heating in bad condition, we paid 4 days and only stayed 1 day because of the uninhabitable that place and did not return the money.

author: Sean P
title: Good address in Financial District
text: Comfortable and clean hotel, great location in Manhattan. Several subway lines very well connected (and express) to midtown and neighborhoods further north. Decent breakfast, for which it is better to anticipate the crowds, which is absolutely normal in New York considering the location and the advantageous rates of the hotel.

author: Chloe T
title: Value Hotel in the Heart of FiDi
text:
My friend and I stayed at the Holiday Inn Express in FiDi for a birthday weekend. It was a great value compared to other hotels in Manhattan and the front desk staff were very friendly and helpful. We had an issue with the room type upon check in (we used Expedia, not booking directly) and the front desk agent, Destiny, helped us with obtaining a room with a sofa bed for the remainder of our stay. She was super kind and thoughtful throughout our stay and I truly think that the hotel has a star employee in her! We also had a slight problem with our toilet and she was able to fix the problem quickly and efficiently while we were out and about. Thanks, Destiny! You truly made our stay great. 

P.S. The pillows are quite nice!

author: Paolo F
title: Very good and reasonably priced hotel in New York
text:
We chose this hotel because it was the best budget option during Thanksgiving, booking made 2 months before our departure.
Very good hotel with good location, close to subway stations to visit Manhattan.
In view of Manhattan hotel rates, we will return to this hotel without problems 
The room and bathroom is small, but to sleep there (since we left early in the morning and came home late at night) it really did the trick. Bedding ok, perfect fridge to put some dishes there buy for the evening to warm in the microwave, heating yes a little noisy but we turn it off at bedtime and we did not get cold at all. Some guests were making noise on the way home later than us, but it's not the hotel's fault.
The staff was friendly, room cleaned every day. No feeling of insecurity as read in some reviews, I went out in the morning alone and in the evening to smoke in front of the hotel without problem!
Breakfast included, simple but good, enough to leave with a full stomach and yet I am difficult... so yes there were people and the room is small, but don't forget it's New York!
In conclusion, we thank this hotel that allowed us to rest and have a good lunch to leave all day for an "affordable" price to Manhattan , we will return for a future stay
