author: Sean C
title: Okay for one night
text:
I stayed here with my family (2 adults, 2 kids) for 1 night before a cruise from Brooklyn. The hotel did the job, but I don't think I would stay there again. 

First, the positives. We were traveling from Penn Station. The hotel was about a 15-minute walk from the Fulton Street subway station, and a 5-minute walk from the Wall Street/Pier 11 Ferry stop (20 minutes from the Red Hook ferry stop). We got in late, but several restaurants were open nearby. The front desk staff was friendly and efficient. The coffee station had hot chocolate. The free breakfast was a bit crowded, but it had a good variety, including pancakes. My child who is allergic to eggs had no trouble finding something he could eat.  

Now, the negatives. The TV in our room didn't work. The shower hadn't been cleaned. I'd requested a roll-away bed when I made my reservation. I called the night before to confirm that we had a roll-away bed. When I checked in, the front desk clerk said the hotel doesn't have roll-away beds. We made things work, but it would have been nice if someone had mentioned that earlier. 

The hotel was fine for 1 night, but I would go elsewhere for a longer stay.

author: Liam W
title: If you can stay somewhere else, please do that.
text: I had a two-night stay at this place. Upon check in I asked Karina the receptionist, if she needed me to pay my balance or would it be processed at check out and she just took my card. However, she failed to check that Holiday Inn Express IHG already had charged my card earlier that day. She proceeded to run my card another 2X which led to an unnecessary hold of more of my money than I was expecting. The hold lasted more than a week until it was finally taken off. I had sent an email to who I believed was the manager, same name of whom I would later speak to, and same hotel name matched the email I had sent. I got no response. When I phoned him, he said he had not gotten that email. He made no mention of guest relations communicating with him, as I had relayed to IHG the issue of the hold. The only thing the manager said was an apology. Communication evidently needs substantial improvement, as well as rectifying holds faster. I believe the issue is with this location, as I have had positive experience with other IHG Holiday Inn Express hotels in the nation. Also, for this location, hot water was not available the second evening of my stay, I evidently only was able to have hot water my first night. Some pros were despite no pool/whirlpool, there was a mini gym, the location of the hotel was walking distance to Battery Park, the breakfast was good, and I was able to get up and down stairs with ease as I requested a floor closest to ground level. I am not a fan of elevators. However, based on my overall experience at this location, I cannot recommend this specific location.

author: Mia O
title: Great location, very old hotel and small rooms.
text: The hotel is in serious need of a major refurbishment. The rooms were small and sparsely furnished. On the positive side, the staff was generally friendly, and breakfast, though simple, covered the basics. The highlight was the excellent location, and the price was relatively reasonable for the holiday season.

author: Grace V
title: We had a good time
text: I stayed at this hotel in early November for 5 nights. At first I was very scared of negative reviews, but when I arrived I was impressed in a positive way. Check in was quick and hassle-free, the room is not large but I realized that in New York they are all small in size. The room was cleaned every day, we had a problem with the hot water since the evening came out warm, we had to shower in the morning where instead there was plenty of hot water. The breakfast room is small so I recommend doing as we did going very early, but there were both sweet and savory products available and the trays were filled continuously. There are two elevators to more than 20 floors and this can involve a bit of waiting, but nothing serious. Let's say that for the price paid, we were satisfied. On the day of check out they allowed us to leave our luggage with them and pick them up later. At the time of the account there were no debit issues, a special thanks to Destiny and also to the other guys at the reception.

author: Daisy Z
title: Amazing hotel don’t read reviews
text:
Stayed here for 4 nights had really good time.
Stayed in room 2602 just beside lift… room very clean.. they came in every day fresh towels emptied bin and clean bedding.. reception staff amazing destiny was proper lush s asset to your team. 

Breakfast was a bit overcrowded but lovely food… pancakes.. bagels fruit..
Defo recommend this hotel a bit out the way but worth it

author: Nathan G
title: Not what expect from Holiday Inn Hotel! Would put me off staying with company again!
text: Other than location there is no positives about this hotel! 1st night when asleep and 2am the door was opened only we  had bolt on door then anyone could of walked in! When opened door there was another customer who advised it was staff who opened door! Went to speak to manager who when did find night staff didn’t seem concerned and was rude like I was bothering her using her phone! Advised was not checked in and didn’t know was in room (could of waited outside room to apologise instead of just leaving customer there) So after 1st night next day room cleaned but no clean towels had to go ask at reception. Next day room cleaned and chewing gum left in bin in bathroom (was there for 2 days as not changed) when was changed no bin liner put in and and empty packet of toilet roll left in sink! Just feel no one is bothered by there job in this hotel! With way rooms are was hole in carpet in bedroom and stains in bath tub didn’t even try breakfast and chose to eat elsewhere. What did find strange was that suitcase kept in room where customers due to eat food following day! This was just few issues we had! But only that have stayed in Holiday Inn express hotels before this experience would of put me off from ever going again

author: Evan H
title: DISGUSTING 🤮

I am travelling around the world and this is the worst experience I have ever had and it is only day one!!!Arrived to check in and after paying over $4000, I was told I was not on their system!!! After more than half an hour, they finally found my booking after getting me upset and stressed, I finally went up to the room and there was only one bed for my adult son and I,, I was already worked up and upset and went back down to reception to tell them I clearly asked for 2 beds as per the paperwork I had provided. author: Elena S
title: Avoid at all cost
text: The room was musty, soon as you walked in it hit you in the face. A strong almost wet smell like must and mold. I paid for two separate rooms one was a king size bed the other was two double beds. The “double bed” room was really a king size bed and a pull out couch that I paid almost $600 for. After getting hit with a $75 holding fee at the desk after they assured me all fees were included the first time around. They said they ran out of double beds and the next step is a pull out couch. $600 down the drain and they’re  “accommodation” was giving me 500 points to ihg app. Breakfast was cold/ nasty and they had no type of system In place, Everyone just bumping and being rude to eachother. There is only two elevators and a 6-10 min wait to use it evey single time. No parking at all and the nearest parking garage is $50 every time you need your car. No trash bags in the room, ice Machine broken. Chair in room is loose and half way broken. The stay in general was HORRIBLE, never again.

author: Anna L
title: Safety Risk.  Don't stay here
text: Safety risk. Don't stay here.  They gave us keys to already occupied rooms.   Three times!   It happens so often that management didn't even act concerned.    We were scared someone would be given keys to our room too. Huge safety issues.   Stay somewhere else.

author: Charlotte S
title: Hotel in the bustling downtown, therefore not quiet and idyllic
text:
First of all: the hotel is in downtown Manhattan and therefore in the middle of bustling New York. That's why the location gets 5 points. The subway is 5-7 minutes away on several lines on foot. And you can be on the East River in three minutes. But: if you get a room facing Water Street, you'll have very loud traffic, and if you get one at the back, a huge air conditioning system roars 24/7 on the neighboring building, making the windows shake. The air conditioning in the room is old and also very loud. So you shouldn't expect a quiet night. 

The hotel as a whole is getting old and not very clean. The rooms are small, cannot be ventilated and are really only bearable with the loud AC. The bathrooms are also small and there is a backlog of renovations overall. 

Breakfast is served in a windowless room that is far too small. It's typically American and you shouldn't expect too much. Everything is served with paper dishes and plastic cutlery, which Europeans will have to get used to. There is endless coffee and tea, and you can always get something from reception.

The staff is really nice and helpful, Sabrina and Thomas are real treasures, without them we would definitely get one point less.

author: Miguel P
title: Ended up surpassing our expectations.
text: My partner and I spent three nights at this hotel to celebrate our anniversary and her birthday in New York. We chose the Holiday Inn Express because it was the best budget-friendly option. It ended up surpassing our expectations. Although the room was on the smaller side, it was ideal for us since we were out exploring the city most of the time, and it was clean and comfortable. The highlight for me was the staff. Anthony and his colleagues (I can't recall their names) were absolutely wonderful—very courteous and easy to talk to. I highly recommend this place!

author: Alexander A
title: AWFUL!! RECONSIDER STAYING HERE
text: Absolutely regretted making a hotel reservation here.We had issues with our entire stay. From the moment we entered the room it had a very strong MILDEW and MOLDY smell coming from the bathroom. It was very likely the bathroom/shower floors were not properly cleaned or sanitized.More than likely they did no replace the shower curtains either. It  such an overwhelming and awful smell. We ended up having to leave our window open just to get fresh air in. The toilet seat and toilet lid was completely broken. It was frustrating and uncomfortable having to use the bathroom in our room. Our bedroom linen was dusty and had clear visible BLACK MOLD on our bedding sheets. If you have any respiratory issues, I would advise you NOT to stay here. There has to be some sort of a HEALTH CODE VIOLATION due to the MOLD and STRONG MILDEW smell. During our stay there we had ants crawling on the floors. We addressed all of our issues and concerns with the front desk associate. Unfortunately none of our serious issues were ever resolved during our stay. We have reached out multiple times with the Housekeeping director, front desk associates, and the manager at Holiday Inn. Our issues and complaint have been intentionally ignored and dismissed. We’ve reached out multiple times via Email and phone. We are still being ignored. One of the worst customer service experienced. It was definitely not a hospitable stay for us.

author: Zachary M
title: What a trip!!!
text: What an experience!!  Day one - the room is extremely small, the room has no drawers and the bathroom sink leaks down to the floor. Then I’m trying to open my suitcase and it bumps the register and the whole front cover fell off.  None of the ice machines work and you wait forever for the elevator. The blanket on the bed is a mattress pad.   Day two - a pro was breakfast, I had 2….lol, but they make the waffles for you in 2 different flavors and deliver them.  Again the elevators were extremely slow, I mean like 10+ minutes wait. Then I go out then come back cuz my phone is dead and none of my outlets were working. The guy came up twice and couldn’t fix it but my boyfriend from Ohio had no problem fixing from Ohio. lol.  The location wasn’t as great as I thought it would be either. But when you’re not from here and you don’t know the road, then you don’t know what is where.  Room 2904

author: Louis B
title: AVOID if you’re travelling to New York as a family!
text:
Long review but a very honest review! I don’t normally review but this one I had to.

We stayed at this hotel for 5 nights at the beginning of August 2026 as part of my our 40th birthday trip. New York was our final stop after San Francisco, Las Vegas and Orlando, where we’d had fantastic experiences and amazing service. Unfortunately, this hotel was a completely different story and ended what had otherwise been an incredible trip on a very sour note.

Things went wrong almost immediately.

The hotel arranged for a a taxi transfer company to contact us to arrange pick up from the airport, which we thought would make things much easier after a long journey. The driver asked for our name and hotel, so we assumed everything was correct. We arrived at what we thought was our hotel, only for reception to tell us we were at the “other Hampton Inn.” We then had to collect all our luggage and walk to the correct hotel.
How would we have known there were other Hampton Inn hotels?! Surely the taxi transfer company knows this so why didn’t they ask us to be specific?! And why didn’t they know which one we were going to when the hotel arranged the contact? 

We were exhausted by the time we arrived, so despite everything, we decided not to complain and just wanted to get some food and go to bed.

Then we discovered one of the lifts was out of order. We were on the 16th floor, and it took around 15–20 minutes to get the remaining lift.

When we finally got to our room, we were genuinely shocked by how small it was. We were a family of four — two adults, a 14-year-old and a 9-year-old — and there was virtually no space at all. We couldn’t unpack because there simply wasn’t anywhere to put our belongings, so we had to live out of our suitcases for the entire stay.

The shower was also ridiculously small. My husband is 6ft 1 and actually banged his head several times while showering.

That first evening, we returned from dinner hoping to relax and watch some TV for an hour. The TV didn’t work.

We tried calling reception — the phone in our room didn’t work either.

That is particularly concerning when you are on the 16th floor and already have one lift out of service. In an emergency, being unable to contact reception from your room is a serious issue.

My husband went down to reception and reported the problems. We were told someone would come up.

By 10.30pm, we were exhausted and had to go to sleep.

The following day, we went out expecting that the issues would be sorted while we were away.

They weren’t.

When we returned, our room hadn’t been serviced at all. The towels we had used that morning were still on the floor, the beds hadn’t been made, and the TV was still not working.

I went down to reception and spoke to Andy, who apologised for everything — the wrong hotel transfer, the lift, the TV, the phone and the lack of room service.

He looked into moving us to a bigger room, but said there were no larger rooms available. He then offered Hilton points as compensation. As we aren’t Hilton members, this wasn’t particularly useful to us.

I asked whether there was any possibility of a refund so we could leave and stay somewhere else for the remaining four nights. Andy told me that this could be arranged, but that we needed to contact the company we had booked through. He explained that they would contact the hotel and the hotel would then confirm that we could leave and receive a refund.

At this point, we genuinely thought we were getting somewhere.

Unfortunately, the following morning my husband spoke to the General Manager, who told him that the information we had been given was incorrect and that we could not leave and receive a refund.

We were also told there were no larger rooms because the hotel doesn’t actually have larger rooms. So when Andy had looked into moving us to a bigger room, there was never actually a bigger room to move us to.

We were essentially stuck.

What disappointed us most was what happened afterwards. Following our conversation with the General Manager, not one member of staff checked in with us for the rest of our stay.

Not to ask if everything was okay.

Not to apologise.

Not to ask whether we wanted the Hilton points that had previously been offered.

Nothing.

On our final night, we returned to find that our room hadn’t been cleaned again, meaning we didn’t even have fresh towels for the following morning when we were flying home.

By that point, I honestly had no energy left to complain again.

Having now read back through some of the other reviews, I can see that comments about staff not seeming to care and problems being brushed aside are sadly very similar to our own experience.

This hotel completely let us down.

We will never stay here again, and although we absolutely love New York and will return, we will definitely be choosing a different hotel next time.

It’s such a shame because this was supposed to be a special 40th birthday trip. San Francisco, Las Vegas and Orlando had all been fantastic, with brilliant service throughout. Unfortunately, our experience here left us feeling incredibly disappointed and frustrated at the end of what had otherwise been an amazing holiday.

If you’re travelling to New York with a family, I would seriously recommend looking elsewhere.

author: Holly W
title: Great.
text: I don’t see how they make this place run so smoothly—great staff from the front desk to the breakfast crew. Standout help from Zay and Alfonzo, but everyone we dealt with was friendly and helpful. The rims are cramped and the elevators jammed, but the location and people make it great.

author: Lucia D
title: If you or someone you love has a disability or travel with a mobility device, read this before booking at this hotel.
text:
I stayed here in August 2026 while attending conferences nearby. My disability relapses unpredictably, and when symptoms returned a few weeks before the trip I tried to modify or cancel my reservation and could not, because I had booked through Expedia (which apparently forfeited all rights as a human). The hotel's website showed accessible rooms available that week, so I requested a low floor in the Hilton app and had my power chair delivered to the hotel ahead of my arrival.

Zay M. the front desk manager, checked me in arranged for my chair to be brought out to me at the front desk. Even so, I was never offered an accessible room. I had requested the 3rd floor and was assigned the 29th. No one said a word about any rules for the chair, including any rule against bringing it into my room, which is how I get around (and the manager even pointed to where the elevators where so I could access my room while I was in the chair).

The room's entryway was tight and there was a mirror in the entryway, and that evening the chair cracked the mirror. I reported it to the front desk myself within minutes and said I probably needed an ADA accommodation. The employee, Marwane, who answered responded with real care: they asked if I was okay, apologized that no accessible rooms were open that night, offered to remove the mirror and shift furniture so I could move safely, and promised to keep checking ADA availability. I said I could make do for the night. If it had ended there, this would be a different review.

Instead Zay M. took over the conversation and the tone turned accusatory. I was told I had never mentioned my mobility issues to him when I checked in. This is the same manager who had my power chair brought to me at check-in. I was told I should not have brought the chair into the room, and that I would pay for the mirror, later quoted to me at $400. It should be noted the hallway outside of the rooms are not wide enough to walk around if my chair was parked there.

I asked to speak with someone else and was told there was no one else and that he was the only manager. When I called Hilton's guest assistance line that evening, the representative checked with the hotel and came back saying I had been offered an ADA accommodation and declined it (probably in reference to my purchase on Expedia in March). That is not what happened, and it contradicts what the hotel's own staff had texted me an hour earlier.

I left that night, in a thunderstorm, and another hotel had an accessible room ready for me within an hour. Between the forfeited nights, the mirror charge, and a last-minute room elsewhere, this stay cost me well over a thousand dollars. It was my first trip without my caregiver for an academic conference that I am presenting at. I would much better have been preparing for that, than writing this review.

There was no understanding of ADA, no understanding of customer service, and there seemed to be way more interest in punishing and dehumanizing guests with disabilities than welcoming them.

author: Rosie N
title: Little space
text: The room is ultra small, the bathroom has a tiny shower. There are 3 of us and to move around, we have to do contortions.

author: Oscar H
title: A hidden gem in Manhattan
text:
The Hampton Inn Times Square South is a hidden gem. We spent a few days there, and everything was a pleasant surprise. When we arrived just before midnight, check-in was quick and seamless thanks to Faith, who was incredibly friendly and efficient. She explained the breakfast details and activated our digital key. The digital key feature is fast and convenient—though it requires a Hilton Honors membership, which is quick, easy, and free to set up. You can unlock your room via the app and even share the digital key with up to three other people. We were assigned a room on the 30th floor with views of various skyscrapers and the Empire State Building—what a fantastic surprise! On July 4th, we were lucky enough to have a room facing the river where the fireworks celebrating the country's 250th anniversary were held; watching them from up high was amazing. Our room was spacious and clean, equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. It featured a large TV, air conditioning, a fridge, a coffee maker with all the fixings, a phone, a desk and chair, two nightstands (with sliding shelves and lamps), a safe, and a full bathroom stocked with hand soap, body lotion, body wash, shampoo, conditioner, tissues, shelves, hangers, shower caddies, and a hairdryer. One of the room's best features was the abundance of USB-A and USB-C ports. There were so many—on the nightstand lamp base, the alarm clock, the desk—plus plenty of standard power outlets throughout the room. The window had both blackout and sheer curtains and could be opened slightly for fresh air. The views were spectacular. The room also included an iron and ironing board. Add a King-size bed (2 meters wide) to the mix, and what more could you ask for? If I had to point out any areas for improvement, they would be that the TV isn't a smart TV (so you can't watch Netflix or Prime Video...), the phone in my room didn't work (though I didn't need it anyway), and the space between the bed and the large TV dresser is a bit tight. None of this detracts from the fact that the room remains comfortable, clean, and very quiet.
Breakfast is included in the rate and features a buffet of hot and cold items: assorted juices (from a dispenser), coffee, cocoa powder, almond milk (though you can request other types), boiled eggs, omelets or scrambled eggs (they alternate), sausages, potatoes, toast, muffins, cereal, butter, jam, cream cheese, fruit (bananas, apples, oranges), yogurt... and best of all, the waffles made by César—the most efficient, friendly, and pleasant waiter we have ever met. He makes them himself because they turn out wonderfully, and you can add various toppings like chocolate chips or nuts; there is also chocolate syrup, whipped cream, and maple syrup (too sweet for me), along with other toppings. It’s a real highlight and a fantastic way to start the day. The breakfast room tends to get crowded during peak hours (between 9 and 10 AM), but if you go earlier, it’s usually not a problem. César is always on the lookout to find you a seat. You can also take your breakfast up to your room.
The housekeeping staff are very kind and attentive, always ready to help and provide whatever you need. They are polite, discreet, and highly efficient.
Alonso deserves special mention; when he is at the front desk, he helps with absolutely anything you need. He is kind, friendly, attentive, and extremely capable when it comes to any request—whether it’s arranging a taxi with a fixed price, giving directions, or recommending local restaurants. By the way, César (from the breakfast room), his colleague, Alonso, and most of the housekeeping staff are Spanish speakers, which is great. The other front desk staff are also very kind and helpful; I needed to print something, and they simply told me to email it to the front desk and they would print it for me.
Finally, I would like to mention Susana McCoon—the best and most approachable hotel General Manager I have ever met. She is personable, friendly, and kind, responding quickly and efficiently to any questions you might have, whether before or during your stay. I had the opportunity to meet her in person and was impressed by her approachable manner, her kindness, and, above all, her professionalism. A perfect 10 for her and her entire team, as well as for this hotel—a hidden gem in Manhattan! We will definitely return and recommend it to family and friends whenever we can. Bravo to you all!

author: Caleb O
title: Pretty central and excellent service.
text:
Excellent central position. As a solo traveller the room was fine, perhaps a little overpriced but you are paying for the position, central and close to most sites and subway near by.
The breakfast was very good and the service from Cesar exceptional. His waffles were amazing.

author: Sean D
title: Big events test the big brands
text:
I am an avid traveller and use Hilton brands wherever is possible. During Knicks finals and 2026 FIFA WC week I booked 2 rooms at Hampton inn. Right from the  check in problems started. Front desk agents do not know how to smile. They always want to "win the game" everything I asked and inquired were answered back in a lecturing tone. In orther words " we are right "
Breakfast was awful as the basics were missing all the time , Milk, bread etc.
When I asked as a Diamond member can I get credit for breakfast, the answer was No!
So overall all good deeds by other properties went down the tube by one unprofessional and indifferent crew at Hampton Inn Manhattan.

author: Hannah F
title: Location and More
text:
Perfect location.  
Friendly staff.  
Clean and comfortable rooms.
Breakfast was good.

author: Alexander J
title: FIX THE VIEW!
text: Overall a great experience however, there was one MAJOR flaw. The cuck chair viewing postion was simply inadequate not to mention the air cushion provided no support and or comfort

author: Lucia T
title: Friendly hotel, quality service
text:
Clean, quality hotel. Room faithful to description, cleaning and change sheets and daily towels. 
A staff with little care, very welcoming, and a big thank you to the service of breakfast, especially the gentleman who looks after the waffles (they are delicious) and it shapes us for our well-paced days.
Continue like this, we are delighted to have stayed here.

author: Claire G
title: Dreamy Skyline Views
text: First of all, I want to thank all the excellent staff members who interacted with me through the Hilton app chat both before and during my stay: Saud, Jessica <3, Zay and Marwane. As someone who loves skylines, this hotel was the perfect match for me. I stayed on the 32nd floor, and the view was a dream. It was pure magic.

author: Adam Z
title: Noisy with unreliable lifts
text:
The only good thing about the hotel is the staff.
We went during a period when they were placing new mattresses and removing old ones.
Any other hotel would have closed during that period because it was ridiculous trying to get in a lift.
The lifts are not good enough for that size a hotel. There is not enough dining space either.
But by far the worst thing about this hotel is the noise at night. I complained twice hoping to be moved to a better room. There was a very loud ac out of the window and I got no sleep. I would advise anyone to avoid the hotel, the only good thing is the kitchen staff

author: Tyler A
title: Bad.
text:
Hello, I want to record my bad experience at the hotel.

Upon check-in I discovered that I had a duplicate reservation and tried to solve it at reception, but I was given no alternative and had to pay for two rooms when I only used one.

In addition, the rooms are very small, the carpets are old (although the bathrooms were clean), and during my stay they were changing mattresses with very bad organization: every time I needed to use the elevator I had to wait between 20 and 30 minutes.

Breakfast was also very poor, although I stress the friendliness of the staff.

Overall, a negative experience. I was expecting a lot more.

author: Emma G
title: Great Location and Very Quiet
text: Great location.  Make a left, left on 8th Ave and subway entrance is one block away on 40th.  The subway is totally practicable.  I went to Yankee Stadium one day, went to the Staten Island ferry one day and lots of other adventures in my week here.  I was on the 30th floor and it was totally quiet.  Staff was very helpful, especially Cesar in the breakfast room.  Breakfast was pretty good and free.  I was on my own and my room was pretty small with a kingsized bed.  That is my only criticism.

author: Lucas A
title: Humanity above a business process
text: Kudos to Saud, Susana and Rixon in the business office. Our family had a tragedy. Our cousin who was visiting the United States for a few days with his wife had booked a non refundable room through Expedia for 3 nights. However he tragically passed away  during the vacation but before his visit to NYC. When we first approached Expedia they refused to cancel and refund the reservation. We called the Hampton Inn directly and Saud did an exceptional and prompt job placing humanity over a business process and along with his superiors assisted a full and complete refund. The returned funds went a long way to help the grieving family fund a funeral in USA and facilitate carrying the cremated ashes back to their home country. Kudos to the hotel management team for their timely assistance.

author: Abigail G
title: Book with caution
text:
Good location, friendly and helpful staff. Previous reviews regarding the concerns with the elevators were right. We stayed on the 9th floor and ended up taking the stairs down with our suitcases because we could not catch an empty elevator or one that we would fit in, going up or down.  

We stayed in a double bed room. The room was SMALL!!!! the hotel in general was small. 

Breakfast area is small. We happen to arrive at the right time and were able to grab a table. The staff making the waffles was helpful. He made sure to take our order and bring waffle to our table.

author: Charlotte F
title: Value for money super location
text:
Franchelent very good
Very good bedding with queen size sets
Clean impeccable
Charming and super helpful staff
Breakfast buffet very good with choice, I recommend the mega waffle of Cesar 
One downside waiting at the elevators during peak hours

But frankly for the price in this season and the proximity to Times square it was very nice

author: Nora B
title: Excellent reception staff,  dreadful customer service
text:
We booked Mon to Fri on this hotel and due to the snow storm that hit New York, our flights were cancelled for 48 hours. We instantly telephoned the hotel, and spokento a lovely lady who told us,  that if we spoke to Expedia,  who we had booked through,  that we could get the dates rearranged. Expedia were excellent and said there was no problem with this and they would let the hotel know. They replied within minutes and told us that Saud a supervisor at the hotel had point blank refused any changes to our booking,  despite it being completely our of our hands.  So having paid for the trip we were able to take just 2 nights in the hotel.

As for the hotel, the staff on front desk are so good, couldn't really do enough for you.  The rooms were OK, clean and tidy,  however the heating system was broken on our room 403, and blew cold air throughout our stay and world just turn on randomly throughout the night and was so noisy. 

After our booking fiasco, we changed hotels to another hotel 2 blocks away and have to say, have been treated so much better in terms of our booking. 

Let's say we won't be using Hilton again,

author: Daniel I
title: Good value for money
text:
Organizing no problem, in New York as in London the rooms are always this size!
The bedding is of good quality
Easy and quick welcome, very nice made us a key again because the children had taken the 2, possible leave the suitcases at the reception on the last day before taking back the plane (etiquette system so top)
Nice breakfast, repeats itself but for 5 days not complaining ... salty / sweet and the famous waffles and good humor of cesar 👍🏼 l other little lady isr very nice too
Small room at rush hour you have to watch who leaves and settle!
So to summarize quality / price ratio very well
To authors of critical messages, whether they compare elsewhere or open their wallets more

author: Lucy N
title: Obscene breakfast
text:
At this hotel, I paid for the breakfast-included package and upon our arrival, you discover that the package includes ONLY ONE item per person.
So, after waiting in line for 20 minutes, you can take only 1 yogurt, only 1 egg, and so on.
The coffee is obscene and the staff is very rude. 
Stay away

author: Diego B
title: Very slow breakfast and at checkout they do whatever they want
text:
We stayed at this hotel from August 4th to the 13th.
Positive notes:
 location, comfortable beds and comfortable bathroom, room cleaning more or less at the usual time and quite fast, satisfactory air conditioning, closet a bit small but several drawers. 
Negative notes:
Breakfast 
the products are good but the service is very slow and there is little attention to refilling products (since the breakfast formula involves choosing three products from 3 categories: 1 preparation, 1 fruit, 1 drink.... it often happened that the fruit ran out and was not replaced with another option).... poor maintenance of the coffee machine.... sometimes I was left waiting for someone to come and put water in... without being able to make coffee!
Resort fee....29 dollars that become 33.35 with taxes...which they grant you as credit to spend at the hotel bar..convenient but with little control.... so much so that at the time of checkout when we had to redeem the 400 dollar deposit (50 for 8 nights) requested at check-in, we were told that the resort fees for the 9 nights would be deducted from that amount...so a total...a week after returning we see from the credit card that they withheld another 96 dollars but it is not known for what reason because at checkout they did not communicate anything.... we have already sent two emails to get explanations and details of the expenses but we have not received a response... we are waiting!

author: Sara U
title: Room
text: Jonathan and Zaida have been absolutely amazing!! They’re both so nice, attentive, and have made my stay such a great experience. I still have an hour left, but I already know I’ll definitely be coming back to this hotel because of them! ❤️

author: Samuel H
title: 2nd Stay - Great Experience
text:
This was my second multi-night stay at this hotel. It’s conveniently located within easy walking distance of Javits Center and close to Times Square and restaurants. I like the size of this hotel - about 120 rooms. The room was clean, modern/ updated and my premium king room had a fancy Nespresso coffee maker. I was not an immediate fan of the resort fee but soon learned how to make the daily food credit in the hotel lounge work for me as the prices there are much more reasonable than food prices at Javits. 
The staff at this hotel is what brought me back for this return stay of 4 nights. They are really friendly and go out of their way to ask about your stay, room, check-in, and genuinely want to know if they can do anything for you. In my experience this is truly unique in hotels almost anywhere these days but particularly in New York City. I was literally greeted by name when I came through the lobby on several occasions!
Special shout out to front desk staff members Robbi and Jonathan for the extra attention and assistance and great efficiency . Also thanks to Neisha (overnight front desk) who took great care of me upon my very early morning arrival at the hotel until my room was ready. She was very gracious, supplied beverages and checked in frequently about my comfort and wellbeing. 
These are just the people I interacted with the most. All the staff members were friendly and efficient. This hotel delivers really well on all the basics but the staff sets the hotel apart and take the experience to another level!

author: Nora S
title: The distrikt rocks
text: Beautiful quiet and super comfy beds. My new favorite hotel for my work visits to Manhattan. Jon did an amazing job!

author: Amelia H
title: COULDN'T BE BETTER!
text: We had an absolutely fabulous stay at Distrikt Hotel in NYC.  The accommodations were excellent, a nice central location for our activities and was topped off by a welcoming, responsive and very friendly staff.  Zeta, Dennis, and Jonathan were all excellent hosts whether it be temporarily storing our luggage since we arrived 5 hours before check-in, greeting us personally on every exit and re-entry and even finding umbrellas for us to use when a sudden rainfall broke out.  I always have a great experience at Hilton properties and this one was one of the best.  Book a room there and find our for yourself!

author: Megan X
title: Yahtzee!!
text:
Came for a 2nd visit and even happier than the first.  Prime location, great room and great staff.  Jon at the front desk really solved some room issues for me, kudos to him.
I’ll be back to this hotel.

author: George M
title: Another Awesome Stay
text:
Another 1st class stay @ the Distrikt Hotel.
My friend & I were in NYC to see a few Broadway shows recently & our only hotel choice is the Distrikt in Hells Kitchen.
The staff is so welcoming & always has a smile & a pleasant greeting. 

The hotel is so clean, safe & has everything you would need & so close to Times Square & the many restaurants of Hells Kitchen.

Gideon, Noha, Chrissy, Mike & Dennis are the best & are always there to help with any questions. 

Don’t stay anywhere else while in NYC!

author: Pierre P
title: Terrible experience
text: I am here in New York for the second time and the stay at this hotel was disappointing for me. It is in a good location and all in all the room is not bad but... breakfast included is terrible, after a while the food runs out and they tell you they don't have any more, not very rich, only cold drinks and bar staff not very helpful, especially if you don't understand them! As soon as you arrive they announce an extra fee of 29 dollars per night per room to be paid with consumption at the bistro bar, too bad that for two consecutive days I ordered salad and it was served to me after quite a wait (and there was no line!) with apologies because it was without carrots, is it so complicated to buy them? I asked for towels because we were 4 people and they had been provided for 3, they were given to me but dirty!!!! Furthermore, since my arrival there has been a protest by the staff of the hotel next door with people continuously shouting and playing drums and cowbells on the street under my room, stopping only late at night, I asked for help because we cannot rest and I was told that they have no other rooms on the other side because they are sold out these days and they don't know how to solve the problem. I would definitely not return here and I do not recommend it to anyone, for what I paid and for the location there are many other better possibilities than this one. If I had known, I would have returned to the hotel where I stayed the first time...

author: Oliver Y
title: Wonderful 3 Night Weekend Getaway
text:
We had a wonderful stay. The hotel was exceptionally clean and in a fantastic location. We’ve stayed at many hotels in New York City over the years, and this one truly stood out because of the outstanding hospitality!

I’d first like to extend my sincere thanks to Shonda at the front desk for her warm, friendly, and funny personality. She made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived!

A special thank you as well to Keke in the restaurant and bar. She was an absolute joy, an excellent bartender, and made every visit enjoyable…Most importantly, I want to recognize Chrissy, the Guest Relations Supervisor. She was an exceptional communicator and went above and beyond to make our anniversary stay extra special. Her thoughtfulness, attention to detail, and genuine hospitality made all the difference, and we cannot thank her enough for creating such a memorable experience, I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting New York City, and we look forward to returning again soon!

author: Caleb W
title: Wonderful stay
text: We stayed here for my birthday and Chrissy made it unforgettable! There was a fantastic surprise in our room when we checked in, she greeted me by name when we came to the bar for a cocktail and really did everything to make sure we had a great trip. The room was a great size, clean, well decorated and very convenient to theaters. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Ella P
title: Very convenient location
text: Excellent location, central and close to the subway stop. Robby at the front desk is truly efficient

author: Ruby X
title: A+ Distrikt staff
text: The staff at this hotel is exceptional. I travel for work, and when I have choice...I stay at the Distrikt when I come to NYC, because of the staff. They have made me feel so welcome over the past year of stays. And they remember you. It's a very warm feeling with a top notch and spacious for a NYC hotel room.  It's my go to place in the city.

author: Lucy C
title: Good Times Square stay
text:
Location of course is great since this hotel is located near Times Square and you know exactly what you're getting yourself into. It's across the street from PABT station, and either a short walk or a one-stop subway ride to Penn Station / Moynihan Hall. Times Sq / 42 St subway station is a less than one block walk from the hotel with many lines available. 
The hotel does charge some kind of resort fee for about $33 per night per room. It includes a $29 food / beverage credit, and local gym access. We did not use the whole thing, we ended up ordering alcoholic beverages and taking them to our room. If I were to do over, I would have ordered bottled / canned drinks and just saved them unopened for later. 
There is an ice water dispenser in the lobby, and capsule coffee machine for free use in the restaurant.
Right now the hotel has a notice of 1 (out of 2) elevators working at a time due to maintenance. The elevator runs at lightning speed, so the wait was really not bad considering the building is about 30 storeys.  There were a few moments when both were working too.
Room is in fair condition but clean. There are things like hooks missing, slightly broken shower head, but everything is overall functional. Nice bath / body products in large bottles bolted to the bathroom walls. Bed was comfy. A/C worked well. Only five hotel rooms on our floor so hallway noise was very limited. 
This hotel was pricey due to many events during the weekend I came, and I only chose this place because it was "relatively" cheaper than others in the area. This would not be my first hotel choice in Times Square in the future, however my stay this time was decent.

author: Poppy B
title: Overpriced and needs renovation
text: We had to pay the standard price for our room and 3 nights came to about $1500. VERY overpriced. One elevator didn’t work. Horrible bistro/dark few food options. Breakfast bad. Hotel needs renovation said shabby. Reception staff was really great. Friendly and welcoming

author: Ella L
title: Veey bad experience.
text:
Overall location is center of Manhattan. However street location is not good. Street is dirty and stinks. 
Even air freshener at reception is of poor quality 
Front desk staff were not clear on mandatory credit. We could not use it on all days. She said it was applicable only once during stay. 
Breakfast lady is very rude.  
Rooms very small in size but clean.
1 lift did not work. Lot of delays 
Room ac is noisy
We had 7th floor room. Very bad view. Street very noisy. 
On last day 1 person tried to enter room forcefully and kepr banging our door.
Overall poor experience.
Pls choose elsewhere
NY subway is user friendly. You can travel easily

author: Giulia N
title: Great hotel and location.
text:
Wow we had amazing stay. The reception team were friendly, the rooms are spacious with a complementary fridge and excellent housekeeping . We had a nice view and the hotel is an excellent location for exploring. The restaurant staff were exceptional served a good choice of food with vegan option and was well presented. It was my mum’s birthday, Chrissy had arranged a beautiful birthday surprise with some lovely gifts. Thank you so much Chrissy. 

We stayed one week, when we checked out the staff were very helpful, a big shout out to Dennis. He helped store our bags and when our transfer arrived Dennis helped  carry our bags to the vehicle. 

We would highly recommend this hotel for everything it has to offer. I would definitely stay here again. 

Thank you for a fantastic holiday and birthday celebration. See you again in the future : )

author: Oliver R
title: Go after July 30 and think about the location.
text:
This is NOT a boutique hotel, I have stayed at Doubletree, HGI and many many hotels in NYC and this is just the same. Its fine. Does the job, no better no worse.

Firstly one elevator working, other out of action since March 30 and not to be repaired until July 30. What that means is chaos  at peak periods. Maids stop on evert floor etc.. Had I known I would have booked elsewhere. Second mandatory daily $29 charge which you can reclaim at the sad airport like restaurant coffee bar at rear. This is run by ms Grumpy who only manages a thank you at time of tipping. Other staff are very helpful and friendly.
If you like the crowds and nonsense of Times SQ and the ugliness of the Port Authority Terminal this is your place.
If you want easy in and out go to below Herald Sq or above 66th.Use the subway and the east side is quieter always than the west side.
I was here on a corporate booking so no choice this time.

author: Daisy B
title: Excellent location and service
text: Great service by Jon and the others who were able to accommodate requests quickly.  He was caring and took customer service seriously. The location was very convenient. My only gripe is the elevator issues. Only one elevator bank is working. Overall, I would stay again.

author: Oscar O
title: Comfort, cleanliness, and perfect location.
text: We were very comfortable throughout our stay. The hotel was exactly what we were looking for: an excellent location to get around New York, clean rooms, and absolute comfort. Everything was very well taken care of, and we felt at home. Without a doubt, a highly recommended option to enjoy the city.

author: Alexander Y
title: Nice Service!
text: I had a great stay in this hotel and had an amazing sausage which was well cooked. Astha was very supportive in the breakfast. The room was very organized too. The staffs were very good at the reception too. Will visit again with my family

author: Elena Q
title: Best Staff!
text: My mom and I stayed at the Clayton on our first trip to London. The hotel was clean and amazing, walking distance to food and shops. I want to give a HUGE shot out to PJ at the desk and Tanzid & Rifart at the onsite bar and restaurant. They were incredible and made our stay even better. Management should be proud. I highly recommend this hotel and plan on returning.

author: Lily T
title: Good ambience and superb food
text:
I had a lunch with my friends at Clayton hotel. The ambience was very good. The people at the service and the kitchen was very excellent.
Wanted to mention Cous Cous salad which was superb. Astha and Derick was there to provide the best for us.
Will definitely come again

author: Emma J
title: Good Service
text: Stayed at Clayton Hotel for a night and had a great breakfast with excellent service there. Wanted to thank Astha who was very good at her service and provide excellence!

author: Anna Q
title: Good Experience and Service
text:
I stayed at Clayton Hotel London Wall and had a wonderful experience. The hotel was comfortable, welcoming, and the breakfast was really good with a great variety of food. I especially enjoyed the freshly prepared omelette there.

The service was excellent, especially Astha, who was incredibly kind, attentive, and helpful throughout my stay. She made sure I was well taken care of and made the breakfast experience even more enjoyable. Really appreciated the warm hospitality and excellent service. Highly recommended!

author: Aiden X
title: Great food and service
text: Wow , service and food 10 out of 10 ! Niraj and Mourad in the kitchen . Wowzers

author: Carlos Q
title: Fantastic hotel
text:
What can i say. This is one of the best hotels we have ever stayed in. Firstly the location is great, about 6 mins from Liverpool Street Station.
Everything about the hotel was first class. The room was great, a big room for London and spotlessly clean with a king size bed and super bathroom with bath and walk in  shower. Air conditioning was a bonus especially in this hot weather.
We had booked the breakfast and it was fantastic well worth paying that little bit extra for. Best hash browns I've ever tasted.
But the best thing about this hotel is the staff who are exceptional. Everyone of them were so friendly and welcoming and took time to have good converation with you.
Another great thing about the hotel is if you arrive before check in time  they will store your luggage in a secure room were no one else has access to.
Overall we had a great stay at the Clayton Hotel London Wall and  cannot reccommend it highly enough.

author: Hugo F
title: Nice stay and friendly staff
text:
I had a really enjoyable stay at this hotel. Great location to central London, comfortable room and genuinely friendly staff.
A special thanks to Hootan, who was very helpful and made sure I had a comfortable room that suited my needs. I also had a great time at the hotel bar with a friend after a while. Tanzid and Rifat were both friendly and welcoming and made our evening even more enjoyable.
I would definitely recommend this hotel and would happily stay here very soon again.

author: Sean E
title: Great team of staff, and such a wonderful hotel
text: Wanted to say a special thank you to PJ at guest services for taking such good care of me during my stay, such a warm welcome and so polite. Nothing was to much trouble. He's a real asset to the hotel.

author: Miguel U
title: The right choice
text:
We went to London to attend a wedding at the One Moore Place, we were 4 adults and 2 children (under 10 years), this is where I was hesitating about staying in the hotel as their maximum occupancy is 2 adults or 2 adults + one child (less than 3 years) by room (hence we needed three rooms), we stayed 3 days/2 nights.
We did some research for hotels around and all were about +10min taxi ride from the wedding venue, we really value our comfort and decided that leaving late at night from the event with kids, the easiest choice was the Clayton Wall (is literally a 2 min walk). We kindly requested interconnected room (which they don't have) or at least close to each other.
All I can say, is that we REALLY did the right choice!, I could give 4 stars review due to the occupancy issue, but I'm been objective here and I consider that it would be unfair.
We were received by a nice lady (sorry I didn't catch her name) that gave us all the information, all rooms were on the same floor and close to each other as requested (we even got an upgrade in 2 of them :) ).
Rooms were nice and clean, plenty of amenities and beds really comfortable.
The breakfast is a must, Mr. Derek and his team welcomed us and provided a really nice service, the quality and quantity of the breakfast is just outstanding.
After the wedding we wanted to visit around, we found Mr. Pomadure (PJ) at the front desk, absolutely a great lad, excellent service, respectful, help us arranging a sightseeing, joking with the kids about football players and teams (soccer), initially he pointed us to a bus stop in the main street, once we arrive there we notice that it was the wrong one and we found out that we had to go to another one, we were calmly walking down the street and next thing I notice is PJ calling us! he actually double checked the instructions he gave us and realized that the bus stop was wrong and went out to find us (which incredibly he did!!), we thanked him and he sent us new itinerary by email.
Honestly we enjoyed a lot our stay at the Clayton London Wall Hotel, I would seriously recommend the hotel management to reassess their room occupancy as their rooms are big and could easily accommodate a small "portable" single bed for kids above 3 years old, although I understand that it my not be their main target audience (families) as per their location.
Thanks a lot for all you help and great service provided during our stay.

author: Lauren F
title: Great experience staying in the City of London
text: Perfect location for a wedding party at a local venue. Extremely efficient and professional staff contributed to a calm atmosphere throughout our stay. The rooms are functional, comfortable and well equipped. The price was suitably reasonable for the area and the amenities.

author: Isla W
title: Great !
text: Great experience ! Thank you Astha and Rifat ❤️

author: Molly X
title: Exceptional Hospitality
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an outstanding experience at this hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive, making me feel valued throughout my visit

The food was delicious, with a wide variety of options, and the service by Bianca and Derick in every area of the hotel was exceptional. The facilities were well-kept, and the overall atmosphere was relaxing and luxurious.

I highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, quality, and outstanding hospitality. I look forward to staying here again in the future!

author: Zoe R
title: London Lunch Memory
text: Wonderful food accompanying by marvellous service by Mourad & Niraz made our day memorable. We are family of three had lunch as part of our central London trip and we thoroughly enjoyed. Special thanks to both of them and chef as well

author: Molly W
title: Family Meet for Lunch
text: My daughter met me and my husband after three years in London. We really had lovely day with help of restaurant team Niraj & Bianca at Clayton Hote. Food and services are marvelous and highly recommended

author: Louis G
title: Amazing people and service!
text: The people here are so so so amazing!! The service, hospitality, and food are some of the best I have experienced at a hotel and I greatly appreciate everyone’s professionalism. Dee, Tanzid, Chef Mourad, and Shagur made our experience so special and I would recommend this place to anyone staying in London for the first time, or returning!

author: Elena X
title: Clayton London Wall Review
text: My girlfriend and I have had a great time thus far! Our room was nice and housekeeping is great with cleaning and bringing fresh sheets/towels. The restaurant is amazing as well. Dee, our server, always provides top notch friendly service and chefs Mourad and Shagun have made delicious meals all week. This is a great option for a short or extended stay.

author: Benjamin Z
title: Anniversary stay
text: Fantastic overnight stay to celebrate our wedding anniversary. We had a wonderful experience from check in until we left. Our room was upgraded, large and very comfortable. An anniversary plate of goodies in our room was a welcome treat. Breakfast was excellent. The staff really made our stay. All polite, friendly and professional. Special mention to Dhana who is a credit to this hotel. Can’t wait to return!

author: Luca H
title: Friendly staff and great service
text:
Stay for business and also did some sightseeing 
Dee and Chef Edy and Moired serves up a great meal on our last night before leaving before they closed the kitchen.  Took extra care to split our shared meal and even made a wonderful ice cream dessert.  5 stars and Dee was a pleasure to talk with and take care of me on several occasions.  
Scott

author: Katie L
title: Hotel Experience
text: I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The entire team was friendly, professional, and genuinely welcoming. A special thank you to Anna for her exceptional kindness and support. She was always happy to help, not only with the hotel but also with recommendations and advice about the city, which I truly appreciated. I would also like to thank the breakfast team for their warm welcome and excellent service every morning. They made every day start with a smile

author: Jack M
title: LOUD ROOMS and no working vaccum-Overrated
text: I gave this hotel a 2nd chance after checking out early the last time I stayed. I should have passed. The 1st stay I had a Queen room which did not have even a window. The staff was rude and the food was poor. This time I booked the King Studio (their highest category) and had 2 different rooms on the front of the building. The first was dirty at check in with a cookie still on the floor, crumbs all over the couch, and hairs on the sheets. The person sent to pick up the cookie told me that they did not have a working vaccum. The light was also out in the bathroom and because it was a Sunday so I was told they could not fix it. I had to move rooms. The windows are not double glazed so you can hear EVERYTHING from the blocks around. The breakfast is the slowest most ridiculous experience. I will not stay a 3rd time.

author: Mia I
title: Absolutely the best!!
text: This is truly a hidden gem in the heart of Manhattan! The hotel is incredibly cozy, and the rooms are beautiful, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed. The staff is warm and welcoming, and the drinks and food are absolutely delicious. Everything was spotless, which made our stay even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this hotel and will definitely be coming back!

author: Ana D
title: Lovely
text: Great location. Friendly staff. Lovely experience. Felt like a European boutique hotel. Highly recommend.

author: Alexander L
title: A hidden gem!
text:
We highly recommend the Merrion Row Hotel! As first-time visitors to New York City, we took a chance booking this boutique hotel on 45th Street, and it exceeded every expectation.

From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and went above and beyond to make our stay easy and comfortable. Our room was charming, cozy, spotless, and surprisingly quiet—such a peaceful retreat after busy days exploring the city.

We enjoyed breakfast at the restaurant downstairs twice, and it was excellent each time. Housekeeping was attentive, our room was always refreshed, and whenever we needed extra towels, they were delivered promptly.

One of the things we appreciated most was the exceptional hospitality. After we checked out, the staff graciously stored our luggage so we could enjoy a few more hours in the city before heading home, making our last day completely stress-free.

If you’re looking for a hotel with outstanding service, a unique boutique feel, and a fantastic location, the Merrion Row is a true gem. We would absolutely stay here again and would choose it over a large chain hotel any day. Thank you for making our first trip to NYC so memorable!

author: Paolo A
title: A change from the big chain hotels
text: Couldn’t be happier , we actually booked in next door at the Hyatt central but when we arrived they had double booked us so we were effectively shown the door (I did get the money back) whilst standing in the street with nowhere to go we seen Merrion , we called in and they had availability and checked us in, what a lovely little hotel, food was lovely , room was clean and very nice the staff are all super friendly and it was more than reasonable . Having stayed at a few hotels in NYC this is definitely the best and I’m pleased we were double booked next door and we will definitely be back and recommend to friends

author: Ruby C
title: Fantastic Irish hospitality in the heart of New York
text:
We recently stayed at the Merrion Row Hotel and Public House and couldn’t have been happier with our choice. From the moment we arrived, the hotel felt warm, welcoming, and genuinely Irish in its hospitality.

We were fortunate enough to meet the owner, Bernie, and it was clear that the friendly atmosphere starts from the top. A special mention must go to Shona, who was absolutely fantastic throughout our stay. She and her team went above and beyond to make us feel at home, and we thoroughly enjoyed chatting, laughing, and starting each day with them.

The breakfasts were excellent. In fact, during our four-night stay we made it our mission to try as much of the breakfast menu as possible and very nearly completed it! Every breakfast was superb and set us up perfectly for a day exploring the city.

Having the hotel linked to Connolly’s Pub & Restaurant was a real bonus. It was a great place for the craic, with a brilliant atmosphere and plenty of Irish charm.

The location on 45th Street is superb—right in the heart of the action and within easy walking distance of so many of New York’s attractions. The hotel itself is small, comfortable, and full of character.

Shona and her team genuinely made our trip to New York even better. Their warmth, humour, and hospitality made us feel like old friends rather than guests. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a friendly, perfectly located hotel with outstanding hospitality.

5/5 – We’ll definitely be back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Nathan U
title: Quaint and Beautiful
text: A beautiful hotel, conveniently located to the financial district, subway and Times Square.  Bar was nice. Manager was very hospitable and accommodating. Room was beautiful and clean. Would highly recommend.

author: Harper O
title: Highly recommend!
text: Very friendly staff and a great location close to Time Square, but on a quiet street. Would definitely recommend!!

author: Connor L
title: Amazing find - highly recommend!
text: This was an amazing little boutique hotel experience right in the middle of town - the staff were so welcoming and warm - the bar and restaurant were great - and provided a bit of peace and relaxation during a fun filled trip. Comfy big beds - big for NYC - quaint and well equipped rooms, and so quiet given where you are! Just perfect.

author: Andrea X
title: Planning a Times Square/Broadway theater trip, look no further!
text: We travel to NYC frequently for the theater and usually stay at more expensive, well -known hotels but decided to give this little Irish boutique hotel a try.  Chef's kiss!!  Cozy, clean rooms, most accommodating staff and well reviewed on-site restaurant.  As we checked out, last week,  I realized I'd lost a special earring in the room. Needing to catch a train for home, I gave up hope on finding it.  The general manager and her staff then went above and beyond to search our room several times. Their dedication to service resulted in finding and returning the earring to me.  I cannot express my gratitude to Merrion Row's staff enough for returning it to me. Can't wait for our next visit!

author: Molly G
title: A Stay That Didn’t Live Up to My First Visit
text:
I stayed at this hotel shortly after it opened in 2019 and had such a wonderful experience. The hotel was beautiful, the rooms were lovely, and the customer service was amazing. I loved it so much that I told myself I would stay here again the next time I visited New York.

Unfortunately, this recent stay did not feel the same.

The hotel itself is still beautiful, and I still really like the rooms and overall design. However, the customer service was disappointing. The staff did not feel very welcoming, and some interactions came across as cold or rude. At one point, while I was waiting near reception, a staff member raised her voice at me without realizing I was a guest, which felt unnecessary and uncomfortable.

The rooms are nice, but they are small and the walls are quite thin, so noise can be an issue.

I’ll be returning to New York in a few months for work, but because of this experience, I’ll be choosing a different hotel. It’s a shame because I truly like the property, but the lack of warmth in the service changed the overall experience for me.

author: Molly X
title: You need to consider this hotel!!!
text: My wife surprised me with a trip for my 30th birthday and we stayed at this lovely hotel. From the moment we stepped inside, there was a lovely fresh scent, all the staff were so friendly, the room was perfect for our 2 day trip, the breakfast was sublime! And right around the corner from Times Square!! 100% would recommend and we’ll definitely be coming back on our next trip!

author: Lucia Q
title: Good location
text:
We wanted a smaller hotel for our stay in New York and Merrion Row met this requirement. The hotel is in a great location for Times Square, Central Park and 5th.

The bar in the hotel was really nice for an early evening drink before heading out. There is also a great deli/shop right next door, which offers good breakfast, smoothie and lunch options.

author: Lucy M
title: An Oasis in a big City
text: We visted last week, an amazing spot, very friendly, food was amazing and great value.  A bi mention to Hugo who was friendly and provided great service and was rally attentive.  Its a really nice bar, and we will definitley return on her next visit,  Very centrally located too - just off Time Square. Thanks again

author: Lucy Y
title: Perfect venue for theater stay!
text: Fantastic stay! Went to see the cursed child. Perfect location for short walk to the theatre. Staff went above and beyond. Friendly accommodating and made our stay pleasant.

author: Evie I
title: A great getaway
text:
This is such a gem of a place. Great location,  excellent and friendly staff, comfortable, clean rooms and a nice place to get away. Really,  the location and room size were perfect for seeing a show. 

Fire an NYC hotel, the street noise was pretty subdued. Room ac worked great and you can open some windows.

author: Juan L
title: Great location. Mediocre experience.
text:
Overall, it’s okay. Depends on your preference and expectations. 

Pros: Fairly quiet. Great Location.  Restaurant on site. Seem-less check in/check out process. Great WiFi. $25 credit per day of stay helped as there’s no coffee in the room. 

Cons: Small rooms, Uncomfortable beds - think Murphy beds, so bad if you have back issues. Bed creaks with movement, especially if you share with someone. Phone in room did not work, so have to go to the front desk in person for help or if you have a question. Rooms not cleaned well for multiple day stays. No coffee /tea, shower cap etc. in the room.

author: Connor R
title: Nice petite hotel in the big city
text:
Nice petite hotel in the big city!
Cute hotel in a great location near Times Square. Our rooms were ready when we checked in, which was a very nice surprise!  The room was very clean. The staff was extremely nice. the breakfast room is super cute and the pub had great food!  There was some street noise coming in the windows even with them shut. We had rooms at the street side of the building though.   All in all a very nice stay and we highly recommend Merrion Row Hotel!

author: Lucy B
title: A Slice of Ireland in NYC
text: Stayed here several years ago and have wanted to return.  Cozy, boutique hotel just a half block from Times Square and next to 2 other popular Irish Bars, Merrion Row has strong Irish vibes with great pints and good breakfasts.   Very comfortable rooms (especially the beds) and accommodating staff.  Small negative on coffee (needs to be hotter!) but otherwise another great visit and would love to return!

author: Ruby D
title: A Perfect Weekend Getaway
text: Merrion Row was fantastic, a perfect stay!! We visited NYC to see a broadway show and then to run the NYC Half Marathon this weekend, and Merrion Row was the best hotel for our stay. The food and atmosphere at the Public House was perfect and Sebastian was an awesome bartender. The room was gorgeous and very comfortable, and the hotel was perfectly situated to walk to Broadway and Times Square. We will definitely be back!

author: Anna M
title: Great expeeience
text: great location, great staff including Chris at Breakfast, Tamang and Shaddaf (not sure I have spelled correctly) at Reception and the lovely fellows helping with bags and taxis.

author: Camille D
title: Lovely afternoon tea time
text: We had a lovely time at our Afternoon Tea today; in large part due to the amazing service we received from Adam! He did not rush us in any way, explained everything thoroughly and was extremely helpful when we needed it while not hovering. The scones were our favourite but the sandwiches and desserts were also delicious, especially the salmon sandwich and salted caramel dessert. The oolong pairs perfectly with the meal. The ambiance in the room is perfect. Decor is modern/art deco but also classic, just like the rest of The Dixon. Highly recommend.

author: Megan R
title: Perfect 5 Days in London
text: The hotel is lovely with all modern conveniences of elevators, air conditioning. The rooms are very comfortable & modern. The staff is warm and friendly. The restaurant staff is outstanding; Adam, Iris and Chris were always friendly and helpful at breakfast. They serve a wonderful buffet with a delicious variety of options. The location is also outstanding. A short walk to the Tower Bridge in one direction & the Underground in the other. This was a perfect locale for our 5 day holiday.

author: Brooke F
title: Highly recommend
text: Beautiful hotel with wonderful service. Our hostess Iris remembered us daily and checked in about our travels. Very personable.

author: Ella O
title: High Tea Yums
text: High tea in the courtroom bar was excellent. Lina was the best. So kind and prompt.

author: Maria E
title: High Tea
text: Lina at the bar was amazing! We went for high tea and everything was spectacular. Highly recommend.

author: Giulia E
title: Cocktails, service, and atmosphere — a proper London gem
text:
What a lovely evening. The standout was The Oath — blueberry-infused gin, St. Germain, caramel syrup, and lime juice. Beautifully balanced and easily my favourite drink of the trip. I also tried the Dixon, which is a seriously strong pour, so consider yourself warned in the best possible way. For food I went with the classic fish and chips and it hit exactly the note you want in London.

The service deserves its own paragraph. My server Lina and the whole team behind her were outstanding — drinks and food arrived quickly, everyone was warm and friendly, and nothing felt rushed despite the pace.

The ambience is quintessentially London: heavy dark woods, low candlelight, and a warm glow that makes you want to settle in for another round.

I’d come back just for The Oath. Highly recommended.

author: Chloe J
title: Friendly
text: Friendly staff in Shakedown restaurant- Adam looked after me until my friend arrived.

author: Oscar L
title: Restaurant Review
text: Excellent service. Lovely food. I would defintely recommend it to other people and Adam was a very polite and excellent server

author: Lucas P
title: Lina is a fantastic bartender
text: Lina was my bartender and she’s the best.  Excellent attention to detail, friendly, personable and my dirty martini was fantastic.  The hotel is well situated and the rooms are great. I would definitely stay again!

author: Gavin W
title: Fantastic Hotel and staff
text: The bar at the Dixon was wonderful and Joy and Lina were both very personable and attentive.  The Oath drink and the the wines were fantastic!!

author: Benjamin Z
title: Work trip
text: Lina was amazing when I was decompressing after a long day at the office!

author: Oscar O
title: Business trip review
text:
Excellent rooms, great atmosphere, specially at the court room bar
 Special mention to Joy, amazing customer service.

author: Sophia H
title: Thanks to yo Adam - Shakedown Restaurant Dixon
text:
Thanks to Adam in the Shakedown restaurant at the Dixon Autograph Hotel for his helpful, attentive and courteous manner and looking after my wife and I. 
We appreciate his excellent service in the restaurant! Adam is a great ambassador for the Dixon hotel. 
Thanks Adam!!!
David from Toronto

author: Alexander L
title: Memorable visit -August 2026
text:
We stayed two nights , location above expectation , service exceptional !
Rooms very clean and we enjoyed our stay, highly recommended 
Very close to bridge

author: Samuel V
title: Wonderful Stay and Exceptional Service
text:
We had a wonderful stay! The hotel has a beautiful atmosphere, and the lighting throughout the property creates such a warm and elegant feel. Everyone we encountered was friendly, welcoming, and provided excellent service.

A special thank you to Rahul, who welcomed us at the entrance. Our family was traveling with 10 pieces of luggage, and he went above and beyond to help us with everything and make sure both our check-in and check-out went smoothly. His kindness, attentiveness, and willingness to help made a huge difference for our family.

We truly appreciated the wonderful hospitality and would happily stay here again!

author: George O
title: Lovely experience
text: Food was lovely. Great service from Lina

author: Zoe E
title: Birthday Afternoon Tea
text: August23 2026. We came to Dixon for a birthday afternoon tea and Lina really looked after us, very friendly and made my Wife’s birthday  special with champagne. Such a lovely hotel and we were very pleased with the food, service and how Lina looked after us. Thank you from Patrick & Helen Collins

author: Freya T
title: Birthday Afternoon tea
text: We had lovely Afternoon Tea for my birthday lovely food and exceptional service from Lina

author: Ella C
title: Waiting for my room
text: My room wasn’t ready when I arrived but I hung out in the bar area for brunch and Lina took excellenct care of me.  I had the French toast and chi latte.  Delicious!  Thanks for the great hospitality Lina!

author: Emma R
title: Great location for tube
text:
Location very good as tube station just a few minutes walk and a nice pub over the road and a nice restaurant connected to hotel.
The staff were lovely and friendly through out and helpful.
When we went to the rooms there was a strong smell of musty damp and this continued when we went in our room. 
The room itself was clean and tidy so no complaints there. we bought an air fresher and that did the trick for the musty smell.
The wi-fi was very bad but as only in room to sleep wasn't to mush of a problem if i had spent more time in hotel would of wanted the internet more.

author: Maria U
title: Good location and good food next door
text:
We chose this hotel as it was recommended on the Amex app with a deal.
The hotel is well situated and easy to get to with plenty of transport near by and amenities. 
The hotel is connected to a Chaiiwala restaurant which was lovely, and the breakfast included in the hotel payment was there, it was great each morning, coming with chicken sausages, turkey bacon, hashbrowns, beans, egg and toast. However, if you wanted English breakfast tea – it wasn’t an option and the teabags given were chai.
We love Indian food and they had a great choice for lunch.
You can also pay £5 each day to access the gym 2 doors down.
There are several pubs within walking distance, lots of takeaways and shops locally too.
The rooms are clean but very basic and in need of some modernisation. 

As we were visiting in summer, I was relieved to discover air conditioning which worked well! I would have appreciated some water in the room, when I asked the front desk whether I could get water he told me to go to Tesco or the local store. Even though I could see a fridge of bottles of water in the lobby. 
The bathroom was not the best, the door to the shower did not have adequate fittings and stayed open whilst showering, flooding the bathroom floor which we had to use our towels each day to soak up. The curtain track in the main room fell down every time we opened or closed the curtains. 
When we went out for the day, despite putting the housekeeping request on the door and switching on the designated light to indicate the room was ready to be cleaned, we would return to hotel around 3pm-4pm to get ready for our evenings and the rooms had not been turned down, had twice ran out of toilet roll and had no clean/dry towels to use, this happened every day. The rooms would be done by the time we returned at 10pm or so, but I really think that guests staying should be a priority. 

Immediate recommendations to elevate the hotel would be:
-	More milk sachets provided in room for teas and coffees.
-	Water in the rooms.
-	Wine glasses in the rooms for guests to use. 
-	Fix shower fittings. 
-	Fix curtain poles.
-	Get housekeeping to do service earlier in the day. 

Nevertheless, based on the location, the cost and the breakfast at Chaiiwala, I would consider staying again, its not the worst place to settle after long days out.

author: Zachary U
title: Damp and smelly
text:
The location is handy for underground stations. We had a basement room and the room was just damp . The bedding and soft furnishings were all damp and it smelled really bad. We barely slept as we basically slept in a bed that was damp. 
there was a leak above the shower which was dripping constantly.

author: Chloe I
title: Excellent hotel for the price
text:
This is our 5th time staying at the hotel and will definitely be returning. 
Our room was spacious and clean, with tea and coffee facilities. 
The bed was comfortable, providing us with a good nights sleep and the climate control was perfect, considering we visited during the recent heatwave.
Staff are friendly and helpful, greeting us with a cold lemonade on arrival.
Location is fantastic, 3 stops from Paddington which is great for exploring London.
We highly recommend as it’s such good value for money!

author: Nora K
title: Fabulous weekend in London
