text: So my partner booked this hotel for our weekend in London to see Lewis Capaldi. London was very busy the weekend of 10th-12th July and we did pay over the odds. We had never stayed this side of London before and after reading the reviews it is safe to say I was very anxious and worried. When we arrived at Kilburn High road I was a bit concerned initially as I walked out, but once we had checked in and walked around we both really liked it. The receptionist was lovely and very friendly. We had a nice room, clean, working tv, working air con, clean bathroom no concerns AT ALL!  We always explore our area on arrival and it is clear other people don’t do the same. We found some cracking pubs on our doorstep, The Old Bell with a lovely outdoor area across the road and some other fab pubs in walking distance. We also found the wonderful  Paddington recreation ground just 10 minutes away. We have never had anything like this in London. A little cafe, kids play area, football courts, tennis courts, athletics track, large field where there was a cricket match taking place, forests and areas of nature, beautiful little gardens. We loved it that much we went for a walk the following morning before heading out for the day. The overground was 7 mins to Euston and everywhere else very easy to get around. Everyone we came across was polite end friendly and we loved it so much we would definitely return! We even went to one of the local pubs after the concert for the second half of the England quarter final football game along with extra time. The bar staff were so friendly and we had no issues at all. Absolutely fabulous weekend in London and would recommend, just keep an open mind. You are in a massive capital city at the end of the day! I appreciate everyone’s experiences are different but we can only comment on ours.

author: David F
title: Avoid at all costs
text:
Avoid this hotel.

We paid £125 for one night during a red weather warning heatwave and were given a room that was completely unfit to stay in. The air conditioning was broken, and despite reporting it immediately through the hotel messaging service and then multiple times at reception, absolutely nothing was done to fix it that night. We were repeatedly told it had been “reset” and would start working within 20 minutes. It never did.

The room remained unbearably hot, and we spent the entire night desperately trying to cool down with three personal fans, the hotel’s ice fan that they provided, cold showers, and even a damp T-shirt. We didn’t get to sleep until around 3am. To make matters worse, the window did not stay open, to create some chance of airflow we had to jam it open with a pillow. the room had ants, and the overall cleanliness was poor.

The next morning, the manager was shocked by the condition of the room. She apologised, admitted she was embarrassed by how the situation had been handled, moved us to a clean room with working air conditioning, and offered complimentary drinks. Unfortunately, this was after we had already endured the entire night and we only had around an hour before checkout. Seeing how comfortable the replacement room was only highlighted how badly our original room had been handled.

What is completely unacceptable is what happened afterwards. We submitted a formal complaint requesting compensation and have made multiple attempts to contact the hotel. We have been met with total silence. Not even the courtesy of an acknowledgement. Taking £125 for a room that was uninhabitable is bad enough; ignoring paying customers afterwards is disgraceful. I see we are in the same boat as others who have left bad reviews.

This experience showed a complete lack of urgency, accountability and customer care. A hotel charging these prices should not be leaving guests to suffer through a sleepless night in dangerous temperatures with broken air conditioning, only to ignore them afterwards. I would not stay here again and would strongly advise others to look elsewhere.

author: Erin O
title: Avoid at all costs
text:
ABSOLUTELY AVOID AT ALL COSTS 
This hotel needs closing down or a serious refurb and management overhaul.

I’m not a picky hotel guest, especially paying less than £100 in London I don’t expect much.

The staff are very dismissive and rude it’s very clear they don’t care about their guests or even to pretend like they care.

I have stayed here on 3 separate occasions and each time is awful in different ways.

First - tiny room, for a “superior double” no window - and the strongest damp smell I have ever experienced. I didn’t even unpack my clothes as I was worried the smell would linger. I asked to move and told the hotel was at “capacity” I have never seen this hotel busy before…
There was also stains all over the bedsheets
The TV didn’t work in the room, neither did the air con remote.
The chair that is sat with the desk was covered in mould at the back.

Second - slightly better room, still not CLEAN, everyone I have found stray hairs in the bathroom.
Then around 10:00pm the fire alarms started going off, everyone was huddled in reception panicked, the only member of staff wasn’t even in the building.
This alarm went on until 2am. No apology, no refunds or acknowledgment.

Third - and FINAL I will never stay at this hotel again. I arrived and realised there was an error with my booking - double booking
Had to go through 3 members of staff all of which again - could not care less and just repeated “ITS A NON REFUNDABLE BOOKING”
The manager they were whatsapping was of course, no help at all and they were way too excited to keep my £80 than to take care of their customer base and have return custom.

And overall the location is horrible too, you have homeless people on the doorstep, it doesn’t feel safe and secure as the front door is open at all times and the staff at reception do not care who enters the building.

There is no manager on site at any point they just communicate via whatsapp 

It’s a really disappointing and uncomfortable experience and I urge you to spend the extra £20 per night and stay elsewhere.

author: Alice T
title: Worst hotel experience
text:
Very disappointing experience from start to finish. The room did not match the facilities advertised online, staff were unhelpful when issues were raised, and communication throughout the stay was poor.

We were unexpectedly asked to change rooms due to maintenance, despite being told it would be done at a time convenient to us, which it wasn’t. To make matters worse, there were late-night fire alarm issues that left guests waiting around for hours.

Overall the hotel felt poorly managed and not worth the money. Would not stay here again.

author: Lucas O
title: Avoid if you value cleanliness, trustworthy staff  and half decent service
text:
Absolutely appalling experience at Maitrise Hotel Maida Vale.

The hotel itself was dirty, poorly maintained and smelt strongly of stale chip fat throughout. There were even flies in the room, which says everything about the standard of cleanliness being maintained.

What has made the experience far worse, however, is the way the hotel has handled missing property following my stay in Room 217 on 9 May. I accidentally left three dresses in the wardrobe worth approximately £300 and have spent days trying to get a straight answer from the hotel. I have been repeatedly fobbed off with promises of callbacks that never happened, ignored by staff and treated with complete indifference.

The final straw was speaking to a staff member called Jenny, who was rude, dismissive and utterly unprofessional. At no point did anybody appear genuinely interested in helping or investigating properly.

At this stage I am extremely concerned about what has happened to my belongings and the complete lack of accountability from the hotel. I will now be escalating this further, including formally reporting the matter and sharing my experience publicly.

Avoid if you value cleanliness, professionalism or customer service.

author: Caleb N
title: I would rate this experience with a zero if that option were available.
text: I would rate this experience with a zero if that option were available. I strongly advise prospective guests to review the feedback before making a reservation with this establishment. My experience was quite unsatisfactory; We had reserved a double room with a window, but the email receipt indicated that we were assigned a room without one. Our requests to switch to the room type we originally booked were disregarded for several days. Consequently, we decided to cancel our reservation and seek a refund, intending to pursue legal action in small claims court. Despite this, our emails and refund requests continued to be ignored. I recommend investing a little more for a reputable and trustworthy hotel.

author: Oliver B
title: Not recommended to others
text:
The room facilities are outdated, necessary repairs have not been made, but are properly cleaned.Windows not to open, no mirror in the bathroom. In the evening only cold water for showering. Wifi with Samsung a problem. Despite info about request to change no success.Organization somewhat caotic.
Good location to the subway.
Friendly staff.
I'm not going to book a room there anymore.

author: Ruby H
title: DO NOT STAY HERE BEDBUGS!!!
text: DO NOT STAY HERE!! we was only in the room not even 1 hour and seen a bedbug crawling up the curtain!!! We ended up going down to reception and asked for a refund & took ourselves elsewhere. Then instead of refunding me I got charged again instead absoutle shambles and reported to local council for health & safety AVOID!!

author: Emma E
title: PLEASE read this before booking here!
text:
I don’t usually write reviews, but this stay definitely earned one.

We stayed here over the weekend, and it was genuinely the worst hotel experience I’ve had. There was a constant toxic sewage smell throughout the building, the room was boiling hot, and the air-con looked like it retired years ago and barely worked. The bed and pillows felt like sleeping on paving slabs, and the plug sockets were literally coming out of the wall with the slightest touch — very dangerous

We couldn’t even use the sink because the plug was jammed, so we ended up brushing our teeth in the shower like civilisation had moved on without us.

We booked breakfast for the first morning with the idea of deciding later about Sunday — safe to say we didn’t return. The woman running the breakfast area was rude from the second we walked in, the food was poor, we had to eat with wooden cutlery, there were no napkins, and we were refused milk for our coffee… which meant a trip back to our room to grab a milk pot.

The weekend in London itself was great, and the room was only meant to be a place to sleep — but honestly, I think we’d have had a better night’s rest on the Tube platform.
Do NOT stay here.

author: Molly Q
title: Not good.
text: Not well... room underground..no windows..smell of closed...smell of musty..we are not there...should be clearer...the guy at reception however was nice

author: Diego A
title: Not the worst but definitely not the best
text: Honestly for a two day stay, this hotel wasn’t the worst. However, there was a lot of things wrong with the room. Firstly, there was filler in the door for two small holes which is a very bad sign, there’s a lot of peeling paint on the roof and walls with very dangerous switches on the wall that are half hanging out. The floor of the shower had yellow stains which freaked both of us out. The room itself has nice presentation until you discover all these things. The hotel staff are normal. Nothing much to say there. The food is okay it’s not the worst or best it’s just okay. The only real positive thing I can say are the beds are comfortable and the shower pressure is amazing. The area is definitely one to be careful  in especially at night. I would never return here and I would advise anyone who’s looking for a longer stay to avoid here. The hotel is livable in but definitely not up to a high standard

author: Julien N
title: STOLEN WATCH ON PREMISES BY A MEMBER OF STAFF
text: Whilst working away on a business trip, I left my apple watch on my bedside.. only to come back from my work event to see it had been stolen by the cleaners. The hotel have avoided my messages,emails and calls. They did not refund me for my stay or offer any compensation, worst hotel I've ever stayed at.. please... please...please do not waste your money staying here. It is not a safe hotel, the area is also very rough so be aware at night. How this hotel meets the required standards to be trade is beyond me, the hotel.. the staff are not fit to work. Please stay way!!!!!!

author: Thomas U
title: You’d be crazy to book this place!
text:
I am currently staying here with a few friends, who booked the hotel because of its convenient location. Unfortunately, that is the only positive I can mention. It is now 3.50am, and I have not slept a single minute due to the unbearable noise coming from what I can only assume is a heat pump or some other mechanical unit positioned next to my room. The noise is relentless, grinding and rumbling every couple of minutes for several minutes at a time, before a brief moment of silence, and then starting again.

The room itself is far too hot, with the internal temperature set at 24°C, and opening the window only makes matters worse as the sound becomes even louder. The constant disturbance makes rest impossible.

To say this experience is disappointing would be an understatement. I defy anyone to stay in this room and not complain. If you are looking for a place to actually sleep, avoid this hotel at all costs. It is an absolute disgrace.

author: Megan A
title: Rude awakening
text:
I was awoken at 8:00 AM by loud renovation work directly above my room, including constant hammering and drilling. I went to reception an hour later to raise the issue, but by 9:15 the noise had resumed and continued until I decided to check out earlier than planned.

It was clear that renovation work was being carried out in Room 118, yet I was still placed in the room directly beneath. This showed a complete lack of consideration for guests and made it impossible to rest.

After several busy days in town, I had hoped to take advantage of my 11:00 AM checkout, but that was not possible due to the ongoing disturbance.

I have video evidence of the noise and expect a full refund for what was an entirely unacceptable experience

author: George B
title: Would not recommend
text: Stayed on business for one night. The hotel is cheap but that’s about it. Do not expect anything from your stay. Rooms are small. Also it’s currently being renovated and rubbish is everywhere. My colleague didn’t have a card from her room! Area is not looking great either .

author: Lucy G
title: Where Hot Showers Trigger Fire Alarms & Staff Forget You Exist
text:
We booked through a travel agent and had to add an extra night when our concert was rescheduled. I phoned ahead, was told I had to book online, and thought it was sorted. Not so. At check-in, reception insisted we were only there for one night. I explained. Then explained again the next morning when staff knocked on our door telling us to leave. Apparently, writing a note on a booking is beyond this place.

Our basement room was directly opposite the linen cupboard, with a corridor that permanently smelled of damp. The TV didn’t work, and reception’s answer was to shrug and say “maintenance tomorrow.” No curiosity, no care.

And then the fire alarms. First at 5:30am reception’s explanation was, “someone was having a hot shower.” Comforting. Then it happened again the following night at 4:30am. Two false fire alarms in two days. Apparently, showers are a health and safety risk here.

When we complained at checkout, the receptionist did apologise and said she would inform her manager which was appreciated but by then, the damage had already been done.

Overall, it’s a mix of chaos, damp corridors, broken facilities, dismissive service, and being jolted awake by alarms for daring to wash. If that’s your idea of a relaxing stay, you’ll love it.

author: Hannah K
title: Great hotel, nice staff
text: Great location, nice room, lovely helpful staff

author: Isla I
title: NCY adventure
text: I wanted to take a moment to express how absolutely incredible our stay was. Everything exceeded our expectations! The room was beautiful, far better than we could have ever imagined. The staff was incredibly welcoming and professional, making us feel at home from the very first moment. The breakfast was phenomenal and the value for money was truly unbelievable for such a prime location. Thank you for an unforgettable NYC adventure, we will definitely be recommending your hotel to everyone we know!!

author: Miguel X
title: Good location, small rooms, but very clean
text:
Just had a nice two nights stay for a daughter mother trip to go see The Lost Boys. Location is very close to Amtrak and the bus station so good on that mark. About a 10 minute walk and you are in Times Square.
The rooms were clean, but small very small but again very clean. With two queen beds there wasn’t much room to move around, but we’re both adults and we weren’t spending all of our time in the room. Just wanted to forewarn anybody that’s traveling with small kids that needs more space. This may not be the place for you.
Hotel staff was very nice. Didn’t really have the breakfast, but the coffee wasn’t bad.

author: Hugo M
title: “Very disappointing experience — poor service and promises not kept”
text:
I had a very disappointing experience at SpringHill Suites by Marriott in Manhattan.

When I arrived, the room I had originally reserved was not available, so I was given a different room instead. Unfortunately, I had to stay in that room for the entire duration of my stay.

To make matters worse, during the first three nights, my room was not cleaned at all. The beds were not made and the towels were not changed. I complained to the front desk, and after raising the issue again, I was told that this should not have happened and that I would receive a $100 discount on my room as compensation.

However, when it was time to pay, I was told that there was no record of the $100 discount and that nothing could be done. This was extremely frustrating. If a member of the staff makes a commitment to a guest, it should be properly documented and honored. Otherwise, it becomes very difficult to trust what guests are being told.

I also found my interactions with Natasha, Jeffrey, Eric, and William to be particularly disappointing and unprofessional. Whenever I approached them to follow up on my complaints, I felt that I was simply being told “yes, yes, yes” to get me out of the way, without any genuine intention of resolving the problems.

Overall, the combination of being given a different room than the one I had booked, having no housekeeping service for the first three nights, and then being promised compensation that was not honored made this a very poor experience.

I expected much better from a Marriott property. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this hotel.

author: Ella H
title: I would return here
text:
This is standing Hotel for its price range and location! I would very much look forward to staying here again on my next visit to New York City. First, you can’t beat the location. If you desire, you can walk to Penn Station. Light many New York hotels, this was an old building that has been renovated. Whoever your interior designers are did an outstanding job of utilizing the space efficiently, designing the window treatments and artwork, and providing furnishings that are functional and comfortable. 

The dining area downstairs was done extremely well. The staff did a great job of making sure that the food was constantly replenished and this was  a very busy morning. Also, I forgot to mention that every place we went was spotless (with the exception of the small outdoor area  an occasional pigeon might visit).

author: Lucia Z
title: Wonderful hotel for the family
text:
We loved our stay at the SpringHill by Marriott on 36th Street in New York! We were traveling as two adults and our 18-month-old daughter, and the hotel was perfectly suited for families.

The room was very comfortable, especially the king bed. We had also requested a playpen (baby crib), which was set up in our room upon our arrival. It was ideal: our daughter had her own place to sleep, while still leaving us the option to take her into bed with us if she woke up during the night.

The location is excellent. We were able to walk to Times Square, Broadway, the Disney Store, the M&M’s Store, the LEGO Store, the High Line, and even Central Park. Central Park was actually a favorite for our daughter thanks to the many playgrounds and water play areas. For Wall Street, we took the subway. With a stroller, some stations are less convenient, but several have elevators, which makes getting around easier.

The staff is exceptionally kind and welcoming. A very special mention to an employee from Senegal who spoke French. Since we are from Quebec, it was very appreciated to be able to communicate in our language when we had questions.

She was also kind enough to allow us to access our room before the official check-in time. Our daughter was taking her nap in her stroller when we arrived, and that allowed her to finish her sleep comfortably in an air-conditioned room. This small gesture made a huge difference for us.

Another point that was very appreciated: if you arrive in the morning during breakfast hours, the hotel allows you to enjoy breakfast even before having access to your room.

In summary, I recommend this hotel without hesitation. The rooms are comfortable, the location is ideal for exploring New York on foot, even with a young child, and the staff is very kind. We would gladly stay there again!

author: Paige K
title: Great hotel stay
text:
Excellent service. 
Jeffrey was very helpful and kind!

author: Marta K
title: Nice Stay in a Great Location
text: Great location. Friendly staff. Nice room; a bit crammed. Lousy HVAC. Great price.

author: Oliver U
title: Comfortable stay in Manhatten
text: Perfect Location in Manhatten, nearby Subway and many sightseeing attractions. Friendly staff, comfortable room, good breakfast

author: Paolo T
title: Best Hotel in NYC for the Price!
text: Excellent Free Continental Breakfast & Very Conveniently Located in NYC - Would Definitely Stay Here Again!

author: Charlotte O
title: Great Staff and Facilities!
text: I was very impressed with the pride and kindness of the staff here. They went out of their way to be very helpful. The hotel was clean, had a good laundry facility (better than mine at home ha ha) and a large fitness center by NYC standards. Also very quiet, no disturbances whatsoever in my room.

author: Oliver V
title: Absolute disappointment
text:
The hotel staff does not clean the room, does not change the sheets or the towels. We have been staying at this hotel for 3 nights and on 2 of them they have not "done the room". An absolute disappointment, we will not return to this hotel.
I must say that it is well located and the people in the lobby are friendly.

author: Charlie K
title: Room too small and too noisy
text:
I recently stayed in room 1402 and unfortunately my experience was very disappointing.

The room was far too small for two beds. There was not enough space for two of us to comfortably open carry-on suitcases, which made moving around the room difficult throughout the stay.

In addition, several maintenance issues affected our comfort:

- The window shade would not open and appeared to be blocked.
The bathroom door did not fully open because it got stuck on the carpet.
- On the first day, we get back to the hotel and noticed the safe was open. Both of us checked the safe before we left the room. Although, we didn’t notice anything missing on our stuff, it was weird to get back to our room to an unlocked safe. 
- Most importantly, the room had an intermittent but very loud noise coming from what seemed to be a piece of equipment.

I reported the noise to the front desk twice and asked either for the issue to be investigated and fixed or for us to be moved to another room. Unfortunately, no effective action was taken. During 2 of our 4 nights, I could barely sleep because of the irritating noise throughout my stay. My friend ended up sleeping with loud music just to tolerate the situation, which made the entire experience exhausting.

I understand that maintenance issues can happen, but what was most frustrating was the lack of resolution after reporting the problem twice. For the price paid, I expected a functional room and a reasonable opportunity to rest. Sadly, this stay did not meet those basic expectations.

author: Freya Z
title: Unpleasant experience.
text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but my recent stay was disappointing due to the way I was treated by a member of the front desk staff.

I arrived expecting an early check-in, which was not honored despite a message noting they would add it to my reservation. During the interaction, I was also given incorrect information about my Marriott Bonvoy status, which added to my frustration. Rather than feeling welcomed, I felt dismissed.

The most disappointing part of my experience was my interaction with an employee named Eric. When I asked for the manager's business card, he dropped it into my hand in a dismissive manner. While management later reviewed security footage and stated it did not appear that the card was "thrown," my concern has never been about that specific wording. The issue was the disrespectful and dismissive way I was treated. A security camera cannot capture tone, attitude, or how an interaction makes a guest feel.

I appreciate that the General Manager took the time to respond and review the footage. However, I was disappointed that the response focused on disputing one aspect of my complaint rather than acknowledging the overall customer service experience. Hospitality is about making guests feel valued and respected, and unfortunately, that did not happen during my stay.

As someone who chooses Marriott because of its reputation for service, I expected a much higher level of professionalism. I hope this feedback is taken as an opportunity to coach staff on treating every guest with courtesy, respect, and empathy.

author: Anna J
title: Excellent choice, ideal location
text:
Perfect location 500 m from Times Square but on a quiet street for New York. 300m from Penn Station, to take the subway, or the train. Numerous restaurants and fast food nearby
The room and the bathroom are small (which is normal in New York) but very clean. The bed is comfortable. 
The breakfast is good and varied.
The staff is helpful and polite. 
I recommend it

author: Mathis U
title: Excelent atention
text: Everything perfect. Good bed, god breckfast and god location

author: Harper Q
title: The worst NYC experience by far
text: I will never stay here again.  I came in June for a concert.  I booked a Terrace room and went to check in at 4 and was told they offered the previous occupant a late check out of 4 and there was no room available. I was told it would take an hour to clean once they vacated and would see what they could find. I had dinner reservations and a concert I was looking forward to. It took them 45 min to find another room and I had enough time to change and get to dinner. After a long 90 degree day in NYC, no shower, I didn't have time. The room was super small, no clock, light by the bed taped with electrical tape and a vacuum cleaner parked outside my door the duration of the stay.  I was promised a $75 dollar credit by desk staff but instead got charged for the terrace room with an addional $150, 3 $50 charges over the next two days.  I reached out and did get one response asking for some time and who promised me $75.  So it's now July and I guess I should consider myself lucky the random $50 charges were removed but no credit, and charged for a room I reserved but did not get.  Be aware, it has a B rating. I sat through dinner and a concert sweaty and uncomfortable.  Who offers a late check out at the same time another person is to check in? Who?  Apparently this location does.

author: Lily B
title: Don't stay here. Unkept, dirty and noisy.
text: Marriott should not have their name on this hotel.  I understand is in the low tier of Marriott's brands but I expect a decent standard, as it used to be with SpringHill Suites.   The quality of this hotel is really, really appalling.  There were several maintenance issues:  The bathroom sink faucet was loose, the towel bar was lose and about to fall from the wall, water pressure was non-existence and taking a shower was a terrible experience.  The bedsheet had a hole in it, curtains look stingy and the overall bedroom had a feel of a budget by-the-highway type of hotel.  The noise was impossible to deal with and we were not able to sleep straight in the two nights that we were there.  I know it's NYC and it's noisy. We go to NYC often and stay in different areas, so we knew this was going to be noisy and busy but we were in a high floor and it felt as if you were at street level, which made us think there was no insulation on the windows.  We chose this hotel because we were traveling with other people and needed to stay within a certain budget, and also needed a location with easy access to go to the sport event we were attending.  A really bad decision. I've had this experience lately with low tier Marriot brands and the quality. That was not the case before as you could always trust their cleanliness and have a basic decent experience.  Don't stay here.

author: Oliver J
title: Awful
text:
Our experience at this hotel was absolutely unacceptable.
We arrived around 2:00 AM after our flight was delayed. We then had to wait 45 minutes at the front desk, where we were repeatedly told there was a "computer problem."

We later realized that wasn't the real issue. Instead, we were given a room that had just been vacated and had not been cleaned or prepared.
When we entered the room, we found:

-Dirty bed sheets that had not been changed.
-Used towels left in the bathroom.
-Food still in the refrigerator.
-Trash left on the couch and the bedside table.

At nearly 3:00 AM, after a long international journey, we had to ask for clean bed linen and make our own bed. This is completely unacceptable, especially for a Marriott property.
The hotel acknowledged the issue and promised us a $250 refund as compensation. This refund is even clearly written on our check-out document.
However, more than a month after checking out on May 18, we have still received nothing. Despite numerous follow-ups with Booking.com and Marriott, the hotel has completely ignored the matter and never responded regarding the promised refund.
Mistakes can happen, but failing to honor a written refund commitment and then ignoring your customers is simply unacceptable.

I cannot recommend this hotel and strongly advise future guests to think twice before booking here.

author: Harper U
title: Great location but disappointing stay
text: This hotel is in a great location. However, the room was small with little space for suitcases. There was the option of the hotel storing your cases during the stay, but it wasn’t worthwhile doing this for a couple of days. The bed was comfy and bathroom nice but the bathroom had a sliding door that was very stiff to open/close. The air conditioning was also very noisy. The water pressure in the shower was poor. The main thing that we were disappointed with was the breakfast. Yes, it was a self service buffet breakfast with good choices, but having paper plates and plastic cutlery to use was not a nice experience! I don’t think I’ve ever stayed in a hotel which has had this, especially for the price we paid. Seating  bench was broken and not a nice set up to start the day. We ended up having breakfast elsewhere after our first experience of it.

author: Noah D
title: Terrible customer service
text: Be careful when booking this hotel. I booked on line and accidentally put the wrong date, I contacted them immediately and explained the error and asked if it could be changed to the day before. I have been told that I can't change it and have to cancel this with no refund and book again and pay again!!!

author: Claire T
title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS
text: If I could give zero i would, the room wasn't clean, the bathroom flooded when we had a shower, they came up with a hoover and hoovered out the drain and the smell in the room after was on real. When I asked if he could clean up all the water in the bathroom he handed me towels and i had to dry it up myself. The staff are not helpfully at all and ill never stay there again. I have proof by the way

author: Taylor Q
title: DISGUSTING HOTEL- DO NOT STAY
text:
I stayed in this hotel for one night and it was the  worst hotel I have ever stayed in. Unfortunately we had no other option otherwise we would have not endured this repulsive stay.

We were greeted at reception and it was extremely slow and nothing seemed to be working , it  took over half an hour to check in , the man on reception was extremely unfriendly and unwelcoming. The lobby was the cleanest part of the hotel and even then it wasn’t great!

They kept repeating that it was a non smoking hotel but our room stunk of cigarette smoke and the stains on the ceiling were evident of it.

When we arrived to the room the walls were covered in stains and the floor was covered in hair . The bathroom had not been cleaned and was falling apart , mouldy and disgusting.The floor,  carpet  , ceiling mattress were also covered in strange unpleasant stains . 

We went to reception to raise these concerned and were absolutely shocked and appalled to find ours and another guests check in paper work containing confidential details left out on the front desk for anyone to witness with no workers anywhere to be seen and they re appeared 10 minutes later from outside the building . This is an extreme breach of data protection and will be reporting this further .

When we did eventually speak to them about the issues we were met with attitude and dismissal , they moved us to the “best room” and it was just as foul. I will attach photos to this review to warn anyone to NEVER EVER stay in his hotel. They refused us a refund and wouldn’t acknowledge the absolute disgusting state the hotel is in.

I have no idea how this hotel is still open and charging the prices they do and is operating at such an extreme hygiene risk. DO NOT STAY HERE!

author: Lucas V
title: Satisfactory
text:
Staff friendly and helpful. 
Hotel very tired  , poor attention to detail on room cleaning  and air conditioning didn't work. 
Felt like it was smart once but has been left .
Reception area was tired  with wall paper coming away from wall .

author: Chloe R
title: Rundown
text: The hotel is central therefore on the corner of 2 busy roads. A/C doesn’t work, WIFI doesn’t work. But it’s clean and there’s hot water. Very wor

author: Hannah C
title: Horrible.
text:
Despite a very promising website, the reality was quite different. You have to run from this establishment.
Upon entering the room, the first thing that struck us was a very strong and unpleasant smell. Then it was impossible to miss the general state: everything was dirty, damaged and absolutely not maintained.
The room was clearly not clean. The furniture is very worn out, there were crumbs on the floor, deposits on the desk, dirt in the corners of the bathroom, a trace of toothpaste on the mirror and even a hair in the sink. To top it off, traces were visible at the bottom of each cup... just disgusting.
The only thing that could possibly save this hotel were the sheets and towels, which seemed clean at first glance. But again, on closer inspection, traces of old stains were visible, which takes away all confidence.
In summary: a very disappointing experience, far from what is advertised online. Gross lack of hygiene, an establishment to be absolutely avoided.

author: Lucy B
title: Rude and dishonest
text: Reserved and paid online for room via DayUse. On arrival, manager asked me to pay again as she has not received payment from DayUse. I stated I had paid for the room already. On leaving, I was asked that I should contact the hotel again during weekdays for money back. On contacting the hotel again, the manager was unapologetic and was suggesting that clients should pay twice if they have not received payments from third party. The manager was unwilling to contact DayUse and was rude when I suggested how I should get my money back. Hotel is par what other reviewers have stated.....dark, dingy reception, dirty floors. Staff are rude and dishonest

author: Marco N
title: Different photos of reality
text:
Do not trust the photos posted by the hotel! The reality is quite different...
Broken mirror in the bedroom, half functional flush, spider web in the bedroom (spider supplement in the morning when waking up -_-)

author: George U
title: Poor
text: Very disappointed. First impression: Grubby Reception, really needs to be redecorated. Family room cost £215 per night but was actually a small room with a large double bed and a puff that folds out. The room itself was also in dire need of redecorating. The lighting was poor throughout and the mirrors were smeared, as if they hadn't been cleaned properly.  Good points: Good sized double bed (I think it was a King) and it was very comfortable. I liked the walk in shower but the fixings in the shower area really needed attention as they were dirty and mouldy. The young man at Reception was incredibly helpful. Note there were no glasses in the room, or any toiletries not even soap. A few sachets of tea and instant coffee supplied. Really, at this price I was expecting a lot more.

author: Lily Q
title: The dirtiest hotel I have ever stayed- truly vile!
text: This hotel was perfectly located for a party we attended while in London. The room sizes were generous as were the bathroom size. HOWEVER...... THE CLEANLINESS WAS VILE!!! truly the most dirty, disgusting hotel I have ever stayed at (and i have done a lot of travelling). I had to instantly go to Tesco and buy cleaning products as the room, and bathroom was utterly disgusting. The carpet looked like it had never been hoovered- ever! There were piles of sheets sat on the dirty carpets in the hallway of every floor (i took the stairs a lot and we were on the top floor. The heating was on full blast throughout the hotel and the window did not open, so it was a real sweatbox. The room also stank of cigarettes. I'm not one to leave a negative review unless something has been truly awful, and this really checked that box! Avoid if you can.

author: Sofia U
title: Absolutely disgusting. And haunted.
text: Room is filthy, windows broken, noisy. Shower randomly turned on as did the lights. Broken bathroom door, hair tie left in wardrobe in front of safe. Vents are extremely dusty, bathroom floor and the toilet bowl are filthy, not been cleaned. Bedsheet inside out and dirty. Television does not work, no parking. Paint peeling off the walls and mirror is broken. Room is mouldy. Avoid this place at all costs. Currently staying here, if I could afford it I would be out of here and booking a room elsewhere. Worth £10 a night at best.

author: Grace R
title: AVOID, AVOID AVOID!!!!
text:
This Hotel has got to be the worst Hotel i have ever experienced. Please do not waste your time and money. 
The room we checked into had badly stained mattress with what looked like blood, carpet was stained. The room and carpet was in general dusty and dirty. The bathroom was appalling there was dirt just piled up behind the door. The toilet looked like it hadn't been cleaned in decades. We asked to change rooms to be sent to a room with the door frame and lock hanging off , was sent to a third room and then the sheets were stained and dirty and chunks out of the wall.  Asked to speak to a manager and apparently none on site. Eventually called booking.com and received a refund. Please so not stay st this filthy and unsafe Hotel.

author: William U
title: Good location but cleanliness standards are lacking
text: Great location. Room was really big, and was clean on arrival however bathroom wasn't cleaned after first night, had to ask for clean towels & toilet roll even though we'd put the towels in the shower to be taken away, they were just left. The windows were good in terms of keeping the cold out but noise levels were really bad on the main road. Overall a decent hotel for the price but wouldn't go back in the hurry.

author: Molly I
title: Do not stay here.
text:
The stay at this hotel was horrific, When checking inn the staff found my booking but said I had to pay. I had already paid when  I booked online through the hotels website. 
In order for me no to pay again I had to trawl through my bank transactions to show them I had already paid. 
The hotel itself looks nothing like it does online, it is so dirty and unkempt.  
The room we stayed in was the dirtiest room I have ever stayed in pictures will be shown. Thick dust on the skirting boards, no hanging rail in the wardrobe so unable to hang clothes. Dirt all over furniture, stains on the carpet were awful. The bathroom was so dirty there was scum all in the shower room, the shower glass had not been cleaned. There was dirt and mold on the bathroom door.
The breakfast was not really a breakfast, cereal in a box, bread to make toast and a few pastries. I would advise anyone thinking of staying here to avoid at all costs.

author: Liam S
title: Overpriced and dirty
text:
The location is great, tho the parking is not! We had to tent a drive for the evening which added cost, 
The room was dirty and mouldy, but the bed was clean and comfy. 
It's a 2 star at best. I've stayed in better travellodges.
It's extremely over priced.

author: Luke D
title: Disappointing Stay – in Need of Serious Attention
text:
Unfortunately, my recent stay at this hotel was quite disappointing. From the moment I entered the room, it was clear that basic maintenance and cleanliness had been neglected.

There was a visible stain on the headboard and ripped fabric at the end of the bed, which gave a very poor first impression. Several pieces of leather furniture in the room, not just the bed, were also ripped and worn, adding to the overall feeling of neglect. The room was generally grubby and felt far from clean. Definitely not what you'd expect for the price paid (inflated prices over Wimbledon weekend). 

The bathroom had multiple issues: the motion sensor for the lights was faulty, meaning the lights kept switching on at random times, which was particularly frustrating during the night. On top of that, the bedroom lights also turned on by themselves during the night, causing several disturbances and making it very difficult to get any proper rest.

The water pressure in the shower was very weak, and both the grout and sealant in the bathroom were badly discoloured and in need of replacement. There was an awful drainage smell throughout our stay. 

Both window catches were broken, and since the room overlooked train tracks, the noise throughout the night made sleeping even more difficult. From reading reviews since my return, it is apparent that the broken window catches are a common theme throughout the hotel. 

Breakfast was also a letdown. It was a very basic continental selection with no thought given to dietary requirements — no gluten-free options, and no alternatives available when asked. It felt more like an afterthought than a proper service for guests.

Overall, the hotel felt tired, uncared for, and long overdue for refurbishment. It’s a real shame, because with some investment and attention to detail, it could be much better. Sadly, I wouldn’t stay again or recommend it to others in its current condition.

author: Isla I
title: Overall Ok, but expensive.
text: The hotel is on the whole ok. It is nicely located, until late evening you can go shopping all around. The rooms are ok, the bathroom was clean. At 150 € a night a bit expensive. Breakfast is a disaster. Toast, a kind of cheese, a kind of sausage, cold eggs, better to go to the bakery a few houses down. So overall ok, 150 € too expensive, skip breakfast.

author: Ryan Y
title: Perfect Location and Fantastic Staff!
text: Absolutely loved my stay at the Putney Hotel! The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly throughout — they really went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. The location is fantastic, just a short walk from transport links and great restaurants. My room was clean, comfortable, and quiet. The walk-in shower was a great touch, and everything worked smoothly. I’d definitely stay here again — highly recommended!

author: Ruby F
title: Lovely staff
text:
The staff was friendly and helpful, my room was clean and bed was comfy.
I really appreciate the attention to detail and the overall atmosphere of the hotel.
I'll definitely be coming back.

author: Paige Y
title: A perfect stay
text: Excellent hotel! Impeccable service, spacious and clean rooms, and a prime location. The staff was friendly and attentive, making our stay unforgettable. Delicious breakfast with great variety. Modern amenities and cozy ambiance. Highly recommend for both business and leisure. Will definitely return! 5-star experience worth every penny.

author: Pierre L
title: Dinner
text: Wonderful hotel near Victoria and flet good experience with breakfast and dinner

author: Holly Q
title: Excellent Breakfast and Wonderful Staff
text:
Had a fantastic breakfast at Premier inn Victoria.  The food was fresh, delicious and really enjoyable, with a great selection available.  Everything was presented, regularly replenished and made for a brilliant start to the morning.
That staffs deserve just as much praise.  Everyone was warm, attentive and extremely welcoming. Staffs would regularly check that everything was okay and making sure guests were well looked after.

Great food, excellent service and a genuinely lovely team.  A really positive experience at Premier Inn Victoria.

author: Holly N
title: My amazing time at London Victoria premier Inn.
text: Was a really fun experience, the staff were lovely, I felt at home and I would 100 percent be back again. The food was amazing and I have no negative feedback to give.

author: Harry Q
title: Will definitely go there
text: My stay was very comfortable and relaxing. I used this accommodation because I had early morning Cleveland hospital appointment and I asked for a nice quiet room as comfort was necessary and my demands were well met. Staff was also on spot, HM and other floor managers were nice alongside other staff. I received a very warm welcome

author: Wyatt T
title: Avoid going to Premier Inn Victoria as is need of urgent refurbishment
text:
Bathroom shower and bath taps very hard to work out.  
Chrome coating on tap came off in your hand each time you put the mixer tap on or off.  As all the chrome coating had come off you could not tell which way to move the tap for hot or cold as symbols had worn away.

author: Tyler B
title: TNyuma
text:
Had a really pleasant stay at Premier Inn Victoria. What stood out most for me was the staff. Everyone I encountered was warm, welcoming, polite and genuinely helpful. Nothing ever seemed like too much trouble, and they created such a positive atmosphere throughout the hotel.

The hotel itself was also extremely clean and well maintained, including my room and the communal areas. A very comfortable stay made even better by an excellent team. Thank you to everyone who made me feel so welcome. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Samuel G
title: Premier Inn
text: Very good. Enjoyed my stay. Everyone amazing and kind

author: Holly N
title: Prebook early check in but near Victoria station
text:
First time visit to London and in the heatwave too so I was glad there was air con.
I recommend if you are arriving early to prebook early check in. Or rooms won't be ready. We weren't the only one to ask. 
However we were downgrading from a family to a double room so the lady on the desk managed to check us in when we arrived. She also thoughtfully gave us a ground floor room which nobody else ever has offered. Despite my visible mobility issues. She recommended the bus to catch and gave some directions. Wish I had got her name but it was 31st July we came, hopefully they can trace the staff on then. She was lovely and helpful! 
Room was clean and tidy, other than potentially train? Rumble every so often, we didn't hear anything.

author: Alice H
title: Was good
text:
I would like to share some feedback about my recent experience at the hotel.

Overall, the atmosphere was very pleasant, and I was impressed with the service. I would especially like to recognise Frances, the manager, who was extremely helpful and professional. I would also like to mention Jaspreet at reception, who was very kind, welcoming, and attentive to guests.

However, I was very concerned about an incident I witnessed last night. An individual was standing at reception, shouting at and verbally abusing the three female members of staff. His behaviour appeared aggressive, intimidating, and completely inappropriate, and the staff were being subjected to unnecessary bullying and harassment.

I believe that everyone working in a hotel deserves to be treated with respect and dignity. I hope management will take this matter seriously and ensure that staff and guests feel safe and respected at all times.

I also hope incidents like this are dealt with appropriately so that the actions of one individual do not create negative perceptions of an entire community.

Thank you again to Frances, Jaspreet, and the rest of the team for their excellent service and professionalism.

author: Poppy Z
title: Family Visit
text: Outstanding service from all sectors and the staff were first class. I had breakfast and stayed there for 2 days. Reception, bar, restaurant and  room all outstanding. Shout out to Francess, Julia, and Jansen. Amazing staff with their Manager.

author: Charlotte J
title: Fantastic location and friendly service by Julia
text: Julia checked us in and made us feel very welcome. She also allowed us to store our luggage in one of the rooms, while the other was being prepared. Thanks Julia!

author: Manon U
title: An ideal Premier Inn
text: An excellent location for anyone travelling via Victoria, with numerous  good local restaurants and cafes, easy access to travel options and walking distance from Westminster.

author: Erin A
title: On check in make sure room is up to standard first
text: Victoria Hotel Premier Inn London 26/7/2026 Room allocation, not premier plus standard, which was what we paid for.    We thought only for one night so made a hot drink, then went to use the loo to find it much too low at 38cms,  well below standard height, We asked to change room but were told we would have to pay again for another room as we had "used" Room 9. This presumably applies to any Premier inn hotel so check room carefully before using any facilities! Did not receive any compensation unfortunately - if we had checked the bathroom facilities out first, we would not have accepted the room.

author: Hannah J
title: Ok but don't bother with Premium
text: Very close to Victoria station so a great location if that is a good connecting station for you. Premier rooms not anywhere near worth the upgrade. A very small room, no different to the rest of the hotel. You get a slightly better cup of tea and shower gel I think! Decent base but don't bother with the upgrade.

author: Laura D
title: A great home ‘a long’ way from home…
text:
Such a great location close to Victoria Station and all the Hop on Hop off routes as well as a short walk to Buckingham House and all of Westminster Precinct. 

The Staff lead by the Amazing Francess were all very attentive and nothing was too much trouble at any time over both of our stays. We would definitely stay here again and will be letting our travel agent know it is one to keep in file for future travel.

author: Freya J
title: #S#
text: Amazing staff ( Julia, Frances’s)great breakfast

author: Megan I
title: Good location
text: Very well located near Victoria Station, ideal for 2 or 3 days. The breakfast was a disaster, they didn't restock plates, glasses, they didn't clean tables, except for the day the waitress Julia was there, who was the complete opposite, very helpful, attentive to everything, exceptional. A 10 for Julia!!!!

author: Anna G
title: Could be better. Not the best premier inn
text: Nice location but had roadworks smack outside which woke us up at 7.30am each morning. Then we had breakfast and the food was not great at all. No fresh bacon, eggs or mushrooms and had to try to find a member of staff to ask for more. Felt a bit like Oliver! Also what are the wardrobe about? They are against a wall and you can only get in from thr side which made it so difficult to hang your clothes, never seen that before in a premier inn. Also the doors weren't soft closing so banged a lot disturbing you.

author: Amelia X
title: 10/10 experience
text: Everything is amazing, would honestly recommend, the staff are extremely helpful and welcoming, would come again

author: Sean U
title: Rude day staff
text:
Do not use if you want a clean room you have to ask for your room to be cleaned daily which I did a very rude and obnoxious women greeted me in the morning and I asked if my room could be clean and that there was a strong smell of cannibis coming from the room opposite she promptly replied we do not allow such a thing in this hotel to which I replied obviously they do she slammed the door behind her.
Upon my return after a 16 hour shift I went to my room shattered my room had not been cleaned and no clean towels provided I went downstairs and asked the lovely man on reception about it he said she hadn’t even wrote my number down to be cleaned. He assured me that this would not happen again and brought me fresh towels.
The hotel is very dated and reminds me of an old folks home the rooms are very small and the windows do not open.
If you want to use this hotel to relax after work and have your room cleaned avoid like the plague

author: Ana Y
title: Excellent choice in the Financial District
text:
The hotel is not luxury, but for a week in New York it is more than fine. I liked the location a lot: during my first trip I had stayed in Times Square, but I must say that I definitely prefer the financial district. It is quieter, less noisy and allows you to easily reach the Stock Exchange, the World Trade Center, the harbor and other attractions.
The room was clean, also equipped with a small kitchenette. The beds were very comfortable, while the bathroom, although being a bit dated, was still in good condition. The view looked out onto another building, so nothing special.
The breakfast satisfied me: there was a good selection of both sweet and savory.
The only real negative note concerns the elevators, only two and rather dated. One evening I got stuck on the 30th floor: I recommend always carrying your cell phone with you and saving the reception number, because the alarm button doesn't inspire much confidence.

author: James L
title: Don’t do it.
text:
This hotel truly disappoints.  No place to place your luggage.  No luggage stand. Privacy blinds you can see through? So you’re either in blackout drapes or everyone can see in.

Room size is honestly small.  Stay at the World Trade Center Marriot. Don’t stay here.

Elevators are a mess. This is not the place you want to stay.  Better deals and quality for the money.

See pic.  Asked for daily room service and after complaining about service with the on duty manager I didn’t get room service or luggage stand.   

Don’t do it.

author: Alexander I
title: Pree is the ultimate front desk!
text:
Pree at the front desk is a DOLL. She helped me to make a birthday special for my guest, and was VERY accommodating. More hotels need a Pree at the front desk!

Thank you Pree!

author: Molly S
title: Great value!
text: This was our first time to NYC and we thought this hotel was a great value! It is very close to a number of places to get a variety of food and an easy walk to the subway. We drove and used a parking garage that was only .2 miles from the hotel - there are several garages nearby. The rooms were clean and the beds comfortable. We didn't have the same issue with the elevators as another reviewer had and we found them to be quick. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Diego T
title: Great cost benefit
text: The hotel is very well located, with many restaurants, snacks, markets nearby. Easy access to metro, to any part of the island. Comfortable room and good size, considering that in NY are very small. Only do not recommend breakfast at the hotel, as it is very expensive for what serves. Besides, I found a great choice.

author: Diego W
title: My new go-to hotel in NYC!
text:
This was the first time I've stayed at this property, but after the experience of the past four days, I am absolutely certain that it won't be my last stay. 

The property itself is outstanding. My King room was a little small, which is to be expected in NYC, but it was clean and well equipped, with a huge TV, fridge and a walk-in shower in the bathroom. There's also a breakfast buffet on the third floor (for a price) and a nice exercise room.  When it comes to location, you won't find any better in the city. The South Street Seaport is within walking distance, as are a number of outstanding restaurants, Duane Reed. Oculus and the Fulton Street transit complex that services virtually every subway line in the city.

Beyond all that and the reasonable rates, the thing that sets this property apart is the amazing, helpful staff -- especially (but not limited to) Donovan at the front desk and maintenance man Ganesh, who seemed to be everywhere, always with a smile! My daughter and her family were with us on the trip and we asked for rooms on the same floor and the staff gladly accomodated our request. Their care and professionalism helped make a memorable trip to New York even better!

author: Freya F
title: There much better options in the area
text:
Ok, this hotel building houses two different hotels. Last week I stay here but on the Residence Inn side. As a lifetime titanium I was given high floor with upgraded balcony. Here at the courtyard, I got a 15th floor room. 

Unlike the other hotel this hotel doesn't include breakfast but you are able to get comp coffee. The breakfast is very much on the level of a free breakfast but staying at the courtyard it will cost you $18. 

Yes, rooms are small like everyone has said previously and the airducts carry noise from the room next door. At 8:30 in the morning on a Saturday my neighbors are talking os loud to each other you'd think they were at a concert. I made complaint and front desk sent someone ip right away to tell them to quiet down. 

The room seemed clean and hotel is close to train, restaurants, etc. My biggest gripe is elevator waits are long and the hotel takes a $200 deposit. The deposit is more than I paid for the room. Residence Inn took a $30 deposit last week, Courtyard a few blocks away from this hotel on Greenwich takes a $20 deposit and the four points behind this hotel never has taken a deposit from me. Such a large deposit and you can't charge the asian restaurant connected to here to the room or order room service from there. 

In the future, I'll stay at the other hotel here because even if its a few dollars more it's worth the free breakfast, bigger room, quieter rest, and not taking such a large deposit.

author: Marco P
title: Good hotel and location, cheap
text:
We booked the hotel last minute and it was the cheapest option in the city that we saw (booked via Expedia). Room was small which is to be expected, we were out all day and this didn’t bother us as it was all we needed. Subway was about 5 minute walk and hotel was also close to Starbucks, Wall Street, Statue of Liberty boat and 9/11 memorial. Other tourist spots were easily accessible from the subway. We also paid for a private car to the airport via the hotel which was a lovely, spacious car and friendly driver. The hotel was well priced and in a good location. We were on one of the highest floors and hotel was quiet for us, no issues with noise at all. 

We were very happy with this hotel and would return here.

author: James J
title: In the quiet of the tumult of the city, but close to everything
text: Ideally located, close to the Oculus, a metro station in front of the hotel door, the staff is very nice, the rooms are quite spacious, I recommend

author: Jack W
title: Nice location but slippery shower
text: After all the bad reviews I’d read I was concerned about customer service and cleanliness, but was pleasantly surprised. Great location. However, there are no non-slip strips in the bottom of the tub. I slipped getting in the shower and hurt my leg pretty badly. Thank goodness there was a grab bar, which I was using.

author: Charlie N
title: Much Better than the reviews suggest
text:
I don’t  understand all of the bad reviews.  The hotel was exactly what I expect from Courtyard. 

Location is great…near South Street Seaport, WTC, Brooklyn Brisge and 10 minute walk to Chinatown and Little Italy. 

Service was good, as expected.

Room was a good size for NYC.  Smaller than a suburban Courtyard but larger than I expected for the price.   Clean, in good repair, comfortable, and quiet.  

View was fine, and I didn’t pay for anything more than that.  

Walk to everything, safe at night, great value. 

We didn’t eat hotel breakfast.  Why would we?  The world’s best bagels are on every other block in NYc.  

Do try to get upper floor through.  That Asain restaurant needs to do something about their hood system.  It stinks on floor 3.

Great hotel for the price.  Highly recommend.

author: Adam O
title: Pleasantly Surprised .
text:
The hotel was lovely and the location perfect .
I was hesitant about staying here because of the reviews but we were not disappointed at all.
It was the cheapest we could find but it was well worth it.
The rooms are perfect , we had 2 single beds which were very comfortable .
Maybe some more hanging space would be better but we managed ok.
The lifts were great and never had to wait .
Location was excellent and close to the Metro stations , restaurants and you can walk to 9/11 Memorial.
My motto always go with your gut feeling and not take too much notice of reviews.

author: Grace U
title: The Hotel 🏨 is in a  good location.
text:
First of all the hotel 🏨 is in a good  😊 location. Second the rooms are very
 clean. Third they have a good breakfast 🍳. Fourth the rooms have a great view. Fourth the hotel 🏨 had a nice lobby . Fifth it’s only 300.00 a night which hard to find in Manhattan. Lastly the people who work here are very nice 😊.

author: Juan K
title: Average Hotel With Close by Attractions
text:
We stayed at the Downtown Manhattan Marriott for five nights at the end of March. We found the hotel to be quiet and clean. The included breakfast was a great way to start the day, with a few hot options as well as baked goods, fruit, and cereal. The staff throughout the hotel were kind and helpful. The location was convenient to transit and many great restaurants.

We were disappointed with the room cleaning service. We had requested daily cleaning but only received it on the first two out of five days, despite not returning to our room before 5 p.m. each day.

author: Sean S
title: Nice People, Awful Smell
text:
The people that work here are very kind. I always find them courteous and downright friendly. I have stayed here  a number of times going back toe their opening around 4 years ago. The rooms are smaller in the courtyard side but the Residence Inn rooms seem to be decently sized and always clean. 

I had to stop staying here because of the permeating odor the Asian restaurant in the hotel has dispersed through the hotel. My last few visits I had notice it was getting stronger and stronger and could be smelled everywhere. The final straw for me was when my pillow smelled like the fry oil and food the restaurant makes. It can be smelled in the hallway due to what I have to assume is a poorly designed and installed HVAC system. I doubt there will ever be a fix for this but if you have a keen sense of smell and don't enjoy these types of odors, I would head elsewhere.

author: Jessica U
title: Great Stay in FiDi – Clean, Modern, and Convenient
text:
I had a great stay at the Courtyard Marriott Financial District. The location is fantastic—right in the heart of FiDi and close to multiple subway lines, making it easy to get to Midtown, Brooklyn, and beyond. The hotel itself is super clean and modern, with well-maintained facilities and a comfortable atmosphere.

I was surprised by so many negative reviews, as I’ve stayed here twice and had positive experiences both times. Yes, the rooms are on the smaller side, but that’s completely normal for NYC. The elevators weren’t an issue, and for the price, I felt the value was excellent—reasonable rates for a well-run, well-located hotel.

Would definitely stay again!

author: Ella N
title: Nice Marriott Property in Financial District NYC
text: Nice Marriott property with two hotels, one a Courtyard and the other a Residence Inn conveniently located on Pearl street. A diner across the street offers a nice breakfast and lunch. Plenty of wonderful places nearby, Crown Shy is 2 blocks away and Yao (new $$$$ Chinese restaurant) is inside the hotel. Rooms are small as expected but have a nice 55" TV and are clean and functional. Elevators are very quick but can get busy during morning hours. Nice price if under $200 but anything higher is expensive for what you get. Residence Inn rooms have small kitchen area.

author: Lauren M
title: Awful and avoid
text:
Aweful hotel and service, are pathetic level.  Had to wait for check in, given room late….except was not what we had booked or paid for!  Told if we wanted room we had reserved, would have been even later… AND actually the room we were being offered was still not what was reserved!

This is a cheap service, small room, poor hotel….at inflated prices

author: Lily G
title: The only thing this place can do is the location: Find another place to live.
text: They don't keep what they promise: At the Reservation they promised that we could get some food upon arrival (21:00) after a long flight with children of 8 months and 5 years, respectively. That was not an option when we arrived. In addition, the rooms are too small and the food at the restaurant is terrible! I've never tried such a bad breakfast experience. Stay away from it. Not even the coffee is worth drinking. None of the food is made on site and it is very poorly cooked. In addition, the service is one-time stack that can not cut in the cool half cold food.

author: Antoine O
title: Not what you would expect from a Marriott
text:
Wow... where to begin?  
Front desk staff was great on checking in and the location is very convenient to seeing the sights in lower Manhattan and accessing local transportation.  
We had booked an upsized king room and were disappointed when entering.  Room was barely big enough to hold the bed. Went back to the front desk to make sure they gave us the correct room and were told that it was correct.  When looking at the evacuation placard on the 18th floor, 1801 was shown as the smallest room on the floor.  Also great view directly into the bedrooms of the building right next to the hotel but this is NYC, right?  Barely enough room for one person to sit and eat pizza, yet alone two, unless you want to use the bed.
Forget eating breakfast at the Forrest Wolf / Residence Inn on the 3rd floor.  $17.99 / person for cold eggs and a poorly stocked continental breakfast.  Drinks have to be poured from bottles stocked in a refrigerator that is barely cold enough.  We found a place called the Squire's Diner on Beekman Street - same prices but much better food and service.
Elevators seemed always full of housekeeping personnel and their buggies.  On the first night, room was not serviced until after 6:00 pm while we were eating in the room.  
Broom closet for hanging up clothes.  No drawers for other laundry - unless you want to cram all your folded clothes on the shelf in the closet, plan on living out of your suitcase... but then again, there won't be enough room for that either.
For the price that is charged and this being a Marriott brand hotel, it did not meet expectations and was the low point for our 3-day visit to Manhattan.

author: Harry K
title: Excellent accommodation.
text: For us we booked the location close to our pregnant daughter in law. Communication was great and we were welcomed and shown around by Lisa. The guest house surpassed all expectations. Clean, spacious,  tasteful room.  Comfortable med firm bed,  double glazed, well equipped, kitchen, outside and inside seating. Great location, Aldi nearby,  loads of restaurants etc. Easy walk from Clapham Junction main line station.  Good value

author: Chloe A
title: Amazing
text: The atmosphere of the guesthouse is very warm and friendly. You have very nice shared kitchens and seating areas inside and in the lovely garden. The room was clean and had everything we needed. The owners are extremely friendly, it’s well located and the neighborhood is pretty.

author: Lily O
title: 10/10 would come again
text: Magical experience. Super nice and friendly staff, and a pretty house with great rooms. Slept well in the beds. I felt a bit like i was at home, lovely shared spaces, did not feel crowded at all. It was very clean and had all the amenities we needed. Great location, close to the city by train, yet still quiet. Lots of stuff nearby too. 10/10 would recommended. thank you for a great stay

author: Antoine L
title: Comfortable stay
text:
I stay here whenever I visit my daughter who lives nearby.
Always comfortable and impeccably clean. Great to have use of 2 kitchen, lovely garden, sat in sunshine and chatted to the lovely Lisa. So friendly.
Always a pleasure to communicate with Tony also.
Will be back!

Thanks again for a great stay.

author: Katie C
title: Hidden Gem w/ wonderful Hosts :))
text:
We were very lucky to book our accommodation at this guesthouse. Tony, and his daughter Lisa are incredibly kind and welcoming, and their customer service is truly superb.
The room was lovely, clean, and very comfortable. We especially appreciated the beautiful garden, as well as the coffee supplies provided both in the room and in the kitchen.
What made our stay even better was the generous discount they gave us when we booked. It was a thoughtful gesture that we greatly appreciated.
Highly recommended! We would definitely stay here again and look forward to returning in the future. 😊

author: Jessica I
title: Excellent stay for a business trip
text:
excellent location!
it's always easy to contact and book
room very clean

author: Rosie U
title: Best B&B in Clapham Junction
text: Fabulous little B&B near Capham Junction. Family atmosphere with extras like a kitchen/ dining room and a garden lounge, even chairs in the sun. Great value for money.

author: Charlotte W
title: A little gem of hospitality in London
text:
Staying at Lavender Guest House was a pleasant surprise. Finding accommodation in London with this balance of quality and price is always a challenge, but this property has exceeded our expectations.

💰 Excellent Value for Money
Prices are absolutely modest compared to the London average, making it an ideal choice for those who want to visit the city without spending a fortune, but without sacrificing comfort and cleanliness.

❤️ The staff was of an exquisite kindness and always available for our every need. We felt warmly welcomed from the first moment, a detail that really makes a difference when you are on the go.

author: Aiden S
title: Lovely place to stay
text: Lovely place, can be greatly recommended. Clean, very friendly oand helpful host, nice shared kitchen area - and close to shops and restaurant area.

author: Charlotte W
title: Good stay
text: Everything ok, quiet neighborhood, a stone's throw from the station, friendly staff attentive and helpful to my needs, clean room, small bathroom

author: Liam W
title: My home from home
text:
This is my home from home, run by a very welcoming family. 

Everything is spotlessly clean and I sleep very well as the area is quiet. There are two dining rooms where there is a fridge, microwave, water boiler, plates, glasses and cutlery.

It´s only a few minutes walk from Clapham Junction station, this is perfect when arriving from Gatwick and it is perfect when going in to London city as it is less than ten minutes by train to Victoria station. An advantage is that you can use an Oyster Card to pay for the trip. With the daily maximum fare for transport in London you will save money, even from Gatwick.

It is with a feeling of losing a part of me when I leave, but I know I will be back as soon as possible.

author: Paige I
title: Stay in London
text: Very pleasant stay in this charming establishment. Perfect welcome. Quality services and proximity to services and transport. I recommend Lavender Guest House.

author: George S
title: Recommended, great service.
text: Great service, very friendly and accommodating. Tony and his sister were very helpful. Single bed was a little uncomfortable, so next time I'll try double bed and larger room.

author: Manon F
title: Comfortable
text: Everything perfect!  It is a small Guest House with an authentic English atmosphere.... Tony is super helpful and very kind....

author: Chloe J
title: A great visit
text: A great place to stay the owner and his daughter were very friendly and helpful . Location was very good would definitely recommend it

author: Matthew R
title: Extremely enjoyable stay.
text: Tony,the owner went overboard to accommodate my requirements even  though it was only for a shot stay. I was treated on arrival by a lovely lady who gave me a tour of the premises. The room was very clean,spacious and above all extremely comfortable.  I had a very enjoyable stay.

author: Katie V
title: Very lovely and accommodating staff and super convenient location!
text: Just got back from staying here for a week and it was truly lovely! VERY conveniently located, next to an Asda and near bus stops and Clapham Junction station. They were very accommodating to different timings for arrival and departure, and Lisa was very kind and gave great suggestions for shops in the area. The room was clean and comfortable, and there were two kitchen areas for having meals. Thank you again for a wonderful stay!

title: Absolutely fantastic
text: Good location, very friendly, helpful and caring. Thankyou for having me. I had a beautiful time. Lovely atmosphere. And a good value for the quality of the room. Thankyou.

author: Aiden Z
title: Excellent
text: Room was spacious and much better than I expected. Owner was very pleasant and very obliging with information. Definitely return

author: Abigail T
title: a revelation
text: the location is perfect, the rooms beautiful and the Welcoming very friendly and generous. There is a communal kitchen that overlooks a garden that was very helpful and pleasant to us.

author: Ethan J
title: I’ll be back
text: Wonderful experience at this hotel. The bed was super comfortable, the staff was very accommodating. I enjoyed the complementary mini bar

author: Megan V
title: Great choice for visiting Paris
text: Great location, the Opera and Louvre are only 20 minutes by foot, Montmartre 15 minutes by foot too and so many other locations worth visiting are nearby. The room was clean and well equipped, the staff of the hotel is so friendly and we were offered everyday free snacks and drinks at the restaurant of the hotel and the minibar of our room. The price was a great deal. We definitely recommend it for Paris’ visitors.

author: Freya M
text:
We had a really enjoyable stay at Hotel Joyce – Astotel during our trip to Paris. From the moment we arrived, the staff were friendly, welcoming and helpful, which made a great first impression.

The hotel itself was very clean and well maintained, and our room was comfortable and had everything we needed for our stay. After spending long days exploring Paris, it was a nice place to come back to and relax.

One of the things we particularly liked was the complimentary drinks and snacks available at the hotel. It was such a simple touch, but really appreciated after being out sightseeing for several hours. Breakfast was also good and gave us plenty of choice before heading out for the day.

The location worked really well for us too. There are restaurants and shops nearby, and it was easy enough to get around Paris using the Metro or by taxi.

Overall, Hotel Joyce was a great choice for our father-and-son trip. It felt welcoming, comfortable and well looked after throughout our stay. I would happily stay here again on another visit to Paris and would definitely recommend it to others.

5/5 – a lovely hotel and a very enjoyable stay.

author: Paolo K
title: Voyce on Joyce
text: We love staying at the Joyce hotel. It is very well located, clean, welcoming..

author: Isla V
title: Exceptional
text:
Exceptional experience, thank you to the whole team.
A special thank you to the gentleman at breakfast who was extremely kind.

author: Paige F
title: Top hotel
text: Super hotel in a nice neighborhood. The hotel room is nice and the beds are lovely to sleep in. The staff is very friendly and does everything to make the stay good. The icing on the cake is the minibar, drinks, and snacks.

author: Adam X
title: Great!
text:
We really enjoyed our stay, the view from our room was incredible.
The breakfast was good and the drinks and snacks provided were very much appreciated 
I would go back without hesitation.

author: Antoine Z
title: Excellent stay
text: An excellent stay at this hotel! The welcome was warm, the staff very pleasant and professional. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. I also really enjoyed

author: Juan K
title: So lovely and hospitable!
text: Excellent experience. Great location, close to everything but a little quieter than most. All staff were truly hospitable and so helpful. The breakfast and afternoon bar were a great benefit, making snacks, cafe and tea so easy. Good value. Recommend.

author: Andrea A
title: Excellent
text:
Clean hotel
Rich and abundant breakfast
The hotel's location is excellent, near the subway and various buses that allow you to reach every interesting point in the city. 
Kind and very helpful staff

author: Connor L

author: Lauren G
