author: Megan D
title: HOTEL OF HORROR
text: THIS IS SCAM!!! Never book this hotel. We ordered it in good faith on the photos we saw, but what we were greeted by was the horror. No proper reception, we got a bed with just a pledge and no duvet, it was completely horribly dirty, the curtains on the windows did not cover the entire window once. There was a sick lot of noise, also looked like someone had broken up the door of the room we were in. It was talking about security so we chose not to stay there 1 night once, we left and booked at another hotel 20 minute walk away. If I could I would give it 0 stars, STYR UNNA!!!

author: Nora S
title: Nice outside ugly inside
text: Convenient location for metro, pubs and various shops. To be English the room clean enough, but with some unacceptable problems (eg toilet flush not working). Entering and exiting independently with a code at the entrance is this convenient thing as there are no time constraints. There is probably better for the same price.

author: Emma R
title: Hotel of horror
text: Hotel of horror, do not book here, worst stay ever we have had to end our break and walk out. Rooms filthy, unsafe as you will see from pictures, unsafe cable and electrics, loud noise, and vile smells, druggies outside the hotel with needles and selling the bedding was a cheap throw shoved in a duvet and only filled half of the bedding, windows broken

author: Antoine C
title: Catastrophic
text: The hotel is well located but very outdated.The rooms are cleaned every 3 days. No breakfast. No elevators and no overnight security. An air and b not cheap because there are key boxes and a code to get in.  Mouse trap in the stairs sewage lifts in the room carpeted uncleaned and smoking room in view bathroom impassable, smoke smells or even more in the corridors a disaster not to recommend

author: Nora V
title: A Night to Remember
text: I am not one to usually write reviews but had to with this one. Well, where do I start...If you like the smell of sewers & filth, if you like the shower water not going down the drain, if you like lots of noise at night and getting no sleep, then this is definitely the place for you.

author: Nora X
title: IF I COULD GIVE A ZERO I WOULD
text: IF I COULD GIVE 0 STARS I WOULD - Room 20 - I booked the Triple Deluxe room and upon entry there was a stench coming from the bathroom as well as a single bed that my grandson had to sleep in was broken. After that we went downstairs to see if they could do anything about it. The man that we had spoke to said that he would sort it the next day without even coming to check giving the impression that he already knew about the broken bed. After that we had to move the bedframe away and my grandson had to sleep on the floor on the matress. The next day we left with low expectation of him fixing the bed as we assume he already knew about the bed. We came back at around 10 PM the next day to no surprise that the bed wasnt fixed. We decided to just leave it as we only had 1 more night at the hotel before heading back home. I have to say we were really considering going to another hotel if everywhere wasnt sold out. the smell was also horrible, we had to keep the fan on in the bathroom aswell as keep the window open bearing in mind its february but the cold was better  than the smell. The only good side was the  location

author: Noah H
title: Only worth the location.
text:
Worth by location. Very close to a subway station. The Earls Court neighborhood is great, full of supermarkets, and relatively cheap places to eat.
But the hotel leaves nothing to be desired. There's no fixed gateway, you can hardly find anyone there.  Thus, if you arrive to check in and have no one, you have to make a call (not via WhatsApp, but by phone itself) for someone to open the door.
Another problem is hygiene.  There is no room service. Bedding and towels are not changed (we stayed 4 nights). But the worst is the garbage that is not collected. Not the bathroom or the bedroom.
Next time I want to stay in Earls Court, but in another hotel.

author: Alice V
title: Toxic Work Environment
text:
I wouldn’t recommend working for Travelodge based on my experience. The managers often seemed to be on power trips and set unrealistic expectations, particularly when it came to the number of rooms you were expected to clean between 10am and 2pm. Being expected to clean 17 rooms within that timeframe felt unreasonable, especially when management would simply tell you to “hurry up” multiple times and “clean faster” rather than offering any support.

There was also an instance where a staff member was expected to work both a morning and a night shift on the same day, which I found concerning and would question whether it was appropriate and even legal. There needs to be an investigation that goes on in that place. Another issue was the way staff were treated when making small mistakes. Something as minor as putting a cup in the wrong position or forgetting to replace a coffee could result in staff being made to feel demoralised rather than being given constructive feedback.

Communication with reception was another major problem. On numerous occasions, staff would try to call reception to report that they were unable to attend a shift, but the phone often wouldn’t be answered. Despite this, managers would tell staff to keep calling, even when there was clearly nobody answering. Also would put in the work groupchat a indirect message about to call the reception instead of messaging the number.

Overall, I found the management style stressful and unsupportive, with unrealistic workloads and poor communication. Based on my experience, I would think carefully before considering a job with Travelodge.

author: Taylor B
title: budget prices AND budget experience
text:
PLUS:
--Great location, budget prices
--Friendly staff
--Good food options – inexpensive offerings, 24-hour pizza, bar, well-priced all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet
--Good-size bath towels

OTHER:
--WiFi – 30 minutes per day free, then it is a package offering – but no details on that – that’s a new one on me
--even with a voucher it could often drop connection, poor info sheet
--No room refrigerator (2nd London hotel without one so maybe a London / UK thing – I don’t know)
--Will refrigerate medicines, tho, except when given a very small 1.5” eye drops box – the clerk said “okkkk, but that’s really big...” – huh
--With good software a note attached to a guest’s reservation indicating there was hosted medicine in the fridge would be helpful reminder at check-out – we’re ok but others might appreciate that extra touch

--‘top off’ door sign for housekeeping not clear its meaning, hang it: we learned = room care: bed made, bins emptied, room cleaned / refreshed
--No info on room care – how often, what is included, green model of care (towels on floor? On rack?), bedsheets
--no hooks for towels
--minimal treads on tub/shower floor
--1 pillow on bed per guest
--No: bathroom glasses, conditioner, lotion, washcloths, hand-towels – copeable but still worth noting
--long access and textured surface if wheelchair use or heavy rolling bags to enter hotel, many front steps to entrance
--can be substantial weekend night noise from bars nearby
--really thin walls, we could hear snoring, conversations, and sneezing like the neighboring guests were in our room

author: Ethan I
title: Zefe is the best!
text: Zefe was an absolute joy to interact with; so customer service oriented, putting up with the morning rush hour breakfast chaos and the many questions-all whilst doing it with a smile😍 you can tell she loves what she does.  She is an asset to your team and I think may even have a bit of marketing flair about her!

author: Noah P
title: Go Zeffe!
text: Zeffe was really kind and got my friend’s daughter an extra fruit. She was very friendly and kept the cafe clean.

author: Samuel L
title: Outstanding Staff
text:
We arrived after a 10 hour car drive exhausted and overwhelmed. There was nowhere to park our oversized disabled vehicle. 

The staff were incredible and patient and immediately launched into action to find a solution. They were truly incredible and turned what could have been a disaster into the best family trip to London I’ve ever had. Special thanks go to Darren, Daniel, Head of Security, and the Management Team. I can’t thank you all enough.

author: Ryan Y
title: Overall good, but breakfast was disappointing.
text:
This was our third stay at this Travelodge.  Staff were friendly and efficient.
It was great to see an iron and ironing board in the room without having to request one.  Next step would be to have hairdryers in the rooms as standard.
The breakfast was disappointing. There is no way that the scrambled eggs could have been made with real eggs - seemed more like dehydrated eggs which were reconstituted.  No fried eggs available - even upon request. The hash browns tasted stale - like leftovers recooked.  Overall, presentation could do with an overhaul.
Would absolutely stay again, but may well choose to have breakfast elsewhere.

author: Lucy G
title: Awful staff, dirty hotel with clear need to refresh the hotel
text:
Poor reception and Managing staff attitude, not enough staff to book people in with long queues forming.

Incompetent bar staff, had to repeat an easy 2 glasses of wine order several times before they eventually got it right.

Front door card swipe mechanism broken, waited outside at night with no one coming to open the door even after pressing reception intercom button several times - another guest opened the door for us while supervisor and security were leaning against the bar chatting and laughing. Very indifferent and rude when I complained to them.

Dirty public spaces especially in and around the lift area.

Broken really small tv.

Nothing super about the so called Super Rooms - don’t waste your money.

Travelodge needs to spend some money on this hotel, it’s in a prime location and it’s a mess.

author: Aaron G
title: Fab location but too noisy at night outside.
text: Great staff. Great location. Great cafe and bar. Very noisy in the ground floor accessible room. Banging and unloading going on at Midnight and 6am.

author: Manon Q
title: Great Breakfast staff
text: Kamil at breakfast time was very engaging and attentive, he kept the breakfast area very clean

author: Lea G
title: Enjoyable stay
text: Supportive reception staff, particularly when I needed a bit of extra help due to low sugar levels (as a type 1 diabetic). Attentive restaurant staff. Room very basic but great location.

author: Claire F
title: Family break
text:
Excellent staff, really good breakfast.
Special mention to Zeffe who works non stop in the breakfast room making sure tables are cleared quickly and replenishing the food, and always with a smile

author: Lily W
title: Great location for short stay
text:
Location perfect for a stay in London. Stayed in a super room, great facilities but room did feel a little small. 

All staff we interacted with during our visit were helpful and friendly. Darron on the bar though was particularly helpful and friendly. 10/10. 

All areas around the site were clean. No noise in the room. 

Useful disability ramp at the rear of the building which we made use of.

author: Paolo K
title: First time stay in Covent Gardens
text:
This was our first time to stay in the Covent Gardens/Soho area.  The hotel is large, modern, and conveniently located near London's famous theatre district and the historic market. The main entrance is down a side street - very nondescript and frankly in need of a good street sweeper.  The area is popular with the late night  crowd; but our room was on the fourth floor so it was mostly quiet (sirens are unavoidable). It was a bit of a walk to public transport - but Ubers/London cabs frequent the area. 

If you have stayed in a UK Travelodge, you would recognize the room. It was clean, and the mattress was firm but not hard. All the usual amenities for this brand hotel. We really appreciated the good ceiling mounted A/C as it was hot in London.  We had a bit of a view from our window - mostly of construction sites as there is a huge building going up nearby.   Everything worked in the room and was in order.   Loved the USB plugs and nightlights in the headboard.  We ate breakfast in the 'bar' and it was okay.  Not cooked to order, but good for a buffet - and, of course, very conveniently located! Hotel staff were on the youngish side and some were being trained.  All very nice, but some were inexperienced.

We needed a few ADA features, mainly the fewest stairs possible.  As you can see, from the photo of the hotel entrance, that wasn't happening at the front.  There is a ramp at the back, but you need a room card to open the ramp gate.  I think the work around is to call reception when you first arrive.  The lifts were great. We booked a 'super room' because we needed a bit more space (can't confirm that it was wheelchair accessible though).  Also, the shower pan was a few inches (5-6) off the floor.

Value:  we were booking late and it was hard to find a reasonably priced room anywhere.  The rates for this hotel were okay; it WAS high season.  We only stayed one night as we were flying the next day.

author: Samuel Z
title: Fantastic. Very happy with our stay.
text: Our experience was fantastic. Comfy clean rooms and great service from the staff. Supervisor Dan and his team were all very welcoming and friendly.

author: Hannah N
title: Great
text: Dan is a good supervisor and his customer service is great, he is welcoming and kind and he interacts with customers so well. The staff he works with are also lovely and our experience with service at the hotel has been fantastic!!

author: Elena H
title: Great Staff, Good Service.
text: Always good service by attentive but not intrusive staff. Made sure I was aware of all offers available.  Ben is great barman and the food cooked by Heysham was well portion and full of flavour.

author: George J
title: Great location and staff are great
text: Stayed for 2 nights for a short theatre city break. Location was central to everything we needed but away from the main road so no noise at night. Staff were excellent and so helpful. We will be returning as great value for money in center of London.

author: David A
title: Good customer service
text: Aziz was polite and friendly and was very helpful. Nothing was too much trouble. I had issues with the Wifi and he helped me and my wife.

author: Mathis E
title: friendly and attentive service
text:
when my family and I visited the UK, we checked in at Travelodge London Covent Garden and were greeted by Emilis at reception, a very sweet and kind young man. He made sure we felt welcomed and properly taken care of from the start, asking all the right questions without ever being imposing or being overly personal.

The room was very comfortable, and we were pleasantly surprised that the bar and resturant were open 24/7 which gave us the opportunity to properly explore the heart of london and not have to constantly worry about resurants.

one issue we had was that the walls are particularly thin so you can hear people when they are being loud. apart from that would recommend and stay again!

author: Hannah D
title: Easy
text: Myyyy goaaatt Emily, Great service and help,  10/10 service on god 😛

author: Charlie I
title: Amazing location
text: Great views and nice staff, rooms were nice and quiet, clean

author: Noah R
title: Quality time with husband as a couple and sight seeing.
text:
Absolutely love the location of this hotel and the atmosphere is very relaxing and tranquil. When we checked in it was a special suprise to find out that we had been chosen as guest of the day and our room was upgraded to the deluxe room which was great thoughly enjoyed our room it was so clean and the bed was so comfortable. 
Definitely value for money with breakfast included. 
The noise level was nice and quiet and relaxing.. 
Will definitely be staying here again it is our favourite hotel by far. 
The staff are all very nice and friendly and helpful.

author: Pierre H
title: Incredible service
text: Fabulous hotel that went above and beyond to create a very memorable weekend celebrating a milestone birthday. Thank you so much. From the extras in our room to the birthday cake and wine.

author: Charlotte B
title: What a view!!
text: What an amazing stay! My mom and I stayed there while travelling to see family. Everyone was super friendly and welcoming. When we arrived we found that our room had been upgraded at no cost and what a view!! During our stay the staff were really wonderful and accommodating. The food was delicious and we were even given the use of a local swimming pool. The location really magical. Right in the center of London. The marinas behind the hotel are full of charming restaurants and cafes and beautiful boats. You could base a whole holiday from here or just pass through. Everything is very convenient. Thank you again to the wonderful staff for such a lovely stay!

author: Samuel P
title: Special birthday
text: Great location, lovely view from room and close to selection of bars and restaurants Friendly and helpful staff. Room small but modern and clean. Stayed at this hotel before and will definitely stay again. Thank you for making my 70th birthday a special occasion

author: Carlos H
title: Disappointed
text:
Room VERY hot!
YES, we paid extra for a room facing Tower Bridge, the view was phenomenal btw.
But we expected Air conditioning!
Air conditioning switches were there, but NO aircon!!
Contacted receptionist, and was told they’d send some ‘coolant’ up?
Two hours later, nobody had been, phoned again, was told somebody knocked but no answer! We were there all the time! They promised again, and didn’t turn up again! When we complained again they sent up an extra fan!!! Not good!
Very few plug sockets available, and one of the ‘few’ was broken!! Expected a USB charge point too, from such a ‘modern’ hotel, but none to be seen!

Chambermaid entered the room without knocking! Luckily we were up and dressed, but disgusted by this!
Complained and were offered a free beverage and snack as an ‘apology’

A nice break, spoilt by things that were so easy to put right!

author: Oliver M
title: Perfect location and quality
text: What a location ! Fabulous room with a Thames view and tower bridge right outside. Atmosphere is relax and very professional. Staff are courteous and friendly and the surprise birthday additions were really well received, room kept clean andbreakfestwas plentyful and well cooked. Loved the omelette station! Best side of London to stay at for me and this is the perfect place to come back to.

author: Caleb K
title: Family break
text:
Stayed here again for our 3rd visit.
Rooms overlooking St Katherine dock which is really nice.
Cocktail bar is lovely especially looking out to the London bridge with lights of a night.
Negatives 
Service charge has gone up to 13.50% 

Staff all great

author: Mia U
title: Good location
text: We chose this for a short visit and theatre show as we knew the location. The hotel was busy but the self-service check in avoided the queue. The room was clean and comfortable and we had a partial view of the river. We had a nice dinner at the Vicinity restaurant with the view of Tower Bridge. The only problem was the air conditioning unit. It was stuck on 27decC and couldn’t be turned down or turned off. This made for an uncomfortable night. Reception next morning confirmed there were problems in more than just our room and helpfully provided a fan for the remainder of our stay. When checking in ask about the air conditioning.

author: Sofia K
title: Comfortable and convenient but average at best
text:
We visited as a family with our 7 year old son for two nights and whilst I would consider staying again, I would have much lower expectations of this hotel. 

Upon booking we requested an extra bed in the room for our son, which was acknowledged by the hotel. We also emailed the day before arriving to confirm this. When we got into our room at 4:30pm we found that there was no extra bed in the room at all. My partner went down to reception to request this and was assured that it would be brought up asap. When we returned from a meal out at 8:30pm, there was still no bed so we once again had to speak to reception to ask that one be brought straight up - they said it would be. 40 minutes later we had a very tired 7 year old who was desperate to go to sleep in his own bed, but still no bed. My partner went to speak to reception for the third time and was told that the bed was on a trolley at that very moment to be brought up. It eventually appeared at 9:30. The fact that we had to ask four times for a bed for our child is absolutely diabolical.

The room itself was, although slightly dated, comfortable and did the job for two nights in London. The bed was clean, there were decent facilities such as a fridge, a kettle and teabags/coffees and a fan (the room temperature couldn’t really be altered as it operated on a central cooling system). 
Housekeeping was fine, although it was discovered mid shower that they had not checked and replenished the shampoo which was totally empty. My partner went down to reception to ask for some more and rather than just giving him some there and then they said it would be brought up. After a 30 minute wait we decided it would be quicker for him to go to the Tesco next door to buy our own shampoo rather than wait however long it would take them, given that it was now 10pm. 

We didn’t eat at the hotel so can’t comment on the quality of food, however the hotel is excellently located right next to St Katharine’s Docks. We visited the Dickens Inn pub, Honest burgers and Emilia’s Cratfted Pasta, as well as the Anchor pub which is a short walk across Tower Bridge,  all of which were great and I would highly recommend. 

Overall, a pleasant enough stay but be warned that you will not be getting anything fancy here!

author: Juan L
title: Above and Beyond
text: What a wonderful surprise when we arrived. We’re currently here for a 2 night stay for our daughter’s 11th birthday and the Front of House team arrange a birthday cake and soft drinks in our room for our arrival. What a room we have as well. Our room on the 6th floor looks directly over Tower Bridge. Brilliant location, lovely staff and so far a fab start to our stay.

author: Poppy G
title: Good Location
text:
Just got back from staying at this Hotel.We have stayed here a couple of times. Room we had was overlooking St Katherine’s Dock.The Hotel is in a great spot but Some of the rooms need upgrading , The shower is over the bath and the toilet reminds me of school toilets nearly on the floor. The service  charge is now 13.5 % on drinks. 
Cocktail,Bar is really nice .

author: Laura Q
title: Lovely customer service
text: Massive shoutout to Valeria for making my stay so memorable during my birthday.

author: Sofia O
title: Family break
text:
We stayed at the hotel as a mini family break. Having stayed here before and enjoyed it. This time was another fabulous stay with friending staff, lovely rooms and a delicious breakfast. 
The new bar on the ground floor is very welcoming, the outdoor seating was enjoyed by us all as it was another hot weekend! We will definitely be back.

author: Mia T
title: Made a nice change
text:
We booked this as we needed to be in a different part of London than usual and this hotel came up on Booking.com.
It’s a big hotel but we upgraded to having a room overlooking the iconic Tower Bridge. Room also had a decent drinks bar which was complimentary.)
Enjoyed our stay and will return depending on price.  Staff friendly and helpful and quiet by night!

author: Giulia D
title: Excellent
text: Excellent room great value would highly recommend

author: Ethan C
title: Avoid.
text:
Avoid this place at all costs, especially if it’s a warm day! It’s like staying in a furnace! 
We checked in at around 2:45, foyer was extremely warm (it was about 25 degrees outside but it was hotter at the check in desk!) we were told at check in that it was a “centralised cooling system, and there was no air con in rooms so we couldn’t adjust room temp”  the check in lady said that if the rooms were too hot we could request a fan and cooler, I immediately said if the room is going to be as warm as the check in area I wanted fans and coolers (I’d booked 2 rooms) and she said she’d requested them and they be there in 20min. It took a further 2 visits to reception, about 10 attempts to call reception & housekeeping on the numbers they’d gave us and a 2hr wait before we eventually got a fan. It was 31 degrees in the room!
The room furniture is very dated, handles missing off drawers, no fridge, the shower system is lethal! I turned on the rainfall head view what appears to and electric shower control, set it to desired temp (cool obviously considering I was staying on mercury!)  I then turned on the “wand” part of shower thinking it was controlled by same thermostat that I’d been using for rainfall… what a mistake! Seemed ok to begin with and then temp shot up to massively hot! I can only describe it as having the Xenomoroph’s blood out of Alien being spilt onto my manly bit, it nearly melted them off it was that hot! 
I would not consider the room we are in as 4* as advertised, 3 at best. Everything is dated, no air con, gotta fight for a fan, no fridge. Check out the photos for true review. 
Would we stay agin? For £200+ for 1 night to be cooked alive… not a chance!

author: Manon B
title: Wonderful stay.
text: We stayed here 5 nights and enjoyed our stay very much.  The double bed room was spacious and the water pressure in the shower was good.  We had a view of Tower Bridge and The Shard and river which I loved.   The concierges were very nice and helpful.   We ate at Vicinity, the hotel’s restaurant, and it was also very good. The lobby is large and comfortable.  The TV screen was very large.  On our departure the concierge called a taxi for us and the porter took our luggage out  for us.   It’s located just a few minutes walk from the Tower of London and lots of restaurants.  I definitely recommend this hotel and will stay here again.

author: Evie H
title: Great London hotel
text: Fabulous hotel and location. Loved the room, restaurant and spectacular views from my room.  Staff were great as well

author: Michael S
title: Just an amazing hotel , great view and great staff
text: Everything was great room amazing view

author: Maria M

author: Harper S
title: Awesome hotel in Central London
text: Hotel is in a great location. Central to everything. Rooms are spacious. The staff is friendly and helpful. Special shout out to Lavanya who has been outstanding.

author: George X

text: Great location. Close to theatres soho and Chinatown. Service was immaculate. Went for our anniversary and the staff went out of the way to make us feel special. A shout out to Maclin Dias for being very professional and passionate to sort out our comfort during the stay and make it special for us.

author: Luke H
title: Exceptional performance (Maclin)
text: I had an n exceptional front desk experience with Maclin. She had warm professionalism, swift service, and a genuinely welcoming attitude that sets a high standard for guest care.

author: Grace E
title: Excellent London experience
text: Very central hotel, very clean, staff very patient and helpful. Impeccable rooms. Maria took care of our room and was excellent.

author: Abigail M
title: Wont be back
text: Im not sure how it got the stars it has. Im sstaying 5 nights. The floor of my room hadn't been vacuumed, so i stepped over walnuts of the last guest as I navigated the bed & bathroom. I'm here for work, so Im relying on a room service thats impossible to get a hold of and inconvenienced when i do reach them. Other than that, I'm a low key guest with basic needs - clean, comfy, contactable. So I wont be back, shame as it looks so pretty from outside in this area.

author: Alexander H
title: Excellent!
text: Everything went smoothly. Breakfast was excellent. Ravneet cleaned our room so well! My only gripe about the hotel was manually reconnecting to the wifi every day, but overall that only takes a minute or two.

author: Gavin V
title: A Fantastic Hotel That Keeps Getting Better
text:
I’ve been staying at this hotel regularly for the past two years, and it has constantly improved during that time.

Lakshani is an absolute star. She always takes such good care of me and my work colleagues and makes us feel genuinely welcome every time we stay.

The rooms are always spotless, and the food is top quality, which is quite unusual for a hotel.

I would highly recommend staying here. If you do visit, make sure you say hello to Lakshani. She is a real credit to the hotel.

author: Paige Y
title: Hotel Stay
text: Excellent hotel. Room was spacious and clean. All staff were polite and helpful. Every member of staff said good morning or good evening when you passed them and held doors open when going through. I didn’t get the name of the lady on check in but aabha on check out both super helpful polite and welcoming. Breakfast choice was plentiful and hot and restaurant staff were efficient in replenishing and clearing tables. We will definitely be back!

author: Marta E
title: Very Comfortable Hotel in a Good Area
text:
I booked a room here for 4 nights because it is air conditioned and it had a room that could accommodate us and our teenage grandson. We were first given room 134 which was very small. I asked the front desk staff if we could get a larger room and they gladly gave us a much larger room with a bed for us and a sofa bed for our grandson. 

When I booked the hotel I didn't think the breakfast buffet was included, but we found out that it was. The breakfast buffet at the Level restaurant was very good and the staff was friendly. 

Our only issue was that there were no instructions on how to use the shower so we had to ask a staff member. In addition, the shower/bath tub was hard to get in and out.

This hotel is in Bloomsbury, a terrific area near the British Museum.  It is a two block walk from the Holborn tube stop which made it very easy to get around. Southampton Row had a number of good restaurants.

I highly recommend this hotel.

Catalina at the reception desk was especially helpful and skillful. She promptly solved problems and gave advice and help to customers who had special needs!

author: Hannah P
title: A beautiful experience in London
text: Beautiful experience! Very functional and clean hotel. The service and staff are always excellent! The arrangements for organizing meals are excellent, in particular the very complete breakfast!

author: Antoine W
title: Great Location!
text:
Doubletree by Hilton London West End is centrally located. The British Museum, Covent Garden and Chinatown are just steps away. There are two Underground stations nearby.
The staff are friendly and helpful. Geetha at the Reception Desk went above and beyond to make sure our family was taken care of. She even hailed a cab for us. Adarsh at the Bar is very welcoming and a nice guy to talk to.
The updated rooms are comfortable and spacious. 
Overall, a great value for its location and staff!

author: Mia A
title: Excellent Location

author: Nora G
title: Ask for Keven
text: Stayed at the Hilton Olympia three nights and my guy Keven hooked me up every night at the society bar. I got the chance to talk to him during my last night and he is an amazing person, with a lot of interesting stories. If you have the opportunity to come here please ask for him because he will make your stay here in London more than worthwhile! Thank you again Keven! Wishing you all the best from the US.

author: Paolo R
title: Excellent stay + Value for Money
text:
Stayed just the one night at this hotel. Not entirely sure why it has such a low score, as we had an excellent stay. We had a late arrival and immediately the staff welcomed us and offered some water whilst checking in. The rooms are indeed dated, but they are exactly like the photos and are more than adequate and the premium rooms are an option where they have been renovated. There unfortunately was no gold upgrades as the hotel was busy, but the staff did check for this. The only pain was there was no plug sockets by the end which was a shame. No outside noise as we were on the 8th floor and also at the back of the hotel (most rooms face the back of the hotel).
However, the breakfast was exceptional, possible one of the best I have had across the Hilton group. The staff were super attentive, the offering was excellent, across both the hot and cold options.
Overall, for what is one of the cheapest Hilton’s consistently across London (often far cheaper than nearby Premier inn and travelodge), it has excellent service and a good night sleep. Would recommend.

author: Sydney M
title: Thank you so much
text:
Simply the best Hilton Hotel in London - As a Hilton Diamond Honors Member I have stayed at this hotel many times over the last few years. It offers excellent value for money; the rooms are clean and spacious; the breakfast is best of class; the staff friendly and welcoming. A few special mentions - Francesca (charming and lovely), the reception team (fantastic and helpful); the breakfast team (amazing and efficient - including the lovely waiter who gets my second cup of coffee); the bar team (very hard working and well looked after during the Diamond Happy Hours). Let’s hope that when the hotel does get a refurb none of its fine charm is lost.

Thank you for always looking after me.

author: Sean G
title: Excellent Staff
text: Currently staying at the Hilton Olympia. I would like to say a big thank you for the excellent and friendly service provided by Bedillia, Natasha, Theo and the rest of the bar team. I always look forward to coming to this hotel as they really make the difference between a faceless service and an enjoyable experience.

author: Sophia E
title: Good Value For Money
text:
I was upgraded at this hotel as a Hilton Diamond member.
Staff are friendly and helpful.
The rooms are very old fashioned apart from the TV which was a Samsung but it’s not connected to the Internet so you can’t Chromecast which is disappointing and a waste of waste of having a top of the range smart TV. Picture is only average which is a known problem in the Kensington area.
WiFi works well. The fridge was excellent too. Air conditioning didn’t work that well and the room was very hot.
The hotel doesn’t have an executive Lounge anymore which is disappointing.
The hotel area is safe and close to High Street shops and there is a Waitrose Supermarket close to the hotel. 
Breakfast has nice quality food but no service. This restaurant used to have amazing service but now it’s a bit of a shambles.

author: Evan H
title: Great stay
text: Really good stay, repeat stay for the last 5 years. Good breakfast, Samir is a superb host along with Bedelia in the bar. Thank you to all the staff, hope to see you next year.

author: Taylor T
title: Great staff - facility needs work!
text: The staff is nice, but the hotel needs an entire renovation. It is old and we think there is musty air coming out of the HVAC system in the rooms. There’s this nice Italian lady who runs around the lobby, but she’s a little too pushy. Hilton should force a renovation here within 2 years - it’s gettin grim and worn out/ run down

author: Charlotte U
title: Good & Clean Hotel
text:
I really enjoyed my stay! The room was really good and the Service of the Personal was great! 
I would say it is worth the Money!

author: Antoine K
title: Not A Quality Hilton Hotel!
text: Hotel is located in Kensington, nice area. However, there is a hospital and police station nearby. We heard sirens 8-10-12 times a night. That alone is reason not to book this hotel. We had a 2 room suite. Rooms very very “sterile,” no wall hangings or other room decorations. Bathroom was very, very dated with subway tile, high lip tub. Bottom line, rooms need a serious update. Breakfast was fantastic, everything you desire. Room service was good. I recommend the British beef ribeye, excellent! Value? Over priced for the condition of the rooms and location, I was surprised this hotel is a Hilton product.

author: Gavin K
title: Excellent hospitality and exceptional service from Mr. Asher
text:

As a regular guest at Hilton London Olympia, I have had the pleasure of experiencing Mr. Asher’s outstanding service on many occasions. He consistently makes every effort to ensure my comfort and well-being throughout my stay.

His attention to detail, professionalism, and willingness to go the extra mile are genuinely appreciated. His dedication to guests is a great example of the high standard of hospitality that makes a hotel feel like a home away from home.

Thank you, Mr. Asher, for your continued care and excellent service. You are a great asset to the Hilton London Olympia team.

Kind regards,
Alireza Jamili

author: Isla S
title: Very good
text: Excellent service of staff breakfasts is very good and well

author: Claire P
title: A simple disclosure would have made this a very good review!
text: The Hilton London Olympia is in a great location, the staff are some of the best I have encountered in 40+ years of travelling! However, their one omission (and for me it is a big one); they fail to disclose that you could encounter stairs when navigating luggage to/from your room on check-in/check-out! I do believe that if this detail was disclosed, potential guests could make informed decisions about stays at this hotel, especially the elderly or those with physical limitations. I did request a room change and was accommodated. So, if stairs are not an issue for you I recommend this hotel as it is in a great neigbourhood with great shopping and restaurants in walking distance. The team are attentive and extremely friendly, but this omission takes a bit of the shine off the apple!

author: Daisy A
title: Good Hotel in Excellent Location
text: Hilton Olympia is a reasonably priced hotel located on Kensington High Street, London. The hotel has good access to central London via the District Line as well as local parks, Kensington, Hyde and Holland. As well, of course, Olympia which is a 5 min walk. I’ve stayed several times at this hotel on business and pleasure. Some rooms are on the small size, but not excessively given this is London. However they are clean, comfortable and air conditioned. Breakfasts, as with all Hilton’s, are excellent and the staff are friendly and helpful.

author: Megan X
title: Great stay for work event and super breakfast
text:
We stayed for an event at olympia. I thought as a group of 8 we would have rooms near each other but we were all on different floors.
My room was comfortable with a good quality clean bathroom. The air con was on but was weaker to a colleague's whose was cold. One room the air-conditioning did not work but reception helpfully provided a fan. On the hottest week of the year it was needed 
Super breakfast choice and my husband was jealous that fried bread was on offer. Lovely bar area too. I loved the country flags on the tables for the world cup.
Would definitely book there if I need to be in West London again

author: Oliver M
title: Amazing!
text: We made this booking at the last minute, and before booking I didn’t read the reviews here, trusting the Hilton brand standards instead. After reading them later, I started to doubt my choice. But our stay turned out to be wonderful and completely without complaints. The room was spacious, with plenty of room, the air conditioning worked, everything was clean, and the bed was huge and very comfortable. I almost felt sorry that we only stayed here for one night because we had so much to do in the city. The breakfast was excellent, and the location was very convenient for transport, while still being a quiet and cozy place at the same time. Definitely will return again

author: Antoine R
title: Pretty Mid, Bordering on Terrible
text:
This hotel is in dire need of a refresh. Some of the rooms have apparently been renovated, and these renovations can't come soon enough. The hotel seems to be in a Victorian-era building, with low ceilings and absolutely tiny rooms. It's actually two buildings joined together and you have to walk down stairs to get to one of the other buildings. Even by London standards, it's very small and cramped. Two people with two checked bags would have a hard time moving around the room. All the furniture and accessories look and feel pretty beat up. There is a lack of charging ports by the bed. Our room clearly wasn't meant to be used by two people, because when the two beds are pulled apart, one of them doesn't even fit the headboards. When you lean back, your head actually hits the reading lamp. The placement of the bed also blocks one of the light switches. The TV did not work either.

But by far the worst part was when the staff barged into our room without permission. This was around 5PM, when the staff came to check if the room has been serviced. This particular member knocked and without waiting for us to answer just UNLOCKED THE DOOR AND CAME IN. This is a MAJOR violation of guest privacy and is completely unacceptable. I have never had this happen in any of my stays anywhere. The staff ALWAYS wait for the guest to open the door before coming in.

Location-wise, the hotel is near the Kensington-Olympia Overground station which places you one stop away from the big Westfield Mall at Shephards Bush. There are some bus stations nearby but it's a 15 minute walk to the nearest Tube station so getting to Paddington, King's Cross, or LHR is not that convenient. There are some restaurants and pubs nearby. Breakfast spread was okay to be fair, but it's basically the same English breakfast everyday.

I've stayed at three Hiltons in London now and this is by far the worst experience. I would stay away if you have better alternatives.

author: Isabella O
title: Pretty basic
text: This is a great location if you’re attending an event at Olympia. Check in was slow and there was no recognition of HH status. The prices were hiked for an an event, outside of events it’s good value for money. The rooms are ok, materially they are showing signs of wear. Breakfast wasn’t great for my stay, the plates were freezing and the food wasn’t particularly warm. I’d only stay again if I was at something in Olympia. I wasn’t blown away.

author: Joseph W
title: Really good reasonably priced room in London
text:
Very happy- quick check in and the room was available early which was brilliant. Very comfortable bed and what I can describe as a huge television.  Very clean and modern. Really helpful to have plug points and USB chargers at the bedside. 

I stayed in a King Premium room and it was a large size with a table and comfortable chair. Nice toiletries and coffee making facilities. 
Staff pleasant and added bonus of adjoining Costa which you could access from the hotel. I did not have food here so I couldn’t say how it was. Staff very polite and obliging. 

It did what I needed it to do and the great thing about Hilton is you know you are getting a decent comfortable room wherever. 
A convenient location in Kensington and a great base for a weekend away in London.

author: Sydney D
title: The staff are excellent
text: I stay here in the summer when the central London hotels are more expensive to fit in with my rate cap from work. The staff make this hotel a warm and pleasant experience which when you are away from home every week means so much more than they realise. Nothing is too much trouble and there is always a smile and greeting after a long day when I return. Diamond members can sit on the restaurant and have a drink and snacks which is welcome when you need another space between work and sleep. They are working their way through refurbishing the rooms as well.

author: Kyle H
title: Just an ok hotel
text: Our room was clean, the lobby and restaurants were nice. The first two floors of the hotel felt tired, like they needed a good upgrade. The breakfast was the same each morning, after seven days, it would have been nice to have something a little different. Overall it was ok.

author: Poppy X
title: Great
text: We had a really nice and spotlessly clean holiday at the hotel. The rooms were clean, and the breakfast was adequate. My family and I stayed for five days and left very satisfied. Also, Mr. Abdul answered all our questions very well and found solutions to our problems. We thank him very much 😉👍

author: Carlos Z
title: Great location and helpful staff
text: Muskan was very sweet and helpful in helping us check in at the reception!

author: Zoe R
title: Clean, comfortable, and well-located.
text:
We came to London as a family and we were very satisfied with our stay. The hotel is very well-located, next to a subway stop and several bus lines, which makes getting around the city much easier.

Everything was very clean and well-kept. The breakfast does not have much variety, but the products are of good quality and everything is very delicious. We especially want to highlight the kindness of the staff: although they do not speak Spanish, they have always made a great effort to understand and help us, resolving any questions or problems with a smile.

Without a doubt, we recommend this hotel and would stay here again on a future visit to London.

author: Carlos O
title: Friendly behavior
text:
I had stayed in Capthorne couple of times in the past. It is a decent, well-located and welcoming hotel. All in all, proposed value is good, considering every aspect like cleanliness, price, etc. 

A point making me write a review this time was excellent staff helpfulness. I have been satisfied with this aspect in the past. But this time, Muskan, one of the staff members went beyond just being helpful. She carefully and with patience explained to me the options I have for upgrading my booking. It just felt like a friend is helping.

Very pleased and happy with this specific stay at Tara.

author: Amelia T
title: Kensington recommendation
text: Location in Kensington was nice. Quick check in and nice accommodations. Special thanks to Rida for her kind service at check in.

author: Olivia C
title: Very well located.
text:
Very well located, near shops, restaurants, public transport, museums.
Points to improve: greater hygiene in the dining room, sticky floor. Needs greater variety of dishes for dinner and breakfast. Air conditioner not operational.
Nice people.

author: Lily J
title: Great hotel
text:
Stayed at the Copthorne Tara for two weeks as part of the LIYSF event. The hotel was a fantastic location, with easy tube access. 

The staff were extremely friendly and very helpful. The rooms had everything we needed and very clean, there was also lots of options for food and drink within the hotel. 

Would definitely stay again.

author: Matthew S
title: Friendly, Helpful Reception and a Great Location!
text:
We recently stayed at the Cura as part of a longer trip to the UK. The front desk staff were very helpful and attentive to our needs as we arrived early and (after a few lovely days) had a late flight out.

The location was fabulous... just a short walk to the Earl's Court Underground station and walking distance to many of the major department stores and museums. We were close enough to the touristy bits that we could get there easily, but just far enough out that there were local folks at the pubs and restaurants in the neighbourhood, too.

A special thank you to the hotel for the nice little treat that appeared in our room on our Wedding Anniversary evening!

author: Katie J
title: A Comfortable Base for Exploring London
text:
We had a good stay at Cura Hotel Kensington and found it to be a convenient and comfortable option for visiting London.

The location was a definite highlight — it’s within walking distance of the Tube station, making it easy to get around the city and reach the major sights without much hassle. There are also plenty of shops, restaurants, and cafés in the surrounding area.

Our room was clean, charming, and comfortable, with everything we needed for our stay. The hotel has a nice character to it, and it was a pleasant place to come back to after a busy day exploring London.

The staff were helpful and friendly, and we appreciated how accommodating they were whenever we needed assistance.

Overall, it was a solid stay with a convenient location, clean rooms, and helpful service. A good option if you’re looking for somewhere comfortable and well-connected while visiting London.

author: Taylor A
title: Possibly our new go-to hotel in London!
text: I love this hotel! The staff couldn't have been kinder and even placed a birthday treat in the room. While the hotel is a little out of the center of things, it was nice to come back to a quieter neighborhood after the bustle of the theater district. The gym is very good; the breakfast excellent and the room was a decent size for London and reasonably priced. It's near the tube and an easy walk to Hyde Park.

author: Luca F
title: Cozy and Close to the Tube
text: Cura Kensington was a convenient home base for our stay in London. Its location was excellent—just a short walk from the Underground, making it easy to explore the city, and surrounded by plenty of great local cafés, pubs, and restaurants. Our room was cozy and comfortable, though the hotel does show its age. The plumbing was a bit noisy during showers, which was noticeable, but it didn’t take away from the overall experience. If you’re looking for a well-located hotel with easy access to transportation and neighborhood dining, Cura Kensington is a solid choice.

author: Sophia H
title: Friendly staff, good location and recently renovated so clean and newish
text:
The Cura has very nice decor having been recently renovated.
It is in a good location with friendly staff.  
There was a comfortable bed albeit the rooms are smallish/cosy (which is common in London) but there is a big screen TV.
The lack of a nespresso machine and fridge was a let down.  
breakfast limited - continental with a couple of pre-cooked extras

author: George Q
title: The best 4* In London.
text:
The Cura is a complete rebuild of the old Park grand, I was a regular customer of that hotel but now it is in a different league. Beautiful new bedrooms and super comfy beds. The lounge/restaurant area is so welcoming. The food is exceptional. The Chef takes great pride in what he does. 

The hotel feels like home, the staff are so welcoming, more than anywhere of the 52 other similar standard/price ranged hotels I have stayed in London over the past 3 years. 

Of course, if you want to stay in a five star hotel and pay accordingly, you may find more luxury, marbled bathrooms and expensive artwork! 

But for the vast majority of people who want to stay in a super comfortable 4* hotel, where the staff are incredibly friendly and treat you like guests staying in their home, with warmth and the personal touch, with great brekkie and all day food, for me this is number one. And I look forward to dozens of stays ahead.

author: Benjamin M
title: Enchanted by this hotel in London!
text:
I stayed for 1 night the day I arrived in London and it was enough to love the city, and of course, the hotel!

Its location is perfect, close to the subway station (we used to get to the hotel), the room is beautiful, super well decorated and even had a heater on the bathroom floor.

The breakfast was super varied and delicious, not to mention the service as a whole that was impeccable. I highly recommend!

author: Jessica X
title: FANTASTIC 👏👏👏
text: Fantastic Hotel, can’t say enough about it, ALL the staff were amazing, fantastic location, great food, will be back👏👏👏👏

author: Holly N
title: Regrettable Experience
text: The management is quite unprofessional and inconsiderate. Overall hotel is more of a 3-star than a 4-star, but the management takes it down a notch even further.

author: Ethan T
title: Great stay!
text:
My husband & I spent 4 days at the Penninsula Hotel in London. It was our first time here. From the moment we arrived we were warmly welcomed by all of the staff after  a long trip from the U.S. 
Angel greeted us warmly at the door when we arrived. He was very attentive and made us feel right at home. He helped us during our stay in many small ways, bringing me a cup of tea “to go” when we were rushing out the door and making sure that our needs were met in many small ways that were greatly appreciated! Thanks again to all the staff at the Penninsula for a lovely stay! We’ll be back

author: Marco Y
title: Gorgeous property and excellent service.
text:
I dinned at Kenny’s yesterday, 29th of May 2026. I was looking for a place for a bit of dinner and I saw this quaint place that looked newly done, still had that fresh smell of new paint and new furniture on the side of Hogarth road. The restaurant as a whole was absolutely gorgeous and the bar was stunning, both contemporary and vintage. It had a feeling of a live art gallery.
I was welcomed with smiles and cheerfulness brimming from
Ear to ear! I was given top tier service from the start. The service went beyond that robotic, manufactured care most people are well accustomed to in London, a transactional acquaintance of a customer and vendor.
I ordered 4 sides, Hummus Paphos, Appliance Burrata, Smoked Ham Hock & Chorizo and the Semolina bread. Ordered the Ken Bun as the main and the sticky toffee pudding for dessert.
The food was brought to the table within 15 minutes and was brought it the manner I requested it. All of it together except for the dessert!
The exec chef brought the food himself and explained the origin of the food and where he source ingredients. The chef’s personal touch elevated the dining experience at Kenny’s, it also simultaneously elevated my expectations of the food.
He went on to explain, the Burrata is brought from Puglia and tomato grown in an abandoned London Underground tunnel using a hydroponic system.The balance of flavours of the burrata, not sweet tomato and the light olive oil perfectly rounded the flavour profile of the light starter!
The homemade semolina bread I think is a must have with this starter, the crispy on the outside and soft and warm on the inside, this simple combination soothes the soul!
The homemade hummus had the perfect balance of tangyness, sweet and sour and that rich earthy kick. Toasted chickpeas rounded the dish with a bit of crunchiness too! The texture was smooth and velvety, just perfect!
The ham hock and chorizo was incredible, captured the complete flavour profile. It was crispy, spicy, tangy and also the white sauce that garnished the dish cools your palette so you can enjoy every bite without compromising the taste! You simply cannot stop eating! I wish there was main dish of the sort! Absolute 10/10!
Now to the main dish, the hero! The Ken Bun! From the soft lightly toasted, brioche buns, the generous and juicy burger of the absolute best quality meat, the sweet and tangyness from the carmelized onions, the thick crispy sort of Carmelized bacon strip and to top it off the runny egg York cooked to perfection! I was told the eggs are organic and brought from Cotswold by the chef.
The dessert, Sticky Toffee Pudding, When I put a spoon full of the sticky toffee pudding with its Madagascan vanilla FroYo custard cream. The warm and soft pudding in the rich velvety sticky toffee sauce and the custard cream froyo makes every spoonful a moment stuck in time! This ranks right on top with the tiramisu I had from Burj a few years back! Absolutely stunning!

author: Jack A
title: You have to experience The Cura Hotel Kensington!
text: Beautiful design led hotel, the rooms have such character and style. Great location too, so close to the underground at Earls Court and then the lovely Kensington neighbourhood environment. You have to eat at Kenny's the food is really good and very well priced, relaxing environment the perfect bleisure option!

author: Camille J
title: Helpful staff and good location
text: Staff are great. Excellent service at front desk, and in restaurant . Room and bed very comfortable . Good location for getting around

author: Luke Y
title: Lovely, centrally located boutique hotel
text: We stayed at this lovely boutique hotel for a week. We had a tough time finding a room with two beds at a reasonable price in London, but the Cura Kensington turned out to be a fantastic option! It’s a three-minute walk to the Earls Court tube stop, which is on the Piccadilly Line and has a train straight to/from Heathrow. The staff is absolutely lovely - so helpful and friendly. Our room was small but charming. Kensington is a great neighborhood and fairly central. Highly recommend!

author: Jack V
title: Lovely Boutique Hotel
text:
Nice, recently renovated hotel. The location is near Earl’s Court Subway station. The breakfast was delicious. The staff was very friendly. 

This is a hotel in an an older building. They did a fine job making it comfortable. Our bathroom was so small, it was difficult to enter. But we understood this was due to the age of the building. There was air conditioning in our room which was a real plus. We would go back here again.

author: George X
title: My absolute favorite in London
text:
This lovely hotel is my second home when in London. Not just because of the perfect location in Kensington and close to public transport. Cura is also close to many of the major attractions and loads of restaurants close by.
The hotel itself is so lovely. Nicely decorated rooms, comfy beds and crisp linen. 
Breakfast is tasty and all freshly made.
Staff is friendly and helpful. Only negative comment is about the waitress at the breakfast. It would be nice if she asked the guests if more coffee or tea is needed.

author: Sophia U
title: Nice hotel, friendly staff, good location
text: Stayed here last week for five nights. We chose this hotel for the location and ease of getting to/from the airport. It’s very close to the Earls Court station and on the Piccadilly line. All the sights are along both lines out of Earls Court and Kensington is an easy 20-30 minute walk (there’s lots to see along the way). Room was clean and a good size. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Food is fairly expensive in London, so we opted for breakfast and it was excellent!  Great coffee and lots of variety each morning.

author: George Q
title: Nicely renovated hotel very near Earl's Court Stn, good food, great staff get Bonvoy points
text: I was hesitant after reading the older reviews, but I can say all the renovations seem to be complete and it's quite comfortable. It is a typical Earl's Court Victorian row/terraced building that was converted to an earlier hotel years ago, So you can't rule out noise radiating from other rooms. I never heard any though. I did ask to be moved after there was a rythmic hum from what was thought to be one of the air conditioners on the roof (I was on top floor). The breakfast is good and they'll cook eggs to order if you wish. They can make food all day in their large restarant/bar area. Mini safe in the rooms but no fridge. I found all the staff to be really friendly and really helpful.  Nice pub nearby (The Kings Head) and a few minutes walk to the Earl's Court tube and shops, and 2 other pubs and resaurants on the high street. Given staff, room, food and price point and easy walk to the tube, I'd stay again. BTW it is part of the Bonvoy chain.

author: William C
title: Recommended
text:
Good hotel .....
room service is very fast

author: Marco O
title: First time in London 🇬🇧
text: Room wasn’t ready when we arrived , so we explored around in Covent Garden , Oxford street. Breakfast waiters & restaurant staff were nice

author: Oliver T
title: Lovely little gem of a hotel .
text: Lovely hotel although we had a ground floor room which was a tad clausophobic. But bed was comfy staff lovely and air con was bliss . Great location  and free bag drop before and after stay was very helpful .

author: Lucia M
title: Nice place, noisy underground
text:
Attended 13th through to the 15th July place is not bad, staff are good and rooms are clean and certainly decent for getting your head down. Only downside it is a bit noisy from the underground 
Didn’t try the breakfast so cannot comment

author: Gavin Y
title: The most gracious and helpful staff
text: I became ill while staying at this well situated hotel very close to Victoria bus station and Victoria station. They were most supportive with advice and luggage and provided laundry service at a reasonable price.

author: Nora Q
title: Best place to stay for me
text: Excellent location for me. Spotlessly clean with wonderful kind and friendly staff. Will definitely stay there again

author: Ethan C
title: Perfect for us .
text:
Had the most comfortable and welcoming stay here at the Portico....great location, quiet, well equipped and tastefully decorated rooms.
Staff were helpful and charming.
We stayed 2 nights whilst visiting the Chelsea Flower Show and would happily return without hesitation.

author: Lucy L
title: Excellent; 5 star review
text: Thank you for a lovely overnight stay. I am taking the time to write this review as your hospitality, friendly team, clean rooms and accommodation to additional mobility needs was faultless. You went above and beyond with a smile every time. I will be back and recommend this hotel to anyone travelling; whether alone or in a group for business or pleasure. Providing you can manage the few steps at the front the hotel is accessible for people with mobility needs.

author: Mason S
title: Small but near underground
text: Small hotel room on the 4th floor. without elevator. Nice staff and close to Victoria station

author: Charlotte T
title: weekend in London
text: a weekend in london! great experience, nice and clean hotel, all super helpful, Neel the receptionist very nice and helpful to any need. advice

author: Mathis G
title: Great hotel close to Victoria station
text: We stayed here for one night when having a short stay in London for sight seeing. Our room was spotlessly clean , beds were comfortable and had a nice hot shower in the morning. Staff were really friendly and helpful and the hotel was close to Victoria station which was really convenient for getting about on the tube. We had breakfast which was simple but just what we needed, overall for the price thought this was a little gem of a hotel and would happily stay again in the future.

author: Abigail P
title: Very nice hotel 🙂
text: 5 minutes walk from Victoria tube station. The room was cozy, clean and cute. No noice at day or night. Service was good. Breakfast was good. Very nice visit for 4 nights. I would love to come again. ❤️

author: Aiden K
title: Really nice and clean hotel. Highly recommend.
text:
So the hotel was very clean, the room had everything we needed and the staff were very helpful.
I asked if they could put a Funko Pop on my son’s bed for when we arrived later on and they did Thai and left him a can of pop. The beds were clean and comfortable, bathroom was great and shower blew the cobwebs away as very powerful. 
We were located in the Lower ground ( basement to you and me) and the breakfast room was just next door. They only offered a continental breakfast, which was great. The breakfast wasn’t included, but we were offered it free of charge. 
We left our bags there and came back later in the day to collect them, well after checkout. Storage room had cctv, so security was really good.

We have no complaints about coming back to this hotel, they seemed really happy and the staff were very kind and helpful to our autistic son. 
8/10 from my son, they had no English fry up for breakfast, that would have earned them a 10/10.

author: Owen K
title: Great location for Victoria Station and the theatre
text: This hotel was one of the cheapest in the area and great value for money. Small but clean room for 3 adults. Comfortable beds with tea, coffee facilities. Is a 5 min walk into Pimlico area with shops and cafes. Great location for Victoria station with a Sainsbury’s and Gatwick Express. Not a big fancy hotel but only approx £140 per night for 3 adults good if you are on a budget

author: Mia Q
title: Great location, friendly staff, spotlessly clean
text: Myself and my daughter arrived at the hotel and were upgraded to a bigger room. A lovely bonus as it is a celebration for my daughter’s birthday. The hotel is beautifully clean, great location and the staff are friendly and so helpful. I would definitely recommend and would stay here again.

author: Harry Q
title: Few issues, but nice enough hotel
text:
The beds are comfortable, location is great and decently sized room for a 1 night stay. 
There were a few issues with cleanliness, but raised this after with the hotel and it was sorted out quickly... also it didnt help when the fire alarm went off at 3am! Scared the #### out of us, and no explanation for it the next day... 

If your on 4th floor, be aware of stairs. No lift! Wifi bit hit & miss, but overall its a nice enough hotel for 1 or 2 nights in London. 

Staff were very friendly too😊

author: Pierre X
title: Good experience
text:
Ordered a dobbel room, but since we were a father and son we got a bigger room with two beds. The room looks clean and nice with a nice bathroom. 
Good service.

author: Thomas M
title: Restful
text: A quiet place, well located, easy access by bus or metro. Restaurants and shops nearby, which is very nice.

author: Emma D
title: Location
text: The hotel's location is close to Victoria Station and within walking distance of popular landmarks. The room is renovated with equipped bathroom. The worst the smell that came through the window that does not isolate anything and gives for inner courtyard.

author: Chloe F
title: Dirty small hotel room
text: I wouldn’t book this hotel. Dirty small hotel room with staining on the bedding and it also had a mattress topper on that was too small for the double bed so it made it very uncomfortable. I clearly didn’t read the reviews before I booked …………..

author: Ruby Q
title: Night visit
text: This is the hotel for those who love small little “creatures” in bed at night. I write about such little creatures who lovingly want to “nibble” you all over your body. These little ones then come home with you and move in and you have to pay thousands of kronor so that a certain type of company comes and “cleans”.

author: Ana C
title: Handsome, thoughtfully designed boutique in a great location
text: Really handsome, thoughtfully designed hotel - makeover from the former Hanover Hotel has been well done with a really comfortable bed, smart marble bathroom and rain shower in a great location on St George's Drive in Pimlico that is convenient to everything.  I stayed three nights in a single and was impressed at how well they had managed to design the small space - thoroughly enjoyed my stay.

author: Brooke E
title: A nice hotel in a nice area staff all make an effort to make you feel welcome .
text: A lovely hotel who are making great efforts to improve and the addition of a swimming pool has made the difference.The barman Zaheen is a great asset for the hotel as he remembered that we visited the hotel 6 years previous

author: Hannah L
title: Calm place to stay with very helpful staff
text:
Hitel provides a calm and peaceful place to stay when visiting Rome. The pool is great for cooling down after a day of walking and sight seeing. 

Staff are great, cheerful and alway happy to help. Variety and quality of Breakfast was very good. 

We opted for two family rooms with joining door. Both the rooms and bathrooms were spacious and kept very clean each day by staff which was great. 

The hotel is a 10min bus ride from the city centre and there are bus stops right outside the hotel making travel easy. Taxis can be booked using the 'free now' app and always arrived very quickly as well.

author: Chloe X
title: Very good hotel with very attentive staff!
text:
A great hotel that met all the necessary requirements. We were very comfortable and the staff's treatment was exceptional.
We took away a great impression of the hotel and we especially appreciate the great attention from María Cristina and Roberta. Thank you!

author: Harry E
title: Fantastic hotel highly recommend
text:
Just returned from a 5 night stay , can  not fault this hotel at all . Staff were amazing hotel was excellent.  We booked through on the beach . I emailed the hotel direct a few weeks prior to see if they they offered airport transfer and they did , Maria was absolutely brilliant on the email arranging this , we had private transfer and Maurizto messaged me to say he was waiting outside and was brilliant. Only took about 30 mins and cost euro 65 . Hotel also arranged from transfer  back too . ( if you are on early flight they will also do you a breakfast bag to go which was brilliant too ) 
Our room
Was lovely king size bed and large sofa bed converted into bed ( teenager said bed was very comfy ) there is a fridge in room which was great and coffee machine , there is also a safe , steam
Iron and in our room couple of the sockets had usb ports , air con 
Shower  lovely and had shampoo and shower gel , we had email from hotel checking how we were settling in and just asking on feedback to which I just said could of done with more coffee pods and coat handles the next day knockOn door with all
Of this ! How amazing service !
Breakfast lovely served 7am -10am and lovely can’t fault it . Swimming pool absolutely brilliant and so happy to booked hotel with pool as was 40deg so was lovely to come back and co
Off , also had a pool day and chilled round the pool and had light snacks and drinks . They serve snack food until 9pm in hotel and drink until 11pm nice seating and lighting outside  
About 15 min walk to metro ( turn left outside hotel up to top of road and turn left all way down there ( just passed mc Donald’s ) also some other shop up there to to get your bus pass ( one with t outside) bus tickets includes metro too eur 150 for 100 min ( remember if on bus you must tap it to validate it ) bus conductors do get on we had one on ours ) there is bus stop outside takes you to city and we also went to trastervere  too ( took 2 stops)  
. We also walked to Vatican took approx 40 mins not ideal in heat but did it early morning . Metro is by far east but if you don’t fancy walk you have bus option outside . 
Lovely restaurant just 3mins down road called Ristorante Arturo turn right outside hotel ( shut on Mondays ) , it’s just before Crown  plaza hotel which is also has a restaurant you can go to too. We also walked past crown plaza to end of road At lights  then turned right and about another 5 min walk and found little sushi bar called nana sushi we had take out and took it back to room ( caught the bus back ) few other little restaurants there and then carry on walking up there is a little fair little ones on right hand side ( just past pharmacy)
We booked a lot of our trips with get your guide and never had any issues . 
Hope this of help . ( dont forgot water bottles to  fill up as lots of water fountains in the city. )

author: Pierre N
title: Lovely stay and good value for money
text: Had a lovely 2 night stay. Added bonus having the pool in the very hot heat. Nice to be able to chill by a pool after a long day of sight seeing. Friendly staff

author: William P
title: Vacation
text: The service was very good; we felt very comfortable. A little more maintenance would be desirable in the outdoor area (pool).

author: Lauren V
title: Great to have a pool in the heatwave
text: Slightly out of the area, but on a main bus route and would be walkable if not in 37 degree heat. Access to a pool was one of the main reasons for booking this hotel particularly for a visit in August. Would return

author: Miguel H
title: Rome stay
text: We had imagined a larger room. The shower faucet was calcified. The furniture was already very old and partly broken. So this is certainly not 4 stars.

author: Pablo O
title: Superb base for site seeing in rome
text:
Great hotel, friendly and helpful staff. 
Clean facilities and the pool was just perfect after a long day out sightseeing. 
Breakfast was perfect with a good choice of hot or cold food. 
Staff were very friendly and helpful we loved our stay with you and would gladly return.

author: Laura M
title: Definitely one hotel to stay in.
text: Business or leisure trip, this is a hotel to stay in. We enjoyed the room, the view, the staff and the breakfast buffet.

author: Daisy G
title: Great stay
text: Wonderful stay! Clean, comfortable rooms, friendly staff, and a great location. Highly recommend! Breakfast was excellent, and we’d gladly stay here again.

author: Mia S
title: Family stay in great hotel with Air Con
text: We had a great stay at this hotel. We used family interconnecting rooms which were great and the Air Con was much needed and worked well.

author: Brooke U
title: Good experience
text: Spacious rooms and value for money. Beds very comfortable. Great location with good transport links to the centre of Rome. Decor is outdated though needs to be upgraded as well as furniture.  Staff welcoming and friendly, always happy to help. Break fast could have been better and to offer more variety especially the fruits please.

author: Isla X
title: Good atmosphere and a beautiful garden to relax in
text: The hotel has good connections and offers a pleasant atmosphere after tours and a beautiful garden with a small pool for relaxing (unfortunately only until 8:00 PM). The rooms are comfortable and the breakfast is good. We had a good time! The service was excellent at all times!

author: Hannah H
title: Excellent hotel
text: It is a very cozy hotel in a good location away from the stress of the center of Rome, it has bus stops right in front and one street away the shuttle that takes you to the airport, on the same street as the hotel you have excellent options to eat like the Arturo restaurant.

author: Noah E
title: first class service
text: excellent hotel and staff, all where polite & helpful, special mention to Zahid looked after us extremely well during our stay as did Chantel who worked the breakfast area and bar, rooms very clean and tidy location is within walking distance of metro line where all attractions can be reached. the pool was a bonus after a days site seeing

author: Ella S
title: COZY STAY
text: From the moment of arrival, the reception staff provided excellent service; they speak to you in Spanish. Good cleanliness, and good buffet. Quiet area with a pool to relax and good bus connections.

author: Thomas D
title: A great place to stay
text:
Friendly and welcoming helpful staff.
Great rooms, very clean and comfy bed!
Lovely breakfast with lots of options including fresh fruit. Friendly staff.
Requested soy milk and they were able to provide it.
Nice to have a cafe for lunch but if you are vegetarian not many options but the margarita pizza was very good.
Easy to get a taxi from hotel. Will definitely come back if we come to Rome,

author: Evie B
title: Very comfortable hotel in nice surrounding
text: Spacious room, parking facilities, swimming pool, friendly service, well to be reached by public transport, quiet.

author: Brooke A
title: Two night stay
text:
Close to city centre and Fiumicimo airport, Occidental Aurelia was an oasis of calm after sightseeing in the busy and sweltering historic centre of Rome.  Bus stop right outside hotel was a plus.
Staff are friendly and helpful.
Our room was spacious and very clean with a comfortable bed and great shower.

author: Lauren A
title: Great!
text: The hotel is in an ideal location, there's transport to everywhere in London. There was plenty of choice of restaurants very near to the hotel. The room was lovely and clean and came with a fan to help keep us cool in the warm weather. We had everything we would need as we didnt spend much time in our room. Staff were all friendly and helpful. We did have a lot of stairs to get to our room, however, we were aware of this possibility when we booked and we were prepared for it. Would absolutely stay here again.

author: Jessica G
title: Some things need to be reviewed
text:
The area is wonderful, Paddington 
The hotel is nice but has no elevator, so for those who have difficulty, it is a significant effort
The tap water is currently not drinkable, we did not understand why 
The breakfast is good but I did not try the English one because I was not awake enough.
Clean

author: William R
title: I liked it
text:
Just a good choice 🙂
Close to everything...Paddington station, Hydepark & pubs

author: Grace D
title: Top hotel at a low price.
text: Impeccable and very clean. Small cozy room. Great service and excellent breakfast. Staff friendly and helpful. Hopefully back there next year.

author: Lea Y
title: Okay for 1-2 nights.
text:
Close to Paddington Station. Noisy due to other guests and you can feel the subway passing underneath.
The breakfast is hot and cold and tastes quite good, only the coffee does not taste good.

author: Ryan H
title: Considering the price, I think it is reasonable.
text:
I stayed in a family room. Considering the balance with the price, I think it's like this. (1 double bed, 2 single beds)
It is in a very convenient location, about a three-minute walk from Paddington Station.
The room is small, but it is clean and well-kept.
The shower room is very small, but you can fit in.
For breakfast, they offer a classic English Breakfast (toast, fried egg, bacon, sausage, beans, mushrooms). It's quite good.
My room has air conditioning, but since some rooms don't, I think you should be careful about that. Since I stayed on a hot summer day.

author: Sara P
title: Nice budget hotel near Paddington station.
text:
We chose this hotel for the 2nd time. 
Due to its perfect location close to Paddington station, Hyde park and Little Venice. The bus stops at the end of the street...
This time we had a room overlooking the park AND with air conditioning...With temperatures outside of 35° this was very pleasant. We slept wonderfully, and enjoyed the English breakfast. The staff in the breakfast room are very friendly and helpful.
Luggage can be left before check-in and after check-out.
We'll be back for sure!

author: Alexander N
title: Value for money ?
text: I arrivef late back from India and was travelling onto Cornwall. I thought rather than arrive around 5 in the am to have a night in London by Paddington ready for the first train. I eschewed the cheaper options ( shared loo) and went  I thought mid range wirh the Shakespear. Bit disappointed no assistance offered in a no lift hotel, change only vending machines, really poor room sound insulation, a shower installatio that even being average height i had to stretch for on a wet shower tray plus a TV that protrudes from the Wardrobe causing a head level obstacle. The full opening window is a novelty in Central London but not sure of the security chain that you can hook on or off from outside or inside. I didnt sample bfast as at a 7.15 start its later than some travellers need to leave. All in all next time Ill take the train that arrives early much better value
