author: Noah P
title: Dirty and old destroyed room
text:
Unfortunately, my stay at this hotel turned out to be a big disappointment. Despite its very good location – close to Victoria Station and Buckingham Palace – the conditions were far from acceptable.

The hotel is old and run down. The room was tiny and looked completely different than in the photos. The furniture was worn out, the electrical sockets did not work, and the bathroom was so small that you could not even close the door while sitting on the toilet. In addition, there was no hot water and an unpleasant smell throughout the property.

The breakfast was unappetizing and the quality of the food left much to be desired. The only positive thing was clean bedding and towels – apart from that, unfortunately, it is hard to find anything positive.

I booked this hotel because of the photos, which do not reflect reality at all. I do not recommend it – unless you only care about the location and are ready for a very low standard.
Definitely not deserved 2 stars! Don't trust the pictures on their website!

author: Grace H
title: No no no.....go somewhere else
text:
What a complete dump... It's 2 star and I'm amazed it's managed to get the 2. 
Rooms feel dirty and common areas are like walking back in time. 
Big pile of old crap left in the hallways on the ground floor.
Didn't bother trying the breakfast as was worried how dirty the kitchen would be if it any reflection on the rest of the place.

author: Grace K
title: Back again
text: This is the third time we stayed at this hotel. This time I asked for us to get a room on the ground floor, which we got (no.2). The rooms need to be looked after, the carpets are not so fresh but the bathroom was ok. The bed a bit narrow for 2 people but it went the 3 nights we stayed here. We had the "coffee machine" almost outside our door so we went there and got drinks for free. A plus there. Likewise, we got clean towels every day which is also a plus. Breakfast: toast, fried egg, sausage and white beans in tomato sauce, coffee and juice. Could have been some cheese or some toppings, but quite ok. The location of the hotel is perfect for us as it is close to Victoria Coach station and restaurants. The Sainsbury's is on the street behind if you want to shop. What I can miss in the room is a small fridge.

author: Caleb M
title: Poorly kept
text:
Hotel was dirty from stains and odd smell coming from bedsheets and pillow. The state of the hotel was in ruins needing repairs but didn’t bother renovating for guests.

Cracks and paint marks found on the walls, the wallpaper is coming off from the bottom next to the mains plug where the bedside table was. 

When checking in the room the Pillows were missing, and had to request from the reception desk for them. The bed was slightly bent to an angle for some reason and so was the cabinet.

Breakfast staff were good, with healthy English breakfast options.

author: Diego T
title: Definitely to be improved
text: The staff was very helpful and the location of the property was central and well connected. However, the conditions of the hotel and rooms were bordering on ridiculous in terms of dirt and services included. We were not allowed to turn off the heating despite my daughter having a fever of 39 and in the room it was over 30 ° C. The breakfast included in the price is at the level of the structure, so bad. We were changed three times the room, another thing that made us lose a lot of useful time to visit the city, once at our request because of the unproposable conditions and the other because the room had to be renovated. I highly advise against it.

author: Miguel N
title: Simple but correct
text: See... the hotel is very simple, if you are looking for an aesthetically beautiful hotel this is not your place. He's pretty normal, but he's got enough to be okay. They change your towels every day, the bathroom was clean, the breakfast is very basic (two hard-boiled or fried or scrambled eggs, milk, two slices of Bimbo bread with jam and butter, and beans), but considering how expensive it is to eat in London, saving you breakfast is a bonus, of course, the long-haired lady is quite unfriendly; however the rest of the staff is very friendly. The location is perfect, a 7-minute walk from Victoria Station where the Tube and buses are; and you can walk in 18 minutes to Buckingham Palace or in 25 minutes to Big Ben and Westminster Abbey. When you leave your room it is all very messy with furniture and boards in the middle, it looks like they are doing renovations, but I don't care if my room is clean and the bathroom too. Of course, the cupboard was scary to open, it would need a paint hand. There are supermarkets within 3 minutes and also cafeterias. Ah! And there's a hairdryer and free wifi.

author: Lea R
title: Bedbugs, mould
text: In the period from 27th to 30th January we were guests of this "hotel". After the second night we noticed bites on our body, which we immediately reported to the reception staff at breakfast and informed them about our desire to change rooms. The staff tried to convince us that such a situation absolutely could not happen, because they do not deal with such things, but they will check. When we left the room it was supposedly checked, nothing was found, and the room was sprayed with something. We naively believed it. We went for a nap, then I woke up bitten. I checked the bed and there I found a bedbug drunk with blood and on the mattress a lot of black dots, which as it turned out were bedbug feces. It was in room number 6. I reported it to the reception staff, the only person who tried to be helpful and competent to Nouman. After giving them the photos taken and showing them more injuries, we again demanded a room change.  Room 5 was offered. I also found two bedbugs on the mattress there and I flatly refused to accept a room change. We were changed to room 27 - I didn't find any bedbugs there, but there was mould behind the beds, and considering that it was 8pm and we were leaving for the bus to the airport at 4am we just wanted to lie down and sleep. We were asked several times not to share any photos. I offered a settlement, which consisted of a full refund of the cost of the 3 nights and £100 compensation, which in the end turned out to be insufficient, because I spent more on dry cleaning all our things, in fear of bringing it home, and medication to relieve the symptoms.

author: Ana P
title: Overall, we had a good family stay
text:
Overall, we had a good family stay and would like to thank Rahul, Waqas, Maria, and the housekeeping team for their kindness and assistance. The housekeeping lady was polite.
However, as an Accor Gold member, I was disappointed that no room upgrade was offered or even discussed during our 11-night stay. I would have expected my loyalty status to be recognized.
I would also like to highlight the following concerns:
Cleanliness: The room and ceiling areas were dusty. The area underneath the minibar/fridge was extremely dusty. I informed a team member and showed a photo, but it was never cleaned. Some bed linen was also old and had visible marks.
7th-floor ice machine: The ice machine was out of order throughout our stay, which was inconvenient.
Restaurant service: We had dinner at the all-day dining restaurant on our first night and paid cash. Service was not very attentive, and one pregnant staff member was particularly rude.
Bar service: The Mirror Bar staff were friendly, but some appeared to be trainees and lacked sufficient product/service knowledge.

Drink vouchers: Because we accepted alternate-day housekeeping, complimentary drink vouchers were offered. However, cocktails were refused when requested, and my son was also refused a milkshake. The voucher conditions should have been explained clearly.

Overall experience: I understand that service standards may differ between London and Dubai/UAE, but the cleanliness, maintenance, service, and attention to detail did not consistently reflect what I would expect from a four-star Accor hotel. At times, the experience felt closer to basic/student accommodation, with the hospitality element missing.

The hotel is large and has great potential, and we did meet some excellent staff. I am sharing this feedback constructively and hope management will take these points seriously and use them to improve the guest experience and better recognise loyal Accor members.

regards 

Nadeem Ahmad

author: Abigail T
title: A positive, comfortable stay in a conveniently located hotel
text: As I had paid extra for early check in , the process was seamy! I still don’t agree with being charged£50 per night holding fee even though the room had been paid for. Reception area is spacious with friendly staff .the room was also spacious with a comfortable bed, which had a convenient plug point by the bed. Both room and bathroom were clean with a/c available. Coffee/tea provided as well as water in the mini fridge. The safe however did not work. There was also an iron and hairdryer and Rituals shower gel, shampoo and body lotion. Ample towels were provided however the bath/shower lacked a bath mat which made it slippery to have a shower. The hotel is convenient to public transport and shops!

author: Marco H
title: Excellent accommodation
text: Modern hotel located in an excellent position. Comfortable rooms and bathroom and good cleanliness. Very satisfactory welcome with check-in carried out by Maria. Breakfast enjoyed only one day, satisfactory in the quality and quantity of the food, but the room used for it was a bit too chaotic.

author: Brooke Q
title: They take deposits and you struggle to get it back
text:
This hotel took a deposit of £50 for each day I stayed, This was on top of charging me for the room on checking in. That was money I needed for my trip. It was in my budget. Why take this deposit? They assured me the deposit would be returned to my account a few days ago. They have not returned it despite my messages asking for it. Now I could end up in a dispute with them. I don't remember other hotels taking a deposit from me.

And, BTW, the room was not very good. It was getting shabby and I do not think they give it maintenance. I do not see this hotel as 4 star but 3 star.

author: Sara S
title: Comfortable Stay with Excellent Transport Links
text:
Comfortable Stay with Excellent Transport Links

We had a very comfortable stay at Novotel London West. One of the biggest advantages of the hotel is its location. Hammersmith Underground Station is just a short walk away, and the Piccadilly Line provides a direct and convenient connection to central London, making it very easy to explore the city.

The Hammersmith area itself is also a great place to stay. There are plenty of pubs, bars, restaurants and cafés nearby, so even after returning from a busy day of sightseeing, there are many places within walking distance to enjoy the evening.

The hotel was comfortable, clean and relaxing, and our room provided a very pleasant place to rest after long days exploring London.

Overall, Novotel London West offers a very good combination of comfort, location and easy access to public transport. Being able to reach central London so easily while staying in the lively Hammersmith area was a real advantage. I would happily stay here again on my next visit to London.

author: Alice I
title: No regard for a guest's personal belonging
text:
I realised I had left my personal item in the room when I got home after checking.  I contacted them immediately to bring it to their attention and arrange collection or delivery.  The item couldn't have been left anywhere else but in the room because I'd used it during my stay in the room .  
Despite numerous attempts to retrieve the item, Novotel has just decided not to cooperate with me because by the time I informed them they had already checked someone into the room.  I have since emailed them twice and I have had no responses.  I am 100% certain that the item was left in the room, so it's either the housekeeper threw it away or decided to keep it when it was retrieved.

author: Camille S
title: Good but needs updating
text: It is in a nice location, just needs rooms to be updated, and same for the tv system, what modern hotel doesn’t have netflix on the TV? Otherwise all good really!

author: Gavin P
title: Receptionist is extremely rude
text:
The lady at the reception on August 4 at around 9:00 PM was extremely rude and very unprofessional.
I was asking about the rooms, and I hadn't even finished my questions yet i told her wait I still have a additional question and she just cut me off. Her attitude was dismissive and made me feel unwelcome.
I didn't get her name, but if she doesn't know how to handle guest inquiries professionally and respectfully, she shouldn't be working at the reception desk. This was a very disappointing experience.

author: Oliver S
title: Crappy room
text: Stayed one night at the Novotel in Hammersmith. As going to see a show. The room we were given was an accessibility room. was spacious enough with twin beds. Which we asked for, but had been pushed together , so looked like a double. Which defeats the objective of asking for a twin room. The carpet was all stained, the bathroom stank and there was something suspect on the shower curtain. Looked like blood or poo. The shower was walk in and flooded the bathroom. There was even a chair in there. All for the privilege of £200 odd as it was London prices. Novotel should be ashamed of themselves for renting that room out. My sister and niece had a lovely room on a different floor. The booking was made altogether, so don’t understand how we got a crappy room. The priemer inn and travelodge s we’ve stayed in are much more nicer than these.

author: Lauren J
title: A large drop in standards over the last six months
text:
Having stayed at this hotel for 20 or so years I have found it to be consistent.  All that changed apparently earlier this year with new management.  The breakfast simply has gone to the dogs!  More about that later in the review.

Firstly though, a mention about many of the good things the hotel has to offer.  It is very convenient to board a Piccadilly line train at Heathrow airport, get off at Hammersmith station and walk about 300metres to the hotel.  The reception staff are friendly, as are most of the staff, and the reception area in white looks welcoming.  Don’t look at the adjacent bar area with its tacky blossoms and other fake flowers though.  

This time all the hotel lifts were working, which certainly reduced the waiting time.  My room was on a higher floor with its separate shower. Recommended, compared to a shower over a bath.  The extensive glazing ensures any traffic noise is largely dealt with.  I do like the two chairs in the room next to a small table. A negative though was that the ice machine on the floor was not working! Reported it on arrival, it was still not working eight days later.  Thank you to the bar staff for helping out by making ice available.

Housekeeping is bit slack with the odd towel or bathmat missed. Most housekeeping staff have very poor English so if you go looking for a missing item communication is difficult.

As noted above, the staff are friendly, but some seem to be fearful of losing their employment. This fear is based on what has apparently happened over the last six months.

Breakfast

Breakfast costs about 20 pounds per person depending on whether it is purchased as part of the room rate or at a casual rate.

The orange juice looked like it was watered down on two of the days I had breakfast and certainly tasted that way.

There were a number of highly processed cereals to choose from, however the only muesli was noted as being gluten free.  No objection to this, but it was powdery. Fresh fruit to add to a cereal was limited to pineapple slices with the skin on, a whole banana or poorly cut oranges.  Previously there was a wide selection of canned or processed fruits available. 

Many people like eggs for their breakfast, previously the traditional fried, scrambled or poached eggs were all available for self-service.  Now there is only fried eggs. Want it poached or scrambled? Only to order for another 6 pounds 50 pence, an omelet also costs this amount. With my poached eggs, a lot of the white was missing. The breakfast bacon appears to have been broiled. Previously it was fried or grilled and a lot tastier. I am pleased the button mushrooms were still available.  The half tomatoes were heated but not cooked, as was the case previously.

The only butter available was described as “vegan butter.” A complete misnomer as butter by definition is a dairy product. The choice of spreads was good, and the comb honey remains.  

Previously guests could cut the baguettes into whatever size or shape they wanted. Now management has decided one size fits all – take it or leave it.
Staff shortages result in it taking longer than it should have to buffet food dishes replenished.

Overall, there has been a huge drop in the standard of the breakfast.  I have had breakfast at numerous Novotel and Ibis hotels in the UK and around the Asia Pacific region and never experienced something as bad as this.

So, to the quality control people in the Accor Group in Paris, all I can say is you need to get involved. Because the current management at the Novotel London West are denigrating the brand with the unacceptable breakfast offering and various complaints from many other reviewers.  Just work out the average Tripadvisor rating in the last six months and you will see why your involvement is needed.

author: Lucy B
title: Pathetic Irresponsible Hotel - DO NOT STAY
text:
I have been visiting this hotel every year for the past three years and I feel I know the property very well. I have approximately spent atleast 12,000 GBP in the last three years staying here.

It used to be an excellent, no-frills hotel that offered tremendous value. It was one of those rare properties that had it all i.e. spacious open seating, large multi-storey conference areas, a lively bar, excellent connectivity to both the London Underground and Heathrow Airport and two bus routes located right outside.

The reason I am writing this review in the past tense is because the hotel has sadly lost much of its glory. During my recent stay, I was genuinely shocked by the now terrible standards of service.

The biggest issue was the complete lack of responsiveness. No matter how many times I called the reception, housekeeping or room service, my calls just went unanswered. Nobody answers your call, no matter what. This happened repeatedly throughout my stay and is simply unacceptable for a four star hotel.

Another disappointing experience was with the minibar. At the time of booking and again during check-in, I was assured that my room would include a minibar as it had on every previous visit. However, when I checked into my room, there was no minibar. For the next two days, the staff themselves seemed unsure whether it would be provided before finally informing me that it would not be. This was despite the clear assurances given earlier.

Also, the situation with water is almost inhumane. We were three people staying in a room and they were giving us less than 1 liter of water per request. Can you imagine this? The booking mentioned that the room comes with complimentary water. Plus they provide water in a small paper carton box which renders it useless for re-filling. Last year, whenever we needed water, they used to give us a whole crate because it was saving their own time of bringing us water again and again in addition to avoiding the inconvenience to us. But this time, it was absolutely crazy. Adding to this, one the front staff representatives was acting pricey for giving us water as if he was doing us a favor, whereas it was in their own interest to give water in one single time to avoid multiple requests.

The breakfast was also very bad. During my seven day stay, the menu remained exactly the same every single day, without even a single dish being rotated or changed. Having to eat the same identical breakfast for an entire week was disappointing and did not meet the standards I expected. The taste is so stuck to me now even after a week that I feel like throwing up typing this.

While I could have overlooked some of these issues individually, what disappointed me the most was the complete lack of accountability towards customers. Over the past three years, I had developed a great deal of trust in this hotel because of the consistent experiences. Unfortunately, this latest stay has completely changed my perception and I don't see myself staying at this hotel anytime soon.

I think because of their advantages of connectivity and conference spaces, they will probably not feel the burn of the lack of accountability. But no matter what, they will not get any business from me.

author: Lucy O
title: Jeff is very helpful
text: I would love to give 5 star to Jeff. His service is the best.

author: Lucy M
title: Good.
text:
Good location, close to Hammersmith station.
Rooms in good condition.
At the time of most movement the elevators become more difficult.
Breakfast is bad! The diversity of dishes is small. Not very clean. Replacement is slow.
The bar is very nice!!!

author: Elena U
title: Brilliant customer service on floor 2
text: The service from the whole team as we used two large rooms for training on floor 2 today was outstanding - the facilities, reception, catering  teams all contributed above and beyond our expectations.  Thank you so much

author: Ruby L
title: Clean Hotel Overall
text:
The hotel was very clean and well maintained, which I really appreciated. The staff seemed a bit tense at times and were not as warm as I expected, but everything remained professional. Overall, it was a correct stay and a good experience.
Visit from 07 06 2026 to 12 06 2026

author: Nora D
title: Woudnt recommend
text: The hotel's location is quite convenient, with easy access to nearby bus stops and train stations. The lobby is spacious and welcoming. However, the room felt quite dated, and the furniture showed significant signs of wear and tear. The in-room amenities were also lacking. The air conditioning was not very effective, and a few of the staff members were not particularly helpful.

author: Molly X
title: Good hotel
text:
Very convenient and functional hotel, usefully situated just outside of the paid congestion zone and very close the Hammersmith tube.

Maria was very welcoming and efficient at reception. The room on the 7th floor was very comfortable with excellent a/c on some the hottest days of the summer.

In the bar area, we must mention Lucy who provided great service with a positive attitude.

Car parking in the basement is plentiful. Use an App to undercut the £40 per day hotel charge.

Recommended.

author: Thomas C
title: Subpar facility would not return but attentive staff.
text:
We are staying here now - July 2026. 

Hotel is fairly remote in a quiet residential area. There are plenty of restaurants within walking distance and a nearby tube stop. However, for the next trip, we would prefer to be more central.  

The rooms are reasonably clean but very tired looking. Grout is missing from the tiles and a little funky smelling in the drain. 

THERE IS NO AIR CONDITIONING.  Given that the hotel advertises air conditioning, we are not pleased. At 90 + degrees we expected air conditioning as promised. Air blows but it’s certainly not cool. And I think they even reduce the air flow at night because we woke up sweating and it felt sweltering.  The reception area is not cooled either. The staff is standing behind the desk with fans blowing.  We reported it to maintenance and was advised that this is as “cool” as it gets and we were offered a fan. 

We are booked as part of a group and would be leaving if we had another option. 

At 5 PM a staff member walked right into our room for an unknown reason. It was very intrusive and strange at that time. 

The experience is really not “average”. It’s well below average compared to our stays in other European cities. However, the staff has been very kind and attentive which makes me incline to give it a 3 instead of a 2.

author: Erin P
title: I wouldnt recommend for a family trip
text:
Our stay was organized for us as part of a larger travel group, and we added some days to the front of the trip. We would not have booked here if we had planned our trip separately. 
We have visited London several times before. This location is further away from the city center and we found there in not much to do in this area. Dining options, especially dinner, are limited, and our experience is everything requires an extended tube ride. Fortunately there is a tube station nearby. I wouldn't especially recommend this area for a family visit. 
The hotel is clean with small rooms. The staff is friendly and accommodating. 

The hotel restaurants have a limited menu, which we tried, and found the food to be uninspiring . 
As noted, our room was small.  It was functional for sleeping but not conducive for lingering at the start of, or during, your day. One caveat is the air conditioning, or lack there of.  The room never really cooled down during the hot days (34c/90f) of our trip and sleeping was uncomfortable.

author: Evan L
title: Yosra was great
text: Yosra was amazing and the service was great

author: Luke M
title: Good location and lovely hotel
text:
Location of this hotel is excellent. Close to Tower of London, Tower Bridge, The Shard and Bishopsgate. Also a 2 minute walk from Tower Hill tube station which is takes you on the district and the circle line. The rooms were lovely and spacious and clean. Stocked with hand wash shampoo, shower gel, fresh towels daily. Also had tea and coffee making facilities in the room, a mini fridge, a hairdryer and an iron.
We opted for breakfast at the Hotel one morning and it was very good with everything you could possibly want for full cooked breakfast and continental options. We also ate at the Natural Kitchen,  the restaurant in the hotel and their staff were lovely and the food was wonderful.
Not in a noisy or extremely street or part of London. 
Very good value for money for location and convenience and great staff.

author: Sofia J
title: Amazing service by Basit
text: We went to the hotel for a couple of days during July to visit some friends in London, we were mostly served by a gentleman called Basit, he was really kind and helped us out with our multitude of questions while providing great service. The hotel was amazing and the roof garden is really nice.

author: Alice N
title: Central location and comfortable room
text: Had a fantastic stay at the end of July. Great location with Circle and District Tube lines in walking distance, and clean and comfortable room, bigger than most at the same price range. Hideki at the front desk was exceptional.

author: Molly J
title: Amazing customer service from Sehar
text:
We had such a lovely experience at the DoubleTree by Hilton Tower Hill, and a huge part of that was thanks to Sehar. She was absolutely amazing from start to finish, so friendly, welcoming and genuinely went above and beyond to look after us.

You can really tell when someone genuinely enjoys looking after their guests, and Sehar was a perfect example of that.

Thank you so much, Sehar, for being so lovely and making our stay even more enjoyable. The hotel is lucky to have you!

author: Chloe V
title: Not a great review
text:
Checkin was very good, room clean and suitable. Houskeeping need to ensure that they clean the cups in the room, had to request that these were changed. The ececutive lounge was understaffed snd not greeted warmly, the drinks were limited to larger and wine with usual soft drinks and food very average.
Dont expect to get a relaxing morning. We were woken by the refuse collection at 0615 and he noise from the road below didnt stop till we finaly gave on and got up, we were on the 6th floor. Would i stay again, as a Diamond honours member this did not live up to the experiance that normally comes with that tier and would look for another hotel for the reasons above.

author: Daisy D
title: Comfortable and in a strategic position, the only problem is the Italians...
text:
As for location, no one beats this hotel: practically in front of the Tower of London (you just have to cross the street) and a three-minute walk from Tower Bridge, very convenient with the Tower Hill subway stop a stone's throw away and just a bit further the Tower Gateway DLR station (useful if you arrive at London City Airport) and the Fenchurch Street train station (not very useful for a tourist but it's nice to know it's there if you need to travel out of town).
I booked a basic room but as a Diamond member of their loyalty program, and as a regular customer of the hotel where I stay several times a year for work, I was upgraded to an Executive room on the upper floors, which even if small had a wonderful panoramic view and in addition guaranteed access to the executive lounge where from 6 PM to 8 PM happy hour is served with snacks and drinks galore.
Unfortunately this time, perhaps aided by the summer period and the presence of many rude tourists, the experience at the lounge was not up to the quality level of the hotel: after the staff had set up a rich buffet, around 6:30 PM numerous guests snuck into the lounge with bags and various containers and literally raided the buffet and the available drinks, under the horrified eyes of the (paying) customers who were present in the lounge. The staff was obviously absent and only reappeared after an hour and restored the buffet supplies.
Similar scenes at the restaurant during breakfast, with several guests, who this time were mostly Italians (from southern Italy) who raided the buffet filling bags and various containers as if they hadn't eaten in a month. The previous review is funny in this regard, with the "benevolent" response from the General Manager to behavior that is strictly forbidden in all hotels in the world (I'm not saying taking an apple or a banana, but here it was a matter of a few kg of various foodstuffs, which if done by all customers would ruin the hotel).
Despite everything, the 5-star rating remains, hoping that future stays will be worthy of the hotel's level.

author: Leo G
title: Great stay and warm welcome
text: Great stay, regular visitors of this amazingly located hotel near Tower Bridge and Tower Hill tube station. What a warm and friendly welcome from Seha on check in, thank you.  Lovely room on the 10 floor, bright, crisp and clean.  We will be back again soon.

author: Paolo J
title: Fantastic
text: Fabulous stay at the hotel staff were amazing caring and attentive  rooms very clean breakfast 10/10  tube station five mins away beautiful views of Tower of London  perfect and can’t wait to return 🙏

author: Owen Y
title: Great stay close to transport
text: We made a switch to this location at the last minute because of the heatwave. The lobby and halls are not air conditioned but the rooms were lovely and cool! Everyone here so helpful. Just a 2 minute walk to Tower Hill station. The breakfast was outstanding and worth the prepay for. We would stay here again in a heartbeat.

author: Zoe D
title: Kurian on reception was brilliant!!
text: Stayed for three nights . Upon arrival very impressed. Not stayed at this Hilton before. Lovely and bright , immaculate clean. We were greeted by Kurian, very professional yet friendly guy. Was polite and chatted to us , nothing was too much trouble. He acknowledged we were Hilton Honours members and gave us a complimentary upgraded room. The usual warm cookies were welcome. The room was on the 6th floor. Very nice and clean, modern and spacious for a London hotel. Bed comfortably suitable for our stay. Hot powerful shower. The savage garden bar was an added pleasure, delicious cocktails. The staff up there were amazing, very friendly and knowledgeable on the cocktail menu!! We ate in the hotel one night, really nice and not badly priced too. Hotel is convenient for the tube . Walking distance to borough market and the shard. Lovely hotel , great location.

author: David A
title: Another Happy and Comfortable Stay
text: I've stayed here many times and have not been disappointed.  My last stay of five nights last week was another most pleasant time.  The value for your money (or points) is bang on  in a very expensive city like London.  Breakfast buffet was a delight with eggs cooked to order.  Bedding very comfortable.

author: Manon L
title: Excellent experience with reservations team
text: A really great experience for my upcoming reservation thanks to Iona, reservations manager and their team. They really went above and beyond to assist me with my booking. I'm in London frequently for work and pleasure and thanks to their support, I'll definitely be using this Hilton again. Can't thank them enough!

author: Abigail Q
title: Very good hotel and it wouldn’t take much to make it great
text:
My starting point for hotel stays is always would I recommend to friends / would I stay again. The answer is yes to both questions. 

Location 
The hotel is in a fantastic location. It’s next to Tower Hill Tube. This is the District / Circle line which is one of the better Tube lines with great AC on trains. From the hotel 5 mins walk you’re in the City and 2 minutes in the other direction you’re at the Tower of London. We walked to the West End along the Thames, a leisurely stroll took around an hour. By Tube, it’s no more than 20 minutes. The Houses of Parliament are a similar distance. There are lots of good restaurants and bars around the hotel. There’s also a fantastic restaurant Natural Kitchen actually in the hotel. 

Bedroom 
We had an executive king room which was good, but a bit on the small side which is often the case in London. The shower was excellent but there was no bath. The bed and firm pillows were comfy. AC worked well. 

Executive Lounge
We’ve stayed in lots of Hiltons in the UK and abroad. We like the brand. Unfortunately the main negative of this hotel is the Executive Lounge. In no way is this a reflection of staff as they were all to a person friendly and helpful. It’s located on the ground floor and is a small dark room. Each day for breakfast it was extremely and unpleasantly crowded. The food choices were very limited. The yoghurt was not refrigerated and so, due to the very hot weather, was often warm. The coffee, which was from a machine, was lukewarm at best and undrinkable. The hot  items were stored under lamps and looked congealed. We stayed at the hotel for three nights and on the first morning, the Lounge actually opened for breakfast an hour later than advertised. The staff member was very apologetic but to be honest I would have excepted more of Hilton ie that another member of staff would have set up breakfast. 

We chose to have breakfast elsewhere on the other two mornings - externally to the Hotel and in the Natural Kitchen. 

Happy hour in the Executive Lounge is 6-8pm. On all three evenings of our stay, it took place in the City Café rather than the lounge. The wine was good and staff were friendly and welcoming. Food was extremely poor. Our most recent Hilton stay was Hilton Malta which has an amazing happy hour and I know we judge all Hilton happy hours in relation to that. There is really no comparison. 

Areas of the City Café were cut off last night and every table in the permitted area was taken. It felt therefore quite tight. I understand the hotel wanting to minimise the area they need to clean but I also think it’s important to consider customer experience. The nice areas in the city café are those adjacent to the windows which were out of bounds. 

Natural Kitchen

This restaurant is within the Hilton and is fantastic. We had lunch twice and breakfast once here during our stay. All I can say is all staff are super friendly and welcoming and the food and drinks are fantastic. We had harissa chicken and chicken burger and both plates went back entirely empty. For breakfast we had Greek yoghurt, berries and granola which was amazing. Coffee is also lovely so we relied on this in place of the lukewarm machine coffee offering in the Executive Lounge. For two of the meals we had our 13 month old grandson and staff were lovely with him and brought him some avocado on his own plate. 

Returning to where I started, I would definitely stay here again and just hope the hotel improves its Executive Lounge. It’s the only thing that lets it down!

author: Grace G
title: Lovely hotel & Amazing service
text:
Really lovely hotel! Everything was clean, modern and well looked after, and we had a very comfortable stay. The staff were friendly and welcoming throughout.

Mohammad was especially lovely and really made our experience. He checked us in, was so polite and helpful, and even upgraded us to a better room which was such a nice surprise. Amazing customer service and a real credit to the hotel. We would definitely stay again!

author: William U
title: Good hotel.
text:
I stayed with my family for a week; cleaning and changing of sheets and towels every day, excellent breakfast with the
Possibility to prepare sandwiches for lunch, two bottles of water per day in the room, ice on the 5th floor that you can take with the container you find in the room. Bring containers if you can to put cut fruit in so you can eat it during the day, or food bags. Shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and body lotion provided are fantastic. Meters away, 1 minute or even less. I recommend dining at the Keepers restaurant opposite, good prices and you eat well. I recommend it.

author: Charlotte J
title: Plesent
text: It was a pleasant stay. I would like to thank Mr. Basit for the support he provided me in making my stay more pleasant

author: Ian T
title: Good but could do better
text: We've stayed at the Doubletree, Hilton Tower of London several times. A nice hotel, decent rooms and service. Good breakfast which is up to Hiltons high standards. Location is good for many attractions. Tower River pier for the uber boats close by as is Tower Hill tube. St Katherine's dock is a small walk away. Only thing that irked me was that we advised them in advance it was our wedding anniversary. Last year we stayed at Tower Bridge Hilton, had an upgrade, a card and cake in the room and a drinks voucher for the bar. At the Tower of London.  Doubletree Hilton we got NOTHING not even an acknowledgement from reception! As Hilton Honours silver members we don't expect the earth but if the Tower Bridge Hilton can go the extra mile why can't the Doubletree Tower Bridge.

author: Carlos A
title: Brilliant Location
text: My husband and I have recently been to the Doubletree Tower Bridge for 2 nights and had a really lovely stay. The staff throughout the hotel are very pleasant and friendly and when we checked in at reception we were given a yummy cookie each which was a lovely surprise welcome. The hotel is in a fantastic location, being only a very short walk to the Tower of Lindon and Tower Bridge. Our room was very clean and spacious and there was a plentiful supply of delicious food for breakfast, We would certainly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting London.

author: Harper J
title: Corporate Summer Party at Savage Gardens, London
text:
A perfect venue for a corporate summer party; mix of great terrace and indoor space which was clean and comfortable.
The pre event organisation was efficient, the food on the night was excellent, staff were polite and attentive. Positive feedback on all aspects was obtained from guests. Highly recommended.

author: Jack Q
title: Thank You Sehar
text: I stay at this hotel regularly with work, the team are always cheerful and helpful but today I had a few issues with my billing that needed resolved.  I’m so pleased that the person helping me was Sehar, she was amazing she took ownership of the issue, that was nothing to do with her and went out of her way to resolve it for me.  Excellent customer service and also very kind ensuring I had water for my follow on journey due to the exceptions heat London is currently experiencing.  Thank You Sehar you are a star.

author: Evie S
title: Not as good as it used to be.
text:
My sister and I have been coming to this Best Western in Swiss Cottage every year since 2017.  The hotel location is very convenient - in a nice residential area, steps from the Tube station (and therefore everything you might want to see in London). 

Sadly, the previous owner passed away last year, and the new owners seem to have a different focus. In the past, we have been greeted like family - with hugs and people genuinely happy to see us.  This year, we found that some of the long-term staff were leaving, and/or reducing shifts due to the changes. The new staff don't seem to understand what working in hospitality means, and some of them were dismissive, and one was downright rude. I feel sorry for the first-time guests, for whom this was their only experience of this hotel, because I can't imagine they'll be returning. We have decided to return once more in 2027, to see if any positive changes have been made with the feedback that we and others have given them.  If we don't see any improvements, our 10th stay will be our last.

author: Henry Q
title: Lovely Hotel, Friendly Staff
text:
Lovely hotel, A bit dated but was spotless and the staff were lovely, No aircon so it was hot, they did provide fans but they only circulated hot air. 
Didn't have the breakfast so cannot comment on that. 
We found it very quiet not noise from other rooms or heavy feet upstairs.
Would come back but not when its this hot.

author: Henry G
title: Great Location
text:
Great staff & location! The neighborhood was quiet, yet near a lot of activity. The farmer’s market & food stalls next door was a pleasant surprise!
Staff was great.
Right next to an Underground station as well!

author: Brooke C
title: Disappointed!
text: Well located & clean & 2 staff members were helpful. Hotel branded as a 3 star hotel, when in reality it's probably closer to a 2 star hotel. Booked a 9 night stay. One would think that I would have been given a decent room with an air conditioner given the length of stay. This is by far my worst stay I have have ever had during my travels in my lifetime. My room temperature was probably between 40 and 45 degrees every day and night - no Air Conditioner provided, despite my length of stay. I was told the hotel has 4 rooms which have Air Conditioners - well I was not allocated one, despite staying for 9 nights and being unwell during my stay. I did request a room with an Air Conditioner during my stay, given my condition, but this was not provided nor was a plan made to get me a portable Air Conditioner. Needless to say, I was unable to sleep at night due to the level of heat in my room and I never recovered from my illness whilst I stayed at the hotel - in fact I went backwards, due to having to deal with the intense heat. There was also a 3 day event held at the hotel whilst I was there and it was very disruptive, as attendees took over the lounge and bar area every day and evening and other guests were unable to use those facilities as there was no where to sit. Attendees also congregated outside my room and made a noise one afternoon when I was trying to get some rest, given that I was unwell. On Trip Advisor it says the hotel has a Newspaper, provides bottled water and has a safe. Well this is not the case - the rooms have no safe, bottled water is not provided and a newspaper is not provided or made available for guests. The rooms also do not have a bar fridge where guests can keep soft drinks cool during their stay. I would not recommend this hotel - it's outdated, does not have the amenities it says it has and it's not 3 stars!

author: Michael P
title: Very Poor All Round
text: Great location but that's where the great ended.  Very shabby hotel in need of decoration.  Room was like a sauna, bathroom dirty, stained towels, no shower gel, handle on furniture missing or broken and tiny twin beds.  Bar not open to the times advertised.  Breakfast was good but very slow.

author: Charlotte J
title: Something from the old days
text:
The Swiss Cottage district seems to be a semi-posh neightborhood, and so it looked like this would be a great hotel. The reality of it is that it is a bit shoddy, and has seen better days. It's not terrible, but one does need to approach it according to its age.

The women at the reception were super helpful and friendly all the way through my stay - my mobile phone was robbed on the street on my first night, and I got help from the reception, trying to call my bank etc providers to turn everything off. While the phone connections didn't work, they still helped as much as they could. They also borrowed me an UK->EU power adapter which helped a lot as I forgot to bring my own, and I could work with my computer.

The hotel itself is seemingly old, and the construction, corridors, elevator and rooms reflect this. Everything is a bit squeaky, such as floorboards, my bathroom door and  room windows (which I had to pad with toilet paper to keep them open, when otherwise they would have banged against the frames whenever they'd caught a breeze) The hotel definitely has charm and character, but it's somewhere from the 90's and maybe a bit out of date.

The room, bed and linens were clean but the bathroom could do with a makeover. Bathroom tiles and plaster is dirty and faucets have rust on them. There was also no AC, and it happened to be the hottest summer season while I visited, so the room was super hot with air moving nowhere. Amenities in the room included a water kettle, tea bags, a couple of biscuits and a big TV. Free wifi too. 
Even with the robbery shock giving me chills, I slept well enough.

Breakfast was average at best. Cereal varieties was packaed in mini Kellogs boxes and pastries were... dry. I ordered an omelette with mushrooms, which was made to order and fresh. Juices were available, as well as coffee and tea. Generally, the breakfast serving is also something that could use a bit of a refresh.

So all in all, while not expecting luxury, there are some minor things that would make the experience more pleasurable overall.

author: Juan F
title: Great value for money.
text: Near the Swiss Cottage tube. Lovely area to explore.

author: Diego X
title: Comfort and convenience!
text: I appreciated the warm welcome upon arrival. It's a very good location (next to Hampstead Theatre, Swiss Cottage tube station and the Finchley Rd. with a plethora of good cafes, restaurants etc. and walking distance or a short train ride to Hampstead Heath). There is a Luton airport bus on the Finchley Rd. just 5 mins walk away, which is super handy!  There are lovely period features (especially in the lobby) and I liked my neat, well organised clean single room, for a reasonable price. The bed was a bit firm for me, but it was a decent bed so I still slept well; the area is nice and quiet so that also helps!

author: Juan S
title: A lovely boutique style hotel nestling in a leafy suburb a stones throw from Primrose Hill
text: We had a wonderful short break at this lovely hotel situated in a pleasant area not far from Primrose Hill and Regents Park. It’s a traditional hotel with old style furnishings, high ceilings and comfy beds. Everything you’d expect from a hotel plus superb breakfast each morning that really set us up for the whole day, good selection of fresh fruit, fruit juices, cereals, baked goods and hams, cheeses and salads, plus individually cooked to order English breakfast, whatever you wanted, we went for eggs, bacon, sausage, hash brown, mushrooms, tomatoes, beans and toast and the eggs were cooked to perfection however you’d like them, scrambled, poached, fried, and they even had lovely boiled eggs too. Definitely compliments to the chef, and the staff were very pleasant too!! Thoroughly recommended and we will definitely be back again very soon 🙂🙂🙂🙂

author: Kyle I
title: Disappointed
text:
Hotel was dirty, the glass bathroom shelf in our room kept falling off the wall. The bed had a massive dip in it. Very disappointed 
Good location close to tube

author: Rosie Q
title: Excellent experience
text:
Great location compared to central London
Metro 50 meters
Huge triple room, never seen this in London where the square meter is so expensive!
Value for money at the top
Hearty and delicious breakfast especially pastries
I recommend 100 percent

author: Mason F
title: Fantastic 2 night stay at Swiss Cottage Best Western
text:
Just had a fantastic stay at the Best Western Swiss Cottage hotel.
Our room was fabulous, high ceilings, loads of room to move about and everything you need as if you were at home.
The staff were great, a big shout out to Erika, Beatria and Tashala on reception for being so friendly and making our stay a memorable one.
Staff in the breakfast room were also amazing and worked so hard.
Breakfast itself was the best hotel breakfast we have had.
We stayed 2 nights for concerts at the Roundhouse, so easy to get to the venue and around London. The underground a few steps from the hotel and bus stops are around the corner.
We felt very safe here and everything was on the doorstep.
We can't praise this hotel and the staff enough, we will be back.
Thank you Best Western.

author: Gavin R
title: A gem in London
text: What an amazing hotel! We had the most incredible stay! First, the location is outstanding. You may think you are slightly outside central London but the hotel is about 1 minute walk to the tube station and two stops to central London. The walk to the station and arrival in central London is 10 minutes. There are also many buses very close by.  The hotel is in a very safe area and you don’t need to worry about walking round even late at night. The hotel is charming. We stayed in a huge room. No tripping or jumping over luggage to get to the bed. There were also wardrobes and drawers to unpack. There are many outstanding restaurants nearby. The hotel staff were so friendly.  They went out of their way to help us. There are a couple of things that you should know - there is no air conditioning, no refrigerators and no safe in the room.  There are fans in the room. The hotel will store your stuff in the hotel refrigerator for you. I always ask the question when I stay at a hotel, if I would like to stay here again. The answer is a definite yes.  It is a real find in London.  I can highly recommend this hotel. Thanks to everyone at the Best Western Swiss Cottage for a wonderful stay.

author: Sara E
title: Lovely hotel close to tube and bus network
text: Meet up with friends once a year and whenever we decide to visit London we always stay at this hotel. This is mainly due to the fact that the hotel can accommodate three people in a room.  We were in room 402 which was on the top floor (stayed in this room before) and thankfully, there were fans available as it was quite hot.  However, the room was comfortable and spacious enough, cleaned every day and a reasonably sized bathroom with bath and shower.  I liked the shower gel, soap and shampoo provided.  Breakfast was included which was a bonus; full English or Continental with lovely pastries and a range of fresh fruit.  Eggs could be scrambled, poached or fried and omelette available.  The staff were very friendly and the waiting staff in the breakfast room were particularly industrious.  Nice little bar in the hotel which we made use of after our long day exploring London.  Only one comment:  room 402 has a strange smell like heated plastic which is quite strong when you enter the room.  Otherwise, a super hotel, close to the tube and a good network of buses going into the centre of London.

author: Luke O
title: A great little find
text:
We booked this hotel as we thought there was going to be a tube strike during our stay and we needed to travel to Wembley for one of the Coldplay concerts. The hotel is near to South Hampstead station which is on the overland Lioness line and operates to Wembley Central. As it was Coldplay changed the concert date and there was no strike on that day. The hotel were great - we had booked a non refundable rate but they were super helpful and changed the date once we explained the situation. With no strike we were able to take the tube to and from Wembley Park - Swiss Cottage station is a 2 minute walk so the hotel is perfectly positioned. 

We had one double and one quad room. Whilst a little tired they were very clean and spacious with good towels and bedding. The bar area is comfortable and cosy and we pretty much had it to ourselves after we arrived back from the concert - bar open until 1am. Breakfast was included - very busy and the service was a little slow, but once it arrived it was hot and tasty, perfect to cure sore heads. 

I wouldn’t hesitate to return if I go to Wembley again or want somewhere to stay in the leafy area not too far from Regents Park.

author: Isla L
title: Enjoyable stay
text:
Quirky hotel.
Well placed for the tube particularly for Wembley concerts.
The staff are great and the breakfasts are lovely.
Immaculately clean but decor is getting old and it desperately needs a makeover.
Best Western need to seriously invest in this hotel or sell it to someone else who will.
It is good but has so much potential to be amazing

author: Nora B
title: Good for the price. Watch out for bargains. Great for transport links.
text: I've stayed at this hotel off and on for some years. It's affordable by London standards and there are often 3for2 nights and other bargains if you go on the email list. Staff very friendly, beds very comfortable. Transport links very good. Regular street market outside. Residential area pleasant to walk round. Breakfast basic but OK for the price. Free wifi. Old fashioned decor, but that suits the building. It's not soulless.

author: Chloe I
title: Avoid the breakfast....
text:
Accommodation was OK, if a little dated.

Location isn't too bad for west London, two minutes from the tube station.

Had a really tough time with the breakfasts though, over successive days.

First day we waited around 25 minutes for simple poached eggs on toast.

When I requested an update from the waiter they were brought to us immediately, looking, and tasting, like they'd been prepared the day prior!

Second day was even worse.

I avoided the poached eggs this time, and opted for scrambled eggs on toast.

Imagine my surprise when I was presented with poached eggs, no toast.

By the time this had been rectified, my dining partner's food (more on that in a moment) was cold.

When mine did arrive, you'd be forgiven for thinking the eggs were rubber. Oh, and the toast was burnt.

Coming back to the meal my dining partner was presented with..

Some items were missing, which we challenged, and advised that the toast could be prepared, but it was "too late" for the missing cooked items, so she'd have to make do with what she had, and that is almost verbatim. 

Oh, and the bacon was burnt.

Seeking an alternative I went to the buffet, only to discover no orange juice, water, or pastries and very little fresh fruit.

This was 09:45am by the way, the advertised time for breakfast to be served  is until 10:00am

I did make a point of mentioning this to the receptionist on checking out, but was advised that "they never have complaints about breakfast", implying we must be in the wrong.

I was then given a generic email address for A Manager to send my complaint to, as she was unable to assist further, other than advising they only have one chef.

That is all well and good, but on both mornings no diners came in after us, and everyone already seated in the restaurant were either eating, or had already eaten; there were only our meals to prepare. 

It was surprising, or maybe it wasn't, to see how many people left food on their plates though.....

author: Megan C
title: the Room was boiling hot
text:
Room on top floor was too hot to be comfortable. True, London was at 29degC  but nothing had been done to try and cool it down eg there were 2 fans in the cupboard that could have been switched on. 
Avoid this hotel or get a ground floor room if weather is hot.

author: Hannah K
title: Ok for a couple of nights
text: The standard of London is not high and this hotel confirms this. It would need a major renovation is also a major cleanup.  Convenient to the metro to the most famous areas. Value for money modest.  Room before refrigerator

author: Katie F
title: Great help from Norman! Bell assistant
text: Norman the Bellman was very helpful! He assisted in places to Eat. We ate at bakery and deli next door! It was very good. He recommended the hotel restaurant Shanghai Me! It was really amazing food and excellent service!

author: Carlos G
title: AI Related help
text: Fantastic experience. The combination of AI-assisted planning, app-based check-in and Digital Key made the whole journey feel effortless

author: Charlotte J
title: My stay at Hilton London
text: I had a really good experience at Hilton London Hyde Park. The hotel is in a fantastic location, with easy access to public transport and many attractions nearby. The room was comfortable, clean, and well maintained, and the staff were friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout my stay. Overall, it was a pleasant and relaxing experience, and I would happily recommend this hotel to anyone visiting London.

author: Lucy D
title: Best Experience
text: The AI travel planner was surprisingly useful. I entered that I wanted somewhere close to Hyde Park and public transport, and the recommendations made choosing the hotel much easier.

author: Laura Q
title: Digital check in
text: Loved the digital check-in. I completed everything through the Hilton app before arriving, which saved a lot of time at reception.

author: Ethan B
title: Comfortable and Great Location
text:
TLDR: Comfortable; great location to tube, restaurants, and sites; a little on the dark side

My husband I just returned home from our trip from England, and we stayed at this hotel during the last leg of our journey in London.

Room: Very spacious, comfortable, and quiet. We slept very well! We were stationed in the back half of the hotel on the 1st floor, so our room overlooked a garden area/buildings. I'm not sure if you would have a quiet experience on the street/park side of the hotel. There's a table, 2 chairs, and luggage racks, as well as a small closet. Had we stayed here for longer than we did, I thought the space to hang your clothes was limited (perhaps fitting 5 shirts on the rack). Biggest complaint here was the room lighting. It was very dark. There is 1 floor lamp, 1 can light, and sconces next to the bed. I'm not sure if the bulbs were dim, but it was difficult to see in the room, even with the curtains open.

Bathroom: While sufficient, I was very disappointed in the lighting. Like the room it was very dark. The room had a shower/tub convo. I'm not a bath person, but the tub was big enough for a tall person to sit comfortably in.

Location: This was right next to a tub location, which was excellent to get around the city. However, travelers be warned. This is an older area of London, and an older tube station; therefore, there are NO ELEVATORS. We had a rude awakening when we had to lug our 4 bags up several flights of stairs. We wound up taking a taxi to the train station at our departure because we didn't want to deal with that on our return. As I mentioned, it's relatively quiet. It's right across from the park and next to restaurants, which are all walkable. 

Staff: Very helpful and friendly. They helped us book a taxi for our return trip and brought up a few extra towels very quickly one day.

author: Megan S
title: Worst Hotel Ever
text: Arrived early. Bought the most expensive room. Room not ready until after 5 pm. Lounge service dismal. Go to Bonvoy. Nothing special about this place. No matter how much you spend with them or your status.

author: Liam C
title: Fantastic Location
text: You can't beat the location of this hotel! Right next to a Tube stop, it made it so easy to get to and from the hotel each day. The rooms are small, but that is to be expected at a downtown London hotel. Very clean though with helpful staff and wonderful extensive breakfast in the morning. Great base for exploring London!

author: Connor B
title: Another great stay at Hilton Hyde Park
text: We had another great stay at Hilton Hyde Park. Mohammad and the team looked after us so well and made a special effort for my wife’s birthday stay,  which was much appreciated. I found the location of this hotel to be really great, the Aubaine restaurant that forms part of the hotel is high quality but more than anything, the staff were, as ever, excellent and the personal touches from Mohammad went above and beyond - thank you.

author: Gavin E
title: Excellent reception and front desk.
text: I took an extra few minutes out of my very busy schedule to write this review to thank Mohammad.  Luggage leave, Mohammad took care of it.  Adjusting the discrepancy between the category I originally booked and the room I stayed in, Mohammad took care of it.  Extending my stay, requesting housekeeping, extra waters for the room, early check-in, late checkout, printing a document, delivering my luggage to my room, booking a taxi—Mohammad took care of it.  Everything I needed during my recent stays at this location was accommodated and anticipated by the front desk, and they all really deserve both praise and a raise.  It's a busy area, a busy hotel that is often fully-booked, and a historic building with the quirks that come with such a building, and I can't thank Mohammad and the rest of the front desk workers enough for their kindness, professionalism, efficiency, and making me feel welcome.  I hope to see them on my next stay in London.

author: Alexander L
title: Shocking. Worst Hilton I’ve encountered
text:
This Hilton lives up to its bad reviews. I literally have nothing good to say about it. I only stayed as I had to book a last minute room here for my last night in London, when I normally stay at 100 Queen’s Gate. Highly recommend that Hilton btw!

I am a gold member and usually the London Hiltons let me check out a bit later as my flight back home doesn’t leave until night time (and are 25 hours mind you, so it’s a massive journey and normally the staff have a bit of empathy). Not only did this Hilton not let me stay even 30 minutes after check out, but they were incredibly rude about it too. 

The man on the desk’s reason was that they were fully booked, but when I looked the hotel up, there were plenty of rooms available for the night.

The Hilton is also run down, the beds and floors are creaky and the walls are paper thin. I also don’t know how someone above 5’5 and 50kg could fit in the shower. I literally could not fit in the shower when trying to shave my legs. The ‘buffet breakfast’ is also extremely limited and lukewarm.

Honestly had this not been a points stay I would have been extremely irritated, but luckily I paid what the hotel was worth, which was nothing. Do not stay here.

author: Benjamin M
title: Amazing hotel in London!
text:
I stayed for 2 nights in the hotel with my sister and it was more amazing than I expected! Its location is excellent, super safe neighborhood and facing Hyde Park, a beautiful park and perfect for relaxing.

It also has easy access to the subway and buses that lead to every corner of London, always busy region and we feel very safe.

The breakfast is a separate show, super varied and had options of eggs prepared at the time as you want.

Immaculate attention since our arrival, we left our bags for a walk and when we returned we were immediately received with a beautiful and cozy room.

I have no words to thank for the amazing stay, I highly recommend!

author: Aaron E
title: Poor
text:
Reception staff snarly and obtuse.
Rooms tired. 
Bar staff lethargic.
Stain on bed sheets
Night porter that moved my room v.kind and apologetic, 
Look around for something better.

author: Sofia Y
title: Great experience
text: It was a pleasure from start to finish with Talat he was wonderful to deal with made everything run smooth

author: Antoine D
title: Great stay in a fantastic location!
text: Loved my time at the Hilton Hyde Park. The location right on Bayswater Road makes it incredibly easy to explore the city. Clean rooms, comfortable beds, and the staff was great. A special shoutout to Talat who was super helpful throughout my stay and really made the experience feel personal and welcoming. Would definitely stay here again!

author: Dylan Y
title: Greta location in a cute neighborhood
text: Thanks to Idris for a great welcome and stay! He got us settled into a great room, had a lovely card and snacks for us - it was the perfect welcome to London. Love this hotel, great location to be on the western side of the city. Make a left around the corner and find a very cute neighborhood- amazing restaurants and pubs!!

author: Samuel T
title: Great location and staff
text: Hotel is in great location. Staff was great. Only downside was that I was not recognized as a diamond member because we booked thru Delta Vacations.  They were not able to attach my number to the reservation because we went through a third party. No points.

author: Sara Y
title: Love This Hilton
text: We loved this hotel! The location is excellent, next to Hyde Park and we loved exploring the area.

author: Alexander D
title: Hilton Hotel, Hyde park
text: Amazing room and such amazing staff, especially an employee named Talat, he was so helpful and friendly over my stay. This hotel is amazing and in an amazing location

author: James L
title: Ibraheim
text: We have a problem with our room and that it was extremely noisy from our neighbours upstairs. Ibraheim was incredibly helpful in finding us a new room. He went above and beyond the call of duty and nature that we were satisfied. he was polite, professional in all his dealings with us and we really appreciated it.

author: Alexander E
title: Our experience at Hilton Kensington London
text:
We spent 14 nights with the family (5) and we had two connecting rooms and additional.The hotel Consciege and front desk were very helpful it’s very close to underground stations with a bus stop by the hotel and a big shopping mall Westfield.

Very good breakfast to start the day and Mihaela Sandu and her team were very exceptional.Thank you

author: Abigail P
title: VASI
text: My stay was cozy and comfortable. Every necessity is nearby.

author: Isabella M
title: Really nice place to stay in London
text:
Our staying at the Hilton Kensington hotel was great! The rooms were clean, modern and comfortable, the receptionists and the concierge always polite, smiling and helpful and the breakfast was amazing, fresh, hot and with an enormous variety of dishes. Michaela there was really nice!
Thank you all! Until next time !

author: Isabella C
title: Pleasant stay
text: Pleasantly suprised after reading previous reviews. Yes the hotel could do with some updating. But rooms clean, beds comfortable and air con just about adequate in the heatwave. Stayed for 2 nights. Bus stops right outside the hotel, which was great. The hotel staff were all very welcoming. Had breakfast the day we left and it was of a good standard. It was very busy, but we got seated very quicly. I'd defintely be happy to stay here again.

author: Lucas E
title: Book book book!!! :)
text: Had a lovely stay here, rooms were super clean, The hotel was so accommodating, had pleasant interactions with housekeeping staff and also breakfast staff especially Samir who was so kind and helpful!!! Tbh all the staff were quite friendly from the ones who helped us to store our bags and everyone working breakfast A1 service and professionalism!!!. No hand soap in the bathroom but clearly just an oversight lol :) they were quite busy when we checked in. Honestly sad we couldn’t stay longer, Booked through love holidays so great value for money, great place to stay and would definitely come back again! Thank you so much

author: Harper U
title: Amazing family location
text: We stayed for 3 days in august, during a heatwave and thank god for AC in the room and water. We booked one double room and then a double room with interconnecting twin room. Everything was spotless, good tv station, shampoo conditioner, shower gel, body lotion and hand wash all provided. The breakfast was amazing, they select of breakfast was superb, cereals, fruit, children station, pastries, takeaway teas and coffee. I would defnitely stay here again, 3min walk from shepard bush underground, and 5mins from Westfield shopping centre.

author: Mathis K
title: No frills…
text:
I stayed at the Hilton London Kensington recently, having last visited over 16 years ago, and the hotel hasn’t changed much in that time. The reception area still feels dated and doesn’t make much of an impression, but the location remains one of its strongest points. It’s only a few minutes’ walk from Shepherd’s Bush tube station and Westfield London, which is extremely convenient.

I used the Hilton app to check in and went straight to my room without any staff interaction — everything worked perfectly, including the digital key. The room itself was very small, but clean and functional. What really stood out was the air‑conditioning: London was unusually hot during my stay, and the room’s cooling was powerful, consistent, and genuinely excellent. Hooray! 

I didn’t try breakfast and checked out online, so I can’t comment on service. Overall, while the hotel isn’t modern or particularly memorable, it delivered a comfortable, cool, and hassle‑free stay. If the price was right, I would happily stay here again. For plus £200 you could be more central and have a greater experience.

author: Samuel R
title: One of the best places i’ve stayed
text:
We had such a wonderful stay at the Hilton London Kensington – Holland Park Road. From the moment we arrived, we were made to feel so welcome, and the staff went above and beyond to make our stay special.

A very special thank you to the nicest reception team, Thanuja, Sakina and Anakha. They were genuinely some of the kindest and most attentive receptionists we have ever met. They were incredibly polite, informative and always happy to help, making sure both my mum and I had everything we needed.

Nothing was too much trouble for them, and they went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and looked after. Their kindness and professionalism really stood out and made such a difference to our stay.

Honestly, these ladies deserve a pay rise! They are a real credit to the Hilton and an absolute asset to the hotel. It is lovely to come across staff who genuinely care about their guests and make you feel valued.

Thank you, Thanuja, Sakina and Anakha, for making our stay so enjoyable. We will definitely be back! ❤️

author: Adam B
title: In need of significant investment
text:
I hadn’t stayed at this hotel for a while, having used it frequently in the past, as it’s needed significant investment for a long time. I stayed here for work and it’s fair to say not much has changed in the last few years. One thing which is good is the breakfast offer however it’s outrageously priced. 

They removed the exec lounge and use the old space as a meeting room. It could have been a perfect opportunity to put a proper gym in this space instead of it being in the car park. They closed the sauna and steam room during COVID for it to never return. 

The rooms themselves are small and incredibly dated. The furniture hasn’t changed since I first stayed at this hotel in 2011, I’ve posted a photo of a room from then, recognise the TV stand anyone? The carpets are in need of replacement, the beds don’t have plugs next to them and the bathrooms are tiny with very low ceilings. The bathrooms needed replacing 15 years ago. 

I get that a hotel of this size and age must be hard to justify investment as it would be millions to get it up to a modern standard, however it’s gotten to the point now that a premier inn is of a better standard. 

Time for a significant overhaul.

author: Molly U
title: SAKI - ADAM and SABY
text: I recently stayed at the Hilton London Kesinington  and wanted to specifically commend SAKI and ADAM  one of your receptionists. She was incredibly nice and pleasant, providing an excellent first impression of the hotel. Her warm welcome and helpful demeanor truly enhanced my stay. I also want to mention how impressed I was with the breakfast selection; it was truly excellent and clearly catered to guests from diverse backgrounds, which was a thoughtful touch. Thank you, SAKI, and the entire team, for your outstanding service and a wonderful experience! F&D also SABY is an amazing team member ,( I would like to mention the lady yellow hair on the floor she need more Smile) 😄

author: Caleb G
title: Fantastic location let done by rooms
text: I’ve stayed at this venue numerous times, it has a fantastic location and the staff are lovely. But… each time the rooms get worse and it’s now beyond acceptable, the rooms are majorly dated, grubby and long overdue a refurb

author: Miguel U
title: Amazing experience Ms Saki thank you 🫶
text: Thank you so much Ms. Saki at the time of check in she made everything so smooth. Our small group also coming the next day she did everything hassle free. Really thank you so much for your great hospitality and gesture. Good luck ❤️❤️

author: Lucy F
title: Good place
text: This was my first visit to London and I was part of a tour group. My room was on the top floor and the weather was unseasonably warm, if not hot. The building's air conditioning was probably not big enough to compensate for the heat. I thought the staff did an honorable job of sympathizing with the guests as they offered free water and ice cream to beat the heat. That was a nice touch, especially the blueberry infused water. The room was snug. Not much floor space. The room was clean and quiet. (mattress reviews are highly subjective). The bathroom was also snug and the walls of the tub were very high. Be careful getting in and out. Tub faucets were not "American hotel" as it took me a while to figure it out. Bathroom was clean and well stocked. The hotel has next-day laundry which comes back nicely in a box. The place was very busy. The breakfast was well attended as I had to wait for a table. It was worth the wait. The staff and food were very good and the entire operation was very well maintained. The bar staff at night was great, too! A classy, upscale mall and some restaurants are a short walk in one direction. A bunch of other neat stores and restaurants along the street are a farther walk away in the opposite direction.

author: Ruby G
title: Clean functional but far out from most attractions.
text: Located quite far out but good bus links just outside hotel. We had a twin room on the fifth floor which was small out very clean. Beds were ok but pillows were awful. Bathroom small but clean. No noise either from corridors or outside. AC was poor.

author: Sophia H
title: Not worthy of the Hilton name
text: Very disappointing.  You can't select the room temperature, the hotel is shabby, in need of repair and updating.  The staff was courteous, but can't  effect the physical conditions.

author: Adam V
title: Price of Hilton - stay like a school Dorm
text:
We stayed at the Hilton Kensington and were extremely disappointed with our experience. The air conditioning barely worked, and with the afternoon sun shining directly into the windows, the room became uncomfortably hot. It made it very difficult to relax or get a good night’s sleep.

The shower was extremely small and awkward to use, making it uncomfortable to shower. The room itself was tiny, with barely enough space for two suitcases, making it difficult to move around. To make matters worse, not all of the power sockets worked, including the ones beside the bed, which was very inconvenient for charging phones and other devices overnight.

The rooms felt more like basic school dormitories than rooms in a Hilton hotel. Considering the price we paid and the reputation of the Hilton brand, we expected a much higher standard of comfort, quality and maintenance.

Overall, this stay was very disappointing and certainly not what we expected from a Hilton. We would not recommend staying here.

author: Erin D
title: Dirty Pet friendly hotel
text:
I stayed at the Hilton Kensington in June 2026 as part of a Conference group booking.

I am asthmatic. Within hours of arriving I felt unwell, which I initially put down to travel fatigue. It was only the morning of checkout that I understood why: the carpet was heavily contaminated with pet hair, which had transferred extensively onto our clothing, and bedding. 

This was not an isolated oversight. The hallway carpets throughout the hotel were visibly full of fluff and debris, which suggests the hotel is not using equipment capable of adequately removing pet hair. For a property that accepts pet-friendly bookings, this is a serious housekeeping failure.

The reaction left me so unwell that I missed important morning sessions of a conference that does not come cheap. This was not a minor inconvenience - it was a significant personal and professional impact.

The gentleman at reception who checked us out was visibly shocked when we showed him the images. That reaction said everything.

I raised the complaint in person with the manager, Dora, who acknowledged it and said she would follow up. I also sent a formal written complaint with photographic and video evidence attached.

That was over a month ago. No response. No follow-up. No empathy whatsoever from the hotel.

The Conference organisers, to their credit, apologised promptly and have invited us back. The Hilton has remained completely silent.

A guest with a respiratory condition was placed in an allergen-contaminated room, became unwell, missed paid conference sessions, and was then ignored when they raised a formal complaint. That is not the standard of care anyone should expect from a Hilton property.

I would not return, and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone with allergies or respiratory conditions.

author: Claire D
title: Amazing  coustemer service from ADAM T
text: The hotel continues to be a 'home away from home' with excellent personalised service from the front desk  Adam T he is so friendly  and so we'll come i will definitely  come back again the breakfast  was so delicious  thank you .
