author: Laura A
title: Exceptional service but with 1990s style rooms
text:
Stayed here with my mum when she visited me for my call to the bar. The staff made the stay even more special by giving us 20 drinks vouchers (which we never finished using). Sadly, the extremely dated room let the whole experience down. If they would renovate the rooms, it's no doubt a 5-star experience. 

It's extremely good value for the location. Though one should know that it's more Fulham and Hammersmith than Kensington and Chelsea. If you don't mind the extra ten minutes on the underground, this is a good choice.

author: Morgan A
title: The ravages of time are taking their toll
text:
First of all, you can get a good night's sleep at the hotel. The rooms are clean (though quite worn out), but the ravages of time are gnawing everywhere. In principle, the hotel should be closed and completely renovated. The bathroom is completely outdated and the air conditioning makes noise but doesn't cool. 
If you are only there to stay overnight, then it's okay. Anyone expecting Hilton standard will definitely be disappointed.

author: Isla U
title: Great hotel
text: Perfect experience! The hotel is well located, very nice, clean and the staff is really nice! Thanks to Zain especially 😊

author: Mason P
title: It's OK here
text: Ok stay, no major complaints.  The room is basic and could have been cleaned better (found previous occupants documents under the bed).  Room was 231 right opposite the lifts so a little noisy at times.  However, we all slept perfectly well.  Hotel bar and restaurant just ok.  Breakfast also just ok.  So all round everything is OK at this hotel.  Wouldn't pay above £250 for it though.

author: Ella Q
title: Good temporary house in London
text: Great location, about a 10-minute walk from the train and metro station. The staff was very polite and helpful—special thanks to Abu at reception for being so welcoming! Comfortable rooms and a generous breakfast.

author: Claire K
title: Great experience
text: I have regularly stayed at Crown Plaza kings cross and have always had a great time. Aneta has always taken great care of us!

author: Gavin S
title: Excellent
text:
I went to London for a weekend with my 8- and 6-year-old children. We loved the hotel, which is truly "family friendly." 
At breakfast, Shine was adorable with the children and made sure we didn't lack for anything. Thanks to him. 
We will come back for sure.

author: Molly R
title: Very good comfortable hotel
text: Very good stay, well-maintained hotel, and a big thank you to ABU at the front desk for his kindness and his help with the early check-in, very good and professional, I recommend it

author: Olivia K
title: Would recommend.
text: Zain on reception was friendly and helpful. The hotel is clean and great for families

author: William C
title: Comfortable stay
text: I stayed here with my girlfriend for three nights. The room was clean and a good size. The bed was incredibly comfortable, as was the duvet. The bathroom was appealing, with a lovely, powerful and adjustable shower and a bench in the shower as well. Unfortunately there was a slight smell coming from the drain in the bathroom. The staff at the reception were helpful and friendly, though my experience using the fitness centre was slightly negative, as it is overly complicated gaining access to the centre- you have to ask at reception for access- and the pool is seemingly permanently closed off. The gym is basic but nice and clean.

author: Rosie W
title: Perfect
text: Very good experience! The hotel is very good and well located. The staff is very attentive (especially Shine!)

author: Adam H
title: Wonderful stay
text: The place was amazing..next to tourist destination in london..breakfast was great..always filled with guests everyday.. Kids and family friendly…Superb 5-star hotel..thanks for the wonderful summer…

author: Ella O
title: Excellent experience
text: The hotel and the room are very clean. Excellent breakfast. Staff is really nice and accommodating for special requests. Particular appreciation to Abu at the check-in desk.

author: Abigail M
title: Tour in London with friends
text: Hotel very nice and clean,  various breakfast and kindly staff especially Abu .

author: Evan J
title: The stay was very good.
text: Check-in experience is good, front desk staff is ABU, service attitude is very good, learned we want to study after letting us check in early and no need for us to provide a handling fee, a good experience!

author: Matthew A
title: very good hotel
text:
We spent 5 nights at the Crowne Plaza Kings Cross at the beginning of August.
Warm welcome from Iffat starting at 3:00 PM on the first day. We were on the 2nd floor on the courtyard side; the hotel is quiet and well-located, whether for going toward St Pancras or King's Cross station or taking the buses at Mount Pleasant. There is also a nice little neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and bars at Exmouth.

Regarding the room, it was large; you do not need a power adapter because there is a French outlet and USB and USB-C ports.
There is a hair dryer, an iron and an ironing board, as well as a safe.
There is a lack of storage space in the closet!!! as well as towel racks in the bathroom. There are plenty of towels, shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, and body lotion. The shower also serves as a bathtub and has very high pressure.

We were on the 2nd floor and we always took the stairs.
Regarding breakfast, there are a lot of people and there is a lot of choice. On the weekend the kitchen is open and you can order pancakes and waffles. There is always flavored water available for self-service.

The pool and spa are no longer working, there is just the gym. It was a 4-star regarding the pool, so it is becoming a good 3-star.

In any case, we had a very good stay.

author: Andrea J
title: papin amazing man
text: Papin did amazing job deserves the manager role

author: Chloe X
title: Papani to the Rescue
text: Our visit was very good, however the breakfast was disappointing, due only offering scrambled eggs. Which I have never come across.before?! The hotel standards and service overall was a very good experience and in particular the service we received from Papani was 1st class. He was very attentive, and professional in his service at all times. He showed a real genuine interest in engaging with us and that has been memorable. Thanks you for our stay.

author: Luke O
title: Great stay
text: Had a great stay here, starting with checking in with Abu. He put us on the top floor at my request, and found us joint rooms when he saw our party size. Then, Abu sent housekeeping up to make sure the fold out beds were set up for us. Later, housekeeping brought up extra blankets and towels quickly, and the next day when we went on our local adventures and came back, they called to make sure the rooms were cleaned to our satisfaction. Overall, a very clean and nice stay for our vacation.

author: Charlotte U
title: My first experience
text:
I’m absolutely delighted with the service at this hotel. Everything is impeccably clean, warm, welcoming, and beautifully chic. The atmosphere is truly lovely, and the whole experience has been wonderful.

A special mention to Shine, who made my cocktail perfectly! He was incredibly kind, friendly, welcoming, and attentive. His warm and caring attitude really made the experience even more enjoyable.

Thank you for such a lovely stay and for making me feel so welcome!

author: Charlotte A
title: Excellent hotel
text: Excellent hotel located in a central area, a 10-minute walk from the subway. I had dinner and the options are very good, plus they have very good vegetarian options. I recommend it and will definitely return

author: Luca J
title: Great service from abu at the hotel
text: The service was very charming and the worker Abu was very nice as well thank you very much :)

author: Chloe B
title: One night stay for Hyde Park concert
text:
The hotel is about 7 or 8 minutes from Lancaster Gate tube and about 3 or 4 minutes from the nearest entrance to Hyde Park so it very convenient for that part of London.

The rooms are clean but quite small and the bathroon looks a little bit dated but the there was a large comfy bed. Reception staff were friendly but there was no breakfast option as their breakfast room was still being refurbished, finishing in Auguest ?

author: Henry F
title: Disappointed deceived experience!!
text:
Very disappointed experience. Everything we were expecting, according to their website, was a lie. The only thing that made us stay longer was the good attitude and willingness of the front desk ladies and the manager. Unfortunately we couldn’t keep up with the amount of problems we faced. Smelly rooms, broken shower in the bath room. Additionally the safe box didn’t work and when was changed the tool guy left sharp pointed screws on the floor and my daughter almost had an accident with them. 
The building is old and supposedly in renovation. Anyone can describe it as tasteless facelift. I don’t understand why they are in business deceiving guests with fake fotos of something far away from the reality. Don’t get near the place your money is very welcome somewhere else. We finally decided to move to another much better hotel almost for the same amount of money.

author: Henry C
title: A great London-hotel
text: Clean, charming rooms with comfortable beds. Nice breakfast! Friendly and service minded staff. Easy to find and a central location!

author: Marco K
title: Exceptional kindness and outstanding customer service
text:
Exceptional kindness and outstanding customer service

Although I was unfortunately unable to stay due to a family medical emergency, I felt compelled to leave a review because of the exceptional kindness and compassion shown by the hotel team.

When I explained that my mother had become seriously ill, Simona Mihalache, the Front Office and Reservations Manager, responded with genuine empathy and immediately cancelled my reservation free of charge as a gesture of goodwill. During an incredibly stressful time, this act of understanding meant so much to me and my family.

It’s easy to review a hotel after a stay, but I believe the true measure of hospitality is how people treat you when unexpected circumstances arise. The professionalism, warmth, and compassion I experienced have left a lasting impression.

Thank you again to Simona and the entire team for your kindness. I sincerely hope to visit in the future under much happier circumstances, and I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel based on the outstanding customer care I received.

author: Pierre S
title: Loved the location and front staff
text:
Staff were amazing- the location was fine and a nice neighbourhood
The rooms are small and the restaurant was closed sadly as they are renovating. We asked for soap, maps and ice and they were gracious - Dianna and Beverly  especially .
Reliable hot water was a problem

author: Claire B
title: A wonderful hotel 🌟
text:
I attended a conference with work at the Lancaster Gate hotel staying the night before.

The rooms are beautifully appointed with divine bedding, The White Company toiletries and lovely robes!

The food was delicious- I had dinner, drinks and breakfast and was not disappointed.

Every member of staff I came into contact with were an absolute pleasure from check in to check out. A special shout out to Yolanda in the restaurant who walked the line as we queued for lunch following our conference break. Extremely friendly and attentive.

I am surprised by some of the reviews for the hotel as I would love to have the opportunity to visit and stay here again and would thoroughly recommend The Lancaster Gate 🌟

author: Anna X
title: To return when refurbishment is complete
text:
This review takes into account the fact that the hotel is under major refurbishment. 
We were advised two days in advance that there is no hot water and took the decision still to go.
Despite this, the location was great, the staff terrific, the size of the room was much better than similarly priced London hotels we've used, and the hotel was clean.
We'll definitely consider returning- once the refurbishment is done.

author: Kyle Q
title: Lancaster Gate Hotel Review
text: Very nice hotel, breakfast currently unavailable which wasn’t ideal but it does have very handy transport links with three tube stations within walking distance. Very friendly staff.

author: Daisy O
title: Hotel from HELL
text: This is the worst hotel I have ever stayed in, we stayed for 10 nights unfortunately, at a cost of close to AUD $3k, the bathroom tap had scum from years ago looked like it had never been cleaned, the rooms were serviced badly, left without toilet paper constantly, never vacuumed, dirty cups left in room. 4 days in we then had no hot water for 2 days which meant we could not shower, they did not give two hoots about it, then 2 days later we had no flushing toilet for over 48 hours, the shower never ran the water out of the bath whilst showering so the water was up past your ankles. A major safety breach. My daughter slipped and could have hurt herself seriously, they still didn’t care. The front staff including management were so rude. I have asked for a refund for this disservice and utter disgrace of a hotel and they blatantly refused. I booked through booking.com and they also have done nothing to obtain a refund. Overall the hotel was a disgrace. We were not the only guests who encountered this issue. Do not stay at this hotel, the rating should be a 1 star and booking.com should not be listing properties like this.

author: Paolo C
title: Shame about the renovation work
text: We have stayed here numerous times, the location is good, its been value for money and service has been good. However, the hotel is currently undertaking a substantial renovation. The temporary reception area was cold and very noisey - power tools. The breakfast area is a lot smaller because of the work - fewer choice options and the hot food area is close to the temporary entrance - all the cooked food was cold and congealed. The seating area is reduced in size and the noise from the contractors was unacceptable. The bar area is currently tiny. The hotel did email about the work but didn't really explain the implications. We will return to the hotel but only when the work has been finished. I think the hotel should be offering discounts or vouchers because of the work.

author: Harry C
title: Terrible smell in bathrooms
text: We stayed in two different rooms in this hotel in December 2025 and both bathrooms smelled awful.  We complained about the first bathroom but the smell in the second bathroom was even worst.

author: Giulia J
title: Nice hotel
text: We stayed 5 nights We were on the entrance floor Corridors reminded the ship The area looks quality Near the bus stops near Kensington Gardens so you can walk directly to Oxford street Paddington train station in 15 minutes Near there are two subway stations Our room is spacious Two sized luggage comfortably placed in the room We have not encountered any problems Recommendation For everyone The bathroom is spacious The small bites can be seen

author: Oliver R
title: Horrible Front Desk
text:
We stayed for 4 days in room 210 on November 16-2025.We had not made a Reservation in advance, the receptionists didn’t want to pick us up saying there were no rooms available at the hotel.They had to pay when they showed room on the Internet.
We wanted a double one-large bed, they insisted on two single beds.
The hotel''s location and room value balance are good, but the front desk staff are all very nervous and never help guests at all.

author: Lucy F
title: Terrible Stay.. Sewage Smell Room & Rude Staff
text:
Room 995… if you do decide to stay here and are allocated this room, ask for another room
IMMEDIATELY!!!!! 

Stayed at this hotel with work, checked in and was told I had an upgrade… brilliant I thought. Headed to my room in the basement … 4 beds, hardly an upgrade for a lone traveller but I went with it. 

Room window open, but could smell something, thought it was the outdated wooden furniture so thought nothing of it. 

Came back from dinner … closed the window, did some work, an hour later the room smelt.. it was coming from the bathroom. 

As I was ready for bed I stayed in the room and closed the bathroom. At 2am used the bathroom and it was disgusting the build up of smell of sewage/drains built up, I physically gagged. The shower in the morning was just as bad. 

Rude staff and manager 
Went to reception to explain, staff member started to talk to another customer mid explaining and asking for another room. I called him rude and said I will be back packed with my case. 20’mins later I was back at reception, spoke to the manager and said do not put anyone else in that room it’s vile. She reassured me that wouldn’t happen, I then explained re the rude member of staff  about talking to another customer and no word of a lie she stopped me talking to talk to another customer as I complaining. I just said WOW,  I then left for work. 

That evening I returned to receive a card to a new room! The receptionist who checked me in the night before who was so polite and lovely, she deserves a
Medal working there! She acknowledged there was an on/off issue with the room and that she had checked someone in that night, yes a family had been checked in! She said the room smelt nice, I said yes that was my Jo Malone I sprayed this morning as it was so bad! 

She laughed and said oh no they are going to complain aren’t they in the morning… I said oh yes!!!

Just a complete sham, they don’t care! 

Ps yes I did get another room which was fine, just a very dated hotel like the other reviews have stated! Shame as the building is beautiful!

author: Nora P
title: Nice Hotel ver well situated
text: We stayed 9 nights in total, the hotel is very well situated and the staff was very helpful and kind! Juan, Soranh and Welleny are the most! The breakfast is very good and with several options

author: Holly S
title: London: city to walk!!!
text: We stayed with my husband 3 nights in mid-May. Great location!! Ideal to get to London for the first time from Heathrow by train to Paddington Station, and walk 5/6 blocks to the hotel. Two blocks from Hyde Park, subway, collectives, near Notting Hill, tourist bus stop 2 blocks. The building is very nice and very well maintained. We booked double room with breakfast. The room was not big, but comfortable, good mattress and pillows, very clean. The bathroom complete with everything you need. The very spacious dining room and very complete breakfast, great variety and very rich. It has a very nice bar sector. It has no restaurant but is surrounded by very good pubs and restaurants. The staff very attentive, we arrived early and the room was not ready yet, they kept our luggage, gave us a location plan and directions of the nearby places to tour. The adapter we had stopped working, and they provided us with one.  The hotel is in a super quiet and safe neighborhood, close to public transport to go anywhere, and if you like walking, close to many of the tourist spots. London is for walking!!!! Very good value for money, I recommend it without hesitation.

author: Sean G
title: Excellent hotel
text: Very good hotel, spacious rooms, extremely quiet neighborhood, located very close to train and bus stations. For a while you are in museums, and historical sites of interest. Very good and hearty breakfast although little varied. I'd come back.

author: Charlotte L
title: Old hotel, not updated, not very clean
text:
I came home yesterday. The last time I stayed here was 3 years ago as it has gone downhill since.
Pros: The staff was very friendly, would quickly call a taxi, would provide extra towels, toilet paper, etc. at the front desk. 

Cons: Upon check in, I learned the hotel was under new management by a German company and they have made changes to match the amenities at all their other hotels, I was told. That sounds OK, but here's what I found different. From a full English breakfast, they paired way down to what they call a "cold breakfast". The only thing hot was hard boiled eggs. Still about £15 if it's not included in your room price. There's no menu. You have to get the buffet or go elsewhere. I was able to buy just a cup of coffee one morning. After the buffet closes, there is no more food that can be purchased until the next morning. There's a bar with liquor but no food or even snacks.

My room was dirty. I found string, balls of hair, etc. on the floor. The sheets had stains on them. I was there for 9 nights. After the second day, I told the front desk I needed someone to come in and vacuum. I didn't get housekeeping every day, but probably 3 times in the 9 days I was there. The bedding was never changed, as evidenced by the stains and the rip in the pillowcase. The floor did not appear to be vacuumed again. The carpeting is old and stained. They need to just remove it and put some kind of vinyl flooring.  The mattress is old and I could feel the springs as I slept, which caused me back pain after a few nights.  

The bathroom is dated, which I knew and wouldn't mind generally, but the water pressure was so hard that even with the shower curtain closed, the wind from the water blew water out onto the floor, which I had to mop up after every shower.   I found lots of hair stuck in the drain, which I pulled out myself.  There are no boxes of tissues in the room. The amenities are very small bottles of shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. No bar soap, even to wash your hands. I tried to tell my issues to the housekeeping staff, but the 3 women I encountered spoke not one word of English. They just stared at me. I believe all staff in a hotel should at least speak some of the language of the country they are in.

There was no phone in the room and 3 nights after midnight there was loud noise among other guests in the hallway. The only way to notify the front desk was to get dressed and go out there so I did not do that and just tolerated it.

The AC worked and was 1 split unit. Unfortunately, it blew directly on my bed so I either had to be hot without AC or freezing with cold air blowing on me. Finally someone from the front desk came to adjust it. It was somewhat better, but still either really warm or really cold in the room. Near the end of my stay, I had nasal and throat issues from this.

While I didn't watch much TV, when I tried, the TV was terrible. Hardly any channels were available, there was no guide in the room and the remote did not work properly.

I really enjoyed my stay at the hotel 3 years ago, but I would not stay here again. If you want a cheaply priced hotel and a place relatively near a tube station and Hyde Park, this is your place.  If you want decent quality, cleanliness, and a place to get food at various times during the day, stay elsewhere.  

You have to pay upfront when you check in. I thought about asking for a refund and going elsewhere, but as I checked prices of other hotels online, because it was late notice, the prices were triple what I was paying here.

author: Pierre N
title: Far from modern
text: Stayed in 4 etg in this otherwise beautiful street hotel located in. Lobby is nice and clean. Then you get to the floor where the room is. Fragile floor with carpet. No hand soap in the room. Light conditions like a sterile doctor's office idiotic to stay four nights under such awkward conditions but at least clean. One more thing, the towels are small. Don't get this floor next time.  Or as far as the hotel if they don't change. In their description of the hotel, they call this modern. Where have they been for the last 30 years???

author: Mason B
title: Central abd clean hotel

author: Claire W
title: Recommend this hotel

author: Sean U
title: Disappointing stay – definitely not the Junior Suite we thought we had booked
text:
We stayed at La Suite West on a Saturday night for a special occasion and, unfortunately, I wouldn’t return.

We deliberately booked a Junior Suite based on what was advertised: an air-conditioned room, a four-poster bed and ample space to relax. What we actually got bore very little resemblance to what we believed we had booked.

The bed was extremely low – effectively at shin height – there was no air conditioning, and the bathroom was one of the smallest I have ever encountered in a hotel. Most frustratingly, the room we were given appeared to be the same room shown on the hotel’s own website as one of their smallest bedrooms, rather than what I would reasonably expect from a Junior Suite.

The lack of air conditioning was particularly disappointing. There was a small fan provided in the room, which suggested to us that the hotel was already aware the room did not have functioning air conditioning.

I questioned the room when we arrived and raised my concerns again when we were leaving. Unfortunately, the interaction with the manager made an already disappointing stay considerably worse. Rather than listening to the concerns we were raising or trying to understand why we felt the room did not match what we had booked, I found his manner argumentative, defensive and unnecessarily confrontational.

What I found particularly uncomfortable was how the dynamic of the conversation appeared to change when my husband joined us. As a confident woman who was perfectly capable of raising my own complaint, I did not appreciate feeling that my concerns were treated differently once a man became involved. I matched the manager’s directness, which clearly wasn’t well received.

Eventually, after a lengthy and unnecessarily confrontational discussion, the manager did offer compensation. At the time of writing, however, I am still waiting to see whether that compensation actually materialises. I will happily update this review if and when it does.

For a hotel that talks about its standards and guest experience, I would seriously question whether those standards were reflected in either the accommodation we received or the way our complaint was handled.

My biggest regret is not reading the TripAdvisor reviews before booking. Had I done so, I genuinely don’t think we would have stayed here.

When you book a Junior Suite for a special occasion, you expect to receive what has been advertised and, if there is a problem, to be treated professionally when you raise it. Sadly, neither happened for us.

I won’t be returning.
Photos attached of what we booked and what we got!

author: Molly N
title: Booked a junior suite but got a small room
text:
Booked a junior suite but when we checked in, we got a smaller room. The hotel insisted that is a junior suite. They then moved us to the correct room the next day which is much bigger. Not very happy with the first night. The room was not only small, the air conditioner was not working properly. No matter how low we set the AC, the room was too warm to sleep. Not a good way to start our vacation after a long haul flight. 

The shower drainage was not draining properly. The TV signal was pretty pathedic. Overall we did not have a good experience.

author: Evie C
title: Smells mould and has tiny rooms
text:
The hotel looks really nice from the outside, the bed was comfortable, and the air conditioning worked reasonably well. However, there were several issues that significantly affected our stay.

The entire third floor had a strong mouldy smell that was noticeable as soon as you stepped out of the lift and into the rooms. After just one night, I woke up with a completely blocked nose. While the room itself was clean, it was extremely small. We booked a Junior Suite for four people, but once the beds were made up, there was barely any space left to move around.

The shower was good, although I couldn’t really see the point of providing bathrobes given the size and standard of the room.

It seems that the top floor has been cosmetically renovated, but it feels as though the underlying issues have simply been painted over rather than properly addressed.

Finally, the lift felt very old and unreliable—we genuinely preferred taking the stairs because it seemed like it could break down at any moment.

author: Benjamin M
title: Worst experience of all!
text:
Bad experience – not recommended for families

We came to London with our children to walk and rest. We chose this hotel just because we believed we would have comfort after a full day of tours, but unfortunately the experience was very disappointing.

We stayed on the first floor, with windows facing the street. The noise is simply absurd throughout the night, and, to make it worse, the room does not have a good insulation from clarity. Result: We can hardly sleep.

The children stayed on an extremely uncomfortable sofa bed. Only by lying down was it possible to feel the entire structure of the bed, leaving marks on the body. We complained, and the only solution offered was to put a pad on the mattress, but that didn't solve the problem.

Another negative point was the hair dryer, which did not work. I requested the exchange three times and, by the time the checkout, the problem had not been resolved.

In addition to all this, the rooms are very small, which makes the stay even less comfortable for those travelling in family.

Unfortunately, it was a rather frustrating experience. I do not recommend this hotel, especially for those travelling with children or looking to rest during the trip.

author: Emma N
title: Good location - bad breakfast
text: Great lokation. Our room was smalle but the layout was fine. The breakfast was terrible. The kitchen was unable to even boil an egg. Book the hotel because af the great location, but don't pay extra for the breaksfast.

author: Sofia R
title: Avoid this hotel
text:
Room stank of smoke, we told reception but they weren’t interested. 
Dirty disgusting bed sheet and poor security. Complained to reception and informed them that someone had been in our room while we were out and had slept in the bed. We asked to move to a different room but were told they had none available. They brought us up clean sheets but we said we didn’t want to sleep in the bed. It was soiled and damp!!! Had to sleep on a chair all night. 
The shower had broken loose parts on the floor. We didn’t bother reporting this to reception, not much point after the lack of interest when we reported the other issues to them. 
Manager was very dismissive and abrupt. He didn’t apologise at all when we spoke to him the next morning. He said CCTV showed no one had been in the room when clearly they had. 
Terrible attitude for a manager.

author: Adam T
title: A solid choice ...
text: This is a classic London terrace house converted to a hotel in an up and coming area. The lobby is modern and well appointed and the staff at the front desk at very efficient and friendly. Two tube stops are very close by and you can get just about everything around the corner on the hight street which is a bonus. It's not within walking distance of much of anything, but I took the tube to Oxford Street and Covent Garden which was a simple task. Please note that the rooms are very, very small and my room was good for one, but would not have worked for a couple at all. They are tiny, but well appointed and I had a place for everything which was good. My only complaint (and it annoyed me a lot) was that the housekeeping staff kept barging into my room during the day multiple times -- they would knock and not wait for me to answer and just barg on in. Other than that, this was a good pick and I'd stay here again.

author: Emma P
title: Spacious suite in beautiful neighborhood
text: I loved the location and the spaciousness of the suite.  It felt so luxurious to have that much space in London.  Lots of great restaurants nearby.  We enjoyed eating breakfast outside on their nicely shaded terrace.  it's a gorgeous neighborhood. Bed is comfy.  I took off 1 star because we heard the underground trains rumble by at regular intervals.  i brought earplugs.  We stayed 3-nights and by the 2nd night I got used to the regular rumbling.  I feel this was a very good value London hotel.

author: Megan W
title: Good, Mediocre, Bad and Not Worth Repeating
text:
Good location on a quiet street only a 1/2 from a busy street and Bayswater Tube Station which does have steps, but it ain't enough to discourage toting luggage up from the tube stop.
Good decor of the lobby and good + creative interior design of the petite rooms. 
Bad - Thin walls so you hear both hallway noise and next door guests.
Mediocre - continental breakfast buffet.
Good - friendly staff with helpful suggestions of where to go.
Given high cost of this hotel compared to similar hotels that I looked at near Paddington, I know that next time I will try a different one.

author: Megan B
title: Honeymoon
text: The staff here are super friendly. The room was smaller than we expected but overall it was still very comfortable. The pillows were the only thing I found uncomfortable but I think that just comes down to personal preference.

author: Chloe Z
title: The Room Upgrade

She is very courteous, knowledgeable and efficient and she goes above and beyond to make our stay very pleasant.  She is extremely good at her job.

author: Sydney N
title: Room2Reward Streetvet RVN of the year donated stay
text:

The staff were so lovely and made us feel very special and at home straight away. Donating a room to say thank you to volunteers is such a kind and generous thing to do. I will remember this trip fondly. Thank you!

title: Couple trip

author: Olivia U
title: Nice Hotel
text: A nice hotel, very conveniently situated five minutes walk from the Earl's Court Tube Station.  We had a very good sized room, very clean and with a comfortable bed.  The breakfast offered plenty of selection.  The staff were friendly and helpful.

author: Aiden A
title: Recommended
text:
Very comfortable hotel in a strategic place of London, metro stop a few meters, residential and quiet neighborhood. Our room was large enough and comfortable, the shower large but the spaces in the bathroom small, there are few footholds. 
Cleanliness in my opinion great, very courteous staff, good breakfast, we asked for an extra jug of milk and were given it without problems. 
In the lobby you will find some fruit, water and juice available, working wifi, there are no USB sockets so you need to bring the adapter. 
The hotel is perhaps a bit dated but I found it comfortable and comfortable, comfortable bed and especially there were not those suffocating temperatures that you sometimes find in certain hotels.

author: Amelia D
title: Great value for money and very convenient location, in nice neighborhood
text: A five-night getaway to London in three, with my daughter now entered the "adults". It is not easy to find a hotel with a spacious, centrally located and affordable triple in London, I realized it practically immediately as soon as I started the search. For just over £600 we also had breakfast included and I must say I was very happy with the choice made, despite here on the tripadvisor the reviews were not convincing, but on booking and google it was better. Taken courage 2 hands I booked, aware of finding me a hotel not freshly renovated but with spacious rooms, strategic location and verified reviews with an average of 8. I gave my best here, not because it is a perfect or luxurious hotel, but because it is perfect for the value for money and I would stay there again tomorrow. Metro 5 minutes, nice area where nothing is missing, plenty of space and a breakfast where nothing is missing, although you certainly can not expect homemade food or a chef. Products however suitable for a small 3 star. The elevator is true that it is old and small, but it is there and convenient with suitcases. The area is elegant and comfortable, full of shops and places to eat for all tastes, ms also quiet the street where there is the hotel, so sleep tight. The staff is very friendly and helpful.

author: Mia O
title: Suprise call 40mins before flight!
text:
Terrible experience, ruined our weekend in London.
Booked the room 1 month prior date of stay, got called 40mins before flight and told our room was not available anymore because of overbooking.

• 2 option: they give us an other accomodation, which I am forced to accept while not even there to check what I'm going to get. Another unacceptable behaviour.
This accomodation is an apartment, further from transports, not clean and not on the same level of what I paid to get.
I also got told I had to walk 10 minutes in the morning to get my paid breakfast.
On top of that the place didn't know how many nights we were staying and made us waste a lot of our time.

It was very unprofessional behaviour and I don't recommend this hotel at all, if you don't want to ruin your stay.
Overbooking is unacceptable.

author: Andrea Q
title: Incredible staff and location, but Standard rooms need maintenance
text:
We stayed at the Holiday Inn London Kensington High St from August 15-21, 2026. The absolute highlight was the extraordinary staff. The breakfast team was incredibly warm and welcoming every morning, and Richard at the bar provided attentive and professional service. The entire team, from reception to housekeeping, made us feel right at home.

Pros:
Location: Perfect for exploring, just a 2-minute walk from High Street Kensington station.
Dining: Food was excellent for both breakfast and dinner. Very convenient to order for pickup at the bar.

Cons:
Our Standard room: The room felt small due to a poor layout, and the closet had no drawers for storage.
Maintenance Issues: The mattress was in poor condition with springs poking through, which was very uncomfortable. 
In the bathroom, the shower design caused the floor to flood every time we bathed.
Atmosphere: It was odd that the main restaurant wasn't used for evening service, forcing many guests to eat in the bar area.

Overall, the staff and location are a 10/10, but Standard rooms (at least the one we stayed) urgently need updates to match the high-quality service.

Phil

author: Luca E
title: Great Service
text:
Absolutely — here’s a polished, natural-sounding hotel review that highlights the stay and gives Sujal a special mention for the bar service:

### Hotel Review

I had a wonderful stay at Holiday Inn London – High Street Kensington. The hotel was comfortable, welcoming, and in a fantastic location, making it really convenient for exploring London. The staff were friendly and helpful throughout my stay, which made the experience even better.

A special mention to **Sujal** at the bar/lounge for the excellent service! He made me an absolutely amazing Pina Colada and Espresso Martini both were fantastic, but the Espresso Martini was definitely one of my favourites! 🍸 The drinks were perfectly made, and Sujal was attentive, friendly, and made the whole bar experience feel special.

Overall, a great stay with excellent hospitality. I would definitely recommend Holiday Inn High Street Kensington and would happily stay here again!

author: Lucas M
title: Avoid if you want a goodnights sleep
text: If you want to be cooked alive, well ‘‘tis hotel is definitely for you ! There are to fans in the room, so at least you’ll be cooked evenly ! We spent two nights here and neither of us had a good nights sleep due to the room temperature. There is a small top window, which was open, but any fresh air which manages to enter the room is very soon elevated. The food was the worst that I ever been offered. The bathroom which looks ok, absolutely stinks, and definitely needs the drains throughly clean . The only positive thing I can say is that it is near Camden market.

author: Mia A
title: Good value budget break in Leafy North London
text:
We went on a Caledonian bus trip for 4 nights.
Have to say we expected very little and were pleasantly surprised.
Clean, good shower, bed OK, food good and plenty of it.
Yes, it was unprecedented heat and the rooms were uncomfortably warm but the fans and keeping curtains closed helped.
Great location for tube, buses, Uber and TESCO Expresd - for the bus trip price was excellent value. No complaints from us.

author: James J
title: Good value budget hotel.
text:
This hotel is situated in a very affluent part of London, near to Primrose Hill. There is an underground station about 15 minutes walk away, and it’s a 15 minute ride into town.
Price wise it is a budget hotel, and we paid around £120 a night each for single rooms. Included in the price was the coach journey to and from Glasgow, as well as all you can eat breakfast and evening meal buffets.
The food was of a perfectly reasonable standard bearing in mind the price, and there was a good choice of dishes. Breakfast displayed a comprehensive variety of English and continental breakfasts. Unfortunately the one criticism of breakfast was that all the fried eggs were overcooked until rubbery. Please note that a lot of British consumers like fried eggs more runny than those provided.
The room was spacious, the bed comfortable and the shower excellent.
The weather was remarkably hot, and although there was no air conditioning fans were provided, which, when well positioned, kept the room at a bearable temperature throughout the night.
The staff were pleasant and helpful.
Considering that many Airbnbs in the area advertise rooms with no private bathroom or dining for at least £100 a night, this hotel is definitely good value.

author: Poppy M
title: Please ignore the negative reviewers!
text:
Have just returned from a four night stay with Caledonian Travel. This short break was extremely good value and included dinner, bed and breakfast with inclusive coach travel from Glasgow.
Having read the many negative reviews, we were somewhat apprehensive but, on arrival, we were pleasantly surprised by the very pleasant reception and lounge bar area. Our rooms had obviously been recently refurbished (there is currently scaffolding at the front of the hotel which suggests that the whole hotel is currently undergoing an upgrade). We had good sized rooms with a pleasant modern  en-suite shower room with plenty of hot water, very comfortable bed and pillows, a good powerful hair dryer and tea/coffee making facilities. Although the windows in the rooms could not open, a fan was provided which provided adequate air movement and room cooling…..even in the middle of a 33 degree heatwave!
The food, for a budget-priced hotel,  was buffet-style at both breakfast and evening dinner. Breakfast was particularly comprehensive, offering mixed cereal ,fruit,  and a variety of cooked dishes. There was always something to be found at the evening meal with a choice of main course and  potatoes/chips along with nice a soup and fresh salad, hot pudding (which I didn’t try),  fresh fruit, and cheese and biscuits.
This hotel is located in a very residential area of London and is within easy walking of Chalk Road underground station, Primrose Hill, Camden Lock and Market and Camden Town itself,

author: Henry E
title: Puzzling reviews
text: Stayed on a coach trip , 1st room television was broke so the room was changed to a room with a fantastic view of London,  hotel was clean , the food was excellent,  lovely tea and breakfast I'd say it was the best organised service out of all the coach trips we've done , a big credit due to all the restaurant staff , the hotel is having work done so there is all scaffolding up on main street side .Yes the rooms are warm but the fan did its job , The only downside is no draft beer but there's a pub just up the rd

author: Ruby T
title: Adequate
text:
Stayed here as part of coach theatre trip. The room was dated but clean with good shower water pressure and comfy beds. The drafty window made a handy make shift fridge for drinks with the curtains closed.
The food  both evening and breakfast was awful but hotel close enough to shops and Camden to get a decent meal. Staff friendly and polite cant blame them for lack of investment

author: Lucy D
title: Avoid
text: Not a hotel i would recommend to anyone unfortunately.  Believe the reviews, this hotel is very dated. Rooms are not very nice & grubby. Our beds were clean thankfully.  We requested to be moved rooms as given a double bed instead of twin room. Very very uncomfortable nights due to heat as rooms do not aircon but do have fans which don't help at all. Breakfast was ok had most things. Dinner was edible we ate once & decided to eat elsewhere.  Check your plates/ cutlery as some not cleaned properly. Nice bar/restaurant The Washington just down the road.

author: Evie E
title: Absolutely Dire and describing it as a hotel is wrong on so many levels!
text:
Horrible hotel. 
The room given was nothing more than a glorified prison cell and the cost was a rip off at £324 for two nights! 
Once in the room it can only be described as walking into an oven with a pathetic fan in to alleviate the heat. Unfortunately I ended up only staying one night it was so unbearable and lost money as a result. 
Do not visit here in a heatwave!

author: Connor Y
title: Avoid in summer
text:
Very old, dated, worn. Staff are nice enough. Food was basic but fine, hot and edible. 

Rooms are unbearably hot. Unfortunately our stay coincide with a heat wave. There's no air con. Thankfully we were provided with fans. But they didnt help one bit. Got little to no sleep for 2 nights. Checked out early.

author: Gavin M
title: Could be amazing 😕
text:
Stayed here as a party of 7 women on a Caledonian trip 2 nights stay to see Abba Voyage on June 19th.
We were initially pleasantly surprised on entering the lobby and staff were very friendly as we were allocated our rooms.
We were on the second floor and the weather was 30 degrees. We opened the door and it was like opening an oven!!! 🥵🥵🥵 the curtains were closed except for a gap at the top which wouldn’t open or close the entire weekend. There were 2 fans which were absolutely useless and just circulated the hot air. The room was very dated (I was prepared to overlook this as I knew how  central the location  was and it was, after all just a base for visiting London ) and it was clean.
We had 3 single beds each with one pillow and very light quilts. The beds were quite lumpy and uncomfortable. Lots of wardrobe space with an iron and ironing board in the wardrobe. Lots of plug sockets also and including usb charging points which was helpful. A small desk with a mirror above and a kettle with tea, coffee etc. The wardrobe also had a full length mirror in it.
The bathroom was ok (very clean) with a large walk in shower, which we used regularly for cold showers to cool us down! We also had plenty of towels although a bit small.
Now the worst bit… the food! Absolutely inedible on the first night, in fact we struggled to identify a couple of dishes. Because the windows were slightly open little ants were on the table too. 
The breakfast wasn’t much better but anything they didn’t need to cook was ok ie cereal, toast, yoghurt, fruit and pastries. 
The bar is very expensive but every bar in London is! It’s also cashless so card payments only. There is only one table outside with 3 chairs.
We chose to go to The Washington pub which is a few minutes up the road and it serves lovely food. There is also a Tesco express a few doors away which was handy
We saw a man have his mobile phone snatched from his hand by 2 people on a small moped and apparently this happens a lot so beware. 
On the Saturday night we went the other way to Primrose Hill and a beautiful street of bars and restaurants where we had a beautiful Italian meal.
Chalk Farm tube station isn’t far either.

This hotel could be amazing if it updated the rooms and had air conditioning as the location is lovely.

All in all we had an amazing weekend but because of the extremely hot weather it was very unpleasant to be in the hotel room even just to get ready or sleep!
Iv written hundreds of reviews and I’m always completely honest. I hope this helps prepare future guests

author: Jack W
title: Ok but not great
text:
The location of the hotel in next to primrose hill it's a very nice area very close to camden market and the underground is only about 10 mins walk away and for any oasis fans noel gallachers old house supernova heights is literally a 5 mins walk from the hotel.
OK on to the hotel I went with my husband travelled down with caladonian travel the hotel looked really dated from the outside,inside the foyer was decorated very nicely...our room on the other hand was very dated and there was marks on the wallpaper etc carpets where frayed aswell,we had a balcony view which showed really amazing views into London.. We only had some really small towels in the room aswell if these rooms where updated this hotel would be am amazing place to stay because it is sitting in a lovely spot..the food wasn't that great either I'm afraid the food wasn't as hot as it should of been so didn't really eat there....Some of the staff where friendly than others....wouldny stay here again..

author: Katie T
title: Great apart from the high temperature in the rooms and corridors
text: We loved the location (such a nice part of London) but the room/bathroom were extremely hot! We'd stay there again, but probably only in cold weather! Sleeping under the covers was out of the question, and if was necessary to have the fan they provide on all night, and at any time you were in the room. The only shower you could have was cold or tepid! It was a bit noisy having the window open at night (room 306) because you could hear the constant hum of the central heating system at the back of the building, but other reviewers have said that being at the front of the building is noisy as well because of the traffic, so perhaps being at the back is better. It's a shame they can't reduce the temperature in the summer because it'd be a great place to stay otherwise, and very reasonable too.

author: Evie U
title: Greatlication, got potential but could do better!
text:
We came here with a Caledonian Travel tour. 
Great location for Chalk Farm underground & Camden Market. Rooms are a bit tired but bathroom seems to have been recently renovated. 
Waiting staff in dining room were very pleasant & helpful, couldn't do enough for us. 
We are here just now during May heatwave, externally there are 2 tables with 2 seats at each of them, there is room for another 2 tables & at least 1 more seat at each one. Large table with 4 seats on terrace too but glass top badly needs cleaned. 
We arrived on Mon,it's now Wed evening & our room hasn't been serviced at all, given the temperatures there are lots of empty water bottles in the bin that is now full! We had to ask for clean towels this evening .
We are in on.our first night, salad choices for starters were very good main course was adequate but we chose to eat out in Camden Market after that.

author: David E
title: Lovely stay - friendly staff and good food
text: I booked a Chelsea Flower Show package with UK Breakaways and originally the included hotel was in Canary Wharf however this was changed to the Britannia Hampstead having read the negative reviews I was a bit concerned.  I decided to stick with it and hope all would be well.  I had a lovely stay and as a solo traveller I had a spacious double room for sole occupancy. (I did pay a single supplement of £100).  The room was clean and in good condition and the shower room appeared to be new as it was immaculate with a good shower with plenty of hot water. There was plenty of tea and coffee and a kettle. Other guests have mentioned portable heaters but my room had a central heating radiator obviously not needed during the Bank Holiday heatwave but nice to know for any winter stay.  There was a 4ft floor fan which along with the black out curtains kept the room at a reasonable temperature despite the 30 degs outside.  The food was quite simple home cooking with a choice of fresh salad or hot buffet.  The main was a choice of roast meat (turkey one night and roast pork the second night which was delicious) or braised beef  chips or potatoes or pasta or rice the veg was just mixed veg which let it down a bit. The homemade soup was lovely and for desert there was rice pudding or cheese and crackers or a selection of melon. For breakfast there was a good selection of cereals, toast, croissants and cakes - fresh fruit and yoghurt and the usual hot selection of eggs, bacon, sausage, mushrooms, tomatoes, baked beans and hash browns. All the staff were friendly and pleasant even though very busy.  The restaurant tables were cleared promptly and thoroughly cleaned after each person.  The hotel has a nice bar area with comfortable seating as well as seating outdoors.  Buses stop more or less outside or you can catch the tube to Chalk Farm and it is a 5 to 7 minute walk to the hotel.  I stayed in room 515 and had a lovely stay I can only assume I had a refurbished room and if they still have rooms to refurbish they need to get it done as it is a lovely hotel is a convenient location,

author: Hannah Y
title: Coach stay
text:
Recently stayed as part of a coach trip to Chelsea Travel Show, for 2 nights. We had a lovely room in floor 5 (518) which was a good size with decent size bathroom with large sofa. Tall fan in bedroom which we needed on all night as it was hot. The traffic was quite noisy both nights. Although bed was comfy I didn’t sleep well possibly due to the heat.
Food not great on first night. Turkey, chilli con carne rice spaghetti mixed veg salad. We went to a nearby pub for a meal the second night (the Washington) which was great.
Breakfast the first morning was chaos. There was a school party in and they were at doing nothing for ages. Everybody else was queuing and had to give room number and wait. They didn’t shout hours and after seeing some go in that gave number after us I asked if they’d missed ours and he let us in. Though I had seen him write number down in his sheet but it wasn’t there when I approached him so no idea what happened. The breakfast buffet was good but things are in wrong place so everybody’s reaching over for things ie hot water, cereals near toaster.
Staff polite. Bar only has bottles. They advertised cocktails but had none.
In a nice area but probably wouldn’t stay there again

author: Ethan Y
title: Chelsea Flower show weekend 2026
text:
We stayed here whilst at the Chelsea Flower Show.
Typical Brittania hotel, organised chaos, with all foreign staff.
Room was clean, but curtains were stuck closed, no plug in sink, expensive drinks at the bar & absolute chaos in the dining room for breakfast & dinner.
The hotel is in a very nice part of London.

author: Paolo P
title: Hideous experience
text:
I booked a "double en-suite room"  for London and RHS Chelsea.
What I actually got, at Brittania Hotel, Hampstead, was a disgraceful, shabby little room with a shower in a vertical coffin.
I have a list of complaints wrt Room 202
1. Next to LIFT : noisy, vibrations from 5.30 am until early hours of morning   i.e very little sleep
2. FOOD : breakfast was O.K...cold coffee and cheap bread etc. Dinner had choice of "school lunch" type food, which was pretty pathetic but edible. Overall Yuck!
3.Reception : I asked for an extra pillow.... the young lady did not look at me...simply said.        " No, we are full". No interaction whatsoever.....this was pretty typical of the staff.  But NO extra pillows....1 per guest!
4. Room 202 : Clean bedding and great fan.....HOWEVER dirty window overlooking bins...stuffy wee room, so had to keep window open. Dirty curtains. 
Toilet was tiny, no windows. Towel rail too high for me to replace (over 6 ft off the ground).
5.SHOWER : was in a small cupboard!!!  
The shower tray and drain was pretty tiny, ( see photographs)  could touch walls with bent elbows. No shelving. I had to open door and ask partner for towel !     A vertical coffin with a wooden, cupboard door. Mould and mildew around very chipped shower tray!  Utterly appalling . Photographs included. Not fit for purpose 
6.Service : non-existent. Tiny towels, did not replenish tea and coffee etc.....did not even empty BINS.....unhygienic!

The hotel is obviously getting refurbished in a very ad hoc way . On speaking with other guests.... some had bathrooms refurbished, or had good sized bedrooms. We had a disgusting, shabby room and ironically I had booked before most other people.
