author: Evie T
title: Never again!
text:
Very clean, except for curtains, which were hanging off and didnt shut properly, as well as minging! Very dated but en suite clean and ok. Didn't refil tea/milk etc for second evening/morning.

Breakfasts were appalling!! Cheapest produce used (except Twinnings tea bags!!)  Bacon. Sausage, ash browns revolting. Cheapest bread for toast i have ever seen or tasted.

The staff I came into contact with were very nice.

author: Lauren H
title: Not a great stay but good location
text:
We stayed over Easter weekend during a coach trip with Caledonian. The hotel was generally clean but in dire need of updating. The staff were friendly enough but all male of Bangladeshi origin who hardly spoke a word of English. We only ever saw one female working as a receptionist. Our room on the 4th floor was a good size with tea and coffee and a working TV with a over bath shower. The cleanliness could have been a lot better as there were cobwebs on the ceiling and dirt under the toilet rim. We had a nice view of the London Skyline but the windows were very draughty and were whistling all night due to the wind which kept us awake. The pillows were barely pillows at all and when we asked for more we were told no as all the hotel had asked for them as well and they'd run out. 
The food was bog standard, dry tough meat and not a great selection so definitely not worth the price.
The hotel is in a good location within walking distance of Camden Market ob a regular bus route but there is a steep hill climb to the hotel so bear that in mind.

author: Hugo B
title: Perfect 40th anniversary stay at Le Patio Bastille
text: Lovely hotel in the quieter part of Paris with easy metro links to all popular areas and attractions. We were 2 couples travelling to Paris to both celebrating our 40th wedding anniversaries and stayed at Le Patio Bastille for 3 nights from 20th August. The Hotel is very deceptive as it has a small front entrance that opens up to the large hotel hidden behind the main facade. Lovely well maintained hotel with very helpful reception staff, clean spacious air conditioned rooms with a small kitchenette, large very comfy beds and nice clean bathrooms with hot showers. We had breakfast included in our stay making starting each day easier and it was fresh produce every day with fruit, breads, meats and cheeses, yogurts, cereals, fruit juices, tea and coffee, cooked breakfast items, pastries and jams all very nice. Reception staff get bonus points for being lovely, very patient and very helpful especially showing us how to us the RAPT app on our phones to buy metro tickets and getting around. Hotel is well situated for a good nights sleep as its in the quieter 11th Arrondissement but an easy 5 minute walk to a wide range of bars, cafes, bakeries, shops etc. We all highly recommend this hotel for a relaxing stay in a quieter area whilst maintaining easy access to all parts of the city whilst guaranteeing a restful nights sleep to recharge and a good breakfast to set you up for each days activities.

author: George V
title: Really nice hotel
text:
It has really comfy beds.
It is located a little far from city center, but well communicated with metro stations and bus stops nearby

author: Anna H
title: An Ideally Located and Pleasant Hotel With Exceptional Staff
text:
I've now stayed at Le Patio Bastille on two seperate occassions and each time the staff have made sure that everything went well.
On my first trip there were some issues with the booking - I did that through a third party and it was in no way the fault of the hotel - but the reception staff were able to resolve that for me.
For my 2nd trip I booked directly with the hotel and it was so much easier with the ability to complete some parts of check-in before I arrived. During my visit, i received a couple of WhatsApp messages just making sure that I knew they were there to help - a nice little touch I thought.
The hotel is ideally situated with 3 metro stations within a 5 minute walk - this gives you 5 different metro lines to choose from, meaning most attractions are within easy reach.
Within the grounds of the hotel are areas where you can sit out and finish the day off enjoying a nice glass of wine.

author: Chloe K
title: Clean And Tidy
text: Staff friendly and helpful. Establishment clean tidy, rooms clean & presentable. Check in & check out easy no issues, cleanliness of the whole site makes the difference. Getting to hotel from airport was easier wee thought easy to find.  Easy to to and from places plenty of restaurants Bars food places in surrounding areas

author: Luke C
title: Very well-connected hotel that offers very good service.
text:
It is a hotel that offers more than its category indicates. Very good air conditioning, excellent service, very clean, and it features a kitchenette in the rooms.
It is very close to the Nation transport hub and is also next to the city bus stop.
The staff is very attentive and professional.

author: Sophia Q
title: Disappointing
text: Room dark, bit derelict, you smell the smoke from smoking area in patio; breakfast room has no windows

author: Sofia W
title: Perfect well priced Paris location
text: Great location close to metro in authentic neighborhood. Big clean rooms with air conditioning is rare for Paris. Great service and cute garden!

author: Harry G
title: One feels good there.
text: Ideally located and very well equipped, the hotel also stands out for the quality of its welcome: a professional, attentive, and listening team.

author: Aiden K
title: Good location, great staff
text: The first room we were allocated was very small and had a musty smell. The bathroom was also tiny, with the boiler looking halfway out of the ceiling and everything seemed very improvised. We complained and staff were very understanding and gave us a different, much better room the next night. The breakfast room is like a school canteen, but the inner gardens are really nice and shady. The hotel is ideally located. The staff are very friendly and helpful.

author: Lauren G
title: Calm and cozy
text: We enjoyed our 7 days stay at this hotel very much. The rooms are located around a small but nice patio. Within a 5 minutes walk there is a connection to 5 metro lines: 1, 2, 6, 8, 9.

author: Alice S
title: pleasantly surprised
text:
This may not be the hippest place in Paris but I was pleasantly surprised by a few things.
I liked the location, it is in a quiet street in a lively niegbourhood that is not invested by tourists.
Restaurants and bars close by,
The room was really spacious, a rare find in Paris at this price level.
Loads of cupboard space to hang op clothing and stash shoes. A silent mini ridge. Free bottle of water, comfy big bed.
The room ws clean and quite at night. Airco worked really well, no noise. 
The curtains where not all that dark, if you like darkness then you might want to bring a eye mask.
But all in all good value for money. Nice staff, parking at the premises.
If you want. to see pretty paintings and flashy decor then visit one of the great Parisian museums and book this place to dream about what  you saw.

author: Samuel V
title: Satisfied
text: A nice hotel with excellent staf. It was what we looks for. Not a LOT of tourists that we think is rather nice.

author: Nora N
title: Great Place
text: Great place to stay. Comfortable, friendly staff, excellent dining nearby, easy access to Metro, and the air conditioning works!

author: Mason Z
title: A small, fine hotel.
text: Very attentive staff, good connections, nice bistros. With the family, we were in Paris for 2 days, and there is a good metro connection.

author: Megan P
title: Peter B
text: Do not eat in the restaurant, it is an acoustic desaster. The menu is very limited and totally without any vegetables. The uniformed dressing among staff is a joke.

author: Abigail T
title: Deplorable hotel.
text:
Thieves! The hotel does not live up to its reputation, prices are excessive, a real scam, tiny room, dishonest management, not professional at all. 
Avoid it; this is the worst hotel of our entire lives.

author: Pierre Q
title: Very good value for money.
text: The location of the hotel is perfect for a visit to Paris on a limited budget. Two very well-connected metro stations are within a short distance, and it is also only about a 20-minute walk to the particularly trendy Marais district. There is a convenient underground garage, but it is only accessible for smaller cars. The breakfast has room for improvement, which is completely acceptable given the price. The rooms are very quiet, but the renovation status has gaps. What really bothered us was the long hair of the previous tenant in the bathroom. Those who can live with small flaws will be very well accommodated here.

author: Zoe B
title: Disappointed
text: A spacious but outdated hotel. Spacious quadruple room but the bathroom is very small and poorly lit. Holes in the walls that should be filled! Nonexistent decor. Hearty breakfast but basic quality. Disappointed with the value for money.

author: Wyatt V
title: Very dated hotel
text: I wouldn't recommend this hotel at all. Service was below average and the facilities were very poor. The staff didnt speak much english so sometimes was hard to communicate.

author: Kyle D
title: Good place
text: The location of the hotel was very good, and good service. The breakfast area was quite small and quite little space to walk between the tables. But otherwise good breakfast.

author: Lucas H
title: Parisian stopover
text: Good location for reaching Notre Dame in the Marais district and a few steps from the Bastille. A beautiful interior garden equipped with small tables and corners for a break. Our garden-view room was spacious and had all the comforts. We did not test the breakfast because we preferred the Parisian boulangeries.

author: Camille X
title: Enjoyable with amenities within walking distance.
text: My husband and I were on a short get away. The front desk and restaurant staff were attentive and friendly. The room was perfect and housekeeping was great. The hotel is close to shops including a pharmacy and a grocery store, very handy. Strongly recommend.

author: Jack D
title: Anniversary stay
text:
We booked a 4 night break to celebrate our 30th wedding anniversary and we had a fantastic stay from start to finish.
The check in was very smooth and quick and we were very impressed with our room overlooking the courtyard.
The beds were a great size and very comfy.
We went for breakfast the first morning and was really impressed with the decor of the breakfast room and the food offering.
The hotel is very close to some great bars and restaurants and also close to the metro to visit all the landmarks.
I would recommend this as a great place to stay to visit all the Paris Landmarks.

author: Gavin Q
title: Our stay was a big disappointment, poor service, inadequate organization, an unkempt and outdat
text:
This hotel was a big disappointment.
Even before our arrival, we had reserved a table for dinner, but never received a response. Upon our arrival, we discovered that the hotel restaurant was closed. The parking space reserved for us was also already occupied by another vehicle.
The elevator in the building where our room was located seemed to have been out of service for weeks. So we had to walk the way to the 4th floor every time in the intense heat. Manage the floor via a very unattractive staircase. The employee dragged and hauled our suitcases up the stairs. Given the way they were dragged over the steps, one almost got the impression that the staircase was being intentionally wiped down at the same time. 
The room was old, worn out, and in poor condition.
The low point, however, was the breakfast: In the breakfast room in the basement, the same rags used to wipe the tables were subsequently used for the floor as well. That seemed extremely unhygienic and unappetizing.
How this hotel got its four stars remains a mystery to me. Unfortunately, we cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Wyatt I
title: Perfect hotel in perfect location
text:
Wow! Perfect hotel. For some reason we walked from the train station ( via everywhere) a good 60 minute walk. Supermarket 1 minute walk from the hotel.
The reception was having work done but no bother to is. The courtyard was stunning as we walked to the room. 
Oh my what an amazing room!!
Kitchenette, fridge, bath, and such a comfortable bed!!
Clean and perfect. Staff were amazing and helpful. 
Great location. Quite in your room with bustling bars and cafes surrounding. 
Highly recommend. .

author: Abigail T
title: Expensive for “ average” , room for improvement.
text: Great location, very clean, we had jr suite so space ok, ac worked well in room. Bar area ..inside no air con and infrequent staff attention so no atmosphere.Staff slow . Front desk..not enough desks , congested , slow. Errors on bill. Restaurant - inside bar area ..too hot . Had one simple meal ..food ok.Breakfast very good. Overall we were lucky , we heard ( from staff) many people were not , especially due to faulty air con which in July is not acceptable.

author: Sean T
title: Nice spot for walks and bars
text: Just ok. Great if you’re not in the hotel much and just want somewhere to sleep.

author: Lily T
title: Staff were wonderful
text:
Although we had some challenges with the hotel in terms of the air conditioning and getting the room type that we reserved the staff made our stay worth it. We especially want to thank Penny, who works in the breakfast room and is originally from the UK. She truly went out of her way to be helpful, kind, and welcoming.

On our first day, she provided us with helpful directions and information about the Marais. Throughout our stay, she always greeted us warmly and asked about our activities, making us feel genuinely welcome and at home. On our final day, she even touched us with a sweet parting gift—a personalized drawing of us in Paris with her waving goodbye.

My granddaughter, Finley, would also like to share her thoughts:
"Penny was very kind. She made us feel welcome in a place where we were unfamiliar. She was always there to talk or help us. I found this very sweet. Thank you, Penny! ❤️"

author: Harper Z
title: Poor hotel, 3 star not 4.
text: The rooms are 3 star not 4. The shower is in bath tub with no room to move around. Dated room in general, location wise it is a bit far from all the tourist places. My room also had a broken  Toilet seat. I had breakfast included which is very basic and average quality. This is a 3 star hotel at best.

author: Holly Z
title: Penny at breakfast made out stay
text:
Lovely hotel 

Rooms clean and bright plus bring spacious and well decorated 

Penny at breakfast , made our stay . Great service with a smile . She decorated our table with balloons for my friends birthday . Although she was busy , she made us feel special . Thank you

author: James P
title: Could not be worse
text: I stayed at that hotel for nine nights. The misfortunes that occurred were so many that it would not fit here to recount all of them. The last straw was when, upon arriving at night and wanting to take a shower, there was no bath mat, even though I had carefully left everything picked up so that it would not be taken for washing. Since the floor was marble, I knew I would slip. I went down to look for that mat, which was so necessary if I didn't want to break my neck. I told the man at the reception and he replied that he could not give it to me, that they would bring it to the room. He forgot it and no one brought me anything. I had to take a shower like that, and of course, I slipped... as if I had broken something. They did not care, just as they do not care about the opinion I might express here, because I am just one Spanish person and not a group of convention. I called indignantly, and that was when they sent it to me. When the next day she recounted everything that had happened to me, a young Spanish woman attended to me and said, "we will try to compensate you." I do not seek any compensation, just the service I have paid for. In the evening, there was a tiny box with four mini truffles... I suppose as compensation (for having to go up the stairs with my suitcase upon my arrival, since the workers did not clear the elevator, due to a refrigerator that was not working and much more). With those truffles (which I returned), there was a message explaining that they did not engage in acts of discrimination. So if I had been the daughter of a magnate and so many mishaps had happened to me, they would have given me that little box too. The next day, they put a plate with fruit in front of me: some grapes, an orange, an apple, and a kiwi (I think). If I had broken my foot, they would surely have brought the fruits to the hospital. When I left, a pleasant woman could only say, "I am sorry." I am fed up: I feel sorry for myself, paying for a service and receiving what I received. It could not be worse. It is the French politeness: they apologize, but first, they have caused you trouble.

author: Chloe F
title: Not Worth 4 Stars
text: It's listed as a 4 star boutique hotel, definitely overrated. Upon arrival, the front desk was significantly understaffed given the large number of guests waiting to check-in (30-45 min per guest). Spotty service in all areas for the most part. For example,  It took 3 attempts to get a bucket of ice. In the end we went to the restaurant and got it ourselves. Our room was definitely not what we booked or expected considering we paid for a 4 star room. Upon check- out from our 6th floor room, the only elevator in our wing was broken and there was little in the way of help with bags from bell staff. On the positive side, the location was good.  Overall, we would not stay at this hotel again.

author: Henry O
title: Awful.  The rooms are tired, our room faced a dingy staircase and the lift wasn’t working.  We are really disappointed
text:
Awful experience, so noisy and
A tired hotel

author: Ian T
title: Alberto was amazing.
text: Fabulous hotel, beautiful, clean rooms, and good food. Buffet breakfast with a huge variety of both sweet and savory options. I recommend it.

author: Paige I
title: Les Jardins Du Marais
text: If you are wondering if you can stay in Paris at a clean, quiet neighborhood hotel in the happening Marais fairly cheaply, the answer is YES. Located on Rue Amelot, the hotel has 263 rooms; however, it feels cozy and quaint.  There is an outdoor courtyard where one could read, eat, or talk with a friend. There is a small gym and wellness area. The beds are comfortable and clean, and there is a/c.  The staff is very friendly and kind.  It is a no-nonsense type of place, which was what I was in the mood for, and you can't beat the location.  There are tons of fantastic restaurants and cafes nearby, and it's only a hop, skip, and a jump to the Musée Picasso and Musée Carnavalet.

author: William D
title: Flawless.
text: Nice city hotel. The courtyard is particularly nice. Like a small garden, so green. Nice rooms, solid. Very friendly staff. Great breakfast.

author: Megan D
title: Helpful staff and comfortable room
text: This is a comfortable hotel within easy reach of the sights. The room was small but nice, and the breakfast was very good.  We were lucky that we had good weather, as you need to go outside across the courtyard to get to the breakfast room. I wouldn't recommend it for people with mobility problems because there are a lot of steps and uneven flooring to get into the building. Also, in our room, there was a step-in bath with the shower over the bath, but no handrail to help people with mobility problems to climb in safely. Maybe there are special rooms with walk-in showers if you ask. The staff were very helpful; they managed to find the passport that one of our party had left in the room and send it to the airport in time for the flight, for which we are extremely grateful!

author: Gavin U
title: Average hotel in a convenient location
text: This is a perfectly fine hotel in a very convenient location with a very good breakfast. We checked in very late in the evening after a long day sightseeing, however, we were a bit disappointed to find that our room was very strangely located outside the fire door at the top of some emergency fire stairs. It meant that I felt uneasy leaving our valuables there when we were out and most importantly, the room was very cold. The room itself was small with a tiny bathroom but for one night it was fine. Thankfully, the breakfast was very good. If you're expecting modern day four stars, this is not the hotel for you.

author: Charlie Q
title: Four-Star Prices, Budget Hotel Quality - do not go!
text:
If you are looking for a true four-star hotel experience in Paris, don’t make our mistake. Read the reviews carefully and take them seriously.

This hotel is a depressing, dated three-star property at best. The only redeeming quality is the courtyard, but considering how enormous the hotel is, it’s not difficult to invest in one attractive common area while leaving hundreds of rooms feeling neglected and subpar.

The rooms are old, tired, and clearly designed to do the absolute minimum required to maintain a four-star rating. There is nothing refined or enjoyable about staying here. In fact, the room itself feels so bleak that our main goal became spending as little time in it as possible.

There is no attention to detail whatsoever. Bathroom amenities consist of a shampoo/body wash combo only, no conditioner, no thoughtful touches, just the bare minimum. The complimentary tea is cheap Lipton. The wall-mounted hose hairdryer looks like it belongs in a budget hotel from 20 years ago. The lighting has the harsh glow of a McDonald’s. In a city as beautiful as Paris, the decor feels like a complete afterthought. The plastic silver wall lights are particularly awful.

There is a visible lack of maintenance and cleanliness. The bathroom had grime and mildew buildup around the shower trim and sealant, deteriorating caulking, and visible mineral stains. These are not minor cosmetic issues, they are signs of a hotel that is no longer being properly maintained.

The rooms also smell old, and the soundproofing is practically nonexistent. You hear everything.

What makes the experience especially frustrating is how many corners feel intentionally cut. Our room included a small kitchenette with an old dishwasher and hot plate, yet the only dishes provided were two wine glasses and a sign saying additional items could be requested. It perfectly captures the overall feeling of the hotel: outdated features they don’t want to properly maintain or remove, combined with an unwillingness to spend money on basic guest comfort.

Even the TVs feel outdated and restrictive. There is no practical way to stream or watch movies, which feels absurdly behind the times for a hotel at this price point.

Some negative hotel reviews come down to a one-off mistake or bad luck, and I understand that things happen. But our issue was not a unique incident, it was the actual quality of the hotel itself. Some reviews suggest certain buildings or rooms are better than others, but we specifically asked to move rooms and ended up seeing five different rooms during our stay. They all had the same problems. So if you are hoping you might just get one of the “good” rooms, I would not count on it.

author: Molly Y
title: Perfect
text: This hotel was perfect for us! Room was clean & beds are comfortable! Nice outdoor area to relax. Great neighborhood. Lots of restaurants within walking distance & a market a few doors down.

author: Ryan G
title: Paris is always worth a mass
text: Clean hotel and logistically well-placed, near the Seine, with the subway very close. Room up to Ibis standards, but super comfortable bed complete with a topper. The policy of only one large towel per person does not satisfy us much, but by now we have gotten used to it. If we really want to find a flaw, the luggage storage service pre-check-in or post-check-out is for a fee via automatic lockers.

author: Thomas T
title: Perfect stay.
text: Excellent location, small room but functional for two people. Perfect breakfast with plenty of choices between sweet and savory. The hotel lobby is very welcoming, fast check-in. Possibility to leave luggage after check-out.

author: Ian H
title: Two night stay
text: We had a fantastic 2 night stay here while in Paris. The hotel is just a short walk from the metro stations with good connections to the airport and central Paris. We arrived quite early but there was a room ready so we were able to check in earlier than we should have. There are 300 rooms at this hotel! The room had aircon which was adequate. A small bathroom which was ok and the room was very clean. Staff here were so helpful and friendly. There are chargeable lockers if you need to store luggage and there are safe deposit boxes that are free to use all in a seperate location behind the check in desks. Breafast was a great experience all the standard cheese ham etc. The bar was very resonable with the prices and they have an happy hour. Nice coaktails too. Our room was on the top floor with a great view of the Bastille column. A pefect stay.

author: Mason P
title: Excellent experience.
text: Very well served by public transport. Small room and small bathroom. Good breakfast. Super kind staff.

author: Daniel Z
title: Great stay for 2 weeks
text:
I was a bit concerned having read previous reviews, but I would absolutely stay here again! I stayed for two weeks for a business trip. The location is absolutely outstanding - close to so many different eateries, grocery stores, pharmacies, metro stations etc. A great market is just down the street each Thursday and Sunday. 

I stayed on the 7th (top) floor. The room was impeccably clean and the air conditioning was great! Comfy bed and ample space to hang clothing, unpack, and a good sized desk/chair to work from if necessary. Lots of outlets and lighting options too. I do agree that the bathroom is an odd layout/quite small, but for a solo stay it was not a problem at all. 

It does seem like there are some rooms right next to the elevators, so I'd ask for one away from these. The breakfast is repetitive, but if it is included in your rate I'm not sure I would pay extra to have the breakfast when there are so many other options in the area. Note that they do not have irons/ironing boards in the rooms - they instead have an ironing room on the fourth floor which is not suitable (iron was dirty, board needs replaced, not a pleasant smell in the ironing room). This needs to be improved.

Other than that, great location and I'll stay here again next time I'm in Paris.

author: Luke L
title: To avoid
text:
The only positive point of my review was the location of the hotel.

Upon our arrival, we were welcomed by Julio, who gave us the two room keys. He briefly explained that there is a bar and that breakfast is to the left!!!

We went up to our room and to our surprise, there were open suitcases and toiletries in the bathroom. 

We went back down to Julio, who told us that it was not possible, our room is empty, empty, empty, and empty. He even spoke to us rudely. We insisted, and he asked his colleague for advice… and he returned to us saying that he is dyslexic and that he had mixed up the rooms!!!!! He did not apologize, modified the keys, and got up to go drink a glass of water according to his words!!!

Upon our arrival in the
 room, it was a cold shower; for a room at 294 euros, we expected to have something better, but especially in better condition. For two people… 2 towels, no towels for hands or hair.  The next day, passing by the reception, we informed them that there were missing towels, and we were told that it was just. For ecological (or economic?) reasons, that is how it is. 
Very small room and not well maintained, tiny bathroom.
The photos will speak for themselves. I do not recommend this hotel.

author: Harper H
title: A tourist trap
text:
On the positive side, the location of the Hotel and the lobby downstairs. 

On the negative side, the price, quite high, the tiny size of the rooms where walking around the bed becomes a problem if you are two people. Forget it if you have bulky luggage. The shower room is tiny too. All the equipment is very dated and could do with a change. Unconfortable beddings too. 

We chose this Hotel for a family reunion at the occasion of a wedding in Paris. Most of us travelled very long distance to get there. And this choice was definitely a mistake.

author: Antoine R
title: Tiny budget level rooms
text: 2 stars for reception area and staff only. The rooms are tiny and no better than a budget hotel. I would avoid and

author: Chloe W
title: Pleasant Stay
text: The hotel is very nice and the staff extremely helpful. Only downside for me is the bed being too soft and the mattress moving and sliding off the bed. Toilet difficult to manoeuvre. Breakfast very good.

author: William H
title: Poor Cleaning, Good Staff
text: We stayed for two days and unfortunately the room was not cleaned at all during our stay. The bedsheets were never changed and there was an unpleasant smell in the room. This made the experience quite uncomfortable. On the positive side, the staff were friendly and helpful.

author: Jessica D
title: Perfect.
text:
Excellent welcome with a smile!
Very nice decoration inside the hotel and very spacious.
The room is quite small but functional and sufficient for short stays.
Breakfast is excellent with everything you can look for in a buffet.
The hotel is very well located (near the place de la bastille, 5mns walk)

author: Jessica D
title: Basic but good value for money hotel
text:
We stayed 2 nights at this hotel in March 2026 with a couple of friends.
The hotel is conveniently located in a quiet and neat neighbourhood, 150 m from Bréguet-Sabin Metro Station and 300 m from Bastille Metro Station (where 3 metro lines meet).
The hotel is fairly recent, has 300 rooms and has 3 stars (official category).
The rooms are small but functional, everything is basic.
There is a bar and a restaurant (limited menu).
For its 3 stars the breakfast is extensive, good quality (especially the different types of fresh bread) and very favorable in price (12 euros).
In the spacious neighborhood (Place de la Bastille) there are several restaurants and brasseries.
Conclusion: good hotel with a favourable price/quality ratio, sufficient for a stay of several nights.

author: Ana K
title: Nice hotel, good location, good price
text:
Clean, small room, couple of coat hooks, TV, hair dryer. Mini bath. Small desk, storage area for 1 suitcase. For the small shower you must not be heavily pregnant or severely overweight. Unfortunately, it also leaks despite the door and floods the bathroom. The shower does not attach well and turns away when the water runs.
Little storage space in the bathroom.

For Paris, the room is 'normal'. For 2 adults actually too small, but if it's just for sleeping, it goes. The window can be opened, but from Wednesday onwards there is a lot going on in the streets in the surrounding bistros, where people sit outside and eat and talk. Traffic noise is not strong, though.

My duvet was too warm for the season and the bed was kind of strange- in the middle of the double bed was like a raised arch of the mattress, so lying obliquely or transversely could not. But you don't have to:-)  

You can also sit outside at the ibis. There is also a bar and a nicely designed foyer with cosy armchairs and lots of green plants. I think it's very pretty. 

Breakfast is great by French standards, there are far more than just croissants with jam- eg eggs, scrambled eggs, ham, cheese, pastries, fruit and cereals. Also juice, tea and coffee, with the coffee tasting really terrible.

The location is great, easy access to the metro and directly many options for dining around, as well as supermarkets and bars.
The Marais is within walking distance.

In the house there are lockers for the suitcases.

For an ibis really nice, I would come back!

author: Tyler O
title: Overall a good stay
text:
We stayed at the property from 13/02 to 16/02/26 .The hotel is located in a very convenient area to the metro stop which is 5 minutes from Gare de Lyion station. Convenient for every move. The area is quiet full of restaurants and cafes. The reception staff was on every occasion kind and helpful. The structure is furnished in a simple and comfortable way rich in plants, water supply , spaces to eat and relax in complete relaxation. The rooms are a bit small but for those staying for a few days and just have to sleep there I would say it is perfect. Very convenient express check out: you pay the tourist tax upon arrival and on the day of departure you hand over the key card in a special box that makes everything smoother and quicker.
The room was clean and warm. The only flaw is one large towel per person, I would say another for the face would have been appreciated. 
The breakfast/dinner area is really nice furnished in a simple and pleasant way that gives a sense of peace and that slightly retro feeling of the Parisian atmosphere.
We took advantage of the half-board service with a dinner voucher worth 70€ , which includes food and drinks, and you pay, possibly the overrun.   The breakfast buffet is very simple, but characterized by local products from sweet to savory. Dinner went well two nights out of three, although the menu remained practically the same for the three days, but the quality of the food is great and the waiter Nathanell (I hope it's written that way) was exceptional of extreme kindness and always available and smiling, even in the evening when, due to a mix-up in the kitchen, our waiting times were prolonged a lot. The staff made up for it by buying us drinks the same night and the next. Their apologies paid off for the mishap that had been created.  

Overall it was a good stay. Thanks go to the hotel staff who followed us from the beginning to the end of the stay.

author: Juan K
title: A hostel disguised as a 3 star hotel
text: Quiet area, well served, with many local nearby. Hotel to forget. Suitable for young people on a school trip (and in fact there were two groups of Spanish and British students), but not for adults. Small room, no wardrobe, with a micro-desk and only one chair (room for two!). Narrow bathroom, looks like a camper van. Bath towels for shower only, no face/hand towels. Heating management incomprehensible. Cleaning? In short! Dust on the shelves of the shelf that should replace the cabinet and on the headboard, hair in the shower. Good mattress, while the pillows were torture: 4 pillows all the same and all very high; I suffered for the cervical all 3 days of stay. Breakfast barely acceptable regarding food, but unacceptable for service. Self-service counter, with small tray where you have to put everything from cutlery to plate, to the foods you chose, university canteen style (it took me back 50 years!). It looks more like a hostel than a 3-star hotel. To avoid!

author: Evie R
title: BEST BIRTHDAY GIFT
text: I spent my birthday night at Ibis Bastille Opera and it was the best present my friend could have got me. People who work there are amazing, welcoming and have always a smile on their face which is one of the first thing you bring home after a vacation. The atmosphere is warm and cozy and once I got into the room I found balloons, cookies and a little birthday card from the staff. They do really care about their guests. I woke up the day after and had a delicious breakfast, with good coffee and various selection of food. The waiter and waitress made me start the day with the right mood. Thank you for this amazing and memorable experience.

author: Ian Z
title: Too average
text:
Dormitory hotel: you sleep there, nothing more... On that side, nothing wrong. It is well located, clean and the staff is really charming and welcoming.
On the other hand, the services are extremely basic... The bathrooms are tiny and limit themselves to providing two cardboard cups and shower gel... Same observation for the room: no water, no safe, no tissues, no coffee... strict minimum.
The atmosphere of the rooms is austere! 
The automatic deposit system is also difficult to access when travelling with large luggage.
I have nothing against this hotel per se, but the value for money is clearly excessive. At €90 per night, this remains consistent. Beyond that, especially when prices exceed €200, it simply becomes unjustifiable. At this price, it’s better to pass its way because there are other clearly more interesting proposals in the sector! 
The only highlight of this hotel is its employees and location!

author: Sara Z
title: An elegant, comfortable and convenient structure
text:
An excellent experience because the structure is elegant, the accommodation in the room is very comfortable, and 5 minutes you are metro.The staff is highly qualified and about this We want to thank The receptionist Angelica, True Strength for Us Italians.He indicated with scrupulousness all the various points and places of interest with so much accuracy.(Our next stop will be Disneyland, and we will definitely choose this hotel again for the hospitality we received from Angelica)The breakfast is Great and prepared with Gusto. Consiglio this 'Hotel.
Fusco Gerardo family.
Greetings from Nicolas.

author: Sara O
title: Practical
text: Very good to enjoy the city light. Great hotel and restaurant! Normal room for Paris, very high quality breakfast to enjoy even outside

author: Amelia M
title: Very pleased
text: Hotel is at a very good location accessible easily by public transport. There are many food and drink places near it or at walking distance. Room was comfortable and clean. Hotel staff was very friendly, kind and focused on client pleasure. Breakfast was satlsfactory. We left very happy to get the service of that we had paid.

author: Chloe G
title: My first choice
text: Grand Hotel Français is my first choice when visiting Paris. This is a quality hotel which is quiet, clean and comfortable and well-situated for local commerce and for transport to all areas of Paris. The staff are professional and helpful and you are made to feel welcome. Any issues are resolved immediately. Special thanks to Assia and Bryan for their professional and friendly service and to the manager for his generosity. I look forward to my next visit.

author: Evie S
title: EXCELLENT
text: We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. Everything was great, very clean, the staff was very friendly and polite and always willing to help. Also, metro is very close and it was very convenient for us.

author: Julien C
title: Nothing to report
text: Pretty good and consistent with the establishment

author: Ella T
title: I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel.
text:
I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel.

Pros:
The staff were extremely friendly, professional, and always responsive to any requests or questions.
The location is excellent and very convenient for getting around.
 The hotel was clean, and the facilities were good considering the price.
 It offers great value for money.

Cons:

The only downside was that it could be a bit noisy at times.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this hotel, especially if you’re looking for a comfortable stay with a great location and excellent service at a reasonable price.

author: Joseph R
title: Excellent Stay
text:
We had a lovely stay at this small hotel. The rooms were comfortable, the breakfast was delicious with a good selection, and the staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always happy to help.

The location is excellent, just a few steps from the metro, making it very easy to explore Paris.

We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely return. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Thomas L
title: A magnificent stay at the Grand Hotel Francais
text: This magnificent hotel has everything needed to be more than satisfied: beautiful well-equipped rooms, welcoming and attentive staff, exceptional breakfast, and the metro nearby in a truly vibrant Parisian neighborhood. I have already been there twice and I will surely return during my next visit to Paris

author: Freya R
title: Great stay
text:
Great location near metro stop and people here , friendly and accommodating. Air conditioning worked perfectly.
Breakfast was delicious

author: Brooke T
title: Staff are amazing- would recommend!
text: Went for a short trip with my friend and we were welcomed and assisted very nicely by all the staff. Room was clean and area was safe. The staff went above and beyond to accommodate our needs and ensured we had a pleasant stay in Paris! Would recommend

author: Thomas J
title: Great hotel!
text: Great experience! I really loved it. Super friendly staff, everything was perfect.

author: Evan D
title: From two happy returning visitors
text: We love the Grand Hotel Français. We have stayed there several times over the years and the more times we visit Paris, the more we appreciate the hotel's location and especially its staff. ZIYAD and his colleagues made us feel welcome every day of our stay. In fact we have already booked two more stays there for our Paris trips this summer August and September. It's hard to find such reasonable rates in the runaway inflation of 2026 Paris and such service with a smile.

author: Lucy S
title: If you stay in Paris right here
text: The location is of course and very friendly reception and fantastic welcome drinks. Old but clean interior. Everything is perfect.

author: Liam E
title: Very good!!
text: Fantastic staff!! The girl who welcomed us was excellent, and the rooms were perfect. I recommend it to everyone.

author: Nora V
title: Excellent customer service
text:
Assia is incredibly kind and very helpful during our stay. A special mention for the excellent service and friendliness of Jean at breakfast. We are delighted with our stay at the Grand French Hotel. 

Francine and Guylaine

author: Nora U
title: Fantastic
text: Went to the Grand Hotel Francais in May. It was by far the best Hotel I’ve been to in Paris. The concierge were excellent and very accommodating. I will be staying here on all my Paris trips from now on

author: Gavin I
title: Nice hotel centrally in paris
text:
Really cozy hotel m good location, good atmosphere and service
We look forward to coming again

author: George Y
title: A wonderful, low key option in Paris.
text: A wonderful, low key option in Paris. My daughter and I spent a fantastic two nights at the Grand Hotel Francais. While this is not an ultra exclusive five star establishment, it is a very comfortable, quiet, clean and friendly hotel in a great area of town: lots of nice cafes and restaurants in the area; a short walk to various Metro lines; and very accommodating and friendly staff. Highly recommended.

author: Laura U
title: Great hotel, wonderful staff
text: Great hotel with a fantastic, friendly staff always willing to help make your stay a good one.  Clean rooms with a great shower.  Walking distance to the cemetery.  Not in the center of Paris but in a nice, quiet neighborhood.

author: Samuel R
title: Beautiful Anniversary Stay 💖
text: Loved our stay! Super friendly and kind staff! Upgraded us for our wedding anniversary, left a bottle of wine and a beautiful little note congratulating us on our anniversary which we're all just lovely touches which made us feel very special! Thank you so much!

author: Katie G
title: Reception triples the value at the end of the stay.
text: It was a good experience during the whole stay, I only had problems in the morning at the time of check-out of the older gentleman who stays there wanting to triple the value of the tourist fee. If you are staying there be careful because a hotel want to fool a foreigner with higher values is very sad, the room service, cleaning and the receptionists in the afternoon and evening are very cordial.

author: Mathis G
title: Everything is perfect in this hotel
text:
A shared pleasure every time I visit this hotel 
Exceptional cleanliness
Immaculate welcome 
High-end quality bedding 
And a delicious breakfast 
Everything is perfect 
With an extraordinary kindness of staff 
Of course I'll come back.

author: Lucas W
title: A good position.
text:
We spent three nights here in our campervan and overall, had a good experience. The pitch was an ample size and on the outskirts of the site. Navigating pulling onto the pitch was made a little stressful by children running around or riding bikes without consideration for the hazards all around them.
Reception staff were friendly and helpful plus the shuttle bus took us into the city centre as expected and for just a small cost.
The toilet area wasn't always very clean but much of this is down to the timings of servicing and how the site's occupants are prepared to leave the facilities after their own use.. As guests, I believe we have a responsibility to each other to leave as we would expect to find.

author: Kyle Y
title: Excellent
text:
The campsite is located on the outskirts of Paris, in the Bois de Boulogne area, a wooded area much quieter than the city. It is still convenient for sightseeing. You can reach line 1 of the Metro with the campsite shuttle or by public bus in 15 minutes. 
We stayed in the Roulotte mobile home with 4 beds for a week. The facility is comfortable and clean. Inside the little house there is everything you need, including 2 fans and a table for eating outside. 
Inside the campsite there is a bar-restaurant that we did not try with a relaxation area with TV, foosball and pool table, a small market and a large playground for children. There is also a small laundry room, with coin-operated washing machines 
The atmosphere is very relaxing because there are comfortable tables and chairs on which you can sit.
The only drawback is that the Wi-Fi almost never worked

author: Julien X
title: Poor accommodation
text:
Nice base to explore Paris 
Shuttle bus is convenient, but not free. A day ticket for metro and bus is cheaper. Our 4 person tent was outdated and in poor condition. The fridge smelled bad, the zipper of the awning was broken and the tent was dirty.  This was very disappointing. The other tents on the campsite were in good condition. We have filed a complaint, but nothing has been done about it. The plumbing is not always clean. Restaurant is fine.

author: Ruby E
title: Good location, the rest disappointing
text:
The location is clearly the biggest plus point of this campsite. Paris is easily accessible by shuttle, Uber, taxi, or bicycle. The site is located directly on the Seine, is easy to reach, offers plenty of shade, and a nice playground. Communication before arrival was also fast and uncomplicated.

Unfortunately, that is almost where the positives end. Despite the stated size of our rig, we were given a pitch that was far too small. The sanitary facilities were disappointing: cold showers with no water pressure, constantly clogged toilets, and sometimes a strong smell of decay at the washhouse. Anyone who gets a pitch near the RV dump station has to endure an unbearable stench every time a tank is emptied.

The security situation was particularly negative: An air fryer was stolen from our awning at night, and during our stay, e-bikes including a trailer were stolen from other guests. The reception showed hardly any interest in this and merely referred us to the police. Even promised checks of the surveillance cameras came to nothing.

The bike rental was also poorly organized, as there were almost never enough bikes available. Overall, this campsite lives almost exclusively off its good location – unfortunately, that is not enough for us.

author: Adam J
title: Extremely Disappointing Stay
text:
This was by far the worst accommodation we have ever stayed in. The chalet was clearly not cleaned before our arrival. It was full of dust, with cobwebs everywhere 🕸️, several spiders 🕷️, and even spider nests in different areas of the chalet. It felt neglected and very unhygienic.

To make matters worse, there was no air conditioning, which made the chalet unbearably hot. The only two fans provided were covered in dust and dirt, making them unpleasant to use.

The most shocking discovery was finding a tube of personal hemorrhoid cream left behind in one of the cupboards 🤮. This should have been removed during cleaning and was completely unacceptable.

Overall, the chalet was dirty, poorly maintained, and far below the standard we expected. We left as soon as we could because we simply didn’t feel comfortable staying there.

I would not recommend this place to anyone and definitely would not stay here again.

author: Claire N
title: Shameful!
text:
Attention campers without vehicles, you will all be crammed into one corner of the campsite, on a mound of dirt, with tents close to each other. Of course, this is not specified when booking by phone.
Note that the campsite is half empty on this weekend of June 26
When we express our dissatisfaction at the reception, we are asked to pay more for a "real spot." It is impossible to speak with a manager; we must send our complaint by email (even though we are on site, strange). This was done in 10 minutes, but we received no response to our email during our 3-day stay. Scandalous.
For €160 for 3 nights without electricity, privacy, and comfort, it is shameful. What justifies such a price?
An empty spot is worth €20 to €30 throughout the rest of France, who are we kidding?
The exclusivity of camping in Paris does not give the right to mock people.
Especially when there is no hot water in the showers, regardless of the time of day or night.
We will not return and will pay for an Airbnb next time; we will know why we are spending money.
Positive point: clean restrooms.

author: Isabella W
title: Avoid this campground.
text:
Campground with great potential as it is ideally located at the gates of Paris, with nice facilities (restaurant and grocery store).

However: 
- overpriced: €150/night for a tent that is in very poor condition (dirty, stained, barely cleaned). 
- tent next to the dam, making sleep complicated if not impossible due to the noise. 
- nonexistent welcome, no information about the campground or anything else. 
- restaurant with nice decor, but you have to serve yourself, clear your own table; in fact, there is no service, yet the prices are excessive. 
- grocery store that could have been nice but is empty, thus of no interest. 
- the tent does not match the photos on the site; we expected much better. 

I do not recommend and will not return to this "money pit."

author: Molly Q
title: Robbery without weapons
text:
The place itself is good, especially the location.Also the infrastructure is right. What doesn't fit is the arrogant staff. Due to an unforeseen event, I had to cancel my stay in April. The campsite has collected the prepaid 380 € space 
and invoke the agb. Never again
!

author: Leo P
title: Carelessness does not pay
text: The campsite as a whole is great but my rating has lowered because being guests of the last stretch as pitch and usufructuaries of the 'last service block, we found ourselves without any warning, on the return of the day in the city, with the services totally closed. We were not the only guests in that area and it seemed to me a very incorrect choice.

author: Holly R
title: Camping nice but can do better
text: Location too far from the reception. Moreover, the people at the reception are not very welcoming or accommodating. Worried about electricity with regular cuts. On the other hand, the positive is the restaurant with great employees.

author: Hugo M
title: Restaurant turns into a discotheque
text:
Camping and buildings really very good. I have been visiting this campsite for a very long time. 
Unfortunately the last time I went there, after transforming the buildings, I think they privatize the restaurant for dance parties. Two nights in a row, Friday and Saturday.
It’s not a problem in itself except that you feel like you’re sleeping next to a nightclub. 
Until more than one o’clock in the morning the music made it difficult for us to sleep.
It was a quiet place, it is not anymore.

author: Ruby T
title: Fantastic stay, fantastic young staff searching for solutions 😉
text:
Fantastic stay, fantastic young staff searching for solutions 😉, 
Great infrastructures, see you soon guys 😉, thanks team

author: Harper E
title: Permanent night sleep disturbances
text:
The cottages are apparently popular with older school classes for multi-day Paris trips. The result: permanent disturbances of the night's sleep (screaming, screeching, running around, blustering, banging on strangers' houses, etc.).
We couldn't really spot a night watch, although at the reception they promised to report the problem to them.
We have intervened several times at the reception and there especially. Harvested shoulder shrugs. One would try to contact the group leaders by phone or e-mail, but would not reach them... 
Unacceptable this lousy support!
This campsite is not recommended for families with younger children.

author: Kyle F
title: Campsite within easy reach of central Paris
text: Camping is located at great distance from the center of Paris, We had bike with us and that was very doable. Spacious place for our camper. Reception was neat and many leaflets and map Paris present. Restaurant and shop with fresh bread rolls in the morning was also fine. Don't expect an extensive menu, supply was limited and at the price. Only the plumbing was terrible, at the showers a mini jet in the morning. The cabins with sink were still going but the toilets were just filthy. Clogged toilets during the days we were there and not clean either. Luckily you could also use the toilets at the restaurant , which were cleaned and were neat.

author: Ruby N
title: Convenient for Paris with a good shuttle bus
text:
The site itself is reasonaubly quiet away from the road, convenient for the centre of Paris and the sanitary blocks are clean and well maintained. 

However, the receptionist initially gave us a small, awkward pitch next to the road and did not indicate that we could have a choice of pitches ; after driving down to the pitch I walked all the way back and explained that it wasn’t suitable for our caravan when she then offered us a slightly better pitch but only after asking what else was available was I offered an acceptable pitch. 

The same thing happened to our neighbour, so is it poor receptionist training, a policy to fill the worst pitches first or laziness on behalf of the receptionists? They need to train the receptionists to explain the types of pitches and ask for the visitors requirements/wishes, ensure that the receptionists know about the popularity/queries for the shuttle bus. They also need to ensure that the shuttle bus drivers do not leave the shuttle stops at Porte Maillot too early.

author: Marta J
title: Halvsløj campingplads
text:
Poor service, dirty toilets, sour staff and biggest minus - a huge road almost through the middle of the square. It sounds completely wild around the clock. It's like sleeping in a tent in the middle discount on the highway ☰
The location in Paris is approximately if you even have bicycles with otherwise it is scot, as it is far from the center and city bicycles have to be parked far away from the campsite.

author: Mathis M
title: By caravan and bicycle in Paris
text:
We were with our own caravan in July 2025 at this place. Cozy facilities with restaurant, small store, cozy space with light chains and seating places where you can sit and enjoy your own drinks or buy something in the bar.

All facilities are relatively new. Clean toilets and baths.

Shuttlebus from the square to metro station every 30 min.
We used our own bicycles, but you could also rent bicycles.

All in all really nice campsite near the center of Paris.

author: Wyatt C
title: Overrated
text:
Claro, aquí tienes la traducción al inglés:

⸻

Very disappointing.
The camping is overrated. The infrastructure is poor: there’s no pool, the cabins have no air conditioning, and worst of all, there’s no nearby parking. You have to walk about 300 meters to reach the cabins with all your luggage. There are no carts available to help, very little assistance overall, and the staff’s attitude was quite disappointing.

author: Mia D
title: Highly recommended
text:
Very friendly staff who speak good English and keep the resort in top condition, easy and cheap transport to town. The store and restaurant are also very affordable, highly recommended.

Next time we go to Paris, this campsite will be the obvious choice.

author: Sophia U
title: Unsafe location for wheelchair users
text: Although the site itself is quite nice, its location is terrible. In particular, the chalets are located right next to a busy, noisy and very polluted main road, with the wheelchair-accessible cabin positioned right next to the entrance/exit gate. As a disabled camper this made me feel extremely unsafe and vulnerable, especially as there did not appear to be any security on site. The chalet was also unbearably hot but because of its location we weren’t able to keep the windows open at night, making it impossible to sleep. As a paraplegic it is extremely important that I don’t overheat as I cannot regulate my body temperature but there were only two fans in the apartment. As result of the heat and location my kid also got sick with heatstroke and we were forced to check out after only one day, despite having paid for 4 nights at over 800 Euros. When I asked for a refund or a compensation voucher as the conditions were wholeheartedly unsuitable for a vulnerable disabled person, I was sent a paltry email saying that they would pass on my comments to the management. Hardly a satisfactory resolution, given the circumstance. This was all extremely disappointing, especially as we had already stayed in 3 other Huttopia sites this holiday and had found the facilities at those sites extremely well thought out and the staff extremely helpful and considerate

author: Paige B
title: Paris
text:
Beautiful hotel close by to Opera and central Paris. 
Room very clean and well appointed with a wonderfully comfortable bed geeat shower and sound proof walls
Decent little cafes locally for an unwind beer or reviving coffee. Metro station Quatre Setembre 2 minute walk. . Extremely helpful staff who attend the reception and who made our stay relaxed.
Can't comment on food because I booked room only. 
If we visited Paris agaim would I be happy to stay here again? 
Absolutely!

author: Lucia Y
title: Worst Hotel Experience Ever – Unsafe, Unhygienic, Disrespectful Staff & Refund Still Missing
text:
The entire stay has been extremely disappointing. The room condition was very poor, with water leaking from the shower and flooding the room, and the overall cleanliness was unacceptable. In addition, the bathroom floor tiles were loose and unstable, posing a safety hazard during our stay.

The elevator was also in very poor condition and highly concerning, as it was used both by guests and for transporting garbage, which is completely unacceptable in a hotel of this standard.

The breakfast experience was equally disturbing. The coffee machine was not functioning, and the cups had a strong unpleasant smell, making them unusable. I also observed serious hygiene concerns, as the same elevator used for waste transportation appeared to be used by staff during service operations. Furthermore, I saw staff handling and preparing food, including cutting fruit, without wearing gloves, which is highly unhygienic.

Additionally, we were unable to sleep due to constant noise from the room above us, which made the stay even more unbearable.

I also had a very serious incident with one staff member who behaved in a rude and aggressive manner, spoke disrespectfully, and threw the room key towards us in front of other guests. Despite the seriousness of this incident, the hotel never even attempted to apologize or properly address what happened.

To make matters worse, the hotel charged a deposit from my card which has still not been refunded despite multiple complaints and providing official bank proof. I spent nearly $3000 on this stay, and honestly it felt like throwing money in the trash. The complete lack of professionalism, accountability, and customer service made this one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had

author: Molly A
title: Fine, but not great
text:
The hotel has a great location and is close to the metro. 
Breakfast I haven't tried, but it's expensive (24 € or 12 € with hot drink, croissants and juice). Nearby there are several boulangeries or bars that serve it at much lower prices.
The rooms are small, the bathroom has a bidet, but is separated from the room with an opaque glass, if used at night it illuminates the room and is not soundproof. In the bathroom there are no support spaces. 
Mini bar, TV and Nespresso for coffee. Everything clean, anyway. Friendly staff, ask deposit of 100€ with card on arrival. 
High price for a hotel like this, because it is not a 4 star. But Paris is quite expensive, so you can accept it.

author: Holly W
title: Great hotel in a great location
text: Great hotel in a great location. Exceptional customer service. Breakfast was fantastic.

author: Ruby X
title: Excellent hotel, great location and top staff
text:
A stay at the Golden Tulip Opera that far exceeded our expectations. The hotel is ideally located, perfect for easy access to Paris.
The staff is really at the top: welcoming, available, smiling, exactly what we hope for when we arrive a little tired or in unforeseen circumstances.
The breakfast is excellent, varied and quality.
Despite the reasons that led us to stay one night in Paris, we had a great stay. An address I recommend without hesitation.

author: William Q
title: Very small room no storage & poor lighting
text:
Was not quite what we expected. We booked a superior room and ended up with a very small room with no storage space to put anything. No draws to store undergarments etc . Small open wardrobe with 5 hangers not enough space for 2 people so we lived out of our suitcase. Bathroom again no storage to put make bag or toiletries bag, except on edge of bath were they got wet when shower was on, so not an ideal place to store. Being short I could just about see the bathroom mirror. Lighting was minimal & very poor which made the room look dark. In Google it mentioned a bar & a sauna & rooftop terrace. However due to the weather we were not interested in the terrace. But never saw a bar which you would assume to be in ground floor, & no mention of a sauna by staff.  The hotel was under renovation on 1st & 2nd floor 
Good points 
Bed was rally comfortable staff were friendly.

author: Katie G
title: Oh, good. We'll be back.
text: Unbeatable situation. Our room was spacious and quiet. Cleaning up ten. Super friendly staff and basic breakfast but plenty needed to start the day.

author: Oliver Z
title: The best
text: This was our 7th visit at this hotel and if Paris was not so far from home, we would visit more often.  It's well situated, quiet, clean and the staff are all friendly and helpfull.  Breakfast is amazing with something for everyone's taste.  It's walking distance from the Louvre, le Palais Garnier, les Galeries Lafayette and many good restaurants.  But what makes us come back is how everyone wants to make sure you're enjoying your stay and how they make us feel special.  Once you get to know all these friendly people, you will also want to come back. I highly recommend.

author: Sean B
title: Great stay in such a good location
text: A lovely boutique style hotel that was in a brilliant location .  It was central for the Louvre , the Seine, Notre Dame and more . Lots of excellent restaurants in the area. The staff were friendly . The room was comfortable although not enough space for clothes to be put away and the breakfast was just enough for the start of the day . A good stay

author: Poppy P
title: Good location without more
text: The location is perfect. Normal breakfast. Check-in time very late, at 14 hours and check-out time very early, at 11:00.

author: Kyle C
title: IF YOU ARE A TRAVEL AGENT BE CAREFUL!!!!!!!!!
text:

author: Taylor D
title: Good experience...
text:
Cute boutique hotel right in the opera district of Paris.  Easy walk to public transit. Also an easy walk to the louvre and gardens.  Slightly longer walk to other tourist destinations but still walkable.

The hotel still uses keys as opposed to key cards.  You'll be given your key and asked to turn it in each time you leave.  Its a fun thing I only see in Europe anymore.  The staff is friendly and dropping off/getting your key won't take any significant time.

The rooms are a bit tight as you won't have much room to walk around your bed. Still, for the heart of Paris you'll be fine.  The AC works but you won't be too cold so be ready if you visit Paris in a heat wave like I did.

Breakfast was included with my stay and I have to say I loved it.  Plenty of options and open long enough to either grab quickly in the morning or grab a bit after a healthy run.

Net, an overall solid experience for my week stay. I'd recommend!

author: Amelia X
title: Great  Hotel
text:
What a lovely hotel. We stayed in room 210. Really nice., spacious room. Very clean 

Hotel is easy to find  in a great location.  All the hotel staff were friendly, helpful., nothing was too much trouble. 

Breakfast was really good. Varied selection that was replenished regularly . 

We will definitely stay here again.

author: Sean C
title: Good hotel and really professional staff
text: Great location, comfortable and quiet. Hearty breakfast. Can add a set of pillows, but comfortable bed. A special mention for the staff, attentive, friendly and helpful even after departure! We'll be back!

author: Aiden P
title: Great stay at the Hotel Golden Tulip Opera De Noailies!
text:
We popped in to Paris for Valentine's weekend and stayed at the Golden Tulip Opera. The hotel is centrally located near the metro, Opera House, Galeries Lafayette Haussmann and so much more. 
The staff really made our stay excellent from the moment we walked in we were treated like royalty! We had an opportunity to refresh, have  a snack, get directions and suggestions, get dinner reservations on Valentine's Night when every restaurant we tried was booked, and so much more.   

The room was a bit small compared to American standards but it fit us (2) perfectly. 
10/10 Staff
10/10 Location
10/10 Comfort
10/10 Value

author: Sara K
title: Excellent
text: Excellent hotel very well located 2 minutes from the opera and in a quiet street. The staff is lovely and the breakfast hearty and excellent. The room good size with a beautiful bathroom and top bedding.Nothing wrong I will gladly return to it

author: Oliver T
title: GREAT LOCATION AND CLEANLINESS🥰
text:
Excellent location of the central hotel, also excellent cleaning, especially in the rooms daily change of sheets and clean bathroom thoroughly!!! Congratulations!!. Friendly and always available at reception (they also speak Italian) they always advised us well .Colazione in the norm, we found a little cold breakfast service a smile would not hurt
 ( I understand it's early morning though...)  We will definitely return🙂🙂

author: Mia J
title: Great location
text: Hotel in a great location, very central, very nice, well managed, very very kind and professional staff both the cleaning and reception staff. Price commensurate with the offer... comfortable and clean well-appointed rooms.. great indeed.... Recommendation...

author: Chloe N
title: Highly recommended
text:
Excellent hotel, modern and beautifully designed, strategic and central location, a few meters from the opera, in a very
Comfortable, full of restaurants and services.
Staff very friendly and attentive to meet all customer needs.
Breakfast with quality products 
Highly recommended!!

author: Poppy T
title: A Perfect Stay in the Heart of Paris: Comfort, Elegance and Enviable Location at Golden Tulip Opera
text:
The Golden Tulip Opera is an extraordinary hotel in the heart of Paris, perfectly located within walking distance of the Opéra. The location is unparalleled, with direct access to both the metro and RER, including the RER A which takes you conveniently to Disneyland Paris. This makes the hotel ideal both for visiting the Louvre, within walking distance, and for exploring all areas of Paris with ease.

The rooms are impeccable, with a nice decor and special attention to cleanliness. Every detail is designed to ensure a comfortable and relaxing stay. The staff is one of the gems of the hotel: the reception is always friendly and helpful, ready to meet every request with professionalism. But it is during breakfast that the hospitality of the hotel really shines. The waitresses and the waitress are impeccable, attentive to every detail and always ready to make your morning experience pleasant and smooth.

In addition, the value for money is exceptional, considering the central location and the high level of service offered. If you are looking for an unforgettable stay in Paris, the Golden Tulip Opera is the perfect choice.

author: Paige J
title: Great Location and a Pleasant Stay
text:
We had a really good time at the Novotel. The location was great and very convenient, although I don’t know why Uber and Bolt drivers seemed to get lost every single time! 😂 It was honestly a little frustrating, so I’d recommend booking your rides early and giving yourself some extra time.
The pool was lovely. It’s on the smaller side, but honestly, in this heat, it’s definitely better than having no pool at all! ☀️
The rooms were okay. The beds in the standard rooms are quite small, so if you’re travelling with children or sharing a room, I’d recommend booking a larger room for a bit more comfort. I also didn’t experience any noise during our stay, which was a plus.
Breakfast was good, with a nice selection. We especially enjoyed the croissants and espresso coffees, and it was great to see gluten-free options available as well.
There are also plenty of places to eat around the hotel, and we had dinner nearby a few times, which was really good.
Overall, we had a pleasant stay and enjoyed our time at the Novotel. I’d definitely consider staying there again.

author: Daisy L
title: Fantastic
text:
It was interesting!
Train and bus were near and available!
The breakfast was fantastic and delicious🥐☕️
The employees couldn’t speak English.
The train station is the front of Novotel and the transportation is very fast and easy!
We payed city taxes but it was cheaper than other hotels and city’s.

author: Lucas V
title: TOP-NOTCH STAY
text:
Clean hotel, very well located, the staff is very friendly.
The breakfast selection is very good; everyone finds something they like.
The pool is pleasant after long days of walking around Paris.
Every day, there is a restocking of products in the minibar, which is very pleasant during a heatwave.

author: Katie V
title: Abusive practices, blackmail, and double billing, AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
text:
A scandalous and deeply traumatic experience at this hotel. After paying for my first night and parking on-site (€321), the front desk claimed the next day that they had 'refunded me by mistake' due to a bug in their system.
Having received no refund to my bank account (the €321 charge having indeed gone through), I refused to pay a second time. Taking advantage of the fact that I had booked a second consecutive night with them, the person who was at the front desk (Julie) exerted unacceptable pressure: she threatened to block my access to my room and to withhold my luggage and personal effects as long as I did not pay again.
Taken hostage and under duress, I had to give in to this blackmail and pay a second sum of €286 to be able to retrieve my private belongings. They therefore extorted €286 too much from me, while half-admitting that the first payment had indeed been received.
Withholding a guest's belongings to force them to pay for the malfunction of their own computer system is totally illegal.

author: Michael G
title: Hotel to check off for a visit to Paris
text: A great hotel for visiting Paris when arriving from Lyon. You can drop off your things upon arrival in Paris to go visit the capital. The hotel is great, the rooms are very spacious, the bedding is super. The bathroom is also large and nice with glass that tints for the shower that overlooks the room. The best part of the hotel is a beautiful pool with a tropical ambiance to relax after your day of sightseeing.

author: Alice L
title: Excellent location
text: 4.5 out of 5, excellent location, good service

author: Lucas S
title: Avoid!
text: It is a hotel that to be 4 stars, as announced, 4 stars are missing. It is bad from the cordiality of the attendants to the despair with the arrangement and cleanliness of the rooms.
photos: [{"url": "https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/33/c8/b8/1b/caption.jpg", "caption": "Uma fralda embaixo da cama. Encontramos também um cigarro e uma cueca.", "photo_id": "868792347"}]

author: Charlie U
title: Very disappointing for a so-called 4-star hotel.
text:
Housekeeping service to be lamented: 1 bed out of 2 made, trash not emptied, no replacement of tissues, sink, and toilet not cleaned. In short, the basics.
Visit to Paris during a heat wave, non-existent air conditioning. After 4 complaints made at the reception, a gentleman came to tell us that our room was the coldest in the hotel. 27.5 degrees in the room with the so-called efficient air conditioning. The cleaning service entered around 9:30 AM without warning, despite the "do not disturb" sign, and responded, "I thought you had left."
 I booked on the hotel’s website indicating that it was for a birthday. No attention was given. I am looking for 4 stars; 2 would be more than enough.
