author: Luke F
title: Good hotel, except for...
text:
Good hotel with pleasant superior rooms with terrace, large bed, coffee machines, large bathroom, pool, and fitness room. 
black spot, disorganized reception, and lack of respect for priority; I advise you to install a corridor and a clear order of arrival with a cord for a proper arrival sequence for your clients.

author: Grace P
title: A VERY DISAPPOINTING STAY FOR A 4-STAR HOTEL
text:
DISAPPOINTING
the front desk staff is deplorable; they have forgotten the rules of politeness!!!
only the housekeeping staff is very kind

author: Poppy D
title: All right.
text: Ideally located, pleasant welcome, spacious and comfortable room and well stocked and varied breakfast buffet

author: Molly L
title: Standard Novotel and best for Gare de Lyon access
text:
Stayed here for a night after arriving from JFK and taking a train the next day to Dijon and then back for a night before heading back to JFK. I’m a huge fan of Novotel and this one was mostly up to the same expectations. I was upgraded both times to an executive room with my Accor loyalty status. Room was spacious though both times it was difficult to get the A/C to work so the rooms were quite warm. Workout room was small but functional and had a water station and towels, so that’s a plus. 
Check in, check out and bar service for my welcome drink was all very efficient. The small pool was also very pleasant. One thing of note- the elevators were the fastest I have ever experienced. Not sure I would recommend for an extended stay but it was great for convenient access to Gare de Lyon. Other note: I plugged in the kettle the morning we left upon departure and blew a fuse. Husband told the front desk and we ended up showering and getting ready without any power in the room.

author: Abigail I
title: Convenient hotel, good value!
text:
Conveniently located right next to Gare de Lyon for metro & inter-city connections. 
Bus stops were a short walk away. The hotel was very quiet — windows could be opened but when closed sound proofing was excellent. Additionally we did not notice noise from adjacent rooms or rooms from above.  Room was clean, with a comfortable bed. Tea and coffee making facilities were available in the room but seriously when you are paying that much per night lose the paper cups!
There were many restaurants in adjacent streets that made eating out easier. Highly recommend Boulangerie Mason Menier around the corner. 
Stayed 4 nights.

author: Hannah U
title: Simply the best!
text:
NOVOTEL GARE DE LYON was absolutely the best! Our stay there was simply brilliant.

Our one night stay (Saturday, 7th March - Chamber 624) was the best hotel experience my son and I have had on a school/business trip, such as this. The best. Full stop. No exaggeration.

Our accommodation was lovely, spacious and enjoyable — we didn’t want to leave! Our room was a large Double/Queen with a Terrace. Our terrace, overlooking the Gare de Lyon was such a wonderful way of being in Paris — it felt like living there, just for a moment. Our own private slice of Paris. 

The food, the service, the pool, the KIDSZONE, everything about it has been thought out beautifully, with the comfort/pleasure of the visitor in mind.

More importantly, the staff at Novotel Gare de Lyon were amazing! And they are to be highly commended for their care and attention. We were treated like *people* and not merely *customers*. 

The best example of this is this:

On the morning of our departure, as we left the hotel to return to England, my son left our water bottles at the hotel. Once we were seated on Eurostar, I phoned NOVOTEL Front Desk immediately. A member of the NOVOTEL staff had already secured the items and had them to hand. He emailed me — even before I could email him! — to arrange returning the items directly to us in Britain. In his email he thoughtfully included clear photographs of the items, so that we could verify that they were indeed the ones we were missing. The items are being dispatched today, and will be with us in 5 days. With such care and attention, all of this happened swiftly. Resolved, even before we had left French soil. This is *customer care*. This is *customer service*.

NB. By contrast - our stay prior to this had been at the MERCURE GARE DE LYON -- they were the worst! We left our Paris souvenirs in our room -- and they were thrown away. This was so heartbreaking for us. Those things were not trash. Yes, our mistake for leaving them, but, just a little thought, care and attention would have made a world of difference in this situation. Thankfully, NOVOTEL reminded us what a great hotel should be!

author: Brooke H
title: Ideal hotel upon arrival at Gare de Lyon!
text:
Nth stay and customer All Plus loyal because: Great welcome from the customer-friendly Reception team. After a very satisfactory resa by live telephone (recommended) at the hotel. +Great value for money because in addition to the functional rooms the most it is the pool and its very wide hours + very clean!
See you soon and thank you!

author: Lucas Y
title: Fab location gif the sights and fab team
text: Lovely spacious hotel and room great location. Had dinner in the restaurant very nice drink after in the bar Vincenzo was an amazing bar man really looked after us. Thanks 😊

author: Isabella D
title: Perfect for a night in Paris
text:
Very well located hotel. A 2-minute walk from Gare de Lyon.
Friendly staff and quick check-in.
Well maintained and clean.

The water pressure in the shower is unfortunately quite weak.
Rooms are rather expensive compared to other hotels of this class and size.

author: Isabella W
title: A Parisian stay at the top!
text:
Excellent experience right from the booking thanks to Abir, a responsive, caring and very professional person. Everything was simple and perfectly organized. Upon arrival, the welcome was warm: the receptionist was smiling, pleasant and very welcoming.
The room was spacious, impeccable and perfectly maintained. The bedding is comfortable, the soundproofing excellent, and the whole offers a more than pleasant setting to fully enjoy a stay in Paris.
Breakfast is full, varied and plentiful: there is something for everyone.
The proximity to metro 14 was a real luxury, making all our travels in Paris more than easy and fast.
Our Valentine's Day stay was a real success, largely thanks to this hotel that is well worth a visit!

author: Adam O
title: Excellent hotel
text: Easy access from the Gare de Lyon, allowing quick access to the city center (metro + RER but also taxis). The lobby is nice with room to receive guests, work... Excellent breakfast buffet. The rooms are spacious and, for some, with terrace. No noise, calm down. This is a very good address especially as the team is professional. WELL DONE!

author: Charlie O
title: Rest for the train
text: Ideal hotel for those going to take the train at the Gare de Lyon. Comfortable room and good breakfast. In addition, it follows the standard of Novotel.

author: Grace Q
title: Excellent location and excellent service
text: Excellent location a few steps from the subway, clean rooms with daily towel change, hairdryer available, rooms with air conditioning, wide sweet and savory breakfast, vending machines for fresh water, definitely an excellent hotel chain 👍

author: Diego G
title: Good location, great breakfast
text:
Good location for any gig at the Accor Arena which is right next door.

They checked us in early.

Very varied breakfast of good quality

author: Paolo M
title: Plan for improvements / renovations
text:
The staff is very pleasant, the bedding is good, however the bathroom needs to be renovated: 
-smells coming up from the sink
-the shower head is leaking
-when showering, the water is hot one moment and cold the next 
-the toilet flush is not powerful enough

The breakfast is very good. 
A few improvements to make the stay more pleasant.

author: David Q
title: Fabulous Stay
text: Cannot fault this hotel. Stayed for 4 nights as we flew from the UK for the magnificent Guns n Roses concert next door at the Accor Arena. The beds and pillows are so comfortable we never wanted to get up!! Lovely breakfast, I am gluten and dairy free and was well catered for. The rooms are small but manageable. My only problem was there were no drawers to put clothes in but we managed. Couldn't believe how quiet the room was especially being next door to the Arena as well.  Brilliant row of restaurants across the road, a small shop and brilliant Indian restaurant just round the corner. All in all a great stay away from the hussle and bussle of the city centre which is easily accessible by the metro outside the hotel or by taxi. Bercy is a lovely area and I highly recommend it.

author: Evie H
title: Mixed feelings
text:
The hotel is ideally located on metro line 14, just steps from the Accor Arena and on the line that leads to the Stade de France. 

Room small, simple... rather acceptable for a short stay.

The breakfast could be improved. 

Negative points: dirty terrace tables... we arrive for breakfast and find ourselves amidst overflowing ashtrays, empty beer cans, and pizza pieces on the ground...

author: Carlos C
title: Acceptable but noisy
text: Convenient location near the Gare de Lyon, pleasant staff, okay bedding, decent breakfast. But the hotel would need to be completely renovated, especially regarding soundproofing. There is really a lot of noise generated on the garden side by the hundreds of people entering and exiting the Phantom nightclub, between 1 AM and 5 AM. A real nuisance because the window does not block out outside noise. In short, I will not return there.

author: Freya A
title: Correct
text:
Good location next to the Accor Arena in Bercy and the subway.

Rooms are quite spacious, but very expensive (in the context of a corporate rental).

Service is acceptable (even though the invoice promised by email has still not been sent).

Breakfast, sweet and savory, is quite good, without being extraordinary.

author: James O
title: Basic
text:
Rooms are small and functional, no kettle, desk, chair, minute wardrobe area.
Bathroom is tired, mind your knees when on the toilet, the wall is about a fingers width away.
Breakfast is ok, the cold cuts  section is disappointing.
Well placed for Accor arena and metro is on the doorstep. If you’re on business or staying for one or two nights then it’s just satisfactory, more than that you will wish you’d searched a bit better

author: Caleb R
title: The shower goes from scalding to cold in an instant and repeatedly.
text:
Hotel that needs urgent renovation. 
Small room with a bathroom and toilet without a shower curtain: the entire tiny bathroom is soaked after a shower. 
Very damaged walls. 
Breakfast is not very varied, with very few fresh fruits... plus a significant line in the morning... 
Uncleaned tables for breakfast. 
Positive point: good bedding from Accor.

author: Abigail G
title: DISAPPOINTING
text:
The location is extremely convenient for Paris Gare de Lyon and even has a metro literally next door, if you don't fancy the ten minute walk from the main station.

There is a Franprix on the same block and plenty of bar/cafés close by, although didn't manage to find a decent restaurant in the immediate vicinity.

Upon arrival, the reception staff were very helpful and courteous. The room itself, was perfectly adequate for a one or two night stay, but I would find it a bit cramped, for any longer.

Very disappointing that the only vending machine serving hot drinks was out of order and even more disappointing that two out of three lifts were out of service. For a hotel with 361 rooms, that really isn't acceptable, as was obvious from the resultant chaos, around departure time.

The breakfast staff were ok, without being exceptional, but the food on offer was pretty disappointing, with the only hot choice being toast it yourself, poor quality bread. Two of the three cheeses on offer were virtually tasteless and the machine-delivered coffee was very weak, without the usual facility, to make it stronger.

I would stay again, if en route via Gare de Lyon, but it was disappointing overall.

author: Nora C
title: Worst hotel experience ever
text: The hotel gave away my room to someone else despite a confirmed booking. The reception staff even had the audacity to say that because it was a Saturday, they give away rooms due to higher demand and they can make more money. Then they put me in another downgraded hotel far away. It was a terrible experience. The hotel staff did not even apologize for it. Nor have they responded to the complaint on email.

author: Jessica I
title: Great!!!!!!
text:
Conveniently located/ Accor Arena!!!!!
Very nice staff, attentive and available
Good value for money.
I recommend +++++

author: Sophia K
title: Very bad experience
text: Very bad experience. The family room I had booked for 4 nights was dirty. The sofa bed cover was stained as well as the curtains. Mould was present in the ceiling of the shower. No air conditioning at the end of April. I was told it was too early and there was only heating. Unbearable heat. The windows don't open completely. I had to ask the front desk to open them for a discharge. We had some fresh air but impossible to sleep because of the street noise. This hotel should be renovated quickly. I don't think it's up to standard and hygiene is deplorable

author: Ella A
title: The worst hotel experience ever!
text:
From far, this was the worst Ibis Styles I ever stayed at, and even worse, the worst experience I ever had in a hotel. We had to leave it after being mistreated and threatened by their staff at breakfast, which is horrible by the way! Not even one hot plate, even the boiled eggs are the canned ones. Staff at breakfast are rude and treat you like rubbish, they also tell you to clean up your table, as if it was your job. They were supposed to refund our last 2 nights, because we had to leave the hotel and they never did! It Looks like we need to take them to court to have our money back!
Stay away from this property!

author: Andrea H
title: No room even with reservation
text:
Even with a reservation more than 1 month in advance, you are not sure you have your room. A rehousing in the suburbs has more than 30 min on the edge of the ring road. 
Inadmissible but in short we had no choice. Difficulty with the taxi that took us because normally pay the receiving hotel. 
Not recommended

author: Jessica H
title: Good hotel for overnight stay near Gare de Lyon
text: Good budget hotel, fairly close to Gare de Lyon (12 - 15 minutes walk) in the interesting Bercy district.  Clean rooms, pleasant bar and terrace, and good breakfast.  A cut above some Ibis hotels which can be pared back to necessities only.

author: Evie O
title: Doesn't really deserve his ranking anymore.
text:
Aging room with poor soundproofing. Surface area and comfort no longer justify its classification within the Accor group. Bathroom from another time and poorly maintained, no accessories and leak in the shower. No dressing room or office. No refrigerator and no more bottles of welcome water or tissues. Really no more service. The air conditioning is noisy and poorly adjusted. Breakfast has become minimalist, no more consequent or varied than in an Ibis budget ( almost as well). For 198€ a night we could hope for better. And what about the group policy that now welcomes noisy hordes without embarrassment to customers. And when a fire alarm goes off at 2am because a young person has smoked in his room, no welcome or explanation at the reception or even of course no excuse or a small intervention to reassure guests. 
Anyway, it’s really the last time I’m going down there 😩

author: Giulia A
title: Almost one without fail
text: Hotel conveniently located with the subway on the sidewalk opposite.Nice and spacious room .The decor is very nice .the bed is super comfortable with a super soft mattress pad .the breakfast is ok (just lacks salty hot) the staff is very nice . Only downside otherwise it would be a 5 ... street noise in the room ... even on the 8th floor you can hear very loud outside noises. So much so that I checked several times if the window was closed ... only unpleasant point the rest is fine.

author: Manon V
title: Good location, clean and comfortable
text: 'Perfect location for our visit, which was based around attending the Indochine concert at the Accor Arena.  The room was clean and comfortable and we enjoyed a very good nights sleep with no noise disturbance. All the staff were very accommodating and friendly.  The continental breakfast was well presented with a lot of choice.  The hotel is ideally located for the metro.  All in all a very pleasant stay.

author: Zoe A
title: Well placed but poorly soundproofed
text:
Great location.
Clean
But very poorly soundproofed! 
Housekeeping service at 8:15 a.m. on a Sunday (it is true that everything must be done), but the employee did not hesitate to slam the doors, the toilet seats.

author: Katie E
title: Nice experience
text: Charming hotel that is well located. It is near a subway station and the Arc de Triomphe. The staff is courteous and professional. Our room was spacious and well-equipped. It should be noted that the room key must be left at the front desk when you are not present. The hallways are noisy but we did not hear our neighbors. The air conditioning ensured that we were not bothered by the heat wave at night.

author: Mason T
title: Immaculate attention!
text: In October 2025, I made my first trip, and it was not just my first trip, it was my first trip, my first international trip, my first time on a plane, the first time going through an immigration. And it was all simply sensational, it took me a long time to find a hotel and I searched a lot until I found the Fertel Etoile, which was an option that gave me everything I needed comfort and security, it is a simple hotel, I indicate without a doubt. A great option for those who want to tour and use the hotel only to sleep and have breakfast. The service of the receptionists is incredible, very cordial and attentive. Great accommodation option.

author: Lea G
title: Hotel for a visit to Paris
text:
Good address during our visit to Paris. We booked this establishment for Slimane's concert at the Pleyel hall.
The room's decor is neat and quite modern. However, the insulation is almost non-existent (we were lucky to hear our neighbors during intimate moments) and the pillow is a bit soft (personally speaking). The breakfast is acceptable.

author: Charlie S
title: Excellent hotel.
text:
In my opinion, the hotel is ideally located 90 meters from the Argentine metro (line 1). Perfect for visiting Paris afterwards.
Staff is available and very kind.
The room is spacious and comfortable: the bedding is excellent, and for my part, no noise disturbed my sleep, neither during the day nor in the morning (important point!).
A very positive point is the air conditioning during heat waves; I appreciated it immensely.
The breakfast buffet is varied.
In short, I will not hesitate to book this hotel again during my next stay in Paris.

author: Nathan G
title: Nothing fancy, but good location and helpful staff
text: Nothing fancy, but the staff were very kind.  One lady in particular was super helpful in assisting me with booking a reservation at a highly recommended nearby restaurant, Chez Gabriel.  The food there is fantastic!

author: Oliver V
title: Paris at your fingertips
text: I spent a nice stay in Paris for New Year's Eve in this comfortable hotel, a stone's throw from the Argentine station of the M1 line that leads directly into the center. The hotel is simple, but comfortable. The room was warm and clean, breakfast offered sweet, savory and good quality fruit. The staff is always friendly. The Arc de Triomphe is a stone's throw away and in the area you can find brasseries for dining in a French style, not touristy and at good prices. I would highly recommend this hotel.

author: Alexander C
title: Value for money top
text:
Nice stay in a great location, close to a metro mouth, and friendly staff. The common areas are clean, pleasant, although a little old. The rooms are renovated, pleasant, and quiet. Equipment is complete.  The bedding is firm but we spend a good time there.
Breakfast is correct for the price, pity for the staff only francophone.
A hotel with excellent value for money

author: Emma H
title: Lovely  hotel
text: Great hotel and location for our recent trip to Paris. The staff were very friendly and helpful. The breakfast was of good quality and the hotel was very clean

author: Harry X
title: Good plan and welcome
text:
Excellent Welcoming, versatility of the solution provided according to situation.
Functional and pleasant room.
PDJ ok
Ideal location

author: Benjamin Y
title: All right.
text: Booking made by my Enterprise, Perfectly located Hotel, Very Good Welcoming and Clean Room. Too bad mine given on the inner courtyard, not very bright so. But it's a detail, I had a very good night.  Excellent breakfast. Thank you again for your Welcoming and advice for the restaurant Le Grand CARNOT. Philippe

author: Isabella I
title: Great location, great hotel
text: Loved this hotel, location was fantastic right beside the arc du triomphe and very handy for the metro! Room was basic but thats all you need when you are out all day in Paris! Hotel staff very friendly and did anything/everything for us. Air conditioning was great, bathroom very clean. Only complaint would be the bed is too hard but that is preference! We stayed in room 108 which was surprisingly a good size considering other hotels we have stayed in Paris before and was not on the main street which was great! For a great price, location, staff were great cant complain! I would come back! Merci!

author: James D
title: Simple that works
text:
Second time at the hotel. For those looking for something very basic, but comfortable, I indicate as a very viable option.

Very small room, ideal for one Cover - or couple with little luggage.

Important point that the air conditioning works wonderfully well, which does not always happen in simpler hotels in Paris.

Location in Etoile, short walk from the Arc de Triomphe, easy transportation to the entire city.

Breakfast simple but good.

author: Oscar Y
title: Great value for money at prime location by the Arc du Triomphe.
text: A cozy small hotel with great beds, friendly staff and good looking breakfast area. Great beds. Chilled wine, soda and water at reception. Loved it.

author: Adam U
text: This is my second stay at this hotel over the past few years, and it continues to impress. I left a 5-star review on Google Maps after my first visit, and since I can't post another there, I'm sharing my thoughts here on TripAdvisor. This hotel is so much more than its 3-star rating suggests. The service is consistently excellent, and the location is unbeatable. Some of the best food spots in Paris are just around the corner... we discovered an amazing boulangerie (The French Bastard) and a fantastic Italian pizzeria (Ciro e i Suoi Fratelli), along with plenty of traditional French and international options nearby. The rooms have been renovated since 2023 and are spotlessly clean, with fully functioning air conditioning. The mattress is incredibly comfortable, genuinely the best sleep I’ve had away from home. If your room doesn't already have a kettle or iron, you can request them easily from the front desk. The service is friendly, responsive, and professional. This place never disappoints. I’m already looking forward to my next stay!

author: Ella I
title: Very good hotel at good price
text:
A very good hotel at a very good price! 
The hotel is 2 min from metro and 5 min from Arc de Triomphe - very good. 
The hotel was clean and tidy and the staff was nice and very helpful. The breakfast included had everything you could want and tasted very good. 
Definitely a hotel I can book again!

author: Luca A
title: Excellent experience to discover Paris
text: Very nice experience with excellent value for money. Ideal location to visit Paris. Very safe place, late reception possible. Room of 11 m2. Shower and separate toilet. Very clean place, perfect cleaning. Hotel located 300 m from the Arc de Triomphe.

author: Miguel L
title: Hotel absolutely recommended
text: Highly recommended hotel, very clean, strategically located, metro and rer stations right in front, close to several restaurants and the convention center, very kind and helpful, adequate breakfast, definitely will be back.

author: Lucas X
title: Perfect place to stay with friends to discover Paris!
text: This hotel provided the perfect base for our Paris mini break with friends this weekend. It is very well situated at just 2 mins walk from the Argentine metro stop and only 5 mins to the stunning Arc de Triomphe. The reception and restaurant staff were all friendly and welcoming. Our room was ample size and very clean, and it was lovely to have the towels changed daily. Our rooms were on the ground floor and were very quiet. We enjoyed the self service breakfast which was a good range of continental breakfast options. We all said we will definitely return to the hotel when we're in Paris next.

author: Holly A
title: Very good value for money
text:
It can be seen that the House was recently renovated. The bathroom is new and clean. Soap and cotton stalk are provided. La
Shower has a great flow (which is rare in Parisian hotels!!). Frankly it is a great value for money. Only small flat: the bed base squeaked but the sheets smelled so good!

author: Andrea R
title: Nice, well located accessible
text: Quiet, clean , Good Value for Award because very well located to go to the Champs Elysee, the Congress Centre or visit the 17th. The immediate proximity to metro line 1 makes it easy to get to the heart of Paris. And also smiling and very friendly staff which is nice!

author: Luke A
title: Review
text:
Very good location
Small room for 3 persons, no View, no furniture 
Very Clean
Very Good service

author: Katie V
title: Great hotel staff with great hospitality
text: Nice hotel with amazing staff. Location is good and nice

author: Elena P
title: Best value for money in Paris
text:
I loved the hotel. At the front desk, they are very polite and attentive, especially Melanie. The breakfast is very much worth it.
I really like the hotel's decor and that they offer free soft drinks, fruit, candy, and pastries from 2:00 PM to 2:00 AM. 
The rooms are very spacious, and the beds and pillows are extremely comfortable. They leave all kinds of free drinks in the fridge that they restock.
In addition, they give you the opportunity to be able to enter any of the company's hotels and have a snack for free. 
The hotel is in a safe neighborhood and close to subways and many buses. We will definitely be back!!!

author: Sofia C
title: Wonderful
text: Excellent location. Friendly and helpful staff.

author: Benjamin Y
title: Fantastic stay in a perfect location!
text: An excellent stay! We stayed in the quadruple room and we loved it: it was super spacious, nice, and was impeccable. In addition, the hotel staff was very friendly and attentive to us. The location is fantastic; we were just 10 minutes from the Galeries Lafayette and about a 20-minute walk from the Arc de Triomphe. Without a doubt, a perfect place to return to. Totally recommended!

author: Freya D
title: Completely satisfied
text:
We had a wonderful stay at this very beautiful hotel. The rooms and the entire stay were pleasant, and the air conditioning in particular was very pleasant during our visit.

The breakfast was delicious and varied, and we also liked the snack bar very much. The central location is a big plus: Many interesting sights and points in Paris are easily accessible by bus, metro, or even on foot.

We would especially like to highlight the very friendly and helpful staff. In addition, the hotel is extremely child-friendly, which made our stay as a family particularly pleasant.

We would recommend the hotel at any time and would also love to come back!

author: Aaron V
title: Perfect
text: Very good, but breakfast is a bit expensive

author: Gavin G
title: The right hotel on the right bank
text: Located on the right bank it is (as are its sister Astotels) a long walk or a metro ride away from many Parisian tourist sites, but the comfortable rooms, the excellent breakfast buffet, the pleasant multilingual staff, the great price, and the relatively easy-to-use metro more than make up for any potential downside. The plumbing, wifi, TV, lighting, mini fridge—everything worked well. Nearby are the pretty church of St Augustin, a post office, a Monoprix supermarket, various restaurants, and an excellent self-service laverie. This was my second stay at this hotel, and I can’t wait for the next time!

author: Sydney O
title: Very high-quality stay, a very good location.
text: Whether at the front desk, the buffet, or room service, the staff is available and always smiling. Very clean rooms, very comfortable bedding. Hearty and varied breakfast. Exceptional stay, we will return with pleasure.

author: Daniel E
title: Excellent hotel
text: Charming hotel. Very reasonable value for money. Very pleasant and friendly staff. Very clean room. Delicious breakfast.

author: George G
title: Amazing experince
text: The people in the reception was extremely kind and helpful. We left our luggages before and aftwr check in perıod, it was very easy. The rooms were very clean, towels and bed sheets were white and clean. the location is very good, just in the heart of Paris. The open snack bar was the most surprizing thing, it helped us to relax even more to get ready flr the next day. Definetly recommeneded! This will be my adress if i come back to Paris again for sure.

author: Daniel W
title: Paris with family
text: Excellent breakfast but the absolute plus is the free soft drink available. excellent location

author: Kyle E
title: Fantastic experience!!!
text: We had a fantastic experience at the Hotel Augustin. All the reception staff were very kind, especially Melanie who was very nice and charming to us. The hotel is very well located, in a very quiet area and close to a lot of public transport, as well as close to places of interest to visit. The room and the bathroom were very clean and the beds are very comfortable. The breakfast was very complete, and a great detail to note is the fact that you can access all the Astotel chain hotels in the city at any time, whether it's to have a soft drink, a snack, or simply to use the restroom (something that is sometimes appreciated). We recommend it 100% and when we return we will definitely stay again!!

author: Dylan R
title: Perfect for staying in the most enchanting of cities
text: Excellent hotel and great location, I felt at home. Highly recommended

author: Oscar P
title: Superb
text: I really enjoyed this hotel, impeccable, very welcoming staff, perfect breakfast, I am delighted to have discovered this establishment and I will return as soon as I have the opportunity.

author: Molly F
title: Very good and central hotel🙂
text: We were pleasantly surprised by the level of service when we got there. They had upgraded our room at no cost, and this was first class. The accompanying breakfast was also very good. One stay at this hotel is highly recommended!

author: Luke H
title: Hip and tasteful hotel...
text: Very nice stay with daughter ... cozy, nice hip hotel. The free open bar (with drinks, sweets and snacks) and free minibar were great. Very friendly staff.. Good location and fast connections to the metro network!

author: Alice F
title: I recommend it.
text: Four family members used it in two rooms. Breakfast was surprisingly delicious and almost the same day by day, but I never got tired of it. The staff were very friendly and kind and made the trip very fulfilling.

author: Alexander X
title: Perfect stay!
text:
We were there for 5 nights at L’Astotel Saint Augustin in July 2026 in a family room (two rooms connected by a vestibule—the doors are difficult to open and to leave open, a 3rd door allows for securing the entrance). 2 adults and two teenagers. 

Our stay went very well. First of all, the people at the front desk were truly exceptional (particularly Melanie and Samara). Furthermore, the hotel is located in a safe and central neighborhood for visiting the city. 
Starting at 2:00 PM, it is possible to enjoy a kind of complimentary snack that was very nice. The rooms were small and a bit worn, but that is not a problem because they were clean with a nice view. Great value for money! We will be back. Well done, keep it up!

author: Emma D
title: Excellent
text: We found the hotel to be exceptional, well located and deserving of more than three stars. We found the staff to be extremely friendly and helpful and went out of their way to make sure our stay was comfortable. We would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel.

author: Henry N
title: excellent experience
text: Stayed here for 4 nights, excellent hotel for quality/price, very clean, very helpful and courteous staff, quiet location and close to the Place d'Italie metro station, recommended for sleeping, breakfast is optional

author: James J
title: Stay in France
text: It was a great experience, good and clean rooms. The team gave tips on what to do in the city. The entire team was extremely attentive and helpful. Near a shopping mall with a large market and a very close train station as well. It is an extremely recommendable hotel.

author: Andrea P
title: Excellent hotel
text:
Two nights spent in this hotel. The room was perfect. The bedding as well. Bathroom was spotless. The towels were nice and thick and of good quality, I find that important.
Excellent breakfast. All the staff are very pleasant and smiling.
Finally, the hotel is a few steps from a subway entrance and is surrounded by restaurants.

author: Lauren S
title: Great location, highly recommend
text: We had a fabulous stay at Hotel la Manufacture. We had interconnecting rooms. Rooms are compact but had everything we needed, pod coffee making machine was excellent. Rooms were clean and serviced daily. Beds very comfortable. We enjoyed the breakfast 3 mornings, lots of choice and well stocked up. Staff very helpful and friendly throughout the hotel. It is a minute walk to Place d'italie metro with excellent links. Highly recommend this hotel.

author: Abigail C
title: PERFECT, as always
text:
A perfect week in Paris, the hotel is magnificent, perfect location, cleanliness, service...a special mention to Queen and Becky who made our breakfasts happy every day...the best in the hotel.
Thanks to Miha, she is a delight!! 10/10

author: Emma S
title: Excellent experience
text: We stayed at this property for three nights and had a very good time. The hotel is located in a quiet area, but well-served: nearby there are subway stations and many places to eat. The rooms we stayed in were a bit small, but this was not a problem for us.  They were clean and comfortable nonetheless, with daily towel changes.  The reception is open 24/7 and fresh water is always available to guests in the lobby. A special commendation goes to Giulia. Breakfast is good.

author: Hugo N
title: Perfect hotel
text: Very good hotel, it is not far, near subway stop, very quiet, room and bed very comfortable, breakfast very good, area not noisy, all staff very friendly.

author: Julien L
title: Excellent!
text: Nice hotel. Excellent service so polite and attentive. Delicious and hearty breakfast. Very clean room. Affordable. We loved it! Family of 4 from Montreal. Highly recommended.

author: Mia B
title: Excellent hotel
text: Great hotel, very beautiful, very welcoming staff, a big thank you to Farouk!!!!!!

author: Molly T
title: The best hotel!
text: Hôtel la manufacturer is such nice place, from the rooms too staff. It’s been a lovely trip and the service has been 10/10! I can only recommend this place. I will come back soon

author: Leo E
title: I will not be coming back!
text: I had requested a quiet room on a high floor and I got a room on the first floor facing the street! Aging and noisy room, very average bedding, and outdated furnishings.

author: Paige P
title: Awesome!!!
text:
Room very clean, well equipped with everything necessary.
The reception staff is very pleasant, smiling, professional, and available.
I highly recommend this hotel...

author: Grace L
title: Essential but good.
text: I can only confirm the positive remarks made by other reviewers.  If you are looking for a no-frills establishment with excellent value for money and convenient for getting around the city, this hotel is for you.  Our room was very small, with a tiny bathroom, but it was still bright, quiet, and clean. We did not take advantage of the breakfast, but there are bakeries and restaurants nearby to suit every taste.

author: Lily F
title: Fantastic experience.
text:
A truly fantastic stay, we felt at home from the very first moment.
The staff was always smiling and helpful.
The room was spotless, well-detailed, and very welcoming.
The location is perfect: a quiet and peaceful area, yet very convenient for visiting the city.
The subway is literally just a stone's throw away: we were able to easily reach all the places to visit, without stress and without wasting time on transfers.
Moreover, near rue de la Butte-aux-Cailles and rue des Cinq Diamants, it allows you to immediately immerse yourself in a picturesque and lively atmosphere in the evening.
Breakfast was a super positive surprise: fresh products, good selection, and the feeling of something prepared with care, not 'industrial.'
The croissants were simply spectacular!
A special thanks to Giulia, always very kind, dear, and sweet, who welcomed us with a smile and gave us very useful advice.
In summary, if you are looking for a cozy, clean French hotel in a perfect location to visit Paris and with a great breakfast, this is the right place.

author: Luke S
title: Fantastic stay.
text:
A hotel that I truly feel comfortable recommending.
From the very first moment, my husband and I were welcomed with great kindness and attention in the charming lobby of this hotel located in an ancient Parisian palace.
The room was very bright, clean, and equipped with every comfort.
I also greatly appreciated the location: a quiet and safe neighborhood, perfect for returning in the evening with complete peace of mind. The subway being so close allowed us to easily reach all the places we wanted to visit, without any hassle!!!
And then the breakfast... truly delicious and of excellent quality.
The staff was very efficient, especially Giulia, who was always kind, caring, and helpful.
It is a hotel I would gladly return to and would recommend without hesitation to anyone wanting to visit Paris while feeling welcomed and pampered.

author: George U
title: Everything perfect at Hotel la Manufacture.
text:
Excellent strategic location just a few minutes from the metro stop that connects Place d'Italie with airports, stations, and points of interest in Paris.
Polite staff, varied breakfast with typical products. The rooms are not large but are functional and very clean.

author: Grace G
title: Excellent solution for a weekend in Paris.
text: We have just discovered this hotel and frankly, the overall experience has been great. Location (very quick connection to Orly and Montparnasse), cleanliness of the premises, kindness and attentiveness of the staff, everything was top-notch 👍

author: Nathan S
title: Fine for a stay in Paris
text:
Hotel Manufacture is an ideal hotel to (re)discover Paris. Near metro and bus lines (Place d'Italie), you have excellent connections to the whole city. The hotel is located in a quiet street with well-equipped rooms. Friendly staff, excellent
breakfast and pleasant atmosphere.

author: Sean E
title: Top
text: Super friendly staff, great welcome, clean hotel and well located.

author: Matthew L
title: Amazing hotel in Paris! 100% recommended
text:
We celebrated my mother's anniversary in Paris and booked the first 4 nights in Hôtel La Manufacture, to discover the new districts of Paris. At the end we liked the hotel so much, that we decided not to change it and booked the next 3 nights here. We were even allowed to stay in the same room and avoid the stress with luggage transportation - many thanks for it!

Due to the rooms capacity we even got a free room category upgrade, what we appreciated so much! Big thanks to the hotel team for this unforgettable stay on Paris, especially to the nice young lady who did the check in!

What we liked:
- the whole hotel is super clean and quite.
- the hotel lobby is looking very cute
- the bed and kisses in the room are very comfortable. We slept very well
- the water in the bath (cold/hot) worked perfectly
- the wifi/internet speed was perfect
- we also liked the small cute balcony in our room and enjoyed drinks there in the evening.
- the hotel team is very very very friendly and is ready to help any time.
My mother was so glad to hear the birthday wishes from the young lady from reception in the morning. It was very nice.
- the area around the hotel is really safe, even in the late evening.
- The connection to the train station and to the city center is amazing, you have many possibilities and can reach everything you want any time (even with night buses). In one minute walk from the hotel there is a bus station with several lines in many directions; in 2 minutes walk there is the metro station also with metro lines in many directions (e.g. direct metro to Paris Gare de l'Est). So, you can reach quite quick everything in Paris. Also Place d'Italie itself is quite interesting area and has its own shopping center. Close to it you can discover China town or old Paris districts with street art. You can also discover Paris by foot from the hotel and e.g. enjoy walking from the hotel to beautiful Jardin des Plantes or even to Pantheon. The streets on the way in comparison to the historical center are very green.
- there are many cafes, (not expensive) restaurants and food shops in a few steps from the hotel. 

What we did not liked: that our vacation ended and we couldn't stay longer in this hotel.

Thanks again to the whole hotel team for this great week in Paris. 
We are glad that we found such a nice possibility for the stay in the French capital and we will surely come back! 

I can recommend the Hôtel La Manufacture to everybody.

.

author: Olivia X
title: Very pleasant stay.
text: Very well-located hotel, very comfortable room, hearty and varied breakfast, welcoming staff.

author: Antoine C
title: Perfect place to stay in Paris
text: We loved our stay here. The staff were friendly and nothing was too much trouble. Annabelle especially took good care of us and made our dream trip to Paris very special by giving us a room with a perfect view of the Eiffel Tower. The room was clean and quiet with great amenities. Breakfast was great too.

author: Hannah X
title: good
text:
cute decorated and quite spacious rooms .
Beds were comfortable all things considered.
Kind staff.
At breakfast you will find few varieties to choose from, but you can adapt.

author: Caleb P
title: Good hotel, but some maintenance issues
text:
The hotel's strong point is definitely the location: it is located in a very convenient area of Paris, near Montmartre, the Moulin Rouge, and with several metro stops easily reachable. This allows you to get around easily to visit the city without wasting too much time traveling.

Breakfast was 
 good, with a good variety of products and satisfactory overall quality. The hotel's common areas are also pleasant and the staff proved to be helpful in resolving issues.

Unfortunately, the initial room had a problem with the shower, which was not working properly, so we had to ask for a room change. In the second room, however, we encountered another issue: the television did not work. These episodes were a bit disappointing considering the level and category of the hotel. However, the rooms were overall welcoming, with very comfortable beds and a good level of general comfort.

Another small detail concerns the water dispenser: it was indicated that sparkling water was also available, but in reality, it only dispensed cold still water.

The hotel, considering the structure and services offered, would have the characteristics to deserve a 4-star rating, but the inconveniences encountered during the stay lead me to give it 3 stars.

author: Leo Y
title: Very good stay!
text: I had a very good stay, spacious and very clean room! A top-notch welcome

author: Nora I
title: Mercure Montmartre Sacré-Cœur
text: Hotel that is dated, even if a remodel was done, the exterior entrance is not clean, the surrounding neighborhood is already not very clean, reception is okay, nothing to complain about, elevators (3) one of which had doors that broke at the end of our stay. Furniture that is a bit dated and damaged, worn benches, breakfast room the same. Room upon arrival, bedside lamp detached from the wall, broken A/C button, toilet water supply cover detached, carpet on one side of the bed with holes as if it were burned? We reported the repairs to the reception, which were done during the day. Basic room, bathroom with a bathtub 🛀 it would have been better with a shower, toilet very small, fridge very small and rusty on the rack, safe, TV. For our stay, street noise, construction 🚧 that we could hear even while being on the 6th floor. Noise also in the hotel, drill and hammer (even though there did not seem to be any renovations in the hotel). In the hallway, door sealed with tape?????? Very positive point, the breakfast, there is something for everyone, staff very responsive and friendly. Basic reception area. Security is very nice, maintenance staff the same, thank you to you all.

author: Camille Q
title: This is not the way to treat paying guests.
text:
I changed my rating from 5 to one star for the service because for 4 mornings I have been woken up by a jackhammer at 8:30; I went to complain at the reception and the girl at the reception (Claire) laughed and asked me, "Do I know you?" No, then why are you yelling?" Unacceptable behavior from a person who works in the front office.

Luckily, Helen from the restaurant managed to "calm me down," so to speak, with kindness and, above all, to note my complaint, something that the nice Claire did not do.
It is not normal for restaurant staff to take a complaint and for the receptionist to laugh in your face. Dear Claire, if you do not know how to handle angry customers, I suggest you go work somewhere else.

Fatou and Helen made my stay better.

author: Amelia Y
title: Difficult
text: Location was good we have stayed here on many occasions. Reception staff allocated a room but did not tell us of Major works being carried out next door at a accor group hotel Ibis. The door taped up where the drillilling and grinding noise was opposite our room we asked for a change of room but they said they were fully booked ( we had paid extra for a privilege room and I am a silver member with Accor but they still put us directly opposite the door where the work was being carried out. We observed delivery of equipment being delivered to the Ibis hotel next door and it looked like asbestos extraction equipment (the door opposite our room where the noise was conmming from had tape all around it to try and stop the any dust coming out..

author: Holly D
title: Good Montmartre Hotel
text: This is a modern hotel, with a nice sized double room, clean and comfortable. It’s best attribute – if you get on the right side – is a good view of the Eiffel Tower. While near the iconic basilica and historic Montmartre, it is away from the historic center of the city. However, a metro stop is within walking distance connects easily with other lines. With the more contemporary feel, the hotel loses some Parisian charm. Also – there shampoo was not provided in the shower! However certainly a good hotel at a good price.

author: Hannah L
title: A bunch of thieves!
text: A disgrace! Real thieves, these chains! I am booking a night by phone at the beginning of June for the weekend of June 27 to 28, 2026. The receptionist asks me for the imprint of my credit card for the reservation. At no point do I receive information about an immediate payment and the impossibility of modifying or canceling my reservation afterward. On Tuesday, June 24, I contact the hotel because my wife is hospitalized, and I need to cancel the reservation. And then, I discover that the €300 has been debited and that the reservation is non-refundable! Shameful!!!!

author: Freya O
title: Unpleasant experience
text: We booked a room with an extra charge for a 9 AM arrival. We were abruptly awakened by drills in action in the establishment. After complaining at the front desk, the surprised staff told us they would inquire and move us if the problem persisted. From that moment on, no further updates, no apologies, no goodwill gesture, and no way to leave a review on the site provided. I find this attitude very borderline and unworthy of a 4-star hotel. I will sleep elsewhere from now on.

author: Evie T
title: Ni air con
text:
Aircon and fan non existent. Especially annoying during this spell of hot weather, and on the hotel’s website description of its amenities it particularly says that they have aircon. If we had known, we wouldn’t have booked here. Otherwise, the hotel has a very nice terrace where you can have breakfast outside in warm weather.
The rooms are fine, but the plastic baths are very slippy if you’re having a shower.

author: Antoine B
title: NO A.C.
text:
The A.C. was not working for 3 nights in one of the hottest weeks in May history, but reading so many reviews with the same problem, it appears there is simple no air conditioning is in fact installed. 

You should stay away from this hotel during the summer and the hotel, should at least place a tower fan in each room.

What saves this hotel is its location, just a block away from bus stop or metro station. Walking distance from Moulin Rouge and Sacre Coeur.

author: Holly Q
title: Sleepless in sweaty Montmatre!
text:
No a/c- be prepared to be hot and stay hot!
Currently staying in the Mercure Montmatre. Great location, convenient for sightseeing and exploring Paris. Lots of bars and restaurants nearby. Hotel is pretty basic but clean…pillows are not amazing, towels are on the small side, bathroom is functional. The toilet is separate from the bathroom and is barely big enough. And it’s hot! The soap and shower gel smell delicious and are lovely.
But there is currently no a/c in the whole hotel. We weren’t told on arrival (Monday) and every day have been told an engineer is coming tomorrow. It’s now Wednesday night. It’s 30 degrees C plus in Paris this week. We are hot, sweaty and are getting no respite in the hotel! So far we’ve been offered free drinks and given some chocolate (which is meting in our hot room). Oh and there’s no ice in the hotel bar. Whoops. The water filling station on level 1 is a god send.

author: Kyle S
title: BEWARE!!! NO A/C!! REFUSES TO TURN IT ON!!! 87*
text: Unresponsive to issues with the room. Air-conditioning never worked and it was 87°F with sun streaming in the room every afternoon; we literally soaked the mattress with perspiration because it was so hot in the room. Multiple times asked for assistance and was promised to have a technician, but never did. One clerk actually admitted they controlled the A/C from the front desk, then a clerk later told me they didn’t. When confronted he looked embarrassed. Breakfast was good, only they were very slow to replenish items.

author: Amelia C
title: Great location to be based
text:
Absolutely lovely stay! Room was spacious and very clean and all the staff were very friendly- special mention for Jonathan in the bar who accommodated us quickly even though it was very busy. 
The bar was an unexpected bonus. Really lovely space to have a drink. 
We had breakfast on our last morning and it was worth the €20, food was hot and replenished. 
Location was perfect, really close to a Metro and walkable from Gard de Nord -  though do be aware of the area around the Moulin Rouge if you come with children….Quite an eye opener!
All in all a really great base and a splendid few days!

author: Amelia Y
title: Very nice surprise
text:
Excellent location at the foot of the Butte Montmartroise,
Just above a public car park,
Lovely, smiling and extremely helpful staff; thank you all,
We were upgraded to a (spacious and super clean) Privilege room very well designed (separate toilet👍).
Impeccable bedding,
Very nice outdoor terrace and garden on the 1st floor  
Cozy and warm commons 
Small parting gift 
Two downsides: 
- €25 per dog/night for two (small) dogs... and no ‘service’, it’s expensive!
- for ecological (and economical, I guess😉) reasons, the air conditioning was not yet functional in the room; rather uncomfortable considering the extremely mild outside temperature
In the end: beautiful discovery, so!!!

author: Julien F
title: Beautiful view!
text: We spent a wonderful week at the Mercure de Montmartre. The hotel is well placed next to all the amenities of the city, but also to crowded neighborhoods such as Pigalle. The staff are very friendly and accommodating. Many thanks to Claire at the reception, who was particularly involved in our stay and who made it all the more pleasant.

author: Caleb L
title: Great place!
text:
A warm welcome by friendly and very helpful staff. A great place to stay in Montmartre.
Full breakfast. Many thanks to Khali,Mariame, Andrei, Noé!

author: Chloe L
title: 4 Nights at Mercure Montmartre Sacre Coeur
text: Stayed here for 4 nights. Rooms is decent. Location is okay. About a 5 minute walk to place de clichy metro. Lots of restaurants close by.

author: Evan T
title: Broken elevator and lies
text:
Elevator constantly broken. 
When you arrive on the first day, they tell you that it broke that day and they will take care of it the next day
I have been here for 3 days and they always say: "The technician is coming tomorrow"
It is not true! 
Going down the spiral staircase from the fourth floor multiple times a day is torture...

author: Julien E
title: To hot to sleep tiny twin beds with basic matteress
text: Hot Hot 🥵🔥 Hot. We had to move hotels. No air-conditioning in hot Paris weather. We had no sleep. The bed was tiny, I felt like I was going to fall out of the bed. We booked three nights and had to leave after two. The staff didn't even ask why. Other people arriving where worried about how they would sleep without a fan or aircon. We are Aussie and couldn't.

author: Daisy O
title: Simple but effective
text:
It is beautiful, but it is old and unpretentious. 

I think it is important to keep in mind that this is not a luxury hotel. 

Someone wrote in another review that this establishment was more like a youth hostel. I would not go so far as to say that, but it is a very "do-it-yourself" hotel experience. 

No room service, unless you request it, before the 7th day. 

We had an apartment on the 5th floor, which was quite quiet and clean. Unfortunately, we stayed there during the recent unusual heat wave that hit Paris. On that note, please note that they provide fans. Do not hesitate to ask for one to cool off. To our great delight, we also had beautiful, large windows that opened. We were not always able to take advantage of them because of our young child.

A remark regarding safety. We had the top-floor apartment, whose windows open completely. There is a small railing, but if you have young children, it would take very little for them to get hurt if they have a tendency to climb. Likewise, in the mezzanine of this apartment, although our little one managed the spiral staircase quite well, there was a wide space between the bars at the top that could perhaps be filled by an additional railing or a plexiglass panel for more safety (my child could squeeze through the bars). 

Roman's service was exceptional. The woman who brought us our pre-ordered breakfast in the morning was also very kind. Place your order at the front desk or scan the QR code. 

If you request a late checkout via the app, it does not constitute a guarantee. We unfortunately learned this very late in our stay. One of our return flights was not scheduled until late in the evening. 

Try to speak a little French or, at least, make the effort to improve. Roman managed very well with my spouse in English, but the woman who handled our check-in, although very kind to French guests, was clearly either unhappy with my insufficient French or nervous about her insufficient English. The friendliness of the staff varies. 

The hotel is simple. And yes, there is no air conditioning. But the location is excellent. And all things considered, we enjoyed our stay. It is a charming building.
 

Yes, there are homeless people in the area. Welcome to every major city in 2026. Honestly, they posed no threat to us during our stay. It may not be very pleasant to see, but it is part of city life. 

The extra bedding was in baskets near the door. Other extra bedding items were stored in the mezzanine closet. We enjoyed our room on the fifth floor. We would gladly come back here, but hope it is not during a heat wave!

author: Marco O
title: AVOID
text:
This was one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had, and I am genuinely shocked that this property is advertised as a 4-star hotel.

The only redeeming feature is the location. Beyond that, everything was deeply disappointing. The area directly outside the hotel was absolutely disgusting. On multiple occasions there were homeless people openly injecting drugs right outside the entrance, and the streets around the hotel constantly smelled of urine. It felt unsafe, unpleasant, and completely unacceptable for any hotel claiming to offer a quality guest experience.

The hotel itself was equally poor. There is no air conditioning, which made the rooms unbearably uncomfortable. The facilities are tired, basic, and nowhere near the standard expected of a 4-star property. In reality, this hotel is closer to a budget 1- or 2-star hotel than anything remotely deserving of 4 stars.

What is most frustrating is the misleading rating. Had I known the true condition of both the hotel and its immediate surroundings, I would never have booked it. The photographs and star classification create expectations that the hotel simply cannot meet.

I would not stay here again under any circumstances and would strongly advise other travellers to look elsewhere. Paris has countless accommodation options, and this hotel should be avoided.

author: Lily F
title: Terrible front office staff
text:
Terrible front office service during the night. Unable to perform a proper check in. Second night, at 10PM with a full lobby and 2 staff members available I was loudly called to attention for forgetting the door code (main door was closed even with 2 staff members available)  
When faced with a complain about the behavior, insinuated I was not treating them properly “in their city” (which seemed a veiled insulation of racism, which I find highly offensive).  Kept talking over me disrespectfully, telling me I used the f* word (which I never did). Worse experience ever in an Accor hotel.

author: Sofia W
title: Vacation with children.
text:
Our apartment on the fifth floor was large and clean, with a kitchenette and a small terrace.
The 2 fans were very convenient.
The kitchenette is equipped with everything: coffee machine (with pods), kettle, fridge, dishwasher, microwave, and all the dishes.
Overall, we really liked the structure and the staff is very kind and friendly.
Convenient location for the metro and very close to Sacro Cuore.

author: Camille A
title: Terrible experience never again!!
text: Terrible staff service, dangerous damaged electrical sockets, smashed skirting boards. We booked 2 interconnecting rooms for 4 adults. Our booking confirmed one double bed and one sofa bed with twin or double bed.  On arrival the sofa bed was not made up. We asked reception to make up the bed for us. We were told we should make it ourselves, that it is simple and the bedding is in cupboard. We returned at 11pm and were unable to put the bed together. When I went downstairs to get help there was no one at reception. I had to enter the back kitchen area to find a member of staff. He was reluctant to help. Finally he came upstairs only to tell us off for the way we  had opened up the sofa bed!!!I He then reluctantly put it together. Then he noticed we didn't even have the correct bedding!!! so he left to get this. He rudely dumped the bedding on the sofa bed for us to make the bed up. Now it was blindly clear that we should not expect any form of assistance during our stay. The dangerous  exposed electrical wiring from hanging plug sockets only added to our feeling of unease. Too expensive for what it offers.
