author: Zoe C
title: Stay of a perfect night!
text:
Very well placed hotel in the Montmartre district, very practical family room with space, good bedding and quiet... A little apprehension, because the hotel is large and has many rooms, but calm reigns.
Very good reception of the staff, on arrival and departure.
We'll be back!

author: Rosie R
title: Very noisy and very basic hotel (more like a youth hostel)
text: Very disappointed with this hotel. Really noisy street and walls are paper thin so could hear everything from neighbouring rooms. Could not sleep until the people in the room above us stopped moving about. Very basic decor. Mattresses and pillows not comfortable. Dead rat on pavement outside the entrance was there for the duration of our stay (3 nights).

author: Hugo S
title: Supportive and caring customer care.
text:
Many thanks to the team for your support durning my stay and ensuring I had the best experience. I am frequent traveller and customer of Adagio Montmartre and it is always a pleasure to spend time in your Aparthotel. 
The location is  amazing and the rooms are comfortable. 
Many thanks again for your support on this occasion. It is much appreciated.

author: Molly J
title: Dust flakes and smelly toilet!
text:
At the entrance a tent of a homeless person with dog was not immediately very cozy and uplifting. The studio we rented for 6 days was not cleaned once, dust flakes around, smelly toilet, broken coffee maker: everything remained as it was. Because this studio had no sweeper except a dustpan and can! The not too friendly staff responded very matter-of-factly to our complaints. 
All this together was not a pleasant experience for us.

author: Joseph H
title: I was stolen while I slept
text:
In September 2025 I organized a trip with my mother and a friend to Europe, we would pass through some beautiful cities, a dream.  Everything was studied and organized with great care. When I was referred to the Adagio Montmartre I found it interesting because it is in a vibrant neighborhood with many options of restaurants and cafes.
Every day I regret this choice, because the tour that would be 15 days of joy was interrupted on the Third party. While we slept in room 1102, we were stolen. They took credit cards, phones, passports, backpacks and cash. The panic has established itself. When we came down asking for help, asking to call the police we were treated with apathy and discredit, the attendant insisted that it was impossible to enter our room.
So, in the moment when we were in the Louvre, surrounded by culture and beauty, our destination was the police station, walking, without even a coffee, we spent the morning there, where we were once again discredited, because they never happened to steal a room with the guests sleeping inside it.
It seems that in Paris impossible things happen and unfortunately happened to us.

Finally, if you want to go through moments of total vulnerability, helplessness and fear on a walk: Aparthotel Adagio Montmartre is the venue.

author: Nora I
title: Highly recommended
text: Apartment in a beautiful area, in the neighborhood of Montmartre, but in a very quiet street. Very close to a metro station. Many restaurants within 2 minutes, some very good. The apartment very comfortable, had everything and we have been a week and very well, recommended.

author: Ryan Z
title: Nice hotel in a good location
text:
Very nice hotel right at the foot of Montmartre. Very good location, you are in the middle of the picturesque district, yet it is quiet, bus and metro run in the immediate vicinity. Also the elevator to Sacre Coeur is just around the corner.

The rooms are very small but well equipped and okay for a city break. Price quality ratio is good. The staff is friendly and helpful.
There were problems in the room (dishwasher leaking), but these were quickly fixed.

The only catch was the shower. It was really tiny, like a camping shower. The splash guard only lasted over a third of the shower tray, it was impossible to shower without submerging the equally tiny bathroom. So for that you have to love the adventure a little bit, but it worked. 

There was no air conditioning either. We were there in very hot weather and I still found it bearable after we had ventilated again late in the evening, but sometimes some guests find this more difficult.

But I would want to go back down there at any time.

author: Mia J
title: Caution About This Paris Apartment Hotel
text: When I arrived the toilet in my room did not flush.   They moved me to another room where the toilet barely flushed and there were two single beds pushed together (I had paid for a double bed).   Finally they moved me to a third room but it was very stressful.   The third room was not very clean and had terrible lighting.   The location is pretty far from things (although I chose it knowing that)

author: Hannah E
title: Family trip in very comfortable structure.
text: Comfortable, clean, area with attractions and a good walk you get to the main attractions

author: Grace U
title: Space and location
text: I liked the room, a lot of space and with a single room apart, kitchen with microwave and coffee maker, close to the metro and the tourist attractions of Montmatre

author: Ian H
title: Great Hotel
text: Me and my family have stayed at the Adagio Paris Montmartre three times so far, and it is always my first choice for accommodation in Paris.

author: Zachary D
title: Great location .
text: Brilliant base for exploring Montmartre, at end of a cul-de-sac just 3 - 4 minutes from Sacre Coeur. security staff  on duty 24 hours, there  was a homeless person camping in a tent with awning just 50 yards away. Building has been refurbished but not to a very good standard. Bathrooms have new tiles on top of old which are not covered over or finished off at door frames, new skirting boards have simply been attached to old boards, loose socket in apartment. Great for backpackers and those wanting self catering facilities and friendly staff .

author: Julien A
title: very nice and pleasant environment
text: Very good hotel, large room, all equipped with mini kitchen, iron and tabua to pass clothes, had even dishwasher, friendly staff, good cleaning.

author: Daisy X
title: A bit disappointed
text: I stayed at this hotel for the third time and, unfortunately, this time I was a bit disappointed. The location remains magnificent and is the main reason why I chose this property again. However, three years after my last visit, I found the hotel rather neglected, with several signs of wear and tear and room maintenance that leaves something to be desired. As I had already pointed out in the past, only one small bottle of water per guest is provided in the room, and no other toiletries or slippers are available. A positive aspect is the common room, where drinks and sweets are offered for free in the afternoon, a touch that is certainly appreciated. However, overall, I had the feeling that the quality of the property has worsened compared to my previous stays.

author: Sofia J
title: No Concern for Customers, No Good Will Effort
text: I had booked a non-cancelable room directly with this hotel for 26 and 27 June, 2026, during the big heat wave.  Our Eurostar from Brussels to Paris was cancelled with less than 3 hours notice.  No Eurostar was available either for the rest of that day or for the next day.  I immediately called the hotel and asked about changing the reservation to another weekend and was told by the desk clerk that he could do nothing, and I would have to write their management--this was around 13h15 on a Friday.  I wrote the management an email.  When I made a follow-up call asking why I'd had no response to my email, I was told that no one would respond until Monday.  I was then told that the reservation was non-cancelable and non-modifiable.  There was NOTHING in the information I was given that said the reservation was non-modifiable, and given these incredibly extenuating circumstances, I would expect some kind of relief.  I offered to come at another time of year when the hotel was slow and to stay extra days.  Their answer was still that the reservation was non-modifiable.  When I wrote questioning this, as I find this nowhere in the information I have received or on their website, I was told that it was in the terms and conditions.  I have not seen this in the terms and conditions and asked to be directed to it.  I received no answer to that email request.  I wrote a few days later asking for a response.  Still no response from the hotel's management.  The fact that the hotel management can not even be bothered to respond to an email asking them to justify their contention that the reservation is non-modifiable speaks volumes to the lack of concern they have for their customers.  As a seasoned traveler, I find this very short sighted and evidence of a total lack of compassion for their customer.  Note that the hotel charged me for TWO days, not just one, and made no effort to offer any compromise measure of any sort even though I have little doubt that given the fact that they supposedly have air conditioning, they were able to let that room both days.  I will never reserve here, or at any Best Western, again.

author: Giulia S
title: This hotel has to be closed !
text:
Simply disgusting !
Very small rooms with ridiculous bathroom !

author: Anna F
title: Great location! On the street of theaters
text: Hotel right across from the "Grands Boulevards" metro station! In the buildings of the Passage Jouffroy where the Grevin museum is located! Comfortable rooms with everything working! Italian shower with hot water, while in many hotels, it's optional! Unpretentious breakfast but very, very decent!!!! Unlimited coffee in a designated room for that purpose! Very friendly staff, also a miracle in Paris! Only downside: the soundproofing is not up to par! The hallways need a refresh as soon as possible! Walking along them, you expect the worst while the rooms are very nice! Considering the services and the location: highly recommended!

author: Lucas F
title: Good deal
text: Just a small downside, we could hear the people in the next room quite well. Otherwise, everything was perfect, thank you and see you soon. Do not hesitate to book.

author: Thomas F
title: Great location, highly recommend.
text: Superb location just a few meters from two very convenient subway entrances for traveling around Paris, exceptional value for money. I highly recommend the friendly breakfast, the welcome, and the impeccable service of the staff. Always attentive, providing good advice, the services of the lounge in the afternoon and evening are excellent. The evening was excellent regarding the room; nothing special, classic style. It was quite warm in the room for this time of year, but the air conditioning worked, so we were able to regulate it. A small downside is that the shower column is broken. It would be welcome to change the shower column of the Acquadimer. And to have a bit more pressure. The neighborhood is very pleasant; you can do everything on foot, close to the Galeries Lafayette and theaters, with many restaurants nearby and the Bouillon Chartier just 50 meters away. If you want to spend a stay in Paris, I think this is the perfect hotel. As soon as you exit the hotel, to your left, you will find the Grévin Museum.

author: Olivia N
title: Family stay
text: Perfect location, clean, excellent breakfast and helpful and kind staff. Just missing a fridge from the room

author: Aiden D
title: Total disappointment: hotel old, noisy and in need of serious renovation
text:
I was disappointed, totally disappointed. The hotel is old, neglected and gives the feeling of having now reached the end of the race. Overall the structure appears poorly maintained: in the corridors the carpet lifts off the floor, a detail that is not only ugly to see, but also conveys an impression of general neglect.

The room was a great disappointment. Sufficient electrical outlets are lacking, to the point that charging phones or other devices becomes complicated, which is now frankly unacceptable for a hotel. Another huge problem: noise. The windows are not soundproof and from the street virtually everything enters, making it difficult to rest.

The only thing that is saved is the bathroom, which at least is acceptable compared to the rest. For the rest, the structure would need not minor touches, but a deep and serious renovation.

You could say that the hotel saves itself for the location, but honestly even that is not enough: in the same area there is better, really. The location cannot justify such an outdated, noisy and poorly maintained structure. Bad experience, would not recommend.

author: Sophia L
title: To avoid
text:
Pros: the receptionist's welcome and friendliness
Cons:
-a light didn't work, rather dark room so
You hear every passage of the subway, which resonates throughout the building
-the walls are as thick as a sheet of paper, I thought we were breaking into my room when the noisy occupants of the room next to mine disembarked in the early evening, left, then returned at 4am.
The sound insulation is therefore totally non-existent, we hear the conversations of the neighboring rooms as if the people were by your side...
-well, like most places in this city, the neighborhood is full of night owls, and we were treated all night in the hotel to "boom-boom" music from whatever bar or nightclub in the neighborhood...
Result sleepless night for me, the worst hotel I've ever known...

author: Katie T
title: Friendly staff and near to the Paris highlights
text:
Location was really good and not far away for the highlights and for the train station. Good breakfast. And providing some free snack and drinks on 2pm-10pm. Staff were really nice and friendly welcoming .
Room was really little space.but very clean. Room service clean every day on request. I can really recommend it!

author: Ruby K
title: Overall pretty good
text: Beautiful historic establishment, classic, mouldings and stuccoes on the ceilings, deco combining the old Haussmannian and the modern. bright rooms that deserve however a small renovation or refreshment, but nothing very embarrassing. large bathrooms. breakfast very correct and varied. ideally located and quiet on the JOUFFROY passage.which closes in the evening at 9pm. it is a shame however that all the staff is not in uniform like those of the breakfast room in the morning, especially at the reception. It would give a much better impression of professionalism, seriousness and good looks for this brand establishment. It is always a little bit missing but it is with this kind of detail that a good impression is given and that ultimately builds a reputation....

author: Antoine K
title: Excellent location, very good value
text: Excellent location, comfortable beds, clean, good sleep (fairly quiet even though the room faced the boulevard).

author: Ryan V
title: Perfect location, good service, nice and clean rooms.
text: Best Western Ronceray Opera is a lovely hotel in a fantastic location. Closely located to the Grand Boulevards and the Opera and the Sacre-Coeur and lots of restaurants and cafes directly outside the hotel and with underground station 2 minutes away makes this a perfect hotel for a visit to Paris.

author: Manon F
title: Poor Quality Service - Barely A 2-Star.
text:
Reasonably well located hotel. Convenient for main line & metro. In an interesting historical building in an area with plenty of restaurants.
Had 2 double rooms. Furniture mostly damaged with doors hanging-off. Room safes had both been destroyed & therefore no in-room security. Neither room was cleaned during our stay nor was there any replacement of consumables (towels, drinks etc.)

author: Mia E
title: A hotel already known and appreciated for years, "our" hotel in Paris
text:
Perfect location for us, central for our movements on foot or by metro, and immersed in the liveliness of the Grand Boulevards just steps from the Opéra Garnier. We have known the hotel for several years, we have been there at least 3 other times and we always find a great standard from all points of view. Breakfast is buffet style, varied and plentiful with an excellent camembert and different qualities of great bread. The yogurt is also very good.
The value for money is very good, even considering the average prices in the area.
The only weakness: in the room there is not even a drawer, the wardrobe is small, not very comfortable for those staying for several days.

author: James P
title: Room next to a nightclub
text: The room played a nightclub or joint, both nights we did not sleep well, as until late at night we listened to music at levels that were not normal. The music was turning up in volume during the night. The rooms are poorly soundproofed and you can hear even the alarms of the rest. A person with a shallow sleep does not rest at all. Too bad for the price we paid.

author: Gavin P
title: You can enjoy the good old Paris
text:
I spent three nights twice, including a two-day excursion, for a total of six nights.
If you are looking for modern hotel facilities and environment, we do not recommend it. But it will be a good experience for travelers who want to feel the good old Paris.
Now part of Best Western, it was originally a long-running hotel under the name Ronceray, and postcards from the 1920s are still available, although it's unclear when it opened. The building is even older, and a plaque in the hotel says that the composer Rossini stayed there around 1830, so we know it was built before that. There is an entrance to the Passage Jouffroy on the ground floor, which is said to have been completed in 1846, so it may be that holes were drilled through the existing building.
Now, let's go into the hotel. The entrance is on the Passage side and you can go to the front desk on the 1st floor (2nd floor in Japan) by elevator. I picked up my card key from the friendly front desk staff and went back to the elevator. Windows in the upper elevator hall overlook the glass roof of the passage.
Use the card key to open the hallway door before reaching the room. The air conditioning is heated by a huge steam system in winter only in summer. The bathroom has been renovated so it feels clean.
Rooms facing the main street have the privilege of viewing the main street from above.
Breakfast is standard buffet style, but you can also enjoy the decor of old with gold decorations and chandeliers.
There is no refrigerator. If it's winter, would it be a good idea to put it outdoors?

author: Brooke C
title: Do not come here
text:
Awful.
 Paper thin walls, you can hear everything. Doors are loud to close so whenever someone closes a door you hear it. 
Right above a club so we did not sleep all weekend. It’s currently 1:45am it’s still going so loud I can sing along to the songs. 
Do not come here.

author: Marta N
title: Canon
text:
Excellent hotel.
Quality location: 15 min walk from the train station, close to the shepherds' follies and large neighborhoods. Very accessible.

Welcoming staff, adorable, anxious to do well.
The bedding is good, the bathroom is optimized.

Small point however: the cleaning is not IMPECCABLE, but very acceptable, especially considering the attractive price, in the middle of Paris

author: Pierre B
title: Comfortable but not recommended
text:
Comfortable hotel but not worth the price paid.
Non-soundproof rooms poor breakfast little choice
Elevator broke us and had to carry hand luggage
The card to enter the room is demagnetized 
Rooms never ready before 3pm

author: Katie S
title: Good experience
text: The hotel is very well located, close to the center and 2 different metro stations. Very friendly service at the reception. It's nice and clean. The rooms are not large, but there is what is different. Morning very nice after French conditions. Several restaurants and bars are located nearby.

author: Joseph R
title: Great experience in Paris.
text: Welcoming and clean hotel. Beautiful, very large room, and a really comfortable bathroom for children.

author: Sofia K
title: RECOMMENDABLE
text:
Excellent attention...location...rooms with good bathroom...towels and robes...coffee maker...electric kettle etc.
Recommended

author: Jack B
title: Optimal
text: Beautiful hotel, great service with all amenities, always present staff, located in the center, convenient location, perfect taxi-hotel service, great breakfast, good wi fi and heating even, clean rooms every day. I recommend it!

author: Ella V
title: Loved the hotel
text: Very cozy hotel. The location is the best in a very nice neighborhood. Very well connected to the city, the airports, and train stations. There are two metro stops near. The rooms are very clean, comfy, and silent. The staff are very nice, professional, and helpful. The breakfast is excellent. And the prices are very reasonable. I would definitely recommend it and will book again there whenever I´ll be back to Paris.

author: Nora B
title: perfect stay
text: from the point of view of both the very benevolent welcome and the quality of the services everything was perfect

author: Liam E
title: Impossible to rest
text: In this hotel it is impossible to rest or sleep at night, not only because of the noise of the bars around the hotel but also because in the face of very noisy guests in the early morning the receptionists do not do their job and ask them to keep quiet vigorously.

author: Ruby I
title: My experience at the hotel was good
text: Hotel very well located, very clean , very friendly staff, breakfast very well too, if I went again would definitely come back. Against : the room a little small.

author: Matthew Z
title: Simple lovely 4star  hotel, triple superior room plesently suprised, beds very comfortable,  city centre,
text: Triple superior room very happy spacious  plesently suprised, beds comfortable, city centre, plenty room, could reccomend to add a  small mini fridge in the room, enjoyed our family stay of 3, seen other double rooms cleaned, ok for 2 people, rooms cleaned daily,  friendly front door staff, everything close by, plenty shops grocery stores, restaurants caffe shops around the corner, Gallery laffayet walking distance of 20 min, 1 km, expect to be very busy traffic, bolt is great to get around but depends where you go, to get back from Eiffel tower took 2 hours wait as very busy, great stay in Hotel Regina Opera, would reccomend,

author: Andrea X
title: good for one night, three stars okay but not four stars
text: tb located, friendly staff, small room but for one night business ok, but clearly not at the level of a 4 star, deplorable acoustics, carpeted floor, dirty TV remote control, stains and blow on the walls, elevator not very clean outside, bedding without more, sheets without more...average way actually

author: Ruby Q
title: PELOVSKI
text:
good positioned hotel
very clean hotel
very polite staff
very good breakfast
RECCOMENDED FOR TRAVELERS AND HOLIDAY MAKERS

author: Louis N
title: Paris trip
text: Full disclosure, we booked this hotel for 7 nights but had to cut our trip short due to family emergency. Consequently, we stayed only one night and left before breakfast was served. Thus, no feedback on the breakfast in this review. What stood out to us was the friendliness of the front desk staff. The hotel is in a good location. The physical appearance and amenities are average and, in our opinion, don't measure up to the 4-star level.

author: Megan D
title: Very low Price quality ratio
text: The staff is not discreet - talk very loud next to breakfast of 7am it is very unpleasant. The headboards are washed out, for 300euro a night the room would look very old and neglected.

author: Claire Z
title: Review of Hotel Regina Opéra: a regrettable experience
text:
My stay at Hotel Regina Opéra was certainly one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had. Despite its central location, lack of maintenance, incompetent staff and insecure surroundings completely ruined our trip to Paris.

Neglected and dilapidated facilities

Photos on the website do not reflect the reality of the hotel. The rooms and corridors are very dated and show obvious deterioration. In my case, there was visible damage to the room, demonstrating the lack of investment and care in the maintenance of the place.

Insecurity in the environment

The area surrounding the hotel is surprisingly dangerous and unsafe. I didn’t feel comfortable going out at night, and during the day it was common to see people getting high in the street, in full view. This is unacceptable for a hotel that promotes itself as a quiet and safe place.

Staff incompetence and lack of professionalism

The most serious point of our stay was the total lack of professionalism of the staff. Because of him, the fire alarm went off twice in the same night (at 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.), going off for several minutes. This completely interrupted our rest. The next day, when we asked for compensation for the inconvenience, the hotel refused, arguing that it had been an “unintentional error”. An error of this kind, which affects the safety and rest of guests, should be treated with the utmost seriousness and not excused in this way.

Disorganized breakfast

To complete the mess, the Breakfast Service is chaotic. The dining room is tiny, with only about 22 places, which forced guests to queue long enough to sit down for breakfast.

In short, I do not recommend this hotel at all. The price does not correspond at all with the quality of its services and the overall experience is deeply disappointing

author: Paige Y
title: Hotel very well placed with top staff
text: The Hotel Régina Opera is super well placed, the staff is top, attentive and very pro, however for the price there are quiel little details to review in terms of equipment and sound of the rooms, we hear quite a lot from the neighbors

author: Alexander G
title: Always good
text: Like other times always good this hotel.Great breakfast, large and clean room, friendly and prepared staff. It was not the first time we came to the Regina, landmark for us in Paris also as position.We will return.

author: Connor J
title: Hotel Regina Opera - highly recommended!
text: Excellent stay overall. The room was clean and the staff was friendly and helpful. There is a metro station very close by that travels to most places in the city of Paris quickly. Be warned that there are only stairs and no escalator or elevator at this station. There were some noises outside of the hotel late at night - but that only happened 1or 2 nights of our 5 night stay. There are a lot of great restaurants and bars nearby and even several grocery stores only 1 street over. I loved this area of the city and would definitely stay at this hotel again in the future.

author: David A
title: Median Hotel in Paris
text: The location of the hotel is very good, but the apartment is tiny. You can't open your bags. The breakfast is excellent. It has various types of cheeses, eggs and breads. The reception and elevator are awful and the night closes the hotel reception.

author: Rosie P
title: Good situated, good mattresses, good breakfast
text:
The hotel is good situated, has good mattresses in its beds, and a nearly very good breakfast.
The room was small but quiet.
Not perfect, but nice.

author: Thomas F
title: Definitely not up to 4 stars
text:
What about this small hotel? It certainly does not live up to a 4 star! My deep disappointment is due to this: booking a 4-star hotel is to expect a level of quality that I have not found. I don't mean that it was a bad hotel, but that it doesn't live up to its 4 stars: it would be a good two stars, or at most a quiet three stars: certainly not a 4 stars! The rooms are very small: they are even microscopic! So small that you can't even open the balcony window, because it hits the bed. The bathroom is just as small and, as mentioned, although it is good, one would expect better. The breakfast, on the other hand, is really poor: the buffet is reduced to nothing and served in a room so cramped that there are not enough tables compared to the rooms. A buffet like this deserves at best two stars, and certainly not four: I have found much better buffets in many two-star hotels. For breakfast, you would expect better than a few touches and an automatic coffee machine! One major flaw: the roughness of the rooms: I was unfortunate enough to look out onto the street and, because of the many pubs that line it, I can assure you that it is impossible to sleep until late at night. In addition, even the partitions are made of tissue paper, which allows you to hear clearly what is said or done in the next room...
Moreover, the hotel's location is certainly not in one of the best areas of the city... quite the contrary: the area is quite run down and, for a tourist, too far from the heart of the city, the Latin Quarter; nevertheless, it is very well connected by the metro.

author: Nora M
title: Located on lively street with restaurant and shops, good stay
text: I was surprised to find a Marriott hotel in such a neighborhood setting. The building is located on street of restaurant and shops. Despite other reviews here I had a warm welcome and staff was helpful in providing me with some help on how to navigate to my business meeting with public transport the next day. The room was nicely setup and I didn't spot any major cleanness issues, and airconditioning worked. So all is good. One downside was the iron board which is the small version with out a stand and you have to iron on the bed or table - i hate those i practical things. On the plus side; I asked staff about dinner options and they offered me several choices and one restaurant nearby was spot on. Breakfast was good although selection isn't abundant it offers enough options to start the day well. The convenience store and restaurants in the street are handy and make for a lively setting. I had a good experience and stay here.

author: Chloe G
title: Great
text:
A big thank you for your warm welcome and kindness.
The service is worthy of a 5-star rating, and both the breakfast and the room are just top-notch.

Thank you very much

author: Mason R
title: Disappointing cleanliness standards for a Residence Inn
text:
I usually stay at Residence Inn properties and have generally had good experiences, which is why this stay in Paris was particularly disappointing.

The main issue was cleanliness. From the moment I entered the room, I noticed that the bedsheets had visible stains. While I cannot confirm whether they had been changed, this is not something you expect when checking into a hotel.

More concerning was the housekeeping during my stay. The room was never vacuumed, not once, which was obvious as the floor remained dirty throughout. The bathroom was also not properly cleaned.

As a simple but telling example, there was a hair stuck on the wall next to the bathroom mirror when I arrived. I deliberately left it there to see if it would be cleaned; it was still there when I checked out. This says a lot about the level of attention given to cleaning.

That said, I would like to highlight Dylan at reception, who was very welcoming and professional throughout my stay. 

Overall, while the concept of the Residence Inn is good, the cleanliness at this property, at least in my case, fell well below expectations. Cleanliness is a basic standard, and unfortunately, this stay did not meet it.

author: Holly H
title: No heating or AC system / poor housekeeping / not a good value at all
text: The location is excellent and quiet, we do like it, we have stayed here before.  Service at the hotel is not very good, housekeeping is poor and we had no working ventilation or heating system in our room - at 300 euros / night, that's kinda nuts.  We were told too bad, open the window, but that doesn't help with heating when needed.  Anyway, it was our final stay there this time.

author: Poppy E
title: Rude staff
text: Staff is remarkably rude, even for Paris. Take your business elsewhere unless you enjoy being talked to like a child. Also, they seem completely unable to process a simple crib request. Not family friendly.

author: Liam N
title: A very comfortable residence in Paris!
text:
Marriott residence Inn Didot was a very friendly accommodation choice when I visited Paris during my trip end of November / beginning of December. The staff were very friendly, helpful, and putting all their effort to make our stay pleasant. The room was very neat, spacious, and very comfortable with sufficient illumination and the toilet was very clean and comfortable. 
The breakfast operation hours and the variety/selection of food were very nice and tables and seats were comfortable. 
Definitely choosing that residence when visiting Paris again.

author: Megan C
title: Great stay!
text: Great welcome. Staff attentive and responsive to our requests. Clean room and great location. We'll be right back.

author: Lucas G
title: Affordable and convenient business hotel in a very friendly neighborhood
text:
The hotel is lovely and very well located in the 14th arrondissement of Paris. The area is quite nice with many little restaurants all around, a real feel of a little village in Paris.
The hotel itself is very welcoming, and the staff is good, but I did have an issue with cleanliness of the room. The room I was in was of a good size and had a little induction stove, which is very convenient if you don’t want to eat out as you have all the necessary tools to cook your own meal. 
I was just disappointed that the whole week I spent there, the room was swiped just once, and even though, the job was not well done. When we first got the room there was some hair on the floor probably from the previous client, and also in the shower.  So that was quite unsettling. Apart from that all was good. 
Breakfast buffet is nice with everything needed, and I also liked the fact that there’s a coffee machine that provides all the coffee, chocolate beverages you want 24/7, for free.
All in all, a good experience if not for the housekeeping issue.

author: Oliver D
title: Small rooms with unskilled staff. No Go
text: The staff had no clue about there own hotel and facilities. The room had a bad smell. Location is ok, but I definitely can’t recommend this place. The entire stay was frustrating.

author: Morgan R
title: Now Residence Inn by Marriott Paris Didot Montparnasse
text:
The hotel is now named Residence Inn by Marriott Paris Didot Montparnasse.
I stayed overnight during my business trip to Paris. The rooms were spacious and generally comfortable. It was convenient because there were many restaurants around. I think it is an option for those who have an errand on the south side of Paris.

author: Chloe R
title: Best hotel we have stayed in Paris
text:
We have been to Paris several times and this was the best hotel. Our studio was upgraded to one bedroom. Large and well maintained suite. Large balcony with table and chairs. Full kitchen. Slippers provided upon request. Most of the staff was nice and helpful except one young man on night shift who was very annoying, claiming that late checkout was based on availability even for Platinum members (not true; 4 pm is Marriott policy and we had no problem getting it).
Breakfast was not bad, especially scrambled eggs; best I’ve had in a while.
Next time in Paris we’ll stay here again.

author: Liam A
title: A true home away from home in Paris with exceptional staff and comfort!
text:
I had the pleasure of staying at the Residence Inn Paris Didot Montparnasse from August 18 to 22, and it was truly a wonderful experience from start to finish.

A heartfelt thank you to Mr. Guillaume Fridrich, Deputy General Manager, for the warm welcome as a Bonvoy Platinum Elite guest and for the thoughtful upgrade to a spacious 1-bedroom suite on the 6th floor. My arrival was well past midnight due to a delayed Air France flight from Toulouse, yet James and Sely greeted me warmly at the front desk. The moment I stepped into my suite, all my exhaustion and stress melted away.

The suite was beautiful and spacious, overlooking the quiet courtyard. I especially appreciated the separate bathroom and toilet, both spotless and well-maintained. The shower had fantastic water pressure, and the air conditioning was excellent—I loved being able to set it to 16°C, which is rare and such a comfort during summer in Paris. The bed, pillows, and comforter were so cozy that I slept like a baby on several nights. A small but thoughtful detail: the safe was large enough to fit my laptop, unlike in many other hotels.

Breakfast was a delight every morning. While the selection is not huge, the quality is outstanding—the pastries, in particular, are exceptional. Whoever their boulangerie supplier is, I can honestly say their croissants and pain au chocolat are so good that I never felt the need to buy them elsewhere. The two coffee machines ensured I could enjoy my Americano each morning without waiting.

Location-wise, this property couldn’t be more convenient. There’s a Monoprix and Franprix right next door, making it easy to pick up anything you might need. The bus stop is directly in front of the hotel, providing easy access to the city center, and the metro is only a short 7–8 minute walk away.

This was already my second stay, and I’m happily planning my third. While I’m aware of other excellent Marriott Bonvoy properties in Paris, I find the Residence Inn Didot Montparnasse offers fantastic value, comfort, and a sense of “home.” Guillaume and his team deserve special praise—every interaction I had with the staff was professional, warm, and welcoming.

This property has my highest recommendation.

author: Zoe C
title: Nice little hotel, very out of the way.
text:
This hotel is fine, but ultimately not somewhere I'd stay again. Pros: Staff were nice, breakfast staff were especially kind. Breakfast was very good. Room was clean and it had a small balcony. Transportation nearby. Nice, residential area. Plenty of stores and restaurants around.
Cons: Room was average, nothing special. Bed was not comfortable. There was no place to store clothes except for the one closet. No drawers at all, except for where the kitchen items were stored. A/C wasn't cold enough. While transportation was closeby, this hotel is at least 30 mins away from city center. If this is your first time visiting Paris and you are not accustomed to taking the metro or buses, this might not be the hotel for you.

author: Freya A
title: Feels like we live in Paris
text: We were pleasantly surprised when we walked into our room. The room is a great size for a couple. It has a separate toilet from the shower and sink area, which makes it very easy to have two people living in the same room.. There is a well stocked kitchen area with a cold refrigerator and a cooking stove with a pot and plenty of utensils to have a homemade meal. The shops nearby our neighborhood stores with very reasonable prices. Close by great restaurants and there’s easy access to many different metro and bus lines.. we got the true taste of Paris in this hotel since it is in our neighborhood far from the tourist areas, but the tourist areas are only 30 minutes away by Metro.

author: Pierre I
title: Nice suite for the family.
text:
This hotel was perfect for our family of 4 to stay 2 nights as we finished a trip to Europe. The front desk staff who checked us in was very helpful as well. The breakfast was tasty and not too crowded, and drinks were available throughout the day. The suite was clean and modern with a balcony, and we got drinks from the convenience shop upon check in. There are several restaurants and a grocery nearby, and a bus from out front took us straight to St. Germaine and major Paris attractions. 
The only issue we had was that we believe the milk from breakfast was left out too long - our kid had a glass at breakfast on our second morning that tasted off, and they vomited 45 min later at the airport, with no further issues.

author: Giulia R
title: An embarrassment to Marriott
text: Booked 6 months in advance through Chase travel. Checked the booking 1 week prior through Chase and everything was still confirmed. Arrived to hotel to be told the reservation had been cancelled in January. Called Chase travel and they had never been notified by the hotel that the hotel had canceled the reservation after initially accepting it. There are other reviews that mention similar issues so this hotel is a repeat offender. I am a frequent business traveler and this is unacceptable. Now I’m scrambling to find a new hotel at the last minute. Great start to a family vacation. Marriott, maybe you should start over with this hotel.

author: Marco J
title: Deeply Disappointed – Repeated Overbooking and Poor Treatment
text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience at the Residence Inn Paris Didot Montparnasse. Despite holding two confirmed Marriott Bonvoy reservations on consecutive nights, I was denied check-in on both occasions due to overbooking. No prior solution was arranged beyond a last-minute diversion to other hotels, and the front desk staff handled the situation with a lack of courtesy and professionalism.

I was promised taxi reimbursements and assured that the second night would be honoured - only to face the exact same issue again. To make matters worse, my credit card was charged for both reservations, which were never provided.

As a frequent Marriott guest, I expect better from a brand that usually prides itself on reliability and service. This property clearly failed on both counts, and even follow-up with Marriott’s customer care has been met with silence well beyond the promised resolution timeframe.

Not recommended! Especially for loyal Bonvoy members expecting recognition and basic service delivery.

author: Michael G
title: Overall basic and very friendly staff
text:
We enjoyed this stay in 2025. This is my thorough review. Overall, simplistic, clean hotel with all the basics you need. It is in a quiet area but not too far from busier areas. It was very clean and very quiet. I did see some other families there. I would prepare to return on a future visit to the city.
Staff: I found the staff to be helpful and kind. Particularly Manuel and Gislane helped my family and were professional and accommodating. We do not speak french and so it helped as additional bonus that they spoke english for our communication.
Rooms: decent and cozy. Has fridge, microwave, cooking utensils, safe, cofee maker. Not cleaned daily however. Important to ask about this up front. Room was larger that i expected it to be (two twins together as a king) and plenty of room for us.
Grounds: very clean. Felt safe here. Elevator in good working order. No problems with noise at all
Foods: coffee/water daily. Breakfast is light options but several satisfying options were available. Coming from usa everything was 20x fresher and tastier here. Yes even hotel food is better than standard usa food.
Travel: we used bolt and uber as well as taxi but i believe you are near the public transport options too. At once i needed a taxi and hotel staff was quick to offer assistance.
Gym: located off site around the corner and has all of the basic equipment. If you prefer the quieter & smaller style of hotel gyms keep this in mind as they are partnered with a local membership gym nearby. Some of the equipment downstairs was confusing and required a membership or email to use it seemed.

author: Benjamin W
title: It takes about 10 minutes by taxi to Montparnasse station.
text: We were planning to go from Montparnasse station to Nantes the next day, so we stayed here. It was cozy and comfortable. The room was about the size of a family of three.

author: Oliver X
title: A comfortable all-suite hotel in a quiet Paris neighborhood
text:
A great property tuck away in a non-touristy local neighborhood. This building used to be the Citadines service apartment but renovated and transformed into Residence Inn.  Supermarket right on the property (downstairs) and a small number of restaurants, shops and groceries scattered around the premise.  Walk 3 blocks south you reach the T3 tram line and 10 minutes northwest to Plaisance station (Line 13) - not the most convenient location but still manageble. The hotel is an all-suite building with kitchenette in every apartment and all suites are refurbished with modern decor and furniture.  My studio apartment is not big in space but extremely functional (there are bigger suites on premise).  Front desk reception is set up in the ground floor but really just for check-in/check-out purpose with service being barely minimal otherwise.  Daily breakfast is provided in the breakfast room with adequate variety/amount of food.  Gym and laundry facility (phone app. operated) are down in the basement.  Functionality wise, this hotel really serves my needs for my business travel, the only drawback is that guest suite walls seem to be a bit thin and I could hear noise outside the corridor every night.

Overall I enjoyed my two-night stay: while this property is not as convenient as other properties I stayed in the past, but I found the place comfrotable, practical and suits my need perfectly.  Most importantly the price is significantly cheaper than most other Marriott properties in Paris.  I am heading back to Paris in Spring 2025 and will likely use this facility again, if the price is right.

author: Samuel U
title: Extremely disappointing stay — avoid if you expect basic comfort or honesty
text:
This has been one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had.

When we arrived, we were told that because a large family needed to be accommodated together, we had been put in a room that “people didn’t love”, but we were assured it would only be for one night. The next day, we were told we could not be moved because the hotel was fully booked. Later, when we asked again, staff seemed unaware of the situation and only said they would leave a note for the manager.

That night, the air conditioning stopped working properly. The unit was on, the windows were closed, and it was set to 20°C, but it was only blowing room-temperature air. The room temperature kept rising to around 29°C in the middle of the night, making it impossible to sleep. When we spoke to reception at around 3:30am, we were told nothing could be done that night, but suddenly they said we could be moved to another room the next day — despite telling us twice earlier that the hotel was fully booked.

The whole experience felt disorganised, dishonest, and extremely uncomfortable. We were given a poor room, promised it would only be temporary, then left to deal with a hot room and no real solution during the night. A hotel should at least provide a clean, comfortable room where guests can sleep. This did not happen.

I would not recommend this hotel.

author: Ruby G
title: Great location with everything you need at a reasonable price.
text: Great location. Close to a metro station with 3 lines. Excellent service. Samuel at the front desk greeted me when I arrived in the morning and had a room available. Remembered my name every time I saw him he asked how things were. The cleaning lady, Djenevou, did a very nice job and quickly cleaned my room. Leslie the manager was also very pleasant. I have been staying at Ibis hotels for years. Always at  good location and not fancy but have everything you need at a reasonable price.

author: Amelia X
title: Home topissimo
text: Welcome to the top of this hotel particularly well located near Gare de l'Est. Upstream to prepare my coming professional and effective exchange by email with Samuel. As soon as we arrived, before 10am, we had the chance to find Samuel and enjoy a smiling and kind welcome, worthy of the biggest palaces. Our room quickly enough available thanks to Adelaide and her fellow housekeepers particularly attentive to the customer that we are. The "feel welcome" is really there with possibility offered by Samuel to choose our room. The room, the 602, renovated, 6th floor on street but very quiet, clean and very well appointed. Widescreen wall TV with French and foreign channels. Small office. Multitake. Proper air conditioning. Bathroom with two bath towels and large shower. Cookies (2) offered. Two more pillows. Comfortable bedding. Blackout curtains. Luggage weighing in the lobby (€1), tea and kettle available and bowl of cornflakes. Nothing changed everything is topsimous. We will definitely be back.

author: Miguel S
title: Basic
text:
I have stayed in Ibis hotels before and knew they were cheap and cheerful. The room was tiny for me and my daughter but the beds were comfortable and it was clean.
The room was freezing cold for the entire three night stay and the heating system did not work, the bath was against the window and you had to squeeze around the shower door which did not fully open in order to enter it, a larger person would certainly not fit, I struggled as a UK size 14. We were only provided one very thin towel each, the carpet was stained with bleach.
The shower head was too heavy for the bracket and wouldn’t hold up on the wall so we had to hold the head of the shower, water pressure was good and the water was hot.
Breakfast - do not pay the rip off price of €13, go to the little cafe next door where breakfast is much better for half the cost. Ham and cheese at the hotel breakfast ran out, juice ran out, you were only allowed to have one clean glass, cup, plate and cutlery each and you have to clear your own place setting after breakfast. The breakfast room is tiny and very cramped.
The location is good for travel however, very close to Gare du Nord and Gare de l’Est with a metro stop next to the hotel. There are several supermarkets, bakeries and restaurants nearby.
I would choose this hotel for a single night stay on the way to somewhere else, but would not wish to stay here for many nights in a row.

author: Freya A
title: Great Location and good price for Paris
text:
Good hotel for location next to Gare du l'est and just down the road from Gare Du Nord which for a couple of overnight stays for a day trip and to travel on was great, the price for a central Paris hotel was also very competitive.
Rooms are great good size bed everything you need, except drinks/kettle etc in room which we always like.
For a central hotel with lots of people coming and going it was quiet at night with no disturb sleep, breakfast was good better than expected, with self cooked hot options on offer a great selection of cheese/cold meat and pastries.
We would use again for a stop over.

author: Isla A
title: Calm around perfect logistics spot to arrive and discover Paris - but the house keeping.
text:
SUPER PLUS: Breakfast Lady + Selection. She presented everything with passion and love, making the buffet very inviting. For an Ibis hotel, it was very lovely.

SUPER MEGA XXL MINUS: Housekeeping: day of arrival: a dirty towel left by the previous guests still in the room. No towels are provided for all guests. The bed frame is not fixed. Broke twice during a three-night stay. The second day, we were friendly since it was New Year’s Day, and we gave her some chocolate; everything was perfect. Third day: housekeeping did not show up until 17:00 hrs. The front desk explained that this is „normal“.

It could be better: primarily, remove bathtubs and replace them with an oversized shower.

With good connections to the Metro and buses, every point in Paris is within 2 minutes. Use exit 6 from Metro.

Gare de l‘Est is perfect. But Gare du Nord is too far to walk and back to the hotel uphill. The best is Bus 38/91 for two stops - 2,05 EUR.

author: Thomas U
title: Saved this weary traveler
text: Late night staff was so helpful and accommodating.  I had no reservations and was not a “member” and the front staffer found a room and enrolled me on the spot.  I had been to 3 hotels prior. Room was spacious for paris, directly across from gare, was quiet(hard to do in this area, clean and even left me two little cookies in my room.  There are exterior window blinds that close out the noise and lights making for a peaceful place to rest.

author: Erin M
title: Great Stay at Ibis Gare de L’est
text: Great affordable hotel in a prime location with friendly staff. They went the extra mile to celebrate both mine and my friend’s birthday by decorating our room when we were out and about. Super sweet of them! Also quick to provide extra towels and etc upon request. I would definitely recommend to my fellow English travellers.

author: Julien F
title: More discount than it looks
text:
I just spent two nights at Ibis Gard de l’Est TGV in Paris. First the good elements. It is very well located about two minutes in front of the station and next to a Metro entrance. The wifi was fine and the staff were efficient and all spoke English. The room was also quiet. 

Presumably you are considering this hotel due to its location to the station. If not there is really no reason to stay in the neighbourhood as it is a bit dicey at night and lacks good places to eat. We went with s friend, and both of our rooms were exceedingly small. We had two big suitcases and there was barely enough floor space to put them. The shower had very low pressure but the bathroom was a good size. We didn’t opt for the breakfast as, knowing Ibis, it would probably not be great. There are plenty of good places for breakfast in the station. Finally, after a long day of sightseeing we were disappointed when our room had not yet been cleaned. But that’s what you get with Ibis.

author: Zachary Z
title: Great service and friendly staff
text: Although we are aware Ibis is Accor's entry level hotel, the staff at this Ibis hotel doesn't make us feel unappreciated. They are very courteous and always greet us when meeting us. Well done.

author: James Z
title: Top staff
text:
Stayed 2 nights, 2 connecting rooms (top)

Plus:
* Well located hotel, close to East station, metro and restaurants.
* Clean room, correct size and functional.
* The Fountain with still water and sparkling water.

Special mention:
* Very Welcoming staff, smiling and caring, from the reception staff to the cleaning lady.

Less: 
* Breakfast room not very warm and noisy (resonance)
* The water flow a little light, especially for long hair 

5 stars despite the two points "minus" because I remain convinced that the staff will listen to the comments to improve!

author: Katie V
title: Good bedding, despite everything...
text: Failed connection and need to spend the night in Paris... Relieved to find this Ibis at the end of a long journey, without prior reservation and with elevator, indispensable for a PMR. No towels in the shower. Even more surprised by the sink, whose syphon was not connected to the drain pipe and which abundantly watered our feet. That said, suitable bedding and good night's rest before continuing our presto trip.

author: Ian I
title: 5 minutes walk from Gare de l’Est!
text:
Excellent welcome, very smiling young receptionist!
We had a very comfortable triple room, with a small dressing area and balcony.
The perfect location for our short stays in Paris, 5 minutes from Gare de l’Est.
Good value for money!
See you soon

author: Camille H
title: Clean and comfortable stay.
text:
A well located hotel for Gare du North and Gare de L’Est train stations. Also located within walking distance of busy eating areas. 

The bedrooms and clean and comfortable, if a little basic. Water and instant tea / coffee is available in the reception area. 

The showers are warm and powerful and the beds are large and comfortable. 

The window shutters were a great addition.

author: Samuel G
title: Simple - effective
text:
The hotel is off-centre from the big noisy boulevards.  The hotel is located in a quiet alley. The rooms are clean and convenient. Very welcoming and attentive staff. 
2 steps from the Gare de l'Est and next to the metro.
The situation is very good.

author: Ethan G
title: Decent budget hotel
text:
Close to Gare de l’est and 10 mins from Gare de Nord, but on a quiet side street. Staff friendly and helpful. We stayed room only so we could sample local cafes for breakfast which worked really well.  We had a triple room which was a little tight for space but it was very clean and had plenty of hot water and excellent shower. Beds only average comfort. No kettle.
Norte Dame/ Louvre etc was a comfortable 40 min walk and plenty of options to eat out close by.
If you are arriving on the Eurostar, it’s a decent budget hotel.

author: Tyler N
title: A sure thing!
text:
I often go to this hotel on my business trips. Always an excellent welcome, the rooms are well maintained, more or less large. 
The breakfast well stocked with the choice of ibis and always several varieties of fruit. 
Never disappointed...

author: Noah O
title: Exceptional service and great location
text:
Stayed for one night and would have happily stayed for longer.
An easy 3 minute walk from Gare de L’Est train station and a ten minute walk to Gare de Nord.
Reception staff were exceptional and so willing to check us in very early in the day as our train from Strasbourg arrived into Paris around 9:30 am. We only had about a half hour wait before being checked in. As our booked room was not available,we were offered a room on the 7th floor which was quite large and plenty of space for two adults and two children. The only way to access this floor is by a key used in the lift by the staff. We were very grateful for this room. More so when we stepped out onto the deck and had uninterrupted views of the Eiffel Tower! Only the occupants of the two rooms on this floor have this opportunity to view during the day and night. Such a special treat for Paris. 
The room came with a kettle and some mugs and whilst there was no fridge, being winter the ability to open the window/doors meant things stayed cool outside. The windows /door also have electronic block out blinds.
Easy access from this hotel to the metro and plenty of food shops and little markets around the hotel.
Would definitely stay here again

author: Alexander V
title: Very welcome
text:
Paris stop before taking Eurostar to London we stayed at this hotel (for the round trip ) located 12 minutes walk from Gare du Nord. Room for 4 people, just right. Breakfast top and very varied, bravo for the choice. The person who welcomed us on our second visit was just great. Respectful, smiling, she advised us on a nice little bistro not far from the hotel...
Thank you to this person, if the opportunity arises to leave from Gare du Nord or Gare de l’Est this is where we will return.

author: Lauren K
title: Unfriendly personnel
text: Unfriendly personnel by check in and poor kindness by breakfast. Not possible to park you car when you are higher than 1,95 meter

author: Molly P
title: Professionalism and courtesy were present.
text: Upon our arrival at the Ibis hotel at 1:09 AM, we were warmly welcomed by Mr. Abdallah. His professionalism, courtesy, and sense of hospitality immediately contributed to making our arrival pleasant and reassuring. We sincerely thank him for the quality of his service.

author: Anna Q
title: Ideally located.
text:
In the immediate vicinity of the Gare du Nord and the Gare de l'Est.
Establishment of the Gaëlle ibis. Well-maintained.
Efficient welcome. A small terrace... For smokers :-(
Complete breakfast in buffet form (bad orange juice).

author: Emma O
title: I recommend it!
text:
Hotel located a 5-minute walk from the Gare du Nord.
Quiet neighborhood.
Welcomed with a smile by the young woman at the front desk.
Arriving at 11:30 AM, our room was supposed to be ready at 2:00 PM because I had requested a room with two separate beds. By changing this option we were able to get a room with a large bed immediately. Which is nice for settling in and visiting Paris right after. A paid luggage storage area in the basement is available. It is not excessive. 
A water fountain, a kettle, and coffee, tea, and herbal tea are available for free in the reception lobby. I was able to leave my ice packs in the bar's freezer. I appreciated that, especially with the heat. 
The prices for drinks at the bar are excessive. Small neighborhood supermarkets sell chilled bottles of water at a lower price.
Air conditioning in the room.
Housekeeping perfectly performed by the room attendant - 6th floor.
It is possible to order pizzas delivered to the hotel.
I preferred to go to an Italian restaurant - rue du chateau Landon offering takeout. 
I recommend this hotel near Grévin, Montmartre, Canal St Martin, and Père Lachaise.

author: Sara U
title: Ok but not great
text: This hotel is ok but having just stayed at the Ibis Hotel Gare de Lyon Ledru for the same money, I have to say this hotel had much smaller rooms and less good air con, and much less in the way of communal areas. We had an issue of the fire alarm going off in the night, and there was little information from staff (and no apology for having to leave our rooms for an hour in the middle of the night!). I wouldn't stay here again.

author: Taylor M
title: Correct, nothing more.
text:
The hotel is very basic. The room was large but without relevant details. The air conditioning wasn't even noticeable (we were in a heat wave). We didn't have a refrigerator. 
The bathroom, clean, nothing more. 
As for the location, it was great, very central and a few meters from the train and the subway. 
Correct, no frills.

author: Dylan X
title: Outstanding help from the staff
text:
First let me start with we did not stay at this hotel.  However, I wanted to say how awesome the staff were at this location.  We were put into a transportation situation by the incompetence of Air France's customer service.  After running out easy options to remedy the situation I entered this Ibis hotel and asked the manager of this hotel for assistance.  He and a desk manager were able to arrange a taxi from their location to the hotel AF provided.

Overall, this hotel appeared to be great the staff I know were very helpful, it had services and options for food and drink in the lobby.   Unfortunately, after getting to the comp'd hotel I realized I should have just tried to get rooms at the hotel instead driving across town.

author: Manon G
title: Ibis Hotel Château Ladon makes a tour to confirm.
text: Great breakfast, warm welcome, thank you Fatima.

author: Freya T
title: Nice hotel ibis
text: It was a nice hotel ibis I would love to visit again very well enjoyedbel hotel thanks 👍

author: Taylor H
title: Weekend in Paris
text: I went there on the recommendations of friends, the stay went very well, it is an excellent hotel, I recommend it!

author: Mason M
title: Good hotel
text: Hôtel is very good and all réception are helpfull spécial Mariam i recommand

author: Olivia E
title: Very good hotel
text: Very good stay, nice hotel, very good welcome

author: Laura U
title: Impeccable service, perfect!!
text: A huge thank you to Mariam and Lucas for their exceptional hospitality. Their kindness, professionalism, and good humor greatly contributed to making this experience perfect. Always smiling, attentive, and caring, they offer impeccable service. It is a true pleasure to meet such dedicated people. We will return without hesitation! I recommend!!

author: Chloe M
title: Service
text: Good Service for my experience

author: Hugo O
title: Superb experience
text: It was a very beautiful experience and would love to come back

author: Olivia O
title: Friends holiday
text: Amazing experience,can't wait to be back.

author: Holly W
title: Sweltering heat and no air conditioning
text: Worst night stay in Paris! Paris was 32C degrees (90F). The room we were given did not have functioning air conditioning and the hotel would not move us to another room. They gave us a fan to move the hot air around d the room! No discount, no refund for unacceptable conditions! Find another hotel to use as ibis Hotel is not very customer centric.

author: Daisy N
title: Perfect!
text: Perfect! I had an excellent stay at this establishment! The rooms were adequate and the welcome exceeded my expectations. A big thank you to Anaïs for her professionalism.

author: Gavin W
text: I would like to warmly thank Mariam for her welcome and professionalism during my stay at the ibis Paris Gare du Nord Château-Landon 10th. Always smiling, available, and attentive, she contributed to making my stay very pleasant. Her sense of service, kindness, and efficiency were particularly appreciated. A big thank you for her help and attention towards the guests. I highly recommend this establishment and hope to have the opportunity to stay there again.

author: Rosie B
title: Good night
text: Good hôtel very renew clean I love it

author: Taylor Q
title: Great hotel
text: Renovated and air-conditioned hotel. Very friendly, professional, and attentive team. Whether for a short stay or a longer duration, I recommend without hesitation! 😊

author: Morgan U
title: Very good stay in Paris
text: Great hotel well located for visiting Paris. The rooftop bar is magnificent with a superb view of the Eiffel Tower. Pleasant and helpful staff. Excellent bedding we were in a suite on the top floor

author: Ian V
title: Lacking!
text: Dark, gloomy rooms. No shelf in bathroom to put anything. No way to hang a towel. Pillows like concrete  PAPER cups no china or even one glass.  Basin did not hold water.  Cutlery in restaurant fit for the bin.

author: Henry O
title: Personal item missing after return
text: A personal item went missing after we returned to our room. I contacted the hotel and still await an update. This is the first time something like this happened to me. I feel extremely upset about this.

author: Owen Y
title: AVOID unsafe
text:
We booked a family room for 2 young children/infant and 2 adults to share the same room. We arrived to a broken and unsafe bed. We told reception immediately and was informed they would get someone to deal with it. We got back at 2200 to find they could not fix it and only offered a blanket at the time to fix it which clearly does not fix a completely broken bed. They wouldn’t give us another room as they did not have any family rooms available. The only option was to separate us on two completely different floors as it was so late we had no choice. Our original room that my wife and other child stayed in wasn’t the cleanest either. The balcony hadn’t been cleaned and was covered in bird faeces. In the morning we found our towels or where the towels were kept had a clump of black hair (none of us have black hair) and a large hair in the shower. Completely unsatisfied we had other options of hotel rooms and even more if we were willing to separate elsewhere but we went with Novotel as we felt it should have been a safe choice but that was not the case. 

No manager on site and does not reply to emails. We booked through hotels.com and they have said if the manager ignores the emails there’s nothing they can do so my advice AVOID

author: Claire K
title: Disappointing stay
text:
The hotel has a fantastic location, with easy access to transport and within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower. The bar also has a wonderful view of the Eiffel Tower, which was a lovely feature.

Unfortunately, our experience with the hotel itself was very disappointing. The rooms were quite small, which is understandable for Paris, but the biggest issue was the extremely strong chemical smell in our room when we arrived. As soon as we entered, the smell was overwhelming and our daughter struggled to breathe. We immediately went to reception for help, but unfortunately they were not very helpful.

Because of the smell, we had to sit in the bar area for over an hour while we left the window open to try and air the room out. We even approached management around midnight, but were told there was nothing they could do. With it being so late, we had no other option but to stay.

The chemical smell never disappeared during our entire four-night stay. We had to sleep with the window open every night, and all three of us experienced breathing issues throughout our stay.

We also requested an iron three times and never received one, which was frustrating.

While the location and Eiffel Tower views are excellent, the lack of assistance from staff and the unresolved room issue significantly impacted our stay. A great location, but unfortunately the service and room experience did not meet expectations.

author: Lucas N
title: Good hotel with poor service
text:
⭐⭐⭐☆☆ 3/5

The hotel has several positive points. The breakfast is excellent, with great variety and good quality products. Another highlight is the rooftop bar, which offers a spectacular view of the Eiffel Tower, making the end of the afternoon a very pleasant experience. The rooftop staff were extremely friendly and helpful, contributing a lot to our experience.

The room, on the other hand, left nothing to be desired. I found it small and with little lighting, which somewhat compromised the comfort during the stay.

The main negative point was the attention. Unfortunately, we did not feel well received. Most of the staff showed little sympathy, and that was an impression we had during our journey through France in general. At breakfast, for example, when we arrived close to closing time (about 10 to 15 minutes earlier), one of the employees was clearly uncomfortable, with expressions of irritation and impatience, which contrasted pretty much with the excellent quality of the coffee served.

In short, despite the great location, the excellent breakfast and the incredible rooftop, the lack of hospitality and the unwelcoming service made the experience not so positive. I would never stay in this hotel again.

author: Lucas W
title: Good hotel from the Accor chain, well located!
text: Very good hotel from the Accor network, well located, well equipped, with excellent bathroom, friendly staff, good room with bath but with poor air conditioning. It doesn't freeze too much, the room selector doesn't work, it seems to be central air conditioning.

author: Miguel Z
title: Positive experience, but the value for money could be improved.
text:
We stayed in this hotel for just one night. The staff was certainly very courteous, helpful, and patient in welcoming even those, like us, who do not speak English fluently. 
Unfortunately, however, the room did not seem to match the price requested, especially considering that breakfast was not included. In our case, it was a room with a double bed and a sofa bed for the children. The latter turned out to be particularly uncomfortable, with a deformed and sagging mattress, making the rest for the little ones quite uncomfortable.
Overall, a positive experience regarding the hospitality, but with a quality-price ratio that could be improved.

author: Rosie S
title: Top-notch service at the rooftop bar!
text: We went to the rooftop on Wednesday, June 3, 2026, on the 7th floor, and Sébastien provided impeccable service: smiling, very attentive, caring, and highly competent. When some people left, he offered us their well-placed table shortly after we arrived. His colleagues also served us well, but since it was raining, we had to retreat indoors and asked a bitter septuagenarian customer, who had four chairs quickly around her, if we could take one... She hurried to tell us that she was expecting company who never arrived (and for good reason with such a demeanor...). We had to take a chair further away. But aside from that unpleasant person, everything was very good.

author: Freya A
title: The hotel is really great.
text:
Great rooms and a good location to the metro. However, it is a bit remote from the hotspot. Breakfast was very good and the staff was very friendly.
The hotel is really great. We booked the hotel partly because of the rooftop bar. However, this bar is mostly visited by non-hotel guests. Apparently, it is a hidden gem. We went there three times and were assigned poor seats. Even after inquiring, we did not receive better seats. Truly poor service. And they do not cater to their own hotel guests.

author: Isla J
title: Noisy room, elevator...the cleanliness of the rooms and corridors leave to be desired. Average restaurant.
text: Service bar terrace lacks professionalism, the reception null....

author: Matthew K
title: Business trip
text: Quite clean but neglected room with stained and ruined bathroom door. Flexibility and kindness of two boys at reception and, on the contrary, rudeness and rigidity of a girl. I was attacked for asking to have a coffee and something solid at 550 in the morning having to leave at 6 for the airport.

author: Camille N
title: Great service!
text:
Great service! We had booked a normal room and were upgraded to one of the suites on arrival. These offer a beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower.

The restaurant Quindici located in the hotel is also recommended. We enjoyed the food in the suite while looking out over Paris.

author: Matthew P
title: Sometimes luck is really by your side A real dream hotel
text: This is the best hotel I've done in my whole life we as a family had booked in advance and arrived on Tuesday the person at reception Joaquino told me he had a surprise for us and he upgraded us to the largest penthouse of the hotel which is just more than double the price normally with everything on and off for our booked price

author: Paolo S
title: far from a standing novotel
text:
very amateur home... .A staff in recption not or little trained , who seems lost.. 
we specify a quiet room, we end up with a room on the first where we hear the roar of the metro...
aging room, you have to wait 5 minutes to have hot water in the shower. a symphatic rooftop but we order a beer to accompany a pastry shop buy elsewhere we refuse to serve us while we stay at the hotel! frankly we are far from the novotel standart ...

author: Julien O
title: Unpublished
text:
I had booked for 5 nights one of the two best rooms in the hotel, an executive suite, surprised at check-in the hotel demanded full payment of the stay, it is a first, usually all the hotels I frequent ask for pre-authorization but not payment!
Not very welcoming, so we refrained from eating any meals, not even breakfasts.
To add, on a rainy day they didn’t even have umbrellas to lend us, and if they had known that this hotel requires a deposit of 20 euros per umbrella, the hotels I usually use put an umbrella directly in the room.
Otherwise the rooms are functional and one of the two suites enjoys a beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower.
Too bad the management spoils the service by its policy, we will go elsewhere for the next stays.

author: Grace N
title: Welcome to the top!
text: Very nice welcome, good buffet and quiet hotel

author: Owen L
title: Top
text:
The hotel is very well located. Everything can be done on foot. 
The big plus parking available
The rooms are clean, the bedding is comfortable. 
The staff at the reception is very friendly helpful and smiling.
Breakfast is plentiful with quality products and various choices. 
We are delighted and will be back without problem on our next visit

author: Aiden D
title: Worth more for location than service
text:
The hotel looks great on arrival, but after installed and using the services, has many aspects to improve.
The location is good, and you can walk to the main tourist sights of Paris, such as the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, the Arc de Triomphe... There is also a metro station right on foot. It is in an area where there is plenty of commerce, from clothing shops, cafes, restaurants and supermarkets.
The room was clean and comfortable and of reasonable size, the problem was to have two bathrooms in separate divisions, something I had never seen, one where the sanita and the rest in another division, separated by the corridor of the entrance what we convened was nothing practical. The shower was on account for my height and I'm not especially tall.
The breakfast is too basic for a 4-star hotel, very little variety and constant lack of bread and eggs. In addition, the buffet is removed 10 minutes after closure.

author: Rosie K
title: I came , I saw , I was not convinced!!!
text: Not having a Samsung or IPhone charger in 2026 to lend or even that I can leave my phone that I come back to get it , for a 4 star hotel ... what a misery. And she smiles at me on top of that as if she were happy with her IV... to flee, really we are in Paris it seems like it is the third world.

author: Evan Z
title: Lovely stay
text: We had a lovely stay at Hotel Ares Eiffel.  The rooms are comfortable, clean, and lovely.  The staff are welcoming and kind, especially Enzo and Roberto.  Highly recommend.  Location is great.

author: Harper A
title: Our new home 🏠 in Paris 🥰!
text:
A simply unforgettable experience!
We discovered Hotel Ares by pure chance during our trip, and it has become one of the reasons why Paris will forever remain among our most beautiful memories 😍!
What makes the real difference is the owner Enrico: a person of rare kindness, warmth, and hospitality. Together with the whole staff, always alert, attentive, and incredibly helpful, he made us feel welcomed and pampered from the first to the last moment!
The hotel boasts a truly strategic location, very convenient to the subway and a stone's throw from the Eiffel Tower, perfect for treating ourselves to wonderful and romantic evening walks 💕! The price-quality ratio is exceptional, with a very high level of service and a truly delicious, rich, and well-cared-for breakfast 😋!
From now on I won't have to look for where to sleep anymore: we have finally found our second home in Paris 🏠!
A heartfelt thank you to Enrico and the entire extraordinary team at Hotel Ares. See you very soon❤️!

author: George S
title: Great Stay!
text: Wonderful stay! Nice personnel. Excellent air-conditioning.! comfortable beds!

author: Mia P
title: 5 stars for the location, 10 minutes from the Eiffel Tower and much more, but for the rest, the hotel gets lost in important details
text: Hotel note: 5 stars for its exceptional location; false advertising because the website offers the classic double room at 14/16 and the superior at 16/18, while in reality, the hotel is dishonest and deceptive because it assigns guests who have booked and paid in advance via an agency the 12 m² classic room, which is really small and is clearly a single room presented as a double room. After our complaints, they changed our room… a little bigger, but the toilet was separate from the bathroom and there was no bidet; the tiny 30 x 30 cm closet, intended for storing shirts and other clothes, was occupied by the refrigerator and the safe; the bedside tables are stools without drawers for underwear, unlike what is usually done in other hotels, even 3-star ones; the bathroom fan has been out of order for 7 days; the lightbulb in the wall-mounted magnifying mirror is burnt out; there are no hooks; no vanity unit under the sink to store toiletries… In short! Negative note: 1 star. The reception staff was kind and helpful, but the Italian owner never came to help us translate or to show us to our small room. It's a shame, because the building is magnificent and the hotel is elegant, with an Italian design that, unfortunately, gets lost in the important details.
