author: Sydney W
title: Paris 2026
text: The staff is super friendly, rooms are nice and clean, located steps away from the Eiffel Tower

author: Brooke Y
title: Quiet hotel near Eiffel Tower
text: Stayed with family of 3. Close to cafes and La Motte-Picquet station. Safe in the evening for a walk from the Eiffel Tower. Very pleasant receptionists with bonjour and au revoir with each passing. The room #61 was spacious for 3 with a very generous bathroom with a shower, tub, and double sinks. Large queen bed a bit hard. Spare bed was small for my 6’3” 17 yo son and creaky but not an issue for exhausted travelers. Quiet room. No view but we didn’t spend much time in there. Very adequate air even in 96 heat. Most locations are a metro stop away. Many e-bikes available with a short ride to the bike path by the Seine. We didn’t have breakfast so we can’t rate the food. Quiet sitting area available to relax and read.

author: Andrea E
title: Girls trip
text: Girls trip to Paris. Brilliant location to access tourist attractions. Rooms lovely and clean in this boutique hotel. Friendly staff.

author: Freya R
title: Best Hotel
text:
This is very far from airport but it is worth it. It is so fancy amd beautiful. The breakfast is a bit pricey but it
is so nice. This hotel is amazing

author: Joseph U
title: Great hotel in a lovely neighbourhood
text:
Excellent stay at the Hotel Ares - I highly recommend it.
Stayed for 5 nights with my teenage daughters. The room was very clean and nicely furnished with a Juliet balcony. Excellent bathroom with waterfall shower and lovely shower and shampoo products. 
The room was cleaned each day.
Everyone who was on reception was welcoming and spoke excellent English. 
Breakfast is expensive at 22 euros per person - children take the same price. However, the local area is safe and buzzy and we took breakfast every morning at Merci Jerome on Avenue de La Motte Picquet which is a two minute walk from the hotel. The area around there is safe, nice restaurants, metro station literally outside that boulangerie and just a nice Parisian feel. It’s also a short walk to the Eiffel Tower.
The hotel is well worth the money - absolutely recommended!

author: Marco W
title: So nice.
text:
A nice hotel, steps away from the Eiffel Tower.
Super nice staff and nice rooms

author: Oliver W
title: A Wonderful Stay in the Heart of Paris
text:
We stayed here with our family and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. From the moment we arrived, the staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome —-friendly, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout our stay.

The breakfast spread was delicious and a great way to start each day of sightseeing. With a heatwave hitting Paris during our visit, the in-room AC was an absolute lifesaver — strong, reliable, and much appreciated after a long day out. On top of all that, the rooms and lobby were beautifully designed, giving the whole hotel a polished, elegant feel.

Highly recommend for families or anyone looking for comfort and great service in Paris!

author: Daniel I
title: Paris!
text:
Lovely hotel, friendly & helpful staff.
They gave us a room with a view of the Eiffel Tower 😎😁
Comfortable bed.
Perfect amenities
Excellent location.

author: Grace T
title: Thank you for your warm welcome
text: Thank you to the whole team for your generous welcome! Arriving late at night, we were wonderfully received, and the next morning, the team was just as smiling and attentive. A perfect stay thanks to you. Well done

author: Charlie C
title: Beautiful Boutique Hotel
text: Fantastic location and room near the Eiffel Tower. This is where I always stay when in Paris.

author: Olivia B
title: Highly recommend
text: My husband and I celebrated our 40th anniversary at Ares Eiffel in Paris. We recommend it! Great location, lovely hotel,  and a wonderful  breakfast. We appreciated all the welcoming, responsive and  professional staff, especially Enzo who was friendly, enthusiastic and really helpful. The staff who served the breakfast also did a great job.

author: Oliver Z
title: Absolutely amazing
text: Our stay was fantastic, we were in the 7th floor and could see Eiffel Tower from our window. Everything about this hotel is fantastic, the location, the decor, the comfort. Eiffle tower was only 15 minutes walk away. Restaurants and shops were close by. Very convenient place to see Exquisite French culture. I would come back if visit Paris the city of Romance ❤️‍🔥 in future.  Thank you everyone who made our stay memorable.

author: Brooke I
title: A gem of a hotel in a quiet neighborhood
text:
This little boutique hotel was absolutely wonderful from start to finish. The front desk staff was so accommodating. Housekeeping was done every day and kept our room nice and tidy. Everyone should be very aware that if you are expecting a room like the United States, you need to adjust your expectations. Rooms in Europe are small, especially Paris. I am certain you could find a bigger room but I am not so certain it would feel this nice.

Crown molding on the ceilings and the air conditioning worked perfectly, which was good because there was a heat wave in Paris (98• F)! We found out upon arrival that kids eat breakfast for free if the adults pay. I believe it was 26€ per person for adults. We chose to go to the bakery around the corner instead but the breakfast looked very nice.

The hotel is located in a very quiet and safe part of Paris while still being in the city and close to everything. We used the subway religiously as it was close by. We couldn’t have been more pleased with our stay at Hotel Ares and would recommend it for any family with young children!

author: Louis P
title: Lovely place
text:
We had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The location was excellent, making it easy to explore the city and nearby attractions. The staff was friendly, welcoming, and always willing to help with recommendations and directions.
We would gladly stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting the area. Thank you for making our trip so enjoyable!

author: Evie D
title: Warm and welcoming!
text: Such a wonderful hotel with amazing staff.

author: Oliver V
title: Good hotel, but the service is not up to the standards of 4 stars.
text: Hotel in an excellent quiet location. Comfortable room for 3 people and a comfortable bed. Unfortunately, the service, especially for breakfast, is not up to the standards of a 4-star hotel. During the booking, we asked if it was possible to have a gluten-free breakfast, and we were kindly informed that it was possible. On the first morning, the staff present in the dining area did not understand a word of English and did not comprehend what we were asking; after consulting with the reception, they offered us gluten-containing products twice, indicating them as suitable for someone with celiac disease. After several requests, gluten-free bread and madeleines arrived. On the following mornings, when we communicated a room number, no one bothered to provide us with anything gluten-free. This is absolutely not the service one expects in a hotel of this category; the staff must be informed! One does not joke with people's health.

author: Megan U
title: Great location & comfy beds!
text: Stayed here for 4 nights with my daughter. Room cleaned everyday, fresh towels everyday, beds super comfy! Yes the bathroom is small but definitely usable! Tv & air con good. The breakfast was open from 6am which was great as we were getting picked up for our flight home at 6.30am. Plenty of choice   fresh bakery , choice of hot & cold drinks. Location good   lots of restaurants nearby, 10 min walk to the Eiffel tower.  I would strongly recommend downloading the Uber app & using that to get about..very cheap compared to normal taxis.  Staff were friendly enough but no helpful when asked questions about the city & where to go etc. .overall I would definitely recommend staying here. Thanks for having us. 26/082026.  Guzel family.

author: Freya X
title: Ok for £
text:
Let start with the positives- 
Clean
Comfortable
Modern
Nice check out experience
Great location!

Negatives-
Tiny room and bathroom was comparable to an airplane toilet, not pleasant although very clean. However online photos do not reflect this size at all.

Stingey  wilth towels. You are only given one hand sized towel and two hair sized towels  as standard. We had to ask for more which they gave without an issue but they’re so small!

Checking in we had a very rude welcome, wasn’t the best first impression.

Hairdryer is like something from an 1980s swimming pool changing room, positioned in front of the toilet and would burn your hand when you had it on for longer than two mins.

No fridge

Tempremental aircon

author: Sofia O
title: Catastrophic.
text: We tried to postpone our stay several times, the first time a month before the date. Then 1 week before. They all refused. In addition to taking the money, he adds a 29 euro tax and obviously the rental fee.

author: Hannah X
title: Berbat
text: The reception staff were completely unhelpful; we booked this place trusting the Ibis brand, but we regretted it. The double rooms were tiny—it was impossible to fit inside the shower cubicle—and the sink was dirty. The room also reeked of strong detergent. We asked to change rooms, but they refused; the receptionist even snapped at us, telling us we should have read the details when making the reservation. I would never recommend this place. And there is no freezer and water

author: Oliver E
title: Excellent location.
text:
A quiet, comfortable and very well-appointed hotel. It is perfect for visiting Les Invalides, Rodin, Eiffel Tower and Grand and Petit Palais. The champs de Elysées and Arc de Triomphe are both within walking distance and there are lots of good restaurants within close proximity. It is also very close to the Metro stop, so easy to get to. This is not my first visit and despite what I will say next, I would still use it again, as it so well positioned.

However, despite the positioning and comfort, there are a number of issues that Ibis/Accor might want to consider.

I was surprised that a few days before I was due to arrive, I had a deposit charged to my credit card, which was the equivalent of one night’s visit. That is fine, especially if it then comes off the final bill when you pay that. However, it is only refunded after you check-out. So, upon arrival at the hotel I paid for the two nights I was staying alongside the deposit. I am glad that I used my credit card to pay rather than a debit card, otherwise I would have been £100 out of pocket. I am surprised that the deposit is not used as part payment toward the actual stay. Perhaps, something the multi-billion-dollar business can investigate improving.

Upon arriving after a day of exploring on my second evening, I boarded an elevator with one of the employees of the hotel. The lift broke down and did not move. He called the emergency number but that was engaged, I pressed the emergency alarm but that was ignored or did not work. The employee then started to bang on the door and shout loudly for help to no avail. Eventually, I forced the door open, escaped and let the employee out. He went to find his colleague and I spoke to reception. The response of the receptionist, other than a look of disbelief left a lot to be desired. No apologies, no offer of compensation, a drink at the bar on the House. Instead, she went out to find the maintenance chaps who were outside. By the time I returned there was a sign on the lift confirming it was faulty.

Finally, be prepared to have to fork out €6 to store your luggage in a locker in the hotel basement, if there are any available. By the time I went down at about 10.30 they were all full and people were abandoning their bags around the luggage room. Given the hotel has over 500 rooms, I cannot believe they do not have better provision for left luggage and do not expect people to pay for the most basic of services. 

So, despite all of this, I am looking forward to my next visit and hopefully a visit to Grand and Petit Palais.

author: Luca W
title: Decent hotel 10 minutes from the Eiffel Tower.
text: We stayed at this hotel for New Year's from December 29, 2025 to January 1, 2026. Beautiful and welcoming hotel, abundant buffet breakfast. Very convenient because it is located near the subway stop. 10 minutes from the Eiffel Tower. The only flaw is the bathrooms... really very small, the door would barely close.

author: Marta K
title: Not good
text: After hospitalization prior to our visit they refused change of date and/or refund. Horrible way to treat their customers. Stay away.

author: Nathan P
title: Stay somewhere else
text: Well let’s start with the room. It might as well have been a broom closet, bathroom was even smaller and room was not at all functional. It was hot when I stayed but the AC never worked the entire time. Luckily I managed to get a fan, but some people were unfortunate and had to suffer in the heat. Desk staff were unhelpful and rude most of the time. Breakfast was ok, plenty of choice, but dinner was meh. There was only one waiter who was rushed off his feet but was rude anyhow. The only good thing was the location, it was a good proximity to the metro for the Eiffel Tower and other places. Shops & cafes were plentiful. If you want a good location, stay somewhere else!

author: Andrea F
title: There is no air conditioning, and there was no water for an entire morning.
text:
We stayed for 3 nights and it was a nightmare. Throughout the stay, the air conditioning did not work, and coinciding with the heat wave, we could hardly sleep. Every time we mentioned it at the front desk, they told us they would check it or notify the technician the next day, but nothing was ever resolved.

Additionally, one of the mornings there was no water at all. We could not bathe, use the toilet, or even wash our hands. We reported it again, and they also did not seem to find it important to help us with anything. 

What is most frustrating is that the hotel's usual response is that they have "central air conditioning" and that it cannot be adjusted by room. That was not the problem. We were not asking for more cold or less cold; it simply did not cool at all. Outside it was very hot, and inside the room it felt practically the same. Calling it air conditioning is misleading because it does not change the temperature at all.

The location is good, but if you are traveling in the summer and expect to be able to sleep with a reasonable temperature or simply have water to bathe, I would avoid this hotel. If it had not been prepaid, we would have left after the first night.

author: Diego V
title: Wonderful location and great service
text:
We had a wonderful stay at this hotel in Paris. The location is fantastic, with easy access to public transport and walking distance of many of the major attractions, if you like walking. 
There are also plenty of restaurants and cafés nearby.
The hotel was very clean and well maintained. While the rooms are on the smaller side, they were comfortable and had everything we needed for our stay.
A special thank you to Mr Said at reception. From check-in, he was incredibly welcoming, helpful, and knowledgeable. He provided great advice on getting around Paris and recommended some wonderful places to visit. His kindness and excellent customer service made our stay even more enjoyable.
We would happily recommend this hotel.

author: Luke Z
title: Great hotel and great location.
text:
We have just returned from a 2 night stay at the Ibis Tour Eiffel and I had to write a review of our experience.
Firstly, the hotel is in a brilliant location. It is located near to the Cambronne Metro Station. There are some lovely Brasserie's near to the hotel, as well as a great restaurant on site.
The staff were all extremely polite and welcoming on our arrival. They checked us in to room 667 and I couldn't believe our luck when we got to our room and had an amazing view of the Eiffel Tower.
The room and shared areas were impeccably clean. The room was ample room for my daughter and I. The shower room was small but there was still plenty of room and you didn't feel cramped.
The room was lovely and cool for the duration of our stay (whilst Paris was in the grips of a heatwave no less)
The lobby has lots of seating, both indoors and outdoors. There are water machines in the area which always had cups.
I definitely feel we experienced value for money and I will be returning to stay here when we visit in future.

author: Laura Y
title: Good value and location.
text:
Would have given 9/10 but off to a shaky start 😊

We had an issue just after check in and returning from dinner.

Reported and nothing done immediately, told to wait till tomorrow!
Room 506.
1. The TV shows message under repair and does not work!
2. The air conditioner controller shows low battery and will not turn off! 
Constantly making noise, so not able to sleep!

If I wanted a cheap hotel room where maintenance was poor I would have booked one 😊

Reception initially told me NO other room available, yet hotel booking site showed availability?

However, on complaining (wide awake) to night crew, we changed to a satisfactory room at 3am and slept 😴.

Things improved dramatically..
The breakfast is excellent with lots of variety and plenty of space, very relaxing, no rush.

Next day a very capable and polite manager gave us a 50% refund for the night, which I thought was very fair.

Great location excellent staff, handy for metro and I’d recommend the 24 hour hop on hop off Batobus Boat that serves most major sights close to the river.

author: William R
title: Basic but clean and comfies. Zero added extras!
text: Basic hotel. Clean and comfy. Room and bathroom absolutely tiny. Perfect for a mum daughter weekend as we were out all day exploring but absolutely no frills.  No kettle for cups of tea etc. Have to pay to leave luggage in lockers if you check out and have time to kill before you leave. Great location 2 mins from metro station. 20 min walk to Eiffel Tower. Didn’t have breakfast - two lovely boulangeries within 2 mins walk of hotel

author: Katie K
title: Wretched
text: It was awful, the worst hotel experience I've ever had. The simplest thing was that there weren't any slippers; it was ridiculous. We asked for them because we didn't have any. Everywhere was incredibly dirty and filthy. I reached out to hang my clothes and the scene was exactly like the photo of my room. We should have realized this from the first encounter, but even the staff were grumpy.

author: Alice G
title: Aging Hotel
text:
Unfortunately, bad experience...
The hotel is aging with still the old cob we knew 30 years ago on the walls of the room.
The small electric radiator at the foot of the window was flickering, air conditioning non-existent.
Tiny shower room 2 or 3 m2 max, no toilet brush.
Non-blackout window curtain and holed, no or very insufficient soundproofing. Strong cigarette smell in the room.
In the lobby, it rained in the hotel at the level of the ceiling tiles and in the greenhouse that led to the breakfast room.

Offer at breakfast very (too standard).

In short, as much as these hotels had their best days, they are now at the bottom of the rankings. I stayed in family hotels in Paris much cheaper but much more neat and finished.

This was my last stay at this type of overpriced hotel.

author: Gavin X
title: Paris business trip
text: I stayed here on a 4 night business trip. The hotel is in a nice location, close to several restaurants. The rooms are small- mine had a full bed, a small table under the TV that fit my closed carryon, and a metal unit-chair with shelves, 5 hangers, and a coffeemaker. No closet, no safe. There was a bathroom-it was small, kudos to the engineer on space utilization. I had to get into position before entering the bathroom (e.g. walk in backwards to use the toilet) because it was difficult to turn around in. Had to sit at an angle on the toilet or my knees hit the wall. The sink drain was slow and the water smelled of sulfur. The corner shower was small and the water sprayed outside of the shower until you got inside and shut the glass doors. I had to dry off outside of the bathroom. There are no wash cloths provided and no convenience store on every corner…so bring a loofa; I had to use a sock. It was clean, bed was comfortable, had a view of the tower. Lobby and area for breakfast was nice. Had a nice looking bar/restaurant that was small-never ate there.

author: Evan P
title: Not the best option
text: We came back from the park asterix super tired, asked for the room and we were given a key that did not open the door, we went back down second key that followed if we opened the room we had been assigned and the third room we were given had to ask to be changed. Already in the room, I found hairs on the sheets and not exactly on the scalp. Even though the hotel is well located, the breakfast is great and I like the facilities I do not recommend it at all unless you are contortionist and avoid hitting yourself on the head or any part of the body with the wall or with the sink of how small the bathroom is. Nor were the beds to our liking so my recommendation is to consider other options in future visits to Paris.

author: Rosie N
title: Robbery at the hotel
text:
I need to share a distressing incident that occurred during my mom visit. My mother was robbed while sitting at her chair during breakfast; her bag—containing cash and her passport—was taken. Thankfully, she wasn’t physically harmed.

When we reported the theft to the reception, we requested additional light to help us redo her documents. The staff informed us that the hotel was fully booked and refused to take any responsibility for the situation. To our shock, they kindly asked us to leave the property when my mother returned from the police station.

Afterward, she had to ask multiple times for the reception to open our room so she could retrieve her luggage. The hotel did not offer any refund or assistance. The only response we received was a generic letter expressing their apologies while simultaneously stating they wouldn’t take responsibility for the incident.

I strongly advise against staying at this hotel. The lack of support and accountability during such a challenging situation was incredibly disappointing.

author: Daisy V
title: Convenient Location, basic rooms
text:
I stayed here as part of an England Rugby Travel package for the England v France Six Nations match.

The hotel is in a convenient location, just a couple of minutes’ walk from Cambronne metro station, with easy connections to other parts of Paris. However, it’s not particularly close to the Eiffel Tower, which makes the hotel name a little misleading. The immediate surrounding area isn’t the nicest, but it’s perfectly fine for a short stay.

On arrival, the reception area felt clean and welcoming. However, there was an issue with our check-in — while the rest of our group had rooms ready, one room in our party was not. We were initially asked to wait an hour, but when we returned it still wasn’t available, which was frustrating as it meant we were at risk of being late for pre-booked plans. To their credit, the receptionist did resolve this by offering an alternative room that was ready.

The rooms themselves are quite small and don’t really match the photos online. They felt a bit basic and not particularly homely — carpet instead of laminate flooring would have made a difference — but they were clean, which is the most important thing. The bed was comfortable enough for a short stay.

One downside is that the hotel sits on a very busy road junction, and traffic noise is noticeable at night even with the windows closed.

Breakfast was a positive — the dining area was modern, there was a good selection of food and drinks, and staff were efficient at clearing tables.

Overall, the hotel was perfectly adequate for a couple of nights and served its purpose, but I personally wouldn’t choose to stay here again on a return trip to Paris.

author: Pablo Q
title: Hotel not far from Eiffel Tower.
text: So what about the hotel in question the Ibis from what it can for the category, do not expect luxury but all in all located near the Eiffel Tower good, friendly staff and generous breakfast.

author: Freya D
title: Eiffel Tower view
text: Spacious room! Excellent breakfast. Pleasant hotel! Availability from the concierges for luggage storage! A few steps from the Eiffel Tower! Truly pleasant.

author: Lily A
title: Excellent location!
text:
Very convenient hotel, 10 min and you are under the Eiffel Tower. 
The only downside is the limited choice for breakfast. The staff is super kind!

author: Wyatt S
title: Amazing view
text:
Crine was a real highlight of our stay—always so welcoming, smiley, and genuinely lovely. In fact, all the staff were absolutely delightful and made us feel very comfortable throughout.
The location is gorgeous, and being able to see the Eiffel Tower from our window was a special touch. Breakfast was also really nice—simple, but very tasty.

However, there were a few downsides. The lift broke down three times during our stay, including once while we were inside, which meant we had to do a lot of stair climbing up to our room on the fifth floor. The room itself was also much smaller than we expected and felt very tight for the price we paid. Unfortunately, we don’t feel it was good value overall.

author: Ruby E
title: Memorable Paris stay
text:
Hotel 15-20 min walk to Eiffel Tower. 200 mts from Metro (trains).  Within 2 blocks many Cafes & Restaurants. Small Hotel, but met our needs, clean, comfortable. Close tour pickup points, enabling plenty of time for sightseeing.
Night time photo of Eiffel Tower from outside Hotel.

author: Chloe I
title: A stay at the top!
text:
Very nice stay at this hotel!
The property is nice, clean and perfectly maintained. It feels good from the arrival.

The staff is welcoming, professional and always available, making the stay even more enjoyable.

The room was comfortable, well equipped and ideal for resting after a busy day.

I recommend this hotel without hesitation and will be back with pleasure!

author: Benjamin C
title: For city break OK
text: Hotel is central, clean and quiet. Rooms are rather small, breakfast modest. Lift is rather old and not for more than two people.

author: Paolo A
title: Perfect for a family break
text: Lovely hotel, great location with friendly staff. Stayed for 2 nights for a family city break in a triple room. The beds were confortable and the room was clean. Staff were very helpful.

author: George B
title: Great hotel!
text: The hotel was very nice! Clean and well maintained, good breakfast. Nice view of the tower. My only complaint would be the size of the room and the elevator, we were under the impression we would be given 2 beds but we only got one, but it's ok. but that was not the staffs fault. Gave me a reason to take the stairs also with the elevator. I needed to excersize. Great hotel. Would stay again!

author: Lily U
title: Nice surprise
text:
5 nights in a triple room, small but very well organized in the spaces. Power outlets near the bed and desk. Comfortable beds and choice of pillows. Bathroom with shower instead of bidet, definitely a valid solution. Friendly staff and great location (metro within walking distance).
Only point to improve the breakfast, good and varied, but not well organized. Few tables and few staff that in peak times struggles to follow the service (they currently do hot drinks) and tidy up at the same time.
Excellent value for money

author: Sean H
title: Hotel well located and in the middle of Paris.
text: The hotel met my expectations regarding the location. It is opposite the Military School where Napoleon studied and is less than 2 km from the Eiffel Tower for example. Other attractions I could do on foot and rarely had to use the subway (but if necessary, the Ecole Militaire station is a few metres away). However, the hotel is far from being luxurious. Small room, small bathroom but well cleaned, air conditioning, fridge bar. There is no room service and breakfast although reasonable, there are very helpful staff who bring to the table the coffee the way the guest wants. Daily in the range of 180 euros. It is on average what is offered in Paris for this price.

author: Leo Y
title: Excellent pisition
text:
Large room with comfortable built-in wardrobe.  Functional bathroom with shower products
Average breakfast, I would have preferred more fruit options
Very nice staff both in the lobby (especially Romeo) and also the breakfast girls.
Good cleaning.

author: Maria M
title: A delightful hotel in an excellent location
text:
To be honest, I struggled to find anything negative about this hotel, not that I was looking for problems, I wasn’t, I just felt from reading reviews that it got a little bad press here and there (you can’t please everyone all of the time I suppose) which is really unjustified in my humble opinion. The staff were really lovely to us throughout our stay. Our room wasn’t ready on arrival so we were able to safely leave our bags and go out and explore Paris. The Eiffel Tower is a short walk away and there’s many shops and restaurants surrounding the hotel so don’t worry about location! We are a family of 3 so got a triple room, there were no triple rooms with a tower view when we asked but it wasn’t an issue as it could be seen as soon as you walked out the hotel door which was nice. The room was modern, clearly recently renovated, and spotlessly clean. It had plenty toiletries and towels for us to use as well as spare pillows and a spare quilt if needed which it wasn’t as the room was lovely and warm. We all had a great sleep having just left Disney after an exhausting few days! There was a hairdryer in the bathroom ladies (and some men!) so no need to bring one with you and an excellent, large, walk-in shower. A lot of people in the below reviews are moaning about the size of rooms, don’t let that put you off, we didn’t have an issue with that at all there was plenty of room for the 3 of us (we had a triple though so could have been why).  There was plenty storage for clothes and our belongings also. The only thing missing was a kettle and coffee making facilities but not the end of the world, you’re in Paris after all, go out and get a decent coffee! Breakfast was plentiful with lots to choose from. It did take some time for the hot cooked food to come out and be replenished but it was nice and chilled so we were in no rush and the girl on duty did explain she was on her own so understandable, she was such a lovely girl and nothing was a bother to her. 
Overall we are so happy with our choice of hotel, a little high priced for a 3 star hotel but that’s Paris for you, they all are! I wouldn’t hesitate to go back or recommend to others. Thank you to the staff for their hospitality.

author: Morgan C
title: Excellent Honeymoon Treat!
text: We just arrived home from the hotel yesterday and I must say, it was one of the best trips of our lives. We booked this for our honeymoon / mini moon and the staff were lovely. The hotels location is perfect and safe. We got upgraded to a junior suite on the 6th floor and it was an amazing experience. Watching the Eiffel Tower light up at night is always great! Thank you to all the staff for being so nice and we will definitely return. We always stay in this hotel when we visit Paris. This was my fourth time! The hotels location is so clean, plus it’s quiet. We will hopefully book again soon!

author: Charlotte J
title: Great location
text:
Great location! 
The hotel had everything you needed. The bed was large and comfortable and the bathroom was very clean and modern. 
We had a lovely quiet room and it was cosy and warm. 
There was lots of things to choose from for breakfast, but they could do with replenishing items quicker. 
The hotel is only a few minutes from a metro station and a short walk from the Eiffel Tower. Plenty of places to eat near by and lots of small supermarkets. 
I would definitely stay here again.

author: Poppy D
title: Pack ear plugs
text: I would certainly pack earplugs due to the wall being paper thin, first night we had rowdy Chinese couple next door  then a single girl the following night she was on her own until 4am when she arrived back with some fella, I don’t need to go into detail but you get the picture.. if you choose this place then pack ear plugs , apart from that the staff are wonderful and the breakfast is excellent

author: Leo G
title: Staff amazing
text: This hotel was a great discovery for the price.  Though the rooms are small but typical of European hotels, I didn’t give it 5⭐️ because it had no fridge or coffee maker.  The location was very good, near metro station and restaurants plus we walked to the Eiffel Tower just about every day.

author: Jessica P
title: Parisian night
text: This hotel was in a great location. Close to the train station that will take you anywhere and a phenomenal view of the Eiffel Tower. It has a classy Parisian look and feel. My room was ready and the front desk was nice. I called in advanced and requested a view of the Eiffel Tower. The elevator is extremely small. Could only probably fit one person. The upstairs were a bit creepy at first, but that's Paris for ya. The room was small but comfortable. The bed was actually comfortable. I rested really well each night. It's extremely quiet area at night. The bathroom was a good size for me as I was solo. They offer breakfast each morning. Not a big breakfast but go early as the food runs out quick. There's also a bar on the premise and I believe they would have Happy hour specials at times. This was a cute hotel and I would recommend.

author: Holly K
title: Great location
text: When we arrived at the hotel, we were pleasantly surprised by the view of the Eiffel Tower. As first-time visitors, the location was great; we were near so many places to eat and drink as well as various tourist attractions. The staff were very friendly and, during our last day, offered to keep our luggage after checkout until our flight, which was in the evening. Once we returned, they offered us some free drinks while we waited for our taxi. I liked that the bed had both soft and firm pillows in the room, as not everyone wants to sleep on a soft pillow, so for me, this was really good and something not every hotel does. The rooms themselves aren't particularly big, but who wants to spend loads of time in their room when they're in Paris? In the end, our room was just under £120 each, and for that price, it is definitely five stars in my opinion.

author: Chloe Y
title: A shame, a scandal
text: A shame, a scandal: It is rare for me to leave a derogatory comment on an establishment, but here there was a sort of record in indecency. Upon arrival, I should have been suspicious—the "reception" was actually a small table in the bar room, where a hole in the ceiling allowed rainwater to drip into a glass placed next to it, even onto the floor! The stairs are narrow and under repair (why accept customers if the hotel is under construction?), and of course there is no elevator, leading to rooms with damaged walls. The "room," akin to what we call a "maid's room" in Paris, is unexpected in a 3-star hotel (how could this hotel obtain 3 stars when it barely deserves one remains a mystery): a narrow 12m² bedroom, hall, dilapidated and furnished with unworthy "cheap" furniture! Two separate beds of 70cm! And a bathroom of at most 2m², in the same state of disrepair as the rest of the room, with a cramped, unusable sink in the corner. Avoid this horrible hotel whose price (210€ that night) is at least three times too expensive. Compare it with the luxurious rooms at the Puli Hotel or the Shangri-La in Shanghai, where I am coming from, which are 250€, or the incredibly luxurious Beaurivage Palace in Lausanne, which are double the price.

author: Emma C
title: Construction site open with customers
text: We stayed in this hotel for three nights! We paid €900 to sleep on an open construction site. If I had known I would have chosen something else for this price. Boxes in the stairs, dust everywhere, elevator not working. Poor breakfast in a room that was half used as a warehouse for chairs and mattresses. The only positive note: the location

author: Megan L
title: Clean, close, and comfortable!
text: The hotel is in a great area.  Easy walking and the metro and bus routes are close.  The hotel was very quaint.  They cleaned the room every morning.  Breakfast was simple and fresh.

author: Miguel M
title: Very good experience
text:
Service excellent , Rooms small but excellent facilities and really excellent staff 

Very noise yay night but that’s because we had a road front view .

author: Isla L
title: Good location, but inconsistent service for a 4-star hotel
text:
The hotel is quite small, but that is understandable given its central Paris location. The location was excellent, the bed was comfortable, the room was generally clean, and the staff were friendly and helpful.

However, we found the service somewhat inconsistent for a 4-star hotel. The minibar contained snacks and drinks without any visible price list or indication of the costs, which was confusing. Coffee capsules were provided on the first day but not the following day; after asking at reception, we were eventually given more.

Housekeeping was generally good, but on two occasions the water was not replenished, and we had to ask for it. On one day, the room was not vacuumed and used cleaning cloths were left in the middle of the bathroom. There was also some mould on the bathroom ceiling.

Overall, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the friendly staff and excellent location, but we expected a little more consistency and attention to detail from a 4-star hotel.

author: Henry G
title: Stylish central Paris hotel.
text:
Location great. 
Atmosphere stylish, mature. 
Rooms, stylish but impractical. Double bed in room
607 very awkward to get into on one side due to sloping ceiling. Location of power plugs under bedside tables very awkward. Shower awkward too. Had to stand in triangular bathtub, no shower curtain. Not great pressure. Room noisy with nearby slamming doors and being close to laundry area on 6th floor. 
Good service though, good free coffee in lobby, although only powdered milk supplied- maybe this is a French thing. Would I stay again? Probably not.

author: Ian S
title: Very good
text:
I had an excellent night at your hotel.
The room is clean and comfortable.
The breakfast buffet is decent.

author: Leo F
title: Hotel near Notre Dame
text:
Great location. Clean room, friendly staff. Very small room but adequate.
Quite slow replenishing the breakfast table, had to ask for more butter and juice.

author: Aiden J
title: Great location
text: Location is really good , clean room , but room and bath are small

author: Erin L
title: Inspired to write poetry
text: Small rooms, but absolutely sufficient and cozy. Very friendly welcome and farewell. It's great that there is a station to fill water bottles or to grab a coffee. Price is also okay.

author: Marco E
title: Average
text:
Superior room. 140/200 bed, too bad.
Breakfast was only pre-prepared items, no cooked dishes due to the lack of a kitchen in the hotel.
Restroom too small.
Well-located hotel

author: Chloe M
title: Average
text: Rooms are very small. Location also not the best. Overall average experience.

author: Dylan N
title: Convenient and a good value
text: Clean and modern room. Super convenient location for taking the RER to CDG while also being amazingly close to attractions, at a great price!

author: Ella H
title: Historic Saint-Germain near Centre of Paris
text:
Reception/Front desk staff great - Provided free use of international adapters during our stay; helpfully organised departure Taxi to Gare du Nord [Taxis can use Bus lanes].
Paid$$$ for a great Paris Location - Historic Saint-Germain-des-Prés is the Excellent 6th arrondissement/district of the Centre of Paris.  Walking distance to Notre Dame; accessible to Metro (Unlimited one-day RATP Navigo Travel pass to substantial Versailles Palace and extensive gardens [Book entry tickets ahead]); South of River Seine.  Wandering Paris' roads and enjoying cafes.
Nice clean Room with small Balcony view.  Disappointed that no Twin room available as previously requested - had to share Dbl-bed with family member.
Airconditioning unit in room was very much needed in Europe's climate-change <35oC summer heatwave; albeit I wore my earplugs to get a deep sleep.
Amenities:  Not applicable/not used.

author: Freya H
title: Good enough but a little below expectations
text:
Amazing location. Staff were mostly helpful. Room was big enough to have two suitcases open which was a surprise. AC was a life saver. They left a kind handwritten note and macaroons on the bed, which was a fantastic gesture. 

A few negatives - bed was super hard. No windows in our room, which made it feel like a basement. Water kept splashing out of the shower so the floor was soaked most of the time. The fridge didn’t keep anything cold so we had to keep food in their kitchen fridge, which was annoying. Their ice machine was broken and they had no solution for keeping drinks cold in the room.

author: Erin G
title: Rob K
text: Nice little hotel  rooms are very small shower wasn’t great

author: Thomas B
title: Just details…
text: The experience was acceptable, nothing more, and did not meet the expectations of some guests. The weak point may have been the comments heard in the lobby about other hotel employees, which reflects a lack of professionalism, even a misunderstanding of the guests' needs. It was mainly a matter of know-how. Nothing extraordinary to report, just details…

author: Zoe Z
title: Magazine worthy “photo shoot” vibe neighborhood…so get out your Apple Map and GO!
text:
Hotel Belloy is a wedge shaped building that is in the heart of Saint Germaine and has that magazine worthy “photo shoot” vibe neighborhood…so get out your Apple Map and GO! Easy walk to a few different Metro stations (preload the app “Bonjour RATP”) to preload a few tickets onto your phone and then just click to go thru turnstiles. Also for those that love to walk and discover the city, it feels very safe walking in the area and is a close-ish walk to Pantheon, NotreDame, Louvre, and Tulleries. We took metro to places a little further like Montmartre, Musee d’Orsay, Eiffel Tower, and Versailles (RER train). 

The staff was always very helpful (one even suggested a better metro station that was safer and would avoid the crowds near SacreCoeur so we would better enjoy walking around Montmartre; another helped us get a taxi scheduled for our return to airport; and another gave suggestions and made reservation for us at local cafes).  The hotel lobby is currently under renovation and was mostly covered in plastic when we were there because they had been painting and prepping walls. We did not eat at the little basement breakfast nook because we wanted to get out and walk in the mornings when it was not so busy with people traffic. 7am, head to grab fresh croissants/pastries down near the Farmers Market (at LaMaison d’ Isabelle) which is also near NotreDame. Makes getting up early so much more worth it. There’s also tons of nearby cafes and restaurants that are delicious. Note: Check for dinner reservations the day before or morning so that after a day of adventure, you have a time and spot for food without a long wait. The staff can help you with that too!

The hotel rooms: You need to know you are staying in a historic building with old world charm. Streets are narrow, windows are big, and it is a city with city noises (I am sensitive to noise and did well, only the police siren sound cuts thru windows…there were no ice makers that I found, and we were around the corner from a staff elevator, and never really heard it—the night Paris PSG beat London Arsenal in soccer, that was a loud night). Walls are kinda thin, but in 5 days we were there, we rarely heard them. We had 3 adults in a room. It’s cozy. Bathroom is narrow. But we knew this. We had reviewed the size (area) of various rooms in Paris, and really wanted the LOCATION. This was perfect…and away from mass tourist hotels. Housekeeping made beds and replaced towels daily. Coffee makers in room (and tea), but we really didn’t use that. There is a tiny elevator (fits 2 people and a suitcase or 2) to access rooms, but we took the spiral stairs all the time to our 3rd floor room.

author: Andrea Q
title: Good
text:
Nice hotel. Very Pleasant staff (Mr. Morgan).
Rooms are a bit small. Bathrooms very small as well.
But it was a pleasant expérience

author: Sophia K
title: Good location, but very small spaces.
text:
Great location and polite staff. 
I honestly don’t think this hotel deserves a 4-star ranking. At most 3 stars. Rooms are tiny, we could hear the people talking on the adjacent rooms. Even when they used the restrooms. 
Hallways and the 1 elevator also very space constricted. We were 2 people in the room and could barely move around. 
Definitely meant only for sleeping. Not spending any time either in the room or in the lobby. 
Again, it’s nobody’s fault, everyone is well-intentioned, but the reviews made it look much better and gave me higher expectations. 
In conclusion, shouldn’t be a Four-star hotel, overpriced, and only meant for sleeping and showering. Not ideal for people who are claustrophobic.

author: Sofia S
title: A hotel near Notre Dame
text:
The Hotel Belloy is very well situated  only a 10 minute walk to the Seine and Notre Dame. 
Hotel Belloy would be best described as a boutique hotel in the St. Germaine district of Paris , very close to the Latin quarter.
The staff are very friendly and efficient and the hotel is very clean. 
If you enjoy large rooms, this is not the hotel for you as most rooms would be considered very small compared to North America but we felt this was very typical of rooms in the area.
If I had one criticism it would be that the climate control system in our room could not keep up to the very warm temperatures Europe was encountering, which made for very uncomfortable sleeping. 
This hotel is worth considering.

author: Isabella P
title: 3 star experience at a 4 star price
text: The hotel decor and Deluxe Double room we had were very nice. However the AC didn't work - basically it was just a fan - though it did help cover the street noise. Breakfast was cold items which was fine, but the coffee is self-serve from a machine. The website shows a lobby bar that doesn't exist. Instead there is a self-serve espresso machine.

author: Sophia H
title: Fabulous & Quiet in a Very Nice Neighbourhood
text:
We’ve been to Rome before and purposely  looked for a quieter stay in a calm neighborhood while being inside the city core. This was a perfect choice’

Close to home we found loads of great local coffee bars and restaurants, and the Termini train station is a very short walk which makes coming and going so much easier. 

The hotel is spotless, cool, and silent. We enjoyed the complementary lemon-mint water and savoury buns each day when coming back after touring about.  Staff are exceptional and friendly.

author: Alice S
title: Exactly What I Needed After a Stressful Start in Rome
text:
Hotel Britannia completely turned my trip around. It was exactly what I needed after a stressful start in Rome.

As a solo traveler visiting Rome for the first time, I was looking for a hotel where I could feel safe, welcomed, and comfortable, and Hotel Britannia exceeded every expectation.

From the moment I arrived, the staff was warm, professional, and genuinely kind. After a stressful experience elsewhere, their hospitality immediately put me at ease. The check-in process was smooth, and it was such a relief to have a knowledgeable front desk available to answer questions and offer assistance.

The hotel itself was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. My room was exactly what I needed after long days of exploring the city. Air conditioning (which was greatly appreciated during the summer heat) and a comfy bed to get a great night’s sleep.

The location was another highlight. I found it easy to reach many of Rome’s major attractions, and there were plenty of restaurants and transportation options nearby. It was the perfect home base for exploring the city.

What stood out most, though, was how the staff made me feel. Traveling alone internationally can be intimidating, but they created an environment where I felt welcomed and cared for.

If you’re visiting Rome, especially as a solo traveler, I would absolutely recommend Hotel Britannia. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again on my next trip.

author: Michael S
title: Decent Hotel for location and price
text: Overall good stay at the hotel, room was very clean, comfortable bed and they had a crib set up for our 1 year old and the staff was incredibly kind. The hotel is just very outdated and power went out while we were there.

author: Lucy V
title: Annual trip to Rome
text: Nice hotel, not too big and with very friendly and helpful staff.

author: Samuel D
title: Not a great place
text:
One big disapointment is how I would rate this hotel. Before getting into all of what went wrong, I have to say that the people at the front desk could not be nicer. 

This hotel represents itself as a four star hotel. It is far from being one. The walls, carpents, and many parts of the hotels are run-down and in a need for an extensive renovation. I walked in and asked to stay for three nights. But on the first day, when arriving to my room at 14:30, after a long working day in the hottest time in Rome, I found that my room was not cleaned. I was told that it is until 15:00 that they are obligated to clean. I have never heard of such a thing. After two nights, I left and rather than charging me for two nights, they changed me for three after I left. When I requested refund, the manager refused to give the refund. Going through my credit card, refund was applied, but the entire experience was unpleasant.

author: Marco K
title: Family stay June 2026
text: Smiling staff, clean room, daily housekeeping service. Varied breakfasts, the dining room is a bit small. I greatly appreciated the mint-flavored water available in the lobby with the heat!

author: Ana R
title: Great option for a Rome visit
text: Friendly, helpful staff. Breakfast option available. Lobby is a step down of about 10 steps. Very small elevators, but sufficient. Close to the termini station which is great if you need to take a train somewhere, which we did. Clean and comfortable.

author: Taylor X
title: A hotel with very good amenities.
text:
Following an issue with another hotel in the chain, we stayed at this hotel, which offers a 4-star service while respecting the "Italian Era" style.
We were received in the best possible way by Manuela at the reception; her good mood and smile reflected the hotel, very welcoming.
The breakfast was excellent with one minor downside: the hot chocolate from the machine was not great, made with water; real chocolate milk would have been better, but it’s a slight point to improve.

author: Dylan W
title: Dismal
text:
Close to tourist attractions 
This is not a 4-star hotel; I would give it two stars.
Do not pay for lunch; it is very bad.
The hotel is poorly maintained.
Customer service was excellent despite the major disappointment with the quality of the hotel.
I do not recommend this hotel to anyone.

author: Nora P
title: Longlasting memory
text:
It is a very nice modern upshaped hotel with a really warm welcome at the reception desk. The people at the desk are very supporting in all belongings.
Rooms are very clean and I had a very nice experience at the terrace next to my room!

author: Joseph X
title: Beautiful little Boutique Hotel close to city center
text:
We traveled to Italy for a wedding my daughter and her boyfriend were attending in Tuscany, and planned to spend just 1–2 days in Rome before heading out of the city. We booked two rooms for one night but ended up extending our stay for an additional night. The hotel staff was incredibly accommodating with our last‑minute request.

The hotel is centrally located, within easy walking distance of the city center. The rooms were lovely, the property was well kept, and the staff could not have been nicer. We absolutely would recommend this hotel and would gladly stay here again.

author: Zoe E
title: Outstanding experience
text: The hotel had great front desk staff, excellent rooms, good breakfast snd a fantastic location for the historic sights.

author: Katie C
title: Britannia Hotel .
text:
The hotel is very nice and clean and the staff is friendly.
Room was very nice and just right in size 
Very nice hotel staff who made sure we had a good experience, very helpful when asking questions and made sure we as guests had a great hotel stay with a little extra when it was both birthday and honeymoon.
Highly recommend this hotel 😊

author: Mia X
title: Quiet Gem
text:
This was my third trip to Rome and the third at the Britannia.  This hotel is small and quiet with friendly staff and great location .
The breakfast was especially good made even better by the attentive service of Simone!

author: Nathan U
title: A rare trip of relaxation made easier by the Britannia hotel.
text: Really lovely hotel - perfectly situated - clean, comfortable and excellent staff . Truly ticking all the boxes .

author: Antoine Q
title: Does not match what is offered on the website
text:
I find it misleading that the photos on the website of this hotel do not correspond at all to the room we ended up in. Of course the room we got was considerably less beautiful, luxurious, complete. At the reception they say that the rooms are different and that our rooms were indeed a deluxe room.

I also find it very strange that as a foreigner you pay for Satellite TV and then do not get one channel where you have English subtitles, let alone Dutch.
A TV in your room is only useful if you understand Italian

author: Harry H
title: To be repeated
text: Great location, friendly staff

author: Laura S
title: GREAT STAY
text: Very nice hotel, classically furnished, not modern, but I'd say that's a plus these days. The breakfast was excellent, varied, and much to my liking. The location was magnificent, 100 meters from Via Nazionale, a stone's throw from Roma Termini and the metro lines that pass through it. More than satisfied.

author: Holly G
title: Farewell Hotel Britannia
text:
hotel not usable by those arriving in Rome by car (in the ZTL area / no parking even for loading and unloading)
difficult and uncomfortable reception access for luggage ( long downhill staircase ) 
lack of information about features and limitations on the website

author: Evan O
title: Great hotel in a great location.
text:
I found the location was perfect, Irish bar at the end of the road, Metro a 2 minute walk, staff were very helpful, we had a great room with a sun terrace, room was spotless, our room was on the 4th floor and never herd any noise from the pub.
Would I stay there again - defiantly. Already talking about going back in a couple of years for the rugby again.

author: Freya L
title: Great for business travellers
text: A regular hotel for a reason and with friendly staff, a modern aesthetic, lovely rooms with a handy good quality restaurant if you're not going out. Such a difference from the larger chains that can feel impersonal. Yes, there's a small gym too. Highly recommend for business.

author: Lauren K
title: Great find, fabulous location
text:
This is a great find. Minutes from Euston, Roos a decent size for central London although we did go for the slightly bigger deluxe room. Coffee machine, iron, lovely robes and bed linen, would recommend highly. Bar are is love,y, staff really friendly. 
Could do with more toiletries and the breakfast selection could be bigger. Would definitely stay again.

author: Chloe M
title: Room claustrophobic
text:
Room and bed far too small - booked a double room but felt like a three quarter bed — very claustrophobic I’m afraid. Was in room 613 - avoid if you like a bit of spaces.

Otherwise good positioned hotel not far from the train station and very clean

author: Evie M
title: Bad deposit experience - check other reviews
text: Stayed here for a concert last Friday with my friend. Room was nice and so were staff, location was great. But they’ve taken a deposit of £50 on top of the full amount paid. I am yet to get it back and it’s been almost a week. When leaving I was told it could be up to 10 days before being refunded which is ridiculous in all honesty. I’m beginning to worry as other reviews have said similar and some people have waited longer than 10 days. This hotel should rethink their deposit system as it’s genuinely put me off staying here again.

author: Jack Z
title: All round great experience
text: Bright and welcoming hotel, very friendly staff

author: Lily B
title: Excellent new find for us
text:
We checked in at 10.30pm after a dreadful experience with the premier inn. Not only did they have a lovely clean and stylish room available but we were upgraded! 
Excellent customer service, very good value for money with the breakfast included too. Great location for getting around. This will be our new go to hotel. Very impressed!

author: Chloe S
title: Weekend anniversary break
text: We had such a lovely stay here , staff very friendly,helpful, room was very clean and to the point of what we needed , would stay here again .

author: Marco X
title: Lovely sleep and great location
text:
We stayed here for our anniversary, and the lovely man at check in didn’t charge us for early check in and he upgraded our room.
The room was lovely, bed was super comfortable and the air conditioning was a god send!
We slept really well.
Also location was great for getting out and about.

author: Pablo W
title: Poor air conditioning
text: The room itself is fine, exactly as pictured on website. But the air conditioning has not worked consistently - only functional for a few hours and the rest of the time the room is a sweltering sauna. The system then gets “reset” but still no relief. I cannot recommend staying here if you need consistent A/C. Has made for a miserable stay in the midst of a heat wave.

author: Oliver M
title: Swerve this one!
text:
We ate at the restaurant yesterday, we used a voucher which had been gifted to us, absolute confusion, wrong menu given to us, hotel tried to say items weren't included despite the voucher saying they were, dreadful service, 25 degrees in the restaurant because the air con wasn't working. Food was just 'okay' nothing special.
I would not recommend this restaurant and will never return.

author: Noah P
title: Good for St Pancras
text: The hotel is located about a 10 minute walk from St. Pancras International.  At check in I wasn't given any details anout breakfast times or check out time.  My room.was on the 4th floor.  It was a reasonable size for London with tea and coffee.facities  a coffee machimr and 2 bottles of house water. The bathroom was minute. Only room for 1 person at a time. 2 spaces either side of the bed to stow cases.  I had booked their dinner bed and breakfast rate but it took 5 minutes for them to.decide what I could actually have. In the end I was given the fixed menu which just had 3 choices. My recommendation is choose from the main menu but they do add.on a service charge. The breakfast buffet looked good but I had to leave early. There is however 1 thing I would change - the hotel manager! He has absolutely.no people skills and comes across as arrogant. When I went to ask about breakfast and checkout I was obviously interrupting something on his laptop.as he ignored me and ley someone else answer.

author: Benjamin Y
title: Absolutely perfect hotel!
text:
Absolutely perfect hotel! Close to Euston Station (ideal if you’re planning a visit to the Harry Potter Studio) and also near King’s Cross. There’s a bus stop right outside the hotel that takes about 15 minutes to reach more central areas.
The rooms were flawless – air conditioning, comfortable beds, and extremely clean! The breakfast had everything you need, the restaurant served delicious food, and the afternoon tea was perfect.
The staff were wonderful, cheerful, and very helpful. Stay here if you’re going to London. It’s hard to find a hotel that offers better value for money.

author: Grace A
title: Afternoon tea
text:
Came to this hotel for an afternoon tea.

We were early but they seated us anyway. The staff were all really friendly and attentive. Checking that everything was ok with our food and drinks. 

The afternoon tea was lovely and filling. There was a nice relaxed atmosphere and we stayed there for a couple hours taking our time. I'd certainly recommend this.

author: Ella R
title: Not 4 Star!
text:
Looks impressive from the outside and in reception, and well positioned for Euston and St Pancras, but we had possibly the smallest hotel room we've ever stayed in - even for London this was tiny.  The double bed was smaller than the one we have at home and there was still barely room to squeeze past.  Whenever one of us wanted to move around, eg when getting dressed, the other had to sit out of the way on the bed.
There was minimal storage and we had to stack our suitcases against the door to get around.  However, it was very clean and shower and toilet were ok.  We didn't eat here at all.
Overall, very poor value for money, in fact a bit of a rip off for what you got.

author: Charlotte T
title: Small, clean, quiet
text: The room was small but thats London. I do wish they had put in more shelves though. There was nowhere to unpack your cloths or put stuff in the bathroom. Other than that the room was very good. It was clean with a big window that let in lots of natural light and had a small table with a chair and ottoman to sit at it. Hot water kettle and coffee maker. Shower is the half door kind that always ends with water in the floor. The toiletries provided were a good quality. Air conditioner worked great and the room got very cold even on the day it was 92 degrees outside. Street was quiet at night but near St Pancreas for train travel and near tube stations. For what I paid it was very worth it for a hotel in London. Id stay again.

author: Oscar B
title: Bloomsbury. The Memoir Club.
text: Excellent stay in Bloomsbury at the Memoir Club. The staff were friendly and accommodating and the room, while small, was comfortable with good natural lighting. Aside from the bathroom floor which seemed to stay wet for too long, everything else was great.

author: Matthew K
title: Perfectly adequate for a London stay
text:
Really nice hotel and ideally situated for the Euston area.
Rooms were compact but nicely decorated and had everything I needed.
Bed comfy, bathroom clean and decent pillows 
Breakfast was extensive and bar area tidy.

author: Sophia S
title: Somewhere in Bloomsbury
text:
Overall, I was willing to give the hotel a very positive review. 
But there's a big downside. And it's reception service. Just one person, but her aggressiveness prevents me from recommending this hotel. So if you choose this hotel, remember that maybe it's just that one person won't like you and they'll be rude to you. I was unlucky, I had to communicate with this man on arrival and departure. And on leaving, the person couldn't even say a formal thank you for your stay. This kind of unprofessionalism is very off-putting.

From the pros: convenient location, excellent restaurant (special thanks for Mediterranean dishes).

Of the downsides you might experience if it weren't for the boorishness at the reception: 

- you need to add vegetables to breakfast;
- you need to change the glazing in the rooms and in the restaurant, because it is very noisy and cold in the evenings;
- the bed can be short and the room itself is small (but this is typical British).

author: Louis F
title: perfect hotel
text:
location and room condition s perfect.
breakfast also lovely.
I will revisit next time.

author: Charlotte Q
title: Lovely, clean, delicious.
text: Great location, quiet neighborhood close to restaurants and transit. Efficient but comfortable rooms. Fantastic breakfast.

author: Chloe Z
title: Unfortunately disappointing
text: Booked this hotel on the day of travel and having stayed at a Berjaya some years previously (albeit in the Seychelles) I expected a similar standard - budget but clean and comfortable. Initial impressions were favourable when I dropped my luggage too early for check-in. The reception is light and there were fresh flowers and very friendly staff. The hotel is situated a few minutes walk from both Bayswater and Queensway tube stations and is surrounded by shops, bars and restaurants. I returned late that evening to check in and was given a basement room in an area of the hotel accessed by an unappealing corridor clearly in need of renovation. I fully appreciate I was in a single room at a reasonable price (for that particular date in central London compared to other available hotels) and I had booked last minute. However the room was well below the acceptable standard of its type. There was grime and debris around the window in the basement which was clearly overlooked by pedestrians on the street above. There was a tatty curtain and I had a direct view of the semi naked occupant of the room at right angles to mine who had not drawn their torn curtain and was laid in full view on the bed. As it was so late I slept there the first night. The shower room the next morning proved to have a dirty window with no blind in the shower area and an unhygienic looking shower curtain, a tiny utility room sized sink and a toilet all crammed into a cupboard sized space. The staff were very accommodating when I asked for another room for my second night and this one was basic but sufficient for one late night sleep post-theatre. Despite it’s excellent location and good staff I would not stay here again or recommend this hotel. It needs a through renovation and rooms the standard of my first one should not be sold to guests under any circumstances. The loss of revenue for a substandard room is considerably less detrimental to a hotel than a negative review I would think.
