author: Holly T
title: A great find
text: A gem of a find. Superb location no more than five mins from two tube stations. Plenty of shops bars and restaurants around. We were in a newly renovated room which was ideal as a base for the weekend. So pleased we have already booked for December.

author: Oliver T
title: An experience I do not recommend!
text: The room does not match the hotel's room photos; it is located in a basement, small and unpleasant, there is not even drinking water, and we had to buy bottled water to brush our teeth.

author: Evie Q
title: Decent hotel centre if London
text: Stayed here a few times nice central hotel convenient for everything in London near tubes car park etc . Good breakfast in side conservatory

author: Isla R
title: One night's acceptable
text: Room 230 Very creeky floors and maze like building.. Windows have huge gaps allowing in all the noice and the curtains let in all the light. I was woken up at 6am every morning! By light or noice For 4x nights. Doors slamming is a issues was woken up at 3am and 4 am 2 nights from guests slamming closed their doors. The light and noise gets in as if I'm sleeping in a tent! Even the door has gaps... Issues with TV goin black it times out or if u keep searching channels it goes black u have to restart the TV. house keeping was above and beyond that was impressive but god help u if they clean the next room very noisy at 9am! Very! .. Front desk good too customer service is valued here. The ac unit in upgraded rooms is good if not a little unresponsive . First checked in I unpacked which took an hour then tried to to take a shower.. No hot water I had to pack and unpack again to change rooms on another floor to access hot water.  the shower is either too hot or too cold it's very hard to regulate a temperature you want. Paid 80.00 a night I can't stay here again as the basics noise and light was way way to much this is a one night hotel only for those reason.

author: Diego K
title: Small room , only Queen size bed
text: The hotel is in an excellent location got Hyde Park and tube stations , with Bayswater and Queensway less than 5 mins walk away. Good selection of eaterys around the corner too. We had a recently refurbished room which was nice , clean and bathroom look unused, HOWEVER the size of the room and bed let it down. Described as a Premier Room it was a small as it could be and the bed was only a small double (Queen). We booked a deluxe room so at least expect a Double Bed. We would stay there again BUT it would have to be a bigger room and bed !

author: Adam J
title: Stay in London
text:
Good hotel 
Friendly staff 
Rooms clean 
Good location 
Luggage can be stored if needed 
ID required on arrival 
£50 bond ( refunded) required for breakages etc upon arrival 
Breakfast wasn't the best! The setting I would of expected this to be part of hotel but it was in a Mayalsian restaurant (at side of hotel)

author: Nathan K
title: Great find in London
text: Very welcoming. Room was small but had everything we needed, incuding a really good hairdriee. Everthing was clean and looked liked recently refurbed. Defo recommend

author: Lea W
title: Terrible hotel
text: Horrendous stay at this hotel, DO NOT STAY HERE. Wallpaper peeling off, holes in carpet, floor creaks, lift big enough for half a person, the door has clearly been kicked in previously and had a hole next to the lock, the bath had a hole in it, holes in the tiles, £50!!! DEPOSIT?! very loud can hear every movement in the hotel. Terrible night sleep, clearly an unsafe place to stay too

author: Ian Y
title: Nice place to stay
text: Really enjoyed my stay at this hotel! Everything was clean and beautifully kept. The location is very convenient — close to the metro, shops, and everything you might need. Perfect for both leisure and business trips. Definitely recommend!

author: Gavin P
title: Booking.com - what a disappointment!
text: We booked this hotel through Booking.com and were very disappointed. First, the breakfast was Asiatic and not English. Second, the water in the room non drinkable. The lift very small and need long waiting. I could add many more disadvanteges, but the worst is WE HAD TO PAY A DEPOSIT of 50 pounds, WHICH THEY NEVER5 RETURNED! We wrote Booking.com many times but they told us to phone the hotel or did not answer. I am considered as a high degree client of Booking.com, but no more! This is not a fair service! There are other companies. which I will use from now on

author: Kyle E
title: Scam of taking GBP 50 from gullible customers
text:
I am writing to share a concerning experience my companions and I encountered during our recent stay at Berjaya Eden Park, in the hope of informing future guests and prompting necessary actions.

On 20th July, as Indian travelers, we checked into Berjaya Eden Park having prepaid for our accommodation. However, upon arrival, Mr. Trevor at the front desk requested an additional payment of £50, citing it as a security deposit. Observing that all guests checking in were subjected to the same request, we presumed this was standard procedure and complied by paying the requested amount.

Regrettably, upon checkout, our request to have the deposit refunded was met with assurances from Mr. Trevor that the amount would be credited back to our account within a few days. Despite subsequent correspondence with the hotel's contact email, where we were advised to wait a few more days for the refund, there has been no further communication or resolution from the establishment.

It is with great disappointment that I must share this experience, as it has left us feeling deceived and frustrated. We wish to alert prospective guests to exercise caution and verify such practices to avoid similar situations.

I trust that this information will be helpful to others and encourage the hotel management to address these practices to prevent further occurrences.

author: Leo P
title: Great Stay at Berjaya Eden Park London Hotel!
text:
I had a lovely 4 nights stay at this hotel. I stayed in the newly renovated Premier Single room, which was clean, comfortable, and had a good view. The location near Hyde Park is excellent, and the room rate was very reasonable.
The staff were friendly and helpful throughout my stay. Special thanks to Celso who assisted me from my booking online to checkout. Ziwan was also very kind and managed to help with a last-minute upgrade at the time of check in, even though the hotel was busy. Tiago, the manager, was patient and accommodating as well.
Overall, a great experience. I would definitely stay here again!

author: Alexander G
title: Great location lovely staff great air con
text: Stayed during the heatwave and was concerned the room would be really hot ..it was fully air conned clean and comfortable. This hotel is excellent value for money in a great location with lovely staff this was our 2nd visit and will no doubt return again

author: Nora D
title: Great London Location: 2 Tube LInes & Kensington Gardens/Hyde Park - Berjaya Eden Park
text: Lovely quiet hotel in a great location (right by Bayswater Tube Station and close to Queensway Station). Hotel recommended by friend and we were not disappointed. Good sized room with modern washing facilities and shower. Staff incredibly helpful.

author: Taylor T
title: Lovely room.
text: We stayed here in the Eden suite as we had booked to go to the Royal  Albert hall. The room was lovely but the radiators and heated towel rail were left on and being 33 degrees outside it was far too hot. So turned it off and put the air con on and left for the evening. On return it was nice and cool. I booked the room as on the website it showed a lovely balcony with table and chairs, so was disappointed to see we couldn’t go out as it was unsafe. Having said that, it was spotlessly clean and reception staff were very friendly.

author: Alice N
title: Not a care in the World, avoid!!
text: My Daughter treated me to a London trip for my retirement, Zack Bryan Hyde Park, we had a Hotel Booked, Berjaya Eden Park London, we arrived at the Hotel, booked in and then off to the Concert, later when we returned to the Hotel we were told there was no room available even though we were already booked in !!. We phoned Booking .com at 1.30am and they confirmed the was no room, they said try to find another Hotel nearby at similar cost, nothing was available anywhere near, we ended up going home on a Coach arriving home at 5.30 am, we should have been given a room at any price, I don’t appreciate walking around London in the early hours, if you can’t rely on a confirmed booking what’s the point.

author: Sofia T
title: Don’t go in warm weather
text: Clean; great location and beds comfy. Wouldn’t recommend going in hot weather. Air con doesn’t work properly and window doesnt open. Also appeared that someone hoovering above us at 7am. Not the relaxing stay we had hoped for

author: Mia E
title: JUST AVOID. OTHER HOTELS AROUND THE AREA OFFER SIMILAR PRICING BUT WITH BETTER SERVICES AND BASIC AMENITIES
text:
Checked in into this hotel on 14th June and the first issue at this hotel started with the front desk. Upon arrival, Front desk staff, Ziwan asked to collect a pre-auth of £50 via credit card. We mentioned to him that we specifically changed cash to make this payment as acknowledged and agreed by the hotel reception a few days prior to arriving. He insisted otherwise and said that they had changed the policy recently to only a week ago that they only accepted card payment.  The change in policy (winthin the week since our email) was not shared with us. 

Additionally, the room that was given to us has no AC and worse, a faulty door locking system. As we are a group of 3 girls on this birthday trip...We immediately felt completely unsafe staying in the room. We spoke to frontdesk staff, Ziwan who came to the room to access the situation and told him to get the maintenance to have it fixed immediately.
Ziwan called us back and mentioned that the maintenance can only rectify the faulty door lock the next day. This convenient solution did not solve the problem on hand. Security for our stay is currently being breached!
When asked if I could speak to a higher management, Ziwan casually mentioned that no manager would attend to our issue. He further mentioned sarcastically that he cant obviously call his manager for every issue that a guest faces in the hotel. 
When asked if I could have the email address of the owner of the property, he simply mentioned its Vincent Tan (Berjaya Corporation), and that I should know him as he is very famous! Like seriously!
The hotel reception was not being helpful and disregarded our immediate security concern. 
When asked if we could have another room, he mentioned that the hotel is full and that there are no other solutions that he could offer.
After travelling from more that 16hrs, Ziwan's attitude proved to be very frustrating as he kept brushing us off by saying he could not help further. He further pissed us off by saying that the Frint Office Manager, Tiago can only speak to us on Monday!! That's in 2 days from date of check in.
At no point did Ziwan nor the Front Office Manager, Tiago, apologised to us nor offered to try find us girls a solution! This may be a 2 or 3 star hotel but it is not an issue that we could just brush off...it concerned safety and security! The best part is they collected a security deposit for damages but the room in itself was already faulty to begin with!!
To add salt to the wound...Ziwan threatened to call the police on us, which he did and the police over the phone themselves probably told him to find a solution for his guests himself, as they have more serious matters to handle!! This is totally appalling and absolutely unacceptable!
He refused to give us a refund, nor assisted to find another hotel for us nearby, nor call for the maintenance nor have a room for us to swap to....NO SOLUTION NOR APOLOGY OFFERED WHATSOEVER! But instead he threatened us with the police.

This could be a one-off situation, but a service provider with zero empathy and with a 'could not care less' attitude is not something I can let pass easily.

A hotel be it 1 star or 6 stars must have the most basic service, ie, AC as well as safety & security offered to their guests. This is By Law!

author: Alice Z
title: The Waltons
text: The hotel is clean and friendly . They went the extra mile to make our stay nice. I loved how old it is and so close to restaurants and small stores . I'll be telling all my friends about this place. Thank-you for making our trip great . Will miss the staff too

author: Evan N
title: A great stay!!
text: The stay went really very well, the accommodation is very well located, the room very pleasant with a beautiful view and the staff is really attentive, especially Saikot Renata. Thanks to him :)

author: Holly O
title: Good service and clean
text: The hotel is clean with good amenities - Le Labo’s Hanoki. Very nice. Were stayed at room 1105. Reception was swift - Saikot was very accommodative and kind. Good service. The only thing, our shower sliding door was not working - the opening is just nice for us too go in/out, and we arrived late. And, the remote to TV does not work, so we had to switch off via the main switch.

author: Charlie M
title: Solid Stay @ The Gate
text: My grandpa, his friend, and I had a lovely short stay at The Gate this week! We were in room 211 which had wonderful amenities and comfortable beds. The 24/7 gym came in handy while trying to work off our jet lag. The breakfast was a very nice array of food on their gorgeous 5th floor lounge. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful throughout the stay. Saikot, Grigore, and the woman running breakfast whose name I didn’t catch, made particularly strong impressions and made us feel at right at home.

author: Joseph O
title: Excellent!!!
text: Very nice experience, beautiful hotel, well-maintained, a very professional and very kind staff. Thanks to Saikot and his colleagues for their welcome.

author: Lauren I
title: Amazing place to stay!
text:
We stayed at The Gate for a couple of nights as part of my husband's 60th birthday celebrations.
Our room was on the 17th floor & we had an amazing view.
All the staff we had dealings with were so helpful & friendly. They really helped make our stay special, including leaving a card & a small bottle of prosecco in the room for my husband's birthday.
The location of The Gate is perfect - so easy to get out and explore. We used the tube to get around on our first day, but walked everywhere on our second day, including visiting Borough Market & then later in the day we visited Brick Lane for a curry.
I can happily recommend The Gate to anyone looking for a decent place to stay in the city, with amazing views & excellent amenities; all topped off with excellent staff. Highly recommended.

author: Katie P
title: Amazing stay and super kind staff
text: The place is really well kept, clean,  equipped with everything you need and quiet. Upon arrival I was greeted by Shiful and Gregore, who was really kind and helpful. They explained me everything I need to know and made my stay amazing. I would recommend this place for anyone who wants to receive high service and kind attitude in this busy city. I would definitely come back.

author: Ian N
title: Convenient and clean place to stay
text: Great hotel. My son and I booked a room with twin beds and it was perfect for our stay. The room was clean and a nice size. I loved that it had a fridge and microwave along with another sink outside of the bathroom. The bathroom did have a bracelet and bobby pin from previous person on the bathroom floor but was overall clean. It was located a short walk from Algate East train station so it was convenient to get everywhere around the city.

author: Brooke X
title: Nice hotell
text: Honestly, this hotel is exceptional in every way. The staff especially Renata and Saikot went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable, particularly since we were traveling with a child; they anticipated every need and made us feel truly cared for. The location is ideal, just steps away from major attractions, yet the rooms are quiet and immaculately clean. Breakfast was delicious and well-stocked, with plenty of variety. We absolutely loved our stay and will definitely be returning on our next trip to London."

author: Carlos Z
title: my review
text: Very nice hotel and nice people.

author: David O
title: Great hotel
text: We had wonderful days at the great hotel; the location is super! We will definitely come back! The staff is extraordinarily friendly!

author: Camille Z
title: 18 months of feeling at home – outstanding hotel and team
text:
I stayed at the Gate Hotel for 18 months with my cat and can honestly say it was my favourite place in London. The hotel is modern, stylish and impeccably clean, but what really sets it apart is how safe and welcoming it feels. As a woman living alone, this mattered enormously to me. Being pet-friendly was the perfect bonus – my cat was treated with the same care as the guests.
Over the months I got to know the team well. The housekeepers are consistently polite, lovely and do an excellent, reliable job every day. The maintenance team are friendly and extremely responsive – any issues were dealt with quickly and cheerfully.
The real stars, though, are the Front of House team. They are engaging, warm and nothing is ever too much trouble. Living on my own, I often stopped by just for a chat and they never disappointed. Special mention to Rupok, the FOH Manager, who went above and beyond time after time, and to Keerthy, the General Manager, who has a wonderful eye for detail and a kind heart. The thoughtful gifts and flowers he gave me on special occasions (and during tougher periods) were incredibly touching and never forgotten. I also want to thank Renata and Anastasia – two of the most helpful people I’ve met. We’ve become genuine lifelong friends outside the hotel as well.
Thank you to every single member of the Gate Hotel team for making my 18 months so comfortable and happy. I will miss you all.

author: Zoe L
title: Lovely stay
text: Saikot was fantastic at front desk, very attentive and welcoming! Great location and amenities everything you need - would come again :)

author: Morgan A
title: Saiket - you’re the man!
text:
Saiket - Top Man!

I’ve stayed here many times before - and I will continue to. The staff are friendly, helpful, and I feel welcome here. Not just another number! 

Thank you all,

Matt

author: Jack N
title: Nice hotel, friendly staff, and close to Tower Bridge.
text:
Our stay at this hotel was a complete success. We were welcomed very warmly and friendly right at check-in. We would especially like to highlight Saikot, who supported us excellently during our stay. He was extremely friendly, attentive, and helpful at all times – a real asset to the hotel. The breakfast is also very good by British standards.

The beds are incredibly comfortable, so we slept very well every night. Overall, we felt very comfortable here from the first to the last moment and can recommend the hotel without reservation. Many thanks to the entire team for the great hospitality!

author: Julien M
title: Top stay
text:
The Gate Apartment Hotel London is a fantastic accommodation in itself, beautiful, modern apartments, a perfect location in Aldgate, and a great atmosphere. But what really made our stay unforgettable was the human touch, and above all, Saikot.
I have rarely experienced such an incredibly friendly, accommodating, and warm-hearted person in service. Saikot meets guests with an honest smile that immediately creates a feel-good atmosphere. No matter what question or concern we had, he always took his time patiently and made us feel absolutely welcome. It is exactly these encounters with such radiant, friendly personalities that turn a good trip into an unforgettable one.
A huge thank you to Saikot for his fantastic manner and this great service with heart! We will definitely be back.

author: Antoine D
title: Excellent experience
text: Great service at the Gate! Staff are kind, attentive and helpful. Saikot went out of his way to make our stay comfortable and memorable!!

author: Evan G
title: Excellent Servife, will come again
text: The Service at the hotel was top notch - appreciated Soikot’s quick support on any request and Renata as well

author: James W
title: Hotel experience
text: Nice and comfortable stay...great n helpful staff

author: Paolo S
title: Wonderful stay
text: Had a wonderful time thanks to saikot he did a fantastic job and was so helpful throughout our stay  and we will definitely be coming back

author: Manon W
title: Hidden gem in central london
text: Great location. amazing rooms & proper cleanliness. Value for money friendly staff specially saikot always ready for help.

author: Jessica J
title: Disrespectful staff and hidden fees, not worth the money!!
text:
We stayed for 2 nights this week and decided never again!

We came here for the first time in 2021 and it was lovely, returning this year though we were met with a very different atmosphere. Staff were ridiculously rude, not even bothering to listen to us speak when we arrived earlier than check in time before interrupting telling us we must pay £40 to stay in the hotel before 2:30 or pay £15 for them to store our suitcase for 45 minutes. 

We then got given a room that looked like a prison cell, a massive room with two beds and a mirror, nothing else and definitely nothing like the pictures. After arguing with staff we eventually got moved to a better room that actually held some resemblance to what we expected, they only listened to what I had to say because I told them I had stayed there before and the room was not like that.

This hotel is ridiculously expensive for what it is and there are so many hidden fees such as £50 for an extra 2 hours in the room. The only plus of this hotel is the location but it still is not worth it, the room was clean but the soaps were almost entirely empty and the toilet was disgusting.

This was a lovely place to stay until they hired rude staff and became money grabbing instead of having any regard for guests comfort. especially at such a high initial price for a room with nothing in  we will definitely not return to this hotel again

author: Connor V
title: ZEDWELL PICADILLY CIRCUS
text: Very close to Piccadilly Circus and near underground, Zedwell is very well situated. rather confortable but not very cocooning. I would recommend the place if you are looking for a medium class hotel to sleep in and visit London.

author: Antoine K
title: Tranquil setting in a fantastic location
text: Great tranquil setting in the heart of piccadily circus. Helpful and friendly staff and comfortable double beds and no noise. Kids loved the cocoon 8 room set up

author: Ruby P
title: TERRIBLE- BED BUGS
text: DONT GO THERE I STAYED THERE WITH MY PARTNER FOR TWO NIGHTS AND WE SAW A BED BUG, we are both covered in BED BITES and we had to spend a lot of money to deal with it

author: Chloe Y
title: Trip to London
text: Very good located hotel near everything. With easy check-in and check-out. The only thing that has to improve it's the cleaning. The room was not vacuumed and the sink in the restroom was dirty.

author: Taylor G
title: Terrible.
text: It’s the worst hotel I’ve ever stayed in. We only needed it for one night but there wasn’t anywhere to hang your clothes. No drawers. Nowhere to put your toiletries on the sink. No front reception desk and staff who weren’t helpful at all. I asked for a couple of paper or plastic cups last night to drink some tap water and all he said was no and shrugged his shoulders. Won’t be going there again and I advise others not to. Thank goodness we’d only booked one night!!

author: Aiden N
title: Unacceptable hygiene standards and false service promises
text:
I stayed for a week with my family (3 people) at The Z Hotel Piccadilly from August 10 to August 16, 2026, and the experience was deeply disappointing.

Although the hotel policy states that room cleaning is performed on the fourth day, this was completely ignored. I complained on the 4th and at the front desk they kept putting us off day after day ("it will be done tomorrow, the 5th", then the 6th), but no one came to clean until the 7th, just as we were leaving.

We spent the whole week in unsanitary conditions: the floor was never swept or mopped, and the sink was dirty. The toilet was so neglected that I had to buy bleach out of my own pocket to clean it myself. When the staff entered the room, the only thing they did was straighten the sheets without performing a real cleaning.

To top it off, being 3 guests, they systematically only left 3 bath towels and a single hand towel, forcing us to go down to the front desk continuously to ask for basic towels. It seems like a deliberate strategy to save costs at the expense of deceiving the customer.

I would never return nor would I recommend this hotel to anyone, and even less to families. Terrible management and a total lack of respect towards customers.

author: Ana O
title: Bed Bugs
text:
I recently stayed at the Zewell Hotel in London. While its location is great, the bed bugs are not. My wife is covered in bites, I am covered in them, and my kids were at the doctor's for a routine appointment where the doctor agreed that the group's bites appear to be from bed bugs.

After doing a quick search, I saw that many of the hotel's rooms have reports of bed bugs. Some of the rooms had black boxes outside of them; I originally thought it might have been some kind of pressure test, but I can only assume now that they were fumigation devices. I wish I had read the reviews online about this before staying, as everyone was itchy and red once we arrived home.

I contacted the hotel, and they suggested there was no evidence of an infestation. They offered 25% off my next visit, but I cannot see myself staying there again. Before booking, I recommend doing a quick search or asking an AI about bed bugs at this location, as there are numerous reports regarding this issue.​ See pics and see my search.

author: Noah S
title: I will return.
text: We booked an 8-bed Cocoon room even though there were 5 of us. The room lacked a closet, a desk or any other type of surface except for about ten hooks on the wall. So suitcases on the floor (luckily we only had small backpacks/carry-on luggage). The bathroom was comfortable, especially a large shower. Cleaning and bed making is a paid service that we did not request. But the strong points of this hotel are two: you sleep wonderfully, with very comfortable mattresses and, after days out and about, it is a fundamental thing. The second, no less important, is the location. On foot or by bus you can get anywhere. You have Chinatown and Soho with Carnaby Street just a few steps away. Lots of places to eat and it is also close to the famous Oxford Street where shops for shopping abound. Obviously there is also the subway around the corner. London won me over, I will return and I will return again to the Zedwell because the quality/price ratio compared to the competition in the area is definitely good.

author: James K
title: Piece and quite
text: We stay here every time we come to London. It is a perfect hotel for our Autistic daughter.  You can't here the slightest bit of noise from the busy streets outside. Also perfect location I'm walking distance to Oxford street, Trafalgar Square.

author: Diego X
title: Horrific
text:
Very disappointing and distressing experience

Our recent stay at Zedwell Piccadilly Circus from the 9/08/2026 to 11/08/2026was an absolute nightmare and not at all what you would expect from a hotel.

During the night, we discovered bedbugs in our room(4107) and at approximately 4am we had to get our entire family of five out of the room. What followed was chaotic and extremely distressing. Instead of our family being kept together, we were separated and moved into three different rooms.

The condition of the replacement rooms was completely unacceptable. One room had an unmade bed and a pizza box apparently left behind by a previous guest, while another had large blood stains all over the duvet. After discovering bedbugs, being moved into rooms that appeared not to have been properly cleaned or checked was incredibly worrying.

The hotel was made aware of the situation, and we expected management to take the matter extremely seriously. Instead, we were left dealing with an extremely stressful situation in the early hours of the morning with our children, while also worrying about whether the bedbugs had got into our luggage and belongings.

Our bags were subsequently steamed by the hotel, which only added to our concern about the potential spread of the infestation.

This was not simply an inconvenience. We were forced out of our room at 4am, our family was split across three rooms, and we were then placed in rooms with serious cleanliness concerns.

We have now been advised to escalate the matter to Environmental Health, which we are doing. We are asking for the circumstances surrounding the suspected bedbug infestation to be properly investigated, including the hotel’s pest-control procedures and whether there have been previous issues at the property.

A hotel room should be clean, safe and properly prepared for guests. Based on our experience, we have serious concerns about the standards at this hotel.

We would not stay here again and would strongly advise other families to think very carefully before booking.

author: Pablo V
title: 5 stars
text:
Everything was great. The rooms were beautiful and comfortable, the staff was available, and the location was excellent.

We had an issue with the air conditioning not working, but they immediately moved us to another room.

The only thing that bothered me was that there was no toilet brush.

author: Morgan L
title: Perfect for a city break
text: Stayed there for 4 nights in early August and couldn't fault the hotel or our room, paid for one of the cocoon 8 rooms and with 2 adults and 3 kids there was plenty of room. Perfect location for access to the tube and within walking distance of plenty of attractions.  Will be back again

author: Brooke D
title: Nice, affordable, great location!
text: This hotel is stylish and minimalistic at the same time.  Self-check-in, but there are humans there to help you as well.  Don't expect traditional room service.  There's no front desk to call.  There is the ability to text the staff, but it seems that the texts are answered by AI and don't always appear to be checked by humans.  If you really want or need something, you'll have to go to the lobby an ask.  There is a nice cafe and exercise room in the building.  We stayed at the location on Great Windmill Street, in the heart of the theatre district.  It was a great location.  Close to Picadilly Underground and one of the main stops for the hop on-hop off busses.

author: Anna N
title: 5 star service!
text:
I had a wonderful stay at Zedwell Piccadilly Circus and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located hotel in the heart of London. The rooms were clean, modern, and provided a peaceful escape despite being just moments from the bustle of Piccadilly Circus.

What truly made my stay exceptional was the outstanding hospitality from Wajiha, the Front Office Manager, and her fantastic team. They were incredibly welcoming, professional, and attentive throughout my stay, always going above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. Their genuine kindness and willingness to help made me feel valued as a guest and really elevated the entire experience.

Thank you to Wajiha and the whole front office team for making my stay so enjoyable. I look forward to returning and would happily recommend Zedwell Piccadilly Circus to friends, family, and anyone visiting London.

author: Noah V
title: Shoebox
text: The room is a small hole, without windows or ventilation. There is air conditioning, but it is quite stifling. For the price it has in high seasons, it could be better. You sleep very well, without noise, that's for sure!

author: Katie G
title: So disappointing and dirty rooms!
text: Really disappointing stay this time round (stayed 3x in the last couple years) we had to be moved rooms due to our first one smelling. The cleanliness was awful, really grubby rooms!

author: Megan L
title: No frills, dark and quiet
text:
Negatives: No frills room -  no closet, nightstand, dresser, or amenities other than towels, soap, body wash, and shampoo.  Early check-in or leaving bags at the lobby comes at a price.  
Positives:  The AC works, the room is completely dark and quiet at night.  Good location in the theater district.

author: Sofia Z
title: Super convenient with no frills
text: It’s super convenient for central London and quiet amongst all the hustle of a busy city. There are no frills: no windows, no TV and no kettle, but we don’t always this. It’s dark along the corridors and dark entering the rooms.

author: Amelia Y
title: Great Location and Quiet - Could Add A Little Bit Extra
text: Went as a family of 4.  Easy to check in and the reception area looked spacious and modern.  Our children loved the room itself.  It was generally clean although basin wasn't.  There was no window, so although it is disorientating, we slept really well.  The air-con was really strong, which we appreciated and the bed was comfortable.  It was generally quiet too.  I feel like the room could be designed a little different to accommodate a desk and a chair or a surface where we could put some of our belongings on, rather than the area at the end of the bed that we have to crawl to get at the bottom bunk.  Unfortunately there was no water, cups, tea or coffee in the room.  I believe we could venture downstairs to buy from vending machine, but we did not bothered as it was too much hassle to get dressed after our shower to get a hot drink.  It did feel expensive for the lack of amenities, but overall a good stay.  It is not somewhere we would like to spend more than one night though as apart from the bed, there is no comfort to the room.  The floor is tiled, so some kind of flip flops would be advised if you prefer softer flooring.  The bathroom door is a translucent sliding door, which can be noisy in the middle of the night for a bathroom trip plus it really didn't matter if the door was solid for more privacy as there were no natural daylight in the room.

author: Ryan U
title: Mama Mia
text: Hotel very well located, it is close to the entrance to the Vatican Museum, it is close to several restaurants, breakfast is included in the reservation, we stayed for 3 days, a pity that the Wi-Fi only reopened a day before we left, out of that the hotel is very good, a suggestion: exchange the beds for more modern beds!

author: Dylan F
title: Hotel disappointment
text:
The good thing is that it is well located, but we left unhappy, why?
Because we have been on a week-long trip at this same hotel, they have not changed our sheets all week, they have not cleaned the room floor at all, they have not cleaned anything in the bathroom, and one day they didn't even come in because they didn't even take the trash bag; the only good thing is that they changed our towels daily.

Dirty bathroom, dirty and very small shower; a person of normal build can shower but not comfortably, the shower head looked white from limescale, dampness on the ceiling.

The buffet is... it's like a cafeteria, with little variety but good; you can have a reasonably good breakfast.

Magnificent customer service from the people who control access to the hotel.

Failure of the card to enter the room; in one week I have had to go down 3 times to have the card reactivated because it kept deactivating on its own.

Regarding the cleaning... the room has a refrigerator, well, they didn't even clean it before we checked in, because when opening the refrigerator we saw a yellow dirt mark, we didn't know what it was, but after 3 days I wanted to open the freezer to put water in, and we found an ice cream and a bottle of water from the previous guests who were in that same room, added to the fact that the refrigerator also had its dirty shelf.

Regarding the beds and bedding... they had dirt stains, the pillow was unbearable.

I consider that it really has more of a one-to-two-star hotel condition, in my opinion.

In other words, an experience not to be repeated; the only good thing this hotel has, in our opinion, is the location, which is 5 minutes from the Vatican and another 5 from the Ottaviano station, from which you can get to Roma Termini and from there take any train or bus if necessary.

To finish, we understand that sheets cannot be changed daily, or a deep cleaning done daily, we understand that, but changing the sheets every 3-4 days (once a week… we are not asking for much), we also understand that they do not sweep every day, but every two days, cleaning the mirror… I do not want it cleaned every day, but every two or three days would be fine; that is to say, we are not people who are always looking for dirt, but it is true that we had to complain since many parts of the room were truly disgusting. 

I hope this review serves to improve everything so that future guests can enjoy it 100%.

author: Taylor O
title: Amazing
text: I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The accommodations were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making my visit very relaxing. The staff was friendly, professional, and always willing to help with anything I needed.

author: Dylan W
title: Great hotel and amazing staff.
text: Lovely clean hotel with fantastic and helpful staff. Nothing was too much trouble for them, they went above and beyond to help us. The rooms were cool and spacious, (the air con was a blessing), and the rooms were cleaned meticulously. This hotel is perfectly placed for eating out and exploring the city, easy walk to the tube station, and Lime bikes were always available close by for early morning city bike rides.

author: Ella Z
title: End-of-year trip
text: Bad hotel for an end-of-year trip; on the second night they blocked the doors of the rooms, and the children had to sleep outside the room, relocating to other rooms and sleeping on the floor. If they are not prepared to accommodate 16-year-old teenagers, they should cater to a different type of clientele.

author: Mia B
title: Delicious
text: Nice staff who explained us where the best restaurants were nearby. Great location. Central to visit all the highlights of Rome. The hotel has been refurbished but not quite ready. Completely met our expectations

author: Olivia T
title: Evaluation
text: Horrible, cold water, missing light, reasonable care.

author: Julien T
title: The hotel claims to offer gluten-free options, which is completely false.
text: The hotel is centrally located, which is its most positive aspect. My daughter has been on a school trip for a few days; she is celiac, and the agency informed us that they were aware of her condition... However, the reality is that during the three days of our stay, they only provided her with bread, nothing else. In countless places in Rome, she was able to eat pasta, pizza, cold cuts, ice cream, in other words, everything. And these gentlemen/lady at the hotel only have bread for one intolerant person, which is very poor service.

author: Daniel E
title: Rome is amazing!
text: Hotel very well located, with easy access to the airport and Termini station, in addition to being close to the Vatican, the Otaviano metro station and an excellent shopping area with many shops, bars and restaurants. Very good hotel, always clean and organized, with good breakfast and excellent staff service, with a highlight for receptionist Elena, very friendly.

author: Anna D
title: A good trip
text:
Great location. Enjoyed being on this side of Rome. Lovely in the evening. Good restaurants and bars nearby - great atmosphere. 
The hotel is fairly basic but clean. The staff at reception were very polite, cheerful and helpful. Breakfast was adequate. There was nothing to complain about. It did the job.

author: Jack J
title: Noise, no hot water or electricity, no bar, no mini bar, no 24 hour reception
text:
This hotel was selected for a number of reasons. Firstly its location then facilities and finally price.
It is situated on the west side of the Tiber, close to the Vatican, but also a short distance from a bridge across the river. You can easily walk into the main centre and find tourist attractions like the Piazza Navona, Pantheon and Trevi fountain.
If you want to get to, for example, the Colosseum or Forum then the Metro is close by and taxis are not too expensive if there are four in your group (like us). I’d suggest using the Freeform app to book one not Uber.
In the immediate area there are plenty of cafes, restaurants (not too touristy) and little bars. The shops are many and varied if that’s what you want.
Now the interesting part, the hotel. It is not very big and has a 24 hour reception although the one time we needed to contact reception from our room outside of normal hours they never answered the phone! When I went down to see what was the problem  the receptionist was sat reading her phone. I asked her if the phone was working and she looked sheepish and checked it. It was apparently! Forget room service because they obviously don’t have any. You can’t even get a bottle of water from them.
It is advertised as having a bar and also mini bars in the rooms. It has neither. The bar is an empty space in a room near reception and the rooms only have a tiny fridge.
Other issues we and people in our group experienced included:
Room keys continually failing to open the door. This was so bad we asked them to reprogram it every time we walked in to avoid having to come downstairs.
No hot water for showers on so many occasions that I got the manager to move us to another room. Listening in on conversations I conclude this is a widespread problem.
The final straw was when they said the electricity would be switched off from 10pm to 6am! No heating, lighting or lifts. When I said this wasn’t safe in the event of fire (did the fire alarm system work? They said “we think so” lol). We came back early to avoid this potential disaster and get up the five floors in the lift only to discover the power went off 1:30am them came in at 4:30am then off again and only came on properly at 5:30am. We were woken up by this so got a very bad sleep. This was quite literally a disaster waiting to happen and should be reported to the authorities.
A number of other annoyances need to be considered before you book. The hotel is close to a busy road  with cars 24 hours a day and also suffers from very noisy people going home from the bars in the area. Even on the fourth floor (the room we were moved to) it kept us awake most of the night. We bought ear plugs in the end!
The hotel also has large groups of schoolchildren using it with the inevitable noise at night.
The rooms themselves are very dated and lacking in furniture. The curtains were hanging off the rails and the metal blinds could not be raised or lowered. The room was reasonably clean but the bathroom had mould in the corners near the shower and stains in the toilet bowl.
One good point is the breakfast but I’m afraid I will avoid this hotel like the plague for the above reasons.
Continually being told by the staff “it isn’t our problem it’s out of our control” isn’t good enough.

author: Ana G
title: Not a 4 star hotel.  Disappointing.
text:
No way is this a 4 star hotel. It's a 3 if I'm being generous!  The rooms are basic. Our room had the curtains half hanging off the rail. Room was clean enough and the towels changed daily.  The beds were hard and the pillows , of which we only got 1 each ,weren't much better. The bar that is advertised on the booking sites , wasn't open at all during our entire stay. No irons available at the hotel. Rooms are very noisy with street traffic until around midnight.  
On the plus side it was a nice location. 5 minutes walk to the Vatican.  5 minutes walk to the metro system,  which puts you within easy access anywhere in the city. Lots of nice restaurants  and a couple of nice bars nearby.

author: Alexander I
title: Some good points....some bad points
text:
Let's start with the good - good location and friendly knowledgeable staff. Unfortunately that's all I can say about the good.

Bad points - tired, dated, noisy hotel (absolutely no sound proofing) with a basic continental breakfast. 
We had a standard double which was very small and consisted of what I can only describe as camp beds with very hard thin mattresses.  The bathroom was small and had an odd smell.  There are no toiletries or coffee making facilities.  On our first night we had a group of school children screaming,  running,  banging on doors in our corridor.  Eventually by 2am we couldn't take anymore and told them to be quiet and go back to their rooms. We went down to reception to complain....of course no-one was there,  however the teachers responsible for these children were having a lovely time down there, even though they could quite clearly hear the children running wild.  They very quickly went to sort them out! The next morning we complained to the staff and they immediately changed our room and gave us a bottle of wine as an apology.  Our next room was much better but once again basic and the smell from the bathroom was worse than the room before. The hotel building is a lovely old building which is slowly being modernised, however the decoration does look a bit shabby in places.  If and when done properly I'm sure this hotel would be stunning. Whilst we appreciate this hotel is in a good location in a world famous capital city the room rate they charge, for the standard they provide, is pretty extortionate. 
Breakfast was once again basic,  coffee and juices weak....but croissants fresh and tasty.
We're not ones to normally complain but on this occasion we felt we needed to say something and thankfully the helpful staff did sort out our problem. They now just need to enhance their service, standards and facilities to reflect the price they charge and it would be a lovely hotel.

author: Katie W
title: Bof
text:
Where do these 4 stars come from? 
We spent 5 days in this hotel and our room was cleaned only ONCE. We ended up asking for a broom to clean ourselves but apparently there was none. 
Let’s not talk about the humidity in the bedroom and the mold on the bathroom window.
Our laundry did not dry, forcing us to dry it in the hair dryer, just as our bath towels remained soaked even 24 hours after forcing us to ask for the change at the reception, the maid not having passed. 
Finally, what a pleasure to be woken up every morning at 7am by the deafening, drill-like sound of the vacuum cleaner! It is curious to hear this noise when you know that the cleaning was almost not done all the time in our room. 
We would have liked a little gesture from the hotel, for example on the tourist tax which was still 120€!!!

author: Erin S
title: Mediocre hotel is not a 4 star
text:
Structure that, despite the high-sounding name, is affected by the years whose rooms (room 318) have recently been partially and summarily renovated (probably the last real renovation dates back to the 80s), the interior furnishings are old and date back to past years but have been partially painted and good (mode to my cousin). Good Wi-Fi.
Bad soundproofing rooms (bring caps if you want to sleep).
Mattresses ok
Mediocre breakfast

Plus: proximity to St. Peter's Square 15 minutes walk.

In summary I do not think it is absolutely a 4-star property but a 3-star (with a lot of goodwill.
Grand Hotel less than ever.
Staff reception and breakfasts 
Friendly and helpful.

author: Maria Y
title: Worst hotel in the world
text: It was the worst hotel I've ever stayed in my whole life. Poorly trained employees, without education and without the slightest condition to work in a hotel, even more one that says 4 stars. The bathroom was rubbish, the toilet lid was loose, there was no box or curtain, it was dirty and there were cockroaches. When we arrived, the sheets had not been changed, were dirty, with clear signs that they had been worn by previous guests. The bed was bad, blankets and pillows were missing, the furniture was about 100 years old and the curtain was falling. When we talked about the problems they were not willing to do anything to help and did not exchange our room, that the hotel was just that. Unfortunately, I couldn't take a picture of everything.

author: Ruby X
title: NEGATIVE EXPERIENCE
text: I have been going to this hotel for many years.I have always been quite satisfied. Instead this time 'was a drama (missing the Director and you've seen...) room small dark TV that you could not see the RAI channels despite intervened maintainer, bathroom with broken doughnut, shower with water that came little and almost always cold dirty duvet ..   A receptionist who wouldn't even answer her phone. I'll stop here.

author: Taylor H

author: Lily U

author: Mathis A

author: Sean F

author: Amelia I
title: The best hotel for our first family trip to Rome
text: We were so happy that we booked with NH Collection Roma Centro for our family’s pre-cruise stay.  Michele was invaluable in assisting to organize our transport from the airport to hotel and hotel to cruise port.  He was always available to address any needs or concerns.  The hotel is beautiful, in a wonderful location with excellent service and staff!  The rooms are spacious, well-appointed and suited our family’s needs.  The breakfast buffet is second to none!  Both our 9 year old daughter and grandmother with mobility issues were comfortable and enjoyed the hotel immensely.   We would definitely stay there on our next trip to Rome!

author: Diego P
title: Good family experience
text: Good experience, the buffet is quite good and with variety. Very good temperature

author: Andrea B
title: Wonderful Experience at This Hotel
text: We came from Greece and had a wonderful stay at this hotel. Everything was clean, comfortable, and well organized. A special thank you to the man at the front desk. He was incredibly kind, welcoming, and always willing to help with a smile.  His professionalism and friendly attitude made our stay even more enjoyable. He made us feel truly welcome from the moment we arrived. We truly appreciated his excellent service and would be happy to stay here again. Highly recommended.

author: Benjamin N
title: Highly Recommended for a Peaceful Stay
text: It was clean and  silent, respectful stuff

author: Rosie L
title: An excellent stay 👌
text: The hotel is excellent, the neighborhood where it is located is quiet and very accessible to the main tourist sites, they offer a very varied and delicious breakfast, the staff's service is excellent and the rooms are comfortable and suitable for the full week we stayed. Cleanliness 10 points! It is to be recommended, without a doubt.

author: Ryan I
title: Experience at NH Collection
text:
I had a very enjoyable stay at NH Collection Roma Centro and would happily recommend it to anyone visiting Rome.

Establishment: The hotel is modern, elegant, and exceptionally well located, making it easy to explore the city's main attractions. The common areas are inviting, well designed, and create a welcoming atmosphere from the moment you arrive.

Maintenance: The property is very well maintained, with clean, comfortable, and well-kept facilities throughout. Everything was in excellent condition, reflecting the hotel's high standards.

Bathroom: The bathroom was spotless, modern, and well equipped with quality amenities. It was spacious, comfortable, and added to the overall pleasant experience of the room.

Service Experience: The highlight of my stay was the outstanding service. The staff were warm, professional, and always willing to help with any request. Their attention to detail and genuine hospitality made me feel welcome throughout my visit.

Overall, NH Collection Roma Centro exceeded my expectations. Its excellent location, well-maintained facilities, comfortable rooms, and exceptional service made for a wonderful stay. I would definitely choose this hotel again on my next trip to Rome.

author: Ella C
title: Attentive and courteous concierge
text:
The hotel’s concierge, Michele, was extremely helpful in resolving my problem posting a letter. I had been to a post office and two other shops (which were supposed to sell stamps, but didn’t). I spoke to Michele and explained this and he said he would handle it. He personally found a post office, paid the postage and sent it. He then took a photo of the letter as a receipt and gave me change from the money I’d given him for this purpose. 
Michele went above my expectations in assisting me in this task!  Thank you for your kindness and professionalism.

author: Jessica M
title: 24 hours in Rome
text: Lovely hotel! Staff is wonderful

author: Brooke J
title: Tiny bathroom with Moldy shower and Poor Service
text:
Our stay began with a frustrating check-in experience. We arrived about 90 minutes before check-in and were told by Giuseppe that our room was not ready. He asked us to wait in the lobby bar and said someone would let us know when it became available.

After waiting until nearly an hour past the scheduled check-in time, we returned to the front desk. The staff seemed surprised because our room had apparently been ready for some time, but no one contacted us.

The room was also not the Junior Suite we expected based on the booking and the hotel’s website. It was much smaller and had a tiny desk placed in the hallway. When we raised the issue, the front desk claimed the hotel had two types of Junior Suites. We later reviewed the hotel’s website and found nothing supporting this explanation.

The bathroom was extremely small and had no counter space for toiletries or personal items. There was also visible mold on the shower ceiling, and the shower leaked water across the bathroom floor. We reported these issues but were told the hotel was fully booked and no other rooms were available. Giuseppe was rude, dismissive, and offered little help.

The location was also inconvenient for visiting many of Rome’s major attractions, including the Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, and other popular tourist areas. We often needed taxis to get around, and the fares added up quickly.

The hotel may look appealing online, but the poor service, room condition, misleading room description, and inconvenient location made this a very disappointing stay. The experience created a terrible start to our vacation, and we would not stay here again.

author: Megan R
title: Rome doesn't deserve a hotel as bad as this
text:
The box barely gives a person to take a shower, The shower doesn't work, The bar fridge doesn't open and doesn't freeze, I ask the staff for assistance, Horrible breakfast, You're charged €10 to use the pool.
Air conditioning does not work and does not freeze.
We had to change apartments because of the air conditioning and we were placed in another room that also does not work. Responsible for the maintenance said that the minimum air temperature is 24° which means we have to stay in a muggy, warm closed room. I took pictures to approve of everything I'm saying. The shower doesn't get stuck. The room is minimal we can barely get to the window. It has an elevator for four people and numerous apartments.

author: Michael I
title: DONT Come This Hotel
text:
Our stay at this hotel was a complete disappointment. The quality of service was extremely poor. There was not even a coffee machine in the room, although this is now considered a basic facility in many hotels.
The breakfast was very poor in both quality and variety. What was even more disturbing was that, as Turkish guests, we were directed to a separate seating area during breakfast. This made us feel discriminated against and was completely unacceptable. All guests should be treated equally, regardless of their nationality.
In addition, while we were leaving the hotel by bus, a theft occurred in the hotel’s garden area. This raised serious concerns about the adequacy of the hotel’s security measures.
In summary, the breakfast quality was terrible, the service was practically nonexistent, security was inadequate, and the attitude toward guests was deeply uncomfortable. We were extremely dissatisfied with our experience at Belstay Roma Aurelia. I definitely do not recommend this hotel.

author: Owen K
title: Terrible youth hostel
text:
Hotel rated 4 stars on paper… two were given, rather bought. 
Hotel at the limits of decency; I would define it at most as a hostel. Outdated, terrible cleanliness, horrible carpet everywhere with huge stains, bad smell both in the elevators and in the areas. 
Overrun by hordes of screaming kids day and night, staying there for sports reasons. The room was not clean; upon arrival, there was a malfunction in the bathroom, the products were never renewed, a disaster. I refrain from commenting on the food because I would become vulgar. The location is terrible, far from any possible communication with civilization. I am attaching funny photos, especially the last one...

author: Brooke U
title: Conference. Medical.
text: I worked at a meeting, I found Massimo the technician, very kind and well-prepared; the food was excellent and the room was very comfortable. I recommend it.

author: Sydney N
title: Nice but decentralized.
text:
The hotel is very decentralized, although there is a free shuttle available twice in the morning and other times in the afternoon to the nearest metro station.
Very large and modern hotel.
Good breakfast, spacious rooms, and bathroom.
Excellent check-in and check-out service.
Unfortunately, the in-house restaurant is not of the same quality, and it is a shame because there are no nearby restaurants as an alternative.

author: Ian Y
title: Very good.
text:
A hotel for tours or conventions, very far from the center of Rome, like any other starting tour hotel.
With an app taxi, FreeNow, it costs 26 euros to get to the center; otherwise, the hotel has a free shuttle for 8 people. The shuttles usually leave at two times in the morning.
8:30 AM and 9:30 AM to the metro station, costing approximately 16 euros for the taxi... Ballestini station, and from there, the metro to the center for 1.5 euros, you will be there in a maximum of 35 minutes.
the Vatican much closer in 20 minutes, two or three metro stations
the staff is excellent.. everyone is very, very friendly and willing to help, I have read bad comments about the hotel, especially about the rooms... I am demanding. But experiences must be lived for oneself, in our case everything was excellent.
rooms, one must know that since they are group tours from operators, and there is a constant turnover of passengers, I estimate they may be more worn out. It is advisable to pay the difference and go for superior rooms that are new for a small difference in euros, this is a point where many passengers make a mistake, one should not save on the budget here... the cost-benefit ratio of standard to superior rooms is enormous and the money is very little
restaurants.. about 200 meters away.. several cheap and good restaurants like Old Wild West, McDonald's, large supermarket, etc.
regarding breakfast, it is a point to improve in the specific case of tourist groups, but it is understood that due to the cost the relationship is fine, keep in mind that through Europamundo or another operator, the hotel is paid much less when taking a tour, it has 3 breakfasts practically one for conventions, another for individual passengers that is more complete, and the tour style Europamundo, etc.
if one wants a hotel closer, better breakfast, etc., they must pay for it, they must book a 5-star hotel and have this service, one must put into context how much they paid for the hotel... but many people forget this when traveling
thanks to all the hotel staff especially to the
Ms. Ilaria from the front desk.... 100 points!!!!!!!!!!!!
the area of the hotel is quiet and not dangerous

author: Charlotte A
title: Average at best
text:
Average at best.  

Just come back and the overall feel of the hotel is clean and welcoming, we knew it was more of a business hotel rather than traditional tourist hotel but we just wanted a bit of a base and to use the facilities 

Pros: 

Room clean 
Toiletries in the room 
Room service every day 
Bar open late 

Cons:

No iron in room or even behind the reception desk. No ironing facilities at all. 
Pool closed. Despite it being May and very hot no loungers or any way to relax outside 
Breakfast cold every day and limited options 

Further to the train station that you think, about 20 mins walk but that’s my fault for not realising however it is only one euro into Rome centre

If you’re a tourist looking to go into Rome, I’d stay somewhere else as the poor breakfast and lack of facilities isn’t ideal 

If you’re there on business for the night, no issues but take an iron!

author: Mia N
title: Gluten free breakfast to forget
text:
The stay was pleasant: clean rooms, comfortable mattress and pillows (although the third bed of the triple bed is small...), large breakfast area, courteous staff... BUT the gluten free breakfast, which I had been assured several times during telephone contacts, was very scarce (only one type of snack packaged and a vacuum sandwich). So, while my friends enjoyed a wide and rich choice of fresh produce, the celiac girl who was with us and I had almost nothing to have breakfast with. When we pointed out the criticality, we were answered that these are the provisions of the Belstay chain throughout Italy regarding gluten free breakfast. The solution? Don't pay the breakfast fee and do it elsewhere. 
Honestly, I had never experienced such treatment in a 4-star hotel.

author: Katie Q
title: Disappointing
text:
We visited the hotel for two nights. 
While the rooms at first looked clear in the bathroom in the sink there was mold inside the tap and where the toilet paper was placed was dirty. The next problem was the breakfast of the hotel which while in part it was delicious was divided into two rooms. In the first there was a great variety of food while in the second, they sent us, there were very few options and even the yogurt and milk you had to put it in a paper cup and eat it with a wooden teaspoon something that in the other room was not done. If something similar happened in Greece the hotel not four stars would have been closed!!!

author: Dylan I
title: An event in the hotel
text: Massimk super helpful and cute, I fstto an event there and it went great

author: Sydney G
title: Restaurant Review and Intolerance Management
text: I stayed from Monday to Wednesday with breakfast and dinner included despite reporting my lactose intolerance, neither breakfast nor dinner was prepared for me. The first dinner on Monday I ate pasta in white. At breakfast on Tuesday I was told that the packed snacks were finished, so I waited for the second breakfast on Wednesday and this morning they had nothing, in fact they offered me gluten-free biscuits containing milk and butter. In 2026 managing in this way a “trivial” and common lactose intolerance is crazy.

author: Jack H
title: Overnight stay for work
text:
I was a guest at this hotel for business reasons.
Dinner, bed and breakfast.
The dinner (according to other colleagues present) a disaster. The service leaves much to be desired, not to mention the portions of pasta ... not even in the hospital.
They made up for it though with the breakfast buffet.
Full of savory and sweet.... many types of drinks (also cappuccino and espresso service) as well as cakes and croissants of all kinds.
The rooms are very comfortable, equipped with minibar and large bathroom with shower and hairdryer. Air conditioning, TV and bed very very comfortable.
Overall a nice hotel. Located at the beginning of the Aurelia it has ample parking and also has a nice well-kept green.
Logistically great location because he wants to visit Rome and leave to go to the airport or the port of Civitavecchia or resume highways.
Overall I recommend it.

author: Sophia V
title: Service for FIS fencing event
text: Large structure with very kind staff. Great for conferences, ample parking for tourist buses. Recommended

author: Paige Z
title: Can't complain had a good experience
text:
I stayd two nights last week, price for value is honest , the standards are up to a four star. cleanlessness 5 stars.

Staff is helpfull and plesant especially an handsome and well mannered gentlmen named Ermes , who was there during night and early morning hours ,  and was always available in taking care of my enquiries

Would reccomend this hotel

author: Grace U
title: Avoid if English
text: Some staff were lovely however 2 poor interactions with hotel bar and restaurant left a poor taste. Insulted me in Italian, I’m English but I know Italian phrases. Super rude when asked for drink and payed 10 euros for drink that was made completely wrong and when asked to be remade was made wrong again. Not sure how you can be a bartender in Italy and not know how to make an aperol spritz. Women with dark hair was so rude and confrontational with guests even some italian guests i saw were treated poorly.

author: Liam W
title: It's very good 👍🏻
text: Our travel agency stayed here 1 night, we got a big room , clean, modern and with good view ; you have to keep in mind that it is far from the center of Rome, however it is a comfortable and cute hotel 🙌🏻

author: Morgan Q
title: Not a good hotel.....
text: As hotels go, it's pretty awful. The room was just about ok, but overall, it's bad. As for the pictures posted here on trip advisor, must be a different hotel! It's not even close to that nice!

author: Poppy M
title: First experience when check in is not comfortable
text:
I just check in with my group, and for me & my son room in the same floor but the posision is in the end of he floor. It’s too far from lobby/lift. It’s scarry .

I try to change to reception, handle by Simon. For the first time, he said can not change because already go inside the room and no more housekeeping to clean the room again. But i already told not use the room . He gave another reasons no more room available, but when i check from booking.com still have 5 rooms available. 

Finally after fighting to change the rooms he gave another level . So i can not in the same floor with my grand son. 

Room is average, but not near in one family is not a good .

Wifi not working well, i can not conect wuth hotel wifi, not only me but most of our group member (28 pax in total) can not conect with hotel wifi
😭😭

author: Hannah X
title: Enjoyable stay
text: Good hotel quality price clean comfortable room. Excellent location outside the center but not far from the Vatican .Unique flaw in breakfast but not for the quantity and quality of the products offered but for the staff in sala.I refer to Mrs. S. not up to her role, as well as being arrogant and rude.We reported to the management that fortunately took up our complaints apologizing for her!

author: Julien Y
title: Bad choice
text: Terrible hotel, very far from rome, there is nothing around. The personell is very rude during the breakfast. Too much people at the same time for breakfast and there is not enough space. It does not smell well in the corridors. They knock your door the day of check out at 9,30 with someone saying that we need to leave the room!

author: Aiden T
title: Perfect
text:
Spacious, comfortable, very clean rooms, bathtub, fridge PERFECT, tea and coffee provided every day along with housekeeping 
Heated, supervised pools and towels available! The breakfast is of varied quality and very good! The staff is very pleasant, attentive, and smiling! A 5-minute walk from the Muratella station which takes you into Rome (48h pass €15/adult)

author: Connor G
title: Exceptional stay with just a few small details to smooth out.
text:
We had a truly very pleasant stay at this hotel, a very comfortable property equipped with excellent services.
 The interior spaces are large and bright, and the private car parking is a big plus in terms of convenience. The pool is well-maintained, clean, and perfect for relaxation.
 Dining: The absolute strong point! We both had lunch and dinner at the restaurant, enjoying truly excellent and well-prepared dishes. The breakfast is simply amazing: a rich buffet with a huge selection of both sweet and savory options.
 Rooms, spacious and livable, even if you can tell from the decor that they are a bit dated. Overall, however, they are clean and functional.
 Staff: Overall, we found the staff to be kind and helpful. The only sour note concerns the restaurant dining room manager (the gentleman in the black suit): a little more politeness wouldn't hurt, especially when interacting with customers. First of all, you greet people, and only then do you ask if you can be of help.
Overall, it is an excellent property where I would gladly return. A touch more courtesy in the dining room and a restyling of the rooms would be enough to reach perfection.

author: Lucia O
title: Perfect Last Day Hotel in Rome
text: This is a North American style hotel. Rooms are large with excellent air conditioning. Great amenities with a pool, fitness center, snack bar, and restaurant. Close to airport which makes it the perfect last day hotel in Rome.

author: James Y
title: Swimming caps required for everyone at the pool
text: Location is near the airport so it’s convenient for a one night stay for a flight home. We are here now (August 11, 2026) and apparently it is common in Italy for pools to require bathing caps- they do here. I get that it’s a rule, but I can’t make myself do it haha. Lifeguard said it’s a government rule  but interestingly enough the hotel I just left in Tuscany today did not require it and neither did our hotel in Sorrento a few days before that. I did some reading online and higher-end hotels and resorts often waive this rule for aesthetic reasons.  I don’t know many grown adults that will willingly don one of these awful things. So keep that in mind before you book!
