author: Michael W
title: Birthday
text: We celebrated the birthday of my dear friend Marco in a very beautiful location where everything was perfect.

author: Caleb F
title: Perfect location for an unforgettable birthday!
text:
On Saturday, August 1st, we celebrated my husband Marco's birthday at this splendid location and we could not have made a better choice! 
The pool area is well-maintained down to the smallest detail and the garden, full of plants, creates a magical atmosphere, along with the background music that accompanied us throughout the evening.
The food was simply excellent, with fresh ingredients and a truly refined presentation that delighted all the guests, and the miniature pastries along with the fruit cake concluded the excellent dinner.
The staff is the real extra edge. From the very first moment, I encountered great professionalism and constant attention to every need of the guests.
I highly recommend the Holiday Inn Parco dei Medici to anyone who wants to organize an elegant, impeccable, and unforgettable event or for a stay in Rome, as it is located just a few km from the center of Rome and Fiumicino airport.
We will definitely return with our family and friends to spend many more unforgettable moments.
Cinzia N.

author: Katie Z
title: Good
text:
I stayed at the Holiday Inn Rome Eur Parco dei Medici. The welcome was excellent: fast check-in, kind and professional staff.
The room is spacious, the bed is comfortable, and the common areas, like the lobby and the lounge bar, are modern and well-maintained.
The general cleanliness is good, however, the toilet in the room had obvious blackening/encrustations inside the bowl, a detail that in a 4-star property should not be overlooked because it gives a feeling of poor care, even if it could be stains due to limescale.
The restaurant offers a fairly varied menu and the prices are in line with those of a hotel in this category.
Overall the stay was positive, but greater attention to the details of cleaning and bathroom maintenance would make the experience decidedly better.

author: Chloe P
title: Pool is the only good thing
text:
I was staying at another hotel when the heat got too much and I needed a pool. So I booked a one night stay before we were heading home including shuttle transfer. 
The pool bar staff only wait on you if you make it clear you’ll be tipping. Drinks allowed in pool which I didn’t like. Drinks take ages to make and are expensive. The meals standard is poor. At dinner I requested bread and was brought a bag with bread and oil and vinegar but not given a plate. I asked for a bottle of water which never came. The next day I waited 45 minutes for my Caesar salad and another 20 minutes on top for french fries. 
Breakfast buffet was hard bacon and burnt potatoes. 
The next day even though I confirmed  my shuttle to airport it didn’t come, only when I went to check was I offered alternative transport. My daughter left her gold earrings  in the room after we left and credit where it’s due these were located and posted back to us (costing 90 euro) but we are glad they were returned. The pool is lovely it’s a shame about the food side of it.

author: Lucia Y
title: Poor quality food and unkempt surroundings
text:
Note, this is not the first time my family and I have stayed in a Holiday Inn hotel around the world. But it will be the first and LAST time we stay in the Holiday Inn in Fiumicino Rome.
The hotel is in a serious need of updating and deep clean. For example, the carpets in the corridors are full of stains. Disgusting. 
But the main reason for making a poor scoring  is the restaurant. The mornings of 27/06, 28/06 we had breakfast. A poor breakfast. The scrambled eggs were COLD, the other hot foods were COLD. My granddaughters had chosen bacon which were cold and therefore more greasy, so impossible for them to eat. In general unsatisfactory. Therefore as the situation was the same the following morning, they opted for cereals, not their first choice and therefore found it difficult to eat. Breakfast later in the centre of Rome went down really well.
This is a follow on from a complaint my son-in-law and myself made about an error made by one of the hosts about the children's menu for which they were obliged to give us a refund. The host on the first evening told us there was no children's menu, so we had to order from the main menu. In fact children under 13 eat free. 
The first day after our arrival, the bathroom was not properly cleaned and the coffee cups were left dirty.
Not a good promotion for The Holiday Inn group.
Below is how the Holiday Inn describes - 
Food and beverage
We’re committed to providing the outstanding service our guests expect with our buffets, room-service and catering services. ​

author: Lily D
title: Nice hotel, bittersweet experience and staff
text:
The hotel is lovely.  
The location is remote, if you are not eating at the hotel, you can’t find anywhere else nearby.
They opened the swimming pool earlier because of the heat wave, that was really helpful and made my stay way more pleasant.
The gym is poor, basic.
The staff is nice, but it was my birthday and there was nothing special done about it.
Breakfast was great, Joanna was a sweetheart, made it even better.

author: Marta U
title: Nice hotel though far from the old sites
text:
We prefer to keep the room tidy ourselves so we were not satisfied with the housekeeping supervisor who would not let us do a simple towel exchange in the hallway with the housekeeper and their cart. We had to go down to the manager at the front desk and have them request it while we sat around in our room waiting for the housekeeper to bring the towels to us in their time. 
Otherwise, we enjoyed the gym and especially the sauna which they turn on upon request. We had dinner at the restaurant and to our surprise, the grilled steak and vegetables was excellent as well as the service. Dessert was also good. We would recommend this place even though the shuttle service did not start early enough for us to utilize that service to the airport. It is there if your schedule works with theirs. The rooms were clean. The pool area is pretty and they have food/bar service during certain hours.

author: Juan Z
title: Not a four-star.
text:
Very commercial hotel, but the rooms do not meet the standards of a 4-star establishment, especially considering the price paid.
Rooms from the 80s poorly modernized. However, the bed was comfortable and the cleanliness was average. Good buffet breakfast.

author: Harper C
title: Not recommended for tourists: noisy rooms!
text:
The rooms look good, fine bathroom and shower too. The breakfast is rich and tasty. The pool was closed, but that looks nice, also with nice seats in sun and shade. The bar also looked nice and cozy. Number of staff speak good English, others (somewhat) less.

We slept on the 6th floor near the elevators. Really slept 3 nights incredibly badly. Continuous sounds of people getting in and out of the elevator and making noise. The rooms are also very noisy in terms of neighbors. 

On Tripadvisor, the hotel has been responding for years that they find this noise pollution very annoying, blah blah blah..... Their reviews are sweet. Always understanding and accommodating. But answers like that really mean something to me when you do something about it. The complaints about noise pollution date back years but nothing has changed or improved. 

Furthermore, I see varying reactions to the reviews, from people who thought it was excellent to people who didn't like it. I myself belong to the group that didn't like it at all, because sleep quality is of great importance to me. 

The hotel is really very far from the center, so if you are coming for a business trip then it is fine. If you are a tourist, I would 100% definitely recommend another hotel. Travelling by public transport really takes quite a while before you get to the centre. Taxis are also expensive in Rome. 

So if you still want to go to this hotel, ask for a room far away from the elevators or wear earplugs or take a sleeping tablet☺️.
Or maybe you'll get lucky and get a room that's quiet. And maybe I'm just a vinegar whiner who sleeps very light and is spoiled at home with a quiet bedroom....

author: Thomas H
title: We travelled to Rome for a birthday city break and stayed at Holiday Inn Rome Medici
text:
Rome Birthday City Break April 2026

We stayed at the Holiday Inn Rome Medici 

We had a lovely stay and staff were really friendly and nice a special mention to Enzo , Andrea and Iuri who are natural hospitality people providing a wonderful service.

I would also like to thank our housekeeper unfortunately I didn’t manage to get her name but she is of Asian origin and wears glasses as well as the housekeeping porter who was a very kind gentleman.

The hotel has a shuttle bus that can drop you off at piramide station and the bus driver again was very pleasant.

We are planning to return to Rome and will be hoping to use the hotel as our preferred place to stay.

Thank you once again

author: Dylan L
title: Early Flight, good rest
text:
We were so tired, we just arrived to sleep,  early flight next morning.
In general good location.

author: Diego P
title: Three days
text:
Great experience in this hotel widely used for Fiumicino airport and congresses, conventions etc etc 
Excellent facilities : gym and swimming pool ( seasonal ) 
Large and cozy rooms (the only defect is the carpet ) 
Adequate and daily cleaning 
Large and varied breakfast with friendly and helpful staff 
Average prices with payment hotel outdoor parking also for customers (unpleasant thing ) 
Anyway ok : it's worth

author: Michael B
title: Very good hotel, well located and connected
text:
The hotel is with the standard of Holiday  Inn band, with a very good staff, clean rooms, good service and comfortable beds. The bathroom is good, and is well connected to Muratella train startion, just 7 minutes walking, with this you can go to Piramida metro Station and connect to everywhere.
Ludovica was amazing doing the check in.
If you wan to be close to Rome and to the Airport this is a very good option. Free trips between Airport-Hotel (free shuttle service in one way) and 1.5 Eur (Feb 2026) to Rome.

The Muratella train stration doesn't have ticket machine, but you can buy it in the Hotel at 1.5 eur

author: Ian Z
title: Great Hotel Experience
text: This is my go-to place when leaving Rome or returning as it is so convenient to the airport. Clean, quiet, incredibly helpful staff, beautiful food & great hot water for the shower! They also offer a fantastic buffet breakfast as well as a shuttle to Fiumacino.

author: Zoe J
title: Noisy stay
text: Only stayed 2 nights but both nights noisy. Had a room in 1st floor and was woken both mornings at 5.30 with the preparation of breakfast. Walls are thin, can hear your neighbours switching the lights on and off. There is a lack of plugs also.

author: George C
title: Not perfect but staff are on top form
text:
The hotel is not perfect however the exceptional standard is superb customer service provided by Kristian elevates this review to five stars. In every aspect Kristian excelled at helping with queries and offering solutions to a somewhat challenging problem I had. 
The room was large, clean with a large comfortable bed and daily housekeeping. The walls aren’t the best as you can frequently hear other rooms and the corridor. There are also no electrical sockets anywhere near the bed. 
The hotel is located fairly close to the airport which is served by a regular train  or shuttle or taxi direct from the hotel. The train also offers speedy trips into the centre of Rome and is less than a ten minute walk from the hotel. There is also a bus which takes far longer but drops you off right outside the hotel. There are taxis queueing outside the hotel for those who would rather travel privately. 
All in all, a very good experience!!

author: Katie D
title: Great accommodation
text:
Great room. Comfortable bed and pillows. Air conditioning worked super well! 
Great bathroom, with towel heater and a super powerful shower.
Full fridge bar. 
Breakfast without much variety, but what was there was delicious. 
Very good location!
Definitely a great choice to spend time in Rome, would choose again.

author: Molly O
title: Third visit
text: Great location sadly building has lost its character since the renovation. Aircondtioning works well staff helpful

author: Jack Z
title: Great boutique hotel, walk to attractions
text: Very nice hotel, attentive staff and very close to many must do attractions. Breakfast was aLeo very good with many options and the staff was very nice. About a 5 minute walk you can reach Trevi fountains and the pantheon, but they are in opposite directions. The area around the colosseum is about a 15 minute walk as well. Our room was a little small, bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was large. There are all numerous restaurants, cafe’s and gelato places a short walk away. The area is also very safe to walk about.

author: Lauren L
title: Excellent Place to Stay!
text:
Hotel Regno was perfect for our 3 night visit in Rome. We were able to walk to everything we wanted to see ( Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon). As well, breakfast was wonderful, with many options and friendly service. The hotel was also close to many great little restaurants and McDonald’s for our very picky teenager. 

The room was spacious and the small bed was the perfect size for our teenager. We also enjoyed the free snacks and beverages in the fridge. The staff were very pleasant and helpful. The only downside was the accessible shower in our room as it was hard to keep the water inside. 

We would definitely book Hotel Regno for future visits and we highly recommend it to others who want to be close to many of the main attractions.

author: Alexander E
title: Excellent stay
text:
Very pleasant stay. The location of the hotel is strategic, and the rooms are very nice, with Lake furniture really nice.
Among other things, they gave us the upgrade of the room we had booked.
A special mention for Iresh, who welcomed us with great warmth, competence and professionalism.

author: Brooke T
title: Fine 3 star city hotel in a prime location
text:
Perfect location centrally in the city center. Within walking distance of many attractions. Breakfast in the house neat. 6. Stock Roof Bar Tuesday to Saturday. Room renovated. Suite large; new bathroom. Windows largely take away the outside noise. Street very busy. Staff friendly.
Bed very good.
Minibar (first filling incl.) in the room. TV, AC + WLAN

author: Owen U
title: Superb comfort and service
text: Friendly helpful staff (especially Paolo!). Very comfortable room with all amenities and private balcony. Wonderful shower with massive bath and great water pressure. Breakfast was fabulous as was outdoor bar each night (included 2 welcome drinks).

author: Camille S
title: The complete package. Location and comfort.
text:
Location is perfect less than 10 mins to major attractions such as Trevi Fountain,  Spanish steps, and 20-minute walk to the Colosseum. Nearby restaurants and cafes were great. The hotel was very clean. The beds were very comfortable. Breakfast was good and there is a roof top bar. The staff were very helpful and friendly.  Any issues were dealt with promptly. 
We would stay here again.

author: Hannah K
title: Great Potential
text:
It has a lot of potential because it's in excellent condition in a prime location.  But they need to make a couple changes.

First, when I checked in the guy made a Xerox copy of my credit card.  I called Cap One about it and they told me to replace my card.  What a pain.

Second. The hotel had a strong chemical odor.  I think it was oil based paint.  We kept the windows wide open all night and hardly slept.  The desk said the smell was coming from a neighbor and the hotel made complaints about it.  We had paid for 2 nights but decided to move to an airport hotel the second evening.  It made our trip home easier but I wouldn't have douple booked if I could get a good night's sleep.

Otherwise, the bed is good, the room is quiet, the shower was perfect, and you can't beat the location.  Easy walk to most attractions.

We were here the second week of May, 2025.

author: George Y
title: DON’T STAY AT THIS HOTEL !!
text:
DON’T STAY HERE!!  OTHER HOTELS NICER AND BETTER PRICED IN AREA Website Video is a sham, hotel 2 star
Room small and tacky colour (photo)
Shower base slippery (dangerous)
No room at side to get out of bed, and
as curtains spread onto floor, you have to step on curtain to get out of bed. (dangerous) (see photo) 
MANY NICE HOTELS IN THE SAME LOCATION, AT NEARLY HALF COST. 
DON’T STAY AT THIS HOTEL!!

author: Zoe D
title: Lovely central hotel
text: A lovely hotel right in the middle of everything. The Trevi Fountain, Spanish Steps, Pantheon and Colosseum are all within 30mins walking distance. The Vatican and Trastevere about 40mins. The hotel was clean, staff very friendly.  The bed was firm and comfy and we had a waterfall shower. It would have been nice if the cleaners actually swept the bedroom floor - that’s my only grumble.  The breakfast room is small, but we always managed to get a table. Breakfast consisted of croissants, toast, scrambled eggs, bacon, cake, cheese, salami, salad etc.  The roof terrace was open during breakfast but permanently closed for evening drinks.  The receptionists can arrange taxis and dinner reservations for you.  Lovely hotel and would recommend and would definitely stay there again.

author: Isabella J
title: Great hotel in good location
text:
Beautiful rooms and newly renovated with taste, very
Also appreciated the first free minibar ride. 
Friendly professional and competent staff.
Congratulations to Paul and Simon.
To review a little the
Breakfast, quite varied, but there should be a greater caries of croissants. 
Very good even the breakfast girls. To return

author: Camille D
title: Great great great
text:
For a 3 star hotel it is ahead of many other hotels that have 4! Great property right on Via del Corso, central area! We took a very spacious triple, very quiet, inside the bathroom an excellent courtesy line, soap, shampoo, shower gel, make-up remover wipes, hair cap and much more. Also excellent cleaning of the room and the structure in general. Gorgeous for the courtesy and kindness of all the staff, very good Simone at reception! 
The only peccq, the ‘Italian’ breakfast leaves something to be desired but we are sure they will remedy this too. 
Thank you for everything we hope to see you soon

author: Benjamin J
title: Very good
text: A cute boutique hotel with a nice view of the street from the rooms. A bit on the small side but it does give a lovely genuine Italian room feel. Breakfast was quite good The hotel is situated in walking distance of all the attractions. A very good experience overall.

author: Lea N
title: Hidden treasure
text: Superbly located in the heart of the city within east walking distance to all of the main attractions. Rome is busy in October so check out the other sites which are considered not so popular. The hotel room is clean and modern. Bathroom is spacious with great water pressure. Breakfast is fruit pastries eggs toast. The opportunity to sit on the roof is also fun. Rooms have double glazed windows so no street noise but open the little balcony doors and capture the essence of Rome.

author: Luca J
title: A little gem in the best location!
text: We loved this hotel …. It was well priced and an incredible location steps away from the Trevi Fountain .   The bed was comfortable and the room had a couch which was nice….. breakfast was simple but everything was very  good .   Loved the ginger pieces ……and the coffee machine …..breakfast was on the rooftop which offered pleasant views .  There is 6 floors and an elevator . Staff very friendly and helpful!   Highly recommended especially for a short stay as most of the highlights are close by and walkable.

author: Juan D
title: Wonderful hotel!
text: Lovely clean rooms.  We stayed on the 6th floor.  The only room on this floor.  Right across from the breakfast area and the rooftop terrace.  Very quiet.  Nice breakfast included.  Good variety of breakfast foods.  The staff are so welcoming, and the concierges are wonderful.  We left a bag on the bus from the airport to the Termini and the concierge called the bus company for us and tracked down our bag.  Great location too, very central to all the famous sites.   Would definitely stay here again.

author: Evie O
title: Hotel Regno is an EXCELLENT choice
text: Incredible 4 night stay at Hotel Regno. Staff at reception, breakfast and evening bar was very attentive and with a wonderful attitude. They always went the extra mile whether to offer umbrella on a rainy day or to call taxi. Enjoyed the variety at breakfast and it was never too crowded during our stay. Can't say enough good things about the location with top attractions within easy walking distance. Will definitely return to Hotel Regno if visiting Rome again.

author: Mathis R
title: Great Location
text:
I give five stars for location alone, ideally situated on the Via del Corso, close to many of the cities attractiones.
Staff were welcoming, friendly and helpful. The rooms whilst small were comfortable and clean with tea, coffee making facilities. We had room at back, didnt have a view but it was very quiet.
Breakfast is included with good selection of foods to start thé day.
Will choose Regno again when we return to Rome.

author: Amelia A
title: Perfect Stay at Hotel Regno
text: We had a fantastic 4 night stay at Hotel Regno. It definitely did not disappoint. Location was perfect, we were able to get to everywhere we needed to by foot, as the hotel is perfectly situated between Parthenon and Fountain of Trevi. The hotel is also very convenient to get a taxi, which stops right in front of the hotel. The 24 hour concierge was very friendly and helpful. We stayed at the rooftop suite and loved our room. It was not only spacious, but we also enjoyed the view at the walkout. Just note that this is only accessible by stairs, so you'd have to carry your luggage up one flight of stairs, which was ok for us. The included breakfast was basic but adequate, and it was well-maintained by the staff. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and we highly recommended Hotel Regno.

author: George V
title: Nice Note, Bad Location
text: We just came home from Rome, staying at the Hotel Morgana.  My thoughts on this hotel are not bad but they're not great either.  Don't get me wrong, the hotel is nice, clean, but it wasn't a great hotel.  First the good.  Like I said, the room was clean.  We had a nice view overseeing the front street.  The rooms on the inner side of the hotel have a horrible view.  The breakfast buffet was also fine, not great.  Now for the bad.  The hotel is very small, outdated, and is in a very BAD part of town.  How small?  Well you ever get on an elevator and see the sign that says capacity is like 25 or 30 people.  This hotel had an elevator with a capacity of THREE.  My wife and I got on with our two suitcases and there wasn't any more room.  I'm talking small.  The hotel buffet was ok but the eggs tasted like fish.  Not sure if that's a European thing or not but I tasted like they cooked salmon just before scrambling the eggs.  They also had hotdogs and chicken wings on the BREAKFAST buffet.  And the location was terrible.  There was a homeless campsite 1/2 block up the street and we witnessed two fist fights right in front of the hotel.  The smell of urine hit you immediately upon leaving the hotel.  And the hotel kept their main door locked at all times.  You had to be buzzed in every time.  But the staff were very nice, polite, and helpful.  So my bottom line on the Hotel Morgana is.......nice hotel, very bad location.  Would I stay here again?  Definitely not.

author: Lucas Y
title: most disappointing hotel experiences we have had in our many years of traveling.
text:
This was by far one of the most disappointing hotel experiences we have had in our many years of traveling.

The location felt unsafe and was nothing like what we expected from a hotel claiming to be in the 4- or 5-star category. The surrounding area was covered in graffiti and frequented by questionable characters, making us uncomfortable every time we left or returned to the hotel.

The hotel itself is extremely dated and in need of significant renovation. Our room overlooked a dirty, rundown courtyard that was anything but relaxing. Every morning, we were awakened by the constant noise of kitchen staff banging pots, pans, and dishes while preparing breakfast.

What made the experience even worse was the attitude of the front desk staff. They were consistently rude, cold, and unfriendly. During our entire stay, we never felt welcomed. I have never stayed at a hotel where guests are not greeted with a simple smile or even a basic "hello."

The breakfast was mediocre at best, with very limited choices and nothing memorable. Overall, the atmosphere lacked warmth, hospitality, and the quality one would expect from a higher-rated property.

We spent three days in Rome, one of the most beautiful cities in the world, yet I literally could not wait to leave this hotel. Based on our experience, this property is nowhere near a 4- or 5-star standard. At best, I would rate it a 2-star hotel.

I would not stay here again and cannot recommend it to other travelers.

author: Hugo T
title: clean, well-maintained hotel with easy access to public transportation
text:
I enjoyed my stay here.  The hotel is located near Roma Termini (the main train station), and is an easy walk from there.  This area can be a bit seedy at night, but the hotel itself seemed very safe, with attentive, 24-hour front desk staff.  Easy access to public transportation is a major benefit of this hotel.

The staff all spoke English well (helpful for this American traveler).  My room was small, but clean, comfortable, and functional.  Breakfast was not included with my room, but was reasonably priced, and the buffet offered some good choices.  Service at breakfast was very good.

author: Evie Z
title: Good hotel, great experience
text: After reading many reviews, I confess that I was afraid. However, I think people make some demands and criticism very nothing to do. Our stay was great, the breakfast was very good, complete, everything organized and clean, with attentive staff. The room is old yes, but of good size, with a classic decor, air conditioning, heater, a good bed, tv, safe, fridge bar, coffee, hot and full water. The location is good too, close to the train station, many restaurants (destack to the Trattoria do Giovani in front), souvenir shops, close to the Santa Maria Maggiore and up to the Coliseum walking we went, thing of 15 minutes enjoying the streets. Reserve without fear.

author: Paolo O
title: A horrible weekend in Rome.
text:
Having come to Rome for a couple's visit with my girlfriend, we decided to choose this hotel because 
 we thought it was in a fairly strategic position to visit the city, it seemed like a great deal... but instead... a terrible choice!!
Upon arrival, we were greeted rudely and assigned a double room that smelled like a storage closet; we could barely fit our luggage and personal items inside the room. (A small bag and a small suitcase) 
Moreover, the room was dirty and the TV did not work. 
I am sorry because I had quite high expectations for this hotel, but I had to change my mind.

author: Marco E
title: Saved by the sister!
text:
Booked 4 nights with my husband. Arrived and met with 3 people smoking crack just outside the door (probably not hotels fault but didn’t make a great
First impression). Showed into our room which was honestly awful, no aircon (was
Advertised but apparently isn’t a thing unless it’s summer), safe was literally a box which could be picked
Up and walked off with and bathroom was the size of a small wardrobe with toilet, sink and bidet (which you had to climb over to get into the shower). Decor was poor. After speaking to reception we were showed a room in a yielding further down the road, passed the crack smokers and into a building with jail type iron doors. The building looked derailing and unoccupied, we were showing into a dark room with similar decor to the first. I’m not expecting 5* just value for Money!
After being hushed away by the reception staff we were shown to be “sister” hotel across The road. This was a completely different experience, it was clean, nicely furnished and decorated, and friendly welcoming staff. After
Speaking to the staff it was apparent that we were not the first customers to be sent here from the Morgana. If anyone has booked the Morgana rethink! If you want my recommendation book the sister hotel Hotel Aristotle

author: Amelia X
title: Not worth a fourth star
text: This should not be called a 4 star hotel. It is not well maintained. The elevators were frequently out of order. Its main virtue is proximity to Termini station. No attention paid to details. For example, there was not a single hook in the bathroom. The rooms are not large enough especially considering the price.

author: Morgan B
title: Atomospheric hotel with friendly staff
text: A very atmospheric hotel with friendly staff, tasty breakfasts, and an absolutely fantastic location—just a 2-minute walk from Termini station, yet بعيد from the hustle and bustle of Rome’s main streets. An ideal base for exploring the city.

author: Olivia N
title: Definitely not 4*
text:
Firstly the positives, the room was clean and the bed was comfortable. Staff on reception were pleasant and helpful.

Negatives, the room was dated, wallpaper was damaged and patched up. Strip lighting hanging off over the bed. Building work outside the room which started early daily. TV in the room did not work.

Location was fine for getting around, close to Termini station, some decent restaurants nearby but some of the streets near the hotel are a little intimidating.

The hotel needs a good refurbishment and modernisation, not up to 4 star standards. Overpriced for the current standards hopefully the hotel will undergo modernisation soon.

author: Ian J
title: I would look for another hotel on my next visit to Rome
text: Good hotel and good situation, excellent staff and good breakfasts, in negative noise outside at night by indigent people and a curious fact is that there is not a single channel in Spanish language

author: Holly C
title: Terrified
text: This hotel is not suitable for families or for the feint hearted . It is located one street away from Rome termini rail station and 25 minutes walk to Trevi Fountain , Spanish steps , Coloseum etc ! Which seems like great location when booking a city break BUT what the travel company won’t tell you is the amount of let’s say non locals or in my words illegal immagrants hanging around day and night causing trouble and fighting amongst themselves asking for money  from tourists. We stayed 3 nights and every night we went to our room before 7pm and heard so many fights between these people! We were terrified and totally spoilt our experience of Rome

author: Elena O
title: Dishonest
text:
Not a 4*. Upon arrival, we are informed that we are staying in an annex building. This one is 90m in a street that smells urine and unsafe, without signage.  The entrance and access, with airlock, fence and two locks is really creepy, as is the staircase and the building. This is not a hotel but an annex to make more figures. A slouchy Airbnb without the kitchen. The window wouldn't close.
We were refused to be re-accommodated in the hotel and even partially reimbursed for the 4 nights. We were denied the opportunity to speak to the person in charge.
You should absolutely avoid.

author: Isla T
title: Do not stay here
text:
No air con even if room if hot and stuffy some pathetic f..g excuse about rules I call. Lies No attempt to remedy lack of sleep due to sweating YES SWEATING IN ITALIES WINTER.. incorrect t bed assignment 1 double I stead of 2 Singles .. WE ARE FATHER AND SIN ..  SAFE BROKEN .. JUST RUN OUT OF HOT WATER AFTER ONE SHORT SHOWER.. THIS PLACE IS garbage
4 STAR HOTEL no way

author: Ruby Z
title: No sleep!!
text: Location great ! Rome is wonderful, but our stay was  spoiled by the hotel. Dark room, and loud noise from the street ALL NIGHT EVERY NIGHT!  We didn't get a wink of sleep while we were there .Thank goodness we only stayed for two nights. Breakfast ok. Please take our advice and book somewhere else!!! I think hotel managers should spend a night in each room to see what guests experience..

author: Holly L
title: Good stay
text: We had a family room, with enough space for two single beds and a marriage. Very attentive staff. Daily cleaning service.  Located very close to Termini Station and all the areas to visit. The breakfast buffet very complete.

author: Andrea H
title: Good/Bad
text:
Good : Breakfast is good and the staff are attentive, Beds are comfortable, Location near all Transport is good, It is clean, the maids were efficient and friendly. The nearby Mercato Centrale Roma is a great and inexpensive place to eat.

Not so good : I found the desk staff unhelpful and keen to dissmiss you, TV in the room was ancient and offered no English channels, the remote worked sporadically, I could easily hear the people in the next room, the lifts need to be bigger.

author: Freya A
title: A Gem Of A Boutique Hotel
text:
Lovely little hotel conveniently placed to transport links and walking distance to several tourist spots.

Friendly staff who were most helpful in booking tickets and suggesting restaurants. Shout out to Gabbino particularly for assisting us with these . 

Continental breakfast was good.  Lovely bar staff too in evening. 

Perfect for our mini break to Rome. 

Thank you from Marc & Linda

author: Mason X
title: Upgrade to a balcony room
text: Brilliant position, easy access to rail and also ‘hop on hop off’ bus, useful if walking is not your thing, otherwise 20 minute walk to most attractions. Staff really helpful, we had an executive room, small but nicely decorated. We asked if there was a slightly larger room, and like a previous review they offered us a huge balcony room in a building a few strides away. Fantastic and no charge. Breakfast was ok, lots of cafes nearby. Would definitely use again

author: Henry O
title: Good option for exploring the city
text:
We stayed here as part of a Jet2 package and found the hotel admirable for our needs. Rooms were clean, well decorated and quiet. The staff were friendly, breakfast was adequate and we were given a breakfast box for one early morning excursion.
The hotel is very close to the main railway station and there are numerous excellent restaurants within walking distance if you keep to the busy well lit roads.

author: Evie A
title: 5* Hotel Morgana
text:
We booked a package city break with BA for our first time to Rome and Hotel Morgana was first class.

From check in and throughout our stay.

We arrived before the 2pm check in and were expecting to store our bags but our room was ready which was excellent.

I had emailed a week before requesting a room with a balcony as we had already booked a luxury room. Not all luxury rooms come with a balcony.

Again the hotel was amazing with being able to give us a balcony room.

We were not situated in the hotel but just down the road which I already knew after researching.

This building is amazing with an old lift in the middle of the stair case. I found it very authentic.

Our room was on the first floor and we overlooked a square.

Our beds were made each morning with fresh towels and replenished the tea and sugar I had used.

Upon arrival we were given bottles of water for our fridge which was very welcome.

The breakfast each morning was lovely with some hot and also continental. A tip would be to ensure you give yourself time in the morning as waiting for a table can take a while but very much worth it.

I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone wanting a hotel in a central location with very friendly staff.

author: Mathis O
title: Amazing staff, clean & comfy room, wonderful stay!
text: During planning, Frederica and the rest of the front desk team emailed back & forth with me many times over the course of months answering questions, offering suggestions, and making arrangements for me.  They booked our transfer from FCO to the hotel, the transfer from the hotel to pier, and a golf cart tour- which was awesome!  We highly recommend staying here - the staff is top notch and our room was clean and comfortable!

author: Sophia N
title: Perfect located Rome stop
text:
Comfortable beds and two tier bedroom with delux. Fabulous breakfast with fresh cooked omelette made well and catering for myself dairy free. Staff very helpful and friendly, knowledgeable on  transportation to port and travel in Rome. 
Couple of tweets 
Gym all equipment should be 100% and steps in room creaky 
Love to stay will return

author: Juan L
title: Great location in Rome!!
text: We were greeted by Gabriel he was very helpful in advising/recommending restaurants walking distance and he was correct. Rooms are nice and spacious we had room with three beds only needed two.  They offer breakfast at an additional charge if you like to stay.  Now I did have one mishap the shower door opens out and is not like me home where glass is locked.  I fell out of shower while it was not too bad and I recovered my elbow still hurts.  Took baths remaining of my stay.  I would recommend staying this is my third stay and not my last.

author: Chloe H
title: Highly recommended for the Termini area
text: Lovely service, convenient location, comfortable rooms, and a great rooftop bar.

author: Liam D
title: Our Central, Comfortable Home-Away-From-Home in Roma
text: I continue to agree with the TripAdvisor review of this hotel I wrote in September 2025 -- this multi-faceted big city hotel has a friendly small town feel to it. From Anna and her colleagues at the front desk to breakfast service manager Monica and her fine service team, the staff is top notch.  The location -- close to Termini Station, Teatro dell' Opera di Roma, the Baths of Diocletian and more -- is very central. And yet the side streets facing the hotel are relatively quiet.  The breakfast offerings are very extensive, including fresh-squeezed orange juice (spremuta), and well-served; the fitness center is a rarity for a hotel in central Rome; and from our (extensive) experience here, the rooms in this solid old building are quiet.  This is not a budget hotel, but the room rates are competitive for this expensive city (it helps to be a Triple A or Best Western Rewards member).  Recommended for all, we look forward to staying here again in September of this year.

author: Harper I
title: Return to Rome
text:
My family and I were just amazed at how much care and thought was given to the comfort of the hotel guests staying in 
the Best Western Universo hotel. The staff was so kind and professional. As a traveler with a disability I am grateful to have a storage space for my wheelchair. I didn’t have to deal with the problem of where to put my wheelchair in my room. When I needed it the staff had it available at a moment’s notice. 
The breakfast buffet was superb. The egg station provided made to order eggs and omelettes. I especially enjoyed the 
range of breads and cakes. The apple strudel was magnificent. 
Rooms were very clean and well organized. The housekeeping staff were very friendly and efficient. I do have one suggestion for the guest bathroom. Guests that have a disability may need a bathmat so that they don’t slip in the bath tub shower. I carry my own but others may not. It would benefit disabled travelers so that no unnecessary accidents happen. I appreciate the grab bars in the shower. 
The hotel is more than just enough, from now on when we will be in Rome, my family and I will stay here. 
You are truly the best in all of Rome!

author: Lucia A
title: Conscientious hotels close to Termini Station
text: We stayed one night on the day of our arrival in Rome, and three nights in the following three days. When I asked if I could keep my luggage in the meantime, I was glad to hear that they agreed. The second time I checked in, I was thrilled that the person who responded at the first check-in remembered me. The room was compact but clean, and there was drinking water, which came in handy. I think it's a good hotel to stay in Rome, where the hotel rates are high, close to Termini station and at a relatively reasonable price.

author: Charlotte D
title: Very nice hotel.
text: 4-star hotel equipped with all the comforts and services worthy of 4 stars. Very clean, spacious rooms, excellent breakfast with fresh products both sweet and savory, a wide selection of cakes and pastries, fresh bread and not frozen (which is not a given). A business hotel just a few steps from Termini station. I recommend it.

author: Harry U
title: 10/10 stars!
text: We had an amazing experience at the Best Western Plus Hotel Universo.  It was very clean, friendly and helpful staff.  We were leaving for the airport before the breakfast opened so they made us "go" bags of food/drink.  The roof top bar was amazing and delicious.  It was the perfect way to end our trip.

author: Jack Z
title: Good location and value
text:
We stayed here for one night.

Pros:
- close to Termini, safe neighborhood, quiet, lots of restaurants and shops nearby
- kind and helpful staff
- comfortable room
- good AC
- great shower (water pressure and amenities)
- lots of counter space in bathroom
- great amenities in the room
- good price booking directly on the hotel’s website

Cons:
- I recommend asking for a room not facing the street. I don’t know if each night is the same, but we were woken up many times by garbage truck, truck cleaning the street, etc.

I would stay here again with a room not overlooking the street.

author: Elena W
title: Roman Holiday
text: Excellent location for Bars, Restaurants and local buses, staff on Front desk, Cleaners and especially Bar staff were attentive and friendly. Will book again next time we visit Rome

author: Isla Q
title: Good location, as well as dinner on the rooftop and breakfast!
text: I booked this hotel for one night, being in Rome for work. Great location, immediately close to Termini station. It offers all the services provided for the category, the spacious and clean room, the as well as the bathroom. I enjoyed the dinner at the rooftop finding a decent proposal and good meals. Also good breakfast offer. Waitstaff available, a little less organized reception. When booking I made a request by email and was given assurance that I would be accommodated. Once at the hotel the receptionist found on the day of arrival was not aware of what I requested and even the next day of departure, the receptionist was not aware of my need! Small details that should be looked after!

author: Noah L
title: Good visit, good value
text:
I had a single room for five nights. The room was very clean and housekeeping did an excellent job during my stay. The shower was a good size and the bathroom vanity had plenty of counter space to unpack my toiletries. The bed and pillows were comfortable. The staff was friendly and provided recommendations about things to do during my first day in Rome, which I found helpful. The breakfast buffet had a good variety of options. I booked directly with the hotel. I found the rate on the BW website to be quite a bit cheaper than on the travel sites. 

I read many reviews prior to booking this hotel. Some reviews mentioned that the area near Termini Station is a bit concerning. Overall, I found it to be typical of any big city. I was a solo female traveler and never felt unsafe in this area. The hotel was far enough from the station to provide a quiet environment, and yet close enough to make it easy to access the train station and metro (about an 8 minute walk) for day trips. There isn't much to do in the area considering all that Rome has to offer, but getting to the center of Rome from this hotel is an easy 15-20 minute walk if you don't want to take the metro.

author: James J
title: Excellent Hotel near everything!
text:
After a lot of search, I booked a week in this hotel. A grateful surprise. All perfect. 
I picked daily with breakfast and recommend. In Rome, breakfast is usually a capuccino and a candy. In the Best Western Universe breakfast is continental. Paes, cakes, colds, juices, coffee, eggs and etc...
The location is perfect. Close to everything and two blocks from Termini station. Various restaurants a few steps away. You can do everything on foot. Super safe and quiet place. 
The suite has a good size, great bathroom, cleaning, fridge bar. It has everything necessary for a great stay. 
Check in in minutes. All very polite and helpful. If you need a taxi, they ask you. 
Check out very fast and efficiently. 
Very good when you fit in full in the choice of the hotel.
Congratulations to everyone!

author: George Q
title: Great hotel
text:
Stayed at the hotel for three nights and we really enjoyed our stay. Our room was a standard double and it was comfortable and the bathroom was modern with an excellent shower. There are tea/coffee making facilities provided - and a fridge. In the corridor near the lift there was also a water dispenser. Nice touch. 

We asked reception for an iron - and later a fan as the room was warm (Too early in the season for the air con) - and both were provided within 5 minutes. 

Breakfast was superb - as was Michael - the egg Chef - always smiling and friendly. All the other staff we spoke to in the hotel were also great. 

Enjoyed a drink in the bar on the 7th
floor. There are also loads of bars and restaurants within a few minutes walk.

author: Aiden J
title: Not 4  star!
text: Our twin bedded room was a great disappointment.  Nothing like the photos on the website.  The cord on the electric kettle was in a dangerous state and the kettle itself would sometimes not work.    One teabag!  The wooden stick given for stirring was not replaced after our first day.  Nothing for the bottom of the bath to stop slipping which was of great concern.  Staff on reception said they could not pre-book us a taxi so all in all not a good choice of hotel.  I would say it was clean and in a good location.  We have every intention of returning to Rome but we will certainly not be staying here.

author: Alice B
title: Good hotel.
text:
We spent one night in this hotel. I couldn't find anything that wasn't right... Great location 10 minutes walk from Termini station, very friendly staff, impeccable cleanliness, super services and rich and plentiful breakfast!
To be considered for a next time in Rome...

author: Ruby E
title: Very good
text: I stayed at the hotel in question between 8 and 13 November 2025. The location is the greatest advantage provided by this Best Western, close to Termini station, which allows an easy connection to all points of Rome, including the connection to Fiumicino airport. Outstanding is also the breakfast, with a huge variety of foods, including hot dishes and fruit, and a very good free espresso, served at the table by diligent staff.

author: Daisy S
title: Travel to Rome and stay here
text:
Hotel Universo offers good accommodation conditions, but its main strength is its excellent location, very close to Termini Station and the ease with which you can reach Rome’s main tourist attractions, even on foot.
Highly recommended.

author: Grace N
title: Superb Roman holiday from 9 to 12 January 2026 at the Best Western PLUS Hotel Universo
text:
Reassuring, comfortable, family atmosphere; not bad for a hotel of almost two hundred rooms spread over seven floors; but it is just so: my wife and I enter it at 1pm on January 9, 2026 and we are greeted by the smiling greetings of the two concierges, who immediately make us feel at ease. After verifying our reservation details and identities, they promptly mark the two suitcases with identification heels and hand over copies to us for collection one hour later. In the meantime, we eat excellent bucatini all’amatriciana at Leonetti in Via Farini, a hundred meters from the Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore. Our Superior room on the top floor faces east on Via Massimo d’Azeglio and to the south is the church, of which we can see from the balcony the bell tower and the two domes. Anyone who knows a bit about Rome knows that I am talking about an area very close to Termini station.
     After a night’s rest, we descend for breakfast to a large room on the ground floor, where everything is well distributed for convenient access to hot and cold food containers: bacon, scrambled eggs, green beans, peas, potatoes, beans, cold cuts, cheeses, pies, croissants, fresh diced fruit, peaches in syrup, slices of white pizza and delicate puff pastry cakes, cereals, yogurt. Water and juices are obtained from convenient dispensers. Cappuccinos are served by kind waiters. Honey, jams, butter can be spread on fragrant toast.
      The hotel has many meeting and conference rooms and a gym. It is located a few steps from the Opera House in Via del Viminale, the church of Santa Maria degli Angeli e dei Martiri in Piazza della Repubblica, the access of Via Giolitti to metro line A. In conclusion, you could not want better from a four-star hotel, also taking into account excellent value for money.

author: Connor U
title: Great service.
text: I would like to Give 5 stars to the service I received by the staff. Especially Megan the customer service agent at the desk. I am a retired Hospitality manager 33 years service.  Megan assisted us and gave us a upgraded room. It was our anniversary and she made our stay exceptional. She is caring and attentive. She displayed all the core values of being a valued team member in the Hilton corporation. Hilton is very fortunate to have  her as a team member.

author: Paolo F
title: Excellent service and location
text: I stayed with my girlfriend and the service was excellent. The rooms are well-maintained, the breakfast has a huge variety, and the property's location is excellent. Very close to the Manzoni metro and a 15-minute walk from the Colosseum. A special thanks goes to Megan who made our stay unforgettable.

author: David Z
title: Perfect location to explore Rome
text:
I have been to Italy 8 times, and to Rome four times, and I believe this is the best location by a country mile. The hotel is situated just 50 to 100 meters from the Manzoni metro station. It is quite convenient to arrive here from Roma Termini station by taking the metro on line  A (red line) towards Anagnina and getting off at the Manzoni station. Just two stops from Rome Termini. The place is safe, and there's also a nearby tram station and a bus stop. Thus, the location was the main reason for me to book this hotel. However, the hotel ticked the other facets. 

The staff are helpful and courteous. The room was clean and spacious, as was the washroom. The self-operated laundry was excellent; I wish other hotels would follow this trend so customers can clean their delicate garments with care. There is no need to worry about laundry staff ruining expensive clothes by using the wrong wash or dry cycle. The hotel has installed Miele products, and a full washing and drying cycle costs just 15 euros. The price during peak summer was reasonable. The rooms are quiet, and the sleep quality is very good.

author: James H
title: A Perfect Home Base for Exploring Rome
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My stay at the Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum was outstanding from start to finish. The hotel is modern, spotless, and in a fantastic location, making it easy to explore Rome's most iconic attractions while still enjoying a peaceful and comfortable atmosphere.

The rooms were spacious, well-appointed, and exceptionally clean, with comfortable beds that made it easy to relax after a day of sightseeing. The breakfast offered a great variety of fresh, delicious options, and every member of the staff was friendly, professional, and eager to help with recommendations and any requests.

What really made the stay memorable was the genuine hospitality of the team. Everyone went out of their way to make us feel welcome and ensure we had a wonderful experience.

I highly recommend the Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum to anyone visiting Rome and would gladly stay here again on my next trip.

author: Marta R
title: Great location & Great Staff
text:
Incredible location! It’s just a brief walk to all the major attractions, and public transport options, including train and bus stations, are merely a minute away on foot. The staff here are outstanding and incredibly attentive. We were so impressed with our experience that we chose to cancel our reservations at another hotel and extend our stay with them for the last few nights of our trip to Rome. We enjoyed three days here, left for ten, and can’t wait to return for another three days. The service is truly exceptional! 

The rooms are clean, the beds are comfortable, and overall, it’s just fantastic.

A few things to keep in mind: 
The elevators are quite small, so if you're traveling with more than 2-3 people and luggage, you may need to make a separate trip. However, this isn't a downside as the elevators are quick—just a heads up.

The staff is ready to assist with anything you need. Need transportation? They arranged our airport transfer. Plus, they provided guidance on using the buses and trains. 
Looking for food recommendations? They helped me discover some delicious dining options. 
Want to book tours? They’re more than willing to assist with that too. 
And if you're in the mood for a chat, they greet you warmly and bid you goodnight. They truly excel in every aspect. Overall, it’s an amazing place!

author: Paolo F
title: Okay hotel, bad service.
text: Shuttle was late and charged me anyway

author: Alexander R
title: Short but intense.
text: I landed in Rome at 6:30 AM after a night flight from Boston, with a few hours to spare before lunch, and I was here to rest. Aside from the comfort of the bed and the silence of my room, there is not much I can review except for the staff's willingness to let me keep the room for a few extra hours to rest. A brief experience in which I found nothing to complain about. I will definitely return.

author: Brooke K
title: Average, plus was the hotel staff was pleasant and helpful
text: It was average, not really worth the price   I paid more bookings directly with Hilton Honors pts then I would have going thru booking.com

author: Holly W
title: Over charged me!
text: Over charged me! Make sure you review your receipt!  I stayed 2 nights and they changed my rate from what was originally booked.  In addition, they charged me "Staff Hotel Appreciation" when I did not approve of gratuity.  When I reached out, they said it was optional tip they offer guests, however no one asked me about it until I reached out. I had to ask twice to get that credited.

author: Rosie Q
title: Excellent service
text: We were very pleased with our stay at the HGI. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Breakfast buffet was very nice. Exceeded expectations

author: Jack I
title: Great, convenient location at reasonable price.
text: We enjoyed our stay with the high quality expected from a Hilton Hotel. Our King room was a good size with American type amenities.  The Hilton staff were all courteous and the breakfast buffet was more than adequate.  Taxi's are crazy expensive (35 Euros to City Center) The location was good, away from the busy City Center and walking distance to the Colosseum.  The metro station on the corner and buses nearby were easy to use to get to City Center and Trastevere (1.5 Euro).

author: Lily S
title: Short visit
text: We stayed here previously last year when it was a Best Western and again this year since the remodel and have been very pleased. The hotel is clean and in a great area in walking distance to the Colosseum by and a short taxi ride to the middle of Rome.

author: Henry A
title: Perfect location, amazing staff!
text: My recent stay here was incredible! The location is perfect—situated in a quieter, less crowded part of the city while still being just a two-minute walk from the Metro A line stop. The metro was a huge time and money saver at only €1.50 per trip. There’s also an amazing little restaurant right across the street, Marco G Osteria, where I had some of the best food of my life. And a special thank you to the wonderful woman at the front desk (I believe her name was Sarah?), who treated me like royalty throughout my stay.

author: Owen D
title: Good stay
text:
We thought our stay at Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum was a fantastic base for Rome.

The location was good, right near the metro and an easy stroll to the Colosseum, which made getting around Rome simple. Rooms were clean, comfortable and quiet enough to recharge. 

What really stood out though was the staff. Reception were friendly, relaxed and genuinely helpful, giving the hotel that easy-going, well-run feel that travellers really appreciate.

A great stay in Rome with good people, good service and a location that makes sightseeing a breeze.

author: Owen A
title: Thank You, Megan, for Such a Memorable Stay
text:
Stay at Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum from April 23 to 25 under the name Lee.

After having a very disappointing experience at another hotel the day before, I suddenly changed my plans and booked this hotel just one day in advance before coming to Rome. Despite the last-minute reservation, all of my requests were properly noted and arranged. 

From the moment I arrived, I already felt relieved. A young male staff member who seemed to be a trainee warmly welcomed me with genuine kindness, and his attitude immediately changed my mood after a stressful experience elsewhere.

As a Hilton Honors Gold member, all of the benefits were properly recognized and provided, which made the stay very comfortable. The hotel is also in a fantastic location — just steps away from the metro station exit. Additionally, having a free ice machine and water dispenser on the first floor was surprisingly convenient during my stay.

In fact, I enjoyed the hotel so much that I decided to cancel my original hotel reservation and extend my stay here for one more night.

But the highlight of my stay was definitely Megan.

I was very lucky to meet her because she happened to be working that day. She was incredibly, incredibly kind and professional. Even though she had only briefly seen my name during check-in, she remembered me the next day and quickly arranged everything so I could remain in the same room without needing to move after extending my stay. The entire process was handled so warmly and efficiently that I genuinely felt cared for as a guest.

On the day of checkout, she greeted me again so warmly that it left a lasting positive impression. I truly want to praise her for making my stay in Rome such a pleasant and memorable one.

The only downside of this hotel — though it may have been specific to my room — was that noise from the main road could be heard quite clearly inside the room. If you are sensitive to noise while sleeping, I would recommend requesting a room on the opposite side of the street in advance.

Overall, this hotel completely restored my impression of hospitality after a very disappointing experience elsewhere in Rome. I would gladly stay here again.

2026년 4월 23일부터 25일까지 투숙했습니다.

전날 다른 호텔에서 매우 큰 실망을 한 뒤 급하게 로마로 넘어오면서 하루 전에 급히 예약한 호텔이었는데, 늦은 예약이었음에도 요청사항이 잘 전달되어 있어 첫인상부터 좋았습니다.

체크인 당시 트레이니로 보이는 젊은 남자 직원분께서 정말 친절하게 맞이해주셨고, 덕분에 다른 호텔에서 받았던 스트레스가 많이 풀렸습니다.

힐튼 골드 등급 혜택도 모두 정상적으로 제공받아 매우 쾌적하게 투숙할 수 있었고, 호텔 위치 또한 지하철역에서 나오자마자 바로 앞이라 정말 편리했습니다. 1층에 무료 얼음 머신과 정수기가 있는 점도 생각보다 매우 유용했습니다.

결국 호텔이 너무 마음에 들어 원래 예약했던 다른 호텔을 취소하고 하루 더 연장 숙박까지 하게 되었습니다.

그리고 무엇보다 가장 인상 깊었던 직원은 Megan이었습니다.

정말 운 좋게 그날 근무 중이셨는데, 너무너무 친절하셨습니다. 체크인 때 잠깐 제 이름을 보셨을 뿐인데 다음날 제 이름을 기억해주셨고, 연장 숙박 과정에서도 객실 이동 없이 같은 방에서 계속 머물 수 있도록 매우 빠르고 친절하게 처리해주셨습니다.

단순히 업무적으로 응대한 것이 아니라, 투숙객을 진심으로 배려해준다는 느낌을 받을 정도로 따뜻한 응대였습니다.

체크아웃하는 날에도 먼저 반갑게 인사해주셔서 마지막까지 정말 좋은 기억으로 남았습니다. 제 로마 여행을 더 좋은 기억으로 만들어준 직원이라 꼭 칭찬드리고 싶습니다.

다만 한 가지 아쉬운 점은, 물론 제 객실만의 문제일 수도 있지만 대로변 차량 소음이 객실 안까지 꽤 잘 들린다는 점입니다. 잠귀가 예민한 분이라면 반대편 객실을 미리 요청하는 것을 추천드립니다.

전반적으로 로마에서 다른 호텔 때문에 실망했던 제 인상을 완전히 회복시켜준 호텔이었고, 다음에도 로마에 온다면 다시 숙박하고 싶은 곳입니다.

author: Ana P
title: Nice and Clean
