Stayed at. Thanks all

author: Luca M
title: The Hotel That Gave Me a Bad First Impression of Rome
text:
We checked in late at night. I’m not sure whether there was some miscommunication between the hotel staff, but our experience started off quite confusingly.

I had originally booked one night and later added a second night. Before arriving, I contacted the hotel in advance and specifically asked whether we could stay in the same room for both nights. The hotel confirmed that this would be possible. However, when we checked in, we were asked whether we had only booked one night, which was confusing considering that this had already been discussed and confirmed with the hotel.

What concerned us much more was the first room we were assigned. After taking the elevator to the fourth floor, we had to walk up another half-flight of stairs to reach it. As soon as we entered, the room was extremely hot and humid, and the air conditioning did not seem to be functioning properly.

More importantly, there was a dead small fly on the bed, and there were numerous ants crawling around the room. The bedding itself did not feel particularly clean either. Overall, the room gave us the impression that it had not been regularly used or properly prepared for guests.

To make matters worse, the bathtub drain was broken, so we could not even shower properly. When we reported the problem, we initially received an explanation about which side was hot water and which side was cold water, which had nothing to do with the actual issue. Eventually, a staff member came up to the room, checked it, and confirmed that the drain was indeed broken.

I also mentioned how unusually hot and humid the room was and asked whether there might be a problem with the air conditioning. We were then offered a room change.

The replacement room was completely normal and in significantly better condition. This actually made the situation even more difficult to understand. If a normal room was available, why were we initially assigned a hot and humid room with numerous ants, a dead insect on the bed, questionable cleanliness, and a broken bathtub drain?

I obviously cannot know the reason, but the difference between the two rooms was so significant that I genuinely found myself wondering why we had been given the first room in the first place — and even whether the fact that we are Asian had anything to do with it. I am not claiming that this was the reason, but the experience was uncomfortable enough to leave me with that question.

There was another interaction that added to my negative impression.

At check-out, I paid an additional €40 and was given an explanation of the charges at the time. However, after thinking about the amount again, I wanted to make sure I had understood the breakdown correctly. The city tax was €7.50 per person per night, so for two people staying two nights, that would be €30. Since the total was €40, I was unsure what the remaining €10 was for.

We had purchased some bottled water during our stay, which I understood to cost around €2 per bottle, and there were also bottles of water provided in the room. I therefore politely contacted the hotel afterward to ask for a detailed breakdown of the €40 and to clarify whether the water provided in the room was also chargeable.

The hotel explained that the €40 consisted of €30 in city tax and €10 for four bottles of water at €2.50 each. Once this was explained, I understood the charge and had no issue with the amount itself.

What bothered me was the tone of the response. It began with “As I said…” and ended with “You can check the receipt.” I fully understand that the charges had already been explained to me at check-out, but I was simply asking for clarification because I had not fully understood which bottles of water were included in the charge.

Considering that my message was polite and was only asking for a breakdown, I found the response unnecessarily dismissive and condescending. A simple clarification of the charges would have been sufficient.

I understand that maintenance issues can happen at any hotel. However, this is a four-star property charging a city tax of €7.50 per person per night, so I expected a considerably better standard of room preparation and guest service.

Being initially assigned a poorly maintained room with ants, a dead insect on the bed, a broken bathtub drain, and apparent air-conditioning issues was disappointing enough. The confusing communication and the way my later inquiry was handled made the overall experience even worse.

Unfortunately, I would not choose to stay here again.

author: Samuel V
title: Good hotel, spacious rooms
text: Good location for Termini station - about 10 mins walk. It's good to be near Termini station for arriving from the airport and taking the metro. It's walkable to some main signs in about 30 mins, but need to take the metro to other places like the Vatican. The staff are friendly and rooms are spacious. It's all very clean. The bathrooms are a little dated in terms of decor but a good size and the shower is good. The lifts are a little small and old fashioned but it's a fun experience!

author: James M
title: What A Joy
text:
A smallish BW hotel within a 12 minute walking distance of Termini (main station).
I was welcomed by an amazing friendly and welcoming gentleman. His name badge divulged his name, but I guess an alias, as Joy. How appropriate.
I had for the first time in my life reserved  a single occupancy room. When I inspected the room and bathroom. I  thought it was quite amazing that everything was there. Closet with enough hangers and a minibar too. The shower room was well equipped.
I called it a cosy room. Airco working very well. Housekeeping standards very high. The room it self looked as new, apart from desk and bedside cabinet which were quite dated. I was told that next year the whole floor would be renovated. as they have already done 2nd and 3rd floor. As far as I see it they only have to replace desk and bedside cabinet.
I had a few requests and they were dealt with by Joy quickly. This receptionist is a huge asset for this property . He certainly deserves a good raise.

author: Andrea M
title: Not what's in reviews is reality
text: Hotel is very far from Termini Station. Furniture was at least 50 years old. Breakfast surely not of a 4 star hotel, nothing you see in the pictures. Only I lift which can fit 2 adults.

author: Thomas A
title: Enjoyable experience
text:
So friendly 
Joy was very helpful 
The breakfast was amazing 
Definitely recommend this hotel

author: Paolo X
title: Pleasant stay
text: Stay in a structure that combines historical charm and modernity... The location is strategic, a short distance from Roma Termini station. I was impressed by the welcome of the staff, extremely kind and professional. Although the lobby retains a charming Art Deco style, I stayed in a recently renovated room: a real surprise for aesthetics, comfort and excellent cleanliness. Congratulations warmly, I hope to return soon to enjoy your new rooms again

author: Hannah E
title: Well located , quiet,  safe
text:
We booked this hotel through an airline vacation package so I'm unsure the room rate but I think it's about 300 E per night. 

We were at this hotel for 13 nights.  

It is very well located just a few blocks from Termini (the main train station) and a few minutes walk from Castro Pretorio (a subway station) .  

In this area there are numerous embassies , government offices, hotels and residential apartments.  We felt safe walking around here . 

The hotel is super clean both the room and common areas.  The room was cleaned / serviced everyday ; none of our belongings went missing. 

The bed and bath linens are high quality ; we had a king size bed that was very comfortable as were the semi firm pillows. 

We had good quality sleep undisturbed by noise. 

The washroom has plenty of hot water and lots of towels. 

There's a small fridge and a room safe. 

The large window opens and allows tons of fresh air and light too. There are shutters to block out weather and light. 

The room was much bigger than the one we had in a similar hotel in Paris last year. 

There are plenty of good restaurants nearby .

Near Termini you will find a grocery store where the prices are about half of what is charged by the corner stores.

author: Lucy A
title: Deeply Disappointing Stay — Misleading Advertising
text:
I am highly upset with this booking — both with this hotel and with Expedia for the false advertising. This property is nowhere near a 4‑star standard. The building is extremely old, and the layout is inconvenient, with floors separated by stairs that force you to drag your luggage up and down. The interior is just as disappointing: ugly grey carpet, small claustrophobic elevators, and lobby couches that are outdated, worn, and dirty.

What made the stay truly unbearable is that the hotel does not turn on the AC until mid‑June. We spent several sleepless nights in a hot, uncomfortable room. Opening the balcony door didn’t help — it only added noise from outside and constant door banging from the wind draft, making the nights even worse.

To make matters worse, the location is far from everything. It’s at least a 40–60 minute walk to Trevi Fountain and other major sights.

Overall, this was a terrible experience from start to finish. I strongly recommend staying away from this hotel.

author: Alexander Q
title: Not a family establishment
text:
Pros- 
nice staff

Cons-
Overpriced
Continental Breakfast was not free and cost 15 euros per person
Beds were uncomfortable 
When you open the shades of your bedroom window there is a sex theatre about 50feet with views into your room

author: Chloe M
title: cannot be a 4 star
text: sheets with holes. dirty walls. unhealthy air in the room. breakfast with hard buns. only the bathroom up to standard.

author: Connor N
title: Excellent quality of sleep
text: The hotel is located close enough to Termini Station, to be reached on foot. The mattress is nice high, it supports impeccably, also the area is very quiet. Overall the level of cleanliness is good, the breakfast buffet is varied, both sweet and savory, with fresh fruit and vegetables. The only flaw is the shower, a bit 'poor for a 4 * structure.

author: Molly B
title: Good solution in Rome, with a flaw.
text: Cute hotel, 20 minutes walk from Termini station and 5 minutes from Porta Pia, offers spacious, well-appointed rooms with fairly clean bathrooms. Breakfast is both savoury and sweet, very good and plentiful. The waitresses on the floors and in the dining room are kind and smiling. The only flaw was the receptionist who checked us in: annoyed, rude and rude. He already addressed himself badly during the data recording, but then he replied hatefully to the colleague who had returned down to the reception because the card had demagnetized. The morning porter was much nicer.

author: Aaron T
title: Very bad experience....
text:
It would not even deserve the time to comment but unfortunately the Hotel is far from what is indicated both as a description and as a service.
Obviously the photos seen presaged a renovated Hotel with a good standard, which is contrary to what was found. A few photos will make you understand the difference from what you see on the site.
If you need parking the answer is that it is 150 meters. (not them but a nearby parking lot). Too bad that it is actually 5/600 meters. and with various suitcases is far from convenient especially if you arrive like me after hours and hours of plane flights.
Finally the top line: if you forget a bag (in my case two) they allow themselves to make it disappear, despite after less than two hours I warned them and I was returning to retrieve them.
What about it? Never in over 50 years have I stayed in such a mediocre Hotel.
Personally I suggest to look for other solutions....

author: Owen E
title: Good will recommend to friends
text: The elevator/ lift needs improvement in size. I will definitely recommend to family and friends.  Breakfast should be more affordable.

author: Caleb V
title: Good location, very friendly staff, good sleep quality
text:
Had a very good stay here. Easy to find with a 10 min walk from Roma Termini. Nice sized room with good bed and bedlinen, so good sleep quality. Both minibar and kettle. Clean room and bathroom.
My room was a bit too cold for my liking, but was told the AC was turned off at this time of year, so nothing to do about it. Checked if would have helped to open the windows to let in the sun and air from the outside, but this was almost at the bottom of some kind of 'shaft', so no sun could enter. Otherwise all good. Superfast internet. Very friendly staff.

author: Chloe C
title: 2 memorable days
text: I stayed with my husband and son on the night of Monday, October 27. Dominique welcomed us at the reception who was efficient and very kind like her colleagues on the next shift. The rooms are cozy, clean and quiet. The bathrooms very nice. Breakfast was good and plentiful and the room staff very friendly and efficient. I must say that I really enjoyed staying there and would definitely recommend it

author: Jessica L
title: Bad.
text:
Horrible. They won't.
Horrible reception, lack of education and lack of patience with the tourist 
Worst experience I had in Italy.

author: Leo A
title: Great location, great value.
text:
We stayed on the renovated floor - it is very much in the art deco style. Nicely done. 

Staff are very friendly and attentive. Basic amenities. Fridge and safe. Great aircon. Comfortable beds. Great value for the price. 

We had breakfast - great selection and again staff here were very polite and attentive.

author: Marco J
title: Best western?!? Good location
text: Clean room, not exactly quiet, weak air conditioning that manages to defuse the room. The look fits the name of the hotel. Artdeco bathroom with bathtub and shower head, but with wooden windows in shower.. spacious room. Good breakfast with little offer of salty and vegan. For the sweet part little selection of croissants (at 8 am most were already finished) excellent strategic location.

author: Hugo U
title: Too Hot to Sleep
text: Air Conditioning was not able to keep up with the heat. We had 2 sleepless nights. Would not recommend because of this issue. Please note the location and make sure it's not too far out of the way for sightseeing. Uber worked well. Taxi from Colosseum wanted to charge us 28 euros to return to our hotel, another only charged us 16 for same route.

author: Alice G
title: Excellent in general, the attention from the staff who are very kind, the room cleanliness, and the breakfast is good.
text: Excellent in general, the attention from the hotel staff who are very kind to the guests, the room cleanliness, and the breakfast which is also very good.

author: Sean T
title: One night in Rome
text: The hotel is very well situated, closer to great restaurants and public transportation.  The room had all we needed, very clean, comfortable amd quiet.

author: Ryan P
title: Great hotel.
text: Price ratio quality👍 excellent location - nearby shops, cafes, subway! Room service every day at A+, breakfasts are monotonous, but everything is fresh! If we still go to Rome, we'll stay in this hotel!

author: George J
title: Hotel Kennedy in Rome.
text:
Hotel with a location close to the train station and next to a park.
Do not hesitate to stroll around the neighborhood to discover restaurants.
Italian-style decoration.
Friendly reception and pleasant staff.
Breakfast was not abundant despite an impressive cappuccino.

author: Tyler G
title: Disappointing.
text: Located near Termini Station and Via Cavour (a major thoroughfare that crosses the main tourist sites of Rome), this hotel seems frozen in an ancient time. The rooms are modest, the decor is aging, the bathrooms are cramped and not very functional, the shower is quite dirty and narrow, and the locks are not very secure. Lack of a safe and mini fridge to keep water cool. The staff is very helpful and pleasant, both at the reception during the day and night, as well as in the dining area. However, a major downside is the breakfast: powdered fruit juices (considering Italy has an abundance of citrus...), a thermos of coffee (again, Italy is known for the quality of its coffee), lack of savory foods (eggs, bacon, cold cuts, cheeses, ...), pastries that are more than mediocre, random absence of bread, and no fresh fruits. In conclusion, I would say that in its current state, this hotel is far from the European 3-star standard it claims to have.

author: Owen L
title: Terrible experience.
text:
The hotel is right across from the station; that would be the only good thing about the hotel. Although the area around the hotel at night is not recommended at all. 
The room is very old, but the worst part is the bathroom; it was tiny, there was barely space to move. The shower was falling apart...
And let's not even talk about the terrible breakfast. The only options they have are pastries, varied but only pastries. And healthy options like yogurts and some fruit, there were no savory options, not even a sad cold cut, turkey, mortadella... NOTHING! They had bread for toasting, but you could only spread it with jam or butter, nothing else.
Not to mention that they serve it in the middle of the hotel hallway... the juices were terrible, because even in many hotels with machines, they are at least drinkable; those in this hotel were undrinkable. 
Moreover, we spent 4 nights, which made for an unpleasant stay and breakfasts that were between bad and terrible.
In this location or nearby, you are sure to find something better at a similar price.

author: Evie K
title: Great Hotel
text: Location is near to almost everything. We had a great stay throughout, staff were very helpful and accommodating!

author: Olivia P
title: Terrible
text:
The front desk was very pleasant but it stopped there.
The room was disgutsing.  Mold in the bathroom!  Not acceptable

author: Ethan V
title: Hotel Kennedy Rome
text: The hotel is ideally located, between the train station and on foot quite a lot of monuments to visit ,it would however require a little refreshment to the rooms,and the street in the evening is a little uncrowded

author: Aaron O
title: Medium
text:
old age, yellow lighting not enough, no shutters but curtains that let through the light, air conditioning only working in ventilation, little pressure in the taps, heavy toilet evacuation, poor soundproofing.
this hotel is not up to a 3***

author: Ethan N
title: Had a few issues.
text: The location was good that it was within walking distance of most sites we wanted to see, but was warned to travel by taxi at night as the area is a bit rough on an evening (which was witnessed). The beds were comfortable but due to an air conditioning issue it was very warm and difficult to sleep at night. Staff were friendly especially the breakfast staff. There was only the same things available everyday though rather than a change of options. Room security was a bit concerning as the lock on our door wasn’t very secure. We did get it to lock but worried it could be pushed open. Bathroom was also not very clean On arrival so I did clean it myself and just kept a do not disturb sign on the door and kept on top of it ourselves.

author: Carlos D
title: 3 days with family
text:
the welcome: just great! the staff is smiling, professional and at the small care of arrival. we feel immediately welcome 
breakfast: pure happiness the service is at the top and the quality of the products is at the rendezvous 
thank you the Kennedy hotel  
  Mrs. Martin

author: Connor M
title: I would not recommend it.
text:
The photos of the rooms are misleading because the rooms are absolutely not like that.
Very old hotel like the rooms (ours was like this) in the stairs there is still the Shining type carpet.
From the bathroom came a stench of sewer that forced us to stay with the window open, also the bathroom was uncomfortable, you had to do the contortions to get to the toilet. The hairdryer was missing, in the shower there was no support for shampoo, bubble bath and more... a disaster. We were only two days when we were always around, otherwise we would have asked for the change of room, hoping for some room like those in the photos.
Breakfast passable.
The only positive things are the staff, friendly and helpful and the proximity of the hotel to Termini station., for the rest 👎

author: Tyler U
title: positive experience
text: satisfied with all the services, I will gladly return to this establishment if the opportunity to visit Rome arises again

author: Evie L
title: Everything perfect!
text:
I recommend the structure for kindness and cleanliness.
We stayed in the annexe JFK house, everything perfect clean and very quiet. The staff was friendly and helpful.

author: Ruby X
title: Simple and safe hotel
text:
Great location near the train station (Leonardo express train airport connection) and bus station (many buses). 2 minutes walk.
Quiet and clean hotel. Friendly and available staff. Friendly and vigilant welcome. 
Breakfasts: good products at will. Quiet rooms.
Comfortable and clean bedding. 
Wall/ceiling paintings and bedroom furniture are to be refreshed. Clean and renovated bathroom. Hot water. Towels changed daily.
Small square right next door (casa de l'archetectura).
Suitable for a short stay. Simple and family friendly. I recommend.

author: George F
title: Italy solo vacation
text: The hotel is very well located, close to everything, with excellent cleanliness, a good breakfast, and very friendly and helpful staff! I was very well received! I hope to return again!

author: Olivia U
title: bad rooms
text: horrible breakfast small showers excessive noise can't sleep a bad experience at this hotel

author: Carlos F
title: They don't even give me hot water. Service Spirit 0 Hotel.
text:
First, you have to go up the stairs to get to the front desk from the entrance. I had a big carrying case, so I thought they were going to carry it, but the staff said something like, "I'm 60, I can't carry it," and the other staff didn't carry it, so I carried the carry myself.
Plus, no refrigerator. If you want hot water, you go to the front desk and there is no hot water. The coffee machine is finished. I was told that. Impossible. It was a lousy hotel.

author: Tyler X
title: Bad luck with the bathroom that was old and was rust and damp. They changed us and rather better
text: Well located, excellent reception staff. Breakfast very improveable and cleaning overall very improveable. There are rooms with old bathroom and others that are fine

author: Louis Y
title: Fantastic stay
text:
Fantastic stay in a hotel in an exceptional location, very close to the most important monuments in Rome. The staff was very kind and very professional: they gave us precise information on what to visit and how to get around. The absolute strong point is the terrace, with a spectacular view. Highly recommended both for those coming to Rome for the first time and for those who want to stay comfortably in the center.
Excellent value for money.

author: Isla U
title: Do not stay here! I wish I could get my money back.
text: First we checked in and were given room 505, while unpacking I felt something drip on me. I looked up and saw a big moldy spot in the ceiling that was dripping. I packed everything back up and went to the reception desk and was then given room 502. I checked the ceiling and it was clear but then noticed mold on the wallpaper and hair on the shower wall. Exhausted from a long day, we decided to just deal with it but only unpack what we needed for the 1 night. When leaving the next morning, we walked past room 505 and noticed they painted over the moldy spot on the ceiling. So bad!

author: Alice A
title: The location and the views from the little terrace
text: Hotel near Piazza Navona and from which you can access different areas by walking
photos: [{"url": "https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/33/e5/f4/cc/caption.jpg", "caption": "Una salita del hotel", "photo_id": "870708428"}, {"url": "https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/33/f7/3c/89/caption.jpg", "caption": "Cerca del hotel. plaza Navona ", "photo_id": "871840905"}]

author: Henry A
title: A comfortable hotel.
text: Very close to Piazza Navona, many places are within walking distance, the rooms are comfortable, and the reception staff are friendly and helpful.

author: Poppy X
title: Terribly terrible
text: The breakfast was terrible, the room was very old with very few outlets, the bathroom was even worse, the shower would turn cold and suddenly it would turn boiling hot without touching it and it burned me. Very bad.

author: Emma A
title: The best.
text: Honestly, I have been to Rome many times and stayed in the same number of accommodations. This was my best experience. Not only because of the location but also because of the hotel itself and the warm attention from its staff. Do not hesitate, go and see for yourselves.

author: Marco N
title: Booking cancelled the day before.
text: I booked and paid for a room on booking.com two months ago, the day before I received an email that my booking had not been accepted. I called the hotel and they said it depends on booking and they had nothing to do with it. No comment.

author: Jessica U
title: Booking error + unfriendly + non-hygienic, worst stay
text:
We booked a double room, but the hotel booked a single room. In the description, I tried to show and explain the booking details, but I didn't see it at all, and you were booked as a single room and the refund was unfriendly to receive through Agoda. The Agoda side tried to talk to the hotel, but the hotel side said that they could not change the room even if they were not contacted. I think the first traveller seemed to be guiding you into a single room without seeing it. 
The condition of the single room was very narrow as the prisoner's bathroom, and the hygiene was poor (the shower room was full of fungus). The wall consent also failed or required to change the room, but only the adapter was thrown and resolved. There was no noise, so the couple in the next room could be heard fighting. Feel almost asleep in the hallway.. The worst hotel.

author: Emma D
title: I enjoyed my stay
text: I enjoyed my stay at hotel genio. The hotel looks quite old fashioned and the room was small but I found myself quite endeared to it after the three day stay. The staff were friendly and welcoming and happy to help. I enjoyed the roof terrace when I wanted a break from the busy city. I found the room to be clean and I liked the bed and shower.

author: Owen A
title: Bof
text: Old hotel smell of humidity in the room need renovation lunch ok without more however the location is two minutes walk from Piazza Navona

author: Owen N
title: Thank you all.
text:
Clean and comfortable, within walking distance of almost every place worth visiting. 
Excellent customer service. Friendly, helpful staff. From arrival right up to the time we left, reception staff in particular, were always ready to help.

No request was too trivial or too much.
Finally, when the transfer to the airport failed to turn up, the receptionist saved the day by arranging a taxi for us.
Many thanks to all.

author: Thomas O
title: Good hotel without extra comfort
text:
The hotel is very central. Nice rooftop terrace. Bathroom could well need for renovation, signs of mold by shower cabin and bed hard as a board
Polite service

author: Olivia F
title: Worst experience
text: Worst hotel I've ever stayed in. It says this is a 4-star hotel but it doesn't even deserve 1 star. Everything was outdated and disgusting. The beds have never ever been replaced and you could feel the feathers in your back, have never had so much pain after sleeping in a bed and I am 25 years old.. Extremely unfresh and smelly inside the room, Responsive and we should not even discuss breakfast .. the yogurt was hot and the bread drier than sand, the coffee was beneath contempt. We were at breakfast the first morning but ended up going out in town and looking for a Café. Would certainly not recommend this hotel.

author: Claire K
title: TERRIFYING
text:
TERRIFYING experience
We booked two rooms at the 4-star Hotel Genius, in the center of Rome, a stone’s throw from the Senate and Piazza Navona.  The room assigned to our daughters had no air conditioning. We called the reception and at my insistence they assigned us another room. In my room and my wife we found the broken wardrobe door (it fell on us); the shower full of ants and dirt; the dirty toilet; the hair dryer not working, old and not very clean furniture, fridge with bottle of water already open. An experience to forget. Only those who want to spoil their holiday can book in a dive like L’Hotel genio. We didn’t just run away because it was 1am.
Absolutely not recommended.

author: Erin L
title: Very convenient location
text:
I stayed two nights in this hotel with my wife. 
It is a dated four star but I found it decent both in the rooms and for continental breakfast.
From the terrace you can enjoy the spectacular view of Rome.
The staff is professional and friendly. 
The location is convenient for both the center and the Vatican area.

author: William D
title: Hotel dated not 4 stars
text: Very old hotel needs renovation entrance and the rooms our assigned had only one switch for all luci.Colazione discreet but with cappuccino or coffee machinetta.Porta elevator that crawls to the ground all the time is quite small not norma.Personale polite in particular Antonio forgives kind and professional.

author: Katie M
title: We'll be back.
text:
Great location
Good facilities according to the city, perfect breakfast and 100% staff attention

author: Maria M
title: Lovely hotel in great location
text: Just got back from 4 nights in Rome staying at Hotel Genio. After reading the reviews I was a bit apprehensive but needn’t have worried.. it’s an old hotel so yes a bit dated but room was a good size with a fridge and kettle in it: bathroom had nice shower and lots of towels. Good air con which was very pleasing as it was very hot. Staff all very friendly and helpful and continental breakfast was good. Plenty of choice. Location of hotel is perfect for all attractions which are all walkable from the front door. Hotel had a roof terrace with views over the city. A nice place to relax after a day exploring. No it’s not 4 star but  it’s clean and comfortable and I would definitely go back there:

author: Mathis Y
title: Perfect location, great rooms and top service!
text: Fantastic nice and nice hotel! Spacious and nice rooms and super service! Eating breakfast on the 6th floor overlooking Rome was magical! Placed very centrally!  Walking distance to the vast majority of sights! Recommended on the warmest!!

author: Andrea G
title: It's a scam.
text:
I booked a single room at the Hotel Genio Roma based on its website description, which promised 13 m2, comfortable single bed, exterior views and an ideal environment to rest. However, the room I was assigned was extremely small (less than 6 m2), with a tiny bed and a noise level that made it impossible to sleep well.

The most frustrating thing was that, after reporting my unhappiness, the hotel refused to offer me any kind of solution. I felt cheated as a client, as what they offer does not correspond to reality.

I would not recommend this hotel if you are looking for a comfortable stay and a fair deal. There are many better options in Rome for the same price.

author: Wyatt W
title: Very bad experience!
text:
On arrival there was no service to carry the luggage to the room. We arrived tired and had to carry our bags ourselves to the 2nd floor.
Old elevator and gives several bumps, very bad! 
Bad breakfast, dark and old room, bathroom water from the box did not go down and finally the air conditioning did not work right, with the heat that was in Rome, we cooked during the night (one hour we stayed in the hotel).
Bad experience, I do not recommend.

author: Paige Y
title: Disappointed
text: Very outdated bathroom, plumbing needs to be reviewed, plus a sewer smell, cramped room, double curtain detached and not functioning, only 3 TV channels. Breakfast is fairly decent, bar service is nonexistent, staff is okay but does not speak French, cleanliness is acceptable. Does not deserve a 4-star rating. On the other hand, very well located, close to the train station and the subway.

author: Owen Y
title: Best affordable hotel in Rome
text: One of the best affordable hotels we stayed at in Rome. Very helpful and friendly staff! Great breakfast with fresh, local fruits, cheeses, breads, and of course coffee. Excellent AC in our room! Great walkable neighborhood with some really lovely trattorias within a block or two.

author: Sophia A
title: Extremely friendly and ideally located hotel
text:
Having read a few harsh comments on here, I had to leave a review on the hotel. The first thing to mention are the staff who are absolutely fantastic, each and everyone we spoke to were really friendly and couldn't do enough for you. The location, in my opinion is excellent with its proximity to Termini and having multiple bus stops within a couple of a minutes walk. 

In relation to the comments about Termini and surrounding areas, we travelled back to the station each night after midnight and walked the 7 or 8 minutes to the hotel without any issue whatsoever. 

The hotel reception and bar area are really modern and spotless with excellent air con, which was much welcomed after trailing around the city all day. 

The rooms are a little dated and could do with an update but were more than adequate for the amount of time we spent in there. It was cleaned daily with fresh towels and for the price, we couldn't have asked for more. 

I would absolutely recommend Hotel Villafranca for a few days city break and wouldn't think twice about returning.

author: Claire F
title: I won't come back.
text: I stayed at Hotel Villafranca di Roma and, overall, I had a good experience. The structure of the hotel is nice, the service was friendly and the Mood is quiet, ideal for rest. However, one negative point marked the stay: the strong bad odor coming from the tubing of the bathroom, which caused even nausea. This problem greatly compromised sleep and comfort, especially in the bedroom. If this aspect is resolved, the hotel surely offers a good accommodation option in the area.

author: Brooke A
title: Nice hotel in good location
text: This is a nice hotel in a good location near the metro stop. The rooms are reasonable and the breakfast is excellent with a wide choice. Also gluten free breakfast available.

author: Emma X
title: Very kind when I come again will definitely be here at the hotel Villafranca
text:
The room in here I stayed and very nice 
Ample breakfast there is ne for everyone
Both the waiters and the people at Reseption are very nice 
The center of Rome is close to reach by metro and was a fabulous stay in Rome an outdoor work of art 
I hope to donate soon again I was fine 
Thanks for everything

author: Luca O
title: Good.
text: Close to Termini station, buses and metro and a few minutes walk from the hotel which is located in a small street. Good value for a short stay.  The staff is very nice and helpful.  Perfect breakfast of choice of fresh products sweet rolls cold cuts and cheeses as well as cereal jams honey fruits etc...we lack nothing. It is true that the rooms would need a little modernity and refresh but the mattresses are comfortable the bathroom is large on the other hand with shower tub. You will find slippers necessary complete toothbrush for the shower as well as a kettle with coffee and tea.  A flat screen TV, small wardrobe and power outlet on each side of the bed but behind the bedside.  We enjoyed our stay.

author: Oliver U
title: Very nice
text: Very good, excellent, good location, very friendly reception staff, speaking languages, very good breakfast , room with a lounge and mini Office, very good experience.Metrony for bus nearby, and many places to eat, I recommend it without a doubt

author: Harry E
title: Hotel Villafranca… don’t stay here
text:
We are at the hotel Villafranca now….. do not stay here!!
We booked this hotel as part of a Gate 1 vacation and what a mistake, it’s totally misrepresented.

The first room we had the toilet wouldn’t stop running and the window didn’t open. The rooms are old and run down, no modern conveniences. 

We moved to a new room and it was worse. The fake wool floors are delaminating and cardboard is showing, the power went out on the enire
Floor. There’s nothing nice or convenient about this place. 

The hotel is advertised as a 3 star hotel but I think it’s a stretch to call it a 1 star.

author: Nora N
title: Perfect and inexpensive Hotel to explore Rome
text:
This is a perfect  base for exploring Rome it is clean friendly and within a 30 to 40 minute walk to all the main attractions 
The staff are very helpful and friendly. 
The rooms are clean and maintained daily. 
A special mention to Donatella at breakfast who looked after my non gluten requirements

author: Daisy L
title: Hard beds!
text:
Very hard beds, and then we mean - very hard beds. We have spent many nights in tents and this could be compared to field beds.
The toilet didn't work. We had to use the garbage cans in the bathroom to rinse down when we used doing. We informed about this and personally tried to fix it. The staff at the hotel is lovely. Service-oriented and friendly. They tried to help where they could. Breakfast is totally ok compared to European standard. The room was cleaned every day, with new towels.

author: Carlos L
title: I do not recommend it!
text: This hotel definitely does not deserve 4 stars. Its glory days were probably several or even dozens of years ago. The rooms need renovation, the bathroom was dirty, the beds were uncomfortable, and there were no power outlets near the beds. The photos in the offer were taken in the previous decade. Breakfast was the same every day for a whole week, with scrambled eggs from a package. The only saving grace was the very good pastries and coffee. For a 6-night stay, we paid €90 in city tax for two people, while the Booking.com offer stated €70... We were afraid to use the small elevator, and the other one was out of order. The only real advantages were the location and the quiet surroundings, which are worth two stars. I do not recommend it!

author: Holly K
title: Very bad.
text: Stay in February 2025, room standard.Hotel not 4 , but rather 2 stars. The room is old,shabby furniture,dirty walls, bathroom cracks, view to dirty and dark courtyard, no TV stand and luggage, plumbing terrible hums and noises when putting water in the tank. The food for 3 is normal, not very good, but you can eat. The only good location near the train station. I definitely won't go again and recommend it.

author: Poppy Q
title: Ideal location close to the train station and close to all transport
text:
Simple but sufficient room that could use a little refreshment. Very clean. 4 stars local standards so nothing to do with France... decor a little old and tv the same but small fridge and large bathroom (bath) with shower gel, shampoo, soap, beauty kit, toothbrush, toothpaste, tissue box, and slippers (rare to have all this). Replenishment every day. 
If possible do not take a room on the street as very noisy. 
Very good breakfast with different breads of savory (bacon, ham, sausages, scrambled eggs, tomatoes, edam) sweet (very sweet, but which corresponds to what it does in Italy with Italian pastries , jams, honey, butter, various cakes, fruits).
Pleasant staff especially the bar lady (morning). On the other hand does not speak French contrary to what is noted in the description.

author: Rosie Z
title: Looks very different from photos
text:
The room looked nothing like it did in the photos. It was very small and there was nowhere for my girlfriend to do her makeup in the evenings. The bed was very uncomfortable, we may as well have been sleeping on the floor. The bathroom was also a lot cheaper looking than advertised in photos. The blankets were very thin for December and we could wake up in the morning freezing cold. As well as this there was scuff marks all over the walls which were in desperate need of a lick of paint for this hotel to be able to claim to be a 4 star. 

The worst problem with the room however was how thin the walls were. We could hear every conversation the man in the room beside us was having on the phone, so much that it sounded as if he was in the room with us. One morning we even got woken up from him coughing at 7am. We could also hear every time he used the bathroom. Our own toilet was also very loud and we had to keep the bathroom door closed every night before going to bed.

Another flaw with this hotel is the elevators. There was 2 elevators but only 1 worked for the 5 days we were there. And the one that worked did not seem one bit safe. As soon as you take a step in it goes down a few inches and when it starts to go up it jolts back down. Definitely the most unsafe elevator I have ever come across.

Another thing that lets the hotel down is the breakfast. The only hot food is sausages, scrambled egg and bacon. One morning all of this was cold and another morning there was no egg. The pastries were nice but it seems like they only put out 2 at a time, so they were usually gone. 

The staff seemed to be the only good thing about this hotel. We would not return.

author: Dylan X
title: Suited our needs
text:
Spent 3 nights here while in Rome. Front desk staff was awesome particularly Serena who was patient, answered MANY questions and arranged our 3am airport transfer. Hotel is a 10 minute walk from the train station and close to the Metro which takes you to all the main sights.
Breakfast was good with lots of variety. Several nice restaurants nearby for dinner.

author: Giulia T
title: Poorly Maintained, Minimal Service
text: This modest hotel has some major maintenance issues.  The air conditioner in our room never worked and the only solution offered was to open the windows.  We had no water the first night - no sink, no toilet, no shower.  The first night there was no power in half of the lobby.  The computer in the lobby never worked.  No coffee in the room, and they would not provide coffee from the breakfast area (despite the hotel guidebook listing which offered it).  Not close to any attractions.

author: Erin R
title: Great Service!
text: My daughter and I did an Italy Tour in October, we stayed 3 nights at this hotel in Rome.  The hotel was average, the shower was really small, however, the room/hotel was clean.  The complimentary breakfast was fabulous!!! And the front desk service was EXCELLENT!  We have to give a big Shout-Out to Nasser, he was awesome!  He always welcomed us back to the hotel, gave us restaurant recommendations and helped us with anything we needed. The hotel was only about a 15 minute walk to the train station which was convenient for us to walk there with our luggage to take the train to Florence.  No issues!

author: Isabella R
title: WORST STAY EVER
text:
WORST HOTEL EVER
TO AVOID AT ALL COSTS !!!
We paid our stay in full but due to medical reason (my wife's pregancy) we have had to cancel our stay and they simply refused to refund even a small part of our 5-night stay... what kind of business is this , not even showing the most basic form of Human understanding !

author: Brooke D
title: First family trip to Rome
text: Just returned back from a fantastic family 4 night stay here. We booked a quadruple room as we have 2 older kids. Both had separate beds. The location is great, we got taxis to the venues which reception will help get for you and then would walk back. The colosseum is around 30 minutes walk and Vatican Museum just over an hour. The breakfast is excellent, one of the best I've had so much selection, even my fussy daughter found something to have. Fresh fruits, yogurts, eggs, croissants and more. Cold fresh water and sparkling water is free so bring a reusable bottle to refill, you will need one if you visit in summer, the heat is no joke but the rooms do have AC which is nice to return to. There's toothbrushes in the room with a small toothpaste in each. There's a kettle in the room with teas and coffee. Overall this was a fantastic hotel with welcoming staff. I would definitely recommend this hotel.

author: Pablo U
title: Lovely hotel
text:
Really lovely hotel. Clean, friendly, good metro connections, great for termini.

Nothing was too much of a problem. 
Room was clean, comfortable (no fridge), great shower, effective aircon, regularly freshened up if needed and well decorated. We were ‘room only’ guests so I can’t comment on the food but it smelt good.

We were allowed to check in slightly earlier than expected and we could  leave luggage with them on the day of our departure.  English speaking and happy to advise.

It’s quite near the man station which is great for travel but I would advise using the metro to get to the tourist destinations (it’s walkable though). We felt safe enough but I wouldn’t walk around on my own after 9pm (female).

We even were able to order in food for my teenagers.

I would definitely stay here again.

author: Liam K
title: The hotel is great.
text: Excellent hotel in the centre of attractions and very close to Termini Station. The hotel is above average and very decent, the breakfasts were great. It turned out to be a great holiday in Italy and the first introduction took place and started with such a beautiful hotel.

author: Tyler F
title: Great Hotel
text: I stayed at this hotel about 2 weeks ago for a couple of days with my dad, and it was very nice. The location of the hotel is very good since it's very close to a lot of the old historical buildings I was looking forward to seeing. The rooms were very clean and comfortable, they even allowed us to keep a spare card to keep the AC running while I was out sightseeing. The receptionists were also very kind and helpful, informing us about where to find any places, including nearby restaurants or convenience stores.

author: Ella E
title: Impressed
text: Room was hot, but the that was the only fault I could see. They even gave us a complementary wine (I cannot actually drink, but it’s the thought that counts). The service was friendly and helpful. I’m honestly I’m impressed.

author: George F
title: The BEST hotel I’ve stayed in.
text:
Hotel Canada is, quite simply, the best hotel I have stayed in. It is the perfect boutique hotel, beautifully restored in a charming terrace. The decor suggests the splendour of a past era with beautifully painted ceilings not only in public rooms but also in our junior suite. I understand they are historic. Elsewhere walls are highlighted in trompe-l’oeil panelling. The furniture and other furnishings match the decor, again in the bedrooms and suites. What a pleasure to sit in the lounge or on the small terrace (used by smokers but tolerably so) or in the delightful bar which serves light snacks, extremely pleasant and very reasonably priced wines and other drinks - I recommend a night cap of one of their excellent grappas. Relaxing in our suite was also such a pleasure. The walk-in shower in the two part, perfectly designed en suite was excellent. And we slept well, the windows dulling the minimal street noise. 
An extensive breakfast buffet with a wide range of cold dishes and some hot dishes, bakery goods, cereals and juices was available in the lovely, bright (windows along two walls) room decorated in the style of the property. Hot drinks are ordered at the table. 
But best of all is that this is family owned, family managed by the third generation who have cared for this property and hotel. Their attention to detail and to managing the hotel with a focus not just on their heritage but also on the customer’s comfort is apparent every where. And the staff we interacted with reflect that philosophy. 
One irritation, as pointed out by my husband in another review, was the fact that the entrance has several steps from the street and no clear way to request help with the big, heavy cases we had. A simple sign at a bell push would suffice. 
This is an hotel I’d love to return to and I seldom say that. It was a perfect end to our European holiday and a wonderful place to stay in Rome. 
This is an hotel that

author: Chloe M
title: BEST hotel in rome
text: Amazing location, superb staff and the room was epic

author: Andrea M
title: LOVE it !
text:
We enjoyed 3 nights at this family run splendid hotel, on second floor in room 220, with its 2 painted ceilings and antique furniture .
The room is actually a suite 2 TV’s, and the walk in shower and wash room are like the hotel TOP quality and so well fitted out and cleaned. There are 2 small lifts.
The only thing wrong was that there is no front door bell for assistance, we had to carry our large cases in, yet there is help taking bags to the room!
The breakfast room large and charming, with some hot and masses of good cold food.
Hot drinks served at table.
Don’t miss the charming bar with great wine list, and the little courtyard “garden” space off the bar.
They sell stick ices, and ham/cheese toasted things.
We would love to stay here again.
(The hotel will sell you Greenline hop on bus tickets, but maybe the Red bus would be better ?)

author: Morgan P
title: Great
text: The hotel was clean, modern, and comfortable, with rooms so spacious I briefly considered charging myself rent. The staff were friendly and helpful, always greeting us with a smile. We skipped the hotel breakfast each morning, so I can’t comment on the food, but I can comment on walking—because we did plenty of it! The hotel was a bit further from Rome’s city centre than expected. By the time we reached the main attractions, my fitness tracker thought I was training for a marathon. That said, it was a pleasant stay overall, and at least I came home with stronger legs and a clear conscience after all the pasta and gelato! 🍝🍦

author: Michael M
title: Beautiful hotel with great amenities - you will want to stay here!
text:
Beautiful Rome hotel in an excellent location, near the train station and Metro. Gorgeous older building with excellent modern amenities, even ac that knows whether windows are open. Beautiful bathroom with walk-in shower. Great breakfast, well worth it. Excellent staff, who remembered our room numbers (we had to turn in the key when leaving the building) and was always friendly and happy when dealing with all of the tourists! My wife and I were on our honeymoon and the staff left a bottle of champagne in our room - a very nice touch. 

We were very lucky with our hotel choices on this trip, and I would strongly recommend Hotel Canada. We will stay here anytime we are in Rome - we found a new home away from home!

author: Poppy S
title: An excellent stay in Rome in a quality hotel!
text: Located not far from Termini and castro pretorio , an excellent hotel! A comfortable room for the three of us, a very good breakfast buffet and a particularly friendly and efficient staff.

author: Rosie I
title: Great spot to start a Roman holiday
text:
Situated on the periphery of Rome this hotel is placed in a unique and exclusive spot amongst some very classy and beautiful restaurants 
The staff are very helpful and courteous here. A family run hotel for 3 generations and it shows with the quality of the place
Journeys to the main attractions of Rome are easily achievable by taxi and tour bus for very reasonable prices. Be sure to book as much as you can in advance to experience the most relaxing and stress free visit to the hotel and also the attractions.

author: James P
title: Treated like family
text:
5/5 ★★★★★ Treated like family at Hotel Canada Rome

We stayed 5 nights at Hotel Canada, Via Vicenza Rome,and it was everything you want in Rome.

Great location — Perfect base in the historic center. Minutes from metro and bus connections that take you all over this beautiful city.

Lovely rooms — Clean, comfortable, classic Roman style with modern touches. Great beds,brilliant shower, and we slept so well.

Staff made us welcome from check-in to check-out. They helped us with two birthday celebrations during our stay — organizing cakes,and drinks.

They recommended places to eat and visit that made the trip. Local trattorias, hidden piazzas, the good gelato — not the tourist stuff.

Special mention to Alber at reception, Simone the barman, housekeeping, the breakfast team, and the porters — who made our stay a comfortable and memorable one. We were genuinely treated like family by everyone.

Definitely return. If you want the real Rome with proper hospitality and easy transport, stay here. Grazie di cuore to the whole Hotel Canada team.

author: Alexander G
title: 2adults and a teenager family trip
text:
I recently stayed at Hotel Canada in Rome and couldn’t have been happier with my experience. From the moment I arrived, the staff were incredibly welcoming, helpful, and genuinely attentive.

The hotel itself is charming, with a classic Italian style.  Our room for 3 people was large and the room was spotless, comfortable, and well equipped, with everything I needed (tea/coffee making facilities and toiletries).  The bed was comfortable.

It’s perfectly situated within walking distance of major attractions and close to public transport. We didn’t use any public transport and walked all attractions. 

Breakfast each morning was fresh with a good variety to suit different tastes. Pistatio filled croissants were amazing!! 

The hotel bar is also great for a night cap after a long day

author: David O
title: A very comfortable and friendly place to stay
text:
Somewhat small, centrally located very well managed hotel. Very clean, friendly staff, very organized. 
Great breakfast, and in the evening a great place for a cocktail. We came back and enjoyed a nice bottle of wine in the evening with reasonable prices.
Easy to get to places, and the staff is very helpful to set you up with transportation or directions.

author: Sara X
title: An exceptionally high quality hotel and staff, in a superb location.
text:
The hotel is in a superb location to get to and from the airport, and all tourist attractions, which are all within easy reach, including all modes of public transport, including regional trains, the metro, buses, and the airport transfer coaches too.  The hotel is just a short walk from where the airport transfer coaches stop. We felt safe in the vicinity of where this hotel is based, and everything is close by, including shops, restaurants and major tourist attractions. 

The hotel itself stands out for it's excellent customer service with warm, welcoming and friendly staff, impeccable cleanliness and comfortable rooms including the bathroom and balcony too. Despite being a three star hotel, the service we experienced was better than the five star hotels we have stayed in. We were always greeted with such lovely, warm, welcoming and such helpful staff at all hours of the day or night, who were always ready to help, and who catered for all of our needs. All of the staff were so knowledgeable and helpful with any queries about the hotel, our room, the local and wider area, with great ideas and recommendations to enhance our stay, and plan future stays too. A special thank you to Leonardo, Arbel and Jesus who we really appreciated throughout our stay for their excellent customer service, and their warm welcome to the hotel. All three of them were very welcoming, warm and friendly, and they are very experienced and knowledgeable members of staff about the hotel, Rome and wider area whatever your interest, and they made very good recommendations, and it is thanks to their excellence and such a beautiful and clean hotel that we would definitely return to this hotel.

Every aspect of this hotel and the room we stayed in has been thoughtfully curated, for example the clever lighting, mirrors, beautiful furnishings, the use of neutral but warming colours, with a beautiful splash of colour with the incredibly comfy chairs in the room. We loved the antique style mirror and wooden tables and desk in the bedroom. The marvellous marble bathrooms are something special with such clever lighting, and built in safety feature in the shower. The towels and bath mat were of the softest and highest quality we've ever experienced, as was the daily housekeeping. The decor around the hotel and the room is absolutely stunning and spotless. The hotel provided exceptionally high quality essentials in the room, for example slippers, toothbrushes and great tasting toothpaste, shower cap, tissues, hand wash/shower gel and moisturising lotion too, a hair dryer, a safe, a fridge with water when we got there, as well as all amenities to have tea or coffee in the room and tumblers for cold drinks too. There is plenty of storage for clothes and other items, a desk and table in the room too. Everything in the room and balcony and around the hotel was just so incredibly clean. We were lucky enough to have a wonderful large balcony to enjoy during our stay, which we really appreciated. This hotel really is a gem of a hotel as are the staff too. The breakfast is more than adequate, well priced and available until 10.30am. 

We were lucky enough to have stayed in a Twin Bedded Comfort Room, which was exceptional due to the level of detail that has gone in to making the room extremely comfortable as well as practical, including the bed and all of the furniture and a beautiful bathroom and large balcony, in a quiet part of the hotel and local area. The beds and chairs in the room were very comfortable. The lighting in the room was clever and there is no shortage of mirrors. The cleaning was flawless every day. I loved all of the additional extras provided for our use while we stayed there, a really nice touch.

author: Rosie N
title: Great, friendly hotel
text:
We had a great stay to see the sights. Hotel was spotlessly clean, with unfailingly friendly and helpful staff, comfortable beds and pillows, decent size rooms. 
Would be good to have a small fridge in the room, but we managed and the lack of this wasn't a problem. The bar staff were happy to provide a small pot of cold milk for a cuppa, which kept fine in the room from the evening until next morning. There was a tray for tea and coffee, with a decent selection, but I prefer fresh milk rather than the tiny pots provided on the tray. 
Hotel was great value for money. Breakfast was good with a wide selection of various foods and all delicious. 
Location - a quieter area, so we were not disturbed by noisy nightlife or sirens / traffic noise. However, it is a minimum 30 minute walk from the closest of the main sights (Trevi and the Collosuem). Main train and metro station Termini is only 7 minutes' walk. Taxis were reasonable for the 4 of us - from 9 to 18 euros depending on traffic to the busier areas. 
The doors are not very soundproof, so we could hear people in the corridors and the cleaners at work from 8.00 each morning. 
Overall really happy with our stay and would definitely return.

author: Dylan D
title: Very good for a 3 star
text: For a 3 star hotel it really does excel beyond its rating, the staff are excellent and attentive, as the hotel is an older style building they have managed to do the best they can, if I had a criticism it would be noise coming from the rooms located either side, it could be intrusive. Bed was very comfortable, and the bathroom was stocked with everything you would need including spare toothbrush, the only downside is its location, that is not the hotels fault but Rome can be a bit grubby with litter.

author: Nora H
title: Great Experience
text: We very much enjoyed our Junior Suite, which we found to be spacious and comfortable for our 12-night stay, including a huge bed, a large mini fridge and two big windows—one in the bedroom area and one in the sitting-room area—that opened. The shower was large, as well, with a wonderfully consistent supply of plentiful hot water. Breakfast featured numerous choices, and the hotel sent a lovely amenity to our room to commemorate our wedding anniversary. Best of all, the hotel staff members were extremely cordial and helpful. A nearby Pam Local store sold toiletries and groceries, including high-quality prepackaged salads. The Castro Pretorio metro station was right down the street from the hotel, and felt calmer and safer than the Termini station, while allowing us to easily reach attractions such as the Colosseum and Testaccio market. We did walk about 15 minutes to Termini one day to access a luggage store, electronics store, pharmacy and sundries/novelties store all in one complex. Hotel Canada’s location, with nearby free parking, was also convenient for a driver to pick us up for day-trip visits to Florence, the Appian Way/Aqueducts/Castel Gandolfo, and Tivoli and Umbria, and to transfer us to the Civitavecchia cruise port at the end of our Rome stay. We would definitely choose Hotel Canada again as our wonderful base for exploring Rome and day-trip destinations.

author: Oliver P
title: Top hotel in rome with best team
text: Top hotel! Top personnel so kind, very nice team. 10 min away by car from centro istorico. Nice breakfast, spacious and ergonomic room. Bravo to all!

author: Tyler E
title: Great staff
text:
We had a great stay at this hotel! There were three of us sharing one room with one double bed and one single bed, and the room was surprisingly spacious. We had plenty of room for all our luggage without feeling cramped at all.
The room was clean and comfortable, and the bathroom was spotless too. The staff were also very welcoming and friendly. Overall, a really pleasant stay and we would happily stay here again!

author: Ruby C
title: Excellent!!!!!!! Highly recommend
text:
I had a wonderful stay at Hotel Trettone! The staff were professional, incredibly helpful, and always polite, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The buffet breakfast was excellent, with a wide variety of delicious options to suit everyone.
The hotel was spotless, the rooms were spacious and comfortable, and the beds were amazingly comfortable, ensuring a great night’s sleep. The shower had fantastic water pressure and the temperature was perfect every time.
The location is another huge advantage—it’s ideal for exploring Rome, with many attractions within easy reach. If I come back to Rome in the future, I will definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

author: Alice H
title: Hotel in the center that I recommend
text:
Hotel in the city center, very kind staff, room with all the comforts, including a kettle for coffee and other hot drinks. Minibar with water offered by the property.
Air conditioning, comfortable bathroom with shower. Very clean environment, both the room and the common areas. Breakfast room on the top floor, very beautiful with a self-service international breakfast. The hotel is located in the center, very convenient in terms of location; I absolutely recommend it.

author: Oliver J
title: Gave me a standard room even though I paid for a superior room
text:
Hotel was okay.  I reserved and paid for 2 rooms, a superior room for my husband and I and a standard room for my adult children.  The superior room was clearly not a superior room.  It hadn’t been remodeled in over 30 years and looked almost the same as my Childrens standard room.  The hotel staff did not offer to refund the difference between a superior and standard room.  I would not advise paying extra for a superior room.

The “superior” room faced the busy street and it was loud even with the window closed.  Fortunately, we were tired and did not let the noise bother us.  The breakfast was great.

author: Michael Q
title: For those with few needs. You pick him for the position and nothing more.
text:
Hotel all stairs and steps, not very functional elevator does not eliminate the luggage lift or entrance to reach the check-in desk or the floors.
Staff are nice and smiling, but indifferent to requests and wishes made explicit when booking or other problems that arise in the stay related to the rooms.   "We're all booked! That's it!" seems to be the receptionist's mood.
Rooms that would need more care from whitewashing to restoring the padding of the bathroom doors.  
Very stiff and low beds. 
Bad value for money when referred to the services and environments proposed to be a three star. You only pay for the position! For the same amount if you go 200 meters you get much more (unfortunately they were already full).

author: Sara O
title: Great location and service
text: Great location and service. Very close to attractions with easy bus access. The staff were professional and welcoming. Note: I’d recommend bringing slippers if you prefer not to wear shoes indoors.

author: Julien F
title: Excellent option steps from Trevi Fountain
text: Very good location, two minutes from Trevi Fountain, Via del Corso. Excellent breakfast and view from the hotel. Very comfortable and well equipped rooms. Very friendly staff. Very good experience!

author: Ruby E
title: Lovely hotel in the heart of Rome
text: Location location location!!! It just cannot get any better. Everywhere was within walking distance and a lovely walk at that. The staff were all very helpful with tasteful rooms and renovated bathrooms. Definitely very good value for money.

author: Hannah K
title: BED BUGS!!!!
text: We stayed for 3 nights. When we checked in, we noticed the room was extremely dusty and it looked like no one had stayed in it for a very long time. My husband went straight to check in to complain and they said they are completely full and we have “the best room in the hotel”. It was not dusted for the duration of our 3 day stay. On the last day of our trip we woke up with bug bites on my kids and I. We did not realise they were bed bug bites until we googled it in the taxi on the way to the airport. When we got home we had to throw out our luggage and belongings as they are so contagious! My husband emailed the hotel and heard nothing back for a week. He had to keep hounding them to let them know there was bed bugs and they simply replied that it must have been mosquitos in the room. Absolutely horrible hotel and management!

author: Anna G
title: To evaluate
text:
The hotel is located on busy street, almost avenue. It can be a little loud. The room is small. No balcony. Comfortable bathroom. 
Breakfast is varied and complete. Access to the flats is by lift, although there are steps to access the lobby. 
The hotel has no living room or communal area. The reception is 24 hours. 
A block and a half from the Trevi Fountain, very busy area.

author: Marco D
title: a little jewel in the heart of Rome
text:
I stayed at Hotel Tritone on two occasions in October, and I can only talk about it very well. Impeccable location, a few steps from the Trevi Fountain and the most picturesque streets of the city: perfect for those who love to breathe the real Rome, but without sacrificing tranquility.

The room was cozy, clean and cared for in every detail, quiet and bright.

Special thanks to the staff, always smiling and helpful: I felt welcomed with kindness and attention, even with my little dog, who was treated like a little guest of honor

A refined, central and pet-friendly hotel, where you can breathe authentic hospitality. I will definitely be back.

author: Nora Q
title: VERY NICE
text:
We had a pleasant stay at the hotel le Tritone. 
The hotel is very well placed, a few steps from the Trevi Fountain. 
The staff is very friendly. 
We couldn't run the air conditioning, we could have asked the Welcoming to come. 
The hotel was in a busy area and close to a street, so there was product on the street. 
I recommend this hotel.

author: Rosie A
title: A few days stay in Rome.
text: Stayed in Rome a few days prior to cruise.  Tritone Hotel is within walking distance to many of Rome’s attractions.  Staff was very friendly, helpful.  Rooms were very nice, clean.  Plenty of delicious food choices for breakfast.

author: Daniel P
title: Great location
text: Good hotel, great location and larger room. Excellent staff, friendly & helpful. Good fresh breakfast on fifth floor.

author: Charlie E
title: Perfect hotel in a perfect location
text: This hotel was absolutely perfect for our visit to Rome. Centrally located just around the corner from the Trevi Fountain. We booked a suite on the fourth floor which was a good size for our family with two rooms, plenty wardrobe space and a good sized bathroom. The air conditioning was very welcome after escaping the heat of Rome. The complimentary bottles of wine and chocolate were a lovely touch and very kind. Breakfast was served on the top floor in a lovely room with views of Rome with a selection of pasties and hot food on offer. All the staff were very welcoming and polite and I would definitely return to this hotel if we were to visit Rome again.

author: Ana J
title: Highly recommended!
text:
Beautiful hotel, location and cleanliness. Super comfortable beds and excellent care!
Ideal location steps from Trevi plumbing and shopping area.

author: Abigail Y
title: Not recommended!
text: The only positive thing about it is the central location. I came with the kids and we were at the market, we checked out, we walked into the room and the cleaner who forgot her cell phone, just opened the door without knocking. The beds were terrible, mattresses like discs and terrible noise, a small shower the size of a cell in prison.

author: Ella T
title: Small Hotel Charm with Big Hotel Benefits
text: Nice hotel and different to the usual big brand hotels. There was something quaint about it. The staff were friendly and the hotel was clean. Breakfast was typically continental but no sign of gluten free food. However, we didn't ask for gluten free but usually, hotels that offer gluten free have signs indicating it. The hotel had great air conditioning and was really well located. It had a small hotel charm but still offered everything that big hotels offer.

author: Evan L
title: Helpful staff, wonderful location
text:
The hotel is in a perfect location - we walked everywhere. 
The room was comfortable and has everything we needed. The bathroom was a little tired and in need of updating but no problems. 
The breakfast was very good. 
The staff on reception were fantastic - always friendly and helpful. Nothing was too much for them.

author: Joseph P
title: 5 floor and no A/c
text:
Walk in to the room with out air conditioning on June 13 when outside was 38 degree and was told they did not know that A/c not working. Cleaning person just clean this room
 And did not tell them? Horrible experience will never stay at this place ever again

author: Henry Y
title: Unpleasant and unsafe
text: Bad experience and not recommended at all. On the first day, they entered the room without permission, and all they did was make the bed and steal a jacket from the closet. From the very first moment, it generated distrust; we had to carry our belongings and documents with us, total distrust. Regarding the service, the breakfast was very scarce: sliced bread and cheese, industrial pastries, and a machine coffee that is preferable to that of a hospital, in addition to a waitress who made you feel observed about what you added to your plate. The room had little ventilation and was dirty (marks on the walls) and various insects like spiders and mosquitoes. In short, I would not return due to the anger and distrust of the hotel staff, poor breakfast, and conditions. I regret writing this review; keep looking for more hotels to spend more comfortable days in Rome.

author: Gavin C
title: Shocking
text:
Location was awful but that’s my fault - I thought booking near the termini would be good for getting about …there was graffiti where ever you looked and just felt dirty ….
Staff were very unhelpful - especially the breakfast lady and one lady on reception , felt like I was putting them out every time I asked a question or collected my room key (room key MUST be left at reception when leaving the building)
Rooms WOW very basic room 113 was like a shoe box, very tatty furniture (chair, dresser and a little table ) the chair was filthy the furniture battered two single beds put together to make a double that kept separating…. However the room/beds were clean can’t fault the housekeeping …
When we arrived we had no tea/coffee facilities…. A fridge that didn’t work .Just awful I would not recommend at all….
I cried when I arrived as I was so disappointed- I didn’t expect it to be all singing and dancing however I did expect a decent room

author: Poppy W
title: Terrible experience that ruined my visit to such a beautiful city
text:
Terrible room, my photos do not match the sites photos.  Door lock worked but look at the picture. Cracks in tiled floor, not good underfoot. Poorly tiled bathroom, small flush on toilet not working. Room needs painting. I avoided staying in the room as much as I could. Noisy after midnight. Bad experience that ruined my visit to beautiful Rome.
Booked from a hotel search site, but it is not possible to review with them ?? 
Requested room change but was told they were full.
Breakfast mediocre, resorted to a 6 euro breakfast nearby. Friendly staff. Room cleaned every day. They were the reason why I gave it 2 stars instead of 1.

author: Kyle R
title: Three stars but it doesn't deserve one
text: Dirty hotel, unsympathetic staff, dilapidated rooms, television not working, breakfast no comment! Wouldn't even go back for free

author: Harper P
title: Hotel with a terrible breakfast and murdered rooms
text: So here we go. The hotel is located close to Termini Station , well this is where the advantages of the hotel and end . Instead of room standard double , provided room with one small bed, to my question why I am provided room of another category , referred that they cannot change the room because there are no places . The room is shaky, of course. The windows overlook the courtyard, from the road is very noisy even when the window is closed. The walls are all scratched, the bed is all stained, the mattress is stained, the bed linen and towels are clean. Regarding hygiene supplies, you can say they are not ( take yours ), give mini shampoo, mini gel and soap (but when cleaning do not replenish much ). Floors wipe so well, there is no particular cleanliness. No slippers either. The room declared a fridge, it wasn't there... just a minibar and that was it. As for breakfast, very scarce and not delicious. Very thinly cut cheese and smeared on the nastiness of mortadella , some pastries (but it is covered in sugar and it is impossible to eat it), coffee bitter and not delicious (although from coffee machine ). Replenish rarely buffet, come late and you get leftovers and need to wait for the plate, they are in short supply. As for the guests, they will not allow you to bring the reception because if you booked room 1 here and live alone. Wanted to go out after 12:00 a.m. ... well, that's your problem as you get back to the hotel (it's closed for the night , the gates are really closed and not allowed in ), although it says the reception is open 24/7. ... experience is not great, the hotel does not recommend.

author: Marco Q
title: Bad experience!!
text:
Completely outdated hotel, old and poorly equipped rooms, painful breakfast, poor service!!
Save yourself the location which is very good!!    Need investment!!

author: Louis E
title: Hell on earth
text:
Horrible experience, terrible staff.
Upon our arrival, the reception staff refused to accommodate me and my daughter. I was told that my reservation made through booking.com didn't have my full name. The reception guy told me that I won't get my pre-paid room until I sort it out. I showed him my reservatin confirmation with full name and my date of birth, I even downloaded the invoice with full name, DOB, payment details - not interested at all. I was hopeless and devastated. After a while he called his colleague and let us in 1.5h later. This was so unnecesary from them, so unfriendly. I felt unwelcome and I was treated like a piece of rubbish. They were so rude.

Breafast staff - two ladies should learn some manners too. One morning they yelled at a guest who pulled a coffee cup from the machine too early and the had to clean the drain. Next morning the other lady yelled at me because I made 4 toasts. 2 for me and two for my daughter. I say what on earth is wrong with the employees.
Such anger in their eyes. Scary!

author: Wyatt N
title: Absolute disaster
text:
The hotel 50 years ago must have been good, for some details it still contains. It is now very old, because it has not been renovated, even in details that are easy. You can tell there is not the least interest.
The safe in the room cannot be used because it has no batteries, no one has taken care of putting them.
The fridge is unplugged. 
Sometimes there is no hot water; it is the fault of the guests, because it works by a tank and if everyone showers at once, it is over.
In one room we could not watch TV because the controller did not correspond to the TV. In the other room, there was no command directly. When we went to claim we were told that you couldn't see it because of an antenna problem, which was a lie to not have to heed the claim. After an argument, surprisingly the antenna problem was fixed right at the same moment that they found control of one of the TVs they had not wanted to search, after half an hour complaining. In the other room I had to follow the antenna problem, because we could not see it because there was no control.
They don't renew the toilet paper in the bathrooms, you have to go to reception to ask for it.
The breakfast buffet is savory with slices of bologna and sandwich cheese. The sweet thing is industrial pastries. Bread is the bad guy's mold, there is no tender bread.
It is a shame, because with a little interest on the part of the management in silly details and at little cost, the hotel, despite being very old, could prove good.

author: Maria M
title: Not as good as you would expect in a normal hotel
text:
We stayed for 4 nights, great location in front of Termini station, both for trains, both for buses and for the metro.
In the evening you have to be very careful about the ugly people who wander in those streets, hotels near supermarkets, ticket offices, tobacconists, taverns/restaurants/bars and not far from the center.
The bathroom door slammed against the bed to open so the space is small, the shower cubicle is small and we did not test if hot water arrived where it arrived in both the sink and the bidet.
In the room there are no bedside tables (at least in ours) but there is a chair (stained and antique) and a wooden table with kettle and some tea bags.... We had read reviews about not closing the windows, instead to us it was the door that could not be closed with warrants seemed broken down... should be fixed for everyone's safety... leaving this out you could hear at any time of day and night the noises the sirens and screams outside or inside the hotel so it is difficult to rest well and without disturbances but at least the bed was comfortable
