A big flaw of the hotel is definitely the breakfast with packaged products... sometimes not fresh croissants, two cold cuts and cheeses that are always the usual, yogurt, coffee maker, hot chocolate, milk and juices.
Please note that sometimes the dishes were stained or dirty ...
The television didn't work when there was television in the room during the time of booking, so we assumed it would work, but no.
I have to say that at the time of our arrival the sheets and blankets were stained, from fatigue we let go but the next day hanging the sign to change the sheets, in addition to having changed them they also washed the bathroom and put clean towels, things that in the following days were not done.
I tried to use the hairdryer but it was half broken, it gave off red light and smells of burning so VERY DANGEROUS....
Also there was a strong stench of cigarettes coming from who knows where.
I recommend it for the strategic location and for the kindness and thoughtfulness of the staff but not for those who want to rest maybe with children and for those who expect a worthy breakfast... especially because for what we spent in 2 with the tourist tax we would find much better and I'm sorry but it was the only option for us
Activities in the area
Metro, clubs, bars, restaurants, station
Security
Bad for not closing the room
Eat and drink
Drinking nothing to say, eating regarding breakfast does not deserve the price paid...

author: Ian W
title: I don't recommend it, I wouldn't even pay myself back
text: Very bad image, reception without knowing Spanish, room deteriorated, we booked double bed and were two 90 beds with bad mattresses, rests heads chipped, dirty toilets, does not swallow water, toilet ceiling with paint chips, no television the whole stay by the broken antenna, closet without being able to close, wifi very very very slow

author: Ethan H
title: Think about it.
text:
We stayed at this hotel with a couple of friends, for two nights.
Very dated hotel.
Positives: large rooms, comfortable mattresses, acceptable cleanliness.
Cons: in both rooms the television did not work and in one room THERE WAS NO hot water!!!
We had read some reviews that mentioned this, but we thought it was a temporary issue. So before check-in we asked, kindly!!, if the problem had been solved: the lady at the reception, very very offended, told us that on reviews they write a lot of things......
They were actually right!! 
One of our rooms had COLD WATER!!
If you decide to stay in this hotel ask for a room with hot water!! 
Unless you like to go around a whole day in Rome and in the evening take a COLD SHOWER in winter!!

author: Ryan Q
title: One of the most disappointing stays in Rome
text: I stayed for two nights at this hotel, friendly staff no doubt, what left me unpleasantly impressed was the room. I enter the room the first thing I see are pierced and dirty curtains, double bed consisting of two single beds practically only a single bed, dirty walls I think the last whitening dates back to remote times, peeling wall and ceiling of the room with patches of water leaks, air intakes I imagine never cleaned by how much fouling you could see, we pass in the bathroom, even here peeling walls and ceiling, the shower door closes but it is not so simple to reopen it, the shower head leaks water from all sides and the shower tray can not drain the water, any buzzer in the shower to be operated in an emergency is wireless so completely unusable and to finish even if it is the least important thing I wanted to see some news on TV, you turn on the TV but does not receive any signal

author: Abigail J
title: Overrated. I don't like it.  Good location the unique
text: The only good thing is the location near Termini . Service from the bad hotel. Regular room uncomfortable bed bad bathroom. Awful breakfast.  Regular reception unkind.  You have two stars left over 🌟 .

author: Amelia Q
title: Το χειροτερο
text: THE WORST BY FAR I HAVE EVER BEEN !!Dirty , toilets door wouldnt close ,the only chair was broken ,toilet seat was broken .After i send them photos and video of the damages they offered me an other room .I went in with the receptionist and tryed to close the showers door ...The door fell down  and they said they would give me a better room next morning ...The "better " third room has only one socket ,no hot water and shower is broken as well . THANK YOU FOR RUINING MY HOLIDAYS !

author: William E
title: No air con in euro heat wave
text: A perfectly fine hotel if there is not a euro heat wave - Rome hit 37° and the rooms don’t have air con. The rooms have a mobile “air con” unit that do not work. I lay awake at night with a wet towel over me in order to cope. It was unbearable and I was reflecting on my life choices with booking this hotel. Breakfast was available but we didn’t partake. Close to the train station which was good.

author: Liam Q
title: We will be back
text: We have used this hotel a few times now and every time we have had no complaints. The staff are really friendly and helpful. Ok it’s a old now and probably could do with a paint job but I found the rooms clean and tidy. We will be using the hotel again has we come to watch the football 3 to 4 times a season.

author: Ella G
title: Avoid this hotel. Don’t be fooled by the photos from the presentation.
text:
Very old hotel. All very degraded mainly the bathrooms. On the morning of the second day the bathroom water above our bathroom dropped all in our bathroom. We had to change rooms.
The sheets are placed without a protection that separates them from the mattress that is old and dirty.
The breakfast is very weak. Bread of one quality and fimbre of the cheapest. 
It does not correspond to a 3-star hotel.
This hotel should have a star or be closed. It's a mistake for tourists.
The only positive point is being close to Termini station, but there are many hotels there nearby.

author: Holly B
title: Hotel de los Horrores
text:
We arrived at the hotel and when we went upstairs to the room, within what we expected, our room at first glance did not seem horrible but it took little time to leave that feeling. 

When we removed the quilt, the downstairs duvet was stained. The fridge had not removed products from the previous housed and when moving the single bed, we saw how the plug of that wall had all the cables on the outside. It was the bed for the little girl, that logically we didn't let her sleep there. 
Dirty curtains unchanged in years and stained. The non-soundproof windows. The headboard of the leather bed shed bits on top of your head if you leaned in. 

The worst came when it came to showering. The water was coming out of the wash and I bideted well, but from the shower it was warm pulling cold... we showered as we could and went down to report what was happening. That we couldn't shower her like that. 

The guy from the reception desk on shift tomorrow (during our stay) told us that we should leave the taps all open, as it is an old building takes time for hot water to arrive. 
When we tried it again it wasn't like that. 
We went down to report and were sent by a technician who could do little with the facility the hotel has. 

We were proposed to change to another room but we found that the water came out even colder. 

That's when it changed. He told us that either we stayed in our room with cold water, where we were offered cold water as well, or they took us to another hotel where we could not have breakfast and we had to come to the hotel to have breakfast and to make the departure on the day of departure. 

Logically, it is not something that seems normal, since if you send me to another hotel it is with all the consequences and services. 

In the end, after 3h, and look with the technician 4 more rooms, only 1 of them had hot (temperate) water. We changed by agreeing to it as it was the last night. 

The transfer we won in water but it is a room with furniture in worse condition, decoration of 1930s and does not have smart TV as we had. The curtains and looks are dirty and the window if you want to open it you keep the handle in your hand. 

Breakfast more than scarce. You have 4 scones, yogurts, cold meat and cheese and only apple juice. 

The attention of the governor and the guy from the hotel reception on late shift has been very good and have been friendly and at all times considerate in every situation. 

The boy from the reception desk on shift tomorrow even when I was at reception in my pajamas, waiting for a solution, started to attend to an arriving client and to do the check in procedure. I had to tell you that it was embarrassing that I had to wait for him to end up with no solution after 2h. 

The girl took a terrible disgust to see us go through this situation. Nobody rewards me for that. Nor the bad taste of travel that leaves us and especially her with how excited she came. 
They have not mentioned having any details with us about what happened, let alone with the girl who kept crying. 

I certainly would never return to this hotel or recommend it to anyone. 
For the price it has there is more for the same area, even on the same street that look better. 

We've felt ripped off. 
Don't go, but you want to meet all this.

author: Manon C
title: NIGHTMARE
text: I do not recommend this dirty hotel the room smelled of cigarettes, sheets and blankets 20 years old. Only thing is close to Termini station, I paid 72 euros just to spend a nightmare and breathe in the smell of tobacco and Mould

author: Grace K
title: Excellent location, great value for money!
text: I feel I have to share the fabulous experience we have had with our daughters here the past three days. I booked this trip and hotel as a surprise for my husband's 50th birthday, and to be honest, after reading all the horrible reviews, I regretted having made a reservation here. Boy was I wrong. This hotel is literally just around the corner from the huge central station (trains and busses) in Rome, a place full of shops and restaurants, pharmacies and (tip!) a great bookstore with tons of books in all languages. As you'd expect from ANY station in Europe, there are always fishy things going on at night, and many people of all sorts gather to drink, do drugs, and pick pockets.. If you are aware and careful then the four minute walk between hotel and station should be fine. The staff is lovely, the rooms have wonderfully high ceilings and great beds, our sheets looked brand new, towels were sparkling white, windows opened up to the buzzing streets below, smart tv showed us anything we wanted. Bathroom was perfectly clean, little bags with schampoo and soap were offered, (bath)shower was even better than at home! The breakfast wasn't extravagant, no, but it was there and free of extra charge. You can go elsewhere if you have specific needs for a wholesome morning meal, but here you received yummy delights (cakes, viennoiseries), coffee, yoghurt, cornflakes, white toast, standard cheese, mortadella and ham. (Bring your own veggies if you can't live without them for a few mornings, there are plenty of supermarkets and/or places to eat in the area). All in all please don't hesitate to give this hotel a chance, either they have made major improvements to fix up the place since last year (granted it's still a bit dated but seriously; for this price who cares, as long as it's clean and everything works..?!) or perhaps the previous reviews were made by people who got unlucky with heating, plumbing or hot water (NB: we stayed here end of Jan so can't comment on AC). Speaking for us, we had the best holiday ever in Rome, and this hotel played a big part in the plan and we are very satisfied with everything, so a big thank you to Gabili, Bruno, the lovely dark-haired lady in the kitchen, the cleaners (who btw cleaned/refreshed/replenished daily) and everyone else who worked hard to make our experience so great. Mille grazie, see you next time!

author: Zoe K
title: Marcella Royal hotel Rome
text: We have just had the most amazing holiday staying atThe Marcella Royal Rome the staff was just out of this world so friendly so helpful we went for a special occasion, took our nephew who’s never been to Rome before for his 40th birthday the lady on the reception desk in the hotel she went above and beyond to make that day special for us, she organize the cake, got it to the hotel, and then arranged for it to be presented on our table after we had dinner in their beautiful restaurant where the food is stunning, the hotel is spotlessly clean. The location is very easy for walking distance amazing value at the hotel. The rooms are amazing just love the hotel and all the stuff to be honest not one of them. You could complain about it’s very quiet hotel. everything you require is available at the hotel. I’ve only been back home three days and I miss it already so I look forward to being there next year in the same hotel. Thank you so much once again for making our holiday so easy you’re just amazing.

author: Daisy T
title: Beautiful View & Spot to Wind Down
text: Hotel offered great service and a wonderful view at the rooftop cafe. Perfect for breakfast and winding down the evening with a drink. Also loved the breakfast selection. The location was a convenient walk from the train station, and I'd definitely stay there again.

author: Camille M
title: Great stay
text: Lovely hotel in a great location, easy to walk to attractions but taxis also readily available. Hotel was spotless, the staff were friendly. Excellent breakfast and the view is stunning from the rooftop

author: Aaron G
title: Our honeymoon at the Marcella Royal Hotel
text: We chose the Marcella Royal Hotel to to stay in for our honeymoon. It was lovely! The hotel itself was amazing clean and the room was big and cool, perfect for the intense Rome heat. The were plenty of options for breakfast and the roof terrace was gorgeous in the morning and evening. All of the staff we interacted with were friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend this hotel to stay in

author: Marco S
title: Solo female traveller Rome August 2026
text: Lovely hotel with great amenities, close to Termini station, metro, bus tours etc. I would definitely stay here again. The room was compact but perfect, clean and quiet

author: Isla K
title: Family August 26
text: Lovely staff, good location not hard to find at all. Rooms are plush with upholstered walls, no tea/coffee making in room, but the rooftop terrace is a nice treat.

author: Sophia U
title: Elegant hotel with excellent service
text: In a quiet area about 15 minutes walk to the Trevi Fountain, this elegant, period hotel suited us perfectly. As you would expect from a city centre period property, the rooms are compact but have everything you need. The staff were very welcoming and the local restaurant that the concierge recommended, Calliope, was superb! We only stayed one night but would definitely book this hotel again if we return to Rome.

author: Katie H
title: Macella Hotel Experience
text: Our room was lovely and clean, the staff were very friendly and helpful. The rooftop bar was a hidden gem which we used everyday. Overall a first class experience. Thank you.

author: Amelia L
title: A friendly, comfortable hotel, perfect for a city break.
text: An extremely friendly boutique hotel whose Reception staff couldn’t be more helpful. Their dinner recommendations were great and very reasonable.  The roof top bar was a fabulous place to relax after a busy day’s sightseeing.

author: Claire K
title: Amazing stay
text:
We had an amazing stay at the Marcella Royal Hotel and it will always hold a special place in our hearts.
From the moment we arrived, all the staff were friendly, welcoming and couldn't do enough for us. The hotel was spotless, the rooms were comfortable, and the location was perfect for exploring Rome on foot.
The rooftop bar and restaurant is something really special. The food, drinks, atmosphere and views across Rome made every evening memorable.
But the biggest reason this hotel means so much to us is because it's where I asked my best friend to marry me... and she said yes! It gave us a memory we'll never forget, and we'll always look back on our stay here with a smile.
Thank you to everyone at the Marcella Royal Hotel for helping make our trip so special. We can't wait to come back one day.

author: Jack R
title: Excellent solution in the center of Rome
text: Very clean room. Abundant breakfast on the hotel's rooftop. Very courteous staff. Location just outside the center of Rome, a few minutes' walk from Termini Station and Piazza Barberini and the Trevi Fountain.

author: Paolo S
title: 2 night stay before cruise
text: Had a wonderful 2 nights here before our cruise and the hotel was just perfect! We explained to the reception host we didn't want to eat that night at the hotel and he recommended an alternative and it was just perfect, it made out trip! Hotel very clean, good prices and brilliant location, cannot fault and really would recommend to anyone planning a trip to Rome and we walked to most of Rome's attractions easily from the hotel.  Also, the rooftop bar and restaurant had fantastic views across Rome and is very Romantic. We even saw a couple get engaged on the rooftop! Cannot rate highly enough. Thank you!

author: Charlotte L
title: Great Hotel, highly recommended.
text: Great location for a city break.  Whilst this is not a ‘modern’ hotel it does not disappoint.  The roof top bar is sensational!  Staff were very helpful, pleasant and accommodating.

author: Ruby N
title: Perfect!
text: This was a lovely hotel all round. We were really impressed with how beautiful it is. For what we paid our room was good and the amenities also. Front desk are so incredibly helpful and friendly, and that rooftop bar was amazing for when you needed a little wind down time between outings! Never too busy and very friendly with good cocktails too! Will recommend for sure!

author: Antoine T
title: Wonderful Hotel
text: The Marcella Royal Hotel was wonderful! The Staff were friendly, professional and most welcoming. The decor and furnishings were outstanding in both aesthetics and comfort. Breakfast and dinner on the roof terrace were superb. I would thoroughly and unreservedly recommend this wonderful hotel for every aspect of its service and location. Thank you to you all, we hope to see you again!

author: Henry Z
title: 60th Birthday Celebration Stay
text:
We visited the Marcella Royal Hotel to celebrate my Auntie’s 60th Birthday. We had a lovely stay and thoroughly enjoyed our time at the hotel. The staff were welcoming, friendly, and attentive throughout our visit, which made for a very pleasant experience.

The only exception was Daler, the rooftop bartender, whose attitude was unfortunately quite rude and unwelcoming. This experience was disappointing enough that we chose not to return to the rooftop bar for the remainder of our stay.

Nevertheless, this was an isolated incident and did not overshadow the overall quality of our visit. The hotel itself was excellent, and the rest of the team provided outstanding service. Overall, we had an enjoyable stay and would happily recommend the hotel to others.

author: Aiden L
title: Perfect Location and Beautiful Hotel
text: We visited as a couple at the end of July and the hotel was perfect for a break in Rome. The location is ideal, walkable to most attractions. The hotel itself is beautiful and authentic. The rooms are clean and comfortable. Cleaned, fresh towels and bedding everyday. The staff are really friendly and helpful and the rooftop bar is breathtaking. Just lovely.. There are also some excellent restaurants really close by. Highly recommend.

author: Katie X
title: Rome Holiday 2026
text: I can only say one word. Excellent, from the accommodation to the staff. Would highly recommend based on our experience.

author: Katie G
title: Amazing hotel
text: Visit this hotel for our honeymoon, not that expensive for a 4 star hotel. It was the perfect place for us. Its within 20 mins walk to alot of the main places in Rome. Being that little further out the centre it was quiet at night, even though there is some lovely restaurants nearby. We had a prestige room which was amazing. Clean, bed comfy and bathroom spotless. The rooftop bar is the perfect way to end a busy day. Lovely atmosphere, food is lovely and staff excellent. Breakfast has its own room at the top where you are able to enjoy the views while having a lovely breakfast. Staff were friendly and helpful. Totally recommend and will be coming back when we visit Rome again. Thank you

author: Louis W
title: Great staff clean hotel
text: I’ve never had a shower next to my bed before. The plastic “floor covering” felt unusual to my feet, the flashing moving light was annoying all night long. Otherwise, the place is neat and clean and the staff was excellent. The breakfast buffet had so much to offer and was delicious.

author: Taylor N
title: Great Hotel Choice
text: Great hotel with a friendly staff, clean and spacious rooms, great breakfast, and great location.  They also offer luggage storage if needed.

author: Anna C
title: Rude Staff
text:
Rude staff, small rooms, hotel stinks, closest Cafes are 15-30 min walks. 

Gets recommended by the cruise line, pick another hotel

author: Katie V
title: Mid-level hotel, decent food
text: The dinner snack session and the breakfast were absolutely great. The staff were where the major problems were apparent. Check-in staff were passable, but gave little to no direction for baggage storage prior to check in, then, once it was found, my party was berated for accessing it without permission. Wait staff at breakfast also took no time to clean the area, which made us lose our breakfasts and had to get our food a second time.

author: Manon L
title: A wonderful stay
text: Rafik I am very proud to host you congratulations very good zahira magnificent warm rossella magnificent 🤩 😊😊😊😊

author: Nora Z
title: Blah
text: Checked in at 2pm. Could not cool the room below 25C (77F). Told front desk 3 times, twice in afternoon, once in evening. Never fixed, no other room offered. Hotel is definitely NOT disabled friendly. Multiple stairs to climb just on ground floor. Can’t get to elevator to breakfast room in basement without going up and down sets of stairs. Hotel is clean,  room was spacious but…..      Hotel is not near city center but they do have a free shuttle to get near it.

author: Luke I
title: Excellent breakfast
text: Service is always excellent. Excellent breakfast and very kind staff

author: Holly V
title: Excellent Place to Stay
text: This hotel is top notch; great service, excellent breakfast with a wide variety of items to choose from; they provide a complimentary shuttle to and from the Spanish steps, which is central to lots of shopping and restaurants.

author: Harry V
title: Excellent experience.
text: Excellent customer experience. I was there for work for one day, and they made me feel at home. Top lunch, exceptional breakfast; they make everything themselves. Highly recommended.

author: Paige B
title: Excellent hotel in northern part of the city!
text:
We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. The staff were exceptionally welcoming and helpful throughout our visit. The rooms are spacious, very clean, and cleaned daily. The beds are comfortable, and the sound insulation is excellent, ensuring a quiet and restful night's sleep.

The breakfast area is spacious and pleasant. While the selection is not enormous, it is more than sufficient, with enough variety to start the day well.

The only point worth mentioning is the location, but this is more a matter of personal preference than a drawback of the hotel itself. The hotel is located in the northern part of Rome, about a 15-minute walk from Villa Borghese and 20–25 minutes from Piazza del Popolo. If, like me, you prefer to explore the city entirely on foot, the daily walks to and from the historic center can become quite tiring. However, the hotel is very well connected by public transportation, and for most visitors this is unlikely to be an issue.

Overall, an excellent hotel that I would happily recommend.

author: Pierre I
title: Recommended
text: Nice location, just outside the city. Friendly atmosphere, rich breakfast, nice rooms, rooftop restaurant also recommended.

author: Evie K
title: Wonderful Rome
text:
We just finished a week's vacation in Rome. Stayed at Radisson Blu, an extremely pleasant and nice experience. 
The hotel is very central to public transportation, on the left we had the light rail and on the right city bus, so you could quickly get to the city easily. Really nice breakfast with mass are options, as well as helpful and smiling staff. The first room was not good enough, but room number two was over the top. Will visit the hotel again.

author: Jessica T
title: Good location
text: Stayed as part of a cruise . Rooms small but clean enough . Bathroom large shower area . Small desk and chair . View of street . Breakfast ok nothing to write home about . Had dinner in hotel restaurant lovely but expensive . Roof top bar €24 for two cocktails good location for sites

author: Ella Z
title: Great value for money!
text:
We stayed one night in this hotel before our cruise, great location and the room was lovely, clean and had everything we needed.
We had a drink in the rooftop restaurant which had a lovely ambience and night time view.
Breakfast the next morning was very good, with lots of choice and set us up for the day, B&b was great value!
The highlight for us was the concierge Massimiliano, who could not be more helpful. He got us a early check in which was much appreciated as we had a very early start that day! He reserved a table for us at a nearby restaurant for dinner and organised a golf cart tour of Rome for us, which was fabulous 👌 He also checked in with us to insure we were enjoying ourselves, top marks to this man, a great ambassador for Radisson Blu Rome!

author: Ella M
title: Kudos to Massimiliano Varchi
text: This is truly a beautiful hotel with exceptional people that work there. In particular, I would like to give praise to the absolute best concierge I have ever had the pleasure of working with. His name is Massimiliano Varchi. Massimiliano works tirelessly and goes above and beyond for his customers. He does this with a smile and a pleasantness that is unusual in today’s society. If you stay here, make sure you stop by his desk and say hi. He made our stay one to remember. Thank you Massimiliano for everything.

author: William X
title: Wonderful experience
text: Very friendly staff and the breakfast was very good as well

author: James T
title: A beautiful first time.
text:
I often stay in Rome, but this was my first time at the Radisson. We stayed for two nights with family and friends for a wedding, and I believe it will become my Roman hotel! 
Elegant structure, spacious and clean rooms, good and varied breakfast, and a splendid rooftop on the top floor. 
The staff is also particularly kind and welcoming; you feel at home right away. 
A special mention for Alessandro, who welcomed us at the reception and quickly assigned us our room, showing himself available for any needs. 
We will return soon.

author: Sean E
title: Be nice to customers
text:
We were booked into this hotel prior to our Cruise. Princess Cruises booked us the room.
We arrived around 13.30 and the room wasn’t ready so we left our luggage at the hotel and went out to explore Rome.
We arrived back at 17.00 and was told that our room was ready. We were given instructions on breakfast etc and then given our room number card. We retrieved our luggage and went to the lift. We went to the lift  where we were directed to go and on the floor we couldn’t find our room. We went back to reception and was (in my opinion) rudely told that we used the wrong lift- He said that he told us which lift to use and “he always tells people”. We got to our “upgraded” room to find two twin beds. We were tired from traveling all day and couldn’t be asked to request the bed formation to be changed. I was still upset regarding the rude attitude about using the wrong lift- 
We are both pensioners and had to negotiate steps to the first floor and then second and correct floor.
Apart from this experience the stay was comfortable, quiet and clean. 
However, after breakfast before check out our room was cleaned, bed in queen formation ready for the next guests, I presume. An apology and less arrogant behaviour would have changed my review from a 2 star to a 5 star

author: Diego U
title: Overall we enjoyed our stay…
text:
We stayed at the Radisson Blu GHR in Rome. It was further out from the city centre than expected but it’s not a problem if you are happy to use the Metro or you can use the local taxi service to get you in and around Rome; although be warned this can vary in price; often being between 14 - 25€ each way!
The hotel staff are welcoming and Massimo who works in concierge is very helpful and friendly. He organised us a private golf buggy tour with Roxanna during our stay which was excellent. I would have liked her details so that I could leave her a review too but we don’t have it. She really was an excellent guide around Rome. Thank you to Massimo for organising this and I recommend this to anyone wanting to explore Rome!
I would say that as lovely as the hotel staff are, this hotel was a little overpriced for what you get. The rooms are a little run down in places and in terms of relaxing in the hotel in the day to escape the heat or rest your feet, there is no separate hotel lounge and bar area where you can get a coffee or cold beverage or light snack. There is just the hotel lobby area which is often crowded and the ‘American Bar’ was in constant darkness during the 5 days we were there. Not sure why? When returning each evening from being out in town, it was a little strange having to go up to the roof top restaurant to have a drink. You’d have to sit in the restaurant amongst diners as there was rarely a free table outside as they are limited in space. Not a complaint, just would have been good to enjoy the space and convenience/service of a separate bar/lounge area which you might expect from a hotel of this star rating and price.
We didn’t sample the Roman Restaurant during our stay but we did order food on our first night in the Roof top restaurant which was lovely. The breakfast was also great with a variety of options. 
Overall the hotel is clean, staff are friendly and we enjoyed our stay.

author: Miguel E
title: Excellent stay and impeccable staff.
text: Great experience at the Radisson Blu. The facility is welcoming and well-maintained, but the real added value is the staff: a special thanks to Rossella from Guest Relations for her professionalism, availability, and kindness. Excellent breakfast, with a wide selection of quality products!

author: Pablo S
title: A half week in Rome for business
text:
Upon arriving at the hotel, the room was without a wardrobe, very small, and uncomfortable. There was no soap at the bathroom sink, and the sink drained water slowly; the shower was dangerous, with a high risk of slipping and getting hurt.
The welcome was good, but at the first complaint, it turned out to be terrible.
There was a lot of resistance to changing the room.
The room after the change was particularly dirty and still small.
On the ground floor, there is a bar that seems open, but in reality, it is abandoned.
Only after a long wait were we informed that there is another one on the seventh floor. Everything is too difficult.
I should have stayed another day, but at midnight, when I returned to the hotel with this request to extend my stay, I was told to ask at the front desk the following morning.
In conclusion: 
A feigned collaborative attitude and instead annoyance at any other request.
Quality of services particularly poor. Unacceptable breakfast, except for a very kind waitress, petite and blonde, who was very nice and helpful; the rest of the service was nonexistent.
Impossible to order from the café, impossible to clean the tables and reset them, staff that disappeared or, at most, wandered aimlessly.
Speechless.

author: Mathis W
title: Location-location-location
text: The hotel located in prime location, in the heart of all the attractions. 1 minuet from the Spanish Steps, Via Condotti and Via del corso, and walking distance from all the interesting places .  A lot of restaurants and bars all over the hotel, great place to stay. The room is clean and comfortable, and has all the facilities you need. Very recommend.

author: Morgan K
title: Great Location, but Room Expectations Were Not Met - Via Ripetta 229
text:
This was my second time using this hotel group, which operates a range of hotels and apartments throughout Rome. For this stay, I booked the Ripetta Luxury Apartments on Via Ripetta, near Piazza del Popolo — and the location was excellent.

Via Ripetta is a fantastic area to stay in Rome. It is close enough to walk to many of the main attractions, but far enough away from the chaos and crowds of the busiest areas. The location was definitely one of the highlights of the stay.

The main issue I have experienced with this hotel group, both on this occasion and my previous booking, is that the room you receive does not always seem to match the photos and description of the room category booked. I had booked a Deluxe Suite specifically based on the description and images, including the characteristics of the room, but unfortunately the apartment I received felt quite different and did not have the features I was expecting. When I contacted the hotel, I was advised it was the same room category, but there was still a noticeable difference between what was advertised and what was provided.

One of my key requirements was having a washing machine, and thankfully the apartment did include this, which was very useful. Another nice touch with this hotel group is the complimentary minibar and snacks, which is always appreciated.

Unfortunately, the bed was extremely hard and uncomfortable. I struggled to sleep and had to add extra pillows underneath me to make it more comfortable. On arrival, we also had an issue with the air conditioning. Someone was sent to investigate, but it took quite some time to resolve what was ultimately just a delay in the system starting. It would have been much easier if we had simply been advised of this upfront.

Overall, there are definitely positives — the location is excellent, the apartment concept is convenient, and the complimentary extras are a lovely touch. However, the uncertainty around which room you will actually receive is a significant drawback. With so many accommodation options available in Rome, I would probably look at other properties next time where the room description and experience are more consistent.

author: Luke Q
title: Ariverderci Condotti!
text:
If personal observation is a guide Rome seems to be replete with non-brand name hotels, especially in the so-called “shopping triangle” where Hotel Condotti is located. Word of caution, there’s more than one hotel in the Condotti Group, all within a short distance of each other, so make sure you’re looking at the right one. 
The Condotti Boutique Hotel where we stayed is tiny (it doesn’t have a bar or restaurant - more on this later*) but very nice nonetheless. Our room was on the top floor and was small but modern and well appointed, but no view and no balcony. The best thing about the hotel is its location - within walking distance of numerous branded & non-branded shops, restaurants, grocery shops and iconic attractions including the Colosseum.
*Our package included breakfast which was served in a restaurant around the corner.
Would recommend.

author: Ana I
title: Not to be repeated
text: Very small rooms, small beds. Terrible assistance from the front desk, terrible quality/price ratio.

author: Nora G
title: This will always be our top choice to stay in Rome!
text: Spectacular location. Wonderful service. Clean, lovely apartment. We will always stay here on our visits to Rome! On a beautiful side street literally a block of the Spanish Steps, it's Heaven in Romw!

author: Sofia X
title: When in Rome stay at Condotti!
text: We would recommend this boutique hotel for anyone staying in Roma.  The staff are all wonderful. They respond to any request quickly and they were helpful with all our needs.  Our room was very bright and clean, always.  Daniele, Alessandra, Victor, Elisa, Ludovica and the rest of the staff were all so nice, we felt like we left family behind.  The hotel is located just a couple of blocks from the Spanish Steps, and we found it easy to walk to most of the major attractions.  We spent a week there, and we wish we could have stayed longer.

author: Julien J
title: Very good hotel
text: Great location to main attractions, lots of restaurants and ice cream shops. Friendly staff. Very clean

author: Julien M
title: Hard beds, flat pillows.
text:
Just ok.  
Good location- that’s about it.  
Apartment stay 3 blocks from hotel lobby, breakfast outsourced to different restaurant, hard pillows, harder mattress.  Only one shower- with very low water pressure.  
Apartment sleeps 6 - but two on a sleeper sofa that is old and flat.  Then makes the living room unusable as well. 
2nd bathroom has a tub with hand held sprayer only.  
Choose somewhere else.

author: Evie E
title: Stunning location, but far from 4 stars, not family-friendly, no soundproofing
text:
We stayed 5 nights at the Via della Croce 15 building with a 2-year-old child. The location near the Spanish Steps is genuinely excellent. That is where the positives end.
Accessibility: The building entrance has a raised step threshold with no ramp. Entering with a stroller requires fully lifting it with the child inside dangerous and physically demanding every single time.
Soundproofing: Catastrophic. The entire interior structure is wooden. We heard every footstep, every toilet flush from every floor, every shower, every conversation in the hallway. Hotel staff were moving equipment and storage items in the hallway closet directly next to our room including repeatedly in the middle of the night. We were sleep-deprived for the entire stay.
Breakfast: Outsourced to a third-party restaurant, which conveniently removes accountability from the hotel. Same omelette every day for 5 days. Staff initially refused to provide a portion for our toddler we had to argue to get food for a 2-year-old. Humiliating and unacceptable.
Staff: Pre-arrival communication via WhatsApp was polished and responsive. In person, staff appeared tired, disengaged and burnt out. The warmth was performative.
Bottom line: The 4-star classification is misleading. If you are travelling with young children look elsewhere.

author: Alexander R
title: Recommended
text: The hotel is very central, next to the Plaza de España and the subway entrance. The room is clean, spacious, and very comfortable. The breakfast is good and varied. The owner is very kind.

author: Henry G
title: Boutique Hotel located near the Spanish steps
text: Perfectly located near the Spanish steps, this boutique Hotel delivers exquisite service and goes above and beyond whenever possible. The rooms are spacious and some have balconies with beautiful views of the Roman roof rooftops. I cannot recommend this hotel, highly enough! Great value and service for the money.

author: Evan C
title: Repeat customer but could improve on description to guests.
text:
Location is fabulous! 
We’ve stayed here three times now, travelling from Canada. So just that says a lot! 

I was slightly disappointed this time when I inquired months ahead to reserve I asked if there were two large balcony rooms I could reserve. I was told yes, Both also the same price as they’re superior. 

When I checked in I find out they only have one large terrace room and the other.. I wouldn’t even say it is a balcony... No chairs or table can even fit out there. It’s a Juliet balcony. You can only stand one person on it. If I knew that I would have just booked the cheaper room for the second as they didn’t even compare. 
It was disappointing especially as a repeat customer. 
Regardless. It is a great location, clean rooms and lovely staff

author: Carlos T
title: The best hotel in Italy
text: Excellent: clean, comfortable, near everything. You can walk everywhere: Piazza di Spagna, Spanish Steps, Via Condotti, Via del Corso, etc. We took the metro from Roma Termini to Spagna, then walked for 2 minutes. You can walk everywhere from the hotel. The staff is amazing: I do not remember everyone's names (sorry), but Daniele, Alessandra, Elisa, Linda, and EVERYBODY are super friendly and helpful. The shower is the best, the bed is so comfortable, and I loved the pillows. We will be back for sure. The rooms are well soundproof because you are in the middle of everything, but you do not hear any noise in your room.  The hotel is clean, elegant, and comfortable. The value for money is perfect.
photos: [{"url": "https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/32/ca/92/42/caption.jpg", "caption": "The Rome sky during our last night", "photo_id": "852136514"}]

author: Ethan H
title: Amazing hotel
text:
Good morning everyone,

I would like to extend my sincere thanks to Ms. Alessandra at the reception of Condotti Hotel. I encountered a problem, and it was resolved with great professionalism. She has a truly wonderful human touch.

I would also like to praise this hotel, as it is one of the most beautiful in terms of location and the quality of service. I express my deep gratitude, as Alessandra was part of my beautiful trip to Rome.

Long live Italy and its respectful people.

author: Rosie X
title: Victims of success
text: Unfriendly staff and totally disconnected from guests. Nice facilities and unbeatable location

author: Samuel C
title: Friendly staff does not make it a 4-star hotel
text: The staff was very friendly. But the double room was so small that one person had to go to the bathroom when the other had to pass by. There were no chairs to sit on in the room, and the roof terrace that they otherwise advertised on the website was closed. There was so little room in the toilet that one had to sit on a slope, otherwise shoulder stumbling against the wall. In my opinion, the hotel can be called a 3-star.

author: Claire R
title: Very small room
text: This hotel was in a great location, easy to walk to all sites. Our room was really dissapounting. It was so small, you had to walk round the bed side ways and the window opened onto the bed. It would suit a soli traveller but not a couple. The air con wasent on so it was very warm. When asking at reception about this i was told it didnt go on till Summer! It advertised a roof top bar and terraces, these werent open either . Reception wasent very helpful ie lack off information, for to be a 4 star and the price you pay its not worth it.

author: Henry O
title: Didn’t make it!
text:
I am beyond disappointed with Condotti Boutique Hotel.

I booked my stay in good faith, excited for a trip to Rome. Due to an airline error at the airport (passport validity not flagged during booking or check-in), I was denied boarding at the gate. The experience was humiliating, stressful and emotionally exhausting.

Despite immediately explaining the situation to the hotel — and making it very clear that I physically could not reach Rome — the response I received was cold, rigid and completely lacking in empathy.

No flexibility.
No goodwill.
No credit.
No date change.
Not even a partial refund.

Instead, I was told “this is an airline issue” and essentially left to absorb the full financial loss for a stay I was prevented from attending due to circumstances entirely outside my control.

I am a business owner myself, and I understand policies. But hospitality is about more than hiding behind terms and conditions. It’s about compassion, discretion, and basic human understanding — all of which were absent here.

Hotels that value their guests understand that sometimes life happens. Condotti Boutique Hotel clearly does not.

I will not be rebooking, and I would strongly advise others to think carefully before booking if you expect any flexibility or empathy when things go wrong.

A deeply upsetting experience from start to finish.

author: Nathan S
title: Perfect Location
text:
Just spent a few days here and it was excellent . Staff were very helpful and polite. It was my husband's birthday so Daniele gave us complimentary breakfast. The bedroom was spotless/ the bed was super comfy and the shower was  powerful.  Room was spacious. 

It was just next to Spanish Steps n lots of shops restaurants in the area.

There was a bit of mix up on way home going to airport but hotel quickly resolved the matter for us 

We would highly recommend this hotel

author: William U
title: The experience with the family room was not pleasant.
text:
⸻

The location of the hotel is perfect; however, our experience with the family room was not pleasant.
The room was extremely cold at night and we were freezing until the morning. When we mentioned this the next day, the staff was polite and responsive — they immediately sent someone to check. That’s when we were informed that the whole building has only a cooling system, which honestly is unusual for a hotel in Europe. The worker even recommended using a portable heater to warm up the room, which felt quite surprising for a hotel standard.

The blankets provided were thin, and this made the cold night even more uncomfortable.
In addition, the bathroom water temperature was unstable — it kept switching from extremely hot to extremely cold, making it hard to take a proper shower. The beds were also not very comfortable.

Overall, while the staff was helpful and the location is excellent, the room conditions (especially heating and water stability) made our stay much less comfortable than expected

author: Charlie U
title: A delightful view of Rome, literally...
text:
I am an Italian-American who's spent years in Italy. However, we were only in Rome this time for two nights, over the Easter weekend, so we chose to stay in a hotel. The Hilton Garden Inn/Claridge was delightful. They were so kind & welcoming at the front desk -- we were thrilled to find our room had a balcony that looked out over Rome, & even had a bit of mountain views!! Splendid. 

The room was very comfortable, with a good coffee pot & little desk. The staff were helpful generally. 

We love that area -- it is easy walking to nice restaurants, the famous parks (like Villa Borghese or Villa Ada); to cafés, the buses or trams to other areas such as the historic "downtown"or Trastevere, etc.; & it's a quick taxi to the train station "Termini". 
(There's even a good supermarket right nearby, the Esselunga.)

I've already recommended the hotel to American friends, & told my Roman relatives, too.
