author: Elena U
title: Excellent
text:
We return often and gladly to this quiet hotel in Parioli.
Excellent location in a quiet area but close to the center, which can be reached with a nice walk through Villa Borghese.
Excellent quiet and comfortable rooms.
Free gym, very rich breakfast, and fair prices.

author: Juan A
title: Hilton Garden Inn Claridge, Rome — 2 stars, generously
text:
I wanted to love this place. I really did. But apparently "Diamond" status here just means the elevator remembers your floor.

Every Hilton on the planet manages two bottles of water a day for Diamond members. Not this one. I guess management decided Rome's 600 public fountains were a suitable substitute. Nothing says luxury hospitality like directing guests to hydrate at the same spouts tourists have been drinking from since the Trevi crowds discovered TikTok.

The room was small enough to negotiate the furniture placement personally. No upgrade offered, despite status that apparently exists only in theory at this property. Breakfast was the kind of mediocre that makes you grateful for gelato two blocks away.

To be fair, the neighborhood is genuinely lovely. Which is the nicest thing I can say about a stay where the hotel did the absolute minimum and I did the walking, the water fetching, and apparently the room upgrading myself.

author: Ian V
title: Uncomfortable experience
text: I recently had a very uncomfortable experience during my stay at the hotel. At check-out, the receptionist asked me for a “voluntary” tip of 25 euros. Although they said it was optional, I felt very pressured. This had never happened to me in any hotel before. As a Hilton Silver member, I expected better treatment. I would not recommend this hotel to future travelers. I hope this practice is reviewed.

author: Julien K
title: pretty decent
text:
I was there at someone else's expense, for a 20 person meeting
The room, yes pretty good, great bed, all very 4*.  I wish the curtain would shut fully, I would have liked a fridge.  The staff were nice
What I didn't like.  No stairs to the ground floor, and with 2 tiny lifts (4 people max) it was a pain.
It's a few km from town and the ruins and churches etc, walkable or buses/trams
And when I asked for directions to the bus for the railway station I was told go up the road, turn right, it's on the other side of the road.  NO, it's SECOND right.  This left me hurrying to catch my flight

author: Andrea B
title: Badly treated by the night staff Stefano!
text:
Here’s a polished and grammatically improved version of your review while keeping your original message and emotions clear:
It’s our first time being treated like this. We’ve stayed at many Hilton hotels before, and this is the first time something like this has happened to us.
I would like to share our disappointment with this hotel. First, there was a staff member named Stefano who was working the night shift on May 25. When we entered the hotel and stood in front of the reception desk, we saw him in the back office watching something at a high volume. He did not come to the front desk immediately to attend to us and instead stayed at the back while asking what we needed.
We kindly asked if it was possible to have a vanity kit, but he asked what it was and then told us that it would require payment if we wanted one. We also asked for extra water, but he immediately asked us in a rude manner whether we were Hilton members. After we answered, he rudely asked again what membership level we had and then told us that the water would also require payment.
In short, it felt like if you are not a member, you will be treated badly by this hotel. So far, in all the Hilton hotels we’ve visited, we were given water and other amenities without any judgment. I personally also work in the same industry, so I am familiar with Hilton standards.
I would never come back to this hotel. It is such a disgrace.
On the positive side, I would like to thank the ladies at the reception during check-in, especially the ladies during check-out, for granting us a late check-out.

author: Evie Q
title: Great hotel and staff
text: This hotel is in a neighborhood by the Embassies.  It does have a tram stop right near it so you will hear it.  However, it is a great property!   Every single one of the staff members went out of their way to make sure we were well taken care of, very friendly and helpful.  The hotel also has a token operated washer and dryer.  There are great restaurants near the hotel and the breakfast buffet was tasty with lots of options.  The room we stayed in was big for a European hotel room.  Loved staying there.

author: Henry R
title: Start of stay negative
text: You arrive at the hotel and immediately notice the noise of the place: on a rather busy road. But... patience... it’s not the hotel’s fault. You arrive in the room.... quite small with a bathroom decidedly small, cramped and uncomfortable. But we are in a four star hotel and what do you find...?? On a chest of drawers two bottles of water (plastic).... welcome??? Nooooo strictly for a fee!!!!!! Welcome to a 4-star Hilton in Rome!!!!!!

author: Megan Z
title: Scottish Girl
text: I unexpectedly went to Rome and booked 1 x night at the lovely hotel and arrived 15 minutes later...and what a wonderful hotel it is! The lovely girl on reception who checked me in was outstanding and so welcoming! My to was large, comfortable and had everything I needed! I had a couple of drinks in the bar, lovely young man server, and had such a relaxing evening I decided to book another night! The next day I was jist enjoying relaxing in the room when reception called to mention to get my key updated as staying the extra night, lovely! I did just that and settled my bill, ordered some dinner which took so long to arrive (takeaway) there was the lovely receptionist from day before and then another lovely girl, she got the lift for me  carrying my food, hope the pizza and chips were nice! Next morning leaving early for airport and another lovely receptionist sorted a car for and the gentleman receptionist to were just so friendly and helpful. This is one of the best hotels I have stayed in with the best staff and if I ever have the pleasure of being in Rome again, I will be making a stop here! Thank you to all of you!

author: Freya J
title: Very negative experience and seriously inadequate staff management
text:
On December 26, during breakfast, my wife left her mobile phone on the counter. After just a few minutes, the phone had disappeared. The dining room staff were uncooperative, offering vague explanations without providing any real assistance.
I asked the front desk for help and requested that the police be contacted. To my surprise, I was told that they were not authorized to call the police and that I would have to go to the police station myself. I firmly objected and asked to speak with a manager, who was said to be “on holiday.”
Only after my strong insistence were the police finally called. The officers arrived within minutes and requested access to the breakfast room’s CCTV footage. Shortly afterward, one of them “coincidentally” found the phone under a paper napkin on our breakfast table, the same table that had already been checked several times. It was clear to everyone that the phone could not have simply appeared there on its own.
To avoid further loss of time, we decided not to file a formal report.
What remains is:
a total lack of cooperation,
absence of internal staff controls,
an initial refusal to contact the police,
no apology whatsoever from the hotel.
This is shameful and unacceptable behavior for a property that claims to provide safety and assistance to its guests.
In situations like this, I recommend not following the staff’s instructions and standing up for your rights.

author: Jack H
title: Great staff
text:
We had a great stay at the hotel. 
The front office gelsomina is very attentive and  helpful, from arranging our shuttle pick up and to our check in.

author: Lauren U
title: Chose Hilton Garden Inn Claridge
text: We stayed for three nights and were most impressed with friendliness and helpfulness of staff. Always willing to answer questions and order a cab. Very clean well-appointed lobby and rooms. Located in very nice area of Roma near Borghese Palace and Gardens. Restaurants all around close. Highly recommend!  Price was reasonable.

author: Isla S
title: Great working position
text:
Great working location just steps from the Luiss headquarters in Viale Romania.
Being a Garden Inn the difference is noticeable, especially in the attention to the rooms.
I think they should be repainted, some bathrooms refurbished.
Overall, when calculating the labor/cost ratio, there are no major complaints.
I do not agree with the choice of snacks at the entrance, but they are business choices.
Good breakfast, not great but fits into the same previous speech.
What could improve without costs related to the work, is definitely the staff.
At the reception the young age, unfortunately has some flaws.
All in all if I were to return to this area for work, it would remain my choice.

author: Grace J
title: Appreciate a young lady in reception desk
text: I stayed 3 nites from 12-15 Oct in Rm 315.  The young lady in the reception is helpful when I encountered problems in buying cigarettes.  Even though the cigarettes stores are closed at 8 pm, I appreciate her guide and explanation.

author: Luke I
title: King super bed and terrific balcony
text: We asked for a king bed and what we got was a double full which is 25% larger than a king.  The highest bed I've ever slept in!   Breakfast was ok - the meat was not cooked well but otherwise acceptable. We got a balcony and there was a nice Italian restaurant just steps away.

author: Emma Q
title: Mandatory tip?
text: Quick overnight stop, good Welcoming and excellent breakfast that is still charged at € 20 each, as well as the garage at € 30. Too bad to find the mandatory tip on the account and have to ask for an account. You sleep well and perfectly sheltered from noise, despite being on the first floor.

author: Isabella V
title: service charge 5% ahahahah
text: very nice hotel, great service embarrassing the fact that you are charged at check out automatically a "service charge of 5%" telling you later, that if I had not agreed they would have canceled it

author: Isla B
title: Hidden Charges and No App Integration
text: They have ZERO app integration - no online check in, no digital key, no digital check out. I think they don't have digital check out because they hit you with hidden fees at the end - expect to pay an additional €30+ per day in City Tax and Gratuity. It's a nice property and staff but the surprise hidden charges at the end leaves you with a sour taste in your mouth. It's also pretty noisy, the area has constant sirens, cleaning staff make a fair bit of noise

author: Mason F
title: Must stay here!
text: The absolute best hotel we have ever stayed at in the US or abroad!!!  Staff and rooms are amazing!  Great restaurant right next door and a comfortable distance away from the chaos of city center without being too far away to walk.

author: Daisy Q
title: Excellent Hotel
text:
Excellent hotel in a very quiet and safe residential area. We stayed there for 4 nights and could not have been happier.  The Hilton Garden Inn Rome Claridge is the perfect place to rest after long days exploring Rome. The hotel is very clean, offers great amenities, and the staff couldn't be more professional, helpful and friendly. Before we traveled, we contacted the hotel a couple of times, and they always replied quickly and with great information. 

A big shout-out to Giulia and Megan at the front desk. They were amazing! They assited us with anything we needed during our stay, and were always very friendly every time they saw us. Giulia and Megan we will not forget how special you made us feel!

author: Chloe F
title: Nice hotel
text:
Stayed 4 night.  Small reception  on 1st floor, staff very welcoming. 10-15 mins walk from train station or $17 taxi. Free good WiFi. Breakfast good, 730-10am with good selection of croissants, cold meals, plenty of choice breads, cheeses and yogarts. Eggs, pancakes, fresh fruit, juice and coffee. 
Room was large and very clean and equipped with fridge. Coffee making. TV. 1 comfortable bed very clean. Bathroom is ensuite and clean with toiletries. Would stay again if price right Great hotel and location.

author: Thomas O
title: Exceptional hotel!!
text: Charming hotel, excellent service, perfect breakfast, well located and very clean!!

author: Alice R
title: First room terrible. Second room very nice. Rest of hotel nice.
text: I am extremely divided about this place. It started as 1 star and finished as 4 star. Rest of hotel is 3 star. This is because when I came to Rome for a 4 day city break with my dad, we booked this hotel because it is slap bang in the centre. I was expecting it at first to be worth it. I actually loved the service, super friendly, and the breakfast was super nice. However, the room, a whole different story (at first). When I opened the door. I literally explodrd. It was claustrophobic as heck, and all there was was a bathroom, a tv, 2 beds and a step you could easily trip on and/or fall from. The shower slightly lightened things up, but overall, it felt like a hobbit house (literally). I literally was going to go home because of how (at the time) disappointed and betrayed I felt. So my dad, the next day (while at the Colusseum) told the staff about it. I was at first terrified of going back into the hotel, but I nearly cried of happiness when I saw our new room (although further from reception and restauraunt). There was a shower and bath shared, but that didn't let me down. My claustrophobes IMMEDIATELY disappeared and there was a locker and a tv and, even better, a whole view of the hotel (albeit with a step). This immediately removed me from the ptsd I was going to get from the other room. And even if we barely even stayed here, i was relieved. Thank you so much staff for saving me from never going back to Rome, the Vatican and Italy ever again! 3/5 (1/5 1st day, 4/5 2nd, 3rd and 4th day).

author: Lea D
title: A great place in Rome to get to know the city
text:
It’s very well located, just a short walk from Termini railway station but in a very good neighborhood. Also at a 5-10-minute walk from the Trevi Fountain and the Colosseum.
Buffet breakfast , spacious rooms, and lots of places to eat nearby

author: Chloe Z
title: Construction work on site
text: Drill and construction work every morning, you cannot sleep! Be aware of that before you book

author: Aiden I
title: A bit strange
text: Excellent location, nice rooms, staff different, organization needs improvement. After the first night, we should change rooms, probably because of a planning error by the hotel. The doorman knocking on the door at 9pm and asking us to change rooms is unusual and annoying. Otherwise, one of the many “hotels” in Rome that do not deserve the name. Apartments bought together over several floors with a reception somewhere. A bit of Air B&B. More precise labelling would be helpful.

author: Noah L
title: Amazing!
text:
The accommodation is really in the perfect location.  

The staff was always smiling and available to serve and help.  

The room was beautiful and clean.  The only negative was that it had only one socket and we couldn 't charge our phones at the same time but you can get an extension from some store . 

There is a bus stop nearby and the subway station is also very close.  Also nearby is the Fontana di Trevi, the Colosseum and taking the bus you are in very little to the Vatican.  

We almost always chose walking because walking you discover and observe the most beautiful things.  

A little further there is a supermarket where you can buy everything. 

We will book again very soon at the same hotel. Thank you for everything.

author: Sydney T
title: Good location in a 3 star , with breakfast!
text:
Close to all places to visit , hotel with small and complicated elevator to take it at peak times.
Our room had a small balcony facing Av. Nazionale, there were 3 of us and we were tight, especially in storage and space.
Breakfast is complete and with good service.

author: David K
title: Perfect hotel
text: What a fantastic find this was! A great location in the centre of Rome but not noisy. The hotel is beautiful and the staff are amazing - very friendly and helpful. There is a fantastic choice for a continental breakfast. Rome is gorgeous and we now have a perfect hotel to return to on our next visit.

author: Molly J
title: Ideal location to visit Rome
text:
The Giolli Hotel is located in a strategic position to visit the city of Rome and all its main points of attraction. The rooms are clean, comfortable and quiet. 
We did not use the breakfast buffet.
The only flaw: the “luggage storage” consists simply in leaving all the suitcases of guests who have already checked out in the main room, we expected a special warehouse to ensure greater security. This removed, highly recommended structure!

author: Henry L
title: FANTASTICO HOTEL
text: We loved the hotel, excellent location, breakfast buffet very well, has everything but without excesses is a 3 stars, cake, fruit, cereal, etc., You can walk to the main monuments, the phenomenal cleanliness, the very nice and attentive staff, our room overlooked a patio and almost better, total silence. I recommend them

author: Alice S
title: Excellent quality and good price!
text: I would like to leave a very positive review. The staff at this hotel were charming, as was the hotel's cleanliness (which I consider essential). Furthermore, the food was excellent too! I can only say thank you!!

author: Daniel L
title: I recommend it
text: My son stayed at this property with friends; they were very well received, adequate room and breakfast more than enough; the boys also enjoyed the centrality of the hotel and the availability of the reception; very helpful also the late checkout... I recommend

author: Sydney H
title: Great location
text:
Great discovery. Practically central location, a stone's throw from everything. Very kind staff and recently renovated room. 
Definitely worth considering for another stay in Rome

author: Paige C
title: Memorable trip - location great, staff great
text:
Really lovely family run hotel. Breakfast basic but to be honest with everything on offer in Rome it’s fine to just get a coffee and pastry and then explore the options on the Rome streets. 

Clean and pleasant stay, our room was small but tastefully decorated and housekeeping came every single day! 

Location wise you can’t do much better for the price. We walked to all the attractions from here and never more than 20-30 mins. Longest walk was to the Vatican but if you allow for stops en route, you don’t even notice how long and far the walk is. I will remember this trip forever.

author: Elena W
title: Busy but that's Rome for sure
text:
Very clean and friendly 
Full breakfast and friendly staff 
Neat room though some noise 
Very good location 
We did everything on foot

author: Katie U
title: Good
text:
Very convenient hotel to reach any important half of Rome.
Very quiet area, well served by transport and easily accessible from the station and terms. 
Room with all the essentials, very clean bathroom. The only small flaw did not work the suction of the bathroom, but for one night was not a problem. 
Room and bathroom spotless.
Essential and discreet breakfast.
Excellent value for money / location.

author: Nora Z
title: Nice and not too bad location
text:
Small charming hotel, nice, very good location if you like to walk 15 to 20 min before arriving in the middle of restaurants, shops.... 15min walk to termini
10min walk to a MC do 
15min walk from the gastronomic streets of Piazza di Spagna
30/40min from the Olympic Stadium in uber depending on the time and day of the match
Cons: the elevator is cramped, no more than 3 people, may not be suitable for people with reduced mobility.... But very nice, the welcome, the rooms .....
I recommend

author: Molly U
title: Review of Hotel Giolli Nazionale
text: We stayed at Giolli recently for 4 days and 3 nights and found the hotel to be excellent. It is in a great location, central and within walking distance of all the key sights and with bus stops close by to take you further afield.  Staff were attentive and courteous and the rooms clean and tidy. We enjoyed excellent breakfasts too which set up our days for seeing the sights and we would stay there again in the future.

author: Lucia G
title: Good for a 3*
text: Stayed with family for a 5 night city break. The staff were friendly. The room was very spacious for a family room which was great, and the bathroom very nice. Impressed the room was cleaned every day. The hotel is excellently located. The breakfast is basic but plenty of choice and very reasonable.  There isn't  a bar or anything like that and it is a little basic but I'd definitely stay here again.

author: Giulia X
title: Rome
text:
We stayed at this property
For a few days.,
From the moment of arrival, the staff proved to be very welcoming and professional. The room was modern, beautiful, and clean, in a quiet area.
A note of merit also for the breakfast, rich in fresh products, both sweet and savory.
The hotel's location is excellent, near Termini station, a few steps from the Metro. You can also reach important destinations on foot, 
Like...
Trevi Fountain
Altar of the Fatherland
Colosseum.
We will definitely return.

author: Manon J
title: Very good hotel for the cost charged, close to everything...
text: Very good hotel, renovated and was beautiful... The good rooms, etc...

author: Brooke N
title: Short stay in Rome
text:
We stayed at Hotel Patria for 2 nights. The location is great for Termini but a bit further on foot to the sights. So if you come to Rome in midsummer, you absolutely have to take that into account.
All employees were very nice and helpful.
We had booked superior and received a super nice, large room. The only drawback is that the storage space in the bathroom is very small, but otherwise we were very satisfied with the room. Also with the air conditioning.
The breakfast was absolutely okay, mega by Italian standards - there was even fried bacon and scrambled eggs.
All in all, I can definitely recommend this hotel and will book it again for our next stay in Rome.
Price-performance ratio is top!

author: Jack S
title: Average hotel
text:
Excellent hotel. For 3 stars it is at the price. Room was not really clean. Hair on the floor in the room and bathroom. Undefined splashes on the wall in the bathroom behind the sink that have not been removed the entire stay. Noisy rooms. Beds reasonable. Breakfast was good. Coffee facility in the room, but you had to buy coffee because you only got coffee for once. Never experienced it before. 
Location is ok.

author: Carlos R
title: Good value for money.
text: Very clean hotels, room cleaned every day, no breakfast, close to the subway, however the bed is a bit firm and you will hear the subway passing by.

author: Ian S
title: Had a great stay , ideally located to transport.Dennis on reception was very helpful friendly and absolutely amazing.
text:
The room on the 2nd floor was modern and cleaned daily.
The communal area needs updating.
Close to restaurants and the metro.
Great location.

author: Daisy P
title: Beautiful hotel with a great location
text:
Very nice hotel. Termini within walking distance and everything else is also accessible on foot. The standard rooms are somewhat noisy and the shower is quite cramped. I would recommend a superior room. The staff at the reception was incredibly nice and was always happy to see us, engaging in small talk with us. They also provided us with sightseeing tips and organized an affordable airport taxi. Very warm-hearted people!
The staff at breakfast, on the other hand, seemed annoyed and disinterested. That was a bit unfortunate!
Nevertheless, I can recommend the hotel!!

author: Ethan G
title: Rome . May 2026
text: We were put on the 5th floor which is the older floor not modernised and pretty outdated needs tlc also lift only goes to 4th floor so if you have any mobility issues ask for lower floor. Walls pretty thin can hear other guests shower hit and miss with temperature. Breakfast 10 euros plenty of choice and options. Staff all pretty friendly and helpful. Bar open till 9:30 pm but we never saw anyone on there to order a drink from . Good location all attractions in reasonable distance few nice restaurants and bars nearby. Overall pretty happy quiet place good rest to recharge before more exploring.

author: Carlos S
title: Recommended hotel
text:
I was alone overnight on May 18, 2026. I was worried that the next day would coincide with my return due to a general train strike, so I stayed for a few hours and checked out already around 8pm and spent the night at Fiumici airport.

The man who dealt with me at check-in and the man who dealt with me at check-out told me that I didn't have to go to the airport so early. The security man responded as well as smiling and being OK. My feelings remained the same as I boarded the bus and left Rome, but the Comfort Single room was a nice, well-lit room on a clean, renovated day. There is a refrigerator and a pot. What's more, the air conditioner worked properly, the shower water temperature was perfect, and it was thoroughly cleaned without a single dust drop.
It would be perfect…

I prefer the newer, cleaner and less inconvenient hotels than the more luxurious ones.

Next time, I thought I'd stay for a while. There are no slippers, irons, toothbrushes and hair conditioners in the room.
The location was only a few minutes from Termini station. The location is also not mentioned.

author: Brooke X
title: Ruined birthday
text:
I was really disappointed with my stay at Hotel Patria. When we arrived, the room looked nothing like the photos online. It was old, dated, and the furniture was dirty. There were even hairs on the bedding, which immediately made the room feel unhygienic and poorly maintained.

We told the hotel staff this, they did not care and we were told we had to pay €60 per night for a better room.

Before arriving, I mentioned that the trip was for my partner’s birthday and asked what the hotel could offer for the occasion. They sent over a document listing different birthday extras and services, but strangely, none of the things included in the document were actually available or offered during our stay. It felt very misleading and unprofessional 

When we raised concerns about the room, staff told us we had only paid for a “standard” room — despite there being only one room option available when booking a year ago. It didnt specify anywhere the tiers of rooms.  We then felt pressured into paying an extra €300 just to get moved into a better room, which was extremely frustrating and felt misleading. This felt as though this was planned by the hotel and maybe a plot to make people pay more. 

On arrival, we also asked to borrow an iron, but were told they couldn’t provide one due to “health and safety” reasons. Reception directed us to a nearby ironing service, only for us to find out it had shut down. We ended up buying our own iron, and later discovered hotel staff had taken it from our room without informing us. We weren't allowed it back until we left.

Breakfast was another disappointment. The food sat under hot lights all morning without being refreshed, leaving most of it rubbery and unappetising. There was also very little choice available.

Some staff were were really lovely but the standards have let this hotel down.

Overall, this hotel did not match the standards advertised online and the service throughout our stay was poor. I would not stay here again or recommend it to others.

author: Harper L
title: Great cost benefit!
text:
Great cost benefit!
Well located hotel, close to train and subway stations and a short walk from attractions such as Fontana di Trevi. Recently renovated rooms, all new and comfortable. Super recommend.

author: Chloe S
title: Excellent hotel
text: Good hotel. Outside a bit dated but Central and metro a stone's throw. I stayed in the superior rooms and they are really nice, equipped with all the comforts cn courtesy kit. Excellent staff, always smiling and super nice. I arrived in the morning around 10:30 my daughter was unwell and we were immediately given the room. Good breakfast. Definitely will be back!

author: Oscar F
title: Would we stay at the Patria again yes we would.
text:
My wife and I have just returned from a 4 night stay at the hotel Patria, after reading many of the reviews we were sceptical. Firstly ideally situated close the rail station, and manageable walks to most attractions,
Room was good and modern, 3rd floor, Air conditioned, although a bit hit and miss, room cleaned every day, we found all members of staff very helpful, the breakfast had plenty of choices. We would like to say a very big thank you to Dennis who manned the reception, and to Alessandro the bar manager, both of them went above and beyond to make our stay welcome, we can also recommend the restaurant a few yards away from the Hotel, called Target.

author: William B
title: Nice staff, not the best hotel I'd ever stayed in, won't be going back anytime soon
text:
So I stayed at hotel patria for 4 nights, the staff were brilliant I can't fault them, very friendly and willing to help, however the room I was given was not the best, the first 4 floors have all new rooms... So if your unfortunate to be given a room in the 5th floor it will be very outdated, draws were all dirty, walls are paper thin, some VERY rude individual was banging on the walls all because I had the telly on at about 10pm, didn't have the decency to knock on the door and ask me politely to turn it down...No... LETS BANG AS HARD AS WE CAN, clown!
Also the lift doesn't go to the 5th floor so you have to go to the 4th and walk up the stairs the rest of the way... Which isn't a problem for myself... But when you find the cleaning staff leave bags all at the bottom of the stairs and I have to climb over them what good is that to anyone, it also poses a risk incase there was a fire because the stairs are completely cut off, I would say this issue needs addressing.
And last of all the area isn't great, scam artist everywhere you go... Can't have a peaceful drink without being heckled by these "doctors and engineers" I can honestly say I won't be going back to Rome in a hurry anytime soon.
photos: [{"url": "https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/32/6b/22/69/caption.jpg", "caption": "Bags left by the cleaners right in the way of the stairs which poses a fire risk, needs addressing by hotel management, I had to climb over them to get out one morning, not ideal", "photo_id": "845881961"}]

author: Daniel H
title: Great hotel with reasonable price
text: It is a very well located hotel, very close to the sights of Rome. It is a 5-minute walk from Termini Station and 15 minutes from the Colosseum. In addition, its staff is always willing to help guests as much as possible. Its facilities are remodeled and very comfortable. Anyway, we were delighted and will definitely stay there again on our next trip to Rome

author: Freya S
title: Untitled
text: Third consecutive time we traveled to Rome, third consecutive time we stayed in the Homeland, and this year we discovered that the previous two years gave us a standard room when we had paid a superior Excellent location, but the level was falling, through these years, not attention, but for example at breakfast, very poor, nothing to do with previous years, does not match a three star hotel.

author: Luca Q
title: Bridge 8 December in Rome
text:
Strategic location near both Termini and Repubblica metro station.
We chose the superior rooms and they were spectacular (over-recommended): living room and a bathroom with oval bathtub, infinity shower and double sink. So a lot of space. No balcony, 2 soundproof windows at the back of the hotel.
International breakfast buffet. They also have something gluten-free like cookies and Nutrifree rusks.

author: Hannah C
title: Dirty and missing cleaning rooms
text: Very weak hotel lack of cleanliness and employees very.antipatics experience to not repeat expensive and very weak not advisable

author: Chloe C
title: We will be back.
text:
Stayed at the Hotel Patria for 3 nights recently in a Superior room which was roomy with a lovely bathroom.The hotel was booked as room only but we decided to have breakfast. This consisted of fresh and tinned fruit,yoghurt,cereal, eggs,bacon,sausage, cheeses,cold meats,salad.Pastries included croissants ,pain au Chocolat, Danish and delicious shortbread with various toppings. Found the juice a little weak but plenty of tea and coffee on offer for 10€ for bfast. Tea and coffee available in room but no milk. 
Great staff special mention to Daniel ..we ll now be following Juventus now! and Angelo for their help.

author: Hugo M
title: Nice hotel but...
text: Nice hotel but the room definitely needs renovation! Maybe some rooms have been renovated but not all. Gentle employees and very helpful. Relatively close to the center on foot. Nice area with shops and restaurants.

author: Noah O
title: Lovely hotel, perfectly placed
text: What a lovely, quiet hotel, the staff are so friendly and helpful. The rooms are exactly what you need for a city break and reasonably sized. Cleaned daily with fresh towels and bedding. I think it is good value for money. Located about a 20 minute walk from the Trevi fountain and only about 10 mins from a big bus hop on hop off bus stop for all other sightseeing opportunities. Would definitely recommend to others.

author: Lucy G
title: Excellent hotel.
text:
It is a lovely hotel in an old historic building, very quirky layout. Lovely rooms, spotlessly clean and the staff were very friendly. 
Unfortunately we had an incident on the last day of our holiday.  The management and staff of the hotel were amazing, kind and caring, they looked after us so well.

I would recommend this lovely hotel to anyone.

author: Sean I
title: Well located
text:
The hotel is located a bit outside the city center,
Check-in went well. The rooms are not very large, especially the bathroom is a bit small. Overall, somewhat worn and noisy.
Room service is very good and takes place daily.
The bar is well stocked but has high prices.

author: Leo L
title: Great stay in the heart of Rome
text: I recently stayed at Hotel Oxford for a couple of days during a business trip, and it was an excellent experience. The location is absolutely perfect. It's within easy walking distance of major attractions, transportation hubs and great local restaurants. The room was spotlessly clean, very quiet, with a very comfortable bed that ensured a great night's sleep.. The staff was incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout my entire stay. The complimentary breakfast buffet offered a wide selection of fresh fruit, pastries, and hot options. I highly recommend Hotel Oxford and I will definitely choose to stay here again on my next trip.

author: Lauren D
title: Birthday trip to historic Rome
text:
The hotel is in a quiet location but within easy walking distance to the centre and attractions. 
Excellent friendly staff, good breakfast. 
Being a city hotel it's of course quite compact but everything is there that you need.
Happily use it again.

author: Holly N
title: Family visit to Rome
text:
From the moment we walked through the door we received a warm welcome.
The receptionist was very helpful. Our large suitcases were taken to our rooms. My husband and I had a room next to our daughters, which was perfect.
Room and bathroom was spotless .
Good location, 15/20 walk into the main attractions.
We did not eat at the hotel so cannot comment, but had drinks at the bar.  Again good service and pleasant staff.
Check out day was very smooth, received excellent service. We left our suitcases behind the desk as we had a late afternoon flight. When we arrived back , reception called a taxi for us to go to the airport , which was €55 , cheaper than when we arrived. It was €65 on arrival.
Loved Rome, lots of walking. But managed nicely. 
Lovely staff at hotel Oxford, can’t fault a thing. Thank you

author: Lucy Z
title: A nice little stay
text: Staff very welcoming…. But when it came to night time someone was running up and down the corridor quite annoying!! Went on for hours food was lovely we ate a few times for an evening meal the breakfast was fabulous!! Disappointing no tea and coffee facilities.

author: Molly V
title: Ideal Base for Exploring Rome – Clean, Comfy & Welcoming
text: Great hotel ,comfortable and very clean rooms and snug bar area to get a drink.  Friendly staff who were so helpful.  Ideal location for visiting Rome.

author: Lucia L
title: At a low price, acceptable terms.
text:
Ideal for short stays when you're just sleeping and eating breakfast at the hotel. Located in a quiet and comfortable area (hotel and embassy area. Nearby minimaret. Termini Station and the main attractions in walking distance.
The hotel is old, but not killed after renovation. Enough edible and dense if desired, though no frills breakfast (buffet). There's not enough pastry by the end of breakfast).
Room and hotel are clear. Linens are changed daily. On the downside, the bed isn't very big.
In general at a low price, suitable for habitation.

author: Oliver R
title: Terrible stay!
text:
The hotel was very dirty, it wasn't cleanded in a while. 
Our room was terrible, pictures are not true to what we got. Small room with no space, bathroom was so small you almost couldn't fit in there. 
Breakfast terrible, every day the same with no taste. 
Location was very good, you had a small 30 minutes walk to fountain de trevi, one hour walk to Vaticans. 
Service was ok but very dissapointed that they could not speak english and was very hard to make them understand you.
I will not come back and recomend everyone to book some other hotel.

author: Charlotte G
title: Can't beat it for value and location
text:
This hotel represents excellent value for money. I always review accommodation in the context of its price point, and honestly, for what you pay at the Oxford Hotel, it’s very hard to fault.

The location is central, the rooms are clean, quiet, and perfectly serviceable, and the staff are genuinely friendly. A particular shout-out to the front desk staff member (apologies for not catching his name) — the Stanley Tucci lookalike — who was especially warm, welcoming, and took the time to give us a great rundown on arrival.

Location-wise, you really can’t beat it. Close to Villa Borghese, and an easy walk to the Spanish Steps, Pantheon, and Trevi Fountain.

author: Lauren U
title: About right
text:
Can’t moan food okay room okay staff great 

Great location 

Right next to shops if you need anything 

For the money can’t see why you can moan at all really

author: Lauren L
title: So-so
text: I slept for the first time in this hotel for one night. Great location a few steps from Via Veneto and also close to Piazza di Spagna or other historic places in Rome. Comfortable room but very small bathroom. Unfortunately, however, I could not sleep because the mosquitoes disturbed me all night and as I was also told by two other colleagues in other rooms the situation was the same. Breakfast so so so.

author: James G
title: Weekend for two
text: Very comfortable hotel with attentive staff. Although a bit old, impeccable cleanliness and very good bedding. Well placed for sightseeing and in a quiet area with plenty of delicious family restaurants. In short very good value for money.

author: Lucas N
title: Staff Great. Room Poor. Breakfast Bad
text:
Positives: The staff are lovely and we enjoyed the location. 

Negatives: The room was nothing like those online.  Breakfast was truly terrible. I’m not sure if the room was meant to have a/c, the controls were there but no cooling. 

Staff are the only thing that made this place tolerable. 

Needs investment by the owners. It will pay dividends.

author: Thomas U
title: Not a 4 star hotel
text:
Not a 4 Star Hotel, no better than a cheap budget hotel. Rooms not as shown on website. Scruffy with dirty marks on walls. Floors under bed filthy and TV covered in dust. Very thin walls can hear people in next room going to toilet. Dirty warm carpets in corridors. Loose stair carpets. Shower door doesn’t close properly therefore water leaks all over floor 

In need of renovation

author: Grace Y
title: Great stay
text: Lovely hotel.  Room was basic but clean, all you need for sleeping in, was out all day.  Only thing missing was tea/coffee making facilities but when I asked at reception I was given a kettle and cups 🙂. Very nice, friendly helpful staff.  Good location for exploring

author: Manon Q
title: A 2-star hotel
text: The rooms are not as they appear on the site. The breakfast poor and always every day the same. Looks like a cafeteria. Super friendly staff on the other hand. I will definitely not be back

author: Charlotte U
title: Disappointed. The website pictures isn’t what you get
text: This hotel is definitely not a 4 star hotel. 3 star at a push.  It’s very tired and in need of some TLC . Small showers , broken plug sockets , scuffs and what seems like childlike drawings on the wall. However the staff are exceptional. Super warm and friendly and it’s super clean. Was I disappointed with what I got ….yes. Did the staff make me make me feel valued and appreciated…also yes. If you  book this hotel thinking it’s a 4* you’ll be extremely disappointed. If you book knowing it’s 3* in need of a little TLC with excellent staff then I’m sure your stay will be excellent.

author: Molly I
title: Highly recommend this hotel for location, cleanliness and care we all received!
text:
I would highly recommend this hotel, in 7 min walk to bus stops and within 15-20 min walk to other places like Trevino fountain, Spanish Steps, Termini station - place where metro/train/shuttle bus is from. Hotel itself small but clean and got everything you need. Staff in hotel and restaurant is very caring and welcoming! They will really help with everything you ask for, very polite supportive and professional. I personally really enjoyed my stay . Hotel has restaurant on ground floor,and us, having full board - we had amazing food on day 2 and 4. On day 3 (Saturday) we been sent to pasta restaurant next door and were well impressed!!! it was also nice to have a little change!!! Both restaurants cater for kids as asked and my kids just loved their spaghetti and pizza. Thank you to staff in reception and both restaurant!!! we really enjoyed our trip to Rome, you all made it very SPECIAL, my Birthday treat was very special!!! 

Highly recommend this hotel for location, cleanliness and care we all received!

author: Jessica E
title: A great option away from the rush of the city centre.
text:
Summary: We loved the modern layout of the rooms and the entire building. Our stay was pleasant and we thoroughly enjoyed the gym facilities, the breakfast and the lounge. We will highly consider this hotel in future trips to Rome when we want to stay away from the crowds and rush of the city centre.

Detailed review:

Rooms: Spacious, clean and modern. Basic toiletries, robe and slippers are supplied.
There's complimentary water daily and extra bottles for Hilton Honors members (silver and up).
The shower area is not fully private as there is a section with no door and people can see you while showering. We are a couple so we didn't mind but for families and friends it should be taken into consideration so people refrain from walking near the shower area when someone is using it.
Noise was manageable, we only heard footsteps at night coming from the rooftop bar (we stayed at the 14th floor) but they were quite muted. If you are a light sleeper,
do not stay near the rooftop bar.

Things to improve: we had a bad experience at The Blade rooftop bar (lack of customer service) and some of the elevators where out of service (2 out of 6). Elevator waiting times for us ranged from 1 to 4 minutes.

Breakfast: Varied and fresh. More suitable for non-vegetarians with only one vegetarian hot option that changes every now and then.
We loved some of the daily special stations but some were disappointing, like the virgin mojito or the pancakes. The fresh juice bar should be a regular feature, it was the highlight of that day.

Lounge: Quiet and relaxing. Good internet speed and enough outlets to charge laptops and work gear. Soft drinks and snacks are available all day long until 9PM and a light breakfast and light evening meal are served at specific times. They're very strict with those times and special drinks and food will be removed on the dot.

Getting to the city centre: 15 to 30 minutes by car depending on traffic, taxi/uber costs around 26€ from or to Trevi fountain
A Bus with AC to via del corso and Trevi fountain stops one street away from the hotel. The journey takes roughly 30 minutes and it costs 1.50€ one way. We used this method when going to the city centre as the ride was comfortable and full of sights.
The metro station is a few minutes away by walk. We never used the metro but other guests said it was quite convenient and the fastest way to reach the centre.
Location: Away from the city centre, so not crowded at all. Not many restaurant immediately outside of the hotel but there are lots of sight-seeing opportunities around this area. There is a shopping mall nearby, mostly accessible by car. There is a gorgeous park with waterfalls just a few minutes away by walk. The streets felt safe both day and night.

author: Ana P
title: Modern hotel but a major elevator problem
text:
The hotel is located near a subway station, which makes it easy to reach the main tourist attractions as well as Termini. The rooms are large, modern, and well-equipped. The breakfast buffet is abundant and the staff is attentive.

Two significant drawbacks:

Between three and four elevators were out of service during our three-night stay, which made the wait interminable.

The executive lounge was disappointing: limited food selection, not very varied, and often out of stock.

author: Taylor I
title: Good hotel, everything is clean, but the service is very bad
text: The hotel is good, everything is clean, the rooms are clean, but there are downsides. The restaurant, I ordered pasta with lobster, they promised 100g of lobster and 100g of pasta, meaning 200g total, but they brought 150g and a little lobster, and it's unclear if they brought shrimp with lobster or something else. We also ordered a steak, a medium rare steak, but they brought a rare one, so we were deceived. Service 0.

author: Sophia L
title: Kindness and comfort even in an unexpected situation
text:
We stayed at the Hilton Hotel due to a flight delay that caused us to miss our connection, and the airline therefore put us up in this hotel.

It was a pleasant surprise. The staff was truly very kind and helpful, always ready to meet our needs. The hotel is very spacious and well-maintained, while the room was very clean, comfortable, and equipped with everything necessary. The bathroom was also very clean and functional.

A gesture we particularly appreciated was their attention to our situation: not having our suitcase yet, they provided us with a personal hygiene kit with a toothbrush and toothpaste, slippers, and a comb, which we were really pleased with.

A short stay, due to an unforeseen situation, but certainly made much more pleasant by the courtesy and professionalism of all the staff. Compliments and thank you!

author: Henry E
title: Great hotel in Rome
text: Staff was amazing. They greeted us with candy and were very helpful. Hotel was beautiful and clean. Location was great as long as you take train to sites. Train station is a block away

author: David P
title: Excellent value for money
text: The best hotel in the EUR area. Very beautiful reception and excellent welcome. Large, clean rooms with all the comforts. Excellent services. Close to the EUR metro stop (5 minutes on foot). Super breakfast. Excellent value for money.

author: Andrea Y
title: Unimpressive
text:
It would have been fairly easy for this apparently fairly new hotel to get a more generous score from me, given that the location, while not central, is fairly close to a metro station, and the rooms compare favorably in size and quality with more expensive hotels located more centrally.

Unfortunately, the executive lounge was a complete waste of time. The unhealthy and uninteresting selection of food there in the evening was visibly inspired by the desire to economize. One might easily forget that the hotel is in Italy, one of the most interesting countries in the world when it comes to cuisine; in this executive lounge the hotel might just as well have been in a country without any food worthy of mention.

In the app I could not check out - the checkout option just took me to a page that said this was where I would check out later. Later, without having done anything myself, the app indeed showed me as checked out. That notification was accompanied by the promise of my invoice by email. The invoice never came. Two days later, Hilton's AI chat, useless as usual, offers the option of requesting a receipt but could then only tell me that "the hotel receipt is unavailable." The app then offered to connect me with the hotel, but the outcome of that was "we are temporarily offline." A response came later, asking me to submit the request by email. I did so and then finally got the receipt (in an email addressed to "Dear Ms. Brown"). I don't understand why Hilton not only doesn't provide me the receipt proactively (which it had said it would), but then makes it difficult to request it.

author: Jack S
title: Perfect business hotel
text: In an ideal location at the Eur in the Palazzo dei Congressi, Palazzetto dello Sport, Spazio Novecento area, a modern hotel with large and comfortable rooms, very comfortable beds, glass elevators, excellent continental breakfast, good gym with a view and brand-new equipment. Perfect as a business hotel even if the nearby subway makes it convenient for families too.

author: Lucy N
title: I have no words
text: Truly a terrible experience, terrible and not to be repeated: I am a GOLD member of the chain and had booked a mid-to-high level room on the 11th floor; in the evening I had a cocktail presented in an obscene manner, without snacks or napkins as shown in the photo. The reservation, as my confirmation shows, lists two guests, and the name of the second guest was clearly specified and well explained upon arrival to Alessandro.... I go to the room and receive a call that the guest has been there for 15 minutes and they won't let him up because the reservation didn't show up for them, and we were treated with indifference. In the morning I look for the manager and they tell me he wouldn't arrive until 9:30, so after breakfast I have him called, and the facility manager arrives with a challenging and arrogant attitude and tells me with insolence that he was the one who said to say he wasn't there until 9:30......

author: Henry J
title: Concierge lets what seems a good hotel down
text: Shame as not necessarily a hotel issue but hotel should have handled better imo.  Booked a taxi through concierge in advance.  Booked for 3AM come down with family to find the taxi company hadn’t accepted booking but no one thought to tell us or try another.  Reception then arranged one but sent the wrong size taxi despite me clarifying there were 5 of us.  Late to airport

author: Amelia O
title: Very Modern Hotel in the Financial District of Rome
text:
We stayed at this hotel with an Italy tour through Gate 1 Travel Company.  There were 34  people on this tour including my husband & myself.  We were in room 1208.

Pros: The room was modern and in the Financial District of Rome.  
It was located on the 12th floor so we had a great view.  
It had 2 double beds that were not twin beds pushed together as is typical in Europe.  The room was very spacious. 
It had a safe that fit our 2 laptop computers and other items.  
The staff for breakfast was outstanding especially Gina that went above & beyond to have the Chef make my husband's special request for eggs in a hole.  They came out great!  Thank Gina & Chef!  
Cons: There were always 1 or 2 elevators out of 6 not working so at times there was a long wait for them.  
The air conditioning controls in our room did not work.  We had to constantly call the Front Desk to have them adjust them since they could control individual rooms from there.  One night at 2am, no one answered & my husband had to go down to the Front Desk about the air.  He was very surprised to see 2 men standing at the desk doing nothing.  Why didn't they answer the phones!?!  He was so mad after that as you can imagine.  
Every time we took a shower, the water leaked out under the door.  This created a huge mess by the sink.  We had to put towels down just to soak up the water.  
Be aware that the doors to the toilet & shower are frosted glass & see through.  The "bathroom" area is not closed of from the rest of the room so if you don't want your roommate to see you, do not share rooms.  
Not many restaurants/food choices near the hotel & the hotel's restaurant was rather expensive. 
I would not recommend this hotel if you want to be close to the ancient Roman ruins.  It is far away & you would need to take a taxi which was 30 euros each way or metro to get there.

author: Sara A
title: Beautiful property, but unacceptable handling of serious guest property damages
text:
We had a deeply disappointing experience at Hilton Rome EUR La Lama involving serious damage to our professional electronic equipment after our luggage was handled by hotel staff.

The hotel itself may appear modern and upscale, but our experience after the incident was unacceptable. We discovered the damage after the luggage handling, reported it, and provided documentation, including photos/videos and metadata showing the timing of discovery. The damaged equipment was not casual personal property; it was work equipment that directly affected our ability to operate our business while traveling.

Rather than resolving the issue in a professional and guest-focused way, the matter was routed through Zürich, the insurer, and the claim was later denied. Their position was essentially that they could not prove the damage happened at the hotel. We strongly disagree and believe the evidence we provided was not fairly addressed.

The part that bothers us most is the lack of accountability. A hotel operating under the Hilton brand should have a serious process for handling guest property, preserving evidence, investigating luggage incidents, and treating guests fairly when expensive belongings are damaged. Instead, we experienced delay, denial, and a response that felt dismissive.

Travelers should be very cautious if bringing laptops, monitors, camera gear, medical equipment, or other valuable items to this hotel. Based on our experience, if something happens to your property after hotel staff handles it, you may be left fighting with the hotel and insurer rather than receiving a fair resolution.

We expected much better from Hilton. This experience has seriously damaged our trust in the brand.

author: Leo L
title: Mixed
text:
The rooms are very nice and perfectly met our expectations.
On the other hand, the reception and parking management are a real weak point. The check-in is long, disorganized, and completely lacks fluidity. The hostesses are barely friendly and make no effort to facilitate the guests' arrival. As for the parking, its access is complicated and no solution is proposed to simplify entries and exits.

Let's talk about the housekeeping, very inconsistent, either every other day and on top of that you have to ask for it!

The restaurant is of good quality, even if the prices are high. Fortunately, the servers raise the level: they are welcoming, professional, and offer impeccable service.

author: Ruby M
title: Special Thanks to
text:
Hotel is very comfortable and staff are very friendly 
Special thank to Mr.Alessandro receptionist very helpful and friendly did our check in super fast and helped me with information about this beautiful city

author: Connor T
title: Gourmet aperitif but too minimal.
text:
I did not stay at the Hilton Eur because I am from Rome, I tried it.
Their aperitif was very disappointing. The tastings were good but really small. Overall, they were expensive and not in line with an aperitif. From the advertisements and photos found online, it seemed like something very different and more abundant. Gourmet aperitif, what a shame. Very courteous staff.

author: Harper V
title: Unique breakfast
text: Very pleasant 4-night vacation. The breakfast buffet is definitely one of the best I have ever tried, and with family and for work, I visit many 4 and 5-star places. However, we did not try to request specific preparations. Restaurant menu needs to be revised and expanded, but the service from the dining staff was punctual and extremely courteous. A serious demerit regarding the room: we booked a corner king room of 50 square meters, and everything was as expected except that... there was practically no cold water. Indeed, when running the water, it kept getting hotter. We requested assistance multiple times, and eventually a maintenance person showed up, opened all the taps, and we waited over fifteen minutes to get an acceptable temperature. It makes me think that the hotel is aware of the issue with the room (only this one?), but continues to make a room available (great in other aspects) with this flaw. Another aspect, perhaps more related to a particular person: the cleanliness of the room on the first night was terrible, the towels were not even replenished (and there too, we had to ask the reception multiple times for the bidet towels). Finally, but this is more comical, the reception did not know that on June 2nd (a holiday in Italy) breakfast was until 11. Upon my request for verification, even the receptionist's colleagues confirmed...

author: Henry D
title: Embarrassing
text:
I have been a guest of this facility multiple times as it is in a strategic location and apparently a top solution. 
Every time it gets worse... long lines for check-in and check-out, with unacceptable wait times and a disastrous elevator situation. 
The facility is vertically developed, the elevators are the fundamental crossroads; you cannot have elevators that slow, considering that the stairs are available but not usable except in emergencies (alarm door). 
At least two elevators are constantly out of order, leaving 4 that stop at all floors during peak times, resulting in a wait of 10 to 20 minutes to go down for breakfast. Absurd.

author: Antoine P
title: I love fashion
text: Tornado ITA 🌪️. Let’s put a rug at the entrance, the most beautiful and always Paris ... Hello Christian

author: Isla Z
title: In short,
text:
The facility is nice and very convenient for the convention center.
The services offered need to be reviewed... the restaurant offers good dishes but with excessively long wait times... check-in and check-out times are unacceptable for a hotel of this quality.
Price quality is not proportional.

author: Marta N
title: An experience not to be repeated.
text: Restaurant - a deep disappointment. Appetizer of frozen zucchini pie served still frozen. Wine of a mediocre level. Meat dish, not worth commenting on.

author: Harper O
title: A good address
text: A bet on a week. Very pretty but a bit noisy because of the old window; impeccable room, decent breakfast, efficient and attentive staff, good advice. Proximity to public transport, convenience stores, and restaurants

author: Ryan I
title: BEST HOTEL IN ROME FOR SHORT STAY - GOOD LOCATION, CLEAN AND REASONABLE
text: Best Western Hotel Astrid Rome is superb for short stay of 3 nights. Great location, easy reach from centre - quiet neighbourhood. Has 2 bus connections to Termini. Very clean and great staff.  Just spent 3 nights in last week of July. Only negative is poor lighting in room, however very big room.

author: Abigail S
title: Average
text: Fairly welcoming property inside a historic Roman building. Reception service very sterile; I personally found a tidy room with a truly small bathroom, bidet almost inaccessible as it was wedged in a corner, and a small shower; unfortunately, the shower tray flooded while showering, because it was probably clogged. The breakfast is absolutely not worth the hotel's name, few products, and above all, it is unacceptable that inside such a hotel there is a broken espresso machine and they do not provide a backup or an immediate replacement.

author: Hannah U
title: Nice and clean
text: Nice and clean hotel near the center of Rome. Friendly and welcoming staff. Breakfast 8/10

author: Nora V
title: Very beautiful place
text:
Extremely easy to reach both from the Roma Termini station and to get to the center with 4 bus stops.
The girls at the reception were very kind and provided us with directions to our many questions and also gave us a map of the city.
Quiet and residential area... also for going out in the evening... the breakfast on the top floor is great from where I admire the beauty of the city.
We will return next year ♥️

author: Ruby I
title: Absolutely not.
text: To forget... the air conditioning was not working, not even a fan, and the triple room was set up for only two people while we were three. Zero attention for the guests. Never again.

author: Ana Y
title: Convenient Location but Comfort Needs Improvement
text:
Overall, the stay was not a bad experience, but there were a few comfort issues that stood out. The biggest concern was the shower size, which felt extremely small for full-grown adults. It was difficult to turn around or bend over once the shower door was closed. To comfortably maneuver, we often had to turn off the water and open the shower door just to pick something up or wash properly.

Additionally, the beds were extremely soft and not very comfortable, which made it difficult to get a good night’s rest. Aside from those issues, the overall stay itself was decent, and the hotel was conveniently located near many great restaurants and shops.

author: Louis R
title: Travel sowing freedom
text: Too far from all a lot of noise and not much service at reception

author: Emma E
title: Great hotel
text:
Very clean hotel with very friendly staff. The hotel is a bit noisy and our room had little space on the side to the bed. Bathroom super clean. The hotel is close to a tram, so you can quickly get to the city. Breakfast is rich.
Would love to come back

author: Poppy C
title: To be recommended
text: Efficiency , courtesy , cleanliness , comfort in a very well located and very pleasant hotel . I will return

author: Nathan J
title: Fantastic!
text: Was always nice and clean. Front staff was pleasant. Store and pharmacy around the corner. The tram service is a 5 min walk and takes you right to Piazza Popolo, not far from Spanish Steps.

author: Jessica M
title: Rome is always Rome
text: small but quiet room good breakfast

author: Morgan E
title: A pleasant surprise in Rome
text: Definitely recommend it for the location, services (breakfast and availability of staff) and for the location! Note of merit to the reception that met our needs without problems!

author: Carlos D
title: Breakfast from 5 stars L!!
text:
Strategic location for this mid-range hotel but with all the comforts; the real must is the breakfast like a real ****L with great choice and quality served in a partially covered terrace and with some space outside; the staff from the Housekeeper Sabina to the delicious and always smiling Joy will delight you and pamper you with sympathy, extreme professionalism and kindness always attentive to the cleanliness of your table and available to every need, various newspapers available every morning. The room is a bit narrow m to very clean. Very attentive reception, the very kind girls, a little less the burly man who is very distracted and, probably, immersed in his own facts and problems taking for granted the arrival or departure and that everyone manages....; any request that comes out of the ordinary is dismissed with a "is not possible". But so it is!
For the rest, enjoy your stay. Recommended with some tweaks.

author: Isla I
title: Enjoyable stay
text: Very good breakfast with great views and very comfortable bed

author: Sara N
title: Good experience.
text: I have stayed at this hotel before. Always a good experience.

author: Laura X
title: Nice hotel
text: Room was very small as was the shower, however, the staff were all very pleasant, the breakfast was lovely & fresh & the location was ideal for exploring.

author: Nora P
title: Astrid hotel
text: This hotel is ok . Breakfast was good . Room cleaned well . The room we got was very small  . It was like staying in a shoe box . Bathroom ok but does need a shaving mirror . Lots of free snacks in mini  fridge and drinks , soft drinks ! . Very close if going to the rugby . Great super market next door and some nice restaurants near by . I would not like to stay in the room we had in the heat of the summer but was bearable in March  . Would I go back to this hotel . No .

author: Giulia Q
title: Strategic hotel
text: I started to stay slin this Hotel as strategically located for my work. IlInnestled in a period building combines charm comfort and adequate prices in the BW standard

author: Henry A
title: A Lovely Rome Experience
text:
Just returned after spending three nights in Rome. We upgraded the room after reading the reviews & were happy with the facilities, especially the view of St Peters Basilica. Ideal time to see Rome especially as the trees werent in bloom to obstruct our view. We were allocated a room next to the breakfast terrace. Breakfast was great & set us up for the day. The girls Gioa (Joy by name & Joy by nature) & Geraldine were great, hard working as it got very busy but so lovely. You had  access to the refreshment facilities n the terrace through the day & evening. It was lovely to return after a busy site seeing day to relax with a cuppa & enjoy the view. 
There is a supermarket at one side of the building. We discovered Pico Gelato amazing ice cream the  best we tried in Rome. There is also a lovely Patisserie. (Good job we were doing 30,000 steps per day) Nice restaurants a short walk from hotel. 20mins walk in to the walls of the city. We felt safe walking at night. Goodys restaurant was very good at all times of the day.

author: Kyle S
title: DO NOT book directly with this hotel!
text:
DO NOT book directly with this hotel! Use a reliable agent like Booking.com. 
Having stayed at Holiday Inn Gare de Lyon 6 times with our dog - which had all been very good experiences which we had relayed to all our friends traveling to/through Paris with dogs  - I tried booking DIRECTLY on their web site AS REQUESTED BY THEIR STAFF. As I was completing my reservation, I noticed that the dates had changed from July 16-18 to TODAY (July 11). I tried to Abort hitting Back space and Escape but the site grabbed my info and processed it anyway. I IMMEDIATELY contacted their Customer Service which turned out to be a contractor. After explaining I receivced an email saying that the reservation HAD been cancelled but that the Manager (Maxime) had refused to refund the charge of $394. BAD!!!!!

author: Paige D
title: Solid functional stay at the center of Paris
text:
The hotel is located close to the Gare de Lyon station, but not too close. Overall, this central placement make it comfortable for you to access all form of transportation. As you should expect, a Holiday Inn is not a palace, but the hotel is clean and well organized. The rooms are spacious (I had the king bed room) and well organized. There is a desk, small closets and very importantly, a safe and a small fridge. The bathroom is nice and has modern fixtures and decent soaps. I stayed on the third floor and there was little to no noise from the street. A little bit seeped from the next door rooms. The restaurant - especially for breakfast - was overpriced. 
Most importantly, the air conditioning was GREAT. You have a modern thermostat too and can control it very well.
In short - it's a very functional, comfortable say at the center of Paris . I with they would  let you get into the room earlier in the morning after an overnight flight, but I understand that's not always possible.

author: Grace M
title: Excellent stay!
text:
The hotel enjoys an ideal location, easily accessible and well-served.
Very warm welcome from the staff and the quality of the breakfast is exceptional.
I highly recommend this establishment for a pleasant and comfortable stay!

author: Nora A
title: Towels are important.
text:
The hotel was very clean. Modern, good breakfast. 
My reason for the three? It was 1,000$ a night. The towels were crusty wash rags. For 1,000$ a night, the towels should be large and fluffy.

author: Paolo N
title: Excellent, well connected, Main station and many restaurants very close.
text:
Apx £35 by Uber/Bolt taxi from Charles De Galle Airport (June 26), takes an hour.
Excellent hotel in a great location, clean, comfortable, great service.
2 min walk to Gare De Lyon Station (Subway/Trains/Metro), provides easy access to Paris attractions.
Buy a travel card.
1 min walk to great pastry shops/Cafes, restaurants, kebab shops, night life etc.

author: Emma P
title: Very poor customer service experience
text:
What a terrible experience staying in this hotel so far. From an extremely slow, laborious and curt check-in service to not being able to exchange the Rock hard pillows for softer ones contrary to their advertised “customise your pillow experience”. 
What a joke !!!
Perhaps management should spend some time in well managed hotels to see what customer service really looks like.

author: Amelia H
title: Great one night visit to explore Paris
text:
Great hotel - welcoming staff on arrival who made us feel at home. We were on the 7th floor room 707 in one of the King Suites (has a King bed in one room, sofa bed in another and spacious bathroom). Bathroom had a full size tub as well as separate shower as well as a TV in the mirror as a fun addition! I’d say the room wasn’t quite immaculate; check behind the bath and under the sofa please but the rest of it was fine and well equipped. Wireless chargers in both rooms for
your phones add to the convenience. Air conditioning had no problem with the 34C (98F) and was such a relief from the heat of the day. I will say there probably needs to be more of a pillow choice. Just couldn’t find a comfortable one!

We went inclusive of breakfast rate as we knew we wouldn’t have the energy to get out first thing. What a grand selection at the buffet with hot (you can have a full breakfast if you want with hash browns, tomatoes, beans, sausage, eggs, bacon) or a cold meat/cheese platter with a lovely selection of french cheeses. Crepes, croissants or pain au chocolat can round off your need to break your fast! Delicious coffees, juices, loose leaf teas also available.

If you want to eat out for dinner I will suggest Le P’tit Zinc, a great gem just around the corner with French eats at reasonable prices.

Thanks for overall a great stay!

author: Emma G
title: Perfect stay
text:
Perfect stay at this hotel. Warm and efficient welcome. The hotel is beautiful; the room, although not very spacious, is very well equipped. The bedding is perfect for a good night's recovery. The room was located on the courtyard side, and as a result, it was very quiet.
You can dine at the restaurant. The selection is limited, but of very good quality. The staff is very pleasant. 
I will return without hesitation.

author: Katie V
title: Great Place - Pros n Cons
text:
Cons - Pros
Location:
Cons -       Yes, it is in what they consider the Sex district.  There is a "Sex Shop" next door.  I never did see and person or un-savory persons hanging around or going into this shop.  It, the Sex District, had no affect on the our stay.  But then again I was not out at mid-night walking the streets.
Pros -       The Gare de Lyon Metro (5 min walk) and Gare de Austerlitz Metro (15 min walk) are very close. We used the Gare de Lyon for all metro's on the same side of the river as this Hotel, the Austerlitz Metro for any Metro needs on the other side of the river.  We also purchased the Navigo card that is good from a week (Monday am to Sunday pm).  It was good for the RER to Versailles, in city Metro and bus, along with the trolly from the top of Montmartre.  Saved us daily time from looking for what tickets we would need to purchase.  We did get stopped once on the Metro where they did check to make sure we had the correct tickets for that Metro ride, no problem.
There is a great pastry place just a short walk, Boulangerie Bo (closed Wednesday n Thursday).

Hotel:
Cons -      We had called a 2 days earlier for early check in which they said would be no problem.  Only for the front desk when we checked in say they had no idea what we were talking about.  No loss, they put our suite cases into a locked room tagged, and we went exploring the city.
We also had a bad smell in the entry way of the room (it has a 5 ft entry before the bedroom) when we first walked in.  Never smelled it again and the room itself smelled OK.
The vent in the bathroom did not work, so when a hot shower was taken, it did fog up everything in the bathroom.  No big deal, until Hotel personnel knocked on our door out of breath from running because the steam set off an alarm down stairs.  I told him it was the steam from the shower, he said open the doors to the balcony to air it out.  We did not have any other problem with that
Apparently the beds in most of Europe are made with only one sheet.  One to lay on, the the comforter over you.  Not a problem, but different from the States.
Pros -       This was the nicest Holiday Inn i have ever stayed at.  Very clean and up to date.  The staff were very friendly and helpful.  They were GREAT (even with the Check in early problem).  The room had a balcony, which was very small with two chairs and a small table (i expected it to be small).  The in-room coffee maker was some of the best coffee I have ever had ( I am not a coffee coinsurer).  

We stayed in mid April 2026, which was great weather.  Slightly cool, used  light jacket, flowers were beautiful.  Rained lightly one afternoon for about one hour.

I WOULD DEFFINATLY STAY HERE AGAIN.  only gave it a 4 because I can be picky.

author: Marco C
title: This Hotel Does it So Well!
text: You can't go wrong with this hotel. Yes, we felt strange booking a "chain" hotel for our trip to Paris, but we had points and have always had an excellent experience with IHG hotels. Imagine our surprise to show up at 11 a.m. and be given the loveliest room on the fifth floor (520) - a space filled with light and a tall ceiling, complete with a thoroughly modern bathroom filled with stylish toiletries. This hotel is so convenient to the Gare De Lyon metro/train station that staying in the 12th arrondisement was a joy. The area is perfectly safe, just lively enough at night, and there are many attractions within walking distance. There is a Monop across the street for any small grocery/personal necessities you may need. Several bistros and boulangeries offer up a multitude of dining options. We are early risers and quickly realized that the breakfast offered at the hotel is a smart way to go if you like a hearty meal at 6:30 a.m. before starting a busy day of touring. There are a tremendous variety of food and coffee options (and as many cups of coffee as you like). It's a bargain, truly, as many places nearby offered a breakfast consisting of one coffee, a croissant, and a glass of orange juice for around 15 euros. For just a bit more, we had our choice of a variety of egg dishes, ham, bacon, cold cuts, yogurt with all of the fixings, fresh fruit in season, and a number of breads that should satisfy anyone. The staff here were always welcoming and helpful. I know part of the Parisian experience for many people means staying in a boutique hotel or at an Air B'n'B, but this hotel does everything that it should so very well, making our stay just that much more pleasant and easy. Cannot recommend high enough!

author: Mia T
title: Five nights in Paris
text:
I was at Holiday Inn Paris - Gare de Lyon Bastille by IHG for five nights.

Positive aspects: Hotel is ideally situated close to several public transportation means; I had a good room with a comfortable bed, with good insulation from outside noise; Staff were helpful; Breakfast was very good; Wi-fi worked very well.

Need improvement: The shower-in-tub was quite uncomfortable; It was difficult to regulate the room temperature.

author: Holly K
title: Very nice Hotel
text:
This Paris hotel is perfect
The Gare de Lyon area is very nice, the hotel is very close to the train station.
The hotel is beautiful, the rooms are spacious, the staff is very welcoming.
Breakfast is a real treat and there are many choices.
We will be back with great pleasure.

author: Brooke N
title: Great hotel, a tad expensive maybe
text: Room 502: facing a busy street (great balcony) nut no nouse whatsoever! Spacious rooms and a brilliant shower! Good bed with decent pillows. Beautiful reception/lounge area. Staff is super friendly. Location is brilliant if you have an early train to catch!

author: Lauren B
title: Hotel with parisian charm. Rooms and breakfast top!  Mr Michael at reception very helpful in safe packaging of my
text: Lots of Parisian charm at this hotel. Breakfast and rooms top! Mr. Michael from reception helped me brilliantly with a safe packaging for my souvenirs

author: Abigail O
title: Great hotel in a good location.
text: Really great stay. Three of us stayed in a family room for two nights. Staff were very friendly. The breakfast was excellent. The room was large and modern. Plenty of plugs.  Good bathroom facilities. Had nothing to complain about. Hope to come back again next year.

author: Amelia Q
title: Excellent choice close to Lyon train station.
text: We have been going to this hotel for years and we are always satisfied with it. Large, clean and well equipped rooms. Breakfast very much above average. Excellent location: Gare de Lyon, Metro and tons of restaurants nearby. Staff always friendly. Highly recommended.

author: Tyler L
title: Holiday Inn Paris - Gare de Lyon - A great value hotel in a convenient locale.
text:
This hotel was situated in a convenient location, near the train station with many great eateries nearby.

The hotel accommodations were top notch. It is in a beautiful space, clean, and has friendly staff. 

We had a great trip!

author: Katie M
title: Bedbugs  Beware
text:
Bedbugs in room 208 

We stayed for one night Sept 30th checking out 1st October 

Everything looked wonderful and we slept well, the staff were charming. 
BUT 
I  awoke covered in bites around my elbows and some on my chest.  Our pharmacist has confirmed they are bedbug bites.
