I phoned the hotel to let them know , the receptionist was rude, denied we had stayed there, and that they did not have bedbugs in their hotel. 
If they will not accept that they have bedbugs, I assume they will do nothing about dealing with the infestation

author: Caleb I
title: Excellent!
text: We had a fantastic stay having stayed before. The area is great as it’s easy to get to and from. The hotel is gorgeous. Our room was well appointed, and had everything you could need. The staff were friendly and helpful. No negatives and we will return soon!

author: Mason Y
title: Very good experience , I recommend...
text:
I regularly stay at this hotel for business reasons.
The staff is at the top.
The hotel is very nice and well located near the Gare de Lyon. Several restaurants nearby friendly knowing that you can also have a drink or dine on the shoot on site.
Breakfast is very good with everything necessary.
I recommend this property with my eyes closed.

author: Wyatt B
title: Reservation cancelled after confirmation: inadmissible
text: Reservation confirmed and then cancelled under the pretext of “pricing error”. The problem is their own system. Very disappointing and absolutely unprofessional. No consideration for the customer.

author: Pablo Q
title: Well without more ... 3 stars but not4
text: Very well placed the neighborhood is quiet nice the means of transport easily accessible. The breakfast is very good staff also but the room is not worth a 4 star due to its cramped bed does not make the 160 the cramped bathroom the bar is empty there is no iron... the elevator is really too small and aging pity!!

author: Noah D
title: Nice location
text:
It’s a very clean and central hotel in Paris.
We were very happy with it.
The breakfast was good and the service very polite.
The shower at the bathroom was a bit difficult for us but over all the room was clean and nice.

author: Rosie L
title: All right.
text:
The hotel is full of charm and modernity. It is very well located, close to many shops and restaurants, and 5 minutes from the metro.
The room is well equipped and warm, as is the welcome by the staff who remain available and pleasant.
In use, however, I find, that we hear a lot of street noises in the neighborhood that is very lively. The renewal of the insulation by a recent and high-performance glazing deserves to be reassessed to gain comfort in the bedroom.

author: Isabella Z
title: Adorable hotel
text: Appreciated how quiet the neighborhood was.  Safe and walkable. The bus wasn't far and uber was convenient. Great view from balcony too.

author: George C
title: Perfect.
text:
It is an elegant, clean and comfortable hotel.
The staff is friendly 
I will return with pleasure and recommend

author: Hannah O
title: Amazing stay!
text: One of the best hotel stays I’ve ever had! I can’t thank you guys enough for such a lovely first time experience staying in France.

author: Lucy W
title: Good
text: Very good service, polite and helpful receptionists, clean and convenient. Thank you for your service.

author: Alice N
title: Super stay
text: Great stay, very good location, great bedding, we were able to walk many places, accessible by metro too. Clean, nothing wrong

author: Manon E
title: Stay
text: Our stay was very good with attentive staff. The room very clean with suitable equipment. We slept well, the bedding impeccable. Very nice stay. I recommend this hotel to 200%. Good location. Value for money very well.

author: Wyatt E
title: Too cute.
text: The standard rooms are too small. The bathroom is tiny and the elevator is too small.

author: Pablo R
title: Lovely hotel
text: All of the staff were very friendly and welcoming. And I appreciate that the front desk walked me to the elevator upon my arrival. My hotel room was so cute, updated, and very clean. I loved the view from my balcony and that my room had a balcony. Also, the hotel breakfast was absolutely delicious! I actually chose to eat at the hotel instead of finding a cafe a couple of mornings of my stay. Overall, I recommend this hotel and would love to stay again.

author: Alice N
title: Weekend
text: Hotel itself nice but room a little small on the other hand the staff night and day is CATASTROPHIC they do not want to go up neither to open the room nor to go up to drink or an iron I had to go down and are unpleasant as I have rarely seen

author: Harry B
title: review
text: I have been at this hotel few other  times . Very nice hotel for the rates, comfortable, and ideal to visit or move around Paris as needed

author: Dylan J
title: PERFECT
text: just one night but in a quality establishment and I highly recommend, with very professional staff

author: Jack U
title: Great
text:
I had a very pleasant stay at Hôtel Pavillon Monceau.
The hotel is located in a quiet and peaceful area, perfect for relaxing after a long day exploring Paris.

The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff were extremely kind, professional, and always willing to help, which made the stay even more enjoyable.

The location is excellent—close to public transportation, cafés, and beautiful streets, yet away from the crowded tourist areas.

Overall, a great experience. I would definitely recommend this hotel and would happily stay here again.

author: James E
title: weekend
text:
good welcome-good hygiene-good value for money
comfort-decoration pleasant
hearty breakfast- good location

author: Daniel K
title: A nice Hotel with super friendly staff
text: We have now visited this hotel for a third time and are very satisfied. It is a nice neighborhood with plenty of restaurants nearby and all the sights of the city are easily accessible. The hotel was thoroughly renovated a few years ago and all rooms and reception rooms are top notch. But the ambiance of a Parisian hotel has been preserved. We regularly visit Paris for exhibitions or concerts and then this hotel feels a bit like coming home.

author: Alice J
title: Paris stay
text: a cosy and quiet hotel with a very good value for money: improve breakfast with better products (e.g. industrial pancakes and medium jams despite the small pots ) and that the staff without trolley do not use the elevator during rush hour ( point already ) because very long waiting and the stairs are not convenient or well lit for guests .

author: Zoe M
title: short stay
text: The room was very comfortable. Cleanliness and breakfast are perfect. The hotel is quiet and the staff is very attentive to the customer.

author: Benjamin G
title: Huge disappointment in Paris
text:
I know that Paris is an old city and some buildings have awkward layouts which is why I requested a room with a view. I asked them a month in advance and we were very disappointed with our room that has a window to a shared public walkway and no view. You can’t keep the window open because someone can crawl inside which presents a safety and comfort issue. 
I’m sorry to say that this is by far the worst hotel room I have ever stayed in my many trips to Paris. The front desk did not honor my wish to have a view, even they have many rooms available with views. The room also smelled like sewage/mildew. 
I’m sure if we were given a room in the main block or looking on the Main Street as we requested, we would have had a better experience. Too bad because location is great. But for 300 a night it’s a disappointment.

author: Sara N
title: A stone's throw from the Louvre
text:
Centrally located hotel, very close to the Louvre. 
Friendly and helpful staff, they also speak Italian.
Small room, tiny bathroom. Carpet everywhere...
Daily cleaning with towel change.
Comfortable beds. Our room was overlooking inner courtyard (other windows very close) very quiet.
Breakfast average, positive note the juice of real oranges (not fake juice).
For a short stay I would recommend it.

author: Laura A
title: Ideal hotel in Paris
text: Stayed here twice now when visiting Paris, for the price I can not fault it. Great lication, clean,  lovely breakfast, cand friendly staff. Will stop here again.

author: Zachary X
title: Great location
text:
Great location. Actually just next to Louvre museum
5min walk from the nearest metro (line 1, where you can get to most of the tourist spots)
10min walk from the RER station, where you get on the train to airport / disney/outlet 
also many buses around 
many restaurants /bakery nearby, including chinese , japanese, French etc
there are some hair left in the Bathroom or the room 
no bottled water is provided in the room but there are supermarkets on the next street 
can store the luggage for free 
highly recommend

author: Nora G
title: You can't beat the location of this cute budget hotel!
text:
The staff at Timhotel were very kind and helpful with recommendations. You can't beat the location being so close to the Louvre and also not far from Notre Dame and the Marais. We traveled with my 89 year old mother and she really liked the breakfast.

The breakfast was modest IMHO but certainly adequate to start the day. The room and especially the bathroom were tight. I've never stayed somewhere with such a small bathroom! But it served its purpose and being in Paris is not about lounging in your hotel room when there's so much to do outside!

author: Evan Y
title: Timhotel Le Louvre
text: The room was smaller than expected- 3 areas - dressing, bed & shower/toilet apparently this is called a suite… great for 1 .. not so much for 2

author: Jack W
title: Great location, excellent value.
text: Great tourist hotel. Rooms are clean and mattress was comfortable. Breakfast was also good. The eggs were great. No one does eggs better than France! Pastry was fresh and flaky every morning. Conveniently located a short walk from the train station and the Louvre. Easy walk to Notre Dame and the left bank. Lots of other museums and other attractions close by. Many restaurants and shopping locations super close. Eiffel Tower is about a 45 minute walk, but there’s a lot to see on the way. Go up one side of the river Seine and back on the other to take advantage of the different views. The Arche de Triumphe is a bit far, but if you’re already at the Eiffel Tower it’s not a bad walk. So much to see! Staff are friendly and will let you store your bags until check in time if your plane gets in super early like ours did. Do make an effort to learn a few words of French for pleasantries while in France. Please and thank you, hello, goodbye, etc. Most service people speak a little English but they appreciate the effort.

author: Megan Z
title: Great location and friendly staff
text: Everything was great overall. The bathroom was a little small, but the location is excellent and the staff were very friendly and helpful.

author: Rosie L
title: Perfect hotel for a short trip- with a brilliant location!
text: We stayed in this hotel for the weekend, and it was perfect for a weekend trip. The location of the hotel was unbeatable. A two minute walk from the Louvre, a short walk from two metro stations, super close to lots of shops, restaurants, patisseries and more. Check in was quick and smooth with a warm welcome from a lovely, friendly receptionist. All staff members were super friendly- from reception, to housekeeping, to the breakfast staff. The room was good for a short stay- it was a little bit small, particularly the bathroom, however it was not an issue at all. The view out of the window wasn't great- but we weren't staring out of the window the whole time we were in the room so again- not an issue! The only tiny issue we had was there was a bit of an odd smell in the room- assuming it came from the bathroom. The beds were super comfy with very good quality bedding and comfy pillows. We slept very well, there was a bit of noise which sounded like rumbling from the metro, but didn't wake us once we were asleep. TV in the room had lots of channels, and the heater and air-con unit was brilliant at warming us up after a cold rainy day. Breakfast was great- nice hot, fresh food, a coffee machine which served good hot coffees, a good cold selection, lots of breads and pastries, and fresh fruit and cold meats. There was a cold water dispenser which was available 24/7 in the reception area- a great touch! Overall, this hotel had everything you could need for a trip away and was perfect for a short trip!

author: Lucas T
title: comfort and availability
text: Very convenient hotel for location, close to the major centers of interest and metro stations, a stone's throw from the shopping street and especially the Louvre, and the Opera

author: Lauren Y
title: Very nice and super central hotel
text: Super central hotel with all facilities below including a supermarket. Two subways including the 1. Warm and renovated rooms just the bathroom a little narrow. Windows with blackout curtains. Good breakfast, staff at the reception who also speaks Italian and is very kind. We had a great time.

author: Andrea D
title: Long weekend in Paris
text: The location is great: metro stop a stone's throw away, Louvre, MAD and Bourse de Commerce – Pinault Collection a stone's throw away. The room is spacious, quiet and clean with a proper bathroom. Friendly staff.

author: Lauren Y
title: a cultural stay in Paris
text:
Hotel to recommend. It is well located, in the museum district. The 24/7 accessibility is pleasant.
One regret: no availability of WIFI in our room, on the 5th floor during our three days.

author: Jack U
title: I could go back
text: Hotel easily accessible by public transport, close to the metro is to the main attractions of Paris.  Surprisingly quiet although we are close to the Louvre. The staff is friendly and helpful. The room a little small, but we are in the Parisian standard. I'll take it into consideration if I return to Paris, a circumstance not excluded because I still have something to see and then... I know the way.

author: Charlotte L
title: Excellent hotel
text: Super fantastic location: Louvre, Palais Royal, Comedie Francaise etc very close. Restaurants, brasseries, everything close. Friendly staff, clean and spacious room, very small bathroom but fine. I recommend this hotel and will definitely stay again.

author: Freya B
title: Timhotel Le Louvre
text: An amazing place, closest to the tourist points, specially Louvre and good breakfast! The team is amazing too!

author: Henry P
text: The 3 stars of the hotel are clearly for its location and not for the quality of the visitor experience.

author: Charlie O
title: Recommend
text: An excellent level of service both by the Welcoming staff and the hotel itself which is renovated and what about the location which is perfect a few steps from the metro.

author: Pablo F
title: Great location, awful smell and dirty room
text:
The location is great, and the staff was kind and polite.
However, the room was very dirty — dust and dirt behind the bed, an unpleasant smell, and a complete lack of cleaning.
I booked two rooms: my children’s room smelled like sewage.
I would never stay in this hotel again.

author: Kyle K
title: My 5 days stay at the Timhotel Le louvre
text:
My stay at your hotel was not entirely satisfactory.

Let's start with the positives. The hotel's location is excellent. The room and bathroom were very clean. The reception staff were always very polite. There was a problem with the bathtub, which was quickly resolved.

However, the room was not always very comfortable. The beds were comfortable, but there was only a small table and an old chair. And there was a small stool without a backrest. Not very comfortable. And no furniture to store our belongings.

But it was the breakfast that we disliked the most. First, the croissants were not good. They were probably industrial croissants bought at the supermarket. Second, the scrambled eggs had absolutely no taste. We would have liked to add pepper to them, but the pepper shaker was always empty. We mentioned this to the lady in charge of breakfast on the first two days, but the pepper shaker remained empty for the entire five days we stayed at your hotel. For the last two breakfasts, we bought croissants and chocolate croissants from a bakery and just had your coffee.

author: Joseph W
title: A stone's throw from Times Square, but with several aspects to review
text:
The hotel is in an excellent location: Times Square can be reached comfortably in about 5 minutes on foot. Furthermore, in the immediate vicinity there are several subway and public transport stops, as well as supermarkets, restaurants and everything necessary to make the stay very comfortable.

I was also lucky to have a room with a beautiful view of the New York skyscrapers, a detail that made the stay even more pleasant.

My room was clean and tidy, however there were several aspects that made the experience less satisfactory. For three consecutive days the soap was not restocked, despite the fact that I had requested it several times from the staff.

Furthermore, I was surprised by the fact that the room was not equipped with a mini-fridge and that, upon our arrival, not even a simple complimentary bottle of water had been left, a courtesy that many hotels now offer their guests.

Another morning I kindly asked if it was possible to have a simple teaspoon, but I was told that I would have to buy it from the vending machine at a cost of €3.50. I found this response truly unprofessional and not very attentive to the customer: after having spent about €2,000 for the stay, I would have expected a minimum of availability for such a simple request.

Finally, although my room was clean, in the hallway on my floor the carpet gave off a strong odor, similar to that of cheese, as if it had been washed without being dried correctly or had not been cleaned thoroughly. It is a detail that gives a bad impression of the common areas and that should be improved.

Overall, the hotel's location is undoubtedly its strong point, as is the view from my room. However, the service and attention to some details were not up to the price paid and deserve more attention.

author: Pablo C
title: Minimal rooms
text: The photos of the rooms are taken with a wide-angle lens and they look bigger than they are. These are minimal and the bed is a Murphy bed because if you open it, there is no room in the room. A shame

author: Zachary G
title: They SCAM customers with rooms that do not match reality.
text:
Our experience at this hotel was extremely negative and, unfortunately, it is the first time we have been forced to leave a property due to the condition in which the room was handed over to us.

We had booked a corner room with a view, equipped with a modern bathroom with a glass shower, exactly as represented in the photos and the room type selected at the time of booking. Upon our arrival, however, we were assigned a completely different room: neglected, in poor condition, with numerous stains, obvious signs of wear, and damaged in several places. The bathroom was also a handicap-accessible bathroom, with the floor full of stains and a shower equipped with a simple curtain, absolutely not corresponding to the room we had booked and the images published.

What is even more serious is that, by consulting the reviews published in the previous months, we found that other guests had already reported the exact same problem, namely the discrepancy between the rooms shown in the photographs and those actually assigned to guests. This shows that the issue had already been brought to the attention of the property for some time and that, despite this, nothing seems to have been done to resolve it or to correctly inform customers before booking.

We immediately went to the reception, asking with the utmost politeness to be able to use the room actually booked. We were told that the rooms of that type were being renovated and that no alternatives were available (the same excuse already used previously with other guests, see reviews on Booking).

At this point we tried to find a solution together with the reception, but the behavior of the staff was, in our opinion, absolutely inadequate and unprofessional. We did not receive any concrete assistance or willingness to find a solution. On the contrary, while we were trying to explain the situation and resolve the problem, some members of the staff continued to be on the phone texting, even going so far as to laugh in our faces in front of our requests and our evident discomfort.

The only solution we managed to find was to contact Booking support on our own. Support immediately took charge of our case and initiated the refund request for the total nights not used. Unfortunately, even in this case, the hotel refused to meet our request.

The following day we were contacted again by Booking and were informed that the property was not willing to find a solution or to meet us halfway and that, consequently, it had opposed the refund.

We lost more than half a day trying to resolve a situation that we had not created and, in the end, we were forced to find an alternative solution on our own, without receiving any real support from the hotel.

It was an extremely disappointing experience from every point of view: room not in accordance with the booking, unacceptable conditions of the property, terrible customer service, total lack of professionalism and helpfulness on the part of the staff and no willingness to resolve the problem, despite it being a situation already reported by other customers in the previous months.

In many years of traveling, it is the first time that we have found ourselves in a similar situation and that we have been forced to leave a hotel due to the conditions of the room and the total absence of cooperation on the part of the property.

We strongly advise against this hotel. We believe that the relationship between what was promised at the time of booking and what was actually offered was absolutely unacceptable and that the behavior held by the property towards a customer who had simply requested what was regularly booked was extremely disappointing.

author: Gavin R
title: Never got refund
text: I booked a penthouse room for my birthday but they gave me a regular small room said the penthouse was flooded at last minute. But they would offer a refund. It’s almost two weeks later I never got refund and they never answer my phone call anymore. I emailed Marcelino who handled my issue at the time and he never responded either.

author: Aiden M
title: Traumatizing experience
text:
Traumatizing experience: Unsafe environment and negligent security
​I am writing to share a deeply distressing experience I had while staying here alone for work.
​20 minutes after check-in, two men under the influence of drugs began pounding on my door, claiming to be hotel staff bringing "bread." When I refused to open, they became aggressive, yelling insults and trying to force their way in with other keys.
​When I reported this to hotel security, they dismissed me, claiming I was "overreacting" and that it was likely a misunderstanding. Even after the police arrived and instructed them to move me to a different room, the security staff continued to minimize the incident in front of the officers.
​I am left traumatized by this. The hotel’s long hallways have no video surveillance, and I shudder to think what could have happened had I stepped out of my room alone. The hotel clearly prioritizes its image over guest safety. I felt completely abandoned and vulnerable. I strongly advise solo travelers to avoid this property, as the management's lack of concern for guest security is unacceptable.

author: Mathis B
title: Not a stay that I had planned
text:
I was happy to get such a great deal on YOTEL, through Priceline. However, the fact that I had to pay a $50 charge for resort fee was shocking, since Priceline did not mention this in my final payment sheet. I arrived at the hotel at 6pm and went to the automated check in service that said that my hotel room was not ready.  That was three hours after the expected check-in time. I asked an attendant to help me, since I could not stand in a long line of 10 people, waiting to go to the desk with two attendants.  He told me that there was nothing that he could do to help me.

I spoke with the agent after a wait and the gentleman was very nice and told me that I could not get my room key without paying an additional $50 for the “resort” fee. I asked what that fee was for, since I had paid taxes/fees with Priceline. He said that there was a gym-free local calls(which no one needs) and free internet. $50 for one night??? The gentleman did extend my check-out time by the three hours that I had missed with checking into my room. He said that there were problems with the automatic check-in system. 

My room was very small, but very clean. There was no comfortable chair, no refrigerator. The remote did not work on the tv, so I could not watch tv.

There is a big lobby where one cannot take advantage of the great buffet breakfast in the main dining room in the summer. There are no comfortable chairs in the upper lobby. The temp felt like 50 degrees. There is a beautiful garden and dining area, but one cannot sit at a table without making a purchase or getting a meal. The outside deck is beautiful. The menu for the restaurant(not the main one) is very limited. The coffee prices are outrageous.

I tried to use the internet but it asked me to accept terms(them stealing cookies), however, I could not look at the terms and conditions, since they would not pop up.

Take-away:
1. For the $50 resort fee, one does not get the normal amenities. The fee is a rip-off for less than 2hrs. It is one of the highest that I have seen. 
  2. Do not use PRICELINE-It did not mention the required “resort” fee

  3. If the hotel has glitches in the automatic check-in, then the hotel has to provide more attendants, but the space in the ground floor lobby is too small for more than two attendants.

author: Gavin L
title: Horrible - Stay - Away
text:
Staff was incompetent and rude. After a canceled flight, I arrived at the hotel at 6 AM morning. Asked for late  checkout when i woll try a flight one more time. Front desk could not figure out the process for late  checkout, and the following day changed their mind and said no. 

Rooms space is non-existent and might be cheap for a hotel to pay after a cancelled flight but would never recommend or stay at this place.

author: Harry Q
title: Light blinked on/off the entire night
text:
I paid over $425/night for a room in which a blue light next to the bed blinked on and off the entire night, illuminating the room and making it difficult to sleep. The hotel did nothing to fix it, despite repeated calls and promises. 

Details:
- I noticed on my first evening that the light next to the bed would not turn off and instead blinked off and on. I called the front desk, who said they'd send someone up. No one came. Terrible night sleep.
- The next morning I rang first thing to ask someone to come look at the light. I was told someone would come. No one came the entire day.
- That evening, back at the hotel, I called again. No one came and so I called again. Now we're at 8 or 9 pm. The guy who came up said "yeah, that's super annoying , most of the rooms don't have this problem any more." But for him to be able to fix it, he said he would need two additional guys to help him move the unit the light was embedded in. He tried to cover it with electrical tape, which made it slightly better, but did not fix the issue.
- I called the front desk again that night to ask for a solution and they said a manager would return my call. No one called me. I called again. "A manager is going to call. " No manager called. I tried again, they put me on hold for 25 minutes, and then hung up on me.  No one ever followed up, and again, a terrible night sleep. 

Things happen at hotels--one has to be understanding about that. But how a hotel deals with those things, and treats their guests, is a big sign of their DNA and whether you should return. 

Other notes: 
- Room was clean and made up tidily
- Breakfast is quick and right value/quality for price
- Super small and not easy to move around--I've stayed in capsule hotels before, but never for $425+ a night. 
- Terrible AI Voice help line that takes forever to navigate, is slow and interrupts you, and just feels like another attempt to remove all humans from interacting with the guests

author: Louis C
title: Never. Again.
text: I've stayed in a lot of hotels and you couldn't PAY me to stay at this hotel again. From our initial entrance, where the revolving door was broken and surrounded by caution tape, to the dark corner you find the reception desk in to the cold, uninviting room that REEKED of cigarette and marijuana smoke and also featured someone else's hair and bobby pins still on the bathroom floor as well as unmade beds for my kids, this was an ABSOLUTE nightmare. The "times square" location is also a joke. This is too far from times square, in my opinion, to be considered a times square hotel.

author: Diego P
title: Perfect
text: Good service, attention, and price.

author: Claire R
title: Very poor hotel and small room no amenities at all even one bottle of water
text: Very poor hotel and very overrated price

author: Lucas A
title: Love the concept but can use updates
text:
I had a quick 1 night stay when my flight cancelled.  Hotel is very nice however it is showing a bit of wear and tear. 
Front desk and bell staff were helpful.  My room was very clean and comfortable. 
Things that can be improved- ice machines on the floors.  I had to try about 6 different ice machines before finally finding one that worked.  Also all ice machines were out of ice bags- I had to use my own plastic bag. 
The outlet panel in my room with regular plugs and USB outlets did not work.  I had to charge my phone in the bathroom.  
One of the shelves on the tv console had a burn mark from a previous guest- most likely from a candle.  The furniture in the room is a bit marked up and scuffed.  
I think with a refresh this place could be perfect!

author: Nora H
title: Major Security Breach & Ignored by Management – Items Stolen From Room 1015
text:
Stayed: June 11–16, 2026

My wife and I recently stayed in Room 1015 at Yotel New York. While the hotel has a modern setup, our entire experience was completely ruined by a massive security breach and an appalling lack of customer service. On the morning of June 16th, we realised to our horror that multiple high-value, personal items had been stolen directly out of our room during our stay.

The detailed list of stolen items includes:

Electronics: A brand new Apple iPad. (Admittedly, I naively left this out of the safe, but a guest should still expect a locked room to be secure).

Cash & Valuables: A personal purse containing $160 in cash, which had been tucked away inside our hand luggage.

Designer Clothing: An assortment of high-end designer label polo shirts and t-shirts. These were incredibly sentimental to me as they were recent birthday presents from my family. Shockingly, the thief went through our personal belongings and took these directly out of the room's storage drawers.

The Timeline & Evidence:
We discovered the theft on the morning we were checking out. However, we had a strict 6:00 AM taxi pickup scheduled to catch our travel connection and simply did not have the time to track down a duty manager at that early hour before rushing to the airport.

My daughter emailed the hotel management team a couple of days after we left to formally report the crime and provide the details. It has now been 8 days, and the hotel management has completely ignored her email. We have received zero response.

To make matters worse, we have definitive proof of the crime. When I used Apple's location services to track my stolen iPad, it pinged live at a commercial shipping depot in Atlanta. Neither my wife nor I have ever been to Atlanta, nor have we ever shipped anything there. Our belongings were stolen from our room and immediately shipped out of state.

To Management:
You have a severe internal theft problem and a complete failure of leadership. There was no forced entry, meaning whoever stole these items had authorised keycard access to Room 1015. This points directly to a member of your staff. Ignoring an email about a major criminal theft in your building for over a week is shameful. I expect management to pull their heads out of the sand, contact us immediately, and audit the electronic keycard logs for Room 1015 between June 11th and June 16th.

To Future Travelers:
Do not trust the privacy or security of your room at Yotel NY. If you choose to stay here, do not leave anything of value exposed. Lock your cash, electronics, and even your nice clothing inside the safe. The fact that staff members are actively rifling through guests' drawers and luggage, and management completely ignores you when you report it, is terrifying. Stay elsewhere.

author: James Z
title: BED BUGS!
text:
🪳🪳🪳BED BUGSSSS!!! do not stay here!!
I checked out and on my walk i noticed bed bugs so we tried calling and no one answered so we turned around and went back to the hotel to ask to check the beds.

The managers were neglectful, would not say one word to me. No sorry, how can we help.. NOT A WORD. the only one that was allowed to speak with us was the security guy. He said we are not allowed back in the room.
They denied my ask for medical attention!! Told me it was too late. I asked to speak to a higher manager (bc the guy wouldn't speak to us) and they declined.

UNCOMFORTABLE. DISGUSTING. TERRIBLE STAFF.

author: Tyler A
title: Solid price and solid location
text: This was my second time staying at Yotel. You cannot beat the price and location. As a gay man who loves theatre, I loved that I was near Hells Kitchen for LGBTQIA+ nightlife and near the theatre district but not smack dab in Times Square. A few disappointments but not deal breakers - our outlets didn’t seem to work fully so I’d sometimes wake up without a full charge on my phone. Plus the way the shampoo, body wash and conditioner were locked into the shower made them hard to pump. I’d stay here again.

author: Charlotte X
title: DONT STAY HERE
text: Extremely unfriendly and rude staff, will never stay there again and will make sure all my family and friends wont either. Asked to speak with a manager for my satisfaction and I was shutdown. Filthy bedding is a health hazard.

author: Emma L
title: Unclean room
text: Dirty rooms unclean . Would never sleep here again

author: Alice U
title: Zero satisfaction
text: Worst hotel ever. Chargr you 50$ per fay as tax for nothing. No coffee machine. No free coffee at the hotrl. No fridge. I was promised a fridge, it wasn't supplied. So, not trusty staff, over priced, small room. Do not come near !!!!

author: Evie U
title: AC was not working in our room.
text:
Ac was broken both nights. Room temperature was 79 degrees. Maintenance did come up, said it was the buildings compressor. We asked to relocate but were told the hotel was sold out.

We left the second night for home after paying close to $400 per night.

Reached out to management and they responded they were sorry. 

That's not good enough, feel we should be refunded or at least a voucher for Boston (Where we live).

author: Luke O
title: Cigarette burns in the room and no AC
text: I I booked a suite, and there were cigarette burns on the credenza and on the bed. The room wasn’t very clean and my AC kept breaking. Staff was very nice, but the room was in very poor condition and was limited. AC made my stay miserable.

author: Nathan F
title: Enchanting stay at the Tophams hotel :)
text: I rarely-almost never - write a review, feeling that I should not bias people based on our experience..However since our return from London, I have felt the urgent need to set the record straight about the Tophams hotel and the rating/reviews it has received. I had looked it up and made the booking despite the multiple unfavorable reviews, sighting quite a few advantages and feeling that somehow I had to give it a chance. And I must confess that we were not disappointed in the least! :) First of all its location is absolutely fabulous..Convenient, safe, charming! :) The room was not big but for us it was sufficiently spacious, comfy and had everything we needed! I understand that the hotel has smaller rooms, but you better check it at the time of reservation, depending on the traveler group size and requirements. Their breakfast was both qualitative and diverse, a great start of the day! And last but not least, their staff was genuinely welcoming and friendly, making us feel that we were home away from home for the week we stayed with them! Thank you very much Tophams for a truly enchanting stay! :)

author: Matthew Y
title: Great hotel
text:
The location is good.  We chose to stay here as our son was running in the London Marathon and it was close to the finish.  It was also close to tube stations and parks.  We enjoyed the continental breakfast and there was sufficient choices for both meat eaters and vegetarians.  A lovely touch were the cakes on offer by the Reception and they were delicious.

A downside was the shower which kept changing temperature from normal to cold and very hot.

author: Erin O
title: Basic but good location.
text:
Small hotel tiny bed and bedroom 2stars ???
Clean tidy , reception friendly. Lift not working half our stay. Ok when we left. Breakfast room very tight tables crammed in.  
No eggs , waiting for delivery but no sorry !!! Continental buffet limited and staff not very happy. I’d look elsewhere next time and if you do go book room only and eat out where you get service and what you want. ( oh coffee was good ).

author: Luke T
title: A stay of 2 days was enough
text: The hotel is extremely dark,and accessibility to rooms difficult if the lift is not working, I feel we didn't get the room we booked. Breakfast is ample the staff quite surly,nicely positioned to see London

author: Michael J
title: A beautiful moment
text:
The hotel is ideally positioned for a London discovery.
Staff at the top thank you Rafaela for her help, and kindness. 
A simple breakfast that speaks a bit of an English touch for tourists like us. But very hearty. Perfect room, very good cleaning. 

Thank you to the whole team for allowing us to discover London with a perfect place to rest from our long visits.

author: Adam S
title: Excellent location.
text: We spent a very enjoyable night there a few days ago and had an excellent room. It was spacious with s bathroom under the road so it was huge. The location is perfect for transport and the staff wonderful, checked us in early, nice bar and good breakfast.

author: Freya U
title: ❤️ Super friendly and welcoming staff! But tiny beds, unbearable floor noise and shower impossible to adjust
text:
We stayed 3 nights at Tophams hotel and leave with contrasting impressions. The welcome and staff were absolutely adorable, always smiling and ready to help, which really marked our stay.

Unfortunately, some details spoiled our experience. The beds are so small that it is difficult to sleep together without feeling cramped. Sound insulation is almost non-existent: you can hear every step and every crack of the upper floor floor, as if the neighbors were walking in our room. Finally, showering is a real challenge – it’s impossible to maintain a stable temperature, you have to hurry when the water is finally at the right temperature before it becomes freezing or burning.

In short, if you are looking for a hotel with a friendly team, this is a good place to stay. But if comfort (beds, quiet, shower) is a priority for you, it is better to look elsewhere. Too bad, because with some improvements, this hotel would have everything to please.

author: Laura B
title: A wonderful hotel with exceptional staff
text:
I stayed at The Tophams Hotel and would absolutely recommend. My heartfelt gratitude goes out to Alba, whose kindness and exceptional service made my stay truly unforgettable. She is a shining star within the hotel, and the other staff also at the hotel were kind and professional 

The hotel is 7-minutes from the Cleveland Clinic Hospital and the coach and train station at Victoria, with an array of charming restaurants and establishments just 5 minutes away. This convenience is appreciated for anyone visiting the area.

Inside, the hotel is beautifully decorated, very clean and very accommodating. The bar area is not only stylish but also provides a calming retreat after a busy day. The character of the building is apparent throughout, enhancing its charm and sophistication in every corner.
I was fortunate enough to reside in one of their suites, which was remarkably spacious and equipped with every amenity one could wish for. From the bathrobes and slippers to the hair dryer, kettle, and mini-fridge, attention to detail is clearly a priority. The suite also features a lovely terrace, providing an inviting outdoor space to unwind. After my recent procedure at the hospital, I enjoyed the most restful sleep on a very comfortable bed. 

I have recommended the hotel to most people and look forward to returning

author: Henry S
title: Ok hotel in Belgravia
text:
Room nice/ clean 
Bathroom poor quality - tiling , dirt, mirror above sink wouldn’t light up 
Shower felt dirty
Not quite living up to the website images
Ok value 
Shared areas looked pleasant - didn’t use restaurant 
Summary - OK

author: Amelia D
title: Like home
text: Close to Victoria Station. Typical London atmosphere, tasteful decoration. Impeccable service with a smile. Small typical pastries at tea time in the salon. Large room and quiet environment.

author: Daniel Z
title: Amazing!
text:
Location was amazing! Staff and service was quiet good. 
Cleanliness I liked and approved of it.
Room had enough space for one person and had a closet to hang your clothes and a ironing machine in each ones rooms. 
Toilet and bathroom was also clean and neat.
Only issue was noise level from other guests in the hallway that were talking loudly in the narrow hallway with lots of rooms at early morning!

author: Noah O
title: The location is wonderful, but that's all there is to it
text:
Very nice, peaceful location. 
No noise at all. 
Room 211 is a very small, unpractical room with an extremely hard bed, and a small and unpractical bathroom as well. 
Not really value for money, in our opinion. 
The staff was helpful and lent us travel adapters because we didn’t have any with us. 
The breakfast is nothing special at all.

author: Michael J
title: Fantastic boutique Hotel
text: We had a wonderful stay at this absolutely lovely boutique hotel. The staff were excellent, especially the young lady that checked us in. The room was spotless and the bed was very comfortable indeed. We selected this hotel for the location, but frankly it hit the mark on every aspect. We loved it so much that we booked to stay there again when we retook London in a few months.

author: Sara E
title: Perfect Christmas trip!
text: We had a great stay at the Tophams hotel. The location is perfect, a beautiful area, always quiet. The staff were very friendly and polite. The beds are small, but comfortable!

author: Hannah Y
title: A great place to stay, definitely recommend!
text: Great location, friendly, attentive staff. Room was clean, very comfortable bed with good linen and pillows. Good shower had steps in room down to bathroom which made the room feel bigger. The downstairs bar and guest areas were beautifully decorated and furnished.

author: Chloe S
title: Nice stay
text:
Nice stay, top location, clean and comfortable.
Kindnesses of the staff. Area with shops and restaurants. Very pleasant.

author: Morgan E
title: Expensive hotel with a room without any view
text:
Hotel in good position, warm family style hotel. In my opinion very expensive, room in the basement with no view except a dishwasher through a window in the basement area. The room vent looked as if it could fall down, clearly had moisture damage and paint flaking off.
Staff very nice and breakfast was good.

author: Jack O
title: Lovely hotel - exactly as pictured on website
text:
My husband and I stayed for one night in November having booked through Booking.com. The price we paid was reasonable and included breakfast. We were in room 3 on ground floor and our room exactly matched the photo on the website. Shower room looked brand new and had lovely hot water with good pressure.  Bar area looked lovely and beautifully decorated. Breakfast was simple but there was a good choice.

If I were to pick holes , the room was small and had no wardrobe space but it is London and that is to be expected, especially for price we paid.

author: Sean W
title: Well located hotel
text: Great hotel close to Victoria and sights such as Buckingham, green park and westiminster. The staff was excellent and very comfortable. I also highlight the quality and variety of breakfast.

author: Juan V
title: Great hotel in London!
text: Fantastic boutique hotel in a great London location.  Rooms are quiet and comfy, and the staff wonderful.  Highly recommend!

author: Charlie B
title: A great stay at Hilton Paddington
text: Great service, especially by the gentlemen checking us in Suvisna. He was very patient when we were sorting our ID out and very welcoming. The room was lovely and the bed was so comfortable. The breakfast was excellent with lots of choices and perfect location by Paddington station for our train home. Overall a great experience.

author: Rosie A
title: Amazing
text: Great hotel and amazing staff! As soon as I walked in I was greeted by Ratish, and he helped with the check in process and made it very smooth for me. He’s very warm, welcoming and efficient!

author: Noah A
title: Excellent Service from Darius
text: We had a business lunch at the hotel, and Darius in particular gave us wonderful service in the restaurant. Plus I love that my father would stay at the hotel when the railway owned it.

author: Dylan U
title: Disappointing Communication and Lack of Compassion
text:
I had planned to stay at this hotel for seven nights, but unfortunately, I couldn't travel because my visa was refused. 

Although the hotel has a good location and meets the standards expected of a Hilton property, my customer service experience was extremely disappointing. Before my scheduled arrival, I sent several emails requesting information about airport transportation but received no response. When I called the hotel, I was given the email address of the person in charge; however, my follow-up email was ignored as well.

After my visa was refused, I politely requested a refund or some form of consideration, as the circumstances were beyond my control. Unfortunately, this request was denied. I even tried to contact the General Manager directly, but I received a response from the Reservations Assistant Manager, who made no meaningful attempt to find a reasonable solution.

I understand that booking conditions are important, and my booking was non-refundable. However, this was during the busiest season of the year, and the hotel could likely have resold the room. I did not stay at the hotel or use any of its services, yet I was charged for all seven nights.

Overall, the experience left me feeling that the hotel prioritized commercial considerations over communication, flexibility, and compassion. While guests may expect the Hilton name and facilities, my experience suggests that they should not necessarily expect the same standard of customer care.

author: Paolo U
title: Appreciate all the staff members were so kind n nice
text: I had a really nice stay, and I especially want to thank the  Daniela da Silva who helped me during my stay. She was very kind, helpful, and professional, and she made my experience much better. I truly appreciate her help and positive attitude. Thank you so much! 😊

author: Antoine O
title: comfortable stay
text:
My stay at this hotel was a very pleasant experience.

In particular, the staff member who assisted me at check-in, Enmela (apologies if the spelling is incorrect), listened carefully to my preferences and assigned a room that suited my needs. She also greeted me with a warm smile whenever she recognized me, which was truly uplifting.

The housekeeping was thorough, and I enjoyed a comfortable and relaxing stay.

author: Jessica W
title: Horrific customer service
text:
I've been a loyal Hilton Paddington customer for many years, so it genuinely saddens me to leave this review.

I visited the Carriages Lounge as a lone diner and made a simple, specific request: due to Type 1 diabetes and other health complications, I needed a smaller meal that I could safely manage, and a dish on the children's menu was the most suitable option for me. I was not asking for anything unusual. I understand perfectly well why children's menus are priced as they are, including the VAT treatment that makes them a lower price point, and I had absolutely no intention of the venue losing out. I explicitly offered to pay the equivalent of a standard adult main course price for the children's menu item, simply because the portion size and the dish itself were what my health required.

The request was refused. Not once, but three times, including after a manager became involved. Despite offering to pay adult prices, despite the dish being actively on the menu and already being served in the kitchen, and despite being clear about my health reasons, the answer remained no.

I have made similar requests in countless other restaurants, chains, hotel lounges and dining venues over the years and have never once encountered a problem. It is widely understood by hospitality professionals that guests can have all manner of dietary, medical and personal requirements, and that reasonable adjustments are simply part of good service. At a hotel like Hilton Paddington, which is busy with transient guests, tourists and visitors from all over the world bringing every conceivable requirement with them, I genuinely did not anticipate that this would be an issue.

What followed was a prolonged exchange conducted at the table, in a busy restaurant, in which I was required to repeatedly explain and justify a private medical matter to staff who were neither equipped nor willing to find a straightforward solution. The situation was handled with no discretion, no empathy and no common sense. At no point was I offered the basic courtesy of a quiet word away from other diners.

Following the visit I raised a formal complaint. The responses acknowledged the distress caused but offered no concrete explanation of what would be done differently and no gesture of goodwill toward a long-standing customer. The matter appears to have been closed by the Hilton without any sort of resolution in my opinion, simply a double downing that the decision made on the day was right and just, but an apology for my experience…

I have no doubt the Hilton brand stands for better than this. This particular experience fell well short of it. I will not be returning to the Hilton Paddington.

author: Michael N
title: Amazing staff
text: The staff are amazing, we were greeted by Khairunesa, she has a beaming smile and very welcoming attitude.

author: Ian V
title: Good option for a family on a short visit
text:
The Family Room with rollaway bed was a great option for me, my husband and our 5 year-old. I was worried about space but the room was spacious, a big bed for the adults which was very comfortable and our daughter loved the little rollaway bed during our 2-night stay. 
We had a bathroom with a bath (great for our little one) and plenty of space for luggage, a desk for working/drawing and no issues with noise. 
The hotel is huge and somewhat old-fashioned (I felt I was in an old US Hilton) but not in a bad way. Breakfast had plenty of options and the staff were efficient if not particularly warm.
The major plus is the direct link into Paddington Station as we took a train into London and then the Heathrow Express out. The major downside was the gym/fitness centre - I have no idea why such a huge (Hilton) hotel has such a ridiculously tiny gym. It is the size of a small guest room, dark and cramped.

author: Samuel C
title: MORE SECURITY BETTER LOUNGE OPTIONS
text: okay we are in the middle of a major hub can you PLEASE provide more security? Like a key card entrance to the elevator or the doors to and from the train station. Like what is happening here. You have a central hub with one dude standing by the door who is a great human but like there needs to be way more. Not a good look. Also Club Lounge like come on. Great location but this is a 3.5 out of 10. It is our second club with Hilton and let's just say we do not need there version. Okay room 301 big, the elevators worked well, the location is great. Just more security and better club. Otherwise maybe come back, probably not, but the location is perect.

author: Ian G
title: Great stay
text: Location was prime, staff were great, especially Fatima at the front desk, she was very hospitable. I was also impressed by the room size. All in all great stay

author: Carlos F
title: Great location. Really horrible room.
text: It’s a superbly located hotel for transport from Heathrow, to Wimbledon (the purpose of our visit) and into central London. The foyer is nice. Reception staff nice. Concierge  helpful. However our room was depressing. Peeling wallpaper, stained lampshades, and a concrete wall a foot away from, and right across the bottom half our window,  preventing us from looking out. Very grim.  Thank goodness we only spent two nights in it. I never want to see it again.

author: Zachary M
title: Location, location, location
text:
We stayed at the Hilton London Paddington for an overnight party weekend, going to see Maroon 5 at Hyde Park. The hotel is perfectly located, just a short walk down the hill into Hyde Park.
The hotel was an excellent experience, many thanks to the staff who made it an enjoyable stay. We arrived later than planned, but were quickly checked in. After a quick turnaround we headed out for our evening's entertainment. Later on we got back and headed straight to bed, and slept like a log thanks to sumptuous bedding. The room was clean, well equipped with tea and coffee, and very quiet.
Breakfast was substantial and covered all bases. The art deco interior makes for some great photos.
With easy access to rail and tube services this hotel is a perfect choice for location and style.

author: Poppy W
title: Overbooked hotel, booked me into Euston instead
text:
Arrived at Euston, walked to Euston Square, caught the tube to Paddington, walked to the hotel. Arrived at the hotel. Got told very sorry but we’ve overbooked the hotel but we’ve booked you into Hilton Euston instead (a much worse reviewed hotel, and also not at Paddington, bearing in mind I booked Paddington specifically because I needed to get a train from Paddington). 

Got put in a black cab back to Euston (waste of an hour)

When I got to the hotel in Euston they also knew nothing about the arranged transport for the next morning but suggested getting a taxi 1:15 before my train, again the entire point of me booking Hilton Paddington was to be at Paddington to avoid this? 

Terrible experience and dealt with terribly in my experience too.

author: Harper U
title: An excellent stay
text:
I've stayed at plenty of hotels in London, and the Hilton Paddington is the one I keep coming back to. The location is hard to beat if you're moving in and out of the city, but what actually makes the difference here is the people.

Emmela at the front desk stood out immediately. She was warm, attentive, and went well beyond what her role required to make sure everything was sorted — the kind of service that makes you feel looked after rather than processed.

The restaurant was a highlight of the stay. Chef Cynthia's food was consistently excellent, and Khairunnesa looked after me with real care and genuine warmth every time. Between them, meals became something I looked forward to rather than an afterthought.

Hotels can be refurbished and rooms can be upgraded, but you can't manufacture a team like this. If you're considering Paddington, this is my recommendation without hesitation.

author: Olivia E
title: Beautiful Breakfast Buffet
text: Had a beautiful stay in this Hilton. The service in the restaurant was especially lovely. Nema was v sweet and really took care of us. The chef making omelettes was equally amazing.

author: Gavin N
title: My July Stay at Hilton London Paddington
text: The service environment was clean. food and drinks were okay. But above all, the courtesy, competence, crowd management and experience displayed by Cynthia was exceptional. Staff like her deserve encouragement because they remain big asset to Hilton.

author: Caleb R
title: Comfortable
text: Comfortable room, great coffee full of varieties, excellent location! I recommend!

author: Chloe J
title: An exceptional Hilton hotel
text: A beautiful hotel that retains its Victorian charm but with all the modern comforts but its the staff that really make the place - can’t praise them enough and especially Khairunnesa and Roshant at breakfast service.

author: Dylan N
title: Great Hospitality
text: Our room was in the new tower, we found it to be spacious and clean. The Diamond breakfast buffet was nice. Our server Dora was delightful and took great care of us. She made our brief stay much more enjoyable.

author: Hugo E
title: Great family stay
text:
This is a perfect base for exploring London. It’s close to Waterloo station, which itself is easy to reach from Euston. 
Rooms are clean, have a great shower and comfy bed.  I’ve come away  from my stay reflecting on how great the staff are there . They really do go above and beyond to make you feel welcome. Thanks

author: Adam W
title: Great Hotel
text: Great hotel in a perfect location, stayed many times always very good. The staff are very professional and helpful, always having time to help.

author: Aiden O
title: Cream of the Premier inns
text: Excellent hotel and staff, the staff are pleasant and very willing to help very clean with Excellent food package, Excellent showers and bedrooms. fantastic position so close to many of the sites

author: Andrea E
title: Recommend
text: Amazing location, outstanding staff🔆

author: David E
title: Good, and Bad
text:
The hotel is in a great location, right next to the London Eye and Waterloo station.
The rooms are big, but dated. We were at the front, it was very noisy most night, to the early hours. Sounded like a motor bike race each night and one night 2.20am a football match. So lacked on sleep.
The bar are is great and not busy, with a good view to people watch.
Staff were very good especially Fay, helpful, chatty and friendly.

author: Charlotte I
title: In praise of the staff
text:
After spending a couple of nights at Premier Inn County Hall I just want to praise the staff, particularly those on reception.
They are dealing with large numbersvisitors from many countries and doing it professionally,helpfully and with a happy welcoming attitude.
Premier Inn should be proud of the

author: Ruby X
title: Excellent location, nice staff and great breakfast
text: Didn’t realise when booking how well located this hotel was! Literally right next to the London Eye and Festival/Southbank area, incredible in a heatwave for a wander, views and the sun. Room was huge although overlooked bins and was very noisy for most of the time we were in the room but with the windows closed it was fine. Bathroom was functional and ok. Other rooms we saw while walking past open doors with cleaners in looked spacious too. Bar service was slow but happy hour 2 for 1 up to 7pm was welcome - 2 drinks for £10 unheard of nowadays let alone in the centre of London! Breakfast was probably the best we have had in a Premier Inn, it was really busy but we were served quickly, food was cleared away quickly, and the buffet hot food was excellent and replenished quickly. Mention to the lady who went around every table checking in on everyone and chatting, she was lovely (my introvert daughter was actually disappointed that she didn’t stop at our table!) but we enjoyed hearing her chatting as she worked. An excellent hotel- we were watching a show at county hall and so it couldn’t have been better location wise!

author: Ian Q
title: Excellent location
text: Excellent location for sightseeing South Bank, Big Ben, Whitehall. Easy walk to tube and stations. Premises tired looking but clean.

author: Julien T
title: Good but...
text: Very good location, very good bed... sleeping like a dream, good breakfast, good bathroom, but not good cleaning... wallpaper in the room was so dirty that we got mork feeds when walking...

author: Hannah S
title: Another great stay
text:
Recently returned from another stay at County Hall. Myself & my teenage daughter have stayed here several times and like it for its great location & easy transport links. This time we were in room 450 and we were very happy with it. No noise at all, from inside or outside the hotel, couldn't hear the night-time boy racers at all!
This room has a shower over a bath which we were fine with. Breakfast was fine, standard premier inn. Good value because daughter still qualifies for the "free child" so can't knock 2 Breakfasts for £14.99!  All staff we encountered were friendly & helpful. Definitely will stay here yet again - premier inn need to start some sort of loyalty scheme!

author: Maria Y
title: Good selection
text: Very good hotel, excellent location convenient to all public transport, train, bus, subway.. good breakfast with a wide selection. very kind and helpful staff.

author: Lucy N
title: Great place
text: Great location. Ideal for families with small kids as there's a park next door and lots of entertainment options within a 5 minute walk. Really friendly staff and the best nights sleep I've ever had in a premier inn

author: Alexander Q
title: Highly recommend premier in London County Hall!
text: This hotel was a fabulous location, great value, And fabulous staff.  Couple of glitches were fixed quickly!  My only issues were the hair dryer - you have to hold the button down the entire time you use it and there are no drawers for clothes!  I used the ironing board, desk and window sill for my dresser!

author: Grace D
title: Great hotel for family and Central location
text:
Good sized family room for 2 adults and 2 kids (1 double singles). Beds comfortable. Usual facilties rooms have a bath aswell as shower. . On site luggage facility (by external partner for a fee) but staff will also take small luggage (small bag or 1/2 items and hold for you for a (suggested) charity donation in a back office.
Food for evening meals and breakfast all good variable choice. 
Staff are very helpful and understanding of problems and can't do enough for you so great customer service there.
The hotel itself is part of the county hall 'complex' with another hotel and merlin attractions within the building is on the doorstep of both the Thames  and london eye also the southbank area. Underground stations (Westminster  and Waterloo) within 10 min walk in either direction so access to major wider london attractions easy.

Will recommend this hotel and will be back in future.

author: Mason F
title: Good for gluten free and near main attractions
text:
Went for a week away to London from Plymouth. The stsff were great and very friendly. 

I am ceoliac and they ask before ordering if anyone needs gluten free and offers a menu and they get your food seperately such as cereals. 

I stayed in another Premier Inn close by a couple years ago and it was dirty but this place was clean and the food was really good. There are also t.v's in the bar area and thry give gluten free meal options and they were really good which I tried to recreate myself.

They have an amazon drop box which was my first time trying.

It was a really cold time of year and our room was freezing. The heating/air con did not work but they sent someone up to the room and said they need to reactivate it from their side. 

On the first morning, about to get in the shower and the alarms were going off so had to rush to get dry and dressed only to find out someone had burnt their toast. 

It is located centrally near the wheel and lots of attractions about with a short taxi/ tube ride available.

As others have said , there is a continuous rumbling of motor bikes and cars revving outside which my window was overlooking and it is loud. Seems an odd place for them to meet up and start revving their engines outside an hotel. I used headphones connected to a tablet.

Would happily stay again but would look for a room opposite the bike/car revving. Good for gluten free options.

author: Katie O
title: Very good
text:
Great value for money and an excellent location, with most of the city’s main attractions within walking distance. The room was a decent size, clean, and comfortable.

There is no air conditioning or minibar, but the air cooling system works well enough for most days. Overall, it’s a solid choice for the price. I’d happily stay here again and would definitely recommend it.

author: Megan L
title: Sweaty!!!
text: Aircon broke on a VERY HOT night so woke up drenched in sweat! YUK!!!  Reception said 'oh dear' there is nothing we can do.  I phoned to Premier Inn number and was told to phone again and complain after we had left as they couldn't do anything whilst we were actually staying in the hotel!

author: William E
title: Great location, yummy food
text: Friendly, helpful and welcoming staff. Great location. Lovely room and kids enjoyed it. Our daughter said' the London eye was in our back garden!' Breakfast and evening meals had lots of choice and we loved that the meals had lots of vegetables for children and adults. We all loved our food and tasted delicious. I would recommend this hotel and would stay again.

author: Isabella K
title: Perfect stay: Super location, very good food and fantastic staff!
text:
What can you expect from a Premier Inn? A few stains on the carpets in the hallway, a few dirty window panes, bad Wi-Fi… all true. 
But also: large, functional rooms and bathrooms, extremely comfortable beds, quiet nights and (quite) affordable prices, plus "meal deals" that are hard to beat financially.
And this is exactly where the special praise for this Premier Inn begins. The food is not particularly good in every one – but it is here! Both the appetizers and the main courses (for me always fish & chips – they were hard to top! It took 16 days until I found perhaps even better ones) were always very good, and the breakfast also offered everything one could want.
What also made this Premier Inn stand out in particular were the employees. Worth mentioning here would be Ryan and Fahim at dinner, a young blonde employee whose name I unfortunately do not know, and especially Rachel, who was simply always cheerful and super friendly and spread a good mood!
It was also really great that the World Cup matches were broadcast on a very good television in the pub area.
In addition, there is of course the sensationally good location of the hotel, right at the London Eye and directly opposite Westminster Palace, Abbey and Big Ben on one side and Waterloo Station on the other. 
Looking back on the entire trip, I must say we could not have made a better hotel choice for London. We will be back!

author: Tyler H
title: Fabulous
text: Excellent location ,clean rooms and communal areas ,staff were brilliant ,great breakfast, comfy bed, modern bathroom ,cant say much more for the money and central London location you can not go wrong !

author: Ian I
title: Lovely staff
text: Nice 2 night stay with my daughter, the receptionist Goolabee was really helpful and was able to check us in early which was fab.

author: George G
title: Lovely staff & central location
text:
Conveniently located hotel with great staff; Wilkey at front of house was so helpful & friendly. 
We will be back.

author: Lucy O
title: Super location and amazing service
text:
The hotel is in a great location, 20 minutes from Oxford Street, Trafalgar Square.
And in London, as we all know, it's best to walk.
The hotel itself is very pleasant, the staff is very polite, the cleaning is excellent, the breakfasts are delicious.
I would gladly return to this hotel

author: Sean P

author: Kyle C
