Highly recommended!!

author: Emma P
title: Stay Very Far Away
text:
AStay very far away from this "hotel".  It has no hesitation to treat its potential guests as financial prey. It stole $691 from me without rendering any services whatsoever. I conducted myself in courteous, responsible, respectful manner and they returned this with an uncaring, thug-like, outrageous response. 
I made a reservation March 1 2026 for May 3. - 7 through Expedia for the Hotel Alahambra in Paris for my vacation. I paid with American Express. Almost immediately after I made the reservation I realized that that I would not be able to make in on May 3 which was a Sunday cause there was not a train I could take from Cannes to Paris after I arrived there at the end of my cruise. I tried to shorten my reservation by 1 day and was told by Expedia the hotel would not do that. I told them that I would arrive, then, one day later than my reservation but would keep the departure date the same. I was told by Expedia I needed to contact the hotel directly which I did by email through Expedia. The hotel responded with "dear Guest,
we will respect the booking conditions of arrival". I assumed that they understood from this cryptic response.  I was boarding the train that Monday, when I discovered that my reservation had been cancelled on Expedia. I immediately called Hotel Alhambra and was told that I was viewed as a no show and as a result my entire reservation was cancelled. I reminded that I sent them an email telling them I would be one day late. They told me this changed the original terms of the reservations and that as a result when I did not show on Sunday May 3, I was viewed as a no show and that Expedia cancelled my reservation. When I contacted Expedia they said that was the policy of the hotel and that that the hotel canceled the reservation. No where in Expedia's site not on the hotel'd site nor on the paperwork anywhere does it suggest that if I was a day late, and told them, that my reservation would canceled with no refund.  I have filed a dispute with American Express  and they have refunded the money.  Expedia's behavior was of no help. They told me they could not recover a canceled reservation. Expedia told me the hotel would get my $691.63. Note I received an email from Expedia telling me my reservation was cancelled on May 6 only after I officially complained to a supervisor. This was 3 days after the cancellation This was an outrageous theft of my money with no services rendered.

author: Aaron G
title: Absolutely recommendable hotel with an ideal location advantage
text:
We were at the Hotel Alhambra, Paris with two families and three teens.

The air-conditioned rooms with modern bathrooms were top.
The teens had an extra-large 3-bed room and a larger bathroom. 

The very good breakfast could. Be taken in the garden or in the dining area. 
There is the typical French breakfast croissants, pain au chocolat, baguette, with salmon, ham, salami, jam, cheese, yogurt, granola, fruit mix, orange and apple juice as well as coffee and tea selections.

The hotel is ideally located between Pl de la République and Bastille.
The Oberkampf metro station is around the corner and you are therefore within 25-30 minutes of all the sights in Paris - regardless of whether by metro or on foot.

Absolutely recommended.

author: Katie S
title: Strict policy, not customer-friendly
text:
Be aware of their strict policy!!
Due to a cancelled SAS flight, I was delayed and arrived early the next morning. I emailed them in advance to explain the situation. They told me they had cancelled my reservation, but they still charged me for the entire stay!

That is, they kept 100% of my payment, refused to let me use the room for the remaining nights, and I was forced to find and pay for another hotel. This policy is completely unacceptable and deeply consumer-unfriendly. The staff showed zero empathy or willingness to find a solution. I highly recommend avoiding this hotel due to their rigid and unfair practices. It’s a risk I wouldn’t take as there so many other nice customer oriented hotels in Paris. 

Check out Hotel Les Theatres instead. Not the same area, but very charming and friendly.

author: Maria R
title: Very good experience!
text: Clean rooms, good breakfast, very pleasant garden. Air conditioning working very well during the heatwave.

author: Ella U
title: Very good.
text:
Excellent experience at a hotel very close to the subway in a quiet neighborhood. 
The hotel is renovated as shown in the photos; the rooms are clean and comfortable, and the air conditioning system was perfect during the scorching days of mid-June at 26 degrees. The staff is very kind and helpful.

author: Hannah C
title: Quiet and clean
text:
Nice double room out to the garden.
Nice clean. Quiet and quiet even with the windows open, no traffic noise.
Close to metro station (100 m)
Good location to walk to the Seine (2 km/25min) and up to the Champs de Elysee.

author: Manon C
title: Visit Paris
text: Great location and perfect for a few days in Paris

author: Pierre V
title: Very positive experience
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Alhambra for a few days during our trip to Paris and the experience was overall very positive.
The location is certainly one of the strengths: the hotel is located near the Oberkampf metro, which is very convenient for moving quickly to the main attractions of the city. 
The area is lively but quiet, with many restaurants, boulangerie and shops nearby, which makes your stay even more enjoyable. 
The property is clean and welcoming, with basic but comfortable rooms, in line with Parisian standards, where spaces are generally smaller. 
We appreciated the helpful staff and the ability to leave luggage after check-out, very helpful to make the most of the last day. 
Overall it is a practical, well-connected and good value solution, ideal as a base for visiting Paris.
I would recommend it especially to those looking for a functional, clean and strategically located hotel. See you soon!

author: Nora E
title: Good hotel
text:
Nicely place
Big room and clean room. 
Staff very helpfully
I will be back soon in 2026 
Breakfast is wonderful for only 15 Euro. 
Nica

author: Noah T
title: Good 3 star hotel 10 minutes from Marais
text: Small but cozy hotel. A ten minute walk from the heart of the beautiful Marais district. Subway at 50 meters. Quiet area and well served. Average rooms for Paris; clean. Daily cleaning of the room. The staff was friendly and helpful. Breakfast in the norm and plentiful. We had a great time.

author: Noah E
title: Exceptional hotel
text: Exceptional stay! The hotel is beautiful, very clean and perfectly maintained. The staff is welcoming, smiling and always available to help. The room was comfortable, quiet and nicely decorated. Breakfast was delicious and varied. I recommend this property with my eyes closed!

author: Paige D
title: Plain Jane
text:
Rooms very very tiny with no amenities except two small paper cups and two
Glasses. Desk helpful but quite abrupt. For the price, I was disappointed. Restaurants within walking distance. Train close.

author: Poppy I
title: 3 nights in the heart of Paris
text:
Excellent Price quality ratio. Welcoming very nice very clean hotel very close to the Oberkampf metro. We enjoyed the location (Marais, reasonable distance to walk to Latin Quarter), very quiet street, good bedding, hearty breakfast. 
Anne Sophie and Hannah

author: Molly D
title: Perfectly situated
text:
This is the second time I have stayed at this hotel. 

It is situated in a great location for exploring Paris. The metro (Oberkampf) is less than a minutes walk from the hotel so perfectly situated for getting around. This is not a tourist area but is a really nice neighbourhood that has a good selection of bars and restaurants. 

My room was small (I stayed in a bigger room previously) but this is to be expected in Paris and was fine for what I needed. It was extremely clean and modern. 

My only criticism is that although I stayed in October, the room was quite warm and I was advised by reception that they had no fans. This is something I would expect a hotel to have available. Air con is available but I was advised that this is switched off at this time of year as it is set for the entire hotel rather than individual rooms .

I really like staying at this hotel and would recommend it to anyone looking for a base to explore Paris.

author: Benjamin F
title: Know where you're going!
text: My comment may seem surprising, as we did not stay at the hotel. However, we had booked a weekend for my son's birthday, from Saturday to Sunday, with free cancellation until Wednesday 11:59 pm. We learn on Thursday morning that my mother-in-law enters palliative care and lives her last moments. Of course, we have decided to stay with him. I therefore contact the hotel on Thursday explaining the situation and asking for the exceptional free cancellation of the stay, as provided on the booking site, with a postponement to another date (which was available with an extra 135 euros that I am willing to pay). The reaction of the hotel was simply to refuse, despite my explanations, strictly referring to the booking conditions. And, indeed, the request for free cancellation is subject exclusively to the good grace of the hotelier. So here we are, 312 euros lost and as they very delicately told me 'there are insurances for that'. What I denounce above all is bad faith (refusal to postpone when dates are open) and a glaring lack of humanity in particularly difficult circumstances. In any case, knowing this, I will never set foot in this establishment!

author: Olivia A
title: Very good, well placed, perfect
text: Welcoming, good sleeping, no noise.  Press available. At the foot of the metro, Brief good experience. I recommend without hesitation

author: Sophia V
title: Perfect for visiting Paris
text: Exceptional location between the 11th arrondissement and the Haut Marais, an authentic and charming Paris. Very nice hotel, impeccable cleanliness and warm Welcoming. Great value for money. Lovely interior garden.

author: Harry C
title: An unforgettable holiday thanks to a team at the top
text:
I had an absolutely perfect stay at this hotel! Everything was excellent from start to finish: the food was varied, delicious and of high quality. The animation was at the top, with a Mood always festive and friendly. The animators were amazing: available, dynamic, funny and always in a good mood, they contributed greatly to make the stay unforgettable.
A big bravo to the whole team, also in Rio and Taha I recommend this hotel with my eyes closed and I will return with great pleasure!

author: Lucia I
title: To revisit and confirm!
text:
For the second time at Hotel Alhambra, I repeat my compliments for the excellent Service, beautiful and comfortable accommodation and super convenient location.
Nothing like getting out of the metro after an intense day and being a few steps from your hotel. Being always well served by the reception and breakfast staff is very important in order to value the Service and enjoy a pleasant stay. Only positive words for careful cleaning in all environments. The varied and tasty Petit Déjeuner can be consumed in a very nice garden adding a note to the most unexpected for those guests who stay there for the first time. Finally, I can only say that I am happy to recommend Hôtel Alambra which I consider an excellent choice also in terms of cost and benefit.

author: Tyler C
title: Very pleasant stay
text: The hotel had everything we neeeded for a 4 day stay, it was located very close to restaurants and the shopping center. The staff was very nice and informed was very well.

author: Chloe V
title: Top hotel in the heart of Paris!
text:
I was fully satisfied with my stay. The hotel is impeccably clean, ideally located, and the rooms are spacious, comfortable, and decorated with great taste. The breakfast is varied, generous, and of high quality.

The value for money is simply excellent. Whether for my business trips or for family stays in Paris, I have finally found my go-to hotel. I will return with great pleasure and I recommend it without the slightest hesitation.

author: James I
title: Terrible experience: zero hospitality and zero humanity.
text:
We were left speechless by the total lack of professionalism and humanity. At 11:20 PM, the hotel canceled our room, despite our request and agreement for check-in at midnight. The reason? The card was temporarily blocked for the guarantee charge. No real attempt to help us, no alternative proposed, no understanding of the situation.

Result: two people left on the street at 1 AM. There was no overbooking; they simply "dropped" us without any regard. This is not service, it is not hospitality: it is a lack of respect towards customers.

Terrible service. Terrible hospitality. Terrible management. Terrible humanity. Absolutely not recommended.

author: Lily F
title: A good place to stay
text: Great location, great place. Very convenient. The room was spacious and clean. We were on the first floor, yes you can hear the metro but it didn't bother us.

author: Charlie Y
title: Bad experience
text: Aircon is broken and no one can help, just explained due to too many people may using cause couple of room without aircon.  Can’t open window due to too many fly.  It was a terrible experience and not worth for such room cost.

author: Julien D
title: Excellent location.
text:
Beautiful room well-equipped with perfect cleanliness. 
Small waiting area with coffee available, particularly appreciated in case of unfavorable weather. 
Staff is also very friendly.

author: Chloe U
title: Excellent location!
text: Our group of four stayed in Opera Opal for five nights. We found it to be an excellent location in a great neighborhood - near metro lines and shopping, with many restaurants, supermarkets, and cafes nearby. At the same time, it was "far enough" that things were quiet at night. Staff were helpful and friendly, with great service. I would definitely stay here again -- and I'll emphasize that the hotel has a well-sized elevator and rooms had airconditioning/heating, so very suitable for different seasons.

author: Lauren V
title: Quality hotel
text:
I had a great time with a very friendly staff 
The room facing the street (to my satisfaction) is very well soundproofed No noise nuisance

author: Paige U
title: Perfect for a short stay in the capital
text: The room was perfect for one night, not very big but largely sufficient, clean, nice with a very comfortable bed. The only downside I would note is the lack of warmth from some staff, we did not always feel welcome or very comfortable facing some, but nothing to spoil the stay.

author: Benjamin A
title: Hotel well located near the theaters but not worth 4 stars.
text: Noisy hotel: underground metro, succinct breakfast with very little offer. Distant and cold staff seeming jaded to welcome tourists. Not worth its 4 stars.

author: Katie H
title: Mixed and very noisy
text: I had a room on the 1st floor where I could hear a lot of metro and my room looked out on courtyard and at night people smoked on the courtyard so it smelled a lot in the room. Very unpleasant. On the other hand the bed is very comfortable.

author: Erin S
title: good establishment
text:
Clean hotel
Room correct and in line with the photos of the site
Friendly and professional staff.
Take note

author: Matthew X
title: Hotel that meets our expectations
text: Very nice hotel very well located. Comfortable and very clean. Only one drawback: the subway. Would it be possible to provide earplugs? Almost perfect.

author: Lea X
title: Perfect.
text:
Very clean and beautiful hotel, very well located. Very nice staff. The very comfortable bed 
Everything was perfect

author: Grace P
title: feel at home
text: Boutique hotel in a strategic location, convenient for access to the metro and central areas. The rooms are newly renovated and even the smallest are cozy and very functional. The staff is always available to provide any kind of information. Very welcome the coffee service, tea and self service water dispenser available to guests at any time. is the second time we return for our business trips and will definitely be back.

author: Lauren I
title: A central nice hotel with a nice flair.
text: A very nice hotel centrally located on foot everything is accessible,with a nice flair.The hotel manager named James is very committed,Warm and welcomes everyone with a smile, takes a lot of time especially for his guests and makes some things possible the staff are all very friendly.We were very satisfied with the stay and wish the hotel only the best and the staff for the future more successful years.Thank you for the wonderful stay.Moore/Möller

author: Nora Q
title: Perfect hotel to visit Paris
text: Excellent structure for quality and ability to accommodate customers. The receptionist who speaks Italian is not a small plus. Requests made before arrival were fully respected, the room was very clean and always was during the stay. I didn't have breakfast.

author: Luke F
title: Opal opera hotel, Paris
text: This is a lovely hotel in an amazing location.  Room was great.  Staff helpful.  The only issue we had was with a leaky shower which we reported and this was resolved by the time we returned.  Other things were small things that would have improved the stay.  As there is no room service, snacks to buy would be nice, also some wine available.  Also water in rooms.  There were only paper cups to fill downstairs which wasn't convenient.  Milk for tea/coffee would also be nice, although the reception staff kindly gave me some when I asked for it.  Other than this, which is quite minor...I know l will be back and stay here again.  Easily accessible to Metro and Buses and walkable to many area.

author: David R
title: Beautiful stay in Paris
text: Very wellness hotel located, everything can be done on foot or by metro. Staff welcome. Good size room for Paris.

author: Holly A
title: Cozy Parisian Hotel
text: This hotel was easy, comfortable and convenient. Very safe and convenient location not too far from tube stations, shops and restaurants. Only negative was that the rooms were a bit on the warm side.

author: Gavin B
title: A perfect stay
text: A wonderful hotel with comfortable, clean, well-designed rooms, thoughtful amenities - like in-room Nespresso machines and complimentary water & snacks - and an excellent staff.  We especially enjoyed the concierge, Anthony, whose warmth and friendliness made us feel welcome. He shared ideas for  our stay and gifted us with a free bottle of wine - above and beyond service!  The hotel is in a great location, close to the subway and within walking distance of Chelsea, the High Line, many midtown sites and lots of good food.   Despite being in a popular area for nightlife, rooms were quiet for sleeping.  It was a great value by comparison to other hotels in the area.  We will definitely stay here again.

author: Pablo P
title: Amazing hotel, just book it!
text: We had a fantastic stay here, the location is perfect for exploring and there are loads of great restaurants and bars right on the doorstep. Hotel itself is beautiful, room was spotless and we slept really well. Staff were also great, particular shout out to concierge Anthony who helped us with taxis and is super friendly and helpful. We will definitely be back!!

author: Giulia C
title: A wonderful, awesome hotel experience.
text: Perfect. Outstanding   Large beautiful junior suite.  We were in awe of our magnificent view of the Empire State Building. The room was so quiet and clean. We received complimentary treats on check in. The neighborhood was vibrant; filled with pastry and ice cream shops. The staff was midwestern friendly, always available for our questions.  I cannot imagine a better hotel experience.

author: Nora D
title: The Hotel That Made Us Feel Right at Home in NYC
text:
A true hidden gem in NYC! We only stayed one night, but this hotel left such a great impression on us. From the moment we arrived, the staff were incredibly gracious, welcoming, and genuinely helpful. They allowed us to check in early, helped us with directions around the city, and every interaction we had with them was warm and friendly.

Our room was immaculate, spacious, and so comfortable. The complimentary snacks and water were an unexpected little touch that we really appreciated.

We spent a long day exploring NYC, so coming back to a clean, quiet, comfortable room at the end of the night was exactly what we needed. After all the walking and craziness of the city, it felt so good to have a place that felt welcoming and relaxing.

For us, it was the combination of the wonderful staff, spotless room, and those thoughtful little extras that made this stay stand out. We honestly feel like we found a hidden gem, and we would absolutely stay here again!

author: Sean D
title: First family visit to NYC.
text: We had a great time and Anthony at the door was great and super helpful.

author: Oscar L
title: Stunning Manhattan hotel
text: Amazing hotel right in the heart of Manhattan, perfect for exploring everything NYC has to offer. The staff are very welcoming, friendly and are very knowledgeable on any questions you have. The rooms very very nice with hot drink making facilities and these were topped up daily along with water too. The rooms were also serviced daily and everything looked very clean. Our rooms overlooked the Empire State and though there was a little noise from the NYC hustle and bustle, this was well worth it. I’d say this hotel was good value for money considering the location and service especially and the hotel just had a really nice vibe and atmosphere to it. Would defo recommend to anyone visiting NYC.

author: Ruby H
title: Fab gem of a hotel
text: WOW this is a gem of a hotel in NOMAD area. Yes it’s a small hotel without a bar or restaurant but that’s not a big issue as there are bar’s & restaurants right outside front door. As it’s away from the hustle & bustle it’s very quiet outside at night so no sirens wakening you up. Right across from 28th st subway. Staff very attentive. Tea & coffee making facilities in room & replenished bottles of water also. For New York room was large with 2 double beds - we had kids prepared for smaller room. We also had a fab view of Empire State Building. Concierge ordered taxi for airport journey & could store luggage. Lobby has a lot of fliers for shows & trips. There’s also a nice quiet area upstairs in lobby where you can sit & relax with tvor books. Would recommend & would stay again

author: Sara A
title: Do not hesitate…BOOK IT!
text:
We could not have chosen a better hotel for our first trip to NY
Location was central to everything, within walking distance to many areas and subway stations for all directions within blocks of the front door. 
The staff, especially the door men/concierge, from the moment we walked in were great. Whether it was on our way out for the day or back in from a day out, no matter the time we were greeted by a smiling face. 
Need a tip on where to go and how to get there? Ask them. Need to store your bags for awhile before your flight out? Ask them.  Need a ride to the airport? Ask them!  They were all helpful and kind. Shout out to Anthony for making our departure easy and stress free

author: George E
title: Great stay
text:
We stayed for 10 nights at Broadway Plaza during the World Cup. (Go Norway!) Both me and my daughter had a great time in NY, and we will absolutely recommend Broadway Plaza Hotel. There is no better way to start a day in NY than waking up to the view of Empire State Building. Our room was large and clean. We had a great terrace with excellent views to ESB.   

A great hotel, great location, and excellent service by the hotel staff.

author: Katie L
title: Fabulous hotel
text:
This hotel is in a fabulous location in walking distance of Madison Square Garden. The rooms are small but with everything you need when in NYC. Our room had a wonderful view of the Empire State Building. 
All of the staff were extremely friendly and pleasant. Anthony on the concierge desk was extremely friendly and very helpful. Top marks.

author: Freya M
title: Great hotel! We loved our stay
text: Anthony was amazingly helpful and kind during our stay! He helped us with getting our cab to the airport and all our luggage.  The hotel is located in a great section of the city and the room was fantastic.

author: Daisy M
title: Perfect location!
text: Amazing location right in the middle of great restaurants and super close to the subway. The staff were wonderful and attentive. Anthony was legit — at the door to open it every time we entered and helped with our bags. My daughter ended up getting sick on the trip and the staff were very helpful and understanding!

author: Molly O
title: Best hotel experience in NYC
text: We had an amazing stay!! Everything about this hotel was perfect: rooms are huge, front desk and concierge are super friendly and courteous and location is the best in NYC!  We definitely recommend staying and we will be staying here from now on when we visit!

author: Evie H
title: Excellent Hotel in a Great Location
text: We had a wonderful stay at the Broadway Plaza Hotel. It began with a welcoming, friendly, helpful staff. The room was immaculately clean, comfortable, and very spacious. It felt like we were in a brand new hotel. We were delighted with the incredible view of the Empire State Building from our window. The location of this hotel is perfect. There are a variety of excellent restaurants very close to the hotel.  It is centrally located - excellent for sightseeing. The staff was very helpful in recommending restaurant options, depending on what we were seeking. The staff also helped us navigate the subway system, and the subway stations were within a five minute walk. When we return to New York, we will definitely stay at the Broadway Plaza Hotel.

author: Kyle G
title: Great trip
text: Broadway plaza hotel was a great location and very clean rooms.. I especially want to thank Anthony for his wonderful greeting with some cold water on a hot day and everytime we left the room or came back for the day he was always there with a smile and a greeting..

author: Taylor F
title: Ideal location and very comfortable and pleasant.
text: The hotel is beautiful, with large and very comfortable rooms. Mine on the 11th floor overlooked the Empire State, spectacular. The attention from all the staff is very cordial, especially from Anthony who resolved our transfer and luggage storage issues until it was time for us to leave. Excellent location.

author: Lauren M
title: Ideal stay in New York
text: Ideally located in the heart of Manhattan, very comfortable room, and very pleasant and attentive staff. Many places nearby for breakfast, brunch, lunch, or dinner. Special mention for Anthony, very helpful!

author: Holly J
title: Great Solo Stay
text: I traveled to New York on my own and had a very enjoyable stay at the Broadway Plaza Hotel. The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the central location made it easy for me to explore the city. A special thank-you to Peter, who was friendly, professional, and extremely helpful. His attentive service made me feel welcome and added a personal touch to my stay. I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend this hotel to solo travelers visiting New York.

author: Olivia P
title: Amazing location and staff
text: Absolutely beautiful hotel. Stayed in room 704 which had a beautiful terraced balcony with a great view of the Empire State Building. The staff were all amazing - professional and kind. The young guy at door, Anthony the concierge, staff at reception and cleaning staff- all lovely. Hotel in perfect location. Thanks for making our 50th birthday celebrations so brilliant. Love from the Derry Girls ❤️

author: Ana A
title: Small, friendly hotel in heart of Manhattan!
text: Amazing location! Ideal for seeing all the Manhattan sites on foot  and hopping on the subway to go further. We were lucky enough to have a view of the Empire State Building from our room. All staff were friendly and courteous. Our room was serviced daily. Special shout out to Anthony for organising our cab for the airport and storing luggage. Would stay again for sure!!

author: Sofia Y
title: Receptionist needs training.
text:
Not bad, clean and efficient for the category. Breakfast was standard.
The only drawback, and it's not a minor one, is that I asked for advice on how to reach the Portobello area and the two receptionists couldn't help me because BOTH said they didn't know that area.  NEVER HEARD OF IT, I DON'T KNOW. BOTH. I speak English and I know how to address people when I ask for information.  This confirms the lack of willingness of the English to interpret the slight linguistic nuances of those who speak another language. I call it rudeness. If you work at a hotel desk in London, you must know where PORTOBELLO is.

author: Elena W
title: Great hotel and perfect location
text:
A lovely hotel with kind and helpful staff. 
Breakfast was delicious and had a good selection. 
Garden area outside was beautiful at night and for breakfast. 
So close to tube station. 
Room was small but had everything we needed including vegan toiletries only downside was no A/C during heatwave.

author: Rosie G
title: NICE BUT IT CAN IMPROVE
text: Nice hotel,near the center.good breakfast.Itcould be much better.we.had some problems with the reservation ,because they didn’t told us the real price .we were three people in the same room and the price didn't include the third breakfast. Moreover tje stuff forgot everytime we were in three persons not two.The stuff.was very nice.

author: Michael P
title: Superb experience
text: What a superb experience. We went for afternoon tea and everything was perfect - the reception, friendliness of staff and the food was delicious. Homemade sandwiches, cakes and scones. Couldn’t fault it

author: Megan M
title: Bedford Stay
text: Good and comfortable stay. Karthik was very helpful .

author: Alexander O
title: No air conditioning!!!!!
text: No air conditioning. The fan in the room made next to no difference throughout our entire stay. Possibly OK in winter but definitely NOT in summer.

author: Evie K
title: Value for the money
text:
The Bedford Hotel was good value. The rooms were clean, and the staff was very helpful. 
The breakfast is buffet with plenty of choices. The option of eating outside in the hotels lovely garden was a plus.

The heat wave this month in London was unprecedented, the hotel is not air-conditioned. The room came with a fan. But the windows did not open completely, so the breeze was minimal.
I would stay here again, but not in the summer. I will also request a larger sized room. My single room was very small (I am American).

author: Dylan A
title: Great stay...again.
text:
Staff brilliant...especially Meaghan.  So attentive and focused on your needs. Left a lovely surprise for my daughter's big birthday.  
Beds so comfortable.  Dining and relaxation areas wonderful. We watched the football in the lounge area which shut during half time. Without asking staff rang a pub down the road to see if a table could be allocated us! Lovely location within walking distance of theatre land.

author: Sean M
title: Family afternoon tea
text: Went to this hotel for afternoon tea with my family. The food was nice mainly and plenty of it, some of the sandwiches were a little dry; the carrot cake inedible. As we only managed to eat half of each tower of food, we asked the waiter if we could take it away with us. He took away the food into the kitchen and we waited. A decent amount of time passed and our food was not brought out so we called over and asked him if the food was ready to which he realised he had misunderstood what we had aske. He then went to speak to his manager who came over and said the waiter thought you didnt want anymore so threw it in the bin!  He then went on to say actually, it was their policy not to allow food off of the premises due to risk of food poisoning. However, had we been told that by the waiter, we may have had some more of the food before leaving. No further offer of replacing the food they had thrown away or further means to make up for this error was made. In fact, quite the opposite as the manager was quite nonchalant about it all.

author: Ana O
title: Excellent customer service
text: Excellent experience location fantastic, hotel room very good. Good price for service accommodation and restaurant. Ken and Marnie on the reception desk provided outstanding customer service. Marnie especially was exceptional in her ability to welcome, support and help senior customers to the Bedford Hotel.

author: Michael J
title: Cons: No air conditioning, tiny rooms, poor ventilation, noisy street on one side, strong sun on the garden side.
text:
On the plus side, the Bedford is well-located: 2 nearby tube stations and lots of buses, close to the British Museum and lovely squares (Russell, Bloomsbury), a reasonable walk to West End theaters, plenty of restaurants, coffee shops and stores. 
On the minus side: no air conditioning except in the lobby. (London is still in denial despite decades with heat waves in summer; hotels with A/C are still a small minority.)  The rooms are small.  We don't know how small the majority of the rooms are but we were given Room 212.  Do _NOT_ allow them to give you this room. From the outside, you'll see that most rooms have a pair of angled double windows: 4 bay-style casements behind flat windows, The little rooms at the ends of the halls, like 212, only have a pair of flat casements behind one flat window with a stationary side and a slider side.  When you arrive, the casements are tethered so they only open a few inches.  If you ask at the desk, they send someone up - not right away but eventually, after you ask a second time - with the key to unlock the tether.   There is also an anemic small fan on the desk but that location is too far from the window to help air circulation. You can move the fan on its short cord to the single outlet for the flat panel TV. It's by the window.  We preferred to get some air and could live without the TV.  Somehow, though, even with the fan on high and rotating, the air is stagnant and the cool-off in the evenings does not bring the room's temperature down or alleviate the stuffiness. 
For light sleepers, another reason to avoid Room 212 is that - unlike any other room in the hotel - there's a lamppost right outside the window whose light shines into the room all night.  Yes, the room has blackout curtains but if you close them then you get no air.  We opted for air and the lamppost light. 
Size of room: the queen bed is about 13 inches from the opposite wall, less at the floor because of the molding.  You learn to sidle slowly past to get to the fridge, window and cupboard.  The bathtub is high: short people may find it a healthy stretch to get in and out. There's a nice handheld for the shower but  when we arrived it was pointed at the ceiling.  Fixable but ... why?  
There is a good cupboard, one side for closet and one with cubbies.  The closet has those 20th-century anti-theft hangers: they don't ride on a rail like normal hangers, they have a sort of nail instead that fits into a little catch on a loop that rides on the rail.  Room 212 has a good number of loops but 4 less hangers than loops.  The good news is that when we asked for more hangers we got regular hangers.  (Well, good for tops and dresses but not all have a cross-piece for pants.)  Exactly one hanger, an anti-theft one, had spring clips for skirts/pants.
The people at the desk are pleasant and generally competent.  They were unable, however, to change our room.  We asked after two nights - got a No - and again the next day. Then we were told that the hotel was full but would 'open up' in two days and to come back then.  When we did, however, there was nothing, although they siad there'd been one room the day before. (Apparently it was impossible to call us to offer the option of that room?)  We understand that our stay was for 10 days, and nobody asked if we'd mind having to move more than once.  We wouldn't have minded, just to have a room that was big enough for two people and had adequate ventilation, like the vast majority of rooms. 
I am posting this with 5 more nights here. Maybe we will get lucky and be able to leave Room 212 before our last night.

author: Ella Y
title: Very quiet for London!
text: Our second visit to this very comfortable hotel and just as good as the first time. This is a suprisingly quiet place especially if you book a Garden room which overlooks the Hotel garden, a private garden and a row of houses which block the road noise really well. There is a little noise from drinkers in the garden but bar shuts at 11 so that's fine. It's a brilliant location in between Euston and Soho and both times we have been able to check in early and get exploring. My only disappointment was that when we fancied a peaceful afternoon drink in the garden one day, we were essentially booted out to make way for a private event, not impressed!

author: Hugo W
title: Simply the Best
text:
What a fantastic hotel...location is so central, rooms are all salubrious, food and cocktails are outstanding and the staff are all exceptionally helpful and very friendly.  A special mention to Sabri our restaurant waiter and Donal the concierge you are assets to the Bradford hotel.   
Look forward to returning soon and thank you

author: Holly N
title: Don't recommend this place
text: Won't be coming back here, I can white a story but no need to waste time..

author: Jack O
title: Bloomsbury bar and courtyard a oasis in London
text: Lovely welcome at the reception on a very hot stay bar and courtyard are a hidden Jewel in Bloomsbury enjoyed the dinner in the restaurant and Breakfast was lovely I booked I had booked a single room and it really was unfortunately no air conditioning in the room so windows open and a fan didn’t cut the unusually warm May evening great location but very uncomfortable sleep

author: Jack S
title: Would stay here again
text: Comfortable hotel in good location. Staff very friendly and helpful. I booked an accessible room as I am in a wheelchair, and found it to be lovely, though noisy due to its position on a busy road. Only difficulty was the lift which was very small and so difficult to manage. Meals were delicious and served in the garden restaurant, which was welcome due to the high temperatures. Good value for money. Would stay here again

author: Ana Y
title: Great addition to Belfast
text: Great experience for my first visit here. Service was brilliant from Jamie and Jorden will definitely return.

author: Amelia I
title: Comfortable and friendly compact room in central London
text: Walking distance to the British Museum, Oxford St., theatres, and other destinations in central London, including the restful  park that is Russell Square.  A clean and compact room for one, overlooking a quiet private garden.  Well priced for the area.  Friendly staff. Would stay again.

author: Mia U
title: Great hotel
text:
Very nice hotel with a welcoming staff. The breakfast was good, but the staff was what really impressed me. They all hunted things to do and clean. All overlapped and there was no - This is not my table. Even the man in suit cleaned the tables. 
The room was sufficient for me; comfortable bed and a lot of channels on TV. But room cleaning hours surprised me a little bit; betwen 1300 and 1500. 
Great location with buses ant underground nearby.

author: Megan U
text: For a 3 star hotel I was positively surprised and my expectations were exceeded. The room was well decorated and had enough space. Only the shower bracket was a bit impractical. The breakfast buffet had a great choice and the food tasted good. The service staff was very friendly and helpful.

author: George W
title: Part of my well planned NY trip!
text: It is so close to Penn Station an Times Square, that makes commute  easier for elders and kids on a family vacation trip to NY

author: Paige X
title: CHECK YELP BEFORE BOOKING
text: CHECK YELP BEFORE BOOKING. Every negative comment on yelp is true. BEWARE OF THIS HOTEL. Hotel staff very rude and not helpful. Place is disgustingly dirty.

author: Lily O
title: Overcharging bogus fees
text: This was the worst experience ever!!! To start they charged my card 2 times prior to my arrival and didn’t have the courtesy to call and explain what happened and this over drafted my account leaving me with no funds for my trip as it too 4 days for refund to hit my account then we put a different card on file for the 150 incidentals and they charged both cards again causing another overdraft fee they also charged us 4 other charges totaling over 400 for room charge and facility fees and I’m told it was just an error by the new guy inputting this incorrect these charges where manual entry so they took the photo copy of our cards to enter these charges I reached out to Wyndham and it’s out their hands as it’s a franchise and I have tried 4 times to be connected to the manager and no luck this hotel seems to be scamming travelers of money and I’m sure many haven’t noticed they would not even comp our parking to help us out for the issue they caused I have never had an experience as unfortunate as this causing so much issue that now I have to deal with my bank to fix all the wrong charges and overdraft fees this has caused and my other bills that got declined as this locked my accounts up the customer service was the worst over this and every body blamed every one else please do yourself a favor don’t book this hotel and be careful of all Wyndham as they will not support or help you for their errors!!! Double check your bills and ask for a copy of all charges

author: Katie V
title: Unacceptable issues
text:
I would not recommend this hotel. There were problems from the moment we arrived, and the overall condition and management of the property were extremely disappointing.

We arrived early and left our luggage with the hotel, and the security for stored luggage was basically nonexistent. I did not feel that there was any adequate system in place to make sure bags were secure or returned only to the proper guests. For a NYC hotel handling travelers’ belongings, that is unacceptable.

When we checked in, we were put into a room that was NOT the type of room I had reserved. I had to address the issue myself and insist that they change it back to what I had actually booked.

The lobby was in disarray and looked poorly maintained. To make matters worse, there were dead flies clearly visible inside the light fixture directly above the reception desk. That should tell you something about the attention being paid to cleanliness and maintenance.

The bathroom was another disaster. The shower water was dangerously hot and very difficult to regulate, and using the shower resulted in water flooding the bathroom floor.

These were not small cosmetic complaints. They involved security, cleanliness, maintenance, and basic functionality of the room. I expected considerably better from a hotel carrying the Wyndham name, especially at NYC hotel prices.

One star. I would not stay here again.

author: Brooke M
title: Good close to places we wanted to visit
text:
Hotel staff was very friendly 
Water very hot 
Complaints 
Shower curtain very dirty and shower rod very rusty. Both need to be replaced

author: Joseph U
title: Decent experience
text:
Hotel very well located.  Close to the train station, the Empire State Building,... fairly quiet.
The neighborhood isn't the best but it's close to everything.
The rooms are spacious. The beds are comfortable except for the sofa bed, it's a nightmare!
Cleanliness needs to be improved, but we didn't have any bedbugs or cockroaches (see previous reviews).
For the price it remains decent but doesn't deserve more than 3 stars.

author: Luca T
title: Would not recommend
text:
This was one of the worst hotels we have stayed at, 
We enjoyed the size of the room, clean towels and bed made daily, the hotel customer service was by far the worst.  As a type 1 diabetic,  I carry extra insulin,  I have an ice pack that n3eds to be frozen for flights home.  This is the first hotel that had no freezer or refused to put the ice pack in the freezer,  they said the staff would take it. The fridge in thr room did not get very cold,  so I'm sure my insulin is ruined. On the day of out check out, out flight was 6pm, out of JFK, we signed up for the airport transport,  while we were out, our flight was canceled and we were now booked to Fly out of LGA, it took me over 3 hrs to get the hotel staff at the front desk to answer the phone.  Worst customer service experience.  And we had to pay a $22 resort fee a day and  For what?

author: Erin D
title: Horrible valet experience
text: Unfortunately, the valet scraped our wheel on a curb, and we got a flat shortly after leaving. I called to get an incident report, and they haven’t called me back. There were also crumbs underneath the nightstand. I would not stay here again. I would recommend the Cambria which is right across the street.

author: Mia P
title: Horrible nightmare hotel
text:
Do NOT book here. Also supervisor said the pictures don't match the rooms and were taken a while ago. We paid for a premium and they tried to put us in a small room then moved us to another small room. STILL NOT WHAT WE PAID FOR. READ BELOW FOR MORE DETAILS

Upon entering our original room, it was immediately obvious that it was not the room we had reserved and paid for. The room was significantly smaller than what was advertised and what we specifically booked. One of the main reasons we chose this room was because it was supposed to include a sofa bed, which was completely missing. This left our family without the accommodations we had planned and paid for.

Unfortunately, the problems did not end there. The cleanliness and condition of the room were completely unacceptable. We found:
- A bloodstain on one of the beds.
- A bathroom that appeared to have not been properly cleaned.
- An already opened bar of soap left behind from a previous guest.
- Water all over the bathroom sink upon arrival.
- A hair dryer left plugged into the wall, making it obvious that basic housekeeping procedures were overlooked.
- A crack in the window.
- Furniture that was old, heavily stained, and in poor condition.

These are not minor cosmetic issues--they are serious concerns regarding cleanliness, maintenance, and guest safety.

When we brought these concerns to the front desk, we were met with resistance rather than understanding. Instead of immediately addressing the situation or attempting to make things right, we had to repeatedly advocate for ourselves before anyone was willing to move us to another room. At no point did it feel like management was interested in resolving the situation or acknowledging how unacceptable these conditions were.
Eventually, after continued discussions, we were moved to another room. 

Unfortunately, this room was not much better.
In the second room, we discovered:
- A large sticky stain on the top bunk bed.
- A roach inside the shower.
- Stains on the furniture and curtains.

By this point, any confidence we had in the cleanliness of the hotel was completely gone. Finding an insect in the bathroom after already experiencing numerous sanitation issues in the first room was unacceptable and frankly disturbing.
Overall, the condition of both rooms fell far below the standards that any paying guest should expect. We paid for a clean, safe, properly maintained room that matched the description of our reservation. Instead, we spent our time documenting problems, speaking with staff, packing up our belongings to move rooms, and worrying about the cleanliness of our accommodations rather than enjoying our trip.

The lack of quality control, housekeeping standards, and customer service throughout this experience was extremely disappointing. We should never have had to argue simply to receive the room we paid for, nor should we have been moved into another room that also had significant cleanliness issues.

I am requesting that this matter be reviewed seriously. In addition to a prompt response explaining how the hotel intends to address these concerns, I expect the refund that was promised to us to be processed without any further delay. I also hope steps are taken to improve housekeeping, maintenance, and customer service so future guests do not experience the same issues. 

Room 504 and 212

author: Emma S
title: Good hotel
text:
We liked the hotel, large room and bathroom, comfortable beds, good location.
Very good!!

author: James A
title: Unacceptable experience!!!
text:
Unacceptable experience- avoid the Family Room during summer. Our family of five, including two children and a grandmother, stayed in Room 801 for two nights beginning July 17. We paid an outrageous premium of >$650 per night, yet the hotel failed to provide the most basic necessity during extreme summer heat: functioning air-conditioning!

The suite was spacious and clean, but that became irrelevant when we could not sleep comfortably. The Family Room appears to be two rooms combined with a wooden partition, without an AC system capable of cooling the enlarged space. On the queen-bed side, the temperature remained at 75–76°F. On the bunk-bed and sofa side—where our children were supposed to sleep- the AC did not work at all on the first night!! That night was miserable!! The unit was repaired the next day, but the temperature still would not fall below 73–74°F. We ultimately had to request two fans simply to survive the second night. Fans are not an acceptable substitute for working AC in a >$650-per-night hotel room.

Even more frustrating, the manager, Mr. Sharma, was unavailable when I tried to speak with him, and I learned that s/he is generally NOT available!

Selling this room at a premium price when its cooling system cannot adequately serve the space is indefensible. Management is basically scamming in the name of "Family Room". I checked one other room and generally enquired. The AC situation is same for all Family rooms. AVOID, if you can! We won't be back for sure!

author: Dylan M
title: BED BUG INFESTATION AND VILE UNPROFESSIONAL STAFF
text:
If I could give this hotel zero stars, I would.
Before our trip, we found multiple recent reviews from guests reporting bed bugs. Concerned, we called the hotel before arrival and requested to cancel our reservation. We were told we would be charged the full cost if we canceled, so we decided to give the hotel the opportunity to provide us with a clean room.
Before officially checking into the room, we inspected it and found nothing concerning. The following day, after housekeeping serviced our room, we returned and discovered what was clearly a bed bug crawling on the bed. We immediately photographed and recorded it, captured it in a sealed plastic bag, and brought it to the front desk.
The manager, I believe his name is John, briefly looked at the insect and repeatedly insisted that it was “an ant” without meaningfully inspecting it. When we attempted to explain why we believed it was a bed bug, he ended the conversation and refused to discuss it further. We no longer felt comfortable staying in the room and declined the offer to move to another room because we had lost confidence in the property’s handling of the situation.
We contacted Wyndham Customer Care, Wyndham Corporate, and even requested police assistance because we were unable to resolve the dispute. The police officers completely agreed with us, but explained that they could not force the hotel to issue a refund because it was a civil matter.
This was my bachelorette weekend, and instead of enjoying our trip, we spent hours documenting evidence, finding another hotel, and taking precautions to avoid bringing bed bugs home with us or to anywhere else we stayed. We also discovered additional charges on our account that we are still trying to understand, an extra $300 worth of charges that, when we called to ask what they were for, they couldn't tell us and refused to give an itemized explanation of the charges.
I have attached videos of the bed bug we found and of our interaction with management so that other travelers can make their own assessment. This was easily the most disappointing hotel experience I have ever had.

author: Poppy T
title: Terribly negative experience, do not go here!
text:
Hello, we should have listened to so many of the past reviews. We found a bed bug after our first night after housekeeping came to "clean it". We talked to the manager and he called the bed bug in the ziploc baggy we had caught, an ant after not giving us the time of day, definitely not an ant. The staff refused to give us a refund. We spoke to corporate, customer service and we even called police officers to come talk to us. We originally had asked to check the room prior to checking in as I tried to cancel the night before checking in and was told I would be charged for the full visit. This hotel is a joke and a scam... Please DO NOT GO HERE!!! This place ruined our weekend and hope you all stay safe and clean because this hotel knows there is a bed bug infestation and are being extremely negligent about it!!! If I could I would attach all the photo and video evidence we have!!
Also not worthy of a 1 but I can't give negative stars...
