author: Lucas Y
title: Terrible Experience!
text:
This is a tardy warning but...stay away from Club Wyndham! Just today, I received a call from one of their sales representatives and it reminded me (like PTSD) of my family's experience with the company.  Our experience was AWFUL!
The original call, in the Summer of 2025, promised me 2 nights in New York City at an "upscale" hotel in Manhattan for $399 (plus fees and taxes). Turned out the fees in NYC came out to over $800 (that's on top of the original $399)!  The place we were assigned - The Tryp Hotel ... was, at best, a MOTEL! Our family travels a lot and this was one of the worst places we've ever stayed! We ordered two beds but were only given one King. I like to work out every morning and the TRYP's facilities were disgusting. I begrudgingly worked out on two mornings. There were NO towels or sanitary wipes and the SAME empty water bottles I saw from the morning before were still there the next morning. Clearly, no one took the time to even tidy up the work out room!
At our required presentation, the THIRD person we spoke to (trust me, it's a hard sell) confirmed that we had reserved two beds and told us that we would be refunded the $100 we paid for the extra "cot" (a prisoner would have been disappointed with that thing) that was rolled into our room.  When we complained about the excessive fees we had to pay, all that representative said was "Well, welcome to New York."
Of course, the $100 refund never came. We still have a bitter taste in our mouths over the whole "bait and switch" experience. I'm mentally healthy enough to get over emotional things pretty quickly, but, the phone call from the Wyndham rep. today reignited my indignation. Here's the kicker: when I started to to voice my criticism from my previous experience...he hung up on me!
My advice: Ignore all calls from Club Wyndham!

author: Antoine E
title: Disappointed
text: Upon my arrival, I was charged an additional 150 fee when it was never referenced on their hotel website. In addition to the surprise fee, my TV didn’t work and maintenance showed up and could not resolve the issue so my only source of entertainment in my room was not provided. If you Make reservations here Make sure to bring shower slippers or flip-flops as the shower is very moldy.

author: Poppy G
title: Stay away
text:
During my stay, the air conditioning in the hotel was not functioning for two days. This created a very uncomfortable environment and substantially diminished the quality of our visit. 
Talked to front desk and they did nothing to help. 

Additionally, I reported a non-functioning toilet to the front desk in the morning and was assured the issue would be addressed. However, when my family and I returned to the hotel later that evening, the toilet had still not been repaired. As a result, I was forced to troubleshoot and fix the issue myself so that my family could use the restroom. 

I submitted complaints to the manager and to corporate and have received no response to date. Do not stay there. They don’t take care of their patrons!

author: Sophia G
title: 0/10 — Extremely Disappointing Stay
text:
Our experience at this hotel was unacceptable from start to finish. We completed online check‑in, yet still had to check in again upon arrival. From there, everything went downhill.

Cable TV was completely nonfunctional for our entire 4‑day/3‑night stay, with staff repeatedly saying it was “being fixed” but never actually resolving the issue.

The air conditioning was also broken for all three nights. The room never dropped below 72°, and despite multiple reports, we were told it was “being looked at” with no follow‑up and no solution.

On top of that, we dealt with extremely noisy neighbors until 3 a.m. every night. Even after complaining, the noise only stopped briefly. We didn’t know these guests, yet they attempted to enter our room through the shared door — an alarming and unacceptable breach of safety.

What makes this stay truly terrible is the complete lack of service recovery. Problems happen, but the absence of meaningful response, urgency, or compensation showed a disregard for guests’ comfort and security.

We would not return and cannot recommend this hotel under any circumstances.

author: Harper C
title: Great for families
text: The hotel was great, very spacious for a large family, which is rare in NYC. Restaurant was amazing and location right next to a subway station. Area seems safe, lots of dining options. Walkable to most NYC main attractions. My only complaint would br that the housekeeping services are done the later part of the day.

author: Zachary D
title: Excellent view and great location
text:
Only stayed one night but positive experience

Room was on top, 15th floor..corner room. 

Family of four. King size bed with bunk beds for kids. 

Great views from room windows on two elevations. Ruined slightly by construction materials store on room balcony. (No access to balcony because of this) 

His and hers sinks in bathroom. 

Bar at reception was good with an excellent selection of bar food. 

Downside. Luggage storage needs to be made more secure. Easy fix to put a lock on it and issue tickets for stored luggage. I could have easily walked out with anyone’s suitcase.

author: Pierre G
title: Decent for a NYC tourist on a budget
text:
This is a decent hotel for a tourist seeking to stay within the Times Square area without paying a premium rate, but I am not sure that I personally found it to be valuable or worth saving money on a hotel. 

Pros:
Location - This is great if you are seeking to be within walking distance to many Times Square tourist attractions. Subway access is plentiful with numerous stations and Penn Station is super close. This hotel is steps from numerous fast food establishments, a CVS (my family liked having this so close for snacks and drinks and I even had to have a medication filled during my trip), and various stores. 

Noise - Despite being in a busy area, we found the noise - both outside and inside the hotel entrance- to be very tolerable. We had no issues sleeping at night due to this, but if we had, the hotel had provided earplugs in our room. 

Cleanliness - Our room was clean at check in and housekeeping visited daily to refresh our linens and remove our trash. This was nice as I have recently stayed at numerous other hotels which don’t do this daily unless you ask them to. They provided us with a couple or two after bottles daily as well which was a nice touch that most hotels don’t offer for free.

Friendly staff - Staff interacted with were all pleasant and eager to help. I had to engage with them for a few specific requests and walked away satisfied and with my issue resolved promptly. 

Cons:

Hotel area - Yes, the location is convenient but the immediate area outside of the hotel entrance was a bit rough. This may not be directly within the hotel’s control, to be fair, but it is worth noting as it something I would have liked to know before booking. The exterior hotel photos are very misleading. As is the case of many NYC areas, the sidewalk along the front of the hotel is fully covered with scaffolding. That alone isn’t an issue but it was much rougher looking in the surrounding exterior area than the other hotels we walked past in Times Square. We stayed 6 nights and for our entire stay there was always lots of trash piled up and multiple nasty used mattresses stacked and propped up along the sidewalk to the hotel. It is right next to another hotel, so I’m not sure if which hotel this is directly attributable to. Again, I know it’s NYC and a level of this is expected, but it was a bit much for my personal preference. 

No rooftop terrace - Many sites list this hotel as having a rooftop terrace open for guest use, but this wasn’t the case during our stay and I admit that I did find that to be disappointing. I wasn’t expecting anything fancy at all, but based on listings and reviews on various hotel booking sites I was lead to believe there would be at least a small rooftop area we could hang out on if we chose to do so. We went to the top floor (15th) to look for terrace access and easily found it, but could see it is used for hotel storage (mostly large paint buckets) and was kept locked. To be fair, I booked directly with the hotel and didn’t see this terrace mentioned on their site so I believe it is a matter of outdated listings on third party sites and older guest reviews. 

No on site laundry - It would have been nice to have a guest laundry area. Similar to above, I don’t recall seeing that listed on the hotel website but did see it listed on most third party booking sites which seems to be outdated information. 

Room seemed tired and could stand a facelift / refresh but it was in line with the rate we paid as compared to other nearby hotels

Bottom line: It was a tolerable stay with no huge complaints but I likely wouldn’t return to this hotel for a future NYC stay. This isn’t really the hotel’s fault but I just feel like it’s not the best fit for my family in general. The value is there is one wishes to stay in the heart of the tourist area for an affordable price, but after my stay I confidently can say that if I could do it over I would pay slightly more for a “better” hotel or I would stay in a more affordable area.

author: Sydney Q
title: Terrible hotel.
text: I booked a triple room and found myself in a room with only one double bed, making me believe that the bed was larger than a normal double bed... after much insistence, especially considering the heat and the lack of air conditioning and a fan, I was moved to a room with two beds... the room was very dirty, several components were broken, it was not cleaned the following day... dust everywhere, very dirty carpet... bottles thrown on the floor in the hallways... I do not recommend it...

author: Camille K
title: Horrible, to be avoided at all costs.
text: Catastrophic and unprofessional welcome, incompetent customer service (very peculiar handling of complaints, especially when it is related to a billing error by the hotel). Very relative cleanliness of the rooms, dilapidated and poorly maintained building. Very frugal breakfast and with basic industrial products. This hotel is a real shame for the Accor Group and for the 4-star Mercure hotels.

author: Owen S
title: Hotel next to La Villette.
text: The hotel is well-located, just a one-minute walk from the metro station. The rooms and bathroom are spacious. Breakfast is acceptable. Unfortunately, the building's air conditioning was not working. Nevertheless, it offers good value for money.

author: Lucia A
title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
text:
Avoid at all costs!
We stayed at this hotel at the beginning of July.
Upon arrival, we were asked if we had received an email regarding the air conditioning not working; however, we had received nothing, nor were we even warned when booking.
It was very hot and we were explained that to compensate for the air conditioning breakdown, we would find a fan in our room. It was so noisy, to the point that we could not run it during the night. To get a little coolness, we then opened the window. It only opens to 30 degrees, and it overlooked the boulevard. Noisy because people were partying there, not to mention the vehicle traffic.
As a result, we were very hot and slept little. Not even a bottle of water in the room...
It should be noted that the bathtub is slippery; it really presents significant risks of falling! So much for safety.
Dirty windows, questionable carpet.
The next day we went down to have breakfast.
Frankly, we were surprised by its more than basic level. In bulk, no small jars of jam but large jars where everyone helped themselves; not very appetizing. No yogurts, we were told that there never were any and that we could fall back on the fromage blanc! No hard-boiled eggs either, only 2 cheeses, few fruits, etc. etc., I'll spare you the rest.
Having stayed in Mercure hotels, I think it is clearly not up to standard. The overall services are those of a 2-star hotel (and even then, Ibis hotels are clean), certainly not a 4-star (except for the price).
This establishment has no place in the Accor group. It even gives it a bad name.
I requested feedback from hotel management by email.
To date no response ... Online obviously with everything else.

author: Samuel N
title: Failed stay
text: First of all, no air conditioning with 35 degrees outside, I let you imagine, the room is cheap and high up, it is good for the price, of course no air conditioning, the breakfast is horrible, have it outside.

author: Charlotte J
title: Bad experience, a 4-star hotel without air conditioning in the blazing sun
text: Ideal for its location for a concert at the Zenith, but otherwise, the room faces a busy street in the heat without air conditioning and the window barely opens. Not up to the standards of a Mercure, and especially not of a 4-star hotel.  It was only for one night; I can barely imagine what guests must endure for several nights.  Average breakfast and average welcome as well. To be avoided this summer

author: Giulia H
title: A rather disappointing stay at the hotel because the hotel is old and not well maintained. We are far from the standard of Mercure Accor.
text: Very old hotel and not at all up to the standard of Accor establishments. The doors work poorly (defective electronic locks), bathroom seals not watertight, plastic toilet seat of low quality broken, air conditioning failure (so they say) thus an awful heat everywhere.... In short, not a great hotel at all

author: Rosie O
title: Paris in a Heatwave
text: I thought it was air-conditioned, but in heatwave Paris, it was hard.

author: Thomas M
title: A joke
text: No air conditioning, the windows do not open at more than 30°, cigarette butts and debris on the inaccessible terrace, a bottle cap on the floor of the room upon arrival, bathroom with scratched sink, bathtub, and toilet bowl, an anemic hairdryer, fries on the floor of the elevator, closet doors abandoned in the hallways, uneven and damaged restaurant floor, terrace with a non-existent awning, exposed electrical wires, a broken parasol abandoned on the terrace, terrace not open before 7:30 AM but with cigarette butts, paper on the ground, unusable tables abandoned on the said terrace, terrace not accessible for people with reduced mobility nor the breakfast buffet, in short, 4 stars that are nothing but a scam.

author: Ryan M
title: Terrible.
text:
Nightmarish stay from June 21 to June 24, 2026. We are a family with two girls aged 7 and 9. Upon our arrival, the hotel charged us the full balance and only afterwards informed us that the air conditioning was completely broken throughout the establishment (in the rooms and common areas) during the heatwave. When we requested an immediate refund to change hotels, we were met with a refusal. They forced us to stay, offering as the only solution a portable air conditioner with a hose that had to drain out the window: the result? A slightly open window on the second floor overlooking a very noisy main street, suffocating heat in the room, and impossible to sleep due to the traffic noise. Unbearable breakfast room (a true sauna). Incorrect behavior and contrary to the duties of transparency towards the consumer. We submitted a formal complaint and they did not even bother to respond. Absolutely to be avoided.

Nightmarish stay from June 21 to June 24, 2026 (Family with two children). Upon our arrival, the hotel collected the balance and only afterwards informed us that the air conditioning was completely out of order throughout the establishment during the heatwave. Categorical refusal to refund us to change hotels. They provided us with a portable air conditioner with a drainage hose through the window: the result, a slightly open window on the second floor overlooking a very noisy main avenue, continuous heat, and a sleepless night due to the noise. Stifling breakfast room. Total lack of transparency and respect for the customer. We submitted a formal complaint and have received no response to date. To be absolutely avoided.

author: George F
title: Absolutely flee!
text:
Flee!

Too bad we cannot give a negative rating!
How are the stars awarded?
Why does the Accor group take on franchisees like this?

In the middle of a heatwave, no air conditioning even though we received a message saying it was aging, while hiding the fact that it had been broken for a long time.
Of course, no response to the complaint email.
Everything is poorly maintained, the sofas in the entrance hall are worn out, like everything else, the terrace tables only stand up by miracle, the luggage storage is paid...
The staff works in unacceptable conditions and remains smiling despite the constant reprimands from customers, and of course, the management staff stays well hidden...

author: Andrea F
title: I will not return to it.
text: It has been 10 years since I last set foot in this hotel, and I can truly say, "it was better before." Air conditioning was broken while it was 95 degrees outside, bathroom needs renovation, room facing the street where you can even hear people's conversations, breakfast that takes 15 minutes to find and is very minimalistic, door card that only works once out of two times. The only positive point I saw there was the pillow and the two bottles of water.

author: Lea E
title: Unacceptable... I just arrived at the hotel for 2 nights, it is 35 degrees... and the air conditioning is not working... shameful, not even a p.
text: The disaster: a hotel that does not inform us that the air conditioning is not working; we are told that they would send us an email that we never received. I request a refund; they do not want to give it, they only offer us the city tax. It is thirty-five degrees; they gave us a tiny fan, and there are two of us. I request a refund, a gesture; I ask that they relocate us... in short, unacceptable.

author: Marta O
title: REALLY SO-SO-SO.
text:
"Oh my god"... the bathroom is malfunctioning, it's almost impossible to turn on the shower faucets. One card out of two works.. 
Paper cups. It's dirty..

author: Paolo K
title: Sleepless night.
text:
Our stay will unfortunately remain one of our worst hotel experiences.

On the night of June 6 to 7, 2026, we experienced a totally unacceptable situation in this establishment of the Mercure group. An entire night ruined by a group of foreigners who clearly privatized part of the hotel for a so-called "family" meeting. These people behaved as if they were alone in the world, creating noise disturbances, coming and going, and showing a complete lack of respect for the other guests who had simply paid to sleep.

The hotel's first mistake was placing our family on the same level as this group. Clients seeking peace and rest should never have been housed in close proximity to such a noisy and uncontrolled gathering. The establishment must have been aware of this event and took no measures to preserve the tranquility of the other occupants.

Even more shocking is the handling of this complaint. Despite the facts, despite a chaotic night, and despite the obvious harm suffered, the hotel manager refuses any genuine acknowledgment of responsibility. No questioning, no awareness of the seriousness of the situation.

As for the "compensation" offered by the Mercure group, it is simply insulting: 10% off a future reservation, which amounts to about twenty euros. So this is what they believe represents a sleepless night, stress, fatigue, and a partially ruined weekend. We had traveled nearly 250 kilometers in hopes of having a restful night to fully enjoy our Sunday in Paris. Upon waking, we mostly regretted not having returned home.

This commercial proposal demonstrates a profound contempt for the harm suffered and gives the impression that the Mercure group considers its customers as taken for granted, regardless of the conditions in which they stay.

Between the lack of management of disturbances, the total lack of acknowledgment of the harm caused, and a ridiculous commercial response, we can only strongly advise against this establishment as well as the Mercure group.

Avoid it.

After such an experience, we fully understand why more and more travelers are turning to Airbnb-type rentals. For our part, this was the last time.

author: Morgan E
title: Bad experience.
text: No air conditioning in the entire hotel during the heatwave. A young person at the reception who is unable to speak clearly and distinctly to provide us with information. Lack of professionalism. It took a lot of complaining to get an air conditioner instead of a fan that was just blowing hot air. A hotel that does not meet the standards of other Mercure hotels we have previously experienced.

author: Henry F
title: Well located but rooms are a bit limited for a 4-star and the restaurant is very unsatisfactory.
text:
Room reserved for 4 people. Classic air conditioning not functional but the hotel provided additional units. Cleanliness is borderline for a 4-star (corners and baseboards not cleaned, bathroom joints a bit moldy).
However, the responsiveness for changing the shower hose that was half cut is questionable... one has to wonder how the cleaning staff overlooked it.
Room with a door connecting to another room reserved by an American guest who was making noise from 5 AM (jetlag). It would be nice if the doors were MUCH more soundproofed.
For breakfast, nothing to complain about, it's perfect.
For the restaurant, it is better to look elsewhere. Staff (man that evening) was not very friendly, managing 3 tables and we had to wait. The dishes are not great and the gratin dauphinois taken out of the freezer was not even hot. The server's response: the cook is all alone. I can heat a frozen dish properly by myself.

author: Samuel Z
title: Outrageous.
text:
Our very bad experience at this pathetic hotel began with a foul odor that lingered in the air of the room. After some inspections, we realized that this repulsive smell was coming from the bathroom sink, and that this stench was actually that of sewage. For a hotel that claims to be four stars, we will think again. 

But the real scandal concerns the breakfast. We booked it in advance and paid 84 euros (21€ per person). What a surprise it was when we learned, from the hotel's postings, that breakfast costs 9.50€ per person if not reserved in advance. A difference of 46 euros is simply appalling, especially when considering families who have to save for months, and whose stay in a hotel is the only vacation they can afford. 
The staff did absolutely nothing to resolve this issue, despite their promises. 

For 84 euros, you surely expect a buffet served with quality... but that is not the case. The line (at 9:30 AM) is endless; we have to wait for the staff to give us permission to enter the breakfast room. Once this step is passed, it is impossible to enjoy your meal in peace. The reason? Half of the utensils and containers are missing; the cups, the spoons, and so on, are nonexistent, and if you have the misfortune to ask for them, you are sent away. 

In short, for a night costing over $300, the quality of the room and service is clearly not up to par, to say the least. Certainly the worst Mercure Hotel you will encounter. Avoid it.

author: Wyatt N
title: disastrous.
text:
I am currently here. No recognition of status and the room is outdated and poorly maintained. The bed is extremely uncomfortable, unworthy of a Mercure.

I also want to add that I am a Platinum member and there is no recognition.

The bathroom is a disaster with the toilet that runs all night. Let's not even talk about the bathtub; it's impossible to take a bath since the stopper is not watertight. I won't even mention the windows that surely haven't been cleaned in 10 years, nor the layer of limescale in the bathtub.

This is officially the worst Mercure in France, which only benefits from its prime location relative to the Zénith and the Parc de la Villette.

author: Paige U
title: That's bad.
text: Good location near metro stop 5. Excellent public transport links. Very bad hotel service. Low qualified reception staff even did not find the reservation on our arrival. In the triple room we found only two pillows. Some services provided in the reservation such as free minibar bathrobe and slippers in the room not available. Bad breakfast service, little staff, small room compared to the number of guests in the structure, little choice of food and drink. Difficulty in consuming due to absence of cups and glasses not readily stocked at the distribution points of the hall. Four stars you don't deserve. Poor cleaning. Structure to be renovated.

author: Ana H
title: NH hotel Opera Paris
text: The hotel reservation personnel was polite. Breakfast room too small considering a four stars hotel and the variety of food selection not adequate again for a four stars hotel. The suite room was nice and renewed but with very bad positioning since located at First floor facing an internal light well. Moreover, pigeon feathers in the gutter was present without any cleaning. Lastly, the air conditioning positioning just on top of the sofà bed caused cold problems on the body during sleeping so we have been obliged to switch off it sensing hot temperature

author: Maria M
title: Great Location, Lovely Service, But  Book a Bigger Room
text:
enjoyed our stay at NH Paris Opéra Faubourg, especially because of the location. It’s very convenient for exploring Paris, with the Le Peletier and Cadet Metro stations just a couple of minutes away. Galeries Lafayette, Opéra and Boulevard Haussmann are also within easy walking distance, so shopping, restaurants and getting around the city were all very easy.

One of my favorite things about the hotel was the little complimentary refreshment station in the lobby. They had water, juice and these delicious blue and white meringues that I kept going back for! It was such a simple touch, but after being out walking around Paris all day, I really appreciated being able to grab a drink or something sweet whenever we came back to the hotel.

The staff were another highlight. The reception team was warm, friendly and very helpful. They assisted us with restaurant reservations, including getting us a table at Paul Bert, which we really appreciated.

The hotel itself has a nice, modern vibe and has recently been renovated. My main issue was the size of our room. We booked the Standard Room, which is 14 m², and for two people with suitcases, it felt very tight. There was barely enough space for our luggage, and even the hallways felt quite narrow. I know smaller rooms are common in Paris, but personally I found it a little too cramped.

If I stayed here again, I absolutely would, mainly because of the excellent location and helpful staff, but I would definitely pay extra for a larger room. The Superior rooms start at 18 m², and I think those extra few square meters would make a big difference.

Overall, a very pleasant Paris hotel with a great location, thoughtful little touches and genuinely helpful service. Just don’t underestimate how small 14 m² feels when you have two people and two suitcases

author: William Z
title: Great stay
text:
Great hotel! We stayed in a junior suite which was spacious for Paris standards and had a very nice balcony and view. Very clean and modern. 

Staff were friendly and the location is good, easy walk to the Opera area, plenty of restaurants, shops, etc nearby. Only complaint is that there is one elevator and sometimes the wait time is a bit too long.

Found it to be great value compared to other places i've stayed at in Paris. Would definitely return.

author: Aiden J
title: Great experience in the city of lights.
text: The bed and pillows were the standout features of this experience. The breakfast was incredible, and the staff was incredibly attentive. Overall, it was a great value for the price. The location was also very convenient, near metro stations.

author: Sophia U
title: best hotel in the neighborhood - we will be back!
text:
"Upon entering the hotel, we were welcomed very warmly by Mounir at the reception, and after the professional check-in process, he upgraded us to a suite as the 'lucky guest for the day.' ;-)"
But the breakfast was also..."

author: Manon Q
title: A good solution in the center of Paris.
text: Great location, excellent breakfast, very friendly staff. The only flaw: finding a dirty towel in the room... not nice! What a shame.

author: Paolo U
title: Great location hotel
text: The hotel is in great location, reachable on foot from many sights, and just steps from some metro line. The breakfast spread is really good. Staff is very welcoming and friendly. Will definitely be back.

author: Zoe L
title: Lack of hygiene.
text:
Small rooms; when you open the bathroom door, it hits the mattress, there are holes in the shower joints and inside the closet, noisy pipes, and terrible cleanliness in the room and in the carpeted hallway where I found several bird feathers that remained there throughout my 5-day stay (they didn't vacuum in all those days in the hallway), and this is despite the hotel allowing pets. The lounge of this hotel is limited to some sofas against the wall that is between the lobby and reception; it does not meet the standards of a 4-star hotel. As one would expect, once I saw the level of cleanliness, I did not dare to have breakfast there. The only good thing about this hotel is its location, but there are other well-located hotels that I have noted for my next trip to Paris. 
The photo of the room that appears on the website is real and apparently nice; I based my decision to book there on it, but once inside the room, the velvets and drapes, walls, armchair, etc., were dusty, stained, and had accumulated dirt. The rooms were supposed to have been renovated in 2025.

author: Tyler R
title: Good, but a bit too expensive.
text: I stayed at this renovated hotel, which is pleasant: decent insulation, comfortable bedding, decent bathroom. A bit pricey compared to other hotels in the area in the same range.

author: James Q
title: Beautiful discovery
text:
Beautiful clean room 
Friendly receptionist, especially Fabien

author: Dylan I
title: Perfect experience
text: Very nice and welcoming hotel; for being in Paris, the rooms and bathroom are large and modern! Top cleanliness!

author: Isabella R
title: Really lovely, comfortable hotel in a good area
text:
We’ve just stayed at the NH Opera Faubourg for 3 nights during the Paris heat wave. We were celebrating several birthdays with friends so we wanted something a little special but still on a reasonable budget. We booked a junior suite, which was on the 6th floor & was larger than the basic rooms. We were so pleased with everything there but especially the air conditioning system!
The room had everything we needed; a fridge; safe; plenty of storage; lovely toiletries & additional items like a shaving kit etc & neat little brush/ comb combo. We had an additional seating area due to being a suite. The bed was so comfortable; the shower was lovely & have I mentioned the air con… so needed during our stay.
Breakfast was plentiful with great options & the staff were incredibly helpful across all areas of the hotel. 
The area is great for Notre Dame, Montmartre  & has good Metro links nearby. There are lots of café restaurants around which are very nice.
My only slight negative would be that you can hear & feel the rumbling of the nearby metro, but not to an extent that it stops sleep… & I’m a light sleeper! The trains  stop overnight so wasn’t a problem for us at all.
We have thoroughly enjoyed our stay & very much hope to return here again when in Paris ☺️

author: William I
title: Beautiful hotel and ideally located.
text: Just a few steps from several must-see tourist sites in Paris. High-quality staff and services.

author: Oliver M
title: Mixed Feelings but Great Location with a Renovated Small Room
text: Location was excellent in the Opera district - quick walk to metro and numerous restaurants as well as Montmartre. Room nicely updated, but very small so only 1 large case could be stored on the luggage rack placed in front of the balcony door. We had two twin beds which may not have been new as they did slope to one side so you felt as though you may slide out! Pleasantly surprised with balloons and a cupcake for my son's birthday on the first day. Front desk staff excellent. The only downfall was the housekeeping during the week (the Saturday was good). We had a room on the 5th floor which had a view of the Eiffel Tower when looking from the balcony - weren't bothered by street noise (only the people in the room above on one morning). The bathroom was functional however, there was a lack of space for your toiletries, it would have helped having a drawer that opened rather than a false one since there was no shelving or counter space around the sink. Also, quite a slippery shower floor. The lobby offers a nice touch with fresh, daily-infused water featuring citrus, cucumber, and herbs. Would rate at 3-1/2* just because of extreme lack of space (even though Paris is known for this), poor housekeeping, and a not so comfortable bed for an average price of $510/night. Even though we had mixed feelings we would recommend this smart boutique style hotel due to the convenient location, renovated rooms and friendly and professional front desk staff.

author: Miguel J
title: Disappointed
text: The cleanliness left much to be desired, and the room, despite being a superior one, was minimal; there was hardly any space to pass between the bed and the refrigerator.

author: Manon J
title: Well located but disappointing.
text: We spent two nights in this hotel; the welcome was poor and impersonal, too accustomed to impressive numbers of tourists, so there was no need to be welcoming. Room with a dangerous bathtub, old herbal teas, and meant for one person. The night curtain that cannot be opened properly; in short, a four-star experience not deserved except for the price.

author: Isla O
title: Always top
text:
Hotel in a strategic position. Staff helpful and friendly. They had mistaken with one of the two rooms since no balcony but they were extremely kind, offering us breakfast which was not planned on our trip.
We will definitely be back and thank you for everything!!!

author: Carlos U
title: A beautiful hotel in the most beautiful city in the world
text:
We are loving our stay at this hotel. On entering the room we were so surprised by the welcoming balloons and complimentary macarons left for us to help us celebrate our wedding anniversary.
The room is very stylishly appointed and the bed was so comfortable just what we were hoping for after 30 hours of travel.
The location is also excellent close to many restaurants and public transport.

author: Matthew X
title: Unbeatable experience!
text: Fantastic experience !!!, it is a cozy hotel, with classic Parisian architecture and unbeatable location, a few blocks from the Opéra Garnier; highlights the attention of its staff, who speak several languages and attended us in Spanish, always very friendly and also had a great surprise detail for us, as I traveled with my wife for our wedding anniversary; definitely recommend it.

author: Louis R
title: Value for money
text: This hotel is perfect for location & room. Super like their receptionist hospitality services. Highly recommend for this hotel

author: Harry S
title: Great hotel
text:
We had a great time at this hotel in a triple room.  The staff were all very good and couldn't do enough to help.Very good location.  Clean rooms.  
Breakfast was great and much better than I was expecting.  I liked the drinks and snacks given in the rooms.
Bathroom was adequate but on the small side.
All in all a great 3 days in Paris.

author: Diego E
title: Beautiful boutique hotel
text: Beautiful boutique hotel, we loved the location and the very warm welcome at check in. The staff are attentive and very pleasant, the decor is of a high standard  and beautiful. The bedroom was spacious and very comfortable with everything we needed and loved the little touches, champagne and great toiletries, We would highly recommend.

author: Lucia T
title: A beautiful, well-kept house
text:
A very beautiful hotel ideally located between the Luxembourg Gardens and Notre-Dame de Paris. Refined and welcoming decor. Quick and courteous check-in with the possibility of early check-in. A room facing the courtyard, charming and impeccable, very quiet. A glass elevator allowing you to enjoy this beautiful staircase with 19th-century stained glass. 
Nice welcome in the room with a self-service minibar, a half-bottle of wine, and small cookies. Always a nice gesture. 
Kudos to you

author: Luke D
title: A lovely time in Paris in a very good hotel
text: We felt very comfortable, the staff are very friendly and accommodating. The atmosphere is really very good and relaxed. The breakfast is delicious and very extensive. We can recommend the hotel without any reservations. We will very gladly book a room again.

author: Ella H
title: Excellent stay
text: Excellent stay in this charming hotel, right in Saint-Germain-des-Prés. The staff is adorable and very helpful.

author: Juan V
title: Parisian weekend to be repeated.
text: Well-located hotel (subway) on a quiet street. Charming front desk staff, clean room, and modern bathroom. Complimentary cookies and wine. Quality restaurant. (freshly squeezed orange juice, smoked salmon +++ everything was perfect.

author: Lucy L
title: Very well-located hotel.
text:
Very warm welcome in this pleasant hotel very well located in the 6th.
Close to the Luxembourg Garden and the nice streets of the 6th.
Many restaurants nearby.
A bit dated decor but very clean hotel.
Excellent breakfast with a very varied selection.

author: Oscar P
title: Great hotel
text:
Very nice and central hotel.
Helpful and friendly staff speaking English. Small surprises in the room when cleaning. New water every day. Superb breakfast with freshly pressed juice and warm crossians!
Many shops and cafes near the hotel! Easy to take track from Odeon to most of the city!

author: Rosie O
title: Thoughtful Reception snd Butler Staff
text:
Our stay at Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche was truly unforgettable and made our first trip to Paris in November 2025 even more special.

From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. Walking into our room to find a bottle of champagne, a personalised welcome letter, and a selection of sweet and savoury treats was such a thoughtful surprise. It was a wonderful way to begin our Parisian adventure and immediately made us feel valued as guests.

The hotel’s location is excellent—perfectly situated for exploring the beautiful streets of Paris, with many iconic attractions within easy reach. After spending the day sightseeing, we also appreciated the complimentary afternoon tea and coffee available in the lounge. While the selection wasn’t extensive, it was exactly what we needed to relax and recharge before heading out for dinner each evening.

The warm hospitality, thoughtful touches, and fantastic location made our stay incredibly memorable. We would happily recommend Hôtel Trianon Rive Gauche to anyone looking for a charming and welcoming place to stay in Paris, and we hope to return again in the future.

Thank you to the entire team for making our first visit to Paris such a wonderful experience.

author: Daniel S
title: Comfortable, charming hotel in a great location
text: We had a wonderful visit to Paris with our family of 4,  The Trianon Rive Gauche was a comfortable stay, perfect adjoining rooms for our family, great location, good AC and the staff were helpful and friendly.  The staff are really what stood out for us.  The hotel is in a historic building and has a lot of charm.  The breakfast offered at an extra charge was excellent and well worth it.  We would gladly return!

author: Luca Q
title: Very good stay.
text: A beautiful stay. Comfortable room even if the bathroom was rather small and the shower too. Very friendly staff. Hotel location was excellent. The air conditioning worked very well. Highly recommended.

author: Ruby I
title: A beautiful hotel in a very good location.
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. Very good breakfast!

author: Joseph Y
title: Margherita and I
text: Perfect location, near the Luxembourg Gardens, impeccable service, friendly and helpful staff. Room over the rooftops of Paris with a priceless view, small but functional. Bathroom recently renovated. Minibar included and water always available in the lobby. Perfect cleanliness. Air conditioning working well. Top-notch breakfast!!! The elevator that served our room was very small and to get to the room we still had a flight of stairs.

author: Oliver B
title: Perfect Location in the 6th
text: We had the perfect stay here - great location in the 6th near Luxembourg gardens and about 10 minute walk from the Seine. Not a touristy/crowded area but also pretty central. The hotel itself was so cute - boutique feel and rooms were clean. Our room had a balcony overlooking the street with great views. We opted out of breakfast but the buffet looked great

author: James N
title: Birthday stay over
text:
Great location 
Lovely staff and reception area. Nice touches in the room such as the wine macarons and the personal note.

author: Ethan X
title: Wonderful trip to Paris!
text: Very nice hotel, well located, the staff is very welcoming and provides us with many small attentions that made our stay an excellent trip! Thank you, it was greatly appreciated! The breakfast is plentiful and of high quality! The afternoon tea time is a must😉

author: Chloe M
title: Perfect location, small but comfortable rooms, very small bathroom.
text: The room was small but comfortable; however, the bottom of the bathroom door was very damaged.

author: Abigail O
title: Well-located hotel with comfortable rooms and welcoming, dedicated staff.
text: Very well-placed hotel with welcoming, dedicated staff who provide good advice. The luggage storage service is very appreciated. The room is decent, and the air conditioning is very appreciated. The mattress is super comfortable, very good bedding. The bathroom is cramped, and we would have preferred a shower instead of a bathtub. The carpet, which is very present throughout the establishment, is not very clean and gives an outdated look to the hotel (unfortunately), and the elevator is narrow and retains heat. There is entertainment (dining, shops, gardens) not far from the hotel. The breakfast is plentiful, with a good variety and quantity. We did not appreciate the "baguette" that tasted "industrial"; it's a shame because artisanal French bread is so good!

author: Olivia X
title: Very pleasant stay in a central neighborhood.
text: Pleasant room with a small terrace sufficient for getting some fresh air. Top-notch breakfast. Very friendly staff.

author: Thomas K
title: A wonderful night for me and my daughter
text: Very welcoming hotel, the room with a view was superb. I will gladly return. And a small thought for Charles with whom we exchanged for his professionalism and understanding.

author: Samuel R
title: Friendly staff, great location.
text: I’ve stayed at the Maison Mère numerous time for business and every time and met with warmth from their staff. The reception team are super friendly and always happy to help with any queries you have. The location is very central with lots of sweet bars and restaurants nearby. Would recommend!

author: Oscar R
title: Maison Mere - Perfect Care.
text: Wonderful. Caring and kind staff. My safe space in Paris.

author: Claire H
title: A wonderful family stay in Paris
text:
We had an absolutely wonderful stay at the beautiful and charming Maison Mère from August 18 to 24, 2026. My wife and I visited Paris together with our two adult children, our 18-year-old daughter and 19-year-old son, and it was the first time we had explored the city together as a family.

The hotel is ideally located in a quiet and pleasant part of Paris. Many sights can easily be reached on foot, while the Metro is also very convenient, especially with a weekly travel pass. During our stay, we visited Sacré-Cœur, enjoyed a cruise on the Seine, explored the Catacombs, saw the Eiffel Tower by day, visited the Louvre and Musée d’Orsay, spent a day at the Château de Versailles, and ended our trip with the Eiffel Tower beautifully illuminated at night. For the Louvre, we especially recommend booking a guided tour. Given the sheer size and incredible collection of the museum, having a knowledgeable guide made our visit much more enjoyable and helped us discover and appreciate many details we would otherwise have missed.

Unfortunately, due to the summer holiday period in France, the hotel’s own restaurant and bar were closed during our stay. However, this was not a problem at all. Thanks to the central location, there are many excellent smaller restaurants nearby. We especially enjoyed discovering places frequented by locals, which made dining out particularly enjoyable and authentic.

The hotel itself was wonderfully quiet. Our rooms were beautifully prepared, very comfortable, and exceptionally clean.

The true highlight of Maison Mère, however, is its staff. Every single person we encountered was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and helpful. The housekeeping team always had an open ear for our requests, the service staff were warm and professional, and the reception team was available around the clock and handled every question or request with great care and reliability.

We felt genuinely welcome throughout our entire stay.

We can recommend Maison Mère without hesitation to anyone looking for a charming, peaceful, beautifully maintained hotel with an excellent location and, above all, outstanding hospitality.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire Maison Mère team for making our first family trip to Paris such a memorable and wonderful experience. We very much hope to return one day.

author: Julien D
title: We will be back!
text:
The hotel is fantastic.
Room, breakfast, and location perfect.
Car was parked safely in the underground garage.
Everything in the immediate vicinity. Restaurants, bakeries, subway. 
Very nice staff.

author: Sydney R
title: Loved this hotel, wish we'd had longer there.
text: This was the last stop on our week inter railing to Italy and back and I wish we'd had more time at this beautiful hotel  The attention to detail was just brilliant.  We were offered water as soon as we arrived and told that we would get breakfast even though we were leaving before 6am the following morning.  I really didn't expect it at all!  The rooms were compact but had everything we needed and the most comfortable bed that we'd had on our entire trip.  Lots of little lovely details made the stay feel personal - a tote bag, some biscuits, free water and a lovely note.  The following morning, as said, we had a really lovely takeaway breakfast given to us which was wonderful for the train home.  I'd definitely love to stay here again.  Staff at check in so helpful as well.

author: Caleb B
title: Amazing hotel and even more amazing service!
text:
We had a wonderful stay at Maison Mère and would happily book again! The hotel has such a lovely atmosphere, but what truly made our stay special was the incredibly kind, warm and personal service from the entire staff. Everyone made us feel genuinely welcome and went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable.

Our only small downside was the bathroom, which had a shower in the bathtub. We personally prefer a walk-in shower as we’re two tall people, but this certainly didn’t take away from our overall experience.

Thank you for a fantastic stay – we would definitely come back!

author: Henry W
title: Topper

But the most important thing was a good night's sleep after a tiring day. Quietly located in a nice neighborhood, a spacious and well-equipped bed. With a delicious breakfast, where you can take honey from a beehive, original! Thank you.

author: Laura R

author: Claire V

author: Amelia I

Excellent hotel near the Gare du Nord. Very attentive staff.
Perfect continental breakfast.
I highly recommend it 
Emmanuel

author: Erin T

Very good value for money. Very close to metro, but no too close. Highly recommended, will stay here again when we come back.

author: Sydney U
title: So quaint and perfect location

author: Mason Y
title: Great hotel, great location.
text: We had a warm welcome with a nice cup of coffee. The room was very clean with enough space for two persons. The staff was always friendly! Then, the breakfast was exactly was to expect from a good 4-star hotel, the quality of the products was good, there was enough choice and always enough place in the restaurant to have a quiet breakfast. At last, the location was perfect for us, if you arrive at 'le gare du nord' by train. It's only 15 min. by foot and the location of the hotel is pretty close to the real centre of Paris so we did everything by foot.

author: Claire B
title: A Warm Welcome!

author: Mathis I
title: Great stay overall
text: Great location, fantastic AC, lovely service. Rooms are not very large but that wasn't really a problem for us.

author: Henry K
title: Lovely gem!
text: Absolutely lovely, the rooms and staff. A lot of care and thought are given to their travellers. I had selected the hotel without a massive search so was pleasantly surprised and relieved it had AC as there was a heat wave. The rooms are a pretty good size - my daughter and I were very comfortable, all updated and modern. The location was a bonus, very easy to walk oit and head to anywhere, short walk from Gare du Nord, making in and out quite easy. I would stay there again, no hesitation.

author: Ella U
title: Great stay!
text: Maison Mere was a great place to stay for our first trip to Paris. The rooms were clean and well appointed. The air conditioning worked extremely well (important during the heat wave). Staff were friendly and welcoming. The location was great too. Close to the metro and outside the very touristy areas.

author: Aiden I
title: A boutique hotel in the heart of Paris

Nice hotel, clean, friendly staff and great breakfast! The rooms were very nice and nice, with children, even the park under the hotel! We will be back!

author: George H

author: Morgan M
title: Thanks everything was perfect ❤️

author: Abigail S
title: We'd always come back

author: Taylor P
title: Just a “meh”
text: Returned late to Paris off the train and needed a close room just for the night. Proximity to St Lazare station is great. Otherwise the hotel feels very downmarket. Small, cramped, needing renovation. Room was just ok. Was fine for the few hours we needed it but would not recommend it for anyone wanting a longer stay or with any comfort or amenities. Bathroom was cramped, shower was poor with no pressure. Beds were hard and not overly comfortable.

author: Anna S
title: Holidays with kids in Paris
text: The services provided were very poor considering the price we paid. The hotel is in desperate need of a full renovation; its only saving grace is the excellent location. Being in the heart of the city, close to major monuments and the metro, is very convenient. However, there are definitely better options nearby for less money. I wouldn’t recommend it, which is a shame because the location is perfect.

author: Andrea H

author: Laura R

author: Sydney E

author: Katie P
title: Serious Security Failure and Extremely Disappointing Check-In Experience
text:
My family and I recently stayed at Le Méridien Paris Arc de Triomphe after booking two rooms directly through Marriott. My wife is a Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite member, and we expected the level of service that normally comes with the Marriott brand.

Unfortunately, our experience was one of the most disappointing hotel stays we have ever had.

We arrived at approximately 11:30 a.m. on June 23 and were told our rooms were not yet ready. We were assured that we would receive a phone call as soon as they became available, so we left to spend the day exploring Paris. It was an extremely hot day, with temperatures approaching 40°C (104°F).

No one ever called.

After repeatedly contacting the hotel ourselves throughout the day, we finally received room keys at approximately 8:30 p.m.—about nine hours after arriving.

Unfortunately, the problems didn’t end there.

The following day, we had to move because the room assigned to us was not the room type we had reserved. Once again, we were told we would receive a phone call as soon as the correct room became available.

Once again, no one called.

We were unable to access the correct room until approximately 8:30 p.m., meaning we effectively lost most of a second day waiting for accommodations we had already paid for.

The most troubling incident occurred when my teenage son was issued a key to a room that was already occupied. Believing it was his assigned room, he opened the door and found another guest asleep inside. Thankfully, everyone remained calm, but this should never happen. It was an alarming security and privacy failure for both my son and the guest whose room had been incorrectly assigned.

To be fair, some members of the staff were courteous and genuinely tried to help once they became involved. My disappointment is not with every employee, but with the overall handling of the situation and the lack of communication throughout our stay.

I understand that hotels occasionally experience operational problems. What distinguishes a great hotel is how it responds. In our case, repeated promises were not kept, communication was poor, and a serious room assignment error significantly overshadowed what should have been a memorable family vacation in Paris.

I hope Marriott reviews its procedures to ensure that no future guest experiences similar issues.

author: Gavin Z
title: Good Breakfast and Quiet Neighborhood
text:
Stayed here during the height of the May heatwave and had a good experience. My spouse's company booked this hotel for a business trip and I tagged along. The hotel is air conditioned. Our room was on the first floor, and was reasonably-sized for a hotel room in a major city, something that can perhaps be a culture shock for people staying in places like Paris and New York City for the first time. The room was cleaned daily. My only point of note is the shower/tub combination had a VERY high step up/in. It was fine for us, two able-bodied adults, but I'm not sure how smaller children, people with mobility issues (including senior citizens), or other impairment would have fared in the same room. It was not considered an accessible room, so perhaps this is a moot point. 

While we were there it was still undergoing its renovation, as other reviewers have mentioned, and there was a period briefly during one days that there was no power in our hotel room for about an hour while they were working on something nearby. It was not a bother, as it was during the time of day that most people would be out and about exploring the city, I just wish they had given us a notice that it might happen so it didn't seem so disconcerting at first. 

The breakfast buffet included in the room rate was a pleasant plus, and delicious. It included fruits, eggs, cheeses, breads and hot and cold cereals as well as bacon and sausage and some crepes and pancakes as well. There is also a coffee bar that serves pastries, lattes, and other espresso beverages, and there's a small self-serve market with potato chips, candies, sundry items in case you forgot something, and beverages that had a nice selection. I didn't need anything so I can't speak to the price. 

Every single staff member we dealt with whether at check-in, the coffee bar, the regular bar, or at breakfast each morning was friendly, helpful, welcoming and so kind. We arrived early from an overnight flight, and despite it being well-before the noted check in time, they were able to get us into a room after only about a two hour wait, for which I was extremely grateful.

I don't know if I would have chosen to stay here based on my planned activities, but it was located only about a 2 minute walk from the Porte-Maillot metro station and there were some excellent restaurants nearby despite it being in a somewhat quieter part of the city. All-in-all, I enjoyed our stay as did my spouse.
