author: Sean P
title: Exposed Wires
text:
Stayed at this hotel and was surprised at how they showed little concern for the safety of the guests.  
On Night 1 there was a flimsy platic sign which fell in the bathroom.  When I investigated it had been  covering what appears to be an electrical junction box with bare wires exposed.  It had just been glued over it.  
I took a picture and went down to the front desk and showed it to the assistant manager .  She said that they would send up a technician.  4 days later it was still like that when we checked out.   I just expected more when it comes to the safety of not just the guests but the staff too

author: George I
title: Avoid this hotel. There’s a reason it’s the cheapest Marriott in the Paris central area.
text:
We stayed here only 2 nights. It was terrible from beginning to end.

Checkin was an absolute cluster. Tons of airline crew in the lobby. 4 desks open, groups of people with no organization or anything resembling lines. Angry guests everywhere. When I asked if elite desk line would be separate she said no, they are just taking people as they go… but then other people just went right past me insisting they were elite (we have titanium status). Just frustration for everyone. 

Lounge is closed due to renovation. 20 euro daily credit offered, but not on your checkout day. We used it once at the cafe- to buy stale pastries. Don’t bother. 

Our toilet broke the first night. Took 1 hour for the technician to arrive. Also, they have no iron. They have a steamer but no place to hang your clothes that is close enough to an outlet to use it right. I had to do some creative holding of the hanger, which caused the steam to burn my hands multiple times.

We took multiple showers on the first day (90+ degree weather), so we wanted our towels replaced. Left them on the floor. Housecleaning just took the same dirty towels and hung them back up. Lotion bottle was empty, never refilled. But the worse? We found a dirty fork on the floor behind the curtain (we never used a fork- so leftover from god knows when). Gross. 
 
We also left a key on the power switch to keep the AC on. Housekeeping removed it (fine) but instead of leaving our key on the room, they took it with them. 
Breakfast the last morning- I was told my breakfast was not included. I said no- it should be? We have status that includes breakfast. After 5 minute of back and forth she called someone. Again? They told me breakfast was not included- that was what the 20 euro credit was for. I said no- I was told at checkin that I chose breakfast and the credit wa online of lounge. Finally someone realized it was their error and fixed it. 

This was 6:30 am, when breakfast opened? Because we had to leave at 7 am for an early flight. What a waste of breath, because even though breakfast starts at 6:30 am, there was no hot food available until 7 am. 

Location- 15 min walk from the C, 2 minute walk to the other subway. Pretty much 30 min+ to get most places. 

2 stars only because they managed to give us an early checkin at 1 pm, but in a worse room.

author: Giulia U
title: A total disappointment — absolutely to be avoided
text:
A total disappointment — absolutely to be avoided

I stayed for two nights this weekend and the experience was frankly disappointing.

With temperatures around 95°F in Paris, the air conditioning was unable to go below 77°F in the room, making sleep practically impossible. I reported the issue to the front desk — without any result.

The breakfast was subpar: a crowd of people crammed together, nonexistent service, and quality far below what is expected from an establishment of this category. The amenities in the room were never replenished despite our stay.

This hotel is clearly at the level of a modest 3-star establishment, and that would even be a compliment. The transition under the Marriott name has clearly not improved things.

Never to be repeated and to be avoided at all costs.

author: Lauren B
title: Disappointing
text: Very simply, it is not a 4 star hotel. I expected better. The photo I submitted is the window of our tiny room. It was frosted over so you couldn’t see outside.,

author: Pierre Y
title: disappointing
text:
We did not stay at the hotel but stopped by hoping for a pleasant moment at the "Luna Bar & Lounge"; it was a mistake...
A cocktail priced at €16 that was supposed to contain rum was actually just lemonade.
No pineau, despite it being listed on the menu.
Rubbery, disgusting chicken nuggets.
It was also difficult to communicate with the staff, even though the waitress was doing her best.
It is disheartening to see such poor service quality in a place that claims a standard it does not have on its website...
We were advised by a former customer, but that was a few years ago...
Avoid at all costs.

author: Harper Y
title: READ THE REVIEWS - 2 star shoe box hotel rooms - not worth the money
text: This hotel is not intended for anyone staying more than 2-3 days.  The standard room sizes are extremely small, and there's not enough room to fit 3 large suitcases and still move around the bed(s).  The bathroom is horrible and poorly designed.  The water shoots out everywhere which floods the floor.  I was told that the room I was given was a renovated room (likely renovated in the early 2000s, which is no longer renovated).  Read the reviews prior to booking.  At least you can make an informed decision and not be disappointed.

author: Michael Q
title: Great hotel with a good location
text:
My wife and I wanted a hotel that was close to Gare du Nord with easy access to the main Paris attractions. We spent four nights at Hotel Lorette Astotel. 

The hotels had just reopened after renovation and everything was spotless. The staff very friendly, the room clean and a good range of options for the breakfast. 

There is a free complimentary mini bar - restocked every day and free complimentary coffee/tea/drinks and pastries/cake available every day from 2pm to 2am. As a guest you can visit any of the other hotels in the chain in Paris and take advantage of their complementary drinks and pasties!

Our room (the cheapest available) was perhaps a bit on the small side but that didn't matter to us and we spend our days exploring Paris and only needed the room to sleep.

author: Noah X
title: Charming hotel in the heart of the 9th arrondissement
text: Human-sized hotel, ideally located in the 9th, Place St Georges. Very well served (bus and metro line 12 in the immediate vicinity). The Opera, the department stores, and Montmartre are accessible in 10 minutes on foot. Nicely decorated room and very friendly staff. The breakfast satisfies all tastes. A multitude of restaurants in the neighboring streets. Very good stay. Address to keep.

author: Alexander S
title: Even with the mistake in my booking, receptionist still considered without stressing, I will come back again 💯
text:
Everything 100% 
I recommend, from staffing, cleanliness, breakfast, midday snacking, the complimentary bar in the room, location, value for money is everything

author: Connor H
title: Wonderful and central
text: A wonderful hotel for a vacation in Paris. Very well located, just a few minutes from the Opera and Montmartre. A very quiet area, with a very good atmosphere.    Subway next door, direct line to Montparnasse station and Place de la Concorde. Friendly and familiar service, very pleasant. Good breakfast and a common area with pastries and drinks, courtesy of the house. Excellent value for money. Essential. We will always return.

author: Miguel M
title: Lovely Parisian style hotel
text: Hotel Lorette is a cute and charming Parisian style hotel.  It is an older building but has been renovated and while I was there, renovation was on going in the other floors but it did not bother me.   I booked a family room for 4 people and the room I stayed in was recently renovated and is  air conditioned. I absolutely loved that the family room had two separate rooms with each one having its own bathroom. One of the rooms face the front and had a nice view. Every morning I would open the window and enjoy the view.  The neighborhood is quiet even though the restaurants are open late with people sitting outside. I sat outside one of these restaurants for late night drinks and loved the convenience back to the the hotel.  At the hotel, all day, you can get coffee, tea, and juice in the lobby for free.  For breakfast everyday, I went to a nearby bakery, I highly recommend Cyprien Boulangerie, to buy freshly baked delicious french baguette and other baked goods to bring back to the hotel to have it with coffee.  That worked out well and I did not need to buy the hotel breakfast. The hotel also offer free snacks from 2pm-2am. I love coming back to the hotel after sightseeing and have the snacks and drinks. You can go to the other hotels in the group for the free snacks as well. Almost forgot to mention, everyday they fill your hotel room fridge with water, soda and juice, all included. The lobby was nice and cozy, also got to enjoy the patio.  The location of the hotel is great and it is only one block away from the metro and it is in a nice, safe neighborhood.  There are good restaurants close by.  I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel and would not hesitate to stay there again for my next visit.

author: Freya A
title: Our Paris adventure.
text: An excellent hotel, helpful friendly staff, great location, clean and handy to all the  treasures of Paris.  We were a family of 4 attending a wedding.  Adjoining rooms made it handy to get together. Breakfast was always very good, staff attentive and full of good info on how to travel about Paris.  They were very considerate.  It was most appreciated.  Ready to go back.    DB Cadby

author: Zoe K
title: Great experience
text:
Great experience in this Parisian hotel.
Welcoming, spacious, clean, and well-equipped room. Complete breakfast. 
Well located with the possibility to enjoy the bar of other hotels in the chain.

author: Pablo F
title: Paris, I love you.
text: Very clean hotel with helpful staff who know how to make you feel comfortable. Located near Montmartre, one of the most dynamic and lively neighborhoods in all of Paris. Very close to the subway with the possibility of easily reaching all areas of the city. An excellent idea for the afternoon snack, free in all hotels of their chain. An experience to absolutely repeat. Highly recommended!

author: Matthew E
title: Nice hotel not far from Louvre
text: The hotel is in a nice location , close to M12 line. The rooms are well maintained and housekeeping is good. We went as a family of 4 with 2 rooms. These were not connected rooms that I expected connecting, they were 2 individual rooms coming in with a common door to get in.

author: Joseph F
title: Fabulous stay in central Paris!
text: We very much enjoyed our stay at the Hotel Lorette Astotel.  The location is perfect, equidistant from Montemarte and Opera and in a vibrant area with many restaurants, bars and nightclubs.  Subway access is across the street.  The hotel is clean and well run.  Staff were pleasant and professional.  Snacks and non-alcoholic drinks are provided for free.  Breakfast was very good and provided a variety on continetal Europe favorites, eggs, and sausage.  Rooms are a bit small, but that is expected in central Paris.  We would definitely stay here again.  Jason, USA.

author: George A
title: Almost next to the Saint Georges subway station.
text:
I was assigned a beautiful and spacious room with a bathroom equipped with a bathtub this Sunday evening, as I am alone. 
In addition to the good level of comfort of the rooms, one of the other advantages of this hotel from the Astotel group is the offer downstairs, which provides each room with a range of complimentary drinks: for example, 2 mineral waters + 1 sparkling water + 1 apple juice + 1 soft drink, and additionally some mini pastries downstairs—all at a reasonably priced rate if you book early enough.

author: Elena J
title: A Wonderful Stay — Paris at Its Best ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
text:
It started before arrival — the reservations team was fantastic, answering every question with patience and care. That kind of attentiveness sets the whole trip up for success.

Check-in and checkout were both smooth and genuinely warm. The front desk team was kind and efficient — exactly what you hope for.

The room was simply fantastic. Waking up to a beautiful Eiffel Tower view every single morning never got old. The room was quiet, the beds wonderfully comfortable, and housekeeping was thorough and consistent each day. A few suggestions for future guests: additional towels, washcloths, water in the mini bar, a hair flat iron, and some way to help towels or hand-washed items dry more quickly would be lovely touches.

Breakfast each morning was an absolute delight — a wide, beautiful variety and everything delicious. The perfect way to start a Paris day. The breakfast team was kind and attentive throughout.

Overall a fantastic, memorable experience. I've already recommended Hotel Lorett to others and will absolutely return on my next visit to Paris. 🗼
photos: [{"url": "https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/33/48/4f/f6/caption.jpg", "caption": "Amazing view of the Eiffel Tower - you can see it sparkle at night. ", "photo_id": "860377078"}]

author: Joseph G
title: What you need in Paris
text: Very nice hotel location. Wonderful breakfasts. Clean, cozy rooms. Hospitality receptionists. Nice bonuses in the lounge: tea, coffee, cookies, candy, muffins. I recommend it!

author: Jessica J
title: Very pleasant stay with very professional and friendly staff.
text:
We have been very comfortable in this hotel. It is very well located and well connected. Very friendly and professional staff. The hotel has very nice details, just like all the ones in the Astotel chain. If we were to return to Paris, we would stay here again. It has a quite good price-quality ratio.  The hotel is very clean and has a very good breakfast buffet, varied and of high quality.
I recommend better rooms on higher floors.

author: Wyatt R
title: A perfect stay in Paris
text:
The location of Hotel Lorette  is superb,  just steps away from the metro with easy access and easy transfers all over the city. 
Breakfast buffet has many options and is very tasty and satisfying .
The rooms are clean and comfortable. 
Drinks are available for free in your room refrigerator and restocked daily. In the afternoon the lobby has cakes and sweets and a comfortable area for sitting.  Drinks and coffee and tea are available for free all day in the lobby.
Staff was professional , friendly and helpful.

author: Aiden E
title: A safe bet.
text: Perfect, the involvement and kindness of the cleaning staff and at breakfast should be particularly praised.

author: Rosie M
title: Top Neighbourhood and Hotel
text:
Ideal location if you are going to see a play or show 
Very friendly staff, concept of soft drinks and snacks available free of charge 
The rooms are spacious and very clean
I highly recommend for a pleasant stay.....moreover, the neighborhood is very nice

author: Camille H
title: Nice hotel
text:
We stayed at Hotel Lorette - Astotel for 6 days.
The hotel is beautifully located close to many restaurants and the metro is just down the road.
Staff were all kind and helpful.
The breakfast buffet contained everything the heart could desire.
A really cozy hotel, which we will definitely return to.

author: Megan S
title: Stay in Paris
text:
Nice charming hotel that also offers a terrace/patio to relax and you can even take a bottle of wine. 

In itself it is pretty and at the reception there is a small lounge where we can fill our bottles with water or have a coffee and there is always a snack cake style. 

The rooms are super small but I know it’s like this in Paris! There was a lack of tablets in the bathroom and the space was problematic for us with the baby. We had written in advance to have extra towels that we did not have. Service at reception ok but no more. 

Breakfast buffet for 10 euros is worth it and the vault in which it is served is pretty!!

So in the end depending on the price it may be interesting but it remained expensive for the room space. 

Otherwise it remains well located with several restaurants nearby.

author: Amelia X
title: Perfect Hotel in Paris
text: Perfect location for the places we wanted to visit in Paris.  The staff were all very friendly and helpful.  Beds were very comfortable.  My husband and I were traveling with two other couples and we all had a great experience.  Breakfast was plentiful and delicious.  We recommend you stay here if you are in need of a hotel in Paris.

author: Evie S
title: Small hotel near Piazza Fiume.
text:
Chosen for the competitive price considering the number of stars and the location. 
On Via Piave, just steps from Piazza Fiume (Rinascente) and about a 10-minute walk from Piazza Barberini (nearest Metro). Quiet area with bars, restaurants, and supermarkets. 
The hotel is small and appears clean. The room is small but functional (despite the 40 degrees, I found it cool). A single elevator for the entire hotel, quite slow and always occupied. The breakfast room on the lower floor is small, with various sweet and savory choices, and fruit. The coffee is good! 
For the price paid, it was fine; perhaps if it had cost more, I would have considered other options as well.

author: Giulia I
title: Very small but comfortable single room
text:
Great location just steps from Rinascente. I booked a single room that honestly was really small but quite comfortable. I would say it was more similar to a nun's cell or the cabin of a ship. Single bed with a comfortable mattress. Cleaning was okay. Bathroom
nice but in the shower, there was no hot water (only slightly warm) and the drain did not work. In short, if it's just for one night, it's okay given the rates, but I would say that 3 stars would be more appropriate at least for this type of room.

author: Grace W
title: Three night stay.
text:
Double room overlooking the Main Street. Room very small and bathroom even smaller. No hot water in handbasin and plug did not work resulting In Water constantly draining out. The shower head kept dropping down.
Reported it at reception the next morning but nothing done about it. Air conditioning was set at 23 degrees! Far too hot in the room. When I asked if it could be altered we were informed that every room was the same.
On the last night, no hot water in shower. Reported it again only to be told no one else had reported it. Not helpful! Saw the person at the front desk constantly vaping!
Breakfast was good.
Great local restaurants all around the hotel.

author: Chloe M
title: Adequate hotel near Villa Borghese
text:
Single rooms are very small. Location is good if you are visiting Villa Borghese and it took me around 15 mins walk from Termini. Not a 4-star in my opinion, but a 2-3 star.
Pros: All staff I encountered were very helpful and friendly.
Breakfast was OK, but there was no freshly squeezed orange juice (surprising for a 4-star hotel?).
Nearby to some great eateries e.g. Ristorante Pizzeria Andrea (Via Castelfidardo), Le Virtù Molisane (Via Collina), YEZI (Asian restaurant).
You can walk to the main sights in around 20 - 30 mins. (Piazza Barberini, Trevi Fountain etc.)
Cons: Rome was 29 degs when I was there and the aircon in the room was very poor. I barely slept due to the heat and the mattress was too firm for me. 
Far away from Vatican city, but I got a 492 bus direct (took 30 mins) from Via XX Settembre - just tap your credit card (1.50 Euro single ticket).
I liked the area of this hotel, but I would not stay in this hotel again. I would find one with better air con and more comfortable beds.

author: Caleb M
title: This Property cannot be classified as a four star
text: This hotel was sold to us by Exotica  as a four star property. Rooms are very tiny, bathroom had a damp smell, property is very dated and really does not qualify as a four star property by international standards. Elevator is old and very slow.

author: Zoe I
title: Quiet and comfortable hotel with a quality vibe.
text: Lovely quiet hotel, well appointed and with friendly staff, about 12 minutes walk from the Roma Terminus. The quality belies the reasonable price. Great area off the tourist trail with lots of genuine and authentic restaurants in the vicinity. Wonderful and extensive breakfast menu!

author: Taylor K
title: Central location, reasonable choice
text: Central location.  Our room was small, but with a lovely view of the French Embassy gardens.  Staff was helpful.  Bus service directly across the street, but nearest Metro stop is 10-15 minutes walk.  Restaurant across the street was able to accommodate vegan member of our group on request.

author: Adam H
title: Overall a Great Experience
text:
Currently staying here on my first visit to Rome from Oxford, and overall it’s been a very positive experience. The staff and service have been excellent—friendly, attentive, and always willing to help.

The room is on the smaller side, which is understandable given the age and character of the building (something we’re used to in Oxford as well). Everything is very clean, and the in-room amenities are above average, making for a comfortable stay.

There was a very minor issue with a smell from the bidet in the room, but this was handled very well by the team. We were offered a different room, and when we chose to stay, they kindly offered a bottle of wine, which was a thoughtful gesture and resolved the situation nicely.

The location is fantastic for exploring the city, with key sights easily accessible. Breakfast is concise but good quality, and the host is particularly friendly—deserving of a special mention for his warm service.

The only slight downside has been the firmness of the mattress—it’s quite solid, which has affected sleep a little.

Overall, I’d still happily recommend this hotel for its excellent service, cleanliness, and great location.

author: Zachary I
title: Great location
text: The Hotel is well located, with a bus stop opposite to the train station. Traditional decor with fairly small rooms. The bed was pretty hard. Equipped with TV, safe, clothes rack instead of wardrobe, refrigerator, iron, hairdryer, coffee machine with kettle. The staff is friendly and helpful. Breakfast is complete but basic. Price a bit high.

author: Claire P
title: Situation and sympathy
text:
Great location with a very friendly and friendly team 
Special mention for breakfast

author: Olivia E
title: Great
text:
Spent a fantastic weekend in Rome, and the Gambrinus as great. Clean, very helpful staff.
You lose 1 star, as the beds were way to firm for my liking!!

author: Nora P
title: Italy
text: Great location, rooms where not big,,so a challenge with luggage,, old world charm.. bathroom was perfect.. lobby is small and offers a small gathering area,,, breakfast was excellent

author: Andrea Q
title: Bad experience at gambrinus hotel
text: We visited Rome on September 2025 with friends and our agent booked this hotel for us and I wanna say that everything was terrible. The service was bad. The food was bad. The room was dirty , the staff were so rude and mean and not helpful too.  I don’t recommend this hotel to no one and exotica they should know that when they book their hotels . No one from our group was happy with the hotel.

author: Sophia M
title: 2 night stay.
text: We had a 2 night stay here after a recent cruise. We were in room 114. Room wasn’t a bad size. Traditional decor. Bed was fairly hard. Shower room had decent shower. There was a coffee machine as well as a kettle. Tv safe hanging rail as opposed to wardrobe. Aircon worked ok. Staff were friendly and helpful. Breakfast was ok not great. The location of the hotel wasn’t bad and we found some nice restaurants in the neighbourhood.

author: Owen A
title: Small but cozy hotel
text:
I spent the weekend together with my partner.

We were very pleased with the welcome (within that they do not speak Spanish). Upon arrival, we checked In din ni gun priblema, I wentmod to the room; this was small but cozy, it was very clean.
It is true that it is an old hotel and that you could give a review to certain things in the room and bathroom, but our stay of 3 days (2 nights) was quite good.

The small but good breakfast buffet; not much variety but enough to be able to give a good tribute at breakfast

author: Chloe O
title: Lovely City Hotel
text: Lovely city hotel. All the reception team are brilliant, fluent English and understood my stab at Italian! My room was fairly small (but expected as a city hotel) but comfy, decent shower and a lovely bed. More than happy. Breakfast was tasty and included a mixed affair of sweet treats, juice, coffee, hot and cold breakfast items. Excellent. Raoul looked after us and what a Brilliant host. So attentive, polite and helpful. A warm and kind man that treats it like his home, making you welcome and feel at ease. All in all, an amazing stay. Close to Cafés and shops. Bus stop outside. About 15 minutes walk to the main Termini station and Metro. Trevi Fountain is near by too so it's a good location for a base to explore Rome. I would give a higher rating if it would let me. Thank you so much.

author: Isla O
title: Clean and convenient
text: Hotel Gambrinus is very well located, with a bus stop outside the door for buses going to and from the train station. Its about 20 minutes easy walk to the Spanish Steps or The gardens at Villa Borghesse. Overall the decor is a bit tired but very clean and the room a good size. The window view was horrible, into a light well with four walls of buildings, it did mean the room was quiet but also very dark. The breakfast buffet was average but the front of house host in the breakfast room was very welcoming and helpful.

author: Jessica T
title: The 4 stars must be earned
text: I stayed 4 days at the gambrinus 4 star fake hotel. They assign us a tiny room so we don't know where to put our bags. Room with windows in the room overlooking a dilapidated blind courtyard in fact we kept the window closed for all days of stay. Not to mention the minimal bathroom shower that made water from all sides without a window and without a vacuum cleaner.  Cleaning lady very distracted in replacing water in the fridge toilet paper and glasses. Finally, an air conditioner that always threw cold air without the possibility of turning it off in the direction of the bed, bathroom doors destroyed. What about I paid for 4 star hotel I enjoyed a poor 3 star. Never again

author: Oliver M
title: Great stay for our first city break
text: Check in was a breeze. Rooms are small but well equipped with a safe fridge iron hair dryer plus large bodywash toiletries. Beds are so comfy. TV a bit low but not in Rome for the tele. All kept very clean. The buffet breakfast small but sufficient, choices of drinks coffees juices, yoghurt fruit and pastries plus scrambled egg and boiled egg, cooked ham cheese plus more. Raul the breakfast person is so cheery and such a delight, a treasure for the hotel and best member of staff, deserves a raise. All staff were helpful. I would stay here again.i will add its worth the breakfast option even if you just want a few coffees. You also get 1 bottle of water each for your first day then the supermarket is a few doors down if you have not found your fountains to refill. We were in room 418 only slight thing was the material on the wall was different under the table and a few sockets around the hotel look too need fixing better to the walls. Showers are amazing though.

author: Freya U
title: Trolleys obstructing passage and reservation paid that did not appear.
text:
The bed was comfortable. The hotel is clean. They put coffee and tea makers in the room, and change towels daily. They also put swags and a small complimentary needer. 
Breakfast would be nicer if I hadn’t had to wake up several times to get stuff...in different rooms. 
The elevator is unhelpful for slow and unique for so many floors and rooms. 
Room space was minimal. I know there were good rooms, but I got one with a window to a small, dark courtyard. The room had no wardrobe, only shelves and hangers. Reception gadgets occupied the top of the little table, so there was no room to put a bag. 
The very hard door to open and bumped into the chair. 
Shower, almost triangular. 
But really what bothered me the most is that I had been accused of not making a reservation, almost threatening that there was nowhere to sleep, when I had already made the payment, and the mistake was yours. 
It was also not right that, having warned them that they could not leave the laundry carts in the hallway, as there was hardly any room to pass, they continued to leave them every day. Passing with suitcases or mobility problems was impossible. 
I thank Mr. Giuseppe for all the times he had to call us the taxi.
Overall I think they were unsympathetic and, of course, I would not return to this hotel or another that managed my booking so badly.

author: Juan A
title: Hotel Ripa in Trastavere
text: Avoid room 213. Old carpet and decor. Mould in the bathroom.  Bath with curtain around it for a shower. Shower pressure excellent though. Bottled water only provided for the first day for some reason, not refreshed at all during our 3 nights.  Sockets on the bedside and around the room don’t work with usual adapters, we shorted the electric trying to use one. The socket used for the TV and fridge were the only ones which could be used with adapter.  Staff friendly. Location handy, Breakast good, amazing fresh melon every day. Restaurants of Trastavere within 10-15 mins walk and easy 45 mins walk to the Colosseum / historic centre. Bus to Vatican & train station from the main road, a 5 mins walk walk from the hotel

author: James H
title: Trastevere gem
text: Location is superb very close to buses are regular taking you into centre of Rome , 20 minutes walk to train station, ideal for train to Fumicino airport direct route, also close to centre of Trastevere and its sights and many restaurants and bars. Staff at hotel couldn't be more helpful, and always very pleasant and helpful. Hotel is a bit quirky with the random statues about hotel. Our room was fine very spacious, and a good shower, breakfast was good a good start to the day and the air conditioning was a blessing. On whole a excellent experience.

author: David C
title: Good hotel in need of improvements
text:
The hotel in general is fine, but the beds are a disaster, full of lumps, they need to be changed...the rooms are spacious but old, the breakfast is good, they have variety, the staff is good too.
It is a 4-star hotel in Rome, here it would be a 3-star, the decor is innovative and striking and it catches your eye from the outside, it has a mini gym but the beds are a disaster.

author: Laura Y
title: Ugly, bad, noisy hotel!
text:
- Crazy hotel (grim decor, strange kitschy statues and nasty sofas)
- Very noisy (read; poorly isolated).
- Old worn rooms (dirty and worn carpets, old air conditioning luminaries, small indifferent cabinets with no space, poor lighting and the difference on all lamps - everything is SO ugly!
- No matter little balcony with ugly views.
- the cleaning of the rooms is mediocre.
- ELENDIG breakfast buffet - there's SO much noise from high pop music and kids riding around. The light reminds more of entering a crazy bar. The food is dull, cold, the eggs are wet and clam.
- Service at the disc is poor and arrogant. Their key system is a really bad idea and when you finally place your key they are completely indifferent and let it lie on the disk (anyone could easily grab it).

This can be done better!

author: Gavin Y
title: Top location
text: Lovely quirky looking hotel. Room was nicely decorated with air conditioning. The Safe in the room was free.  Free wifi throughout. Restaurant was amazing, we were half board and had fantastic 3 course meal every night. Breakfast was quite basic but sonething for everyone. Location is perfect, withing walking distance to all the main attractions.

author: Megan O
title: Nice hotel but it needs renovation in the rooms and bathrooms.
text: Beautiful hotel. Too bad the mattress was old and sagging. The lights in the bathroom are so dim that you can't put on makeup, but the terrible thing was the unbearable smell of sewage.

author: Ryan X
title: Weekend Break - ideal stay
text: Great hotel with the ideal location for exploring. Stayed here for a weekend and the staff were great. Everyone from the reception, catering to the bar staff were really friendly and accommodating. We had a leak in our room which was sorted really quickly and we were moved to another room. Everyone was very efficient at helping us. The breakfast selection was plentiful and  fresh.

author: Charlotte I
title: In the living room..
text:
Fantastic location and very spacious room. The staff is very kind, the hotel has a nice design, and the breakfast is plentiful. 

One note to make: the bathroom is not very large, the tub does not have a shower stall but a curtain, which in my opinion is not very hygienic. Furthermore, it was a bit dim and could use a refresh.

author: Owen Y
title: Could have been a 5 but for ……
text: Having previously stayed in the Pigneto district, I was very pleased with the location of this hotel. Yes, there is a lot of walking to the centre but this is actually what we wanted, although twice we caught the bus from around the corner! The hotel itself is lovely, clean, friendly staff, good value for money. The soundproofing is adequate, we could still hear people in the corridor but nothing more than I would have expected in a hotel. The room was lovely, nothing particularly special but a good size and had a very clean carpet! There was a mini fridge in our room but it was pretty full with very overpriced snacks and drinks and given the time of year, we would have preferred to keep more water in there than there was room for. Breakfast was part of our booking, there was plenty of choice, perfectly adequate to start the day, plenty of seats although it did get noisy when filler. The only downside to this place, and it’s not going to affect your stay, was the evening dining experience. On one evening, we had walked for miles and just couldn’t face going out again for dinner, so we tried the restaurant. You get a 10% off coupon when checking in but it’s not worth it. The meal size was fine for us both but the quality did not meet the cost. My chicken bites & chips was served in a bowl with 4 slabs of chicken on top of crisps essentially, with paper at the bottom that got soggy, ripped and I ended up pulling bits out of my mouth. The chicken had no real flavour and the chips were disks, so lost their filling in the cooking process. Husband had pasta, tasty but nothing special. We each had one drink and the total came to over 40€ with the 10% off, so nearer 50€. I left at minimum 2 thirds of the meal although husband ate all of his. We still left a tip though as service was fantastic, can’t fault the staff for the hotels decisions or pricing! Overall, if we hadn’t eaten at the restaurant, I would have given this place a 5.

author: Mia R
title: Bad hotel
text: The hotel is old worn disgusting carpeting in the rooms would not take shoes off .cleaning bad ,breakfast dining room was like sitting in a school canteen where everything echoed .bad breakfast. Someone in the staff stole money from their wallets every day disappeared ,my daughter lost 3500 SEK my husband lost 1500 SEK I lost taxi money I put away .we filed a police report and they said that it was common in this hotel another couple had been and filed a report before us .the same day,the police had requested to see the cameras but they were broken so fittingly we do not recommend this hotel absolutely nothing four star Max 1.

author: Daniel A
title: Ideal for a short vacation in Rome.
text: Modern hotel with good breakfast and restaurant. Clean and good service. Parking available in the underground garage in the building. Well located for excursions to the city center. Tram 3 towards the Colosseum, Tram 8 towards Piazza Venezia, or Bus 115 towards the Vatican and Via Paola just a few meters from the building.

author: Morgan R
title: Disappointing
text:
Unfortunately, more than a hotel, it can be defined as a motel 
Very rundown rooms, the bathrooms are really cramped, the bathtub is horrible, full of breaks, and there is a strong odor that can be perceived as soon as you enter the room. 
High prices for this type of establishment 
The only strong point is the breakfast; everything else needs to be redone.

author: Brooke B
title: Stay and wellness.
text:
I stayed at the Hotel Ripa Roma and was truly satisfied in every aspect. The structure is beautiful, modern, welcoming, and very comfortable, ideal for those seeking relaxation and quality during their stay.
The staff stands out for their great professionalism, friendliness, and availability: always participative, collaborative, and ready to meet every customer need with attention and kindness. One can clearly perceive the care for the well-being of guests and the desire to offer a pleasant and impeccable experience.
I highly recommend this hotel to anyone seeking comfort, elegance, and high-level service in the heart of Rome.

author: Harry W
title: Spacious, clean, friendly and quiet
text:
I had everything I could hope of the hotel. Spacious rooms, very good breakfast, friendly people everywhere, no sulking faces.
Good restaurant, luscious happy hour. Warm shower, suitably cool air. 1  km to city and trams and buses and restaurants nearby. Thankyou!

author: Jack S
title: Disappointed
text:
Very nice hotel, the superior room was very large, but unfortunately the bathroom was a bit small and the shower was open on one side, which risked flooding the room. 
Unfortunately, I did not sleep well; the mattress was not a double but two singles, and there was an extremely annoying background noise all night long. 
The breakfast was not abundant; the slices of bacon were all stuck together and the eggs were cold.
At one point, the croissants ran out; in general, it was too expensive for a 4-star hotel that did not have the qualities of a 4-star establishment.

author: Jack N
title: Very disappointing experience and security problems
text:
We had a very disappointing and concerning experience at this hotel.

During our stay, money was repeatedly taken from our room in three separate incidents: €20 from the desk, €50 from inside a wallet, and €5 from inside a suitcase (which we intentionally left as a test). The pattern clearly indicates unauthorized access to the room, most likely during housekeeping. We reported the issue to the management, contacted the police, and filed an official complaint.

Despite the seriousness of the situation, the hotel’s response was inadequate. They merely offered to waive €77 of minibar/consumption charges and stated that they would investigate further in cooperation with the police before considering any additional compensation. This approach in no way reflects the extent of the distress, disruption, and loss of security we experienced during our stay.

Beyond the security issue, the room itself was not at all as advertised. The furniture was very old (at least 20 years) and visibly worn, and the carpets were stained and dirty. This was far from the standard shown in the online photos.

Overall, this was not just a matter of comfort, but of trust and safety. We expected a basic level of security and accuracy in what was offered, and unfortunately, both were lacking.

We hope the management takes full responsibility and takes immediate corrective actions.

author: Mia D
title: Adequate but has reservations.
text: This is situated in the Trastevere area of Rome, same side of the river as the Vatican but not other  destinations.  There are no  Metro or  City tour bus  stations nearby, so its either  a tram, local bus or 30 minute walk before you start. Not a bad area to base if you don't mind the start. There are so many great street restaurants all within 15-25 minutes walk. It is close to the Jewish Quarter which also has some unusul restaurants. The hotel has a 'modern' look. Not to everyone's tast. Bar and restaurant areas are good. Breakfast is  good but like many europen hotles that cater for numbers, this also have only two coffee machines  handling over 60 at any sitting!! The cooked breakfast is limited but there is abundance of cereal, fruit, hams, cheeses and pastries as usual. The room we hd were  not efficienlty laid out withthe bed  in the centre of the room with a flat surface topped headboard with an asortment of switches-which are  awkward to to use from a laying down position. The matress and pillows are ok. There are no bedside tables, no drawers or real wardrobes, only hanging rails and open shelves.  The shape of the room, as the breakfast room have curves, awkward and dodgy walking areas with lips etc all to catch your footing. The bedroom has a slope runing uo to the bthroom/shower. This had a 30mm step into which had a hard edge, another  accident waiting to happen, The toilret roll was behind the  sitting position so just impracticle to access. The room was dark with a very large mirror which was poorly lit so no good for makeup etc.  Great shower. The bedroom had a work top at the  far end of the room  from the bottom of the bed position. This had a TV and fridge unit. The sockets were  on the back of this so one has to reach over and try and locate. These were on a built in strip, slighlty recessed so adaptors could not be plugged in.  We had to request an extension lead with several sockets. (phone charging, tongs etc.) Air con worked well and there was a small balcony area with tabel and chairs  on the outside terrace. Views were not worth the effort, but nonetheless good for an early evening aperative or breakfast cuppa. (No milk whatsoever-so you would need to purchase some from a locla store and keep in the fridge) As I said, the layout of the room  was not conventional and not over comfortable. The room wa slight but no mirrors in the main room for make-up, contact lens etc.  The hotel has parking, but what is not informed is that it is managed by a separate company, has limited acess times at weekends and a daily charge.

author: Tyler B
title: Very good stay
text:
We had a family room, it was very good, with 2 bedrooms and 1 PS4, my son enjoyed it. 
At the reception everyone was very nice. 
It is very well located very close to the Trastevere restaurant area but far enough to rest well.

author: Thomas K
title: Always happy!
text: Good hotel in a good location. All within easy reach by bus or on foot. The breakfast was adequate and offered a good start to the day. The rooms were very clean and very spacious (we had the easiest variant). The towels were freshly changed every day and the beds made. We would definitely come back and recommend the place.

author: Julien O
title: We had a good time
text:
Good location to reach the center on foot
Very nice and helpful staff good and varied breakfast

author: Elena U
title: Clean and well located
text:
We stayed there at the third floor in the room with the balcony. Hotel was clean,  the breakfast was fine and staff was friendly. Hotel is finely decorated, with mythological figures which we really liked. We would have liked it more if it had a bigger bathroom :)  
Still the view and its location to historical places make us forget that. We stayed there without any problems.

author: Lucia Z
title: Good value
text: Needed a last minute room, and Hotel Almalfi has everything I was looking for close to Termini, quiet and at a fair price. The room was quirky with painted ceilings, and very comfortable. Would recommend for people looking to stay near the train station and colosseum

author: William C
title: Wonderful "Apartment" Suite at Hotel Amalfi in Rome
text: We stayed as a family at this great little hotel across from the Basilica de Santa Maria Maggiore.  We rented the 3-bedroom apartment with 1.5 baths, a true kitchen, and 1.5 baths located in a building a few doors down from the main hotel (still managed by the hotel with maid service etc.).  It was fantastic.  Very recently modernized with nice lighting, a true kitchen with dishwasher, full-sized oven and refrigerator/freezer, microwave and coffee maker.  The rooms were very nice; very cool rain shower with multiple heads.  It is a full-on apartment that can handle a large family with sleeping for at least 6 out into 3 bedrooms that can be set up as two singles or a double (queen sized).  Very accommodating front desk.  Views out onto the square with the Basilica and monument right in front of you.  Nice window treatments and bedding.  A small lift takes you up front the impressive front door to which you are given a code, to your very secure unit on the top floor.  Loved it, were sad to leave and have to go check into smaller rooms on the next leg of our tip.  Would stay again when back in Rome if I was with a group and did not want to separate out into individual hotel rooms.

author: Maria B
title: Great 3 star hotel
text:
We normally book 4/5 star hotel so we booked this hotel due to good reviews and a reasonable price.
Check-in went smoothly and the staff were.
We were on the third floor and the stairs can be steep but there is a lift a very tiny one.
We booked breakfast and offered gluten free. 
We walked everywhere. 
We also booked a late checkout as we did a parkrun before we did a last tour of Rome and it was great to check out at 3.
The room was small but very clean and there was no trouble heating. 
Highly recommend the hotel

author: Erin L
title: Good location, nice hotel.
text: We enjoyed our stay! Beds were comfy and the room and bathroom were very clean. Breakfast was also good with lots of meats, cheese, yogurt, pastries, eggs, hot drinks, cold drinks, cereal, etc. Could hear noise outside and when people were walking around the hotel, but were able to sleep through it! About a 20 min walk from the coloseum and an hour walk from vatican city so pretty close to what you would want to see

author: Louis N
title: Great choice! Hotel recommended!
text: A small hotel very nice in the center, not far from Roma Termini and Santa Maria Maggiore. Rooms are small, clean, all with pinto ceiling. The breakfast room is particularly nice. Very kind staff, always ready to help. Great breakfast buffet.

author: Miguel N
title: Excellent experience
text: I was very happy with my week-long stay. The staff were great: friendly and helpful in every way. The location was convenient and within walking distance of visitor attractions, restaurants, shops, and the train station. The excellent breakfasts had variety and were well-prepared. The room was clean and comfortable and perfectly adequate for all my needs. I particularly enjoyed the roof terrace. Many thanks to Hotel Amalfi, especially the staff, for helping make my trip to Rome so satisfying.

author: Isla G
title: Stay in Rome
text: Great location for this hotel in a good area for you to see all of Romes major attractions. But as far as the building, it is tiny. The rooms are crammed together and the showers are almost inaccessible. Clean building with nice art on the ceilings but I highly recommend saving money to stay somewhere with more space. Maybe I’d recommend for a solo traveler, not for a family stay. The breakfast wasn’t great and there is no food offered beyond that.

author: Sophia J
title: A pleasure to have stayed here
text:
Booked online with no issues for a 3 night stay. Able to select street room with great view.
Short walk from Termini rail station and bus drop off points. Great walking routes to all the best attractions that Rome can offer. Good area for foods of all types. Close the windows and very little city noise disturbs the sleep, also in december able to control heating and ventilation. Breakfasts to suit most tastes   at self service buffet, though a chef standing by for any special requirements. 
Lovely clean hotel and rooms with fresco type wall and ceiling paintings to make you feel you're in a roman room rather than any faceless brand hotel that could be in any city in the world. 
Would I  come back?  Too right I will...looking forward to wedding anniversary december 2026
Shaun Conroy

author: Anna A
title: Roman holidays
text:
Very nice and clean hotel. Practically in front of the Papal Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore.
Breakfast very rich and delicious.
Very kind staff!
Clean rooms!
Stay from 10!

author: Poppy H
title: Nice hotel, small lift.
text:
Located 10mins walk from the train station, the hotel is located on a main road not far from Pope Francis's last resting place.
Whilst the hotel is clean and comfy, the breakfast is both hot and cold, the room where it is served is small and recommended to book a table to ensure you can get in.
There is a lift, however it is very small, can only accommodate  1 adult and 1 suitcase or 2 adults. 
Staff were friendly and helped with any queries we had.

author: Alexander T
title: Excellent hotel.
text:
This hotel was recommended as clean and adequate for a base for a tourist in Rome. This does not do it justice. Our room was small but with adequate space. The bed was king size and very comfortable with quality linen and as someone with joint problems I must mention the comfortable pillows. The staff were friendly, professional and very helpful. Breakfast was good each morning for only 8 euros.
This hotel is next to S. Maria Maggiore and only  twenty minute walk from the Colosseum. It is near bus stops to travel around Rome and any taxis we requested were always at the hotel within five minutes.

author: Molly D
title: What a lovely hotel
text: We stayed at the hotel Amalfi for four days at the end of September. The location is excellent very close to all types of transportation and sightseeing. The hotel staff were friendly and helpful. They made us feel like family. The breakfast we had every day was excellent. The staff work hard to ensure you are happy. Our room was not next to the busy road and therefore was quiet. The rooms were clean. The beds were comfortable, and I can’t say enough about this place. I would definitely return.

author: Maria E
title: Great located hotel
text: Great hotel with a great location easy access to the train station & hop on hop off buses. Lots of restaurants near by. The hotel was clean & tidy, staff friendly & helpful, our room was clean & comfortable as was the bed, bathroom had shampoo & shower gel, a lovely roof garden to sit & enjoy a drink there is traffic noise but that’s the price for being central. I would stay here again if we went back to Rome.

author: Owen D
title: Great stay. Very kind and thoughtful staff.
text:
Perfect location for sight seeing.  Rooms spotlessly clean, bed totally comfortable and breakfast delicious.
A slight glitch when we first got there was instantly resolved by the genuinely kind and reassuring staff, for whom nothing appeared too much trouble.
Thank you for everything!

author: Daisy S
title: Boutique Rome Hotel
text: This hotel was very charming and has a great location. It’s only around a mile or so to the colosseum and surrounded by great restaurants and coffee shops. They have a cute little rooftop to hang out in as well as a little lounge on the first floor. The hotel attendant that was there during our stay, Julia, was extremely kind and accommodating.

author: William C
title: Great stay in
text:
Great Welcoming, clean and tidy rooms, hearty breakfast and very good. 
Fabulous location.
Exceptional staff.

author: Jack M
title: Great location, friendly staff and beautiful room!
text: We only stayed one night at this fabulous hotel centrally located to all the major sites.. Our room was fantastic with starched sheets and super clean bathroom. The furnishings were top-notch and everyone could not have been more helpful and friendly. I will recommend this hotel to anyone who comes to Rome for a Wonderful experience.

author: Dylan L
title: Family trip
text: We had an amazing stay at the Hotel. Reception staff members was so nice and welcoming. Site seen nearby the Hotel was so beautiful and Recommendable. Nice place to stay with family.

author: Marta C
title: Fourth Time… and Still Feels Like Home
text:
Back in Rome, back in our favorite hotel — Hotel Amalfi.
How I love this place! :)))
I absolutely adore the warm, family-run atmosphere, the beautiful view from the balcony overlooking the Basilica, the delicious breakfasts, the amazing coffee, and the fresh cornetti.

Yes, the rooms are small, and the bathroom is tiny — but that’s exactly the style I love in Rome.
And this year, they surprised us with something new — they opened a rooftop terrace/garden where you can sit, enjoy a drink, watch the rooftops of Rome, and spend a lovely time.
What a fantastic idea and a truly charming place!

Everything else remains at the same high level as always — cleanliness, service, and communication.
As the owner once said: "It feels like home here." And it really does.

I’ve already written three reviews about this hotel in the past, so this time I’ll just confirm once again: it’s absolutely worth coming back here.

author: Amelia X
title: Good Quality Hotel
text:
We arrived in the early hours so the hotel was locked, but we were met in no time by the night staff.

On letting us in, he went through the details, rooms, breakfast, check out times and taxes for the stay.

Our room was huge, single beds but oversized so perfect for us both.

A good location, 5 minutes from the train station, bus terminal, trams and open. Us tours. A 25 minute walk from all the main historical attractions.

The breakfast is continental, but everything was good quality and tasty.

I would definitely stop here again

author: Brooke E
title: When I return to Rome, this will be my hotel.
text:
Very positive experience.
Kind staff, willing to resolve any problems.

author: Brooke R
title: Excellent location
text: Excellent location close to the station

author: Alice F
title: A positive two-night experience! Friendly and Helpful Personnel! Reasonable price.
text: A positive two-night experience! From Fabrizio the porter, who deftly handled our eight bags to the front desk clerks (Maddalena, who spoke perfect English, and Maurizio, who ordered us a private car when we learned of a taxi strike and needed to get to the airport) to Carmine, the friendly and efficient waiter in the adjacent restaurant, we were very pleased with the personnel. Our room was more than adequate for the price (clean, comfortable, air conditioned, with a small refrigerator and safe for our valuables). We enjoyed the location near Stazione Termini and a short (half-hour) walk to the Centro Storico (Fori Romani). I have stayed here before, but this was the first time for my wife. She was as pleased as I was.

author: Amelia J
title: Located in a convenient place
text: Located in a very convenient place close to the Roma Termini station. Colosseum, Roman theater and many other attractions are located very close to this hotel. My room was small one with a double bed. Breakfast was good though limited menu. Staffs were friendly. Many restaurants are located nearby. Parking is difficult to find.

author: George V
title: Better than expected
text: Stayed for one night prior to flying home --- short , straight walk from Rome Termini, to me a large hotel compared to what we were used to staying at in Italy ( 2 proper elevators :)) , it has an "old world" look  and room definitely not brand new but everything clean and in proper order. In my opinion the breakfast was typical to what we encountered in other hotels in Italy- eggs, meat, pastries, cornettos, meat/cheese.  We didn't stay out late, so can't comment on neighborhoodl after 9pm, but before then was fine, plenty of restaurants nearby.

author: Noah L
title: Definitely worth it
text:
Excellent hotel.  Very friendly staff
Very good beds.  Full breakfast every morning.
We dined once in the restaurant: the food is good.
Right in the center. Near the train station, metro and buses.

author: Sean X
title: Good location
text:
On this trip we wanted a hotel reasonably close to the main station,  this fitted the bill.
A very short walking distance and easy to find. Excellent quality accommodation and friendly, helpful desk staff. A traditional hotel, and in good order. Location was stone throw from the Metro so easy to navigate. 
Only one, and only one, criticism was that breakfast presentation and content was dull,  limited choice- compared to others on this trip.
Would book again for location, quality and price.

author: Brooke S
title: A secure base for our touring.
text:
Very enjoyable stay in Rome,used the railway station fifty metres away  to travel to Ostia Antica
Staff at hotel very present and engaged with their work  Very comfortable sufficiently spacious double room
I regret did not use restaurant as it had substantive menu not all fish or not all,pasta like outside We had booked breakfast in buffet lounge

author: Luke V
title: Great staff, reviewable breakfast
text: Good, well connected to Termini station and close to the center of my interests. To improve the breakfast. Excellent staff. Mrs. Jasmine from the third floor in particular. He chased me to give me back the phone charger I forgot

author: Amelia W
title: Misadventures of an invalid
text: I had the pleasure of sleeping one night in this hotel, wonderful welcome and so helpful towards me in helping me find a room suitable for my health problems. I wanted to thank the staff for the kindness shown to me by most of the staff.... but now I would like to explain my vote given what I wrote previously. I'm sorry only for a note out of tune... I'm disabled and I walk with the help of a walker, to go for breakfast in the prepared room there are stairs, otherwise the alternative is to go out and go around a facade of the building... while on the way I found the availability of the person at the reception in helping me by lifting the walker to be able to overcome the obstacle, when I finished breakfast, I expected from the staff a help and I asked a waiter if he could please help me go down the stairs (5 steps), but to my surprise I was escorted to the door, despite it was raining outside, invited to go out and go around the building and then return to the living room. I must say that such behavior really surprised me and I was disappointed, given the reception previously had by the rest of the staff.

author: Ella L
title: Comfortable and elegant hotel just steps from the station.
text:
A stone's throw from Termini station and half an hour's walk from Via dei Fori, an elegant hotel at the beginning of the Monti district with numerous restaurants of various types nearby.
Comfortable and clean. Very basic breakfast with more 3 than 4 star products but acceptable to me.

author: Daisy N
title: Good solution for stays near the station and within walking distance of the center.
text: Very large hotel in an elegant historic building a stone's throw from Termini station. Very friendly staff both at reception and in the breakfast room. The allocated room was comfortable, although the soundproofing was not optimal and the Internet connection took little.  Breakfast buffet very good.

author: Owen A
title: 4 star staff L
text: Surely the "pluses" of this hotel are the location (a few steps from Termini station) and the staff all above average please... The hotel clearly has some "age problem" but absolutely compensated by the helpful staff. In a particular way our experience was marked by a small hitch resolved with courtesy and speed by the staff who also made us a tribute to apologize... really appreciable.

author: Rosie K
title: Great Hotel!!
text:
I love this hotel.
I stayed several times and the experience was always unbeatable.
Close to the Termini and all transport options. Nice and comfortable rooms. Friendly and willing staff.
Good breakfast!
And excellent rate, whenever you want to go to Rome.
For everyone who complains: there are more expensive hotels, next time try out there and maybe put the caviar in breakfast.
This hotel has an impeccable value for money!!

author: Sydney P
title: Great hotel. Highly recommend
text:
Hotel was very nice, clean, very helpful and friendly staff. Located steps away from the train station and subway.  Lots and lots of restaurants within walking distance. Within a tourist area but doesn't feel like it. Security on the door. 
Breakfast is pentiful and delicous. Complimentry wine and water in the room. Room was spacious for Italy. Beds comfortable. Highly recommend. Would give 4.5 stars if I could.

author: Molly C
title: Inferior and Sickening
text: Unfriendly staff, the rooms are dusty full of mites there was an insecticide used daily I got sick on my way home. The equipment inferior. The courtyard-facing rooms are noisy from the kitchen vent. Breakfast miserable. Rip-off is probably their goal. Never again.

author: Molly S
title: Good solution
text: A good hotel near the station. Too bad it is not a very safe neighborhood even though it is practically in the center. Breakfast not great but complete. Rooms not modern but clean and very comfortable. Prefer the internal rooms so as not to be disturbed at night by traffic. Otherwise very courteous and welcoming staff. Decent restaurant but with a bit high prices. For those who need to have the station nearby it is a good choice

author: Elena S
title: Roman Holiday Hotel
text:
Very nice hotel in a good location.  Our room was spacious and clean. The thermostat worked well and kept the room comfortably cool in the hot summer weather. The bed was very comfortable.  The hotel staff was very friendly and helpful in answering questions.  Breakfast was included in our stay and the buffet was very well appointed with a lot of options. 
The only negative that we had was with the shower in our bathroom.  Unfortunately, the bathtub had an odd layout which had the overhead shower head located at the end of the bathtub (as is normally found), however, the bath faucet stuck straight out from the side of the tub. My wife ended up with a large bruise on her leg after hitting the faucet trying to rinse herself off under the shower head. Just a word of warning to be careful!
We would have no hesitation in staying here again if we visited Rome.

author: Lily V
title: To stay and go for a walk
text: Very busy hotel. Huge living room, comfortable. It has a conference room. Full breakfast, gentle waiters and very well organized, attentive

author: Amelia K
title: A warm and wonderful place to stay
text: We had a wonderful experience staying at Hotel Hiberia. The staff were so friendly and helpful, always greeting us and making sure we had everything we need. We felt very warmly welcomed as their guests. We had an unfortunate issue with the third party we booked our rooms through (reminder it’s always safest to book direct!) and the hotel was so kind and helpful in working to resolve the issue, following up, making sure we were not stressed about us, and assuring us everything would be resolved and taken care of. It was so helpful to have them take care of us so kindly. The location of the hotel was perfect for walking everything we wanted to go. We saw everything and got helpful advice from the front desk of the hotel. I highly recommend this hotel

author: Megan N
title: Excellent Location and Outstanding Service in Rome
text:
We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Hiberia. The location is excellent—within easy walking distance of many of Rome’s major attractions, making it a perfect base for sightseeing.

The customer service was outstanding. The staff was always friendly, welcoming, and eager to help. They assisted us with arranging transportation, which made our trip much easier and stress-free.

Our room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained throughout our stay. We truly appreciated the combination of a central location, attentive service, and comfortable accommodations. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend Hotel Hiberia to anyone visiting Rome.

author: Paige G
title: Okay for a very short stay.
text: Well-located hotel. Very good service from the employees. Good breakfast at the restaurant adjacent to the hotel. The rooms are quite spacious; however, the bed and pillows are very hard. Access to the rooms is via an old elevator that must date back to the early century. Many landings, narrow corridors. I will not return despite the very good service from the employees, which unfortunately does not compensate for the lack of comfort for the price paid.

author: Julien S
title: Excellent location in the historic center of Rome
text: Hotel very well located a few minutes walk to the Trevi Fountain and other attractions in the historic center. The room very clean and quiet. The highlight for the check in fast, efficient and with Marco and Raphaelo very kind, being that Marco speaks Portuguese well. Very pleasant experience.

author: Marta V
title: An ok experience
text:
Stayed at this hotel as part of a 4 day trip to Rome and overall we were content.

The staff at the hotel were friendly and helpful, all speaking excellent English. The communications received before our stay were good too, arranging a transfer from the airport for us that got us to the hotel from Ciampino airport in around half an hour.  We were able to check in and access our room and hour earlier than the normal check in time which was good.

Our room was a “Double Classic”, not the smallest they offer, but it was still pretty small with limited storage for our things. We were around the side of the hotel though, so it was relatively quiet apart from some noisy neighbours above us on the last night who were talking loudly and moving furniture loudly at midnight, and then again at 5.30am. We didn’t use the minibar, but prices were reasonable. A kettle and some tea/coffee were provided but no milk/whitener. There were a few toiletries offered in the bathroom. I didn’t really feel it was value for money to be honest, compared to other big cities we had been to.

Breakfast was taken in the attached Restaurant Petrucci and we had no complaints about that, it was well presented and good quality, a range of items that set you up for the day.
 
We did eat in the restaurant one evening and whilst the food was really good, the service was very lacking. It took ten minutes before we were offered a menu after being seated and getting the bill and paying took an age. The staff were very busy, presumably there wasn’t enough of them. We ate out other evenings and there are plenty of places within 5/10 minutes’ walk.

We used the small hotel bar a couple of times, but it was stuck at the rear of the building with limited seating and was not staffed so you had to ask at reception for them to come and serve you. Prices were good value. It was disappointing to sit there one early evening though as the cleaner decided to vacuum up around us – quite an unpleasant experience.

The location is good, just away from the main sights but handy for the Forum, Colosseum, Termini Station and no more than 10 minutes or so walk to the Trevi Fountain and then onto the Pantheon and Piazza Navona area. The hotel is on a steep hill though, and you had to walk back up it to get to it at the end of each day from whichever direction you'd been so be warned.

Would we stay here again? Probably not to be honest. The staff were lovely, but it just didn’t tick enough boxes for us and I suspect there are better value and slightly better locations available with hotels with better communal areas where you could go to to relax at the end of a busy, tiring day in the area.

author: Hannah G
title: Great Hotel and Staff
text: Our first time in Rome and Hotel Hiberia did not disappoint! We arrived earlier than our check in time. Staff stored our luggage so we could go get something to eat. When we returned our room was ready and our luggage was in our rooms.From the awesome welcome we received to the fantastic room service we will stay here again in the future. They give you a map of the city when you arrive. It was so helpful getting around Rome. Everything was within walking distance of the hotel.
