author: Claire K
title: Absolutely perfect hotel
text: The hotel Hiberia is perfect in every way for a city break in Rome. It's in an excellent location, only 6 minutes from Trevi fountain and within walking distance of all the main sights. The rooms are very clean, comfortable and the staff are brilliant. Rafael and Marco are just so friendly, helpful and informative, as are all the staff. Breakfast in the adjoining restaurant was perfect for an adequate meal before a day out.

author: Emma V
title: Surprise at 3*
text: Pleasant discovery in an area never made of Rome. To visit the exhibition The Treasures of the Pharaohs we chose this hotel 2' walk, Quirinale area. Super nice staff, helpful and prepared. Patrick and Raffaele allowed us to make a late check out (obviously applying the ritual surplus) and were always attentive to our requests. I don't know if we were lucky, but our triple room overlooked an inner courtyard, so no noise, and even during the night noises of slamming doors or people entertaining in the hallway! In room 420 quality dwl excellent sleep! And then for those who love walking you can reach in a short time the Trajan column, steps of Trinità de'Monti, the Quirinale a few steps and the Rione Monti with its typical trattorias. Highly recommended for those who want to be in the center of Rome.

author: Manon Z
title: Great hotel
text: Fantastic hotel! Very well located and with fabulous staff! Marco and the colleagues are good people and very helpful!

author: Maria T
title: Fantastic experience!
text: The hotel is super well located, right in the heart of Rome. Everything is done on foot. The space is great and welcoming and the whole staff is simply wonderful! Very good restaurant too. I emphasize the professionalism and affection of Marco. I take him as a friend and whenever I return to Rome, it's here I'll stay. Thank you all.

author: Holly Q
title: Pretty good.
text: Very good location, and very good service. All right.

author: Ella X
title: Very nice stay at the hotel hiberia
text: Stay of 4 nights at the hiberia hotel, everything was perfect: l welcome cleanliness the geographical location near all the monuments to visit. Excellent breakfast in the restaurant of the Petrucci hotel, and the evening meal was excellent (local cuisine and very good value for money).

author: Lea M
title: Great location, hosts and value .
text:
Fantastic location central to most attractions.
Excellent breakfast and resturant.
Rooms Traditional with tea ,coffe and fridge, spotless clean and cleand  every day. We stayed  a week on our 2nd visit.
The hosts are very friendly, helpful and professional.

author: Paolo T
title: A fantastic hotel in a most amazing location. All you could need and more.
text: If you are looking for a hotel that is as central to everything in the city as possible, then this is it. If you are looking for a comfortable place to rest your head at night whilst recovering from an exhausting day walking around the amazing sights and history that the eternal city has to offer, then this is your place. We stayed as two couples in two double rooms for four nights and it was everything we needed. The included breakfast was lovely. The bed large and comfortable. The rooms clean and sufficient. I must also give extra special mention to Stefano and Patrick at the concierge desk. So pleasant and welcoming and nothing too much trouble, even when we requested to change rooms after our first night. They were so knowledgeable and passionate about their wonderful city, highlighting places of obvious interest as well as recommending areas less well known but just as beautiful, including local traditional tavernas. They were a credit to the hotel and made our stay just perfect. We plan to return. Thank you.

author: Sofia I
title: Excellent service, lovely and clean and perfectly situated!!
text:
This hotel is perfectly situated for everything you could possibly want to see and do in Rome. Around 20 minutes walk to the colosseum, 30 minutes to the Vatican, 5 minutes to the Trevi fountain. 
The hotel is small but well maintained and kept beautifully clean! Rooms aren’t particularly modern, but they are functional and there is a safe to secure key items. There is a small lift so you won’t need to worry about stairs (unless it’s not working of course). 
The hotel has excellent staff, they’re attentive, friendly and helpful no matter what time of day. There is a bar which stays open until around 10pm each day it’s very small but it’s comfortable after a long day of walking. There is a restaurant next door that’s joined to the hotel where you can get breakfast, lunch and dinner at reasonable rates, but I would suggest taking a wander around and experiencing more authentic Italian cuisine, lots of side streets with hidden gems that offer amazing food in quaint, authentic settings.  Avoid places near big attractions as the prices are overly inflated just because of location. 
There is a small mini-mart opposite, a coffee shop round the corner, some gift shops close by and a wonderful gelato shop across the road that does all sorts of flavours, plus crepes, smoothies and hot and cold drinks! 
All in all an excellent stay!!

We stayed as a group, but we saw families, couples and singles there.

author: Charlotte N
title: 4 great nights in Hotel Hiberia
text: Just back from 4 nights in Hotel Hiberia with two friends and very impressed with this hotel. Its in a perfect location about 5 minutes walk from Trevi fountain and all the main sights are within easy walking distance, even the Vatican. From check in to departure the staff were excellent, organising taxis when required and giving helpful advice, this is an old fashioned hotel that takes pride in customer service.  We had 3 rooms all of which had a double bed and modern ensuite and large flat screen tv and were cleaned and towels replaced every day.  There is plenty to see and do in the immediate vicinity of the hotel with a small supermarket across the road and a nice bar, bar teatro just around the corner which is great for sitting outside and watching the hussle and bussle, We dined in the restaurant joined on to the hotel on our first night due to late arrival and were pleasantly suprised at the food, atmosphere and service. We will return to rome as 4 days is not enough and we will defintely return to Hotel Hiberia.

author: Emma F
title: Amazing Hotel in Rome
text: Would 100% recommend this Hotel.  Everything was wonderful.  The Receptionist Raphael was so nice & funny.  Very informative and offered lots of advice.  We had a twin room which was clean & roomy, nice size bathroom.  Lovely minibar very reasonable prices.  There is a real old fashioned lift which adds character to the building.  The breakfast is lovely in the morning in the restaurant also. We ate in the restaurant for dinner for 2 nights !  Hands down the nicest pizza I’ve ever had!!!!  Very reasonable prices!  Luigi one of the waiters was great fun.  Location is very good, we walked everywhere and the hotel was a great base.   Would recommend the hotel 10/10.  If I was to go again to Rome I would definitely stay here again !!!

author: James T
title: Everything you need for a good base, to explore Rome!
text:
As far as we are concerned, Hotel Hiberia was perfect for our base to explore Rome. Unfortunately, ignorant on our part, we didn't get any of the staff members' names, but they were all very friendly, helpful, cheerful, and tolerant of our poor grasp of the Italian language! 
We stayed in room 415, which had an amazing city view. The room was quaint, clean and tidy, and everything we imagined for a 3* city hotel. We couldn't have asked for more!
The hotel is in a central location, and most of the main attractions are all just 10-15 minutes walk away. We'll definitely be back someday! 😊

author: Grace I
title: Anniversary getaway
text: We just spent six nights in Rome and stayed at Hotel Hiberia.  We were very happy with our stay.  The staff were always very friendly, helpful and professional.  The hotel was very clean and conveniently located to major sights.    Would definitely recommend.  Well worth the money.

author: Aiden S
title: good hotel in central area
text: hotel near the quirinale and the stables (home to major exhibitions). the Termini station can be reached in about twenty minutes on foot or by bus 64 and 40. very polite and helpful staff. the rooms are on the first floor, clean, discreetly furnished, not tried breakfast

author: Caleb A
title: Good stay in Rome
text: Three-night stay in August. Hotel in a quiet area, excellent cleanliness, thanks to Rome in August no noise at night. Large beds, perhaps a bit firm but it is a matter of habit. I did not try the breakfast because for three of us it cost as much as the room. Kindness of the staff. Excellent stay. Our triple room was practically a mini-apartment! Area that seems quiet, you can reach the subway in 7 minutes on foot. Fair price. Satisfied.

author: Hannah V
title: Good hotel with sufficient facilities and services
text: The hotel was very nice and modern feel with sufficient facilities throughout. The staff were lovely and breakfast was good.

author: Mia N
title: Lovely stay
text: Lovely hotel out of the main centre and a short metro to all the main attractions. We booked a family room and it was big and well appointed. Really helpful staff and the roof top restaurant/bar is lovely for the evenings. Highly recommend!

author: Wyatt U
title: Very good stay and nice neighborhood.
text: We enjoyed our stay (3 nights in July 2026). There is a subway station not too far away and we got an 18-euro subway pass for 3 days, so the hotel is very accessible and makes it easy to reach all the tourist spots. We were well welcomed and informed by the front desk. We were able to leave our suitcases in the luggage room to go for a walk while the room was being prepared. We really liked the breakfast: clean room, lots of variety, and excellent cakes as well. We found the room clean but a bit old with a shower that leaked a little. Foreign TV channels, especially in French, did not work very well in the afternoon and early evening. It was also not easy to get the room cleaned during our stay (it still wasn't done one day at 4:00 PM even though we had properly put up the sign requesting that the room be cleaned). We really liked the neighborhood, quiet, with a good bakery right across the street and restaurants and ice cream shops nearby. We tried the rooftop restaurant: not bad but a lot of wasps, which detracted from the experience. We would gladly return but will ask in advance that the shower leak and TV issues be checked beforehand.

author: Lucas D
title: BAD EXPERIENCE
text: A very disappointing experience. The welcome at the front office was not warm and lacked professionalism. Furthermore, the room was extremely noisy throughout the night due to a lack of proper insulation and partitioning, which greatly hindered the quality of my stay and my rest.  Very bad experience. The front office staff was neither welcoming nor attentive and lacks experience. Furthermore, the room suffered from poor insulation, leading to numerous noise disturbances throughout the night. A stay far from expectations for an establishment of this category.

author: Matthew U
title: Very good
text:
Like all Best Westerns, 24-hour concierge, which is no small thing. The room had a spectacular king-size bed, clean and comfortable, while the single bed could be improved.
Spacious, well-furnished room with a balcony and a huge TV.
The bathroom, unfortunately, was truly meager; clean, yes, but without a window or ventilation, and the shower stall only partially closes with a curtain that we did not use because it carries fungi if it is not well cleaned.
The staff was kind and helpful, with a small exception for a guy at the reception who seemed annoyed, but overall everyone was good.
Excellent location and well-connected to Termini station by bus 310 or by taxi at a cost of € 10.
Breakfast not tried; there was no need since there was a very good pastry shop and café nearby.

author: Abigail E
title: Perfect
text: We stayed for only one night, unfortunately, we had already been there and we will definitely return, we were welcomed by Erika and Luca, the room was large, comfortable, and clean. Thank you for your availability 😊

author: Emma Y
title: Basic, clean, comfortable
text:
The hotel was clean and comfortable. There is a bus (310) opposite that take you to the station and we got tickets for the hop on hop off bus. The area is a student area but not very busy with a couple of cafes. It was a quiet hotel dispute being near to a hospital.  We checked in late as our flight was delayed so it was about midnight. Staff weren’t chatty and to the point. Not much was explained I.e where breakfast was etc and we just found this ourselves in the morning. There is no bar to get a drink but there is one outside on the right as you come down the steps. Nice cocktails! We ate at the roof top restaurant - the food was good but  not a lot of choice. The air con wasn’t great and it was so hot when we stayed so could have done with a better AC. Didn’t really see any staff and when we checked out it was agin to the point and not particularly friendly. 
I would recommend as a base for visiting Rome.

author: Lucy H
title: Okay hotel
text: It's good! Many choices at breakfast. The rooftop restaurant of the hotel needs to be validated. There are often receptions and events (4 to 7), and hotel guests are not prioritized! They still shared their second recommendation for another restaurant, excellent food but it is expensive and far... it is less pleasant when you are tired. Otherwise, generally good. Thank you.

author: Connor F
title: Good hotel, recommended.
text:
We spent 3 nights and were satisfied.
The room was spacious and clean, equipped with a large central television; the only thing we would have appreciated more is if the bathroom had a shower instead of a bathtub.
We did not try the breakfast or dinner.
The staff was kind and helpful. 
The location is convenient to the bus stop for going to the Roma Termini station.
I had no difficulty parking the car on the nearby streets.
There is also an excellent pastry bar in the area.
I recommend the hotel for those visiting Rome.

author: Zoe F
title: Pleasant stay
text:
We could not fault our stay
We knew we were not in the city centre but the metro was nearby. 
Our room was ready on arrival which was appreciated as we were early. Check in was efficient and friendly.
Room was clean.
The bed was comfortable and we did not hear any noise at night.
We only used the restaurant for breakfast which was a good offering.
I’d have no concerns in booking here again. For a base to explore Rome it ticked the boxes

author: Ryan C
title: excellent
text: I stayed at the Globus hotel for a university orientation, and I have nothing to say but everything was perfect. The staff was friendly, and I especially want to thank Domenico at the reception, who was very kind, a very nice person with a big heart❤️

author: Ella W
title: Great hotel..good location.
text: Excellent hotel located in a student area.  Brilliant transport links to Rome Termini and the rest of Rome.  Good breakfast with good selection of food.  We were on the first floor and there was some noise...mainly sirens as there is a hospital nearby but it didnt stop me from a good nighs sleep.  There was also a small balcony to sit out on.  There was tea and coffee making facilities...a mini fridge with complimentary water.  Hairdryer, safe, tv.  Cleaned every day.  A lovely bakery directly over the road...a supermarket a little bit further down (opposite side of the street)  and further down if you keep walking is a great burger place Sunseri.  The nearest metro is Policlinico on the blue  line.....about 10min walk but once we discovered the 310 bus which goes to the termini we used that all the time..runs very frequently.  You can catch it over the road from the hotel.  We bought a 72 hr travel pass for 22 euros and used it on buses..tram and underground.  Well worth it.

author: Freya V
title: Convenient Location but Limited Dining Variety
text:
We recently stayed at Best Western Globus Hotel during our trip to Rome. Overall, it was a comfortable stay with several positives, though there are areas where the experience could be improved.

Our arrival was around 2200h. The reception staff were not particularly warm, but they were not hostile either—just very direct and straight to the point. One thing that could definitely be improved is guest orientation. We booked half board, but this was never properly explained to us upon arrival, so we had to figure things out ourselves. We were also only given one room key, which was inconvenient for a family of three as it limited flexibility when travelling separately. Two keys would have made things much easier.

The room itself was a decent size, clean, and equipped with air conditioning, which made the stay comfortable, especially after long days exploring Rome. The TV was a good size, and the fridge was restocked with water daily, which we appreciated. Housekeeping cleaned the room every day. The bedside tables were quite small and lightweight, making them noisy when moving items around. I also requested two extra pillows, but possibly due to a language barrier, this never materialised. Still, the bed itself was comfortable. The bathroom and shower were clean and functional, complete with a bidet, which is common in mainland Europe.

The location was very good—about a 6–10 minute walk to ’s Policlinico station. There are many restaurants, grocery shops, and food stores nearby, with reasonable prices, likely because the area is close to a university. The hotel is also near several hospitals, so ambulance sirens are frequent and may be an issue if you are sensitive to noise.

The food was acceptable, though the menu was limited. Breakfast was buffet style with sausages, bacon, eggs, salads, breads, pancakes, yogurts, and a coffee machine. Dinner was à la carte with only a small selection available, so guests staying longer than five days will probably try the entire menu. Drinks were not included and had to be paid separately. The restaurant staff were pleasant, though not always comfortable speaking English. It would have been nice to have more variety, including American, British, or Chinese options alongside the Italian dishes.

Check-out was easy, quick, and straightforward. Overall, the hotel provided a comfortable base for exploring Rome, especially because of its convenient location.

author: Ella M
title: Very good hotel
text: Hotel far enough from the center and has a good 10-minute walk to access the subway.  Welcoming staff. Our room was not ready, they have a space to store the suitcases. There was a buffet dinner around 2:00 pm. Value for money ok. Let's have dinner at the hotel Sunday night because everything was closed in the area. Very generous portions.  Good service. Spacious and comfortable rooms, proper bathroom. Cheap hair dryers... windows would be due to be changed, you could not see through some. Cleanliness okay, but could be improved. I would go back to this hotel anyway, as we are comfortable with public transport. Student sector, so we thought it was safe.

author: Amelia G
title: Great stay
text:
We stayed here for 4 nights, the room was cleaned and serviced every day.  We had a great shower and there was a hairdryer in room. The breakfast was lovely with a really nice selection of foods every morning.  The metro is a 10 minute walkaway and its only 2 stops
To rome termini and 4 stops to collusium.  The staff we came in contact with were friendly snd helpful.  Would recommend buying the 72 hour metro ticket or longer depending on how long you are there.

We visited plenty of tourist attractions and they were all worth the visit.

author: Luca U
title: Excellent!
text: Lovely hotel, no complaints whatsoever.  Read a few negative reviews regarding noise etc but we found it extremely quiet and peaceful.  Really handy for Metro and access to all main areas of the City, a 5-6 minute walk to Metro station.  Nice quiet area with some great nearby cafes and shops.  For the price I’d highly recommend this hotel.

author: Mason E
title: Miss Selling
text:
Booked a quadruple room on the explicit understanding there would be 4 beds. Instead there were 2 double beds so my family of 4 had to sleep together. This is misselling and very poor. 
Breakfast was crowded into a tiny restaurant m. One day we had to wait at the door for 15mins to be sat. Breakfast hot options were incredibly limited - rubber scrambled eggs, chicken sausages and bacon. 
Lobby areas are tiny so there's nowhere to sit and relax. Even the tiny restaurant doubles up as a bar area, and it is uninviting to say the least. Location was good though - if you dont mind the sound of ambulance sirens every 10mins as the hotel is surrounded by hospital buildings.

author: William T
title: Wonderful stay.
text:
We were pleasantly surprised by the hotel. Our room was very spacious, in fact we had 2 rooms-one with a double bed and a sitting room which had a single bed. Having booked a 'triple' this was a pleasant surprise. The hotel is near the university and was very quiet when we arrived as it was Easter Monday. When the students returned, the area was livelier and more bars and eateries were open l, giving the area a pleasant vibe, however we were not troubled by any noise at night. All the staff were very friendly and helpful.
The hotel is about 20 minutes walk from Termini station and 5 to 10 mins from the metro.

author: Morgan D
title: Cheap but not cheerful sadly ... avoid
text: Arrived at midday after travelling with 2 young children for several hours and an early wake up to find room not ready for 2hrs, had to leave and come back. At the room, bathroom door handle came off, main door didn't lock (huge chunck of wood in the door frame missing) and lifts not working when on the 5th floor! Broken lock reported and bodged by maintenance, hotel staff just un-reassuringly saying "we have cameras if people try to rob you", hotel packed so changing rooms not an option. Hotel breakfast room way too small for the hotel so unless arrive at start 7am or very end near 9:30am you have to wait for a table. Some families of 4 round a table for 2, breakfast buffet bang average and no real choice for kids unless they only eat corn flakes and toast. Pastries at breakfast were decent but eggs looked like they had been tangoed (very orange) and ranged from ok to inedible across 5 days. Bacon much the same. Wifi is terrible and after 10/11pm when everyone in their rooms it is non-existent. Saving grace for the hotel, its 10 mins walk to Policlinco metro (10 mins to Colosseum) and has a few little family restaurants near-by, one, Gran Sasso was superb and recommended (although wasnt where the hotel recommended). The other saviour for this place is that you are visiting Rome not the hotel, You sleep here and have breakfast if you must, thankfully not much time actually spent in the hotel when the city is incredible ! Wouldn't stay here again, recommend to people to spend the little extra for somewhere better and within the city wall as i will next time, this isnt value for your money. For noise, its near the hospital (which we knew) so great if you like italian ambulanza sirens, ha. Downside is 3 days after coming home i can still hear them.

author: Diego U
title: A place we always return to
text:
We have stayed at this hotel several times and from the last time to the present, many improvements have been made and from the entrance you can notice the changes in floors and furniture, the rooms are totally new and super comfortable.
Breakfast is still in the same place and it is fine, it would just be missing more variety of fruits and waffles.
It has been a pleasant surprise the changes for the better that were made.

author: Zachary X
title: Highly Recommended
text: Just returned from a week at Colonna Palace Hotel. Can't fault it. Staff were so helpful and location is perfect for seeing all the sights. Rooms cleaned every day. Good breakfast and nice little bar to finish off the evening.  Hand rail in shower would have been helpful.

author: Diego V
title: Ok option
text: It’s in a nice location, you can walk pretty much anywhere but the beds are not the comfortable. Also, our safety didn’t work, we told the front desk but the guy never showed up. Really safe place, a lot of police around

author: Erin M
title: Great location!
text: This was our first stop on our honeymoon. The  room was clean! The hotel is in a great location, we walked everywhere! I was able to email the hotel a few weeks before our stay for a private transfer from airport upon arrival.  Very basic amenities and everything was always clean. Our only complaint was the AC(of course we are Americans visiting during a heat wave) it never seemed to catch up but cold showers helped! The staff was always kind and the breakfast being included helped our day start off right!

author: Megan U
title: Location, location, location
text: Location was spectacular, it was literally the center of it all, our longest walk was 20 minutes to the colosseum. Everything else was literally just mins. Restaurants, stores and monuments were relatively close the only thing we got a taxi for was for the Vatican otherwise it was beyond great. Breakfast was good, staff was amazing.

author: Sara U
title: Fantastic staff and hotel
text: This was a well appointed hotel with helpful staff. Breakfast was amazing and the room was lovely. Highly recommend this hotel and  i thank them for their great service

author: Lucas O
title: Staff save the day
text:
I was told this was a 4 star hotel, it is not. The room they offered at first was very small for two people and had stained rugs.  We upgraded to a suite, it was better however the bed was uncomfortable and the bathroom felt unsafe.  The tub was so high, you had to make an effort to leap out of it
With no safety bars to hold on to; I’m a senior citizen.  The breakfast was ok, nice terrace.   Must comment on staff:  they were all very helpful and friendly- truly one of the hotels assets.   The location is vey convenient as well.   Georgia from the bar is a star.

author: Lucia H
title: To be tested
text:
Beautiful building 
Well located 
Old-fashioned room with issues in the bathroom.
Constant blowing noise
Clean
Very pleasant staff 
Simple breakfast. 
Low-quality bedding. Significant lower back pain
Quite noisy on the street

Rooftop with a magnificent view

author: Liam W
title: Good stay at Colonna Palace Hotel
text:
We stayed here for 7 days, and my wife and I were both happy. I was aware it was an older type hotel before booking but its location is just perfect.
It overlooks the Italian Parliament and because of this there is always a large Police presence which I found to be reassuring.The Trevi Fountain and the Parthenon are both about 5 minutes away.
Breakfast on the Terrace overlooking Rome was typical for Europe consisting of breakfast cereals, breakfast rolls, croissants, boiled eggs, scrambled eggs, various cold meats, cheeses, fresh fruit, yogurts, tea and coffee.
The staff were very attentive at breakfast.
Our room was spacious, cleaned every day and I always found the staff to be helpful and pleasant.
We ordered drinks one night and they delivered them to the roof terrace where we enjoyed the evening sun with great views.
We would return to this hotel.

author: Isla N
title: Good hotel very well located
text: We stayed at this hotel 4 nights and liked it. It is very well located and you have the essentials nearby. He's in a traffic-free square, so there's no noise. Comfortable and clean rooms. The reception staff very friendly, and solving any doubts you have. But there are two things that can be improved (that’s why I didn’t give it a 5), firstly that there is no toaster in the buffet to prepare toast and secondly there is a bathtub instead of a shower tray with the risk of falling. Otherwise, all very well

author: Evan U
title: A great disappointment!.
text:
I was very disappointed.
Let's start from the room with worn old carpet and some stains.
The mattress springs felt very uncomfortable, and very low (but this is my personal reflection).
The windowless bathroom has an insufficient aerator, in fact you could smell even without using it. Upon arrival the toilet drain was straight as well as blocked the sink drain (timely and decisive intervention).
Breakfast without a soul; I was sitting at the table I asked for water and was told that I had to take it from the buffet only to make sure that “extraordinarily” they would provide it, but it did not arrive, I took it myself (and thank you anyway).
Cheap products, juices from the vending machine.
Reception: on arrival they gave us the key and did not even tell us where breakfast was held and, in fact, in the morning we went to the ground floor except then go up to the 6th floor.
On the way out nobody asked us how it went.
I just want to thank the lady on the afternoon shift who politely and politely solved a big problem of silent search.
I’m sorry but, I think, we have to intervene with a “refreshment” to the finishing materials “painting, carpeting) and take more care of the customer (even if he stays for one night only).
Not even a bottle of water as a welcome.

author: Nora N
title: Great location, with fantastic views. Would recommend
text: Location was perfect - 2 mins to Pantheon, 5 mins to Trevi fountain, 30 mins to Colosseum. Hotel was lovely, very clean, fantastic view from the roof top terrace where we ate breakfast each day and chilled out in the late afternoon. Hotel staff great before and during the stay; Reception very responsive/accommodating; I emailed prior to stay to organise airport transfers and connecting rooms. (Breakfast lady very friendly).

author: Harper D
title: Birthday Treat 2026
text: Stayed in this Hotel for three nights everything was perfect.   Check in, Room had  great views and a beautiful clean room, comfortable room for a good nights sleep after sightseeing in Rome.   Central for everything.  Breakfast lovely, and the views from the roof top breakfast room was something else xxxxxx

author: Charlie Q
title: A Pleasant stay
text: I stayed 3nts in January. The lobby is pleasant, nice to have a glass of wine in the evening and relax.  The front desk was helpful with directions, calling me a taxi and answering all questions that I had.  The room I had was dated (I was expecting this from previous reviews). The bathroom seem to be renovated.  Wifi was strong and I was able to work as needed.   A kettle in the room would be nice.  For as little time as I spent in my room it was fine.  I do wish the rooms were as nice as the lobby.  The location is excellent, short walk to Pantheon, and not too far to Trevi and Spanish Steps.  I would stay here again now knowing the rooms are plain but the service and staff exceeded my expectations. I did not have their breakfast

author: Lucy N
title: Trusted hotel
text: I return and return because this hotel offers what I need when in Rome…comfort, service, and location.

author: Ian Q
title: Don’t book no matter what
text:
Don’t even think about booking this hotel. The hotel states it is 4 star, based on the requirements for a 4 star hotel this does not meet that. First if you stay here and are at the back of the hotel, you won’t sleep. There is a restaurant and road which is busy day and night. Glass collection is at 7am sharp. The hotel entrance is tasteful and that’s where it ends. The rest of the hotel is faded and in need of an update. The room we had was terrible, the furniture was broken, there was no kettle on arrival we had to ask for one, it should be standard In a 4 star hotel. The bed makes a noise even before you sit on it, the room air con and heating doesn’t work, the room is cold, the buttons are broken. The bathroom is so small you cannot get in and out the bath shower without contorting yourself. The breakfast is not worth the effort, the only hot item is overcooked scrambled egg, not even a toaster. Plenty of salad and meat. The world’s smallest cups for borrowers is what you get to make a brew in. most hotel staff are rude, not sure if that’s just being Italian. The bar server is really lovely and very chatty. ordered some drinks are the bar, was told by receptionist we cannot pay the bar bill until we leave? We have other peoples bathrooms backing onto our room and we get to hear everything they do In the bathroom. Once in a lifetime trip
Ruined baby staying in this hotel

author: Amelia Y
title: Unbeatable location
text: Hotel with an unbeatable location. My room was single and overlooked the square and you could hear some noise. To be a four the room needed some sorting. There are always police because it's right where the presidential palace is. The wifi does not go, even with own data there is poor coverage. The terrace for breakfast is wonderful. Breakfast good. It is a very good choice to stay. Staff at the reception speak Spanish.

author: Lea P
title: Lovely stay at Colonna Palace Hotel
text: Stayed 4 nights at this hotel and the location was perfect for exploring Rome, with many restaurants, attractions and good shopping close by, or within walking distance. Very happy with our choice of hotel, staff were friendly and helpful, rooms were spacious and very clean and comfortable, plenty of hot water and fresh sheets and towels everyday.  A mini bar is provided and a safe.  Roof terrace is especially lovely for breakfast and afternoon drinks, with amazing views across the city. Plenty of choice for breakfast, dont understand anyone complaining about the food in previous reviews.  Location can be a little noisy at night time if you have a room overlooking the Parliament building but this did not really bother us and windows and shutters can close off the noise. The presence of the Carabineri right outside the hotel is reassuring, although we felt very safe throughout all of Rome.

author: Lucy F
title: Beautiful city perfect location great central hotel
text: This is a lovely hotel, after reading some of the reviews I was a little concerned however  I didn’t need to be. The location of this hotel is absolutely perfect it’s so central we could walk to so many attractions and lovely restaurants it enabled us to be in the heart of Rome throughout our trip.  Opposite the parliament building police are present 24 hours which is lovely for security however we felt safe everywhere.  Room was huge as was the bathroom. Yes it’s a little dated but nothing that made us feel it wasn’t a quality hotel.  I would like to mention housekeeping as I’m not sure they always get the recognition they were superb!  Our room was beautifully clean everyday.  Breakfast on the roof terrace overlooking Rome was lovely. Continental style which was all we needed to start the day and appreciated as Rome is expensive so it saved us having to take time out of our day finding places to eat for breakfast.  We wanted to spend all our time out and about and didn’t spend much time in the hotel or the room as we didn’t visit Rome for this reason.  We wanted central, comfortable and convenient and this hotel ticked all the requirements we wanted.   If you want to be central staying in a clean comfortable hotel this hotel is perfect.   Only thing that wasn’t good WiFi is rubbish in the rooms but fine in the main hotel.  We really couldn’t get WiFi in the hotel room  so I would suggest plenty of data if you want great wifi in your room we really couldn’t get a good connection.  But we didn’t want to spend time in our room we wanted to spend all our time walking this breathtaking, beautiful city.  I would recommend this hotel and  sitting outside watching the world go past after a busy day walking around the city was perfect. Want a really great central location within  the beautiful parliament squire this is a great hotel we would stay again if we went back.

author: Paige O
title: Not a 4* hotel
text: I’ll start with the positives, location is excellent, bar staff are good. Cleaners are good. However this is not a 4 star hotel, the internet is poor, reception useless, breakfast is terrible. How can an Italian hotel serve such poor disgusting coffee is beyond me. The whole hotel is in need of refurbishment. The shower is rubbish, the drain in the bath smelled disgusting. I would not return or recommend.

author: Aiden K
title: Dinner on the Seine.
text:
We had a very good time, very pleasant, a beautiful boat ride on the Seine, another way to see Paris.
The singer was brilliant, bravo.
The staff was attentive.
The dinner was very good.

author: Freya R
title: Superb experience.
text: It's just a shame that after the meal there isn't any entertainment on the terrace with a bar, music, or something else.

author: Hannah B
title: Celebration 50 anniversary
text:
Wonderful experience 
Best tour to do in Paris

author: Morgan O
title: Perfect
text: Perfect friendly staff clean room excellent meals

author: Hugo V
title: Terrible Customer Service
text: I redeemed a voucher for a dinner cruise and overnight stay on the yacht on Nov 26 and got my email confirmation on May 16. I then went ahead and booked the rest of my Paris plans and tickets on to the Netherlands for November 27. Then on July 10 I get an email from VIP yacht saying they don't do dinner cruises on Thursday in the Winter which is strange because they knew it was a Thursday when they confirmed. They say they'll move my reservation to Friday night and not charge me the weekend surcharge but I'm from Canada, I can't easily change plans without costs and I immediately emailed back saying this and have been ignored for 10 days. Buyer beware, they don't care once they get your money.

author: Jessica W
title: Very good location, great food, fantastic live music, nice cabin, spacious bathroom
text:
A great experience: Nice ship, very friendly staff, very good food 
Perfect!

author: Gavin F
title: A Unique Stay That Completely Exceeded Our Expectations
text:
After some disappointing accommodation during the rest of our trip, staying here was such a breath of fresh air and completely exceeded our expectations. It genuinely made our time in Paris so much more enjoyable.
The location is fantastic – around a 10-minute walk from both Gare de Lyon and Gare d'Austerlitz with excellent metro and train connections, and only five minutes from the Accor Arena, which was perfect as we were attending a concert.
From the moment we arrived, the staff were incredibly welcoming. Being able to leave our luggage from 12pm before check-in was a huge help, and we were also surprised with a complimentary upgrade to a larger room with our own private deck, which made our stay even more special.
The room itself was brilliant. The bed was much bigger than we expected and incredibly comfortable – so much so that I barely noticed my boyfriend was even there! Despite being so close to major train stations, the room was amazingly quiet. Once inside it felt almost completely soundproof, and we couldn't hear any outside noise at all, which meant we both had an excellent night's sleep.
The bathroom was clean and modern. The shower was good, although in an ideal world the water pressure could have been a little stronger. The only small issue we noticed was a little mould in the shower sealant, which could do with some attention, but it didn't affect our stay or change our overall impression of the accommodation.
We also really appreciated the little touches. While we were out exploring Paris, housekeeping cleaned our room, replaced the towels and restocked the complimentary drinks in the mini fridge, which we weren't expecting at all. The TV also included Netflix, Disney+ and Amazon Prime, making it easy to relax after a busy day sightseeing.
The upper deck is a lovely place to sit and enjoy the atmosphere on the Seine. One thing we were disappointed to miss was the dinner cruise, which looked absolutely incredible. Unfortunately, we weren't staying on one of the evenings the boat sailed, but after seeing it we'd definitely love to come back and experience it in the future.
Overall, this was excellent value for money and one of the highlights of our trip to Paris. The combination of the unique setting, fantastic location, thoughtful service and comfortable accommodation made it a stay we'll remember for a long time. We wouldn't hesitate to book again and would happily recommend it to anyone looking for something a little different from the usual hotel experience.

author: Lily E
title: Lovely stay on the river
text: Great location for our purposes (concert at Accor Stadium) and right between two main stations G de Lyon and G d’Austerlitz. Room was tiny but comfy. Shower was great and air con worked really well which was a godsend in the 36 degree heat! A fantastic fridge in the room that was restocked while we were there with cool drinks and water - Again a real bonus in the heat. Bed was super comfy too. Staff were incredibly nice and very helpful. Great wee find.

author: Sophia H
title: A nice experience despite a few points to correct
text:
The pros
Very warm welcome, delicious dinner, great singer

The cons
Cabin a bit dated with poorly functioning toilets, disappointing breakfast

author: Freya U
title: Very good
text: Great cruise and top-notch service! Only downsides: the parking attendant at the intercom did not want to let us in because there was no QR code. The TV in the room was stuck on the welcome menu. The hors d'oeuvres were limited to one per person at 7 PM; I was expecting a buffet!

author: Lucia T
title: Paris on the Seine
text:
Great experience, attentive staff.
The cruise from 8 PM to 10:30 PM was superb; you can eat and between meals go back on deck to admire Paris with your drink, I highly recommend it!

author: Sophia T
title: Night on the VIP Yacht in Paris
text:
A night spent on the VIP Yacht just steps from the Gare de Lyon (convenient!) 
A very clean boat cabin (small but ideal for a short stay) and comfortable bedding. 
Very good welcome, all for a very reasonable price. 
In short, a wonderful experience to repeat (with a larger cabin if we stay several days...)

author: Sophia M
title: An unusual night on the Seine.
text:
A dinner cruise and a night on the Seine to celebrate my partner's birthday. He was over the moon. The only downside in June is that night falls late, so we docked before the buildings were illuminated, but that is not due to VIP yachts.
The table service is a bit rushed, but the rest makes up for it.

author: Amelia Y
title: The best way to experience Paris.
text: I was here for the second time and again believe that this is the best way to experience Paris as a tourist. The docking place is relatively easy to reach by car, and you should leave the car there, as you would only be stuck in traffic in the center anyway. The staff is extremely nice, the food is acceptable, and the cabins are adequate for a ship (No. 7 is a bit larger).

author: Ruby Q
title: A total success for 80-year-olds in peace
text: Excellent service, hostess and butler who gave good advice on the choice of table among others

author: Benjamin W
title: Dinner cruise to do without hesitation
text:
We were surprised by the quality of the service! 
The food worthy of a gastro and especially the very friendly and available staff

author: Poppy M
title: To discover absolutely!
text: Very good reception and service of very good quality and attentive

author: Manon T
title: Very good time
text:
Overnight and meals on the boat. Very good and comfortable room, just a little warm especially if you use the hot tub! Infrared sauna therefore heats up but not as much as a real one.
Good quality meals and the view of Paris is really beautiful.

author: Matthew N
title: A very nice and pleasant experience!
text: Very good reception by all the staff, very decent meal. The 2-hour cruise is beautiful. We slept on board and that’s cool! A little flat on the aging state of the boat...

author: Diego X
title: Birthday gift
text: It was perfect, great evening

author: Paige S
title: Hôtel Elysées Union – 2 Night Stay
text:
Location

The hotel is in a fantastic central spot. It’s around a 20‑minute downhill walk to the Eiffel Tower and close to cafés, restaurants, shops and major attractions. There are metro stations at both ends of the road, making it really easy to get around Paris. The locality is simply beautiful.

Staff and Service

The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. The lady on the front desk when we arrived gave outstanding customer service and genuinely made our trip. She went above and beyond to upgrade us for our second night and gave us what must be one of the best rooms in the hotel, with a beautiful balcony and an unforgettable view of the Eiffel Tower. We were celebrating our daughter’s graduation, and she made it feel extra special.

Hotel and Facilities

The building itself is beautiful, with a bar, lounge and a lovely atrium garden. There’s a lift, a gorgeous staircase and a free bag‑holding service. They offer breakfast you can simply turn up for without booking.

Rooms

The rooms have everything you need. The bathrooms are modern, while the rooms keep a traditional Parisian charm. The beds are comfy, everything is spotless, and you get a safe, mini‑bar and a TV in each room. Rooms were peaceful with no noise from neighbours.

Overall

We had a wonderful stay and would 100% recommend Hôtel Elysées Union. Good value for money. We’ll happily return every time we visit Paris.

author: Claire F
title: Two nights in Paris
text: Had a great time at this hotel with my daughter for our two nights in Paris. We had a courtyard view for the first night then an Eiffel Tower view for our second night. Both rooms were spacious and clean. The location is perfect,a ten minute walk(we walk fast) to the Eiffel Tower in one direction,ten mins to the arc de triomphe in the other direction. Close to the champs elysees shopping street too which is amazing. We ate at a nice restaurant just up the street from the hotel called le Copernic,good price too. The people on reception were really friendly and helpful. Loved our stay and definitely want to come back to Paris and this hotel.

author: Kyle V
title: Good option
text: Hotel well located, helpful staff, good breakfast, small room but with a balcony with side view to the tower, I did not understand very well because they make many warnings in the sense that if you stain the towels will be charged 99 euros, it happens that the towels are well wrapped, so you will understand né? also charge a bail of 200 euros in my case was stained at the end of the stay.

author: Jessica R
title: Loved it
text: We LOVED the Hotel Elysees Union. It was our first time in Paris and there were four of us with plenty of luggage. Shaheen was an incredible help with everything. We were able to walk to most of the sites.  The staff and our room were excellent.  Everyone's English was excellent, so there were never any language barriers.  Don't know when we'll make it to Paris again, but we would love to stay here!

author: Jessica U
title: A good quality, well located hotel option for visits on a budget
text: We stayed here as a group of friends for a weekend in Paris. It is a decent hotel, really well located with plenty of cafes and restaurants within minutes walk and a lovely view of the Tour Eiffel from the street-facing rooms. It isn’t the lap of luxury and the rooms aren’t huge but it’s clean and with lovely service from the maids and reception (who are dealing with a stream of holiday-makers like us!) it was perfect accommodation for us. One of our rooms faced a lovely quiet courtyard and the other had the amazing view. Both had a massive French window and juliette balconies, which was also really Parisien and so charming. Breakfast was included in our very reasonable rate and was perfectly good. No complaints whatsoever!

author: Owen J
title: Perfect Location!
text: Perfect location near restaurants and shops, that even comes with a view of the Eiffel Tower! Our room was perfect for us and the beds were so comfortable! Staff was helpful, rooms clean, quiet area. Perfect for our trip! We agreed this will be our go-to place when we come back to Paris!

author: Juan H
title: Perfect location!
text:
My husband, daughter and I stayed here for 4 nights over the marathon weekend. Perfect location inbeteeen Arc de Triomphe and Trocadéro. Near to some great cafes and restaurants and a lovely view of the Eiffel Tower day and night. 

The hotel is clean and the rooms are nice. The only downside is that the walls are a bit thin and you can hear activity and talking in the corridors. 

Would definitely stay again!

author: Molly U
title: Unjustified bail
text:
Hello , my friend and I stayed at this hotel the weekend of March 21. Regarding the stay itself, it was satisfying (nice and welcoming staff). However on our last night we were awakened in the middle of the night by the fire alarm. We had to evacuate in a hurry! So that finally we can be told that it was a person in our floor who smoked. Indeed we could smell the bad smell of our room. To date my deposit of 100 € which was normally refunded at the end of my stay has been charged because according to the hotel we smoked in our room!!! Because I quote “we noticed a smell of cannabis in your room”, while I would like to maintain that we are not responsible for that smell. I find it unacceptable to blame the clientele who did not ask for anything for the offences of others!!!
I am still waiting for my refund of this deposit!
Frankly I am very disappointed..

author: Henry M
title: Perfect hotel for a holiday in Paris.
text:
I stayed here with my husband and children for 4 days and we had a great time!
Convenient location, Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe and Champ Elysees within walking distance, for everything else there is the metro station very close. 
We stayed in an apartment overlooking the back of the hotel, very nice, quiet, clean and really functional. The kitchen, despite being small, was equipped with everything (dishwasher, washing machine, microwave, induction hob). And for the first time in my life I found the blinds that really darkened the room, as I wake up very easily even if a thread of light comes in. Normal price comparing it with other hotels in the area. 
Good breakfast and with a decent variety of products. 
Friendly staff.
In short, I highly recommend this hotel!

author: Oscar L
title: Excellent central hotel.
text:
Very nice hotel. The rooms are warm and very comfortable. The staff were very efficient and friendly.
Our room was at the back and very quiet.
There is a view of the Eiffell Tower fron the front of the hotel.
Breakfast is continental only but very nice.
Rooms have hair dryer and towels etc changed daily.
A safe is available in the room.
Lift to all rooms and flat entrance, the restaurant is down stairs, so check this if its an issue for you.
Restaurants a plenty close by and a short walk to the Arc de Triomph and 10 minutes to the Eiffel Tower.
We had a great stay.

author: Rosie Z
title: Amazing balcony view, friendly staff, comfortable room and fantastic location
text: Had a lovely stay here while in Paris last week. I requested a balcony room so I could propose to my fiancée with a view and was very grateful that the hotel staff obliged. It was a perfect and special moment for us and very kind of the staff to help out for the occasion. The room was cleaned each day while being careful to leave our belongings as we had left them. The view from the room was amazing. The staff were ever so lovely and friendly whenever we spoke with them. The location of the hotel is ideal as well and is walking distance from many great restaurants and attractions such as the Effiel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe. The hotel also held our luggage for the day until our transfer was able to collect us. Would definitely come back and would recommend to anyone.

author: William N
title: Excellent hotel in wonderful location, with plenty of space for family of four!
text:
We loved our stay at the Hotel Elysees Union! We traveled as a family of four, with two teen daughters and the room had plenty of space for all of us. They especially liked that there were two twin beds, so they each had their own space. In the bathroom, the toilet area had its own door, which made it easier when all of us were getting ready for the day. 

The location was incredible! We could see the Eiffel tower from our room (we had a room facing the street), so many sightseeing locations were within walking distance (as in less than 30 minutes walking), there were a number of restaurants within walking distance (which was super helpful at the end of the day when we wanted to eat close to the hotel). Even though our room faced the street, the noise level was low and the windows were great at dampening sounds. There was only one night where there was a party in a restaurant across the street that was getting loud, but the closed window helped a lot, and we were all able to sleep well. 

Everything was very clean and well maintained. We also enjoyed that there was a courtyard in the center of the hotel. There's breakfast served daily, and there was a great variety of food options, they were delicious and fresh. 

All of the staff were very helpful, polite, and kind. For our departure the front desk staff made all the arrangements for a taxi to pick us up at the best timing to make it to our flight. They all made our stay great. 

We were truly thrilled with our stay at this hotel, which is a big part of having had an amazing trip. We would go back there again!

author: Zoe F
title: Family trip in Paris
text: We stayed in the apartment which was perfect for our family of five. It was decently equipped, including a washer/dryer, which was so great. The staff were amazing and so kind. The breakfast was continental, but included a decent range to power you for the day - pastries, hot and cold drinks, baguette, cheese, meats, tomato, cucumber, yogurts, cereals, toast, eggs, and more! The location was perfect, walking to the Champs de Elysées, Arc de Triumphe, Eiffel Tower. If things felt a little far away, it was within walking distance of at least three metro stations. It is older, but it was clean and comfortable. Thank you for a great family stay!

author: Wyatt O
title: A fabulous weekend in Paris .  Plan your itinerary carefully in order to get to see the sights. Try booking direct.
text: I went with my 2 granddaughters ages 17 and 15. We stayed for 2 nights. The hotel was in a great position . We could see the Eiffel Tower and it was an easy walk to it. The lights of Paris were amazing. The hotel was warm and  the room comfortable. The breakfast was very good with everything we could think of to eat. We would definitely go back there. It was extremely good value.
