author: Lea B
title: Good value hotel in a great location
text: Visited with family (6 of us) for my daughter's 16th birthday.   Had a great long-weekend staying here.   Hotel is in an excellent location for visiting the main attractions. In a lovely street with some excellent restaurants and cafes close by.   Rooms were modern and clean - both were triple rooms and much larger than I'd expected.  Reception staff very pleasant and helpful. A great hotel for the money.

author: Daisy Y
title: Does not refund the cost of the underwear
text: We didn't have a good experience, because they asked for a shirt of 100 euros and said that at the check out they would refund the amount and could take up to 3 business days, left on Saturday I went to other countries, I already arrived in Brazil and if 5 business days passed and nothing of the value stunned, I tried to contact their WhatsApp and nothing, I tried by email and I didn't have a return. It was a bullshit. Be careful not to get in the same loss me and my family that TBM happened the same. Total of 200 euros and so far nothing of the return of value.

author: Daisy M
title: My daughter’s 16th birthday treat
text: I emailed them prior to our visit to request view of the tower room, they were honest in saying it’s first come first served we arrived late around 7:30 pm and much to our delight we got a view room it was perfect for my daughters 16th birthday! Room 311 is small and cosy be careful on the balcony as it’s very small with a low rail. But the view is stunning the tower light up at night and sparkling. Highly recommend would use this hotel again and again.

author: Joseph J
title: A very correct three-star
text: A very well located 3 star hotel. The double room with 2 beds, spacious and with a (double) window to the street that insulated from noise. Paid Minibar and Free Tea and Coffee Service with Kettle. The bathroom was a bit old although the shower water always came out in good temperature. Breakfast is worth it, very complete. Attentive and very friendly staff.

author: David E
title: Would Highly Recommend
text: I was really impressed with this Hotel.  The location was excellent and so close to the metro.  There were supermarkets nearby, lots of restaurants and shops.  It is in walking distance to the Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Élysées.  The staff were helpful.  The room was clean.  The view of the Eiffel Tower from the room was fantastic.  The breakfast in the morning was good.  I would highly recommend.

author: Gavin Q
title: Mediocre Accommodation - More Effort Needed
text:
Stayed here 21/08 to 25/08 - room 119

Very basic and dated 

Booked a twin room and were given a double. Really annoys me this as if we had wanted a double room we would have booked one 

View of the courtyard so a bit meh

Air conditioning worked but makes a right noise 

Toilet and the sink and shower room are separate so if you want the toilet but someone is in the shower you have a wait so you can go to the toilet then wash your hands

Beds are quite hard and have a mattress topper that doesn’t fit the whole bed 
 
Bottles in mini bar €6.50 each, supermarket just 5 minute walk away had the same bottles for €3.50

Breakfast is not worth the money. We had an early morning out to Disney on the 24.05 so thought for ease we would book breakfast. Not even ready and set up for opening time. Eggs cold when they came out and coffee machine isn’t even like warm. Appreciate a continental breakfast is limited by at €14.50 per person it’s a bit of a joke. 

Location wise it’s walkable to all tourist attractions 

Would I personally stay here again, it would be a no for me

author: Gavin J
title: Excellent hotel.
text: Excellent location and welcoming staff. Daily towel change, the only downside is the carpet in the room.

author: Megan B
title: Great Hotel
text:
We travelled to Paris as a family of 3 for 5 nights. 
The hotel provided a great base for our holiday. We were able to get to the Centre of Paris, Disney and Versailles with no problems on the trains and Metro and it was walking distance to the Basilica and Monmarte. 
The hotel room was spacious with air con and a window that opened fully, so with the high temperatures we were able to keep cool at night. The room had everything we needed such as tea, coffee machine, fridge and bath robes and the shower was a good size.
The breakfast was a continental breakfast, there was a good choice of breads and pastries. The cheese and fruit options were limited on some of the days, but still lots to choose from.
We really enjoyed our stay and it met our expectations for a 3 star hotel.
The staff were so friendly, always offering to help and give helpful advice. 
If you only need a place to rest after a busy day in Paris I would recommend.

author: Julien G
title: Highly recommend
text:
It was my third stay at this hotel and I have never been disappointed.
Very good value for money. 
I also stay regularly at the Libertel at the Austerlitz train station; very good as well.

author: Hannah N
title: Great little budget hotel.
text: Great location within short walking distance of the Gare du Nord ; plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby also the Marche St Quentin for food. Super-clean , air- conditioned ( we really appreciated this in the 35degree heatwave) and thanks to double glazing, beautifully quiet. Friendly staff and terrific value for money for Paris. Will definitely stay here again.

author: Ana T
title: Good value for a hotel ideal for access to Gard du Nord.
text: Good position for transport around Paris and excellent for Gard du Nord. Compact rooms but clean and comfortable bed. Good value, welcoming staff, would recommend staying here for a short stay.

author: Manon W
title: Modern and comfortable hotel near Gare du Nord
text: Very clean and comfortable room, friendly staff. Great location very close to Gare du Nord - ideal for catching a Eurostar the next morning - but still quiet so that you can catch a good night's sleep.

author: Morgan B
title: Excellent experience
text:
reservation for one night at this hotel very well located between the North and East train stations.
The room had certainly been recently renovated, was very well arranged, and was very clean.
The reception staff is friendly and available both on the phone and upon our arrival.
Very complete breakfast in a separate room.
We will return.

author: Andrea G
title: Very convenient location, safe hotel with a nice surprise view
text: We stayed here for one night before our flight back to USA. We had been in Northern France for a week, so we arrived in Gare St. Lazare. We took the RER to Gare du Nord (price of metro ticket) and then walked to this hotel. It is not far to walk - we had all our suitcases and bags - fortunately, several suitcases had wheels so again, a pretty easy walk. We found this hotel easily and checked in. Because it is so close to train station, the neighborhood is very busy and maybe feels less safe. But once we walked into hotel and checked in, we felt safe - it would be hard for someone to walk in and take elevator to rooms without being noticed or stopped. The reception area is quite small. The room was warm when we got there and my husband thought we didn't have AC. But it was just off, we turned on, and room cooled down. The room also is small but fully equipped - a fridge, a coffee machine, a small closet. The shower was a bit tricky to get in as doors hit the toilet. But the window in the bathroom was nice (a small frosted window for privacy). We didn't realize until right before we checked out that we had a balcony and we opened it to a big surprise. The view is stunning - you can see the Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame, Sacre de Coeur and all of Paris! I think the location is pretty ideal if you want to travel all over Paris or France because you are so close to train/metro. Getting to CDG in the morning was super easy. We took RER to CDG (this is not same price as metro ticket) and it was about 30 minutes to Terminal 2E. We would do this same itinerary again.

author: Alexander X
title: Dirty with a side of insults
text: We checked into our room. There was a bad smell but we couldn’t work out what it was. We later worked out it was the pillows; on closer inspection, one had a brown stain on it… we hope that this was not human faeces but the smell suggested otherwise. We went downstairs to query this with reception and to show him the pillows. He informed us that there was nothing he could do, no manager to call and that we should have alerted them as to the stains within 15mins of arrival (despite us dropping our bags off to head straight back out again earlier that day). We asked to move rooms but he advised that the hotel was full. He said the hotel never gives refunds despite guests challenging cleanliness of their rooms frequently. He later came to our room and kindly offered us pillows which we declined. He recommended that we speak to the manager the next day, confirming that she would be on shift from 08:00-20:30. We were unable to find other accommodation at such short notice so resorted to sleeping on our own towels. The following morning, we were told by the receptionist they had smelled the pillows, couldn’t smell anything unusual, that we were obviously lying and that we were idiots for agreeing not to take the pillows. He advised that the manager was not available to speak to, that the only way to contact her was by email (despite us being able to see her sitting in a room next door). The shower leaked, the bathroom floor was dirty. We had wondered why it was so cheap considering it’s proximity to the Gare du Nord however, after one night’s stay, understand why! Interesting customer service, great use of dark tiles and carpets to hide stains. Highly recommend that you avoid booking this ‘hotel’ if you value cleanliness or being talked to with respect.

author: Hugo C
title: Very Basic but close to the Gare du Nord
text:
Very small and basic.  Close to the Gare so that explains the price.
If you are willing to commute then there are lots of better hotels at this price point.

author: Lucia U
title: Close to Gare du Nord in Paris
text: Since we were taking the Eurostar from Brussels to Paris and after Paris our next destination was London again by Eurostar, Libertel Gare du Nord Suede was a great choice because it was about a 5 minute walk to the Gare du Nord in Paris on flat terrain. We had two big hold and two cabin sized luggage since we were traveling for a month in Europe and it was not difficult to do. We were also close to all types of food ranging from American chains, Chinese food, Middle Eastern food and Parisian food as well. We walked to check out Moulin Rouge and to the Sacre Coeur as well as to the meeting point near Port Neuf for our Notre Dame Cathedral's walking tour. Good value and with most hotels, rooms are quite small compared to the average US hotel.

author: Adam V
title: Good choice
text: Great situation only a block or two from Gare du Nord with plenty of places to eat in immediate vicinity.  Bedroom and bathroom were very small but immaculately clean.  Ive stayed in 5* hotels nothing like as clean.  Staff very friendly.  Good double glazing, not noisy at night.  Optional breakfast was very good and plentidful choice.

author: Katie M
title: Good location, comfy, but very loud.
text: Location is great, super easy to get to the  tube and train station. There is also loads of food options around the hotel, and if you prefer to walk to shops/shopping centres it’s only 20/30mins. Rooms are small and not much privacy in the bathroom as the door has gaps in it - so make sure to travel either solo or with someone you’re comfortable with! The bed was super comfy and there was enough room for two people on a short trip, but wouldn’t recommend for an extended stay with large suitcases. Room service comes later in the afternoon so it means you’re not awkwardly awoken. The only complaints I would have is that I was charged some sort of room tax at the beginning even though my booking said my payment was inclusive of all hidden fees and taxes? So i was confused and disappointed by that. Furthermore, it is LOUD. Between the 24/7 construction and super loud neighbours, I didn’t get much chance to relax. The noise was constant and frustrating.

author: Pablo B
title: It's a very good hotel around North Station.
text:
It is a very good hotel.
First, the location is good, and both North and East stations can be reached by easy routes.
The rooms are not large (I think they are standard size in Paris), but given the cost, there was enough space. It was comfortable for both of us.
The water area was clean and the shower booth was very easy to use.
(This is so important that waterways are often difficult to use in Paris hotels.)
There was one thing that was very disappointing.
After five nights, we were planning to move to another place and come back for one night. Of course, I made reservations when I came back. Therefore, when I asked them to keep my suitcase until the next day, they said no, they would not keep it overnight. The staff suggested that guests drop off their luggage at the station or, if they want to leave their luggage at a hotel, pay for a night's accommodation.
I didn't ask to be kept for days, and I made a reservation for the next day, so I didn't understand this unkind suggestion.
If you are planning to leave your luggage behind and go on an excursion, you should only be aware of this.

author: Mia A
title: VERY CONVENIENT FOR GARE DU NORD
text:
I stayed here for three nights and it was a short walk from the station. It’s well located for other transport and walking in a busy part of Paris but, once inside, the hotel was quiet. It was a decent price for summer in Europe.

I had a strangely shaped room with the bed jutting out diagonally into the room. With no luggage rack, I had no choice but to put my suitcase open on the floor at the base of the bed and my carry-on was open on the wedge of shelf above the bed!
There was a wardrobe, fridge, TV, kettle w coffee & tea plus a small espresso machine, however, you only get two pods per stay with extras available for purchase from reception. However, make a quick trip to Aldi across the road and you’ll be set!
The ‘work desk’ was a struggle to use as it was wedged in-between the wardrobe and the fridge. I kept scratching my leg on the cabinet of the fridge whenever I sat there, which unfortunately was a lot!
The washroom was nice with a good shower, toiletries and towels. The wall-attached hairdryer was powerful. However, there was nowhere to hang the hand-towel to dry, so I draped it over the hairdryer!
There is a water dispenser in the lobby with flat and fizzy options. Breakfast is available onsite for a fee.

author: Aaron O
title: Exceptional stay
text: Proximity to the train and general location is perfect. Beautiful boutique hotel with caring friendly staff, cozy and sparkly clean

author: William W
title: Great budget experience
text:
The hotel is good value for money. The gentleman at the front desk was very polite and welcoming. 
The room is a tad bit small but it’s value for what you pay for if you don’t mind a bit of siren noise now and again then it’s fine. It’s also pretty close to the train station. 
The only thing I would like to suggest is for the hotel to prompt guests to keep noise levels down. This is because I had noisy neighbors who were very loud in their talking and gisting , which is fine however they kept it going well into the night thankfully, I was working so it wasn’t too bad for me to cope with however, when I was getting ready to go to sleep, it did get a bit annoying. Other than that I think it’s good value for money

author: Owen Q
title: Good but to improve mold and humidity.
text:
Great location 5 minutes from Gar du Nord which connects well all Paris and airports. The staff was very kind.
The room and bathroom were very small and there was a strong smell of damp and musty (visible even on some walls of the room). Despite this the cleanliness was good.

author: Thomas Q
title: A simple room to feel good
text: Cozy room a really nice person, excellent bedding, furniture and sockets, hyper functional lights, impeccable cleanliness, also in the bathroom. Shower with super flow, top. Only criticism: the shower door closes badly and the excellent shower gel is not hung on the wall but placed on the floor.

author: Sophia P
title: Perfect base for Parisian adventures
text: Well situated property, short walk from 2 main train stations.  Clean, comfortable room - perfect for 1.  Shops and restaurants nearby.  Pleasant and helpful staff.  Recommended.

author: Owen E
title: Hotel Opera Melia
text: Very nice and centrally located hotel. The receptionist Ivan is a true professional and always very pleasant.

author: Abigail W
title: Excellent location and quality
text: We will surely repeat. The breakfast is small but very complete and delicious.  Excellent room with a terrace on the top floor and exceptional staff… Ishara is a delight who helped us with everything. Nothing bad to say…. The location is unbeatable. A place not to be forgotten….

author: Aiden P
title: Our week at Hotel Paris Opera - Exceeded our expectations!
text:
My husband and I spent a week at Hotel Paris Opera Affiliated by Meliá and had an excellent stay. From the moment we arrived, the staff welcomed us warmly. Our room included a lovely welcome gift of chilled Cava, cookies, a tote bag, and a handwritten note.
Ishara at the front desk was outstanding—he recommended restaurants and attractions, booked tickets and reservations, and at the end of our stay walked my husband through Uber and gave clear instructions for navigating Heathrow. His calm help gave us real peace of mind.
We had some noise the first two nights, but the front desk quickly upgraded us to a quiet corner room. The location is ideal, with many sights, restaurants, cafés, and Galeries Lafayette within a short walk. The lobby and breakfast area were always clean and bright, the queen size bed was very comfortable, and housekeeping kept our room fresh daily.
The room was small (as expected in central Paris), and we missed having better TV/streaming options, but overall the value exceeded our expectations. A big shoutout to Ishara—his attentiveness made our stay exceptional. We’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

author: Rosie B
title: Family trip
text:
The best part was the location, a very good area with all services nearby.
As for the rooms, we took 2, we were traveling as a family, worse impossible. Small, they faced an interior patio, terrible ventilation, very unpleasant smell of humidity. Located on the top floor, not comfortable at all.

author: Manon S
title: Great Hotel/Staff!
text: Hotel Paris Opera by Melia was an excellent hotel to stay in! It was so close to many tourist sites in Paris and was a great place to feel like a local. There were so many good restaurants near by and the hotel was very clean. The staff was extremely helpful, especially Ishara who went out of his way to help us on numerous occasions. We highly recommend this hotel and cannot thank Ishara enough for his help with directing us on how to get to each of our tourist locations. Thank you again!

author: Joseph E
title: Hotel Opera, yes!
text: Everyone very nice and helpful, especially the concierge Ishara. Coffee always available and very good! Yay! Really comfortable there. The room, front desk, lobby all great. Elevators a little small. Not a deal killer.

author: Taylor E
title: Great experience at a perfect hotel
text: A perfect boutique hotel in the Opera District. The room was great, as was breakfast. Having the metro right out front is incredibly convenient. The service is fantastic and Ishara, the concierge, is AMAZING. We had a great time during our stay there.

author: Marco V
title: Great stay in Paris
text: We really enjoyed our stay. Great location, room was very pleasant. We were greeted by Ishara who helped us with planning our stay and navigating the Metro. The staff was very helpful and friendly.

author: Jessica C
title: Beautiful hotel, great staff
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Paris Opera for the second time for my wife's birthday.
This time it was very nice again. The building is old and full of charm.
The location on the Grand Boulevard, right at the subway station, is great for exploring Paris from here.
There are also good restaurants within walking distance in the area.
The breakfast at the hotel is also good and plentiful.
Above all, however, the staff is super service-oriented, nice, and competent.
I would especially like to highlight Aurora Borrego, Front Office Manager, who recommended a great arrangement (Romantic Package) for my wife's birthday and implemented it wonderfully. My wife had to shed a few tears of joy and emotion.

author: Oliver N
title: Great city hotel in a fantastic location
text:
We were at the Hotel Opéra Paris for the second time. The location is simply perfect; you can reach many things on foot, and for longer distances, you can use the metro right outside the door. Our room was very nice, and the breakfast also offers a large selection! The croissants in particular are perfect! 
Many thanks to the concierge Ishara, to Aurora, and the entire team at the reception, who fulfilled all our wishes and were always so nice.

author: Carlos H
title: Great place to stay
text: Hotel is very nice, clean, comfortable.   We had a suite.  2 twins and a master.  It was very accommodating.   We were greated by Ishara who told us about the area and made suggestions for entertainment and restaurants.    Very friendly and helpful.

author: Andrea C
title: Value for money in a perfect location!
text:
Great location, right in the heart of Paris. Most major sights are within a reasonable walking distance, and there's also a metro stop right outside the door, so you're never far from anywhere else you want to go.

The reception staff were friendly and welcoming throughout our stay. Our room was bright and spacious for Parisian standards, spotlessly clean, and the bed was wonderfully comfortable. The toilet was on the small side, but I actually liked that it was separate from the bathroom, a nice practical touch.

As a Gold member, I was recognized with a handwritten welcome card and a small treat waiting in the room, a lovely personal touch that didn't go unnoticed.

The neighborhood itself is full of cozy bistros and brasseries, perfect for evenings out after a day of sightseeing. 

All in all, a hotel I'd happily recommend and stay at again.

author: Benjamin S
title: I felt at home!
text:
I admit I had some reservations: in Paris, I have always stayed on Rue de Caumartin.  Today I say that I will return to this hotel! Excellent location, right in front of the Grand Boulevard Metro stop. No problems in the evening, the area is full of venues where we were able to enjoy French cuisine and the Parisian summer nightlife. Well-equipped and clean rooms. 
A special compliment to Ishara and the breakfast staff. Breakfast worthy of a 5-star hotel!   It is very convenient to book with breakfast included! Thank you and goodbye!

author: Lucas U
title: Great visit to Paris
text: Very good value for money. Incredible location for great price. Rooms and linen fresh and clean. The staff went out of their way to help. Ishara especially helpful and lovely to chat with. He is an asst to your business.

author: Hannah C
title: Good experience
text:
Hotel very well located, with the subway stop at the door and taxi stand.
Very good breakfast.
It is worth noting the willingness of the staff, especially Ivan, who helped us make the stay wonderful and advised us so that we could enjoy the city as much as possible.

author: Alice Z
title: J'Adore Paris!
text: Located in the 2nd arrondissement of Paris, it is centrally located with easy access to the major sites of this beautiful city. With many bars, cafes, grocery stores, wine shops, restaurants, and patisserie shops, there's plenty of easy access to any food you can hope for. The rooms are not extravagant but clean and cozy. The price of the rooms were quite reasonable considering the location.  Giovanni and Ishara were of extraordinary help and were always available to help and to answer questions.

author: Juan Z
title: Good experience
text: Good location and good service.

author: Evan K
title: We loved it!
text: Ishara was absolutely wonderful. He went out of his way to make sure we had the best experience in Paris. The entire staff was helpful and friendly. Very clean. Great location. We really enjoyed our stay!

author: Charlie U
title: Great hotel, fantastic service
text: Our experience at Hotel Opera Paris was excellent. The room was comfortable and well equipped, and the service was fantastic. Ishara took extra care to find us activities we wanted to do, and checked in each day to make sure everything was going well. We also received a bottle of bubbles and some macarons which was a lovely touch! The location is great too, easy to get to all the main attractions

author: Olivia S
title: Aussies in Paris 🇫🇷🥖
text: Excellent Service, Friendly Staff. Ishara was very helpful with recommendations and very informative. If you are looking to stay here, would definitely recommend. Central to most iconic monuments.

author: Lea B
title: A Montmartre Gem – Wonderful Hotel & Exceptional Staff
text:
I write this review with genuine sincerity.

The wonderful staff at Timhotel Montmartre have this week accommodated the smallest of requests for a dear friend who is staying there on my recommendation. They have been so patient with the time difference, so obliging with my requests, and wonderfully accommodating in arranging a small gift and note for her.

My uncle has stayed at Timhotel for many, many years, and I too have had the pleasure of staying there.

If you choose to stay in Montmartre — always my favourite part of Paris — Timhotel is a wonderful choice. The views are magnificent, whether of the beautiful street life below or across the rooftops of Paris.

My sincere thanks to the wonderful staff, particularly Eliza and Yazid, who have moved mountains to make my dear friend happy upon her arrival today. Sometimes the smallest gestures mean the most.

Thank you once again 

Simone

author: Ana Y
title: Worth Booking a Room with a View!
text: We loved our stay here and had an amazing view of the Eiffel Tower! The staff were friendly and helpful. Hotel is in a part of Paris with lots of character! Air conditioning works well and can be adjusted to your liking. Friendly staff. Our room was cleaned daily which you don’t always get in the United States.

author: Gavin C
title: Small and nice
text:
Great location, as already mentioned so often 
Room as expected very small, especially the bathroom
But very clean and even equipped with air conditioning

author: Benjamin T
title: Big disappointment.
text:
We are regular customers and we hesitated for a long time before sharing our disappointment with you. Not because of the service, but because of the lack of commercial spirit during the mishap that happened to us following the cancellation of our train (for which we were in no way responsible and which we learned about on the 23rd) and the lack of listening on your part to postpone our stay from 06/28 to 06/29 by one day or to obtain a refund, even though we had booked and paid on 3/8 (210.06€, a supposedly more advantageous price but non-refundable, according to your receptionist, even though she offered us to pay about 189€ again..., quite contradictory remarks). We received no proposal or start of a solution. The only answer given was: " “We have instructions.” Under these conditions, I think we will never set foot in one of your hotels again, and you can count on us to give you (bad) publicity unless you make a commercial gesture...
Mr. & Mrs. Vanantwerpen-Somers

author: Chloe G
title: June 2026
text:
Got a room without working AC, had to change after two days AC worked but the toilet was so small that you could not sit straight with your legs but sat crookedly on the toilet minimal shower area, old carpets where it was not cleaned properly….bad to hang clothes when there was a lack of a rod for the closet….no vegetables for breakfast, a kind of bread ran out…location good!
We will never come back…

author: Marta J
title: Shabby and in need of elementary maintenance
text:
We have just spent four nights at the Timhotel, Montmatre.
The staff – especially the room cleaners and the kitchen staff – are friendly and doing a really good job.
However, the hotel appears shabby and in need of elementary maintenance:
The facade is dirty, wet and uninviting.
Roof gutters are stuffed with debry and water is not lead into the drain during rain. Instead it just spills over hitting the facade and sidewalk below.
A dead pigeon was laying on the sidewalk in front of the hotel during our entire stay. It looked more and more macabre for each day. I bet it is still there!
 The fire alarm started early one morning at 7-7:15 pm sending everybody out of bed, into some basic clothes and down the stairs. There was no fire, no explanation was given.
The doors to the stairwell make a lot of noise when closing.  I sleept less than 2 meters from the door on fifth floor and awakened from sleep in evenings and mornings. Why does the door pump close the doors with such loud noises when it can be done completely silent?
The shower grate was broken off and loose and need replacement. The cleaning staff kept putting it back thereby making showering dangerous and slippery.

author: Daisy W
title: Hotel in Montmartre
text: We stayed 4 nights in this hotel in the Montmartre area, just steps from the Sacré-Cœur and the metro station. The structure appears dated with some maintenance needs; however, the simple room is adequate in size, in line with a hotel of that category. Decent sweet and savory breakfast. Efficient air conditioning, although noisy. Not the cheapest cost.

author: Lauren Z
title: Lovely location and friendly staff.
text: The location of this hotel is perfect, you are situated in the lovely Montmartre, a stones throw away from the Sacré-Cœur. The hotel rooms are basic but for a three star hotel it is as expected. The air conditioning in the rooms worked well and the beds are comfortable. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful, they ordered taxis for us on multiple occasions ensuring we had the taxi registration number and name so that we could find these safely and quickly.

author: Leo W
title: Great location. Comfortable.
text:
Comfortable room, bathroom well.
Only downside the welcome on Sunday morning, the lady hardly kind to the welcome who does not answer when we say hello .....

author: Olivia T
title: Very nice and good location!!!
text: The facilities are very welcoming, the staff are very friendly and ready to help everything, the room we stayed in had everything you need, besides a beautiful view, the location in safe area and easy access to metro stations. cafes, restauramtes and tourist places of Montmartre. We loved it!!!

author: Kyle I
title: Nice Hotel
text: The hotel was in a quiet location very convenient for metro stations.  Very clean and staff very friendly and helpful

author: Jessica O
title: Ideal location
text:
This was a perfectly situated location for the Elysee and other attractions. We also walked to other locations such as the St Martin Canal. 

The room was comfortable and had extra pillows. Everything was clean and  the bed was comfortable, which I don't always find. 

The only improvements I would make is for additional tea products and the staff to engage a little more.

author: Camille M
title: Timhotel
text: We stayed in the Timhotel for 3 nights, the staff weren’t particularly welcoming which was surprising given the reviews and if we tried to ask for anything we were met with a disappointing reaction which left us feeling bad to ask for anything. The room was also right next to the stairs which is disappointing particularly as I told the hotel we were travelling for a birthday so you’d hope for a nice quiet room. On the other hand, the hotel was incredibly clean and in a brilliant location that is easy to get to from the station. I overall wouldn’t come back here as there is such competition in Paris for hotels and could easily find a more suitable option

author: Diego F
title: Great location 👍
text: The hotel is great. Very good location. Worth a visit again and again. Staff are friendly and helpful.

author: Oliver F
title: Birthday trip to Paris
text: Recommended by a friend, this hotel was well located on a quiet street near to two well connected metro stations, and only 8-10mins walk from Sacre Coeur. It was beautifully clean and tidy and the breakfast was one of the best I have had in equivalent hotels. We had a room with a view - as it was to celebrate a special birthday - and we were not disappointed with the fabulous view of the Eiffel Tower and Paris Cityscape. Would highly recommend and will definitely consider staying here again!

author: Jack R
title: small cozy hotel in Montmartre
text: cozy and man-sized hotel, very well located to radiate to different places of interest

author: Evie V
title: A cuddle in the heart of Montmartre
text: A pampering in the heart of Montmartre, the hotel is located at Place Emile Goudeau in a quiet and central location in the heart of the 18th arrondissement is reachable a few hundred meters from a couple of metro stations, spotless, friendly and friendly staff; great value for money, it is already the 3rd time I choose it for my stay in Paris as a couple or family.

author: Chloe O
title: Very nice hotel in a quiet location and yet in a very lively area
text:
Very nice hotel in a quiet and yet very lively area.
Good breakfast, nice room.
A huge thank you to the breakfast ladies who by their smiles and professionalism make us in a good mood in the morning.

author: Jack L
title: Brilliant place from which to explore Paris
text: This was a 5 day stay for a very special occasion, the hotel's location is excellent - we got a fabulous "up the hill" view of the Sacre Couer, its 5 mins from Abbesses (Get the lift up and down with your bags) and it's a brilliant place to start and end walks exploring all around Montmartre, even down to the Seine and back..The staff are very friendly and efficient. The room was cosy, well equipped and well looked after. Breakfast was excellent with a wide hot and cold selection and late service. Our special requests were met . Nothing adverse to report.

author: Harper X
title: From the Philippines.
text: This accomodation is an excellent choice for a backpacker tourist. The room where I stayed was so cozy and comfortable. The location, sceneries, bars, cafes, cobblestones including the rudeness of some french people around it gave me a perfect Parisian experience.

author: Ruby C
title: Recommended!
text:
Small but clean and functional hotel, centrally located, convenient for walking around. Our room 303 was small but perfect, with a very clean bathroom and linens. Varied breakfast with sweet and savory options, drinks from the machine were not bad, overall very good.
A special thanks to Peter at the reception, kind, helpful, and always ready to lend a hand, giving advice to make you feel at home. I recommend this hotel!!

author: Sydney G
title: Professional stay
text:
Very nice stay at this hotel! The establishment is ideally located, in a quiet street, which allows you to enjoy a peaceful environment while remaining central
The staff is friendly, the room: you feel at ease right away.
I recommend without hesitation

author: Zoe Z
title: Timmhotel Palais Royal
text: The normal rooms are very small. The accessible room is very large with separate hotel access and accessible shower. It is recommended to electrify the room door as it is very heavy and closes independently and to hang a shower curtain in the bathroom.

author: Jessica G
title: just for one night
text:
medium, tiny shower, room difficult to pass if 2 people. well located
The air conditioning didn't work, you bastard in the room
For breakfast, perime yogurt for two days

author: Ryan E
title: A comfortable stay at Christmas
text:
We were looking for a hotel for a quiet Christmas holiday in Paris and found Timhotel Palais Royal has a perfect location in the center of Paris and we must say that we are very satisfied and happy with the services and kindness of the staff.

Highly recommended

author: Emma X
title: Hotel well located and well maintained.
text: Upon arrival at the hotel, the welcome is pleasant and attentive. Impression of clean, bright. Very decent room, with a small flat: a shelf, the angle of which should be rounded or softened, which has skinned my scalp.

author: Lauren M
title: Paris Family Holiday
text: Excellent Hotel close to all Paris attractions and transport. We appreciated the opportunity to leave our bags the last day before departure but above all we will remember the kindness of Peter to the very friendly friendly and friendly welcome.

author: Daniel T
title: TRAVEL REVIEWS
text: The room was functional, the staff very welcoming and accommodating. Thanks to them. The location was also perfect. I recommend.

author: Diego I
title: Excellent location, very clean. The building is poorly insulated and thus you will hear garbage trucks nightly.
text: The room size is as expected for Paris. The bathroom shower was on the claustrophobic side and despite closing the small cavity tightly, the bathroom floor was always soaking wet when showering. The water pressure was low and not as hot as I would like it. Beds were comfortable. Bedding was clean and warm. The noise at night was unbearably loud for me due to constant garbage pick up. I think the windows are old and do not provide any soundproofing. Although a budget hotel, well located, clean and comfortable bed…if you value a shower and need a quiet room….this hotel is not for you.

author: Harper X
title: A pleasant establishment
text: The room although small, and the staff are fine but the breakfast could be greatly improved.

author: Chloe A
title: Price - performance not given at all
text: My only highlight was the comfy bed, otherwise totally uncommon, noisy and also not really clean. Between the bed and the wall were towers of dust and waste (had only looked there because I was looking for sockets in vain). Socket sockets are only available at the "desk".

author: Sydney P
title: Stay in Paris
text:
Good place, well located. Nice staff.
The services offered and the hotel correspond to a three star rating. We will be happy to come back to that.

author: Zoe I
title: Nothing like the pic and unprofessional manager
text:
We booked a double room six months ago and when checked in it was nothing like the picture. It’s dark, small, the window is facing the a back blank wall, it’s  filthy, toilet roll was half left, shampoo and stuffs are half way down. It was the day after our engagement, and we felt absolutely disappointed the moment we walked into the room. 

After we reflected to the receptionist, a gentlemen who was very helpful, we were told that the manger gave us one breakfast each to make up for it (we stayed for six nights and we had to move after two nights to a better room), we reflected our disappointment to the manager (an older man). And he spent good ten minutes trying to prove the point that ‘you don’t always get what you see’ rather than putting any sort of effort to make us feel welcome at all. After we insisted, he then agreed to give us the second breakfast. Despite the inconvenience that we needed to move the room during the stay, the man was holding the grudge the entire stay too - no greetings unless we greeted him first. 

I certainly won’t book here again if coming back to Paris but just want to let whoever wants to book here know, you don’t have a clue what you paid for (not the picture for sure).

author: Leo J
title: Small stay in Paris
text: Very well located hotel (near the museum Grevin, Olympia ....) nicely decorated, the staff is very nice.Very good breakfast.

author: Aaron L
title: stay Paris
text: We will return to this hotel and recommend it to our friends, as the hotel is clean the very friendly staff listening and in addition this hotel is well located;-) the top.

author: Lucas K
title: Restaurant visit
text: Restaurant typical of Paris - great Mood - good food - friendly and competent service.

author: Owen X
title: 10/10 Recommend!
text: Loved staying at this property! Location was perfect. Walkable to the Louvre and surrounding areas. Great restaurants and shops nearby. Cute little balconettes. Hotel has an elevator, which is hard to come by in Paris! Staff was lovely and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

author: Rosie C
title: Paris in August
text: Excellent. Rates are interesting at this time of year. Too bad that this is not the case in October

author: Chloe K
title: 10 out of 10
text: I had the most amazing experience at the Timhotel. Clean rooms with a beautiful balcony view, great breakfast  and exceptional service. I want to give a special shoutout to Sammy at the front desk that made sure our stay was perfect! I recommend this hotel to anyone looking to stay at a convenient place is Paris!

author: Nathan L
title: 3 nights at Timhotel
text: Excellent location! Close to metro station. Fresh and basic breakfast. Excellent reception service. The rooms are a little small, but organized and clean

author: Zoe W
title: A fabulous hotel with just the best staff
text:
What a tremendous “find”, this quaint hotel, is not the biggest but it has a real heart…its staff!
The staff are tremendous, nothing is too much bother, always a happy smiling disposition!
Reception lady when checked in was so helpful and set the tone for the rest of the stay giving useful advice when asked.
The breakfast was thoroughly enjoyable especially sat outside in the courtyard. Excellent food, good selection available that accounted for all tastes. The ladies preparing and serving the food were just fantastic, full of laughter and beaming smiles.
I really do recommend this hotel, great location close to a splendid little restaurant ( a must go to!) and close to all transport (around the corner from the Duplex M station) making accessing Paris a breeze.

author: Ella D
title: Street noise a problem.
text: I spent 3 nights here in May. it was a single room which had a double bed in it which was great. the staff were all really helpful and friendly. the breakfast buffet had a great selection of food particularly if you had gluten or dairy intolerances. its located a few minutes walk from several metro stations and is about 12 minutes walk from the Eiffel Tower. All very positive however I got little to no sleep due to street noise. Deliveries to surrounding businesses and what sounded like construction work left me still awake at 5am. Rue Juge is not a quiet street. If i had known it would continue like that for 3 nights I would have requested to change rooms if there was availability. Disappointed and frustrated.

author: Anna G
title: Bad experience
text:
There are 4 of us, 2 adults and 2 11-year-olds... 2 rooms booked as there are no quadruple rooms available 
A room on the first floor that looked like a closet with an even smaller bathroom where the shower cubicle touched the siphon closing it 
A room on the ground floor next to the reception (imagine the comings and goings of people) with a disabled bathroom where there is at least one curtain for shower...
Good breakfast... but not even a placemat on the tables 
In brackets to go to the first floor or use the stairs or an elevator for 1 person 
Price not justified although close to the Seine and Eiffel Tower

author: Thomas O
title: Suggestions
text: The hotel said it had a view for the Tower and it's not true.  The staff did not want to help for the mistake of the rooms.

author: Freya M
title: TimHotel Tour Eiffel
text:
Very nice room, wonderful view from the sixth floor
The staff was very nice with me and my boyfriend, always smiling! 
The breakfast was perfect!!

author: Daniel A
title: I like I like!
text: The staff is really nice and attentive. The rooms are very well cleaned, really it was great 👍🏻

author: William M
title: Good overall
text: Good place to stay if you plan to just sleep in the room as the room is too small,  o much space for your stuff,  the location of the hotel is perfect near the tour Eiffel, the bathroom is a little smelly

author: Sophia D
text: The location was good walking distance from Eiffel towel ( though no view from my room) . Th room was clean though the bathroom was small . the only downside was the lady at the front desk who was sooo grumpy when I checked in

author: Megan Q
title: SHORT SUCCESSFUL STAY
text:
Excellent value for money for this good hotel.
The rooms, although a little small, are comfortable.

author: Charlie T
title: Small holiday in Paris in a superior double room
text: We stayed at this hotel for our little holiday in Paris as the location of the hotel is great and has a good value for money. Overall we enjoyed it very much, the staff is very kind. The only downside we found was the cleanliness of the room... it was always very good except on a day when, when we returned to the room in the afternoon, the bed had not been fixed and on top there was one of the towels from before. Apart from this I recommend this property, overall we enjoyed it very much!

author: Isla S
title: To escape.
text: Disastrous. For 145 euros, a room with a brown carpet, with an old wardrobe and a nice smell of closed. The tiny bathroom (do not sit on the toilet as you will not be able to close the door, your knees touching it). When you open the shower door, there's a pestilent smell coming. Then, an air conditioning noise that goes off every 20 minutes. And I keep the icing on the cake: bedding underneath everything!  Anyway, run! One advantage, the location in a rather nice and lively neighborhood.

author: Holly A
title: Hotel close to everything, wonderful staff!
text:
Tim Hotel is located in 15th Arrondissement
The location is excellent!
We can walk to the Eiffel Tower.
Various restaurants, pizzeria, supermarkets, boulangerie, patisserie and subway.
From our room we have the view of the Tower, we stayed at 62.
Which makes me give 4☆, the room is very small, small bed we didn't get twins beds.
Excellent breakfast!
This staff makes all the difference, we will never forget the affection of Anca at breakfast, mother's affection.
Flavia, Tatiana, Said and David from the reception Wonderful!
They made our days happy!

author: Katie B
title: Temizlik
text: When we entered the room, we examined the toilet and there was the previous guest's poop in the toilet. I have a photo of it, I can send it if you'd like.

author: Daisy E
title: Great value Eiffel Tower view
text: Fantastic hotel, great value for money and watching the tower from bed is amazing. Highly recommended if you want a tower view without paying a fortune.

author: Ruby H
title: First night in this hotel
text:
Nice night, very good quality, very warm and kind Welcoming.
Listen.

Recommended +++
Melanie

author: Harry U
title: Brilliant hotel
text:
My friend and I couldn’t have wished for a better hotel.  Very close to Eiffel Tower with restaurants and local shops just around the corner. Being disabled, I was advised in advance of the best room and it couldn’t have been better.  Comfortable bed and very clean.  All the staff were amazing and couldn’t have helped us more.  We would highly recommend them 
Thank you staff of the Timhotel Tour Eiffel for making our stay so memorable and special.

author: Manon J
title: Rudest staff I’ve ever met.
text: I have nothing negative to say about the hotel and the room. But the staff was incredibly rude and disappointing. The man running the front desk this morning was INSANELY rude to my friends and I. I would never stay here again, for fear of dealing with this individual again.

author: Morgan N
title: Visit to Paris
text:
We had a great time staying at Timhotel Tour Eiffel. The room was clean and staff are wonderful. However the corridor and lift are too small. 
The breakfast lady Anca served us with smiles every morning. 
A big thank you to receptionist Chonden for giving us a clear direction to travel around by train.

author: Zoe X
title: Okay For Cost
text:
It was an okay stay for the cost. Location was nice because it was near Dupleix, but I wish I had stayed closer to the center of the city. The room itself is very very small. The bathroom had a sliding door with no privacy/soundproof whatsoever, and there were cracks so you could see in. The shower was clogged and was not fixed even after we had stated it to the front desk. 
It did come with a lot of amenities such as a shoe shine, toothbrush, shower caps, shaving set, slippers, and bathrobes. The toothbrush set we were given had been previously opened and the toothpaste was missing. There was also a free water machine for cold and sparkling water.
The staff were friendly, though!

author: Holly Y
title: Avoid this hotel at all costs!
text:
This was undoubtedly one of the worst hotel experiences ever. From the moment of arrival, we were confronted with hidden extra costs that were nowhere clearly stated — pure deception.
The room was small, outdated and poorly maintained. There was mold in the bathroom, the ventilation was worthless and the water pressure in the shower almost nonexistent.
In addition, there were obvious hygiene problems: itchy bits indicated vermin, and dead insects were also lying around in the bathroom. This is unacceptable and dangerous.
Noise pollution was constant making sleep impossible.
The staff were indifferent and unfriendly; complaints were hardly taken seriously and if you raised anything, you only got standard, empty answers without any action.
Canceling was impossible, so you're stuck with this nightmare. Management shows no responsibility at all and refuses to adequately address problems.
This hotel is a real pitfall and I warn everyone: look everywhere else but stay away!
We raised these issues during and after our stay at the hotel, but only received standard responses without any actual solution or responsibility. This total lack of action completely destroys trust.

author: Lucy G
title: Excellent service, Mr. Rocco Modesti is great.
text: An excellent location in the center of Rome across from Termini Station, qualified and kind staff, in particular Mr. Rocco Modesti who puts guests at ease, offering the best services that the property provides, which are quite numerous. Elegant, well-structured, and air-conditioned rooms, with excellent bathroom facilities, free Wi-Fi, and everything else, breakfast and dining services for all tastes. I highly recommend it both for individuals and for those traveling with family.

author: Liam I
title: Rome experience
text: I was a little worried about the location but never had a problem. Transport was practically on our doorstep. Although the hotel is quite old we were comfortable and we can ot fault the hospitality we received.

author: Wyatt M
title: HOTEL COROT ROME
text:
we use it a lot as a company for our staff in transit through Rome
easy to reach
located in a strategic and convenient spot next to Roma Termini train station
ideal for a pleasant stop while waiting for your next trip or a meeting
you can reach tourist or shopping spots on foot such as Via Nazionale or Via Veneto 
welcoming but simple environment, everything clean and staff courteous and always available...excellent in everything
I send friends and relatives and no one ever has a complaint or service issue
WELL DONE

author: Diego K
title: The visit was for work, but I would return every time.
text: I spent 4 nights at this hotel and had a great time. Excellent welcome, excellent hotel, very kind and helpful staff, excellent location near the station.  I will definitely return and I recommend it to you.

author: Marta T
title: Very decent
text:
Very decent hotel, we were worried after all the negative reviews we read at the last moment. But once again, that was unfounded. We then stayed at a hotel in Pisa and a hotel in Florence, and neither matched the Corot. So, indeed, you have to ask at the reception to turn on the air conditioning, or at least to adjust it, but once you know the technique, it’s very quick. The staff is very nice, except for one young woman; the gentlemen speak French, and the blonde lady is simply adorable. The brunette lady at breakfast is the same ☺️. Breakfast is classic: bread, croissant, toast; for fruits, it’s either canned or fresh apples, but then there’s a hot drink dispenser. We are indeed facing the Termini station (personally, I live in Paris, so I found it relatively calm 😂). There is a wide choice of restaurants nearby; we actually ate several evenings at Julie’s, a little further away where the owner has some nice anecdotes to share about the flame in Beijing,
Regarding the hotel, the bathroom is perfect, I liked the vintage side, the room is basic; personally, we just ask for a decent bed to sleep. The curtains are very blackout, and there are shutters behind; no power outage between June 25 and June 29. Honestly, we recommend it without fuss (ps: wifi is fine in the rooms and the elevator is fine for 2 adults, 2 large suitcases, 2 backpacks, and 1 banana 😅 honestly, $100 a night for 2 on a trip, that’s not asking too much)

author: Rosie P
title: Perfect location
text: Initially I was a little concerned that we were so close to the train station...that it would be noisy and unsafe at night....however, we never felt unsafe and our sons visited late bars and got back without any issues.  There were a couple of power cuts but these did not have a negative impact on our stay. The staff were helpful and friendly.  Perfect location for trains and metro making it super easy to navigate your way around the city. There are some lovely restaurants close to the hotel with friendly staff and customers where we enjoyed the evening chatting with other diners.

author: Lily Y
title: Perfect location
text:
Lovely hotel with very friendly and helpful staff. Perfectly located near the train station so very convenient for hopping on the train and metro to get around Rome. There were a couple of power cuts but this didn't affect our stay. I was a little concerned before staying there as I was worried the neighbourhood may be unsafe being located so close to the station but we didn't see anything negative.  Our sons ventured out to late bars and were absolutely fine.
Some lovely restaurants close by with great food and friendly staff and customers

author: Noah J
title: Perfect base to explore Rome
text:
First of all, this hotel is very old and dated. If you are looking for luxury, this is not the place for you.

The room was adequate for the three nights we stayed, but the mattress was very hard. On the surface, the hotel appeared clean, with fresh towels and sheets, but a closer look showed that it could benefit from a deep clean.
The plug sockets beside the beds did not work, so we pulled the fridge out to look for another outlet. There was at least a year's worth of dust on top of it, which suggests that area had not been cleaned for a very long time.

However, this is a budget hotel and it does have a lot of positives. The location is excellent, just a few steps from the station, with convenient links to all parts of the city by train, metro, and bus.
The staff were all lovely and friendly, and the continental breakfast was adequate to set us up for the day.

All in all, I would recommend this hotel if you're looking for an affordable base from which to explore this beautiful city. While it may not offer luxury accommodations, its excellent location, friendly staff, and good transport links make it a practical choice for a city break.

author: Sean R
title: Excellent stay!
text: Excellent hotel just steps from Termini station. The staff was always on duty and very helpful. Definitely would come back.

author: Evie Z
title: Great budget stay
text: Perfect location a few steps away from Termini train station so you can access all public transport easily to get around the city. This hotel has a lift, although pretty small. It fits 3 people without luggage. The staff is very friendly. You need to pay local tourist tax on arrival. Room was ready before check-in. Room was big enough for 3 people. There was a fridge which is very handy for drinks and snacks. Rooms and bathrooms are a little dated but we did not expect much for the price we paid for our stay. Room was cleaned every day to a good standard. Breakfast was continental with a selction of meats, cheese, breads, jams, cereal etc. Coffee was great with several options to choose from (self service machine). Noise levels from outside are a little high when the window was open due to location. Noise levels in hotel were great, we didn't have any issues. All in a great budget hotel.  The only thing I really had an issue with was the hardness of the bed, they could invest in more comfortable toppers/mattresses maybe to make them a little softer.

author: Morgan X
title: Hotel Corot Rome – Simple, Clean, and Perfectly Located by the Station
text:
I stayed at Hotel Corot for one night during my visit to Rome, and it worked well as a practical, budget-friendly option.

The main reason I chose this hotel was its location, and it definitely delivers on that. It’s right next to Roma Termini, which makes it extremely convenient if you’re arriving late, leaving early, or using Rome as part of a wider itinerary. Having the main transport hub just a short walk away removes a lot of stress, especially with luggage.

The hotel itself is fairly basic, but it was clean and comfortable, which is exactly what I needed for a one-night stay. The room had everything required for a short visit, and while it’s not modern or luxurious, it offers good value for money given the central location.

Because I was only there for one night, I didn’t spend much time using any additional facilities, but for a quick stopover it did the job perfectly. The surrounding area also has plenty of places to eat and grab essentials, which adds to the convenience.
I would recommend Hotel Corot for travellers looking for an affordable, no-frills hotel in a very central location. If your priority is convenience, cleanliness, and easy access to transport, it’s a solid choice for a short stay in Rome.

author: Freya X
title: Rome stopover
text: Overnight stay in Rome, excellent location opposite Rome termini and close to shuttle bus for airport, and also to jump on the hop on hop off bus for sightseeing, staff all lovely snd very helpful, continental breakfast tasty snd plentiful, would definitely recommend

author: Olivia Y
title: Comfortable and safe
text: 100m. from the termini station that takes you everywhere and leaves you the Leonardo train that takes you to the airport, very good rooms, very clean, with good air conditioning, the perfect bathroom and breakfast also rich the Italian sausage.

author: Evie Q
title: Great location
text: Whilst a basic hotel, it was clean and the room had everything we needed. We were busy exploring the city so literally just used the room to shower and sleep. The traffic outside can be noisy but was to be expected due to location to busy main roads around the station. Great location due to close proximity of station for getting to and from airport and within walking distance to all main areas of interest. Some lovely restaurants and bars close by. Some confusion on arrival as both Hotel Corot and Hotel Rimini are the same building but with separate receptions. We were on 3rd floor which was fine as steps don’t bother us although there is a small lift. Shower could do to be more powerful but was useable. A great stay in Rome.

author: Luca R
title: Hotel Corot
text: The staff was pleasant and the linens were clean, but the breakfast was very basic, the hotel overall is ok for a one-night stay rather than a longer visit.

author: Daisy W
title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent Stay at Hotel Corot!
text:
We had a wonderful experience at Hotel Corot.  The location couldn’t be better…just steps from Termini Station, making it incredibly convenient for early trains and sightseeing around Rome. The staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful throughout our stay.  Our non-smoking room was clean, fresh with no odors at all.

The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, always ready with a smile and great advice.  When we mentioned we would be checking out before 6 AM and would miss their breakfast, they went above and beyond by packing us a generous breakfast-to-go bag filled with fresh items.  Such thoughtful service made our stay extra special.

Highly recommend Hotel Corot for anyone visiting Rome…great value, perfect location, welcoming staff, fresh breakfast and outstanding hospitality.

author: Poppy P
title: Terrible hotel
text: Description-false, there was no kettle, no coffee, not even a cup, no minibar.  Terrible smell of sewage, which gives you a headache, you can't open the window because there is a cafe downstairs and it's very noisy.  The air conditioning is centralized, you have to call and ask to turn it on.  Very thin walls between the rooms, you can hear your neighbor flushing the toilet, and in the morning from 8 am the rooms are cleaned and there is noise again.  Terrible hotel.  I made a mistake by paying for three nights at once, hotel is not cheap

author: Luke N
title: Great location and staff
text: Absolutely great location and great staff, great for a non-frills stay. Location is great, just a few steps to the main train station, buses to the airport and a metro station. There are supermarkets, restaurants, bars, and shops nearby. The property has an elevator, which helps in a town where not every hotel has an elevator. Good public transportation also nearby. Special thanks to Sabina, very helpful and ready to help. Staff is a matter of fact great in a general way.

author: Alexander I
title: Great location with friendly and helpful staff
text:
I travelled with my son from Saturday 19 until Tuesday 22 July. We were looking for a hotel that was central and allow us to access all the major attractions we were keen to visit Colosseum was 20
Mins was walking. Trevi fountain and Spanish Stairs also within walking distance. 

We were 5 mins walk from hotel to the Tremini station with access to bus, train and subway. This meant we could easily access Vatican City by subway. This would have been an hour walk and as we had museums booked early we did not want to set up off too early by foot. Subway was 6 euro return. Also from airport; we flew into Ciampino, we managed to get a bus direct from
Airport to station for 16 euro for both of us. I believe a taxi was 55euro. It was a quick walk from station to hotel. 

Hotel was nice. Basic but had everything we needed. Very clean and room cleaned everyday with fresh towels each day. We did not spend much time in the room as we had so much to do in terms of the site seeing we wanted to do. The staff were extremely helpful and polite on all occasions we interacted. When we arrived the staff seen that we had been allocated a double room and offered to change to a room with a double bed and a single. I get cold at night so the extra cover in the room was perfect. 

I had considered booking a hotel with a pool. Whilst that would have been nice we would not have had time to use this hence Corot was sufficient.

I would recommend this accommodation for those on a city break and would happily stay here again.

author: Michael J
title: Lovely Hotel was a Lifesaver for traveling Anerican
text:
Dear Hotel Corot,

I am writing to offer sincere praise to one of your front desk clerk’s – TINA! During a recent stay in Rome. My spouse and I were accidentally separated at the main terminal train station on June 21st, 2025. My spouse departed on a commuter train to Santa Marinella before I had boarded. Therefore, I was stranded in the terminal without my cellphone/cash/credit cards/ID. For safety reasons – my spouse was carrying everything. I approached the Trenitalia customer service office and local police but neither were able to offer any assistance. As I was attempting to acquire transport back to our hotel where I had available cash/credit cards in the safe – I came upon TINA near your front door who immediately offered assistance. I was quite distressed and without many options. Tina brought me into your air conditioned lobby, contacted my local hotel, offered me water, a bus pass, and even allowed me to call my spouse from her own personal cellphone. We got to know a little about each other as I waited for my spouse to arrive to rescue me. After we were reunited – we discovered once back at our hotel that my spouse had accidentally left his cellphone on the counter of your hotel. Tina took the time to call our hotel to let us know that she would keep the phone safe at the front desk until we were able to come back to retrieve it. Tina was my angel and protector during a very stressful situation. I will remain ever grateful for her genuine kindness. I believe that your hotel is very lucky to have her onboard. Please pass along our best wishes and Thanks to her from Shane in the USA. 

Warm Regards,

Shane Noel & Mike Doner

author: Lucia A
title: Terrific place and restaurant
text: Everyone is so friendly and helpful. We ate at the restaurant and the food was so good. I had the ravioli and my friend had the scallopini.  Both were delicious!!  Tha waiter was very friendly and fun.

author: William V
title: Feedback
text: They are so kind and they are very professional

author: Alice G
title: Best Hilton staff ever!!!
text: I travel extensively for work and spend about 100 nights a year in a hotel and have to say this was the best service I have ever had in a hotel. From the check-in to check-out and everything in between, the staff was second to none. Chiara gave us the best restaurant recommendations and left a little treat in the room for my wife’s birthday. Lorenzo was incredible giving us directions and recommendations for our travel days and hailing us a cab. Flavio worked wonders in the kitchen and Giulia was always there to greet us with a smile. Kudos to this hotel and its wonderful staff. Also the location was incredible. 1 block from the subway, laundromat, grocery store and plenty of top rated restaurants. I can’t recommend this hotel enough for your stay in Rome!!!

author: Lily P
title: Restaurant
text: The Restaurant was great!! Bartender who was also the server and cook was excellent!

author: Ella N
title: An oasis in hot Rome.
text: Everyone from the front desk, bar and restaurent was extremely friendly and most helpful. My wife rented an electric scooter for our stay in Rome. The Hotel staff was very accomodating. The hotel is clean and well kept. Our shower was very refreshing after venturing the hot city. The Spring House was like an oasis next to the Vatican and the Cipro station.  Thanks the Mayo 's from Alabama USA..

author: Lucia M
title: Great Hotel
text: Awesome Hotel and staff. Food was great in the hotel. Confident to many places of interest.

author: William V
title: Thank you
text: As a solo traveller my experience has been great. The front desk girls went far and beyond and they all took care of my needs. Love the atmosphere, great location and lovely rooms.

author: Sofia N
title: Incredible Italian Experience!
text: It was amazing! The service was swift and polite. Food was delicious! Great start to our Roman experience.

author: Louis V
title: Best hotel I have stayed at
text: Staff very attentive to our needs, rooms equipped with everything necessary and tidy. Wide selection of delicious food. I would return to Rome just to stay at this hotel.

author: Megan Y
title: Excellent property a stone's throw from the Vatican!
text:
I booked this hotel for a couple of friends who had a really great time. The property, recently renovated, is welcoming and well-kept, with professional, kind, and always helpful staff.
The terrace with the hot tubs is very beautiful; the rooms are spacious, clean, and equipped with all comforts.
I had the opportunity to have an aperitif with them on the patio on the day of their arrival and the atmosphere was truly pleasant.
Excellent service, I will definitely recommend it again.

author: Paolo R
title: Perfect stay before our cruise 🛳️
text: Adorable and quiet. Front desk ladies were superb! Our room was two levels and sooooo clean and spacious! My parents had their room and got it early which was great after an overnight flight from the US. The breakfast was amazing! I can’t say enough great things. I would recommend it! Far enough from the madness but close enough to take cab. The Vatican is so close.

author: Sean B
title: Outstanding Customer Service
text: I made a critical error with my reservations. I reached out to Francesca in reservations  for assistance. She immediately responded and very quickly corrected my error!  I was in a bit of a panic but she very promptly eased my fears. Thank you Francesca!!!  I look forward to staying at The Spring House next year and am so grateful for the outstanding customer service that I have already received.

author: Katie J
title: Perfect Roman Getaway
text:
Our stay was simply outstanding from start to finish. What truly made The Spring House Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton so special was the exceptional service provided by the staff, always professional welcoming and attentive.
The bar is a fantastic place to relax and drink excellent drinks. We also loved spending time in the patio area, a peaceful oasis as well as the terrace with hot tubs and steam bath.
A truly great experience

author: Chloe H
title: Not a place for families
text:
Pros:
Nice facility
Small but comfortable rooms
Close to the Vatican. 

Negatives:

We were traveling as a family with 2 adults and 3 teenage daughters. Booked 2 rooms for 2 people each for 2 nights as no rooms available for 5 or 3. We’ve done this in Hilton properties in the US and Europe, as the girls are (sometimes) willing to share a king bed for short stays. However, upon checking in, we were told that we could not put our three daughters in the same room that was booked for 2 — per Italian law. So, we were told that we would have to purchase an additional third room.
Ok, if it’s Italian law, then we’ll abide. 
But, they did not have a third room available for our second night, so we would have to find a third room in a different hotel nearby.  Seems like they would understand our situation, but to no avail. 

Second, we purchased some food from a nearby sandwich shop and brought it back to the hotel to eat on their nice outdoor terrace. We didn’t see any signs indicating that we were not allowed to eat there. In fact, we saw signs for how to order food from the hotel restaurant on the empty Terrace. Shortly after starting to eat, an employee emerged and scolded us. We were bluntly told that we were not allowed to have any food from outside unless we ate it in our room.

Third, the next morning, I sent our 2 oldest daughters (age 17,15) down to the breakfast area for our included breakfast (I’m a Hilton Honors Gold member). They gave the host our room number and my name, but they were told they were not allowed to eat breakfast unless I was down there with them. That’s never happened to me at a Hilton-owned property before. Furthermore, the included free breakfast would only apply to two people, even though we booked 3 rooms in their hotel.

Finally, later that evening, my wife and daughters were sitting in the lobby, waiting for me to come downstairs. A hotel employee approached them and asked if they were guests of the hotel and asked to see their room keys. 

Because of these experiences, I can never recommend this hotel.

author: Lea I
title: Really enjoyable stay and lovely staff
text: Very nice stay. Staff were lovely and welcoming and always helpful. The hotel is in a great location with easy access to transport to all parts of the city. AC and cleanliness also good.

author: Sean P
title: Former Best Western
text: Previously a Best Western before Hilton acquired. Clean hotel but not many amenities. Construction in the morning woke us up. Price ok but comparison shop before booking! Had balcony room for extra $$ but not really worth it since you overlook the street.

author: Emma T
title: A Lovely, Relaxed Stay in Rome
text:
Our family of 5 (including a teen and two young adults) thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Hilton Spring House! We chose this location because of its close proximity to Vatican City (about 2 blocks from the museum entrance) and because it was in a quieter part of the city. Vatican City, many excellent restaurants, and lots of shops were walkable from the quiet side street.

Our family had a king deluxe room with a terrace and a 2-story family suite. Both had comfortable beds and adequate mirrors in the living area so that we could all quickly get ready at the same time. The rooms had mini fridges with complimentary water provided. The air conditioning worked great, except it got a little warm in the second story part of the suite. The kids did not realize that it had a separate AC unit at first. And asking housekeeping to keep the ceiling sunshade closed during the day (which they did not realize they could do) would have likely helped, too. But the rooms were overall fantastic!

The 20 euro breakfast buffet was tasty, with kids (under 18) eating free. They were able to provide information about allergens (nuts and shellfish).

The stars of our stay were the super nice and helpful employees! They spoke excellent English and were able to assist us with information about the best transportation plans, changing restaurant reservations, assisting with laundry, and more. 

There is some construction happening at the end of the street. We did not really notice it until the last day when we were “sleeping in” until 7:45. It may have bothered late sleepers more. Of our two rooms, only the room with a balcony facing that direction heard the noise. 

We would highly recommend this hotel to others!

author: Oliver X
title: Nice Hotel, Friendly Staff, but Check the Bill
text:
Nice hotel in a good location, with friendly and helpful staff. A special shoutout to Malick, who was extremely helpful and friendly with the parking during our stay, both when we arrived and when we left.

Our room was small, but properly cleaned, and the bed was comfortable. Overall, the stay itself was pleasant.

The only thing I found a bit unusual was a €24 “staff tip” added to the bill at checkout. It was mentioned quickly, and I only realized it was optional after I asked about it. Since we paid over €750 for two nights, I felt…  I don’t know. Never seen anything like it. 

Apart from that, it was a good stay with a nice location and very friendly service.

author: Taylor F
title: Congratulations
text:
Great stay just steps from the Vatican!
Welcoming, clean, and well-maintained hotel, in a truly strategic location for visiting the Vatican and the center of Rome. Friendly and always available staff, comfortable and quiet rooms. Varied and quality breakfast. A special thank you to all the staff for the professionalism and friendliness shown during the stay. Highly recommended for those seeking comfort, tranquility, and an excellent location. Congratulations!

author: Rosie X
title: “You’re home now”
text: After 10 hours at FCO that resulted in a cancelled flight, we chose this hotel for a one night stay.  We were greeted warmly by Chiara at the front desk who told us “You’re home now” and that’s exactly how we felt.  They handled everything from our bags, dinner recommendations, and ordering a car for the next day!  The hotel amenities were great, room was fantastic, and breakfast was wonderful.  I would definitely come back, and recommend this hotel a short walk to the Vatican!

author: Amelia B
title: Perfect spot in Manhattan
text: Never disappointed by the Arlo.  I stayed here somewhat randomly the first time but it is now one of my go-to spots in NY.  Love the garment district location and the amenities are perfect.  Don’t miss the rooftop deck or the atrium seating just to hang out and enjoy NY.  And use an umbrella if it rains!!

author: Ruby E
title: Theft of deposit
text:
Good afternoon, we had this hotel booked and paid for through an agency in my city (Seville), upon arrival they charged us 200 euros in taxes plus a 100 euro (by card) deposit that is returned on the day we check out.
That day I asked them why they hadn't returned the deposit and they told me that it is a held amount and not charged and that sometimes Spanish banks take up to a month to return it.
A month has passed and they are already in Seville and the hotel keeps telling me the same thing. When more than a month passed and after speaking with my bank, the hotel told me that they had charged me the 100 euros (it was no longer a hold) for some drinks that they claim we had consumed.
THEY ARE LIARS AND SCAMMERS. WE HAD NEVER CONSUMED ANYTHING OF WHAT THEY ARE TELLING ME.
As of today, a month and a half has passed, they have not sent us receipts for those drinks that they say were signed by me.
It is clear, they keep 100 euros from each of us who go there, some of us do not notice and others they tell (months later and once back in Spain) that it is for drinks.
NEVER STAY AT THIS HOTEL BECAUSE THEY KEEP YOUR MONEY IN A VERY RUTHLESS WAY.
