author: Jack C
title: You Will Love This Hotel - Arlo Midtown
text:
Beautiful, impeccably maintained, and infused with state-of-the-art technology, this hotel offers a modern and thoughtfully designed experience. While the rooms are compact, the efficient layout makes them feel comfortable and more than adequate.

As impressive as the property is, its greatest asset is the exceptional, world-class customer service—especially from Nikki. Her attention to detail, genuine thoughtfulness, and proactive care elevated every aspect of our stay. She anticipated our needs, ensured everything was seamless, and made us feel truly valued. Nikki’s outstanding hospitality transformed an already beautiful hotel into an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended.

author: Nathan N
title: A hidden gem
text: Our family of four had four nights in New York and I found this hotel on the internet.  We were arriving late at night from Penn Station and it was a quick walk to the Hotel from there.  My husband and I were lucky enough to have been given a larger room which was fantastic.  We knew rooms in NY are usually small so this was an added bonus.  The rooms were very tastefully designed, beds were comfy, the bathroom was a great size, great shower - everything you want in a hotel.  The elevators were fast and we never had to wait long which was something I had read in a lot of reviews of hotels when I was researching.  It is within walking distance of everything.  We were able to get to breakfast cafes easily and then continue with our day and then at the end of a tiring day, not have to venture too far to get to great restaurants.  A special mention to Ken at the Front Desk who was super friendly and helpful and we saw him everyday.  He arranged for us to have a late checkout in the large room on our last day which was greatly appreciated as our 18 hour flight back to NZ didn't leave until 10.00pm at night so we could do some more exploring, then come back to the hotel and all shower before we left for the airport.  The hotel is located down a fairly quiet street for NY standards but still had everything close by.  I would thoroughly recommend this hotel.  We will definitely be back here when we visit NY again.

author: Antoine X
title: Lovely hotel convenient to everything!

When I requested water, no charge was mentioned, and the hotel had confirmed by email before arrival that extra water would be provided. Despite this, I was charged EUR 9 at checkout.
Disappointing experience regarding transparency and billing.

Stay booked entirely with points. The hotel still charged €15 per night as a tourist tax, which should not be applied to stays booked with points according to Rome rules.

author: Rosie A
title: Our Preferred Spot in Rome
text:
We prefer the hotel Bolivar whenever we stay in Rome. Its location is unbeatable in terms of easily reaching attractions by foot. It is right in the heart of it all, yet it also enjoys a privileged location set back off the main streets, which reduces road noise and makes the hotel a peaceful oasis. It’s nice to come back and rest up here after a busy day of exploring the eternal city. 

Everything is kept spotlessly clean. Yes, the rooms themselves are on the smaller side, particularly from an American perspective, but by western european standards the size is on par, and the rooms are equipped with everything you need. Complimentary wi-fi worked well during our entire weeklong stay. Beds are on the firm side, which I love. 

Breakfast is good and the self serve coffee machines in the breakfast area in particular are very nice. The ladies who work in the breakfast area are as sweet as can be. The views of church domes from the breakfast area are inspiring. 

The guys who work the front desk are great and really go out of their way to be helpful. They ordered us a cab which was perfectly sized for our family of 4, but also without having to get a van which would have cost more. He found us the “sweet spot.” I’m also thankful he informed us that it wasn’t worth taking the Leonardo express to FCO in our situation (4 people, 4 checked bags made the economics and time savings of a cab better for us- it’s another story for solo travelers or couples. 

I should add that the maids were very friendly and great at their jobs, too. 

This was our second stay here and we plan on returning.

author: Grace S
title: Great Location, Small rooms, Professional Staff
text:
This hotel has a great location, walking distance to many sights, short walk to Trevi, Forum, etc. We rented Lime bikes to move around. We walked to metro close by to get to Airport. Location was my main priority, and I was highly satisfied with it.
Rooms are small, bed a bit firm, but clean, well kept and functional. Even though hotel is  tucked into a courtyard, it was a bit noisy from city activity. Wifi was great. 
Breakfast was very good, plenty of choices, although it was same every day, maybe a little rotation would be nice, but the pies were great!
 Staff was super friendly. 
Housekeeping was good, fresh towels daily. Bathrooms are renovated, so function well.  View from rooftop breakfast is nice, there is an outdoor roof top, unfortunately it is used as a smoking area. Elevator is tiny, but we chose to use stairs. Front desk is also friendly. Even though we prepaid our room, we still had to pay E7.50 per person, daily, per Rome fees, just an fyi. In september weather is mild, so we opened the floor to ceiling doors and enjoyed our Juliet balcony and fresh breeze.

I enjoyed it, I think that for the price I paid, I received great value. We walked a lot, never used a Taxi or Metro. If you want great location, this hotel is it. If you want a larger room, to relax and hang out in, this may not be it, but for the price I paid I was highly satisfied.

author: Antoine C
title: ⚠️ BEWARE: Deceptive Pricing & Extra Charges at Hotel Bolivar Rome
text:
I feel compelled to share my deeply disappointing experience at Hotel Bolivar in Rome, booked by phone for a stay from May 2 to May 5, 2025. What started as an exciting vacation quickly turned into a frustrating and stressful ordeal due to deceptive pricing tactics and unacceptable customer service.

## Misleading Pricing and Bait-and-Switch Tactics
We selected Hotel Bolivar for its central location and the advertised online discount rate. Their official website even offered a 7% discount for nights 3 stay. To confirm the best deal, I called the hotel directly and spoke with a staff member named Piter, who offered us a price $80 lower than the lowest website rate. Based on that, I provided my credit card information to secure the reservation.
However, when we arrived at 9PM, Piter was nowhere to be found. 
The front desk person claimed the quoted price was a "computer error" and insisted we pay $937 for the same three nights. When we pointed out that their own website was currently showing a rate of just $313 for the remaining two nights of our stay, they refused to adjust our rate or allow us to cancel. 
They essentially held us hostage to the higher price despite clear evidence of their own lower published rates.
👉I am attaching screenshots of both the booking.com listing and the hotel's own website as evidence of the pricing discrepancies.

## Customer Service Nightmare
When I attempted to address this discrepancy:
- The front desk staff, who could barely speak English, refused to help resolve the pricing issue
- I was told the manager was "unavailable" until after my scheduled departure
- Staff claimed I could not cancel my reservation despite the price misrepresentation
- When I presented a formal written complaint, the staff was openly rude and refused to even read it
- No alternative solutions were offered
Communication problems made the situation even more frustrating, as explaining our concerns was nearly impossible with the limited English proficiency of the front desk personnel.

## Room and Facilities Not Worth the Cost
While the hotel's location is convenient, this advantage is completely overshadowed by their business practices. The room itself was clean but located on the ground floor with windows directly facing the street, creating noise issues and privacy concerns. Given the premium price we were forced to pay, the room's location and overall value were extremely disappointing.

## Warning to Travelers
I strongly advise potential guests to:
- Get any price quotes in writing before booking
- Take screenshots of online pricing
- Consider alternative accommodations in the area

Despite our best efforts to resolve the situation reasonably, the hotel staff was unwilling to honor their quoted rate or offer any form of assistance. It was an extremely frustrating experience that cast a shadow over our time in Rome.

author: Owen K
title: Ok in August I guess
text:
I had a mostly pleasant stay here, and the room was definitely one of the highlights. It was cute, stylish, and had a great overall vibe. The AC worked really well, which in Rome in August is not a small thing. The shower was also excellent and honestly one of my favorite parts of the room.

The minibar was fine—nothing particularly exciting, but it did the job. The gym was also perfectly adequate for getting in a quick workout, although nothing particularly memorable.

Unfortunately, the breakfast was where things took a serious turn.

For the price, I expected much better. The bacon was hard and tasted suspiciously like pepperoni, while the scrambled eggs were watery and essentially flavorless. The espresso tasted burnt, and somehow the cappuccino managed to be disappointing too—which, in Italy, feels almost personal.

Then there were the pancakes. Calling them pancakes is generous. They tasted like actual cake and seemed to contain enough sugar to launch a small child into orbit.

The pastries weren’t much better. The cream croissant was the best of the bunch, but there was approximately three molecules of cream inside. At that point, just call it a croissant.

The fruit was fine. Nothing to write home about, but perfectly acceptable.

Overall, I liked the hotel and enjoyed the room, AC, and shower. However, the breakfast was expensive, underwhelming, and easily the weakest part of the stay. I’ve had some incredible food in Rome, so unfortunately this was not the final Italian breakfast experience I was hoping for.

author: Giulia O
title: Top service and location for cost
text:
I was very pleased with my stay at the Nhow. To preface, I brought my parents to Rome for their first time. The location of the hotel is great, with a market .2 miles away and plenty of restaurants and shops a close walk away. 

The real star of the show is the service. Everyone and I mean everyone was great. When was the last time you stayed somewhere for 3 nights and everyone was pleasant? From taxi/welcome service gentleman to check in staff, wait staff, tour guide reps EVERYONE was not only friendly, but helpful as well.

The two people that made this stay notable for me were two ladies. One, the waitress at the breakfast buffet Maria Luigia, who even with me having a language barrier (I speak zero Italian, I know sorry)  was able to get our coffee and omelette order correct. Not only that, but she remembered are order the next day and the day after that making everything seem less. 

The second person was a savior, Michelle. I have been emailing her regarding our stay before we even landed for airport pickup. Our flight got canceled until the next day, she was able to change our hotel stay by a day (day later check in and check out). She rescheduled our taxi pickup. She helped find a golf cart tour of the coliseum the same day (difficult if not impossible). In the midst of my flight cancellation, the lost one of my luggage at the airport, she kindly helped me the best she could to reach out to the airline, calling from her office, finding emails to contact etc. 

I would return to stay at Nhow for sure and will definitely recommend this hotel to friends planning a Rome Trip 

Thank you all who made the stay memorable

author: Daniel K
title: Great location, even better hospitality
text:
We had the pleasure of staying here on our honeymoon, and we truly can’t wait to return. The entire staff went out of their way to not only provide great service but also help us feel celebrated. We stayed at a few different hotels throughout our honeymoon, and the staff here did more to help us celebrate than the other hotels all combined. We greatly appreciated everything they did to help make the trip special.
As for the hotel itself, if you can get a room facing the park, you won’t be disappointed. The views to the park every morning are magical and dark & quiet at night. The room was clean and welcoming, and had unexpected touches of luxury. Overall, it’s well worth the walk from the Metro.
The only moments we had that were less than positive during our stay was attempting to dine at the hotel restaurant for dinner one night: neither meal stood out and it was a long affair to get the food ordered. Fixing dinner service would go a long way, although breakfast was efficient and delicious.
Overall, highly recommended and we will be back the next time we’re in Rome.

author: Mathis P
title: Fun, modern, and exceptionally executed stay
text:
As a frequent traveler who usually stays at higher-tier properties, I found nhow Roma Vittorio Veneto to be a standout 4-star hotel that delivers everything you actually need for a solid city stay.

​Check-in was completely smooth and our loyalty status was recognized right away with a welcome upgrade to a big, spacious room. The entire property was exceptionally clean, and the unique, vibrant vibe makes it a fun change of pace from standard classical hotels.

​The breakfast spread went well beyond the basic offerings. The location is another major plus, it sits in a great spot for walking right into the city center or taking a stroll through the nearby Borghese park. Acceptable quality, good execution.

author: Sophia F
title: Rude Staff, Poor Service, and Unacceptable Conditions
text:
Our stay at this hotel in Rome was, without question, the most disappointing part of our entire trip to Italy. From the moment we arrived until the day we left, the service and overall experience fell far below what was advertised and expected.

When we first arrived, the front desk staff didn't greet us warmly or provide any basic information about the hotel. We weren't told where our room was, where breakfast was served, where the gym was located, or given any orientation whatsoever. To make matters worse, the bellhop left our luggage unattended on the street while showing us where the reception desk was. Anyone could have walked away with our bags, which was both careless and unacceptable.

After a long journey, we mentioned that we were hungry and asked about food. Rather than offering helpful guidance, the front desk simply told us to "go out and find a restaurant," despite the fact that the hotel has its own restaurant that was opening shortly. We decided to wait and eat there, but once it opened around noon, we were completely ignored. Staff walked past us without acknowledging us, and after waiting for an extended period, we had to repeatedly ask for someone to take our order. Instead of apologizing, one staff member responded by saying that we hadn't stopped her or made her aware that we were hungry and waiting to be served. That response was both dismissive and inappropriate. The meal itself was overpriced and of very poor quality.

While we were eating, a staff member came to the restaurant to hand us our room key. Once we finally settled into our room, we discovered small brown ants crawling all over the floor. This was incredibly unsettling. The staff's only response was, "This has never happened before." We then had to wait for another room, hoping it would at least be in the same building.

Unfortunately, the problems continued throughout our stay. The Wi-Fi cut out every night, making it unreliable. The television had only a handful of channels, and most had no signal. Our rooms were also missing robes and slippers, despite these amenities being advertised.

Breakfast was another disappointment. The buffet consisted mostly of cold pastries and underwhelming eggs, with very little variety or quality. The breakfast hours of 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. also felt unnecessarily limited for a hotel catering to tourists who may want a more flexible morning schedule.

Throughout our stay, the front desk staff rarely wore visible name tags, making it difficult to identify who we were speaking with. One employee, whose name we believe was Clarissa or Clarice, consistently made us feel unwelcome. Her attitude was cold, dismissive, and rude, and she set the tone for what became an incredibly unpleasant experience.

To top it all off, when we checked out during the final week of July, the hotel's apology for the numerous issues we experienced was a box of stale chocolates. It felt like an afterthought rather than a genuine attempt to make things right.

Rome itself is an incredible city, but this hotel was the lowest point of our vacation. Between the rude and unhelpful staff, poor service, cleanliness issues, unreliable amenities, and lack of concern for guests, I cannot recommend staying here. There are far too many excellent hotels in Rome to risk spending your vacation at this one.

author: Lucia B
title: Wonderful
text: Wonderful hotel! My second time here, clean room, excellent shower, great location

author: Jack H
title: Awesome!
text: Awesome drinks, service and super fun!

author: Ryan B
title: Pleasant stay
text: We have been there several times and always a good welcome, the room clean, the kettle and the minibar restocked every day. The breakfast is really high quality

author: Chloe F
title: Convenient and comfortable hotel
text: Excellent value for money

author: David E
title: Parisian stay
text:
Pleasant, quiet, and functional hotel.
Elevator, decent breakfast, pleasant staff.

author: Poppy M
title: A nice hotel in Paris
text: We stayed there for one night as a family. Everything was really good, from the welcome to the breakfast service to the check-out.

author: Ian N
title: Convenient to public transportation
text: Great location in between Rome and Clichy. We were able to walk to the train stations and convenient bus stops. The staff was very friendly and had complimentary soft drinks in the room. We had a room with twin beds and it was very clean. My only issue was that the walls were so thin and the floor creaked in several places as you walked around. There isn't much they can probably do about that but we could hear conversations and the alarm of the room next to us. The air conditioning was good and there was a window that could be opened. This place was great for our trip.

author: Michael E
title: Great stay
text: Good location, comfortable and  clean room. Lovely to have free drinks both in the room and the lobby during the heat wave.

author: Claire B
title: Great hotel
text:
So much more than expected for a 3 star hotel. Nice and clean. Super to have access to all the sister hotels' snack bars across Paris.
Mini bar with soft drinks refilled daily. 
The room was small, but didn't lack anything. 
Great location: All the major sights within walking distance.

author: Alexander I
title: Excellent stay at the Astoria Hotel, 42 rue de Moscou in Paris
text: The Astoria Hotel, 42 rue de Moscou in Paris, is very well located for visiting the major Parisian monuments. It is located between 5 and 10 minutes on foot from the metro and bus lines allowing you to get to the main monuments. The neighborhood is safe. Excellent welcome at the hotel. The soft minibar in the room restocked at no extra charge every day, as well as the free soft open bar and snacks every afternoon, are very much appreciated, especially after a day of sightseeing in Paris in August. A small downside for 2 or 3 stains on the bed linen. Otherwise, the room and the bathroom were very clean. I recommend it.

author: James U
title: The discreet charm of professional service.
text: A very well-equipped, quiet room. An attentive and discreet welcome.

author: Nathan R
title: Great value hotel
text: A lovely hotel that was well located and clean. Staff were friendly and helpful. Free drinks and snacks were very welcome after a long day sightseeing. Very efficient air con that we definitely needed in the heat wave! I would happily return to this hotel.

author: Freya V
title: Good 1st experience.
text: Very good, just a few small adjustments to make. Regarding the snack area all afternoon and in the evening, there were only mini pastries and small donuts, which were certainly very good. I was expecting to have fruit, savory items, bread... And at breakfast, a problem with the coffee machine which was no longer working. Replaced by thermoses of coffee, but a little too strong for my taste. For the rest, perfect, whether it be at the reception, in the upgraded room, the quietness. Very good.

author: Olivia U
title: It is not grand luxury, but everything you need is present or nearby.
text:
Pleasant hotel in the 8th, close to many tourist sites and many restaurants, in a safe and quiet neighborhood.
Friendly and helpful staff

author: Camille L
title: Well located and good quality
text: Excellent hotel, very well located near subway stations (lines 2 and 3 a bit further away). Friendly staff and delicious breakfast. Small downside, the walls are not soundproofed. The rooms are very clean and comfortable.

author: Connor Q
title: The hotel room is decorated with care and the breakfast is excellent.
text: A place to recommend, the reception staff is very attentive to the guests. I have stayed at this hotel several times.

author: Sean R
title: Great boutique hotel!
text: I recently stayed for two nights in early July. It was my first trip to France and I had a great stay! Over the course of the month, I stayed at three different Astotel properties, and this hotel location stood out as being particularly excellent! The neighbourhood is beautiful and charming, close to everything, but also feels calm and quiet. I found the area very safe and the hotel was clean and tidy. The room was a bit small, but that’s to be expected in Paris /most large cities. The air conditioning worked well during the heat wave! The free drinks each day were a nice touch. As someone with food allergies (notably nuts) it was a bit harder for me to take advantage of the afternoon snack bar, but I was able to find enough “safe” foods to enjoy the breakfast at the hotel each morning before starting my day. The hotel reception staff was kind and courteous. Merci, Hotel Astoria Astotel!

author: Tyler Z
title: Wonderful
text:
We had a great time! We will definitely be back! Exceptional staff!
Thanks a million ❤️❤️❤️

author: Sophia M
title: A gem of a hotel.
text: Greet location, clean and comfortable and lovely staff. Will definitely come again!

author: Claire D
title: Wonderful
text: Very beautiful experience at this hotel with super friendly staff. We were welcomed like royalty. The minibar drinks are free, which is exceptional. The hotel is very quiet and very well located.

author: Sophia B
title: Great Hotel
text:
Great Hotel, good breakfast and always helpful & nice staff. It’s in a nice and quiet neighbourhood and there’s 3 metro stations near. It was easy to navigate. 
The only downside was that the walls are quite thin and we had loud neighbours.

author: Evan V
title: Professional and friendly welcome. Quiet hotel.
text: Well-maintained and welcoming hotel. It is always a pleasure to return there

author: Amelia A
title: A Wonderful, Relaxing Stay in Monti
text:
My husband and I stayed at the Hotel Colosseum in August 2026. We specifically wanted to stay in the Monti neighborhood, and this hotel was perfect for us.

- The street outside and the hotel itself were wonderfully quiet. Our room was both comfortable and peaceful, making it a great retreat after long, hot days of sightseeing.
- Every single staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful.
- The free breakfast was a highlight. Instead of a small two-hour window, they offer breakfast over a generous four-hour period. There was a fantastic variety of food, including plenty of healthy options that I really appreciated.
- We were within easy walking distance of the Colosseum, the Roman Forum, and a few other major attractions, as well as a wide range of restaurants.
- The views from the rooftop bar are stunning, and our bartender was a very sweet guy who made great cocktails.

We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would absolutely stay at Hotel Colosseum again on our next trip to Rome!

author: Abigail F
title: Colosseum in Rome! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text:
We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Colosseum in Rome! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The hotel was very clean and comfortable, the breakfast was delicious, and the location was perfect—close to many of Rome’s main attractions, restaurants, and shops. The entire staff was friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help.

A very special thank you to Mr. Alexandra, who went above and beyond to help us find a nearby hotel when we arrived very early. We truly appreciated his kindness and excellent service.

We had such a great experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

author: Antoine D
title: Great location & very clean
text: Single mom traveling with 12 & 14 yo kids. Felt like a safe area to walk even at night. Found many restaurant and shopping options within walking distance. Beds are hard but I was comfortable. AC worked great.

author: Zoe Y
title: Solid 3-star hotel near Colosseum and Monti neighborhood; I would return
text: Very solid 3-star hotel. Would definitely recommend. We booked a triple, but were upgraded to a quad with 2 full bathrooms for no extra cost. Decent A/C and tall ceilings in our room. Helpful front desk, who helped us with taxis, restaurants, and tours. Lovely rooftop terrace with a great view of Rome and a small bar. Our room rate came with a free welcome drink. The hotel asks you to keep the room key at the front desk when you go out (old school vibe). Breakfast was good -- scrambled eggs, sausage, ham, cheese, breads, pastries, yogurt, fruit, cereal, coffee, juice, etc. -- although was somehow a bit lacking. Breakfast started at 7:30am, which sounds reasonable when you are on vacation, but was too late when we had early tours (we booked the first tours of the day to avoid the August heat). Convenient location near the Colosseum and the trendy Monti neighborhood with lots of cafes and small stores. Also not far from a Carrefour Express. Luggage room was not locked, but seemed safe. Overall, a great find and I would return.

author: Harper N
title: Loved our stay, would definitely stay again, great locay and loved rooftop bar for sunsets and cocktails before!
text: We absolutely loved this hotel! Location is great and walking distance from lots of locations. Very friendly staff and clean rooms. They put on a fantastic breakfast spread every morning that’s included. And it’s not just stale bagels n coffee! It would keep us full till lunch, I’ll attach pics. The best part is The Rooftop Bar! Opens at 6pm, we would go every night for sunset and cocktails before going out! I would have given it 5 stars but there is no restaurant or  ice machines! Us Americans love our ice! But every night when we got back to hotel the kind man at front desk would fill up and ice bucket for us so we could fill our water bottles! Would definitely stay there again!  :)

author: Lily C
title: Great experience. Will go back again.
text: Excellent location. Walking distance to many attractions. Room was very nice and renovated. Breakfast was perfect.

author: Claire R
title: Great hotel, but a little concerned about security.
text: I do highly recommend the hotel Colosseum. My only concern was a potential security risk as you had to leave your key at the front desk went away so anyone could just ask for your key to get into your room.

author: Amelia J
title: A Great Base for Discovering Rome
text:
Hotel Colosseum turned out to be a very enjoyable choice for our visit to Rome. Its location is one of its biggest advantages — the hotel is in a quieter street, but many of the city’s famous sights are within easy walking distance.

The atmosphere is comfortable and welcoming, and the staff really made a positive impression. They were friendly, helpful, and happy to provide recommendations or assist with arrangements during our stay.

Our room was clean and comfortable, and the breakfast was a great way to start the day before heading out to explore Rome.

The highlight for me was definitely the rooftop terrace. After spending the day walking around the city, it was wonderful to sit upstairs, enjoy a drink, and take in the views over Rome. Watching the city change at sunset was a particularly nice moment.

Overall, Hotel Colosseum offers a great combination of location, cleanliness, friendly service, and atmosphere. It may not be the most modern hotel in Rome, but it has plenty of character and provides everything needed for a pleasant city break.

A very good choice for anyone who wants to experience Rome on foot and return to a welcoming hotel at the end of the day.

author: Erin C
title: I’d definitely stay here again!
text:
This team is warm, friendly, attentive, and goes above and beyond to ensure a great experience.

We stayed here after a cruise and utilized their cruise port transport, luggage drop-off, and forgotten item support services. Each service was seamless and hassle-free. The room was large enough for a family of four and had two showers which made getting ready a breeze. I’d definitely stay here again!

author: Anna F
title: Good Hotel in Termini
text: Very good Hotel near the Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore!! it is also close to Termini. It has a very good breakfast, and it has a terrace where I recommend going to watch the sunset over the Eternal City!!

author: Lily M
title: Perfect
text: Perfect in everything, friendly and nice

author: Harper C
title: Customer service made a difference.
text: Our reservation was made directly on the hotel website and they did direct emails to me for confirmation and to offer other services. We wished they would have given us more detailed instruction on what direction to use for walking to hotel, as we ended up walking a difficult 1.5 flights of stairs UP with our heavy suitcases. NOt a good experience. The hotel was medium size for Europe with location in an area where walking to some attractions was convenient.  The staff were cordial, although not all had good English speaking ability. The main difficulty encountered was the situation of the Air conditioning being totally inadequate in our triple room for the very hot temps outside during our 1 night stay.  Staff during arrival did not seem to have authority to offer switch to a different room. Finally after dinner, I approached the front desk again, and a different person, possibly a manager, offered to let us sleep in a room where the AC was more effective, and did not require us to move all of our baggage /belongings to the room, since it was 9 pm at night.  The rooms themselves were clean and well supplied, but the Cooling issue would have caused a ZERO rating if things had not been adjusted with the different room.  The breakfast was a reasonable offering of proteins, starches, fruits, etc.  They helped us with a car to get to airport the next day and did store our luggage before the transfer.  The rooftop terrace was small but very nice added feature.  Rome's heat put a bit of a damper on things, but over all, we left hotel with a positive experience.

author: Sara Y
title: Love it
text:
I stayed at Hotel Colosseum during a work trip to Rome in July, and the hospitality and service were top-notch.
​The front desk team was professional, welcoming, and exceptionally efficient—assisting with prompt check-ins, local transport advice, and scheduling taxi arrangements. Despite July heat in Rome, the air conditioning worked perfectly, making the rooms a comfortable refuge after long workdays. Fast, reliable Wi-Fi throughout the property made catching up on emails seamless.

author: Lauren S
title: Fantastic August Stay in Rome
text: The hotel and staff were amazing throughout the visit. The location is ideal for easy walking around parts of Rome and if you need to get somewhere else it is right by the train station/metro station. The place is very clean, well kept, and welcoming. I would definitely stay here again if I ever find myself in Rome again.

author: Isla A
title: Handy Location  in Rome
text:
We stayed here for two nights before flying home to Australia after a four week holiday in Europe.  The front desk gentlemen were excellent, did so much for us and organised our transfer to the airport. They also recommended a local restaurant which turned out to be excellent.
Unfortunately I have a couple of negatives!
The room we had was so small, we could hardly open our suit cases, and the shower was so small that my husband struggled with it and he's not huge.
They also, have a rooftop bar, but unfortunately it does not look like the lovely photo you see on their website.  Also, the young man who works there, behaved like he didn't want to be there...what a shame!

author: Aiden J
title: Good stay, disappointing experience after check-out
text:
Our stay at Hotel Colosseum went well — until check-out.

The hotel offered to store our luggage in a secure storage room so that we could collect it later in the day. We were asked to leave our three suitcases, a laptop, and two backpacks right by the hotel entrance.

I was concerned about leaving all our belongings there unattended, especially as they clearly could not remain in that spot for several hours. The receptionist reassured me that our luggage would be moved and safely stored away.

Still uncomfortable leaving our backpacks and laptop unattended, even for a few minutes, I decided to take those with me and only left the three suitcases.

When we returned more than five hours later, we were shocked to find that the suitcases had not been moved at all. They were still exactly where we had left them, in a busy passageway right next to the hotel entrance.

Leaving guests’ luggage unattended for more than five hours after specifically saying that it would be placed in secure storage is simply unacceptable.

Unfortunately, the impression we were left with was very clear: once you have checked out, you are no longer treated as a guest

author: Rosie O
title: Roman delight
text: Hotel was great. Room air conditioner was fantastic given the heat wave. Front desk personnel were extremely helpful. Breakfast was excellent. Definitely consider this as an option when staying in Rome.

author: Sean Z
title: Wonderful Hotel
text: Wonderful hotel situated within 10-15 min walk of more sights and the train/coach station. Very good breakfast to set you up for the day and very comfortable beds and clean rooms with fridge and safe along with friendly bilingual staff. Highly recommended.

author: George I
title: August 2026
text: Your basic hotel room, breakfast was typical hotel breakfast but no complaints. The AC was pretty cool for being in Europe. The staff were friendly and helpful. About a 10-15 min walk to the colosseum. We enjoyed sitting at the rooftop bar at night, pretty view of the city.

author: Isabella S
title: Warm Welcome to Italy
text: We had a delightful short stay before embarking on our cruise.  We were allowed to check in early, as soon as our room was ready, and were invited to have a cup of coffee while we waited.  The front desk arranged for rides from the airport and to the cruise terminal.  They held our bags while we explored both before and after check in.  The gentleman at the front desk kindly showed us the route to the Colosseum which was a 10-15 minute walk at a leisurely pace. The room was very clean and the rooftop terrace had a spectacular view with comfortable places to sit and enjoy a limoncello or beer.  Breakfast was top-notch with a large variety of options.  The warm personal welcome was a wonderful way to start our trip to Italy.

author: Pierre L
title: Good although a bit dated hotel
text:
A small a bit dated hotel located at the doorstep of Santa Maria Maggiore, near Cavour metro station and in a walkable distance from Termini station. Clean although a bit small rooms with air condition, free wifi, kettle and fridge. Friendly and helpful staff. 
A restaurant in the neighbouring building. Breakfasts in the hotel available, but we didn’t try them, there are many local cafes nearby.

author: Manon E
title: Great Location and Friendly Service, but a Little Dated
text: The location is definitely the main selling point of this hotel, making it a really convenient base for exploring. The atmosphere was pleasant and relaxed, and the service was very good, with friendly staff who were happy to recommend places to eat. The reception is staffed 24/7, and you have to hand your key in whenever you leave, which is a nice security feature. The rooms were clean and did the job, but the hotel is quite dated and could definitely do with a refresh, with things like broken lampshades. The cleanliness was good overall, although the **amenities** could be improved, particularly the air conditioning, which didn't work very well and wasn't ideal during the August heatwave. The noise level wasn't an issue for us during our stay. Overall, the hotel offered decent value for what we needed, mainly thanks to its excellent location and friendly service, but it would benefit from some modernisation.

author: Henry M
title: Most uncomfortable bed I’ve been forced to sleep on.
text: Absolutely nothing like the photos, plus the most uncomfortable bed I’ve ever had to sleep on. There are zero amenities so it’s basically a cot and a bathroom. Photos show an outdoor dining/seating area, balconies on the rooms and plush beds — not the case at all. Way over priced, old, dated and gross. Only upside is how lovely the staff was, otherwise I was completely scammed.

author: Tyler V
title: Awesome experience with the staff at this hotel.
text: 1000/10 Highly recommended! Throughout my entire stay, the staff at this hotel took wonderful care of me and answered every question I had. I can't recall their names at the moment, but a special thank you goes to the lady and gentleman who recommended where to buy whole-bean coffee, and another special thank you to Mohamed for his attentiveness. Everyone there was incredibly friendly. I thought the location was phenomenal—just a 10, 20, or 30-minute walk to all the beautiful sights in the historic center. Plus, you have everything right nearby: a supermarket, a pharmacy, bars, and restaurants. Thank you, Hotel Verona!

author: Lily U
title: Lovely central location
text: Amazing location. We would stay here again. The 24 hour staff / concierge are delightful. It feels safe and there is next to no noise when the window is shut. However, the room temperature is then hard to control. The other major down side included a very firm mattress and thin flat pillows. Towels aren't changed mid-week: only the beds are turned down. There is just one key, which they require to be left at reception whenever going out.  Guests with mobility problems or large luggage would not manage easily as the lifts are strangely located on the landings between two floors.

author: Miguel P
title: Disappointed
text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this stay was genuinely disappointing. We only needed a simple place to sleep because we were out all day and most of the night, but even that basic expectation wasn’t met.
The room was extremely hot and uncomfortable. Normally opening a window would solve that, but the room was directly above a very noisy street, so opening it meant constant traffic noise that made it impossible to rest.
The shower was also incredibly small, around two feet wide and barely usable. Anyone larger than slim would struggle to fit comfortably.
The biggest issue was the bed. It wasn’t level at all and felt like it was sloping badly to one side. It genuinely felt like I had to brace myself with my knee just to stop sliding, which made it impossible to relax or sleep properly.
We didn’t expect luxury we literally just needed a bed after long days out but unfortunately this didn’t even provide that. Overall, it was a very uncomfortable stay. I did mention the heat but little was done no aircon or offer to move.

author: Pierre T
title: Excellent three stars
text: Hotel in a very convenient location for both the station and the city center. Excellent value for money for a three-star, very kind staff, small but clean and elegant rooms.Un tip: book directly from them by phone or email, you save on commissions and do not even require the deposit.Consigliatissimo

author: Jessica S
title: Lovely find in Rome
text:
Very clean and modern room. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful, after arriving early they arranged early checkin. Room was large with comfortable bed which we requested additional pillows, nothing was too much trouble. We hired a kettle at €20 deposit as this is not included in the room you get the kettle and tea bags, you would need to bring coffee and get milk, there is a fridge in the room which there is water provided.
5 minutes walk from Termini and 20 minutes from most other attractions. Lots of restaurants and bars near by as well as Cafes and supermarkets.

author: Andrea Z
title: Second visit this year
text: Second time visiting this hotel this year, rooms a little tired looking, have everything you need though, but overall a lovey experience here, staff are friendly, helpful and welcoming close by all the sightseeing you will need, order lasagne from restaurant next door it’s amazing. And we had a recommendation to eat at Da Robertino, second time trying here as well and food is authentic, very nice.

author: Dylan T
title: Very good
text: Two nights in this hotel. Good location, close enough to walk to major downtown attractions. A little dated but rooms and bathroom sufficiently cozy, shower a little small. Excellent cleanliness. Really friendly receptionists. Good value for money. Recommended.

author: Lucia A
title: Lovely stay
text:
Just returned from a 4 night trip. We had a pleasant stay. Corridors and reception clean.  Our room ( 504) could do with a bit of a decor update, but was clean and a good size. Comfortable, king- sized bed.  You hang a sign on your door handle if you want your room serviced.  Bathroom clean. Shower small and would not be suitable for larger people but water was always hot. Ok for me but my husband who is average size struggled a bit. Soap dispenser in the bathroom but no shampoo/shower gel, so make sure you bring your own. You can have breakfast for €10pp each morning, and it has a bar if you want a drink, but we didn't bother with either.
We were on the 5th floor. Some street and traffic noise at night but didn't bother us. Lift doesn't stop at each floor, so we had a short  flight of stairs to climb from 4th to 5th floors when we got out. 
The cleaners had the habit of wedging  the door of the lift open with buckets on the ground floor each morning, so we couldn't  call the lift and had to use the stairs.  Receptionists were all  very friendly. Check-in was quick. Don't forget to add the city tax  to your costs. We paid 48 euros for the 4 nights. 
The hotel is centrally located, so great for sightseeing. We purchased the hop-on hop-off Big Bus Pass 72 hour ticket  for €50pp but this also included a one hour night bus tour, worth €23 if booked separately, and a free ice cream from a Gelatist outlet worth €4 so it's good value for money if you use the buses everyday as we did. Great for 1st time visitors like us.  There is a stop next to the Basilica Santa Maria Maggiore ( the largest church in Italy dedicated to the Virgin Mary), which is  visible from the hotel and just a couple of minutes walk away.  Turn right as you leave the hotel, walk across the front of the church, and the bus stop is just across the road. The  bus stops at 8 points around the city.  You can get to all the major  sights from these. We got on the bus and did a full circle of the route  to get our bearings when we arrived, which I would recommend for 1st time visitors. There is an audio guide, which is informative with free packaged headphones on each bus, and they arrive about every 15-20minutes. Just hop off on the stop you need, then visit the sight you have chosen and then hop back on and go to another site. There is always some walking to do after you get off the bus to get to your chosen site, so wear really comfortable footwear (and a hat in summer). It was 29C degrees whilst we were there, and visiting Rome involves lots of walking. There are company assistants at every stop to help with any questions. The 72 hours  start from the time you these assistants first print off your tickets. You can get 24 and 48 hour versions, too. 
You can walk to the Colosseum ( which we did), from the hotel in about 15 minutes at a steady walking pace, and the Forum and Palatine Hill are next to this. We visited these on the same day, but it was exhausting, and I would highly recommend you split this and do the Colosseum one morning with the Forum and Palatine Hill the following day. I was so tired by the time I had walked around the Colosseum and Palatine Hill that I didn't have the energy left to walk all the way around the forum. Tickets to the Colosseum include the other 2 sites, and you can visit the latter 2 as long as it's within 24 hours of your Colosseum visit anyway.
The walk from the bus stop to the Vatican is about 1.5 miles. We walked a total of 7.5 miles that day. We visited Piazza Navona in the morning beforehand.
All the major sites are extremely busy, people and queues at each, especially at the Vatican.   Skip the line tickets are helpful, but it is still difficult to negotiate your way around, and you will still end up in a queue. The queues are not  well organised. 
I would recommend buying Colosseum, Vatican and Pantheon tickets online before you go. Tickets are in time blocks and they sell out quickly. I booked mine a few days before we travelled. I would recommend the Arena ticket for the Colosseum which allows entry to the area where the gladiators fought. A very different perspective to the area where the spectators sat. 
 Take a water bottle with you to keep  hydrated, although there are  places to purchase drinks.  
We did the Vatican garden tour. It was a  nice rest to sit on a bus for the garden after the walk up to the Vatican. It doesn't include St Peter's Basillica which we didnt visit. But again, I would recommend you do this separately  to the Vatican/Sistine due to the amount of walking involved. The queues for the Basillica were also huge.
Due to the crowds, keep an eye on your wallets/ purses/phones as  they are  a pick pocket magnet. 
There are loads of pizzerias/ trattorias everywhere for eating. We ate at the pizzeria just outside the hotel on the first night as we were tired after an early flight. Food and service  good but all the places we ate at were also good so choose any. 
Rome is a lovely city. I advise you plan an itinerary before you go. The Colosseum, Sistine Chapel, and Trevi fountain are must see,  but everywhere is extremely busy, and the large crowds at each do taint the sight seeing a little,  ( unavoidable though) but overall, we had a enjoyable stay. The Verona is a very nice, comfortable hotel, well situated  for touring  Rome. I would be happy to stay there again.

author: Kyle P
title: Would not stay in a place with staff who lie
text:
We tried to book this hotel and it showed availability online but when I rang to ask a question about having a cot in the triple room they said the room is not available and I would have to book 2 doubles.

Would not recommend this hotel for families.

author: Charlie F
title: Good compromise
text: Hotel in.central position near Termini station, easily accessible on foot , view of Santa Maria Maggiore and not far from the Colosseum , nearby ber restaurants dinogni type, friendly and helpful staff, comfortable rooms and with renovated bathroom, only to improve the attention to detail in the preparation of the rooms.

author: Freya Q
title: Great little hotel!
text: I’m not sure why everyone gives this hotel such poor ratings, especially knowing it’s a 3* hotel when booking. We’ve had a great stay at Hotel Verona, the staff are so lovely and welcoming! We stayed in one of the refurbished rooms on the fourth floor, which was a little small but perfect for our city break in rome. The air con worked really well and could be adjusted. However, the condensation has dripped on the floor, but we were able to mop this up with a towel no problem. Some people may find the mattresses too hard, but we didn’t find this an issue. Overall we’ve had a lovely stay here and would 100% come back when returning to Rome! Grazie 🇮🇹❤️

author: Anna Z
title: three Roman days
text:
A hotel with good quality price convenient to all means of transport such as: train, bus, metro.
Near Santa Maria Maggiore the second church of Rome, nearby there are also excellent pastry shops.

author: Matthew S
title: Dirty rooms, and a disappointing experience overall.
text:
I rarely write reviews, but I felt compelled after my recent experience at this hotel. Unfortunately, it was one of the worst stays I’ve had.

First and foremost, the room was very dirty. There was dust everywhere, the bathroom had visible grime,the shower curtain was very dirty and the bedding didn’t appear freshly cleaned. It was unacceptable and made the entire stay uncomfortable.
The smell of the hotel was terrible .
Overall, I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. For the price paid, the standards should be much higher. There are definitely better options in the area—I suggest staying elsewhere.

author: William G
title: An ideal place.
text:
Lovely friendly hotel.
We are just home now from our trip to Rome. Four nights at the Hotel Verona was an ideal centre for all we wanted to do and see. A perfect location for walking to various sites and an easy hub to use transport from Termini and Cavour metro. The staff are so helpful and accommodating…every one of them knowledgeable and communicative. We had a small but adequate room at the rear which was quiet and had a nice veranda. Breakfast is a simple affair but we didn’t expect much as it’s not really an Italian meal. Lots of lovely places to eat and drink in the surrounding area. Make sure you take an identity card or passport with you if you want to visit ancient sites. The city was very busy and we were well warned about pickpockets but nothing untoward happened to us. A most enjoyable trip.

author: Owen A
title: Terrible expereience in this overpriced Hotel
text:
Please stay away from this hotel. Stayed there for 3 nights from Apr 24, 2025  to Apr 27, 2025. Worst hotel I've ever stayed . Paid close to US $700 for 3 nights and it's totally not worth it. 

Issues-- 

1. Weak toilet flush due to low water flow. 
2. Poor quality mattress, bed sheets, pillow ..
3. Old & small size room.
4. No internet connection for TV. (no YouTube etc.)
4. Poor & rude customer service. 

When I reported these issues, that guy at the front desk (in the night shift)  didn't even bother to fix the issues and rudely replied that Rome was totally different and I should be thankful for getting a room in that hotel, at this this time of year (Easter Holidays & Pope's death) , as if they they had rented the room free of cost. Paid $230 per night and I booked 2 weeks in advance.  

I booked this hotel since it was closer to the Roma Termini station & Santa Maria Maggiore basilica.  Tuned out to be a horrible mistake and  unpleasant experience.

author: Andrea Z
title: Friendly and welcoming
text:
This hotel was a great location, the restaurant next door had the best lasagna ever.
Staff at the hotel were friendly and welcoming.
We had a recommendation from the gentleman on the front desk for food and for the best gelato/ ice cream for our little boy.
It was the best restaurant we had ate in. 
Was disappointed on leaving as we never got to see him to pass on how great we thought his recommendations were. So thank you if you happen to see this. 
Also the housekeeping staff were very thorough and room was spotless. Cleaned well every day. 
Enjoyed our stay so much so here that we would definitely return here.

author: Alexander Y
title: Hotels in Rome
text: Beautiful this hotel is very welcoming the receptionists very nice available if you ask them recommend you well the restaurants the premises the room very nice and cozy the bed very comfortable and the bathroom very nice you were very well

author: Luca W
title: Praise
text: This hotel is wonderful! The staff at this hotel helped me a lot even without being a guest. Excellent service! Excellent hotel!

author: Henry S
title: Would stay here again without hesitation
text:
We stayed here 28th may-1st June prior to arriving i emailed the hotel to ask about ensuring our room had 4 beds (2 adults one teenager one child) as some reviews said it was a sofa bed. They emailed me back within 20 minutes! Which alone is unheard of.
I was  reassured all rooms have been renovated and it will be fine. And it was! 
Biggest room ive ever had on a city trip. Long corridor which consisted of full sized wardrobe bathroom with shower and bidet,a double bed and 2 single beds perfect!!

Air con in the room hot water for everyone's showers.Room serviced every day!

Staff were all very friendly.

Hotel is literally 15 mins from most big attractions in Rome (apart from vatican, but even that is only a 30 mins walk)

The underground were on strike whilst we were there so couldn't utilise that as much as we'd like.

Monti Is a trendy area of Rome to stay, lots of boutique shops restaurants etc 

As a family we all felt totally safe too!

Would stay here again without hesitation

author: Laura C
title: Highly recommended!
text:
We gave the stay at Hotel Virgilio in Rome to my mom for her birthday – and it was just a great choice! We were very satisfied all around.

The room was large and very nice, as was the spacious bathroom with a large shower. Everything was freshly renovated and really spotless. Our wishes for two beds and a shower instead of bathtub were fulfilled without any problems, which we greatly appreciated.

Although it was a bit noisy from the street, but at night we could still sleep well – after all, you are in the middle of Rome and very centrally located. The proximity to many attractions, such as the Trevi Fountain and the Colosseum, is a big plus.

Special praise goes to the team at reception: The boys were incredibly friendly – thank you for the warm welcome!

Breakfast also convinced us: delicious, varied and something for everyone. We were particularly happy about tomatoes and cucumbers, which is not always a given in Italy.

Thank you very much for the wonderful time in Rome – we would love to come back!

author: Hannah C
title: Perfect for a visit to Rome
text:
Staff attentive and available 
Breakfast quite correct 
Cozy room and practical bathroom 
1 single flat the street noise

author: Chloe Q
title: Great location, close to everything
text: A very good hotel even though I was in the pieces that are accessed from the outside. I even think it was even better because we didn't feel the hustle and bustle of a hotel. Comfortable and spacious bed, large bathroom. Perhaps it would improve the isolation between pieces because the conversations of the neighbors are felt when everything is silent. The location is great and the neighborhood is very nice and quiet. Good breakfast buffet. The receptionist spoke Spanish and very friendly and helpful. I would definitely come back

author: Henry Y
title: Was an amazing hotel with very good rooms
text:
All you can eat breakfast was very nice they replenished the drinks in the mimi fridge lovely balcony is thing good price and place the only bad thing was the shower wich was a bit annoying with the pressure and temperature beds were also very comfortable no English channels on the TV :(

I loved it very much

author: Matthew J
title: An awesome, convenient hotel
text: The hotel has a lot of nearby shops and restaurants

author: Harper I
title: Visit Rome
text: With a group of friends from the Lions Club of Siena, we spent 3 days in Rome staying at the Hotel Virgilio in via Palermo. Our group was followed and treated with extreme courtesy, a choice that proved very apt. Rooms and services of excellent quality, a special mention to the staff and, in particular, to Mattia who followed us with extreme kindness and competence. We'll be back for sure. Good!

author: Jack D
title: Stayed 4 nights in Rome
text:
We stayed at this hotel for 4 nights.
The staff is very friendly.
The hotel is very well located in a street where we felt safe. Many restaurants are nearby. The hotel is located 15 minutes walk from a lot of attraction. We were able to do everything on foot without public transport, even visiting the Vatican.
Only one downside for the noise, our room looked out onto the street (lots of passing cars) but especially the staff who spoke very loudly at 06:30 in the hallway.
Breakfast was limited I think. The juices were bad (machine chemical) and the choice was not up to the price.
The rest was perfect.

author: Michael F
title: Great hotel!
text: This was our first time to Rome so we were a bit nervous.  I chose this place because of location and price and both of those proved true.  This place turned out great for our needs for 6 nights.  The staff was very helpful and friendly.  We stayed in a room which was in a building right next door.  Yes, it was 2 singles put together but we thought the beds were great.  It was a very basic, nice clean room.  We had access to the breakfast buffet in the hotel.  It was an extra cost for us but that worked out well for our stay.  Some of the mornings were had to leave the hotel before they started serving at 7:00.  Those morning we couldn't take advantage of it and didn't pay for it.  The others morning we just walked in with no reservation and they just added the cost to our bill.  It was a very good breakfast and very convenient saving time in trying to find other food.  I am recommending this hotel to any family and friends with trips of Rome on the horizon.

author: Alexander Q
title: Great staff, great hotel
text:
Clean, lovely staff, and great central location from all the iconic land marks perfect stay. 
Rooms cleaned daily and the Annex is a great way to spend a few days in Rome.

author: Adam U
title: Ideal location
text:
We spent 4 nights at the hotel. Good communication before arrival as the hotel replied to my email and gave me options of how to travel from airport to the hotel. We chose shuttle bus from outside the airport then walked the last 15 mins to the hotel. 
Hotel room comfortable and clean. It’s an ideal location- 15-20 min walk to most sites. 5 mins to the metro with then a short journey to Vatican City. Breakfast was great and fresh. Hotel reception very helpful providing maps and helpful information. 
Some lovely places to eat in all directions from the hotel

author: Ian I
title: Great place for this city break
text: A perfect location, central to all the fabulous attractions and restaurants all in walking distance, or an uber/bus ride to Vatican city. Very friendly helpful staff. Rooms were spotless great air con and the most comfortable beds. Would definitely stay again.

author: Pablo F
title: Central location, great staff
text:
As a family of four, we enjoyed our stay at Hotel Virgilio. We were able to secure one of the family apartments situated next door to the hotel. It was a bit strange not being attached to the actual hotel but we had lots of room for 2 adults and 2 teens. Even being beside the hotel, regular hotel services were available and the room was clean and well appointed.
The location was ideal for a visit to Rome. The main attractions were all within walking distance and there were plenty of nice restaurants nearby.
Certainly not a five star hotel, but friendly staff and a great location make it worth a stay

author: Alice T
title: Perfect for a City Trip to Rome!
text:
We had such a great experience at hotel Virgilio! The location is absolutely perfect, just a 10 minute walk from both the train station and the Colosseum, and also close to the city center. It was so easy to get everywhere on foot.  There were many stores, bus stations and restaurants just around the corner, but the street where the hotel is located is very quiet and not chaotic! 

The rooms were spotless, modern, and elegantly designed. The beddings were very comfortable, and the air conditioning worked perfectly, the room stayed cool, which was a relief in the summer heat. 

The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. They went out of their way to assist us, from calling a cab late at night to recommending the best places to visit.

Breakfast and room service were also very nice and convenient.

All in all, this hotel was the perfect choice for our city trip to Rome, especially for such a reasonable price. We absolutely loved it and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city!

author: William P
title: Great room, okay breakfast
text:
I would stay again and I would recommend it. 
Our room (#22) was very clean, large, quiet (overlooking the courtyard), and cool (great AC) and the bed was very comfortable. However, you could hear everything from the hallway - we lucked out and had respectful neighbours. 
Front desk was helpful - we were able to get into our room a bit before check-in.
The breakfast was okay - basic continental. Thankfully, the coffee (from a coffee machine) was decent and there was plenty of seating. 
And there is a good salad bar restaurant (Sano Lab) close by if you need a carb cleanse.

author: Pierre H
title: A great spot to stay it in Rome!
text: We had a wonderful stay here, the room and bathroom were very large and clean. The staff was friendly and helpful and the breakfast was tasty. The location is perfect for walking to all the major tourist spots. Definitely would stay here again!

author: Dylan A
title: wonderful
text: Family of 4 had a wonderful stay at Hotel Virgilio.  Walkable (15 minutes) to all the sites we wanted to see (except the Vatican which we got and $18 cab ride).  Front desk staff was always kind and the room was kept tidy.  Would recommend this hotel.

author: Isabella N
title: Great experience!!
text: Hotel Virgilio was fantastic. They arranged my cruise transportation and airport transportation. Hands down the best concierge, I have ever dealt with. The hotel was also very clean, modern and in a safe neighborhood. It was walking distance to everything. Will definitely stay here again on my next trip to Rome.

author: Mathis U
title: Good experience
text:
Great location to visit many places in Rome. Close to Termini station and within easy walking distance.
Quiet location away from busy roads.
Sleeps great and comfortable beds.
Spacious rooms and even more spacious bathrooms.
Cleaning everywhere.
The staff was friendly and friendly.
Improved breakfast however honorable.

author: Lauren D
title: Noisy, not good. Not recommended.
text:
Last two stays have been really poor. My room was upgraded and has me near a local pub/club and the noise from the outdoor music is ridiculously loud so I can’t sleep. 
My previous stay the room service meal was cold and air con not working. 
In my experience it’s really gone downhill and not recommended at all for business travel.

author: David H
title: Modern, comfortable hotel in great location
text:
Great location for mainland trains and underground plus buses
Hotel staff were friendly and helpful. 
Issa on Reception was most welcoming on check in, as was Aida on departure.

The twin room we had was bigger than most London hotels we have stayed in, and very clean and comfortable.

Good choice of food on the buffet breakfast as well as food to order for breakfast.

author: Joseph H
title: Beautiful hotel in great location
text: The Canopy by Hilton London City is located within a short walking distance of the Aldgate bus/train station which makes it easy to see all the sights London has to offer. The hotel has a nice upscale atmosphere with rooms that give a modern industrial feel. The breakfast was fantastic with many hot items as well as cereals, fresh fruit, yogurts, cheeses and breads. Wonderful fresh juices were available. Staff was amazing and often remembered us by name and room number. It was a pleasure staying there.

author: Andrea Q
title: Amazing !
text: First time staying at a Hilton in London & I can highly recommend! Had such a nice welcome from Alicia, super helpful

author: Ana D
title: Overall good experience
text:
We loved this hotel's location close to the Tower of London and Whitechapel and overall really enjoyed our stay.  

The only mark against the hotel was that one evening, when sitting directly between the front desk (staffed with 2 employees) and the bar area (staffed with 3 employees), my bag was stolen by two women.  We were at one of the tables having a glass of wine, and it was by my feet.  It was planned and they were working in pairs - with my cards being used within a half an hour of the grab.  The police were notified, and it was on camera.  And I know no place is safe.  But it was crazy to have it done in a hotel lobby.  Thank God my passport was not in my bag.  Sadly no follow up from the hotel regarding the situation.

author: Leo D
title: Concert stay
text:
Having stayed at The Canopy on many occasions, I can honestly say the experience is always consistently good. 
Check in was welcoming and efficient, received an upgrade as a diamond member to a Twin Premium room. 
Upon entering the room there were some petit fours with a welcome note which was a nice touch (thank you Greg) 
Myself and my son ate in the St Clare bar, the food and service were very good. 
I didn’t eat breakfast on this occasion but it is a good selection. 
I had a couple of queries which were dealt with very well using the Hilton App chat facility. Thank you to Chelsea and Alicia with their prompt and helpful replies. 
See you again soon.

author: Holly X
title: A great luxury place to stay in the heart of London
text: Excellent hotel with amazing food options, chill out lo-fi DJ midweek, nicely placed opposite Aldgate East tube.  Rooms are comfortable and quite spacious, although the air conditioning does lead to stuffiness as you cant really open the windows for air.  Ice and water freely accessible outside your room (remember you key card!)  and the bathrooms are very nice.  Staff are excellent.  If you get selected as a "guest of the day" insist on free socks instead of the pointless keychain bicycle bottle opener thing.  the socks are the best thing ever!  Not cheap, but for business or pleasure, its a very nice hotel.

author: Julien G
title: Canapé Cafe - Best Coffee in London ☕️
text:
Let’s start with Abdul from the walk in Canapé Cafe on the ground floor. 
Abdul greeted us with the biggest smile, nothing was a problem but his coffee omg …best coffee in London! Don’t hesitate to come try, you won’t be disappointed. Breakfast was yummy and faultless as well. We will be back.

author: Erin Z
title: Lovely modern hotel
text: Lovely hotel, very modern and perfectly located for my needs. Super friendly check in service from Joshua and Natalia who were so welcoming and extremely efficient.

author: Poppy F
title: Wonderful!!
text: A wonderful experience, especially for breakfast where Ciro and Walter together with the whole team made us feel at home! Really well done!!!

author: Joseph A
title: excellent experience here
text:
This hotel boasts an unbeatable location with generously spacious, stylishly modern rooms offering fantastic views. The rooftop bar on the 11th floor is a standout highlight — it features wonderful music paired with absolutely stunning scenery. What’s more, it delivers fantastic value for money and is comparatively affordable.
The Natacia staff are incredibly friendly, thoughtful and attentive, they anticipate every single need of guests.

author: Evan K
title: A brilliant weekend
text: An absolutely fabulous hotel! Really modern and spotlessly clean! The staff were welcoming and friendly and nothing was too much trouble!! Location is really great,  Aldgate tube across the road! Very central for everything!! Special mention to Walter at breakfast who was very friendly,  kept everything running smoothly and making sure every guest had everything they needed!! Rooms were spacious and quiet and the whole experience was brilliant!! 😃

author: Oliver U
title: Definitely recommend
text: Loved the location! Room had nice amenities and was very clean. Front desk Josh was helpful and great to work with!

author: Poppy V
title: Two couples visiting London for the first time!
text: 2 cup visiting London for the first time. They canopy by Hilton was the perfect location… Rooms were so comfortable and employees were terrific!

author: Katie H
title: Hospitality
text: I came here with my mom for my birthday, eveyone was so nice and helpful. We gpt into the room and the bed was decorated and they gave us a desert and birthday card which was so sweet! We truly loved staying here. Plus the food in the restaurant in the hotel was so good!

author: William D
title: Amazing hotel, Service from staff exceptional
text: Amazing hotel, beautiful room! Special shout out to Natalia and Chelsea on the front desk, amazing service and will be coming back again for their hospitality!!

author: Michael M
title: What an experience!
text: I came to Canopy after I prepaid for another hotel for 6 nights! What a difference! The atmosphere was serene, clean, super-trendy  and friendly. Staff at this Hilton hotel were Amazing. Everything was top notch and the service  was amazing, Kubra, Derya and Baris were all gracious and hospitable. When you come to Istanbul, look no further folks!

author: Grace I
title: Great 2 night stay
text: Really good value for money stay at this hotel. Good location, well appointed rooms, nice breakfast. Staff were really friendly and always seemed on hand to help. Only slight gripe was that our pillows weren’t the most comfy, but that was the most minor of complaints. Overall a great stay. Would definitely recommend.

author: Grace T
title: Great hotel and friendly staff
text: Great hotel, centrally located for business travelers going to the City of London and walking distance to tourist attractions like the Tower of London. Wonderful staff, particularly Joshua, who was friendly and helpful to many guests including myself.

author: Juan E
title: Fabulous Hotel
text: We love this hotel, its great value, clean and well presented.  Beds are extremely comfortable, air con good, not blasting out!  Staff always friendly and efficient.  Chelsea very helpful, lovely lady.

author: Sofia V
title: Nice hotel
text:
We stayed at this property for three nights in January 2026. The location is very good: close to Montparnasse station and close to the Luxembourg garden.
The welcome and service are very good. The property is clean, the room is spacious and very quiet.
The breakfast buffet is good.
Only problem: the elevator is smaller than our old phone booths.

author: Leo B
title: A very good 3 stars. With lovely staff.
text: Charming staff!!!! Nice location. However the hotel is for me a 3 star. The room has equipment in medium condition.( broken bedside lamp, split bathroom sink...) bcp small details despite a great team.

author: Camille V
title: Excellent
text:
I had a great stay at the Nude Paris hotel.
Welcoming was excellent, friendly staff and care. 
The place is very nice and it is ideally located. 
I recommend++++

author: Evie A
title: Total disaster. Lack of commercial loyalty. Total absence of air conditioning.
text:
We arrived on June 29, 2025 and stayed until July 5 to celebrate our 50th anniversary of marriage. We pay for everything in advance. They lied to us that they had air conditioning. THERE WAS NO SUCH AIR OR VENTILATION. 
PARIS WITH RECORD TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 35 AND 40 DEGREES. They wouldn't give us another room or return the money paid. The deal was practically terrible abandonment of elderly people in a country foreign to us. We spent only one night without air could not breathe and the window that overlooked the street got warmer. EXCRUCIATING. An embarrassment for French hoteliers. No one took responsibility. It seemed more like they were funny situation. They wouldn't let us settle any complaints. They were shielding at the counter from what looked like a reception. They were just saying that there were difficulties with the air that on some floors were not walking but that they had no idea when it would be fixed, amid laughter.
In my country never could this hotel have obtained the 4 STAR rating.

author: Rosie I
title: Unsatisfactory. Non-existent conditioning.
text:
Everything was good, except the complete lack of air-conditioning in our 5th floor room at the onset of our 5 night stay. We spent the check in night in blazing heat, wrote a message via Booking.com message, requesting another room or we would seek a relocation / refund. The next morning we were offered another room, if we could check out and leave our bags. We were on our way to catch a train to our tour, and could not do so. That night we were given a portable fan. The next morning we checked out and when we returned we moved into a room on the 4th floor. No air-conditioning again. I asked the desk clerk to come check the room to verify that everything was turned on and working. He came up and said he was sorry, but the owner was in the process of correcting the old building's air-conditioning. We were given a fan for the remaining days, and as the temperature had dropped, we slept with the windows open and the fan on all night. Once you are in Paris, it's too late to change. Check my other ratings, I have nearly always given 10 out of 10 ratings in our prior trips to Europe.

I didn't see many negative reviews, and marked it up to outliers. If the ambient temperature is satisfactory for you to sleep in, then risk it if you choose. At least you can open a window, although without air-conditioning the humidity may be uncomfortable regardless of the temperature.

author: William C
title: Boring location, cheaply run, no A/C
text:
The air conditioning system was not working when we arrived on Thursday the 19th of June. It took until Sunday Morning, June 22 to fix. We were lied to continually about the status of the air conditioning system. When we checked in, we were told that it had only been out for a couple of hours which turned out not to be true, according to other guests we talked to it  had been out for days prior of the time we arrived. We were told that the system would be up and running by evening, which it was not. We were only told this so we didn’t leave, but we had no choice to stay since we had prepaid for the hotel. We were constantly told that it would be only a few hours before it was repaired only to find out that that again was a lie. We were offered no compensation for the fact that for over half of our stay, there was no air conditioning. Ok, one of the staff bought us a beer.

Location is a dead zone in the 14th, you need to walk several blocks to get to an interesting restaurant or good boulangerie, only bars on the block. 

Felt like the staff didnt like their job, not sure how they were treated by the boss. Whole place felt like they were trying to get by as cheaply as possible, only one towel per person in the room, pretty threadbare. 

Room was not serviced on one of the days we stayed.

Breakfast area was the best thing about the hotel but there wasn’t much to look at out the windows.

author: Grace K
title: Never to visit
text: Good location but nothing more. Management absolutely disgusting taking our money and not even telling us the cooling was broken a week before our stay. Management did not notify us of this issue at any point prior to our check in or offer any resolution of alternative accommodation or even a fan!!!!  We got a cold bottle of water to be stored in our hot room in the rooms warm fridge. Don’t waste your time and money!!. Other patrons actually sleeping in the foyer/ restaurant area as the rooms were over 35 degrees! Totally disgusting

author: Tyler H
title: Nice place
text: Nice room, good location, tasty french food. Everything was good. Room was clean everyday. The location was really good, everywhere was close. Small elevator, if you arrive with a lager suitcase only one person will fit, byt it is not inconvenient

author: Giulia M
title: Don't consider this hotel when in Paris! To be avoided!
text:
The location is pretty much the only good thing about this hotel.  Very accessible to metro/train/RER as well as many restaurants and sights.  Rooms on the top floor were hot because AC was not working well (and outside temperatures were only in the low 70s Fahrenheit when we stayed there).  Facilities truly need a facelift!
Beside that, we booked 2 superior rooms with city views and were given 2 classic rooms.  They ended up switching one room for us after the first night.  When we asked for a refund of the difference in rate for the other room they gave us the runaround saying that the manager had to handle it but she was not working weekend.  Needless to say there was no way to reach them once we checked out.  Their dishonesty and abysmal customer service make this hotel a place to avoid!  Never never let them steer you to Room 06 (the one on the ground floor behind the front desk) even if they brag about bigger bathroom and noise-insulated thick door!  Better yet, avoid this hotel altogether!!!

author: Diego B
title: ❌ Avoid this hotel unless you enjoy cold showers and excuses! ❌
text:
I stayed at Hôtel Nude Paris - Color Vision from February 5-10, expecting a comfortable experience. Instead, I got a “Parisian Ice Bath Retreat” for three days because my room had no hot water. 🥶
• Feb 5: Reported no hot water to the front desk.
• Feb 6: Asked again, and they said, “Other guests reported the same issue, but it’s fixed now!” (Spoiler: It wasn’t.)
• Feb 7 (morning): The hotel called us and confidently said, “We’ve fixed the issue!”
• Feb 7 (night): We got back to the room and checked again… still no hot water. So we called the front desk, and another staff member came up to test it with us. They confirmed: “Yes, there’s still no hot water.” 🤡
The staff even admitted that a refund should be given and said they’d talk to the manager.
• Feb 8: Finally moved to another room—meaning the hotel knew the issue was real.
But the real Oscar-worthy performance came when we contacted Agoda about a refund. The hotel’s response?
👉 “The guests didn’t know how to use the faucet.” 🎭
Seriously? Your own staff confirmed the issue twice, even moved us to another room, and now you’re pretending everything was fine? If you’re looking for a hotel where customer service is nonexistent and basic amenities are optional, this is the place for you. Otherwise, save yourself the frustration and book elsewhere. 🚫

author: Liam N
title: Poor customer response
