text: I was supposed to visit Paris with my daughter alone for 2 nights and was supposed to stay at this hotel between 23-25 Dec 2024. I booked this hotel through Agoda. Due to a missed flight from Melbourne due to a delayed incoming flight, my whole plan to visit Paris got cancelled as I was reaching Europe only on 26th. I informed the hotel before check-in that I would not be able to make it but would like to visit Paris again in Oct 2025 as my daughter has never been to that city. I wanted the room to be given to someone else those days as it was peak season time rather than keeping that on hold for me. I was ok with any 2 days in early Oct 2025 as alternate days for stay as per the hotel's convenience to give to me if they can. My mail was answered by Simon from reception informing me that the management is looking at my request. However on follow-up and sending multiple emails to the hotel's email ID starting from 24th Dec onwards no answer was provided. After not hearing from the hotel, I informed Agoda customer service to follow up with the hotel and after their multiple efforts, they informed me on 13th Jan (nearly 3 weeks of the planned visit) that they would not honor my request. I know I had booked a non-refundable hotel room initially but the cancellation was never on my side, it was due to a missed flight. I had informed the hotel in advance too before my check-in date. Also, the hotel's customer response is very poor at least over emails.

author: Katie B
title: NEVER STAY HERE!
text:
NEVER STAY HERE! I have never experienced such poor level of customer service. This hotel owe me £400. They continuously ignore any communication and refuse to engage in any conversation about my booking. Absolutely shocking experience.
DO NOT STAY HERE.

author: Caleb B
title: Beautiful stay
text: Lovely hotel in a great location, a 2 min walk from Port Royal station and Jardins du Luxembourg. Lots of bars, restaurants and amenities nearby. Hotel was clean, comfortable and staff were very friendly. Overall an amazing stay, thank you!

author: Miguel T
title: Great stay in Paris for anniversary
text:
We stayed here for 6 nights while we visited Paris for our 29th wedding anniversary. Our stay was great.  Older reviews talk about problems with the elevator.  We had no issues during our stay.  It is small and slow, that is often the case in old Paris buildings.  After spending all day walking and seeing town, you won't care that its small or slow.  You will be happy that you aren't walking up flights of stairs like many who will visit Paris.

We chose not to do breakfast, so we can't say how that was.  There are so many cafes and breakfast places we chose to use our time out and about. 

24 hour front desk person is a nice thing to have, it didn't matter what time we came in there was always someone there to greet us and answer any questions or help us with anything we needed.

Room was clean, no bad orders of mold or milder, no smoke smell.  Standard room was a typical small Parisian hotel room but was well equipped.  Cloths steamer, no issues with water pressure or temperature.

Only negative remark for entire stay, laundry service.  The web site said they offered but when we got there, we were informed they didn't do that any longer.  Hopefully they fix that.  However, with the great service they provide, they informed us to the location of the nearest cleaners, both a drycleaner and laundry service only a half block away.  So, we were forced to sit at a cafe and enjoy a coffee and snack while our clothes washed and dried.  Got to tell you it's not a bad way to spend a couple hours in Paris.

Thank you, Hotel Nude staff, for a great trip and taking care of us during this part of our trip to France.

author: Marta L
title: Our stay at this location was a great experience, and one we will try to repeat on our next visit
text: We had such a good stay at this property.  This small boutique type hotel was perfect for our needs.  The location was very close to many restaurants and even a couple small grocery stores.  One day we bought a bottle of wine and a couple sandwiches at a nearby deli and had a wonderful lunch at the nearby Jardin du Luxembourg.  Although at night, you had to close the window because of the loudness of the bars, cafes and traffic, that was not a problem, as the windows kept out the sounds, and the air conditioner worked quite well.  Three different metro stops were within a 15-minute walk, which made the city very accessible.  The breakfast had many hot and cold selections and was consistently fresh.  The facility was very clean, and the room was serviced daily.  We received great value for what we received.  The only negative we could think of is that the refrigerator was not as cold as we expected, but that was not such a big deal.  We especially want to call out the great reception we received from Pauline, and the friendliness we experienced with Simon.  When we return to Paris, we will stay at this property again.

author: Ana D
title: A Hotel I Highly Recommendation
text: A hotel that you do not expect with friendly kind people and always ready to fulfill your every wish the room in the norm but spotless breakfast good plentiful and excellent quality Hotel near the metro easy for every move I can only recommend it with great sincerity

author: Lucia A
title: Cozy and comfy
text:
I had a lovely stay at hotel Nude.
Very good location in a Paris character building, helpful staff and yummy continental breakfast every morning.
Room with good size considering the boutique style. Area with many options of restaurants, walking distance from Luxemburg gardens and easy metro/ bus lines to the other areas. Close to everything, but far enough of the busiest.
Will come back

author: Connor U
title: Lots of amenities!
text: Truly a wonderful boutique hotel.  Excellent location, more of a neighborhood than a tourist area but close to the metro.  The staff was so very kind as we were almost delirious with jet lag and not thinking clearly :)  They recommended a wonderful spot for lunch while we waited for our room to be ready, and gave us an early check in.  The room was spacious (for a Paris hotel), and the bathroom was superb with a regular size tub, and a long shelf to put our cosmetic bags on (usually there is just a sink and no shelf).  There was a magnifying make up mirror and a regular size hair dryer (not the typical small one that you have to hold the button down to use).  The best thing was the garment steamer - what a luxury to have after squishing our clothes in a suitcase.  And the window actually opened!  The lobby was lovely and they offered a bar and snacks.  Highly recommend, a good value!

author: Zachary B
title: Charming and super well located hotel
text:
We loved the hotel! Modern and tasteful decor, very charming! Wonderful location, super attentive staff and delicious breakfast!  The room was comfortable and the bathroom was large. Just the elevator 
 small, but it's quite normal in Paris. We think we made a great choice!

author: David O
title: Nice hotel
text:
Beautiful hotel well located near the Luxembourg Gardens, the catacombs and various theaters.
RER next door.
Beautiful room, comfortable bedding.
Small but functional bathroom.
Disappointed with the breakfast which is not of the standard of a four star: little choice, industrial products, few fruits and a little outdated in terms of freshness.
Damage !

author: George S
title: The best hotel in Paris !
text:
A wonderful wedding anniversary!
We had the most amazing time 
Hotel and staff are so incredible and can’t do enough for you. 
The pool was a bonus and lovely although a bit cool !

author: Noah I
title: Lovely, quiet location near the Opera and Galleries Lafayette.
text: We booked two rooms for our family of four for our recent stay in Paris.  The hotel is in a very quiet location, and it is an easy walk to a metro station.  The hotel staff was lovely and accommodating, the rooms are clean, and the decor is fun.  Our rooms were a deluxe and a classic.  The deluxe room was quite small, but we were out and about seeing the city, so that wasn’t a problem.  If you wanted to spend much time in that room, it would be a bit snug.  Bathroom shower is great, if small!  Classic room was a much more comfortable size.

author: Isabella O
title: Great experience!
text: I was very pleased with my room. The location was fantastic. I was able to walk wherever I’m able to be. The staff were friendly and accommodating, even though I didn’t speak French. I was able to get a great night sleep. The staff was very helpful in getting me anything I needed.

author: Rosie E
title: Thank you for everything and then some.
text: Our wonderful experience with this hotel began months before our arrival. Every question I had was answered and every request I made was fulfilled. Explanations were given, reservations were made and even a special pick up was done for us. All with smiles by a very attentive staff. Kudos and a special thank you to Freddy.

author: George L
title: Content
text:
Our stay was perfection. The rooms
Were beautiful and each was designed for comfort and a luxurious feeling. Everyone at the front desk was always so happy and willing to help. Especially kudos to Marwan who kindly booked trains for us and always advised us well. Will always recommend this place to friends and family.

author: Sofia W
title: A Paris Gem
text: We stayed a single night after a month of travel. We stayed a week earlier on our trip. Our room was clean, comfortable and the stay was excellent. The staff is supportive and friendly. Highly recommend a stay if you are in Paris.

author: Zoe H
title: Perfect hotel!
text: Very beautiful hotel. Nice room and very clean. Very friendly staff. Very good breakfast in a nice setting. Furthermore, the hotel's location is perfect for visiting Paris.

author: Louis O
title: Hotel wonderful area not so wonderful.
text:
Hotel was beautiful, we had a large room with very comfortable two twins, gorgeous linens.  The hype on the pool is just that, hype.  It is a pool in a little cave area too shallow to exercise in, not enough space to swim, more like a pool temperature hot tub.  Pool was pretty and very unusual though only worth one look see visit.  I wish at check in they would hand out info on the pool, exercise room and free patisserie cake, tea and coffee in the evening. I didn't even know they had an exercise room until the last day. I believe they would make people happier if they gave out more information.  Some of this may be that there is a language barrier and they would just as soon not talk too much.  A written ( in English) one sheet note would overcome that problem.  
Most of the staff tries  hard to help you, we needed help on train reservations to Monet's Garden and the front desk was most helpful.  
If I could change one thing about the hotel it would be its location.  It is not in easy walking distance to good restaurants.  We walked to some local bistros and cafes but their offerings pale in comparison to restaurants.  The walking distance cafes and brasseries in in an area not attractive and frankly dumpy, dirty streets.  Blue Jean young crowd people probably wouldn't mind but 75 and older people feel like you are in the slums.  We ended up taking cabs to more high class dining establishments.
Very much liked our rooms and hotel though, if you can put up with cab fare go for it!

author: Isla C
title: Two-day stay in Paris
text:
A very well-located hotel, with very welcoming and friendly staff.
Absolute calm in the heart of Paris
Very well located for visiting the city

author: Marta T
title: Very beautiful experience
text: Very pleasant hotel, well located. The staff is charming. The room (upgraded) was very beautiful with a nice view from the 6th floor. And the wellness area in the basement is more than welcome after a hot day in the month of July.

author: Miguel Q
title: Superb experience
text: Great Hotel! I had a great stay there.

author: Sean K
title: A romantic stay
text: We had a wonderful four night stay.  Botris gave us a lovely welcome and as it was my birthday weekend he very thoughtfully organised a surprise in our room.  Our room was excellent.  Overlooking the opera up in the eaves of the building it was large and very romantic.

author: Paige T
title: Divine
text: Just an amazing time, the hotel was perfect, the location amazing and customer service exceptional. Can't recommend highly enough

author: Nathan U
title: Your pied a terre in Paris
text: This was our second visit to Maison Favart and it will not be our last! Terrific location- close to the Marsis, Opera, and the Louvre. Wonderful, thoughtful staff (shout out to Boris and Freddy) that provides quiet attention. There are many terrific restaurants within walking distance. You feel like you are at your Parisien pied a terre!

author: Nathan C
title: Quaint hotel with high quality service
text: Absolutely lovely. Quiet street but so close in walking distance to the attractions. Fantastic customer service. And beautiful accommodations. Highly recommend!

author: Ella I
title: Girls Trip
text: Wonderful stay and hotel! The staff was so friendly and accommodating. Big shout out to Mounir who was attentive and flexible in upgrading the classic room I booked for a suite. Thank you we will be back!

author: Brooke E
title: Paris for my birthday
text: The location is perfect walking distance for the centre / a beautiful atmosphere itself and great friendly service . Only one small thing was it is quite dark in the room and just completely surrounded by the building with no view .

author: Ruby P
title: La Maison Favart should be your top hotel choice in Paris!
text:
Paris can be very challenging.  Navigation, transportation are generally a nightmare.  That is true until you need the outstanding assistance from Macicilia and Boris at the La Maison Favart, located in the second arrondissement near the Opera Comique.

We were very stressed when we needed to get across town for an Eiffel Tower tour.  No taxis/uber were available because it was morning "rush" hour."  With the incredible assistance of Macicilia and Boris, we made it to the metro station.  Boris personally escorted us to the Metro station, help purchase our tickets and pointed us in the correct direction.  

We have never had a hotel concierge service go to this level of assistance, anywhere!  Other transportation arrangements were also made for us during our three night stay.

The best - the restaurant recommendations and reservations made by Marcicila.  Au Petit Riche was excellent.  This was our second time there.  The best was Le Minet Galant.

Bottom line.  La Maison Favart is a beautiful, centrally located boutique Paris Hotel.  Concierge services are the best.  Many thanks to Marcicilia and Boris.

author: Liam V
title: Best hotel in Paris, hands down!!
text:
I travel frequently for work and have stayed in countless hotels around the world, but La Maison Favart is one I'll genuinely miss.

The staff are exceptional—warm, welcoming and effortlessly attentive. They create the kind of atmosphere that makes you feel like a valued guest rather than just another booking.

The rooms are elegant, full of character and thoughtfully equipped with everything you need. Every morning started with a fantastic breakfast that quickly became one of my favourite parts of the day.

But the real standout is the location. I honestly don't think there's a better place to stay in Paris. You're within walking distance of so many of the city's iconic sights, incredible restaurants and beautiful neighbourhoods. After spending all day exploring, it was always a pleasure to return to La Maison Favart—it truly felt like coming home.

If you're looking for a boutique hotel that combines charm, impeccable service and the perfect Paris location, look no further.

author: Brooke S
title: Our favorite hotel in parís.
text: The hotel is excellent for those who want to walk to most of the popular tourist sites or at worst a short taxi ride . It is a boutique hotel which we love and the pool was a life saver after a day in the 40c heat! . The staff at the front desk are the best and Freddy the conserge was always there and willing to help.

author: Morgan E
title: In general terms, very good
text: The price-to-comfort ratio is very good, and it is very well located. Additionally, it is very central for the tourist

author: Giulia G
title: Rest time
text: Thank you for making our stay something very special. The staff is very attentive and helpful. Impeccable rooms.

author: Mia O
title: Great stay
text: Great location and service, every request fullfilled, we loved the room the location and will come back again

author: Lucas R
title: Pleasant stay
text: We had a great experience here. We felt very welcome and the staff was extremely helpful. Highly recommended!

author: Lucas N
title: Disappointing stay
text: Very disappointed with our stay . It’s up a very steep hill so not advisable for older people. And not for families as the rooms are very small

author: Charlotte J
title: Great location and helpful staff
text: Great 4 star hotel. Reception staff very helpful and friendly. Perfect location close to major sites of interest. Room very clean. Comfy bed.

author: George P
title: Highly Recommended
text:
The rooms were clean and very roomy. The location was handy. Great variety for breakfast.

The staff were amazing, helpful, friendly and went above and beyond to ensure our comfort and needs were met.

Highly recommended and will stay there again hopefully in the near future.

author: Mason P
title: Bad hotel
text: We arrived at the hotel, with booked in advance, after a full day of travel and was crowded. We were with paid reservation!! The hotel has no accessibility, we went down the stairs with all the bags, so only after delivering all our documents, the receptionist warned that we would be transferred to another hotel. Say passing, a very lower hotel. I do not recommend and will never return.

author: Pablo H
title: Worst hotel in Rome
text:
We arrived at 21h with a reservation made more than a month ago, and to our surprise the hotel was crowded, I would have vacancy from tomorrow.
Out of all trouble the poorly educated, badly-humored receptionist
He said the hotel driver would take us to another smaller hotel and he would take the bags and the driver simply said he had a back problem and would not take any bags
Outside the entrance that is a super narrow staircase and has no one to help

author: William W
title: Highly recommended
text: The property is located in an area of downtown easily accessible both on foot and by public transport. Very nice and clean room; friendly, helpful and friendly staff. Extremely positive experience.

author: Lily U
title: Wonderful
text: My stay at Hotel Al Manthia was absolutely exceptional! From the moment I arrived, the staff provided warm, professional service, ensuring every detail was perfect. The rooms were spotless, elegantly furnished, and offered incredible comfort. The central location made exploring the city effortless, with major attractions just a short walk away. Breakfast was delicious, offering a wide variety of fresh options to start the day right. The atmosphere was welcoming and luxurious without feeling pretentious. I truly felt at home and well cared for throughout my stay. I highly recommend Hotel Al Manthia for an unforgettable five-star experience!

author: Paige T
title: Great hotel in Rome
text: We booked Hotel Rinascimento; due to an issue with leakage, urgent repairs were needed and the 3rd floor closed which we learned on arrival. The receptionist was overwhelmed, however transferred us to sister Hotel Al Manthia. The moment we arrived, we were warmly greeted by Roberta. We got a room upgrade to compensate for the troubles. Roberta and Sonja were very competent, attentive and warm and ensured we had a great stay. Rooms are very clean, tastefully designed and in great condition. The location is 5 minutes from Trevi Fountain, very central. Metro Barberini is around the corner. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this hotel.

author: Chloe O
title: Thank you.
text:
A big thank you at the reception for his kindness and efficiency that allowed me to quickly find my phone.
I recommend this hotel very well placed. Nice room, clean and hearty breakfast.

author: Dylan F
title: Great location,  friendly staff
text:
We had booked Hotel Trevi but were taken to Al Manthia, a sister hotel. We were a bit disappointed as had specifically booked Hotel Trevi due to its proximity to the fountain. Instead of a 2 minute walk it was an 8 minute walk. That said, it was a great, central location with transport links just a couple of minutes walk away. As well as that there were plenty of shops, restaurants etc all around. So location wise it was perfect. 
The staff were all lovely, helpful and accommodating. Couldn't fault them. We'd heard so many bad reviews and just dont understand why they were so negative about the staff. Special mention to Roberta(?) Always a smile and willing to help / advise. 

The not so good bits: the pillows were not good, the beds were hard, the rooms very small. BUT  they were cleaned daily to a high standard and served us well for a short stay. 
The hotel is not suitable for people with accessibility/ mobility issues due to the stairs at the entrance. The walls were also thin so take those ear plugs! There wasnt any tea and coffee facilities which i fine odd for a hotel, especially since we paid a premium to stay. I dont think it was worth the price we paid, you'd expect and could get more for your money elsewhere. 

Food: we had breakfast daily and there was a good choice of delicious food, varying each day. 

Overall it was a great stay and the staff and location made our stay a great one .

author: Charlie C
title: Hotel quiet, comfortable, not accessible, well located and takes care of your bank details.
text:
The hotel is well located for walking tours and is well connected to public transport.
The right rooms, small, quiet, and air-conditioned, although we had to ask to raise the temperature that was centralized, had to modify it from reception, to cold, all night to 22o.
As for accessibility it is inaccessible for wheelchairs and for staff with reduced mobility, it has a large staircase downstairs where the reception is.
Regarding the Service, it was generally adequate in terms of the treatment of the staff, but I want to point out as IMPORTANT that when checking in the receptionist, very friendly, we took a printed folio asking me to write down all my Personal data and bank card details including the control digit (CVV) and to sign it, this document allowed me to be charged possible damages, damages, debts for the mini bar etc. Obviously I flatly refused and comment that this type of information cannot be asked for because you are exposed to possible scams undue charges or go to know where that data ends up. I actually asked the receptionist if she would give that data to a hotel, or if she would give it to me and sincerely she said she wouldn’t, so it’s a shame that they do this to tourists.  The receptionist when I refused gave me the option to leave a deposit of €100 that would be returned to me on departure. Since I no longer trusted the "managerial policy" of this hotel, record a video on departure to verify that we left the room as we found it, without damage breaks or losses caused by our stay. Indeed on the way out I was returned without problem.
As for breakfast, it is better to have breakfast outside the hotel, it is lousy, it is not worth explaining more, there are places very close to where to have decent breakfast.

author: Harry M
title: Great hotel
text: The hotel was in a great location. Less than 10 minutes to the Trevi Fountain and near some great restaurants. The room was spacious and great for our family. There is an elevator, although it is small, and there is air conditioning. Note: there is a flight of stairs to get in and out of the hotel.

author: Juan Y
title: Reasonable Hotel
text: Hotel without accessibility, access by staircase without wheelchair, breakfast cafe without many varieties, weak in sweets, very small rooms with Box Shower area less than 1,00m2, and price not compatible, only sympathetic to the attendant during the day, the others are antipatic, do not speak Portuguese, are not very cordial.

author: Freya U
title: Cash grab booking. They knew they were over booked and still took bookings and pawed people to their other locations
text: Booked a superior room in the Trevi collection and was told on arrival that we were being moved to a sister hotel. Got to the Al manthia and was greeted with a strong sewer smell and put in a quadruple room but was told it’s a junior suite even though it showed the pictures on the site. Requested an iron but to be told they only had one and you could only use it in the breakfast seating area. The quadruple room is two levels with the top half like a sauna as the air con did not work and leaving the windows open only cooled the down stairs. Bed was like a slab of stone and walls were so thin we thought someone was walking up our stairs even though it was next door

author: Carlos X
title: Mixed bag..
text: We was booked to stay at the Trevi collection hotel but upon check In we was told that we was staying at one of their sister hotels .. this hotel. No explanation as we booked specifically the Trevi collection with Easyjet. Never have I been told that we could stay at one of their chain hotels within my booking..upon arrival at reception there was a very strong sewerage smell when u walk down the steps.. this was very strong and was there throughout the whole of our 3 night stay.. several guests we spoke to said the same thing about the awful smell. We checked in at 3pm and was given a quadruple room 301. The room was lovely and spacious. Clean had a minu fridge amd bar which u had to pay for if u use any of the mini bar but it does state this in the room. There was a double bed down stairs which was kept in a wardrobe which u pulled down but we used the upstairs bed. Beds are very hard and we got several bites in the night while staying here... very noisy street so hard to sleep at night and no aircon worked.. which is why we booked trevi collection as it had aircon sk this was very disappointing. The maid was trying to get innour room to clean while we was a sleep but we put the lock kn we wasn't awarenof the do not disturb button where the key card goes and receptioned phoned and woke us up asking if we wanted pur room cleaned which you would of thought that the door being locked and occupancy light on they would get the hint we didt want to be disturbed. The staff was polite although pushy into selling you trips obviously on commission..the lady on the desk never said hello had a face like thunder and was often on personal calls yelling and laughing and joking while we walked in and waited for our taxi. Poor customer service on her behalf..breakfast looked shocking but couldn't eat it anyways with the smell of the hotel reception was way too strong. Location was good near spanish steps and trevi fountain.. would be stay again..honestly no we wouldn't

author: Harry V
title: Excellent stay at this hotel.
text:
When we arrived at The Trevi Collection hotel we were told that we weren't staying there,a mini bus would take us to another of their hotels within Rome ?????? The La Manthia hotel was lovely.A short distance from trevi fountain,Spanish steps and down the hill to Barberini underground and the 'hop on/off' bus tour.
We were greeted by a nice and polite receptionist.Paid city tax €60.And took the small lift to the 4th floor.As soon as we entered the room you could see how clean it was.Lovely room with a nice view.Opposite where the Italian president lives.Area felt safe,a little hilly,but didnt mind that.Would stay there again.Breakfast was good too.

author: Maria L
title: Top
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Trevi for 5 nights, in two rooms, a quintuple and a double.
At the time of booking we asked for the possibility of having the two rooms close together, we were pleasantly accommodated and the double room was of a higher standard than the one booked.
Clean, spacious, finely renovated rooms. Spacious bathrooms with shower and tub in both rooms; in the quintuple room, the tub was a whirlpool.
Excellent daily cleaning; we even found a small bottle of water each as a welcome.
The reception staff was very kind, available for our every request, and even helped us manage the emergency that forced two of our guests to depart early.
We also appreciated the excellent quality breakfast.
A positive note for us was the location of the rooms outside the main building; it guaranteed us greater privacy and also easier management of the children.
The hotel's location a stone's throw from the Trevi Fountain is priceless.
This is the third time we have stayed at the Hotel Trevi and it has never disappointed us.
Highly recommended

author: Freya D
title: Excellent
text: Excellent location, excellent work by Roberto the receptionist. A very good and comfortable atmosphere. I traveled alone and they were super helpful

author: Jessica K
title: Unbeatable location
text: Very good treatment from the staff in general. In a privileged area, a few meters from the Trevi Fountain, and despite that, no noises were heard inside the rooms they gave us. It is a place to keep in mind in case of arriving in Rome.

author: Joseph D
title: A great central base
text: Hotel Trevi was lovely and did the perfect job of being a central base as we ran around Rome.  Our room was in a building near to the main reception, which was unexpected as we weren't informed about this prospect at all prior to booking.  But it wasn't too much of a problem; we were still very close by.  There was a very narrow lift to our floor, which wasn't always working.  The air conditioning in the room was much needed in the heat wave.  I had booked for 3 adults and 3 separate beds, but we got a double and a single.  We made do. The room was very clean and had everything we needed.

author: Poppy H
title: Great hotel!
text: Fantastic hotel and value.  Clean and modern rooms.  Great air conditioning.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  I would definitely return.

author: Alice A
title: An Okay Experience
text:
We picked Hotel Trevi for it's location, which is close to the Trevi Fountain and Spanish Steps.  This was a pre-cruise hotel for 5 of us.

The street that the hotel is on was narrow and our driver wasn't able to drop us off in front of the building, so we were dropped off a short walk away.  So had to drag our luggage over cobblestone streets to the hotel lobby.

The staff was extremely friendly and helpful, but upon check in we were given rooms that were in a different building down the street, not in the main hotel building.  They did have someone bring our luggage over to that building for us which was helpful.  The building had lots of stairs and only 1 extremely small elevator that barely held 1 person, so most of the time we had to walk up and down all the stairs.  It was definitely not a good choice for anyone with mobility issues.

As with most hotels in Italy, the air conditioning was barely cool and the 2 nights we spent there, got very little sleep due to the room being so hot.  And we were there during the heat wave which didn't help.

Our room was just fine, beds were comfortable and plenty of places to put your things.  Little bit of an odd set up, with 3 stairs going up from the bed area to the bathroom sinks (there were 2) and a large sunken tub.  The toilet was enclosed in a small room with a door and the shower was near the sinks.  

I can't say enough about how helpful and friendly the front desk staff were.  I would just caution anyone with mobility issues to request a room in the main hotel when booking.

author: Pablo A
title: Trevi Hotel room 604.
text:
Trevi Hotel room 604.
Poor insulation.
The room is right next to the restaurant kitchen, which is noisy; we had to go out each time to ask the staff to speak and laugh more quietly.
The photos of the room versus what we received have absolutely nothing in common.
Misleading advertisement photo.
The staff was super kind and helpful.

author: Molly C
title: Although well located, I would not return.
text: We chose this hotel because it was very central. Upon arriving at the hotel, the reception was very nice, everything was very clean. The problem was when we were accommodated in one of the annexes of the hotel. The entrance was a rather neglected place with two very old and dirty carpets and bits of wall debris on the floor, which were not cleaned throughout the week. The rooms, although not very large, were good; the bed was comfortable, but the carpet on the floor and the baseboards were full of dirt. If we return to Rome, I would not choose this hotel again.

author: Evie J
title: Stay June
text: Beautiful vacation. Super skilled and friendly entertainers! The service for small children is also very good. The entertainer is very respectful, attentive, and extremely available, especially for the needs of families and children.

author: Aaron V
title: We pay for the location.
text:
Nice location for traveling around the historic center of Rome.
Speaks little or not at all French.
Carpets need to be reviewed in the common areas.
Decent breakfast with a variety of choices, but located on the 5th floor where you have to take the elevator to the 4th floor and then climb stairs.
Small room that lacks storage; the photos from the travel agency do not match at all.

author: Thomas U
title: Might as well know.
text:
A bad experience among all our trips to Italy.
Upon arrival, we were taken to an annex. First surprise: an old and dilapidated building. Second surprise: a tiny elevator for one person and no luggage. Third surprise: endless narrow corridors that are poorly maintained, with a lot of woodwork. Fourth surprise: a room without a window and a bubble in the ceiling. Fifth surprise: the fire safety standards would need to be justified. Sixth surprise: the room does not justify the price of 1395 euros for 4 nights.
Given our refusal to take this room (risk in case of fire, in particular), we were given a very small room in the main building for one night, then another for the last three nights.
AIR CONDITIONING: unpleasant airflow directed at the face while in bed. A lack of oxygen was felt.
ROOM: the carpet is very dirty, with many stains.
BATHROOM: no ventilation, shower joints with mold, sink with water drainage issues.
BED: very hard as it has no springs and no slats; it feels more like a board.
ROOFTOP BREAKFAST.
Rotten plants in the window boxes, tables and chairs very cramped, many foods exposed without a cover.

author: George A
title: Very good experience
text:
As positive points, the room is very comfortable and complete. It has an excellent location. Just a few blocks from the Fountain and the Piazza Spagna. The staff is very friendly and attentive. The breakfast is very complete and has gluten-free options.
As a downside, when we went to check in, we found that the room was not in that location; it was a block away, so it took us quite a while to settle in, and there were also stairs.

author: Ian I
title: Great hotel
text:
On arrival we were kindly received, staff is friendly and helpful. We were too early but we could already drop off our suitcases and they were put in a special room.
To bridge the time we went to explore Rome a little. The hotel is really central and within walking distance of Trevi Fountain, Coloseum and Spanish Steps. 
After checking in someone walked us to the room and helped us with the suitcases.
We were in an annex which was just around the corner, and it was also explained to us that we had to open the outside door with a code and at the room the keycard was explained. 
Room was neat and equipped with TV, kettle and mini fridge. Beds are good.
Bathroom was also spacious and tidy.
Breakfast room is in the main building on the top floor, which gives a nice view of the city.
Breakfast is fine with a wide choice.
We had a great stay here!

author: Daniel J
title: A large suite that was not complete!
text: Maintenance worker covered our clothes and opened suitcase with dirt and dust!

author: Hannah C
title: Perfect location in central Rome, around the corner from Trevi Fountain
text:
When checking in we had to wait quite a long time because the mutual chat between staff was apparently important.
The bellboy was also very long in coming and was anything but friendly.
We were dropped off in an annex, where there was nothing of connection (no wi-fi, but also no ordinary data connection via 4 or 5G - virtually unreachable so...
The room was spacious, as was the bathroom. Everything was also clean and cared for.
However, the existing window in the room was not worthy of the name: it opened into a niche in an inner courtyard of another building, where the waste bins were located.
For breakfast we had to go to the main house just around the corner (no minute walk), the breakfast room was on the roof floor and so had a nice view.
The breakfast itself was TOP, really nothing to criticize - it seemed more like brunch than breakfast, with everything from sandwiches and toppings to cold and hot prepared dishes, bacon and eggs, sweets and yogurt with cereal and (fresh) fruit.

author: Connor G
title: Great location and service!
text:
This hotel was perfect for us!! Front desk hostess Ana was very friendly with welcoming information to  the hotel. It’s in a prime location, walking distance to most sites. From our room we had top views of Rome! Fresh breakfast daily,  homemade breads, eggs, and more!! Ms. Marzia and Erika are both very kind and friendly people. We enjoyed our stay at the Trevi Hotel, it’s worth it! 
Thank you,
Ricardo and Elizabeth- San Diego, CA

author: Henry T
title: Amazing location
text: The hotel is located right next to the Trevi Fountain, 20 minutes walk from everything, there is no better place to stay.

author: Chloe M
title: Hotel to escape
text:
We are very disappointed by our stay at Hotel Trevi. Given the prices charged, we expected much better quality services.

The room was particularly dilapidated and poorly insulated. The windows closed badly, resulting in constant noise nuisance throughout the stay — no night was really relaxing.

The furniture is also in a worrying condition: damaged bathroom cabinet, poorly installed shower cubicle whose doors open outward during use, worn and stained carpet, aging switches... The whole gives the impression of lack of maintenance.

The value for money is clearly not there. We thought we were booking a luxury hotel, but the reality is way below expectations.

author: Manon T
title: Holidays in Rome
text: We have been happy to spend our holidays in Rome, staying the Hotel Trevi, which is located a short walk from the Fontana, the facilities, the professionalism and friendliness of its staff and the location are the reason for our satisfaction that we do not hesitate to recommend.

author: Morgan Z
title: Experience fell short
text:
I stayed at Hotel Trevi and unfortunately the experience fell short in several key areas.

At check-in, we were told there had been a power outage and that Wi-Fi was down, but they expected it to be fixed quickly. It was never resolved during our stay. To make matters worse, there was essentially no cell service in the rooms either, which made it very difficult to stay connected or plan anything.

We had specifically requested a room with two beds, but instead were given one bed and a pullout sofa, which was not ideal or what we booked.

Breakfast was another disappointment the space was extremely cramped, and the setup just wasn’t worth the time or effort.

The one positive is the location. It’s very close to the Trevi Fountain and other major attractions, which makes getting around easy. But overall, the lack of basic amenities and the room situation made the stay frustrating.

author: Andrea P
title: Disappointing hotel. I would not return.
text: Hotel Julia, although located in the heart of Rome, has absolutely embarrassing rooms. I stayed for two nights in July.  The bathroom was old with a broken shower stall, and there was only a shutter in the room, with no screens. There was no desk and not even a surface to put things on. Not very clean; in fact, the first night there was an insect on the pillow. Quality/price ratio... paid too much!

author: Kyle R
title: Worst hotel ever
text:
Location ok close to Trevi fountain but is
An hotel without a soul. Terrible rooms terrible reception terrible lights terrible bathrooms terrible showers terrible beds. Noise of water during the night. Don’t chose this hotel do yourself a favor
For the same price you can get much more.

author: Isabella I
title: Convenient.
text: A convenient hotel for exploring Rome, close to the Barberini metro stop and the Trevi Fountain. Friendly staff.

author: Morgan V
title: Best price if you want to be in the center of Rome
text:
A very central hotel of everything, less than 5 minutes from the plumbing. It has no frills but is clean and the rooms are not dwarfs. We had a very nice week, and the price is very good to be in the same center., and in the evenings it was not noisy either. They change your towels every day and your sheets one day a week. 
You can even have a simple and very cheap breakfast. 
The staff is also very nice and helpful.

author: Morgan H
title: Not enough of a budget hotel to return
text: I am afraid that a third time will not be the charm. After a six year absence, I decided to visit Hotel Julia once again in an effort to save some money because of bloated Jubilee year rates. The savings was not enough. I knew breakfast was eliminated but you would think the hotel would offer a pot of regular perculated Maxwell House coffee (never mind those espresso machines) and the Rome equilavent of Tim Bits gratis, just to get you going in the morning. The on again/off again Wifi in the rooms in this day and age is inexcusable. But there are pluses...excellent location, walking distance to major sites and bus line is close by and a subway station is just around the corner and only two stops to Termini rail station.

author: Luke F
title: Very central
text:
For a job, I have to come to Rome. decision taken at the last minute, for the area where I had to work (near Via Sistina), I lean towards this hotel.
The structure is not particularly elegant and the room is small. However, the staff is courteous and everything is clean. Not the best breakfast, to be paid separately and consisting of a packaged brioche. Anyway, one night for work is more than fine.

author: Oliver T
title: Phenomenal little hotel with lovely staff in best location
text:
Phenomenal little hotel with lovely staff in best location

Was there for one night and found this hotel nearby my event at palazzo Barberini.  I had a large room with AC which was clean and pleasant. The staff was wonderful both Amedeo and Carolina. 

It’s a no frills hotel located in a great location with very polite and pleasant staff.

author: Ian W
title: Never switched a hotel so fast
text:
We booked 4 nights. We lasted 1.

This place claims to be a 3-star hotel—no clue how. The only thing going for it is the location, which was actually pretty good. Unfortunately, that’s where the positives end.

The room was tiny, the bathroom was barely functional, and the toilet seat was half broken. There were ants in the bathroom, even found a few in the bed and some mystery bug hanging out in the shower. The sheets had a stain (yes, really). 

The room was dusty enough to write your name on every surface. Clearly, cleaning isn’t high on their list of priorities. The ceiling was one of those false ceilings you’d normally see in an old office building—just added to the whole depressing vibe.

To top it off, the Wi-Fi was basically decorative. You couldn’t even load a basic page.

We weren’t expecting luxury, but basic hygiene and working amenities shouldn’t be too much to ask. We arrived late at night and had no choice but to suffer through one night. Checked out the next morning and never looked back.

Bottom line: this is not a 3-star hotel. It’s barely a 1. Don’t fall for the location. Just book somewhere else.

author: Matthew V
title: Avoid this cesspool of a hotel at all costs.
text: The individuals leaving positive reviews for this hotel seriously need to reevaluate their judgment. My partner and I booked a room for four nights but ended up checking out after just one night. This hotel is far from deserving a 3-star rating; it feels more like a scam and should be shut down. We encountered mold in the bathroom, ants in the bed, broken decor, weak Wi-Fi, and a loudly rattling air conditioning unit. We didn’t even bother asking for a refund; we simply handed the key to the receptionist the following morning and walked out. It is an absolute cesspool of a hotel.

author: Henry S
title: Clean affordable with good location
text: We were looking for an affordable clean location during our trip to Italy and Rome. Hotel Julia was on a Side street, close to Trevi. A small bar area downstairs and nearby coffee shops allowed us space to visit and eat. The rooms were comfortable and provided all the amenities that we needed. A good sleep and good location for visiting without breaking the bank.

author: Marco H
title: Hotel Julia Rome
text: Hotel located in Barberini Rome area. There are many restaurants and vibing places near hotel. Trevi fountain is just 4-5mins walk from hotel. Hotel room is neat and clean. Room is spacious. Hotel allowing to keep your luggage prior checking and after check out as well

author: Lucy S
title: Correct hotel near the Trevi Fountain
text: Hotel with good value for money. Close to everything, also close to the main avenues if you want to do shopping. Spacious room, clean and with everything you need for a pleasant stay. Very friendly staff. Around there are plenty of bars and restaurants.

author: Molly T
title: Dated but central
text: The structure is dated, the rooms are not the best, they do not have a fridge in the room and in the bathroom there is no guest set for the toilet. But in its favor it has that it is hyper central and connected to the Barberini metro. Practically on foot visit the main places in the center.  Also you sleep well, despite the centrality you can not hear street noises. Recommended for a hit and run in the capital.

author: Dylan H
title: Overnight stay for one night
text: Courteous staff and gentile.stanze small but for one night is fine, cleanliness ok, quiet environment, perfect location.relation quality 'price great for those looking for the essential without spending unnecessarily much money. I will be back

author: Andrea R
title: It sucks.
text: The hotel sucks dirty noisy rooms badly repainted walls taken off the wall there is no hot water the empty fridge , smells of mold everywhere , the concierge at 8.30 pm dines in front of the reception in front of the TV and then goes to bed joining chairs in the elevator reception with scratched broken walls peeling non-working bulbs. The Chinese who do the cleaning in the morning start at 7.30 am to make a big noise with mobile slammed doors moved on Sunday Morning used the hammer.

author: Manon F
title: Hotel in a great location but in need of a deep renovation
text: Over the years we have often been guests of this hotel and I gave 3 balls more for esteem than for actual evaluation (it deserves 2). The location close to the Barberini metro is exceptional and allows you to move easily on foot in the center of Rome. However, the structure is undergoing a decline that seems to me has also accelerated in recent years. It needs a major renovation. It is also a shame that there is no longer breakfast in the ground floor room. The employees are always friendly and efficient (a greeting to Mrs. Rosa).

author: Ella P
title: Great location
text: It''s situated in a great location, 3 minutes to Trevi and 10 minutes to the Pantheona, and you can walk from the flat hotel and get there nowhere. The only problem was that I didn 't offer Recommendations for heart patients or the elderly . The rooms were clean, but they didn 't work up a sweat, which was my biggest shortcut.

author: Evan P
title: Good location and friendly place
text: Central to most things. Clean and cozy. The rooms are clean and the location is excellent. You can walk most places. For the relatively cheap price in Rome, you cannot really complain. Staff is friendly and helpful. There are restaurants and breakfast places nearby.

author: Taylor L
title: Great Location
text: Hotel staff are friendly and helpful. Hotel rooms are spacious with all the necessities. Location is excellent, walking distance to all main attractions.  About 5 minutes walk to Trevi Fountain.  Restaurants, Cafes, Gelaterias ,Bars , Shops etc are all at your doorstep. Will stay again .

author: Mia U
title: Good hotel overall but bad wifi
text:
As per the title good mini stay had in this hotel during my short holiday in Rome.
Centrally located hotel, a 3-minute walk from the barberini metro stop and a 6-minute walk from the trevi fountain

Very professional reception staff, welcoming and helpful, the famous "human factor" that deeply compensates for certain flaws of the hotel.

Standard room but with everything you need, including shower in the room (thank you for the upgrade), Quiet and clean enough. The big flaw is the wifi that was disconnected frequently and when it went was slow, since in the room even the phone did not take (I know it is not the fault of the employees). 
Mr. owner, 3 routers per floor, 30€ per router and with 3 weekend stays you recover the expense. 
Adequate price. Recommended yes, but bearing in mind the flaw of WiFi.

author: Samuel C
title: DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL
text:
A very disappointing experience and unacceptable conditions.

I am writing this review as a travel agent, on behalf of some passengers who recently stayed at this hotel.

The experience was extremely negative. The establishment is very old and the facilities are in urgent need of renovation. During their stay, the air conditioning in the rooms was not working correctly, despite the high temperatures in Rome. The hotel only provided them with fans, a totally insufficient solution, and my passengers could not rest or sleep properly due to the unbearable heat.

The problem did not only affect one room: other families staying there also expressed the same complaints. The passengers recorded the situation at the front desk, but they did not receive an effective solution or an alternative room.

The conditions were so difficult that they considered leaving the establishment before finishing their reservation and looking for other accommodation on their own. It is unacceptable to offer rooms in these conditions, especially during the summer, without informing guests beforehand that the air conditioning system is not working correctly.

I would not recommend this hotel until they carry out a serious renovation of their facilities and improve the way they respond to their guests' complaints.

author: Henry L
title: Very disappointing stay – avoid this hotel
text:
The welcome was barely satisfactory.

The parking, advertised as included, is not even located at the hotel. Even worse, the reception staff advised us not to use it, explaining that they had recently experienced a problem with it.

In the bathroom, there was only one tiny packet of soap provided for two people (see photo).

The breakfast buffet was extremely limited, with very little choice (see photo). In addition, the dishes and cutlery were simply dirty (see photo).

Although it was around 34°C (93°F) outside, the air conditioning did not work. We reported the problem to the reception. When we returned later that day, the issue had still not been resolved. We were then offered another room, but the electricity was not working there. We were eventually moved to a third room, which was larger and had a fan. Unfortunately, the air conditioning still did not work there either, and the room was dirty.

During this whole situation, I also witnessed a particularly shocking scene: the reception staff reprimanded the technician in front of guests in a manner that I found humiliating and completely inappropriate.

The only positive aspect of our stay was that the Wi-Fi worked well.

We will not return and cannot recommend this hotel under any circumstances. In our opinion, it does not deserve its four-star rating in any way.

author: Maria Q
title: Terrible
text: Terrible, fortunately, I only stayed one night. Air conditioning not working in the middle of July (the issue was reported immediately without receiving assistance or intervention). Dilapidated bathroom and inefficient plumbing (the flow of hot water was just a trickle in both the shower and sink). Breakfast with very little choice, especially in savory items, as there were neither eggs nor cheese and nothing in terms of fruit. Highly discouraged

author: Mia P
title: Basic, good value
text: This hotel fit our needs well. The room was small, but that is typical of hotels in the area, and this provides a good place to sleep. Maybe a 10-minute walk to the train station, with one subway stop even closer and many busses nearby. In this historic building, rooms are old but clean, and ours had windows opening onto a quiet back street. There is even a church on the third floor! This was our second stay at this property, and we would return again.

author: Charlie S
title: Older charm with great location for a weekend in the Eternal City
text:
A perfect location for a long weekend in the Eternal City. 5-10 minutes walk from Termini and many nice restaurants in the immediate area. 
The palace, that is, the hotel, which was the residence of an early pope, has its own chapel, beautiful halls and charm. But like most older houses a tad tempered with a certain need for care.
Very quiet in the room, a little hard beds, spacious bathroom, and nice view of the beautiful courtyard.
Breakfast was a bit limited, with ok anyway.

author: Poppy O
title: Sleeping rooms only!
text: The Hotel lacked many amenities, but in particular disappointment my room was so small there wasn’t a chair to sit in. Either lie in bed or go somewhere. The neighbor had several homeless people sleeping nearby. The TV was not working well, no where to sit and relax, I was forced to walk around more than I wanted. I didn’t even know there was a chapel in the hotel.  No brochures or anything.  Just a bad experience.

author: Jack U
title: Hotel disaster (for reception above all)
text: Although the situation is good and the building very nice , the worst is that they are not friendly, they are edges and not attentive at all, the room was dirty, one day they did not make our beds or collect trash, even down the hallway of the plant, one of the days we returned from dinner about 11, we had an attempt to hold up the door, which was closed and we spent more than 10 minutes chopping because in reception were not , breakfast a horror: bad, the hard bread as well as the pastries , the coffee the worst and see that in Rome is a delight and the treatment in trattorias, cafeterias and in general is very friendly and hospitable. Rome is beautiful and worth visiting many times but this hotel is not even up to the standard of a 2 star hotel in Spain, especially for the cleanliness, service and attention (very unfriendly)

author: Charlie T
title: It deserves a restructuring
text: Small hotel housed in a historic building in Rome. Among the special features is the presence of a large chapel on the third floor and an internal garden. The room we were assigned was definitely dated and in particular the bathroom needed a total renovation.  Friendly staff and satisfactory breakfast.

author: Anna H
title: Unpresentable
text: Horrible hotel in all its points bad cleaning rooms that literally fall apart to take a shower you have to get into a dangerous and slippery tub with a dirty curtain water that does not come down the drains if you use the bidet enters the water in the shower courtesy kit three sachets of which an open roll of dirty toilet paper I do not know that of previous guests kettle do not work with two herbal teas expired army troop (perhaps even worse) with bread of a week poor salami old pasta .high price for the nonexistent services you save only the location but do not go there

author: Marta A
title: Not recommended. It's not 4 stars.
text:
It's not a 4-star hotel, historic building, with its charm and drawbacks.
He hasn't been given a review for at least 20 years. 
Unfortunate facilities, one thing is classic another is ancient.
Very sparse breakfast, pension category.
Staff, except cafeteria staff who do what they can with what they have, pretty dry and uncollaborative.
Minimum maintenance for furniture, toilets and hotel elements. 
Correct cleaning, as far as possible, does not give for more.
I would avoid this hotel on next visit to Rome.

author: Isla J
title: I will stay there again for sure
text:
Large room, large shower and there was excellent cleaning.
From the reviews we read it seemed horrible, but we were pleasantly surprised.

author: Holly D
title: Avoid at all costs. Not a 4 star.had to move rooms as room1 had mould in bathroom.no space in rooms. Carpet not clean.stale undr
text: The breakfast deserved to be in 2 star not 4, no hot options  . Stale bread and pastries. Plumbing in rooms needs updating, toilet constantly running. No space in rooms. No temperature control in shower and shower floods if you're in there longer than 30 seconds

author: Carlos H
title: We've been sick
text: I'd take all the stars off this hotel bad room bad facilities bad nothing works

author: Kyle F
title: A good base to explore Rome
text: All in all I was undecided whether to rate the hotel 3 or 4. We were nervous about our stay based on recent reviews. However, in summary, the hotel is more "weathered" than the 4 star rating, but our room was clean with fresh bed linen provided and was an ideal base for our trip to Rome. Its location was well located for connections to the sites of Rome but its proximity to Rome termini worked well for a day trip to Pompei. We Jane no issues with breakfast which included a good continental selection of fresh bread, meats and pastries.

author: Antoine P
title: Don't go there.
text:
I spent 3 nights in this hotel and it was definitely not a positive experience. The hotel boasts a 4-star rating but has nothing of a 4-star, apart from the location. We had asked for a two-bed room and remembered it three hours before our arrival. We were given a very small double room that they did not want to change us except the next day. Obviously one more double! They shared the beds and in the picture you will see the distance between the two. Heating not working and nights in the cold. Summary cleaning. Nothing in the fridge that was actually missing in the second bedroom. Not a glass... a bottle of water... nothing. Beds not made. Instead of an extra blanket they gave us a cotton bedspread.
Badges to enter the room demagnetized. Poor breakfast with bad bread and without a toaster. Brioche in limited numbers, if you arrive later you get packaged brioche of unknown brand. Industrial juices. Only low-quality apples are produced. What I regret is that everything qs falls on the very few service people who have no fault and who spread their resigned arms. It was not possible to speak to a director. Too bad. the building is beautiful but neglected and let go. Don't go there!!!!
