author: Noah P
title: Disappointing hotel
text: Hotel with an excellent geographical location and parking facilities, which goes to compensate for the lack of comfort that a four-star hotel should give. Environment rather old, with old bathrooms and clogged drains. Not to mention the disappointing and miserable breakfast.

author: Matthew J
title: Would need a big clean shot
text:
Lamentable breakfast buffet 
Outdated room 
Bathroom smell disgusting and shower that does not work. Just well placed establishment

author: Lea P
title: incredible hotel
text:
Brent News for booking that Hotel . Now in the first Week
Of December starts room heating by outside temperature plus 5 during the night from 6. p.m. up to 6. a.m. next morning. We got two rooms. One room was without heating 
two days . Fortunately, my wife was able to find shelter in our daughter's warm room.We have no future dealings with this hotel.

author: Amelia K
title: Frustration
text:
The only plus is near Termini Station
Breakfast is meagre - no god of eggs, no cheese. Then they brought a couple of pieces of sausage, the baby had nothing to feed, grated carrots from vegetables, or leftovers. They were hungry all day, they would have taken up eating in the cafeteria beforehand. The interior is squalid, the lift barely worked, the bathroom is ancient.

author: Lucy Y
title: Comfort and excellent location
text: Trust this hotel despite seeing negative reviews. Because experiences are subjective. This is an appropriate hotel for people who appreciate history and art. It is a beautiful palace of Cardinal Rospigliosi (Pope Clement IX) with large rooms and historic stays. Its old structure prevents certain adaptations such as large and comfortable elevators. It has a small but sufficient reception and always very well attended by competent staff. The two rooms were spacious and very comfortable. Having a window in front of the Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore is something unique and listen to its beautiful bells from the early hours of the morning. Some things can be improved. The taps in a bathroom were very old and a small cabin. But the bathroom was very spacious and comfortable. Daily cleaning and well attended. If you are looking for a modern hotel this is not your place but if you love the elegance, beauty of the antique furniture and paintings, you will be staying in a palace in a comfortable and well located way. Some things for each other. But overall my 5 night stay has been excellent and I would return again.

author: Leo U
title: Very negative experience
text:
I travel very often for work and usually stay in hotels. During my stay from May 19 to 22 at the Celicia Hotel in Rome, I had a very disappointing experience.

Upon my arrival, I presented my driver's license, unfortunately recently expired, having forgotten my ID card and passport at home. Despite explaining that my daughter could immediately send me a copy of my identification document, the manager, Mr. Antonello Greco, reacted aggressively and in very loud tones in front of other employees, leaving me deeply disappointed and uncomfortable.

The first room assigned to me, located on the ground floor, was very damp, with a strong smell of mold, and even the mattress was damp, causing me to spend a sleepless night. Fortunately, the next day Mr. Gaetano at the reception proved to be helpful and professional, managing to get me a room change.

The hotel is dated and needs more attention to cleanliness and maintenance. Regarding management, an improvement in communication and respect for customers would be truly desirable.

author: Anna C
title: Awful - do not book!
text:
DO NOT STAY HERE. This hotel is awful. 

We wanted to stay near the Appian Way, and booked one of the “best” rooms in the hotel.

We arrived in our room to find peeling wallpaper, cigarette butts on the balcony, holes that had been patched but not painted. The electricity did not work.

The walls behind the front desk are covered in stains, it’s in a sketchy part of town on a very busy street, and just outside the driveway there are big overflowing trash cans being sifted through by the homeless.

We left and went to a nicer hotel - we did not come to Rome to stay in this miserable dump. When we asked for a refund the front desk clerk said no, we should have given them time to fix the problems (clearly impossible) and that he didn’t care if we left a bad review.

The only good things I can say about this hotel are that it was reasonably close to the Appian Way and that the young woman who originally checked us in was pleasant.

This place sucks. Trust me and book somewhere else!

author: Lucia Q
title: For one night is fine!
text: Hotel neglected but "acceptable" value for money, also considered the area and the presence of parking (for a fee)

author: Harper I
title: 550€ and 200U$D stolen
text:
A stay that started more or less acceptable, turned into chaos.

We arrived on October 6 at night and were given a room that had the defective Safe.

I went to warn them of this problem and they told me that there was no other room or safe, that I could use the lobby if I wanted. I refused to use the lobby, as I didn’t find the idea too safe.

On our last day at the hotel, October 9, we entered the room and while I was assembling the luggage, I thought to count the money I was bringing (which I had kept in the suitcase, hidden among the clothes). To my little pleasant surprise I was missing 550€ and my friend 200U$D. 

The hotel director, Antonio Greco, wouldn’t give us any answers, treating us as liars and saying that if we wanted to walk to the police station. We insisted on calling the police to come, he refused to say the police were not going to come for such a small thing.

Eventually we called the police and the police came, took our complaint and told us that it was a good thing we did that since the police station was closed.

Anyway, they gave us no answer, and we were left with less money.

I attach photos of the police and the hotel.

A beautiful stay in Rome, ruined by the ineptitude and insecurity of this hotel.

author: Zoe G
title: Perfect for short stay great location
text: Warm friendly greeting on arrival gentleman was polite helpful. Room was clean and tidy unfortunately the shower well that was a experience for my husband as it was very small cubicle .shower curtain was tatty and there was mould around the cubicle that I’m sure with a good scrub would come off. ! There is meant to be a bar service but it’s not really maned waited a long time to get a drink which seem to annoy the female on reception. The hotel is perfect for short stay great location metro was easy to use lots of shops nearby too. Breakfast was pleasant and has a nice out side space too. Hotel is just a bit dated needs a bit of tlc but overall a lovely stay. It’s 3 star 🌟 good value and would recommend for short stay great location.

author: Sofia T
title: Excellent hotel solution
text: I always find myself cn pleasure in this 3-star hotel, in the semi-central area of Rome, clean room, new sheets, very good breakfast, parkingampia.La structure has its age but the fundamentals are there and considering the excellent value for money I think you have to settle.

author: Morgan M
title: Always a guarantee in Rome
text: Thirty years ago, as a student, Hotel Cilicia was my refuge. Today, returning as a professional, I found the same warm and familiar atmosphere. A “vintage” charm that smells of authenticity, far from the modern impersonal. Staff always courteous and reliable, cozy and quiet rooms, rich and tasty breakfast, convenient and safe private parking. It's not just a hotel: it's a part of my story.

author: Nora K
title: A journey between vintage and decadence
text:
Unfortunately, I have to confirm the uninspiring impressions of the travellers who came before me. Hotel Cicilia is just a few minutes' walk from the Museum of the Walls, in an area so served by public transport. 
Inside, time stopped about 50 years ago, without constant maintenance. Too bad, because the structure deserved better Processing.
Dirty and ruined wallpaper, mothballed and chipped furniture, carpet kept in embarrassing conditions, sanitary ware and taps left to age badly, upholstery in tatters. The mattresses, then, were a drama, at least as far as I was concerned. Hotel Cilicia, unfortunately, is all this... but not only. Breakfast is not bad, although the farinati did not completely convince me. The staff at the lobby and in the dining room, however, has always been friendly, helpful and courteous, but it is not enough to make up for the serious nancialncies mentioned above. The price, at least, seems low (when compared to the fares in Rome), but you have to be aware of what you are facing. 
If I may be allowed a suggestion, you should at least eliminate the daily cost of indoor parking (€10): it could be a sort of compensation for inefficiencies. What can I say: it is really difficult to recommend this structure... if they send you, know that there is yes worse, but also much better.

author: Sydney W
title: Hotel to forget as soon as possible
text:
We have booked 3 double rooms for 28, 29 and 30 May 2025. The bed mattresses leave a lot to be desired, the shower cabins that in addition to being small, should have a door, have a garish curtain that is disgusting to touch, the sinks do not swallow enough and dirty water accumulates on the feet, preventing a hygienically normal shower. The desk chair has the upholstery padding completely crushed and one feels that it is sitting on the crossbars of the structure. All this functional stuff.
As for aesthetics, the exterior structure of the showers is completely corroded and chipped giving a very improved appearance.
We have been travelling around Italy in five different destinations and by far the worst hotel, the most expensive and the worst service offered. And to top it off, the only one we had paid parking in. Quite a gem.

author: Harper K
title: Too terrible for words
text: The hotel is dirty, dirty carpeting in the hallways and room poorly maintained and the cleaning crew does not come to your room every day to make or clean your bed. Been 2x in 5 days. The bathroom was even worse toilet seat was the low vd toilet off so unhygienic as anything. Following the pictures there would be a shower cabin nothing is less where the door was out of the cabin and there they had professorially hung a shower curtain. The plastic of the cabin was torn and smeared with brown glue, in short a horrible hotel.

author: Ian U
title: Secure your belongings.
text: I booked this hotel as a surprise for my dad, when booking I selected a twin room. On arrival I was told there was no twin rooms available and that we would have to have a double. Not a massive issue, we realised once in the room that we could split the beds ourself, so that’s what we did. The next morning we left the room and went out for the full day, unfortunately my dad had his passport and wallet stolen so we were in a-bit of a panic on returning to the hotel (not the hotels fault) as of what to do about getting home etc. once in our room we made arrangements to pay for emergency travel documents and I paid for these, but when looking for my bank card I realised £60 had gone out of my purse that I left inside 2 bags in my room. I went to see a male on reception to explain that money had gone missing and a room attendant must of been in and taken it as the beds had been made etc and we’d been out all day, this money was £ not € so I know I hadn’t spent it as I’d been using my Apple Pay to pay for things. The male blamed it on myself and said it shouldn’t of been left in my room, I asked if he knew which room attendant had cleaned our room to which he replied no, he then said he would have the director of the hotel contact me the following morning. Nobody contacted me the next day so I went back to reception to be snapped at and told it was my own fault. The same night this same male was on reception again, we had gone into the bar area to order a couple of drinks as it was the last night of our stay and wanted to relax in the hotel. We was told the bar was closed and only soft drinks were available, I opened up the website to check the bar details as I was sure it said 24hr bar and it was only 8.30pm. The website stated 24hrs, I shown this to the male to which he replied “no I’m not a bar man and I’m not serving you drinks” he was so rude, I’ve paid to stay in a hotel as a surprise for my dads birthday, wasn’t rude in anyway even when I realised money had been stolen from my purse to be treated like dirt. When booking to stay somewhere you are also paying for a service and the service was poor, the hotel was very dated and had very little staff. After reading other reviews I’ve now realised it’s a common theme of people having money stolen. I wouldn’t return back to this hotel, and I don’t recommend anyone else booking here.

author: Manon Z
title: My experience 2025
text: I do not recommend it. You will have a terrible experience staying at this hotel. First, I was robbed when I left money in my bag in the room. Second, the breakfast is horrible and every day is the same. Third, despite being close to the city center, the area where it is located is not very good. Despite the price, I recommend looking for another one!

author: Hannah E
title: Good value for money
text: The hotel staff is very friendly, the area is relatively close to the sights and some rooms have balconies. Despite the above, the hotel requires renovations but sleeps well. The hotel's attention from the receptionist is noteworthy.

author: Sean E
title: Old and little cleaning
text:
I stayed at this hotel only one night as it was very close to an event we attended! The hotel itself has potential, good location, beautiful green space in which it is immersed, definitely a nice hotel .. but 40 years ago! It needs several renovations, the bathrooms are old, the showers poorly maintained (dirt in the corners, mirror inside the shower broken and peeling, toilet seat of the wrong size), the bedside tables were broken .. having good prices but not very low, I think the least they can do is to give the customer cleanliness and comfort, points on which they sin a little '! Parking is nice big, but they still ask to pay 10€ per night. Breakfast is very poor and with little choice .. all in all but acceptable!
I just wonder how bravely you can present a room with such a bathroom and shower!

author: Samuel G
title: Tired Hotel
text: We stayed two nights the master bed one side was higher than the other and the small size the springs dug into you and impossible to sleep. I mention this to the reception man who did nothing about it. The very old shower is the smallest we came across in six weeks. If you weigh more than 100kgs you will not fit. The hotel furniture from the breakfast room the sitting area is all worn out with no support feels like you are falling through the chairs. It needs a complete makeover. It only got two stars because the breakfast was its saving grace. There are no bars or restaurants close by.

author: Pierre D
title: It's canny for the price
text: Only place to fit a travel plug was in bathroom.duel carage way outside so getting a taxi was a nightmare.1.4k to metro. Bus closer 360 to town.only pizazz places to eat at night but could get draught beer.nice hotel and staff.breakfast ok.good for price.i would stop there again.single bloke easily pleased.

author: Joseph Z
title: Avoid!!
text: First of all, the room and the entire hotel are dated and run down. In desperate need of refurbishment and substantial investment. The room looks nothing like in the pictures. The wallpaper in the room was dirty. Marks on the walls. The sink was plugged, and the water was not draining from it. The toilet bowl was dirty. The shover was a joke! The Average size man is unable to make a move inside! The fridge was not working and was extremely filthy inside. There was dust on fixtures and dirty carpet. The staff was unpleasant in contact and very patronising. The location is away from Metro station, and there are very few local shops around. Overall, the place is run down, not looked after, and also dirty. Would not stay again and would recommend avoiding this hotel!

author: Isla M
title: Hold dere unna dette
text: Worst hotel I've ever visited. Incredibly rude and angry employees. Wallpaper held on and falling off the walls of the room. Breakfast was more or less inexpensive. Hadn't expected very much of a 3-star hotel, but that staff are polite and stuff must be expected.

author: Lucy K
title: Short stop for the David Gilmour concert
text:
We needed a place to stay for a night in Rome after David Gilmour's concert and found this hotel at a great price for one night.
The staff available, especially in the evening they welcomed us very well in the lobby during the rainstorm (what bad luck!) and also available at night. 
We spent a quiet night, we even ordered food on a delivery app and it was possible to eat in the room without dirtying anything.
In the morning breakfast at the hotel, quite simple but nothing was missing.
Highly recommended

author: Ella H
title: Awful experience, find somewhere else!
text: Shocked to read so many good reviews tbh! It’s one of the worst hotels I’ve stayed in. Broken shower, broken shower door, rot under the windows, dirty carpets, scabby shower tray, electric tripped when I plugged my charger in as the socket is hanging away from the wall. Walls are all marked, wallpaper peeling off, no body wash, noise from the other rooms, crunchy boney beds that make you ache, it’s really quite shabby and I was tempted to check out as soon as I checked in! Didn’t want to spend my short trip looking for an alternative hotel, otherwise I definitely would have. Wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone, also, getting around is difficult, no buses or trains locally, nowhere to get good breakfast nearby (didn’t have breakfast at the hotel for £10pp after the room being so rubbish I dread to even imagine what that’d be like) very disappointed with my experience in Rome on this occasion due to this hotel.

author: Sydney P
title: Ok
text: Ok hotel. No real welcome. Couldn't find our booking no communication about that by the boss Daniel.  Finally found it. Did not explain that if we took wrong lift we would end up in hotel next door. Otherwise clean but dated. Breakfast fantastic & rest of staff good! Restaurant next door excellent - the boss - fabulous & food too!

author: Poppy F
title: Good location no frills
text:
Good location for exploring all the sites everywhere is walking distance except the Vatican.  
We had a basic room that was clean and a comfortable bed.
The roof garden is nice for breakfast especially the very top terrace.
Only downside was lots of wasps and pigeons in August.
Staff were good and efficient.
Would recommend

author: Evie U
title: Lovely hotel!
text: This hotel was stunning. Staff friendly and hotel was spotless. The views from the Roof Terrace were stunning! Only criticism I have is that there is 1 small lift on which is slow, especially in the mornings around breakfast and check out time

author: Diego I
title: Nice hotel
text:
The room was a comfortable size for three people and very clean. My only real complaint was that the refrigerator never got cold, even after maintenance came to check it, and the air conditioning struggled to keep up with the outside heat. The hotel’s breakfast was adequate—nothing special—and after two days it did start to feel a bit repetitive.

The staff were consistently friendly and attentive, and the location was excellent. Being so close to Termini Station made getting around incredibly convenient. Pro tip: if you’re waiting on the main elevator while guests with luggage load in and out, there’s a smaller elevator around the back. It only fits two people and no luggage, but it’s almost always free.

Overall, despite a couple of minor issues, I would stay here again.

author: Nora G
title: Wife got food poisoning.
text: Hotel staff and room was lovely. Food was absolutely poor, set menu and we only liked 2 things from it and then after the beef fillet my wife has been throwing up and diarrhea since Tuesday night. We got home friday night and its now sunday and shes still poorly.

author: Claire X
title: Functional property in a Central location
text:
Very well located property. I have honestly never been to a cleaner hotel so full marks for that. The rooms are the size you would expect for a capital city....if you are large people you might struggle. 
The staff are neutral with only the bar man going out of his way to be cheerful. 
Pros-
Location, value for money, cleanliness, comfortable beds and pillows, beautiful roof top. Free water machine. 
Cons - 
The breakfast is not what I expect from a 4 star establishment.

author: Lauren O
title: Does not look like the photos
text:
Room booked for 4 days, paid 700€, enticing photo on the site but in no way the reality. We had to leave the hotel 1 day early, small room that smells of humidity/mustiness, view, well if you can call that a view, pipes were passing in front of our small window. 
Do not recommend because of false advertising

author: Connor Z
title: It is not a bad option, but some things are missing.
text:
The cleanliness is good and is done daily, and the staff is friendly; we encountered several who spoke Spanish. But it seems to me that it would not qualify as what is considered 4 stars in Spain. The bathtub is very high and makes access difficult.
The breakfast area is small inside, and the outside area requires going up and down stairs to get what you want.
On the terrace, it is impossible to eat because the pigeons are lurking, which is not the hotel's fault, but it becomes very uncomfortable.
Even so, it is in a good area within what is Termini. Close to the train station and with metro connections, you do not hear street noise, and it seems like a good option for accommodation.

author: William I
title: Air conditioning in the rooms is dreadful.
text: Hotel is ideally placed for the tourist spots. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful. However, the rooms air conditioning is rubbish and not up to the job if keeping the rooms cool. Other guests we spoke to said exactly the same as us. This made for a uncomfortable room to be in and especially sleep in.

author: Isabella O
title: Very nice hotel
text:
Located a few streets from the termini,good central position for sightseeing and exploring. 
Lovely reception and foyer with plenty of seating. Lifts to all floors
Staff very polite and friendly 
Room was slightly smaller than expected from the pictures, but did have hairdryer and tea and coffee making facilities. We were on the sixth floor and our room overlooked a back square with air conditioning pipes running up walls,so not very pretty and quite noisy. Description states has digital TV but was pretty useless. Remote control was inadequate could with great difficulty get BBC news which was quite depressing. We were there in the heatwave, so needed to spend some time in the room during the heat of the day. Did have a mini bar which we did not use, but was not extortionate if needed. Rooms cleaned each day. Air-conditioning was turned off between 10am and 11am each day as hotel policy which seems to be common to save energy in hotels. 
Breakfast was very nice with a good choice of hot and cold, a drinks machine for hot drinks.served on the seventh floor, with indoor and outdoor seating.
The bar itself was open from midday and was a nice refuge for a rest and a beer, food available to order. The barman was a lovely young man very polite

author: George I
title: Half Board
text:
We stayed at Hotel Diana on a seven-night half-board holiday and, unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing.
The biggest issue was the evening meal arrangement. Half-board guests were given a very limited set menu that remained virtually unchanged throughout our stay. This was never explained before booking. Had we known we would not have access to the main restaurant menu, we would have chosen a different hotel.
The menu offered very little variety. Around three-quarters of the dishes were fish, which my wife does not eat, leaving very few realistic options. Vegetarians would have had even less choice. One of the main courses was completely raw minced beef, which may be a local delicacy but is unlikely to appeal to many British holidaymakers.
We raised our concerns with reception on several occasions. Initially, we were told the manager would not be available for three days. After insisting on speaking to someone, we were promised a different menu the following evening, but this never happened. We were then told the restricted menu was simply hotel policy.
The hotel tried a few one-off solutions, including offering my wife a plain pizza and later saying the chef would prepare something different. When she requested simple Italian classics such as lasagne or spaghetti Bolognese, neither could be provided. Instead, she was served a very basic pasta dish consisting of plain pasta, chopped tomatoes and a few cubes of cheese. It was extremely poor and certainly not what we expected from a hotel restaurant.
After repeated broken promises, we gave up eating in the hotel restaurant altogether and paid to eat elsewhere for the remainder of our holiday. We also stopped using the hotel bar because, after making our complaints, we no longer felt welcome.
The accommodation itself was acceptable, but the half-board experience completely spoiled what should have been an enjoyable holiday. After returning home, I discovered numerous TripAdvisor reviews from other guests describing the same issues with the half-board menu, suggesting this is an ongoing problem rather than an isolated incident.
If you're considering staying here, I would strongly recommend booking room only or bed and breakfast and eating elsewhere. I certainly would not recommend the half-board option unless the hotel makes it clear before booking exactly what is included.

author: Alexander G
title: Not a palace, but nothing to complain about.
text:
I gave 5 stars to balance out the very negative reviews a bit. 
The air conditioning: there seem to be rooms that are more or less recent, but in our case, the air conditioning worked very (too?) well. We even had a bit of trouble not setting it too cold, before fully understanding how to use it. It is not very noisy (just the ventilation, of course we can hear it, but it is not bothersome). After discussing with other members of the group we were traveling with, there are older and noisier air conditioning units, but they work. It was 32°C in Rome. 
The street noise: there is a bit of noise, but once the windows are closed and the interior shutters are in place, there is no more noise (less than the ventilation) and no more light. They also help to prevent the room from heating up during the day. 
Otherwise, the room was renovated, not super luxurious, but a comfortable 160 cm bed (2 mattresses), a somewhat Scottish shower, but with good pressure, a safe, and a TV.
Good breakfast, hearty, very nice rooftop, even if the dinner cuisine is average. 
Convenient location in the train station area. 
In summary, not a palace and for the same price, one would often get better in France, but here we are in Rome and hotels are expensive, so no hesitation if the goal is to sleep well and visit.

author: William E
title: Beautiful time
text:
For our trip to Rome, we chose the Hotel Diana Roof Garden and were not disappointed. 
The reception was very friendly, and it must be said that this applied to the entire staff.
Our room was on the 5th floor. It faced the street, which did not negatively affect the quality of sleep.
The room was a very good size, very well maintained, and had everything one needs. The bathroom was particularly nice, everything was very, very clean, top-notch.

However, there is a point deduction for breakfast; the selection is very limited, and the facilities—except for the rooftop terrace, which is very nice—leave
 much to be desired.

All in all, we had a very nice time and would overlook the breakfast issue and come back.

author: Paolo B
title: Nice Hotel, pleasant and friendly staff.
text: Good location, 15-20min walk from the Coliseum. Friendly staff and nice atmosphere. Room was OK lacked a bit of storage, large modern bathroom. Quiet and clean. Good choice for breakfast, although we were half-board and had set menu for evening meal. Unfortunately, by the fourth night we were repeating meals, would have been better with two menus rotating weekly. Overall a really pleasant stay and would definitely go back.

author: William L
title: Clean and convenient
text: This is a nice hotel and a decent part of town, close to Termini train station (a 7 min walk) and lots of Rome's attractions. There's a nice restaurant on top of the hotel that has good food and good service. This is not a four or five star hotel in terms of amenities, but it's clean, safe, decent, and convenient. I stayed 3 nights and the room we were in was clean and comfortable, but it was not fancy in any way. Very utilitarian. If you're looking for a clean and safe place to stay on a mid-level budget, this is it. Front desk staff was accommodating. There is a bellman and there are three elevators in this hotel. Free breakfast each morning 7-10 a.m. was good -- more than continental, they had eggs and meats. I would totally stay here again.

author: Katie R
title: Couples city break to Rome
text:
We stayed at Hotel Diana Rooftop Bar in Rome  in May for three nights after booking through Love Holidays back in September 2025. Before our visit, I emailed the hotel to mention we’d be celebrating a birthday during our stay and asked about arranging any special touches, but unfortunately never received a reply.

On arrival, the welcome felt a little abrupt and we were simply handed our room card. The reception and entrance area have clearly been recently renovated and look sleek, modern, and very clean. Our room on the second floor was more dated in comparison, but it was clean and perfectly adequate for what we needed.

A lot of reviews mention street noise, but honestly we didn’t find this to be an issue at all.

The rooftop bar itself was lovely, although it was occasionally closed for private events, meaning we couldn’t use it one evening. Another time we visited, we enjoyed absolutely glorious views across the city. Drinks were definitely more expensive than nearby bars, but you are paying for the location and views. Surprisingly, both times we visited it was very quiet.

Breakfast was fairly basic and lacked much variety, with more of an American-style offering. We ate there on the first morning but afterwards chose to explore nearby cafés instead, where we found much better coffee and pastries. That said, if you just want to fill up before a day of sightseeing, enjoy the rooftop views, and don’t mind fairly mediocre included options, it does the job.

We were out exploring from around 7am until 10pm most days and love walking, so for us this hotel was ideal — clean, in a safe area, and within walking distance of many major sights. However, if you’re looking for a more luxurious city break experience, you may want to look elsewhere.

author: William A
title: A nice place to stay
text:
A very nice hotel with a beautiful panoramic view of Rome rooftop patio restaurant. 
Small rooms. Small and slow elevator.Friendly staff.
Restaurant food was very good although choices were limited so don’t be expecting a burger and fries.
Free self serve continental breakfast also on the roof top patio.
It’s located near the train station (although you can’t see it) but not recommended to go exploring near that area at night.
If you are energetic it is within walking distance of the Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, and the Spanish Steps (all under 2 kms) plus lots of restaurants and shopping.

author: Molly H
title: Great Hotel, beautiful roof restaurant, incredible staff!
text:
I’m so glad I chose this hotel for my first trip to Rome. The hotel was lovely and staff were amazing! 
It was also my first solo trip, and while there I accidentally got locked out of my phone. The staff at reception were incredible and helped me to get another boarding pass printed out (as mine was on my locked out phone) I honestly can’t thank them enough! 
The roof top garden bar and restaurant was so beautiful and the food was so good. Best Carbonara I’ve tasted! 
The staff at the roof top bar and restaurant were great and so welcoming. 
My room was lovely and clean, with a comfortable bed, nice and quiet on a night. It perfect for what I needed. 
The location was great within easy walking distance for me to Colosseum, Trevi fountain, Roman forum and all of the other mind blowing places I wanted to see. 
I left a part of my heart and soul in Rome and I will definitely be back in this mind blowing city again soon!

author: Ana G
title: Situation at the top
text:
Weekend with friends in Rome we were 7, we had a good stay of 3 nights in this hotel which is ideally located on foot 5 minutes from the train station, 5 minutes from the metro, 20 minutes from the Trevi Fountain and 25 minutes from the Colosseum.
Cons the air conditioning not working and intense noise all night for the rooms overlooking the street.
Pros: the bedding, the super nice roof top for a drink at sunset and the choice of salty sweet breakfast there is something for everyone. 
We were able to leave our luggage without problem upon our early arrival and late departure.

author: Gavin O
title: Wonderful experience
text:
Hotel Diana
From walking into reception you are greeted with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.  The staff are do helpful 

Our room had a king size bed with a balcony. This was wonderful for your morning coffee 
The room is spotless clean 
The roof top garden is wonderful for breakfast in the morning, then cocktails in the evening 
You gave a wonderful view of Rome you can even see the vatacan ftom the roof top
Breakfast is continental  with a great choice

I would recommend hotel  diana

author: Mason F
title: Loved It!
text: Excellent! Would absolutely recommend and of course stay again 😃 We stayed as our only day & night in Rome and cannot say enough about how comfortable, accommodating, and thoughtful the hotel team looked after us. Laurene especially could not have been a better host to us. And the hotel is a lovely boutique-style with large rooms including a lovely little tea/cafe sitting table, a roomy bathroom, and a big comfy bed, Thank you Laurene! Amber&Will 🙌

author: Ethan D
title: Great stay in Rome!  Cute terrace for breakfast!!!!
text: Our stay in Hotel Cellini was great!  Rooms were so clean and bathrooms seemed very updated.  Mel at the front desk was so nice and welcoming.  We liked how the hotel was located very close to so many major landmarks in Rome.  The neighborhood felt very safe walking around even in the evening hours. The terrace for breakfast was so cute!  We enjoyed the breakfast spread each morning with a cappucino.  Thank you for a wonderful stay, from your Filipino friends from the US!

author: Rosie T
title: Walking Distance to most things
text:
We had a lovely stay!  We booked a double room.  Prior to our arrival, I emailed and had airport transportation arranged by Mel.  It was a relief to have someone waiting at the airport for us and taking us right to the hotel.  Our room was nice, with large windows.  The shower was really small - barely enough space to turn around.  The bed was ok, but a bit firm.  We had a small fridge and a coffee maker.  Breakfast in the morning had a variety of croissants, eggs, yogurt, cereals, meats, cheeses, fruit & more. 
The staff were all nice.  There is an elevator, but it's small.   It's in a quiet neighborhood, close to the bus and metro stops.  We were able to walk to the Colosseum (about 20 minutes), the Vatican (about 20 minutes), Trevi Fountain (20 minutes).  There are several good restaurants in the area that we ate at.  The Termini train station was about a 10 minute walk.

author: Mason F
title: Great Hotel, wonderful staff!
text: We were very happy with our stay at Hotel Cellini. The hotel is in a short walking distance to most of the main tourist attractions. The rooms were very spacious, super clean and comfortable. The staff at the reception were friendly, polite and were always willing to help with anything we needed assistance with. We enjoyed our time there and next time we go to Rome we will stay at Cellini again

author: Olivia U
title: A lovely place with lovely people
text:
We stayed here for at the end of March for our visit to Rome.  The staff were positive, professional, friendly, and very kind.  They were so good to us and communicated well. They were kind enough to watch our bags after check out so we could see one last thing before grabbing our train to the next city.

The place was clean, safe, had a lift (for those with heavy bags), and the rooms were a decent size.  It was well lit and a lovely atmosphere.  We had the family room (a double and a twin) which did not feel crowded. We did not hear other guests and the place always felt very safe. I liked the little details in the room, which made it feel elegant and Victorian.  Tables in the corridor allow you to enjoy a cup of tea while planning your next excursion, adding a touch of charm.  Orchids in the room were a lovely touch.

They have breakfast at the hotel if you wish to done there.  The place was located within walking distance to the subway/metro and it was walkable to many go-to sites.

The cost was a good value for the location.  I would definitely recommend staying here to anyone and would come back in the future.

author: Holly J
title: Hidden Gem
text: Can't speak highly enough of this hotel, rooms absolutely amazing and spotless, staff are so friendly and couldn't do enough for you starting from check in to breakfast. The hotel is ideally located only a short walk from the train station and walking distance to all bars and restaurants and everything you need to see. Would have no hesitation in booking here again, thankyou

author: Zoe S
title: Perfect vacation hotel
text: An older hotel but very well maintained. The breakfast is good and the staff goes above and beyond to offer help and advice. I would recommend this place for your vacation stay and if we’re back we’ll stay here again.

author: Marco X
title: Outstanding Service Exceptional Employees
text: Our room was fabulous. As an admitted obsessive clean freak, our room was immaculate . The shower was first class, the orchids in our room (in full bloom) were unexpected. Additionally we viewed orchids through out the hotel. The breakfast was exceptional. We will definitely stay again and will always remember our special hostess Lauren who made our stay very memorable.

author: Charlie V
title: A gem of a hotel
text:
Spent one night in the Cellini as we were transiting through Rome.  The hotel itself is on a small street and occupies the second floor of an unobtrusive building.  There are a couple of steps that you'll need to carry your luggage up to reach the landing where the elevator is situated.  It's located near the centre of Rome, is close to the Metro, and has quite a number of restaurants close by.

Hotel staff are amazing.  They responded quickly to our email queries prior to arrival and organized car service for us from the airport to the hotel and the following day on departure.  We were warmly greeted on arrival by Daniel, who also provided wonderful help regarding nearby sights, dining, etc.  Our room was clean, very spacious and comfortably appointed.  

Similar to what was mentioned by other reviewers, I did find the shower/tub situation slightly inconvenient.  You essentially have to step up into a tub to take a shower.  The tub is a bit slippery and would be well-served by anti-slip strips.  The small half glass partition attached to the tub also doesn't block all of the water spraying around so expect to find a little water on the floor after your shower.  My other minor quibble relates to the window coverings.  Our room had sheers, which diffuse light, and side panel curtains (these are only decorative and do not close, so the window is essentially only covered by sheers).  Our room was immediately adjacent to the breakfast terrace so our window looked right out onto it.  There was an outside latticed privacy screen for the terrace, but I was still a bit weirded out that people outside, either on the terrace or in one of the other buildings closely overlooking our window might be able to see inside our room, especially if the room lights are on.  Yes, noise does carry in the morning when the staff prepare the breakfast buffet, but it wasn't a big deal.  The buffet itself was enjoyable, with plenty of food choices.  Regardless of the shower and curtains, we'd still 100% stay here again since the  hotel was very nice, is in a great location and the staff are so wonderful.

Thank you to all the Cellini staff, particularly Daniel and Mel, for your hospitality!  We hope to be back soon!

author: Ella R
title: Good hotel for a short stay
text: We stayed for 1 night as we needed to leave Rome early the following morning to get to the airport. The hotel is in a good location with a 10 min walk to Termini train station. Staff were friendly and helpful and are at the front desk 24 hrs. We needed to leave at 5:30 am and were able to check-out and get assistance with getting a taxi. This is a very small hotel and the building has multiple hotels in it. When we arrived, the door to the building was open, but there were no signs for which hotel was on which floor. Hotel Cellini is on floor 2 and is a quick elevator ride up. The room was basic, but clean and worth the value for a short stay. My only complaint is when we first entered the room, it smelled horrible like dirt or bad body odor. I quickly figured out it was coming from the air conditioning. Once we turned the ac off and opened the window, the smell went away and the rest of the room was spotlessly clean.

author: Charlie L
title: This gem of a hotel made our stay in Rome perfect!
text:
To cap our 18-day Italy trip, we chose to stay in this lovely boutique hotel in Rome, which turned out to be one of the most memorable stays of our journey.

This classicaly designed hotel was spotlessly clean, beautiful, and filled with fresh flowers, which made the entire place fragrant and gave it such a warm atmosphere. Our room was well-appointed, and the bed mattress was the best we slept on during our entire Italy trip (We're curious about the brand!) The bathroom’s whirlpool tub was also perfect for relaxing after a day of sightseeing.

The generous breakfast spread was excellent, with a wide variety of pastries, meats, and cheeses. We were served fresh cappuccinos every morning too. Service was outstanding as they served us a complementary bottle of wine for our anniversary, helped with restaurant reservations, and were happy to keep our luggage after checkout so we could pick it up later before heading to the airport. Mel, in particular, was attentive, kind, and helpful as he stood out among the staff that we got in touch with before and during our stay.

The location is also perfect: The hotel is within walking distance from Roma Termini station and just a stone's throw away from Repubblica metro station and a number of nearby bus stops, making it convenient and easy to get around the city.

Hotel Cellini was recommended by Rick Steves in his Italy and Rome guidebooks, and I’m so glad we chose it among others. We would love to stay here again someday!

author: Sofia Q
title: Great breakfast in central Rome
text:
Very nice boutique hotel in central Rome near Trevi Fountain and Spanish Steps.
Updated and nicely furnished, clean rooms.
The free breakfast was wonderful with a large variety of options.
There was some inside seating as well as the outside covered patio.

author: Rosie E
title: Hurray  for Hotel Cellini!
text: Great hotel with welcoming, helpful staff!  Small hotel on second and third floors of a nondescript building.  Staff helpful and offered good restaurant recommendations.  I'd stay there again in a heartbeat.

author: Megan B
title: One of the best!
text: We spent two nights at Hotel Cellini in May 2025 and had a wonderful experience. From the warm welcome at reception to the spotless rooms and attentive, friendly staff—everything was top-notch. A special thank you to Gaetano for his kindness and outstanding support during our stay. Highly recommended!

author: Ethan G
title: Excellent
text:
Ample rooms, comfortable beds, very attentive reception, very good breakfast.
We stayed for 5 days and for us it was a grata surprise. we recommend this accommodation, no shadow of doubt.

author: Adam J
title: Gem of a hotel
text:
This hotel is truly a hidden gem!!! A pleasant first stay for my first trip to Italy. We stayed here for four nights. Location is incredibly choice. We easily walked with all of our luggage from Termini to Hotel Cellini. The area is relatively quiet and surrounded by amazing food. We had no trouble finding good dinner after a long day of being tourists. For breakfast, you don’t even have to step out of the hotel! They serve a variety of freshly prepared breakfast items every morning. I enjoyed eating on the terrace.

And have to highlight the service!!! Donato checked us in and was incredibly kind. He suggested some sites to visit and showed us how to navigate the public transportation system on the map. We interacted with a total of four receptionists during our stay and they were all super friendly and receptive to our questions and requests.

The room itself was spotless and felt luxurious! It was very cute; you’d normally pay double for such a room in Vegas. I had no issues. It was nice to return to this room after so much sightseeing.

I will recommend Hotel Cellini to anyone who wishes to visit Rome!!!

author: Hugo K
title: Super clean - great place!
text: Very clean hotel, great location, staff very friendly and helpful. The hotel is only 700m from HBF Roma Termini and we could reach all the sights within 10-15 min walk. Also the breakfast was very good, the coffee too! We would love to book the hotel again.

author: Chloe M
title: Love it
text:
I absolutely love it! It's one of the best hotels I have been, small, cute, wonderful.
The rooms are big, u can find everything you need in the bathroom, the beds are comfortable. Ppl are so friendly, so you feel at home. I love the breakfast. Its very close to bus and metro stations. 
I absolutely recommend it!

author: Oliver S
title: One of the coziest hotels I’ve stayed. Loved it!
text: They are absolutely amazing! The staff is gentle and competent. Mel, the clerk who checked us in, was the best and made us feel very welcome after just having had problems with the other location we first reserved. Breakfast is more than I would have expected for small hotel - very good! The room is big with comfortable bed and great linen. Also well decoration. Internet works amazingly. Location - oh my God, it is so so good. We walked everywhere! I recommend this hotel and would most certainly come back without a doubt.

author: Chloe I
title: Structure recommended.
text: Hotel located in a strategic area, near the Metro Station "Repubblica" and very close to Termini Station. You can also move around on foot and visit many places of interest. The staff was very friendly. Very good cleaning. Interesting breakfast, The only negative note that does not allow me to give full marks was the noise due to the voice of the staff in the early morning when the kitchen opens for breakfast and during the early afternoon when the cleaning closes. For the rest structure to recommend.

author: Noah L
title: THE BEST !
text:
A big thank to the staff. They make you feel like you have known them for years. The lady who welcomed us on Monday 10th of August I don't remember her name . And then Mario and Francesco. Also the housekeeping did an amazing job . Thank you . 
The location is our favorite. Via Nazionale feels like it's the center of Rome . Buss stations and metro station so close. Coffee shops, pubs and tigre supermarket is 2 minutes way . 
The view from our room was AMAZING.  Can't wait to go back for our 3rd time.

author: Henry V
title: Excellent hotel!!!
text: Excellent!!! The staff Francesco was very helpful, we loved your tips. An excellent professional. I highly recommend this hotel!

author: Mia E
title: Ideally located in the city center close to the train station.
text: Very good one-night stay at this hotel perfectly located in the city center and 10-15 minutes on foot from the train station. Room for 3 or 4 is quite large, but the extra single beds are not comfortable at all. Beautiful modern bathroom. Well-equipped and air-conditioned room. Very good breakfast with a variety of options. Very good welcome (in French) with recommendations about Rome, thank you!

author: George Q
title: A good hotel in a central location.
text:
A nice hotel, very centrally located near Termini, the metro, and the bus. Many attractions are easily reachable on foot. Rooms are adequately sized and clean, as is the bathroom. The staff is very friendly. The only downside: the breakfast could be significantly improved. Aside from the fact that there is almost nothing for vegans (which we are used to), unfortunately, there is not even vegan milk for cereal here. Only toast bread and small, soft rolls are available. 
It was bearable for 6 days, but not great.
Aside from that, there is nothing to complain about.

author: Diego K
title: Great location
text:
Small but very comfortable hotel, clean and conditioned rooms. Very good reception, they waited for us with the rooms early which made it easy for us to arrive. 
It has a very good location, ideal for walking to most important sites.

author: Luca G
title: Good value and amazing stuff!
text:
During my stay in June 2025, I had an exceptional experience at Hotel Miami in Rome—one that I will always remember with deep appreciation.

At that time, due to the escalation between Israel and Iran, many Israelis, myself included, found ourselves unexpectedly stranded abroad. What began as a regular trip quickly turned into a stressful and uncertain situation, both emotionally and financially.

In the midst of this, Hotel Miami stood out not only for its comfort and excellent location, but most importantly for its humanity. The staff showed remarkable empathy, understanding, and flexibility toward my situation. They made a genuine effort to offer fair and considerate pricing, which made a significant difference when continuing to pay hundreds of euros per night was no longer feasible.

I would like to express my special thanks to Mario, the manager, and to Francesco and Mario from the front desk. Each of them went above and beyond to support me during this difficult time. Their kindness, patience, and genuine care made all the difference, and I will always remember their help.

Beyond the practical assistance, it was their attitude—the warmth, professionalism, and willingness to help—that truly set them apart. In a challenging and unexpected moment, they provided not just accommodation, but a real sense of support and reassurance.

I am sincerely grateful to the entire team for their compassion and professionalism. I wholeheartedly recommend Hotel Miami to anyone visiting Rome—not only for the quality of the stay, but for the exceptional people behind it.

author: Chloe P
title: Brilliant place to stay
text: Excellent staff , Mario and Maria were really good hosts and helped us so much . Lovley clean room , ideal central location . Would definitely recommend.

author: Megan E
title: Great stay!!!
text: Excellent hotel!!! The most sightseeings are on a walk distance. There are very many shops arround. The hotel itself is cozy, very clean and safe. They offer nice breakfast with aditional charge. We will be back again for sure.

author: Brooke A
title: impeccable
text:
Conveniently located hotel in the historic heart of Rome
Small room mes comfortable and clean 
very pleasant and helpful special dedication for Mrs Murielle
hearty and varied breakfast
classical and very pleasant ancient architecture   
Trevi Fountain nearby

author: Sydney Y
title: Good experience
text:
🏨 My stay at the hotel was excellent.

📍The location is perfect for walking around the city.

The whole hotel is accessible.

👍🏻 The service is very good.

🛏️ I stayed in room 302, okay, with a double bed and another one of a place. The bathroom is a little small and the shower theme could be improved as occasionally the water went from cold to hot. It had air conditioning available. In addition, there was a tray with electric kettle, tea and disposable cups.

💧In the hall there is water dispenser available.

🥤 On the fifth floor, before breakfast, there are two machines available for drinks and snacks.

🥐 Breakfast is very complete, with cold cuts, fruit, bills, juices and coffee machine with different options. Plus the price is economical.
