author: Ryan C
title: Gorgeous
text: I would like to thank mario , muriel , Francesco and all the staff in the breakfast room for the tireless kindness shown to me over the 20 years I attended in your beautiful facility. Let's applaud the conductor Marip Canzanella , his son Achillle and granddaughter Vittoria. I hope to spend a stay by December

author: Katie O
title: All around my best place to stay in Rome, Italy.
text: In my frequent trips to Italy, Hotel Miami has been the best place to stay in Rome. Impecable cleanliness, friendly atmosphere, good breakfast.  Very good location, near to all interesting places to visit; and nice staff willing to help visitors. Very affordable prices. About safety, in my opinion it’s up to you. I’m 86 years old, travel alone, never in groups, touring by myself and never had any problems.

author: Aiden I
title: Close to Termini Station
text: Comfortable rooms away from street noise. The view over Rome allows you to enjoy the beauty of the millennial history of the capital. Friendly and professional staff. A short distance from Termini station.

author: Daisy T
title: I love this hotel!!!
text: I love this hotel in Rome!! I've been to it three times!!! Comfortable rooms, windows with sound insulation, great breakfast!! It's old, of course, but very charming. The elevator is a very cool point... old... and there are no such places in Brazil! Super friendly staff! It has a very small room, q they only release in an emergency situation, as was mine on one occasion, but still I felt comfortable in it (but the suitcase did not open rs). There's no garage. Close to Termini and city sights. I do everything on foot... to the Vatican.

author: Louis S
title: It was lovely until final day
text: My mother, father and I had a lovely 10 night stay, all of the building staff were so lovely. Breakfast is basic but good selection of fruit. My husband joined afterwards on the 6th day as he had to work. I informed the hotel of this upon check-in and they kindly asked if he would come down and show his passport when he arrives. We had a lot of tours booked and this slipped our mind. Upon check out, I was scolded and even mocked when I apologised, it was very strange and rude. If it was so imperative they could have easily asked me to come down from my room on his scheduled day of check-in (which I was very transparent about). It really ruined what was a lovely stay.

author: Rosie V
title: Very well especially the Welcoming!
text: We stayed only one night (between 23 and 25 August) guests of the Miami hotel and we enjoyed it very much. Clean and tidy rooms, polite staff. In particular very kind and professional receptionist Mr. Maria (translated into Italian), who provided us with all kinds of assistance. Thank you.

author: Mathis S
title: Perfect location and hospitality
text: Super well located hotel, close to the main sights, you can do almost everything on foot. And it's close to the metro station, which makes it quite easy. Breakfast full and well varied. The room is very cozy The receptionists are friendly and hospitable. I recommend!

author: Pablo E
title: Dont believe the website description.
text: 6 nights in Rome to see the Caravaggio exhibition.  Hotel Miami rooms are definitely not as advertised on the website.  Room 531, a single, was so claustrophobic, had only one window ( in the bathroom) I immediately asked for a change.   Room 530 was similarly cramped, not "spacious" or have a "picturesque view overlooking Via Nazionale", and had no mini or basic tea-making bar.   Very clean. Good location.   Nice breakfast.  Pleasant staff.

author: Erin G
title: Bad experience small room showers need renovations old hotel
text: Guys don’t go there it was a negative experience , and very stressful room very small wc and showers need renovations bad beds and the staff was very bad the cleaning was zero-and also not safe cuz in your building is also a apartments it was very old hotel that i saw in italy

author: Ryan G
title: Very comfortable hotel with fantastic location
text:
Hotel located on one of the main roads of Rome, inside a building. Small reception attended very kindly in several languages. We were allowed to leave luggage on arrival and departure to fully enjoy the time available.  Simple room but spacious and very clean, as does the bathroom. Very complete and rich breakfast. Vending machines in the hallway. Very friendly staff at all times and willing to help.
A minor drawback is that many ambulances pass through its centrality, but we did not care.
Very central, next to the metro and close to the station. You can walk to all the main monuments from it and if not, the metro is very comfortable.
When we return to Rome we will repeat in this hotel.

author: Evie R
title: Excellent experience
text: Excellent hotel in Roma termini. I was impressed by the politeness of the staff particularly Erika. She was effective, polite always hvaing a smile on. I had an enjoyable stay.

author: Joseph W
title: Disappointing ecperience
text:
Nice hotel, staff professional and somewhat friendly. Clean and modestly decorated.
Did not have breakfast at the hotel so cannot comment on it but there are lovely cafes nearby that are good value for money. Good transport links and based in the centre of the historical attractions.

CAVEAT ... Be careful of your possessions. Left a beautiful dress in the wardrobe when i checked out and within 24 hours of contacting them, they claimed it wasn"t there and the housekeeping team had no knowledge of it which is quite dishonest of them as i actually saw it but git distracted and didn't take it. Makes me wonder what else. Not impressed at all and on that basis alone will not be returning to the hotel or recommend it to anyone else.

author: Isla H
title: Very Disappointing Stay
text:
0 out of 5

The only positive thing about this hotel was the staff—they were polite and friendly. Unfortunately, everything else was extremely disappointing.

This hotel is advertised as a 4-star property, but it felt more like a no star hostel. It certainly does not deserve its 4-star rating. The rooms were outdated, poorly maintained, and nothing like the photos. The overall condition of the hotel did not justify the price.

The biggest issue was the neighborhood. It felt unsafe, especially in the evenings. Even several locals warned us to be extra careful because of the high number of pickpockets in the area and advised us to avoid certain nearby streets. That made us feel uncomfortable throughout our stay.

I would not stay here again or recommend it to anyone. The staff deserve credit for being kind and helpful, but they cannot make up for the poor quality of the hotel and the disappointing location.

author: Evan J
title: Great location and friendly staff
text:
The hotel is less than 5 minutes from Rome Termini station. My room was very clean, comfortable and quiet.
Good coffee at breakfast (you can request cappuccino or expresso )
Great food choice for me as a vegetarian..
All staff were friendly and very helpful.

author: Owen J
title: Crack avenue
text: I want to be as honest as I can be writing this review. I am writing this whilst waiting to board my plane. This hotel is not a 4 star more like 2/3 The hotel its self is okay if you are using it only for somewhere to sleep (like a base). We picked this hotel based off location and being in walking distance to the major sites like the Trevi Fountain ect. This location is vile. You have drug addicts sat outside of the hotel. During the day and night. First day we arrived we witnessed 2 people smoking crack right outside. We also witnessed a women smash a glass bottle and hold it up to someone else’s throat. We The whole area is full of drug users. I am glad that we done a coupes trip and didn’t bring our children along this isn’t a location for children! This area doesn’t feel safe at all. The hotel room could be better horrible bathrooms and room could be cleaner. Some staff friendly. Other not so much. Breakfast wasn’t great. Overall I wouldn’t recommend staying this side of Rome definitely not near the train station anyway.

author: Evie D
title: Cleanliness, location.
text:
Perfect location to communicate with the airport and the city center. In addition in restaurant area.
Clean and with spacious room. Very friendly staff.
Breakfast, correct, but a little simple, not up to the hotel. 
It is worth staying here always.

author: Isla S
title: Don’t stay here
text:
Really small rooms 
Felt clostrafobic and also very hot, all they can do is turn ac off, windows open and pidgins

author: Samuel I
title: Ariston Hotel is excellent
text: After an exhausting 12 hour overnight flight to Rome, we were so glad to get to the Ariston hotel. Even though we were too early for check in, reception was happy to organise our room. After a short wait in the very comfortable sitting room we were shown to our room. It was a very pleasant surprise to see the very well appointed room with ample closet space, comfortable couches and superior bathroom facilities. The breakfast next morning was excellent. The staff are very friendly and professional and we lacked for nothing.

author: Thomas Y
title: Meh
text:
Room is outdated and not like the pics. It looked like a rush job to complete. Sloppy paint job,  terrible caulking, walls were dirty. Bathroom had a constant unpleasant moldy odor. 
Close to the train station which is ideal but constant street noise makes it hard to sleep due to defective windows. Thankfully only stayed for 1 night. Breakfast was subpar with limited options. There are better hotels out there for the same price range.

author: Ryan L
title: Family decandia
text: Great clean very kind hotel and honest prices

author: Daisy P
title: Good middle range hotel located in a more than adequate spot for visiting Rome and beyond.
text: Booked as flight and hotel package, but probably could have got it cheaper booking directly with hotel and flights separately. A good middle range hotel.Great location from main train station and to reach many attractions by foot or public transport. A comfortable room with adequate space. Kept to very clean level by friendly staff. Yes, noise heard from outside hotel, but to be expected given central location of a very busy city as was the unsavoury characters that are attracted to such areas. It was quiet inside hotel mind and felt safe. A fair amount of tastes catered for at breakfast, with some unusual items,but it certainly filled us up for a day of sightseeing.

author: James J
title: Awsome staff and helpful with location close to main station and most Rome lacations easy acessable, will have no prolem going a
text: Location and expecally staff

author: Olivia Z
title: Experience that I will not repeat
text:
I stayed only one night in this hotel passed completely sleepless. The street in which it is located is extremely noisy and throughout the night has been animated by squawks, screams and all kinds of noise. The windows of the room totally inadequate to preserve the tranquility of the living room. Very dated bed devoid of comfort. 
To point out the discomfort, little and inadequate willingness to find a solution in line with what is expected for a 4-star service. 
I will definitely consider other options for a future stay in Rome.

author: Maria Q
title: Great location but noisy due to faulty windows and not 4 star
text:
Very disappointed with this hotel. The location near the station was definitely where this review gets its extra star but sadly I can’t say a lot of other positives for a 4 star. 
Had to change rooms, first room was massive and a pleasant room but it was on the front and the window didn’t close properly. My son and I stayed the first night but got hardly any sleep. 
Asked to move the following morning, I’d checked online first that I could book a room before asking and yet at first the receptionist tried to tell me they were full. I don’t like lies. 
They did move us to a much quieter room which was clean, but basic a bit like a hostel but quiet and the bed was comfortable so acceptable but not 4 star. 
The following morning we had a power cut whilst I had wet hair! 
Breakfast was odd. Lots of Choice but some options felt more like leftovers from dinner.. Green beans and cous cous? 
The bar looked nice but was never open so we went out for a drink. 
I wish I’d have done a bit more research and stayed elsewhere.

author: Mathis Q
title: Great stay
text: Just spent four days at this hotel, it was clean, comfy, great welcoming staff and brilliant location. I would defo return if staying in Rome and recommend to friends. Thank you to all the lovely hotel staff.

author: Adam A
title: but which 4 stars!!!
text: To avoid. tiny room, tiny shower and with little pressure, room with defective window and therefore the night in full noise of the neighboring area Station .. screams, noises!... breakfast just enough .. NOT to repeat

author: Antoine U
title: Modern hotel conveniently located for Termini.
text:
Stayed here for a long weekend in Rome on a Jet2 City Break.  The hotel is located only one street/ a 2-minute walk from Termini on its south side.  Being this close to Termini there is always a concern for transients/ unsocial behaviour (particularly on the north side) but it wasn’t an issue in this location, although I wouldn’t want to stay much further east along the street.  Location is always a trade-off in Rome and while all the main attractions are within walking distance from this hotel, it’s a 10 minute walk from the hotel just to get to the top of Via Nazionale, which means that it’s an extra 1-2 miles of walking each day staying here to get to most attractions (assuming you don’t go back to the hotel during the day) compared to a more central location.  Okay for a long weekend, but that could add up to a lot of extra miles/ time over the course of a week.

An early check-in was quick and easy with friendly English-speaking staff at reception.  There are two lifts in different parts of the hotel, so no issues getting up and down to the fourth floor.  Small bar area and modern lounge.

The room was modern and appeared to have been recently decorated.  It wasn’t large but still had enough room for 3 large cases, without blocking space.  The décor reminded me of the colour scheme in a UK Holiday Inn.  Bed was comfortable.  The bathroom was large and roomy with a large walk-in shower.  Good pressure and plenty of space on a shelf for toiletries.  There was a mirror over the sink that wasn’t fully fixed to the wall, so tended to move and steam up easily.  Again, plenty of space for toiletries and a plentiful supply of shampoo and shower gel.  There was a bit of a smell of drains in the bathroom and also  in some of the public areas of the hotel at times.

The room did tend to get a bit warm, but staying here in November air conditioning wasn’t an option.  Tried opening the window but the noise from pigeons meant this wasn’t a viable option.

Plenty charging options for devices.  There was a small fridge which kept drinks reasonably chilled but I wouldn’t want to have kept food in it.  Television with Sky TV, but this was never used.

Breakfast was in a room at the rear of the ground floor.  It was snug and while it got busy, there was always a table available.  Breakfast options were a bit limited compared to other hotels that I’ve stayed in previously in Rome.

No food available in the hotel in the evening but plenty of restaurants in the area.

author: Hannah Q
title: The hotel from hell!
text: Room so small nowhere to leave suitcases without having to walk over them. Staff very out of it and unhelpful. Anything is too much for them. When we went to collect our possessions as arranged, they’d already thrown them away!! Etc. Etc. Breakfasts ideal for anyone losing weight!! NEVER EVER AGAIN!!!

author: Lea S
title: Do not stay here.
text:
First off with our stay specifics , we check in & get to our room. The AC doesn’t work , the TV doesn’t work, & the fridge doesn’t work. The room had a chop shop make over at best. Most work done poorly with ill fitting fixtures etc. The rooms are nothing like the photos for 1. The area isn’t too sketchy , but it doesn’t feel safe. 

We tell them night 1 AC isn’t working, they claim to fix it. Get no sleep due to how hot it was. Leave the window open & bugs come shooting in. 
Next morning remind them NO AC No TV & No fridge. 

Come back 8 hours later , still no TV or AC k the fridge is lukewarm rather than hot. 

Call again about the AC & someone finally comes to our room and says it’s broken and they’re full so we can’t move rooms either. 
We’re here for 4 nights & have to sleep in a hot muggy room or sleep with the window open and the bugs to intrude as they wish. 

Truly a horrible experience & I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

author: Ethan O
title: Nice Hotel Stay / Convenient Location
text: We had a pleasant stay at Hotel Ariston. Our room was clean and comfortable and spacious. Hotel is a short walk to Termini station, making it easy to get to major attractions in Rome. We walked to the Colosseum, Trevi Fountain and Spanish Steps from the hotel. The hustle and bustle of the city is very evident in the vicinity of the hotel; however, we never felt unsafe. The buffet breakfast had many offerings; we enjoyed having it available to us before our full days of walking around Rome. Overall, service was good.

author: Aaron V
title: Best hotel experience.
text:
Breakfast is always a great experience. Rose and Norma was fantastic today and everyday. 
They really are an example for the hospitality industry. 
Not forgetting the reception staff, Christine and  Stanley are so welcoming and friendly. They do their best to help with amy issues . 
This hotel staff should be the industry standard. 
Everyone tries their best to be helpful and solve problems.  The maintenance and housekeeping staff are always at 5 star level.

author: Oliver Z
title: Poor Front Desk Experience!
text: The 2 stars are mainly because of the staff. The hotel itself is clean and very well located. Unfortunately, the daytime staff was unfriendly and disrespectful. We were given incorrect information, and when we tried to clarify, they made it seem like we were the ones who had made the mistake. Customer service definitely needs improvement, better training and more careful hiring at the front desk would make a big difference.

author: Lily H
title: Christopher saved the day!
text: This past Saturday, July 18th, my husband and I were traveling from O’Hare (through Newark) to see Bon Jovi perform on Sunday night (7/19). We had an 8:40am flight. At 2:15pm, our flight was cancelled due to weather in metro NYC causing ground stops. After rescheduling, we were rerouted to Boston with a connecting flight to Newark, getting us into Manhattan after midnight. I called the hotel to explain the travel nightmare and I gave my authorization to check us in over the phone. Within less than five minutes, our flight from Boston to Newark was cancelled (still bad weather). I immediately called the hotel and explained my plight to Christopher, as I didn’t want to be charged for the room for Saturday, but still needed Sunday's reservation.  He put me on a brief hold and told me that he’d be able to cancel my reservation. He told me to book a separate reservation for just Sunday. I did that with him on the phone. He confirmed he was able to see it in the system, and then he cancelled my original reservation. After 32 hours of travel, we finally made it to the hotel. We were able to check in and relax before heading out. Our travel was a nightmare, but Christopher was able to remove my anxiety by ensuring we would not be charged for our initial reservation. Thank you, Christopher!!!

author: Aaron E
title: Don’t stay here
text:
I would not stay here again.

First, the rooms are extremely small for the price. We paid around $300 per night, and it definitely felt like the rates were inflated because of the Jay-Z concert. For what we paid, the room did not meet expectations.

Our biggest issue was the air conditioning unit. On the first night, we noticed a small leak and assumed it was just condensation. By the next morning, we had to place towels and a pot under it because so much water was dripping. Later that day, after we returned to the hotel, the entire floor was soaked. My luggage had been sitting underneath the AC unit (where there wasn't a leak when we left), and the unit had apparently been dripping directly onto it for hours. The inside of my suitcase was completely soaked, and the handle became so weakened from the water damage that it eventually broke off.

When we called the front desk, maintenance came up and opened the AC vent, and water literally poured out like a waterfall. It was obvious this wasn't a minor leak. We requested to be moved to another room, which they did, but when I mentioned my damaged luggage, I was immediately told there was nothing they could do about it.

To make matters worse, when we went downstairs to get keys for the new room, the front desk employee had an attitude and insisted we return our original room keys immediately. We explained that we still had to pack up all of our belongings and move everything into the new room before we could turn them in.

The following morning, I spoke with the manager about my damaged luggage, only to find out they had no idea the room had flooded, that maintenance had been called, or that we had even been moved to another room. The night staff had never communicated any of the incident to management. After the manager contacted their supervisor, I was told they could not reimburse me for my damaged luggage. The only compensation they offered was a refund for one night's stay. While I appreciate that gesture, I'm still left having to replace an expensive suitcase that was damaged because of the hotel's leaking AC unit.

To make matters even more frustrating, after the handle on my suitcase broke, I asked if they had duct tape so I could at least secure it enough to get home. Instead, they handed me a roll of Scotch tape, which was completely useless for a broken luggage handle. At that point, it just felt like one disappointment after another.

I also filed a claim with Marriott, but I was again told there was nothing they could do regarding my luggage.

Overall, the rooms are overpriced, the maintenance issues are concerning, and the communication between staff is clearly lacking. Some of the daytime staff were pleasant, but the nighttime staff were not very friendly or helpful during a stressful situation.

If you're considering staying here, I would be very cautious. Based on my experience, it doesn't seem like the AC units are being properly maintained, and if your belongings are damaged because of a hotel issue, don't expect much accountability.

author: Samuel U
title: Xavier & crew here amazing.
text: View from our room is amazing !! Floor 46! Xavier L was professional & quick w check in etc ! :) couldn’t be happier w our experience!! Thx Xavier! :)

author: Tyler N
title: Great front desk
text: Kayvon at the front desk is really wonderful. Very helpful with great advice.

author: Diego I
title: Spectacular view
text: We loved everything, however, the room was not cleaned thoroughly; they only made the bed and took out the trash, and we were not provided with paper and soap in the bathroom until we requested it.

author: William U
title: Nice experience, pleasant and very convenient location
text:
Was exactly what I wanted. A good location, clean, comfortable, good breakfast.
 a bit crowdy , but should be normal for NYC Manhattan. Good Reception  Desk clerk, good  organisation. A bit unexpected , that Receptionist is charging 40 usd deposit for possible damages , and the amount will be return to credit in couple weeks?.. ( I need to check that on my CC)
My booked room was with Kichinette, well equipped, although I did not need it... The Inconvenience was in the shower , as it had only fix upper head. Which I did not like to use...

author: Megan K
title: Perfect place to stay in a great neighborhood
text: Loved my stay at the TownPlace Suites by Marriot in Chelsea while in town to spend the weekend with friends.  Our rooms were very clean and modern and the staff at the front desk were exceptionally helpful to visitors, especially Nancy who was so great during check in when we arrived.  Such a great hotel in one of NYC best neighborhoods!

author: Carlos Q
title: Clean and safe
text: Such a relaxing trip and lived my room. Very clean and staff was so friendly

author: Joseph H
title: Short and Sweet stay
text: I wanted to take the time out of my day, to share what delightful experience I had with  TownePlace Suites Chelsea.I went with my friend for her 30th birthday and our stay was very relaxing and everything I could have asked for.The rooms were clean, staff was very polite and great views from the 23rd floor. I would 100% be coming back on my next visit to NYC.

author: Juan N
title: Perfect location
text:
This hotel is perfectly located for getting around the central area of NYC without stress. If you are a good walker, most of the attractions can be reached by a walk, alternatively there are many metro stations at your fingertips; the round trip to the airport is also convenient and does not require private transfers.
Breakfast is the classic of the medium-sized North American hotel chains: various types of bread, three hot courses (vary every day, usually one sweet and two savory), jams, yogurt, porrige, a cold course (varies every day eg salad, cold pasta etc); appreciable the presence of gluten-free products, without having to make explicit request every time. 
The only real flaw are the elevators, on days when the hotel was full the wait was considerable (even 20 minutes) and, when you are on the 20th floor, walking down may not be a viable option. 
There is the possibility to choose rooms with a kitchenette, very convenient, and, in addition, from breakfast you can take away (they provide containers and disposable cutlery, without having to ask them, for those who, in addition to breakfast, want to have a snack to take away). 
For us it is an overall great option and we will still choose this hotel the next time we return to NYC.

author: Morgan C
title: Comfort and cleanliness in a strategic area
text: Clean and well located hotel in a strategic area, convenient for easy access to the main attractions of New York. The room was small but comfortable, with really impeccable cleanliness. The staff was always very kind, polite and helpful, making the stay even more enjoyable. Only less positive note: having the room on a rather low floor, the external noise at night has often disturbed our sleep, which is why I do not feel like giving 5 stars.

author: Miguel Z
title: Good experience
text:
I recently stayed at this hotel in New York and overall had a great experience. The location was excellent, making it easy to explore the city and reach major attractions within minutes.

The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, with all the essential amenities. The staff were friendly, professional, and always willing to help with any requests or questions.

I would especially like to thank Xavier and the entire staff for their kindness and professionalism, which made my stay even more enjoyable.

author: Dylan A
title: Clean and great location
text: Went to see a Broadway show and wanted to stay in a safe area. This hotel is PERFECT!.. great location, friendly staff and super clean.

author: Lucas O
title: Great Location, Tiny Rooms, and Absolute Breakfast Chaos
text:
Stayed at the TownePlace Suites Manhattan/Chelsea for a weekend getaway, and the main selling point is definitely the location. You can walk to Penn Station, Times Square, and pretty much all the classic “New York is New York” spots. If you’re here to explore the city and just need a place to crash, it does the job.

Just be ready for very small rooms, pack light or you’ll be climbing over your own stuff. The building is tall, so the elevators fill up fast. If you’re on a schedule, add a few extra minutes because you might be waiting.

Breakfast was honestly the wildest scene I’ve ever seen at a hotel. Crowded, chaotic, and not exactly relaxing. This is not the place for calm or quiet.

Overall, it’s a standard NYC hotel: compact, busy, and all about the location. If you want to stay in Manhattan without paying a fortune and don’t mind the hustle, it’s a solid pick.

author: Molly O
title: NYC fun!
text: Quick 4 day trip to NYC & stayed here. I had a room on 2nd floor as I had read about elevators. I was surprised to discover there was a private patio attached! The weather was mild so I drank my coffee in the a.m & a glass of wine in the pm (They supplied an extra comforter so I could get cozy!) every day! The front desk amazing-shout out to Ashton, Janelle, Ariel & Xavier!! Close to Moxy -has an awesome 35th floor bar!

author: Paolo T
title: Great location for average hotel
text: Well situated and close to Penn Station, the subway and shopping (Macy's), this hotel has smallish rooms that are comfortable with fairly basic ammenties.  Several things in the room did not work (coffee maker, HVAC) but the hotel addressed post stay.  Breakfast is well organized but the food quality is average (these hotels always have the weirdest reheated egg products).

author: Owen K
title: An ok stay
text: We stayed here for 4 nights and there was some great things about it and some bad. We stayed on the 5th floor and were in a corner room- we could not hear the elevators but right by a stairwell door which slam shut so loud- installing something to make it not slam would help a lot. We had to unplug our fridge too because of the loud noises it made. Bed was comfortable- we requested extra pillows which never came, but slept fine overall. The staff were all very nice. Breakfast was mediocre and busy- the standard unfortunately. Location is super convenient for anywhere you’re going- one block from the subway. We used the bar area for our luggage which helped with space since the room is pretty small. Overall good stay & decent price. If the elevators didn’t suck so bad people wouldn’t use the stairs and slam the doors.

author: Lea T
title: Good location and efficient
text:
Surprisingly, this was a good place to stay. It is located in midtown and easy to get to the train station walking. Close to MSG to catch a game or event and with in walking to time square.

Loved the room set up, felt cramped but after staying there it was perfect and what you would expect for a manhattan hotel. 

Cost effective and the mini kitchen was perfect. 

Limited hanging space but you can make do for a couple night stay.

Hallways are extremely tight and elevators are crazy confusing on which one is opening but you will have to see it to believe it.

Front desk staff is amazing and very helpful on ideas for places to eat or things to try out.

Recommend staying here!

author: Liam G
title: Excellent stay except the air conditioning
text:
Pros : Walking distance to Gare du Nord, Staff Friendly, Majority of customer facing staff spoke good English, Hot and Cold variety of things for breakfast, good room service (food) during evenings. Close to pharmacies and GPs (walking or short taxi ride). Lots of Uber Eats selections available.
Cons : Air conditioning simply is not good enough. Max fan speed is only a quarter of power you would expect in a UK hotel (e.g. premier inn). Also set to 18 degrees it auto changes it hours later to 22 degrees. When challenged they offered a plug in fan which we accepted and it helped along with keeping curtains closed entire visit.

author: Nora T
title: my favourite hotel in Paris
text: Cosy rooms, very clean, great location, nice people and profesional staff, very good service, good value for money, a place where you are welcome every time!

author: Amelia S
title: Highly recommended!
text:
For our girls trip we stayed at Hotel Mademoiselle and had a great time here. The building, the interior and the rooms are all very nice and cozy. We stayed at the room with a balcony which really gave us the perfect Parisian vibe. Very close by, and in walking distance from Gare du Nord and very close to other metro stations. 
A/C was working and made our stay comfortable, also rooms are clean, quiet and the breakfast is really superb!
Overall a great experience, value for money and service! We would definitely come back!

author: Katie P
title: Lovely little boutique hotel
text: Lovely little boutique hotel ideally situated for transport links across the city. Staff very friendly, clean and beautifully decorated. Definitely recommend

author: Emma X
title: One. Great Lady
text:
Very nice hotel, not very far from the Gare du Nord but away from the hustle and bustle and very close to the covered market.
Room 605 on the top floor, under the roofs of Paris, quiet, clean, spacious, in short, a good time. Very good breakfast and thanks to the receptionist who has a lovely Romanian accent.

author: Lauren T
title: Paris holiday
text: Great location and easy access to major sites , friendly and helpful staff .

author: Camille S
title: Perfect hotel!!
text: We stayed for 2 nights. Great hotel!! Attentive service, neat clean rooms. Delicious breakfast everything as it should be.

author: Ryan H
title: Great base for a city trip!
text: Stayed here for 2 nights last weekend. Happy with the hotel air conditioning because it was a warm weekend. Reception neat and very friendly. We had room 605 which was accessible via the 5th floor. The room was fine, not too small, all space and there was already taken into account the sun, the shutters were down. There is access to a coffee machine from Lavazza and a kettle, unfortunately no fridge. Bed, fine. Pillows were nice too! Shower, our room had a bath and in the bathroom products from Rituals, lovely! So your shampoo and shower gel can leave you at home. We slept well here, not much bothered also by noises in the hallway. Breakfast was fine, baguettes, croissants, toppings, yogurt and freshly squeezed juice. Check out was at 12:00 and that was really nice to be able to take it easy on the day of departure. Hotel is near Gare du Nord station. During the day and early evening fine but later we found it more pleasant to stay in the hotel. You noticed that the atmosphere on the street was getting worse.  Yet we did eat out twice about 5 to 10 min from the hotel. For a city trip we would definitely recommend the hotel, with the metro you are so at the highlights of Paris. We would book this hotel again.

author: Charlotte D
title: Quality hotel.
text: The hotel is very clean, the rooms are functional, and the staff is very pleasant and available.

author: Sydney Q
title: Wonderful find - perfect for Eurostar travellers
text: Excellent find, minutes from Gard du Nird

author: Poppy A
title: Paris
text: Wonderful hotel, great location, very clean and good size rooms for Paris.  This was my 3rd stay and I would highly recommend it.

author: Mason I
title: Beautiful hotel
text: A very nice establishment, well located between the Gare du Nord and the Gare de l'Est, with amenities and restaurants nearby. Excellent welcome. Quality breakfast included. I recommend it!

author: Maria R
title: Excellent stay.
text:
Hotel very well located. Welcoming and warm staff.
All our requests were met.
We opted for the private relaxation area, and everything went perfectly.

author: Taylor K
title: Home away from home, especially when traveling the Eurostar
text: Best welcome we could’ve ever had especially being out of town AYRES as in out of country – out of town, AYRES! Ryan 💎💻 welcome to so well with the ability to store our luggage while we were sightseeing and when we came back, my daughter needed to take a pill with yogurt and JIMMIE took her to the kitchen talk with her like he was one of his own and got her yogurt so she could try to take this pill for a cough. She developed on the plane! The Hydro massage was pretty great – it really relaxed my husband when he needed it after all the travel I was making him do and we could not have been happier with the staff at breakfast. Oh my goodness – the breakfast! We have nothing like this in the states! We’re talking hot food, crêpes, one of the staff you can help me poach an egg! The tea was wonderful. There were so many options and I wouldn’t be back there right now! If you have the opportunity to stay near here, especially if you’re traveling the Eurostar, which is the reason I booked it, I would definitely recommend 1000 times!

author: Luca D
title: Comfortable, great location, good breakfast
text:
5 minutes walk from Gard du Nord, so it's perfect for passengers coming in via Eurostar. Gard du Lest is also close by, along with Poissonierre metro station so an excellent base from which to tour round Paris on the public transport system. 

Comfortable rooms, with tea/coffee making facilities, a safe, multi channel TV. Complimentary drinking water provided every day. Usual toiletries and slippers in the ensuite bathroom. 

Breakfast was good, with juices, hot drinks, cereals, fruit, breads, pastries, eggs, pancakes. 

There is a local supermarket two doors away from the hotel if you need any supplies. Aldi and Carrefour are also nearby. 

Plus plenty of restaurants in the vicinity. We were pleasantly surprised to find several Indian vegetarian restaurants a few minutes walk from Gare du Nord.

author: Paolo K
title: Very good value for money
text: Friendly welcome and well equipped room and comfort roof with very good bedding. I recommend

author: Charlotte C
title: Very great trip
text:
Everything was perfect. 
The only minor issue was the WIFI-Speed. 
And maybe you shouldn't let football fans not come to the breakfast room in underwear.

author: Hannah O
title: City trip Paris
text:
Location: ideal location to the station and the city center
Rooms: small but very neat
Staff: very friendly and helpful
Breakfast: very tasty and extensive

author: Nora F
title: At the top!!!
text: Quality service and staff always smiling and caring. I highly recommend!!!

author: William C
title: An enjoyable stay.
text:
Great location near two main stations.
VERY helpful staff.
Quiet room - much appreciated.
Good selection of hot and cold items at breakfast buffet.

author: Lucy V
title: Very good
text:
I loved the hotel and the staff are very professional. I hope to be back soon. 
Continue with your excellent service

author: Lauren A
title: Excellent
text: Was a really nice stay! Reception very friendly and helpful at all times. Room was nice and clean and in a good location in terms on metro and buses.

author: Laura O
title: Price quality fine choice
text: Price quality fine hotel with ideal location in a lively safe-feeling neighborhood 1.5km on foot from Montmartre. Fully equipped rooms.

author: Nora F
title: citytrip
text: excellent position in Paris/ accessible by bus from and to North station/ hôtel a little old fashioned but great welcoming and breakfast

author: Daniel U
title: A hotel in a good location for tourist activities
text: The hotel offers friendly staff, air-conditioned and clean rooms with good beds, and a normal breakfast buffet. Only the subway and the street are somewhat noticeable.

author: Ruby S
title: Perfect!
text: I recommend this establishment, everything was perfect and the welcome was top-notch! I will return without hesitation. The breakfast was also very good. Perfectly located hotel.

author: David Z
title: Nice hotel with friendly staff
text: Had the family room which had plenty of space for the two of us and our 10 year old. Friendly staff too. Some nice restaurants and cafes nearby.

author: Ruby I
title: Great Location and a Clean Hotel
text: The hotel was clean, and the location was excellent. I booked a room with breakfast, but it didn’t really impress me. There was juice, coffee, croissants, cold cuts, and cereal. What I found strange was that the milk for the cereal was warm because it came from the coffee machine. Although I guess that’s probably common in French hotels. Overall, though, everything else was great.

author: Grace D
title: very satisfied
text: the location is perfect, the welcome is pleasant, the rooms are clean and comfortable. The breakfast is complete and very good

author: Mathis B
title: Trip with my daughter and granddaughter
text: Central location. Front desk people very nice and helpful. Very small, boutique hotel. You just need to know it’s small. The family rooms worked well for us.

author: Laura B
title: Very Parisian Experience
text:
Lovely hotel in an amazing location. 
Room very clean and comfortable. 
Staff very helpful
Highly recommend

author: Freya L
title: Eurotrip
text: Just a little cozy place to be able to sleep, away from all the tourist craze, Welcomed with smiles and very nice people,

author: Alice T
title: Very good hotel. Exelent service and very friendly staff. Possition is very good. Good area
text: Exelent friendly people are working here. They give you very good service. I was feeling very welcome here. Bed is super comfy and new. View is spectacular. Area is very good. Everything is near.very good quality for this money.Will recommend it to my friends

author: Ruby Q
title: AVOID!!! Cancelled Our Room At The Last Minute, Then Refused A Refund!
text:
AVOID THIS COMPANY!

As we were about to board the flight to Paris, they sent a message saying that the two bedroom apartment that we had booked was not available and that they had an alternative.

We arrived in Paris late in the evening and arrived at the apartment, only to find that it only had one bed. This was completely inappropriate, so we had to find another hotel at the last minute (over Easter Weekend!)

That would have been bad enough, but they are refusing to refund us for the stay (over £500) and are no longer responding to any messages from us or the website that we booked them through.

I would strongly advise that you do not use this company!

author: Holly M
title: Bad sleep
text: I couldn't sleep, because of the noise and the trembling of the metro every 30 seconds. I asked another room, but that wasn't possible. So I was very tired all the time and after my stay. Not a good experience.

author: Grace U
title: Very good
text:
Clean rooms, amiable staff, well located and very reasonably priced. Lots of nice cafes and restaurants nearby. Easy walks to
Montmartre and to the city centre.

author: Chloe F
title: Hotel stay
text: The room was extremely clean and cozy. There was a leak in my bathroom where I had to switch rooms twice and I  was offered two free breakfast meals which was $34 Euros. I think I  should have been offered a voucher for my next visit or even a bottle of wine.  While the staff was great, my experience should have been better.

author: Henry L
title: It's a safe hotel.
text: The hotel was conveniently located for walking around the opera and was a quiet place to sleep at night. Perhaps because I was not dealing with a group of customers, I was able to have breakfast at ease. The bottled water that was first given to me was also very helpful because I could always refill it.

author: Harper B
title: Space and elevator too small but location and service excellent
text: Space and elevator was too small but location and service was excellent staff were very helpful and accommodating close to everything vet convenient

author: Charlie C
title: Metro noise
text: The hotel itself is very good but the noise of the metro made me have a very bad night. The frequency of the metros were also very high.

author: Oliver U
title: Sufficient for a good stay
text: Well positioned in relation to the city, near the metro, enough breakfast, helpful reception staff, rooms with no great amenities but good to rest. The main problem is that we felt in the rooms the subway passing underneath. The breakfast service by some employees is not expeditious, they let the food run out and were late to resume.

author: Erin H
title: Love Paris, enjoyable stay.
text: This is the second time we stayed at Hotel Opera Lafayette through JET2 City Breaks.  We stayed in a room on the fourth floor we had emailed in advance asking for a room on a higher floor as we knew the road noise could wake us. We slept very well in room 47 at the end of the corridor no road noise and hardly felt the metro this high up. Lovely french windows to open   for fresh air and take in the view.  The room was cleaned, beds made and new towels every day.  One day we had put on a do not disturb sign on the door for a sleep in and left the used towels outside. Later housekeeping came back and knocked, in my basic french I managed to ask for new towels and a bath mat, the ladies were very friendly and helpful.  Shower powerful and just needed a few minutes to warm up.  Used the hairdryer provided in the bathroom and I had to remove the end cap or it would cut out but worked fine after that.  Shower body wash, hand wash, shower caps, cotton buds provided in the bathroom. Safe to use in the room. Kettle,paper cups, bottle of water and a few coffee sachets included. We didn't have breakfast at the hotel as there are many boulangeries nearby.  Cadet Metro a few minutes walk away.

author: George W
title: Good location
text:
The hotel is well located, right next to Cadet metro station.Many restaurants and supermarkets nearby.
The carpet in the room is very dirty and should be changed. The subway passes under the hotel, I knew it, but apart from the noise of the subway, the walls are very thin; you can even hear someone blowing his nose in another room. One day, someone entered my room around 3:30 p.m. while I was trying to rest after a long walk (no one apologized). The bathroom door is sliding and does not close properly.If you use the shower, the entire bathroom is flooded because the pipe is defective.Breakfast without fruits or vegetables.

author: Luke J
title: A great find!
text: I had never been to Paris before and I stayed 3 nights at this hotel including breakfast. The hotel is very clean and comfortable. The day and night concierges were excellent, very friendly and helpful! Easy to travel to from Orly airport, via metro . This hotel is in an excellent central location for visiting the main attractions in Paris, either by metro,bus or walking. I walked all over Paris, le Louvre, le Marais, Eiffel Tower, Montmartre etc. The breakfast at this hotel had an excellent, good selection of options. My single room (double bed ) was very comfortable with a lovely bathroom.  Close to Metro, Restaurants, bars etc, this hotel is a great choice. I can't recommend enough! Thankyou

author: Joseph Z
title: WEEKEND IN PARIS
text: We received this hotel as an alternative to another for a mishap and I must say it was a nice surprise as it is practically on the road leading to the Lafayette Gallery. Serviceable rooms with the necessary, good lighting, excellent soundproofing as the street noises are heard very little (unfortunately I can not deny that you hear a slight roar of the metro passing under, but it has not affected the living room at all). Breakfast easy from sweet to savory, good cleaning of the tables. Cleaning of the rooms every day and very neat. Perhaps I would recommend a mirror before the exit of the room as it is only present in the bathroom and small. Friendly, kind and especially understanding staff as I did not speak French.

author: Evie C
title: Avoid this hotel
text:
Our stay at this hotel was extremely disappointing.
The entire property had no hot water because all of the boilers were broken. This happened in the middle of December, when temperatures were close to freezing every day. Not having hot water under these conditions is completely unacceptable.
We repeatedly asked the hotel for a solution, such as a transfer to another hotel or access to another facility where we could at least take a shower. Unfortunately, nothing was offered. The staff only said they were waiting for a technician to fix the problem.
After the second day, the situation became unacceptable and we decided to move to another hotel at our own expense. The hotel staff assured us that we would be refunded for the nights we did not stay. However, to this day we have not received any refund, and our messages are no longer being answered.
Because of the lack of basic services and the unfulfilled promise of a refund, I cannot recommend this hotel at all.

author: Poppy E
title: Great 3* hotel
text: Definitely recommend this hotel! We stayed for 4 nights and is in close proximity to Cadet metro station. Walking distance to the Louvre and Opéra. Staff extremely friendly, and reception is 24/7, you also hand your key in every time you leave the hotel. Modern bathroom and room, unlike corridors which are slightly dated but no complaints. Don’t be deterred by the hotel being on a main road, as windows are very sound proof. Room cleaned and towels changed daily. Only minor issue is that there was a wooden sliding door on the bathroom, limiting privacy, although based on photos I think other rooms do have actual doors. This hotel is a gem and deserves higher ratings! Hotel sorted is a return taxi to the airport no problem. No noise from other rooms/guests. Good amenities in close proximity. Great value for money. Tea, coffee, water etc in room.

author: Grace V
title: small noise
text: It's not soundproof you hear the steps of aisles acsensor two people extreme aisles noise of the subway and street, you ask for room for three and in one of two they put a bed you run out of room, not very kind the very cold workers do not interact the rest as another hotel more

author: George T
title: Mixed feeling
text: It is within 10 min walking distance from Gare du Nord. Hence, if you come to Paris by Eurostar, it is a close place. Walking to Opera is possible and Rue La Fayette is safe to walk, but it'll take 20 - 30 min.  Public transport is good as it is close to the Cadet situation. The room, itself is a bit run-down. We have difficulties in opening the bathroom door. Having said that, the three-bed room has 3 equal-sized bed, and is sizeable for 3 people to move inside. It is not bad for budget travellers.

author: Claire W
title: Spotless room
text:
I had a 3 night solo stay. I was greeted by the reception staff that spoke English and other languages. They were very efficient and gave clear instructions. I had booked a single room and was very pleased with the cleanliness and facilities. The bathroom was spotless and included tissues, hair dryer, shower and sink soap and the usual shower cap, ear buds etc.
The bed was a decent size for a single and it was very comfortable.  There was a tv and a kettle in the room and some sachets of tea and coffee, which I used, its a shame these were not replenished but there was a coffee machine in reception for 2 euros. There was also a bottle of water in the room.
Breakfast was available in the hotel, but I had booked room only as I like to eat out.
I had my own transport from CDG Airport by Uber which was 40 euro.
Reception staff booked a shuttle for the return costing 28 euros. I would definitely recommend this hotel and I will stay again

author: Brooke D
title: First time in Paris and Opera La Fayette stay is excellent!
text: We stayed here for 3 nights. We are a family of 4/2rooms. Everything was spot on. Clean, welcoming staff specially Abdel who is hospitable with a lovely smile and gave us all the information that we need on our arrival and on departure. The hotel is very accessible everwhere you want to go either walking, metro or bus. We love how close it is to shopping, restaurants, cafes, bakeries with lovely french treats. You can even walk to historical sites too. We highly recommend this hotel and if ever we will be back in Paris, we will surely come back to this hotel.

author: Adam P
title: A pleasant discovery
text: We stayed at this hotel from 07/06 to 09/06 and are really pleased with our stay. The hotel is so pretty with modern and well-kept interiors, located a few meters from the Galeries LaFayette and the Opéra Garnier, in a lively but quiet neighborhood, a very central and strategic area to reach all the main points of Paris thanks to the presence of the metro a few meters. Beyond the excellent location, the breakfast was really good, the croissants and pain au chocolat were exquisite, but above all the great attention to replenishing, having us customers always everything available, never missing anything. For us it is important to emphasize the breakfast because some reviews we read before departure could have made us skeptical but instead it was a nice surprise, a buffet with good products and always stocked. The room was beautiful and very clean, with balconies with spectacular views of Rue LaFayette. Finally we wanted to thank the reception and in particular Abel, a guy who made our stay even more beautiful, helping us on every occasion, including last minute reservations such as the Seine tour and the restaurant Le Vieux Bistrot in the Latin Quarter that we recommend. The availability, kindness, care of all impressed us a lot and we thank again the decoration of the room on the evening of the birthday. We will definitely return to discover even more Paris.

author: Ryan E
title: Lovely hotel
text: What a lovely hotel, it was friendly, clean, comfortable and offered a good breakfast. It's great for getting to the sights and it as some very nice cafe's, bars & restaurants close by. We really enjoyed our stay.

author: Ryan K
title: Clean, comfortable and very well located
text:
Very well located hotel.A bit tired in parts but extremely clean. Un Acceuil chaleureux - the receptionist didn’t just provide a corkscrew but a wine glass too!
Two nearby metro stations, walking distance to the Gare de Nord with RER link to CDG and many varied restaurants including an excellent Thai just two minutes from the hotel. As a solo traveller felt very safe.

author: Owen U
title: Very good option in Paris
text: Very well located hotel. Excellent service. Very basic breakfast. The room is large and very comfortable as the box spring. Very clean. It's a hotel I'd go back to but without hiring breakfast. It's modern and quiet. It has supermarkets and greengrocers nearby.

author: Molly I
title: Yeah, good!
text:
Very clean room 
New SDB
Impeccable bedding 
Excellent breakfast  
Top location, near a park
Very nice veranda for lunch 
Friendly staff 
Careful decoration 
Nothing wrong
,.,.............................

author: Erin H
title: Noisy arrondissement
text: Stayed at Hotel Opera Lafayette with Cadet Metro Station nearby.  Within a 15 minute walk from Gare du Nord Train Station with a slight downhill slope walking towards the Hotel but will be uphill going back!  The hotel room we were given on arrival was on the second floor at the front of the hotel, The room was clean, the bathroom seemed newly renovated, had a great over head rainfall shower,l and a hairdryer and toiletries. Kettle in room. Two huge french windows with a balcony and view of the street and square across the road.  All seemed great but unfortunately the road noise was too loud for us and we didn't get any sleep.  Hotel staff were helpful and gave us the key cards for two other rooms we could possibly move to.  We chose  Room 21 still on the second floor but at the back of the hotel, windows could be opened for air but no view, the bathroom was not newly renovated but we did get a better sleep even tho we could feel and hear the metro underneath the hotel, that is just one of those things the hotel can't change.  In Room 21  the shower was powerful  it just took a while to get the hot water through, the hairdryer would cut out on high so it took forever to dry my hair on the low setting and there were some small toiletries.  When using the kettle in the room  I had to keep my finger on the button to boil, two small bottles of water,  two paper cups and no coffee satchets just some tea.  Even tho the room was cleaned no more paper cups we left were so had to go to reception for some more. We didn't eat breakfast at the hotel as there are plenty of boulangeries nearby plus a Starbucks up the road. Well located but basic hotel for you to explore Paris.  Would I return probably not as I have stayed in quieter areas of Paris.  It's just a different experience to be more central.

author: Isla F

title: UNHAPPY!!!!

We asked for a commercial gesture on the price of our
Room, not possible according to our interlocutor…. A bottle of wine should be enough to satisfy our dissatisfaction... the third room is finally clean, it is unacceptable to find hair, fur and a floor covered with the passage of previous guests!!!!! author: Zoe J
title: Not recommended
text:
I stayed at this hotel and the experience was not pleasant. The property is quite far from the center of Paris. To reach it you have to use the subway, but the walk to get to the station is not safe at all.
The hotel is located in a highly degraded and dangerous area, adjacent to a car park full of homeless people and surrounded by real mountains of trash. The feeling of insecurity is constant.
To make matters worse, there is the staff: politeness and courtesy are not found here. The staff proved to be cold and unwelcoming.
The only positive note of the entire stay was the Uber app. Thanks to this service we were able to get around everywhere, at any time and at absolutely affordable prices, avoiding walking in the area around the hotel. I strongly advise against this property.

author: Ryan I
title: Safety concerns
text:
I am writing this review to warn other guests, particularly women and families.

During my stay at Novotel Suites Paris Montreuil Vincennes, my sister, my young niece, and I experienced a serious and frightening security incident late at night.

On Saturday 17th, shortly after midnight, we had just returned to the hotel after a long day at Disneyland when an unknown adult male followed us into the hotel, entered the lift with us, accessed our guest-only floor, and followed us to our room area. He initially spoke to me in English, asking where I was from. When I challenged him about his room, floor, and room key, he suddenly claimed he could not speak English.

We remained by the lift because we felt something was wrong and did not want him to know which room we were in. The man lingered in the hallway, became aggressive, and shouted at us to go into our room. He walked towards a staircase, returned and questioned us again, then moved towards the other staircase. At that point, we ran into our room and locked the door.

When I contacted reception, I was explicitly instructed not to call the police. I was told security had checked CCTV and that no one was seen. No reassurance or meaningful response was provided.

An unauthorised individual accessing guest floors at night and repeatedly confronting women and a child is a serious failure of guest safety.

I did not feel safe for the remainder of the stay. Until this hotel can demonstrate proper access controls and an appropriate response to serious incidents, I cannot recommend it. Families and women travelling alone should exercise extreme caution. DO NOT STAY HERE.

author: Wyatt P
title: A great stay at a sweet hotel
text:
We stayed one night in this hotel (myself and my young daughter) but would have loved to stay longer. 
We loved: 
The room -----size (bigger than others we had in Paris) and decor (a big desk was so helpful and night stands) and lighting (enough lamps so overhead lights weren't necessary). We also loved the bathroom - a big shower, very comfortable towels and lovely soaps.
When the windows were closed we didn't hear the outside at all. A plus in a busy neighborhood. Also the hotel itself was quite calm and quiet. 

The location----- was really great- I had been concerned we'd feel too far out. Instead, we were in an incredible neighborhood and had one of the best meals we had had our whole trip. There are sweet shops, a Monoprix, and many many restaurants, boulangerie, etc. 

The whole hotel (our room, breakfast room, lobby) was very clean but not sterile- a nice feeling. 

Good to know: We had a twin room- 2 person occupancy. There were two twin beds but they were pushed together like a King. This was the case in each hotel we went to, but good to know if you're traveling with someone who isn't your daughter/spouse/etc.

I would absolutely stay here again. The price was comparable to many of the other city hotels we booked but I liked this neighborhood, the staff, and the room a bit better.

author: David C
title: Nice boutique hotel
text:
This is a small boutique hotel in a quiet residential street near to the Arc de Triomphe, the Bois de Boulogne and the Palais des Congrès. Within a five minute walk, there are supermarkets, bars, cafés and restaurants on the nearby Avenue Malakoff and Avenue de la Grande Armée. 

We booked three nights in the “romantic room with balcony”, and whilst it was very nice, both room and balcony were a little smaller than we expected. But I guess, that’s Paris! The room decor is very pleasant and in excellent order.

The staff were all very friendly and helpful. We arrived in the middle of a heatwave and the centralised a/c in the room just wasn’t enough. No matter, the staff at reception organised for a standalone unit to be brought to the room and installed while we were out for the evening. This made a huge difference, and we both slept well.

We didn’t book breakfast so can’t comment. I would give it a five, except that we both felt it was maybe a little expensive for what it was. But we very much enjoyed exploring a neighbourhood in Paris with which we were not familiar. It was nice to be able to walk to the Champs Élysées for breakfast.

author: Alexander I
title: A Welcoming Hotel in a Quiet Paris Neighborhood
text:
Our stay at this hotel in Paris was a very pleasant experience overall. The location is excellent—just a short two-minute walk from the consulate offices, and set in a quiet, beautiful residential area that felt safe and welcoming.
The hotel itself, along with the staff, were truly lovely. From the moment we arrived, we felt well cared for. We were traveling with our dog, Joanna, and the staff immediately showed her kindness by bringing her water as soon as we entered, which was such a thoughtful touch.
As this was my first time staying in Paris, I don’t have much to compare it to. Coming from Canada, where hotel rooms tend to be more spacious, I did find the room quite small. However, the three of us—myself, my daughter, and our dog—managed comfortably. The bathroom was a good size, which was appreciated.
I also want to note that having a lift available was very important for me due to my disability, and it made a meaningful difference in our stay.
If I were to offer a couple of minor suggestions, it would be that the room carpeting may soon benefit from being refreshed, and the electrical outlets seemed somewhat loose, making it difficult to keep plugs securely in place.
Overall, we had a positive experience and appreciated the warmth and attentiveness of the staff.

author: Anna L
title: Ineligible
text:
Hello,

This is by far the worst stay I’ve ever had in a hotel, especially for over €250 a night for two people.

We stayed there 3 nights. To begin with, we had booked a room with a double bed, but we had a more than dismal room, with two single beds glued together. The shower/bathtub was malfunctioning: the push button to switch from tap to knob was not working. As a result, even in shower mode, the water still flowed partly through the tap. In addition, the toilet flush was leaking.

We had to re-start the staff twice to have an intervention planned. Arrived on Friday evening and left on Monday morning, everything was finally in order only from Sunday evening.

Breakfast is very limited. The “fresh” cakes stay at least three days on site, and the quality of the products is more than deplorable.

On Sunday mornings, they offer a brunch package for only €25 extra per person (for people who already have a breakfast reservation). The waiter told us that this was included in our reservation. As we had already eaten a little, we simply tasted some elements of brunch, thinking it was included. But at the moment of returning the key, the person at the reception, very unpleasant in passing, announces that there is still 50 € to pay for this brunch. I refused to pay, as a staff member made it clear to us that it was understood. Later, I received a message from the assistant director informing me that the money would be taken from the bond.

The service is more than bad for a 4 star hotel. Given the price, it is better to sleep anywhere else.
