I would absolutely stay here again without hesitation. Highly recommended if you're looking for a comfortable hotel in a great location with excellent service! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Mia W
title: Okay for Shortstay
text: The location is close to Port Authority and Penn Station. Really busy area walking distance from Hell’s Kitchen and Times Square. There is a cute size lounge area on the 1st floor. There is also a Portugese Restaurant that has a bar in the lounge area that has weekly Happy Hour. The rooms are not roomy like hotels in other tourist areas. There is a small refridgerator that has snacks without prices, but are charged to the room if taken. There is also a small coffee maker that makes espresso.  We stayed in the 2 Queen Bed room. No closet, & no ironboard. The safe was in the nightstand between the beds. The beds came with a drawer under the bed like a Captains bed. It will do for a short trip when you on not being in the room much. Well maintained and very clean. The  staff is very friendly as well. Great price when we used Airbnb.

author: Ana K
title: Basic small rooms, very confined. Room cleaning good.
text: 2.5 Bog Standard Hotel. Rooms very small and basic. Cleaned well. Rest of hotel dark in corridors. Communal areas down stairs near toilets not nice. Entrance to hotel needs re decorating. Would recommend not staying in this area as Times Sq is not very nice. Would suggest staying in other areas nr Central Park, Financial District, Chelsea or Greenwich.

author: Owen O
title: Great hotel near Times Sq and Port Authority
text: We absolutely loved this hotel. It’s modern, cute, the staff are fantastic and it has a comfortable lobby with bar, food and tvs. The room with two double beds was spacious enough for us (we don’t travel with a lot of luggage) and really comfortable. It was one of the best hotels we’ve stayed at in NY. The location is very close to Times Square which most tourists will love. I dislike the area but despite that I would stay again because I loved the hotel.

author: Wyatt N
title: Top Hotel in the Heart of New York City
text: Great stay at CR7 Times Square. Immaculate room, very friendly staff and perfect location right in the city center. I highly recommend.

author: Ruby X
title: Great hotel, location, comfort
text:
Great hotel, great location, clean rooms every day, good sound insulation, super comfortable mattress, excellent service. You can bring a take away to the hotel and have lunch/dinner at the cafeteria. They say there is no breakfast, however bagels and croissants are served every day. Also has coffee/milk/capuccino machine
We love the stay

author: Mathis G
title: Super place to stay
text:
This was our first visit to New York and should we return in the future this hotel would most definitely be our 'go to' place to return to. The hotel is in a great central position yet offers a quiet space, perfect for resting after a busy day. 
All staff were welcoming, friendly, informed and so helpful to us.
Our rooms were comfortable, very clean and included coffee/tea making facilities which along with the complimentary supply of breakfast bagels was a lovely and tasty addition to our stay.  Thank you everyone at Pestana CR7 for making our visit so memorable. Special thanks to Rachel, Antonio and Colin.

author: Pierre Y
title: High expectations... but low results.
text:
The hotel was nothing special... the room was very small, but well cleaned. I chose a king-size bed... and it was very comfortable... the most annoying thing about the room was the air conditioner, which emitted a deep sound every time it turned on and off (as if something was falling). Slippers were not provided, which are usually available in hotels, and I had to make do with those I brought from the airplane. 
The truly terrible thing was the breakfast... the croissants were undercooked, and from the photos, you can see that the toaster was, to say the least, dirty (the photo was taken just after breakfast opened).
To conclude, I had left my luggage at the front desk after check-out to work and then pick it up before leaving, and they were losing it.... 

So what can I say, it was not a positive experience, as the expectations were high... if I were to return to New York, I would not come back here.

author: Daisy A
title: Best hotel in town
text: Atmosphere!! Cleaning! People … everything was perfect!

author: Daniel N
title: Great stay
text: Great hotel, perfect location

author: Manon H
title: Excellent location for sight seeing
text:
This hotel is clean, modern, helpful staff and offers complimentary bagels/croissants and coffee at breakfast. 
Located near Hells kitchen and just a short walk from Time Square it sits well for sight seeing and exploring.
Lots of football memorabilia in lobby and 2 huge tv screens playing British and European matches (on silent) with this being owned partly by Cristiano Ronaldo.
We were in a deluxe room on the 20 floor which had a very comfortable bed and the hotel kindly swapped pillows for us as they were pretty thick.
Contemporary bathroom, nice shower gel and plenty of plug socket points for charging various devices. Little coffee machine if you like an espresso. 
Only 2 hangers per person for the wardrobe so we didn’t empty our suitcases.
Safe box should you need it.
We were located next to a housekeeping room which wasn’t ideal but we had ear plugs in every night as the noise is so loud from the road outside you cannot do without them. Note: this is throughout New York not just this hotel.
One day housekeeping didn’t show up till 4:30pm when we were back in the room resting so Front desk gave us complimentary late checkout which was appreciated. 
Note anyone returning to Jfk via taxi from here needs to leave a minimum one hour thirty for the journey due to how busy this part of town gets

author: Sara B
title: Recommended!
text:
Excellent hotel, clean, very kind and helpful staff, good breakfast.
In a strategic position to visit Paris, well served by public transport.
Many places to dine in the surrounding area.

author: Samuel V
title: Comfortable, Reasonable, and Well-managed
text:
We stayed here ten years ago when we needed to be near  the Montparnasse train station. I have been recommending it ever since as a good-value, well-managed hotel. If anything, it's even better than before. 

We were able to check in right away when we arrived midday, which was a delightful surprise. The process was quick and easy. 

Our room was comfortable and well-equipped, with some really thoughtful touches. The light switches made complete sense, with one to light up the entryway as soon as you enter the room. That is not always the case!

We actually had two stays here, a few weeks apart. For the longer, second stay, we upgraded to a top-floor junior suite. The huge room had a sitting area and a large marble bathroom with double sinks, a tub/shower combo, and a separate WC. It was the largest room I have ever had in Paris, and I have been coming here for over fifty years.

We used the honor bar one night, and had a great conversation with some wonderful folks who, like us, love travel, live music, and combining the two.  The breakfast room/ lounge is very comfortable and a great place to meet up with family or friends. 

The location is convenient, even if you are not arriving or leaving from the Montparnasse train station. There are several historical markers on rue Delambre alone, and dozens more in the surrounding area. There are metro stops at either end of the street. You are surrounded by great cafes and restaurants. 

The staff here is very kind and helpful. When you stay here, you know that you are in good hands. I could not recommend it more highly!

author: Ian P
title: Amazing hotel, would stay again 🥰
text: What an absolutely beautiful hotel, the hospitality is amazing, the staff are lovely and so friendly.  Breakfast is delicious there is lots of different options, fantastic area for restaurants as

author: Evan L
title: Absolutely UNREAL
text:
How has this hotel ONLY got 3 stars?!

Me and my boyfriend stayed here for 3 nights and it was AMAZING!

It was super close to 3 metros and a train station and there was nowhere in Paris we could not get to from these stations.

The staff are absolutely lovely and cannot do enough for you. They go above and beyond and even upgraded us to a junior suite which was so spacious and just absolutely unreal!!

It is super clean and a lovely classy atmosphere. Amenities are spot on, had robes, slippers, 24/7 bar and room service.

Excellent value for money, could not recommend anymore and will definitely return!!

author: Morgan L
title: Clean and well placed, nice welcome
text: Nice little hotel close to Montparnasse, rate in the neighborhood average.It has been redone recently,everything is clean and in condition.Little flat, during our visit the elevator was broken down...Room reserved on the 6th floor! No gesture of compensation that would have been commercially the least of things...

author: Benjamin I
title: FALTA DE FLEXIBILIDAD
text:
Por causas de Fuerza mayor ( anulación de todo el traffico ferroviario por inclemencia climatologicas ) no pude utilizar mi reserva en el hotel.  El hotel ha sido inflexible y no ha permitido el cambio de fecha de la reserva solicitado

For reasons of force majeure (cancellation of all rail traffic due to bad weather) I was unable to use my hotel reservation.  The hotel was inflexible and did not authorize the change of date of the requested reservation.

author: Matthew O
title: Great hotel and base
text:
Pleasant stay with excellent location between two major metro lines. Located in a quiet street. Many restaurants in this nice neighborhood. The hotel room has all the facilities and a very good bed. Everything is very neat. Reception is staffed 24h/24h. Breakfast is fine, is regularly replenished. 
You can fill it with free chilled water and sparkling water to take to the room. Hôtel is highly recommended.

author: Lucy Z
title: Lovely hotel great location
text: We stayed 2 nights here excellent location.  The rooms are lovely clean and comfortable. The reception staff were very friendly and helpful.  Overall an excellent hotel and great location to explore Paris.

author: Giulia B
title: Good Value Paris Experience
text: The hotel was chosen due to the close location to Montparnasse train station since we had an early morning train to catch to Bordeaux. We stayed for two nights in #54 which was a very nice smaller suite.  with a small step out balcony. Its a smaller boutique like hotel but it does have a self-serve bar and a good breakfast service. AC issues initially were fixed, very nice bathroom, but suggest a bath grab bar due to high step in/out. An opportunity with hanger space and no drawer space for unpacking. Put up some hooks for coats and jackets. Friendly reception and a good lodging experience.  So many cafes in walking distance and the cemetery is worth a visit.

author: Dylan X
title: Excellent Three-Star in a Top Location
text: I was at Lenox for three nights, it was a most pleasant stay.   The rooms are well designed, well appointed, and with good -size bathrooms.   Everything was in excellent condition.  The staff were very nice and helpful, and the breakfast is excellent.   The hotel is in a great location, Montparnasse is a lively area and there are many restaurants within a few blocks, while the two metro lines (4 and 6) can take you easily to tourist destinations.  The Luxembourg Garden is three blocks away, where you can relax and enjoy the park. I had a club room facing the back courtyard, quiet and with a nice view.   I'd recommend those rooms, and get the breakfast included.   Looking forward to my next visit!

author: Ryan L
title: Welcoming, charming, comfortable
text:
We saw an article about this hotel in the NYT and thought we should give it a try, based on the writer's recommendation. 

I will start this review by naming three outstanding front desk managers who welcomed us and continued to provide smiles, information and valuable assistance throughout the week. The graciousness of *Hichem*, Magdalena and Herman was much appreciated. 

We had a junior suite on the 6th floor and enjoyed the extra space. The room was immaculate, and the bed was very comfortable. The high-quality linens and towels, plus the bathrobes and slippers, provided an upscale experience. The shower was modern and large, with great water pressure. The safe, Nespresso coffee maker and small fridge were appreciated, too. 

There are a number of nice restaurants within walking distance, along with well-stocked grocery stores within a block either way of the hotel. The bountiful daily breakfast/brunch for 19 euros was a nice option. It isn't inexpensive, but it is reasonably priced, and there is much value to be had in staying in this charming hotel.

author: Holly V
title: Nice little hotel in a good location
text: The location is wonderful, quiet and yet many good restaurants, bars, etc. just around the corner. The rooms are nicely decorated, the staff friendly and the breakfast sufficient to start the day.

author: Samuel P
title: very good
text: we booked 4 days at Lenox Montparnasse. we had a great time, great Welcoming and availability, very nice structure, the rooms are not very large but there is everything, breakfast with fresh produce and with a certain choice, quiet, basic, comfortable and welcoming. for sure we will be back (also because Paris is beautiful)

author: Louis B
title: Great stay in Paris
text: I really enjoyed my stay here. My daughter (adult) and I had a two twin bed room. It was small but worked well. The shower was superb! I enjoyed the breakfast-lots of choices. The laundry service was very good and the location was great. A short walk to everything we wished to see. The staff were great. They were very polite and really helpful. I would stay here again. It was very reasonably priced for what it provided.

author: Harper H
title: Very positive experience
text: This is a really good 3 star hotel, not fancy, but very peaceful. I chose it based on previous ratings and was pleased. The room seemed recently renovated and the space was well used. Our room on the back side ws very quiet and looked over a peaceful courtyard. The bed was comfortable and the pillows were great. The bathroom was a good size for the total square footage/meters and had a rain shower. Plenty of closet space. The climate control kept the room cool on a very hot day. There was a safe, kettle and a smaller than usual fridge. My only disappointments were that the fridge was too small for 1.5 liter soda bottle and there were barely enough electric plugs. Therefore, I always travel with a 3-way plug for situations like this. The location is a feels a bit upmarket and just a few streets from Tour Montparnasse and train station. Metro line 4 is a two minute walk away and line 6 is about 5 minutes. I found this to be a surprisingly lively with lots of nice restaurants, bars and supermarkets. It was missing the cute little shops you find in the 9th and 10th arr, but that's the character of this area. Don't miss the Montparnasse cemetary 2 streets away. It's like a park and a relaxing place.

author: Taylor Q
title: Great hotel , location and staff really make the experience
text:
Good hotel , stylish rooms with new bathrooms, friendly and relaxed use of the lounge area during the day. Great location for Montparnasse and Luxembourge Gardns , a must. Located very close to Vevay Metro and buses into Central Paris. Monntparnasse centre just up the road. Plenty of fair priced restaurants nearby. 
What really makes this hotel are the staff , all excellent, friendly and helpful, plus the breakfasts are a must.

author: Miguel I
title: A Regular Hotel Guest
text: This was my 9th?, 10th stay at this hote? What I find interesting is that there is clearly no record of my past stays. I don't want to be fawned over, I'm just surprised they don't have a system to keep track of regular guests. This time I chose The Lenox for myself and friends who were first time visitors to Paris. I stay in the Junior suites, they are much larger and also more expensive, but for the cost of the room, you can't beat the value of what you get. The room is comfortable, especially for 2. There is a plentiful breakfast in the morning. The one thing I have noticed the last few times I've stayed is that they do have tour groups stay here, which is not something I've experienced until the last few years. The only reason I bring it up is that they all hit breakfast at the same time and it is near impossible for the one breakfast staff member to keep up resulting in a pretty untidy room with supplies running low and not being refilled. It also meant many dirty tabels and nowhere to sit for several minutes. I did find this frustrating. Once the group left, it was fine. It remains my go to hotel in Paris and also a place I recommend to friends visiting for the first time Oh!, and you CANNOT beat the location.

author: Zachary G
title: Perfect for a few days based in the Montparnasse area
text:
Great location for the Montparnasse area.
Smallish room, but as expected for a city hotel.  Well-equipped, clean and everything worked.
Very friendly staff on the desk, and very comfortable switching to English when our French wasn't good enough.
Good buffet breakfast, but we should have locked into the cheaper price available when booking the room rather than deciding each day.

author: Sean T
title: Brilliant apart from the pillows!
text: We chose Hotel Lennox based on reviews on TripAdvisor. We were really pleased with our choice. The room and bathroom were nicely decorated and beautifully clean.  Everything was great apart from one thing - THE PILLOWS!!! There was four of us staying in two separate rooms, one twin and one double and we all found the pillows awful, they were so stuffed full of filling there was no give in them whatsoever and made for a very uncomfortable night. This is a shame as everything else (location, cleanliness, friendliness of the staff and breakfast) was absolutely brilliant.  Unfortunately when you can’t sleep well it does affect your opinion of the place.  Please, please Hotel Lennox look into getting better pillows for your guests.  You’ll definitely get a five star instead of a four star review from me if you do!  We would stay there again as the location is fantastic with lots of great restaurants around especially ones that cater for gluten-free and given that my sister-in-law is a coeliac that was a real bonus. Next time though we might think about bringing my own pillows!

author: Luke D
title: A very good stay
text:
Very nice rooms with a good welcome and close to the Gare Montparnasse.
I had booked 3 rooms. One was upgraded because I wanted 2 twin beds. I appreciated the gesture.
A sumptuous breakfast served at will delicious. Too bad that the rain and the work in front of the hotel were annoying.

author: Giulia R
title: Charming hotel in a less touristy area
text: This was a cozy and charming hotel close to boulangeries, shops, metros and pharmacies, and we loved that it was not very touristy.  We ate at restaurants where we heard mostly the chatter of locals.  We loved that you can open the balcony doors for fresh air and despite being hot during the day, the night breezes were lovely.  The metro is close by  for when we were too tired to walk.

author: Freya W
title: Extremely disappointing experience — especially because of the management’s unacceptable and aggressive behavior.
text:
I stayed for four nights, and on the fourth night I was moved to an attic room that was completely unacceptable. When I complained about the room and asked to cancel, the manager refused to cooperate and instead became aggressive, shouted at me, and insulted me. Even when I decided to leave, he followed me and continued arguing.

The room itself had serious issues: the bathroom was built inside the room, with an extremely narrow entrance that required you to turn sideways to get in. There were also two doors inside the room, in addition to the main entrance, with no clear explanation of where they led. I felt genuinely unsafe and spent the night worried about my security. The bed sheets were also visibly dirty.

For a hotel charging over €200 per night, this level of
 room quality, cleanliness, security, and especially customer service is completely unacceptable.

I strongly recommend reconsidering this hotel before booking.

author: Charlotte N
title: Father Daughter Trip Base in Paris
text:
Here’s a more complete TripAdvisor review that incorporates your experience:

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Hotel Minerve. This was a father-and-15-year-old daughter trip, and the hotel was able to provide comfortable twin beds, which worked perfectly for us.

The location is outstanding in the Latin Quarter—an easy walk to Notre-Dame, the Panthéon, Luxembourg Gardens, and countless cafés, bakeries, and restaurants. Metro and bus connections are excellent, and getting to and from CDG Airport by RER and Metro was straightforward.

Our room was air-conditioned, clean, and surprisingly quiet despite being in the heart of Paris. The double-glazed windows blocked out the street noise when closed, but it was also nice to be able to open them for fresh air. The elevator was appreciated after long days of sightseeing, and every staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful.

For anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located hotel with excellent transport links and plenty of dining options nearby, Hotel Minerve is an excellent choice. We would happily stay here again.

author: Juan V
title: Gateway to Paris
text: We were thrilled with the location of the hotel - easy access to transportation and walking distance to many interesting places! The room was spotless, cool, and quiet. It was small, which one expects in Europe, and we had packed accordingly. Great view from 6th floor balcony. Very satisfying breakfast. The staff are all very helpful and kind.

author: Evie L
title: Lovely Paris Hotel
text: Minerve Hotel has helpful, friendly staff, rooms are charming and clean, and the location is convenient for sightseeing.

author: Erin G
title: Wonderful stay!
text: Loved the quaint hotel. Very comfy bed and the staff were all wonderfully welcoming and helpful!  Quick walk to metro and activities while being away from hustle and bustle.  Can’t wait to visit again.

author: Rosie G
title: Great
text: Excellent service, location and delicious breakfast . Personnel are extremely helpful and friendly. Location is excellent

author: Giulia T
title: Perfect
text: 1 night, perfect. I highly recommend it +++ you can go there with complete confidence! Even more beautiful in person than in the photos, whether it's the room or the breakfast buffet (royal). Very comfortable bedding! Impeccable cleaning (the kettle in the room is without limescale!) Very pleasant staff, whether at the reception or in the kitchen! We will return with great pleasure if the opportunity arises! Just 3 minutes on foot from Paradis Latin...TOP!

author: Lucy L
title: Well-Run Mid-Range Hotel in a Great Location
text: Well-appointed three-star hotel in the midst of the Latin Quarter. Staff were friendly and helpful and rooms were comfortable, if a little on the small side. We were there during a heat wave and the hotel and the room were well airconditioned. The room A/C was fairly quiet and provided enough gentle white noise to cover street sounds during the night. Great breakfast buffet. A few minutes' walk from the Seine, not far from Notre Dame.

author: Mia X
title: Awful Experience
text: This was awful.  We had to carry our suitcases up to the 6th floor because the elevator wasn't working.  The man at reception watched us wait for the elevator and didn't mention it was broken and then he  watched 6 of us carry our bags up the stairs with no apology or offer of help.  Yes, the room is "air conditioned", but our room never got cooler than 80 degrees.  We contemplated leaving to find another hotel.  The temperature was mentioned several times to the front desk and nothing was ever done.  It was clean.  Bathroom amenities were provided.

author: Michael V
title: Weekend at the Latin Paradise
text:
More or less satisfied with the location: compared to the Latin Paradise, there is nothing better; it is just around the corner.

As for the rest, the rooms are extremely small and very outdated, with a view of a sort of courtyard resembling a dump.

Regarding the amenities: none, except for a television. I usually ask for ice to have a little drink in the room, and this is one of the only hotels that told me they did not have any, without looking for a solution (which I ultimately found myself around the corner).

Overall, it is quite disappointing. I will not return there. This hotel is not worth its 3 stars.

author: Katie X
title: Very good hotel in Latin neighborhood, well located in quiet area and close to tourist area. Excellent service
text: Recommended, by location, cost and quality

author: Oscar U
title: Lovely hotel in a perfect location
text: We loved Hotel Minerve.  It's in a fantastic location in the Latin Quarter, on the Rive Gauche, with lots of restaurants, cafés, and even a decent grocery store with lots of ready-made meals available.  It is an easy walk to the Seine, Île de la Cité and Notre Dame, and all the tour boat companies have stops on that stretch of the river.  The Hotel itself is pristine, the staff are very friendly and very patient with my attempts to speak French, even though they all spoke English.  The room is small by North American standards, but larger than we had expected.  Our room was on the first floor (we would call that the second floor in Canada), and we had a small outside patio with a table and two chairs, which was very nice.  The patio was completely enclosed by buildings, so no issues with safety.  The queen-size bed was very comfortable, with lots of pillows and extra blankets and pillows in the closet/wardrobe, and we enjoyed the period look of the room, complete with some nice paintings and lovely period furniture.  The only issue we had was that there was no chest of drawers in the room, which would have been nice.  There was a kettle with coffee, tea and hot chocolate in the room, and a machine that made excellent coffee for 1 Euro in the lobby.  I'm not sure why the hotel is only rated 3 stars, maybe because it doesn’t have a full restaurant.  It does serve a buffet style breakfast, with the usual pastries and warm dishes in the mornings, which looked excellent.  We didn’t do the breakfast, but chose instead to walk to our morning destinations and pick up something light on the way.  We highly recommend the Hotel Minerve.

author: Nathan Q
title: Wonderful Stay at Hotel Minerve!
text: Loved this place. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The room was very clean and comfortable. The hotel, located in the Latin Quarter, is within walking distance of Notre Dame and more restaurants, cafes, and shops than I count.

author: Benjamin H
title: UBS appears not to be working
text: The UBS connection in the desk lamp appears not to be working. I tested it to make sure there were no confounding variables.

author: Nathan B
title: A Perfect Stay
text: My 18-year old grandson and I have just returned from a 3-night stay at Hotel Minerve.  What a lovely hotel!  Reception staff were welcoming and helpful.  We had superior single rooms, 106 and 206, which were identical.  The double beds were very comfortable.  There was a kettle and a good choice of tea, coffee and hot chocolate.  The bathrooms were small but plenty big enough for us, with good quality toiletries and towels.  The rooms were spotlessly clean and the housekeeping lady was lovely.  The location is excellent, with the Seine and Notre Dame a short walk away and lots of cafes and restaurants in the area.  As other reviews state, the lift is tiny (just big enough for 2 people with suitcases), but it does the job if you can't make the stairs.  We only had breakfast on our first morning, as it was quite expensive, but the food was good (choice of hot and cold food, fresh fruit, juices, cereals, cold meats, cheeses etc).  Again the staff were efficient and friendly.  I have no hesitation in recommending this hotel; a very pleasant experience.

author: Chloe Y
title: Excellent hotel
text:
Very welcome, very friendly and understanding receptionist. 
Breakfast, although a little expensive, is excellent and varied.
I recommend this hotel.

author: Hugo F
title: M'enerve @ Minerve?
text: For EUR 200 per night, I would like the room to be a bit better equiped. I understand the building is old and rooms are renovated in order to 'cater' to 21st century requirements, but it did not completely work out that way. The sink in the room has no space at all to put your toilet bag on, and I don't like showering in an area that becomes completely inundated with water as there is no proper shower cabin. The floor of the shower/toilet area was not cleaned properly. Further more, I do take umbrage when reception staff are eating there meal behind the reception desk. Very unprofessional indeed. I would not go back to this hotel as there are other options available.

author: Samuel O
title: Wonderful Experience
text: This is my first time in Paris. I have to say this hotel contribute a wonderful experience during my tour. First, every worker at the reception is polite and enthusiastic. They helped me a lot even after my check-out. Second, the cleaners are dutiful and replace the towels and sheets every day. Every time when we see each other, they would nod to me and say Bonjour monsieur. So delighted and make my day! Finally, if I have opportunity to come to Paris again, I still want to live this hotel next time.

author: Amelia C
title: Good stay happy
text: I had a great time and they were really nice and helpful. I felt very safe as a 19 year old girl on a solo trip.

author: Ian U
title: No traffic noise
text: Great location which felt safe and relatively quiet for London. Room was very quiet with no traffic / emergency vehicle noise - first for London. Approximately 8 minute pleasant walk to Paddington station and tube. Rooms were a good size. Only downside were public toilets which were dirty on day of arrival and had no toilet paper on day of leaving.

author: George F
title: Great location, friendly staff
text: The staff were friendly,professional and extremely helpful throughout my stay. The hospitality was excellent and I will definitely come back

author: Sofia R
title: An amazingly friendly hotel in a great area
text:
We loved our stay at this Premier Inn.
The staff were so friendly and helpful and there always seemed to be someone around. The hotel itself was clean and tidy, it looked quite new actually.
We found it was in a great location, literally round the corner from the canal basin and floating pocket park. We wouldn't hesitate staying here again!

author: Jack K
title: Comfortable Stay
text:
The hotel is located very close to Paddington Station and it made travelling from the airport a breeze. It is central for exploring with amenities like groceries, drugstores and restaurants right next to it. The staff at the reception area were always friendly and helpful. The rooms were a good size for our family of 3. The rooms were clean, the beds were very comfortable and it was very quiet. The Aircon in the room worked perfectly and the bathroom was big enough to get dressed in after a shower.
All in all the hotel is basic but offers the essentials for a comfortable stay at a reasonable price.

author: Chloe T
title: Perfect 👍
text: We had a wonderful weekend at this hotel. It's very well located in the heart of London. The rooms are cozy and spacious. The staff is very friendly and attentive.

author: Ella N
title: Great stay
text: Great stay at Premier Inn Paddington basin. The room was very clean and comfortable and the staff were friendly and helpful. Good location and would definitely stay again !!

author: Paige A
title: Paddington Basin
text: Really nice at Premier Inn Paddington, the room was clean and bed very comfortable and staff very welcoming. Good location and overall a very pleasant experience. Would definitely recommend.

author: Louis K
title: Excellent stay
text:
Excellent location, just a short walk from the railway station.
Rooms were immaculately clean and the bed was very comfortable. 
Excellent breakfast.  Lots of choice and the staff were working very hard to clean tables and replenish the food.
We would definitely stay again.

author: Mathis J
title: Greart value for price
text: Beds were excelent, its a great option for a fair price, especially for families with children, no noise, nice staff, could have more options on breakfast but it is good nevertheless. Location is good and with 24h Tesco around the corner, shops services ans transport fairly close. It was a nice stay.

author: Thomas O
title: Zero cleanliness
text:
They do not clean the rooms and they do not inform you of that. The normal thing is that when you check in, they inform you that if you want them to clean, you
have to say so the day before. You pay like a hotel but the service is like that of an apartment. It is not worth it. Nobody speaks Spanish.

author: Olivia W
title: Great experience
text: Very entertaining and welcoming . I was able to rest and relax well. I enjoyed staff interaction and room comfort. Overall quality is high

author: Grace D
title: Room not ready
text: Stayed on a Sunday night, had paid for early check in from 11am. As it turned out I didn’t get there until after normal check in time, but despite this was told my room wasn’t ready and would be 10 mins. After 20 mins nobody had updated me so I went back and was finally given a room. Who knows how long I would have been waiting otherwise. Saw lots of people I the same position and we all had places to be, so many unhappy people. Room was ok once checked in but the service needs to improve

author: Evie R
title: Check in delays
text:
Hotel is well presented in a good location just a few minutes walk from Paddington Station clean and tidy with a large bar/restaurant. My issues with the stay started at check in. Check in is from 3, We arrived around 3.30pm to be told our a room wasn't ready and it would be 2 minutes. We sat and waited 15 minutes went back to reception to be told it was going to be a while. This was now nearly an hour after check in time and the only room they could offer us was an accessibility room which we took as we were tight for time. The room was clean and tidy at least. 
Next issue was breakfast the next day massive queue to get a table seemed to be 1 or 2 members of staff that just couldn't keep up with the demand loads of empty dirty tables not cleared

author: William L
title: Premier Plus disgrace
text: After having a lovely stay last year at the same hotel, it was our first choice for our stay for a concert. As it was also my daughter’s birthday on the Sunday, decided to book a Premier Plus room to enhance the stay. Our room was on the 19th floor and the first thing we noticed was the heat when stepping out of the lift. The room itself was cool on arrival. We noticed the shower head riser attachment was broken so when trying to shower you had to hold the head as it as hanging limply with no way to adjust the height. Even on maximum flow, the water trickled out, so you had to sort of hand flick the water to attempt to wash. We informed reception of the issue and was told that someone would enter the room whilst we were out to fix. When we arrived back around midnight, the first thing we noticed was the temperature in the room. It was now quite stuffy and the tv was on showing a concert, which we thought was unusual. When we checked the bathroom, was extremely dissatisfied that the shower head was untouched, resulting in yet another unpleasant shower experience after a very long busy day travelling and going to a concert. The room remained stuffy despite following the instructions left on the desk for the air con, which resulted in a very unsettled night due to the temperature. We decided to leave that morning earlier than planned due to the disturbed sleep. On check out we informed reception again about the shower and was told that we should have been offered an alternative room the day before! Very disappointed, would not stay again.

author: Diego Z
title: Comfortable hotel let down by poor handling of lost property
text:
We stayed at Premier Inn Paddington Basin for several nights while visiting London and, in many respects, it was what you’d expect from a Premier Inn. The room was comfortable, the location is excellent for Paddington Station, and check-in was straightforward.

Unfortunately, our experience after checkout completely overshadowed the stay.

I accidentally left my Apple AirPods in our room and contacted the hotel immediately after checking out, asking for them to be secured in lost property as I would be returning to London the following week to collect them.

The issue is not that the AirPods were misplaced – these things happen. The issue is how the matter was handled.

Using Apple’s Find My network, I was able to track the AirPods after leaving the hotel. They later appeared at a private residential address rather than remaining at the hotel or being logged as lost property. I provided this information to the hotel and to Premier Inn Guest Relations.

Despite this, the hotel’s response amounted to saying they could not find the AirPods and had no record of them being handed in. No explanation was provided for the tracking evidence other than speculation that another guest may have found them elsewhere in the hotel.

I appreciate that the hotel cannot conclusively explain every lost item, and I am not suggesting conclusions that cannot be proven. However, when a guest provides credible tracking information showing their property subsequently at a private residential address, I would expect a far more thorough investigation and communication than simply stating the item could not be found.

The disappointing part was not losing the AirPods—it was the lack of confidence that the matter had been properly investigated.

I hope Premier Inn reviews its lost property procedures because guests should be able to trust that forgotten belongings are handled transparently and securely.

author: Diego J
title: Nice family stay
text: Family of four, spent 2 nights here. Good food, quiet room, and very nice folks at the front desk. We stayed in multiple Premier Inns on our trip and would choose this one again.

author: Ian I
title: Lovely hotel, does exactly what it says on the tin!!!
text: We had a lovely stay at this Premier inn, very handy to both Paddington tube station and Edgeware Road which gets you most places you want to go. Witherspoons just around the corner which was handy as we couldn't check in straight away as the hotel was full and we arrived at 12, which was fine. When we came back at 2 we were checked into room 1324 which was perfect for our needs. The mattress is so comfortable we slept great. Lovely Aircon as well because it was sooooo warm when we were there that was greatly appreciated. The staff were lovely and very helpful and we are booked to stay here again for the NFL Games in Oct, thanks to all.

author: Daisy A
title: Great hotel
text: A few new hotel. Close to padddington and Edgware tube stations. A great base to explore London from and very nice feel locally around it.

author: Michael B
title: “Premier plus” room in a terrible state
text:
I have stayed with Premier Inn several times before and have generally had positive experiences, but my stay at London Paddington (Paddington Basin) was extremely disappointing, particularly as I had booked a Premier Plus room.

On arrival, the carpet was covered in numerous large bleach marks, along with several brown stains. I reported this to reception almost immediately after checking in early, but when I returned to the hotel that evening, nothing had been done and I had not been offered another room.

The bathroom was in an appalling condition. The extractor fan was covered in a thick layer of dust and did not appear to work properly. After using the shower, the walls were soaking wet with condensation, and the paint was cracked, bubbling and peeling in several places.

There was also a heavy build-up of dust and what appeared to be mould behind the fridge, along with dirty marks on the walls and skirting boards. Overall, the room felt grubby, neglected and poorly maintained.

To make matters worse, the advertised “Ultimate Wi-Fi” produced a download speed of just 1.32 Mbps, which is completely unacceptable for a supposed premium service in central London.
This fell far below the standard I would expect from Premier Inn, let alone from one of its upgraded rooms. Unfortunately, it was the worst stay I can remember having at any hotel.

author: Lucia L
title: Very happy with Premier Inn, Welcoming Staff!
text:
I honestly cannot praise our stay at the Premier Inn London Paddington enough! Our room was clean, and the bed was incredibly comfortable-exactly what we needed after a long day of exploring. We visited during a hot spell in July, so having good, reliable air conditioning in the room was an absolute lifesaver.

What truly set this stay apart was the exceptional service. Every single staff member we encountered was helpful and quick to address our needs. The morning breakfast team and the staff at the Bar+Block restaurant were polite, courteous, and attentive throughout our entire stay. Speaking of the restaurant, we enjoyed some very tasty burgers there, and I particularly recommend the Choc Fondant for dessert—it was super!

A special thank you to Chanelle and Sokhawat Hossain, who both went above and beyond to make us feel genuinely welcome.

Management, please keep up the great work and look after your team—they are hands-down your greatest asset!

author: Carlos D
title: Unsanitary room
text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but after my experience at The Washington NYC, I feel obligated to warn future guests.
My son and I had just completed a cross-country drive from San Antonio, Texas. After checking into the hotel around 7:00 PM, we immediately left to visit the One World Observatory and the 9/11 Memorial. As a 100% disabled U.S. Navy veteran and medically retired LAPD police officer, paying tribute at the memorial was one of the main reasons for our trip.
When we returned to our room around 9:30 PM and had a chance to actually look around, we were shocked. The room was filthy. There were boogers and what appeared to be other bodily fluids on the walls and doors, dried food residue on multiple surfaces, what appeared to be feces on the wall next to the toilet, black mold in the shower, stained curtains, and a refrigerator that smelled like a dead animal. It honestly looked like the room hadn't been properly cleaned in a very long time.
I immediately contacted the front desk. After waiting approximately 20–30 minutes, we were moved to another room, and I was assured it had been cleaned.
Unfortunately, the second room was nearly identical. Once again, there were boogers on the walls and doors, food residue on the walls, dirty and stained curtains and bedding, unpleasant odors, and an overall feeling that the room had not been sanitized. By this point it was nearly 11:00 PM. My son was exhausted after our long day and had already fallen asleep. After traveling across the country, moving to a third room late at night was simply not a realistic option, especially after seeing the condition of the first two rooms.
I also contacted Priceline, but our call was disconnected before the issue could be resolved. We checked out early the next morning because we could not wait to leave.
Since then, I have repeatedly tried to speak with the hotel manager—on the night of my stay, the following morning, throughout the day, and again afterward—but no one has returned my calls. At this point, I'm not even convinced there is a manager available to address guest concerns.
I've stayed in countless hotels throughout my military service, law enforcement career, and personal travels, and I can honestly say this was one of the most unsanitary hotel experiences I've ever had. The condition of not just one, but two rooms raises serious concerns about the hotel's cleaning standards.
I have photographs documenting the conditions I encountered.
The location is excellent if you're visiting the World Trade Center and Lower Manhattan, but that does not make up for the deplorable state of the rooms or the complete lack of management response.
I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone until significant improvements are made to its cleanliness and customer service.

author: Marco V
title: Spend the extra money for somewhere nicer
text:
I’ve previously stayed here due to location being perfect for access to everything including 9/11 memorial, close to Brooklyn bridge, Wall Street, trains straight to mid-town etc. The first time was manageable (2024) minus a few issues. However staying there this year seemed that they lowered their standards to the floor. 

Not only did we request to change our room four times…before we had even been there an hour due to stains in the sheets, holes in the bed, tears in the sheets, missing fridges, filthy bathrooms or smells but the the comfort of the room is terrible. For the amount of money you spend to stay here you might as well of slept on the bench across the road. 

The staff were as helpful as they possibly could have been but you can tell they all just don’t care. 

Out of six lifts present in the hotel. Two worked. 

One in the main entrance and one other to get you from the lobby to the rest of the 50 odd floors. You will be waiting a significant amount of time just to get in or out of the hotel. 

It has a gym which can be accessed, pretty standard. They do not have a breakfast/eating facilities on site. Eating out is necessary but this is expected with this type of trip. 

Overall, the first time I would have given it 5/10 just for the fact it was my first time in NYC. But I most certainly will NEVER be staying here again. -1000/10

author: Leo C
title: No luxury here. Just handy and pretty rough and worn out.
text:
A bit dated and in need of better lighting and a very good deep clean. Bathroom was dimly lit. Hairdryer was all noise and no action. No iron. No coffee making or even a kettle. ( After long flight this would have been nice)
Dated furniture in the guest lounge, all seen better days. Lighting terrible. Less than interactive staff. Door man was the friendliest. On pulling up, it looked closed. Carpets and lift all need revamp. If you want luxury, move on, you won't find it here. Lifts are slow DnD often out of service. Housekeepers were lovely and made up our room. We had plenty of towels, but given time, they don't have chance to deep clean bathrooms and floor was slippery when wet!!! Yuk.
Very close to the 9/11 memorial and for food Flavor Deli is open 24/7. Great food, fab staff, good prices. No services at this hotel. Also close to O Haras Irish bar for good and a drink. Well placed, but past it's best.

author: Lucas W
title: Shut them down.
text: Absolutely the worst Hotel I’ve ever had the displeasure of staying at. The staff is about as friendly as a pile of rhinoceros feces, and they are as honest as the Trump administration. After barely honoring my reservation, they stuck me in the worst room hotel that had no air-conditioning. I tried for over 24 hours to resolve the situation until they finally moved me into another room. The servers been admitted, but the air-conditioning didn’t work and that the thermostat was broken in the day were not able to get a part to repair it. I tried to have that first night refunded to me and they refused. I’m in the process now of suing them.

author: Lauren E
title: Don’t understand the hate!  This place is fantastic value for money
text: I don’t understand all the hate and complaints in the reviews.  I had a great stay here in April.  Large room with a king sized bed, great views and clean bathroom and closet.  Friendly and accommodating staff, efficient room cleaning, and super location.  It’s a tad inefficient getting to the rooms with two elevators but frankly I’ve stayed in Ritz Carlton hotels with the same thing.  This is an excellent value for money.  You will be hard pressed to find a hotel room in New York as nice as this at this price point.

author: Lucas O
title: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE - AVOID AT ALL COSTS
text: Absolutely abysmal experience at this hotel. Firstly, the staff was less than welcoming and not helpful. Second, there was only 1 functioning elevator for the entire hotel. We booked 3 rooms in advance, and got put on 3 separate floors. Additionally, the staff neglected to notify us that we would not be able to get to floor 20 via the elevator, causing us to get off one floor below or above and take the stairs to floor 20 since the button was broken in the elevator. The rooms were dated, peeling decor, less than clean bathrooms. To top things off, to store ohr luggage after checkout resulted in a fee. This is something I have never experienced. I would not send my worst enemy to this hotel.

author: Olivia B
title: REPORT TO 311!!!!!
text: ABOSLUTELY DISGUSTING! DO NOT STAY HERE. I stayed here for one night as a solo-traveler and made several attempts to communicate with hotel management regarding these issues both DURING my stay and after and they remained unresponsive for nearly a week. First, my room had an odd stench of smoke or an otherwise unidentifiable odor and boast rust and stains all throughout (see pictured) from the floor to the curtains to the walls. It appeared to not have been cleaned besides the bed. The bedframe had rust and a visible peeling from LED strips and was simply UNCLEAN and UNSANITARY from the headboard down to the base near the pillows. Secondly, there was no wifi upon my arrival until my departure, so I was unable to do my work via my devices throughout my entire stay. When I contacted the front desk before checkout regarding this, she stated "I was not here yesterday, so I can't help with that"... meanwhile the Wifi had still not been working when I called her. I emailed the front desk as well during my stay, STILL TO NO RESPONSE. There is no urgency or customer service at this hotel and management is inadequate. So when I escalated the contact to reach a resolution or explanation from the hotel, through a third party, they responded denying the facts and stated I had not contacted them which I have clear proof of. Additionally, the main elevators were not operating and there is only ONE elevator servicing the entire building to access rooms from the lobby. This isn't a hotel it's run like a motel ... don't waste your money or your time. As for the Washington, I'll continue to await a resolution, you will not ignore me.

author: Megan D
title: Nice hotel right next to the wtc in manhaden.
text: The hotel is in a perfect location, right next to the wtc. You can reach everything perfectly on foot, the subway is also just 5 minutes away. The perfonal was very friendly and accommodating. We can recommend the hotel. The rooms were also very clean.

author: Matthew I
title: Not recommended. Poor service
text: The front desk makes you feel like it’s hassle to do their own job. Unfriendly staff. There is no coffee in entire building. No coffee machine in room. The fridge was not working. Elevators of the building were out of service. Home less loitering in the 1st floor lobby. No wine opener available in entire hotel or room. No microwave in the building.

author: Ian M
title: Unforgiving Cancellation Policy
text: I booked a stay at this hotel in error and discovered my error within 15 minutes of booking (stay was three weeks away) and immediately called to cancel the booking. They gave me the run around for weeks and then said their policy allowed no cancellations and it was out of their hands.  I paid $600 for a room  no one was in. It was also over the busy holiday season and they would have had no problem re-booking.  Horrible customer service. As a frequent NYC visitor, I would never recommend or stay here.

author: Hannah R
title: Dirty Hotel without any amenities.
text:
This hotel is in shambles. It was a previous W. Since it lost its name brand nothing has happened. The walls and carpet are filthy. I was very unhappy that I paid $400 to stay there. No one should even step foot in there.
The staff constantly apologized.

The elevators broke making timely entry and exit a problem. They even charged us to store our bags while we went to have lunch:/

author: Lea T
title: Fantastic
text: Don't understand the negative reviews, elevator problem was solved, nice room, fantastic view, good bed and shower, everything clean and at the reception is a water tank with hot and cold water , so coffee you can make yourself.

author: Noah Q
title: Unprofessional and offensive
text: Unfriendly staff and hidden costs apply. Despite supposedly fully booked hotel, only 1 in 3 elevators go. This results in unbearably long waiting times and overcrowded elevators. After the check out you are treated like dirt and even insulted. My recommendation, find something else...

author: Julien I
title: Best 1* hotel in the city
text: Do not stay at this hotel unless you want to have elevator issues every other day and roaches the size of baseball the staff are great and location great if you coming to nyc and want a 1 * hotel this is the hotel for you

author: Abigail B
title: Bad.
text:
I had booked this hotel through Booking in January for a planned stay in December. Before departure I had contacted both the property and Booking to make sure everything was confirmed, and I was guaranteed that there were no problems.

One month before departure, the hotel cancelled the reservation without a valid reason. I contacted Booking to ask for assistance or equivalent alternative accommodation, but was told they could do nothing.

I find it unacceptable that, after months of confirmed booking, a property can cancel at the last minute and that Booking does not protect customers in any way in these cases.

Very disappointing experience, both with the hotel and with Booking: little seriousness and total lack of responsibility towards the customer.

author: Charlotte P
title: Low rates for this hotel
text:
The location is ideal. The splendid view because we were lucky to have a room overlooking the world trade center.
However, we spent 8 days with the elevators broken down. We had to go through the Service Lift, generating a lot of waiting... except for the day when it also broke down!!! 20 floors on foot. Not a word of apology, not a commercial gesture. 
The rooms are very primary. We had 2 bedrooms and the services of the 2 bedrooms were not similar. They recycle as much as they can. But at the price of the hotel, it's very disappointing.

author: Aiden O
title: Worst bed ever
text: Booked this hotel expecting the basics, unfortunately so dissatisfied. For starters the sheets looked dirty. The bathroom had only one tube of shampoo and a tiny tube of body wash for two adults. No lotion, no conditioner. There was only 2 towels. The worst thing of all was the mattress. It was way too soft and weirdly sinking in random spots. I slept a total of 2 hours for the night…the only upside is the views. Also need to use two separate elevators each time you need to leave.

author: Benjamin R
title: Dodgy lifts
text: This hotel was very reasonably priced for Manhattan. It’s down between Wall St and the Battery very close to the World Trade Centre so transportation is really easy, you can be in Times Square in just over half an hour, the room was spacious with an amazing view one One WTC. The staff were nice and the room was cleaned every day. Now the downside, we had a fridge and an iron which was great but no kettle, which for a Brit was tough. The building has 30 floors of rooms with one lift to reception on 5 and a second set to the rooms. When you arrive it feels like a nightclub with little or no sign to explain where to check in, luckily someone told us. The big issue was most of the lifts didn’t work. One of the 3 from the street was operational and one of 3 for the top floors, which completely gave up at one point and we had to use the service lift. I would stay there again for the price but leave plenty of time to exit the building!

author: Zachary Z
title: Great!
text:
Great hotel! Great view! Service to the top elevator that works! A great stay!
I was afraid we read the comments but no worries everything was top!

author: Adam T
title: Disappointment
text:
Not worth the price paid at all. This 4-star hotel deserves no more than 2.
Only positive: the view from the room.

Otherwise, the establishment is dilapidated: stained walls, sloppy cleaning, omnipresent dust... Too bad, because the place has potential.
The bar was closed, and the terrace was also inaccessible.
Elevators often broken down and dilapidated, elevators hold with tape

For 11 nights, the bed linen was never changed.
The icing on the cake: at 2:30 a.m., the fire alarm went off, prompting the intervention of firefighters.

author: Leo A
title: Great Stay
text: Great location if you want to stay close o Termini Station. Hotel is being renovated and we stayed in a very comfortable and large. The breakfast is great! They have a large variety and the food is fresh. The staff is very friendly and helpful, especially Diogo at the front desk.

author: Claire P
title: Very good choice for Rome
text:
Location near the station
Triple room, actually 2 separate rooms, ideal for parents + 1 child or teenager. 1 bathroom + 1 shower room.
The rooms have been recently renovated, soft and harmonious decor. Our room overlooked the courtyard, no noise disturbance. I highly recommend this hotel, which does not deserve the average rating on Google and TripAdvisor.

author: Aiden K
title: Highly Recommended hotel.
text:
Would recommend this hotel.  Very close to Termini Train Station for connection to Airport & within walking distance of a lot of attractions.
We had a Junior Suite & it was very  nice & clean.  Breakfast was a bit repetitive but was handy to have before setting off for the day.  Refreshing glass of Prescesso !
Overall,  we really enjoyed our experience at San Remo.

author: David H
title: Good home base!
text:
Excellent welcome. A very friendly team.
The breakfast is rich and diverse. The service is impeccable.

The room is pleasant for a couple or a family. 

The hotel is well located: the proximity to Termini station is a plus for Roman getaways but also for the connection to the airport.

author: Connor O
title: Great experience
text: Great experience! Very convenient for those arriving by train at Termini station, clean and well-kept environment. Some rooms are being renovated, others already renovated like the one I had. New bathroom, TV, safe... everything you need for a stay in beautiful Rome! Perhaps breakfast could be improved a bit as it offers many savory options, a little fewer sweet ones! But it remains a recommended hotel nonetheless!

author: Lily U
title: Decent hotel for a night
text: We stayed here for a night before our cruise.  The staff was very friendly and breakfast was very good.  We picked this hotel based on its close proximity to the train station so we could walk there.  We never felt unsafe at the hotel.  However, right around the train station was not so good, and we did see one man doing drugs down the street from hotel.  Hotel is close to shops and cute outdoor cafes and we were able to walk to Spanish Steps, Trevi, Pantheon, Colosseum, Roman Forum.  Our room was big - 2 bedrooms, 1.5 baths.  It had been updated, but the air conditioning wasn't super cool, but comfortable.

author: Taylor M
title: Needs improvement for returning customers
text:
I was disappointed with my stay this time. The room was very small for two people, and despite asking several times to be moved, we were repeatedly told that no other rooms were available.

The staff were also much less helpful than on previous visits, which was very disappointing.

Another issue was the air conditioning. In the room, the temperature seemed to be locked at a certain level unless you specifically asked about it. Additionally, there was no air conditioning in the breakfast room, which made it very uncomfortable given the hot weather.

The location remains one of the hotel's biggest strengths and is a major reason why we continue to return. However, overall, there are several areas that need improvement, particularly when it comes to looking after returning customers. This stay did not meet the standards we had experienced before, and I was left feeling quite let down.

author: Hugo B
title: A good base for a future return
text: I had already been here, so I chose it again. Some issues due to ongoing renovations, but everything is bearable. Friendly and helpful staff.

author: Brooke V
title: Excellent experience
text: One night for a business trip, excellent experience, just outside the Termini station, clean and well-equipped room, and abundant breakfast. Friendly and helpful staff.

author: Pablo S
title: Average Experience
text: The airconditioning in the room was not working the whole time and it was a heat wave in rome in May. Nevertheless stayed for 2 nights.

author: Lily P
title: Disappointing experience during a 4-day stay in Rome.
text:
I share my experience hoping it will be useful to other travelers. 
I really do not recommend this hotel, extremely disappointed with the experience I had. We booked a small double room, so we expected a small room with a standard double bed. Very unpleasant surprise, the bed was barely adequate for one person or at worst, an adult and a child. After reporting it to the front desk, no solution was proposed due to a lack of available rooms: I had to look for another hotel for the same day.
Additionally, there were ongoing works outside and inside the hotel, with an unpleasant smell in the room. I really do not recommend it, the staff was nice, but nothing more!

author: Mason M
title: Excellent stay
text: Very nice hotel undergoing renovation, but we were not disturbed by the construction work. Ideally located, we were able to do a good part of our stay on foot. The rooms are large and very well equipped with all the necessary comforts. We were on the street side, but the window insulation blocked out any noise. All the staff are extremely friendly. Not everyone speaks French, but they do their best to find a common language with a lot of patience. The breakfast was of high quality with good fresh products. Thank you! 🥰

author: Megan B
title: Courteous
text: Nice hotel with friendly courteous staff. Renovation is underway. We had a nice renovated room.

author: Isabella V
title: Excellent stay
text: Lovey freshly refurbished  bedroom with all amenities. While the main reception area is still under refurb this did not inconvenience our stay. Super friendly staff, great location and surrounded by lovely restaurants and bars I would recommend.

author: Jack X
title: Nice stay in Rome
text: Hotel 5 minutes walk from Termini Station , very convenient to Fiumicino airport . Very comfortable room, top bathroom with Italian shower. Our room overlooked a courtyard so no car noise. Very kind receptionist speaking French.

author: Elena K
title: We visited Rome for the Six Nations rugby, and the hotel was a great base for a long weekendd
text:
I have been here before, and the hotel was fine then, but recent refurbishments have improved it further. My room was very clean and the facilities were all new.  It was nice and quiet. As the breakfast room was being upgraded, we ate breakfast at the hotel next door, which worked nicely and was very nice.
The hotel is close to Termini station and not far from attractions such as the Museum of Rome, Opera, and Santa Maria Maggiore Church.

author: Isabella N
title: Would not recommend
text: Hotel under construction no advance notice, Rude staff very unhelpful. Room recently decorated. No coffee shop as advertised no place to have a drink or food you have to go to sister hotel next door . Definitely put a damper on the break . I’ve never stayed in a hotel like this before I think the staff should look for new jobs as they obviously are not happy here.

author: Jessica V
title: Currently under renovation
text: The hotel itself is currently under renovation, we are not advised of this beforehand. I was on the 3rd Floor, brand new room, heating was not working, called reception and they sent a young fella to the room to fix it but he had no clue. The following evening, it the same. My friend got me an extra duvet instead. Wifi also did not work in the room, advised reception and he just shrugged it off. No dining room or lobby open, was directed their sister hotel next door. Despite having a kettle in the room, there was no milk sachets for tea/coffee, it was not available when I asked as there is currently no kitchen on site. I was very disappointed with this hotel, after being out all day long sightseeing, its a basic necessity to have heat in your room.

author: Elena S
title: Beware of Reconstruction Disturbance/Noises
text:
Reconstruction noise, dust, 
Disappointed that wasn't advised of reconstruction in advance of staying here.
Asked reception about this and was clearly told they are not "obligated to"!!! This is not a painting or redecorating job but full building hammering & drilling noises,workmen carrying blocks, plaster equipment, change of breakfast room size/shape, relocation of reception across from left to right of entrance, furniture moving, abysmal WiFi, etc.
Appreciate that it will be an upgrade when finished BUT was not able to make an informed choice about our stay.
Despite this, the positives were the location, room facilities, shower and breakfast staff.
So please check about the disturbance before you book so you can make an informed choice unlike us 🙁

author: Erin Q
title: Relaxation and comfort in a very welcoming structure
text:
This is the second time I have stayed at this hotel and I think the location, the kindness of the staff and the prices of this hotel are really exceptional.
polite rooms, very quiet and refined rooms very accurate with structure in excellent condition as finishes and bathroom with shower very comfortable
Several restaurants in the surroundings and a step from Termini station convenient x all movements both on foot and by public transport ..
Absolutely to keep in mind to spend a nice holiday in Rome

author: Matthew F
title: The best view of the trevi fountain
text: Perfect location and incredible views

author: Sydney T
title: Right at the Trevi
text: Trevi fountain right outside the front door. Staff was pleasant, room was clean. Lots of activity in the area, a little difficult for automobile pickups and drop offs but not impossible.

author: Nathan D
title: Avoid
text: The hotel is in a great location opposite the Trevi fountain but that is all it has going for it. The hotel is dark and dingy and smells of mould. Furniture is old and broken, paint is peeling from the walls. The bathroom was damp and in desperate need of an upgrade with mouldy sealant when present. Room was cleaned daily with a fresh threadbare towels left to use. Breakfast staff were lovely but the man at reception was rude and aggressive. Tourist tax had to be paid in cash only! Be aware that due to the location the hotel is very noisy throughout the day and night.

author: Lauren W
title: Best spot with the worst service.
text: This is the best spot in Rome with the worst service possible. They behaved like they were  tired of tourists. We pay $25 per person to visit the rooftop and had the worst experience ever.  They included 1 drink and a snack with the price, however they didn't have most of the drinks in the menu. No whiskey, no rum, no tequila, no coke and the peanuts were soggy. Basically you are almost obligated to have a spritz and a bag of potato ships. The lady was not happy with us and we were the only group  in the room (4). The view is beautiful, but we were not allowed to take pictures or basically to move in the room. The room was hot and the a/c is too small to cool the space. Visit is not recommended at all.

author: Charlotte T
title: Just returned from a lovely 3 night stay at this lovely, quirky, welcoming hotel
text:
We have just returned from a 3 nights stay at this lovely, quirky, welcoming hotel.
Yes, this is an old building but it adds to the charm of this hotel. 
We were a family of 4 staying in 3 rooms 103 & 104. Both had comfortable beds and were very clean.
All the staff on reception were very welcoming and friendly and happy to help with any questions or queries.
Every morning we injoyed our continental breakfast overlooking the trevi fountain, the ladies who looked after our every need were very accommadating and very friendly. 
This hotel is a situated in a perfect location to enjoy all the best sites of Rome! 
You can step outside and join the buzzing atmosphere of the city on your doorstep then retreat back into a quaint hotel and relax in a cool airy relaxing room.
Would we recommend? Yes!
Would we return? Absolutely!

author: Thomas H
title: Excellent Stay for the 2nd Time!!
text:
I recently stayed at Hotel Fontana from June 13–15 with my son and daughter-in-law during their visit to Italy, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience. This was my second stay at the hotel, and it certainly reinforced why I chose to return.

First and foremost, I would like to commend the entire hotel staff, especially Pierfrancesco, for providing exceptional customer service throughout our stay. He was professional, attentive, welcoming, and truly went above and beyond to ensure we had a memorable visit.

One of the highlights of our stay was the breathtaking view of the Trevi Fountain from my son and daughter-in-law's room. It was truly a million-dollar view and made their first visit to Rome even more special.

The rooms were also outstanding—comfortable, spotless, and equipped with amazing air conditioning, which was greatly appreciated during the warm June weather. Every detail contributed to a relaxing and enjoyable stay.

This was my second visit to Hotel Fontana, and I can confidently say it will not be my last. Thank you, Pierfrancesco, and the entire Hotel Fontana team for another exceptional experience. I look forward to returning again in the future!

author: Elena G
title: Location and view are excellent, quality is questionable
text:
We booked the hotel for the second time after spending a lovely weekend here last year. Unfortunately, I was disappointed this time regarding the value for money.
This time we had a not too large room with a view of the Trevi Fountain. The bathroom was in a deplorable condition. Peeling paint on the walls, a smell of mold, and poorly draining sinks and showers.
The breakfast on the rooftop terrace could be a hidden gem just because of the view of the square and the fountain. Unfortunately, the buffet is rather meager in Italian style. Also, compared to the previous year, the porcelain plates have been eliminated. Guests are expected to use cheap disposable plastic plates. When I asked for a fried egg, I was informed that it would only be available for an additional charge of 6 euros. I then decided to forgo it. 
With the high room prices, you pay for the location and view, but not for quality.

author: Henry I
title: Poor Service
text:
We stayed here in March 2025 and had an amazing experience—friendly staff, early check-in at no extra cost, and a very comfortable room. Because of that, we were excited to return in March 2026.

Unfortunately, our second stay was completely different. After a difficult travel day, my daughter was feeling quite ill when we arrived. I politely asked the front desk if early check-in was possible—even offering to pay a fee—but the gentleman at reception responded very rudely, raising his voice and insisting that check-in before 2pm was absolutely not possible.

We tried to wait quietly in the lobby, but were told to leave and sit in the rooftop restaurant instead. Eventually, we found a hallway bench where my daughter could lie down out of the way while we waited.

When we were finally checked in, we were given Room 207, which was extremely small and not suitable for our needs. I use a walker, and there was barely enough space for both of us and the walker—we had to store it in the bathroom and move it each time we needed to use the facilities.

To make matters worse, I later observed the same staff member being rude to another guest during check-in.

This was a very disappointing experience, especially compared to our previous stay. Because of this, we have already chosen a different hotel for our next visit to Rome. It’s unfortunate, as we truly loved this hotel the first time around.

author: Connor T
title: Central, basic, clean but loud.
text:
Just returned from a 4 night stay at the Hotel Fontana. 
We arrived before check-in time but were allowed to leave our bags which were taken up to our room which was a nice touch as the hotel lift is tiny and navigating the stairs with suitcases would have been tricky after travelling. 
Once we got into our room we found it quite small, basic and pretty dated. But it was clean and had a private bathroom which for us was the most important aspect of booking any hotel. 
The plug sockets were all an old style 3-prong type and we found it difficult to find a socket that would accept our 2 prong adapters. The TV was small and the remote had no back (batteries exposed). The flush on the toilet plainly didn’t work.. you had to press the button 4 or 5 times before any water came out. 
Our main issue was the noise, which wasn’t the fault of the hotel, Rome is an especially noisy city anywhere but at the fountain there is an almost constant noise which even having the window closed on a night was inescapable. Along with also being able to hear everything from next doors bathroom, I mean everything. 

The bed was clean, fresh towels daily and the bathroom was also cleaned every day. The breakfast room was top notch, the ladies working up there are fantastic. 

With this hotel I feel you are there for a reason, the fountain which is amazing and you don’t get a better location or view than one from this hotel. I’d recommend this hotel if you’re a first time traveller to Rome as the location is superb, but remember your ear plugs and bring good shoes.

author: Megan V
title: Avoid
text:
We checked in late on March 3rd and were allocated room 104 which was not featured on the hotel website.
It was tiny. The double bed just about fitted into the room and there was only access from one side. The bathroom was less than 2m by 2m and you had to be a contortionist to sit on the toilet without hitting the small sink in front. The shower was the size of a small tray with a curtain on two sides. Once you were wet, there was no escaping having the curtain sticking to you!
The AC didn’t work and the window opened onto the garden patio meaning that we could not leave the window open.
The electrics were dangerous – unsheathed wires - and would fail inspection in the UK. 
After looking at the fire plan, we realised that we had been given the smallest room on the floor; on the plus side the staff were able to change our room a day later. 
In the new room (101) the electrics were again substandard with a dangerous socket and the hairdryer cut out at certain angles when plugged into a different socket.
Again, the AC didn’t work and being nearer to the Trevi Fountain, the noise outside was continual. Additionally, we couldn’t escape the noise from the 4am rubbish collection. 
Breakfast average
