author: Ryan C
title: Do not stay here
text: Terrible place, horrible staff and very dirty do not stay here!

author: Wyatt T
title: Terrible. Avoid at all costs.
text:
The manager is the rudest man I have ever met. He shouted at us & was extremely confrontational.
The place is run down & dirty.

author: Nathan P
title: Great location 👍 small and old room
text:
The single room is too small, some rooms so converted from a closet should not exist. You can't move in the bathroom. I don't know about the other rooms. I didn't use any other services, so I can't comment on anything, wrongly my room was clean but the bathroom too old still showers her with curtains, I hadn't seen things like this for 30 years. Unfortunately, the accommodation facilities in Rome are also this. But the
Magic to have under the fountain of trevi makes the sorrow pass.

author: Lea N
title: Breakfast with a view of the fountain? Please!
text: Right across from the famous Trevi Fountain! An old house that welcomed us warmly and had a lot to tell us. Perfect location and very fitting for old Rome.

author: Harper M
title: Value for money to improve
text:
Only positive note the location, the small room to be renovated, clean, as far as conditions allow.
The shower given the small space hThe tent, which I would highly recommend to replace as the sheets at each guest change, because it was not clean!
The price for the low season I think it high, also lacked the hairdryer.

author: Ruby F
title: Incredible view and service
text: We stayed one night at Hotel Fontana and had a great experience! We were nervous after reading some reviews, but I’m glad we didn’t end up canceling. Our room had a view of the Trevi Fountain that truly was unimaginable! The hotel staff were very kind, spoke great English, and helped us in every way possible. Maria from the upstairs bar was super sweet, we loved her. The room itself definitely had older decor, but the beds were super comfy, room was clean and shower worked great. The best thing about this place is being able to go out to the fountain at 1am and get gorgeous photos. We felt very safe here and experienced no issues!

author: Charlotte W
title: Lovely staff and excellent food
text: Lovely receptionist, she was very kind and we felt very welcome. We visited for breakfast paid €25 each for the rooftop bar view, staff were very attentive and always smiling, couldn’t have asked for more :)

author: Alice A
title: Bad Experience
text: Where to start? Place is out dated. Room had no air conditioning. Told the front desk only to tell me it's not America. But it sad Mitsubishi on it? And we have them in America. Also revived a cab from hotel and he charged us on meter for 3 people. So please pay attention. Wouldn't definitely recommend.

author: Laura Z
title: Perfect view of the Trevi Fountain
text: Location is a 5 star. The view out of our room was directly over the Trevi Fountain. Although the crowds are big from 8 AM to 10 PM with the windows closed, you couldn’t hear the noise.  It’s a perfect place to stay for 2-3 nights while in Rome. That’s what we did then moved next to the Coliseum.

author: Isla B
title: Incredible hotel with stunning views
text: This hotel is a little gem with breathtaking views of Trevi fountain, the rooftop for breakfast very hearty and varied buffet served by an adorable person, the room with views of the fountain you never get tired of it so much it is beautiful I recommend for a visit to Rome

author: Thomas P
title: Very small rooms but very clean
text:
Initially, I was disappointed with the hotel since the room was very small. My husband and I had several suitcases and there was no room to open them or even walk around them. Being a Hilton gold member, I expected an upgrade. We asked to be moved to a bigger room but since they were full, we had to wait until the next day. We were upgraded to a junior suite which gave us adequate space. I wanted to change hotels before we were given the upgraded room, but they refused to refund our stay. This is a boutique hotel so amenities are limited. There is a restaurant and a gym. No pool or rooftop and a very small lobby. 
Hotel is very clean and staff is friendly. Bathroom has nice, thick towels. Unfortunately, the bed is very uncomfortable. I requested a mattress topper but that did not help much. Pillows are also very thin. The rooms are best for solo travelers are very short stays with limited luggage. 
Breakfast was a buffet and it was quite good, 
We were in London celebrating a milestone anniversary but there was no recognition of our special day.

author: Paolo W
title: Cosy spot with outstanding service
text:
Tattle has such a warm and peaceful atmosphere. The selection of drinks was excellent, and we really enjoyed what we ordered.
A special mention has to go to Jun! He was incredibly friendly and helpful, and have us some recommendations for places to visit. We had a really wondeful time here. Highly recommend!

author: Liam I
title: Nice London Hotel
text:
We stayed for one night and had a room on the 6th floor. Check is was easy and although our room was not ready, it was cleaned as a priority and we were given a voucher for a free drink. Our room was very small and with two suitcases, we would not have been able to cope for more than one night. A strange thing was that when we opened the curtains we could not see out of the window as it is covered in some sort of film making people not see in or out. It did make the room seem a little claustrophobic due to the size and not seeing out of the window.
Breakfast was nice and the restaurant was not too busy. The location is good although I did hear the rumble from the underground trains through the night.

author: Katie J
title: Apparently, this isn’t accidental.
text:
First time @ Lost Property was three years ago and a really terrific experience.   Super location, fun aesthetic, engaged staff (we have extraordinary food allergies)… we left grateful, and totally pleased.  So much so, the restaurant manager (Constantine) became embedded in group-lore as a standard of exceptional customer attention.

THIS TIME… same story.  Constantine still runs the show in a busy (but effortless) manner, the staff was GREAT; special thank you’s to Katan, “the new guy” and the other guy (sorry to have misplaced the card that I used to write down both of your names!).  And food is so well crafted, it’s hard to believe it’s a ‘hotel restaurant’.

Just to be objective, the house Pinot isn’t that great.  

Anyway, making plans to return and a snap-salute to the GM “Catrin(?)” for her obvious leadership. 

Seeing the Lost Property’s stellar position on TripAdvisor’s hotel ranking over-time is no accident - it’s hospitality by design (as it should always be).

author: Brooke M
title: Amazing hotel
text:
There’s a reason why this hotel has excellent reviews. The staff are so nice and helpful.
The hotel is spotless and the rooms are lovely - no wear and tear.
The breakfast was very nice, with lots of choices & I’m sure the restaurant will be good too.
The location is great. So close to St Paul’s, lots of restaurants & you can easily walk across the Millennium Bridge to the Tate Modern, the Globe & even more restaurants.
There’s buses to/from Kings Cross, Trafalgar Square, Covent Garden, London tower etc as well as the tube.

author: George V
title: Amazing hotel
text:
What an amazing hotel, super trendy, really clean, great location. 
Loved it from the moment we arrived at the moment we left  
Well, 100% be coming back and recommend it to anybody visiting London

author: Camille R
title: Fantastic Hotel
text: Fantastic location right near St. Paul’s Cathedral and just up the hill from the tube station. Staff were incredibly kind and helpful. Rooms were clean and breakfast was fantastic.

author: Ruby C
title: Great for busines travel
text:
Great Business Stay

I had a great stay at Lost Property Hilton during a business trip. The service was excellent, the location was ideal for an overnight stay, and the room was  clean, comfortable and welcoming. Everything was perfect for a convenient and relaxing stay.

Definitely recommended, and I’d happily stay again!

author: Hugo D
title: All the ingredients for a perfect stay
text: Excellent property in great location. Service from breakfast team, particularly Rafael , was exceptional.

author: Poppy H
title: Tattles for Coffee
text: Stopped into Tattles for coffee. Jun was exceptionally helpful.

author: Matthew D
title: Wonderful evening
text: Fantastic location. Wonderful food and atmosphere at a great price. The service was second to none, with our server Mihir going out of his way to look after us. We'll definitely be back soon. I cannot recommend it highly enough.

author: Abigail P
title: Great find in London
text:
Excellent experience overall
Good location
New hotel/well maintained 
Great breakfast. Rafael the server is attentive and friendly 
Would definitely go back

author: Connor I
title: Great service, room, and location
text: Had a great experience at this property. We really appreciated our bartender, Star, who was willing to make us a new to him mocktail. Very clean room and great location as well.

author: Erin X
title: Lovely stay and bar experience
text: Lovely stay, easy to get to places around London! Served by Star at the Found bar who made the experience so welcoming and lovely! Rooms were nice and clean and good value.

author: Laura P
title: Love this place
text:
Great location and great cocktails. A nice and quiet hotel bar. 

The staff here are helpful, unobtrusive and knowledgeable. Mihir made he last visit flawless.

author: Elena M
title: Great for out of town guests!
text: It was a very good experience.  Very friendly staff and delicious food!  Exceeding our expectations.  Star was very helpful with ordering and we thoroughly enjoyed our food and drinks!

author: Ruby R
title: Fantastic location and excellent service
text: Such a stunning location right opposite St Paul’s in the heart of London. Only visited for an evening meal and Ketan couldn’t have been more hospitable his services was excellent. Food was also great and the muscles to start with superb. 👌🏻 would highly recommend and will be returning for possibly the bottomless brunch.

author: Emma N
title: Excellent location near St. Paul’s Cathedral
text:
Excellent location, comfortable room, friendly staff, great breakfast, great value for money. 
Thank you, Constantin, for taking such good care of us every morning at breakfast! Much appreciated!

author: Olivia R
title: I will be back here again!!!
text: Good food, good experience, excellent customer service!!

author: Zachary X
title: Great stay, fab bar and bar staff!
text: Fantastic stay! The rooms are really nice. All the staff are friendly and helpful. A special shout out to Star and his colleagues in Found bar, great recommendations and polite, professional service. Really appreciated. The bar has a really relaxing vibe. Very enjoyable. Thank you.

author: Freya F
title: Excellent Boutique Hotel
text: Hotel Santa Maria is the CUTEST boutique hotel nestled within the alley way of Trastevere. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The staff was so accommodating and friendly and Kevin (the bartender) was seriously the best! The breakfast and aperitifs were great! He gave us phenomenal service and we had so much fun! 10/10 would stay there again and highly recommend!

author: Harry A
title: Wonderful Place!!
text:
I just spent five nights at this beautiful little oasis in the heart Trastevere. I could not have been happier or more comfortable. A stunning, quiet, haven from the August heat with cool aspect and orange trees - it was an absolute pleasure!!
It would be unfair to single out staff members by name because everyone from the reception staff to those who served the complimentary breakfast (and the delicious cocktails), to those who kept the rooms and grounds clean and fresh were super friendly, helpful, kind and considerate. I send them all my heartfelt thanks and best wishes - and I really hope to be able to stay here again in the future.

author: Anna K
title: Amazing
text: Excellent location, unbeatable service, absolute delight to stay here.

author: Julien Q
title: A charming and peaceful stay in Trastevere
text:
My boyfriend and I stayed at Hotel Santa Maria, and we had a wonderful experience. The hotel is beautiful, peaceful, and full of character, with a lovely courtyard that makes it feel like a hidden oasis in the heart of Trastevere.

The room was clean, comfortable, and quiet, and the staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful throughout our stay. The location is perfect for exploring Rome, with many restaurants, cafés, and attractions within walking distance.

As a traveler, I truly appreciated the warm atmosphere and the excellent hospitality. We felt very welcome and enjoyed every moment of our stay. I would highly recommend Hotel Santa Maria to couples looking for a relaxing and memorable stay in Rome, and we would definitely return.

author: Sean E
title: A calm little oasis in Trastevere
text:
Hotel Santa Maria was wonderful. It's set in a little oasis in the middle of Trastevere. It's not the easiest to reach by car, but the taxi dropped us in front without any trouble.
The staff were really friendly, the buffet breakfast was wonderful, and the evening cocktails/apeo were welcome after a lonf day sightseeing  — I'll miss my basil smash. The rooms very clean, and the whole place feels calm. It's not modern — but that's exactly the charm. A really special stay.

author: Isla C
title: 11 out of 10!
text:
The built in amenities speak for themselves. A hearty breakfast featured European and American style options (bacon and eggs, and pastries and Nutella, plus fresh fruit, veggies, cured meats and cheeses) for a 3 hour window each morning, including made to order espresso drinks by very helpful staff. Then, for the price of one drink (wine, cocktails, or non-alcoholic) they offered a free buffet of appetizers like caprese skewers, foccaccia with a variety of toppings, fresh vegetables, and other antipasto from 5:30-7:30. Drinks were always terrific and generous.

Our room was one of the few 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom suites and amply fit our 2 adult, 2 teen party. In a heat wave of 38° C/ 100F, our air conditioning kept our room cool all through the day and night. The breakfast/bar area was always cool and the orange trees shaded the interior courtyard so eating outside was pleasant. 

But the real proof of their hospitality was the staff. They helped us find an air conditioned taxi to take us around during the heat of the day to sightsee and for photo ops so we could enjoy Rome without heat stroke (and for 1/3rd of the price of a guided tour). They allowed us to check in early and check out late. They never knocked on the door so our jet lagged family could sleep at odd hours, but made sure we had everything we needed (fresh towels, etc.) They even opened the breakfast room and kept the AC on when we needed to wait beyond the late checkout time for our private car to our next destination. But how can I describe the kindness and helpful attitude of true professional hospitality staff? Despite my lack of Italian, they figured out or anticipated my needs, always with a smile and good wishes. I felt like an honored guest, even at my most disheveled.

We will  be back (but maybe not during a heat wave)!  Yet, even at the height of the heat wave, the nights were pleasant and we were able to enjoy the romantic cobblestone streets and outdoor sites too hot to visit in the day. Trastevere really lights up at night, with street performers at Piazza Trilussa until the wee hours and all ages in the streets and squares enjoying a moment of cool air.

author: Evie H
title: Amazing place for family stay
text: My family had a wonderful stay at Hotel Santa Maria. The staff went above and beyond to make us comfortable, and the location was perfect — this was my parents' first trip to Europe, and they couldn't have asked for a better experience. Thank you!

author: Brooke K
title: wonderful stay.
text: We loved our stay at the Santa Maria hotel, the family room was perfect for our family with 2 teenagers, the hotel staff is charming, it was a pleasure to return to the hotel at the end of the day for a very pleasant aperitif sheltered from the heat of Rome.

author: Juan E
title: First Class Experience
text:
Excellent stay 
Rooms alittle dated but extremely clean 
All staff were very friendly and accommodating and couldn’t be enough for you to feel welcome and to have a lovely stay especially Adriano at reception and Kev at the bar plus the breakfast staff who did amazing coffee at breakfast time.
Location was excellent right in the heart of trastevere but still had the peace and quiet on an evening.
Really happy with our pick of hotel for our stay this n Rome.
We stayed in Room number 1 which was very private and had its own patio area .
Would definitely use again and recommend to family and friends.

author: Freya S
title: A hotel, a haven of peace
text: A charming hotel, very well located in Trastevere, with attentive staff who make it a point of honor to make your stay in Rome as pleasant as possible. We spent 5 nights there, and not only do we recommend it, but we will return.

author: Harry B
title: An oasis of calm in the Eternal City
text: A refuge in the middle of the Trastevere district, good breakfast, free afternoon snack, functional, quiet rooms facing the courtyard, air-conditioned. Very friendly staff, we will be back

author: Ella D
title: Best hotel in the best neighborhood
text: Love this hotel. This was our second stay at Hotel Santa Maria. The serene courtyard and the delicious breakfast are a welcome break from the crowds and pace of Rome. Will return again soon.

author: Amelia U
title: Best hotel in Rome
text: Location and atmosphere are unmatched! We walked everywhere. So is the service and delicious breakfast. We had the best spritz of our 2 weeks in Italy at the hotel bar! Everyone who works at Hotel Santa Maria is incredibly nice and helpful. The room was very comfortable for our family of 4 and the A/C was a lifesaver in the summer heat. I cannot recommend this place enough!!

author: Hugo X
title: Our rooms did not merit the almost perfect  reviews this hotel gets
text: Charming hotel. Great location. Rooms are dated and that is clear to see in pictures.     But dated and not clean are not the same. Our bathroom had specs of mold and shower head was green with lime indicating it was not clean. I  am sensitive to mold and found this challenging. My advice. Do a full check or room upon entering and speak up early. I did not discover this until after 10p and by then we were exhausted.   Rest of facilities are clean.  Good breakfast and coffee. Happy hour spritz is 15 e but it includes some cold treats pizza and sandwiches. People are very nice. Air conditioning in our room was cool not cold.   Rome is steaming this summer. Literally 40C today. Our early stay was at the smeraldo…much better experience and value.  This is budget choice in a nice area of Rome with benefit of larger family rooms.   Once you get a room so a full review to ensure you are happy.

author: Lucas N
title: Best option in Rome
text:
What an amazing experience!

Great location in Transtevere, close to the best restaurants and bars in the city.

The hotel is in a very beautiful and quiet place, with a wonderful garden to relax and enjoy moments in the family. The breakfast is excellent, and the happy hour offered daily was a differential that made our stay even more special.

The room was spacious, very comfortable, and the air conditioning worked perfectly, something essential during the summer.

The highlight, however, is the team. Everyone was extremely attentive and did everything to make us feel at home. They even helped us carry our bags and, when my wife went wrong during the trip, they promptly called a taxi and offered all the assistance we needed, demonstrating a care and kindness that we will never forget.

I would like to thank and congratulate the entire staff, especially the staff at the reception, such as Jacobi and Adriano, Kevin and all the bar staff, as well as the owner, who manages the hotel with great affection. Your hospitality made all the difference in our journey.

I could not recommend this hotel more than I recommend. If one day we return to Rome, we will surely stay here again.

Thank you for making our stay so special!

author: Molly O
title: Heaven in Rome!
text: This hotel is far and away our favorite place to stay in Europe - staff is incredible, rooms are quiet and comfortable, and location is perfection. Plus the vibe/atmosphere of the hotel is so sweet. We easily fit our family of 4 in one of the suites  and it was spotless! Most delicious breakfasts as well. We can't wait to go back!

author: Sydney A
title: Fabulous hotel in Trastevere
text: We loved this hotel. Went with my 2 teenage kids and stayed in a triple room. It had everything we needed and the air con was much appreciated in the Rome heat! Breakfast and happy hour were brilliant, plenty of choice and good quality. Location was perfect, the area comes alive in the evening, this hotel is like a calm oasis within vibrant area, which was perfect for us. We definitely plan to return.

author: Gavin R
title: Exceptional service
text: The hotel is in a perfect location and the customer staff is unbelievable and made us feel so welcome. We lost our luggage and Armando went above and beyond to assist us and was truly amazing. Would recommend this place to everyone

author: Paolo B
title: Great visit with family of 4
text:
We had a fantastic stay at Hotel Santa Maria in June 2026.  We traveled with our family of four, including two kids.  The hotel staff was kind, attentive and thoughtful.  The room was perfect for our family and everyone had their own space.  We would especially like to recognize Armando and the front desk staff who were  incredibly responsive and supportive from the moment we booked the trip.  They assisted us to get transportation, restaurant reservations, and more.  Additionally  Norman and the bar staff were awesome too! They were creative and thoughtful and made amazing drinks! 

The hotel was a clean sanctuary in the middle of a lovely neighborhood - best of both worlds.  We look forward to returning some day!

author: Jack W
title: Best in Rome - Hotel Santa Maria !
text: We enjoyed our stay ! Hotel Santa Maria -best Hotel in Rome -in our opinion ! Our 4th stay ! We will be back .

author: Olivia Z
title: Very nice hotel in a great location!
text: Kadesha and T'sai were excellent!  They were very helpful in accommodating our request for a higher room to avoid noise.  They were so professional and kind.  I wish all hotel staff were as dedicated to customer satisfaction.  The rooms were very clean, and the beds were incredibly comfortable.  The high end hair dryer and steamer were a nice touch. (The doorless shower was a little awkward, but we proactively put towels down to catch the splashing.) The windows are not soundproof, so you may want to bring a noise machine.  But there wasn't too much noise from Port Authority.  (the location is excellent if you are going to Broadway!) The $25 daily food credit was very nice, and the "to go" sandwiches were delicious!  The gym is spacious, and the equipment is in great condition.  And I didn't have a problem with the elevators, even though we were on the 31st floor.  The fee is reasonable, and I would come back here again.  Thank you!

author: Jack A
title: Worst experience of our life
text: This trip has been hell. There is a protest going on outside the hotel 24/7 and we were never warned, even though it was going on when we booked. We cannot sleep a wink. They have drums and are screaming. They have saucepans and are blowing whistles. I cannot believe we paid so much for this. They refused to put us at the back of the hotel when we asked.

author: Camille H
title: Great Bonvoy stay in NYC. Very good location. Very nice staff. Great little bar. Very convenient and well priced for NYC
text: Excellent locale and Value in Times Square

author: Evie I
title: Wonderful 3 night stay at the Delta Hotel
text: Spent three nights with my daughter at the Delta hotel. The price to quality ratio is excellent. The hotel is located by the neighborhood of Hell’s Kitchen on one side which offers many moderately priced ethnic restaurants. On the other side, just a short walk away from Times Square and broadway shows. Our room on the 26th floor was well equipped and quiet. The desk is large enough to do some work. I would definitely consider staying again at the Delta hotel.

author: Charlotte Q
title: Would Stay Again
text: This was my first time staying at a Delta hotel and i will definitely be back. Location location location, is everything while in Manhattan and this property was in the center of it all. Nicole and team were great even allowed an early check-in. The bathroom situation as a little strange with no shower door, but it worked. I visit NYC a lot and this was probably one of the larger of the rooms that i have been in. Overall, when looking for a place to stay within the Marriott family, I always hope this property is available.

author: Freya M
title: Not bad spot on a budget
text:
Location: super convenient location. There’s a lot of food, Times Square is an easy walk, as is most Broadway shows/disney/universal stores and javitz. 
There’s rooms are pretty small if you have more than 2 people. We had 3 people with total 6 suitcases and it was cramped. The room in general is small. The hotel lay out is weird and some of the room door open up literally to the elevators. Inside the biggest complaint was the showers. They were like prison style, no door, and it made it inconvenient if someone else wanted to use the restroom while someone was showering. 
Atmosphere was ok. When you walk in, the hotel stinks like a restaurant, mixed with the fancy hotel smell they put in the air systems and I feel like the stink part would stick to your clothes. There’s options to eat at the hotel and those looked nice. 
Overall, the value wasn’t bad. The hotel was super affordable and nicely located

author: Rosie Y
title: The VERYBEST
text: Delta is awesome, I am typing this after coming from the Greyhound Bus terminal Delta is on 40th and you take a right out of the Delta front doors down 40th then take a left at 8th the bus terminal is right there on the left. The room is perfect nice sofa, big bed, television, windows great view great shower. Complimentary package was give to me. The perfect spot for tourists in New York City. I’ve had a great experience so far I was brought in to attend and meet Snow Tha Product. She is amazing and the best performing act I witness. Gawd Bless All Latinas, Americans deserve a great HotSpot to stay at Delta Night life Club open till 4am check out of Delta at noon 12 pm I got 3 hours and 10 minutes left peace yall!!

author: Sara E
title: Stay somewhere else
text: I am a Bonvoy Elite member and stay in a LOT of hotels. This was among the worst. First, the elevators were being repaired, which means that two out of three of them were out of commission for most of my stay. And the one that was working randomly stopped on most floors even though there was no one waiting. I can't entirely fault them for this because elevators need to be repaired every once in a while. However, the bathroom was a horror show. The shower had no door and turning the water on meant that it sprayed everywhere. But worse: taking a shower at 7am there was no hot water -- it wasn't warm enough to actually shower. The towels were small, stiff and scratchy. Also, the doors to the room required some weird trick to keep the deadbolt from staying open, which they did not share with me when I got my keys, and when I called the front desk to find out what to do because my door wouldn't close, I got a busy signal five different times. However, calling the actual number in the Bonvoy app, I got through immediately. The beds were itchy and for some reason the top sheets were OVER the bedspreads.

author: Adam I
title: Hotel Staff Proactively Emailed and Returned Lost Phone
text: My stay at this hotel was excellent! Special shoutout to Kayla and Donavan who went above and beyond. I left my work phone and charger in my room and checked out none the wiser. They emailed me to let me know I left it and held it for two weeks until I was able to return to NYC and pick it up. Kayla recognized me from my previous stay (I was there for a conference and hundreds of us were at the hotel) and made sure my pick-up was smooth and seamless. Excellent customer service. I highly recommend this hotel for its excellent staff!

author: Matthew L
title: Very successful stay
text: Nice stay at this hotel: impeccable room, perfectly prepared and very fresh on arrival.

author: Isla S
title: A clean neat New York City hotel
text: Price-performance hotel in the city center .. close to the metro bus station .. with super clean rooms and common areas .. staff friendly.. Don't imagine an early check-in like in Turkey, we handed in the luggage and started sightseeing the city..it's a central hotel for those obsessed with noise and there's noise right around ..we're happy to stay at the same hotel if we arrive again

author: Laura Q
title: Delta
text:
Receptionists not very welcoming.
Clean room every night.
Room very poorly insulated both in terms of noise (you can hear the sirens, the shower of the neighbor) , but also the cold wind coming in through the windows.
Breakfast passable, on the other hand the person who welcomes you to ask you your room number was unpleasant , especially if you arrive at 9:15 , looking at his watch and looking up to the sky!
Pros its location.
I would not recommend this hotel

author: William T
title: Exactly what you need after a long day in NYC
text:
Great hotel in Manhattan with an excellent location. The beds are comfortable and the shower is hot — exactly what you need after a long day walking around NYC.

They kindly allowed me to check in a bit early and gave me an extra hour for check-out, which I really appreciated. I honestly have nothing negative to say about my stay.

author: Samuel I
title: Fantastic
text: I was here a whole week and it was lovely. Everyone who worked there was super nice (especially Paul!), the lobby is cute and welcoming. Subway and airport transport could NOT be closer, all kinds of (mostly fast) food around, Empana Mama was my fav, and there's a Pret around the corner. It's a little well worn around the edges, but clean and a tight ship. Amazingly comfortable bed with nice sheets, desk/work spot, fridge and coffee maker. The "pantry" in the basement is awesome - I had access because of my mom's Marriott points, I have no idea how it works otherwise. Brilliant idea, way better than a free breakfast buffet. I could go any time and get some snacks and drinks, lots of great breakfast options and fancy coffee/lattes. I don't understand or like the weird shower design, but oh well. Otherwise room design is nice and tasteful. There's many decent hotels on the street and it felt very safe.

author: Louis X
title: Nice hotel but issues with returning security deposit
text: The hotel was nice and in a good location. Just frustrating that we are still waiting for our security deposit to be returned  nearly 4 weeks later 😡 I was told it was being followed up but still nothing

author: Rosie O
title: Bad area next to Port Authority, dirty, disgusting, poop on the street.
text:
Hotel is ok , small but handles high volume of ppl. Rooms are basic.  Air conditioners are noisy and gives uneven temps (hot/cold), faucets gives out load noise and all drains got plugged.
The worst part is the street that is on, it’s next to some homeless shelter or food bank. We saw a grown man taking a poop on the middle of the street. The entire street is dirty and nasty, I would not recommend any hotels on that street.

author: Alice R
title: Approximation, disorganisation and unagreed costs and costs
text:
The hotel is very close to Times Square and strategic to the main tourist destinations.  Other than that, nothing positive... 
Poor desk and little organized. Faced with a difficulty with credit cards, the staff was unsympathetic. Absolute lack of empathy for a problem that we then solved, by phoning the bank. In general it is not clear what the command line is for a continuous turnover of very young and inexperienced staff at the desk: they received requests but solved only part of the problems.
The room was in line with what was stated and the furniture was in good condition. However, the bathroom was badly organized: an open shower with a flush base with water draining to the rest of the bathroom due to a design error, fixed overhead shower to the roof without shower inside the shower to compensate for the lack of bidet, lack of suction, lack of cap and other utilities present in hotels of equal standing.
The room was often untidy until late afternoon, with lack of towels due for 4 people. The sheets were changed only once in 11 days of stay after our insistent request.
To end the last day we found a charge of just under 100 euros not agreed in the contract for additional feeds whose nature is not understood. To be avoided.

author: Chloe I
title: All right.
text: Great location, very close to metro and Times Square. Around there are also places to eat cheap, fast food, pizzeria. There is a fountain for refilling water bottles in the hallway. Staff good, friendly. Many people in the hotel, but normal, it is a very large hotel. After making the bed they left the pajamas anywhere, one day above the lamps. Weird people in the area, high, homeless, but no problem, they're not a danger.

author: Camille F
title: Not a good hotel
text: Not a four star hotel and poor service. Check in at 3pm was not available and I had to wait to get a room. Room was not properly cleaned and never got towels that I request during my stay. Elevators didn't work properly and the housekeeping was nowhere to be found. Front desk gentleman receptionist was unprofessional and simply didn't want to help. For the amount of money a night cost here stay somewhere else.

author: Freya V
title: Great location
text: Location is the best . I took train from airport quick and easy. Staffs are really helpful. I had an issue with the deposit and they supported me in very nice way. Room is large enough. And everything is very close to the hotel.Time square is just few min away and with one direct train you can find yourself in WTC.

author: Taylor Z
title: A Confirmed Booking Meant Nothing
text: One month after my confirmed reservation, the property cancelled my booking, citing a “system error”. Meanwhile, the room was being offered again at a much higher price. This was extremely disappointing and demonstrated a lack of reliability. I definitely do not recommend this place.

author: Erin Q
title: Scam Alert: Do not book here. They will force you to pay for their broken rooms.
text:
Save your money and book somewhere else. This hostel uses predatory bait-and-switch tactics to squeeze extra cash out of exhausted travelers.
When I checked in, the AC and fan in my room were completely dead. The room was a sauna. I went to the desk, but instead of apologizing or moving me, the staff strung me along for two hours making up ridiculous excuses—like claiming a broken AC "takes 30 minutes to get going."
When they finally admitted the room was uninhabitable, they refused to move me to a working room unless I paid them an additional $30 "upgrade fee." It was past midnight, I was dead tired, and they essentially held a safe, cool room hostage until I handed over more money. I was forced to pay it just to get some sleep.
The kicker? The AC in the "upgraded" room was broken, too. I spent the entire night sweating in a sweltering room after being scammed into paying a premium for air conditioning they didn't even provide.
Management clearly does not care about guest comfort or fulfilling basic reservations; they only care about extracting hidden fees when you are too tired to fight back. Avoid this place at all costs unless you want to pay extra for the privilege of sleeping in an oven.

author: Daisy I
title: Great location and clean facilities, but beds might fall short of expectations
text:
Location is excellent, and the facilities are clean and well-maintained. There’s a kitchen area and a lounge space where you can work, which is a nice bonus. The staff were friendly and helpful—for example, they adjusted the air conditioning in the evening upon request.

The only downside is that the beds didn’t match what you could expect from the website and their advertising material. I was anticipating capsule-style beds that can be fully enclosed and dark, but in my room they were regular bunk beds with a small curtain covering only about one-third of the bed length. As other reviewers have mentioned, there's only a thin sheet + a polyester blanket.

author: Brooke A
title: Cozy bed, Bright Lights
text:
The location is great, with easy walking to theaters, Times Square and Central Park. I was in a quad room which was very clean, as was our bathroom.

5he one 5hing that brought down my rating is, the bright ceiling lights are on motion sensors.  Not only did the lights come on when a guest arrived late, or when someone got up to use the restroom-they came on every single time I moved in my lower bunk! Several times a night. A curtain covers half of each bunk' giving some privacy but not prote lion from bright lights. Sleep masks are available but I thought they were more a gimmick. Even using one the second night only helped a bit. I still woke each time the lights came on. Surely there is a reasonable fix for this.

Location, price (still not cheap) and cleanliness would bring me back again. I just will not expect a good night's sleep.

author: Emma F
title: Very convenient
text:
Handy if you have very little time in New York, I was there for an afternoon and evening and still wanted to take a shower somewhere and leave my luggage before I went into town.
You have a bed with light and sockets, and a locker. With a curtain it is separated from the hallway. The shower and toilet are in the hallway and in my case shared with another 'pod'.
The clean, quiet, fine shower, affordable and 5 minute walk to Central Park and 10 minute to Times Square.

author: Oliver O
title: If you want to make the most of the day in Manhattan this is a good option.
text: I stayed one night alone. A good location at a good price near Central Park. The shared room of 6 was complicated because one can check in at any time and many people arrive very late and enter the rooms disturbing those who are asleep. Added to the fact that the top beds of the bunk beds are welded at the tips, then if you put something on the side of your mattress, it will likely fall on the person below. If you need to leave your luggage for a while you can do so by tying it to chains that are on the stairs of different floors.

author: Leo S
title: Safe hostel with okayish beds
text:
I stayed four nights in a shared 6 dorm and one night in a deluxe pod. The first night I discovered that my blanket (100% polyester) was completely torn at the bottom. Fortunately I was able to get a new one the next day, but I still wondered how this could have happened. The temperature in the pod was far too warm, whereas on other nights I was completely freezing (you can get a second blanket but you have to pay).
The interior of the pods is sufficient and the black color makes it easy to fall asleep. I find it impractical that the lockers for storing the suitcases are also completely black. You can buy padlocks for them on site if you need one, they cost around five dollars. The “kitchen” includes a microwave and kettle. 
The Deluxe Pod was quite nice, I liked the starry sky, but I probably wouldn't pay the extra price again. 
Overall, my stay was okay, but I didn't really feel comfortable, mainly because of the plastic bedding. However, the price for this location is good and I felt safe.

author: Adam L
title: It was amazing. I think we'll use it again.
text:
Its favorable location near Times Square allows for smooth travel around New York's major tourist attractions. However, the low price will keep your accommodation costs down, so if you want to travel while saving money, it's an option first. The room was dark, but because it had curtains, I felt that privacy was also considered. I was able to use the toilet and shower without any problems.

I had to check in beforehand and had to deal with it via email, which was quite confusing. Last minute, your room number and pass will be displayed when you fly the link included in the email. The person I messaged and the person at the front desk were probably different, and I couldn't get through the offer to give me the room number and pass via the intercom, so after about two minutes of talking, I accessed the link above from the QR code at the front desk to get the room number and pass.

author: Benjamin R
title: High-tech hostels of the moment in the heart of Manhattan
text:
After booking your hotel,
Online check-in is required before staying.
We will also scan and send you a passport copy.
On the day of the event, you will be sent a PIN number for the entrance, which you can access and enter.
I double-checked my passport at the reception desk.
Entrance on the day, your domi will be given the room password, bet unit and locker number to enter.
It is very systematic and safe, although it is uneasy if you are not used to it.
It is inconvenient without a mobile phone that can be used locally.
If not, probably push the doorbell and tell them you've booked
When you enter, there is a person at the reception counter on the right hand side, so you can check in.

Domi unit is comfortable with a sense of private room.
There is both USB and power in the unit.
There is also a reading light, but it is much darker.
The bed has a fairly soft mat.

The blankets are light and warm with good indoor heating.
Large bath towels are also included.
I brought a towel and used the bath towel as a towelette.

Bathroom, toilet, kitchen and lounge are also clean,
Liquid soap soap shampoo is also provided.

Lockers are three times louder than company lockers (there were no hangers) and can hold a lot of stuff. Bring your key and you can lock it.

The lounge and kitchen are also clean.
Water heater, refrigerator, microwave oven and tableware are available.

The wifi will connect, but after setting at the reception desk on the 1st floor, I need to reconfigure again at the bed unit
It was tedious to have to enter different passwords over and over again for the entrance to the hostel, the room where my unit is located, and the wifi used in the unit. But it's kind of safe.

It's a little more expensive than other dominos in New York.
I'm glad there weren't many sensible people and strange people.
I'm not in the middle of Manhattan without a party peephoe.
I think you all went to bed pretty early.

author: Alice E
title: Very clean
text:
Great location
Good service 
Clean beds 
Clean sheets 
Very professional staff 
very good price
Comfortable beds 
Security 
Clean bathrooms 
Clean rest areas 
Laundry service 
24/7 receptionists
It has elevator 
Shops Nearby

author: Lucy T
title: Perfect Stay in the Heart of NYC!
text: Nap York Central Park offers a prime location near Central Park and Times Square, with clean, modern capsule-style rooms. It’s quiet, secure, and features friendly staff, lockers, free Wi-Fi, and charging stations, making it ideal for budget travelers.

author: Matthew G
text: Nap York Central Park is a hidden gem for relaxation in NYC! Highly recommended for anyone looking for a peaceful and affordable hostel pods! The staff was friendly and accommodating, making sure everything was set up perfectly.🫶🫶🫶🫶

author: George K
title: Amazing NYC stay!
text:
I recently visited NY for the first time as a solo female traveler and Nap York exceeded my expectations!! 
First thing I noticed is how easy the check in was. I did the online registration about 3 days before arriving and when I arrived I just called and had my pod in less than 5 minutes. 
The experience overall was amazing! The staff is friendly and professional, the facilities are clean an comfortable and the location is just perfect. 
Definitely going back!

author: Michael O
title: Solo travel to NYC
text:
THE BEST PLACE FOR SOLO TRAVELLERS. BOOK WITH EYES CLOSED

They got you covered, and have everything you need for a relaxing stay. I was shock to find out that their price is not even the best part about this hostel, I would go to Nap York even if its priced higher next time in NYC

author: Erin K
title: Loved my stay!
text: The best hostel in New York City! Everything is well-kept, with really sweet staff members and a heart-warming stay. It's great for solo female travellers. They've got lockers, so I know my stuff is protected and I have a place to keep my overnight food. Thanks for the great accommodation!

author: Henry Y
title: Great first NY experience!!!
text:
Awesome place for solo travelers or groups too. Clean, quiet and with friendly staff.
Beds are comfortable and the rooms were perfectly organized. Location is one of the best, just around 5 min from Central Park and many public transportation around. And together with all that: afordable price for NY.

author: Aaron J
title: Great Location and Privacy
text: I stayed at Nap York during a short holiday in NYC, and it was exactly what I needed. The hostel is modern and offers great privacy with bunk beds that have curtains, making it feel like your own space. It’s a safe and quiet place, with a dedicated floor for women, which made me feel comfortable as a solo traveler. The location is central and easy to access major attractions. Highly recommend for a secure and peaceful stay!

author: Ethan Y
title: They don't give back the damage deposit as they were supposed to.
text: They charged me U$ 50,00 as a damage deposit, that would be canceled after the check out, if there wasn't any damage. Although there wasn't any damage, they didn't give me back the damage deposit. I have already complained about it, but they haven't solved my problem.

author: Grace V
title: Attention so bad it ruins EVERYTHING
text:
The location is excellent and the facilities are pretty good.
Unfortunately not even the most expensive Business pods have sheets. It only has a bedcover and a very small blanket. Sheets charge you aside, pretty ridiculous considering you pay for a more expensive bed.
The worst thing the hotel did and the truth should be ashamed of is that I booked this hotel 9 months ago for 16 nights. After a few weeks I wanted to add an extra night as the airline changed my flight for the other day. I contacted them (I have their emails saved) and they confirmed several times that there was no problem adding one more night. In fact I booked that extra night through her 3 month old website before traveling.
Two days before my arrival at the hotel I was cancelled the extra night due to their policies. They had more than 3 months to cancel me so I would have had time to find other accommodation. They didn’t and waited until the last second to cancel my Reservation and literally leave me on the street my last night in New York. Upon arrival I spoke to several receptionists about this and none of them cared. I really should be ashamed of doing this to a guest. I repeat, I have your e-mails reassuring me that there was no problem. They already knew more than 3 months ago that I needed to stay one more night and they cancelled 2 days before I arrived. Lousy service from ALL hotel staff and above all business rooms have NOTHING better than normal. There's not even a shelf inside the pod to support things. I hope that at some point they will reflect on what they did to me and not do it again to another Traveler because one comes for pleasure and is PAYING. It's a shame what they did.

author: Lucas E
title: Loved it!
text: Check-in was seamless, and the staff were friendly and helpful, providing all the information I needed about the facilities. The shared bathrooms were clean and well-maintained, which was a pleasant surprise for a budget accommodation. I appreciated the privacy curtains around each capsule, allowing for a sense of seclusion despite the shared environment.!

author: Miguel W
title: A solid choice - a very good value for a new, clean and comfortable room in a convenient location
text: Stayed in a city view, two queens room for two nights. New, clean, and a pretty decent size, for a NYC hotel room. The beds were comfortable, and the A/C ran quietly (NOT the kind which continuously cycles on and off). We stayed on the 13th floor, and the street noise wasn't too bad. We could have used more hooks in the bathroom though (I think there was only one), so there weren't enough places to hang all our towels in the bathroom. Took off one star off because the room was not ready by the 4:00pm check-in time, and the elevators were a bit slow (one of the three elevators was out of service). Front desk was friendly, but they could have been more helpful in explaining how the elevators worked and mentioning that there was coffee available in the mornings and a water machine in the food area. A good value and in a convenient location, near major subway lines and a 10-minute walk from Moynihan Train Hall.

author: Juan D
title: Hotel right in the city center
text: Nice hotel, the view from the room is magnificent, very clean. Pleasant staff. Very disappointing breakfast. We had to buy food for the morning. Little choice. Needs more effort! No parking.

author: Gavin R
title: Very good location and good bedding
text: Great location to visit New York. Quiet street in the center of New York. Located in the flower district. Metro line 1 around the corner 3 minutes walk. The bedding is good. Shower room correct, a little small. On the other hand no storage in the bedroom or in the shower room. It was quite embarrassing to have to open the suitcases every day, especially when you stay 1 week. But otherwise we really enjoyed the situation and the bedding.

author: Lily V
title: Couple of Kiwis in NYC
text:
Whole stay was excellent 
Shout out to the amazing Tara!  at the hotel bar 
arriving back after a long day sightseeing was nice to see a friendly face and have a chat and of course help with fantastic drinks choices 
She knows her stuff!

author: Laura T
title: The flower district is a great option
text:
Out of the Marriott tiers, Aloft is a more basic option; however, the Chelsea location is pretty decent. 

Pros include location and nice folks at the front desk. 

Negatives include the cost and the low quality furnishings. 

Still, not bad.

author: Lucas G
title: Solid Hotel for Price
text: The Aloft in Chelsea is a solid, updated hotel for the price. It has a contemporary feel and rooms have style that reflects the brand. The bed is comfortable and bathroom is clean. Shower towels are paper thin and small. Free coffee in the lobby is well-appreciated but had no taste (I know, beggars can’t be choosers). Most importantly, staff is friendly and attentive. We would book again.

author: Rosie W
title: Perfect
text: I've just spent 14 nights at Aloft Chelsea and want to say how wonderful the staff were - especially Genesis Tetteh. Everyone was so warm and friendly, even the housekeeping staff. The place itself is pristine and modern, with the comfiest beds in Manhattan. Highly recommend!

author: Laura H
title: Awesome time
text: We had a great 5 days in New York.  Saw all kinds of Amazing places.  Had an amazing bartender Tara!! She was so great to all of us. Thank You, Tara

author: Nora X
title: Great experience.
text: Perfect location! Room was a little small but expected in NYC.  Nice and clean!  The GEM of this hotel is their bartender, Tara Ivers!  We were there a week and looked forward to winding down our day with her.  She was so friendly and kind.  She was knowledgeable and always took time to answer questions and offer suggestions.  In addition, she makes a very nice espresso martini! 😃  if you stay at Aloft be sure to stop by the bar and see Tara.  Can’t wait to go back!

author: Evan Z
title: Go see Tara!
text: Tara at WXYZ is the best! She made our whole stay here so much fun and is an asset to your team! The rooms were spacious and clean. No complaints! Great location

author: Alice L
title: Tight but nice
text:
This was my first stay at this property and while there were a few things that annoyed me, I still think it was a good value.

First the good. The location can't be beat and there is easy access to many subway stations. Five blocks north is the Herald Square station which is the connecting point for over a half dozen lines. One black to the east is the R & W "Broadway Local" line, one block to the west is the IRT 1 "7th Avenue Local" and five blocks to the south is the 23rd St station for the F "6th Avenue Local".

The room I was assigned was on the 30th floor looking north and the view was spectacular. Yes the room was rather small, but at this price point, most are in Manhattan.  Since there are only 8 rooms to a floor, space is at a premium. I found the room to be very clean and I liked that it had non-carpeted floors. The shower was great, with lots of pressure and hot water. 

The not so good... As is the trend these days with hotels, the bathroom has a sliding door which does not seal all the way. The result is, well, use your imagination. Turning the TV volume up helps somewhat, but when someone has to go in the still of the night, everyone will hear it. I don't know why this is such a big design trend these days and I've railed against it in other postings. If the hotel management is reading this, part of the problem can be alleviated by cutting out a one inch notch from the lower molding so that the door closes flush with the wall. Another beef of mine was the Bluetooth "Marhall" speaker bolted onto the nightstand. With space at such a premium, it takes up 3/4 of the table. This means little to no space for chargers or even a glass of water. I doubt very much that guests even use it.

I found the staff to be top notch and would not hesitate staying there again.

author: Nathan H
title: Tara is a star at the bar.
text: Tara at the bar is awesome! Will come again because of her.  She was serving, cooking, talking, she’s a star!  Ps rooms are great.

author: Luke Y
title: Great hotel! Best bartender!
text: Great stay! Clean, comfortable and nice people. Highlight for our group was Tara, the bartender. Great convos and the best recommendations. She made our stay perfect!

author: Miguel P
title: friends in nyc
text: great location, but the bartender TARA was incredible! she was super friendly, made the best drinks and all around wonderful person!!

author: Gavin I
title: Hotel is just ok
text: The hotel was just OK.  We had a room on the 19 floor. View was great but the price wasn’t really worth it. Nothing really outstanding about the hotel other than it’s in the flower district so every morning the streets are beautiful with flowers, trees etc for sale.  Close to the subway.  One thing that really bothered my was the shelf in the bathroom. Super inconvenient as a left handed person in was in the way of moving my arm, in the way of the mirror.  Someone needs to pay attention to functionality

author: William R
title: GOOD STAY!
text:
Stayed here for 2 nights for business.
It is a well-managed property and I had no real complaints.

Pros:
Excellent location – in the Chelsea neighborhood and within walking distance to FlatIron, Koreatown, and Empire State Building.  Very good restaurants nearby, grocery store (Fairway Market and Whole Foods) within walking distance.  McDonalds right around the corner.  Pretty much everything you need.
Clean room and cleaning staff did a great job making up the room
Fast elevators
Excellent view – could see Freedom Tower from my room on the 29th floor
Fast and reliable WIFI
Free hot coffee served in mornings at lobby bar
Lobby bar has free drink events throughout the week.  They also sell hot breakfast food items, along with snacks and drinks.

Cons:
Room is a bit small but was OK for a solo traveler.  I would not recommend for families.
The walls are thin and you can hear people in the hallway and doors closing.  However, management does a good job enforcing quiet hours.   I had a family next door with a toddler screaming and texted management and they took care of it quickly.

Tip:  If you want to save money, take the NJ Transit train from EWR airport to the hotel.
Take to New York Penn Station, look at signs exiting to 7th Ave./31st St.  Walk south on 7th Ave. and turn left on W. 28th St.  
Total time was about 40 minutes (including 10 minutes walking outside Penn Station) and cost $17.

author: Ian R
text:
It was loud with street noise. Starting  1:14 Am.. Garbage trucks running and lifting a few dumpsters or two on the street my room was facing. 
This went on for a bit. 
The thermostat would not start cooling or felt like it didn't for quite some time. 
We would throw the duvet off then you MIGHT feel a little cool it would suddenly get warm and your throwing the duvet back off. 
I don't know if it was humidity like some have mentioned here in reviews. I know we barely slept. As far as all the noise from the street we were on the second floor so maybe that has something to do with it, and noise can bounce off buildings..?? 
I just know I didn't sleep and today I feel exhausted. 
We were at a hotel in Times Square for several days earlier in the week and somehow it was much quieter. I wanted to return and stay there but unfortunately it's too late and we're heading to the airport now. 
We loved this area but our stay was anything BUT relaxing.

author: Daisy Q
title: Good hotel and super comfy.

author: Alice T
title: Clean, spacious rooms with great views
text: We loved this hotel! I travel to NYC with my teen/tween kids several times a year, and we usually stay in this neighborhood because of its convenience and proximity to Penn Station. We have stayed at the Eventi (too expensive), Hilton Garden Inn across the street (run down, dark, and dingy), and a few others, but this was our first time trying Aloft. Our room was exceptional — big and spacious, with tons of light and floor to ceiling windows. Beds, bedding, and pillows were excellent (and I am very picky!). Everything was super clean. Elevators were fast and front desk staff pleasant. Stephanie Martinez was immediately helpful when I reached out with a room request in advance. The Aloft will absolutely be our go-to Chelsea hotel from now on. Thanks for the great stay!

author: Marco S
title: They lie. Avoid

author: Holly I
title: Book a better neighbourhood.
text:
The hotel is located at the start of Pigalle, the Red Light district.   What attracted me initially was the decor, each room decorated in the style of a famous artist.   We stayed in room 304, the Augustine Renoir room.   Small, ideal for one or two nights, no more.   Air Con was out of action for the previous 2 months which in August heat was terrible.   Lots of homeless and immigrants hanging out at the little fountain outside a noisy at night.  Not recommended for solo travellers as seen someone robbed as drunk by a guy going over offering to help him.   Paris in general is expensive.  Lots of good places have queues outside at all times of the day.   Moulin Rouge 5 minutes walk away.

Best little cocktail bar nearby is an unassuming place called ‘Dirty Dick’, not a gay bar! But with the cheap cocktails starting at €17 a pop, we had 2 each and left.  Bring a good pair of walking shoes, the subway system can be tricky to navigate and unless you know the zone your travelling, your better off getting a day pass.

Flat rate to the airport is meant to be €56.  Hotel advertises it at €63, driver charged us €72.

Took 30 minutes and not up to 3 hours as advertised on some reviews.   Safe too than the RER B train at €14 per person one way and we saw someone robbed on the train out from the airport.

author: Sophia H
title: Hotel with original decor.
text: Very good location right next to the Pigalle metro station, with many attractions and restaurants nearby. The staff is pleasant, available, and ensures that the stay goes as smoothly as possible. The room was clean and quiet (street side) with a small balcony that included a table and two chairs. The decor (just like the rest of the hotel) is unusual. A fridge was present in the room, and two bottles of water were provided as a courtesy. Excellent water pressure in the bathroom. Complete breakfast in the hotel's basement with very cheerful staff in the morning. A few downsides: not many electrical outlets in the room, a larger partition in the bathtub would be helpful to avoid flooding the bathroom when showering, the air conditioning, which works well, is apparently turned off at night (not great given the current temperatures), the elevator is a bit slow, and the breakfast room is rather small and narrow (maximum of about twelve seats). Despite these few points, a very good establishment in Paris that I recommend.

author: Harper U
title: Great experience
text: My Granddaughter and I have just returned from this hotel and we loved everything about it. The Moulin Rouge theme is tastefully done. Room was an ok size and everything worked and was spotless. Bathroom was good size and good hot shower. Staff were exceptionally helpful. Breakfast was good value and tasty. We will certainly return when it's not so hot!

author: Isla I
title: A pleasant Parisian interlude.
text: A very nice hotel, just like its staff. The rooms are pretty and clean. I recommend it 100%.

author: Camille C
title: A TOTAL DISASTER
text: The first room received wasn't cleaned at all. I had to wait in the heat while the receptionist finishes shouting at his colleague on phone. The second room I received was a downgraded version. I decided not to complain about this because I was too tired and it would have been alright as long as I could rest in the air-conditioned room. However, the ac was not working. The receptionist said that it was broken in all rooms and he could not provide a fan either. He told me to leave the windows open instead. The noise level from outside was too high, with all the drunken people and sirens. I could not rest at all. I can't believe that this hotel actually has stars.

title: I recommend it.

The staff is always kind and helpful, and the breakfast is good. You can comfortably walk to the Montmartre district, just a few steps from the Moulin Rouge; it is a very beautiful and central neighborhood for visiting Paris.

author: Diego A
title: Horrible, insecure staff.
text:
My stay at this hotel was unfortunately marked by a very unpleasant experience with the night watchman. When I arrived late, he was particularly aggressive, both in tone and attitude. Instead of welcoming guests with professionalism and courtesy, I was treated to inappropriate remarks and behavior bordering on harassment, which is totally unacceptable in an establishment that is supposed to guarantee security and serenity. I pay to be safe in my room and not for the staff to come home while I sleep, I will not let them go through this kind of incident. 

This incident profoundly affected my stay and left me feeling uncomfortable. It is essential that management take this type of behaviour very seriously and ensure that their staff take a respectful attitude towards clients at all times. The hotel was charming but the stay was ruined by disrespectful behavior. I specify that the day staff was perfect with me as was the breakfast staff. 

Unfortunately I do not recommend this hotel as it is, until measures are taken to prevent this kind of situation from happening again. I'm not the type to leave comments but this one will be useful for women who hesitate to book. An e-mail will be sent to management regarding this man's abhorrent behavior.

author: David R
title: This is a ⭐️⭐️ hotel not 4!
text:
Do not be fooled by the four star rating. They don’t deserve more than two. Let me explain.

We had a regular room overlooking the nightclub around the corner. It was decent. The canopy makes the room and that’s it. It is very small. And a series of details were disappointing. Landline to reception not working. Bathtub stopper not working so you cannot keep your tub full. The thermostat not working so you need to beg for a heater to warm up the room.  

And then came the power outages. Two of them over two days.  Not in the neighborhood, just in the hotel. Long hours in the dark. No Wi-Fi. 

But the worst is that they did not even try to make up for it. Any normal Hotel would have offered some form of compensation simply to say sorry. But no. After all, they are French and royal.  Why apologize? 

If you are looking for a hotel with a theme, red velvet and charm, you will find much better in the neighborhood, just a few blocks away.

author: Benjamin M
title: Peugeot do a better 205
text:
I was very close to giving this 4 stars, but had a night to sleep on it and consider my thoughts. With that in mind... lovely welcome, we were given a key to our second floor room (205) and off we went. First impressions were of a very nice room. Brilliant views and great balcony, comfy bed. Then we noticed that the bathroom/toilet didn't have a door. Okay, we've been married for 10 years, no biggie. Then I noticed the burn mark on the floor, again, it happens. Wouldn't really expect them to rip up the whole carpet for it. 

After a very long day, I went for a shower, it's handheld which at first is a pain, but it saves water so again, no biggie. My wife wanted to use the spa bath. It didn't work, that was annoying as it was one of the reasons we booked a better room. 

On the morning of our last full day, we noticed a leak coming from the ceiling above the bath and mentioned it on the way out. It would be looked at we were told. 

We had a late night that day (dinner cruise on the river, lovely stuff) and returned to what was an even worse leak. So off I went downstairs and reported this. The extremely kind chap moved us to another room (this one had a bathroom door and a fully functioning spa bath that we didn't use as it was gone midnight). If we had had this room from the off, this would have been a 5 star review. 

The location is brilliant, it's a lively area so you expect some noise but the windows are good at keeping the worst out, I really enjoyed the hustle and bustle.

So there we are. Avoid 205 and I am sure it will be great.

author: Hugo G
title: Fine, but not luxury, though good location
text:
OK Hotel, certainly 3 stars at best. Room was clean, but shower was a shower head over a (not working) jacuzzi. Air-con was OK, but it wasn’t particularly hot, so I don’t know how effective this would be in mid-30s heat. Door handle came off in my hand. Still worked and I’m sure they’ll fix it, but feels all a bit tired. 

Also, bear in mind that the breakfast is a tray service you to the room. Average at best. A lukewarm machine cappuccino, and the bear minimum of actual continental breakfast spread. 

Area is fine. Loads of restaurants and bars (and sex shops/bars if that’s what you’re after…). We were there when PSG won the Champions League, so generally noisy, but I’m sure that’s not normal. Only a short walk from Sacre Coeur and the funicular to the top. Metro is right outside so good connection to Arc de Triomphe, Louvre etc. we went on from Gare du Lyon, which was 20 mins on the Metro. Same route on to the airport, so easy to get around.

title: A tired hotel  that needs updating.

author: Zachary P
title: Positive experience in general, but attendance at check-in was frustrating!
text:
The stay at the hotel, overall, was very positive. The hotel has a modern structure, good location (about 5 minutes walk from the subway station), plus nearby market and fast food options.

The room is comfortable and the bed excellent, but a little small. We also lack a chair or support bench. Another point that caused us some discomfort was the configuration of the bathroom: the box glass is turned to the room and even being dim, it ends up reducing the privacy of those who are using the shower.

We really liked the daily voucher system offered by the hotel, which can be used in the coffee shop, grocery store and bar, a very interesting differential. The service of the maids was also great during the whole stay.

As a negative point, on the last day we noticed a strong smell of smoke coming from some room or nearby environment, which ended up being unpleasant.

Unfortunately, the biggest problem of the experience was the early check-in service. We had contacted the hotel in advance to check out early check-in for an additional fee, and we were informed that it would be possible if available. As we already knew we would arrive very early, we requested in advance, if possible, the reservation of a room available.

After a trip of more than 30 hours, I arrived at the hotel around 4:30 a.m. and was informed unheartedly that check-in could only take place at 7:00 a.m. I remained waiting at the reception and, even returning close to the time only to confirm if everything was okay with the documentation, the service continued to be rigid and unacceptable.

The most frustrating was to discover later, with other extremely kind and helpful staff, that there was already room available from about 5am and that the check-in could have been done earlier. Given the wear and tear of the trip and the fact that an additional fee would be charged for early check-in, the situation was quite disappointing.

Despite this episode, the overall hotel experience was good!

author: Jack P
title: Unexpected $500 Damage Charge After Checkout
text:
We checked out of the Radio Hotel (2420 Amsterdam Ave, New York, NY) on 4/30/2026 at approximately 10:00 AM. At the time of checkout, everything appeared normal. We were told there were no issues, our stay concluded without incident, and our deposit was returned. The room was left in the same condition it was received in, with no damage and no concerns raised by staff during checkout or inspection.

Several hours later, at approximately 4:00 PM, we noticed multiple attempted charges to our credit card for $500. When we contacted the hotel regarding these charges, we were informed that they were allegedly related to damage to a television in the room, specifically that a hole had been “punched” into the TV. This was the first time we had ever been made aware of such an allegation.

We strongly dispute this claim, as no damage of any kind was caused to the television or any other property during our stay. At no point during checkout were we informed of any damage, shown any evidence, or given the opportunity to address any issue before leaving the property. The timing of the charges—hours after checkout combined with the lack of any prior notice or inspection discussion—was extremely concerning.

Based on our experience, we are sharing this information so that future guests are aware and can document their room condition carefully at both check-in and check-out. We recommend taking photos and ensuring all interactions during checkout are clearly recorded.

author: Lauren K
title: Great neighborhood, but the hotel is lacking. Stay elsewhere unless this is your most practical option.
text:
I wouldn’t stay here again unless I absolutely needed to. I was staying here because it was the best option for taking the bar exam nearby. Washington Heights is a great neighborhood. Wonderful food, people, and culture. However, unless you’re going to be in the heights your entire trip, stay someone else that’s nicer for the money and visit Washington Heights instead. The neighborhood is spectacular, the hotel is a short walk from the awesomely brutalist GWB Market, the hotel leaves a lot to be desired. 

When I first checked in, the window in my room did not close and latch properly. Because of this, there was a draft and lots of noise. A repairman was sent up to investigate, but he unfortunately did not do anything to resolve the issue. When I raised the issue to the front desk again, it took multiple attempts at explanation for the front desk to understand that the window was open and could not be closed and locked (the person thought I wanted it opened). She kept saying she could not guarantee a similar class of room where the window would open. This was in February just after a blizzard, so I’m not sure why she thought I would want this. I kept trying to explain the issue was that I wanted a room with a window that would stay shut. 

Finally, once the front desk understood my issue, I was able to switch rooms. That room, however, had hair on some of the towels and stains on several of the walls, blinds, and hard surfaces. All things that were easy to see and could’ve been cleaned up if housekeeping just took a little extra time in each room. 

Ultimately, the rooms look much better in the photos than in real life, as is typical for “recently renovated” boutique hotels in high-traffic locations like NYC, and it’s a shame that management/ownership don’t maintain the property like they should.

author: Juan C
title: The right place for us
text: We love to travel and have stayed at a wide variety of places — B&Bs, airport hotels, quaint rooms in ancient buildings with creaky staircases. We were absolutely delighted with Le Jardins during our recent two weeks in Paris. We wanted a nice, quiet, and impeccably clean hotel conveniently located to transportation and dining. What we got was a nicely appointed (and air conditioned) room with a balcony overlooking a lush garden atrium and a super comfy bed. We could even glimpse the Eiffel Tower if we leaned out over the railing. One of the distinguishing assets of the facility is its attentive and guest focused staff. They are eager and willing to cheerfully accommodate your needs. We also loved the convenience. It's a block and a half from a Metro station giving you fast access to the whole city. Located on a serene and narrow one way street, it's only two blocks away is the busy Rue Cler market with its wide variety of restaurants, grocery stores, and other vendors. A five minute walk takes you to the Seine and another few minutes finds you strolling the Champs Élyssée. We like to travel light and do laundry as we need to. We took full advantage of the laundromat directly across the street. If you're looking for hustle and bustle and the vibrant sounds of nightlife, this isn't the place for you. If you're looking for a gentle refuge from the bright lights of the city, this is the place to be.

text:

My room was pleasant, clean, quiet, and looked out and down onto the plant-filled veranda where one could choose to sit and enjoy the sun or have coffee or eat the yummy buffet breakfast. 
The staff members were all friendly and helpful, never impatient with my speaking English instead of French.  The location was an easy walk to the Eiffel Tower yet far enough away to not be bothered by noisy tourist crowds. If I come back to Paris I will definitely stay there again!  Loved it!
