title: Fairy-tale hotel
text:
This is the fifth time I have returned here and every time it feels like being at home, I want to thank THIN in particular for her kindness, helpfulness, and cheerfulness. Thanks also to KRISTINA. 
The location for me is excellent, in one of the most beautiful areas of London. The private garden is a great little spot to have breakfast or to rest and relax for a moment. We will return here as always for our future trips to London. THANK YOU

author: Dylan J
title: Simple and functional, well located
text: Simple and very functional room with all the necessary comfort for a stay of a few days. Comfortable bedding. Clean. Very quiet. Perfect location 10 minutes from Liverpool Street Station, for those arriving by plane from Stansted Airport. And good value for money.

author: Taylor D
title: Lovely Hotel
text:
Great little find. Super clean. Great value for money. 
Great service and will definitely stay in this hotel chain again.

author: Nora X
title: Nah, not worth it.
text:
Pros:
Great location right next to Liverpool Street. Easy check in and check out. 
Staff nice and polite. 

Cons:
Rooms are small. I was on my own but we would have struggled if there had been two of us. Maybe about foot on the right and at the end of the bed. Shower room small.  
Lights - I’m pretty good with technology but I struggled to get the main light off. Without turning the whole room off.  It’s a touch pad where nothing seems clear and you’re there asking yourself why won’t it turn off? Am I pressing too hard, too soft, or in the wrong way?!
Not ideal at the end of a day or night, and I was sober. 
Air con - room had air con and I appeared to have got it working despite the touch pad, but it wouldn’t cool the room, only the fan came on. Not great. 

Overall maybe you’ll have a good experience here but I’m not sure I’ll go back even if I need a crash pad for the night. The price would have to be ridiculously cheap to make me book again.

author: Brooke U
title: Compact It Is!
text:
The compact rooms are really, really compact! These rooms would be ok for one person but it is tricky to move around if you have 2 people in them.

Away from that, nice hotel in a good location, clean and modern. I should have picked a larger room.

author: Joseph W
title: Best budget hotel I’ve ever stayed at
text:
This single handedly was the best budget hotel I have ever stayed in. Incredibly modern with touchscreen lighting even mood lighting. 
Air con was excellent as it was 35 degrees outside, a large lovely garden space to sit in. Decent continental breakfast and very helpful, pleasant staff, 
Bed was excellent and I just thought the interior was minimal but great. Travelodge down the road was more money and you are not getting this quality.
Small niggle is no coffee or tea making facilities but otherwise a perfect stay with a very comfortable bed.

author: Taylor Q
title: Functional but basic
text:
Great location right in the heart of it all. If you simply want a bed for the night and a pretty basic room then this will suit you perfectly. 

No wardrobe or desk to speak of, it just felt a bit clunky - with 2 plug sockets in awkward positions and limited space.

There is some funky mood lighting, the shower was ok but not particularly adjustable. Bed was comfy so no complaints with that.

Continental breakfast and coffee in the morning was ok - selection of pastries ham cheese and yoghurts - if you are looking for a full english this is not your place.

Defo not for the family market this would be a crash pad for the business traveller or someone passing through. 

For my one night business trip yeah - but I doubt I’ll be coming back.

author: Samuel X
title: Super Hotel !
text: This was a lovely hotel with very helpful and kind staff . Rooms were lovely . An unreal location and will definitely be staying here again !!

author: Leo Z
title: Travel to London
text:
A really pleasant stay!
But a special thanks goes to the girls in the hall THTN,KEERTHNA and IRENE kind, smiling, helpful and always ready to help with professionalism and courtesy. They made the experience even more beautiful making us feel welcomed from the first moment. Congratulations for the service and attention to guests!

author: Thomas X
title: Very happy with my stay
text: Clean, quiet, great location, and friendly staff. I didn't have time for breakfast but it looked like it was generous. I will definitely stay again.

author: Harper P
title: Excellent stay
text: Hotel in a great location for getting around town. Close to metro station and many bus stops. Quiet area. I stayed three nights, room small but basic and above all clean. Great breakfast and varied. Friendly staff who did everything to help us since we speak very little English, to recommend to those who come to London for tourism.

author: Amelia X
title: NOT A 3 STAR HOTEL!
text:
NOT A 3 STAR HOTEL! This hotel is being sold as something it is not. For a 3S hotel, tea making facilities should be in each room - or available in the common area in reception. Not only no kettle [do i really have to buy a travel kettle for London?] but to try and charge £2.50 for a cup in your own hotel is a rip off. It's £2.40 round the corner in Sainsbury's.

So no welcome cup of tea for this disabled traveller when I arrived. Then came the room. Disappointment is an understatement. The pics on this site are for the disabled room. That's why it looks so spacious. Next time I'll book that as I almost had a fall in the bathroom as the shower is too small. Actually, there won't be a next time.

The rooms are tiny. I mean really, sell this as a pod hotel. As you can see from the photo, the shelves fold down from the wall. Think about that - 'fold down from the wall'. Never seen anything like it in my life and I'm an experienced hotel traveller.

Then there's the hanging space i.e. your room decorations. Don't try and put any more than two things on the buttons as they just fall off. Why the hotel gives dozens of hangers is a mystery to me. Mine ended up on the floor.

These are single person pods only. Two of you will be heading for couple's counselling after one night in this room. Bathroom is tiny. Two towels and a bathmat only.

For location - great. If this is your first time to London and you don't care where you lay your head, maybe this will work for you. Personally, even then I'd feel a sinking feeling every time I had to go back to it. Confinement is a better term for your stay.

Breakfast usually makes up for it but it is 'continental' i.e. an ok croissant, spam ham and hard cheese.

Final word. No.

author: Sydney H
title: Annual Point A stay
text: This is a great hotel that is staffed by even greater people. My fourth visit and hopefully back next year.

author: Chloe Z
title: Ok but could be better
text:
Negatives:
The rooms light and climate controls are all digital and touch enabled without any physical buttons. I hope the accessible rooms have physical buttons at least.
The fact that the hotel charges it's guests to keep luggage and for early check-in is poor form in my opinion.
The fact the rooms only get serviced every 3 days is also poor form. While the room might not need to be cleaned and towels changed every day, it could at least be tidied up and bed made.
No even a bottle of water is provided in the room.
This room's layout had the bed blocking the whole back side of the room, where the mirror and the furniture is, making it unusable.
The lock in my room also wasn't working. Unsafe and not appropriate.
Check-in is only at 3PM.
Unfortunately there was no decaf or alternative milk in the coffee machine. First world problems, I know but they were problems for me none the less.

Positives:
The breakfast menu had vegan pastries (honestly don't see that very often anywhere). The location is central. The staff were friendly. The rooms were clean and the air conditioning worked well. The beds were comfortable.

author: Rosie X
title: Bag storage fee? No thanks
text: Very small room without any kind of storage space at all. Fine for one night but I couldn't imagine staying there for longer. The "garden view" room actually had no view, as the window was frosted and did not open. Good beds but overall all very tight and not much privacy, as the bathroom had a glass door  - a very silly idea in my opinion. There were works and very loud drilling noises in the hotel from 8am, and the garden (advertised as "always open") was actually closed. Finally, on top of the already overpriced €150 for the night, we still had to pay for luggage storage, a practice I haven't seen anywhere else. Sorry Point A, but we will not be staying again.

author: Oliver U
title: Point A(recommended)
text:
My 8-year-old son and I stayed here last weekend with the main goal of visiting a football match. Location is top, few minutes walk to various stations, nice covered marketplace nearby. We had a double room and it was quite small, but fine for the two of us, we have not been there that much. Rest of the room was clean and quite luxurious.
Breakfast was also just fine, sandwiches, croissants, cottage cheese, youghurt, lots of fruit etc etc.
We had landed very early, so went straight to the hotel to drop off our bags. We were told by the receptionist Irene / Ireen that we could check in at 3 pm. We then went into London, but because my phone was empty at the beginning of the afternoon, we had to go back to the hotel. Irene/Ireen then checked if the room was free and so we could enter our room earlier. Furthermore, we were really very kindly helped by her, but also her colleagues were always ready when we had questions.
My son wants to go back next year, or to the same hotel (and with his mother and sister there) and another room, otherwise it's too tight he thinks;-)
Point A is definitely a good, nice hotel, with a good location.

author: Lea T
title: Nice, clean and recommended!
text: Very nice, clean, modern hotel. Friendly & helpful staff. Subway 9 min walk. Room small but normal in London but you have everything you need. Very nice chill lounge. Good breakfast buffet, good selection. Perfect for short London trip!

author: Ruby O
title: One night stay
text: Booked this because it was closer to Liverpool st station .. Tried to check in early but I was told it would be £15 left our bags there at a cost of £3, the room was very clean beds comfortable.. great location . Quiet aswell . No where to hang your clothes but good value for a night in London..

author: Evan P
title: Interisting modern hotel in good location
text: Good location and rooms, great breakfast. Rooms are well-eqiuped with modern smart house issues. Unfortunately hot drinking water is not included. I'd recommend this hotel t stay in London for it's value for money ratio.Especially recomenned for thise who arrive at Stansted airport - direct bus service to this location.

author: Charlotte K
title: Excellent location and quiet, clean stay
text: Clean, quiet, very central and very efficient staff. Breakfast decent. Rooms small but very clean. A comfortable stay.

author: Luca D
title: No One at the Front Desk Key System Down Locked Out of My Room
text: The entire key swiping system is down so no one can get into their rooms. The front desk staff has to manually open the door for every guest but by the time I got back, I had to wait 30 minutes to get in cause the front desk was empty. Unless you really wanna save money, DO NOT COME HERE.

author: Aaron I
title: Justin is an amazing worker, give him a raise!
text: Justin, the man at the front desk, is my brother from another mother. He made our experience here 20x better and i’m very thankful to have met him. Anything we needed or asked him for, he was on it. That man deserves to be getting paid $100 an hour. The hotel is also very nice. I think Justin’s aura brings the whole place into a perfect harmony and keeps everything running smoothly.

author: Elena E
title: Very good stay
text:
Pleasant stay with an amazing host Justin,
Cheers from France 😉

author: Lauren Y
title: very comfortable and relaxing experience staying here in the severe weather
text: amazing and super comfortable experience staying here especially considering the winter storm and all. friendly staff, quick service and really good hotel rooms.

author: Manon X
title: Basic af - you pay for 0 frills then pay some more
text:
The only reason this hotel gets any stars at all is because I have to rate at least a “1”. I have to say that it is clean and somewhat modern. That’s about the only thing going for it other than location. 
If you’re trying to do anything other than sleep here though, well f%#

author: Charlie F
title: Disappointing.
text: A true disappointment. The overpriced hotel provided cell like rooms, the worst being the ones on the first floor...or you know the basement. They are small, cold and hard and nearly windowless...unless you rase the black shades so people walking by on the street can wave at you. The staff is brusque and the venue is cramped over all. The location directly on House is convenient...but only to 24 hour street noise.

author: Marta K
title: Not worth your money
text:
My husband and I visit NYC once a year and have stayed in a lot of different hotels (chain & boutique) as well as Airbnb in different areas. This was one of the worst. The website states there is a safe, iPhone clock with phone charger, free WiFi, coffee pot in each room plus 2 bottles of water per night.   When we checked in we had to pay a $17.21 fee which we were told was a facilities fee for WiFi (even though it states on the website it’s free), the water bottles we never received and filtered water. We asked 3 different employees about our bottles of water and one had no idea that was a thing, the other one said she’d have to look into it and the last one said they hadn’t gotten their “shipment” in and stated there’s tap water in the lounge area. We didn’t even mention about the safe or lack of clock. 
Our room did not have a pillow top mattress nor the nice curtains in the pictures. It would have been nice to have had a mini fridge. We also had a major drainage issue in our tub. It took over 10 minutes to drain after just one 10 minute shower. 
I never leave a negative review but this was not a great hotel and I would not stay here again nor recommend it to anyone else.

author: Nathan T
title: Nothing Works and No Help or Effort to Fix!
text:
Extremely Disappointing Stay – Would Not Recommend
I had an overall poor experience at this property and will not be returning.
I chose this hotel solely based on its proximity to where I needed to be. The total cost for a 3-night stay was $1,156.22, with an additional $51.63 charged at check-in—referred to inconsistently by staff as either a “hotel fee” or an “incidental hold,” depending on whom I spoke with. I will return to this point later.
Upon arrival, I found the entrance confusing and poorly marked. The automatic doors were locked, requiring guests to either use a key or press a call button and hope for a response. After waiting several minutes, I was eventually let in.
I had booked my reservation through American Express Travel, linked directly from my AMEX card. During check-in, I was met by a front desk employee named Samantha, who proceeded to lecture me about the drawbacks of using third-party booking sites such as "Experian" (presumably she meant Expedia), claiming that reservations made through such platforms are not cancellable. My printed reservation confirmation clearly stated that it was fully cancellable, but I chose not to engage as I had no intention of canceling.
After a long day of moving a family member into a new apartment, I simply wanted to relax. Upon entering my room, I discovered the following issues:
The television did not work.
The hotel phone was inoperable.
WiFi was extremely unreliable.
The main light bulb in the room was burnt out.
I returned to the front desk to report these issues. Samantha offered to move me to another room, but I declined due to exhaustion and instead asked that maintenance address the problems the next day. After troubleshooting with my husband (an IT professional), we concluded that the error message on the television suggested the property had not paid its DirecTV bill.
The next morning, I spoke with another guest in the elevator who confirmed that his TV and hotel phone were also non-functional. I stopped by the front desk to report the ongoing issues again, and staff acknowledged that there were widespread problems with both phone and TV service, which they claimed they were "working on."
That evening, I returned to find that the issues persisted. Again, no resolution. That night, my stay was further disrupted by a loud, unsupervised party involving underage guests running through the halls, slamming doors, and congregating near the stairwell adjacent to my room. I attempted to contact the front desk, but again—no functioning hotel phone, and repeated calls from my cell phone to the main line went unanswered.
The following morning, I discovered there was no toilet paper in the room. I attempted to contact the front desk again by phone (cell and hotel line), but received no response. I was forced to go down to the lobby in person. It took an unreasonable amount of time for the attendant to locate a roll. When I asked for two rolls, he hesitated but eventually complied.
My third day was equally disappointing: persistent issues with room lighting, no improvement to water pressure, and a shower that alternated only between scalding hot or freezing cold—with no in-between setting. It consistently took over 10 minutes to produce any hot water.
I raised my concerns with every front desk staff member I encountered throughout the stay. Samantha, in particular, received multiple complaints from me, though I also dealt with at least two other staff members whose names I did not catch. On the final night, a young male employee assured me that I would receive a partial refund at checkout due to the numerous unresolved issues.
At checkout the next morning, I was again met by Samantha, who stated that no refund would be provided and that there were no notes on my account indicating any such arrangement. I asked to speak to the General Manager, Dario, whom I had left a voicemail for on Day 2 of my stay and never heard back from.
When Dario was reached by phone, he was dismissive, offered no apology, and reiterated that no refund would be issued. His reasoning was that because the reservation had been prepaid, he was unable to process any refund—even for the $51.63 charge at check-in, which had been described as either a hotel fee or an incidental hold. When I inquired about that charge—pointing out that I had not incurred any incidentals and, in fact, had not even been provided the opportunity to do so—he again refused.
Following the stay, I contacted American Express. They spoke with Dario directly and reported experiencing the same dismissive attitude. At that point, Dario apparently agreed to refund the $51.63, though I have yet to receive confirmation that the refund has been processed.
Conclusion:
This property is poorly managed, communication is inconsistent at best, and guest concerns are routinely ignored. The lack of basic functionality (TV, phone, internet), unreliable staff, and absence of meaningful customer service rendered this stay completely unacceptable—particularly at this price point. I strongly advise others to seek alternative accommodations.

author: Ana K
title: Next to a beautiful park, but….
text: This is a great hotel; small, but close to the Bowery area. Room was clean and well maintained, staff is friendly.  The only negative is something the hotel can’t do anything about - the noise from the park across the street! Our room was directly across from the basketball court, which was busy at all hours (we stayed 3 nights). Loud music and a few times there was a DJ or announcer of some sort.  Just be forewarned to bring good earplugs! If not for the noise this would be a 5 star rating.

author: Charlie H
title: Amazing!
text: My boyfriend and I had a FANTASTIC time at this hotel! The receptionist, Marcella, was so kind to us. She talked about her life in NYC and gave us suggestions for our trip — sweet woman!

author: Rosie J
text: Inexpensive, CLEAN, super comfortable bed and linens. BEST location for East Village.  Staff is lovely.  Victoria is the best.

author: Jessica O
title: Awful, charged 315 for essentially a giant middle finger when I arrived.  Do not recommend.
text: Garbage hotel, the hotel canceled my reservation because I showed up 30 mins late from overnight trip from cleveland in the early am.  I was stuck in Jersey traffic.  I paid for whole weekend and they charged me a day in advance.  Only to show up with my room given away because "i was a no show".  I gave them notice I was going to potentially be late and they "noted" it but apparently that note is worthless.  They held 1st day money and gave refund for remainder of reservation but now I'm stuck in NYC with no hotel.  Manager is unavailable by phone, email only.  I would give this place a negative if I could for terrible service.  I want management to call me, they don't even pick up phone.  I called 6 times this morning.

author: Henry G
title: Major shoutout to Kristal, the front desk manager
text:
I normally don't write reviews for hotels but I wanted to write one and give a shoutout to Kristal, the front desk manager. We got into NYC after a crazy day of traveling and were completely exhausted. The room we were assigned was unfortunately unusually loud and I asked Kristal if we could switch rooms. She took a look, did some research, and was able to get us a new room that was significantly more quiet and had a beautiful view of the city! We stayed for several days so this made a huge difference in our stay. She really didn't have to do that for us so I really appreciate that she went above and beyond on this. Major props to Kristal! 

Overall, the new room itself was great! It was clean and had a beautiful view of the city. I wish they provided a small fridge.  Other than that, I would definitely stay here again!

author: Holly G
title: Room with no windows for 400 usd???
text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience at the Gatsby Hotel in New York. I booked a room for around $400 for one night, based on photos that showed a bright, stylish space with windows. Instead, I was placed in a basement-level room (floor -1) with no windows, poor lighting, and constant noise—both from the street and what sounded like construction coming from the elevator shaft.
The water took over 10 minutes to heat up, and the pressure was incredibly weak. When I complained at the front desk, I was told there was nothing they could do and that no other rooms were available.
This is unacceptable. If there’s a chance that a guest might be placed in a windowless basement room, it should be clearly disclosed at the time of booking—and charged at a significantly lower rate.
I felt misled and overcharged. This was a terrible experience, and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. It reflects poorly on New York’s hospitality standards.

author: Lily F
title: theft of airpods
text:
On Friday during the day we were robbed of airpods where on Saturday I make the report I know why I did not go out with them because I used them only so as not to disturb my father who slept in the morning 
deliver all the information and tracking of my search app airpods on Saturday by showing them in a place I've never been 
They never took responsibility for the situation telling me that the staff hadn't been and that maybe I lost them. 
as shown by the text issued
I find this an unconvincing answer.

author: Zoe F
title: Good inexpensive hotel
text: This is an inexpensive and well-maintained hotel in a great location on the border of the East Village, Lower East Side, and SoHo. If you are looking for a luxurious spa vacation, this isn’t the place—and that was great for me because I wasn’t. I wanted what I got: a helpful person at the desk, named Peter when I stayed; clean elevator; clean room, bed, and bathroom; functional air conditioning. Will definitely be returning when my travels take me back to New York City.

author: Hugo Z
title: Very good
text: The location of this hotel is really great! It’s in the heart of SoHo next to several great bars and shops. The shops down Broadway are just a 10-15 minute walk away. It’s very clean and the people at the front desk are very nice. Krystal stands out at the front desk! Very helpful and patient!

author: Sophia L
title: Small and Perfect !!
text: This quaint little hotel in New York City was perfect for me, a solo traveler. The front desk had someone there at all times and they were very pleasant. They also had a wonderful room to the side with coffee, hot water where you could sit and relax before or after your day. The extras in the bathroom were organic and very nice. I want to point out that the air conditioning system worked perfectly, which enabled me to sleep very well. I would definitely come back to this hotel again.

author: Lucia C
title: Brilliant hotel,brilliant staff, brilliant location, brilliant all around
text: Would give 20 out of 10 if I could. Staff especially Kristal were superb,she stored out luggage after checkel out as we had a late flight. Location is excellent. Despite some reviews, it fell very safe. Housekeeping was brilliant also, room was immaculate each day. Can not recommend this hotel and staff enough

author: Camille Y
title: Amazing hotel....
text: My say at The GATSBY HOTEL for 1 night, before getting on the Greyhound. To come home to Warren R.I ... Was amazing the staff was awesome! I got to pay for my booking, a day in advance, was my first Hotel stay in NYC! At checkout Kristal was awesome!

author: Ethan J
title: The great deal
text:
We came as a couple for 2 nights and it was amazing, the room was clean, well maintained and spacious.
The reception staff spoke English at a high level and the staff was nice.
They allowed us to leave our luggage in the utility room free of charge and even until the evening.
The breakfast was amazing.

author: Katie B
title: Very good location and service!
text:
The hotel was really good for a 3 stars hotel.
Nothing was missing. The services are really good. The location is 4 minutes from the Central Station Termini. 
Many shops and restaurants are around.
I really recommand this hotel.

author: Sydney O
title: Friendly Staff, Perfect Location
text:
I had a lovely one-night stay at Hotel Milani. The room was very spacious, clean, and comfortable. The location is great—only about a 3-minute walk from the train station and around 20 minutes on foot to the city center, which made everything very convenient.

A special thank you to Nadia and Beatrice at reception—they were incredibly warm, kind, and helpful. They really made my stay even more enjoyable.

I would happily stay here again on my next trip to Rome and definitely recommend it!

author: Daisy A
title: Great location for getting about
text:
Hotel was all good
Uber from door was the ticket to seeing everything
Very clean with all that was needed
It’s Rome so no parties in the room 😳
Bathroom had it all 
Breakfast okay
No problems

author: Aiden A
title: Nice experience.
text: Nice experience. Spacious, clean, and quiet room. Large bed. My wife was also happy. Rich breakfast. Very kind staff. Excellent location, easily reachable from the station.

author: Jessica G
title: Stay in the heart of Rome
text: Beautiful property, convenient and comfortable for a business stay in the heart of the city, a stone's throw from Termini station. Kind staff and excellent breakfast.

author: Mathis B
title: Roman weekend
text: Clean and bright room, perfect location very close to the station and the historic center. The real gem is the staff, always kind and helpful! We will be back!

author: Matthew D
title: Everything top-notch
text: Excellent service and great professionalism

author: Isla J
title: The beauty
text: Spectacular 💖 excellent service, exceptional cleanliness.

author: Kyle B
title: Everything perfect!
text:
Excellent location near Termini Station, clean room, and friendly staff.
I recommend it!

author: Camille Q
title: I would go back!
text:
Very nice hotel. Really comfortable and clean. Kind staff attentive to my (small) requests. 
I had a short stay but I highly recommend it

author: Oscar O
title: Nadia
text: The best of all, they have helped me a lot!

author: Carlos P
title: Hotel stay
text: Nadia was sooooo sweet and such a great help she recommended the best places to eat and made she everything was well with my room. Highly recommend this hotel it’s near everythingn

author: Gavin O
title: Absolutely one to forget.
text:
We stayed in this ‘hotel’ for two nights. After arriving, we left our luggage in storage and returned hours later, since the room was not ready. Upon our return (4:00 PM), we unexpectedly found the room totally dirty (I am attaching photos). I immediately called the front desk, but the room phone was not working, so I used my cell phone to explain the situation to the girl at the front desk. Shortly after, she came up to the room, wanting to take photos herself to show the housekeeper, apologizing for what happened and promising us that the following day it would be their priority to ensure everything was cleaned (at least within reason). The room had hair on the desk and on the floor. Hair in the sheets, the sink looked used and not cleaned. The toilet paper holder had rust, as well as dust and dirt. In the bathroom, there was only one kit (2 cotton swabs, 1 cotton pad, 1 shower cap), but there were two of us. (I specify this because we had asked before booking if it would be in the bathroom, to travel lighter, and I was told there would also be slippers, which we did not find, so imagine walking barefoot, according to them, in a dirty room with residue and hair, in addition to the dust). I also report that the bathroom drain does not work; she says she would immediately inform the maintenance worker. The girl, mortified by what happened, told me that unfortunately a room change was not possible; I replied that if things did not get sorted out, I would provide a review explaining what happened, but, hopeful, we waited for the following day. In the evening we went out and upon our return we found two flutes and a bottle of sparkling wine in the room, along with a note (which I am attaching in a photo) to apologize for what happened. Something we appreciated but did not consume while waiting for the next morning, once cleaning was completed. In the morning, having gone down to go to the breakfast room, the reception staff did not deign to greet us even despite our good morning; we overlooked it. Afterwards we went out (at 7:30 AM) and returned at 5:00 PM, still without being deigned a greeting by the receptionists. And here is the surprise in the room: it was exactly in the same filthy condition as the previous day with the same hairs in the same spot, white powder still exactly on the desk, no extra kit, shower and bathroom not cleaned. The toilet paper that I had specifically left out of the holder was now inside, and naturally I did not reuse it, opening a new roll that had not been in contact with dust and rust. The drain still did not work. They had only pulled up the bed sheets and replaced two towels. They had not even emptied the trash can full of garbage.
On the morning of check-out, I returned the bottle of sparkling wine to the reception. 
Despite our willingness to wait for improvements in cleaning, behaving politely with the staff, we were treated like scum and not even given the slightest consideration. Who would want to stay, paying €300, in a dirty room? I believe no one. 
The location is excellent, very close to the station, but this does not depend on those who work there. 
Certainly, if the cleaning had been done on the morning of the 2nd day, I would have avoided writing a review because I understand it is mortifying, but being made a fool of is worse. So it makes me think that the bottle was a CUNNING gesture? Apparently, yes. 
If I may give some advice, avoid this property unless you like staying in other people's dust and hair and have no basic expectations regarding cleanliness. 
The breakfast was okay, even though the cakes in the buffet were packaged, while the mini croissants were hard, as if they were from the previous day. 
Hotel colors and a very cute room, if it hadn't been for all these mishaps. 
We would not return.

author: James R
title: Photos are not real
text: Outdated and smelly room, a test for your tolerance

author: Ella P
text: A wonderful hotel with an excellent location and outstanding service. The rooms are clean and comfortable, and the staff are friendly and helpful. My stay was very enjoyable and I highly recommend it.

author: George J
title: Reasonable Hotel
text: Hotel well located in terms of transportation, close to Termini station and shuthe to the airport. Good lunch. Reasonable cleaning. In a friend's room there was 1 day without cleaning.

author: Emma X
title: A hotel that does not meet the minimum standards.
text: An outdated hotel that is not worth the price it charges. Unsatisfactory breakfast. Reception is unavailable from 11 PM to 7 AM. As mentioned, the hotel needs a major renovation: the good thing is the location, you sleep well and do not hear noise, which obviously depends on where the room faces. Very close to Termini.

author: Charlotte R
title: Everything was perfect.
text: Great stay. Super central hotel, very kind staff.

author: Aaron U
title: Excellent facility and great experience.
text: I stayed at Hotel Milani and we had a very good time.

author: Juan H
title: beautiful!
text: beautiful room with air con and a balcony, breakfast was delicious with plenty of options and the staff were so lovely and helpful. Definitely book an hour in the spa

author: Paige Q
title: Top
text: Beautiful hotel and exceptional spa

author: Pablo V
title: 5 Nights
text: Stayed at Hotel Delgj Aranci for 5 nights while visiting Rome. Can't complain staff are 24hours at the desk, cleaners come every morning. Hotel room was lovely and clean, bed comfy. From the hotel you are able to grab the bus into 'city center' could walk it but decided against due to the heat. Breakfast was lovely, have a good options of bacon,sausage and scrambled eggs, pastry's.

author: Zoe U
title: Notification
text:
The hotel is super nice to stay in. It offers many experiences: delicious and selective breakfast buffet, delicious restaurant, if you are tired of city tour, a large and cozy lounge to relax in mm. 
The hotel has an authentic and cozy atmosphere in which you feel safe and comfortable. 
Very pleasant stay. Not my last visit!

author: Jack V
title: Hotel Degli Aranci
text: This hotel is beautiful and the staff are amazing!  The front desk was so helpful with suggestions that we asked for.  I really can’t say enough about this hotel!

author: Miguel F
title: Romance with the scent of orange blossom
text:
Enchanting property in one of the most elegant and quiet areas of Rome. 
The fragrance of orange blossom that you breathe upon arrival already projects you into a romantic dimension, in which a chromatic harmony based on refinement and retro taste reigns.
Extremely welcoming staff from check-in, they upgraded my room from single to double, spacious, clean and equipped with every comfort, starting with the bed, very comfortable. Excellent variety for breakfast as well. 
I hope to be able to return as soon as possible. 🔝🔝🔝

author: Thomas L
title: Fantastic experience
text: Delightful hotel, superior room with a fantastic terrace, friendly and helpful staff, especially Danila, who is beautiful, capable, and kind.

author: Nora V
title: Best birthday ever celebrated in Rome.
text:
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the hotel. I was traveling to Rome with my eight-month-old infant to celebrate my birthday. The establishment is a renovated historic villa that has been transformed into a hotel. It features an excellent spa, a well-equipped gym, a superb restaurant, and, most notably, a highly professional and accommodating staff. My only concern is that the villa itself is not easily accessible for strollers or wheelchairs. The staff consistently provided assistance with carrying the baby stroller. It is worth noting that Rome, in general, presents accessibility challenges for wheelchairs and strollers; public transportation, including buses, has high entry points, a significant majority (approximately 80%) of tourist attractions have stairs at their entrances, and the pavement is composed of cobblestones.
Also the domestic staff have to pay a little more attention to the bathroom tiles to prevent mold (in the shower). I have those bathroom tiles too and cleaning them is a hustle. I would return when my baby is older and doesn't need a stroller 🤣

author: Sophia U
title: Very pleasant stay with excellent staff.
text:
A very beautiful hotel with a lot of charm located in a quiet residential area, Villa Borghese is a 15-minute walk away.
The staff is very attentive, helpful, and genuinely cares about advising you.  Excellent welcome from Lucrezia, who speaks French very well and was charming and very efficient throughout our stay. Before our arrival, so that we could still have dinner due to the late hour caused by our flight delay, she provided us with a choice of dishes. When we arrived, everything was already prepared in the room. Thank you also to Daniele.
Additionally, we were upgraded to a lovely suite with a large terrace overlooking a beautiful panorama of the city rooftops. The rooms are really very clean, spacious, and equipped with everything you might need.

We warmly recommend this hotel where everything is done to make our stay pleasant.

author: Poppy O
title: Great hotel quiet location
text: Excellent hotel in a peaceful, nice location only 30 mins stroll through Borghese park. Rooms are good size and beautifully decorated in art deco style. Very clean, aircon great, breakfast had great choice. Taxi if needed 15 euros to Piazza del Popolo.

author: Owen O
title: Loved it
text:
Really beautiful authentic hotel, the room was spotless, staff attentive and good variety for the continental breakfast, eggs, toast, breads, cheeses, hams, fresh fruit, hot beverages, yogurts, pastries and cereals. I’d happily stay again. 

It’s a good walk into the city about 5k but at least you have a good excuse for plenty gelato. Villa borghese gardens is a short walk from the hotel and worth visiting. 

We also ate at some lovely restaurants within a short 5-10 min walk of the hotel which I’lll list below.

- Rooftop restaurant “Le Roof” (in Radison Blu) lovely cocktails and we had fish of the day. Excellent views.

- Ristorante Ambasciata d’Abruzzo the food was gorgeous here and staff so friendly!

- Taverna Rossini (sea food dishes only) 

The hotel also has a restaurant but we didn’t eat here as the menu seemed limited. 

Transport 
Best to walk and take a good pair of trainers, the walk is pleasant.

If you’re not good on your feet taxis are readily available but expensive, you can uber scooters and bikes and there is a tram only a short walk from the hotel.

author: Isabella N
title: A beautiful hotel, very welcoming and special; everyone is very helpful and friendly, and especially very human. The breakfast and dinner were exquisite, the room was beautiful, and I think the garden-level rooms are very underrated; they are beautiful too! The atmosphere is very neoclassical, and both the spa and gym are very well equipped and welcoming, and the bar is beautiful on the terrace!!
text: In my opinion, it is an underrated hotel! At the Restaurant

author: Mathis D
title: Feeling good in Rome at the hotel.
text: Welcoming place, excellent hygiene, kindness and availability, in a quiet and elegant setting.

author: Diego B
title: More than a positive experience
text: Excellent service, kind staff, efficient location.

author: Chloe N
title: Rome in 36 hours
text: Super cute hotel and extremely kind staff. They welcomed us with professionalism from the very first moment. We will return for the next Roman experience. Congratulations!

author: Julien F
title: Wonderful stay At Hotel Degli Aranci!
text:
Wonderful stay at Hotel degli Aranci!
The staff was incredibly helpful and made our stay especially enjoyable. A special thank you to April and Lucrezia, who went above and beyond with their kindness, professionalism, and attention to detail. Their warm hospitality truly made a difference and made us feel very welcome throughout our visit. The hotel itself was lovely, and the excellent service made the experience even better. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Rome.

author: Chloe X
title: 10 out of 10
text: The experience was very nice, although brief. We had the grace of having breakfast with the scent of blooming jasmine. A wonder. The staff was very courteous. The tasting menu for dinner is recommended, especially the tiramisu that you do not expect.  10 out of 10

author: Isla Y
title: An amazing experience from start to finish!
text:
Our stay at Hotel Degli Aranci was truly wonderful! April was an incredible support in preparing for our large group. As a corporate booking, April ensured our experience was seamless; from organising rooms to booking a wide variety of transfers for guests.

The hotel itself is breath taking.

author: Mason T
title: Very good experience, makes you want to return.
text: Very nice experience with perfect hospitality. We were surprised to sleep in a suite; it was really nice. Incredible breakfast. We found the restaurant a bit expensive compared to the dishes offered. We recommend this hotel.

author: Paige C
title: My room in Rome over the long weekend.
text: The rooms not that big, but cleanliness is  very good. The bathroom is spacious but only the shower space is quite small. About the TV, it will be much better if they have a cable so that we can watch international show in english. Also, a smart tv, so that we can just mirror our mobile phone to the tv, if they cannot provide a cable channel.

author: Alice A
title: Nice hotel, great location
text: This is a nice hotel in a great location.  The room was clean and we loved having a small balcony.  The breakfast buffet was very nice - everything from baguettes and croissants to eggs and bacon.  Several juice and coffee options, and the hostess, Chafia, was LOVELY, and she even made homemade chocolate chip and vanilla cake/bread for the buffet.

author: Hugo V
title: I come to this hotel often but this time I would like to commend the kindness of Chafia and her cakes!
text: I come to this hotel often but this time I would like to commend the staff who are adorable and a big bravo to Chafia for her welcome and her "delicious" homemade cake.

author: Wyatt Q
title: Recommended.
text: Location is excellent. Unbeatable in fact, just 15 mins from Gare du Nord trip to St. Michel station beside hotel & smack bang in front of Notre Dame. Rooms are "compact" but nicely decorated (as always thr photos on the website are a bit flattering. Service friendly and efficient. We didnt have breakfast here but the price seems reasonable compared to cafés outside. Our family room had a small terrace facing in to the courtyard. It was just right for having our august siesta and hanging out at night watching TV before bed. We will definitley return

author: Molly U
title: Perfect location!
text: Outstanding location, 5 minute walk from Notre Dame. Great breakfast with cheerful service, Chafia was a delight each morning. Highly recommend.

author: Laura V
title: Great location
text: This hotel is in a great location

author: Noah L
title: Wonderful spot to stay in Paris
text: Great find.   Quality,  friendliness,  location, and breakfast, excellent

author: Aiden E
title: Fantastic, especially the breakfast
text: Hotel very well located with spacious and well-equipped rooms. The little extra that makes us come back: the very diverse, hearty breakfast. They never leave any baskets empty.  The cakes are homemade and most importantly, the welcome from the lady at breakfast is more than perfect. A great lady with a big heart. I recommend +++++

author: Kyle G
title: Very Happy Solo Traveller
text:
In the heart of the Latin quarter (named for being the area where the first university was held and Latin being the language of academics/monks)   5 min walk to RER B (blue line) which takes you directly to Paris Gare du Nord in 10 min. 1 min walk from the hotel and stops for multiple buses.  Notre-Dame Cathedral is 10/15 min walk away and the Palace de Justice as above but in the opposite direction.  If you love medieval/gothic architecture then this is the place for you as there are numerous churches close by, one just 2 min walk from the hotel.  
Fab atmosphere, especially the evening. The lights, delicious aromas of restaurants, people watching heaven, quintessential French - MAGNIFICENT! 
The restaurants, food was 😋 
Rooms are small although I had a large double/queen bed ( VG comfy, I love soft pillows so I was able to smother myself into four ) and the bathroom consisted of a shower which had plenty of room to move around in. Good lighting for the mirror ladies ✔️. Wardrobes built in with double doors/ mirrors, plenty of room for storage. I was surprised with the large TV and the kettle, tea/coffee and fridge.  

Staff were lovely and helpful and also a shout out to the cleaning staff.  The rooms were fantastic.  Another plus for me, wooden floors (sound proofed or at least none disturbed me), hate hotel carpets (regardless of their ⭐ rating so to be able to see and walk in clean floors was great.  My room overlooked the side street with restaurants and with the windows closed the noise was minimal. 
I absolutely loved this beautiful old building and it is good to see some of the original features. 

So to cut a long review short, would I recommend and return? Absolutely, I am making plans to return in the autumn

author: Mia M
title: Great Location!
text: Can't beat this location!  So close to so many different places to see, cafes and restaurants. The neighborhood is terrific with a great vibe and so many wonderful streets to explore. We booked a room with a balcony, which was great.  If you are sensitive to noise, don't book the balcony side of the hotel.  I enjoyed the music from the late night establishments, but was still able to drift off to sleep.  Rooms are a little tight, so I will probably move up a category.  For an older hotel, I really appreciated having an elevator/lift and GREAT A/C!

author: Aiden U
title: Location, location, location
text:
We stayed here for three nights after arriving in Paris and before traveling through other areas of France. It was easy to take the RER train from the airport with an exit a block away from the hotel. We were able to store our bags until the room was ready and went out to explore the city. The young lady at reception sent us downstairs to an area to freshen up after our long flight. 
This hotel is in the middle of everything, we could not have asked for better location, pretty much walking everywhere. Our room was clean and comfortable. The only downside was that we did not have manual control over the air conditioner. It was controlled by the hotel. I think this is  common in Europe, but I would have preferred to have control myself. I would still stay here again.

author: Mathis F
title: Charming-looking but TINY and Expensive
text: Don't be fooled by the pics submitted.  They are all done from unique camera angles.  This place is tiny by anyone's standards.  Our bathroom was smaller than a cruise ship's.  I couldn't sit on the toilet because I ( six foot -two) couldn't get my leg around the sink pedestal.  Furniture was all cheap and old. Not antique-old but like garage-sale old.  The hallways were blocked by bags of laundry which makes the area even more cramped.  The location is super great but doesn't warrant the price tag.   The saving grace is the front desk staff who were very helpful and helped us graciously through a major problem.  Breakfast buffet was compact but had everything and was well-attended.

author: Henry C
title: Beat up , worn out mess.
text: This hotel is a beat up, run down mess, $500 a night is a joke, save yourself the pain, look somewhere else.

author: Miguel K
title: Perfect hotel for a family
text: I can only recommend this hotel! We stayed here as a family of three with a 13 month old baby and everybody was so friendly and helpful and did everything to make us feel comfortable. I was sceptical to travelling to Paris with a baby but this hotel and Paris in general proved me wrong. Location is perfect with walking distance to both Notre-Dame and Le Louvren. We got a room with balcony on fifth floor with nice view over the small streets of Latin Quarter. Special thanks to Mattias and Louis for being extra friendly to our little daugther, I hope we see you again in near future!

author: Poppy E
title: Overrated with what was reality!
text: The hotel is tired ! Things are starting to break down ! We had the suite which was unique on the 6th level. The air conditioner was leaking water for 3 days ! Elevator only goes to the 5th

author: Camille J
title: We had a great stay at Hotel Europe Saint Severin!
text:
We stayed here for a total of four nights on two different occasions a week apart. First, the location is 10 stars. We had so much fun staying in the lively Quartier Latin and there are tons of restaurants just steps away along with grocery stores, shops, etc. Notre Dame and the Seine are a 5 to 10-minute walk. We also walked to the Louvre, the Jardin du Luxembourg, Musee d'Orsay, and even the Eiffel Tower. The latter is a 40-minute walk but there's lots to see on the way. The hotel is easily walkable to a few different Metro stations as well. 

As for the hotel itself, I would fully recommend it but I'm giving it four stars instead of five for a couple of reasons listed below. The lobby is nicely appointed and the staff is friendly and speaks English very well if necessary. The elevator is handy and arrives quickly. We loved the ability to open the giant w4indows and let the breeze blow in. The rooms were clean. No issues there. 

The main issue is the rooms are very small. I have rarely stayed in a hotel room that small and we have traveled a lot. I highly recommend the upgrade to a larger room so you have a place to put your suitcase. We stayed in two different rooms and the one with a balcony was worth the extra because of the extra square feet. Second, although a small quibble, they don't provide as many products for the price point as I'd expect. There is a small tube of body lotion and a dispenser of body wash/shampoo in the shower. Shampoo and conditioner would be a nice upgrade for $300 a night. The third issue is something that didn't bother us but is worth noting. The noise coming from the street (garbage trucks, people yelling, etc.) can be loud. I like street noise personally, but it did wake me up a couple of times.

I wish breakfast was included. The 14-euro breakfast was just continental and we didn't eat it because there are so many creperies and other restaurants nearby. I've stayed at many hotels at this price point and most included a simple continental breakfast.

A bonus--the Italian restaurant attached to the hotel was delicious and one of the best meals we ate in Paris. I highly recommend the burrata appetizer with the mango and avocado. Sounds weird, but it was good!

Overall, way more good than bad!

author: Andrea O
title: Amazing location
text:
My family of four stayed in a junior suite on the 6th floor. It was perfect for us! We had the sofa pulled out into two twin beds and still had room to move around without being on top of each other. The staff was friendly and the room was clean. Best of all, it was right near the RER B that got us to/from CDG and Gare du Nord, RER C to Eiffel Tower, the metro for everything else, and walking distance to so many things. We stayed with kids and so it was great to have so many casual restaurants and at least two food markets within a one block walk. 

One note - there's plenty of privacy in the suite. When I booked the room months ago I hesitated and almost didn't because I saw an older review that talked about there being little privacy except for the toilet. I'm glad I ignored that and booked it anyway because that wasn't the case in 2026. The shower has a door and the upstairs bedroom has curtains that can be pulled shut to block the view from the downstairs (not that my kids looked up from their phones when unwinding after exhausting days of sightseeing).

author: Mason J
title: Perfect location
text: Perfect location in the heart of the Latin quarter. Got upgraded to a room with a balcony on 5th floor- no noise issues whatsoever. Small room but more than enough room for couples with hand luggage

author: Jack X
title: Perfect location and personal to small care
text: Stay of a few nights between girls.  The place is ideally located to discover Paris.  But the nights are peaceful: no noisy neighborhood, our room was large, superb bathroom and very clean.  I strongly advise, ideal for a city trip.

author: Leo L
title: Great hotel, great location
text: This is the second time I have stayed here and I really love it.  The location is perfect, right in the heart of the Latin Quarter, but on a small street that is pretty calm and quiet compared to other streets in the neighborhood.  Everyone that works there is very welcoming and patient, and everyone speaks English but still were very kind and tolerated my attempts to communicate in French.  Much appreciated!  The rooms are small (typical) but they have everything you need, a comfy bed, a TV where you can stream YouTube among other things, a little mini-fridge to keep things cold,  and both times I have been there the rooms have had a little balcony, which I love!  The bathroom was clean and well equipped.  The neighborhood is very lively, and it is close to Notre Dame, Luxembourg Gardens, and the Sorbonne.  There are also a lot of little movie theaters that play movies from many countries, a lot of old classics, and sometimes film festivals highlighting a particular director for example.  There are also a lot of Metro stations in the neighborhood, and one thing I really love is that you can get to the RER B train that goes directly to CDG airport, it's less that 100 yards away and there's and elevator if you have bags!  I have felt very comfortable, safe, and well taken care of at the Hotel Europe Saint Séverin and I heartily recommend it.

author: Emma Q
title: Very good
text:
Hospitable and prepared staff.
Room always clean and tidy at every return to the room.
Place in general warm and welcoming.

author: Paige Q
title: 24 hour stopover in London
text:
1. Great location; very close to Paddington Station which is the terminal for the Heathrow Express and has a number of Underground lines. It is walking distance to the West End and other areas of interest.
2. The staff were so helpful. I arrived at 7am from Heathrow after a long flight. They managed to check me in which meant I could shower and then go exploring.  The hotel also has baggage storage facilities which I used after I had checked out.
3. Spring Street has good eating places. 
4. The hotel was clean and tidy.
5. The hotel offered compact rooms for a very reasonable rates, which was ideal for me as I was staying 1 night.

author: Anna E
title: Room paranoia. Useless manager.
text:
An incident occurred during our stay which significantly affected our experience. I am awarding 2 stars, primarily because the air conditioning was functioning well.

Our first impressions were positive. The gentleman at reception was polite and kindly stored our luggage before check-in.

Unfortunately, the lift was out of service, which was inconvenient when carrying suitcases. As we made our way up the stairs, the age and condition of the hotel became increasingly apparent. There were cracked walls and worn carpets with visible damage. While some wear and tear is understandable in a budget hotel, there are reasonable standards that should still be maintained.

After checking into our room, we had been there for less than ten minutes when a member of housekeeping entered without knocking. At the time, I was lying on the bed without clothing, trying to cool down during the heatwave.

I found the incident both embarrassing and upsetting. I immediately contacted reception to raise a complaint and was informed that the manager would contact me.

After waiting for approximately an hour without receiving any response, I went downstairs to speak with the manager directly. Unfortunately, I found her attitude unhelpful and dismissive.

I explained that the situation was unacceptable and appeared to demonstrate a lack of communication between staff members. As paying guests, we are entitled to privacy within our room, and this should never have occurred.

Although the manager apologised, my request for a partial refund was declined. No alternative form of compensation or goodwill gesture was offered despite the distress and embarrassment caused.

As a result of this incident, we felt both uncomfortable and unsafe for the remainder of our stay. Knowing that someone had entered our room without warning left us concerned that it could happen again.

We found ourselves constantly watching the door and anticipating further interruptions. The situation caused significant anxiety, to the extent that my partner placed our luggage in front of the door for added peace of mind.

Given the impact this had on our sense of privacy and security, we ultimately decided that we could not continue our stay and requested a full refund. A refund still not received. 

I made it clear that I would be leaving a review of my experience. Based on this incident and the way it was handled, I would not choose to stay at this hotel again.

author: Grace P
title: Very good value for money
text:
We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. Its biggest advantage is definitely the location, which is excellent and makes it very easy to explore the area and access nearby attractions, restaurants, and transportation.

Another highlight was the friendliness and helpfulness of the staff. Everyone was welcoming, attentive, and always willing to assist with any questions or requests.

The hotel itself is rather simple and could benefit from some refurbishment and general maintenance in certain areas. However, considering the price paid, we felt that the overall value for money was very good. The excellent location and the quality of service more than compensated for these minor shortcomings.

We would gladly stay here again and would recommend it to travelers looking for a well-located hotel with a friendly atmosphere and reasonable rates.

author: Dylan F
title: Excellent customer service
text: I walked into the Edward Hotel in May 2026 after getting stuck at Paddington late in the evening when all trains to my destination were cancelled.  Helga, the receptionist, saved the day by being welcoming, giving me her full attention and finding me a room. I've met few hotel receptionists with her customer service skills. Thanks again!

author: Daniel L
title: Worst hotel ever! Unsafe conditions and appalling service.
text:
This was hands down the worst hotel experience I've ever had. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that basic standards of cleanliness and hospitality were optional here.

The room smelled strongly of damp and stale cigarettes, and within 10 minutes my daughter, who has a lung disease, began breathing very heavily. The stench was so overwhelming that my husband, who is immuno-compromised, began vomiting.The carpets were stained beyond redemption and so dusty it felt as though they hadn’t been cleaned since the hotel first opened. Although the downstairs areas look presentable, do not be fooled — this place is a complete waste of money. 

The staff were equally disappointing. When we addressed our concerns with the manager, we were met with blank stares and excuses. Management were unwilling to help in any way. They repeatedly directed the receptionist to deal with complaints, who confirmed she had no authority to do anything. They refused to provide any certificate or proof that the hotel is damp-proof. We spent over two hours trying to negotiate a refund, which was also refused. 

Other guests were complaining that there was no hot water in their rooms. We didn’t even get a chance to use any facilities as we left immediately. We were forced to find another hotel in the middle of the night. 

Avoid at all costs, especially if you have children — the service and conditions were disgusting and clearly pose a risk to health. If I could give zero stars, I would.

author: George A
title: Great base, great location, friendly staff
text: We found this hotel a great base for our break in London, so close to Paddington Station and Hyde Park where winter wonderland was on, very clean hotel with very friendly and helpful staff and we also felt very safe in the hotel, lovely cafés, restaurants and pubs nearby also.

author: Oliver R
title: Just to sleep
text:
Just to sleep, despite the comfort of the bedding the rooms are tiny (as often in London) but there at 180 € a night and WITHOUT breakfasts (because the hotel does not) even for a central hotel it is much too expensive 
I've been in London several times a year for 25 years and I know the hotel business perfectly well

author: Poppy Z
title: Perfect location
text:
Fantastic location, very welcoming staff.
The rooms are on the small side but we were only sleeping there we left our bags and was out for the rest of the day and evening.

The beds and pillow were so comfy, the reception staff advised us on where to go the next day and we could leave our bags after we checked out which was great.

would 100% return.

author: Gavin V
title: Unbeatable location
text: Lovely though small room. Amazing location. Staff is very helpful and smiley all the time! Plenty of restaurants in the area. And Tube station is just a couple of minutes away.

author: Kyle V
title: We didnt sleep well at all
text:
The room was extremely cramped and there was no place for our stuff in the bathroom. 

The pillows and the matresses were awful. The whole family didnt sleep well. The matress/the whole bed was 10 centimeters shorter than me.

The good thing was that the climate control was working.

author: Poppy P
title: Great location
text: The room needs updating . The bathroom was nice and  clean. Staff were friendly and helpful great location close to everything.

author: Evie W
title: TOOOO small, Owner takes no pride, staff was nice.. Owner issues
text: The Pro is the location, room was clean and staff nice. CONS:  Way too tiny for 2 ppl, couldn't open a door without hitting a bed or person. It was the a little bigger than a walk in closet.   Whoever owns this hotel takes no pride. Their is NO attention to detail.  Lots of broken, worn out bathroom fixtures. Curtains were from the 80s and dirty.  You can tell the cleaning staff does the best it can with what they have to work with but mold in the bathroom and old grout was disgusting.  A little paint, new curtains and fixing what is broken or needs to be replaces would be a nominal expense that I guess the owners just dont care about (sadly).

author: Ian S
title: Had a great short stay experience for business meeting !
text:
This was my first experience and I am so thankful for the convenient service provided by staff, will stay again !
Thank you so much !

author: Olivia K
title: Excellent value option in the Paddington area of London
text: This place is a solid, value option in London Paddington.  The people at reception were very nice and friendly.  It is small, no doubt, with one elevator, etc.  But you get what you pay for and this was well, well worth what we paid.  Rooms are small, but clean and you simply can't beat the location.  You are a stone's throw from a Big Bus stop (blue route), 1 min walk from the Circle and District Tube lines, across the street from other major train connections, and the entire area is great for bars and restaurants.  You're not far from anything.  If you want a great location at a great price, with nice staff and a clean room, this is your spot.  Helga and company, thanks for a great stay - we love London and will be back.

author: Dylan D
title: Good value for money
text: Considering the location, this was a good value for money hotel.  The room we had was very small but we didn’t expect anything larger.  The location was perfect for restaurants, transportation and Hyde Park.  The staff were friendly and welcoming, prompt with any requests.

author: Lucas N
title: Johanna Dahlström
text: Very good location and very easy to get to the hotel from Heathrow Airport. Also easy to the rest of town. For our purpose, the hotel worked perfectly. However, could have been a little higher standard, but it is so general with all hotels in England, I guess

author: Sara L
title: Edward Hotel London - Highly Recommended!
text: Amazing service! The staff were incredibly helpful and made our stay much easier. The best service we could ask for. Fantastic location—close to all major attractions. Good WiFi and a comfortable stay. Highly recommend this hotel! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Gavin V
title: Nothing to complain
text:
Perfect for a short stay. Room had air-conditioning. No breakfast but plenty of options around. Located just a couple of minutes from the station. Hyde Park is nearby too. 
Room was small but just like any other London hotels.
Price was excellent.

author: Chloe Z
title: Not good
text: We had booked a family room with 3 individual beds but only got a room with one double and one single bed. The water in the shower did not really get warm, even after running for a long time. Upon our complaints to reception nothing was done about it. The bathroom was supercold, no heating in there. Not great.

author: Julien X
title: Disgusting hotel, avoid!!
text:
This hotel is disgusting, so much so that my boyfriend and I had to leave and book somewhere else to avoid staying here - the receptionist staff are rude and unresponsive when asked direct questions. The room was absolutely disgusting, had other residents rubbish in it still and black mould growing everywhere. The bathroom was also unclean and looked like the cleaners hadn’t touched it in between visits. I don’t know what the cleaners are doing there but it certainly wasn’t cleaning our room.

The man on reception wasn’t even shocked when we left to find somewhere else which shows how often this occurs, honestly avoid this place at all costs! Stay in the Premier Inn!! Much nicer and CLEAN!

author: Evan P
title: Wonderful stay in Rome
text:
We had a wonderful stay in Rome. The hotel was beautiful, very clean, comfortable, and offered spacious rooms and an excellent breakfast. We especially appreciated the attention to detail and the warm hospitality of Katia at reception, who was extremely kind to our daughter.

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience and look forward to returning in the future. The hotel is also very well located, in a quiet neighborhood close to the Colosseum, making it an excellent base for exploring Rome.

We highly recommend staying at this hotel to anyone visiting Rome.

author: Oliver P
title: Rome 26
text: Location was perfect close to restaurants and 10 min walk to colosseum lovely hotel staff very friendly would definitely recommend.

author: Lauren S
title: Wonderful stay in this beautiful hotel
text: Amazing stay in this lovely hotel located in a quiet street near the Coliseum. The rooms were beautiful and spacious, the staff was very kind and we loved the rooftop terrace for a drink at night. We would choose it again in a heartbeat.

author: Adam B
title: Fabulous
text: Absolutely fabulous, beautiful hotel, staff and location.

author: Chloe H
title: Leisure trip
text: Excellent hotel supported by the splendid Katia and the mega galactic Virginia who made my stay at the hotel fantastic; maintenance is prompt and attentive to every small detail; we will definitely return.

author: Rosie A
title: Very clean hotel well located
text: To highlight cleanliness, location and friendliness of the breakfast and reception staff, specifically Karina, very attentive, polite and always willing to help with a smile.

author: Isabella W
title: Excellent
text: Extremely happy with customer service. The girls in the front desk could not be more professional (Karina) she was super helpful,professional, super friendly, super knowledgeable

author: Leo B
title: Great stay for our family trip to see Rome!
text: Beautiful hotel!  Rooms were amazing - the AC  worked so well and was so appreciated after long hot days of touring the beautiful city. Breakfast was delicious. Views on the rooftop were so picturesque. We were able to easily walk to restaurants and the Colosseum! Katia at the front desk was always helpful an d always available.

author: Alexander D
title: Very nice stay and hospitality by Katia
text:
We had a wonderful time at the hotel, but the absolute highlight of our stay was Katia. From the moment we arrived, she went above and beyond to help us with everything we needed. Her warmth, genuine kindness, and hospitality made us feel right at home.
Beyond the fantastic service, the hotel itself exceeded our expectations. The room was spacious and comfortable, the service throughout the property was top-notch, and the food was delicious. We couldn't have asked for a better experience and will definitely be returning!

author: Miguel I
title: Amazing 🥰
text:
The location of the hotel is perfect for visiting the colosseum. To get to the other side of Rome (Vatican city)  it’s around a 45min walk due to the extreme heat I ended up getting taxis. 
The hotel staff were extremely friendly and helpful. I went for my birthday which they kindly left a bottle of Prosecco on ice in my room for when I got back from a day out. 
I would also like to say thank you to Katia for helping my partner find a nice bakery so he could get me a surprise birthday cake. 
Reception was very relaxing, free water (lemon, mint & lime) available 24/7. Luggage storage facilities & help with ringing taxis for you. 
The room at the hotel was fantastic. The bed & pillow were very comfy. A-lot of free amenities which included water, shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, hand wash & lotion, tooth brush & paste, shower cap & chocolates. There was also a mini bar in the room to purchase drinks and snacks. 
I visited the rooftop bar a couple of times while I was there and it was very peaceful but quite hot up there. The drink prices were a little over average but I think you pay for the privilege of sitting on the rooftop. 
I paid for breakfast at the hotel and I have to say the selection of food on offer was really good. If you haven’t added breakfast I would 100% recommend this. 
I would stay at this hotel again in the future. Thank you to all the staff for making my birthday and my stay in Rome unforgettable♥️
