author: Oscar C
title: Brilliant experience
text: I went with my wife and son for one week,our experience at your hotel was brilliant, we had a very warm welcome and the staff were so helpful,at the restaurant or bar we were treated as valued customers and were always asked what we had done that day, food was first class , we had taxis booked when we asked and room was always perfect when we came back from our days out, I would recommend this hotel and would come back again, 100% for service and friendliness,  cannot find any fault,fantastic job.

author: Sophia W
title: Nice!
text: Great ambiance and wonderful hospitality! The front desk team was extremely friendly and helpful. Fantastic location—all main attractions were within easy walking distance.

author: Lucas F
title: A magnificent hotel.
text:
This is the second time we have stayed there and we will return in the future.

Special thanks to Katia for all her help.

author: Hannah C
title: Karina was so kind and helpful
text: Karina was an incredible front desk host. She greeted us each time with a joyful smile and always checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. She was super helpful and got us to our room with ease.

author: Antoine C
title: Would definitely go back!
text: Staff was very friendly.    Rooms were beautiful.  Breakfast was delicious.   Rooftop bar/restaurant had a fantastic view.   LOVED this hotel and would definitely stay there again!

author: Alice R
title: Near-perfect!
text:
Nestled in a relatively quiet corner in the heart of Rome, Room Mate Collection Mia, Rome Colosseum offers an incredibly convenient base from which one can explore the rich historical attractions that the city has to offer. It offers an incredible view of the Colosseum from the rooftop bar and restaurant, which deceptively makes the structure appear further away than it is, when in reality it takes only five or so minutes to stroll there.

The hotel is relatively small, featuring only approximately 65 rooms, which makes it a more intimate setting than larger hotels. Showcasing a spectacular view of the colosseum, the rooftop restaurant and bar offers not only a very decent dining option, it is where the morning breakfast is served - incorporating a generous spread of both hot (scrambled and boiled eggs, bacon and pancakes - although the pancakes are served at room temperature etc) and cold (yoghurt, fruit, cereal, pastries, cold meats etc) options. A well equipped gym is located on the basement-level floor (floor 0), and provides a decent spread of both cardio and strength training equipment for all gym goers. Although the hotel has more than one lift, only one was in operation during my stay, and was very slow. Many guests chose to skip the lift altogether, and opted to use the stairs, as the hotel is spread across only four floors. It is also slightly removed from the chaos and “hustle and bustle” of the main tourist-flooded centre, whilst remaining only a stones throw from various dining options, souvenir, panini and convenience stores. 

Tastefully decorated, the rooms are generously sized. They are equipped with an electronic door entry and privacy functionality, and a full minibar spread is on offer, with both alcoholic and non-alcoholic options available. A coffee machine is provided, with the standard tea options also offered for guests, all complimentary for guests. On arrival, guests are greeted with a bottle of water (which is only refilled from the tap by housekeeping throughout the stay) and some welcome chocolates. The bed is large and comfortable, and provided for a very decent night of sleep each night - a must after a day on-foot in the height of Roman summer. The bathroom is also tastefully decorated, and offers a large double-doored shower.

The hotel’s strength is most definitely the staff. Check in was prompt (although expect a wait if you arrive prior to check in time of 3pm), but was very polite. Karina gave me a warm welcome, and provided all required information regarding the hotels facilities, whilst apologising for the outage of the two of the three lifts. She kindly arranged for my bags to be taken to the room by a member of staff with me. The breakfast staff were also attentive. The lady knew us by face (and I love that she attempted to recall our room numbers from memory). Our plates were cleared promptly each time, and the food was replenished regularly. Just be aware that if dining on the rooftop, you will be competing for your food against the hovering wasps that like to linger. In saying that, it was hilarious to see the rooftop bar staff had a weapon to combat that - a tennis-racquet looking device that “zaps” the pests. Free entertainment at its best!

Given the option, I would rate this hotel 4.5 stars. I considered my stay in the hotel the highlight of my visit to Rome - it was so close to perfect that awarding it only four stars does not do it justice, but it falls just short of five stars. The provision of replenished filtered water in the rooms would be a nice touch. The staff, location and rooms are all fantastic. If you would like to stay in a hotel outside the tourist-flooded areas of Rome, but still in an amazing location only a short stroll from endless photo opportunities at the colosseum, this near-perfect hotel is a fantastic option for you!

author: Gavin G
title: Incredible stay
text: Lovely stay, amazing staff. 10/10 would recommend would stay here again.

author: Pierre Q
title: Modern hotel in great location
text: Beautiful hotel set in a great location. The room was spacious and well equipped with amenities replenished everyday. The breakfast buffet had a good range of food and had gluten and dairy free options available. The rooftop bar had a view of the Colosseum and the waiting staff were friendly and welcoming as well as the rest of the hotel staff. The metro is within walking distance and is  easy to use. There is plenty of restaurant’s around which serve fresh Italian meals  and a small carrefour locally with all everyday things you may need Highly recommended hotel and location

author: Poppy G
title: Great location
text: Clean. Friendly, great location!!  Easy to explore the city on foot.

author: Oscar B
title: Best hotel ever!
text: We stayed for a two night girl’s mini break. Best hotel I’ve ever stayed in. Staff were incredible, so helpful and friendly. Room was immaculate, modern. Hotel felt like a home from home. Amazing location so close to the colosseum. Everywhere was walkable. Roof top terrace and bar were a massive bonus and so well laid out. Hairdryer and toiletries all provided. Air conditioning in the room was amazing and silent! We LOVED this hotel. Don’t hesitate to book it if you are looking for somewhere to stay in Rome.

author: Connor Z
title: Wonderful Roman Hotel
text: I have stayed at this hotel on each trip to Rome for over 20 years. We have always been treated lovely, the breakfast is amazing and the beautiful marble throughout the bathrooms is just gorgeous. It is centrally located to everything and has the best pizza place in Rome right down the street on the right. I recommend the Pear and Gorgonzola pizza.

author: Ruby P
title: Outstanding service
text:
What a lovely hotel, the staff are outstanding ( went to the colloseum but forgot my wife's passport, phoned the hotel and they emailed a copy to us so we could get in OUSTANDING SERVICE)
The hotel is clean with a nice old school feeling with a lovely bar to relax in at the end of the day, it has central locations minutes walk to the shops and restaurants, (go down  the side streets and it's a lot cheaper, 2 mains ,water, two drinks and bread 50 to 70 E ) you are 25 minutes walk from the Vatican and 15 minutes in a taxi  20 E from the colloseum.
Fle markets on Sundays 20 euro by taxi.
I will definitely book this hotel in the future and recommend it.

author: Thomas V
title: Brilliant hotel, central location near to the main attractions
text: The hotel is in a fantastic, central location which means all of the must see sights are within easy reach. There is a metro station just steps away so if you want/need to use public transport then this is easily accessible. The staff were all pleasant and friendly. The rooms felt authentically Italian with their decor & the beds were some of the comfiest I’ve come across at a hotel in recent times. Breakfast was great, with a variety of choice & always plenty of space available in the breakfast room. We’d all leave full up after breakfast ready for a full day ahead. Later of an evening after a busy day of sightseeing, this hotel was close to lots of restaurants within a few minutes walk, which meant we didn’t have to go too far from our hotel of an evening to find food. We often found ourselves going later on for a sit by the Spanish steps as these are within a short 10 minute walk. I would certainly recommend this hotel to someone who wants a hotel in a central spot to all of the main sightseeing attractions.

author: Hannah J
title: Great choice in Rome
text:
Overall: well located hotel and clean, nice and very good service.

Location: as many others say, the hotel is very central and nice. 

Service: Very friendly, even when I needed to change room. Effective, kind and very professional employees. You feel like a guest, not a customer. Everyone is welcoming and friendly. 

ROM: 
All rooms are beautiful and clean. It is tastefully decorated and well equipped rooms. But the standard and DeLux rooms are very small and there are narrow and slow elevators in the building. Therefore, it is advisable to make sure that you book a room that suits your needs. We upgraded to one of the rooms at the atrium. That was lovely. Nice bathroom with luxurious products, delicious towels and bathrobes. The room is very clean and nice. 

Common areas: everything is clean and neat and neat. The breakfast room is cosy and we always had good space. The bar is cosy, especially sitting out.

Food: breakfast is very good, especially to Italy to be. Good selection of fresh fruit and proper eggshells. Delicious coffee and good selection of both sweet and salt.

author: Molly Q
title: An oasis of calm, coolness & welcome.
text:
I traveled with my partner and young adult sons.  We’d booked the deluxe rooms and they overlooked the courtyard; it was always calm and peaceful.  The hotel is a little bit quirky (one lift to the first floor and a smaller lift to higher floors) and the rooms are individual, beautifully decorated and the air conditioning was quiet and effective.  It was lovely to lie in the bed after a busy day in Rome and relax before going out to enjoy the evening.  The room sizes were not an issue for us, I unpacked and my partner lived out of his suitcase and there was plenty of room.

Breakfast was great, lots of choice and always plentiful, even towards the end of service.  
The bar area is beautiful and we had THE best Aperol spritz of any we had in Rome…we tested extensively.

All the staff without exception were friendly, welcoming and helpful.  

The location is fantastic…close to the metro, tram and bus stop.  Across the road from Piazza del Popolo and the city awaits…  You can see the Flaminio obelisk from quite a distance, so it was always easy to navigate home.  We bought a weekly travel pass and zipped about.  The buses and metro are good.  

We would return to River Palace in a heartbeat…Thank you so much for having us.

author: Amelia U
title: Great experience
text: Beautiful older hotel with a very nice lounge to relax in after a busy day of sightseeing. Beds were comfortable. Delicious abundant breakfast.

author: Sophia I
title: Vile and filthy puts it mildly
text: We had a wonderful Italian vacation marred by our final stay at the River Palace Hotel.  Where can I start?   Well, it went down hill fast when we were assigned to a room accessible only by taking an elevator up one flight and then taking a side staircase up 3 flights (yes, no elevator).   Although we booked and paid for a deluxe double room, the room measured approximately 150 square feet only.  Then, things got bad.  The bed consisted of a hard foam mattress with extremely flat and hard pillows. The rugs were stained very badly.  There was no comforter or quilt on the bed, but there was a comforter in an armoire.  When I pulled out the comforter, it was stained with what looked like dried blood.   Now, for the kicker, there were glass patio doors in the bathroom with only very sheer curtains.   To cover the bathroom from being visible from the opposite building, I grabbed the bathrobes to cover the patio doors.  Oh, the bathrobes were covered in body hair.   Let me also mention that the towels in the bathroom had been used and were still wet.   There were no other rooms available.  We stayed only one night and made our escape early in the morning.   The hotel was a filthy disgrace.

author: Amelia C
title: Elegant and Comfortable Stay
text: The staff were welcoming, professional, and always helpful during our stay. Breakfast had a great selection and everything was fresh and delicious. The room was cozy and comfortable, perfect after a long day exploring Rome. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city.

author: Oliver M
title: Beware! This Hotel May Steal You Money!
text:
Be warned, this hotel refused to give me a refund for a seven night stay I had booked and paid for several months before when I was unable to arrive in Rome due to the fact that the pilots from the airline I was flying went on strike.

As you can see from my reviews about hotels on this site, I travel a lot. So, I understand the way a good and honorable hotel will treat their customers. And, this is not it!

To tell my story, approximately thirty-six hours before I was to fly to Rome, I get a notice from Lufthansa Airlines that they were experiencing a strike, and my flight had been cancelled. As this occurred last minute, I could not find another flight to get me to Rome on time. Due to this fact, I contacted River Palace Hotel with this information and asked for a refund. Here is their reply.

“Thank you for your message and for informing us about your situation.
 
We are sorry to hear about the disruption to your travel plans due to the flight cancellation. Unfortunately, according to the terms and conditions of your booking, the reservation is non-refundable.

However, we can provide you with a confirmation of your booking, including all applicable terms and conditions. You may use this documentation to submit a claim with your travel insurance or the airline in order to request reimbursement of the costs.
 
We understand the inconvenience this situation may cause and remain at your disposal should you need any further assistance.
 
Kind regards,
 
Tetyana Filyants
Deputy Manager”

As nice as that message sounds, this means they are keeping approximately two-thousand dollars of my money. I believe we can all understand that is simply the wrong way to do business. There is absolutely no reason that they cannot refund my money. And, no excuse they claim will make their decision just, decent, or acceptable. They are STEALING my money simply because of a situation that was completely out of my control!

Keep this in mind, as it may happen to you if you book a room at this hotel.

author: Jessica J
title: Very good hotel in very good location close to everything
text:
It's the 4th time I come to Rome I've made the best choice this time. 
Very good hotel location, breakfast service everything perfect

author: Alexander F
title: Rome delight
text: The hotel was very nice, clean and the staff were exceptional friendly especially Greta and Musa.  The location was very good

author: Anna U
title: Fabulous birthday break
text: Had a fabulous five night stay in the River Palace Hotel. All the staff were welcoming friendly and very helpful. In particular Greta and the rest of the front of house team. Breakfast was excellent and the staff were very friendly and helpful. Also the location of the hotel made it perfect to see the sights. A great place to stay

author: Mason J
title: Rome in Feb
text: Fantastic hotel and very friendly, helpful, knowledgeable staff. Great location with easy access throughout Rome. Rooms were very comfortable and breakfast very good. We will be back ❤️

author: Sean K
title: Great accommodation in Rome
text: My family and I stayed for four days in Rome this early year and stayed at the River Palace Hotel. The overall experience was very pleasant, starting with Greta, who welcomed us very kindly on the first night and helped us whenever possible during our stay. The hotel is very well located, a few meters from Flaminio metro station and a Tram line. You can walk from there to the Villa Borghese and the historic center of Rome without much drama. The hotel is finely decorated, almost looks like a charm hotel. The room we stayed in was wide enough, though it was two-story (there was a staircase separating the double bed from the lower floor, where the bathroom was). The breakfast is very good. A short walk away is Via Del Corso, where you can shop and a lot of good restaurants (including the excellent Sud, which was recommended to us by Greta). For those who go with children, Explora is also nearby, a kind of "children's museum" where they can play and have fun. Anyway, I highly recommend and would return again without hesitation.

author: Liam W
title: Excellent Hotel
text: We really loved the River Palace Hotel. The location is excellent and makes visiting all of the beautiful areas of Rome quite easy.  Located within a few moments to the Piazza Del Popolo - we walked down the beautifully decorated churches and streets in the central area.  Rome for Christmas was amazing and I would recommend celebrating here especially where family members  live  in different countries around the world. Meeting in Rome for Christmas was perfect as the traditions are familiar, the food was fantastic and the sites beautiful.  The River Palace Hotel offered an excellent daily breakfast and it was clean, quiet, friendly, and professional.  I recommend it without reservation.

author: Charlie T
title: A Perfect Gem in Every Way
text: The best boutique hotel ever. The greatest staff, smart helpful patient available, they all speak every language and calmly put up with some of the most thoughtless travelers... They are full service day and night. The location is amazing, perfection. The rooms are beautiful and perfectly clean. They have convenient parking in the middle of Rome! I love this hotel, this was our second stay. I wish I could live in it. Thank you. And special thanks to Tiziano for going above and beyond to make the dates all work out.

author: Sara D
title: Great stay
text: We stayed at the River Palace for 2 nights last week post cruise. We had a lovely stay, hotel is an old building that has lots of charm. It is spotlessly clean, our room was lovely and comfortable. Breakfast was excellent. The hotel is in a great location for sightseeing Rome.  Staff were exceptionally helpful and the lovely lady on reception booked our golf buggy tour, we were collected from the hotel.  Great for those of us that can’t walk everywhere in a day. Thank you for a lovely ending to a fabulous holiday.

author: Pierre E
title: Unforgettable birthday.......
text: Fantastic experience. Clean, comfortable and quiet room. Hearty and above all varied breakfast. Location close to all the most iconic places in the city, you can walk freely. The reception and breakfast room staff are helpful, professional, friendly and above all ready to meet any request. Thank you for making the birthday unforgettable.....

author: Nathan H
title: Room Very Small and Rundown
text:
The room  very very small. There was very little room to store any items on a table, no place to put your suitcase so it was constantly in the way. Bathtoom was really small. You could not get dressed in the bathroom if you tried and the shower cubicle was very tight. My elbows kept hitting the sides when showering (I am a size 8).
The bathroom was run down with patchwork done and mould in the shower cubicle.
Bath towels were lovely though.
Carpet was filthy, I did not walk barefoot at all which is annoying after you want to kick your shoes iff after a day of walking thousands of steps!
2 lifts in the building. 1 which went from reception to 1st floor and then you had to switch to another lift from floor 1 to floor 8. This lift barely fits 2 people and their suitcases in. Very small lift. We were on the 8th floor which meant at times we were waiting over 15mins for the lift.

author: Caleb Z
title: Great Location and nice staff
text:
Great location and very nice staff.
Breakfast was good.
Bed was comfortable but bathroom had only stand in-bath shower which was not ideal.
Elevators are small, ancient and a bit crazy but you get used to them……eventually
Our room had noisy gurgling plumbing noises which was a bit wierd.

author: Maria Y
title: Perfect location
text: The location of this hotel is perfect. All tourist attractions walkable distance.

author: Anna S
title: Avoid at all costs!
text: Aside from the staff, who are friendly, and the central location just behind the Galeries Lafayette, this hotel should be avoided. I stayed there during a week of heatwave, and the establishment has no air conditioning. The fan provided only circulated hot air. The temperature in the room, tiny with a low ceiling and carpet, reached 95 °F: impossible to sleep there. As for the breakfast, it was very disappointing, served in a cramped and stuffy room. All of this for €250 a night. A completely unjustified rate considering the services provided. An experience I do not recommend.

author: Zoe L
title: Terrible hotel
text:
My room smelled very bad, I would say it was truly awful. 
I immediately informed the front desk.
I said it is lamentable to give a room like this, and he told me not to complain because there is another room, especially at that price, and then he told me that I am not pleasant; I told him, excuse me, the one suffering is me, I am changing floors with all my luggage and there is no normal help.
At breakfast, no one says hello.
The orange juice is disgusting, and the pastries are not good and frozen.
Breakfast where there are too few options.
Avoid at all costs.

author: Luca W
title: Disappointing.
text:
I spent three days in this hotel located in a very convenient and central position in the city. The presentation photos on various sites, including the official one, are beautiful and indeed convincing for a 3-star rating. In reality, the structure is quite different, with small rooms, uneven flooring even though covered with carpet, no wardrobe or drawer in the room, no air conditioning, and at night it was impossible to sleep due to the heat, no safe, and a minimal breakfast served in a tiny room.
In short, a two-star rating would have been more appropriate because the only thing three-star was the price: 900 euros for three nights.

author: Molly C
title: AVOID!!!!!!
text:
Do not trust the photos on online booking sites or the positive reviews.
It's a rat hole. 830 euros for 3 nights in a room less well-equipped than at Ikea... an old rack, a handmade desk made from 3 plywood boards... 830 euros for 3 nights!!! We are much more comfortably welcomed in budget hotels around the ring road for four times less. Avoid it, respect yourself.

author: Lauren F
title: Good value for money
text:
Very clean hotel- Sober room but with all the comfort and necessary -Quality breakfast 
Good location

author: Isla G
title: Successful experience
text: Selected for the location and price I was very satisfied with the services. Serious and professional staff

author: Wyatt O
title: Very good stay!
text: Very good for a short stay in Paris. The room is not very large but everything is well thought out and functional. Very good bedding. Quality of products available. Very welcome.

author: Holly T
title: Easy access
text:
It was very convenient as it was near the Opera Garnier and had cafes and restaurants nearby.
I made a reservation using Booking.com and specified two single beds. When I checked in, I was told that there were no rooms with two single beds available, which made me feel deceived.
I was very disappointed as I could have lowered the price if I had chosen a room with a double bed.

author: Diego F
title: Anniversary
text:
The staff is very friendly and the hotel location is fantastic!
We were very well received and recommend the hotel!

author: Jack J
title: Good for a short stay
text:
Very good for a short stay of 2/3 nights or for a couple.
We were 3, (2 adults + 1 child) in a Superior Plus room, and it was quite narrow.
It's a shame we don't have a real wardrobe.
Very friendly staff.
Very well located.
I would still recommend, but watch out for the room if you are 3.

author: Megan C
title: Disappointing
text:
Staff not pleasant, do not have to ask anything, deposit of 5€ per suitcase if you arrive before the cheking and the same for the departure
Overheated hotel, it was necessary to open the windows of the room, the same in the morning in the room of the
Breakfast is very cramped
Hotel and staff who enjoy the location pity we will not return

author: Benjamin E
title: well located, but expect no more
text: Tiny room and bathroom (about 50cm between the wall and the toilet bowl to enter the shower), window opening onto a reduced space (bad smells) all for an excessive price compared to the services, and the unpleasant surprise of breakfast not included

author: Luca A
title: Very nice hotel
text: Very nice hotel, ideally placed, very friendly team, good services, cozy atmosphere and special mention for breakfast

author: Louis Y
title: location and welcome very well
text: As part of energy saving, heating is too extensive in the bedrooms and even in the lunch room

author: Lucy M
title: Reservation for the pitch
text:
We chose this hotel for the location near the Mogador Theatre but we were very disappointed.

The photos on the site did not match the room which turned out to be very small, poorly soundproofed, and the bathroom was below what you would expect for this price.

Breakfast was good but still happy that we got it free in a special offer because at 16€, it is indecent.

Only positive, the staff was smiling.

author: Mason I
title: Enjoyable stay
text: We had a very good stay despite the small inconveniences due to the closeness of the place and the soundproofing on the hallway and other rooms.  The staff was very pleasant. Luggage storage for a few hours is a little expensive (5 euros).

author: Anna N
title: beautiful but not exciting
text: hotel in a strategic position behind the lafayette gallery, near the opéra garnier, one-way street but served shame the little space in the room for 3 people little place to put luggage without a closet, just a cart with some crosses, good cleaning and daily, staff not warm but polite, ideal for those who want a good location, right compromise quality '/ price.

author: Alexander H
title: perfection
text: everything is perfect to spend a pleasant stay in Paris and be able to access all the activities of the capital, museums, shopping, theater etc.

author: Mia F
title: Big disappointment
text:
Comes personally in December 2024 => 140€ per room (super, large, silent room etc) per day and taken over 2 days
this stay October 2025 => 220€ per room (4th floor, noisy, very small, dark) per day over 4 nights
Hence my huge disappointment

author: Nora H
title: Good stay!
text: Stayed here two nights. The room was good sized, beds were comfortable and bathroom was clean. The AC wasn't working very well..we went back to the room a few times during the day it was very warm in the room. We couldn't set the AC below 68. It was cool enough at night though while sleeping. Breakfast was good, not crowded at all like other reviews say. No issues waiting for elevators either. Pretty quiet for NYC also. The rooftop bar was great..amazing views! Great location too, near Times Square and Rockefeller Center. Probably wouldn't stay here again as we really didn't need a suite with stove and dishwasher, etc but it was free since I had won my stay in a sweepstakes.

author: Diego D
title: Excellent!!
text:
Our experience at the hotel was incredible, all the staff were super attentive and willing to help with any request, the breakfast is 10 out of 10, varied and super abundant, we loved the help that Jose santa fe offered us, he was super kind, cordial and very attentive to making us feel comfortable with the breakfast and with our questions, he made us feel at home.
Congratulations to this hotel for its very kind staff.
The hotel is super clean and the rooms, although they are not very big, are very comfortable.
The hotel's location is another plus that should not go unmentioned.

author: Kyle J
title: Great
text: We stayed here twice during the World Cup and had an amazing time! Huge thanks to Ynocencia for being so wonderfully helpful with our baby during breakfast. Excellent hotel and incredible service – highly recommended!

author: Rosie X
title: Friendly service and perfect location.
text:
I had an excellent experience at the Home2 Suites in Times Square. The hotel was very clean, the location is perfect for exploring the city, and the atmosphere was very pleasant.

I want to especially highlight Ynocencia, who was incredibly kind, attentive, and helpful throughout my entire stay. She always greeted us with a smile and was willing to help with any question or need, making us feel very welcome.

I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting New York. 
Thank you, Ynocencia, for making our stay even more special!

author: Aiden A
title: Excellent service
text: Excellent service from Ynocencia in the dining room 10/10 very kind treatment, she should have a better position with the service she offers

author: William V
title: Good option
text:
The location is very good. 
The staff is very friendly, especially Ynocencia, she is the cheerful soul of the dining room, she deserves a raise.

author: Alice K
title: Good experience
text: Excellent and very good service from Ynocencia.

author: Chloe M
title: Ms. Ynocencia Made My Stay Special
text: Loved my stay! Ms. Ynocencia made every morning so much brighter. Special thanks to her wonderful service! :)

author: Holly N
title: I recommend!
text: I loved the location of the hotel, it's super central. But I felt I was with a lot of people at the same time, which interfered slightly with comfort and attention. Outside it all OK

author: Lily L
title: Thanks to the Home2 by Hilton hotel staff
text: I take away very good service and kindness from all the staff who served us, especially the dining room staff Anita, Inocencia and SantaFe, they are excellent people, very kind

author: Paolo B
title: Thanks
text: Ynocencia is the best she is wonderful attending with a Smile

author: James F
title: A fantastic experience!!!
text:
Excellent service and attention. 
Of the people I met who served me very well are: 
Inocencia in the restaurant and Yalitza at reception, beautiful women, very lovely and attentive in their treatment.

author: Katie E
title: Excellent experience
text:
Excellent location. Very good breakfast. Room small but comfortable. Noisy A/C.
Fantastic service by Gurami at check-in. Superb, friendly and courteous service in dining room by Ynocencia, Ana, and Santa Fe.

author: Jessica R
title: Recommended hotel for visiting New York
text:
Very well located hotel.
Very friendly staff.
Very good service from the waiters (Danyushka was very attentive and even recommended several excursions and places to visit)

author: Aaron G
title: Excellent service
text: The hotel's attention was very special, they were very attentive to making us feel comfortable. Santafe and Edinson were very helpful and attentive, we felt very happy! Excellent service

author: Nora M
title: Excellent service
text:
Thank you, Santafe, for all your attentions; it is a pleasure to come like this, and we will return soon.
Excellent service

author: Caleb Q
title: Not a bad stay, but pay attention to your bill
text: I stayed at the Home2 Suites over the weekend to attend a Broadway Play.  Overall the stay was good, the room was clean, the elevators were not as bad as other reviews have stated.  I didn't witness any construction until checkout time.  The hotel is extremely busy, that could be reflective of the numerous things happening the last weekend of June.  It is definitely in walking distance to sites, trains, and of course Broadway shows.  Everyone in my party felt the location was perfect. A couple of people in my group stayed across the street at the Hard Rock.  I didn't eat breakfast.  My score is based on a couple of things no ability for Early check-in which I anticipated but even at check-in time I was told my room was not ready, fortunately I had left for an outing.  There was a lot of luggage being stored when I arrived, and they were stored in the eating area initially not sure if they stayed because I left, fortunately someone in my party arrived the night before so I put my bags in her room.  The app never notified me that my room was ready, so didn't get to use the virtual key.  I did ask for a late check out.  I was given a courtesy checkout the night before departure and told to check the next day, when I asked for an additional time I was told $50 for the two additional hours, yet was charged $100. Then when I called was told that a note was entered stating that I was aware, which is a lie.  I am a seasoned traveler and a Hilton Honors Member, but that's my fault for not asking for my receipt at check out.  I have never been told check out was $50 an hour at any Hilton that I have ever stayed out.  In addition one of the ladies in my party had paid for her reservation in advance, but was then charged again when she checked in.  They took care of it at check out, but it shouldn't have happened.  So I say just clarify fees, and pay attention to your bill.   Other than the billing issues I have no complaints. It served its purpose.

author: Giulia Q
title: The family trip.
text: The staff at the café is very charming and they are very nice, plus a chef makes waffles for me!! Very grateful for the treatment. Mrs. Yncociencia in particular, a big hug! 🤭

author: Mathis X
title: Great!
text: Top hotel! Breakfast was fine and you had plenty of choice. Staff are very friendly and helpful. Gurami in particular has helped us well. Room are neat and clean and have their own kitchen unit. There is a water point on each floor. The elevator can sometimes be a bit full but the higher your floor the better because then you can always get in.

author: Louis D
title: nice staff and hotel
text: This was a great hotel for us.  They don't have adjoining rooms,  but do have ones that are bundled up,  it worked great for us.  Breakfast was great,  it is busy but they keep the food flowing and did a great job.  Staff was great,  we had them hold our bags before we checked in and then again afterwards so we could explore.  They did a great job and they did a great job getting us back to JFK,  their limo service was cheaper than an uber for a large party and the car was waiting when we were ready.  Overall great stay.

author: Lucas N
title: Good hotel in central London.
text: Nice hotel, quiet and very clean, large rooms which is not common in british hotels, basic service, great location to visit London for a couple of days. Not the best breakfast ever, or value for money relation, but overall a good experience.

author: Katie D
title: Well-worth a visit
text: This is a very good up-scale hotel in a neglected corner of central London. Rooms are very clean, and a decent size by London standards. The beds are exceptionally comfortable. As a whole the hotel is very comfortable rather than luxurious, but that's the way I like it. Staff members are lovely, Breakfasts are very good, evening meals less so but functional if you need an on-site restaurant. It's a bit off centre but equally it's not that far from the sorts of places people might want to visit. The area itself is not much visited but actually of great interest especially: the historic Inner Temple legal area and the Temple Church, accessed through a gate in the courtyard behind the hotel which is always open on weekdays, and for much of the year also at the weekend; the Thames Embankment, and South Bank on the other side of the river; and Somerset House including the world-class Courtauld Gallery. There are some very good restaurants nearby (Spring and Toklas are excellent, and Covent Garden is restaurant-central). All in all, I highly recommend staying here

author: Taylor C
title: Great hotel in a quiet area but still very central
text: I was happily surprised with this hotel. Staff and facilities are great at a decent price for central London. The hotel has a beautiful yard and you can walk everywhere.

author: Lea O
title: Excellent value for money
text:
Excellent stay. Bedroom was lovely and spotlessly clean, quiet room and spotless en-suite. 
Breakfast was very nice, served by friendly polite staff to your table, some continental foods on the buffet. 
Would definitely return as great value and very close to many theatres and Covent Garden

author: Evie V
title: Weekend getaway
text: Thank you for a great weekend, we had a overal very good experience, pillows are awesome and I would really want to know where to get some if you can share?

author: Nora Z
title: Fabulous
text: Perfect location, really comfortable with excellent amenities, amazing views from our attic room of Big Ben, London eye right across to the shard. Room was large for a standard room with big bathroom and everything you need for your stay. Clean and quiet we will definitely be back.

author: Michael B
title: WONDERFUL STAY !
text:
A spacious room
A helpful and attentive staff
Delicious, high-quality meals
An excellent location !!!

author: Nora O
title: Beautiful stay
text: It was so nice to return to this lovely pleasant hotel again. We were warmly welcomed by all staff and to our great surprise we were given a lovely birthday card and sweet treats on arrival, just so kind and thoughtful. I love all the extra little toiletries and gaining another Shirley duck! Beautiful quiet balcony room, clean and fresh with an amazing view to Westminster and the London Eye. Fantastic breakfast and friendly, cheerful, courteous staff at reception and breakfast dining area. Excellent service from everyone. Hotel is also in good walking distance to theatreland. We had another really pleasant stay and look forward to coming back again in the future. Thank you to everyone at Team Apex Temple Court for making our birthday holiday in London extra special!

author: Jessica D
title: Quiet yet central location
text: We had quite an extended stay at this hotel and were delighted with our choice.  The Inns of Court provide an historic and peaceful setting, even though you are in the centre of London.  The hotel is slightly awkward for taxis to find, Our rooms were a good size - worth paying the extra. The staff were friendly and helpful and the in house restaurant, Chambers, was excellent.

author: Jessica V
title: A short stay in London
text:
A great hotel, an oasis on a hot busy London street.
We had a birthdays and they left some lovely surprises in the room.
Overall, a great couple of nights.

author: Elena X
title: Family Vacation
text: Great location, great breakfast, rooms are spacious, people were friendly. Outstanding value for a great product.

author: Jessica F
title: Top class hotel
text: Exceptional stay. All staff were absolutely lovely, the room we stayed in was gorgeously decorated, everything felt luxurious. Food (had lunch and breakfast) was delicious and very well presented and cooked. Bar area was comfortable and cosy. Everything felt really clean, well looked after and well presented. Location was perfect for exploring that bit of London and visiting theatres. Would highly recommend.

author: Tyler F
title: Nice hotel, Clean and close to Center of London
text: Had a good stay in this hotel. Clean room and a kind staff. Breakfast through menu-card, limited buffet  (first time I experienced) but personally I rather have a well sorted buffet.. I think price is on par with facilities and location!

author: Abigail G
title: Overpriced, mid-level business hotel
text: I've stayed here multiple times on business trips, but I try to avoid it whenever possible. The prices are targeted towards a business segment, but the overall quality is mid-lower tier

author: Charlie Z
title: Mostly eggseptional!
text:
Excellent location. Perfect and friendly check-in. Immaculately clean room and bathroom. 
Missing eggs off the breakfast menu meaning 8/9 items unavailable. Leaving the almost full breakfast the only option.Although cereal 
And pastries were good. 
Mattress was too firm for me. 
Easy check out and stored bag while we shopped for the day. 
A couple of free beers for our anniversary was a welcome surprise.

author: Paolo N
title: Always Comfortable
text: We had a two night stay in room 323. We are big fans of this hotel. The location is excellent, staff always helpful and the rooms very comfortable. It is our go to base when we visit London.

author: Tyler F
title: Excellent 7-day trip to London
text: Excellent hotel in a very quiet neighborhood but a 10-15 min. walk from everything you need.  Large room.  Comfortable bed, beautiful bathroom.  Clean room and excellent breakfast!

author: Ella R
title: Breakfast
text: Jash, I had an amazing time at the restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was top-notch. I'd definitely recommend it!

author: Antoine V
title: New hotel for us
text: Really glad we changed from our regular London to this as it was excellent.  Good location, nice friendly vibe and excellent staff attitudes.  All good and we will be back

author: Hugo M
title: Best Apex Hotel Stay in London – 16 Years of Reviews Confirm Outstanding Service & Genuine Care
text:
After 16 years of professional reviewing, Apex Hotels remain my preferred landmark in London and Scotland—I rarely stay elsewhere. Every visit shows clear improvements and renewed standards. The allergen leaflet was a standout: our severe gluten allergy was carefully noted, and the exceptional gluten-free welcome cake after a long journey from Paris lifted my mood and showed real dedication. Receptionist Gall handled check-in and check-out in under two minutes—brilliantly efficient. Breakfast ran perfectly on time for my schedule, with thorough gluten-free double-checks. Bar staff were always polite, unhurried, and ready for genuine conversation. Compassionate staff make all the difference. We’ll gladly return. Well done, Apex!
Best wishes 
Skomante Klein

author: Isla I
title: Great Boutique Hotel
text: Found the hotel by chance as I was already staying in the area . All the staff I met were very friendly & welcoming . Really good breakfast included in the price

author: Sara A
title: confrotable and quiet
text: a very nice and welcoming staff. A nice and confortable room in a quiet street but close to the Victoria station which is convenient.

author: Sean I
title: Unacceptable Bathroom
text: We stayed in a Double Room, which was situated oddly. It was 2 rooms and a bathroom no common area. The bathroom shower was disgusting. It had black mold around the caulking. The caulking was separated from the shower walls allowing water to go in and underneath the shower pan. The walls of the shower had built up soap scum. There was a rodent trap behind the toilet. The carpets were stained. There was no place to put a suitcase or dresser to store clothing. The location of the place is outstanding. But the cleanliness was unacceptable.

author: Evan T
title: Beautiful b&b in the heart of Belgravia
text:
Excellent b&b in a beautiful neighborhood 
Checkin was easy 
Late checkout was provided free of charge 
Very short walk to Victoria station, and many shops and restaraunts 
Would 100% return

author: Marco M
title: Mice in hotel room
text:
STAY AWAY!! 
While location is excellent, we had a terrible stay. Mice in the room. In the bed, in our suitcases, on the table. Needless to say we did not get a lot of sleep. 
On top of this, no reaction at all from management on this issue. 
Doors do not close tightly, so while you may believe we just had a bad room (#7) we saw them several times running out of our room below the door, and either into the kitchen or other rooms. 
Just stay away!

author: Sara E
title: Lovely place to stay
text: Really enjoyed our stay.  Excellent location if you want to be near Buckingham Palace and Victoria tube / station.  Room was spacious and pleasant, very comfy beds and quiet.  Breakfast was really good, plenty of choice and the full English breakfast was very tasty and a generous portion.  Everyone at the hotel was professional and friendly.  Many thanks

author: Wyatt I
title: Disappointing.
text: A rather disappointing stay. We booked a twin room, but there was no bedside shelf for one bed, it had been removed and was in the wardrobe. It obviously did not fit when the double bed was changed to twin beds.  The shower handle fell off and when you put it back, you had no way of changing the temperature. The breakfast room is very cramped and not big enough for all the residents if they arrive at the same time.  I was disappointed to be told that I could not have my croissant warm, even though the kitchen is in the dining area. My husband did enjoy his cooked breakfast.  Although there is complimentary coffee and tea, be aware that this is not in the room and if you are on the third floor it is quite a way to go for an early morning cup of tea. The staff were very pleasant but didn't have answers, it felt as though there was a lack of anyone managing the place. A shame as the B&B is in a very pleasant area, with good restaurants and cafes. Our room was quiet at night.

author: Noah E
title: Great place to stay
text: We loved the location as we only used the train for transport. We could also walk to most locations.

author: Anna H
title: Just Say NO!
text: We booked the B&B Belgravia sight unseen, because of its location to Victoria Station. Great location, but that’s about the only good thing we will say. We arrived in the afternoon and were informed that our room was not in the main building, but down the street, and on the 3rd floor. No elevator. The stairs were steep and narrow - 52 steps with 6 landings. I was hot and sweaty and couldn’t breathe by the time we got to our room. It was tiny – seriously, about 10’x10’ with a double bed that dominated the room. No air conditioning. No closet. That was a bit of a shock, but that wasn’t the worst part. The shower was filthy. There was a ton of hair in the drain, surrounded by mold, and bugs crawling around. It was revolting. We took pictures and then contacted our travel agent and asked if we could get a refund and move to a different hotel. The B&B staff said no. They said we didn’t need a/c because it was November. (But being on the top floor and after those stairs, it was HOT! We did have a small fan.)  The television was very small and old, and the remote control did not work. We checked for bedbugs, but didn’t see any, thank goodness, or we would have cut our losses and left anyway. Instead we found a store nearby and bought a strong bathroom cleaner. We used it in the shower twice and wiped away the mold and hair (did I mention there was a LOT of hair?!?!) and killed the bugs, so we felt better about using the shower. Our travel agent advised us to contact the front desk ourselves, which we did and complained about the unsanitary condition of the shower. We told him we had cleaned it ourselves, and he said we should have called him to come and see. We said we had pictures, and he said, “How do I know those pictures came from here?” In other words, he accused us of lying. The electric kettle was dirty and crusty inside, so we didn’t use that. We stayed 3 days, because we had paid $300 per night and could not get a refund! The hotel description said it was economical, but I strongly disagree. Housekeeping did come to make the bed every day, but that was all they did. They didn’t change the sheets or the towels or clean anything as far as we could tell. One good thing I can say is the bed was comfortable.
