author: Caleb Z
title: Perfect Location
text: A lovely wee B and B, just perfect for our one night stay in London. Great bonus of breakfast included.

author: Lily E
title: Great hotel with great location
text: Nice hotel with a good location. We walked to London Eye via Bukingham Palace. The breakfast was good and the staff were very kind!

author: Ryan R
title: Lovely B&B
text: The best B&B I have stayed in close to bus station and easy to get around London from there, breakfast was delicious and room lovely.  Powerful shower the only criticism is would have liked a kettle in room and we as a family are bit of a tea fanatics,  can get tea and coffee in reception till 11 pm but would still like a kettle

author: Louis V
title: No flexibility on missed reservations due to outside influences.
text: B+B Begravia had a 'No Refund" policy, but we missed our reservation due to a flight interruption on our connecting flight into London. We had our booking agent contact B+B Belgravia to advocate a refund for us, and I contacted B+B Belgravia myself, but the hotel refused.

author: Manon X
title: Miserable stay
text:
Was excited to stay in this area. Was celebrating my daughter’s 21st. Upon arrival everything was fine. Nice friendly reception staff said could leave our luggage as wasn’t time for check in. 
So, firstly the room - extremely hot. Had window open and if have young children I recommend not staying here. Window opened right down and big drop. Could easily fall out. 
Bathroom, an absolute trip hazard. 
The worst part :- the very loud banging noise ALL night. We had no sleep and couldn’t make breakfast as so exhausted. Was a real shame. I did a video of the noise at different times in the night. I showed this to the staff when checking up. Young receptionist girl said, sorry but manager not here. She said you should get a refund though for that. However was more concerned about what the noise was for the next person. She took my details and said manager be in touch. Of course he didn’t. So, I have been in touch with them directly. Absolutely Nothing!!!!!

author: Elena O
title: One night stay
text: Lovely stay. Lovely room. Clean and comfortable. A bit noisey as near entrance and ground floor but bed comfy so I slept! Breakfast tasty.

author: Elena G
title: Excellent accomodation near Victoria Station
text: This B+B in Belgravia provides simple but clean accommodations and responsive service within walking distance of Victoria Station. It is close to a large number of shops and restaurants, but conveniently located on a quiet street.

author: Ella O
title: Conveniently located a stone's throw from Victoria
text: Conveniently located a stone's throw from Victoria, clean and basic for a couple traveling to London. We will definitely keep it as a reference

author: Lily N
title: Great area, good price, clean and comfy room with a great breakfast
text: The location is great, upscale, yet close to Victoria. The room was comfortable and clean. Breakfast was great.

author: Jessica Q
title: Great location
text: Great location. Very friendly staff. Good cooked breakfast. Extremely comfortable bed. Quiet location bearing in mind how central this property is. Perfect spot if you are coming into London Victoria train or coach. The only downside was the toilet flush which was a bit temperamental but we got there in the end!!

author: Thomas G
title: Everything fine. Would come again. Good place to stay in London. Very good staff!
text: Would come again. Good place to stay in London. Very good staff and location. We enjoyed our stay very much.

author: George W
title: Net positive
text:
Our experience was largely positive with with a huge shout out to Kalim. 
The rooms were beautifully appointed with unique features celebrating the Harlem location.
Operationally, the hotel seemed to struggle with their full capacity. Our room assignment occurred 2 to 3 hours after 4 PM and our room was not cleaned on a daily basis.
That said, the front desk team was calm and professional.

author: Adam D
title: Great Days in Harlem
text: Great stay. Third time at the Renaissance. Can't beat the location. Very convenient to transportation options as well as walkabity. Check in can get busy at times but the staff is very accommodating. Thumbs up to Jaziah at the reception desk. Discount vouchers are a welcome touch. The lobby bar and restaurant can be crowded but hang in there. It's a fun spot. And you can't beat the views if you can get a high floor room. Looking forward to my next visit.

author: Amelia G
title: A nice stay at nyc
text: This hotel is brand new, the service are so nice, breakfast are delicious, salad Nichole and aamier are amazing , will be back!

author: Wyatt A
title: Outstanding Hospitality and Unbeatable Location!
text:
I absolutely loved my time here! The staff are incredible—so attentive and welcoming that they actually remembered me from my previous visit. A special shout-out to Kenday the bellhop, who was consistently patient, helpful, and kind throughout my stay. They also stored my luggage for free while waiting for my check-in time! 
Having stayed here twice, I can say the accommodations are great. My first room was perfectly comfortable with plenty of space to move around, while my second room was impressively spacious.
Don't miss the Victoria Restaurant! While it is on the pricier side, it is well worth it—the food tasted fantastic and the portion sizes were excellent. To top it all off, the location is unbeatable. You are steps away from everything: shops, street vendors, banks, subways, bus stops, and the iconic Apollo Theater. I will definitely be back!

author: Nora D
title: Good stay
text: The staff was helpful with ordering food and when my key stopped working. Rooms were nice!

author: Wyatt V
title: Who  knew it Rains indoors
text:
My family stayed at the Harlem Renaissance Hotel. This was the worst stay ever with Marriott.

We checked in on Wednesday June 24th 2026 to a 2 Queen Bed Room with a Central Park View. Our room had the following issues we found out on Wednesday evening from returning from our day in the City. This was suppose to be my Birthday Weekend present

A shower that allowed water to escape and cover the entire bathroom floor that we had to wipe up with the clean towels we had each time we went to take a bath. This issue was also a physical hazard which could have caused a slip and fall for me and my family members.

A TV that glitched and could not get a clear channel

Both issues were communicated to multiple front desk staff as well as the Front Desk Supervisor, Nichole Maurice who has tried her best to assist our family with the issues. We thought the problem was resolved when the maintenance guy put some type of guard between the shower doors and Reset the TV on Thursday evening, July 25th. We woke up this morning Friday, July 26th to see that water was now coming from the ceiling air vent in the shower all on the floor. We contacted the front desk staff and I personally went down stairs to speak to a mgr. The staff communicated Maranda Joseph the Front Office Mgr who was not much help who moved us into a Handicap Accessible room when my orginal  room was a Central Park View Room with a higher rate than an Accessible room. While my family had to abruptly pack everything up and move two floors up the Maintenance guy communicated that the problem we were experiencing was an existence issue and that he would need to deal with the room above us causing the leak around the toilet. 

The Front Office Mgr could have suggested deducting a night from our our stay which has been terrible. Moving my family in a room without the view I paid for and a TV that still glitches and adding points to my account does not come close to making this right. 

I will never stay at this Hotel again and so disappointed in how the Mgr handle the issue no follow up no communication with me to ensure all was good. Still no TV.....

author: Emma U
title: Best Place in NYC
text: This is the best service and value in NYC.  The staff is top notch!  I also use the facility to meet my family for dinner as well.

author: Emma G
title: Meh stay
text: I would rate this as a 2.5 - I was sure hoping for a lot nicer of a stay. I arrived early, and got to hang out in the lobby - and noticed everything just seemed grubby --- like the tables had water stains on them. The room was decent, but thankfully I was solo. The pocket doors for the toilet area would have been a dealbreaker. I had a connecting room - and all I could hear was coughing all the time. Small things were the more disappointing thing - front door you had to open yourself, security sometimes not there, gym was hot and missing wipes, gym patio had ... (wait for this), large glass pieces all over it (thick pebbles?!?) and in the patio paver cracks, along with a Qtip and garbage in the corner.

author: Oliver S
title: Not good for business meetings
text: Was very difficult working with the event staff for a smaller (30 people) meeting I had that included a room block. Not responsive to emails; I had to follow up and follow up. They did not have coverage for sales/event team when there were out or sick. I spent so much time following up. Requests that were approved were not followed through on. It was my worst experience meeting planning. Front desk staff was not that hepful either. The person who helped with out meeting space the day-of was helpful and the most responsive. But it was hard getting in touch with anyone.

author: Zoe J
title: Awful
text: This hotel really fell off. I stay here once a month and the last 3 have been a nightmare. Front desk is no help. Service sucks. Check in is way too late. They don’t assist with a late check out. Food sucks. Just choose another hotel.

author: Maria Z
title: Good hotel 🛏️
text: The hotel was quite nice. On the first floor, there is a theater. Almost every night there is a party on the 5th floor. Do not be surprised if, upon checking in, you find that money has been deducted from your account. This is because every day you have a $25 credit at the hotel restaurant (NON-REFUNDABLE). I recommend the cheeseburger from the restaurant. It was the best hamburger I had in New York. Please support me with a like.

author: Adam B
title: OK hotel, but the add-on fees make it not worthwhile
text: This was a nice hotel,  in good location, but it could’ve, and should’ve, been better. My biggest objection is the charging of the so-called destination fee. In my view, those are inherently dishonest, and shows that the Renaissance management treats its customers with content by adding on fake fees. In terms of other, more minor, issues the water in the bathroom was hot enough, but just barely.  The biggest attribute of the hotel was its location, but sometimes location is just not enough to make up for other issues.

author: Nathan I
title: Amazing Service
text: Joey was amazing, courteous, personable, and genuinely attentive. He made the experience smooth and enjoyable. Highly recommend!

author: Morgan R
title: My experience is a perfect 10!
text: I wanted to take a moment to just share about my experience at the Renaissance NY Harlem Hotel. First, when I entered the floor for checkin, I asked a representative where check-in was and they pointed me to the front desk. I asked the representative at the desk where do I check in, and immediately Tasha stated I could come around the counter and she would help me. I requested if there was a possibility for an early check in, Tasha stated she wasn’t sure, but she would be glad to check and see what was available. After a long flight, it was encouraging to be greeted with a smile and immediate assistance. Tasha went through the computer system and found a room that would be available. Also to mention, I had an original reservation for three days, but reserved another room to come a day early. I asked if she could make it so I just had one room and didn’t have to be stranded without a room in between the two reservations. Tasha continued in the system, acquired additional assistance from Daisa. They worked together and made my reservation fluid with one room, no change and before I could finish my conference call, she had the room ready for me. I just felt so taken care of, my experience is a 10! And in addition, I received a $25 voucher for dinner or breakfast. I will definitely book at this hotel again. The customer service here has been incredible!

author: Hannah V
title: Great place
text: Man this place is a beauty! The location of the hotel is in the heart of Harlem and easily accessible to public transportation. The front desk clerk Kalim Smith was extremely helpful and  Knowledgeable at his job. I highly recommend!!!

author: Erin P
title: Great customer service by Armani
text: I had a great experience at The Renaissance Hotel. Armani was extremely accommodating and went above and beyond to ensure all my needs were met. I’ll definitely return

author: Erin P
title: A Consistently Exceptional Home Away From Home
text:
Every time I visit, one word always comes to mind: consistency. Anyone who works in customer service knows there are both easy and challenging days, but the team here handles it all with a smile. Watching how they work proves they’re doing many things right. 
Check In Experience: Check-in takes place on the fifth floor, and when the elevator doors open, you’re greeted by the bar and restaurant area (more on that later). Look to the right and the front desk is right there. In my stays, there have always been at least two team members ready to attend the moment you arrive. In the morning, you’re welcomed with warm coffee or another hot drink. In the afternoon, expect cookies, hot chocolate in the winter, and fresh infused water. If your room isn’t ready, they’ll have the bell staff take your bags and escort you to a comfortable seating area. From there—just relax. They’ve got everything under control. 

Guest Rooms: The rooms are always clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The housekeeping staff clearly take pride in their work. Each housekeeper leaves a card with their name, so tipping becomes personal and easy. And if you can’t find them, simply leave the tip at the front desk and they’ll make sure it reaches the right person. 

Bar & Restaurant: If you enjoy a good happy hour, look no further. This is the spot for a strong, well-made cocktail and something delicious to hold you over before heading out for the evening. It’s also the perfect place for a nightcap when you return. I’ve never had a bad dish here. There are three bartenders I highly recommend (in no order): Kory, Gio, and Zack. They’re all knowledgeable about the spirits they pour, the menu, and Harlem itself. You’ll be in great hands with any of them. 

Exceptional Service: A special shoutout goes to Tasha and her team (she knows who they are!). She recognized me without even seeing me—just from my room number. That level of attention made me realize how much they value their guests. From that moment on, I knew this hotel would always be my go to whenever I travel here. 

Final Thoughts The value you receive here is worth every penny. The service, location, comfort, and consistency are unmatched. Tell them Eric sent you

author: Wyatt L
title: Great Service.
text: Stayed in February 2026 for event at Columbia. Every member of the staff was awesome.  The management seems to have everyone on the same page. This is type of service is very important. The only reason I gave a 4 and not 5 is that the room was very small, even for NYC.  The room was clean and was cleaned without asking even though we only stayed two nights.  Most hotels only do after two nights.  The room was a little outdated and beds were very low. I took the park view.  Never saw Times Square from this view point. I would recommend this hotel.

author: Sara M
title: Can’t wait to return!
text: Loved my stay at the Renaissance. From the time I checked in with Deja at the front desk, my experience with the staff and service at the hotel was top tier. It was quite cold in NYC that weekend so I opted to dine at the bar in the Victoria restaurant for lunch and dinner. The bartenders were very warm and welcoming, and the food was delicious. I really enjoyed the collard green dip. The decor, ambiance and aesthetic of the hotel is tastefully and beautifully done, and the service was phenomenal. I look forward to returning.

author: Sean W
title: Unprofessional Staff - Horrible Customer Service
text: Horrible customer service. I booked two rooms for  4 nights in advance and received confirmation directly from Marriott, when I showed up at the hotel to check in the front desk could not find my rooms. Supposedly there was no manager present, and there were no rooms available. I asked for customer service number and I was told they don't have it to google it. After wasting 30min on the phone with customer service and them telling me they do see my reservation on the system at the end I was told there were no rooms available anymore and the person on the previous shift over booked without knowing. I asked them to walk me to another hotel and they said no I had to find a place on my own to stay. It was 1am and I had my 3 kids with me and I was not offered any assistance. Pretty much got kicked out with forced to find alternative accommodation late at night and on poor weather conditions. I opened up a case afterwards and their resolution was "we apologize but there's nothing we can do"

author: Zoe S
title: Air conditioning is problematic.
text:
The hotel is acceptable, but in my opinion, it does not deserve a four-star rating. My room was nice but not very large (just a bit more than the size of the bed).  The staff is really friendly (thanks to the receptionist on Monday evening who pointed me to a good restaurant). The street is quiet. Close to the subway and the tram. 
 The breakfast is pleasant, but the choice of products is not vast compared to other hotels.
For me, the main problem was the air conditioning: it made very loud creaking noises, making it impossible to keep it on at night. Fortunately, I was there a little before the big heatwave.
Another problem: every morning I hung the sign "please do not clean the room," an option offered by the hotel to limit the use of cleaning products. And every evening I noticed that the housekeeper had come to clean the room.  So, inconsistency...

author: Samuel P
title: Pleasant stay
text:
It's a shame there is no connecting room 
Convenient transportation, but very noisy at night due to the street and the people in the hotel who do not respect those who are sleeping at night
Breakfast and housekeeping staff are very nice and attentive

author: Benjamin G
title: Poor customer experience
text: I'm not satisfied. My room was booked several weeks ago and I had the unpleasant surprise of finding myself a room for disabled people when I had taken care to call the hotel beforehand. My interlocutor made no effort to find a solution. I will not go back.

author: Lea S
title: Good Location and affordable prices with poor breakfast practices
text:
We booked this hotel through the BW website, and it turned out to be the most affordable option given its location and proximity to metro and tram stations. The check-in process was smooth, and we are grateful to William for his professionalism. We stayed with our family in two rooms for five nights and were given the highest, 6th floor, as requested during booking.

The triple room, intended to accommodate two adults and a child, smelled strongly of cigarette smoke, so we were offered a free upgrade to a more spacious family room on the second floor, thanks to the forthcoming and helpful approach of the manager, Violet.

The hotel itself is somewhat outdated, with small rooms and tiny bathrooms, half-detached curtains, etc. The tiny elevator, which could fit only two people at a time, added quite a bit of nighttime noise and vibration to one of our rooms located next to it. However, the rooms were equipped with modern air conditioning, which made it unnecessary to open the back windows for fresh air—especially since, instead of fresh air, you could often smell cooking odors from the neighboring buildings’ back doors.

The buffet breakfasts were rather poor and did not meet the standards expected from a BW Plus hotel, nor those of travelers who prefer more than a croissant and a cup of coffee for breakfast—especially considering the price of €18 per person. It was quite annoying to have to ask for bread repeatedly and receive the same nervous reply, “I will check,” only to be given 3–4 slices of bread for several guests. Joceline, the lady in charge of breakfast service, seemed to spend more time staring at guests and waiting for requests rather than replenishing the food. Sometimes, she even declined requests nervously, well before the official breakfast closing time. This was the first time we felt genuinely uncomfortable with BW’s food service, as it almost felt like we were taking Joceline’s personal food rather than enjoying a prepaid hotel breakfast. We believe the management should address this issue promptly if they want to encourage guests to have breakfasts at the Hotel rather than eat elsewhere—which, in fact, many tourists chose to do.

Fortunately, there were several good dining options nearby, as well as a well-stocked supermarket just a one-minute walk away. The neighborhood felt safe, and we had no concerns about security at any time.

The location of the hotel is excellent. It is only a 1–2 minute walk from the Porte de Vincennes Metro station, where you can access Metro Line 1—the main line that easily connects to all the major sights of Paris, including Notre-Dame, the Opera, the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and even to trains leading to Versailles and Disneyland (with a simple line change). Metro and tram tickets can be purchased directly at the Porte de Vincennes station entrance. Note that at some busy stations, such as Opera, tourists may be asked to show their tickets, so it’s advisable to buy them in advance to avoid fines.

Overall, Best Western 61 Nation is an average hotel offering decent prices compared to other chain hotels in Paris. Its convenient location and the responsiveness of its management are definite strengths that make it a reasonable choice for budget-conscious travelers.

author: Sofia V
title: Nice option
text: Nice location, Great experience. Close to the train and accessible for all. Fully recommendable a great experience  fully

author: Megan V
title: Not what we expected
text: The hotel does not live up to its price level. Some surfaces had been renovated, but water was leaking from the bathroom light (room 307, we showed video anout the leaking to the staff). The room wasn’t ready, we had to unfold the children’s extra bed ourselves. The staff seemed more focused on other things than the guests. The hygiene of the hotel breakfast was questionable — bread was placed on display with bare hands. Sounds carried through from the neighboring rooms. The surroundings of the hotel are not very pleasant. I do not recommend it.

author: Mathis H
title: Nice hotel!
text: Hotel close to public transport. Welcome, good breakfast with fresh bread and very friendly service staff. To see: small problems of operation of the TV (ch. 406). Possibility not to make the room every day. Good for the planet.

author: Luke D
title: Pleasant
text:
I arrived during the night, and ,the Young woman who was present at the reception informed me very kindly about the modalities of my stay. All this to contribute to a good stay. Very nice.
I hope the next one, I'll get a nice welcome too. 

. February 2025.

author: Alice I
title: Not up to a 4-star rating
text:
Nice and attentive staff. Good breakfast. Buffet; good location, quiet, close to transport; very good bedding. However, very small elevator (like 1 freight elevator), narrow corridors, small room, the carpet is very stained, leaving a doubt about its cleanliness and maintenance; Mini bar that did not refresh; good quality TV but blocked in store mode (TV features banner that remains permanently on the screen) the display is therefore parasitic...
Disappointed for a 4 star rating.

author: Emma X
title: Clean hotel
text: Very clean hotel compared to Hotel Twelve!!!! I highly recommend modern well equipped room

author: Evan Q
title: very good value for money
text: Hotel easy access, quiet and well appointed. the rooms are well appointed. Close to metro line 1. Very attentive staff.

author: Carlos V
title: not up to the standard Best Western plus
text:
no bottle of water available in the room on arrival despite your commitment
total absence of towel in the bathroom,
many unsucked long brown hair present all over the room at the time of my arrival = cleaning not done..
Very uncomfortable mattress and pillows.
Decoration of the room not neat
Buffet Breakfast not up to the price and whatever: you don't even know how to make scrambled eggs, yours tastes like spices.
And when I pay leaving the next day I am asked to pay 6€ more on the room while night paid with my loyalty points Best western Diamond Select.
As for the tourist tax of more than 8.5€ per person, I don't even talk about it.
In short while several planned stays nearby planned, I will never set foot there again.

author: Marco V
title: Stay Business
text:
Very professional welcome and varied breakfast.
Room 604 is spacious with very comfortable bedding
I will be back with pleasure!

author: Benjamin W
title: Very good hotel
text: Very nice hotel in a quiet area, the welcome is excellent and the staff is attentive. Very large choice at breakfast, spacious room and very clean

author: Andrea I
title: Memorable!
text:
I had a wonderful stay at this hotel, perfect for a couple stay. The staff is very welcoming, professional and always ready to help. The rooms are clean, comfortable and well equipped, with special attention to detail.
The location is ideal, close to the main attractions and well connected. Special mention for breakfast, which offers a wide variety of choices and fresh produce.
I highly recommend this property and will come back with pleasure!

author: Sydney O
title: Very nice and well located hotel
text: pleasant stay this Weekend in this quiet hotel and well located 100m from metro line 1. very good value for money. staff at the reception and serving breakfast very available. varied breakfast with a cheeseboard rich in variety and delicious farm yogurt.

author: Daisy Y
title: Avoid! Avoid! Avoid!
text: Please, please, please avoid this hotel!!!! Our room was raided a couple of hours after check in. Over £4000 of goods were stolen. We were able to trace all our Apple goods leaving the hotel as we arrived back after a short trip out. It was as if someone was tipped off about our arrival back, as 5 minutes later our goods were at the nearest Metro station. The hotel staff did not want to know. The door had not been forced, so someone was able to easily gain entry. There was a camera covering the front desk. They refused to let us look at it. As it is a small hotel and the front desk faces the door, they would see people entering and leaving. We went to the police station immediately and filed a report. We were able to supply a current address for our iPads but don’t think the Paris police could be bothered to chase it up. We then tried to claim back from the hotel as they should be liable. They assured us they would investigate but this has clearly not happened. They have not supplied us with any information concerning the ‘investigation’ and have ignored the last couple of emails. Absolutely disgusting way to treat customers and has left me very wary when staying in hotels now. Please book elsewhere when visiting Paris.

author: Anna Z
title: All right.
text:
2 nights without hitches:
- cleanliness RAS, 
- quality of the breakfast buffet,
- friendly staff.
- home 24/24
- no noise problems (I was down the hall)

author: Ethan Z
title: Disappointing
text:
Tiny rooms.
Smells like cigarettes.
Expensive breakfast with the remains of the day before then the day before.
Tiny elevator.
No water in the mini bar (completely empty by the way).

author: Hugo P
title: All right.
text:
Great location, convenient with all amenities around.
Too bad for the continuous noise at night but that did not prevent to spend good restful nights.

author: Nathan P
title: Friendly
text: Great location and friendly people

author: Nathan A
title: Great Weekend Stay
text: Had a great stay and the staff was very accommodating! Thank you to Elizabeth R and Alonzo for the great service!

author: Ruby K
title: Cordial staff. Welcoming.
text: Great place to stay. 3 minute walk to great theaters on Times Square. Clean, comfortable, quiet. Excellent temp control. Garvey’s is great place for breakfast and for drinks. I’d stay there again any chance I get.

author: Ethan B
title: For God's sake
text:
Horror!!! 
One of the worst experiences ever in New York
We book with the reassurance: "pay directly at the property, no advance required".
Perfect, except that a week before the trip I find myself $2,000 deducted from my credit card without any clear explanation. And it doesn't end there: on arrival we are also asked for a deposit of $150, which after 15 days has not yet been returned (at my phone call I was only told to "be patient").
1 150& should make them to us.. as a reward for staying at this place....
As soon as we arrived the situation was surreal: check-in is literally inside a pub/restaurant, between the smells of cooking and people eating and drinking. The
"reception" is a desk in the corner near the door. If we hadn't already paid, we would have run right away. Now I see why they're parading your money earlier. Otherwise at the sight of this "place"
Everyone would run.
Up in the room, the disaster continues:
• Lift with buttons attached with scotch.
• Small room, with air conditioning so noisy that you do not sleep. Options to choose from: dying of heat or dying of cold of cold.
• Non-working refrigerator that, in addition to not cooling, gave off hot air to the point of melting my lipsticks in the beauty that I had placed on top of the desk (the fridge was located below)
Bed so soft you could spend the night
to "go up the mattress", so during the day you walk around New York and at night, instead of resting a poor man has to go up the mattress....
• Non-existent cleaning: blonde hair not mine in
bathroom (I'm a brunette) remained there all holiday, a coin left on purpose on the ground never collected in 7 days, behind the bed old trash. Towels changed only partially we found the dirty ones folded as if they were clean. And in 7 days only
3 even partial changes in towels.
Cleaning is done every other day. Why is that? Mystery. We do not know... 
A nightmare. Holiday ruined

author: Anna X
title: Ruined Our Trip! Shady!
text: This hotel lost our luggage & ruined our trip!Natalia at the front desk told us to leave our luggage in a small black hallway by the front desk/door before check in & against my better judgement we complied. It’s scary enough to travel to NYC for the first time but they made it hell! Elizabeth at the front desk later on told us multiple times that our room would “absolutely be comped” and then told her coworker trying to help find our bags that the place was “ghetto.” We missed our Broadway show due to our wallets and etc being missing in our bags. Bags were eventually found but we could not get an answer as to where they were. Manager emailed us when we got home trying to say we will only be given $100 due to the full compensation “not being approved.” It’s even funnier that it’s been two weeks and we have yet to even receive the $100! We will be disputing this with our bank-Avoid this shady “ghetto” place as Elizabeth says! Not to mention the room had a bathroom trash that was full upon first walk in! Gross!

author: Emma X
title: Don’t stay here! Horrible.
text: No hot water. Not even a drop of it. It was a known issue with zero communication, even upon check-in. In fact, we booked last minute, so they were aware of this issue at booking but didn’t care or communicate this important fact at all. Their response was totally unprofessional and inappropriate. The manager ducked my attempts to call or email. Talk about lack of accountability. They gave me a measly discount for ‘my inconvenience’ which was a joke. They didn’t even adjust the taxes, which add up quickly, esp in NYC. This hotel was horrible. Sticky floors in our room and a lobby that smells like a frat. I will never stay here again even if they comped me a room. Horrible experience!

author: Ella F
title: Small, clean, in the middle of NYC
text:
We were here for one day. Room is small, but clean. Nice bed and duvet. Shower needs some introduction, but works after all. We had a room on 5th floor, back side. No noise from street, but fans of all sorts of restaurants, with all their smells, makes a lot of noise! At first I thought it was the airconditioner, but that was not. I guess the room will be very hot in summer, it was still now (daytime temperature 14°c). For one or two days ideal place to stay in the middle of NYC. Besides the noise, still recommended.

Needs to pay a deposit. Don't know when it will be refunded (wrote this three days after visit).

author: Morgan C
title: Horrible place the room was like a jail cell it was 7 by 7  i would not recommend this hotel shocard the worse i ever been in f
text: The worst experience from a hotel ever do not go there they need to give me my money back I'm traumatized from that place could not believe how the desk clerk lied and would not help out

author: Jack Z
title: Turn away if you love each other
text: Without hot water for two days with a paltry 20% discount on the first day and 40% on the second day. If the kitchen is off, many rooms do not have hot water, we left on the Third party day. Dirty room and noisy air conditioning. Accommodating and helpful staff but this hotel is a scam

author: Mathis O
title: FRAUD
text:
CHEATED.
We stayed at this hotel in July
2025 paying the facility to fully through
Booking.com.
Three days after our arrival, at 3:00 am we were charged an additional amount not due of more than 600.00€. We immediately contacted reception, who confirmed that this was their mistake and that 42 other rooms had experienced the same problem.
They guarantee we have already issued the refund and instead, despite several reminders by email and in person, the refund never arrived.
To the various mails, they always reply apologizing for the inconvenience and saying that we only have to wait for the credit to be visible on our card; in fact we have repeatedly contacted the issuer of our card (VISA GOLD) which guarantees that the refund has never been issued.

author: Katie V
title: A place not to be causes depression.
text: Came for two nights. This hotel is dingy, overpriced, offering very Miniature space of 22 feet with no comfort. The boiler broke down and there was no hot water. I was offered a 20% discount on each night and in fact I only got 14.9%. I will  never come back. In a word BAD in two word VERY BAD, Never again in this shocking hotel.

author: Katie Q
title: Awesome stay, near time square!!
text: Very accommodating with restaurant and bar attached. Clean room with balcony (7th floor). They let us keep our bags there before and after our stay.

author: Giulia M
title: Antonio is great!
text: We had a great time during the weekend of NYC pride! Very comfortable room, and excellent staff, especially Antonio the Night Auditor!

author: Holly A
title: Elizabeth the front desk person is the best
text:
Elizabeth the front desk person was amazing 
We are not familiar with the city subway system and she printed us out detailed directions how to get there and back to each destination.  
I would go back to this hotel because of her.  She definitely shows pride on her work which is so often not the case these days. 
The world needs more Elizabeth’s

author: Evie M
title: A/C Did Not Work and They Didn't Seem to Care
text:
We stayed here this past weekend for one night, but have stayed here a time or two before as well. Unfortunately, this most recent experience was not up to par. When booking online, no confirmation email was sent, leaving me to wonder whether I'd made a mistake. I booked AGAIN, and didn't get a confirmation email that time either. This lead to some unnecessary confusion with phone calls and emails to try to straighten out the double-booking. 
Most unfortunate was that the air conditioning in my room stopped working overnight, leading to an extremely uncomfortable night (the room was 78 degrees in the morning). The maid had failed to leave water, and there is no drinking glass provided...so i was pretty miserable overnight. In the morning when I let the front desk know, they said I should have let them know (in the middle of the night) that the A/C was broken and they would have switched my room or sent maintenance to repair it. Who wants to pack up their room and move in the middle of the night? Or allow a repair person in?? I clearly should have been compensated for the night, but they were able to turn it around and made me feel like it was my fault. When I checked out, the person in front of me was also having an issue with booking, and I heard another couple complaining to management about their room. So... this was a disappointing experience for me.

author: Pierre X
title: Great base to see NYC
text:
Hotel Shocard is not a resort. It's in the middle of Times Square giving you easy access to all the touristy activies.
The price of accommodation was extremely competitive. The trade off is that the rooms are extremely small.
Clean, well appointed, friendly staff. Thank you Alonzo, Antonio and Elizabeth you helped us to enjoy our stay at Hotel Shocard and NYC.

author: Sean Y
title: WHAT A DUMP!
text:
That Trip Advisor summarized this with 4 stars is a warning to always dig deeper and act on their recommendations with caution. The photos are misleading as is the presentation. This hotel is dingy, overpriced, offering microscopic spaced rooms with zero comfort amenities, worn out, apathetic and noisy accommodations that you could easily improve on for the money. In a word, GARBAGE DUMP.
Never again, couldn’t pay me to stay in this depressing, awful, misrepresented space.

author: Olivia A
title: Staff courtesy was the differential, along with great location
text:
The courtesy of staff was the differential!
It’s my second time staying at Schocard (1st was 5yrs ago).
At this stay, in the 1st moment I was in a room very very small, without windown and noisy.
After 2 nights requesting to be change, the front desk, specially Carolina and Cliff, were very niecely with me and changed to a better room, with more space and view to the street. 
For me, the location is the best or Manhattan, close by the main subway station (42nd), which is possible to connect to any subway line.
The room’s furniture needs a makeover, but its not a big deal to prevent the stay.
My special thanks to the employees, who made my stay very comfy.

author: Thomas Y
title: Hotels to stay at next time
text:
I used Shocard for a nine-night stay.
The hotel was right in front of Times Square, and the subway was right in front of the hotel, making it a great place for sightseeing.
The room was big enough for me to stay alone and clean.
I think the bed was comfortable.
It was a cold season, so I wished I had an electric kettle and humidifier in my room.
All the staff were friendly and even I who don't understand English was kind. I am especially grateful to Carolina for all her suggestions about tourist attractions, musicals, etc.
The restaurant on the first floor was also free of weird customers, and I was able to talk to local customers who sat next to me, and I enjoyed the time in the hotel.
The next time I go to New York, it is a hotel I would love to stay in.

author: Charlotte Z
title: One strength: the location
text:
This hotel is definitely the best place to stay.
On the other hand it is located above a pub and there is a lot of noise because the soundproofing is bad.
The rooms are small, aging. 
Mine looked out on a wall so it was always dark in the room.
The sockets next to the bed were not working and a metal bar next to the coat rack came loose and fell on me during my passage.
The air conditioning makes a lot of noise.
The drawers to put our stuff in are worn out.
As for the welcome I have to say that it was much friendlier when the people were men, with a special mention for Antonio who was top.
In conclusion I find the rates high compared to the services.

author: Ian N
title: Fine for NYC
text: It was fine. Expensive, but thats NYC. It was pretty loud at night but they do provide ear plugs which worked great. Gym is small but does the job. Breakfast is 6-9am but we didn't make it down in time. Subway is about a 5 minute walk.

author: Emma J
title: We were very happy here.
text: We had an excellent stay at this hotel. It was myself and my husband there to see Rush and just do tourist things. This hotel was friendly, clean and our room was pretty quiet. There were ear buds but we didn't need them. The air conditioning was excellent. We had a view of the Empire State Building and the full moon one night. The outside of the hotel was clean and safe with many options for dining on the same block. We mostly walked but also had easy access to and from the subway. We picked up a few items in the dining area during breakfast and they weren't the best but I appreciate that they offer anything. The bagel shop next door is great. The folks at the front desk were very friendly, professional and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay.

author: Thomas E
title: Family stay in the heart of the city
text: Great location and enough room for my family of four including utilizing the sleeper sofa.  We loved being able to walk the city and come back to a quiet space.  The included breakfast was a plus and it was plentiful.  Hotel was clean, a great value and every staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful.  The front desk helped us arrange transportation to the airport and provided waters daily.  There was also a refill water station in both the lobby and dining area that we took advantage of.  All of our request were met promptly for extra pillows and blankets.  If you are looking for a family stay in the city this is a great choice!

author: Carlos U
title: Small rooms but clean, friendly staff and environmentally friendly
text: The room was smaller than standard Hyatt rooms but that's understandable considering we are in a very compacted city of New York.  That said, the room was clean, the staff were helpful and the management  was noticeably environmentally friendly. Love the planters outside hotel lobby! I hope they'll find a way to get more sunlight for those plants!

author: Molly Y
title: Great stay in convenient location.
text: Great location, very good customer service, and breakfast bar was well done. The room was unusually quiet for mid-town and the top floor terrace, overlooking the Empire State Building, was really nice.

author: Ana S
title: Good hotel -
text: Good hotel! You can have breakfast there! And is exactly what you expect!

author: Molly Q
title: Not the best
text: Not the best stay at the Hyatt. I was assigned the 19th floor as I had paid for two rooms on a high floor but at check in time, we were informed the rooms were not ready. We were moved to 26th floor which is their highest floor and we (my children and I) could not sleep due to the constant banging coming from the elevator shaft. Seems the hotel ran out of duvet covers as our beds were made with just sheets. The dining area was not clean at the time we came down for breakfast, tables were dirty and food was on the floor it was quite messy and the breakfast options were quite limited.

author: Olivia H
title: Overall Good
text: Ok place to stay in the heart of the city. Expensive for its quality but serves the purpose. If in need of an urgent booking good option.

author: Sean S
title: Great experience
text: I loved the breakfast time there was enough variety. My hotel room had a good view of the Empire State Building which was a good bonus

author: Zachary F
title: The nicest hotel stay of my life!
text: The hotel was sublime, from room size to fantastic breakfast to the courtesy of the staff to the location.  Highly recommend.

author: Nathan X
title: Great place to stay!
text: We had a fantastic stay here. The location was very convenient -- walking distance from Penn Station and close to the Broadway theaters as well. Our room had a wonderful view of the Empire State Building. Breakfast was decent. We're very happy with our stay and would happily come here again.

author: Caleb P
title: Impossible to sleep... AND THEY KNOW IT!!!
text:
It is true that New York is a noisy city, but what happens at this hotel is crazy. 
We specifically requested a quiet room and they gave us the 23rd floor (which was supposedly good to avoid street noise).
What they did not tell us is that right in front of the hotel there is a rooftop with music blasting until 2:00/3:00 in the morning. 
When we went down to complain, they told us that we had earplugs in all the rooms and that they were not going to do anything, that it was not their problem. 
You pay a fortune to be sleepless. It is crazy.

author: Mathis Q
title: Great Base to Explore the City
text: This Hyatt Place is in a great location close to theaters and great restaurants and museums. The staff is friendly. The rooms are comfortable and there is a free breakfast buffet with lots of appealing options.

author: Charlie W
title: Above and Beyond Customer Service
text: Hannah, and the rest of the front desk and housekeeping staff went above and beyond to make my mom's surprise trip to NYC special. They decorated our room with confetti and balloons which was the sweetest gesture. It was the attention to detail for me and the special hand written card. She was very surprised. Thank you!! Rooms are very clean, great location, and I loved that the doors locked at night.

author: Miguel A
title: Great Stay in the heart of NYC
text: I have stayed here a few times, and I love the location and experience.  The location makes this hotel accessible to Penn Station or Grand Central. The staff was welcoming and wonderful.  Room amenities are perfect. Will stay here again.

author: Taylor W
title: Best location
text:
I chose this hotel for quick holidays in New York and have mixed feelings about this hotel. 
The location is unbeatable. Walking distance to some iconic places like Times Square and accessible from the airport by the public transport. Tons of cafes near by.
The hotel room is quite dated. The carpet does not look clean and the shower design is bad. Anyway, the price wise is better though.

author: Julien Z
title: Excellent hotel
text:
It is a very good option to stay. I went with my family (3 adults and 3 minors) It has an excellent location (close to metro stations as well as truck stops (we used the omny) which allowed us to move to all attractions. The hotel has everything we need, is clean, safe, all the staff were very friendly. Breakfast is good and varied. For example, one day there are hot cakes, another day wafles and another day French bread.  Concerning the elevator is good, and fast, only in some moments where people crowd (breakfast) have to wait a little, nothing exaggerated.  
We got a room overlooking the Empire so it was nice to wake up watching this skyscraper.

author: Noah J
title: Truly feels like home!
text: This Hyatt is wonderful!  I've stayed here 4 times now and every visit has been perfect.  Front desk staff is the BEST!!  Highly recommend.  Perfect location.  My room has always been clean.  Beds are super comfortable.  And the windows open so you can get fresh air and hear the city sounds.  Awesome views of skyline too!!

author: Noah S
title: Good value property with many pluses and a few drawbacks
text:
All in all, I would recommend the Hyatt Place Midtown South for a budget option in a great location, with important notes, as I don't think it would be the best for everyone. I stayed here 3-4 times during a 16-week period of weekly travel to NYC.

Here are the good parts!
Location
Great location for exploring the city. Close to Penn Station when arriving, with lots of subway options, traveler amenities, etc.
Staff
The staff was nice and helpful. The breakfast staff works so hard for you.
Rooms
The rooms are a good size for NYC. The views can be really nice from the top floors.

Here are the challenging parts
Rooms
Rooms facing 35th street have A LOT of street noise. I think Wednesday overnight, they do the trash on 36th, which is really noisy. I moved to a lower floor (6) to be on the quieter side, which didn't have any view.
The rooms are getting a bit dated and showing signs of wear and tear
Hotel Capacity
No matter how busy the rest of the city is they pack this hotel to the gills. I stay at Hyatt about 40+ nights a year and usually get an upgrade, but didn't receive one to see one of the good (quiet side) city view rooms. This capacity filling also makes the breakfast not a great experience. So many people!

If this hotel were renovated, including better insulated windows for sound, I would be back for sure.

author: Leo V
title: Great stay!
text: The location of the hotel was great, near stores, restaurants and close to subway stations. The hotel staff were great, Franco specifically was very helpful. You can store luggage there upon early arrival or late departure so you can explore the city. We had an Empire State Building view that was absolutely amazing. The hotel was quiet too, no street noise. The free breakfast was great too, full hot breakfast along with cereal, toast, bagels and oatmeal. The coffee and tea area was great too. There were 5 in our room and the sofa bed was comfortable as well as the queen size beds. We would definitely stay here again.

author: Charlotte H
title: WELL LOCATED, but....
text:
I have been to this hotel several times, which is very well located, near the subway, theaters, restaurants, and shops; 
The rooms are small, but comfortable and clean. Several times, the elevator was out of order....... I did not return because the prices had increased terribly after covid.

author: George K
title: Very good
text:
Qualified and friendly staff, clean, tidy and comfortable rooms. Very quick check in and check out. Great location.
Recommended!!

author: Zoe X
title: Excellent
text: Small b&b in Montmartre, small but comfortable and very central. The staff was friendly and helpful.

author: Olivia Y
title: 3 days City
text: The hotel is super central.the staff are very friendly and very helpful.we were nicely received and the room on the 6 floor was also ok.great view,the breakfast as well as the coffee was fully adequate and it was delicious ,you can recommend very well

author: Isla E
title: Excellent experience
text:
We just stayed at this small hotel in the 9 arr of Paris. The location is strategic, close to two metro stops, a short walk from rue de la fayette and Opera. A 15 min walk from the quaint Montmatre district. If you want you can walk to any site of interest.
Our room on the top floor was bright and spacious, maybe a little dated, but we were not there to spend the days in the room... anyway, despite being in the center, very quiet. Very comfortable beds.
Good breakfast.
The staff was very kind and helpful. A special mention to the nice Mr. Oliver who was able to give us valuable guidance.
I highly recommend this property

author: Jack F
title: Don't ever come here!
text:
This hotel has no qualms to check guests into a room with a bathroom door that cannot be closed proper. Because the door cannot be closed fully and leaves a gap,  a ray of morning sun enters the room on my side of bed when the sun rises in the morning.

Seriously, how long does it take to replace a door handle?

Paint was also chipping off the wall and ceiling at the bathroom window and falling onto the floor below it every day.

And obviously, these are not just oversights or new issues. It was a rushed and last minute booking so I had missed out on reviews online about these issues.  

This plainly shows how much the hotel cares!

I give it 0/5 but the minimum here is 1/5, so...

What would  you make of this - my above post at Google Review was REMOVED!  And when I re-posted a 2nd time after I  discovered,  it was REMOVED yet again!  Ho ho...

And the hotel responded to Vio whom I booked the room with and feedback-ed to with: 

hotel:  ‘While we take all reviews seriously, past comments do not allow us to identify the specific guest, room or the exact issue at the time of the stay.'

my response:  

the hotel is saying it had not 'MANAGED’ to spot these issues for MONTHS from the time they were encountered by guests before me, till my feedback in late January. my stay was late dec and i feedbacked to Vio in late January.  

Or, are these issues just so rampant at the hotel such that they are ‘just another day at Pavilion Opera Grand Boulevards’ and no one sees any need to do anything about  them as the hotel is rotting anyways?   :)

hotel:   ‘These matters had not been reported previously for this room or identified during our inspections.  Once they were brought to our attention, they were addressed promptly.’

my response:   the hotel is confirming it failed to identify these issues EVEN during its routine room INSPECTIONS for nearly 1 good month!  That it only promptly rectified the issues, alas, nearly 1 month after my stay, when it received my feedback from Vio.

For clarity, I stayed at the hotel in late Dec, checked out 31 dec.  .  I feedback to Vio only in late January.  :)

I am just giving my plain honest feedback.

with love …

author: Zachary M
title: Cosy
text:
Arrived on January 1, we were greeted by a very nice and helpful gentleman.
Clean room, small but comfortable.
Breakfast basic but good.
I recommend it for convenience and strategic point.
The only shame that the heating is not so hot but still in the room there is a fan heater.

author: Holly O
title: Quiet hotel, in a convenient area for travel and well stocked by restaurants
text: I stayed at this property for 4 days, for the first time in Paris, booking from the lastminute.com website.I must say that I really enjoyed it! The area is quiet but full of good places to dine (note the crème de Paris for a quick bite and Chartier Bouillon for a typical French dinner). Very close to the Grand Boulevard metro station, served by metros 8 and 9 which are very useful to see the center without having to change. We have seen many areas even from walking from this hotel. Nice rooms, very well cleaned and renovated, not very large. Very kind staff, they brought forward the check-in time and allowed us to leave our luggage after check-out for free. On request they also printed the plane tickets for free.

author: Lucy R
title: Stayed September 2025
text: Staff attentive, a kind gentleman at Welcoming called Olivier. Very average room, pity no air conditioning and very complicated the electrical system to connect a fan. Fortunately we had an upgraded room in the rooftops, so a little larger than the classics which are quite small. But very comfortable and no noise

author: Ethan R
title: Experience Fantastic
text: The hotel was very clean and clean. I stand out for the treatment of the staff, especially Fernando, a very attentive man and his explanations were magnificent. He treated us like we were his family. We'll be back again.

author: Zoe B
title: Amazing experience
text: We've had an amazing time, upgrade would be fantastic but we have not travelled to stay in the hotel. The beds are so comfortable best ive ever stayed in. Staff are all fantastic but we must give an extra special thank you to Fernando

author: Daniel G
title: Alright.
text: Really good location, easy to navigate and 15 min walk from Gare du Nord (train station that we got off at from the airport). Reception staff are lovely. Room was small but was exactly what we wanted as it was just somewhere to sleep. No AC which meant the room was really warm, I found it difficult to sleep the first night due to this. A fan was provided but seemed to just blow hot air. We booked breakfast which was incredibly basic and confusing. It's a help yourself sort of layout which I had never experienced before and we weren't told this and when we were looking for food, no one helped us even though it's right in the middle of the reception area. The fridge was hidden as was the crockery. We said we'd maybe stay here again given it was a cooler season but we would not opt for the breakfast. Also the shower was not attached to the wall so it was difficult to actually wash yourself properly.

author: Hannah V
title: Unbearable heat in the room and sleep-free nights
text:
If there was a price for the loudest and hottest accommodation, this hotel would be at the forefront. Already at check-in we noticed: The room was located directly on the street side – the noise from the outside did not make you think of sleep. With the windows closed? Unthinkable, because the air conditioning did not work. And so we had to listen to Parisian nightlife with our windows open – until early in the morning.

Especially "creative": As a solution, we were given a cheap, noisy fan in the already cramped room. Its cooling capacity? Minimal. His noise level? Maximal.

The bathroom window? Defect. It could not be closed or locked properly. This exposed the room to the blazing sun during the day, with no way to shut out the heat.

The photos prove:

defective window mechanism,

an air conditioner that was switched on but did not bring anything,

a simple tower fan as "compensation" for a completely overheated room.

Of course, the hotel is very centrally located – but what good is that if you spend the nights sweating and sleepless?

In my opinion: Only for heat-resistant night people who love party noise. For everyone else: Finger weg!

author: Lucia T
title: Hot room!!!! No A/C!!!!
text:
There is no A/C in the entire hotel.
The room is very hot.
Staying in this hotel during the hot summer is inconvenient.
If you pop a window open, there is too much noise outside. 
Please read the amenities in their website before booking to avoid inconvenience.

author: Owen Q
title: I would stay here again for sure!
text: This is a wonderful budget friendly hotel! Across from the Follies Bergère and near ‘Japan town’ so many Ramen restaurants! Also in the center of many, many covered passages. Walking distance to the Palais Garnier and the famous shopping stores. There is a convenience store a block away! For families…the triple rooms have a pull out couch and you would feel safe ducking across the street to grab a drink at the cafe after putting them to bed, if your children are older. The staff was wonderful and so accommodating!  Just wonderful. I would stay again!
