author: Amelia W
title: Great location. Room was small but the staff made it all worth while.
text:
The area was perfect for sightseeing which is what we were there for. We walked everywhere (our choice) and the Eiffel Tower was a 45 minute walk which was fine. Good Metro service which we only used once. The room was very small (you opened the bathroom door onto the side of the bed) as was the bathroom but it was all clean. The bed was nice with lovely pillows. 
No coffee/tea facilities in the room which was sad BUT, the two lovely men who ran reception were the most helpful people. Ferdinando and Olivier could not do enough for us. They both completely made our stay. Starbucks (other coffee establishments are available) was literally just round the corner. I would go back here but I’d ask for a bigger room.

author: Lucy F
title: The best stay in Paris (5 times)
text: Has an incredible time from start to finish. Olivier was beyond helpful. A true gentleman with incredible humour and service. We had the very best time, helped by Oliviers recommendations and professionalism. Thank you and we will return.

author: Manon A
title: City break
text:
Our stay was short but fantastic. Great customer service , easy check in and check out,very close to city centre. It was first time visiting Paris for me and my fiancé’ and the receptionist made our stay memorable, making sure all our needs are met. Our stay in Paris was a present for my fiancé birthday, I spoke beforehand with the receptionist about a special request I had , and he made sure as well that we receive the best service . Very kind and polite , very helpful , his recommendation for a great culinary experience was on point. The room itself quite small but for our needs was perfect. Very very happy with the customer service and the whole experience. Highly recommend Pavillon Opera Grand Boulevard!!

Merci beaucoup , à la prochaine! 

Alex & Georgiana

author: Kyle S
title: VERY SMALL ROOM
text: Central hotel, good location, the shame is that the rooms are super small, there is hardly space in them and in the hotel, all the spaces are very tight, I would highlight the excellent treatment with the reception staff, recommended

author: Lauren J
title: Great.
text:
Very nice experience and very welcome 
As I said before leaving the hotel, the pleasure of having stayed in Paris was partly due to this state of affairs 
Very clean and very well soundproofed room 
We'll come back to that. 
I highly recommend

author: Henry X
title: Absolute ripoff
text:
I spent £250 staying at the dump. It was a very hot night in London and my hotel had no air conditioning. So I checked out and traveled across London to stay in the ‘fully air conditioned rooms’. I spent my £250 checked in, only to be told that ‘oh yea, sorry the air conditioning doesn’t work in that room. We can give you a fan!’. So I am sat here with a tiny window that opens into a well that contains all the working AC units, so any air that does make it in is baking hot.
So my advice is don’t believe anything anyone says about this hotel. The place is an absolute dump and they will scam you for every penny they can get.

author: Daniel B
title: Won't stop there again
text:
Location brilliant for Buckingham Palace
Nice and friendly
Rooms are expensive 
Value 5 out 10
No restaurant for evening meal. You could order in and eat in the room where they serve breakfast
Breakfast is continental only, despite someone posting their omelettes were cooked to order.

author: Ruby F
title: Good hotel if you're watching Wicked
text: A great little hotel l, just 5 minutes walk from Apollo Victoria (Wicked). Room was clean and perfectly usable for an overnight stay. Super shower! Breakfast was ok, continental with a few choices but perfectly adequate.  Friendly staff, would recommend for a cheap break in Theatre Land.

author: Anna Q
title: Good hotel, privileged location
text: Good hotel, room is small but very comfortable. Breakfast good but simple, has the potential to improve guest experience. The best thing was the location that allowed us to make various travel with quite ease. My reservation was regarding the hygiene of the room because when I picked up a Lego from my son on the floor I was quite surprised by the amount of dust that was under the beds. I suggest you do a more thorough cleaning!

author: Camille V
title: A good hotel
text: After we'd booked we read some reviews and as a result almost cancelled our booking. So glad we didnt. We asked for a top floor room - it was really quiet and a good room for the price. No complaints at all. It was a continental breakfast but quite a good variety. Would stay there again.

author: Ana P
title: Not the most comfiest of stays....
text:
Great location, staff were plesant, check-in was speedy, and room was ready on time. 

We were allocated a room on the ground floor round the back. Our room was down some stairs, and through a pointless door to our room door, strange layout.  The room was compact, clean, had a hairdryer, iron and board, and tea & coffee making facilities, plenty of hot water and a powerful shower.  I found the room stuffy and had the air con on in January! If your 'neighbour' above wakes before you then you're pretty likely to too, you can hear every footstep!  Oh and not forgetting the noise from the underground. 

This place didn't really provide us with the most comfiest of stays and we're unlikely to return in future.

author: Paige J
title: Beware basement rooms
text:
I stayed here for one night while working nearby in Victoria. I was given a basement room, which had a frosted window which didn't let in any real light. I could hear people walking past, trains on the nearby railway sounded like I was right under a flight path, and before 7am there was a lot of banging around and what sounded like rubbish bags being thrown around. It was very noisy. The heating unit was set high with no way of controlling it, but I didn't want to open the window being a lone female and my room then being accessible from the street.
The hotel has a strange layout, and I had to consult the map on the back of the room door to remember where the lift was (inside the breakfast room) when leaving in the morning.
Breakfast was okay for a continental but nothing special - bread/toast, two types of pastry, four cereals, yoghurt, fruit, cheese, ham, and a pancake maker. Juice, water, tea, and coffee.
Staff were friendly.
If you have limited budget this would be an okay place to stay, but next time I am in the area on business I will be going elsewhere.

author: Andrea D
title: Terrible customer service
text: Unwilling to be understanding of flight delay despite giving them notice early in the day that we would not make it. Only hotel I have ever dealt with that still charged 1 nights room & tax instead of being understanding during the stress of travel delay. Book Elsewhere!!

author: Joseph L
title: Cosy
text: Cozy hotel in quiet area. Very close to Victoria station to metro and bus station. Friendly smiling and helpful staff , reception open 24 h . Good breakfast with sweet and savory also the pretty breakfast room. Room: small but well cleaned, modern furnishings cute essential, french bed a little small but ok, floor and not the annoying carpet. nothing was missing c there was also ironing board and iron , coffee maker or tea. Bathroom also here small but equipped with everything beautiful shower always perfect water. Daily towel change although not required and room tidied up every day, which I nn found in a Nh hotel. If I return to London I would have no doubt about it I would choose him again. Good job to all the staff

author: Isabella N
title: Avoid of you actually want any sleep.
text:
Absolutely the worst and noisiest hotel I've ever stayed at. 

My room was next to a traffic light on the ground floor, with noisy cars and bikes going all night. Supposedly 'sound proofed', it's wasn't. 

Also dust and cobwebs in the room.

author: Juan V
title: Odd Room
text:
Took elevator to 2nd floor then had to go down steps with luggage to room. 
Seems like on 1.5 floor. The room had an odd floor plan. Got in front door and saw bathroom to the left and sink is outside from bathroom door. Unit felt like an inlaw add on to hotel. It was hot during my stay and had to open the windows because air conditioning was not that strong. Also A/C was loud. Windows should have screens to prevent insects flying in. Saw hair (not mine) in bedsheet. Chose this hotel mainly because of location near London Victoria. Along this street are many small hotels. Next time there, I'll check on the other hotels.

author: Evie R
title: Hidden Gem in Victoria
text: We stayed 2 nights on each end of a multi-country cruise.  First, rates are different depending on which site you use, so check out a few.  Both times, (different rooms) we were happy with our stay.  The location is great- right near the train and bus station, convenient walking to local pubs (St. George's Tavern, next door, was our favorite.), stores and a supermarket. They certainly do a lot in a small space! The rooms are quite small, but recently renovated and very nicely done.  There is an elevator. The whole facility is immaculate. There is an optional breakfast available, though it is just basic. The staff at reception is exceptional.  They are so kind and pleasant, despite having to deal with quite a crew of grouchy travelers. "Check in is at 2PM"- so when folks arrive at 10 and are told their room isn't ready they become quite grumpy.  There is a comfortable lobby available, and they will keep your bags if you want to explore while you wait for check in. We would definitely stay there again.

author: William S
title: Great x visit London
text: Super optimal location x move by bus and tube to all over London, practically opposite the tube. Very nice also the victory area with pubs and clubs. Vote zone 10! Very small but very nice and modern rooms. I found many stains in the interior of the sleeping duvets x the bed and this was certainly not nice. Comfortable beds. Very poor breakfast! There was no honey, no bacon or sausage, only two kinds of jam, pun cake only One day..

author: Daniel M
title: Close to Victoria Station, family of 4
text:
Got this as our main base while we go about London. Its location is very good, across a pub and about 30 steps to Victoria station where you can easily get transportation, and food. It is close to Buckingham palace,Green park and Westminster. 

Rooms are sufficient and clean, it has a/c so that is amazing. The family room can sleep 4 people and that is a plus in our books. Lobby is small and intimate. There are no lifts in this place so be careful specially if you have heavy luggage’s.

The floors are very thin and noisy and if that person above you decided to move furniture at 3pm, YOU WILL HEAR IT. One other thing is that there is someone in the reception that reeks BO and if that person is the first point of contact by the guest, it is a major turn off and reflects the business and brand.

author: Brooke X
title: Stay Away – Uncomfortable and Unresponsive Service
text: The air conditioning remote was missing from the room, and no one could provide a replacement despite multiple requests. I had to leave the windows open just to get some air, but there were no screens or barriers—meaning bugs or animals could easily get in. Overall, this was a frustrating and uncomfortable experience. I would strongly recommend staying elsewhere.

author: Pierre K
title: Not a Normal Comfort Inn and Suites
text: This hotel was not what we expected. They say they have elevators but they have these odd rooms which we got that you still have to drag your luggage up 14 stairs but it is considered on the first floor so the elevator does not go there. It was terrible. I asked for a room change and the guy was not willing to work with us even though he had rooms available. The AC was subpar and the room was very hot. (you need to keep your room card in a slot by the dooor to keep the lights on?) They did not have a phone in the room or provide any ice or fridges like most hotels offer. They told us to go to the pub across the street and they would give us ice? Crazy I know. They dont give you wash cloths as well. The shower door would not close properly and water would go out on the floor. The bed was also hard as a rock. I could have slept in a tent outside and been cooler and happier. P.S. One of the few choice hotels that make you pay for the free breakfast. So, not a place where I would want to stay again. Staff not helpfull, ammenities are poor, the only thing it has going for it, it is close to the Victoria Station for buses and Trains. Kinda like staying at a Hostel.

author: Miguel F
title: Great hotel in  great location close to Victoria station
text: Great hotel the staff were friendly.  Very clean room with comfortable beds and bathroom was clean with a great shower. Plenty of towels. Arrived early but were able to leave luggage and book in later . Only negative was tv sat out from corner at coming out of bathroom and hit my head a few few times.  Will definitely be returning here again next time in london.

author: Evie Y
title: Great hotel great location
text: I stayed here as a young solo female traveler and it was great. Central location and close to all major attractions and tube station. Very close to restaurants that were very good. Rooms were clean for most part, bathroom had some black dirt like specs on the floor by the shower but not a big deal. Yes you can hear the tube and it can be loud but it didn’t bother me and I sleep with a noise maker so I was fine. Room on first floor was great, perfect and felt super safe!!!

author: Molly T
title: Central and good standard
text:
The hotel and the rooms (at least the ones we had) are renovated. Holded good standard, and as several have written, spacious to London to be. 

Centrally located, just minutes from Victoria station. 

Breakfast totally ok, selection as expected. 

Nice operation in the desk, so a good choice this.

author: George K
title: Hotel ideally located!
text:
Very good value for money and above all, conveniently located in London. Easy access.
100m from Victoria station, less than 100m from the departure of buses to Harry Potter studios, Hop on Hop off buses etc...  Restaurants for all tastes nearby (pubs, qualitative restaurants, fast food...). Nearby Sainsbury's for those who want to have a picnic... 
Heart of London within walking distance!
Clean hotel and rooms redone a short time ago.
The staff at the front desk and breakfast are nice and available.
As for all hotels in London, provide balls that are quies in case your room overlooks the street because the double glazing is not that of France...:)
Luggage storage on the day of arrival or departure in a room.

Only small catch, it lacks ventilation so the towels had trouble drying...

author: Isabella Y
title: No google review allowed
text: I called up the reception of the LH Lloyd Hotel Roma, wrote emails and tried to contact them for more than 2 weeks. The man on the reception was totally unfriendly and unprofessional. I tried to explain to him many times that i have a Gutschein/Voucher from Groupon that i wish to redeem. He started talking totally badly with me and had no idea that you can book a stay there with Groupon or Jet set for you. I said when your Hotel provides these Vouchers/Gutschein through Groupon you also need to have Customer support service for the following.  He was totally unfriendly and told me to do whatever i can. He hanged up the call. I called him again and said i will leave a review or complaint for this rude behavior. Then he again misbehaved with me and said you know what you can't write anything because you can't leave any Google Review for LH Lloyd Roma. To my surprise,  i checked and honestly you can give google reviews for other Lamin Hotels right now but the google reviews for this particular hotel (Hotel LH Lloyd Roma) has been turned off. You cannot even submit any review when their staff misbehaves so badly with you. I am still waiting for the issue to be resolved. I have already paid through Groupon and now are they are misbehaving and not allowing you to book a stay and redeem you Voucher/Coupon. The management seriously needs to look up into this. Such behavior is not good for the entire Line of Lamin Hotels.

author: Ethan Y
title: The hotel needs improvements
text:
The hotel is careless. Already at the entrance you can see old furniture, carpets with bad appearance and walls with bad appearance.  The room we stayed was of good size and with a great air conditioning, but carpet and armchair with bad appearance (with dirt spots). 
Breakfast is not good, as is the appearance of the place where it is served.
The staff at the reception is attentive.
The hotel is located close to good bars and restaurants and supermarkets.

author: Megan L
title: Noemi Nonell-Spain.
text:
The hotel is standard and comfortable and close to any tourist spot in the city.
But without a doubt the best thing is the treatment received, the receptionist Cristina is a 💯 I travel a lot and I have never seen such a nice and willing girl.
From Spain, beautiful Cristina, my daughter and I will remember you a lot..

author: Camille E
title: Meeting other neighborhoods of Rome
text:
Good cost benefit!
Good location, close to the subway (700mt).
Room needs care with furniture, are a little worn out. Very soft mattress.
Polite and helpful employees.

author: Luke O
title: SOMETHING OUT OF A HORROR MOVIE AWFUL HOTEL!
text:
DO NOT STAY HERE AVOID!!!

I just stayed at this hotel with my boyfriend for 7 nights. As soon as we walked into the room we were shocked and disgusted and completely underwhelmed. The rooms look nothing like the photos , completely misleading! Carpets are stained, room really old and shabby I was horrified and they moved our room to one with a balcony . This room was just as bad, 
the shower base door was falling off and the shower door do not shut, the bathroom floor was wet my boyfriend fell out the shower as the door wouldn’t close one day and hurt his back, we complained about the room first day were told all rooms were identical by the lady at reception, but she moved us to one with a balcony and we made do with it. Throughout the stay, the room just had a dirty feel about it , I felt uncomfortable using the shower and bathroom, the hotel lacks facilities . No kettle, no water, no fridge in the room basic things you would expect, I complained to the lady at reception about the fridge and she just laughed . My boyfriend told the other man about it at reception who said he would sort something out but never did, it was hot and we couldn’t chill out drinks which made it quite painful. The air conditioning did not work at all and we went end of May in 31 degree weather!  Again we complained about this to the staff who just did nothing about it; completely ignored us everytime we complained about something, on day 4 we had left the clea my room sign out side the door and our room was not cleaned , my boyfriend went down to reception again we explained about all the issues she then moved us only on day 4 to a bigger room with four beds. This room was not much better and in fact maybe even worse than the first room . The hot water did not work ; you would need to leave it to run for about 15 minutes , again dirty feel to the room and dark no proper lightening . 

The hotel itself is very basic, no facilities, no nice outdoor seating; no proper bar . One day we came back at 11 at night and asked for a bottle of water and they said they had ran out! And had none the breakfast was absolutely disgusting, would not even feed it to my dog. Eggs and bacon cold, coffee machine did not work, basic selection of foods we did not even bother after the first day.

We stayed out mostly everyday as we did not fee comfortable here at all, holidays are meant to be relaxing but staying here made us just feel stressed out and not happy. It’s far away from  most things, very dated in need of renovation. Should not be classed as a 3 star . I would not even rate it a 1 star . 

When we complained to the receptionist before check out again, she tried to lie and say we did not report the issues when we came to her about 4 different times ! Absolute joke we never settled as we had to be moved twice during our stay, but even despite this every single room had problems and how can she say we did not report issues when she literally moved us from room to room’
 

DO NOT STAY HERE ‘

author: Olivia G
title: Average hotel
text:
Hotel located 25 minutes from Termini station, very average for many reasons: soft bedding, cleanliness very limited due to carpets in the room, TV channels only in Italian, breakfast buffet very poorly stocked and quickly depleted, forget about the so-called terrace, the furniture is disastrous! Not to mention the outdated, noisy, and ineffective air conditioning. All of this for €150 a night.
One piece of advice: do not go there!!!

author: Henry Q
title: Hotel in good location but in need of cleaning and updating
text: Definitely not a 3 star hotel. Very run down and dirty in bedroom and corridors.  Thankfully we were out most of the day and only used as a base. Came back late one evening to find our door had not been closed after cleaning. Thankfully nothing had been taken. Breakfast was fair but they often ran out of items during busy periods including cutlery and plates. Although location had close access to metro and bus stops we wouldn’t stay here again and would not recommend

author: Daniel G
title: Spectacular
text:
Amazing attention from Alessandro, Rome, Maybell, Cristina and the rest of the staff. Clean, well located, better breakfast. 💯% recommended. We'll be back. 
Susana and Juan Bariloche Argentina

author: Sophia K
title: Not recommend
text:
To be honest this hotel needs a huge revamp.
The girl at reception was absolutely excellent but the hotel is very run down wallpaper coming off walls, paint chipping off walls, the room we got was very small ,hardly room to stand in shower, we went down and asked for upgrade and the girl got us upgraded the next day it was better than first room but still not great .
The staff in the breakfast room were not very efficient ,they waited till all the bacon was gone before ordering more as a result you would have toast and no bacon, same with the cutlery you would have your food and no cutlery so you wait again for them to go in and wash them to bring out more, very bad service. 
There is no bar/ lounge in hotel 
It's also a 40 min walk into main landmarks ,so quite a bit far away.
The best thing about the hotel were the reception staff ,that's all I can say it is a very outdated hotel

author: Alexander T
title: Shabby & Dirty
text: Myself & my daughter stayed here for 3nights. Thankfully we only slept . The hotel is actually filthy and there never seems to be anyone around cleaning. The toliet beside reception has no handwash since we came and it has not been cleaned since we got here. The whole place is very outdated and shabby. The breakfast was not to bad could have been better. Not more with this place at all. Will not be back.

author: Ana C
title: Compliment to our stay at LH Hotel Lloyd Rome
text:
Compliment to our stay at LH Hotel Lloyd Rome

We were a group of 8 people, having occupied 4 rooms, all very spacious and comfortable. We stayed in the renovated wing and, although it is noticed that the building is many years old — which is perfectly normal, namely on the mattress floor with some nodos — it did not take away the comfort of the stay at all.

I would like to highlight especially the cleanliness, which was irreproachable. Every day the rooms were carefully cleaned and the towels renovated. A truly 5-star cleaning service.
The breakfast always presented a good variety, with constant replacement of the missing products. The mixed eggs, in particular, were very appreciated by all guests, which demonstrates the attention and care of your team.

Finally, I leave a very special thank you to Omar from the reception. He was an exceptional collaborator: extremely friendly, proactive, patient and always available to help us with everything that was needed. A true example of professionalism and dedication.
Thank you to the entire team for providing us with such a positive experience. Definitely a hotel to recommend.

We will definitely be back!

author: Hugo E
title: Unpleasant experience
text:
Unfortunately the photos do not correspond to the current rooms. 
As soon as we checked in, we found dirty towels in the room, there was blood in the sheets. 
Dirty rooms, air conditioning almost non-existent in its function (just a lot of noise), the minibar in the room does not exist at all, bathroom with mold and shower full of rust, carpet with stains!  On the other hand, the staff is friendly.

author: Erin A
title: Shame on a 3.*
text: Hotel rated 3*, It’s a bit shameful! Access to the room through a corridor in the middle of construction where cleaning is not done (leftover meal on a plate on a table in the corridor). Room with very slippery shower (dangerous), impact on door.... Chairs in the dining room ill-adapted because they take up too much space at the expense of the traffic of customers. However positive for bedding and breakfast.

author: Freya B
title: Basic but friendly
text:
Booked this through our travel consultant, so wasn't certain to expect. 

Located a 20 minute walk from Termini station. It is centrally located ti most areas of Rome. 

The accommodation is basic yet functional and is a standard 3* hotel for the area. 

Breakfast consists of pastries, cheeses and cooked meats. Fresh juices, teas and coffees also available. 

The staff were so friendly and we must give a big 5* to Cristina on reception. Such a wonderful and bubbly character who went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. Thank you. 

The local area has plenty of eateries, coffee bars and shops to keep you occupied. 

We recommend making use of the Metro system to get about Rome starting at €8.50 for a day pass. But beware of Termini station at night as it is dangerous and risky. 

Top tip: always carry your passport or some other form of I.D.
You can be stopped at anytime by police and requested on demand for your documents to prove your identity and validity (this happened to us). You also need these to gain access to most clubs for checks. 

Overall a great stay if you're budget thrifty person.

author: Lucas B
title: Very good
text:
Very good hotel. 3 stars quite in Italian standards, even more. 
We found the welcome very friendly throughout our 5 day stay. Our room was made every day with daily change of towels. 
Very clean room, large TV screen, air conditioning, nice desk.
Very complete breakfast with a special touch featuring pastries from the country.
Very convenient location: 15 minutes walk from Termini station, 200m from buses that drop you off throughout the city and historic points.
Away from tourist areas without being far away.  You will find in the neighborhood and even in the street typical and cheap trattoria. 
We will return with great pleasure.

author: Luca A
title: Lousy hotel
text: Abysmal hotel, without a doubt the worst I have been to in my whole life, we have not had hot water for two days and they do not give us any solution. Don't go to this hotel I don't recommend it at all

author: Tyler T
title: Fatal
text: Fatal. Since we've been here without hot water. The room is not bad but the rest of the hotel rather sloppy and dirty. I don't recommend it and I won't come back

author: Sara U
title: Very good
text: I would like to thank all the staff of the Lloyd Roma Hotel in Via Alessandria 110/A for the Welcoming that was reserved for my relatives who arrived from Trani. Clean hotel and exceptional breakfast. Special thanks go to Cristina who dedicated herself with extreme kindness to Welcoming. A really prepared and helpful person. Unique.

author: Holly Z
title: Good hotel and clean
text: Quiet hotel, very friendly reception people, only carpeted rooms, but large room and large bathroom, breakfast some products did not have and left when we finished breakfast, but good overall.

author: George L
title: Don’t understand how it’s 3 stars
text:
The only positive I can say about this hotel is that the staff are incredibly friendly and really kind. 

Understandably, when you book a 3 star hotel, it’s obviously not going to be amazing. However, I’m beyond confused as to how it’s even a 3 star hotel. Me and partner stayed here just as place to rest our head while we explore Rome and Pompeii. However, are pillows are covered in mould (refer to the photographic evidence). Not to mention while the breakfast is free. The quality of the food should and would bring shame upon the Italian people. Disgusting quality. I really hope my partner and I don’t get ill from staying here. The fact that we get charged €6 tax per day for a hotel to provide us with mouldy pillows is abhorrent. Disgraceful when you think about. As for the cleaners we purposefully left the mouldy side showing upright in the hope that the cleaners would remove the contaminated pillows. Instead they just flipped them over so it looked like it had been cleaned. I wish I could get my money back

author: Henry S
title: Very poor experience
text: First night we got there the shower had broken it took 50 minutes for someone to come up and check on it the whole thing had broken and fallen onto the ground after that we received not a single sorry or any sort of compensation we had to completely re pack and then in pack into a new room, staff are very unwelcoming to English speakers and generally will not want to serve you. The breakfast options are wide but when we had made our hot chocolate we had found maggots in the cup absolutely disgusting. Not sure how it’s 4 stars realistically Its a 2.5-3 star hotel.

author: Oscar T
title: Great reception
text:
We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights from July 22 to July 25 2026.
Martina at the reception was very polite helping and nice
She explained everything 
Please appreciate and reward her 
Hard to find good people like her

author: Ella M
title: Good value for money
text: The hotel is located in a very quiet area. We chose it because we were looking for a hotel with parking. Our room was comfortable and clean. The staff is kind. We recommend it.

author: Laura P
title: very kind staff and nice rooms
text: hotel with a lot of service staff, all very kind, we stayed in a deluxe room with a balcony, clean, spacious and with a nice, well-stocked bathroom, breakfast was a wonderful surprise, excellent coffee and cappuccino and a lot of choice, both sweet and savory (not always available in this category of hotels), also recommended for the location for those going to Luiss on Via Pola

author: Andrea Z
title: Weekend in Rome
text: Very kind and qualified staff. Convenient location. Comfortable environment and excellent cleanliness. A special mention to the restaurant, which offered us exceptional raw materials and top-level cuisine.

author: Noah B
title: Ordinary stay
text: Very ordinary stay, nothing great about it. It's a no frills 2.5-3 star hotel, so come with a low expectation

author: Anna F
title: When in Rome…
text:
This is a very nice hotel located in a pleasant suburb of Rome. There is a metro stop around 300 metres from the hotel and it takes about fifteen minutes to travel into the city centre.
The hotel itself was beautifully furnished and our room was spacious and clean. I loved the outdoor patio area that hotel guests can use for an evening drink or just to relax after a busy day.
The staff were always friendly and helpful, learning to put up with my very basic Italian language skills. The team who looked after the serving of breakfast each morning were always kind to us.
This was a brilliant hotel to stay in, a little piece of calm sanctuary amongst the hustle and bustle of Rome.

author: Wyatt N
title: Excellent, friendly and welcoming
text: A lovely hotel situated in a quiet residential area. Less than 10 minutes walk to metro through a safe area and from there 15 mins to centre. All of the staff were extremely helpful and friendly. Breakfast was good, they provided a small take away bag for the day we were going out very early. Would recommend if you are not bothered about staying right in the centre.

author: Charlotte T
title: Excellent stay, recommend
text: Perfect welcome and check out, clean and spacious room, very full breakfast buffet, and quiet location not far from the center, 5 minutes from the metro, make this hotel a perfect place for a citytrip in Rome.

author: Aaron R
title: Very Disappointing!
text: Very disappointed. First, we booked for 5 nights in their biggest, most expensive room. We paid extra for early (10am) check in (that they offered on their website) - was not available when we got there - and staff didnt acknowledge - Second, our travel plans changed (tour guides etc.) and we needed to check out earlier, they were not flexible at all, I understand I paid the lower rate when I booked, but it felt like was being punished for paying full amount in advance - Finally, I am glad we left anyway because there were ANTS, especially on the bed (looks like they were coming from behind the headboard - when we told the staff when we left (after two nights) we were told "we will look into it" - not even an apology

author: Kyle O
title: Good staff make the difference..
text: Fabulous Hotel  made better with excellent staff.. Filipo, Joir, Genesis.. so professional, friendly and helpful and fun.. Staff can make a place and they definetly enjoy working in this hotel and it shows.. looking after the customer was priority for them..  food here was superb, rooms beautiful..

author: Thomas T
title: Nice Hotel in Lovely Neighbourhood
text:
Good sized rooms compared to central Rome hotels. Cleaned well. AC was non existent so
maybe hot in summer. Lovely neighbourhood with plenty of places to eat at and visit.  Breakfast had a hood selection however, we went out most mornings to
Immerse ourself in the local area.  Metro station nearby with easy connection to Termini and other tourist areas. Overall much preferred this hotel to our choice close tonthe Colesseum.

author: Paige M
title: Would highly recommend
text:
Location, ideal for many attractions, if you enjoy walking around a city and exploring
Great staff, very friendly and attentive
Great room, clean and quite
Overall cant find fault
Would highly recommend

author: Paige V
title: Nice hotel in quiet area of Rome
text: The hotel is located in nice and safe area of Rome, about 3 metro stops to city centre. Staff very friendly and room was very clean and quiet. We enjoyed the stay just the breakfast was a bit disappointed. Many items were not filled and mostly of them were cold, even if on the middle of breakfast time. But overall we liked the hotel

author: Sofia E
title: Good hotel
text: Hotel a little 'off center a 25 minute drive from the Colosseum but in the tranquillissima.dotato garage.stanze with wooden floor and very clean.ragazzi reception very kind and always available with a smile.breakfast in normal

author: Evan Q
title: Very good value for money
text: We stayed two nights to visit Rome. The hotel is quiet in residential area 5 minutes from the metro. The room was clean, quiet and comfortable. The only downside is the benefits of our platinum status. We didn’t get an upgrade when the hotel wasn’t fully booked and the right drink isn’t visible in the app. We had to claim it. Nevertheless we were able to benefit from the late departure and we were able to get a spritz as a drink. Breakfast was half-hearted. The first hot the hot buffet was not replenished while the service was not over. The second day, there was more choice. Compared to other mercury in Italy, it is above average.

author: Isla P
title: Very pleasant stay...
text: This hotel in an outlying residential area of the hyper center of Rome has very good assets: it is very easily accessible by metro (5 min walk from the station Sainte Agnes) and is in a very quiet area. The rooms are very comfortable, very clean and well equipped. The staff was very friendly and the breakfast excellent. In short, a very well thought out hotel for a high quality Roman stay. It was perfect, and we will return with great pleasure...

author: Megan V
title: Gorgeous hotel worth the Metro ride!
text:
We had a lovely 3 night stay here last month. 
We didn't want to stay right in the heart of the city, so chose this hotel in a residential area, a short metro ride away from the main tourist spots. 
The hotel is very unassuming from the outside, but has a very modern, slick and stylish interior and garden area.
There was a slight mix-up with our booking, but this was swiftly taken care of by the team at the hotel and we were also given 2 complimentary cocktails. 
The room was very clean and spacious, and had complimentary bathroom essentials and drinks.  
The breakfast had a wide selection to choose from, which was all fresh and simply delicious. The coffee was 10/10 also! 
The staff were very helpful and lovely and helped make our stay in Rome an unforgettable one.

author: Hannah J
title: Giubileo di Roma 2025:Quiet and pleasant stay in this busy city in its holy year
text: We stayed at this hotel with a lot of comfort. Friendly and helpful staff. Located in a safe neighborhood with easy access to public transport ( metro and bus).

author: Nora S
title: A Decent Stay with Some Room for Improvement
text:
Overall, the hotel offered a clean environment, with friendly and welcoming staff. The bathroom was a highlight—modern and well-maintained. While the location was quiet, it was set within a busy neighborhood and a bit far from the city center, which might not suit everyone’s needs.

The dining experience left something to be desired; options were limited and the quality was average at best. Breakfast was not particularly impressive, but it was sufficient to start the day.

All in all, the hotel provided a comfortable and clean stay, with good service, but there’s room to improve in the dining and breakfast offerings.

author: Nathan Z
title: A lovely surprise - We will return!
text: Hotel is easy to find and a quick walk from either Termini station or the metro.  The area is a welcome respite from the fray of Rome, being in a tranquil location. All of the hotel staff were pleasant and kind, they were extremely helpful and responded quickly to our needs. Breakfast was delicious, offering a great variety and served at the rooftop lounge/restaurant. Although it was extremely hot, the rooftop had a nicely cooled A/C area and an open area with shade and lovely breezes. Cocktails were carefully prepared by Ugo and were delicious - we really enjoyed the extremely relaxing atmosphere on the roof! Our room was large and nicely furnished - the bed was extremely comfortable with high quality sheets. There are restaurants nearby and the front desk personnel gave us excellent recommendations. This hotel doesn't have every possible amenity but what they do have is extremely well-done with attention to detail. Thank you for a lovely stay, Hotel Montecarlo!

author: Ian E
title: Given a DIRTY room
text: 90 counties, 1000+ hotels, and never have I been given a DIRTY room from a previous guest. Worst hotel I have ever stayed at with awful customer service.

author: Manon B
title: I advise
text:
3 nights in this top hotel, friendly and pleasant staff 
Breakfast on the 7th floor on the rooftop, a lot of sweet and savory choices

author: Manon N
title: Perfect
text: My wife, son, and I stayed for 3 nights. It's conveniently located near the terminal. We were very pleased. The hotel is very clean and impeccable. The staff are very polite and courteous. The breakfast is excellent. The rooms are very comfortable and well-maintained. The location is good; the Turkish Embassy is right across the street. The metro is nearby. Thank you to everyone involved.

author: Chloe H
title: Centrally located, great receptionists and overall great experience at hotel
text:
We stayed a total of 8 nights at the Hotel Montecarlo in Rome, Italy.  We were warmly greeted at Reception, and all the receptionists during our stay were knowledgeable and helpful.  Full breakfast included a full range of hot and cold items (scrambled eggs could have been a little warmer, but we have known only one hotel that was able to provide hot scrambled eggs during our many years of travel).  
We used their Bistro the first night we arrived for a wonderful pizza and wine.

It's an old hotel, but well maintained (absolutely love the elevator, which was always working!).  Very clean bathroom with a sauna feature which we weren't able to figure out but didn't miss anyway.  Only slight negative was the clearing space between the sink and the bathroom door - we're not large people, but you basically have to open the door, get in and then you have to close the door in order to access the sink.  Not insurmountable, just required maneuvering!

The bedroom was a good size for the two of us - particularly liked the wood flooring instead of less hygienic carpeting found in other hotels.

Within walking distance of many restaurants and Metro and Termini Train Station.

Overall, an excellent stay - we would stay here again.

author: Maria R
title: Historic Rome Hotel
text: Historic hotel of Rome for over 100 years. So the rooms have an old decor and presentation but the rooms are the necessary for a stay in Rome to visit. They have a restaurant that allows you to make a meal with typical Italian food, is 5 minutes from the metro station of Castro Pretorio that has the connection to the main monuments. The hotel is in a safe area as it has several embassies in the vicinity and there are no shortage of restaurants and supermarkets nearby in addition to in 10 minutes if you can get to Termini station on foot. The reception staff is very friendly, friendly and always available to help with tips and suggestions!

author: Diego U
title: Fantastic experience
text:
My wife and I stayed at Hotel Montecarlo for a long weekend in Rome, and we had a thoroughly enjoyable experience.
The hotel strikes a lovely balance between comfort and charm. The rooftop terrace is a real highlight — breakfast there in the morning is relaxed and pleasant, and in the evening it transforms into a cosy restaurant with very good food.
The staff were consistently polite and professional, making us feel genuinely welcome throughout our stay.
A special mention goes to Hugo, the barman, who was not only friendly but also impressively multilingual. We were particularly surprised when he spoke fluent Portuguese with my wife — a rare and thoughtful touch that made our stay even more memorable.
Overall, a very positive experience, and we would certainly consider staying here again on our next visit to Rome.

author: Alexander H
title: Great breakfast and service
text:
We are incredibly pleased with our stay. The hotel is about 10 minutes' walk from Termini train station. Perfect for using Leonardo Express to and from the airport. There is also a metro station right near the hotel. In the area around the hotel there are several nice and good neighborhood restaurants.
The room we stayed in was good in every way (maybe a little hard beds). The reception is open 24 hours a day and the staff is friendly and helpful. The staff who work in the breakfast room are extremely efficient and make sure to immediately refill things that run out and that everyone quickly gets somewhere to sit, even when there is high pressure. Breakfast is a good mix of hot and cold, nutritious and sweet.
The hotel is affordable and by far met the requirements we had for a hotel in this price range.

author: Claire G
title: Comfortable
text: Hotel located quite close to the station district, room a little old but nice. Breakfast to avoid, nothing good to eat.

author: Morgan E
title: It gets better
text:
I was only for one night with my figlio.La area is not so close to the station, in the sense that walking you can do but if you have suitcases better take a taxi.L'hotel is located in the embassy area so there is nothing around but military who watch, I must say that it is quite quiet but sometimes quite buia. Consiglio in the same street a very nice tavern where we ate a great cheese and pepper.
Our room was on the top floor, and for this reason we were recommended another very narrow elevator with the doors still antique that open by hand, because this came directly to our floor, but it was unusable to go to the terrace or use it with luggage because it is really tiny: moral every time you had to go down to the 5th floor and then take the largest and most modern elevator.
the room if it wasn't for the furniture left in the 80s, it wasn't bad, even the new bathroom, and a nice terrace that made it less stuffy.
breakfast very poor, with croissants lying in a basket, did not make me particularly follere.Sicuramente at the price paid there is better, or even worse in Rome, but I would definitely not go back.

author: Luca H
title: It was fine for the last 2 nights of our trip
text: We were booked here by Gate 1. It was fine. Good location (to Termini) mostly helpful staff, clean, quiet.  Decent WiFi, Served our needs perfectly.

author: Grace V
title: Positive experience
text: Nice hotel located in a strategic position as it is about 800 meters from Termini station.  The staff at the reception was always friendly, helpful and courteous. The room located in this ancient building always clean and more than decent. Seven-story building with the top used for breakfast. Breakfast assorted and with great desserts. Also good value for money.

author: Aaron Z
title: DON’T WASTE YOUR MONEY, DON’T BOOK THIS HOTEL
text:
I stayed at this hotel during my trip to Rome, and unfortunately, it was one of the worst experiences I’ve had in a hotel. The room was not as described, and the service was completely unhelpful.i requested a bassinet as it is in their website they advertised that crib is available upon request, they told me they don’t have one, after insisting on having one for my baby they provided me  a broken bassinet!!
The staff showed little concern when I mentioned issues of crib that was unsafe for my baby, unclean and no mattress .
they still charged me 25 euro per night for that Bassinet that I couldn’t use, they told me they will take care of it the next morning where they never did .
Instead of resolving the problem, they charged me extra and offered no apology or solution.

For the price I paid, I expected much better hospitality and safety standards. I do not recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Rome — there are many other places that actually care about their guests.

author: Michael T
title: Positive experience
text: I stayed in the company of a 'friend and we had a great time. The reception staff is really very kind and professional, the cleaning thorough throughout the hotel and in the rooms. Beautiful terrace on the seventh floor with variety of sweet and savory products for breakfast. Thanks also to barman Marco for his excellent aperitifs and chef Alessandro , both good , professional and nice . Also convenient proximity to Termini station.

author: Aaron N
title: Welcoming clean hotel meters away from Termini station.
text:
In a last minute decision to leave to Rome myself and family needed a base for a long weekend. Hotel MonteCarlo was available and had our requirements for breakfast and close to the center of Rome city center. Its located 5 mins walk from metro station Castro Pretorio on line B so very easy to get to all the major landmarks and is three stops from Collosseum (Collosseo). 

Mica from reception gave us a warm hearty welcome and spent time giving us good advice and tips on what to do and getting around. We were given a triple room (204) and a twin room (203). The rooms are spacious with high ceilings and well maintained. All of us were happy with our rooms and over all pleased that we had ended up here. There is also a lovely glass lift to get you to your floor if you are too tired to take the steps.

Breakfast is a good selection . Hot drinks juices and water, fruits, breads, toast yoghurt, beans and egg and delicious cake slices.. The food was warm  and the staff are fantastic at replenishing items. 
As well as Mica in reception  I found Louise very helpful and Franco was engaging aswell. When I needed laundry doing Louise took time to tell me about the local laundrette and ensured I knew how to get there. Very lovely service I found. Aswell as the launderette being just a few metres away there is a small food centre called Cador. It had everything I needed at a reasonable price to ensure we had snacks and essentials.

Though the hotel is not in the midst of the action I found that I enjoyed retreating in to a calm area that mainly has embassies around there.  I found bus travel worked best depending on the site i wanted to visit that day. The bus stop is on the opposite side of the street and a few steps towards the right.

The streets around  the hotel are quiet and even if there was noise outside then the windows are fully soundproofed. There are some restaurants open till late with outdoor seating which was perfect. Hotel MonteCarlo also has a bistro set menu at €20 however I didnt manage to try this.

Thanks to the hard working staff at the hotel and we would recommend this hotel  to family and friends visiting Rome.  Bellissima

author: Thomas J
title: Beautiful holiday
text: We are staying at this hotel very convenient for the proximity to the station and also very nice. Very kind staff at the reception, but the great added value are chef Alessandro and his right-hand man Marco who welcomed us with warmth and sympathy, delighting us with their dishes and drinks. We will definitely be back!!

author: Holly E
title: The perfect holiday
text: Very comfortable hotel beautiful terrace on the seventh floor. The wonderful food, the very nice and playful chefs, have spent fun and pleasant evenings. I will return to stay especially for their sympathy and professionalism.

author: Matthew C
title: Handy Rome accommodation
text: The staff were very friendly and always helpful. The room was simple but very comfortable and in a good area. Breakfast was great on the rooftop and at night the rooftop turns into a great chill place to have a drink.

author: Pablo Z
title: A charming hotel in the heart of the Eternal City.
text: This is a lovely hotel not far from the main train station. The room I had came with a lovely balcony. The roof top terrace is gorgeous for an evening drink as well as for breakfast. The breakfast was a really nice continental breakfast and well worth the price. Nothing at all negative to report.

author: Daisy Y
title: Enjoyable stay
text:
We stayed 4 nights and there’s lots to like.  It was 36/37 degrees when we were there (early July) so the big plus and very much needed was the good air conditioning! 
The hotel is older in style but it has charm, our family room was dated and dark however my parents room had been refurbished recently and was bright and airy.  That said the family room was still a decent size, the shower was good and there was a fridge.  
The hotel is really well located in a safe and accessible area to all the main sights, only about 18mins walk to Trevi, Spanish steps etc.  it was also very clean, spotless in fact and had a lovely little roof top space and a nice lobby.  There are a few nice eateries around it and a fab gelato place about 10mins stroll.  Lovely staff and an enjoyable stay.

author: Amelia T
title: Shocking - not the good kind.
text:
​Prospective guests should be extremely cautious before booking here.
​Our family stay was ruined by severe health and safety violations:
​Biological Hazard: Our room flooded with raw sewage (feces and urine) from the toilet, soaking into the carpet where my young children had to walk. No sanitization or footwear assistance was provided.
​Unauthorised Entry: Staff entered our locked room unannounced under the excuse of "refilling the minibar"— we stayed in two rooms and neither room had a mini bar so I am unsure how that is an excuse.
​Safety Risks: The replacement room offered to us contained chipped, broken glassware.
​Management will likely respond below by claiming they "addressed the situation" or offered loyalty points. 
Do not be misled: offering loyalty points for raw sewage and broken glass does not erase a severe public health hazard. Furthermore, the booking platform has already acknowledged the severity of these issues in writing and issued a cash refund directly from their own pocket due to the hotel’s refusal to take responsibility.
​The health, safety, and security of your family are not worth risking at this property.

author: Diego D

author: Lily C
title: Valuable belongings disappeared from our room and the hotel’s response was appalling
text:
My three friends and I checked into Novotel Paris 17 on 19 June. Our initial check-in was pleasant, but the rest of our experience was extremely concerning and disappointing.

One of my friends had brought a very expensive pair of shoes with her. She did not wear them on the evening we arrived, the following day or on the Sunday. On the second day of our stay, we left the hotel at around 2pm. When we later returned, we were told that our room could not be cleaned because the housekeeping staff had already finished for the day.

The following morning, when my friend went to wear the shoes, we realised they were no longer in the room. We searched everywhere, turned the room upside down and checked every bag, cupboard and possible location, but they had disappeared.

We immediately reported this to reception and asked the hotel to investigate who had entered our room. The electronic door records showed that the housekeeping manager had accessed our room after we left at around 2pm.

The hotel later claimed that CCTV showed the housekeeping manager briefly opening the door and looking inside to check whether the room had been cleaned. This explanation made no sense to us because the room was not cleaned afterwards. We could not understand why an occupied guest room needed to be accessed simply to look inside, especially when we had been told that housekeeping had already finished.

When we explained the situation to the front-desk staff, they were rude, blunt, discouraging and completely unsympathetic. Instead of showing concern or reassuring us that the matter would be properly investigated, they blamed us for not putting the shoes in the safe. A pair of shoes would not reasonably fit inside a hotel safe, and guests should not be made to feel responsible when belongings disappear from a room that hotel staff have accessed.

The disappearance of our belongings was serious enough, but the rude and dismissive attitude of the front-desk staff made the situation even worse. We were treated as though we were at fault rather than guests reporting missing property from a room that hotel staff had accessed.

Despite the hotel confirming that a member of housekeeping management had entered our room, there appeared to be no serious or transparent investigation. There was no meaningful search for the shoes, no clear explanation and no practical support. We were simply told to report the matter to the police.

Unfortunately, the police were not very helpful, partly because of the language barrier, and appeared only to file the report.

After returning to our home country, I also discovered that my leather card holder was missing. It contained all of my bank cards, loyalty cards and membership cards. My ID was the only item not inside because I had removed it before going out.

We have since contacted customer service and escalated the matter to senior management, but we have received no satisfactory resolution or meaningful support.

I cannot personally prove who removed the missing belongings. However, the facts are that valuable items disappeared from our room, the hotel’s own records confirmed that a member of housekeeping management entered while we were away, and the hotel failed to conduct what we considered to be a proper investigation.

author: Antoine W
title: Just go to another hotel
text:
Value - Too expensive for what is offered. It is not a 4 stars at all (most likely 2 stars). No fridge in the room.
Room - not clean enough / strange smell
Service - It was OK during the check in. At night my key was not working and the person in the reception was rude. Missing towels.
Noise Level - the sound from the rooms can be listened outside (dog barking, kids playing). For me it is not a problem, but it might be for less tolerant people.

author: William P
title: Once again very good!
text:
We stayed for the second time in this hotel, accustomed to the Accor chain, it is one of the best located to access the center of Paris by car with a parking lot large enough to accommodate our Espace. Room on the 3rd floor, well soundproofed and well air-conditioned. 
Decent breakfast but not transcendent for the price! 
Big plus, the fresh water fountains on each floor available for free. 
We will certainly return for our next Parisian stay.

author: Matthew N
title: Needs renovation
text: Very average. Bedside light broken, bathroom crumbling, safe broken, TV remote that works when it wants to..., Needs serious renovation. Advertised as 4 stars and charged as such. Not justified.

author: Ethan Z
title: Eaten badly
text: The food was very bad fries never seen such a fries. Meat was not chewable.

author: Abigail U
title: A good hotel for a family with older children in my opinion
text:
Booked through jet2 and was our first visit to Paris. Was a bit worried as reviews were not all positive but we were really pleased. 
We had 2 teenagers with us and although the hotel isn’t in the best location (our room was overlooking a dual carriageway!) there was not really any noise from outside. 
We got the bus most days to wherever we were going which was only a 5-10 mins walk from the bus stop. 
Breakfast at the hotel was okay and we filled out the blankets breakfast in your room card a couple of times which we were happy with. 
We ate an evening meal on our first night which again was good and not overpriced. 
Overall, a good clean hotel which isn’t badly located if you’re there to look around Paris but I would say it’s more suitable for older children due to the location. 
We would definitely visit again

author: Ana P
title: Family stay
text: Great stay! Clean room friendly helpful staff

author: Molly R
title: Good reasonably priced hotel, but needs some customer service

No cups to make tea or coffee, despite asking I am still awaiting them to arrive in my room on check out. Check out is 12pm yet at 9am I was disturbed by house keeping seeing what time we were leaving. This isn’t great

author: Diego I
title: Had my belongings stolen in the hotel lobby
text:
Stayed at the hotel for 2 nights, the neighbourhood is dodgy and didn’t make me and my family feel safe at all, rooms are average and definitely overpriced for what they offer, but what made my experience terrible was having my handbag stolen in the hotel lobby in the middle of the day, while retrieving the luggage I stored there for the day. 
My handbag was stolen by an individual who entered the lobby without being noticed, let alone challenged, by the receptionist sitting at the front desk, and left by the fire exit that wasn’t even alarmed. 

When I noticed my bag was gone, little to no support was offered me by the receptionist, I had to ask them more than once to check the CCTV for me, which they eventually did. In a situation of panic and distress I felt completely left alone by the hotel staff, and a brief email exchange with the hotel Manager the next day, made me understand they consider what happened to me and the fact that a thief entered the premises in the middle of the day, normal because the lobby is “a public space” and there’s nothing they could do to make their guests feel safe. 
I consider an hotel a safe space, where one should be able to feel protected, relaxed and at home but Novotel failed on all accounts and didn’t even try to make the situation better. Of course no compensation has been offered, but not even a glass of water when I was in distress. Avoid this hotel at all costs.

author: Ethan W
title: Good hotel and excellent breakfast
text: Hotel in good location, rooms are a little small but acceptable. The wonderful breakfast, and very quiet, you can not hear the noise of the adjacent rooms. I would stay here again without hesitation.

author: Michael E
title: Excellent city hotel with slightly less good location.

Breakfast with all the trimmings, friendly helpful staff. Small parking spaces 19 euros per night.
Limited menu in the restaurant but quite tasty.
Location hotel is not ideal, you always have to take a taxi to the center, a tram or metro (change by metro).

author: Paige C
title: Novotel Paris 17eme
text:
A well located hotel, but areas for improvement

The location of the Nouveau Hôtel Paris 17e is one of its great assets: easily accessible, well connected, and located a few minutes walk from a mosque, which is valuable for Muslim travelers. The rooms are relatively spacious for Paris, which contributes to some comfort.

However, there are several aspects to the experience. The main negative point is the sanitary facilities: the toilet is cramped and separate from the bathroom, which is not very convenient. The bathroom itself is not very suitable for the elderly (difficult to access), and most importantly, it has clogged repeatedly throughout the stay, requiring frequent interventions by staff or the use of a device.

The staff is generally friendly.

author: Miguel L
title: Excellent family stay
text:
Excellent family stay, we booked via a Jet2 City Break.  

The good;

- While on the outskirts, it was a straight forward transfer from airport, and cost less than 30 euros by Uber.
- Room was modern, comfortable, noise proof, air con worked, room cleaned well every day.
- The breakfast was decent, I enjoyed the scramble eggs and bacon, and pastries.  We mainly had our breakfast early before the late morning rush, it did get busy one time we left it late and a few issues (ie drinks machine queues).
- Water machines next to lifts, cold refills came in handy.
- Location was fine, never too far from decent spots to eat and drink.  We enjoyed FanFan in particular.
- Service was overall excellent.
- All things considered, well worth it!

Merci!

author: Emma Q
title: Not worth repeating
text:
We booked and paid for this hotel quite last minute (about three weeks in advance) for three people – breakfast included – via TUI. The price was attractive and the hotel has its own enclosed parking (19€/24h).
Check-in was difficult: We had arrived around 10am, but could not register at that time; only from 2pm was this possible. The lady at the desk was clearly new and still in training, which slowed down the process. We had to pay the parking and the accommodation tax immediately, but only received a payment receipt via Mastercard and no official invoice.
The room was relatively clean, with a well adjustable air conditioning. The window unfortunately could not open, which we found unfortunate. The breakfast was decent – everything you expect from a standard hotel breakfast – and the parking was a real plus.
Unfortunately, checking out became a particularly unpleasant experience: The receptionist first claimed that we had not paid for the parking and then that breakfast was still open. He was remarkably unfriendly. Despite showing the TUI documents on my iPhone (which were also issued at check-in), he persisted stubbornly. When a female colleague joined, the story suddenly changed: extra people would have had breakfast on our room number! We then decided to end it and leave for home: our day was already ruined.
I immediately reported this incident to TUI. Too bad, because this could have been a pleasant stay.

author: Marco P
title: Great experience
text:
Great hotel, clean and spacious rooms with very comfortable beds.
Very assorted breakfast and also the restaurant not bad.
Friendly staff, kind and always available for any need and informazioni.Occhio of regard for the needs of children.
Close to public transport.
We will definitely be back.

author: Jack S
title: They tend to overcharge you with "deposit"
text:
Well I have booked from Hotels.com seeing their 4.1 rating there, but I should have checked google reviews honestly.
Beware, they will charge you an upfront 100 pounds as a "deposit", and they may afterwards charge you for ludicrous staff.
I have been to many hotels and this is the first time I was charged 20 for a hand towel that had some stains on it and "rendered unusuable" (which was some residue from hair dye). This is at the very least bad practice, and at worst malicious intent. And I would say management was quite rude in subsequent correspondence.
You can see many past reviews that they are quite problematic in this "deposit" part, so travelers beware.

author: Diego H
title: Bad hotel
text: The price at the hotel was tempting. We arrived at the hotel and the lobby was very small. They let us wait until the evening without a room. When we entered the room, we realized that we were wrong. There was no place to put the suitcase. There was no place to move. The employees there entered the rooms and stole things, took pictures and said that we had caused damage, and then charged money from the credit card after weeks of vacation. A hotel of thieves.

author: Liam T
title: OXFORD HOTEL - Accidental reservation.
text:

Contacted with Revolut to request the cancellation and indicate that I am not concerned because the error will be understandable and that contacting the company to inform you of the cancellation and the response will be negative. Before this situation was contacted with the company directly explaining the reasons for disclaiming and practically refusing the cancellation of the reservation, it was not difficult to contest it. If you wish to receive a new email informing you that you will create a negative result from the hotel, if you respond, you will be notified of the creation of false results.

Disconnect the service simply by asking me with my dinner for a trip that we do not intend to organize, so that we cannot travel and leave.

All this is certain and demonstrable, therefore, I have a negative valuation of the hotel and I recommend that we do not stay in the hotel, but we can have an idea of ​​inflexibility in a situation as I imagine that it will actuate in other ways.

Breakfast is lovely, great restaurant with all of the cooked breakfast offerings, with pastries and lots of fruit 🍇

text:
I’d like to take a moment and share my thoughts regarding Hotel Oxford and missing items from the hotel room. It was a  souvenir bag from Warner Bros studio clearly displaying their logo and containing numerous valuable items that have gone missing from our room, Items such as mugs, posters,books, the bag wasnt closed or sealed in order to be mistaken by trash, it was clear new recently bought items were inside the bag.

Managers didnt even bother to talk to me or explain next steps, they clearly do not care about their customers
Cannot recommend this hotel to anyone going to London as the lack of response from the responsible personnel is frustrating

If the cleaning staff mistakenly discarded this bag as trash, it is a clear indication of very poor training and a lack of attention to detail in your service. author: Alice M
title: Stolen items from our hotel room
text:
My recent stay at this hotel was a huge disappointment. Unfortunately, items from our hotel room went missing during our absence. When we reported this to the reception staff, we were met with an unhelpful response. They simply told us they have a "procedure" in place and would get back to us in two days—despite the fact that we were leaving the next day on an early morning flight.
It was extremely frustrating to be left without help in a situation where our belongings had disappeared from a supposedly secure hotel room. The lack of urgency or concern from the staff made it clear they didn’t prioritize us as customers. We were essentially left in the dark, not knowing what happened to our things.
I would not recommend staying here, as the safety of your belongings and the support from hotel management seem to be low on their list of priorities.

author: Mason N
title: Lovely experience!
text: I was really worried after reading some reviews, but the hotel was lovely!  Very central in a really good location. It was a 2 minute walk from the tube. It had Tesco express, boots, pubs, cafes and shops right opposite. It was cleaned everyday.  The room was lovely! Had everything you needed. Perfect place to stay for a couple getaway to London.

author: Nathan S
title: Oxford Hotel London: A first-class stay with outstanding service and a tasty breakfast
text: The Oxford Hotel London is a first class hotel with an excellent location and outstanding service. It is easy to get around from the hotel to various attractions and transport hubs. The hotel is highly recommended for both business and leisure travellers. The extensive breakfast buffet offers a wide selection of delicious dishes that will please every taste. Around the hotel you will find a vibrant neighborhood with exciting restaurants, shops and cultural attractions, which makes your stay even more memorable.

author: Grace K
title: Bad booking experience & unresponsive hotel staff!
text:
We are extremely disappointed in this hotel and how they state that you can book the hotel room and can cancel if needed! This is such a big scam! We accidentally booked for a few days on the wrong dates and tried reaching out to cancel the booking and reschedule for another date, not only did they not respond they did not pick up our calls and now we are disputing this with our bank! This is one of the worst hotel experience we have had! We have traveled extensively all over the world and never encountered such a situation!

They are unresponsive and will leave you hanging, I definitely am not going to stay at this hotel as I believe if there is an issue they will not respond nor take care of the guest. Do yourself a favor and go for another hotel. If the hotel responds back I will update my review.

author: Ethan D
title: Great Hotel
text:
Me and my daughter stayed her for 2 nights. 
The location of the hotel is brilliant just a minute or 2 from the tube station. We were here for Wimbledon and the the tube station near the hotel had a direct line to Wimbledon. It also goes straight to central London, 
The rooms were modern and clean. The rooms are on the small side but that’s wasn’t an issue for us as we didn’t spend much time in the room. Good pillows, clean bedding, toiletries, Mini fridge and good tea/coffee making facilities. 
Each member of staff that we met was friendly and helpful. We couldn’t find our room (rooms are located in different buildings) went back to reception and the man at check-in, took us to our room. On checking out we ask to leave our bags, they tagged them and gave us tickets, they took our cases and on return retrieved them for us.
I would 100% stay here again.

author: George Q
title: Perfect spot
text:
Nice and fresh hotel.  Newly renovated rooms. Helpfull staff. Perfect location just 5 min walk from Earls Court Station (zone 1). We landed at Stansted and used the expresstrain and tube (aprox 1 hour and 50min all together) 
Nice continental breakfast.

author: Isla R

If they acted like this with a normal, ordinary dress, I wonder how they would act with more valuable things. Dodgy service, for sure...

author: Noah M

Kept helping us with our key card but had to ask a couple of times for some more sheets one night. Noise not too bad for NYC. Overall atmosphere good. Was my second stay here

author: Freya V
title: Clean but worn and has a security issue.
text: We booked this hotel for 4 nights with Wyndham award points which included breakfast.   The breakfast was very dissappointing.   It's served in a dingy windowless basement with over cooked scambled eggs.  We did not go back for breakfast there for the rest of our stay.  The hotel room was clean but was worn and needed updates.  The elevator is not secure.  Anyone off the street can go to your floor since the elevator does not require your room key.   The top floor did have a cool bar with a glass wall to view the Manhattan skyline north where you can see part of the Empire State building.  The room cleaning staff was pleasant. The front desk was cool but efficient although we did stumble an argument with newly arriving guests with the front desk but we don't know what caused the tension.  So overall we found this hotel wanting and will not return.   The nearby Hyatt Bowery 50 hotel is much better option for us.

author: Aaron T
title: Awesome big apple experience
text: All good things, location, cleanliness and hospitality.

author: Hugo T
title: Great view and accomodating
text: Easy check in, great breakfast and very friendly staff, best location for chinatown

author: Laura F
title: The Best Wedding Imaginable
text:
Thanks to Sean and Shana and the entire Wyndham Garden Chinatown staff we had the most amazing wedding!  Sean and Shana were incredibly communicative and helpful for the months in advance to the day of the wedding.  The entire staff jumped in the day of to make wedding spectacular.  They all fell like part of our family!

The venue is stunning and it’s a true hidden gem!  The location is perfect for people coming from the outer boroughs, New Jersey, or abroad.  It’s in the heart of Chinatown, but it’s a few blocks from LES, SoHo, NoHo, and Little Italy.

The rooms are spacious and very comfortable, and my family stayed in rooms with balconies…a nice surprise!

Within Wyndham Garden you have at least 3 great bars and a great restaurant…you don’t even have to leave the building if you just want to relax.

All in all it was a 10/10 experience and I highly recommend Wyndham Garden Chinatown and its stellar team.

author: Hannah Y
title: Great stay

author: Chloe W
title: Horrible
text: Everything was terrible. The employees were very rude. We book this room 2 weeks ago and when we got here we Didn't get the room in time we waited for 2 HOURS. Only told us to wait and didn't do anything else if I come to New York again we would NOT choose this hotel.

author: Leo E
title: Amazing Hotel with Great Hospitality!
text: Lin at the front desk was amazing!  Such great hospitality!

author: Zachary T
title: Exceptional Service and Hospitality for Our Group Event
text:
We recently hosted a group event at Wyndham Garden Chinatown and were extremely pleased with the experience from start to finish.

Despite a very short planning timeline, Sean Sy and the entire team were professional, responsive, flexible, and genuinely committed to making our event successful. Communication was excellent throughout the process, and every detail was handled with care and efficiency.

The meeting space was well prepared, the beverage service was excellent, and the staff went above and beyond to accommodate our group's needs. Their hospitality made a significant difference and allowed us to focus on our program without worrying about logistics.

A special thank you to Sean for his outstanding customer service and partnership. It is clear that he and his team take great pride in providing an exceptional guest experience.

We highly recommend Wyndham Garden Chinatown for meetings, group events, and accommodations in New York City, and we look forward to working with them again in the future.
