author: Hannah M
title: Family room No111.
text: We stayed during April and fortunately it was only for one night, so it was tolerable for that reason only. Three of the lights didn't work (either side of the double bed and the one above the mirror) making the room overall dark, relying on what lighting was left. None of the USB sockets worked. The floor surface was a cheap laminated wood type; but as you can see from the photos, has seen better days. The room is tired and needs repainting. Reception staff on arrival (Axelle) was brilliant; however reception staff on departure didn't even apologise when told about the lighting issue, merely said "thank you for telling us". Another point regarding room 111 - you have to step sideways between the  bottom of the bed and a wall to navigate to the other side of the double bed as the room is so cramped.

author: Leo L
title: Not up to it
text:
Madam; Sir, 
I regret to say that my last stay at your establishment took place very far from the usual standards of the profession. Former member of the hotel and catering industry, now a consultant in the same field, I would like to make my contribution to your progress space, which seems to me to be more than important.

Home: It is announced that elevator works will be carried out during my stay but that they will not impact my tranquility, indeed this was the case and it is good because for the rest everything is in degraded mode at least for room 105 that I occupied

Room cleaning: I found on the carpet a cigarette butt (I do not smoke) apparently present for some time, I handed it to the reception no reaction from the person in charge on Thursday morning 22/01
Comfort; the bathroom is very small impossible to sit on the toilet without touching the prote with his knees, the sink has traces of rust
Shower small, dated, not very clean on arrival
Bed with mattress HS
Some channels on your TV network are not working or are without sound
The second day my room was not made, the person in charge at the reception told me that if I did not ask it it would not be...we are in a 3* hotel???
A person, every evening between midnight and one o’clock in the morning, descends from the laundry boxes on the stairs by throwing them against the landing doors which gives a lot of noise, when he is told that one wants to sleep it is answered that he “he wants to work”.
Breakfast is not extraordinary but nothing wrong with this side
When I left I asked that my note be put in an envelope, the receptionist did not have one and could only offer me a Mermaid pouch with dubious cleanliness that I of course refused...

Thank you for answering me by email to tell me what you think of my observations.
Good to you.

author: Claire E
title: average hotel
text: Location at eurostar is ideal, luggage I can store, also day of departure so you can pick up just before your train goes, staff nice. Stayed 3 nights, not cleaned at all, also no clean towels, picked up at reception. Hotel would need a lot of refurbishment. public transport on the doorstep as well as shared bikes, a few buildings further small supermarket and a nice bakery. Rooms very noisy, with earplugs doable. For sleeping alone nice hotel but are you several hours in your room then it is not advisable. In pictures it looks more beautiful

author: Harper C
title: How to be a bit basic and perfect at the same time.
text:
If you're looking for haute cuisine or even a full English, or if you're looking for sophisticated decor that looks like the Palace of Versailles, then keep walking because this is not the place for you. Yes the hotel may be a bit tired in places, but if you can look past that and appreciate what you are getting for your money then this is a really good place to stay. It is less than ten minutes walk from the Station Gare du Nord, so if you're in Paris for sightseeing from the UK then this place is perfect. It's important to say that whilst some parts look tired, the place is spotlessly clean.

Breakfast is continental, and you can have as much as you like but don't go looking for sausages and black pudding because that's not going to end well for you unless you venture beyond the front door, it's Paris baby, live a little and have a continental breakfast, you can have sausage and bacon when you get home!

The reception staff are all really nice people, and the friendliness and charisma they exude easily patches over any qualms one may have of this hotel not troubling Michelin. The rooms are compact and bijou with little in the way of storage, but you get a safe for your valuables, the shower was excellent and the plumbing works fine. The street outside is incredibly busy and noisy and seems like the emergency service vehicles all got new sirens last week and are running them in BUT when the French windows are closed, the sound insulation is very very good. We slept well on the very comfortable bed.

We stayed for five nights and as I say the accommodation is basic, but absolutely perfect for what we were looking for, incredibly close to the railway station, an excellent boulanger just around the corner, pubs, cafes and restaurants all on hand for the evening too. The staff were brilliant, nothing was ever too much trouble for them and they all ways showed interest in the customers even if we were just passing through. 
Yes even you Ousamme, we thought you were great too - did you share that box of cakes we left?

author: Lucas R
title: ⭐ Not recommended for business travellers
text:
Pros: Rooms modern and clean
Cons:
- No hot water in the shower (despite notification no solution)
- No goodwill: full charge despite late arrival due to strikes
- Invoices incorrect multiple times
- Personnel less solution-oriented
👉 For about 180 € per night absolutely disappointing

author: Sean R
title: No Hot Water for 5 Days – Worst Hotel Ever!
text: No hot water for 5 days! Dirty, noisy, no cleaning, no toilet paper, and staff didn’t care at all. One of the worst hotels I’ve ever stayed in – avoid at all costs!

author: Ella H
title: If my mother likes it, it's good
text: Hotel located very close to Gare du Nord, on a large avenue, carpeted, reasonably clean, with correct bathroom. But if my mother liked it, it's perfect.

author: Henry A
title: Excellent location , friendly and accommodating staff and large family rooms
text: We stayed her on our way back home from Disney. Very convenient for the gate du nord. Staff were brilliant and the hotel looked after our luggage all day while we looked around Paris. Rooms were large and clean. Our family room had two TVs which the children loved. I would recommend this hotel

author: Holly U
title: Seeing is not believing.
text: Don't believe the photos you see. This is one run down tired hotel. It's like a Frankenstein hotel all a mish mash of pieced together stuff. The only good thing I can say about it is that it does have an elevator. If you are on a limited budget, I suppose it would do.

author: Owen T
title: Awful
text:
On the plus side it is very close to the Gare du Nord, but then again so are some many shop doorways, and benches which would probably provide the same level of comfort and security.  The photos are a masterclass in polishing a turd.  

The whole hotel looks like it was painted in a hurry 30 years ago and not been repaired since. Look at the photo of the hall way - it is disgusting. I am not sure it has ever been hoovered or cleaned, and I'm honestly not exaggerating. Also take a look at the "view" from the window. The bathroom is a cupboard without a bath and a shower door that won't shut so the floor gets drenched. 

The worst part though was that our four bed cell, I mean room, had what appeared to be badly filled in rodent holes. I suspect that's what they were because they had not got round to doing one - see picture. 

The breakfast was awful. They had a bowl of uncooked eggs that you could boil yourself if you wanted one together with some tired cheese and bread still on the packet so you could pull it out yourself and share your germs with the other guests. Ironically the cleaning lady barged into the room at 10.40 when check out is at 11 demanding that she did her bit whilst we were in there. All just very weird.

It cost us almost EUR 400 for one night so if I were you I'd stay literally anywhere else.

author: Charlotte S
title: Great hotel for visiting Paris
text:
I stayed with my sisters and a friend for 3 nights. 
This was my 4th or 5th time staying. 
I love the hotel. It is perfectly situated, clean, and all the staff are lovely. 
Breakfast is excellent for the price.  
It is on a busy street and there is traffic - but I find that part of the charm.  Easy walking distance to many of the main attractions.  
I shall be back again.

author: Zoe T
title: Good location but VERY loud
text: Rooms are nice, clean and tidy and very modern. However, no storage space at all. Not even a rail to hang stuff on so we had to live out of our suitcase for 4 days. I heavily suggest they purchase some wardrobes or atleast coat hangers for those staying longer than a night. Breakfast very basic. This hotel is located on a VERY noisey road. Car horns beeping every night till about 2am. Access to public transport is great to get about that city and price is good. Good for those staying a night or 2, longer than that I wouldn’t recommend

author: Adam O
title: horrible experience
text:
1 star review. deserved for this hotel. i recently stayed here for 3 nights. the room itself was fine, everything around it was horrible! the service gets a 0/10. 

first of all, when we arrived we were told our room would be ready in an hour. so we left and came back after an hour and a half, only to be told our room wasn't ready for another hour. fine, so we went outside again. we came back and got "our" key at 15:00. 

when we went up to "our" room i opened the door to 2 people having sex in the room, i wish i was kidding. i went back to the reception where acinu "helped" me. he told me our real room was not ready and we again had to wait. he offered nothing for the traumatizing experience of me walking in on two people. 

we had to wait for our room until 16:00, but at least we got one day of free breakfast for the inconvenience of waiting, but nothing offered for the incident. after asking for the manager we got offered a 17 euro boat tour to compensate as we would not be able to get our money back or a discount. 

the whole situation was handled horribly. acinu was no help at all and didn't seem to care about the situation. it was his manager who apologized and offered anything at all. 

the breakfast we got for free was of bad quality, very minimal. the wifi also sucks btw.

the rooms are not soundproof at all, you can hear anything going on in the other rooms as well as in the hall. the personell does not take this into account as they are giggling and talking very loudly in the halls in the early morning. 

the staff also does not speak english well and look at you like you are crazy for speaking it to them. completely disregard you and speak in french to each other. even though i knew some french, they pretended to not understand anything and would just walk away without helping me further.

overall, the room itself was great, especially for the price. but the service was so so so SO horrible. i cannot justify anything above 1 star.

author: Sofia K
title: not a 3-star
text: Location very close train station north. The bedroom and bathroom were under the roofs with velux. In the bedroom, it is impossible to move without bumping or being forced to stoop even in the bathroom. Toilet glued to the bathtub and sink. And no curtain or wall to wash. (so plenty of water in the bathroom and on the toilet.) The hotel does not have the status of a 3-star hotel.

author: Aiden R
title: Located in the charming Marais...
text: We spent three nights at the "Aida" hotel, located on a quiet street. The room is a bit small and angular, but equipped with air conditioning and clean. Very pleasing for a three-star hotel: there is body lotion!  The breakfast is okay. The ladies and gentlemen at the front desk were very friendly and helpful (tips for dinner).

author: Lucy N
title: Avoid the poky rooms at the back. Good hotel otherwise
text: Mixed experience here, booked a superior double via Booking.com. Arrived to find we were in room 11 which is more like a cupboard, the roof was sloping and the bathroom so small I had to sit on the loo sideways! I complained to reception and the guy told me “ all the rooms are superior “. He did however try to move us but the rooms were all fully booked. He arranged to move us the next day but we had to pack all our things and put them in left luggage. The second room was 301 and was a much bigger room with a great bed and bathroom which I couldn’t fault. We found it very handy for both Gare du Nord and Gare Lyon. Also easy to reach the top sights.

author: Lucas D
title: Not recommended
text:
They have broken furniture that you are charged for if you do not notice it upon entering the room and reporting it.

Staff entering the rooms after check-in by the guests (with clothes, luggage, documentation, money, etc.)

author: Olivia X
title: An excellent hotel.
text: An exceptional stay in a refined and calming setting. Attentive staff, impeccable rooms, high-end service, and delicious cuisine. An unforgettable experience that I would recommend without hesitation.

author: Henry Y
title: Horrible
text:
Stay away at all costs. We booked through booking.com. The manager, Oscar. Would not reimburse us for a tour booked with Viator that we missed because our safe would not open. They claimed they had to get a technician only to have the cook come 30 minutes later with a key. Oscar advised us that because we left a bad review on trip advisor there is nothing he can do. I took the review off but am reinstating it. I waited for the director, a Mr Rosen to call me to no avail. Booking.com reached out for a resolution and was unable to find a suitable solution. 
Please do not stay. They do not honour guests.

author: Harper S
title: Hotel Aida Marais lovely
text:
This was my second stay at Hotel Aida Marais and once again it was great! The staff were all really friendly and helpful, from reception to the kitchen team.

The rooms were clean, towels were changed daily, and the whole hotel was well looked after. Breakfast was lovely too. The location is perfect, close to lots of attractions.

I honestly can’t fault anything. I love Paris and will definitely stay here again next time!

author: Jessica J
title: Short trip to Paris
text: Location is perfect for visiting Paris. Metro nearby. Lots of restaurants and bars. Bakery Mamiche is the best of Paris!!!!!

author: Isabella U
title: very good hotel
text: The hotel is very well located. The room was spacious and very clean. Breakfast was very hearty. The staff are friendly and smiling, and available for our various requests.

author: Zoe K
title: Very good hotel
text: Very good hotel, well located, breakfast very well, welcoming staff. This is my second stay and if I return to Paris I would choose this hotel again.

author: Oliver G
title: EXCELLENT OPTION
text:
Excellent location, staff always willing to help, spacious and comfortable twin room and good bathroom.
Plus some nice little details like coffee machine in the room and tea, coffee and something sweet every afternoon in the lobby.

author: Laura C
title: Excellent
text: Perfect Welcoming / Spacious room, clean and with coffee maker, water, ... / hot and cold drinks with self-Service pastries at Welcoming / hearty and varied breakfast

author: Mason F
title: Ekaterina
text: Nice hotel, well situated with good service. We enjoyed our stay there; it was 3 nights. Near the hotel there is very good bakery, restaurant and metro station is in 5 minutes.

author: Charlotte H
title: the receptionist called me fucking idiot
text: It was the most terrible experience ever. The deposit left could not be refunded for an error of the receptionist at check in, I ask to have the invoice and the receptionist at check out does not listen and closes the account without entering either the name or the VAT number of the company, offends me by calling me dumbass, telling me that I am a fuicking client, sends me away from the hotel screaming personal offenses in my face, takes me back without my consent with his mobile phone saying that I am a liar. I ask to speak to the manager and he shouts in my face "are you a fucking idiot? do you think I can call my manager at 8:40 in the morning? I feared for my safety and left the hotel.

author: Megan L
title: Paris on the terrace
text: Excellent room on the 5th floor with access to a terrace with a view. Hotel close to place de la republique with metro nearby and located in area with many restaurants Quiet and clean

author: James P
title: Nothing wrong!
text: Short stay but nothing wrong, quiet and clean room, beautiful bathroom, good bedding. Decent breakfast.

author: Poppy H
title: Excellent
text: The location is great and customer service was superb. Close to coffee shops and transportation facilities. The hotel is in a safe and nice neighborhood with great views of the city.

author: Katie N
title: Comfortable & friendly hotel near Metro
text: We enjoyed our stay at Aida Marais! Great location near multiple Metro lines; walkable neighborhood; friendly & helpful staff; very comfortable beds; coffee machine in room; free luggage storage.

author: Jack D
title: Nice stay in Paris
text: Excellent stay. Room 25 was perfect: clean, comfortable and very well equipped. The breakfast was also of high quality, with choice and fresh produce. A very good experience overall. I recommend this property.

author: Zoe Z
title: Bedbugs
text:
Oh, please. Disinfect room 505. It's full of bedbugs. I got stings all over my body.
Awful experience.

author: Tyler A
title: Great hotel
text:
Location is perfect; close to good metro connection.
The street is quiet.
Nice breakfast.
Friendly staff, friendly staff.

author: Zachary H
title: Spend the extra money if you can for a private bathroom and a good night sleep
text:
If you're looking for a place in a good location that doesn't break the bank, this would be reasonable. But the rooms are so small and tight you can barely move.

Plus, you can hear every single little thing as the cubicles are so close together, and you can hear people's footsteps, coughing, and peoples' conversations in the common areas and bathroom. So if you want to get a good night sleep, this is not the place. I was lucky to have gone back to sleep, but I was woken up by so much noise (and I'm not talking about the noise that you would hear in the city like from sirens, cars, honking, and just overall city noise), but noise from my my room.

Plus I had to walk up 5 flights of stairs to get to my room. Check-in is on the fourth floor. I did not know any of this. I wish there was an elevator because I had my stuff to bring up and down the stairs while checking in and checking out.

The good thing was that I always felt safe here, since they give you a key to get into the front door, as well as a key for your room. Check-in process was very easy and smooth, as well as checkout. The staff were nice and pleasant,!and the other guests were polite, but it came down to not having a good night rest, and peace and quiet, especially at night. Plus not a ton of space to move. 

I woke up with a terrible headache the next morning from being woken up to all of the noise coming from my floor, even though the hotel reinforces quiet and they have quiet hours. You can still hear everything.

Breakfast is very minimal and bathrooms are so tight. The stall is only one stall and the sinks had other peoples' hair on it. They do have a hair dryer that is high speed and works well, but would not recommend trying to get ready there because you are sharing space with everyone else on your floor. And if no one happens to be in the bathroom while you were trying to blow dry or curl your hair, then you're all set, but you can't count on that.

Overall, try to find another place to stay.
Even though this is a really fair price, and you can't beat this kind of price in Manhattan. I would not be staying here again.

author: Paige E
title: AVOID
text: I haven’t been able to sleep well during my stay and decided to rearrange my trip by canceling and flew back home early. Only way I was able to get a full nights rest was by sleeping around 3-5am. You can hear and feel when people walk by. To stop someone from snoring, one of the staff members will knock until the snorer stops… This will also wake up others. What was supposed to be a peaceful trip quickly reminded me most ppl wont care if they disturb others as long as they find something affordable.

author: Henry N
title: Great friendly staff
text: Very very friendly staff like sunny. Loved the whole stay. Got more than what I expected. Suitable pricing for center of Manhattan.

author: Erin S
title: Great and convenient stay
text: Great location, 2 minute walk from Penn Station and MSG. You can go anywhere in a very quick time. Continental breakfast was super useful and the staff were extremely friendly!!! Super fair price for the location, especially in Manhattan. Would come here again if I had to. I want to thank Sunny for being so courteous and friendly!

author: Jack G
title: Better than New York itself
text: Thank you Sunny for an amazing stay in New York. Affordable, homey and great people! Thank you for feeding us every morning, too!

author: Kyle N
title: Pocket-Sized NYC Adventure
text: Great breakfast! Perfect and safe location for exploring NYC. Quick to resolve issues with noisy guests during quiet time. Very nice host SUNNY – helpful, always in a good mood, and talkative. Caring cleaning lady – thumbs up for her!

author: Chloe E
title: A fantastic place to stay
text: The staff here are extremely friendly, accommodating, and thoughtful of all the guests. I didn't have a single negative interaction with them, and as long as you're respectful of them and the other guests (as well as quiet during quiet hours and following the very simple rules) you shouldn't either. The bathrooms completely surprised me with how clean they were, I didn't see any mess a single time, the water for the showers and sinks are always hot, and the other guests are as polite and considerate as they can be. The actual sleeping space, despite its size, has all you'll need, a replaceable bath towel, a very nice, neat bed, a deceptively good sized trash can, a little desk for any extra appliances that also has a fan, and plenty of storage room under the bed and desk. I never felt unsafe while I was here. The breakfast is a bonus on top of all of that, unfortunately I couldn't eat much of it due to time, but there was always something available when I saw the offerings. Great local

author: Chloe T
title: Perfect space for solo travel
text: Comfortable and peaceful!  Clean!!!  Friendly staff!!!  Highly recommend!!!  Great location to Penn Station and Madison Square Garden!

author: Katie G
text:
“Excellent stay! Clean rooms, friendly staff, and a perfect location. Highly recommended. 

Host Sunny is awesome and best.

author: Noah L
title: A wonderful place in Manhattan!
text: This place feels like home. Sunny (the host) and all the staff are incredibly kind and welcoming. I highly recommend for everyone who wants to enjoy NYC on foot. Best place ever! Thanks again Sunny for your kindness and for the amazing gifts.

author: Anna W
title: Host very kind and welcoming
text:
Impressed by the calm of this place and the breakfast offered.
Cool unlimited water ideal for the New York heat

author: Daisy J
title: Nice stay for simple people
text:
New York Spirit Retreat is the perfect hostel for everybody who wants to stay for a short time in NYC!
There is a great vegetarian breakfast provided, the room and shared areas are clean, and the hosts are all super friendly and helpful.
The location is good, close to everything one wants to see during his trip in NY.
A specialty about Spirit Retreat:
The offer a program, in which they distribute food to those in need in the city.
It happens three times a week and everybody is encouraged to come and participate.
Totally recommend it!
Wish you guys all the best for the future!
Luca

author: Megan A
title: Love Thy Neighbor, Above All Love God.
text: The hostel was a very quiet and friendly place. Hosts Alfred, and Sunny are very warm and welcoming. I know it goes a long way to help the needy and they do it so well. I was very happy to know that I stayed where I could lend a hand by supporting this amazing kitchen. We may not all be the same in our own journey but I know that I love Christ very much and it does not take anything from us to love one another. Why? God so loved the world that He gave His "only" begotten Son, and that whosoever believes in Him shall not perish but have everlasting life. I am very humble to serve God in this way. I love you all and I want you to know.

author: William S
title: Amazing ❤️🌼
text: Great experience. Lovely accommodation that takes good care of pm their guests 🙏❤️ Highly recommend this accommodation to others.

author: Andrea H
title: Great Stay in New York!
text: I love this place! This is the real New York City Experience. Transit is very close and you feel right at home. I definitely recommend it!

author: Michael E
title: Best hostel in new york
text: Stay was really good, neat and clean bed.. Everything was hygienic …Time square is near by  and many other location .. thanks for provinding great stay.. and thanks to Sunny so kind and helpful.

author: Rosie U
title: A Hidden Gem of Kindness in Manhattan
text:
This place was more than just a place to rest, it was a reconnection.
Thank you to SUNNY for your charisma, your love, and your beautiful hospitality.
May your light continue to shine on those who need it most.
I truly recommend this place as a special and meaningful spot in Manhattan.

author: Hannah V
title: Nice centrally located budget rooms
text: Small cozy rooms like advertised, good value for money. Location is very central and easy to find. Sunny was very welcoming, friendly and warm. There's good all day breakfast and overall nice positive vibes. There's also yoga and other activities if you'd like to partake.

author: Charlie Z
title: A Good stay
text:
I had a truly wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The apartment was exactly as described—spotlessly clean, stylishly decorated, and fully equipped with everything I needed. The location was perfect, just a short walk from great restaurants, public transport, and local attractions. The host was incredibly welcoming and responsive, always quick to answer any questions and offer helpful local tips. I especially appreciated the small touches like fresh towels, coffee, and even a city map. It really made me feel at home. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!
Thank you!Sunny!

author: Marta T
title: staying at Alfred.
text: I really enjoyed staying at Alfred. The staff was especially friendly, and I want to send many prayers for my best friend Sunny. Wherever he is, may he always stay in peace. Whether you’re a businessman or a tourist, this place is truly worth it. I give it a full 5-star rating.

author: Julien X
title: Let's not even go there
text:
Really ugly place. Old, cold rooms and mattresses as hard as concrete. Small and dysfunctional bathroom. Poor and limited breakfast, only English breakfast available. 
The only saving grace is the location, near the subway.

author: Evie E
title: My BDay Vacation in London
text: We had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help. The location was convenient near in subway and bus lines. it was an excellent experience, and we would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

author: Andrea D
title: Good value for money for London!
text:
We spent 3 nights at the Gresham Hotel and, overall, we are satisfied with our stay. The hotel is very well located, a few minutes from Paddington, which is really convenient for visiting London.

The rooms are small, but that is quite standard in London. They are clean, decent, and sufficient for a city trip. The bed was a bit soft for our taste, but we still slept well.

The staff is really very welcoming and helpful, always with a smile.

The breakfast is simple but gets the job done: English breakfast every morning, some pastries (pre-packaged), cereals, hot drinks… The selection is not huge, but it is decent. The breakfast room is in the basement and can be a bit noisy. The hotel's soundproofing could also be improved.

In summary, a simple hotel, well located and with very good value for money to discover London. We would return there without a problem.

author: Daisy I
title: Enter at your own RISK!!
text: Location ok, the place itself is so bad, never ever have we been in anything like it, after 3 room changes we settled with the best but is far from the best, the place is smelly, dirty, falling to bits, it should never be trading, please don't go there, worst experience in our lives.

author: Miguel Z
title: Pleasant stay and cleanliness top
text:
I stayed for 5 nights with my boyfriend in this hotel. Its location is excellent, just minutes from the metro, TESCO supermarket, MC, various souvenir shops and where you can eat. The staff is present h24 in the reception. Cleanliness is great, towels are changed daily and milks redone and arranged.
The only downside is that the master bedroom was very small and was located in an area of the hotel where noises were heard all the time, making rest a bit difficult. The bathroom was quite large and functional, with hot shower and hairdryer.

author: Jack U
title: Gresham in the Garden
text: Our room was small with access by lift and stairs.  Breakfast available including an option of English Breakfast offered by the kitchen.  Reception operates 24 hours and you leave your key there when going out.

author: Sara M
title: Good, central, well priced
text: Two streets from Paddington Station. The hotel was very clean, we had the quad room, two double beds. Staff were helpful. Breakfast is good for £5.00, cereals, toast, yoghurt, fruit cocktail, cooked but don't always have bacon. But hey its five quid in Central London. Front desk is staffed 24/7, and they store luggage. Beds were  firm but comfortable. Also got a microwave and fridge in the room. There's a couple lifts too.

author: Oscar Y
title: Dismal experience
text:
We had a terrible time because it has no air conditioning and it was horrendous hot in the room. There was only one fan that was not used to relieve the heat and we could not open the window because huge ants came in and you could also hear the pigeons that are in the inner courtyard and noises from the kitchen. The bathroom is very small, but I think it is in every hotel in London. 
If you go to this hotel because it includes breakfast, I do not recommend it because it is lousy. The English breakfast lousy, there is no hot milk, you have to order it and they take a long time. There's no coffee, just sachet coffee.
A few cereals, toast, jam and Nutella. There are no cold cuts and the juices are disgusting. It is preferable to go to a supermarket and buy something for breakfast and coffee outside.
I do not recommend it and would never return.

author: Erin L
title: 2 night stay for Coldplay
text: had a very pleasant 2 night stay at the Gresham, friendly staff, great location, room was adequate.  Hotel was very clean, the lifts worked.  Handy for tubes and plenty of bars and eating places nearby.  would stay again. cooked breakfast could have been a little better but apart from that 3 couples had a great stay.  close to hyde park too

author: Ryan I
title: Close walk to Paddington station
text: The staff was nice. The room was small. But we were only sleeping there, so that wasn't a big deal. It was hot and the fan that was in the room didn't work great. As other reviews stated the WIFI wasn't great. We would have WIFI then suddenly not have it, that was annoying.  My son got a cut on his leg from a screw that wasn't all the way screwed into the bed. They had a full English breakfast (eggs, sausage, and beans). We didn't eat that, but we ate the other things that were offered (cereal, oatmeal, toast). But by far the best thing about the hotel was the location. It's about a 4 minute walk from Paddington Station.

author: David D
title: Enjoyable stay
text:
Good value, great location and perfect for my solo needs. The breakfast was good if you are not vegan, luckily I am not a breakfast person. I would like to mention the rat problem. There are no skips for the row of hotels and rubbish bags were placed on railings opposite - the council need to sort this out - one ran across my feet when I was returning from a day out and I’m not sure who got the biggest shock - me or the rat!
That was the only thing that bothered me and I enjoyed my stay. The staff were pleasant, the shower good and I’m glad I stayed here

author: Lauren Y
title: The smallest ,  hottest room I have ever experienced
text:
Lovely little hotel in a perfect location for Hyde park.
We were put in a room on floor 4  ?
OMG it was absolutely horrendously hot.
A tiny room with a tiny window in the attic space .
Window wouldn’t open more that 5 inches so we put a shoe there to try and keep it open,
The owners had placed a fan in the room however it was like a hairdryer on constantly, we couldn’t sleep in the 30 degree temperature up  in the room.
Breakfast was very much a disappointment.
Walked into the basement dining area with no guidance on what to do?
A lady then said “ full English” to which we both said yes .
2 plates of sausage, egg and beans arrived?
I run a restaurant and that certainly isn’t a full English breakfast ?
Pleasant staff and probably ok for maybe one night?
Definitely not recommended for anything longer than that sorry

author: Katie M
title: Lovely Staff- Great Hotel and the location is excellent
text: Wonderful hotel! The staff are so nice here- it exceeded my expectations to be honest. A beautiful Victorian building looking out at other Victorian buildings it was everything I wanted from the London experience. The room was very clean and the bed was dressed everyday. The bathroom which was spotless was as big as the room with a shower bath and the towel and toiletries changed every day. We were up on the fourth floor which was lovely and quiet. The hotel is in a lovely, quiet and safe location. I was travelling with my daughter and we never felt unsafe there and it is five minutes walk from Paddington train and underground station which was very handy for travelling around. The A2 bus also brings you to a stop beside the train station to and from Luton airport which is very handy for people flying in there but the bus must be pre booked online but there are no changes to and from the airport it’s direct so it’s very handy. The location of the hotel is fantastic with lots of restaurants, nice walks and convenient transport so close by. Overall we had an amazing experience- it was a dream, the staff are fabulous both at the reception and the kitchen staff who serve the breakfast are so friendly and helpful and the housing keeping staff take great care of the place and ensure it’s spotless. The only recommendations I would make would be that an investment in a proper coffee machine and a slice of bacon at breakfast would go a long way but we loved our stay and will definitely be back.

author: Mia C
title: Met our needs.
text:
Stayed here for one night.

Location good for us (close to Paddington).

Room was small with dated and tired decor, but was quiet and clean. Beds were very comfortable.  'English' Breakfast comprised 2 eggs, 1 sausage, baked beans and toast. Was fine.

Overall we would stay again, but probably not for more than one night.

author: David Z
title: Good breakfast, but full of problems
text: The only reason that I gave this hotel 2 stars is because it has a nice English breakfast included (beans, eggs, sausage, toast, and a few other items), and most of the front desk clerks are helpful.  The reason that I didn't give more stars is because my 6 day stay had a number of problems attached to the hotel.  First off was the noise from the room above me. (I was in room 219).  This is an old building and has thin walls and ceilings/floors.  Whoever was able me was walking around constantly in shoes into the wee hours of the morning.  When I told the clerk the morning after she told me to come to the desk if it happened again (there are no phones in the rooms) and that the clerk would talk to them and explain that they need to be quieter.  Well, the second night I went down to the desk at 11:30 pm and basically, the male clerk said that there was nothing he could do, that they were sold out and couldn't get me another room.  The noise went on till 3:30 am.  The next morning the woman clerk told me that she would find me another room, and she did (room 253).  That helped for the next 3 days, I finally got some sleep.  The last night we were there I woke up  at about 11:30 pm because the wall lamp came on.  There was water dripping down the wall from the ceiling into the lamp.  I tried to shut the lamp off and got a bad shock.  I wasn't sure what to do so I went to the desk, and a different male clerk found me a new room immediately, thank goodness.   But I had to pack and move twice, and was in 3 different rooms in 6 days because of problems.  I would never recommend this hotel to anyone, and I'd never stay there again.

author: Henry B
title: Perfect hotel for price and good location
text: We were in a couple for three nights. The room is small but it is excellent value for money as it is clean, they make the bed every day, change your towels, you have a commensurate breakfast and that is not easy to get at this price in London. Of course the location is privileged because you go to all means of transport just walking 200 meters and if you want to eat in the neighborhood is full of restaurants! Excellent would return

author: Jack Q
title: Good value for money, good location
text: Great value, close to station, bars and restaurants, friendly staff, small single rooms but adequate, good breakfast included but no bacon, set in a quiet square with not much traffic noise. Very close to the Paddington basin and little venice

author: Ana O
title: Nice
text: I enjoyed my stay of 8 nights.  The entire hotel staff were very nice and accommodating. Breakfast was always great with a nice cheerful kitchen staff.  The hotel was clean and quiet & peaceful at night. My room was cozy and comfortable. I would definitely  recommend  this hotel and I would gladly stay here again.

author: Ana M
title: Dissapointing
text:
This seemed to be reasonably priced with breakfast included but was a complete let down.

Continental is self service but English Breakfast isn't which consists of one sausage, beans and two fried eggs
Staff were ok but needed to be more welcoming on arrival I thought

Although the room was small, it was clean and the hotel is located close to Paddington station
Unfortunately, it's not a hotel I would return to

author: Oliver Q
title: Location good, otherwise very poor quality. Not recommended.
text:
Wanted somewhere close to Paddington Station and this was ideal, about 500 yards from the station. 
On arrival staff were polite but not very welcoming or friendly. 
Hotel is run down and needs an upgrade urgently.
Room was a decent size, but the furnishings were poor, and there were several negative points.
Generally clean but lots of dust and fluff on high surfaces (eg lights over bed) and just under bed where I put my case.
Furniture very old looking and the drawers were hard to open. 
Flaking plasterwork on wall by head/headboard. 
Flickering fluorescent lights were a nuisance. 
Plenty of towels available and lots of hot water, but the shower head was cracked and covered with limescale and the water went everywhere but where it was meant to go.
Bed and pillows reasonably comfortable, but thin throw on top of a single sheet was not very warm. 
The hotel was extremely noisy. Traffic noise was very loud from up on the street, and the windows poorly sound insulated. 
Doors banging throughout the night and loud voices kept me awake. 
All in all although it is a budget hotel, it was pretty poor value for money at over £130 for a single night. There is better value out there. 
I will not be back here and with the exception of the location I do not recommend it at all.

author: Lucy J
title: Pleasant
text: A very pleasant welcome A clean hotel a cozy terrace

author: Isla P
title: Great location
text: As previously mentioned in other people's reviews we found the room cosy, fine if you dont have much luggage to store away,but no where to store larger luggage. There are no fridges within the room should you need one. The mattress were quite hard. Great air condition lovely to come back to a cool room after a day in Paris. Location really good easy to get into the city by either bus or metro, both a few minutes walk away. Lots of food choices on the doorstep and a supermarket a short walk away. Lovely quiet neighborhood.

author: Kyle X
title: Best air con.
text: I only stayed at this hotel because after researching online extensively, I realised that the air con in Paris hotels can be hit and miss. With temperatures high at the moment, I didnt want my trip ruined by a hot hotel room.  After staying at this hotel for 4 nights I can indeed confirm that the air condition was suberb, in fact it was so cold at points that i had to adjust it and turn the temperature up. Other than that, it was comfortable, clean, the bed and bedding was good quality. But if you are looking to get out of the heat then go to the Apolonia.

author: Rosie U
title: We keep coming back here.
text: We have already been here 14 times. Stayed in this cozy hotel and will come back again and again. It is located at the foot of Montmartre and is a wonderful starting point for exploring Paris. The hotel team is super friendly and attentive. We were especially taken with Tina and Gabriela, who brightened every moment for us with their warmth. Thanks to the entire team!

author: Freya V
title: Excellent experience
text:
Excellent stay at the Apolonia Montmartre hotel! The location is ideal for discovering the Montmartre district and the main sites of Paris. The room was clean, comfortable, and quiet, which made our stay very pleasant. The staff is welcoming, smiling, and always available to help. We also appreciated the proximity to the subway and the quality of the breakfast. I recommend this hotel without hesitation and I will gladly return during my next stay in Paris.

Azzeddine and all the friends.
Room 102.

author: Grace G
title: A Comfortable Hotel
text: This hotel is in a great spot in Monmartre. Our room was clean and comfortable after a long days travel. The staff were very welcoming and couldn’t have done anymore for us. The breakfasts were filling and simple. However the shower in our room was a Houdini styled one, where you had to squeeze into it. But on a beautiful Saturday evening the bars and cafes across the road made for fantastic people watching. Thank you.

author: Luca A
title: Excellent hotel
text: Well for being in Paris so a bit different from Italian standards it is a great hotel. Recently renovated and done really very well. The lobby is breakfast room is located on the ground floor, they are not very large but very very cozy. Breakfast the right d everything very good. The room is a little small but very nice, kept perfectly, all new. Large shower. And comfortable bed. Beautiful location in a neighborhood of restaurants and bars but at the same time very quiet and peaceful especially at night. 1 minutes from the metro stop and 5 minutes walk from the church the sacred heart, where there are other shops etti and restaurants. I STRONGLY RECOMMEND IT!!!

author: Amelia K
title: Great hotel
text:
Our family of four had a lovely stay here last week. Both our twin rooms had been recently renovated and were very clean and comfortable. The rooms weren't that big but we expected that and had no problem with it. 
The reception staff were great, very friendly and nothing was any trouble. 
We didn't take advantage of the breakfast, instead we used the lovely boulangerie next door. There's another good one just along the road as well as a Carrefour supermarket for any bits and pieces you need. 
The hotel is well placed for exploring in the Montmartre area, only about 10/15 minutes walk or so (steps involved) from Place du Tertre and the Sacre Coeur and there are lots of cafes and restaurants nearby. 
We used the public bus quite a bit, there was a stop just along the road which took us right to the Louvre and other stops close by to get to other areas/landmarks.
We would recommend this hotel and would happily stay here again on a future visit.

author: Mia P
title: Superb stay!
text: Fantastic from the moment we arrived! We got to Paris earlier than usual check in time but wanted to drop our bags off. Luckily they checked if a room was available and kindly allowed us to check in earlier. The room was small but exactly what we need for a 1 night stay in the city.

author: Mathis K
title: Things to review
text:
Nice hotel in a nice tourist area. Ease of getting there and lots of shops nearby.
Welcoming and warm staff, decent breakfast for the price.
But, quality / price ratio not good for the service. Room said "comfort", window in single glazing (on Saturday, the bar opposite is lively and we had the impression of being with the young), worrying about joints so condensation +++ when waking up! Shower joints poorly cleaned and bathroom mini, mini (better not be corpulent otherwise you do not fit in the shower). "Day" that passes under the bedroom door, a person in the hallway = light that turns on = light that enters the bedroom. Not to mention the privacy... In short, remember:
+ Staff and breakfast.
- Room (too bad, because at, the base we come to a hotel for that)

author: Carlos C
title: Clean and well located.
text:
Clean hotel, recently renovated.
Well located, 15 min walk from the Sacré coeur. Metro Station 4 minutes walk ( Line 12: Lamarck- Caulaincourt )
Comfortable room. Bathroom a little small.
Everything is functional.
Thank you for the self-service candy at the reception:-)

author: Oliver P
title: In general okay
text: It was a good stay. Location is great, you are in the middle of a nice neighborhood with restaurants. Metro is around the corner. And the staff is very friendly. Only thing is that they were doing work, so all three days we stayed there was noise early in the morning. Even on weekends. It started around 8/9 a.m. And the room is also very small, smaller than we expected. We also regretted that the room was cleaned instead of cleaned. Would have liked after a few days to have new towels and toilet paper.

author: Noah S
title: Recommended
text:
We stayed here at the beginning and end of a rail trip to Nice. The rooms are, as you would expect for Paris, quite small but serviceable enough. The bathrooms are tiny and the one in our first room was a miracle of engineering to get all that in the space of a large cupboard. Nevertheless it was all there and included very nice rainfall shower. Beds were comfortable and aircon efficient.

The breakfast was comprehensive enough and the decor was refreshing. Staff were invariably friendly and helpful. Useful that although there is no room safe you can have an individual drawer safe in the reception area.

The Hotel is a short walk from the Lamarck Caulaincourt Metro stop but do be aware that there is a flight of steps to negotiate across the road from the station entrance - so remember that when you are leaving and carrying luggage.

Location of the Hotel is quite residential but there are plenty of places to eat and drink a short stroll away. Also easy to walk round the main points of interest in Montmartre - including the Sacre Coeur  - but you will be going uphill a fair bit. Obviously the Metro being so close means its easy to get to the main sights of central Paris.

author: Harry V
title: Small scale nice and nice hotel in Montmartre
text: Small scale hotel in Montmartre. Nice and nice hotel. We had a Comfort Double room. This one's small. You can just walk around your bed and there is little closet space to put your stuff in. With 2 suitcases because of the interrail it was pass and measure to get somewhere to put them. Bed is also queen size, please note that (is also on the site). For us, fine. Bed was comfortable. No kettle in the room, but a Nespresso machine. Bathroom was also very small. Drying was one thing. You'll be a loan, shall we say. They only clean your room on request. For us no need every day. The room was very clean and there were fine soft large towels. Staff are very nice and speak all English. Breakfast not taken advantage of. Next to the hotel is a bakery and a little further on a Carrefour. Also all nice restaurants around the corner and the metro stop (Lamarck - Caulaincourt, which has an elevator by the way) is also nearby. We will definitely come back sometime or we book the other Apolonia hotel. However, I would choose the family room for more space.

author: Matthew H
title: Avoid this hotel. Find a good hotel in the cool Montmartre neighborhood
text: In a top location, very very nice neighborhood with lovely people. But hotel itself, avoid!!! Very small bed, 140cm? Really not to be done with the two of us.... And short, I'm 170 cm but bed was too short. Twice put up sign asking to clean, is just ignored!! Not done! And it's also dirty, glasses cleaned twice with boiling water, dust Seemed drawn in, so long not polished here. When you shower, the whole bathroom gets wet. Price quality very below standard. Very unfortunate.

author: Rosie U
title: Great hotel with very good value for money
text: We stayed here for the 13th time and will always come back because the hotel is truly unique. The staff incredibly warm and accommodating. The rooms are small but absolutely sufficient for a city break, nicely decorated and very clean. The hotel is in the Cartier Montmartre, Metro just 2 minutes away. There are many bars and restaurants nearby, here you can spend nice evenings. This place is really highly recommended.

author: Luca E
title: Perfect.
text:
Very good experience, a small efficient and very clean hotel.
Great bathroom and nice room.
Very professional staff, whether at reception in the evening and in the morning. 
Perfect location 10 minutes max from the sacred heart. 
Thank you for this stay

author: Rosie C
title: Position ok
text:
The location is very convenient to Montmartre.  Breakfast is included in the price, not plentiful but there is.
I recommend staying here.
Small room and bathroom but in French standards!!!!
Cleanliness perhaps not impeccable.
They only redo the room if you ask.

author: Ethan U
title: Room on the ground floor almost basement
text:
I stayed from May 7 for 3 nights at this hotel, we were 3.
I had asked, if possible, both when booking and a week before arriving a room on the upper floors.
I was assigned room No. 4 ground floor almost basement WITHOUT WINDOW with a double bed and an open sofa bed to the side not a single bed as described when booking, and carpeting to the floor UNACCEPTABLE.
In contrast to the room the bathroom is large and new with shower but no box so in 3 to wash with splashes and water everywhere.
It was not even possible to leave the door open to circulate some air as the courtyard facing the room was used by customers and staff as a smoking area, resulting in smoke in the room.
Breakfast was served in the only good common area of the hotel with sufficient variety of sweet and savoury. With hours from 06.30 on working days and from 7.30 for holidays.
The staff was very friendly....
The area is a bit secluded, but lively and very Parisian which I personally appreciated a lot also because it is far from the “caravans” of tourists visiting Paris.
At check-out you can leave your luggage free of charge until departure.
For me it was NOT a positive stay so if you book attention to the room you are assigned.

author: Chloe O
title: Staff went above and beyond!
text: Such a great hotel in a fantastic location!! AC was cold, rooms clean, and beds comfortable. Staff went above and beyond by storing our cheese for us in their refrigerator for a few days while we went to south of France before returning back to Paris. Cannot say enough good things!! Great value for price. Less than 5 min walk to metro.  Many food options very nearby. Front desk is staffed 24hrs a day and they were always willing to assist us. We stayed in twin room— twin beds right next to each other but with own bedding—room was small but comfortable. I would stay here again!

author: Sydney A
title: Our No. One Choice
text: The staff at the hotel is very friendly and helpful, this is especially true for Sergio at the front desk.  For all four stays at your hotel (over the past five years), he has always gone out of his way to be extremely helpful with suggestions that have made our stay in Paris all the more enjoyable.  Sergio is one of the major reasons that return to the Hotel Muguet year after year.

author: Rosie X
title: Splendid Muguet
text: A  golden 3-Star gem which is a bit like our home away from home which brings us back!  We have stayed here numerous times over the past 1 !/2 decades simply because it is consistently clean, quiet, and staffed by those who focus on superb service.  Sergio is the exemplar of FINE SERVICE!

author: Grace F
title: Pleasant stay in a setting that is still human.
text: Very welcoming hotel with very pleasant staff, Sergio in particular, not to mention the other staff members.

author: Poppy Q
title: Incredible find in Paris
text: I was traveling eventually to Lamotte Beuvron for a horse competition and took the opportunity to visit Paris and Bruge before heading south.  I picked Hôtel Muguet because of the location but was pleasantly surprised with what a find it was and great value for the money.

author: Sophia V
title: August
text: My 2nd time here. Always a great stay! Location is excellent, Sergio is just fantastic and the rooms are wonderful!

author: Molly D
title: A Reliable Gem In the 7th
text: This has been for years our go-to hotel when visiting Paris. Staff is friendly, welcoming and helpful. The rooms are comfortable, clean with all amenities working as intended. Located within easy walking distance to metros, taxis or buses. Several very good restaurants, shops and Rue Cler also within easy walk. Overall, a very good value. Recommended.

author: Carlos O
title: Safe, close to eiffel tower but very small rooms
text:
My sister and I enjoyed our quick stay of 2 nights. Hotel is too small, rooms are smaller. The good thing is that is about 4 blocks from Eiffel tower and you can walk freely to a cafe, the tower, grocery store and restaurants. Very accessible location. Very clean and very glad the bathroom is renovated and super clean. A/C works like wonders. 
The colors of the decorations are something else, purples and reds, would look better with no carper at all. The stairs are very tight and they are spiral shape so if you plan to bring multiple or a big suitcase, be ready for a workout because the elevator can only fit you and a suitcase where all 4 walls are touching you. I would not recommend this elevator to a claustrophobic person, like myself. Would be nice if the hotel offers a suitcase carry service for sure. 
There is nothing complementary but the wifi, so do not expect free coffee or anything.

author: Diego H
title: Very pleasant stay
text:
Ms. Pelletier and her staff go out of their way to make our stay pleasant, whether it is for business or leisure.
The hotel, in addition to being well-located on a quiet street in a lively neighborhood, is remarkably clean and regularly renovated, which offers perfect conditions for a successful stay.

author: Mathis Q
title: Fabulous hidden gem hotel in Paris
text:
This hotel was a recommendation from our Travel agent and it did not disappoint.

The location was perfect walkable so much stuff and nearby a ton of great food and both walkable to the Eiffel Tower and we had a room a view of the top of the Eiffel Tower!

author: Liam C
title: A lovely stay for a couple
text:
The location is the best as you are within walking distance of major attractions particularly just an 8 min walk to see the Eiffel Tower at any time of the day! 
The service was great, all at reception were friendly and helpful with local knowledge. The rooms were very clean and lovely. And I think we got good value for money in July!

author: Poppy Q
title: Absolutely recommended
text: Very nice and clean hotel. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Absolute recommendation, thank you very much!

author: Luke K
title: Hidden Gem in the 7th
text: A wonderful boutique hotel with an extremely attentive staff. On a quiet street near many great sights and metros. Sergio at the front desk went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable and help with a back issue. Also the hotel has great AC which was welcome in the heat wave.

author: Harper N
title: Perfect for first time visitors in Paris!
text: This was the perfect place to stay for my first visit to Paris.  Very convenient, clean and friendly.  I would definitely return and recommend it to anyone.

author: Matthew U
title: My Go-To Hotel in the 7th
text: The hotel is quiet and well located.  Rooms are lovely and well appointed.  The staff is outstanding! I’ll be back!

author: Olivia T
title: Cute boutique hotel
text: Great location, very quiet but still able to see the Eiffel tower. Staff was amazing, super helpful and friendly. Nice breakfast, Good value. Highly recommend.

author: Kyle Z
title: Very, very nice hotel and staff
text:
If we ever go back to Paris, we’ll definitely stay at this hotel again. It’s ideally located on a very quiet street, but there’s a supermarket nearby and a really charming little street lined with cafes and restaurants. The Eiffel Tower was very close by—you can easily walk there—and if you’d rather take the metro, there are two stations nearby. 

Our room was very clean and very quiet. And they have wonderful beds. 

But what really made the hotel exceptional was our receptionist. He made every day a celebration. He was always cheerful and was there to help us with advice and assistance. And not unimportantly: he was very easy to understand because he spoke fluent French, English, and Portuguese. 

We had a wonderful time!

author: Mason X
title: What a Gem!
text:
Just spent a week at Hotel Muguet- tremendous location, very clean and the service from the front desk was over the top. Everyone was helpful but Sergio- AMAZING!
He always greeted us with a warm smile and went out of his way to make anything we needed happen 
I would definitely return here when in Paris

author: Ella I
title: Perfect Hotel!
text: 6 of us stayed 4 nights at Hotel Muguet a few weeks ago and had a fantastic stay. The location is quiet but extremely convenient to the Metro and is easy walking distance to the Eiffel Tower, Invalides and Rue Cler.  The hotel staff is helpful and friendly and the rooms are comfortable and in great condition.  Reasonably priced as well..a great choice in Paris!

author: George G
title: You’ll Love Muguet!
text: Nice room, helpful and friendly staff, really nice breakfast, very convenient to Metro, restaurants, etc.

author: Megan F
title: Great hotel in quiet area.
text:
Excellent hotel!!!
We stayed at the hotel for 5 nights.
The hotel is located within walking distance of all the major tourist attractions in Paris. 
The rooms are very clean and smelly (there was not even a stone in the electric compound), and they are designed at a very high level.
Breakfast is good, it would be nice if they were varied with some vegetables.
Staff are friendly and have a very high service consciousness.
Great hotel, warmly recommended.

author: Ruby U
title: Happy travelers
text:
We stayed for 16 nights. August 2026.

The hotel is beautiful and perfectly situated for visiting all the wonderful sights of Paris. 

Suggest using uber to get around. They arrive fast , and they are cheaper than taxis. 

The hotel staff were brilliant and helpful and so very friendly. 

Highly recommend for one night or a longer visit.

author: Alice F
title: Nice would stay again
text: Hôtel was clean and in a good location. Was offered complimentary coffee and croissant when checked in. Was also able to leave our bags as we got in early. And were able to have early check in.

author: Erin B
title: Lovely stay for a quick visit to Notre Dame
text: Wonderful experience with this charming hotel. Staff were friendly and extremely helpful in securing shuttle service to and from the hotel/train/airport. Easy walk to Notre Dame. Nice-sized room (by Paris standards) with a petite balcony, mini fridge & safe. Highly recommended!

author: Connor V
title: Perfect experience
text: The service was excellent; we received a friendly welcome, and the staff were very attentive. Special thanks to Sebastian ️ The rooms are comfortable, and the location is great, with parking and plenty of places to eat nearby. You can cycle to the Tower in 20 minutes. We will definitely be back—thank you to the hotel for taking such good care of us.

author: James S
title: A great little hotel in a wonderful location
text:
This little hotel is a fantastic base to explore Paris.
It sits in a quiet street in the Latin quarter just around 10 minutes walk from Notre Dame. We booked the balcony room on the 2nd floor and it was really nice. A small room, but with everything we needed - fridge, desk, balcony with table and chairs. The bathroom was clean and fully equipped with kits like toothbrush, shaving etc.

The staff were all super-friendly with us.

As a base, its in a fantastic spot just minutes from many, many bars and restaurants. Notre Dame is just a short walk as are the tour buses and the Seinne itself.

We couldn’t find any fault to be honest. We took breakfast one morning and it was a decent selection of pastries, eggs, cold meat etc. All good and we’d certainly consider returning to the same hotel if we come back to Paris.

author: Isla M
title: Amazing
text: We are always so happy to be here. Excellent location , great atmosphere, staff are all efficient and so kind .

author: Evie G
title: Good accommodations. Good service. Great location
text:
Wonderful experience staying at the Hotel du College de France. We were upgraded to a 6th floor balcony room and the hotel staff was super helpful in all our needs. Continental breakfast with inclusion of eggs each morning. Great location! Hotel is located in the Latin Quarter next to the wonderful Cluny Musee and a few streets from Notre Dame. 
I would highly recommended.

author: Aiden Y
title: Very good establishment for exploring Paris
text:
Very good stay at this hotel. Close to the subway, in a very pleasant neighborhood, an excellent base for exploring Paris: close to everything but quiet! The entire staff is friendly and responsive.
The hotel offers a good breakfast and can keep your suitcases so that you can enjoy your last moments before leaving.
Coming to Paris regularly, we will come back to drop off our suitcases during our next visit. 
I recommend it

author: Laura V
title: More Than a Hotel — A Beautiful Part of My Story
text:
There are some hotels you remember because of their location, their rooms or their comfort — and then there are hotels you remember because they become part of your own story.

Hotel College de France is one of those places for me.

I had stayed here before, years ago, during a very different chapter of my life. Coming back to Paris and staying here again made this visit unexpectedly meaningful. Sometimes it is difficult to explain how much life can change over the years, but returning to the same place and realizing how far you have travelled — not only geographically, but personally — is a very special feeling.

And this hotel made that return even more memorable.

The service from the entire front desk team was truly exceptional. The gentleman at reception who assisted us during our stay deserves a very special mention: always smiling, always kind, always willing to help, and with that rare ability to make a guest feel genuinely welcome rather than simply attended to.

Julie, Yana and the entire team also showed us extraordinary warmth and kindness. Every interaction came with a smile, patience and a sincere desire to help.

For anyone visiting Paris and looking for much more than simply a place to sleep, I can wholeheartedly recommend Hotel College de France. Its location is wonderful, but what makes this hotel exceptional is its people.

Thank you for making our stay so special and for becoming, once again, a beautiful part of my memories of Paris.

Until next time. ❤️

author: Lucy N
title: Quiet, cozy, friendly!
text: We had a lovely stay! The breakfast was a terrific value (and delicious), our room was cozy, clean and comfortable, and the staff members were all very friendly and kind. We liked the neighborhood very much - quieter, but with quick access to tourist attractions!

author: Ian S
title: Lovely stay at Hotel du College de France
text: We had a great stay at Hotel du College de France. Room was spotlessly cleaned daily, air conditioning was cool during the summer weather, our room's balcony was lovely, and the front desk folks were welcoming and responsive to our needs. I also appreciate that they connected with us on WhatsApp to check in before, during, and after our stay. Thank you!

author: Zoe E
title: Good location, friendly, clean, good accommodation
text: Good location, friendly, clean, good accommodation

author: Leo T
title: Mother/daughter trip
text: The hotel is very well located. The staff is delightful and hospitable able to answer all our questions and humoring our attempt at French. :) the breakfast is delicious.

author: Evan Y
title: Perfect everything!
text: What a lovely place! Ideally located, our room was cozy and sweet with all the amenities including a small fridge. The bed was extremely comfortable.  Needless to say everything was clean and bright. The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. Their breakfast option was delicious with many options and at a very good price. We would highly recommend this hotel to any of our friends and family.

author: Ethan P
title: Excellent
text:
The location was close to many places we wanted to visit and to the Metro lines, very convenient. 
The room was very clean and we appreciated the AC!
The staff were truly amazing, all were incredibly friendly and helpful. They went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed and had an excellent stay.

author: Olivia Q
title: Hotel experience
text: Loved this accommodation - the staff were super friendly and helpful ! So comfortable and the location was perfect ! Would definitely recommend for solo traveller. 😘

author: Oliver C
title: Perfect location in Latin Quarter, Amazing Staff and AC!
text:
The staff here are amazing! So attentive. Everything we asked for or about was answered nearly immediately on WhatsApp or at front desk. Location in Latin Quarter perfect - near so many great restaurants but doesn’t have that tourist area vibe. 

The room is small but that can’t be helped as the building is like 500 years old or something - but rooms clean, modern and EFFECTIVE air conditioning during gross summer heat. Definitely recommend!

author: Harper T

text: Excellent hotel. Very clean and comfortable, and the people who work there are very kind and speak English well (for my wife). If I come back to Paris I would be very happy to spend a stay here. Thanks to everyone

author: Matthew K
title: Quaint hotel in an awesome location.

A courtesy tray is provided. The air conditioning is effective (I preferred to turn it off!).
The welcome is friendly (rare in Paris!).

They told us they would fix it but we didn't hear a check up after  we needed to mention it several times they didn't even compensate it with something. It was very warm, in our room it went up to 30 degreees. only on te last night they changed our rooms, i don't do reviews normally but this was necessary.

author: Katie O
title: Hotel

author: Camille O
title: Amazing

author: Matthew Z
title: Very good hotel, to discover
text:
Very nice surprise for this hotel.
Booking without problem for 2 nights. 
The hotel is very well located (14th), 10/15 minutes walk from Montparnasse station and 2 minutes walk from the entrance of the Metro! Pleasant shopping street, to eat without problem.
The room was friendly, the bed comfortable. Kettle + in case appreciated. 
The breakfast is perfect. On the other hand, small room so do not arrive too late in the morning to have room and enough to have breakfast.
The welcome is very good.
Small downside: the hallway light stays on all night and passes through the bedroom door (on the sides). 
I recommend, address to keep for a future stay in Paris.

author: Lucas V
title: Enjoyable stay!

author: Tyler F

author: Liam R

Convenient location for who arrives station Montparnasse.

author: Alice T
title: Excellent night
text: Recently renovated hotel, very functional. Very friendly welcome. The room was spacious and very nice, furnished and tastefully decorated!

author: Poppy B
title: Very nice and well-kept hotel, with some small reservations
text:
I stayed with my children at the Hotel Magenta during a trip to Paris in August and we had a very good time. The hotel is really nice, very clean, and recently modernized. Our triple room was definitely more spacious than the average Parisian room: it had two large windows overlooking the Boulevard de Magenta and a small, but brand new and very functional bathroom.

Also much appreciated was the possibility of having hot and cold drinks available for free, as well as a small outdoor space at the back, pleasant for a break during the day.

Two less positive notes. The Boulevard de Magenta is a very beautiful and convenient area, but in the evening hours the people frequenting the street make returning to the hotel a little less peaceful, especially for those traveling with children. Furthermore, we were asked for 15 euros to be able to check in just an hour before the scheduled time: a request that I found a bit excessive, considering the very small margin.

Overall, however, we liked the hotel and I consider it a good solution for staying in Paris, especially for the cleanliness, the care of the rooms, and the quality of the room.

author: Katie G
title: This is a good one

author: Adam Z

The people who worked at the Reception are super friendly and accommodating- very good experience in this Hotel. Will recommend it
