author: Wyatt A
title: Lovely stay 3 nights
text: Very beautifull,cosy, friendly hotel. Kind staff and very good location. 4 min walking to bayswater station. Good breakfast.

author: Sophia F
title: Wonderful stay in London!
text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Princes Square Hotel. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with a very warm, friendly, and attentive reception, which made us feel comfortable right away.

The breakfast was absolutely amazing, truly one of the best we’ve had, with great variety, quality, and everything very fresh. It was a highlight of our stay.

The overall experience was excellent. The hotel is located in a beautiful, safe neighborhood and has a perfect location, close to main attractions and very convenient for exploring London.

All the staff were extremely kind and helpful throughout our stay. A very special thank you to Nara, who was incredibly attentive from beginning to end and truly made our experience even more perfect.

We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

author: Olivia V
title: Pleasant hotel, near to the underground and comfortable rooms
text: The hotel is only a short walk from the underground and several coffee shops.  The rooms are on the smaller side but contain all you need for a couple of night's stay.  The shower is a little small and the room does get rather stuffy at night, so we opened the window.  Tea, coffee and water are provided.  The bed was very comfortable and we slept well but noise does carry in the hotel, we could hear someone moving around in the room above in the wee hours of the morning.  The staff on the desk were very helpful and friendly.  For the price it was just what we wanted and we had a good stay.

author: Harry J
title: Disappointing Stay – Not Worth the 4 Stars
text:
I booked two triple rooms at Princess Square Hotel for 7 nights (June 6–13), each costing £1834. I intentionally chose triple rooms for extra space, as I had previously tried a double room and found it very small. Unfortunately, I was shocked to find that the triple room was even smaller than the double. The previous double room had a large wardrobe and a desk – this one had neither.

Each room had stairs inside, which were inconvenient and tiring – especially for my mother’s room, which required climbing two sets of stairs to reach the bed area. When I asked to change rooms, the request was denied.

We also asked for water in the room, but were told that the hotel does not provide water and that we could fill up from a tank in the basement. This is unacceptable for a hotel that claims to be 4 stars.

My room had a tiny window with no curtain or blind, so I woke up every day at sunrise. Despite multiple requests, nothing was done to fix it.

On the last night, I ordered water through a delivery app and asked the receptionist to receive it and bring it upstairs. He refused, saying he couldn’t leave the desk. But when I came down to pick it up myself, he was not at the desk – clearly, he was able to leave when he wanted to.

Very disappointing experience overall. I don’t understand how this hotel is rated 4 stars. The service and facilities do not meet even basic expectations.

author: Ryan R
title: Great experience
text: This hotel was great! Very clean and comfortable rooms. The location is perfect as it’s super close to public transportation. It’s on a quiet street just a 5 minute walk from lots of shops and restaurants. Would highly recommend to anyone traveling to London.

author: Antoine Y
title: Adequate but nothing to recommend.
text: The location is great. The layout of the hotel is a bit of a maze. Our room was small but fine for the two of us. The breakfast was definitely not worth the cost. I suggest you forgo the hotel meal and go to any number of eateries nearby. Our only other complaint was the staff was unable to arrange for a cab for us, even though we gave them several hours to sort it out. I suspect the problem was that they only use their own drivers and no one was available. When we asked for a cab to the airport, they provided a private driver at a considerable cost above what a cab to the airport cost me when I was in London in December.

author: Ryan S
title: Comfortable stay
text:
Pros:
- brilliant location, 5 mins walk from Bayswater underground stop
- staff were incredibly friendly!
- very modern look
- bed is comfy

Cons:
- unfortunately the walls are paper thin.. heard the couple next door doing the deed one evening. 
- the air con doesn’t work unless the outside temp is 22 degrees plus, but the window doesn’t hardly open either so was a very hot and stuffy sleep 
- shower is tiny!!
- bed is a small double
- bedside lamps had wireless chargers on which is a really good idea, but they didn’t work!

author: Amelia N
title: Very good hotel
text: Very good hotel, in a very quiet street near the metro (5 min walk). The reception is open 24 hours a day, the rooms are clean, the cleaning is done every day. The staff is very friendly. (The only downside is that the hotel and a bit away so we have to cross a street with little passage). From this hotel in 30 min we can be in Piccadilly. A bar serving breakfast is nearby

author: Anna J
title: Rooms a little small but hotel fine as a base when visiting London.
text:
The hotel was in a great location around the corner from Hyde Park and Bayswater and Queensway tube stations so ideal as a base for visiting different areas of London. 

The service from the front desk team was great. 

The rooms themselves were slightly on the smaller side and extremely hot. The air conditioning can’t be turned on unless the temperature outside is above 21 degrees so it really hits you in the winter and unable to turn it down. 

Our room was facing the road so it was a tad loud in the morning due to lots of building work going on the street and with single glazed windows the sound travelled easily. However appreciate this is outside the control of the hotel to a certain extent. 

For the price, we found the hotel to be fine for what we needed and ideal as a base in London for a few days. 

Didn’t eat breakfast at the hotel but around £20pp if you wanted to.

author: Lily A
title: Winterwonder land trip
text:
We booked  a triple room and specifically asked for a room with 3 single beds in it ,  
 we did not get that  room, we got a room with a 1 double and 1 single bed ,   we had booked almost  5 months before  our stay ,  and at check in staff at reception  said it was subject to availability , and had not got a room with 3 beds ,    if it wasnt available 5 months ago when we booked  why did they confirm the booking ? or was it that they got a better offer  ??  maybe  some one staying longer then us  or paying more for the rooms  closer  to the time ?    we were just told more then once  its subject to availability !  we were not happy with the way we were treated  as they just didnt seemed to care that we didnt get the room we had booked ,
 Apart from all  that the hotel looks very new and spotlessly  clean,   rooms are a little bit on the small side , but has everything you need . 
 We didnt eat in the hotel as we thought  £19 was a bit expensive for breakfast 
Location is great too.

author: George Y
title: Excellent family room
text:
Booked a family room and was pleased to see a double and 2 proper single beds.  The hotel is in a lovely quiet area with easy access to lots of local amenities.   Very close to the tubes giving easy access to the rest of London.  Easy walking distance to Hyde Park.
The staff were all very friendly and helpful.  We were able to leave our luggage and even access our room early.  
Breakfast wasn't available at the property but there are plenty of places to eat nearby.  
I would definitely recommend this hotel and we will be back.

author: Leo K
title: Excellent place, value for money
text: The bed and pillows are soft, we sleep very well, everything is clean and a good size. Room cleaning service every day. Safety box in the bedroom and cupboard for storage. Window in the bedroom.  We liked the place, I will return there if I go to London. The only problem is the wifi which is not very efficient….

author: Lily E
title: Very good hotel in an elegant setting
text:
A night in this very good hotel immersed in an elegant context, 5 minutes from the park and the road that runs alongside it, well served by public transport.
Friendly staff
Excellent wifi
Clean and spacious rooms
No breakfast
Our room had a quiet internal view but even the street in front was not noisy

author: Daniel U
title: Pleasant stay!
text: It was a nice stay here. The only reason not 5 star is it was a little chaotic, with noise etc going on with the reconstruction and I couldn't make head or tail of which stairs to take etc.  Staff were so lovely, room was very nice. Air con worked an absolute hoot. Could not fault it in the slightest. Would definitely stay again.

author: Lily T
title: Great Hotel
text: Great hotel. Had a clean, newly renovated room. Set in a great location. The hotel is currently undergoing a renovation but the staff were extremely helpful and carried our luggage up to the fourth floor. Would stay here again. Thank you! :)

author: Molly M
title: Disapointed costumers.
text: Not even close to pictures showen on web. Very small room, 4th floor without an elevator , not working aircondition and not place to sit down.  A breakfast was not provided. It would be nice to know ahead that the hotel is under reconstruction. Very disapointed. A bed for two was just full size 140 cm.

author: Michael Z
title: Pleasant stay
text: Perfect location located in the city center but not crowded,a bit quieter. The hotel has aircondition, beds are comfortable, clean and they have 24 hours reception.Special shout out to Brian the night reception he was very accomodating, he gave us all the information we needed, and Rudy the housekeeping he was helpful.Good value for money includes breakfast. Many thanks

author: Megan L
title: Good budget hotel.
text:
Good budget hotel with basic facilities but you don't really need anything else in Rome because you are.out.all day. Breakfast was basic but adequate and you could have as much as you want.
It is in a good location and not far from the termini. We travelled on the Metro which was easy to navigate. Ask reception for a map and which line to access for different destinations. It's really quick and fairly cheap. 
Would stay here again.

author: Sophia A
title: Once in Rome is enough.
text:
Lovely hotel. Rooms basic but clean. Beds were very hard, which I like but my daughter found them very uncomfortable.
Breakfast was ok  but it would have been nice to offer a variety of fruit. Only apples and oranges. Staff were really nice but didn't know about the lovely restaurants  just across the road. 
Taxis are a total rip off.

author: Claire J
title: Read all reviews before booking
text:
Do read all about this hotel before booking
Positives
Clean 
Friendly staff
That’s it
Never before have we experienced a breakfast like it.  You cannot help yourself.  Very limited choices 
Room so dated   
We felt we had to take taxis to get to anywhere 
Would not go back to this hotel

author: Kyle H
title: Great stay
text: This hotel.was really quite remarkable.  A former convent with the reception having direct access to the beaitiful Bascillica of santa Croce directly access from the hotel. Staff were wonderfully friendly.  Typical continental breakfast served by warm, welcoming staff. Hotel.is handy for Lodl metro station, trams.and buses. Easy access to the rest of the city. Next time I'm in Rome I'll definitely stay here.

author: Mia N
title: 2 night break
text:
Was abit apprehensive at first.
Always gone for the 5* beach holidays.

Although this was a very basic hotel, it was perfect for our 2 night stay. 
2 daughters aged 18 and 17 and myself.
Excellent location
Close to all amenities 
Nice check in and check out.

Room is very basic but very clean and bathrooms are immaculate. 
Fresh towels provided daily with toilet rolls and toiletries.

Basic breakfast with all the basic foods like
Cold meats
Cheese
Yogurt 
Fruit
Tea/coffee
Pastries.
Jams/honey
Cereal.

Overall I will rate this a 4* for the price I paid and for what u get.

author: Matthew M
title: Lovely hotel and Great location
text:
We looked at lots of hotels but loved the history of this one and thought it fitted in nicely with the Rome holiday we were looking for. This hotel does not state to be a 5* so if this is what you are looking for in a hotel then don’t book it but if you want history, kind staff, great location and a comfortable/clean bed then book it. 
We enjoyed our 3 night stay here, between walking, e-bikes/scooters the main sites of Rome were easily reached. Great value for money and lovely views from the rooftop terrace. We had a late flight home so had a day in Rome and they stored our bags for us free of charge and was always willing to help. I would recommend this hotel.

author: William I
title: Converted from an Old Monastery. Great Hotel 👍
text: Stayed here for 3 nights sightseeing. Was impressed by the size when we first walked up to the building. Check-in was swift and we were shown the way to our room. What a lovely building, full of history, converted from a monastery. The corridors are massive, the room bright and airy with air-con and a safe (free) if you wish to use it. Breakfast is downstairs in another cave type room. Continental breakfast which is served by 2 very friendly people. The location of the building is perfect, approximately 1 to 2 miles from the Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, Spanish Steps, etc. Tram stops just across the road and Bus stops all around to take you anywhere you want to go. Check-out was also really quick (we paid the tourist tax on entry which speeds things up). They also have a couple of drinks machines really reasonably priced. Couldn’t have had a better stay and would definitely recommend 👍

author: Dylan M
title: Not recommended
text: Unmet expectations. Foul-smelling room with mold on the ceiling and cracks. Unwashed blankets and an uncomfortable bed. The breakfast was very disappointing, with limited food choices and low quality. A fake buffet because there are two staff members serving food and drinks, probably to discourage consumption. The only redeeming quality is the location, but the management is not good at all.

author: Holly M
title: A historic hotel in an area of beautiful surroundings.
text: Stayed here through booking with on the beach. In all the hotels an old monastery with the most beautiful working church in between it. The hotel itself well it’s not 5star if you want something different and interesting this is the place we stayed on the fourth floor overlooking the plaza. Tip, if you want a good nights sleep in the summer you’re not going to get it the road is busy 24/7. Request a room at the back. The room it self was basic to single beds usual furniture it does have A/C but noisy at night. En-suite was ok. Excellent water pressure in shower. The bonus was the view from the window. There’s no bar in the hotel but you can byo drink and drink up on  the rooftop terrace. The view from there is amazing. Breakfast was a let down. I know continental is for some, it’s extremely basic. Sweet cakes and croissants bread that wasn’t the freshest but a toaster there to remedy it. Yoghurt, cereals, cold meat and cheese. You have breakfast juices and tea or coffee from a machine. Nothing warm as in scrambled or boiled eggs. The staff are fantastic so friendly and helpful. It’s a 30 min walk to the colosseum. Tip if you come out of the hotel turn left theres a metro line 5 mins walk it will take you through Rome on the under ground. It’s 9 stops to St Peter’s square if walking it’s an hour give or take on the metro literally a 10 minute journey. It stops close to all the major sites. Anyone doing the colosseum when you finish walk the extra few minutes to della Vitoria or known as the wedding cake the view over the Roman forum are spectacular. Food, do try Italian food across the from the hotel are some excellent restaurants. Over all yes I’d stay again as you’re staying in a historic building. Minutes from termini rail station.

author: Isla Y
title: Not energetically healthy and no comfort
text:
My partner and I had an 8-night stay booked at this hotel, but could not stay for 1 night. It was cold, miserable, smelt damp and felt 'bad' - in fact, it was so bad we checked out and left. 

The room was bare and basic, with 2 what I would call old conference chairs in the room. The mattress was thin and very hard & that was just from sitting on it. The walls were marked, and the whole place could do with a spruce up, and please read I was not expecting luxury for the price - I was expecting comfort 

Now I pick up on energy, and it felt wrong & I knew it was an old monastery before I booked it, and it was a great price, and that did not keep me there 

Maybe you will like it - I didn't 

The reception staff were great & helpful, and not their fault at all 

I can't write about the location as we didn't stay long enough - I literally could not wait to leave, even if it was going to cost me more money to find another hotel

author: Chloe J
title: Domus Sessoriana
text: This place is full of culture, rooms a little dated but acceptable for what we wanted. Staff on reception were brilliant, every one of them! Only let down was the breakfast, stale bread but again the staff were good

author: Aaron X
title: History over Hilton for me any day
text:
If you want modern rooms with coffee machines and big screen tv’s then stay at the Hilton. If you want to stay in an amazing building that’s multi centuries old then this is for you. 

We got the train from the airport and it was a 15/20 minute walk to the hotel which was fine.  

The room was good. Everything we needed as if you are coming to Rome to stay in the room then you’re at the wrong place. The beds were comfy enough, the safe worked, the bathroom was in decent condition, a working hairdryer and the shower was hot and powerful enough.

Breakfast in the morning was enough to get you going. Fresh pastries, coffee and cereal served by the staff and you could have as much as you wanted. 

The staff were very helpful and very friendly and reception was staffed 24/7. 

Location of the hotel was great … a 20/30 minute walk to the colosseum or trevi. Found a couple of supermarkets nearby to get some drinks and bits for the room and there were some ok restaurants nearby but we found better 10/15 mins up the road.

The added bonus of the  Basillica next door with its relics and artwork was a bonus and shouldn’t be missed either.

A really really good hotel … Grazie Mille

author: Poppy T
title: My 60th birthday
text: The rooms were clean but basic. The breakfast was very basic. Bread, cheese , ham turkey, cherry cake, tubs of butter jam and honey. Tea coffee orange juice.

author: Oscar Q
title: Very good hotel - breakfast only acceptable.
text: The hotel is quiet, with about 10 minutes walk to the metro line A is to be expected, from there it takes only another 10 minutes to be at the main train station. The rooms are small but clean and tidy! The bathroom is also very well maintained. The only thing you have to consider is the not so great hairdryer and the breakfast is also getting used to, so would rather recommend going somewhere else for breakfast. Otherwise the monastery / hotel is very good!

author: Mathis X
title: What’s around Heart of Rome
text:
Charming structure, impressive and full of history.
Professional staff, fast very kind.
Breakfast terrace with panoramic views of Rome

author: Ella J
title: What a beautiful view to start the day
text: clean and quiet rooms, well heated and cozy. beautiful terrace where the time for breakfast appears endless.

author: Brooke O
title: Lovley hotel
text: Lovely hotel, clean, good food and helpful staff. Would definitely stay again. Hotel was also in a good central location.

author: Brooke I
title: Beautiful building
text:
Spent 4 nights here recently. It’s a beautiful old building and the rooms are cleaned daily. 
The breakfast is basic but fresh and plentiful. 
The staff are friendly and helpful. 
A great experience from start to finish. And close to some excellent restaurants!

author: Ana U
title: Definitely one to miss
text:
The one good thing that could be said, it's near the metro.  The building was old/historic and quite impressive  ' from the outside ' but not a place to stay in. We found it Unclean, The atmosphere was definitely musty. The plaster was falling off the walls every time you went near it which couldn't be helped as there wasn't room to squeeze down the side of the bed without rubbing on the wall.  The furniture ( what there was of it ) was smelly. But worst of all it was infested. We ended up putting everything back in our suitcases and keeping them off the ground.
We would say that it was more like a youth hostel but nobody should want to stay there. Staff were ok, breakfast was basic although the views were pretty good from the rooftop.

author: Anna E
title: Not worth it in my opinion…
text:
I booked this hotel at a higher price because of its location right on Via del Corso, so I was very disappointed to find out upon arrival that our room was actually in a separate building away from the main hotel. This building did not feel like part of the hotel at all, yet we were charged the same price. Unfortunately, the experience did not match what we expected for the price.

The bathroom was quite rundown and had visible mold, which was especially disappointing as it is a health issue. On our last day, the air conditioning was turned off or it stopped working completely. The room became extremely hot and humid, making it very uncomfortable to stay there. I called reception, and they sent someone to restart the AC, but the room never properly cooled down.

Because of the heat, I struggled to fall asleep until very early in the morning. We had an early trip the next day, so this really affected the end of our stay, my daughter’s birthday and left us exhausted and irritated.

I usually try to find something positive to say about the hotels I stay at, but unfortunately, this experience was so disappointing. The location is great, but given the price and the overall condition and comfort of the accommodation we received, I don’t feel it offered good value for money. I sadly don’t recommend this hotel, check for reviews in other locations.

author: Brooke K
title: Horrible
text: Despite a confirmed reservation since May for a 12:30 PM lunch at the garden rooftop and without any communication from the hotel, we were shuffled from floor to floor to be told that the rooftop did not open until 4:00 PM

author: Jack U
title: Central hotel
text: We have just come home from a 2 day visit, the accommodation was clean.  Staff friendly.  The hotel is very central just what we wanted for our short visit, the Spanish steps no more than 5 minute walk.  Lots of restaurants and shopping on the doorstep.  Would definitely stay again

author: Wyatt F
title: Excellent Excellent Excellent
text:
Fantastic hotel in the best location in Rome. 
With a winning team and large and spacious rooms , a bomb air conditioner , no noise from the main street as soon as you close the windows . We were in the wing and the stunning Weldy , a safe, bright and pleasant entrance . 
All first close winner! 
I wish everyone to enjoy how much we had here. 
Welcome to Hotel Mozart, Rome 
We will go back to visit. 
🩷

author: Tyler X
title: Unwelcome choice
text: The rooftop is a very nice place. But the change of the Coca-Cola from 33 cl to 20 cl at the same price is unacceptable

author: Joseph Z
title: Always a guarantee.
text: Perfect rooms. Very courteous staff. Good breakfast. Just a stone's throw from the Spanish Steps.  Recommendation: book directly on their website.

author: Morgan X
title: Mozart is the ideal hotel to stay in Rome.
text: I stayed with my wife at the Mozart Hotel for the week throughout the first week of May this year and I would like to think warmly of the hotel's dedicated and kind staff who helped us with any questions and requests.We are in room No. 326 which was quiet and with a comfortable double bed crazy.Breakfast is very delicious and mainly distinguished by the amazing pastry served in it every morning such as Maritzu's supermarket and Porvoo's great croustette cakes.

author: Isla S
title: Disappointed
text: Very noisy room despite being a superior one.

author: Lily S
title: Excellence a stone's throw from the Spanish Steps
text:
Staying at this property was an impeccable experience in every respect, characterized by hospitality of the highest level that deserves to be mentioned.

The jewel in the crown; the real added value of the property is the splendid panoramic terrace, an authentic lounge above the city. It is the ideal place to stop and recharge your senses.

In summary: If you are looking for a combination of excellent hospitality, unbeatable location and aesthetic beauty, this hotel is a must. We will definitely be back!

author: Julien P
title: when is an annex not an annex
text: Beware: this hotel has an 'annex' that is NOT part of the hotel but a couple of blocks away in a tenement style building.  they charge the same price as the hotel and it is DIRE.  There is NO MENTION of the 'annex' on their website so when you book the hotel and they put you in the 'annex' you have no idea what you are getting.  You would never book that room at that price if you knew what you were getting.  totally dishonest and misleading.  scam.

author: Ian I
title: Great location nice terrace rooms that needed maintenance
text: Hotel located near Piazza del Popolo. Clean and nicely decorated. I had a single room so spaces were tight. The only flaw in the bathroom was a bad flush smell that, of course, also affected the room. Great breakfast with the famous husbandzzo. The terrace is also beautiful where you can have a drink.

author: Chloe M
title: BAD EXPERIENCE
text: Lousy experience at the Mozart Hotel. The last two times I was there, it got worse and worse.  I booked a superior room.  Arriving at it after climbing and descending stairs because the elevator did not leave me near it, the wifi did not work, the bathroom chair was broken.  They had to change me to another one that was in the same condition, so they had to change me a third time to another one. Unbelievable.  Breakfast service is not from a 4-star hotel. Building that does not have easy access with elevator to the rooms.  Lots of stairs, which makes it very difficult to transfer bags or people with impaired movement. I'm never going back to this hotel.  They never apologized for everything I had to go through.

author: Diego B
title: Average but with some flaws
text: The hotel is pleasant in the interior spaces and the rooms are average, the breakfast is international and always average, what is unacceptable for a 4-star is to find a room with shoe tracks on the floor for an extended area of the room and a shower in which no water drains resulting in flooding of the bathroom.  I also add the total lack of disposable slippers, which I find not appropriate as a 4 star.

author: Benjamin P
title: Beautiful hotel stay
text: Had the most wonderful time here. The hotel rooms are lovely, I was in the annex and was suprised as so many reviews were negative. It was clean, spacious and had everything you could need. The location was perfect, the staff were soooo lovely! I would definitely return!

author: Ana V
title: Good value for money
text: Great location allowing for maximum walking tours.  Excellent and hearty breakfast

author: Alexander K
title: Convenient Location but Horrible Street Noise
text: The room was extremely small and my reasoning for the 2 stars is the street noise is unbearable. We did not sleep the window or walls are no where near soundproof, it felt as if I was sleeping on the street. For the price you’re paying clearly that is for the location which is convenient and easy near everything. The front desk staff were not welcoming and when I would walk in the lady would give me rude looks after I smiled at her. Would not recommend.

author: Ruby X
title: Perfect value for money
text:
Perfect location, SUPER friendly staff, very nutritious breakfast and good for gluten free guests. clean. All together: perfect value for money.
The only thing needs to be improved is the space for entry into the shower. Too narrow.

author: Hannah U
title: Provincia
text: Great location, very friendly and helpful staff, good food, really worth the visit. Book again for upcoming visit to Rome!

author: Oliver P
title: Pleasant stay in a nice and clean apartment, great location! Comfortable beds, spacious and well distributed spaces!
text: Nice apartment, located in a great location, clean and well cared for in detail, comfortable sofa bed and double bed, I recommend it!

author: Isla M
title: BAD BAD BAD
text: Worse experience. I would recommend if you are black not to attended. Th hotel staff racisit, externally rude and lack customer services. I didn’t get the man’s name, however also addressed me as a sir. Honestly I would not recommend this place at all! Good luck if u book. The staff ruin it all.

author: Alexander X
title: Unfortunately wouldn’t stay again
text:
Room itself was in poor condition. The shower head was broken and wouldn’t stay in its holder. One of the plug sockets was hanging out of the wall exposing wires. Several of the light switches didn’t work. Noise levels were terrible, we was unaware they would be completing refurbishment in the hotel therefore hammering and drilling woke us up at 8am every morning. The upside of the room was that the bed was extremely comfy. On our final morning, we had staff walk into our room 3 times, twice without knocking, around 8am, then 10am and 11am, despite check out not being until 12!
Good location, easy underground routes to central London. It’s worth knowing that security staff will question you where you are going if you get back to your room after hours, but this is to be expected as it’s located inside the grounds of the football stadium.

author: James T
title: Awful again
text:
Once again disappointing 
Come here again as Chelsea my fave place being a life long supporter every time it’s a disappointment and don’t reply for me to contact someone cause that’s a farce they never get back to you 
Once again over zealous security trying to limits my access and genuinely rude 
Heater of hotel room on the hottest day of the year had me wondering if air con was working 
I’ve had some disaster stays here and as much as I love Chelsea this will be my last

author: Manon I
title: The place and the people can make you happy or they can ruin your time.
text:
The accommodation is lovely. All the staff are wonderful and friendly, especially the on-duty manager (Habiba). She is incredibly kind, friendly, and sophisticated in her dealings. She is also very responsive, calm, and extremely respectful. 
All the staff were friendly and responsive from the first day I arrived at this hotel, except for the duty manager (Maria). Her treatment was absolutely terrible, unbelievable. 
I extend my sincere thanks and gratitude to the duty manager, Habiba. She is an exemplary and respectful employee who deserves all the appreciation and respect. I was delighted and reassured by her presence and her pleasant and comfortable manner. With her around, I regained my comfort and relaxation, and I will spend enjoyable and pleasant days during my stay with her and her assistance. Thank you, Habiba, from the bottom of my heart.

author: Lauren L
title: Excellent!
text: We were so impressed with the care and kindness shown during our daughter’s stay. Our 19-year-old daughter was staying at the hotel throughout her internship in the city when she became unwell. Neal and Maria took such great care of her and really put our minds at ease, especially as we were not nearby. Communication was excellent throughout, and the level of care and attention they showed was exceptional. We are incredibly grateful and would highly recommend this hotel.

author: Daniel K
title: Another fantastic visit to Stamford Bridge
text: Some places always deliver, no matter the occasion or the individuals present at the time of your stay. Fortunately for my Son and I, The Stamford Bridge Hotel (formerly Millennium & Copthorne at Chelsea F.C.) is just such a venue. Having decided that a night in Chelsea would be the ideal culmination of a few days travelling about England, once again our choice of venue did not disappoint. Having stayed in this hotel a number of times in the past, we hoped that we would experience the kind and friendly welcome that had been extended to us previously. This visit would not disappoint. No football this time, just somewhere to have a bite to eat and a couple of rooms in the grounds of the young fella's favourite Premier League team. From the moment we arrived in reception to be greeted by Habibe and her front of house Team of Izedora and Ayoade, we were made feel welcome and valued. Ayoade explained that there was extensive renovations ongoing, which did not concern us in the slightest. Having been given information regarding an offer that was available at the time and providing details of the location of the rooms, we headed to the 2nd/3rd floors respectively. We had opted for Superior rooms and these were spacious, well appointed and extremely comfortable, with ample tea/coffee/biscuits to allow us catch up on stone TV before heading to the bar for a bite to eat. The menu may not have been extensive, however, it was varied and extremely well priced, considering the location and the somewhat captive audience. We both opted for the Calamari to start and a Pepperoni Pizza as the main offering, accompanied by J2O and excellent quality lattes, served by another dynamic duo of Prajjwal and Anamika,  who along with Sujit at breakfast, completed the triumvirate of Nepali natives that we met and, thanks to each of them, it was easy to see why the people of the Roof of the World are considered amongst the warmest and friendliest you will meet anywhere. Following our evening meal we bumped into the fabulous Habibe once more and this time she introduced us to DM Neal. Having met before, some time ago, it was like a reunion and Neal took time out of his crazy schedule to explain the renovations, the changes to the hotel and to assure us that whatever we needed we need only ask. After a good night's sleep breakfast in the 55 restaurant was tasty, hot where required and varied in the buffet-style offering. The aforementioned Sujit along with Mamata were attentive, friendly and professional throughout, ensuring we had everything we needed to provide the perfect kick-start to the day. Which left checkout and the only change to the front of house Team from the night before being the arrival of Kalkidan as a late substitution for Ayoade. I can assure you this was in no way detrimental to the team and to our overall experience as, once again, we were treated every bit as well on departure as we had been on arrival. So, yet another visit to Stamford Bridge and it's hotel was over. However, we still had time to visit the club shop followed by an hour in the adjacent Tea Bar, which turned out to be a highlight of the entire visit to London. Again the coffees, one latte and one iced mocha, were excellent and the prices were, once more,  extremely reasonable, but it was the pleasure of meeting Adriana that made the visit so memorable. We were regaled with reminiscences of Adriana's 20-odd years of association with Chelsea FC. This was such an enjoyable way to end our 22 hours in West London and all of the people mentioned made our sojourn much more enjoyable than it might otherwise have been. Thank you, Stamford Bridge Hotel, 55 Restaurant and The Tea Bar. We will be back... You have been warned!! TF & AF.

author: Sophia E
title: Avoid at Present
text:
Checked in at 3:35pm. First room they allocated had a broken small old Samsung TV that had no signal. The bed was damaged and the air conditioning which I was then told it wasn’t air conditioning as advertised but a cooling system wasn’t working and the room was very hot. I reported this and it took 90 minutes before a manager came to my room he tried to fix the TV but couldn’t. He then left the room and came back in 15 minutes and said he needed to move me to another room as could not fix the TV. He offered me breakfast as gesture. It was however a bit embarrassing in front of other guests because when I went to the restaurant I was told in front of other guests I was not down on the list to get a breakfast so on the second day I decided to forget breakfast as not sure I would be on the list. In the restaurant the first morning they had an omelette burning in the pan with no chef in sight. The new room wasn’t much better because the 2 USB ports at the desk didn’t work. The USB ports were replaced by an engineer who was very helpful on the 2nd day in the late afternoon to one USB and one USB-C port. The hotel did try to fix things.
Like the first room all the furniture was damaged and needs replacing. The room smells damp. The WiFi worked and didn’t drop out which was one positive. The Stamford Bridge hotel is a total building site at present. For a hotel under refurbishment the rate needs to be much lower in my opinion. The room had a safe and a cooler but not an actual fridge. They also switched the water off at 8:45am, so I could not have a shower.
They also need to make sure everything works before renting out a room. The bed was very uncomfortable. The shower has very poor water pressure and is over a bath and the shower bracket is broken so you have to hold the shower head to wash your hair which is not so easy to do. I personally prefer a separate shower cabinet. No shaving mirror The Paint was also falling off the ceiling in the Bedroom and Bathroom. I found out about the current renovation through third party websites when really they should inform people on their official website and also inform booking websites. This then gives people the true picture and is fully transparent and customers can then decide if they want to stay at the hotel. I did give the hotel the opportunity to refund my money 3 weeks ago when I heard about the refurbishment but the hotel refused to cancel the reservation and refund my money. On a positive note the staff were all very nice people and so was the Duty Manager. The engineer was also helpful.

author: Matthew N
title: Excelent
text:
Good location, clean rooms, the fridge was not working properly. 
Excelent breakfast, all crew very kind, many thanks to Gabriela and Silvia.

author: Tyler W
title: It is okay, but I will not book it again.
text: Housed somewhere next to the hotel, air conditioning unusable. If you are not from England, you have to adjust significantly right at the reception.

author: Isabella B
title: Disappointing!
text:
Hotel was undergoing refurbishment but no mention of this on booking. First room allocated air conditioning was not working when reported reception didn’t seem surprised.  Advised Manager would check & if not fixed we’d be moved & our luggage moved.  On return we had to collect luggage & move to reallocated room in separate building.  This room smelt of damp/ of drains we soon found why carpet was sodden wet outside bathroom (toilet on that wall) we reported but as it was late didn’t want to move rooms again.  Next morning opened curtains to find mould around windows.  
Overall room was very tired, stained carpet & marked walls, furniture and decor very dark and dated.  Bathroom  stains & mould with shower curtains which need replaced with more hygenic doors!

author: Wyatt K
title: Backpack Trip
text: We really enjoyed our stay in there. Nice room (a bit of A/C issue but they sent a techs to get it fixed in no time) & good location (close to tube station). The brekky was top with both many cold & hot food options. Staff in there included Gabriela, Mamata & Lady are super attentive & nice. We felt very welcome. I would highly recommend this place particularly the breakfast.

author: Katie T
title: Very nice experience
text: Everything was perfect, specially the staff. Miss Gabriela from the 55 breakfast restaurant was trully magnificent. She made aur mornigs very very sunny.

author: Owen F
title: A comfortable haven for travelers!
text: This hotel was an ideal place for travelers. The bed was comfortable, and the breakfast was hearty and satisfying. The No. 14 bus conveniently took me to many of London’s key attractions. I’m truly grateful for the kindness and hospitality of the staff. And as a fan, it was such a joy to see photos of Chelsea F.C. legends~!

author: Nora A
title: A disappointing revisit
text:
Main hotel under a refurbishment but no mention of this on their website or any others advertising this hotel. A very unprofessional reception desk located in their other hotel across the drive. 
Our room was very tired, stained carpet, curtain track falling down, base of bed in tatters.  Furniture and decor very dark and doesn't look as if anything has been updated in the past 20 years. Also the bathroom needs a good makeover with shower curtains replaced with more hygenic doors! Such a shame as this used to be a lovely hotel!

author: Dylan N
title: Great!
text:
Very comfortable bedding. Very clean. Very well located for both buses and the subway.  The breakfast buffet is very complete and the welcome is very good. 
Please note that check-in is to the right upon entering Chelsea Club.

author: Louis G
title: Avoid!!!!! Hotel Staff are liars. No AC.
text: AVOID AT ALL COST!!! Worst hotel experience ever. Before we even checked in, we got an email saying thanks for coming. On check in, we were offered a room that had a faulty AC. They knew it was faulty because when I went to complain at the front desk, I saw a sheet of paper with a list of rooms that had no AC. After requesting a room change, I was offered another room without AC still only to be told by the staff that “The hotel wasn’t built for heat” while offering me a standing fan. Shameful for a Chelsea affiliated hotel.

author: David R
title: What a scam
text: Booked for 3 nights but upon arrival we were shunted over to an adjacent building called 'Hotel at Stamford Bridge', as the hotel we'd booked was being refurbished. Our accommodation was a far cry from the 4 star rating as advertised.  This is tantamount to fraudelent misrepresentation,  as no prior warning was given or reduction in room rate offered. I complained to the receptionist and Immediately emailed the parent company, but no redress was forthcoming. We were here for my wife's birthday. What a let-down. We'll never use ASCOTT STAR again.

author: Camille V
title: Poor
text: As my husband is an avid Chelsea supporter then I treated him last minute to a night away in Stamford Bridge Hotel after first calling to check we could watch the FA Cup final on the Saturday we were there. Was told definitely yes they were showing it in their bar and Frankie’s was also showing it. However, when we arrived we were directed to a Reception in the side building as the main hotel reception and atrium was under refurb, we understand that this has to happen but we were not told of any works when I phoned. The bar was closed so a small area in a conference room was set up with two tv’s and a trestle table at the back that had spirits and mixers on, no draught drinks. It was empty and not very welcoming so we went to Frankie’s bar where we were told that you had to book and they were full another thing the hotel did not mention. We paid £181 for a  Superior Double room because we wanted to watch the football but couldn’t. The room was not in the main hotel and was very tired, shower curtain over bath, hole in the bottom of door, something that looked disgusting running down the back of the bathroom door and they had screwed a floor rubber door stop to back of door. We just expected more of a 4 star hotel in Chelsea. Don’t think we’ll stay again.

author: Louis S
title: Wouldn’t Recommend
text: This room was gifted to us to enjoy an evening at a Chelsea game. We were told they were “working” on the hotel so reception had been moved. The man working reception was not friendly or inviting and was borderline rude. When we got to the room we were debating immediately checking back out (even though it was free to us) and going somewhere else. It was drab and old looking. Furniture was Asian design, carpet was stained, couch was run down (notice stain on wall) and bathroom was from the 60’s. While eating at their 55 Restaurant we watched the host that sat us (the only nice person throughout the place) get screamed at by his boss right in front of all the guests causing a scene. The whole experience was terrible. Employees looked miserable. It was shocking that this would represent a stay at the historic Stamford Bridge.

author: Nora U
title: Our stay at Stamford bridge hotel
text: Thank you for your help Sudarshan and all reception staff

author: Mathis B
title: Breakfast
text: Excellent breakfast, full of everything and with very prepared and kind staff. Accurate service in particular Signora.Gabriela was very attentive and kind to all

author: Evan A
title: Freshly appointed rooms and kind welcome but facilities could use more care.
text:
Kind welcome from the front desk team and clean, recently refreshed facilities. The welcome amenity and note for my status with Accor was a treat.

On the flip side; the aircon did not work suitably well in our room, the shower  temperature varied quite widely from hot to cold without adjusting it, the shower panel leaked substantially, and the toilet did not flush fully. 

I’m confident that the management would have found us a different room had we asked, but we were only in the room very briefly between a late arrival and early morning airport departure, so I just left it alone. 

That said, I expect these sorts of issues not to occur (especially all at the same time!) in a property of this caliber and cost.

author: Erin A
title: Grazie mille
text: Very clean and comfortable hotel in a quiet neighborhood. The staff was amazing. All of them are very helpful and kind. We will be back for sure!!!

author: Lucas K
title: 100% recommended
text: Excellent hotel, great service and adequate service, very well located

author: Giulia H
title: Perfect stay
text: Great location, nice rooms and the staff is spectacular!

author: Lily F
title: Just out of town and a good spot
text:
Visited this hotel for the Italy v England Six Nations weekend as part of a package. 

While slightly out of the city centre (to the East), the tube is super close and it's just three stops to Termini, so absolutely perfect. 

We did bed and breakfast and the offering was great - loads of choice and replenished pretty quickly. The coffee machines were a bit temperamental and/or slow. 

The staff here are all great - very cheerful and helpful. 

The room we stayed in had a decent sized bathroom while the room itself was a little on the small side, but fine really. There was a huge TV in the room but very few channels you'd want to watch or that are in English. 

We didn't visit the bar but it seemed to stock all the essentials. 

In terms of restaurants / places to eat and drink in the local area, there isn't, frankly, an abundance. We did find a couple of decent places after some short walks but don't expect to be absolutely spoilt for choice, considering where the hotel is. 

The hotel is very clean throughout and we had no issues with that at all.   

The only gripe I had really was that the shower pressure was pretty rubbish.

author: Amelia N
title: Good hotel
text:
Good hotel for the location that allows you to move easily around the city by public transport and for the quality of the room.
Too bad about the bar oversight. Pay with a 7€ card a simple crodino (real value 80c) and receive a 5€ receipt.

author: Megan H
title: good hotel
text: hotel good not only for the structure but 'for the polite staff, professional, really helpful unique people. as David, Marina, Eddie and others that now I do not remember the name, only defect the doors of the rooms that do not work well opening and closing.I wanted to praise Georgia in the fantastic breakfast room always smiling unique.

author: Marta G
title: Mercure Roma Piazza Bologna
text: Good breakfast 3 stops from Termini and 5 from Colosseum by metro. Very friendly staff. During check in we were told everything: Receptionist gave us map, recommended few restaurants, explain all the policy for breakfast and room. Very good pomegranate juice during breakfast. Very friendly ladies on the breakfast. Really nice stay.

author: Poppy R
title: Stay in Rome
text:
Good hotel in a great location in Piazza Bologna, where thanks to a friendly and welcoming staff, you can stay in clean and perfectly heated rooms.
Given the advanced age of the structure, although clean and well maintained in every environment, the plumbing of the bathrooms should be renewed, to have more efficient services and adapted to modern needs.

author: James V
title: I thought better
text: I must say I expected better given the price. The room has nothing special, indeed the bathroom should be renovated. Breakfast did not satisfy me at all. I'm not going back.

author: Mia Z
title: Good hotel for family and near metro
text: Clean hotel, good bed, attentive reception and good location near the metro and good pizzerias and with good price. Near the excellent quality bakery in the corner near the hotel.

author: Marco L
title: Pleasant but needs modernization
text:
The Mercure in Piazza Bologna in Rome is located in a quiet and pleasant residential area north of the centre. Restaurants are within easy reach and the centre is about 15 minutes by metro or bus.
Nevertheless, the rooms are beginning to age and are getting older, so it is time to modernize them. The air conditioning system is a little outdated. On the other hand, the bedding is comfortable and the breakfast good quality (but the radio in the breakfast room tends to knock out in the morning. It's useless). The staff is friendly, friendly and attentive.
Good address but until a modernization is done, prices should be reduced a bit.

author: Oscar Q
title: Great location
text:
Just three stops on the subway from Rome termini and then a couple of minutes walk from the station makes this an ideal spot to stay . 

In the suburbs from the crowds and a good deal of bars and restaurants in the surrounding streets . 

The room was spacious and clean. Enough variety at breakfast and the reception staff were very friendly and recommended nearby eateries .

The only let down was the bar which opened in the evening . Trying to find the barman and then trying to get your drinks within 30 min of ordering was difficult, even though we were the only patrons as others gave up the wait . 

This is an ideal hotel to stay in when visiting Rome

author: Morgan I
title: Excellent cost and benefit
text: Excellent Hotel, I recommend. Great room, clean, good shower, good bed, all very good!!! Breakfast well presented. I really liked the hotel, location near the bus stop, near the metro, shops and restaurants near the hotel. I will definitely return to the Mercure Bologna. Excellent Cost benefit.

author: David A
title: Simple hotel but great cost benefit
text: Hotel well located near the subway. It's not a tourist destination, but a student. Various good restaurants and with reasonable peanut near the hotel.  We were given welcome drinks and the reception was attentively reading when explaining how to go to the sights and sold us discounted tickets.

author: Luca C
title: Good helpful Staff but Hotel has problems with AC
text:
Our AC was just not working properly in all 4 days. We had complained every day. The staff tried to resolve every day but the AC used to become ineffective again in a few hours. So thats where we were very disappointed. I think we should have asked for a room change instead. But we kept believing in the hotel every day. :-( 
Otherwise the hotel staff is nice, break fast is good, location is a little off from city centre but then it is conveniently located on the metro line B. So travelling to excursions in the city is not a problem.

author: Hannah I
title: The certainty of a family environment.
text:
Great hotel!! Comfortable and spacious room. Magnificent location for those who avoid the bustle of the historic center. Cleaning that meets expectations. And, above all, an extraordinary welcome. We were greeted with the room ready in advance and with mimos that any tourist likes to receive. The reception was always very attentive and welcoming. They provided a family and facilitating environment . If they were willing to help in every moment of our stay.   Aurora and Aurélia were exceptional in serving us professionally, efficiently and with special attention. Thank you to the staff at Mercure Piazza Bologna. We will definitely return!!! 
Adriana and Anna Lucia

author: Katie M
title: Great hotel in quiet neighborhood.
text:
A nice hotel in a quiet neighborhood. Breakfast had a large variety to choose from .
Rooms were clean and the bed was comfortable. A little out of the way unless you take the metro. Many of us did not avail ourselves because we were unfamiliar with the system. Many of us ended up using taxis. 
Nice little bar in the lobby and staff was helpful. Had maps to help navigate around Rome.

author: Anna Y
title: A hotel in a quiet neighbourhood
text: The hotel is 3 metro stops away from the Termini station. And then a few minutes walk to the hotel from the station. It’s in a quiet residential neighbourhood and we felt safe at night. There are a few restaurants nearby. Our triple room is spacious and we were able to open our large suitcases with no problem. The breakfast buffet is adequate but feels like there could be more food options for a Mercure.  There’s a free bottle of still water and a free bottle of sparkling water in the room, but only for the first night.

author: Zachary I
title: Excellent hotel
text:
The hotel located near Piazza Bologna, I was pleasantly impressed by the kindness of the staff and their care in meeting the needs of customers.
The rooms are nicely decorated and spacious. Excellent international breakfast.

author: Ella D
title: Tourist stay
text:
Top-notch staff, well-stocked breakfast, very clean room.
Proximity to the Gare de Lyon is perfect for dropping off and picking up luggage.
I recommend this hotel.

author: Harper G
title: Lovely staff and great location!
text: We stayed here recently as it was so close to the Gare de Lyon train station which is what we needed. The price was really reasonable. The hotel lobby is gorgeous, and the staff were all lovely and helpful. The rooms are tired but they were very clean. We travelled as a family of 4 in two separate rooms as our teenager and pre-teen to share a sofa bed now. I would stay here again.

author: Connor T
title: Great hotel facing the Gare de Lyon.
text: Very good hotel in its category! Well-insulated rooms, very clean, friendly staff. Everything to like!

author: Laura L
title: Remarks
text:
3-day stay for various exhibition visits.
Ideal location for train arrival and departure, and access to other transport, restaurant on the ground floor with half-board very convenient, and a very hearty breakfast!

author: Ryan I
title: Comfortable and clean hotel
text: We stayed at this hotel for only one night while passing through. Convenient because it is right in front of the Gare de Lyon station. Clean hotel, kind staff who also spoke Italian.  I recommend it

author: Harry E
title: We couldn't have found a better place.
text: Hotel with a restaurant across from the Gare de Lyon. It couldn't be more convenient. Well-designed rooms, with a kettle, tea, herbal tea, milk, and coffee. Minibar with drinks (for a fee, of course, but not an exorbitant price). Beautiful bathroom with marble on the walls. We will come back when we have a train to catch at Gare de Lyon. Also worth noting is the great kindness of the staff

author: Benjamin H
title: Very good value for money
text:
Very good value for money  
Very friendly and smiling welcome 
A top-notch breakfast, well-stocked and with lots of choices

author: Chloe E
title: Stay Review 12-17/08/2026
text:
Value for money hotel in the center of Paris.
Helpful and polite staff.
Attention should be taken to the cleanliness of the room (dusty bathroom, wall with water residue from a leak), loose furniture (the refrigerator shelf had come loose from the rest of the furniture) and the curtain was coming out of place.

author: Joseph M
title: I recommend it!
text:
Spontaneously pleasant, friendly, and warm welcome. 
Well-equipped room, super quiet, comfortable and impeccable bedding. Impeccable cleanliness. Breakfast: Great! and a very warm welcome.
Excellent restaurant: Italian restaurant: It is as good as in Italy. A soft spot for the veal milanese / spaghetti. As for the tiramisu...superb!!!!

author: Claire N
title: Excellent location
text:
Perfect hotel for a short stay due to its location across from the Gare de Lyon.
Very comfortable and quiet room.
Only the breakfast could be improved.

author: Evan Q
title: Very convenient.
text: Excellent location for getting around easily by public transport. Rooms a bit small but clean and very comfortable bed. Very kind and friendly staff. Excellent French breakfast. Recommended!

author: Thomas I
title: Very good hotel
text: Very good hotel, very good welcome, and very good location. The nearby restaurants are open late; even arriving after 9 p.m., you can eat well.

author: George R
title: Nice welcome and well located
text: I highly recommend this hotel, we were very well received and the stay went very well. The location is ideal for visiting Paris. The quadruple room is well-equipped, air-conditioned, clean, and spacious. We will not hesitate to return. A big thank you to Célia for her pleasant welcome and to all her colleagues who were top-notch in ensuring our stay went well.

author: Harry W
title: Excellent location near Gare de Lyon, Paris
text: The service at this establishment was magnificent, and the front desk clerk was very attentive; he helped me a lot during my stay. I recommend it!

author: Sean Z
title: Ideal before taking the train
text: Very close to the train station and reasonably priced. The room is not very big but is more than enough. The staff is truly attentive. I plan to return for my next stay.

author: Tyler V
title: Welcoming and pleasant hotel
text:
I recommend it with my eyes closed.
Thanks to the receptionist for her kindness, her friendliness, and her professionalism.
The breakfast was also appreciable and hearty.
See you very soon and good luck to your whole team.
A delighted customer 😊

author: Aiden K
title: Family weekend
text: We ate very well, clean room, only remark not too big especially the bed side and the bathroom

author: Claire D
title: Charming hotel.
text: A very short stay but a good memory, particularly regarding the kindness and availability of the team.

author: Ella R
title: An all round good experience.
text: The receptionist was very helpful. I was relieved that he spoke english well. The location was where I needed it. The room was clean and tidy. The noise level was quiet. It was great value for money. The atmosphere was friendly.

author: Giulia X
title: Will not return
text: This hotel was in a perfect location for our very early train leaving from Gare de Lyon at 6am. And the welcome we received was very warm. The gentleman on concierge was amazing. Sadly that is where the positives end. The hotel was dated and tired. The room smelt musty and it was dated. Unfortunately we didn’t get any sleep due to people talking in the next room (they were not talking loudly) - I believe noise levels must be a regular complaint as concierge was not surprised. Such a shame but I can’t really say I would stay again especially as it was not that much cheaper than the Mercure.

author: Zachary Q
title: Good experience, top location
text: We had a good time, we took two doubles, spacious and confortable rooms, good value for money, excellent location near the metro and pubs and restaurant. Typical English breakfast, Kind and efficient staff

author: Brooke F
title: Great stay and great location
text: Had a lovely time at this hotel, hotel staff super helpful and friendly, perfect location with the tube just down the road, 5 minute walk or 10 if you have a 5 year old, and the air conditioning was the best, especially being as hot as it’s been, we would definitely stay again.

author: Daniel J
title: Perfect for 1 night with children
text:
Convenient location, easy check-in & out and good breakfast.
A quad room was a bit of a squeeze but absolutely fine for 1 night.
Room could do with a bit of maintenance and the double bed was very hard and uncomfortable.

author: Jack U
title: Best hotel
text: Amazing. Everything. Location

author: Chloe M
title: amazing
text: sabhana was very friendly !!!

author: Oscar I
title: Amazing London
text: Another amazing holiday in London. As always the beds were so comfortable, room and hotel clean and staff so friendly and helpful. Massive thank you to Dawn - forever happy, helpful and kind

author: Freya G
title: Deficient
text: Very central, train line directly under the hotel, breakfast ok, no cereals as described in the pre-order, rooms are spacious, but not well maintained. Everything seems very dingy and dirty. Staff is helpful and mostly friendly.

author: Sophia G
title: Excellent hotel with the best team.
text: This hotel is perfect for families. The staff are wonderful, friendly, and always willing to help. Marcela is a true professional and we will never forget her kindness and support when our daughter sprained her ankle. The location is ideal, in a quiet neighbourhood with excellent transport links to the rest of the city. The room was perfect for a good night's rest, and everything was spotlessly clean. The breakfast served in the bar was delicious, with a wide variety of options to suit everyone. Once again, thank you to the entire Premier Inn team. We will definitely be back.

author: Taylor X
title: Not the biggest family room, but  great hospitality
text:
A special mention must go to Dawn, who truly made our stay memorable. She went above and beyond, offering incredible local knowledge and acting as our personal tour guide. Her warm and helpful attitude made her a pleasure to deal with. The hotel’s location is also fantastic—Earl’s Court station is less than a five-minute walk away, which made sightseeing effortless. 

The air conditioning in the room was ideal for the hot weather. 

We loved the great breakfast selection and the nice variety of restaurant food. The common areas were consistently clean and tidy.

 It was also very convenient that reception offers a taxi ordering service. 

We stayed in a family room which was smaller than expected. 

Upon arrival, we noticed the bedding on one of the beds was wet. However, this was sorted promptly. 

It is a decent place to stay, but keep the room size in mind if traveling with family.

author: Ruby Z
title: Nice hotel to stay
text: Lovely hotel, staff very accomodating! Rooms were lovely and clean. Would definitely recommend

author: Zoe T
title: Great location and experience for a family visit to London
text: We stayed there for 7 nights and it was great. Stuff were very friendly, the room was clean and breakfast was good. I loved the location as it's in zone 1 and just 5 minutes from Earl's Court but it;s not loud at this hotel

author: James O
title: Good experience
text: Really amazing Service and dinner

author: David T
title: Convenient, comfortable with a fantastic team of staff.
text: A really comfortable and pleasant stay.  What made it a great stay was the staff though; so helpful and friendly.   Nothing was too much trouble.   We ate a lovely meal  in the evening.  There was a good variety of choice and the portions were good and excellent value for money. Breakfast was also a great experience with one of the best stocked buffets I've seen at a Premier Inn.  Very convenient for Earl's Court station and just a 15 minute walk from the Royal Albert Hall.  We will be staying again.

author: Hannah Q
title: Very friendly and efficient
text: A few days spent in an ideal location in a hotel that is obviously well managed. The staff are extremely friendly with special mention to Dawn who made us extremely welcome and to Marcel for his attentiveness. Alan and Vivien

author: Hannah H
title: Cleanliness is an issue
text:
Rooms are extremely expensive for what they are, we paid £400 for 2 nights room only and yhat is considered budget.  

The room carpet and walls were grubby, bathroom had dirty walls and hair from a previous guest all over the wall tiles in the shower/bath area.

If you want breakfast in the hotel then book it in advance otherwise you will pay a lot more.  Breakfast was ok, buffet style but nothing to rave about.

The air con in the room was great though.

author: Lucy G
title: Excellent Location, Disappointing Service
text:
We stayed at the hotel for 8 nights. The location is excellent. It is very close to Ears Court station, and you can also easily walk to many attractions. Supermarkets, cafés, and other shops are only about a 5-minute walk away.
However, I would also like to mention the issues we experienced. We were a family of four—my wife, myself, and our two daughters (ages 14 and 11). Our room had one double bed and two single beds, but it was extremely small. There was no refrigerator in the room, and the wardrobe had only one shelf and about five or six hangers. Since we had medication that needed to be kept refrigerated, we had to leave it in the hotel's kitchen. Whenever we wanted to collect it in the evenings, we had to wait quite a while.
The hotel also smelled strongly of food. If you stayed inside for more than five minutes, your clothes would absorb the smell of cooking and spices.
We booked our stay with breakfast included, but the breakfast was exactly the same every day.. After a few days, you naturally get tired of eating the same food. If you're only staying for a short time, the breakfast may be fine, but for a longer stay, eating the same breakfast for 8 or 9 days isn't enjoyable. We only had breakfast at the hotel for the first three days and ate elsewhere for the rest of our stay.
Room cleaning was only provided if you requested it before 12:00 noon; otherwise, the room was not cleaned and the towels were not replaced. Even when housekeeping came, they only changed the towels and made the beds. The floor was never vacuumed. On one occasion, although we had left the bath mat inside the bathtub to indicate it needed replacing, they simply shook it out and put it back instead of giving us a clean one. The bed linens were not changed at all during our 8-night stay.
Overall, we were disappointed with the service. The hotel's location was the only aspect we were truly happy with.

author: Thomas X
title: An ideal Hotel for events at the Royal Albert Hall
text: An excellent location for the Royal Albert Hall, Kensington Gardens and the Natural History Museum. Also the best Breakfast we have had at a Premier Inn - superb and very friendly staff. Thank you.

author: Mason N
title: Solid hotel near Earl Ct. Tube Station
text: Convenient quiet location near Earl's Ct. Tube Station. The hotel seemed to be short staffed most of the time, however the staff were friendly.  Room was standard, nothing fancy, but we didn't spend much time in the room. A/C was a plus during the hot weather! It was markedly different as to the coolness in the A/C system on the first floor and second floor, as the second floor was much cooler, as we had two rooms. TV was not up to date, there was no guide to show channel selection, and very limited channels to view. Otherwise, the hotel is a solid choice in a safe location. Coffee shops, convenience stores and cafes near the tube station were a plus.

author: Sofia S
title: Moldy smell, damp towels, can't air the room
text:
When I arrived, the room had a nauseating chlorine smell that lasted for about 3 days. 

I wanted to open the window, and even though the outer pane had a sticker that said "limited opening", the first pane was stuck. I reported it to the reception, they said they'd send maintenance to fix it and I came back to the same stuck window, but this time with a new sticker that said "doesn't open, but there's sufficient airflow". 

On the second day I understood why the overwhelming chlorine smell: it was there to mask the moldy smell of damp towels, as the bathroom did, in fact, not get enough airflow. Towels would stay wet overnight, uncomfortable to use after the morning shower. 

Also, although the room was booked for 2 people, the would constantly bring one less hand / face towel, even if mentioned several times at the reception.

author: Sophia J
title: Cannot fault - 5 stars
text: Throughly enjoyed my stay. Stayed for 3 nights for a conference. Found All staff to be very pleasant and attentive, particularly the staff in the restaurant. would definitely stay here again.

author: Mathis Z
title: Event in the Regency Suite
text: Our event was for family and friends and we booked the Regency Suite. We were very impressed by the quality of the function room, services, food, staff and also bedroom. We would absolutely recommend the Clarendon and staff without reservation.

author: Grace K
title: Amazing staff
text:
Had a lovely meal here with friends and was really impressed with the food. Everything was delicious and full of flavour! We all really enjoyed our meals
A special mention has to go to Samantha behind the bar. She was amazing! quick, friendly, and really welcoming throughout our visit. Her great service really added to the experience. She was also helping the rest of the staff clear the tables and food. She really went above and beyond 
We had a brilliant time and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!

author: Harry A
title: Lovely staff and great wedding venue
text: I had my wedding at the Clarendon Hotel in August 2026. Julie and the entire events team were amazing to work with and were able to answer all of my questions leading up to the big day. Both the Regency Suite and Meridian Restaurant are lovely spaces for hosting a wedding and the staff worked so hard making everything just right. We also received many compliments from our guests about the food provided - another great touch to a special day ☺️

author: Antoine G
title: Surprise birthday lunch in the Marquee.
text: We had a fantastic event courtesy of the Clarendon. The arrangements were carried out perfectly and the staff were attentive, friendly and professional. I fully recommend the Clarendon if you are considering a celebration event.

author: Sofia A
title: get afternoon with great friends
text: i had the pleasure of attending the clarendon on Sunday the 23rd of Aug all staff members were very accommodating with all the requested that our larger group of 12 needed and every thing was done with ease. The ambience was beautiful and the piano player was extremely talented. Special thanks goes to Isabelle and Samantha for their amazing service. We will be back again thank you

author: Leo Z
title: Afternoon tea and carvery
text:
I was blessed to go with a group of ladies for afternoon tea and carvery yesterday - 23rd August 2026.  Isabel was such a wonderful person to our group and helped to serve us really well. 
Sue Redford.

author: Anna F
title: Weekend stay at The Clarendon, Blackheath
text:
I recently (7-8/08) had a great short stay at The Clarendon and have to say that the standard of hospitality that I received was exemplary which made my stay so enjoyable. It's obvious that the front of house staff work very hard to accomodate guests with whatever needed which is a real help when travelling. 
This is my second visit and each time the rooms have been very clean, bright  and comfortable and the restaurant and room service excellent.
Will be back soon! 
Margaret

author: Laura G
title: First Time Experience
text:
I had a gloriously fantastic time with my fellow Christian sisters at The Clarendon Hotel.
The moment we got there the  Manager Isabel was very, very accommodating.
And so were the other staff members, Bella, Samantha and Jagriti.

They were patient, friendly, polite and helpful.
It was indeed a pleasure to be served by these people.

I do hope they are recognised for their service and I do hope this review gets read.
Thank you very much ladies.

The food was also absolutely delicious.
I had the soup of the day which was Cream of mushroom and I give it a Solid 10.
The roast menu was delicious as well.
The gravy was a solid 10.

All in all, a solid experience.

Thank you.

author: Ella L
title: Welcoming
text: Always a great experience at the Clarendon. Very welcoming staff, especially Isabel who is always kind, professional and on point with fantastic customer service.

author: Lily Z
title: Sunday Roast at the Clarendon
text: I visited The Clarendon Hotel restaurant today with my mum and church friends. The service we received was amazing. I had a roast dinner - beef, pork and lamb which was the perfect size. Isabel paid extra attention to our large table and made us feel perfectly welcome. Samantha was also very happy to help us and had great service.

author: Rosie D
title: Love my experience
text: Great service, looked after us really well. Nothing was to much trouble, very friendly and welcoming, not far from the shops and Blackhealth train station. would definitely be going back again.

author: Holly L
title: Best service at the restaurant
text: We went for afternoon tea and it was amazing. The food was great and the service was excellent. We were taken care of by Amy and she was so nice and friendly and honestly couldnt do enough for us to make sure we had a lovely day! We will definitely be going back!

author: Hugo P
title: Awful!
text: Awful! Have posted a review directly on their site. Staff singing in the restaurant and having super loud personal convos in the adjacent bar. Do not try it out. Have stayed in the rooms (once) in the past and they are just as mediocre/outdated. It’s like the Fawlty Towers of Blackheath.

author: Antoine Y
title: Exceptional service
text: My friends and I attended an afternoon tea at the Clarendon hotel, we was blown away by the exceptional service. We were served by a lovely member of staff called Amy, she was incredibly patient as my friend has a lot of diary requirements, she let us take our time and made us feel very valued, the service was quick and the food was delicious, we will definitely be returning!

author: Paolo O
title: Great service lovely person
text: I came for a meal with my family and the experience was made even better by a lady called Amy. She made sure that we had great service, nothing was too much trouble and she was warm and welcoming and made us all feel welcome. She looked after us really well. Nothing was too much trouble.

author: Erin B
title: work stay
text: breakfast good isabel great waitress very attentive  location good

author: Pierre Z
title: Great experience
text: It is always nice to visit this place. The attention and details are always on point. At the restaurant, Faye made a great job as our server. In the bar, we had some nice beers and cocktails. The experience is always marvelous as a way to escape the big city.

author: Sara T
title: Awesome experience
text: We were here also to celebrate my daughter’s birthday and very fortunate to be served by Faye on the first evening. She advised a bakery down the street and so we could organize without our daughter even knowing. Faye handled it beautifully and it was the best birthday in the restaurant. Thank you Faye! We would highly recommend this site to friends and family

author: Wyatt W
title: We will be back
text:
Great hotel, outside but still well located. By train in 20 minutes to the center. Easily accessible from the City Airport by bus. Very friendly staff. 

@Kushi from the restaurant served us very nicely and attentively.

author: Henry T
title: Fantastic service from Isabel!
text: Fantastic service from Isabel as always! We use the restaurant regularly for the carvery lunch on a Sunday. Isabel is always so lovely and looks after us along with the rest of the team. The carvery is very nice!  Look forward to our next visit.

author: Thomas L
title: Missing items
text: I went to the hotel with my daughters. When we got there, there was a ton of construction going on lots of dust and dirt andnoise. The power went off periodically throughout the day and evening as well. An entirely separate note my daughter left her rings on the dresser when  went out and when we came back, our room had been made up and there were no rings. I immediately went down to the front desk to let them know that we are missing our rings. They said that they would check with her housekeeping staff. I continue to go down each day to no avail. I asked to speak with a manager. I spoke with a manager, and she said that she would contact the owners and discuss it with them and call me back. This never happened. I never received a phone call or an email. I think that they just felt that I would go away. I’m not going away. I’m missing valuable items and didn’t have a stay that was up to my expectations. I would strongly suggest staying somewhere else if you want to keep your stuff safe and have a peaceful vacation.

author: Giulia Q
title: RUN! DON’T DO IT!! Pictures are Deceitful!!
text: The hotel looked nothing like the pictures online. The room was very small with old furniture, and the window faced a brick wall. We found a roach in the bathroom, and the shower made loud rumbling noises. I didn’t feel safe sleeping in the bed because of the roach. We left after the first night. We only stayed because it was late and I had a conference the next morning.

author: Nora S
title: Perfect Location
text: We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel St James. Was it luxuriously fancy and new? No. But it was clean and charming and the staff (particularly Emma!) were super friendly and helpful (we had never navigated NY). The location is PERFECT! Right on Times Square and we walked to most of the highlights of the city including our broadway show. The subway took us everywhere else and that was convenient too. Take advantage of the ice and water station in the “bar” and the neighboring pub and deli were fantastic. This hotel was exactly what we needed for our visit and within our budget. Highly recommend.
