author: Erin M
title: False advertising and missing manager
text:
We were very disappointed in our stay at the Sure Hotel. We stayed here for three nights, but we would have cut it shorter if possible. When we booked the hotel online, they advertised the rooms as climate controlled with air conditioning. Upon arrival to the hotel, there was a strong smell of sewer gas coming from the bathroom, and the remote control to turn on the AC was not working. We tried to call the front desk, but the phone in our room was also broken. We went downstairs to ask the front desk, and they told us that the AC was currenlty "shut off" in every room, but could not tell us why. We opted to sleep with the window open, because the room was very hot and stuffy, but the sounds from the street and the mosquitos coming in all night kept us awake.

On our second night, we tried to take a shower just as we had on the first night, and found that the hot water was broken. We waited ten minutes for it to heat up, and nothing happened, so we went back down to the front desk. The staff told us that the hot water was broken for the whole hotel, and that there was nothing they could do, but that we should bring it up to the manager in the morning. They said that they couldn't even have someone come to fix it until it was cleared by the manager. The next morning, we went to the front desk to speak with the manager, but the staff told us the manager wasn't there. They asked us if we wanted a new room on the other side of the hotel, where the hot water was still working. We asked why nobody offered that to us last night, and they didn't have an answer for us. Our new room on the other side of the hotel did have hot water, but the air conditioner was still not working, so we slept with the sounds of the street and the mosquitos again. The bathroom in the new room also smelled strongly of sewer gas. We asked when the manager would be in, and they told us tomorrow because it was a Sunday. We tried to ask the staff if we could have a partial refund due to all of the problems we had experienced during our stay, and they said that only the manager could issue a refund, and that they would bring our concerns to her.

On our third day there, we tried to go speak with the manager again, and the staff told us she would be there later in the day (it was still early around 8 am), and that she would be working until around 5 or 6 pm. We came back to the hotel around 3 pm, and the manager was still nowhere to be found, and the staff could not say when she would be back. They claimed that she was gone because she was still dealing with the hot water issue. We asked if they could please have her contact us, because we were going to be flying home the next day, and we have still heard nothing after a week. 

We tried to contact Best Western customer support about our stay, and see if we could get a partial refund though them. We weren't aware of this until we called, but apparently all Best Westerns are privately owned and operated, and it is ultimately the decision of operator/manager of each location if they want to issue refunds or not, which means that our call to customer service was pointless. We thought that there would be some sort of standard with the Best Western name, as we have stayed at many great Best Western hotels in the United States, but I guess the standard is not upheld everywhere. Customer service told us that all they could do was contact the manager of the location for us, and tell them our concerns and that we were requesting a partial refund. A hotel room should have working climate control and hot water at the bare minimum, otherwise you're better off camping outdoors. For anyone trying to stay here, please be careful of the false advertising and the missing manager in case you have any problems like we did. And don't rely on the customer service number to help you either.

author: Claire G
title: Last day of trip
text:
We read a number of poor reviews for this hotel, however as we were departing from Gare du Nord the next morning it was well positioned. The receptionist was very pleasant. I will confess to not being entirely happy being asked to pay 150€ as deposit even though we had already paid for the room, it was however removed from my credit card bill before payment. 
The room itself was actually very nice even though you could only really access the bed from one side, if there for several days/week it might be an issue but one night is perfectly fine. The bathroom is rather nice as is the kettle with tea & coffee.

author: Isabella L
title: Air condition did not work
text: The rooms are quite standard for a budget hotel in Paris. It’s a small room and small bathroom but it’s  a place to sleep. What was below standard was the air condition. It did not work properly and the room was very warm. They said that they ”restarted” the air condition but it didn’t help. And they did not have other rooms available and we did not get any discount or anything for paying for something that did not work properly. Apart from that, there was a lot of noise from the toilet and the drain. The breakfast did not look very attractive, so we had breakfast at a great (I believe Sri Lankan) bakery to the left of the hotel. That was good value for money. The neighbourhood was not super nice. It’s close to Gare du Nord, but I would recommend staying in another area.

author: Claire N
title: Unacceptable Comfort and Safety Issues
text:
My stay at Sure Hotel by Best Western Paris Gare du Nord was deeply disappointing. The air conditioning unit in my room was not functioning properly and, shockingly, I was told it was meant to shut off automatically after a few minutes — requiring me to restart it manually. This made getting rest nearly impossible in peak summer heat.
The room phone was completely unusable, and I was informed it had been out of service for some time. Since reception is located in a different building, I had to walk outside to get assistance — inconvenient and concerning, particularly in a rough neighborhood that felt unsafe at night.
To make matters worse, the window hinges were broken. I was advised to force the window shut at an angle if opened again, which posed a clear safety hazard. I ended up keeping it closed throughout my stay.
Basic amenities were also neglected. After room cleaning, tissue and hand soap were never replenished — a surprising oversight that added to the sense of poor service.
Altogether, the lack of room functionality, unsafe conditions, and subpar housekeeping make it hard for me to recommend this hotel.

author: Alice B
title: Avoid at any cost
text: The room was tiny with barely enough room to open a suitcase. The instructions for the air conditioning unit were useless - after trial and error it had to be switched off as it was deafening. The lift was from another era and could not carry two people with suitcases. Our room was on the top floor of an annex. The door to the room didn't shut properly and there was no security on the building entrance. I asked to be moved to the main building but was told there were no rooms available.Thank God we were there for just one night. Will not be returning. Ever.

author: George E
title: Highly recommended
text: Excellent affordable hotel. Good location. Friendly staff in a good location. Room was clean and bright. Breakfast buffet is decent. Highly recommended.

author: Sydney V
title: Great family experience
text: We stayed at this hotel for 4 days with my son and husband, and we had a wonderful time. Even though the Termini area is not very beautiful, the hotel's location is truly excellent for visiting Rome both on foot and by public transport. Moreover, the hotel was a pleasant surprise for its elegance, cleanliness, and the availability of staff 24/7. A well-deserved 3 stars.

author: Michael I
title: Hotel Windrose
text: Close to Republic metro and city bus servives this hotel was an excellent choice for a mini break. Nearby there is a great choice of affordable restaurants. Comfortable room with spacious ensuite and large balcony overlooking city rooftops. Reception staff were extremely helpful. Breakfast offered plenty of choice. Certainly worth a second visit and value for money.

author: Megan L
title: Excellent stay
text: We are just back from 3 nights at the hotel Windrose. Rooms were really great spacious with a lovely balcony. Close to the metro and terminal. Room cleaned every day.  The gentleman on reception was really a great asset to your hotel. Lovely restaurant opposite. Thank you for a great stay.

author: Benjamin K
title: Very good location and attention
text: We stayed 6 days in total, a first stay of 4 days, left bags in guard for 15 days and returned another 2 days and everything was taken care of and protected. The location is excellent, close to Termini for trains and subways. We highlight the kindness and excellent attention of all the staff who made us spend some unforgettable days. Thanks Windrose, we will be back!!

author: Dylan G
title: Bad Hotel (verrated and Overpriced)
text: Stayed in this hotel on 6-7 March 2026. Rooms are very narrow and small where barely a singleperson cot can come. There is no space to move in the room and to keep luggage if you have more than baggage. Bathroom is tiny with smallest bathing cabin and smallest wash-basin. Not worth spending 100euros+ for this hotel. There is no drinking water given complimentary in the room. You have to pay exorbitant price for a small water bottle. AC was not working , it took considerable to get AC functioning. Overall overrated and overpriced hotel. Not worth spending your hard earned money.

author: Evie I
title: Excellent
text: Great as always, when I come to rome is my home I always find myself very nice staff... great location perfect throughout

author: Lea T
title: EXCELLENT EXPERIENCE
text: Great location for those traveling by train, friendly staff, very clean room, large and comfortable, affordable price, to keep certometne in mind for my next trips to Rome.

author: Miguel N
title: Pleasant touch and Roman escape
text:
Excellent location, very close to Termini Station.
Great and varied breakfast
Comfortable room 
Staff helpful and kind.
Recommended.

author: Julien K
title: Excellent stay
text: Excellently located hotel, modern and comfortable rooms and friendly and helpful staff. Also excellent luggage storage service

author: Lauren N
title: Attentive service and strategic location.
text: I had chosen it above all as a foothold to break long train journeys to and from my family. The location is excellent, despite the proximity to Termini is quiet, the rooms are basic, small but comfortable (bathrooms always fully functional and practical). The service is always ready, considerate and, as already written, I consider it an added value! The kindness of the staff and the cleanliness of the rooms represent for me the security I was looking for on my travels. Ideal for staying in Rome even more days for the strategic location.

author: Alice L
title: All right.
text: Welcoming staff. Comfortable and very clean room just like the rest of the establishment. Our room overlooked a courtyard so very quiet. Breakfast buffet with choice. Close to the train station and tourist sites. I will be happy to come back!

author: Paige G
title: To be taken into account
text: Hotels near Termini. Well maintained, clean. Reception friendly and helpful. Rich breakfast. They accepted the smartbox voucher unlike other hotels without the slightest problem. Room not very large but equipped. Highly recommended

author: Chloe I
title: Excellent
text: Clean hotel excellent breakfast the reception all kind and courteous... fantastic I highly recommend it... only thing the rooms a little 'small.

author: Joseph A
title: An evening for work in Rome
text: Night in Rome for work, hotel in a great location compared to Roma Termini and in a fairly quiet zoan, correct and fast reception, new and well furnished room, sufficient and quality breakfast, just a note on the lack of sustainable products at breakfast such as the Fairtrade Tea that in other hotels of the same category improves the experience of the BreakFast.

author: Poppy Z
title: Highly recommend
text: Highly recommend this beautiful little hotel. Staff were very welcoming, friendly and helpful. Room was immaculate, very comfortable and quiet. We didn’t book breakfast but you can add on for €9 once there.  Ideal location, the 5 minutes walk from Termini railway station made our in/out bound trips from/to the airport stress free. Major sightseeing attractions from 30 - 60 minutes walk away or can use the metro from Termini station. Plenty of well priced eateries nearby. Would definitely book here again.

author: Jack Z
title: Good value for money in a good location
text: 3 minutes walk to Termini - from there all buses (hop on hop off and normal bus service), also the airport bus stops here. Our room was simply furnished, a bit worn out but clean. The breakfast buffet was adequate, nicely decorated and the breakfast room cozy. Within walking distance you will find shops, restaurants, bars and sights, the large mall and countless dining options at Termini. Since we were traveling all day, it was just the thing for us.

author: George J
title: Adequate for one night
text: We stayed one night before an early morning flight. The staff, especially Paolo, were friendly and helpful. The breakfast had multiple choices. The room was clean but tiny. For one night it was fine. More than one night would have been claustrophobic. The shower is barely large enough for a 175-200 lb. male. We could not get the AC to work, so we slept with the window open. Perhaps this is what to expect for $215

author: Paolo A
title: Close to the Termini and has everything you need.
text: Well located hotel with everything you need. 5 minute walk from the Termini. The room was clean and had a good shower. Buffet style breakfast, very pleasant and welcoming staff.

author: Laura M
title: Great stay
text: Checked in for one day. They had our room available early. They were great the whole time. Front desk Paulo was very nice.

author: Isabella N
title: Magical beyond words
text: This place has a sense of magic - words do not equate - from the people that run the ship - the warmth of the entrance - the rooms so efficient - the location - we stay here rather than closer to our son's school because it is truly that magical - home from home - again just not enough words!

author: Benjamin N
title: Amazing style and location
text: Amazing location in a fantastic arena. The hotel is an amazing experience with great style. Loved that there are rooms with 5 beds.

author: Mason W
title: Not worth the price
text:
Unfortunately, my stay was very disappointing. The first room was dark, smelled moldy, was not clean, and the air conditioner was extremely noisy. After complaining, I was moved to a better room, but it faced the street, and the noise made it almost impossible to sleep. I also had to pay extra for the room, despite being told I would receive a discount.

The check-in time (4:00 PM) and check-out time (10:00 AM) are not guest-friendly. The rooms need modernization, housekeeping should pay more attention to cleanliness, and the staff could be warmer and more welcoming.

Overall, the hotel offers very poor value for money and is not worth the price.

author: Julien E
title: A nice New York stay
text: Very nice took care of our luggage before and after checking in so super nice to not have to rake care of that stuff. Very walkable from stores and the metro. Also a nice sitting area underneath the reception to relax in. Clean and comfortable just a little small but that comes with the city.

author: Nora I
title: Excellent historic property - clean + quiet room
text: Loved this hotel - would stay again and highly suggest to anyone. Friendly and helpful front desk staff.  Large quiet room with a very nice bathroom, comfortable beds, great bedding + pillows. We did specifically ask for a quiter location and they delivered - slept great!   There are two lounge/lobby/seating areas to gather - the first floor one especially great to meet up/chat with travel mates. Note that there is a large flight of stairs to get to check in/rooms (and more stairs to upper floors). Hallways are also narrower than typical as it is an old building - this had no impact for us but maybe useful to know. Also note official check in is late - 4pm - and there is a charge for early check in (though they did offer complimentary late checkout if needed)

author: Abigail H
title: Hotel or Time Travel Machine?
text: Without a doubt one of the most unique and wonderful hotels in the NYC. It's like stepping back in time. feels like a speak easy from the 1920's with all the modern luxuries. Loved the gathering areas, for reading a book or checking your phone. Makes you feel welcome throughout the hotel and not just trapped in your room. Unfortunately, for us, we were only there one night on layover from a Vacation, would have loved to stay there more.  I can't say enough good things about the hotel. The Bowery is the Bowery and has been the same forever, so the area around the hotel might be a little intimidating for a lady or someone traveling alone, especially at night.  Coffee in morning was nice touch. No elevator so prepared to lug your bags.  once in your room, that doesn't matter

author: Benjamin G
title: eclectic and comfortable
text: Loved the location close to Little Italy and subway lines. Beautiful decor. Friendly staff. Comfortable accommodations for a family of 5.

author: Sara V
title: Wonderful experience
text:
Highly recommended! The hotel is absolutely beautiful, with stunning design and wonderfully maintained common areas that are clean, inviting, and thoughtfully decorated. What truly makes this place special is the exceptional staff. Everyone is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and genuinely eager to help. The level of service goes above and beyond expectations, making every guest feel valued and cared for.

There are only two minor points worth mentioning: the curtains in the room do not completely block out the sunlight, and the bathroom in the standard room is quite small. However, these were minor inconveniences compared to the overall experience.

Other than that, everything was perfect. A fantastic stay from start to finish, and I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a memorable and enjoyable visit. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Lucas X
title: Great Hotel near Little Italy and SoHo
text: We needed a room for 4 adults and one child and this was perfect. The hotel was immaculate, beds were very comfortable and the atmosphere was fun. The staff was great and it allowed us to stay in the neighborhood we needed. Would definitely return.

author: Grace G
title: A must-do.
text: A hotel just the way I love them. A carefully curated decor, typical of the atmosphere of a hotel in the spirit of the neighborhood. Top-notch bedding. A staff that is kind, lovely, and attentive. A special mention to Sandra and Larbi, who were incredible. The bedding is fantastic. In short, we love it.

author: Oscar Q
title: Excellent choice
text: Great location. Very cool decor and modern design. Great quality for the price. Quiet at night. Easy walking distance to shopping and some great restaurants. Loved it!

author: Pablo K
title: Pretty yet only So-so in Soho
text: The staff at this hotel was fantastic. The hotel itself was  nice. Room noise was a little excessive because of door slamming and noise in the hall. Bathroom was uncomfortable and entire room was what I consider small for a four-star hotel. Location was okay, fairly close to Soho and Chelsea. great if you want to eat in Little Italy. Overall I have to say I would not choose this hotel again.

author: Emma P
title: Good place to say with kids
text: Nice hotel in lower east side. Well decorated, good coffee & tea... staff is nice as well. room a bit small. close to the metro. Overall good value for money.

author: Sofia V
title: a nice place to stay for vacations in New York
text: A great experience. Local environment of the hotel is great with close subway stations. Service team is quite friendly and helpful.

author: Claire O
title: Only stay if sleep is not important to you
text: I can’t recommend this place. The only thing it has going for it is the location and its quirkiness. Other than that, the rooms are really small, there is a $25 service fee for things that are usually free in hotels like WiFi, luggage storage and morning coffee. The rooms are so noisy, I was across the hall from the hotel bathroom and people came in and out all night, had chats in the hallway and ran up and down the hallway. Didn’t sleep well for both nights. Staff does the bare minimum, friendly enough.

author: Leo Q
title: impossible to sleep...
text:
I had to endure noise disturbances every night: air conditioning systems right behind my bedroom window, constant sounds of running water, loud music on Friday and Saturday nights (probably coming from the artist’s studio located just below), neighbors talking, etc.
I would not recommande the Sohotel.
It’s really a shame because your hotel is charming, very well decorated, ideally located in the city, and reasonably priced. But you choose a hotel above all to sleep, and with you, that wasn’t possible.

author: Jessica E
title: Beautiful, historic hotel in a great location, loved it!
text: Beautiful, historic hotel in a great location. Our room was spacious and clean. The view wasn’t great (walls and venting pipes) but that comes with the territory in an old tenament building - we were only there to sleep anyway! Plus as we were away from the road, it was quiet…apart from the vending machines outside the room door. 2 nights in a row, we had very loud youngsters return to the hotel late at night who would then gather by the machines buying cans of drink which was very noisy at sometimes gone midnight. Maybe the machines could be relocated?  Other than that I have no complaints at all. There was a bathtub with shower over, shower gel, shampoo and conditioner provided (and really lovely stuff too!) and a hairdryer provided. The hotel does not provide any food but there are loads of places nearby open early until late. Grand St station is a very short walk away and gives easy access to trains going to all the main attractions. There are no tea/coffee facilities in the room but complimentary fresh coffee and tea is provided in the foyer every morning. The decor is fabulous and the whole place smells divine! Be aware there are no lifts and the reception desk is on the first floor (not too many steps and staff are on hand to help if needed). We only left yesterday and I’m missing it already!

author: Erin R
title: Hit and miss
text: A lot about this hotel to like, great location, beautiful interiors in communal areas but some simple things really let it down. We booked the deluxe family room which was meant to have a renovated bathroom - while the bedroom was fine, the bathroom was very old and had paint flaking off the roof and water dripping through the roof every time we had a shower, old shower curtain like a hospital. Shower gel was empty and never got refilled even though I mentioned to the cleaning team. Heater didn't work. I reported some of the issues to the hotel but still haven't had a response.

author: Alice A
title: Great experience
text: Great location and exterior lights at night made it easy to find. Clean room, comfortable bed, hot shower, friendly staff.

author: Adam C
title: Great Location
text: The staff were great and very helpful. The stay was good and I think I would stay again if I was in a different room. I would have given a five-star review, but the room we stayed in was right on the intersection of Bowery and Broome, and the noise was constant. We did not have restful sleep any of the three nights we were there. Besides that (which was something the hotel couldn’t do much about), the rooms were very clean and comfortable. The location is really great and right in the center of Chinatown and Little Italy. There’s a ton of great stuff right in the area, and if you want to do something farther away, the nearest subway stations are a five to ten minute walk away.

author: Daniel W
title: Pleasant stay and exceptional hospitality!
text:
Our stay was truly very pleasant. The hotel is small but well-managed, extremely clean, and located in an excellent position for getting around. 
A special thanks goes to Mr. Ahmed at the reception, who distinguished himself for his extreme kindness, helpfulness, and attention toward us. Throughout the entire stay, he was always friendly and ready to help us with any need, making us feel welcomed and looked after with great professionalism. 
We really appreciated his thoughtfulness and the way he took an interest in making our stay as pleasant as possible. An exquisite person who certainly contributed to making our experience even more positive. We highly recommend it!

author: Sofia Y
title: Eight nights stay
text:
I decided to stay in a different location in Paris this time, very close to Gare du Nord. The hotel was small with a small lift. My room had issues with the bath sink not holding water, this was a problem when I wanted to shave. I told reception and eventually I was offered a different room. 

The other room had a wall right behind of the window, so no light was coming in, it was during the heatwave, so the days were very bright. I informed reception of this issue and again I moved to a superior room this time which was very bright and spacious. Plug and charging sockets could be better placed

Breakfast was "ok" the lady seemed stingy with cooking the sausages, and I often had to ask her to make some because there were none left.

Vibe was calm and nothing special.

author: Mason C
title: Excellent
text:
A hotel with all the amenities. 20-30 minutes from the monuments of Paris (Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Louvre Museum, Orsay, Tuileries, Luxembourg Gardens...). Gare de l'Est station is a 5-minute walk away and you have several bus, train, and metro options. 

The hotel is modern. The rooms are very comfortable. The cleanliness is very good. The breakfast is very decent and the staff is very attentive and friendly. Toufik offered to store our suitcases for us at no cost upon checkout. 

The truth is that it has been a very pleasant experience, a place to return to without a doubt.

author: George W
title: Small but charming – to be recommended without hesitation!
text:
We spent ten days there while temperatures were very high in Paris at that time. The very pleasant atmosphere of the hotel, the extremely friendly staff (especially Toufik and Ahmed who never stopped providing us with information to help us find the best route for our excursions), the delicious breakfast, and the air conditioning in the room after a long day of heat made our stay even more pleasant and successful! If we return to Paris, we will return without hesitation to this very pleasant hotel, which also benefits from numerous transport and dining options in the immediate vicinity. The Gare de l'Est is only 5 minutes away!!! We will recommend it without hesitation!
Thank you very much, Toufik!

author: Michael A
title: Good.
text: Two nights stayed at Hotel Soft with my daughter. Nice room with nice view! Lovely air conditioning after a hot day walk. Lovely bathroom, everything you need is there. Breakfast is fine! Very nice to be close to the station and metro and also sights such as Monte Marte is within walking distance. We were kindly helped by TOUFIK. Highly recommended this hotel!

author: Leo U
title: the perfect experience in paris
text:
I stayed in this hotel for 3 nights, we had a great time, excellent cleaning services and the breakfast was delicious.
The owner was immediately available for any request and kind.
We can't wait to return to stay in this wonderful hotel.

author: Lucy Z
title: Couple's trip to Paris
text:
3 beautiful nights 
Very tidy rooms and welcoming and very kind staff, in particular Ahmed who also recommended places for us to visit, the breakfasts were very good and the
staff truly pleasant and hotel truly top-notch

author: Caleb H
title: We would love to come back.
text: We were there for three nights and can only recommend it. The hotel room was clean and quiet at night. The hotel staff was very, very friendly. The breakfast was very good and the transport connections as well (metro 5 min walk away). Excellent price-performance ratio.

author: Hannah C
title: Small but nice🤗
text:
Friendly welcome, we would especially like to mention Ahmed the night porter 🤩 he had a great time with us every evening
Room, small but tidy, the mattresses perfect 👌 
Breakfast sufficient 
Hotel will be completely renovated at the end of the year - we will be back😉✌️

author: Taylor D
title: Hotel Soft; The Parissiene dream
text:
Hotel Soft is truly a 10/10! Perfect location, clean rooms and nice people - especially Toufik en Serge :) Thank you so much for having us.

À bientôt!

Olivier & Maria

author: Taylor S
title: Great location
text: Very good service - friendly and professional! Thank you, Toufik!

author: Daniel C
title: Excellent stay
text:
Excellent welcome from Toufik who listened to our various requests, pleasant hotel, impeccable breakfast service. 
I highly recommend  
olivier chevreux

author: Caleb Y
title: Good welcome
text: Thanks to Toufik for the welcome and to Amina for the breakfast service.

author: Oliver Y
title: Super satisfied
text: A super cozy hotel, the best bed one can imagine, we slept wonderfully. Despite the small room, everything was there, from air conditioning, refrigerator, a great clean bathroom, and super nice staff. Mr. Toufik was very competent and welcomed us warmly. The breakfast left nothing to be desired, it was delicious, with a lovely ambiance, and the entire staff was friendly and competent. Thank you for the wonderful days.

author: Sydney W
title: Hotel Soft a hotel located close to transportation, excellent for visiting Paris. Small but clean hotel rooms. The entir
text: Hotel Soft a hotel located close to transportation, excellent for visiting Paris. Small but clean hotel rooms. The entire staff is extremely kind and ready to help you. At the reception special thanks to Toufik and Ahmed. The entire hotel staff deserves our thanks. It was a pleasant stay at this small cozy hotel8

author: Brooke E
title: A hotel that feels like home
text: The hotel is nicely located, there is a few restaurants nearby and a Carrefour as well as the Canal Saint Martin and Gare de l’Est at walking distance. The staff was great in particular Ahmed from the front Desk, and Amina at breakfast, really made us feel at home. Would recommend!!

author: Lucas T
title: Central hotel in Paris
text:
The hotel is located on a quiet side street near Gare de l'Est, making it perfect for arriving by train. We have been here for the second time now and have been very satisfied each time. The rooms were very clean, and the breakfast was more of a continental style with scrambled eggs, ham, several types of sausage, and cheese. As a tea drinker, I particularly appreciated that a kettle is available, allowing tea to be freshly brewed with boiling water rather than, as is often the case, with "hot water" from the coffee machine. The availability of teapots and even creamers can be considered an additional bonus point. 
The staff is extremely friendly, especially Toufik, who welcomed us. At least all the people at the reception speak English. Thank you very much to everyone!
A small note: Toufik informed us that the hotel will close for six months starting in early January due to construction work.

author: Andrea V
title: stay
text: no worries, everything was good - calm and peaceful

author: Morgan F
title: Great accommodation.
text: From June 1st to 3rd, 2026, we stayed at Hotel Soft. The hotel is conveniently located within walking distance to Gare de l'Est. We were received very kindly and were able to check into one of the two rooms earlier. The rooms are small, but clean. The breakfast was fine. We can gladly recommend the hotel.

author: Sofia T
title: Highly recommended
text:
My friend and I had a very good experience. The location of the hotel is excellent: just steps from Gare de l'Est and 10 minutes from Place de la République. 
Breakfast is plentiful and good, with plenty of choices. And it is one of the few hotels in Paris that does not charge an outrageous price for breakfast, so this is an important aspect to consider.
The staff is extremely kind and helpful. 
The only downside: the bathroom is small and the circulation fan is not very effective. It was a sauna!

author: Freya U
title: Budget by name,  but perfect for the price!
text:
Along the main road through the 19th arrondissement, the IBIS budget La Villette 19éme is only a 10 minute walk in either direction to the nearest Metro station, making it perfectly situated for quick transportation across the city. 

With budget in the name, it provides a comfy bed, shower, toilet and storage for luggage. And if you’re on a city break, that’s more than ample to have place to rest and recuperate after exploring Paris.

The front desk was staffed by friendly and welcoming Parisians, who cheerfully checked us in, even if my French is rather rusty.

author: Claire F
title: Decent for the price
text: Rooms are quite small. Breakfast buffet OK. Bath towels with a funny smell...

author: Marta W
title: Okay for the price.
text:
Does the job for a decent price-quality ratio.
Lacks a bit of staff at the front desk. 
Room for 3, more like for 2.

author: Samuel H
title: Simple Hotel, Great Location and Good Value
text:
We had a very good stay at ibis budget Paris La Villette 19ème and would definitely consider coming back. It’s a great example of a budget hotel that offers exactly what you need for a short city break.

The hotel has a very convenient location, just a short walk from Jaurès and Stalingrad metro stations, which made it really easy to get around Paris and reach all the main attractions.

We stayed in a room with a bunk bed, which worked really well for our group. The room is small and very simple, but clean, modern and practical. The beds were comfortable and we all slept well.

The bathroom is compact but functional and well maintained, and everything was clean throughout our stay.

The staff were friendly and helpful, and the hotel overall felt well organized. It’s a basic hotel, but everything works as it should.

The breakfast buffet had a good selection of simple items, enough to start the day well before heading out to explore the city.

Overall, it’s a no-frills hotel, but clean, comfortable and excellent value for money, especially thanks to its great location and easy access to public transport.

author: Louis L
title: worst
text: Lower your expectations, the staff barely knows any english and they’re very unintrested about your issues on your stay and they can’t cooperate. I was there with my school and when we arrived the door wouldn’t open with our code and they told us to wait, we were staying echsausted from a long day and they didn’t helped us with anything. All our bagadges and chlotes etc were in that room, they told us just to wait when the next day at 8 AM we should go back home…UNBELIEVABLE.At breakfast ( a poor one) the dishes were dirty, the towels were stained also and the bedsheets. When you entry your room it’s probably been vacuumed a week ago or so, very bad conditions. Even if we are with our school now, i don’t reccomend. Run away when you hear IBIS BUDGET, unbelievable

author: Oliver N
title: Excellent breakfast
text:
We stayed 3 nights which were very pleasant. The room small but very clean.
Towels always clean every day.
They provide water water with gas and hot water has microwave and tables for snacks use.
The strong point is the breakfast the crossaints and the always hot and fabulous delicious chocolate bread.
The staff are helpful and attentive.
If the intention is to sleep and breakfast is the ideal hotel as the metro is right nearby.

author: Ella C
title: Very good family stay
text: I want to give this hotel a positive review as I've seen some poor ones on this site, we arrived at 11pm , checked in without issue , we found both rooms clean and comfortable as was shower and bathroom , rooms are compact but If you need a place to stay for exploring I found this hotel great value . Its also close to 3 metro lines which makes getting around Paris very easy and there are plenty of Restaurants, Fast food, Bars and supermarkets close by

author: Ella D
title: WORST IBIS I'VE EVER LIVED
text: The warming was awful. We stayed 5 days and no day the room was swept or the bedding changed. We were in 3 and left only 2 towels. The third bed was never arranged. But none of this compares to the rough, rude and terrible reception service, especially on January 12 at 19:45. I've been to more than 40 ibis world out and none compares to this one. A bad experience.

author: Evie P
title: Mixed stay
text: A few little cuckoo that make me a little disappointed with my stay. The air conditioning that is not at all silent and the control button that does not work, there was no lighting in the toilet so very unpleasant to be forced to leave the door open and finally the shower door that did not close and water flowing into the room.  Too bad because the room overall could have been nice and especially a great lunch.

author: Abigail H
title: Hotel suitable for a few days in Paris.
text:
The hotel seemed basic: as for the somewhat small room the bathroom area, although it was clean and in order. The breakfast is good and complete. 
Its location is far from the center but nearby has metro lines. I recommend line 7 that takes you to the opera.

author: Andrea N
title: It's not what it used to be
text:
I chose this hotel for its proximity to Gare du Nord as part of an international trip.
We have stayed several times in Ibis Budget and we have to note that this is not what it was. 
I booked a night for 2 adults and 1 child (the confirmation email attests) and when we took possession of the room, the bed for our son was not made. 
You pay to get a Service and make a bed is part of it. It is inconceivable that it is up to the client to make his own bed! I will pass on the cleanliness of the sheets which leaves much to be desired. A while ago, when the stains no longer go to the wash, you simply have to throw them away and invest in new sheets! 
Consideration should also be given to fairly extensive training in client management and Welcoming to staff. Both on arrival and on departure, the staff have no consideration for the guests.
This was my last experience with this type of hotel that is declining sharply.

author: Sean C
title: Location and price
text:
Rooms ,comfortable bed, as you see it in the picture, just to rest, the wash is inside the room, the shower next door, and the cup on the other side with door, but all that looks and knows, but all right, we caught it with breakfast, which is fine and I recommend it, basic, but for the prices of Paris that a coffee costs € 5, here being buffer, you can drink the ones you want and eat toast the ones you want.  And so you don’t waste time looking for a place to have breakfast and take advantage of the trip, because Paris has a lot to see. Right next to the hotel you have a carrefour, which comes super good for everything. The nearest metro station is Jáures line 5, which you can go to many places and is only 5 m from the hotel, line 7, stalingrad, you have it 8 m , which has even more connections. So very good. The area la villette is very good, you have many bars for dinner or drinks after a long day of visits. So I'd go back to this hotel.
Before going to Paris, if I recommend that you take a good look at the airport you arrive, because Beauvais airport, is 1 hour 40 paris, there is a direct bus that leaves from the airport to porte villette, that is good , the aerobus, are 59€ round trip, but you have to keep in mind, when the others are 17/30km and you arrive much earlier at your destination.

author: Daisy G
title: Not what I expected
text: I went a few days a go we were three persons what I saw was a boat room. The third bed was in an uncomfortable place and not even had sheets they expected us to do their job .The bathroom was smelling like a public toilet and the room was so cold more cold than outside.About the cleaning terrible job! We were ordering some nights and they did us throw the garbages they left them there suck*ng and dropping on the floor also a lot of broken windows we coudnt get fresh air. For me it’s a no!!!

author: Anna T
title: Good value, clean no-frills hotel
text: There are plenty of people who will scoff at a basic no-frills offering of the kind Ibis Budget provides. But the La Villete location is absolutely fine. Its rooms are compact but clean. The hotel is near bus and metro routes and cheap places to eat, at least by Paris standards. Honestly, don’t be put off this hotel for a short stay.

author: Ethan K
title: In a suburban neighborhood a cozy and unpretentious room awaits you in Paris
text:
Located in the La Villette district of Paris, between the Juares and Lumiere metro stations, the hotel is large, seven floors high, with many small but cozy rooms.
Quiet, except for the elevator voice.
The bidet is missing and the bathroom does not allow much privacy, but the room is clean and the staff attentive and attentive.
Breakfast, for those who have it, average. Avoid fruit and waffles. Everything else is fine.
Enjoy your stay in Paris

author: Leo D
title: Its ok!
text:
It was an ok hotel, there was no issues an the location was ok, also the breakfast was free and good, I totally recommend the hotel.

I hope to go again with a room more on the last floor to see the amazing view of paris, but it was ok, no issues at all.

author: Anna D
title: 5 days in Paris
text:
The hotel in the.complex is good. The location is great (100 meters from metro 5 stop Laumiere) and with 10 minutes by metro you are in the center
The rooms are actually minimal... but for a few days you can do
I confirm that there is no hairdryer (knowing I brought it) and that the 3 bed was to be made 
Breakfast for me was great
Sweet, salty, yogurt, bread, fruit... nothing was missing
Also excellent is the free water dispenser, both in the lobby and in the breakfast room,
Overall I recommend it, very good value for money
Possibility to leave luggage in the lobby lockers both on arrival and departure, but are subject to a fee (4euros per day for small luggage, 7 for large where in reality are fine 3 stacked trolleys)

author: James F
title: Uncomfortably hot sleeping, lovely staff
text:
Downside was the shower is right next to the bed. The toilet has a thin wooden door that cannot be locked. The biggest issue was no A/C. Ordinarily  fine but it was 35c outside, it is 39c in a few days. Sleeping in the evening was a real challenge. Having the window open then introduced the “lively” areas sounds throughout the evening. Would recommend the hotel in all months but June July and August.

The hotel was nice enough, in a reasonable area and the staff were very helpful. It is close to a few metro stations.
The room was clean enough with a third bed that went over the top of our double bed which was quirky.

author: Daniel Y
title: Poor attitude and standards at Ibis Paris
text:
Communication with your staff proved to be challenging, even though one member of our group is fluent in French. Responses from your team—whether in French or English—were consistently unhelpful, dismissive, and lacking in empathy. The level of service provided was not in line with the rates being charged and there is a clear disconnect between the cost charged and the overall value received even for a budget hotel.

All members of the group expressed dissatisfaction with several aspects of the stay. Most concerning were the poor room conditions and the unacceptable state of the bathrooms. It is evident that there is a drainage issue which requires urgent attention. Furthermore, the quality and presentation of the breakfast were well below the standard expected even of a 3-star hotel.
I expect more from an Ibis Hotel.

author: Camille T
title: Poor quality of service
text:
On the mattress and shower presence of hair.
The housekeeper threw away my phone charger cable while Hey returned to the scene an hour later. She wouldn't let me into the room.
A pitiful service in terms of quality of service.

author: Ella O
title: Nice hotel naar Place de la Sorbonne
text: I stayed at this hotel for two nights.The staff is very helpfull and friendly. I like this neighbourhood very much, next to the Sorbonne, close by the Pantheon, Jardin du Luxembourg and the Bv St Germain.

author: Caleb F
title: Great centrally located hotel
text:
A beautiful centrally located hotel with excellent service and excellent coffee! We wish we had the same coffee at home, including the coffee machine. 👌👌👌

We stayed there in July and were delighted. The nearest metro and bus stops are within easy walking distance, as is the nearest park for relaxing, and a beautiful museum for lovers of the Middle Ages and history.

The service and helpfulness at the hotel are also excellent; you really feel very well taken care of.👌

author: Charlotte T
title: A reliable choice
text: The Hotel Design Sorbonne is a great choice for a stay in Paris. The rooms are clean and well-appointed, and the air conditioning works well. The hotel is far enough away from many of the main sights to be quiet, yet close enough to everything you might want to do during your stay. If you are in basic good shape, you can walk to the Louvre, the Paris Opera, and all the main sights on the right bank. Notre Dame is a stroll away. The neighborhood is charming with lots of options for food and shopping. The Cluny Museum and the Pantheon are a five-minute walk away. The  Sorbonne Pantheon is across the street. The hotel staff will help you with anything you want to do. Uber picks up out front.

author: Andrea N
title: Very good location
text: We have stayed at this hotel, I recommend it because it is very central, it is next to the Pantheon, about a 10-minute walk from Notre Dame, the rooms are small, especially the bathroom, but we were there for a short time so we didn't notice the difference compared to a larger one. I recommend it with breakfast because it is very good, very pleasant staff

author: Sydney S
title: Charming hotel in a great area.
text:
We have stayed in Paris many times but this hotel is one of our favourites. It’s located in a lovely area, a close walk to the metro or the river which allows you to explore all the main attractions. There are plenty of great restaurants nearby too.
It’s a small hotel with a friendly feel and the staff are so helpful. We were travelling with elderly parents who were gluten free and they were happy to provide suitable products for breakfast which was a great help.
A great stay in a charming hotel.

author: Harry V
title: Delicious
text: A simple and comfortable hotel. Kindness, friendliness, and helpfulness from all the staff. The hotel is clean, located a few steps from the Sorbonne University. Very convenient for reaching Notre Dame, the Cluny museum, the Pantheon, and the delightful Place Sorbonne, bookstores, and bistros.

author: James Q
title: Great location with helpful staff
text: The facility is located right across the university. It is very convenient to go to the park and take public transportation. The hotel staff is helpful. Even though the facility is old, it is clean. The room is small but suits us well for a refresh and sleep. We were on the fifth floor and was quiet. The elevator did not work on June 3, we appreciate that the night shift staff helped us moving our heavy luggage. We recommend this hotel to other travellers.

author: Lily W
title: A pleasant hotel, well located.
text: Excellent reception at the front desk. We had a good stay at the Design Sorbonne Hotel. Very well located: close to sites like the Pantheon and the Luxembourg Gardens. Many restaurants nearby. A breakfast buffet prepared with care. One small downside: the shower products did not smell very good.

author: Nora A
title: Great Hotel in Quiet Street
text: Lovely small hotel in a quiet street.  Clean rooms decor is a bit garish but rooms are well appointed.  Staff helpful

author: Taylor R
title: Good hotel in a quiet, central location
text:
This is a good hotel, in a really good central location close to the Pantheon, Jardin du Luxembourg and Notre Dame. There are many bars and restaurants nearby as well.

Our room was to the front of the hotel with a view on to the street but it was very quiet. The room was small but okay for a few nights stay. The lift was also really small, so I preferred taking the stairs. We had  pre-ordered a bottle of champagne for arrival so I was pleased to see it in the room when we got there!

author: Zachary G
title: Good welcome.
text: Thank you to Redouane for his excellent welcome at the reception. We had a good stay at the Design Sorbonne Hotel.

author: Lily O
title: Good location. Short walk to Notre Dame & the Seine
text: Hotel is situated in a convenient location with good transport links, restaurants, Sorbonne & the Luxembourg gardens

author: Antoine X
title: Nice hotel
text: Very friendly and helpfull staff. Good place to stay in center of Paris. Very quiet place. A ltot of restaurants and terraces in the neighbourhood.

author: Charlotte S
title: The perfect choice for a hotel in Paris!
text:
The hotel looks like it is: a genuine French hotel with a cozy atmosphere, a small elevator, good French breakfast and not least a fantastic location in a quiet street but close to everything! 
A good bathroom and good beds - but a little too big duves :-)
It was our 3rd visit and we will return to the same place and the same hotel!

author: Morgan R
title: Nice hotel in nice place
text: Nice hotel in a great location! Cozy neighborhood and also very central. Redouane at the reception was very friendly and helpful.

author: Nora Q
title: Fantastic!
text: I have now been here for the 4th time alone and the stay for August is already reserved. A super location, clean rooms, good breakfast and very friendly and helpful staff. I can't wait to get back!

author: Katie L
title: Compact, cosy and friendly staff.
text: Location is great and friendly staff like Redouane and the team. Near slights like Pantheon and Luxembourg gardens, Museum Cluny and Notre Dame. Near to RER-B(airport and Gare Du Nord) and  walkable to Metro. Plenty of food nearby and special mention is BOULANGERIE MODERNE, it’s Croissant is superb, won 2nd prize.

author: Paige J
title: Good Hotel
text: We have a very nice vacation in the hotel Mr. Redouane on the reception was very friendly and helpful for us. The breakfast is good and plentiful. :)

author: Taylor O
title: Hidden gem of Paris!
text: Very nice en friendly hotel. Redouane has helped us very professionally en kindly! Nothing was to much! We are definitely will stay hier again. Thanks, Olga and Jackie.

author: Brooke W
title: Excellent choice!
text: Central, clean, quiet hotel with very good breakfast and very helpful employees! Easy access to public transport, but on foot you can go almost anywhere. The rooms have sufficient space without creating a problem of narrowing.  I would prefer it again!!

author: Mathis X
title: Wonderful hospitality and a very comfortable stay
text:
I stayed at BH Hotel for two nights and had a wonderful experience. From the moment I arrived, the front-desk team were exceptionally warm and attentive. They helped with my luggage, offered me water and snacks, and when I mentioned that I was hungry, they kindly gave me three small pastries to take with me. It was such a thoughtful gesture.

My room was not ready when I arrived, so they stored my luggage while I went out to explore. By the time I returned, the room was ready and my bags had already been placed inside. A member of staff personally accompanied me to the room, explained how everything worked and showed me where the restaurant was.

The hotel is modern, beautifully renovated, clean and very quiet at night. Breakfast is available for a generous amount of time, with a fresh and well-chosen selection of juices, coffee, pastries, desserts, hot food and cereals.

The location is also extremely convenient for sightseeing, taxis, restaurants and the train station. What impressed me most was how well managed the hotel felt—everyone working there seemed genuinely positive, welcoming and happy to help. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Connor W
title: Comfort and care
text: Everything was wonderful! Pleasant aromas, a delicious and healthy breakfast, the hotel staff is very hospitable and caring, wonderful location, near the station, bus stop, and taxi stand.

author: Evie E
title: Great choice for visiting Rome
text: The hotel is beautiful, the staff is excellent, very good location, the breakfast is very complete!

author: Lea O
title: Great place to stay in Roma!
text:
Great place to stay in Romal! The people at front desk, restraunt / bar and house keeping are great people and gave us a very warm welcome. I'll recomend it.

Thanks for all!

author: Hugo V
title: Excellent option
text: Excellent option for staying in Rome,

author: Alice O
title: Chía Roma
text: Fantastic hotel! They made us feel welcome. The breakfast was spectacular, the drinks and appetizers were excellent, but the most pleasant thing was definitely the attention and kindness of the staff. 🇮🇹✨

author: Katie O
title: We will definitely come back!
text: This was the last hotel we had the pleasure to spend 1 night at after staying at 4 other hotels during a 13-day trip. It was our favorite and we were so sad that we were only able to stay 1 night. It exceeded our expectations in that the accommodations were so thoughtfully added. The next time we are in Rome, we will most definitely come back.  Thanks for making us feel pampered and well taken care of!

author: Lucas X
title: Quality room at good value price
text: The hotel was excellent value for money considering other options in the area. If you want a clean, smart, quiet and easy hotel close to Termini station I'd recommend this hotel. The room was very comfortable and we had a great sleep. Service was efficient and friendly and we had welcoming drinks in the courtyard and rooftop as well as a delicious breakfast. The area itself is pretty quiet so if your looking for a bit more action you'll have to walk a little bit everything is close by.

author: Freya H
title: I still can’t believe it isn’t officially a five‑star hotel.**
text:
**BH Hotel Rome was absolutely fantastic — I still can’t believe it isn’t officially a five‑star hotel.**

 Cleanliness is the most important thing to me, and this hotel exceeded every expectation, especially during such an important occasion: my mother’s milestone birthday.

The hotel is beautiful, the location is perfect, and the staff… truly unforgettable. Every single person we encountered was warm, kind, and genuinely invested in making our stay special.

We especially adored the woman in the dining room — we hugged her on our last day because she treated us like family. Every morning she brought us coffee with sweet handwritten messages in English and Spanish for my Latino parents, who kept speaking to her in Spanish instead of Italian. Her kindness set the tone for each day.

The outdoor spaces are gorgeous, and the rooftop happy hour became one of our favorite moments. My sister and I shared lovely conversations while taking in the stunning Roman views.

The reception team was amazing, and I have to say **mil grazie** to the plumber who helped my mom recover a very important piece of jewelry. That gesture meant the world to us.

BH Hotel is a gem — elegant, spotless, welcoming, and full of heart. I will absolutely stay here again.  
**Thank you, BH familia… mil grazie!**

author: Poppy D
title: Celebrating Mom’s 80th birthday in style
text: This hotel is a hidden gem. It is a 5 star hotel for a great price. I travel a lot and this was one of the nicest hotels that I have ever stayed at. The staff were fantastic. They went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. I was traveling with elderly parents and they met our every need. The hotel was very clean and the amenities were wonderful. The breakfast options very diverse . The food was delicious and fresh. The staff who worked the breakfast were friendly and so kind. She knew we were celebrating my mom’s 80th birthday and she went out of her way to make sure mom had everything. The happy hour and rooftop seating were great touches. We would start our evenings with happy hour and time on the rooftop. The ambience is lovely. Oh, and I can’t forget to mention the beautiful scent of the hotel. There are diffusers spread conveniently around which add a subtle but lovely scent in the hotel. I liked the scent so much, I looked into purchasing the diffusers used by the hotel. I will definitely be returning to Rome and will absolutely stay at the BH hotel again. Thank you to Seif and the whole team. You are appreciated more than words can describe.

author: Nora H
title: Stunning hotel
text: Amazing hotel, the staff were very good extra caring and made sure we had everything we needed, very good for the price and had the most amazing holiday staying here, nothing I can say other than it was beautiful !

author: Laura I
title: Outstanding service, great hotel
text:
My stay at B.H. Roma Hotel was absolutely wonderful. The rooms are compact and quaint, impeccably clean, and thoughtfully maintained, making them both comfortable and charming.

What truly sets this hotel apart is the exceptional service. As a family-run hotel, they genuinely make you feel like part of the family from the moment you arrive. Every member of the team is warm, welcoming, and attentive, always going above and beyond to ensure your stay is perfect. Nothing is ever too much trouble, and their kindness and hospitality make all the difference.

The location is another huge advantage. Many of Rome's most iconic attractions are within easy walking distance, including the Spanish Steps, Trevi Fountain, the Colosseum, and the Pantheon. It made exploring the city effortless while still having a welcoming place to return to after a day of sightseeing.

If you're looking for a hotel with spotless rooms, a personal touch, an unbeatable location, and truly outstanding service, I can't recommend B.H. Roma Hotel highly enough. I would happily stay here again and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to anyone visiting Rome.

author: David F
title: Great hotel
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I can’t recommend this hotel enough! From the moment we arrived until the day we checked out, everything was absolutely perfect.

The hotel is beautiful, spotlessly clean, and made us feel comfortable from the very first moment. The breakfast was excellent—fresh, delicious, and a wonderful way to start each day.

What truly made this stay unforgettable was the incredible service. Every member of the staff was kind, welcoming, professional, and always happy to help with anything we needed. They genuinely care about their guests and go above and beyond to make every stay special.

A very special thank you to Roberto. Your kindness, warmth, professionalism, and attention to every little detail made our trip even more memorable. Thank you for making us feel so welcome and for always being there with a smile. You truly made a difference, and we will always remember your amazing hospitality.

This hotel made our entire trip to Rome even more special. If you’re looking for outstanding service, a wonderful atmosphere, and people who truly care about their guests, this is the place to stay.

Thank you to the entire team for an unforgettable experience. We will definitely be back, and we will recommend this hotel to all our family and friends! ❤️

author: Liam A
title: Super!
text: Super, super, super. That's all I have to say.

author: Harry D
title: 10/10—highly recommended
text:
Our stay was absolutely wonderful!
The location is excellent—perfect for exploring Rome on foot and with easy access to everything we wanted to see.

The breakfast buffet was fantastic, with a great variety of fresh and delicious options to start the day.

What truly made this hotel stand out, though, was the staff. Everyone was incredibly warm, friendly, and genuinely helpful. They gave us amazing recommendations for places to visit around Rome and even helped us secure reservations at restaurants. Their local knowledge and kindness made our trip even more memorable.

We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. 10/10—highly recommended, and we would happily stay here again!

author: Laura T
title: Wonderful
text: Beautiful hotel, spotlessly clean but the best thing about the hotel is the staff. They were the nicest, friendliest people, so welcoming and helpful, always offering to help in any way. The rooftop is lovely and peaceful. Would 100% stay here again.

author: Henry P
title: Great night in Rome
text: What a fabulous find. The hospitality of the staff at this hotel was amazing. Everyone we encountered went above and beyond. The café was terrific. I only got a couple of names Marat and Amir were both terrific. I would recommend this hotel to all our friends and family.

author: Freya F
title: A 10/10 experience from start to finish ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
text:
Our experience at this hotel has been unbeatable. From the first moment they made us feel at home.

We want to especially thank Roberto, who welcomed us upon our arrival. We arrived around 1:00 PM, an hour before the scheduled check-in time, and even so he welcomed us with a smile, offering us something to drink while he explained, with a city map, the main points of interest and gave us recommendations on what to visit. In addition, they had the thoughtful gesture of giving us the room before 2:00 PM, something we greatly appreciated.

We also want to highlight the service from Seif, who was just as kind, attentive, and professional during our stay.
Seif, CHOUKRAN BARCHA. Yaishek
All the staff were always attentive to any need we might have had, making the experience even better.

The room was impeccable, with excellent cleanliness, and the whole hotel had a very pleasant scent that conveyed a great sense of care. The included breakfast is a very complete buffet, with a great variety of options and everything very delicious.

Finally, we want to thank you for offering to store our luggage on the day of our departure without any problem so that we could make the most of our last day in the city. It is a detail that makes the difference.

We are leaving very grateful for the treatment received. Without a doubt, if we return, we will repeat at this hotel and we will recommend it to anyone visiting the city.

author: Charlie D
title: Very good experience.
text:
Very quiet hotel, very good welcome and lots of thoughtful touches: welcome drinks as well as small pastries, very welcoming staff at the front desk (Seif) and at breakfast. The breakfast is varied and of good quality. Bottles of water (sparkling and still) every day in the room. We recommend it.
(Annie and JY)

author: Luca T
title: Excellent hotel
text:
Very well-maintained property in the Termini area. The staff proved to be very kind and efficient toward the customer.
Excellent value for money.

author: James E
title: No air conditioning available and this is lied about!
text:
Attention: false advertising! The hotel does not have (working) air conditioning and that is advertised and was mentioned on our booking confirmation. We had specially selected for this because there was a heat wave in Paris. We unfortunately did not get what we paid for and are therefore forced to check out with our 3 children after a bad and hot night. Now the hotel refuses a refund of the 3 remaining and therefore unused nights! This is hallucinatory: if you offer air conditioning through Booking.com, I expect to get that as a customer. So pure deception and then again refusing to pay back... 

When I checked in in the morning, I had asked if the air conditioning definitely worked: yes, they said, and “if it’s not enough for you, you can come get a fan.” But it didn't work at all, and they knew that very well. If they had just been honest, I could have found another hotel. Judging by the reviews, they knew for at least 2 weeks that the air conditioning was not working. Disgraceful!

author: Anna M
location: Costa de New Jersey, Nueva Jersey
title: Bad
text: Bath is a plane size bathroom very small, bath tub in other room smell, this place DO NOT HAVE A/C if you are  planning to go in the summer  be prepared to be in hell, people was begging for a   fan in the reception, metro station close but u have to pass a bridge homeless under the bridge  asking for money

author: Dylan O
title: Very good for the price
text:
Well-located hotel 30 minutes from the Stade de France, with parking [€20], room very well laid out, upgraded to a triple suite due to an availability error.
Well-stocked breakfast.
Friendly and professional staff.
Thank you for your hospitality

author: Mia B
title: It's terrible. Never again.
text:
We are very disappointed with our stay and absolutely do not recommend this hotel. As far as we are concerned, this hotel is not worth four stars. Not only because of the faulty air conditioning, but especially because of the way we were treated as guests.

On arrival, the air conditioning in our room did not work, while it was 40 degrees in Paris during our stay. The room became unbearably warm. We immediately reported this to reception. An employee told me someone was coming by to fix the air conditioning. After two hours of waiting, there had still been no one. When we went to the reception again, it was said that people did not know when someone would come, but that someone would still come along. At the end of the day, no one came.

Because we were then told that we would get another room the next day, we decided to spend the first night in this room anyway. However, that was terrible. Without air conditioning or fan, the room was unbearably hot. We put wet towels on top of us and literally lay down in bed with soggy towels to cool our bodies a bit. Nevertheless, we hardly slept.

The next day it was again 40 degrees. The poor sleep and the constant heat made all three of us feel exhausted, drowsy and unwell. I myself became so dizzy while shopping that I almost fainted and we had to interrupt our day. Your body simply can’t recover if you can’t cool off for a moment at night.

When my girlfriend asked if we could get extra towels so we could shower more often to cool off, this was initially refused. Although we had explained how warm the room was and that we had hardly slept, no understanding was shown and no apology was offered. Only after insistence did we finally get one extra towel.

The next morning we were told that we could leave our stuff in the room and that we would get another room in the evening. We entered the city on the basis of that commitment. When we came back that night, suddenly there was no other room available at all. It was then said that we should have come in the afternoon, when we had never been told. The promised mechanic had still not visited either.

The lowest point was the attitude of the receptionist. When we told him how bad we felt and I told him that I almost fainted because of the heat and lack of sleep, he started laughing. There was no excuse offered, no understanding shown and no thought given to a solution. We found that perhaps even worse than the broken air conditioning itself.

Eventually we decided not to stay in this hotel for the second night and to book another hotel at our own expense for about €400. This cost us a lot of extra money and unfortunately left a big negative mark on our city trip to Paris.
We hope Booking reviews this property critically. The way we have been treated as guests, we do not grant anyone. In the end, the problem was not just the broken air conditioning, but above all the way it was handled: empty promises, no understanding, no excuses, no solution and even being laughed at when we said how bad we felt. In all our trips we have never experienced that we have been treated like this as paying guests. For that reason, we absolutely cannot recommend this hotel and hope that future travelers will be saved from the same experience.

author: Zoe O
title: Very special mood - retro sporty!
text: Cosy hotel with retro- mood ambient. Very keen and professional staff. Clean wide room, while bathroom not so comfortable (sort of box). Silent. Breakfast very basic self service under the expectation vs the rest of the hotel. The district is not really the best in Paris but much more “clean” then in the past.

author: Manon C
title: Horrible
text: Dirty carpet, missing chunks of molding around shower, chips out of furniture and sink, chair filthy, floor dirty  - absolutely the worst hotel we have ever been in.  It’s not even a 1 star.

author: Freya O
title: Hotel
text:
Very good hotel prope nice room 
G flat the cartier c is not the best placed the metro is next door pleasant staff at the reception is listening

author: George C
title: Great location and pleasant stay
text:
I stayed there because I had a concert at Adidas Arena. 
It is well located, close to transport and the concert hall. Accessible less than 10 min walk🙌🏾
The room was spacious, well equipped and clean. 
Just no place to hang the towel in the toilet and no iphone jack in the bedroom. 
Only Reserve: the breakfast schedules (at my check in, I was told that for public holidays it was until 10:30 am or when I arrived the next morning the team insisted that it is 10 am while in the rooms it is even posted 11 am! 
Unpleasant moment with staff in a hurry to clear and insisting on the 10am slot. I still ate but it was uncomfortable.
Otherwise welcoming and helpful team, thank you!

author: James G
title: Very unpleasant stay
text:
I stayed at this 4 star hotel and would like to share a very unpleasant experience. Upon arrival, I was greeted by a certain Hakim at the reception, whose attitude was totally unacceptable. Instead of a professional Welcoming, he was aggressive, speaking loudly and almost shouting in my face, explaining that he could not postpone a night I had missed. I say that I never asked for a refund, but only a minimum of understanding.

His behavior was far from what a receptionist expected: no courtesy, no professionalism, and a neglected presentation (with long and dirty nails), which does not fit the image of a 4-star hotel. When I raised this with other employees, they confirmed that he is known for his lack of education.

The next day, I had an exchange with the manager, who was polite enough to apologize, but that does not change the fact that this experience greatly tarnished my stay.

In addition to this, there are other disappointments: microwave failure, lack of cutlery in the room, and Service generally far below the price paid (600 € for 3 nights).

I would definitely not recommend this hotel.

author: Rosie J
title: Not a great location however the room and service was excellent
text: Cool room layout, modern, all amenities needed are available in the room. Clean and excellent service at the front desk

author: Aiden B
title: Clean, nice breakfast
text: Stayed here one night while on a group tour through Europe.  A short ways from the city center, offered breakfast, rooms were clean. Knowing large tour groups stay here often, they should be a little more prepared for feeding large groups of people.  Food was good, just ran out quick.  Most of the staff very friendly but one in particular seemed didn’t have patience for our big group and our American questions. Overall a nice hotel, not much around this area so if want to be able to walk to restaurants and sight seeing, better stay closer to the city center. It would be worth it.

author: Morgan T
title: Very satisfied, the staff were very helpful!
text: The room was big, modern, comfortable and quiet. The staff were all very polite and accommodated all our needs. We even had a medical emergency and the reception lady rushed to call for help when my mother contacted her some time after 1:00am. The breakfast buffet (which was an extra charge) had many options to choose from too and it was very delicious.

author: Jack G
title: Lack of professionalism in disappointing customer care
text:
Booking for two nights for three people with breakfasts extra 
room not made, between the two nights towels not changed despite our requests. The cleaning company has changed several customers are unhappy, we will go back to our manager.
Without return to date 
No commercial gestures 
Very disappointed

author: Freya E
title: Comfortable hotel near the door of the Chapel
text:
This hotel does not have a very glamorous location at the foot of the ring road but enjoys a number of advantages. The rooms are well equipped, rather large for the rate and renovated / new. The position a few hundred meters from the metro 12 station door of the chapel is a plus (the red mill 25 minutes). Although close to the ring road, the hotel is well soundproofed both from room to room and outwards.

Buffet breakfast is sufficient and offers a varied offer for people adapted to the majority of diets 

The clientele is international with bcp tourist groups. The hotel is therefore not intimate than others. Remaining for a business tourism does not pose any particular pbm

author: Luke P
title: Too far from Paris city
text: Their room was OK. Not enough light in the halls. Coffee maker was dirty. Air conditioning didn’t work so well.  There is a disaster at breakfast buffet because a lot of people come daily to this hotel and they stay just only one night after three days. They manage better this situation.  We asked the front desk for face tissue and bath tissue.  They never came.  I had to pick it up myself.  A lot of homeless people around and below the bridges nearby. no restaurants or coffee shops nearby we had to order food using Uber eats.

author: Emma P
title: Big hotel quality at a budget price
text:
Let’s get this out of the way. If you’re paying €125 a night for a hotel in Paris, you’re not going to get a ‘big hotel’ experience; don’t expect room or concierge service. What you will get here is a great hotel with fantastic value.
So it is still a B&B Hotel, so expect the usual budget hotel check-in and breakfast experience (both of which were good for us). We weren’t expecting our 10th floor room though - almost a suite, complete with kettle and coffee facilites, fridge, large table and chairs, sofa. Really comfortable bed, very clean, great view and great soundproofing - it’s right next to the périphérique and we heard nothing.
The cost-savings comes from its location - it’s a 15-minute metro ride, and then a 5-minute walk from the absolute centre of Paris. There are also tram and bus options close by. The area feels a little sketchy, but we had no trouble, even coming back late at night.
In summary, if you’re prepared to forgo room service, you’re happy to use public transport, and stay outside the touristy centre, B&B Hotel Paris Nord is a brilliant stay, and excellent value for money. Definitely recommended.

author: Molly P
title: Totally unacceptable treatment – never again
text:
This was without exaggeration the worst hotel experience we've ever had. From the moment we entered the door, we didn't feel like guests, but like a gene.

No “hey”, no “welcome” – just a cold and rejecting message: "You can't check in yet." Fairly enough, we knew the check-in was not until 14:00, so we sat in the lobby and waited. But obviously, you shouldn't either.

First comes a cleaning lady and violently gesticulates that we have to move because she has to clean. While we’re still packing together, she goes and throws my yogurt – which I was still eating – onto another table. Without a word. We move to the place she points to, and shortly afterwards a cleaner comes and asks us to move us again because he has to vacuum. Finally we get to know that we can wait in the garage. A hotel where you can't even stay in the lobby. We had a two-year-old with us, and we were literally chased around like we were in the way – all the time, the whole place.

I tried to talk to the front desk, but just got the same blank sentence over and over again: "Don't check in." No interest, no empathy, no willingness to help. We had to figure out where to go. We had to be in the lobby because they had to clean and no check in. So we went out...

When we were finally allowed to check in, I asked for a baby bed. I was told that it would be passed on. I got the same answer every day and every night – but the bed never came. Not even an excuse.

And the room itself? A disaster. The toilet door cracked so violently that you almost woke up the whole room just by opening it. There was water running in the pipes all night, so it was impossible to calm down. The bed was stone-hard – you could as well have slept on the floor. Speaking of the floor: it was not vacuumed one single time during the entire stay.

This hotel lacks not only service – it lacks complete respect for its guests. We will never come back, and I would strongly advise anyone to book here – especially if you have children with or expect just a minimum standard of comfort and proper treatment.

author: Zoe Y
title: The worst hotel ever
text: The hotel is terrible, and the customer service is awful. They only care about money and have no compassion for their guests. I do not recommend it at all. Stay away! I would never indicated this hotel to a enemy. They charged a fee to that was not fair and I tried to receive my money back and to contact customer service but they never replied.

author: Mason V
title: Good experience
text: Clean room, bright, and well equipped, well insulated from noise from outside. Very varied breakfast that is also suitable for different diets, rather cheerful team and who does not hesitate to respond to different requests.

author: Isabella J
title: Happy holiday
text: The rooms were very spacious and clean. The staff were very friendly and helpful and the breakfast had a huge selection and was delicious. The accesable room was perfect and spacious, and the bathroom was huge. There was also a machine in the reception to order take out.

author: Alexander I
title: Cool room in hot Rome.
text: Decent experience. 4 day stay. Very convenient Monti neighborhood. Not so little Pam grocery store right next door. Still working on the double booking charge. But that shouldn't affect this review. Pleasantly surprised how cool the room was considering how hot Rome was when I arrived and the rules on how how cool an establishment can keep a place only 15° below the outside temperature. I even had to turn the temperature up a few times. The mini bar was stocked with their beverages, so hard to keep any of my own items. And it is on the floor, fairly small and could be colder. There is a kettle with some coffee and tea samples I didn't try. My room was on the 2nd floor, king bed, comfortable. A little desk and chair. Clean room. Pictures can show more than I can describe.
