There apparently is a new service charge of 30€ besides the daily city charge of 7.50€. It was not mentioned at booking so I declined to accept the charge. Oh, the electric outlets- I'm not sure why but it took forever with the micro USB for my phone and tablet. My euro adapter wasn't  any better. I can't describe the breakfast, I got a better deal by opting out. They have a little offering at the entrance of either coffee or tea and a pastry or cookie in the early morning. There was also pastry occasionally in the afternoon. I guess whatever was left over.

author: Anna D
title: A Gem in Rome
text:
This was our 3rd visit to Hotel Raffaello, but our first visit in about 12 years, and I can say it was every bit as good as before, if not better. It is perfectly situated in a quiet street just off Via Cavour, and close to Termini Station, the Colosseum, Forum, Repubblica, the Metro, etc, and even close to a children's playground. 

We had booked 3 rooms for our family and the baby cot was set up in the one room as requested. Check in was very easy and the staff are extremely helpful. The hotel is undergoing renovations with one floor closed off, and we were fortunate to be in the newly renovated rooms. Everything about the rooms was amazing (although we did miss the "old charm" from the previous rooms a little bit 😜). The bathrooms are large by Rome standards and well equipped with all products required and have a huge walk-in shower with good water pressure, and the beds were very comfortable. There was fantastic air-con which helped as we were in Rome in the heat wave and the wi-fi and TV channels were excellent too.

Breakfast was of a high standard with a continental buffet including the most delicious freshly squeezed orange juice, fresh fruits, meats, cheeses, cereals, yoghurts, eggs, bacon, sausage, breads and pastries. There is also a coffee and cake station in reception available at all hours. Unfortunately we had an early train to catch on our last day so we missed breakfast, but when I mentioned it on their survey I was immediately contacted by the hotel to apologize and explain that we could have asked for a packed breakfast. I appreciate that they took the time to reply to me, and I will know for next time.

I would highly recommend Hotel Raffaello for people staying in Rome as it is a high quality hotel and still fairly reasonable priced. Thank you.

author: Lily Q
title: Great hotel for families in Rome
text: Unbelievable hotel with an amazing staff that makes you feel at home. Nice and clean rooms and an excellent breakfast. All the facilities working Ok during a terrible hot wave. Thank you Hotel Rafaello!!

author: Sofia Z
title: Perfect Hotel
text: This hotel is wonderful. The beds were comfortable. The staff is friendly. The bar at the top has great service. Anoosh is kind and helpful. It’s easy to walk anywhere from here. You won’t be disappointed if you choose to stay here. We would definitely come back.

author: Benjamin I
title: Wonderful place to finish our European Journey
text:
This hotel was a delight.  The front desk staff were wonderfully helpful and friendly.  They all spoke English, which was a big help to this non-Italian speaker.  
Our room was well appointed, pretty, and clean.  We had a King Standard Room and there was plenty of room for our 2 weeks worth of luggage for 2 people. 
Breakfast was delicious, albeit a little expensive. 
The location was great.  Easy walking distance of Santa Maria Maggiore.

author: Rosie S
title: Great location and would come back again!
text: This was our first time in Rome. This location was perfect as it was very central to everything we wanted to see.  Front desk was helpful and friendly everyday.  Breakfast (+$) was amazing and a special thank you to Flavia for her friendly service. Room was very comfortable but our favorite part was spending time at the rooftop bar every night.  Great place to just relax and enjoy the view.  Thank you to Nadia & Anush for the great service and for the recommendations. We would definitely come here again.

author: Dylan F
title: Pleasant stay
text: Perfect room resulting from a spontaneous upgrade offered upon arrival. Polite and helpful staff. PERFECT breakfast!!!!

author: Jack Z
title: Great neighborhood, very quiet
text:
We had a twin room that overlooked the side street, so it was very quiet.

Pros:
- comfortable beds and pillows
- amenities in the room
- amazing breakfast: eggs, bacon, pastries, cereals, toasts, fruits, yogourts, etc.
- very kind , helpful and attentive staff, some were able to speak French
- nice neighbourhood: very quiet street, 15 min walk from Colosseum, 5 min walk to Cavour metro, 12 min walk to Termini station 
- lots of shops and restaurants close to the hotel

Cons:
- can be a bit difficult to get in the shower if you have mobility issues, since you need to lift your leg high to get into the shower
- no fixed showerhead, and to take a shower I had to be very careful not to leak water since the glass panel separing the shower from bathroom was not tightly sealed

I would stay here again.

author: Katie N
title: Nice hotel-decent location.
text:
The hotel was comfortable, clean and neat.  The staff were very friendly and accommodating. The hotel room was the size of a standard Best Western hotel you would find in the United States.  The shower was small and the rain shower style shower head was pretty much useless and leaked out the top.  There was no safe in the room.  The location was somewhat conveniently located to the attractions.  The metro and train stations were within 15 minutes' walk.  

 There was a nice selection of food for breakfast (Keep in mind breakfast is not free, can be added to your reservation at time of booking or play by day).  The hotel had free espresso and pastries in the lobby during the day.

author: Freya W
title: Very nice affordable hotel
text:
Very nice affordable hotel about a mile from the Colosseum and near the bus stop from the hop on hop off bus.    Most Rooms have been refurbished and are quite comfortable and well maintained.   The terrace rooms were being refurbished so we had a standard king bed room for 3 days.   The breakfast was good but mostly sweets, with some cereal and eggs and toast available as well as your normal European breakfast favorites.  Service was very friendly and good.   You need to bring converters for the outlets for Americans but the front desk will lend you a couple for free. 

No real view because of location on a small street but that was expected because of the more reasonable price of the hotel.  

I would surely recommend to anyone going to Rome and not wanting to pay the high end hotel prices.

author: Lily O
title: Our base in Rome
text: We happily returned to the Rafael For five nights. We continue to really like the location, the staff, the rooms, and even the breakfast. My previous complaints about no conditioner, and no toilet paper were no longer valid. The hotel rooms and bathrooms have been upgraded.  In the bathrooms we found fluffy towels, lots of light, and ample amenities. Hotel staff were even able to direct us on use of public transportation, including how to get to Tivoli using trains and buses. We will continue to use this hotel as our base in Rome.

author: Freya A
title: Great Hotel
text: Room was spotless and included all the basic amenities - soap, shampoo, body wash, kettle. Shower pressure was high and water hot. Staff were excellent, polite and provided quick services. Now onto one of the locks to any man's heart - food... The breakfast buffet was great, coffees were available and a wide variety of foods. They typically had four hot foots, which rotated. Examples include chicken strips, scrambled eggs, bacon, sausages. Cereals, fruits, fruit salad, plums in syrup, peaches, yoghurts, pancakes, pastries, cakes which rotated. Examples include sponge cake with chocolate filling, orange cake, blueberry cake, carrot cake (these also rotated). It is close to several key destinations, however Rome is quite vast, so it's impossible to be close to All of them. I would HIGHLY recommend this hotel. Apologies for the long food talk, I hadn't seen a detailed review of it when booking myself.

author: George Y
title: Lovely Lodging in the Heart of Rome
text:
Our stay at the San Raffaello was simply divine. The location (an easy walk from the Roma Termini) was exactly what we needed and was within walk or train rides to virtually all parts of the city. There are plenty of fun bistros in the area as well.

The highlight, by far, was the superior hospitality we received by both the front desk staff and the breakfast team. Speaking of breakfast ... don't skip the most important meal of the day. It'll be worth every Euro.

author: Molly L
title: Good hotel but the optional tip needs to go
text:
The hotel is very good.  I chose it based on the location and the price, and I was satisfied with the value.  The single room was small, but that's not unusual in Europe.  The room fit my needs perfectly.

At check-in the gentleman at the desk mentioned that when I check-out I will be able to include a percentage of the total to tip the staff and that it is optional.  T wasn't sure I understand correctly.  I have never heard of such a thing, and I've travelled quite a bit.  Even in the US where people expect a tip for pouring a cup of coffee, I have never been asked to add a tip for the staff when checking out of a hotel.   

I spent 3 nights there, and based on my stay I have no complaints.  When I checked out, the woman asked if I wanted to add an optional percentage to tip the staff.  I said no.  To be fair, she didn't blink.  She finished checking me out, gave me my receipt and asked whether I wanted to store my bag for a bit before heading to the airport.  I was not made to feel at all uncomfortable because I didn't add the tip.

However, I felt strange about it.  It bothers me enough that I am writing about it now.  The tipping "option" leaves an awkward final impression. It's really a horrible policy and without it, I would recommend the hotel wholeheartedly.  But as long as they continue with the police, I would only recommend the hotel if you are aware of it in advance and are ok with it.

author: Amelia D
title: Great place to stay
text: The reception staff were the most helpful & nothing was too much trouble. Rooms were well appointed. Breakfasts offered a great variety. Would definitely stay here again.

author: Kyle O
title: Overall excellent experience at the raffaello hotel
text: The service from start to finish was excellent. Staff very friendly and helpful. My experience at the hotel was good. I would highly recommend for anyone to stay there. The rooms were comfortable very clean and the bed very comfortable to sleep in overall i cant fault this hotel

author: Laura T
title: Wonderful hotel, central location
text: Wonderful service, clean and peaceful hotel. As a mid-priced hotel, the quality was surprisingly high. We enjoyed it. For family with teenagers, just perfect location and safe hotel to stay.  Good breakfast. Reastaurants close.

author: Nora Y
title: We will come back and recommend it
text:
It was our first time in Rome, and after doing research on where to stay for first timers, Monti is the place that kept coming up. Monti worked well for us as we arrived by train and Monti is close to Rome Termini. 

After narrowing down the area to stay at, it was time to find the hotel in Monti that fit our budget and also our expectations. We decided on Hotel Raffaello and we are glad we did so. We enjoyed our stay so much, that we will stay here again, and we have already recommended this hotel to friends and family. 2 of our friends, who are Roman, and live on the outskirts of Rome, visited us at the hotel, and they were surprised that we found such a gem, in such a great location. I figure that as Romans they know what they are talking about. 

We enjoyed, as a couple, a 4-night stay at the end of September.

The location of the hotel is central and close to local businesses and restaurants, and it is not far from the Colosseum (10 minute walk). Other points of interest are a little further (about 30+ minutes to the Pantheon, for example) but navigable on foot if you enjoy walking, as we do. Important to note that the hotel is only a 5 minute walk from the train station. The area is also safe and quiet. 

Wander the many narrow streets in the area and try some of the local eateries or shops. It's a little less busy than the bigger touristy areas. There are many nice restaurants/bars/coffee shops in the area. There is a small, well stocked, supermarket next door.

As a nice surprise, we were assigned a room that had 2 independent bedrooms in one, separated by a door: one bedroom with a king bed, and the other bedroom with 2 twin beds. Needless to say, we had all the space you can wish for. The room was well maintained, with a traditional decor. Most importantly, it was CLEAN. 

The beds were comfortable and the pillows were good, thick and plenty; hence we slept great.

The bathroom looked to be relatively newly refurbished. It was a little tight- to be expected considering the age of the city and building - but nothing that took away from the overall satisfaction. Yet, the bathroom had all the comforts you need. Perhaps a little more counter space would come handy, again understandable for the age of the building. 

Air conditioning worked well and was quiet, and we didn't hear much from any guests in the nearby rooms nor from the outside. Street noise, with the windows open, is not bad. The street where the hotel is located is fairly quiet. Some back alley chatter and traffic noise, but nothing to keep us up at night. You'd expect that in a busy city anyway.

The staff everywhere in the hotel were always friendly, genuine and helpful. We had the need to order taxis several times, and the staff at the front desk were always willing to order us a taxi every time. 

We had breakfast every morning and it had your usual continental offerings; staff were prompt in refilling needed items and checking in on guests. I understand why some reviewers find that the €14 charge for breakfast (at the time of posting this) is high for what they offered, yet we were happy with the whole breakfast experience. The best part for us were the 3 ladies tending the breakfast, they were the sweetest and most willing to help and please, always with a beautiful smile in their faces. 

There is also a small coffee station on the lower floor, with complimentary coffee and pastries, 24 hours. 

The rooftop bar was a fun place, where we had the best conversations with other guests. Consider the touch and go weather (rainy, windy), which makes it necessary to shut the bar, and to close the umbrellas. They have already lost too many umbrellas to wind damage. Anush, who tends the rooftop bar, was a highlight. 

I have read in several reviews that they find odd to be asked at check out if they want to leave a tip for the staff. I completely understand the reviewers surprise as they say that they might expect it in Canada/North America, but not in Europe, where tipping is less of an expectation. For us personally, we were willing to leave a tip for the staff as each one of them were so genuine and helpful, so we were glad we had a way to do so. 

PS/ We had the opportunity to talk to several of the staff members, and they all had one thing in common: they have all been with the company for many years. They all said that the owners go above and beyond to help the team members, in ways you don’t even expect. We were so warmed to hear this about a company that cares so much about their employees. And the owners caring for the workers shows in the workers happy demeanor, which translates in good service, hence in happy customers.

author: Harry N
title: excellent experience
text: 10 minutes walk from Termini station and the historic center, helpful and friendly staff, clean and quiet environment, ideal for a short stay in Rome

author: Evie M
title: Great hotel in a quiet area
text: The hotel was great. We were upgraded to a 3 person room (room #306) with a king and a single bed. It faced the street, but the neighbourhood was pretty quiet, just regular city noises. The only real downside to our room was the lack of counter space in the bathroom, but otherwise everything was great. It was a quick walk to the colosseum and the Maggiore Basilica. There are lots of restaurants nearby, but if you want something quick you are likely getting pizza. There is a small grocery store a couple doors down the street. The breakfast was good, but a little pricey (14 Euros/person) for what you get. We also tried the rooftop bar. It was a decent view, but the food was average (we had grilled veggies and the fried basket).

author: Chloe Z
title: Great location, Awesome Staff, Cool Decor
text:
Pros: Great location, very friendly service, clean room and shared spaces, really cool decor
Cons: The A/C never really made the room cold, the rooms are very compact, no free breakfast or welcome drinks for Marriott Titanium members

author: Grace R
title: Okay if the temperature is just right
text: Location is good. Lobby bar is 24/7. Room was clean and quiet. Unfortunately, the room is terribly stuffy. There is no airflow and no windows to crack open. I am aware AC isn't a thing in a lot of places in the area but even with the fan on "high" you literally cannot feel any air coming out of it and this was all compounded by ending up here during an unprecedented heatwave. Now obviously that is out of anyone's control but if you find yourself in this situation be prepared to figure out a fan at least because there is no circulation whatsoever.

author: Ruby F
title: Fabulous modern hotel
text:
Brilliant service by the hotel. The rooms are super cool with a nice iPad to help set the lights mood etc.
My only issue was the bedding. It was a little too rough for my liking and the lack of a kettle or any tea/coffee

Staff were friendly and approachable but both check in and check out was done by just yourself.

The hotel is ideally located near Southbank and only a short walk to borough market, bringing a lovely atmosphere.

author: Samuel O
title: I'm still angry about this hotel.
text:
This is not a 4 star hotel. No coffee or tea facilities, no kettle, no iron, no fresh water, no minibar, not even a glass to get a tap water. I was told to come downstairs to borrow glasses. In the morning, I couldn't even make a cup of tea and downstairs they wanted to charge me extra for it. This is completely unacceptable for a hotel clearly intended for business travelers. 
The room is tiny, poorly laid out. The bed is pushed against the wall, sink in the bedroom, no fresh air, no in-room temperature control. The bathroom is moulded plastic and feels like showering in a school dinner tray. Even the hair 'conditioner' was awful - I doubt it was even conditioner. The TV is controlled by an ipad, with no TV guide and limited channels. 
There's no proper reception - you're expected to self-check-in and out. The 'canteen' is as basic as you could imagine. Plastic everywhere, school-style trays. The room and lobby look nice, but don't be fooled. 
If this was 2-star, I'd give it a nice review because it looks nice, but I'd still take issue with the lack of iron, tea, coffee, kettle etc. It's genuinely the worst hotel I've experienced and I've stayed in some dives.

author: Isla O
title: Cetral and clean hotel
text:
Opposite the Tate modern, 5 Minutes Walk to the Southbank of Thames and Millennium Bridge. Only a short distance walk to London Bridge Station and Bus Stop direct opposite the hotel.
Modern, warm atmosphere with very small but clean and fuctional rooms. 24h reciption, self check in and out, bar an restaurant, but didn't use the service during this stay. 
Unahappy with the noicelevel with a room to Southwark Road after I had to change the room from the opposite and quiter side of the building. 
They have free highspeed wifi but it was often without  good service or completly interrupted. No big issue for me personally, but someone who need a fast and stable wifi connections could come in trouble.

author: Lily S
title: Very nice
text:
Really nice and friendly genuine staff (Charlotte,  Christopher and Jef - and a lovely man from Mexico behind the bar)
2 nights, on a wet weekend in London. Fabulous location for getting around. Nice room, very clean.
Only downside, window side of the bed doesn't have a shelf.

author: Isla O
title: Consistently good.
text:
Another nice stay at a CitizenM property.
Between locations in Rotterdam, Glasgow, Amsterdam and London, I must have spent 100+ nights in this chain over the last 10 years, it's always a consistent product.
Beds are always comfy, public lounges are spacious and attractive, staff are friendly and helpful (except the Shoredich location that has unfriendly staff and overcrowded lounges), breakfast and bar service is topnotch.
Highly recommended for budget friendly short stays !!

author: Olivia R
title: Never again
text:
The citizenM Bankside has a great location and certainly uses technology and design to mask a stay in extremely tiny rooms—really tiny—with barely any space to hang clothes or store luggage. The room I stayed in was basically a corridor where a double bed was wedged in on three sides, so if, unfortunately, two people are sharing the room, one has to climb over the other to get out of bed. The sink is in the room, not separated, but what’s truly terrible is the thin, semi-transparent cabin (even if frosted) that contains the toilet and shower. The door has a wide gap at the top and bottom, so despite the tiny extractor fan, smells, sounds, and steam all end up in the room. Oh, and for a semblance of privacy, they’ve added a very light curtain to separate the “shower+toilet capsule” from the sleeping area.

Another thing to note: at check-in, they inform you that if you want your room cleaned (which I’d consider standard unless stated otherwise), you have to request it via the app on the tablet in the room. But beware—you can’t request it the same morning; you have to do it the day before. Otherwise, like me, you’ll come back in the evening to an unmade bed. So as soon as you enter the room, make sure to set your preferences for the next day.

In summary, the price is far too high for the discomfort of the room and the services offered—especially if you're sharing the room. Otherwise, my advice is to choose a different hotel option.

author: Isabella K
title: Totally overpriced and gimmicky strange " tech"
text: Booked in by partners employer but would not choose this at this price. So called Tech hotel but really didn't like many of the features. Horrible little pod like room with no kettle, hit drink facilities in room ir even a glass. I pad to control everything but no streaming options on tv. Strange bed which is slotted in to one end of room meaning partner has to climb over to get into bed. No information anywhere even on so called hi tech ipad.

author: Poppy N
title: All fur coat and no knickers
text:
The lobby is beautiful and the room very high tech. But:
1) Hot and stuffy. The room was ‘cooling to 18c’ all night. I’m not sure it ever got near. I stayed in 2 rooms across 2 nights (one was paid by my employer and the other by me as a tag-on).
2) No tea or coffee. For > £200/night you expect to be able to have a brew in the morning. Room service not available at that time either.
3) The rooms are small, although this is expected. Any more than a couple of nights as a couple and you’d struggle.
4) No glasses in the room for water etc.

I genuinely think a Premier Inn is more comfortable, but a lot less stylish.

It’s a shame, expected more. Ok as a singleton for one night but will look elsewhere if staying as a couple again.

author: Lea Y
title: A Few Hiccups, However Staff and Location are Lovely
text:
I recently took a multi-country trip across Europe and am reviewing all accommodations from that trip in a standard manner. As an invisibly disabled woman who travelled solo, my review will consider those factors.
Staff/Booking/Communications
I booked directly through the hotel website for this stay, being familiar with this brand.  Generally, if you find a deal on Expedia for them, you’ll find an even better one on their website (although this may change with the Marriott acquisition).
Accessibility of Facility
I was able to walk right in and take an elevator to my floor. YMMV if a wheelchair used but invisibly disabled, I found the room reasonably easy to use.
Room
I opted for a room overlooking the courtyard, however always felt other people could look into my room which meant I kept the blinds shut quite often.  I enjoy natural light so this was disappointing. The iPad that controls the room kept not charging (broken wire) and the app was broken due to the Marriott merger so there were more hiccups than I expected from Citizen M.  The room also grew hot overnight and seemed unresponsive to the ipad temperature controls.  There were also two early morning fire alarms that woke me up.  The building has no all clear announcements and there was no clear way to reach front staff for advice as a disabled woman. It was quite distressing and both were false alarms triggered by guests.  I will say that hotel management addressed this quite appropriately and were frustrated by what was apparently a new fire alarm system themselves. I hope it’s sorted out in future! 
Bathroom/Toiletries
I love Citizen M toiletries especially the AM one and I’m fairly scent sensitive.  A great money saver to use theirs on an extended trip and hold my own for the next stop. The shower had decent water pressure and good room to navigate/bring out belongings.
Area Safety/Features/Location
The hotel offers a laundry service referral, however it has mixed reviews online. The 24-7 food in lobby is decent. There are also multiple food options in the area from affordable (Tesco meal deals) to treats (Ramsay). Area is extremely walkable to both Tube stations and sights including the Tate and St Paul’s. Area feels relatively safe (city girl taking usual precautions).
Overall
Well appointed and well located in London, great if you score a deal on it.

author: Olivia H
title: Budget under the gloss
text:
CitizenM Bankside is a well-decorated, stylish hotel with a trendy, modern vibe. The staff are reasonably welcoming on arrival, and at first glance the place feels promising. Unfortunately, the experience quickly dips beneath the surface gloss.

The rooms have no tea or coffee facilities — a surprising omission for a hotel at this price point. If you do fancy a hot drink, you’ll need to head downstairs and pay £3.40 or more for the privilege. There’s also no bottled water or even glasses provided in the rooms, so again you’re left to fetch them yourself from downstairs — something even a Premier Inn or Travelodge manages to offer as standard.

The mattress was adequate but nothing special; in fact, the budget chains probably edge it for comfort. The in-room technology, which is supposed to be a standout feature, didn’t live up to the hype either. The iPad control for lights, blinds and TV was unreliable — a gimmick that sounds impressive but doesn’t really work.

Staff were occasionally a bit distant, which perhaps hints that management don’t quite look after their team as well as they could. Breakfast was also fairly underwhelming, with limited choice and average quality — again, not what you’d expect for the price.

I did ask the feedback to be given back to the chap on reception and was told we get this feedback all the time but that’s the way it is,

Overall: CitizenM Bankside looks good, but style outweighs substance. It’s sleek but not especially comfortable, and the basics — tea, coffee, water, a solid night’s sleep — just aren’t done well. You’ll likely have a better night (and morning) at a decent budget hotel, even if it’s less photogenic.

author: Sophia S
title: Stay in CitizenM Bankside
text: It was my 3rd time in this hotel. Great location, small but comfortable rooms, lobby and bar area full of modern design, nice staff. I’m sure I’ll come back again.

author: Liam P
title: An absolute gem!
text: First time visit and enjoyed every minute. Great location, great decor with a funky vibe and loved the rooms - very comfortable and so cool with everything operated from the ipad. Great choices at breakfast, could not fault.

author: Paige Z
title: Top experience in citizenM London
text:
As citizenM promotes it, room is very modern and no flaws to be seen. 

Breakfast is recommended, also for people with food allergies.

Can only recommend it

author: George Y
title: Small but mighty!
text: Small room, perfect for one.  Great location in London but room was too noisy.  If Ipad goes out you can't use tv, etc.

author: Freya F
title: Loved our stay
text: Nice hotel in a great location! rooms are small but well designed and functional. We had a great stay

author: Maria C
title: Hotel or Hostel?
text: I would not recommend this hotel.  The location is great but the rooms are not well-maintained and the customer service is really lacking if not downright rude and dissmissive. They try to positon the fact that the room is controlled by i-pad as hip and tech-y, but in reality the heat does not work and the lights are broken. Very gimmick-y. This felt more likea hostel than hotel to me.

author: Oscar V
title: Overpriced horrible room layout
text: Bed huge but difficult getting in and out for over 60s as only one open side. Lighting controlled by ipad but linked to blinds. Problem finding a way to go to loo in night without putting all lights on and not raising blind. Toilet not very private.

author: Mia R
title: Not worth 4 stars
text: Poorly maintained rooms everything just too small or awkwardly decorated. It's not worth the 4 stars. I won't book another hotel like this. Business isn't and private isn't either.

author: Brooke Z
title: Dirty and noisy ….AVOID
text: Stayed above ground in a room with a ‘window’ which was half frosted and could only be opened a few cm’s. Tried to dry my hair and got told off because it set off the fire alarms and got offered to finish in the communal area (don't attempt to blow dry your hair guys). The rumbling from the underground is so constant! Luckily enough we were at a concert so we were not in the room long but as a light sleeper this kept you awake ! We had read reviews and decided to pick a higher floor to avoid it god were we wrong.  The sheets were stained and covered in what looked like wee and the whole room was covered in dust. Staff are unhelpful tried to book an additional night before travelling and was told i had to make another booking and the phone was put down on me. Location is good but i think we will go somewhere else next time

author: Charlotte J
title: Ideal quick stop over
text: Great convenient overnight. Basic facilities, small room - but perfect for a quick stop over. Some staff were super friendly, one a bit abrupt & rude. Clever concept for the type of traveller & accommodation it targets.

author: Chloe Z
title: Good Stay
text:
The hotel location is good as Edgware station is nearby and Paddington station is not too far off. There are lots of Middle eastern restaurants in the vicinity. 
The rooms are compact and if you have big luggages and carry-ons, a bit of a squeeze. 
The staff members are friendly, helpful and always with a smile. As there’s no kettle in the room, they are kind to fill up the water bottles at the reception. 
Overall a good hotel

author: Olivia Y
title: Ideal for getting to Wembley without being in the center
text:
Hotel is very well located if you want to attend a concert at Wembley as the gate is close with a train to Wembley.
Smiling and friendly staff. The room is sufficient in size. The bathroom is, however, a bit narrow,
You can sometimes hear the subway, but at night it does not run.
The hotel is ideal for spending a night or two.

author: Andrea X
title: Fabulous hotel and staff
text: Amazing hotel, my daughter booked it as I wanted to spend a big birthday in London. The staff were so helpful and nothing was too much trouble for them. The room was clean and comfortable. There was air-conditioning in the room. Breakfast was amazing it is continental, which is my preference, the selection was so good.  If you're looking for a good location, clean,comfortable and staff who go above and beyond hotel look no further

author: Andrea S
title: Good Location
text:
We arrived early in the morning so my preferred room was not ready. Instead we were offered another room but charged $27 (£)  for early arrival. Overall the room was small but adequate and clean. We did hear rumbling noises due to the underground trains running nearby but it was an issue. The breakfasts provided were really good. Location -  It's a short walk to Paddington Station.

My one complaint is the fact that this hotel charges for storing luggage which I find is nothing more than a money grab. If someone has already paid for the room surely the hotel can store luggage as a courtesy.

author: Nora D
title: Great exp
text: Very nice room and staff. I will be back

author: Charlie J
title: Lovely hotel in a great location!
text:
Wonderful hotel, very friendly staff - fantastic location. Short walk from Paddington underground.

Rooms were bright & cheerful and surprisingly enough, ours was street facing and it was much quieter than I expected.

For breakfast, there was plenty of choice, only problem was seating.

Fab choice for our trip.

author: Sara B
title: Basic but fantastic. Very happy with our stay
text:
Absolutely fantastic stay at this hotel. From the minute we walked through the door, all the staff were so welcoming, professional and helpful. They looked after our bags as we arrived before check-in time. Rooms were clean, spacious, had a  helpful number of plugs. Breakfast was delicious and the location is perfect. 

One downside is that noise is carried from areas in the hotel and outside, second is that there's no kettle in the room but would still definitely stay there again. Thank you for super stay.

author: Liam E
title: Medium
text: We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights. The room is correct, bedding rather good, you can choose the color of the LED strips (to my mind too gadget). I also enjoyed being able to choose the room upstream via the online check. However the big downside is breakfast, we expected scrambled eggs, pancakes, something very English. None of this, a few growing hard-boiled eggs, slices of ham and cheese that don't make you want to. Tasteless juice. Too bad it ruins everything.

author: Adam W
title: **Excellent Value for a One-Night Stay in a Great Location**
text:
Stayed here for one night last week and found it a very good option for a short London stay. The location is excellent, close to Paddington Station and Paddington Basin, so ideal for transport links and plenty nearby.

The room was very clean, the bed was very comfortable, and it was impressively quiet which made for a good night’s sleep. Staff were also very friendly and helpful throughout my stay.

The room itself was small, but perfectly functional for a one-night stay. There was no desk in the room, although there was a good shared space near reception where I was able to work comfortably that afternoon, which was helpful.

Breakfast was fairly limited, but absolutely adequate.

Overall, a cost-effective London option in a strong location. I’d happily stay again for a short trip.

author: Chloe O
title: Friendly
text: Very friendly welcome

author: Isla D
title: Updated hotel
text: This is very updated and clean hotel.  We chose the “cozy room” and it was quite small.  OK for two women but I would recommend a different category if you want more space.  It’s definitely geared to the digital age which was a little challenging for two older women, but the staff was very helpful.  We used Uber to get around the city and it was very convenient.

author: Brooke Z
title: Disappointing Stay With Serious Comfort Issues
text: We booked the room knowing it would be windowless, but the lack of proper ventilation was a major issue. The room was not clean and felt unhygienic. Breakfast options were extremely limited and did not meet expectations. The only positive aspect of the stay was the warm croissant served in the mornings. Overall, the experience was disappointing and did not offer good value for money.

author: Chloe J
title: Great staff!
text:
We had a three night stay while visiting London. Just a 10 minute walk from Paddington station and easy to get to the West End by bus or tube. The room was clean and comfortable despite bring quite small. Breakfast was limited and there were no tea making facilities in the room. 

However the staff were always extremely friendly and helpful, five stars for the staff! We were able to purchase tea and snacks from reception when we got back late at night, which they prepared for us exactly as we wanted it. We would stay here again if staying in the area, but we would also look for somewhere with tea making facilities in the room.

author: James C
title: Hotel a little gem..
text: Excellent Stay…wonderful staff went above and beyond. Lovely breakfast. Great location. Amazing value…a hidden gem in Paddington.

author: Nora Q
title: Good hotel!
text:
Great location, 5 minutes walk from Edgware rd stations. 15 minutes walk from Paddington along to almost the end of Praed st. 

The hotel looks to be a recent refurb, everything looks clean and inviting. Staff really lovely in check in and allowed an early check in at 12. 

Id requested a quiet room  and we were allocated 203. It was a little awkward to find as it’s kind of in an annexe, half way down between two floors. 
The room is quite small and leaves only room for 2 people to move around one another. Room, bathroom and bed very clean but mattress a bit lumpy. Pillows were lovely. 

Very little storage but we managed fine for 2 nights. I think longer stays with more luggage and you’d struggle with the room size. 

It was quiet, could hear a strange tapping / gurgling sound every now and again - think it’s linked to someone above flushing the loo. You can hear the tube rumbling below but it wasn’t too loud to affect our stay. 

Breakfast was lovely - continental style with ham, cheese, fruit, bread, pastries. 
No tea and coffee making facilities in the room but you can purchase from reception. 

All in all a good hotel in a decent location. Clean and convenient. I’d say 3 nights max stay though

author: Kyle M
title: Very nice hotel
text: The hotel is very good location and the rooms are very clean but the best part of our stay is the friendly staff.

author: Isabella P
title: Amazing Stay and Exceptional Service!
text:
I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. Everything was perfect from the moment I arrived. The staff truly made my experience special — friendly, professional, and always ready to help.

A special thank you to Andreea, Rem, Ali, tatiana, Shima, and Harsh for their outstanding service. They went above and beyond to make sure I felt comfortable and well taken care of throughout my stay. Their warm attitude and attention to detail made a big difference.

The atmosphere was relaxing, the rooms were clean and comfortable, and the overall experience was excellent. I would definitely choose this hotel again and highly recommend it to others.

author: Harper W
title: Never again
text: The worst hotel room ever, Small &  below ground, noise of tube railway beneath coming through.  could only get out one side of bed  no tea making facilities strange lighting system

author: William N
title: Incredible
text: The location was incredible! Everything is fairly close by or at least reachable through grand central which you can get to in 5 minutes. The only thing I was a bit confused about is that there is no toilet brush 😂 But other than that 10/10

author: Pablo K
title: Home in New York
text:
Pod 39 is my favorite place to stay in Midtown Manhattan and has become my go-to choice every time I’m in New York. This was my third stay, and probably one of the best.

The location, at 39th and Lexington, is perfect for everything I need. The hotel has a genuinely great atmosphere, excellent amenities, and, by Manhattan standards, remarkable value for money — easily the best quality-to-price ratios I’ve found in the city.

My rooms have always been impeccably clean and, surprisingly for such a central and consistently busy hotel, extremely quiet. I’ve never had issues with street noise or with sound from neighboring rooms, even when the hotel was fully booked.

The staff are exceptionally kind, relaxed and helpful, and the whole place manages to feel lively without ever becoming chaotic or impersonal. There’s a real sense that everything works exactly as it should.

After three stays, I no longer really look elsewhere. Pod 39 simply feels like my New York base.

author: Hannah V
title: Perfect for a weekend getaway
text: Comfortable stay, friendly and helpful staff. The room was small but it was exactly what I needed as a solo traveller. Grand central station was less than 10 minutes walk, and the location of the hotel is in the quieter part of the neighborhood.

author: George N
title: Love the pod !
text:
Pod Hotels are just incredible - staff are amazing and friendly, they provide great service and they answer any of your questions !
Location is perfect ! The vibes are great.

author: Anna K
title: Great experience
text: Excellent location!  Entire check in / check out process easy.  Room was small but perfect for our needs.  Without hesitation would recommend and plan to stay again.

author: Lauren Y
title: Nice!
text:
Very good welcome from all the staff.  
Thanks to Jeané for her attention and listening during our stay. 
Hotel very well located, clean and very pleasant.

author: George D
title: Amazing stay at the heart of nyc
text: Amazing place and staff. Everything is clean and price is ok for new york. Rooms are just what you need for a vibrant city where you ll be out most of the time. The rooftop is beautiful and the complimentary coffee in the morning is a nice touch. I would def come back.

author: Lea A
title: A gem with everything you need for the compact traveler
text: Came in from Newark and got the Express Bus for $ 27 to Grand Central then walked 5 mins to hotel. Would not recommend traveling with your bags on the subway, might save a few dollars but much nicer via bus. Excellent check in. Room is compact for sure but has lots of hot water and a view of the city. Clean and was serviced everyday. Quiet area with small convenience store on the corner. Utopia bagels is a couple of blocks south. Bed was very comfortable with excellent air conditioning. Free tea/coffee until 10am. Highly recommend and would stay here again.

author: Matthew H
title: Clean rooms, great location.
text:
Second stay at the POD39, basically still very satisfied. Great location, clean rooms, and friendly and helpful staff.
What was not nice this year, while accompanied by my 11-year-old son, we unfortunately did not have access to the rooftop bar…
Because of the small rooms, it was a pleasant way to end the day there, especially in the evenings.
But overall a great location for a budget overnight stay.

author: Joseph R
title: Definitely recommend
text: A very nice hotel in an excellent location for a reasonable price. The rooms are small but well designed and well kept. The service is great. I'd strongly recommend it for people who want to explore Manhattan but not necessarily spend a lot of time in the room - the Grand Central is a five minute walk from the hotel and there are plenty of good restaurants in the neighbourhood.

author: Molly S
title: Incredible and friendly!!
text: We enjoyed our stay at the pod hotel so very much. Check in was super simple and we were even upgraded to a bigger room without asking! The room was very clean and well designed. All staff was extremely friendly and helpful with cleanings, storing our luggage for us after we checked out and directing us around the hotel. This place was incredible not to mention the incredible price and the fact that checkout was 1pm. Can’t beat that!

author: Sofia K
title: my birthday trip:)
text: The hotel is very cozy and feels private. Ten minutes away from the Empire State Building and about the same time away from Times Square! Loved my vacation, the rooms are nice and very modern. Service is fast, cleaning is great. Highly recommend! Went for my bday w my bsf.

author: Harper T
title: Excellent stay
text: Excellent lodging option, the hotel is clean, has an excellent restaurant and terrace, the staff was always attentive and friendly, it has an excellent location, affordable price, I would definitely return on my next vacation

author: Hannah P
title: Thoughts on a pod
text: Very nice and convenient place to stay. Room is small but very clean and functional.

author: Lucas Q
title: Exceeded Expectations
text: Great service and very accommodating.  Great front desk person.

author: Nora I
title: Perfect staying!
text: An excellent experience, small room but with every comfort, very kind and helpful.

author: Julien V
title: Would hook again
text: The location was great and close to grand central station which made it easy to use the train system. I had trouble checking in but that was my fault, the customer service was nice and friendly and ready to help if they could. the rooms were clean and cosy.

author: Megan C
title: The real Manhattan stay
text: For a short experience in New York east side it was adorable the rooftop was impressive has the overall view of the real Manhattan.    Our room was what we sign up for and we couldn’t complain because that shower blazed was totally relaxing.   But, I needed a computer access but there was none so hope fully that adds to an addition including having the rooftop open late for guest and having vending machines to buy a coffee or warm cocoa.   Thanks will book again 🥰

author: Brooke R
title: Fantastic stay with world-class hospitality.
text: My stay was absolutely perfect, and the staff went above and beyond to be attentive

author: Evie K
title: Nothing could have been better
text:
Could not have had a better experience 
Staff went over and above.  Everything was spotless

author: Lauren R
title: Lovely, friendly and clean hotel
text:
It was a wonderful stay. The staff were all extremely helpful and friendly, especially Raphael. The room we were in was small, but so cleverly designed that we really didn't feel cramped at all. The en suite was really lovely. Very clean throughout the entire hotel.

The breakfast is continental and is open from 6.30 to 11am, so plenty of time to have a leisurely meal. The food was very fresh, and regularly replenished. Hot and cold drinks readily available within the breakfast time slot.

The only down fall is that the corridors were dimly lit which wasn't great for my mother to navigate with poor eyesight.

It is perfectly positioned, close to King's Cross and St Pancras Station, with a lovely Greene King pub opposite!

Highly recommend this hotel.

author: Giulia F
title: Would definitely stay again
text: Great location--walking distance to Kings Cross even with luggage. Small rooms (typical in London) but SUPER CLEAN. Not super luxury but had everything I needed. Front desk staff was so friendly--welcomed me every time I walked into the hotel. I really liked the area--ate at multiple restaurants in the area (breakfast and dinner) and they were all great. Always felt safe even late at night by myself.

author: Grace Q
title: Brilliant stay
text: Stayed for 1 night for a concert at Wembley. Convenient location for King’s Cross, very friendly and accommodating staff. Karolina especially made my stay very comfortable and was very welcoming.

author: Sofia W
title: Best for Budget Near King’s Cross
text: I’ve stayed here multiple times and enjoy this establishment. It’s five minutes from King’s Cross and the pub next door is awesome for food. Room is always clean and comfy and staff are super friendly and helpful. Highly recommend.

author: Mathis G
title: Excellent
text:
Room 504 cozy, fragrant, very small bathroom but clean, perfect shower.
Room with a window, not so obvious in England, so I recommend paying attention when booking.
Air conditioning and chromotherapy in the room.
Comfortable bed, I would suggest the possibility of a sheet, because even though it was hot, there was a duvet inside the duvet cover.
Two elevators
Water fountain available for guests.

author: Ruby W
title: Great location and working A/C
text: Great location to the train station within walking distance with luggage and places to eat.   When considering this hotel keep this in mind they have very good A/C, the time we were there last month we came back to a nice cold room, it was one of the hottest week London had. The rooms are small but we made it work.  During our visit, we met other people whose hotel A/C didn’t work. When making room reservation option for the breakfast as it’s worth the cost.

author: Luca F
title: Super base for a short London break
text:
A super convenient location when arriving in London by train. We have stayed there several times - it is worth paying a little more to get a bigger room.  The rooms are very clean. The breakfasts are excellent & the staff are very welcoming & helpful.
2 small gripes - rooms are serviced every 4th day - we only stayed 3 & therefore bins etc were not emptied
We also paid £6 for our small cases to be stored for 4 hours - this is new, no charge in our previous 6 visits - in my experience even grumpy Parisian receptionists store cases for free!

author: Carlos J
title: Good location (near Kings Cross station), but charges for bag storage
text:
Booked two rooms at this hotel after returning from Edinburgh into Kings Cross station.

The hotel is about a 7 minute walk from the station in a very lively area.

The rooms are very small. The door in my room could not open fully (stopped by the bed), although there is space under the bed where you can store your suitcases to give a little extra space).

Air conditioning was good (many London hotels don't have it) and breakfast buffet had a good variety....with a seemingly endless supply of frog croissants and bread rolls.

One annoying feature: Unlike most hotels which offer free luggage storage as a guest service, this hotel charges 3 pounds per bag. When we had four bags to store for a few hours after check out, we incurred a 12 pound charge.

author: Oscar L
title: Convenient Location - Great for a Short Stay
text: Point A Hotel at King's Cross is conveniently located close to the Kings Cross train station – perfect for easy arrivals and departures! The hotel was clean and tidy, ideal for a quick overnight stay. However, be aware that the rooms are quite small; it’s best suited for travelers needing a convenient base rather than a comfortable long-term stay.

author: Amelia H
title: Bed bugs. Very small room.
text: Bed bug found crawling on bed and woke up with bed bug bites. Room was very, very small. Location was good with proximity to King’s Cross. Breakfast options were good.

author: Harry G
title: Compact and good value
text: We had a small windowless room on the third floor which was spotless! The breakfast is fantastic but there are no kettles in the rooms which is sad 😞 the rooms are very small but the location is ideal.

author: Benjamin X
title: Great London Base
text: Great base for exploring London! Convenient location, clean room and great air conditioning (especially since we visited during a heatwave) The staff are very friendly. The rooms are very basic but perfectly formed and a great budget option

author: Hannah Y
title: Convenient location
text: Very reasonably priced hotel room if you want to get around the King's Cross area. Comfortable bed, quiet rooms, and enough space to open a bag of luggage (but not loads of space). There's a lot of activity in the area downstairs, which is good or bad depending on your preferences.

author: Louis Z
title: What a find.Great Value
text: What a find. Very.welcoming and helpfull reception staff which is the best start in my book. The reception and bar areas are well appointed. The room was spotless and a very comfy bed. We will use again

author: Mathis R
title: I mean...
text:
The hotel's main plus points are its proximity to King's Cross and St Pancras International stations (both a few minutes' walk away) and breakfast, which, while not offering classic British alternatives, offers sufficient variety and quality. For the rest: microscopic room, cleaning from the third night (unless expressly requested), in my opinion unsuitable for family stays or otherwise beyond two nights. 
Staff at reception are courteous, if you want to store your luggage after check-out a fee of £3 per suitcase is required...

author: Diego K
title: Hotel well located
text:
Great location 5min walk from the train station and very clean 
Windowless room that does not interfere 
Big negative the incessant noise at night (shower noise and slamming doors)

author: Mia G
title: I recommend ++++
text: Great hotel. Well placed , clean room, good bedding, great breakfast, friendly staff. Frankly I recommend +++

author: Camille Q
title: AVERAGE
text:
Such a clean hotel and very close to King’s Cross which is perfect. 
BUT - breakfast was very very average 
The rooms are SOOOO small. No wardrobes just ju

author: Daisy F
title: Great hotel with everything you need
text: I chose this hotel due to its close proximity to St Pancras International for an early Eurostar trip(an 8 minute walk). Check in was quick and staff were excellent. The room was spotless and had a comfortable bed and large TV. The bathroom was also spotless and enough space for myself. There are many restaurants,fast food outlets and bars close by too. I will definitely return to this hotel and highly recommend it for travellers using Eurostar at an ungodly hour like I did today.

author: Maria A
title: Excellent solo stay
text:
Currently staying here ( room 707) and I have no idea why there are some poor reviews. Staff have been brilliant - accommodating my request for a higher quiet room as I am solo travelling. Room is spacious with great air con and good storage and location is perfect! Pick a window room!! 

Room is quiet and spacious .

author: Ana N
title: Great city break.
text: City break with granddaughter. They organised all our trips and guides and a surprise in her room for arrival. Very comfy beds and nice rooms. Would very happily recommend. Thank you for a brilliant four days.

author: Matthew Y
title: comfortable stay in a great location
text: The Independent Hotel in Rome offers clean, comfortable rooms, friendly staff, and a convenient location near Termini Station. The rooftop breakfast was varied and enjoyable, making this a great choice for exploring Rome.

author: Emma A
title: Great Stay
text: We had a great experience at the hotel. The hotel was clean, close to the train station and the staff was very helpful with directions while we were there. We will return.

author: James R
title: Wonder Hotel
text: We went to Italy as a birthday celebration and decided to stay at the Independent Hotel. The staff were always friendly and happy to help. The room was clean and tidy. The view from the restaurant/bar on the top floor was  was simply stunning, particularly at night. The breakfast had a good variety to chose from, and the drinks were amazing! We were particularly fond of the cocktails. It's in the perfect location to catch transportation. The reception will happily call you a taxi if you need one too. Everything was a short distance away. The atmosphere was very pleasant. It was cosy and charming. The air conditioning was a life saver after being out in the July Italian heat!

author: Freya F
title: Great location and lovely hotel.
text:
Stayed for 3 nights as a family with two teens. Lovely hotel, very clean and all staff very welcoming. The room was a great set up for us all. Perfect location to explore Rome as the termini main station is a couple of mins walk away.  Highly recommend. 
Only suggestion to the hotel is to get some citronella repellents for the roof terrace- the wasps swarmed at breakfast. We will recommend this hotel to others and will hopefully return again.

author: Jack S
title: Visit Rome
text: Everything perfect, to be tried again

author: Katie H
title: Unsafe for Female Travelers
text:
Formal Complaint

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this hotel.

We booked three consecutive nights in the same room category. However, during our stay, we were asked to change rooms three separate times. This caused significant inconvenience, as we had to repeatedly pack our luggage, move all of our belongings, and reorganize ourselves throughout our stay.

The most serious incident occurred before the scheduled check-out time and before the agreed room-change time. A male staff member knocked on our door only twice and then immediately opened it without waiting for our permission. Even though we responded from inside the room, he continued opening the door and entered.

There were three women staying in the room. At that moment, one of us was lying on the bed and was not fully dressed. This was a serious violation of our privacy and made us feel extremely uncomfortable.

Afterward, we went to the front desk to report the incident. Instead of receiving an apology, the reception staff simply stated that they trusted their employee’s version of events. The employee himself claimed that he did not see anyone who was undressed. However, that is not the main issue.

The real questions are:

* Why did a staff member enter our room before the scheduled check-out and room-change time?
* Why did he continue opening the door even after we had responded from inside the room?
* Why was a male staff member sent to enter a room occupied by three women?
* Why were we not contacted by phone or notified in advance?
* Why, after we clearly expressed our discomfort, did we not receive even a simple apology?

We believe that the hotel demonstrated a complete lack of respect for the privacy and safety of its guests. As three women traveling together, we felt deeply uncomfortable and inadequately protected.

Of all the hotels we stayed at during our trip to Italy, this was by far the worst experience in terms of both service and respect for guests. We expect hotel management to take this complaint seriously and implement concrete measures to ensure that similar incidents do not happen again.

We will not recommend this hotel to other travelers.

author: Manon A
title: A smart hotel that provides a great base to explore Rome
text: A smart hotel within easy walking distance of Termini - central and well-connected but quiet at night. The rooms were spacious and attractively decorated with effective air conditioning. The rooftop bar has both internal (air conditioned) and external space and provides a lovely location for breakfast and early evening drinks with views across the city. All the staff were friendly and helpful. A great base to explore Rome.

author: Samuel V
title: Great rooftop bar
text: We didn't stay at this hotel but just popped in for a drink at the rooftop bar. The views are great and the bar is nicely decorated with a chilled atmosphere. There's a good range of drinks. The prices are a little higher than expected but that's due to the rooftop location. Good attentive service.

author: Jessica R
title: Great hotel
text: This hotel is just steps away from Termini. It is beautiful, clean, and the staff is very friendly. The rooftop has breakfast in the morning and drinks in the evening. We left wishing we could this hotel with us for every stay in our trip!

author: Oscar D
title: Excellent stay
text: Great location, staff, and rooms.  Excellent value

author: Juan G
title: Think Twice before Booking
text: Stayed for 3 nights before cruise. We were upgraded to the top floor below the rooftop restaurant and there’s only one suite in the entire floor (the other 2 units are long term rentals). It’s a spacious 3 room suite. It was overall comfortable but rather dated  . The biggest disappointment is on our second  day  the one and only elevator was under maintenance and we had to walk down the stairs when my wife has problem with her knee. The next day the elevator was still under maintenance and we had to hire a porter to carry our heavy bags down the long stairs which almost crushed the fellow. Again my wife suffered pain having to walk down the stairs. This hotel having only one elevator is its Archille’s heel as I understand it breaks down frequently. The hotel also has no lobby, not much of a resting and reception space to speak of. It is too much money for what it offers.

author: Amelia Y
title: A gem in Rome
text:
This is the most amazing hotel. Great location, fabulously clean rooms, super friendly staff on reception and Michelley at breakfast was just wonderful. 
The hotel has a fantastic  roof top bar with amazing views across Rome. Cocktails execellent. 
Breakfast is also served at roof top bar and has a great selection of food and lovely coffee. 
The complimentary mini bar was a really great touch for our particular booking. 
We loved every minute of our stay and will absolutely be back. Thank you to all the staff, everyone so kind and helpful.

author: Maria P
title: Nice hotel with great air conditioning
text: The hotel was clean and very close to the train station.  The air conditioner worked extremely well.  Beware that the elevator is incredibly tiny.  You aren't fitting a lot of luggage and people in there at one time.  The only issue we had was that upon check in we asked if they had a water fountain and the gentleman at the front desk told us the mini bar was free and we could take the water out of there.  When we went to check out, they tried to charge us for the water we used from the mini bar.  I don't know why they told us it was free, but do not drink anything from there unless you want to pay for it.

author: Sean R
title: Excellent experience
text:
We spent 3 nights at this hotel, everything was perfect, the welcome, the room, excellent air conditioning, the morning breakfast included with a huge selection of very high quality.  The service there was very good too, the view from the terrace while having breakfast was breathtaking.
The hotel is a 5-minute walk from the Roma Termini station where there are trains, subways, and several shops.  We walked from the hotel to the Vatican and the Roman ruins, about a 25-minute walk, which allowed us to really see and experience the city.  Very close to the hotel there are at least 50 restaurants, maybe even too many, it's hard to choose.
As for the room, very clean, very comfortable bed, and especially the shower, wow, I love a big shower head from the ceiling with a huge amount of water pressure, like a waterfall, on our next visit to Rome, we are going back.  As for the elevator, it worked very well with little wait, the concierge from Kenya was super nice to all the guests.

author: Henry G
title: Lovely clean hotel!
text: Nice and clean hotel; walking distance to Termini. Friendly welcome and friendly staff. Breakfast on the rooftop which is delicious. Attractions about 25 minutes walk. Top hotel!

author: Chloe V
title: Great Location for the Train Station
text:
Perfect location for us as we were taking the train to the FCO airport in the morning. Wish we were able to enjoy the rooftop restaurant in the morning, but had to leave too early to do so.  

Room was spotless and the bed very comfortable except for the pillows being a little to hard for our comfort. There may have been other pillows available, but we did not check.

Porter was a bit overzealous which I'm sure will annoy some, especially other Americans. Take my advice and always have a few Euro coins in your pocket for such eventualities and just let go with it.

author: Jack D
title: Great Hotel, great Location,
text:
We arrived at the hotel for our 4 night stay just after lunchtime staff were very helpful while we got booked in as our rooms were ready for us. 
Our rooms were on the 4th and 5th floors, rooms were a good size and had everything we needed, the housekeeping staff kept the rooms spotless everyday, so a big thank you to them.
We had breakfast in the rooftop dining bar area every morning the views were out of this world, great choice to pick from and a good start to the day,the staff were super friendly and very helpful, at nigh-time we had drinks and the atmosphere was so relaxed and again the views were great. Thank you too all the staff.
The hotel was in a fantastic location very close to main train station and also buses and metro. We managed to walk to colosseum, Trevi fountain and Spanish steps.
We would definitely recommend this hotel we all had a great time and many happy memories.

author: Katie O
title: Great hotel and staff!
text: Lemin the bell boy in the hotel is absolutely brilliant! Couldn't do enough for us during our stay, went above and beyond and is so friendly and polite. The hotel and other staff are great too, comfortable accommodation, lovely roof terrace for evening meal (although not loads of choice) and a delicious buffet breakfast.

author: Evie C
title: Nice hotel, but the staff are not very warm and friendly, and also the lift seems to be broken a lot
text:
The hotel is very clean and modern, with a beautiful rooftop bar overlooking parts of the city, which is also where the breakfast was served. It was close to the Termini train station, which is why we chose it as we needed to catch an early train on our last day.
The staff were not especially friendly, there was no warmth from the reception staff, when compared to other hotels we visited during our travels, which was a shame, however the man who helped us with our bags who was always very happy. 
The lift was a nightmare, we were on the 6th floor and when we arrived it was broken, meaning a walk up multiple flights of stairs for my 70 year old mother who has health problems, so this was not ideal at all for her, she really struggled to do this.
Overall it was a nice hotel, in a good location, but the lift and not particularly friendly reception staff let it down.

author: Abigail Q
title: Class & elegance in the City
text: We had a lovely experience at the new Derby - everything was fresh and appointed beautifully in our room. We didn't get time but the high tea experience also looked amazing. Nice location close to Monument Tube station and Liverpool St if you are flying into Stansted. Thanks again to Soumya for the delightful sweets waiting for us when we got to our room.

author: Zoe G
title: Wonderful experience
text: A lovely time with our daughter Darcy-Really helpful staff particularly Setenay and Alby on the front desk this morning. Our room had a bath with amazing views over the river and was well appointed . Lovely cocktails last night and a fantastic breakfast this morning . Thank you for a great stay in the city

author: Rosie U
title: Absolutely Excellent
text:
I stayed at The Derby for a week while traveling for business and honestly, best service I’ve had at a hotel. I tend to get a little anxiety when I travel but Sam at the front desk was absolutely wonderful and so so helpful. He made sure I had everything I needed in my room, including wall adapters. And when I checked out, he made sure I had the right transport to the airport, and switched out my room cards so that I’d have prettier ones as a souvenir. It’s that kind of individual care that I value. 

Overall, my room was very clean and comfortable. The cafe had really good food and great service. 

Finally, the location of the hotel itself was super convenient. It’s right down the road from the Tower of London, Tower Bridge, The Shard, the Monument to the Great Fire, and so many really fun restaurants and bars.

author: William K
title: Refreshing stay  stay - Great value for money
text: Was an awesome stay. The staff are really accommodating and polite. Wonderful accommodation; slept well. Breakfast spread was decent. Beautiful colour scheme - Green and gold. Very centrally located to London’s attractions and near a train station.

author: Katie D
title: Charming Stay at The Derby
text:
My wife and I stayed at The Derby for our first international vacation for a week stay. It was also the weekend of a friend's wedding, which was down the street from the hotel.

Even before the stay, we were welcomed by the head concierge, Adelino, with an email detailing itinerary options for tours, restaurants, pubs, and more, that helped to shape our stay.

Upon arrival, we were greeted by Setenay, who was extremely helpful and polite for our entire stay. The room was clean and elegant, with views of the City of London area from both our bedroom and bathroom. During our stay, we had one small issue, and the staff handled it with class and professionalism. 

Overall, the stay felt like a home away from home. It is a charming hotel with an outstanding staff. We would highly recommend The Derby to anyone visiting the area.

author: Daisy U
title: Amazing!
text: Very accomodating to our special (birthday) needs. Staff at breakfast were amazingly friendly, as well as reception personnel. Thank you for a great weekend!

author: Kyle M
title: Great Stay!
text: The Derby is a wonderful hotel! All of the staff were friendly and helpful especially Nathan & Sam. Location is great situated right between Monument Station and Tower Hill Station. Note that Tower Hill has an elevator while Monument does not. Stayed in a queen room with a fold out bed with 2 friends and room was a good fit for the 3 of us. Had a lovely view of the skyline and the church next door. Nespresso machine with bottles of real milk restocked daily in the fridge for our use. This hotel was just opened this year so everything is clean and bright. Loved the bathroom with its large shower. Would definitely stay here again!

author: Marta B
title: Comfortable, clean and friendly
text: Lovely hotel. Front of house Nathan was great, greeted with a lovely smile and very accommodating.

author: Dylan A
title: Memorable stay
text:
The hotel was really lovely and had a fresh, clean smell throughout. The staff were very helpful, especially Anmol, who made the stay even more enjoyable with excellent service.

The only downside was that the TV in the room was positioned a bit oddly, making it less comfortable to watch. Other than that, everything was great. I really loved the hotel and would happily stay here again!

author: Marta A
title: Great Stay
text: Space was very clean and the amenities were plentiful and readily available. Receptionists Oksana and Jaya were very helpful with accommodating me.

author: George K
title: Very pleasant stay
text: We had an amazing experience while our 2 day stay in this brand new hotel-  we got a complimentary upgrade for our room, late check out and other small extras. The stuff is very friendly and helpful, breakfast is delicious too. The gym is brand new - spacious with good modern equipment. I highly recommend!

author: Daisy D
title: Brand new and very central hotel, a stone's throw from the Tower of London.
text:
The hotel opened in April 2026, so 4 months ago, and you can still smell the newness in the various areas and rooms. 
Very fast check-in thanks to the three very nice receptionists and an upgrade to a room with a panoramic view thanks to the Hilton Diamond card. 
The room assigned to me, although well-furnished, was quite small, but it had a huge bathroom with a bathtub in front of the window and a view of the Shard.
Good level breakfast, but the bar and restaurant are closed on Saturdays and Sundays. 
I was hoping to be able to taste one of their cocktails that are offered to guests at 5:10 PM every day (a benefit widely advertised on their website, but they are careful not to say that it is not offered on Saturdays and Sundays).
Prices starting from 150 pounds on the weekend, which however sometimes triples on weekdays.

author: Andrea B
title: The Derby
text: Everything was perfect , thanks to all staff and special thanks to Setenay at the reception for her warm welcome ,  professional approach and care … Thanks

author: Taylor G
title: Anna is the queen!
text: We had such a wonderful stay at The Derby Hotel! From start to finish, the experience was warm, welcoming, and incredibly comfortable. Anna at the front desk was absolutely wonderful—so kind, helpful, and genuinely lovely. She made our stay feel extra special. We would stay here again in a heartbeat and can’t wait to return!

author: Oliver Z
title: Great Stay
text: We had a fantastic visit. Our room was clean, comfortable and had great views of London. Our check in and checkout agents were of great help.

author: Marta H
title: Wonderful Experience of the New Hotel
text: Near 2 underground stations, very convenient. Elegant vibe and style of the hotel. Room was clean and quiet. The price was reasonable. Thanks to Anna and Jaya, who were really welcoming and considerate.

author: Oliver Z
title: Check in
text: Jonas was very friendly and helpful.

author: Sofia L
title: Lovely Assistance and Stay ❤️
text: Very nice hotel. The rooms are small, but they are very clean and well maintained. The staff is extremely helpful and welcoming. Anmol, who was very nice, friendly, and always ready to assist. ❤️

author: William S
title: So cool
text:
We had an excellent stay at the Hilton! As soon as we arrived, Nathan, at the front desk, welcomed us with a big smile. He was very warm, kind, and truly welcoming, which immediately put us at ease.

The hotel was very pleasant and everything went perfectly well. At the time of departure, Yonas came to help us with our suitcases, and he was just as friendly and pleasant.

A big thank you to the whole team for this welcome and this attentive service. A very beautiful experience, with a truly kind and attentive staff! We will return with pleasure.

author: Harry K
title: Brilliant hotel - exceeded all expectations
text: Nathan and the whole team were wonderful - super service, lovely new hotel - comfy beds, silent rooms. Loved it.

author: Ryan F
title: Premier Experience At The Premier Inn!
text: Third time staying at Premier Inn Blackfriars and it didn’t disappoint.  The hotel is in a great location, it’s in good condition in terms of both the public areas and the rooms, breakfast buffet is good and the staff are all super friendly and helpful. The one thing that let it down was the cleaning.  My wife is focussed on cleanliness, especially the bathroom and seeing a toilet bowl that didn’t appear to have been cleaned properly for quite some time was a real turn off.  However, overall a great experience once again and well will be back.
