author: Evie D
title: Great hotel for cyclists in center of London
text: We came for a one night stay without reservation, after cycling a whole day.  We received a warm welcome and the manager told us that if we made the booking on line, we could benefit from a cheaper rate (instead of having the hotel complete the booking).  So that was really appreciated, it saved us money for a lots of beers!  We could store our bicycles at our room or at the luggage room.  Service was excellent, room was clean, shower refreshing, bed was nice so had a good sleep and breakfast was great. We were ready for another day of cycling!

author: Andrea A
title: Lovely stay
text:
Good morning,

This was our second time staying at this hotel, and just like the first time, it was great. Everyone was very welcoming and friendly, and always happy to help.

I was celebrating my 40th birthday with my girlfriends, and we were offered complimentary breakfast, which was a lovely touch.

We will definitely be coming back again!

author: Tyler P
title: Our favourite premier inn
text: We had a really enjoyable stay at the Premier Inn. The room was clean and comfortable, with a lovely comfy bed and a really good shower. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the food was also very nice. Overall, a great stay and we would happily return.

author: Zachary K
title: Perfect stay near Fleet Street
text: I received the warmest of welcomes at Reception, and when I explained that I had a change of circumstances, he and a lady who joined him were most helpful, and I felt they genuinely cared. The room was spotlessly clean, very quiet and very comfortable. The hotel is located just off Fleet Street, close to bus stops and Blackfriars Underground. I was very lucky with a scratchcard I was given, as it was for 50% off main courses at dinner, so I made use of it. I had chicken makhani curry, with rice, poppadom and mango chutney, and it was delicious. There was a small technical issue which meant there was a lull during dinner when there was noone available to order dessert, but sometimes these things happen - it wasn't a huge problem for me. Full breakfast was included in my deal, and there was a choice of full English, cereals, croissants, yoghurts, fruit, various hot and cold drinks/juices... It was all fresh and delicious. I would definitely stay in this hotel again.

author: Samuel H
title: Amazing
text: Everyone was very welcoming, a big thank you to the staff on shift Wednesday afternoon. We really enjoyed our stay.

author: Erin U
title: Great hotel and really worth the money
text: Very good hotel. Central but on a calm street. Polite and helpful staff. Very easy and practical to live there. I was on a solo trip and it was a very good place to stay. Close to tube station. Lovely breakfast. Cozy rooms. Everything great and will come back!

author: Aiden G
title: Great customer service
text:
The staff couldn’t do enough to help us, very welcoming and kind in all aspects of our visit. Large family room, clean and tidy. All you need to rest your head for a brief nights stay. 
Great breakfast, great service, thank you.

author: George R
title: Fantastic
text: An absolutely amazing weekend . Yusaf was the most hospital man I have met and a credit to the company . His customers service is phenomenal. So this was a great start . The rooms were clean the location amazing and the breakfast fabulous value . All in all we will definitely  return here . Six stars from us

author: Mathis K
title: A grotty soulless hotel
text: A tired looking hotel inside and out. The carpets are a mess and everything is basic. There is a massive amount of building work going on making the place difficult to find even using Google. It would have helped if premier inn would have at least put some signage guiding customers to the hotel entrance. We ended up at what I think is the staff entrance. The rooms are small and their isn't any draws or cupboards. The views are just tall buildings. All in all a grotty soulless hotel.

author: Camille V
title: Brilliant for families
text:
What a fantastic find in London!

Breakfast at the purple palace is usually fairly standard but this was absolutely spot on, really well maintained space.

Also- so quiet and cool. Room 3 (downstairs) if you’re looking to request a room with excellent air con and room for a family v quiet.

Very well located to the tube and walking distance to Holborn.

Definitely our new find in London!

author: Erin L
title: Weekend for a 60th
text: Excellent location very friendly staff who worked extremely hard to ensure everyone was catered for … well done to the entire team. … our friends 60th Birthday weekend was excellent!!!

author: Morgan P
title: Brilliant
text: Best Premier Inn we have stayed in. Food was lovely and also hot, staff were very helpful. Room was lovely a spacious. Service was excellent

author: Oliver M
title: Great location
text: Great location..close enough for everything and close transport to get everywhere amenities within walking distance..

author: Claire P
title: A great stay
text:
An enjoyable, comfortable overnight stay. We both had a good night’s sleep.
The Manager and Staff were great. They were welcoming, hardworking and helpful. They went above and beyond. Full credit to all of them.Other Premier Inns will have to go far to beat the Blackfriars Premier Inns. Highly recommended.

author: Erin C
title: 4 days in london for the family
text:
Just returned from a 4 Day stay 2/6. family of 6 in 3 rooms.
This was are 4th stay at this Hotel, and it still maintains a  Great team of people. From the young man who looked after are room, up to front of house. bar staff, restaurant, cleaners.everybody  makes you feel so welcome, nothing is a problem.They have introuduce  a happy hour /kids eat free, .We all had another great time.

author: Isabella R
title: Handy location but poor wifi and plumbing
text:
Handy location for both busses, the tube and walking. Being off the main street noise was not a problem. Room was comfortable but watch out for poorly maintained plumbing and very slow wifi. Wifi forces you to accept marketting spam, so shouldn't be called free in my opinion - and then was too slow to use.
Reported a plumbing/safety issue to front desk but it went unaddressed the entire stay -> I will avoid this location in future.

author: Alice M
title: A good stay
text:
Stayed for 4 nights, overall really pleased.

Decent value for London as I booked a year ahead.  Clean room and really close to a good underground station on the district line.  Also had a Tesco across the road which we used daily 

We got access to our room at 9am for an extra £15 which seemed good value and they kept our bags after checkout 

In terms of negatives AC was hit and miss, room cleaning isn't automatic and they didn't have a proper shower.

author: Thomas T
title: Premier Inn with a good location, at a decent price
text:
Great location, direct train from Kings Cross on Thameslink. The hotel is a couple of minutes from Blackfriars station, and the Thames at Blackfriars on a quiet street. Nice walks along the embankment to the west end.
Within half hour walk of the Theatre District, Covent Garden etc. and 10 minutes to St Paul's in the other direction. 
Great staff, good breakfast, good size family room. Only one negative - the bathroom could do with a re-fresh. But for the cost it's good value.

author: Michael K
text:
I've stayed in quite a few Premier Inn hotels over the years, and this has by far been my favourite stay. I enjoyed my experience so much that I'm already planning to return next year.
The location is perfect—within walking distance of St Paul's Cathedral, with excellent transport links and plenty of brilliant restaurants nearby.
I also really appreciated the toy section in Reception. My son made great use of it, and it was a lovely touch that helped keep him entertained.
The staff were consistently polite, friendly and approachable throughout our two-night stay. I also used the self check-in system for the first time, and it was quick, straightforward and completely hassle-free.  
The only downside to my stay was the smell in the hallways. I couldn't help but notice a persistent damp, musty odour throughout the corridors. I appreciate that wet shoes and luggage from the rain are probably inevitable and may contribute to this, but it was quite noticeable during my stay.
Overall, this was an excellent stay, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this Premier Inn to anyone visiting London.

author: Mathis R
title: Broken mirror not by us!
text: We stayed in this rundown hotel, as it calls itself. The room was small and the air conditioning was noisy. But what really upset us was that they kept our $100 deposit, blaming us for breaking the mirror, which was absolutely not our fault. The staff was not at all courteous; no matter what we asked, they didn't respond politely. The breakfast wasn't plentiful; the tables were few and dirty, and often occupied. The morning we left, we asked if they could pack us a bag of breakfast, since we have a young child, but they refused. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone, even though the location is good.

author: Connor K
title: Strategic hotel
text: Quiet hotel conveniently located close to walk to Time Square and surrounded by quiet places to eat, basic clean hotel, clean rooms, normal breakfast nothing exaggerated but normal nutritious and good , friendly and courteous staff

author: Evie U
title: You Get What You Pay For
text: The hotel is priced below most hotels in NYC.  There are reasons for this.  It’s about 3/4 mile to the theater district; the rooms are very small and it’s definitely “no frills”.  That being said, if you’re just sleeping there and don’t mind the walk (or taxi ride) to get to where you’re going it’s an OK choice. The staff was friendly and helpful; the breakfast was just what you would expect from Comfort Inn, and we felt safe, even walking back from the theater at night.

author: Lily N
title: Unacceptable Experience at Comfort Inn Midtown
text:
I rarely write reviews, but my recent stay at your Midtown location compels me to be brutally honest: this was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

The Wi-Fi was a complete nightmare—slower than DSL, intermittent, and completely unreliable. Two public networks were available, neither functional: one (“Comfort_Inn”) promised connectivity but failed to reliably log in, and the other (“Wireless”) barely registered at all. For a hotel in the heart of New York City, this is absurd and unacceptable.

The staff’s behavior, however, was the most egregious part of my stay. I was subjected to a litany of unprofessional, petty, and legally questionable behavior, including:

Unjustified demands to enter my room: Staff repeatedly tried to gain access without valid reason and refused to provide details in writing, turning a simple stay into a stressful ordeal.

Harassment over my service dog: Staff insisted on seeing physical certification or a vest, despite ADA laws clearly stating this is not required. They attempted to intimidate me, citing a “no pets” policy that has no legal standing for service animals.

Dismissiveness and outright rudeness: Every attempt to address the situation calmly was met with condescension, ignorance, and petty power plays. Staff seemed more interested in asserting authority than actually serving guests.

General incompetence: Between the Wi-Fi issues and the staff’s unprofessionalism, it felt like the hotel actively worked against providing a basic level of service.

This experience was not only frustrating but also made me feel unsafe and disrespected. A hotel’s responsibility is to provide a secure, welcoming environment for paying guests—not to create unnecessary drama, violate guest rights, or showcase ignorance of fundamental accessibility laws.

I strongly urge management to seriously address these failures. Training, accountability, and a thorough review of policies regarding guest rights, accessibility, and professional conduct are essential. Guests should never leave a hotel feeling belittled, harassed, or disregarded, as I did during my stay.

author: Pierre N
title: This hotel was disgusting! Booking photos were lies!
text: This hotel was disgusting, unclean and dilapidated. I was moved once and neither room matched the booking photos. My first room had no working lights and a dead phone. I had to call the front desk from my cell and ask to be moved. The second room had visibly dirty carpet and sticky bathroom floors. The booking photos showed a stall shower and these rooms had tubs. Stall showers are important for a mobility impaired person like me and the tub wasn't even clean. When I moved,  I left a bag in the first room. Your front desk staffer wouldn't go with me to look for it so I had to wait for the shift change to get one of your employees to care. I have never seen such terrible service and unfit facilities. Your company should be ashamed of itself. This dump shouldn't share a brand name and no customer should be treated like I was. This was FRAUD!

author: Caleb F
title: Better than expected!
text: The maps lead you to believe this location is out of the way, but that is not the case!  While it's not immediately next to the public subway, we easily walked to Times Sq and Broadway theaters with plenty of awesome drink/restaurant options along the way.  These hotel rooms were substantially larger than expected for NYC rooms--included breakfast & Keurig coffee makers in the room were a nice plus.   Electricity/USB ports by both sides of the (Queen) bed always makes us happy.  Check-in/out was painless and the front door has easy access for Uber/Lyft and easy walk ramps for big bags and those with limited mobility.   Overall cleanliness was excellent.  This hotel is definitely a good find that exceeded expectations and we will book again!

author: Amelia X
title: Convenient hotel to stay when cruising out of New York.
text: Great convenient stay when cruising out of Manhattan cruise terminal. The staff is very friendly. They keep the outside in lobby area very clean. There is a breakfast buffet in the morning get there early sometimes it gets a little crowded.

author: Ana H
title: Just for one night if you don't find anything else
text: Just for one night. Not more. Rooms are very small and not very clean.  Breakfast is very poor, they just serve machine drinks, no croissants, no cakes, two types of small jams. only bread, eggs and sausages, no cheese or cured meat...and if you have any allergies you don't eat at all. And they also forget to give you towels when the room is cleaned.  I won't choose that hotel again.

author: Owen L
title: Basic and well located, but with some limitations
text:
I stayed at the Comfort Inn Manhattan - Midtown West from June 23 to 28, 2025. The hotel is located between 11th Avenue and 48th Street, in a rather quiet and suburban area by Manhattan standards (about 250 meters from the piers), but still convenient: Times Square can be reached on foot in about 10 minutes, and the M50 bus stop is a stone’s throw away (49th/50th Street).

--- Room ---
I booked a standard room with two double beds, but unfortunately I found it very small. As soon as we entered we found ourselves practically on the first bed, with very little space to store our bags. The layout was somewhat sacrificed, with about 70 cm of space at the foot of the bed and only a narrow passage to the bathroom.
Cleanliness in the norm and beds still comfortable.
A negative point was the air conditioning, a fan coil placed on the wall opposite the door, practically in contact with the second bed. The adjustment was very limited: it was not possible to change the fan speed, but only the desired temperature. This made the use particularly uncomfortable: the airflow was too strong and the noise generated excessive, so much so that the use of the air conditioning during the night was prevented without compromising sleep.

--- Service ---
The staff were always friendly and helpful, except on one occasion during breakfast: I reported some bad milk that had thickened once heated, but initially I was not taken seriously. Only after a second attempt (with practical demonstration) was this understood. An unpleasant episode that did not compromise the whole experience.

--- Breakfast ---
Breakfast is buffet style, but a bit basic. Present: white and whole wheat bread, jams, orange juice, waffle maker, American coffee, hot water to prepare tea, eggs, sausages (sometimes small hamburgers). I would have liked to find some other desserts or some cold cuts, an extra choice for those who do not like the classic American breakfast.

--- Conclusions ---
Overall, a basic but functional structure, suitable for those looking for a foothold to visit Manhattan without much pretension. The price was in line with that of the city, and the location all in all convenient for getting around. I would recommend it to travelers with limited needs, who adapt to some compromise in exchange for a discreet location and manageable price.

author: James J
title: Recommended
text: Would stay there again, only flaw the location away from the metro which is a bit far. Walking to Times Square takes 15 minutes. Breakfast does not offer many alternatives to the classic New York breakfast (eg croissants)

author: James X
title: Close to cruise terminal
text:
What a find in mid-town Manhattan in Hell’s Kitchen area, close to cruise terminal! 
Smallest room ever but clean, comfortable bed. 
We appreciated the early check-in as lobby area is very small.
Breakfast was nice but very limited seating. 
Close enough to walk to cruise terminal.

author: Sophia V
title: Good accommodation for visiting New York, great value for money for tourists

author: George M
title: Only postive was a clean room
text:
Only positive was a clean room
Aircon not working as intended and you cant open windows to to compensate
Wifi works 50% of the time
Bed was not good
................................................................................

author: Maria M
title: This is Scammer Inn, go elsewhere.
text: Very small and smelly rooms. Breakfast corner is a MESS, you can't even get anything before they run out of food and it takes 15 minutes to replenish. Staff if mostly rude except for Mr. Morales, and cleaning staff does not care about the 'Do not disturb' signs. Cherry on top : The safety deposit you made? Well it's gone. They tell you it's been processed, they involve sales and say they wanna help but in the end, the money is never returned. STAY. AWAY. FROM. THIS. PLACE.

author: Freya Q
title: Beware!!!
text: We were booked at this hotel through a 3rd party booking agent during a mandatory evacuation for Hurricane Milton. $1,700 for a 3 night stay. We live in Florida and would never evacuate to Manhattan. There was a language barrier during the booking and the agent booked us at the wrong hotel. We were supposed to be booked in Florida. We immediately tried cancelling after receiving the confirmation email but it was too late due to the no refund policy on the rate that the agent selected. We tried calling the hotel multiple times to explain but the front desk agent would NOT let us speak with the manager. They were never available. We tried explaining to the front desk but they said they could not do anything due to non-refundable policy. They took our name and number multiple times but the Manager never responded. We tried to dispute with the credit card to no avail because the Hotel manager said it was non-refundable. We are out $1,700 due to a language barrier with our reservation during a state of emergency. We really wish this could have been settled without posting our negative review but we're never able to speak with a Manager.

author: Lucas K
title: Unjustifed charge after checking out.
text: We stayed at this hotel for one night from September 14 to 15. A day after checking out we received a charge on our CC for $100 for a broken toilet seat. We contacted the hotel for more information, but were never able to have management respond to us. The fact is, that there was no broken toilet seat when we checked out of the room. Unfortunately, it is never possible to have someone from the front desk come to your room at checkout, which means that you are at the mercy of the hotel with such charges. Our CC company was not able to help resolve it.

author: William R
title: Card charges
text:
Good location and decent hotel. However be aware that they will place large pending charges on your card that will remain on your account fir a long time after you check out. A bit dodgy to be honest.

Very difficult to contact the hotel as there is no email.

author: Megan C
title: Noisy very little privacy
text:
Room was 10 feet from front desk and breakfast area, basically in the lobby.  No effort was made by staff to keep noise out conversations low, could hear conversations people eating and laughing, and doors banging.

Location was good.  Changed hotels

author: Leo V
title: Many unresolved problems!
text: The hotel has many problems already subject to negative reviews. Among many, an inadequate and embarrassing breakfast for a Big Apple hotel in 2024. The wifi works every other day and this is an unacceptable defect. In the room they should leave the complete set of towels. They don't and we had to protest. The kindness of the staff is out of the question but the problems remain unresolved. Management should handle the situation as a matter of urgency.

author: Caleb K
title: HOVEL STAY CLEAR RUDE STAFF DIRTY HOTEL
text:
From arriving at the hotel the receptionist was rude and arrogant it was 2,30 all the cleaners were sat in the reception eating their lunch  and being loud and racous we were told rooms weren't ready we had been travelling over 36 hours and were exhausted, when they had all finished eating she called us over and said rooms were ready ????
She wanted a credit card and wanted 100 dollars for damages b4 we were given the room. We were 2 single ladies and she put us in a room with 1 double bed when I asked for 2 single beds she refused this booking was made over 10 month ago,  It was shabby and dirty and was more like a hostel rude staff dirty hotel and and rude arrogant reception staff. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY HORRENDOUS  HOVEL.

author: Zachary K
title: Honeymoon
text: We always choose ibis for the breakfast!! And the rest is awesome, too!! Lovely honeymoon here, thanks a lot, Gaurav!

author: Brooke W
title: Nice stay in London
text: Rooms are nice. Our bathroom Is small but functional

author: Harry C
title: ibis london blackfriars breakfast
text: lovely atmosphere and great food! arya helped us out and was very kind :)

author: Rosie P
title: Decent value
text:
Great location, room was clean if a little basic and small but had everything we needed. Decent AC which we made good use of. 
Breakfast was also pretty good.
I'd definitely recommend this hotel if you want a cheap room in London.

The most annoying thing about this hotel was the bedroom lights are either all on or completely off, which makes the bedside lamps completely useless.

author: Jack Z
title: Excellent location for visiting London
text:
Very nice hotel and, above all, in an excellent location for visiting London. We stayed for 5 days and had a very good time: for those who use the hotel mainly as a base to tour the city, it is more than fine.

The rooms are a bit small, but functional nonetheless. The bathroom has a somewhat unusual layout and might not be to everyone's liking, but overall we had no problems.

Breakfast is good, with a more than sufficient selection to start the day.

Overall we were satisfied, especially with the location and the convenience for getting around. Good hotel for a stay of a few days in London.

author: Harper D
title: Professional and polite
text: Sardar was very professional and polite and served me very well.

author: Diego A
title: Excellent service
text: Excellent service - thank you Sardar!

author: Nora A
title: Thank you Aliza for the service
text: Very well welcomed and served by Aliza, a very kind waitress.

author: Holly W
title: Abi Rahm A Great Guy
text: Abi Rahm is a very friendly fellow. He is always helpful and a pleasure to be acquainted with.

author: Diego G
title: Very good budget friendly hotel.
text:
Good location close to metro .
Quiet and clean room.
Friendly staff, friendly staff.

author: Henry D
title: Very friendly staff
text:
Amazing stay because of the super friendly staff of the hotel. They always made sure you feel welcome and helped with everything. Especially Malavika, who was super friendly everytime we had breakfast and refilled out waterbottle a dozen times. She even gave us extra ice when it was 30 degrees outside. 

The room was totally fine for a city trip, not super big but the bed was comfy and everything was clean.

author: Mia H
title: Great experience
text: We received a very warm welcome, especially from Graurav, who was attentive and took the time to explain all the details about breakfast. The breakfast itself was excellent!

author: Noah F
title: Charlie’s corner
text: It’s now my seventh time at ibis London Blackfriars. I always get a great service from Aliza. She’s very friendly and always asks if everything is okay or if I need anything.

author: Ella R
title: Excellent
text:
Ideal location: 30 minutes by bus from St. Pancras (line 63), next to the Tate Modern, close to the Thames. 
The Circle Line passes 5 minutes' walk from the hotel. 
The hotel is quiet with a practical and clean room. 
The breakfast is very hearty and served during wide hours. It can easily allow you to skip lunch 😉
But above all, all the employees were smiling, kind, and efficient.

author: Hugo F
title: Nice staff credits goes to Abhiram..
text: Nice location  near to transport ,good rooms

author: Paolo E
title: Good location for train network.
text: Hotel is ideally located for Southwark tube station and connecting lines to London. The hotel entrance was nice and welcoming, bar area very dark though. Stayed on 12th floor but opposite lift which made room noisy. Despite having the quiet notice on our door we were woken early by the housekeepers noisily hoovering and banging the skirting boards next door. The room was comfortable though, have stayed at Ibis before so the pod bathroom wasn’t a surprise although the extractor didn’t work so got warm in there.  Tea and coffee making facilities, hair dryer and iron and board in room. Have another concert stay booked for September so would request away from the lifts.

author: Freya P
title: Fabulous Service
text: Fantastic service from Gaurav & his team at breakfast, fabulous choices & excellent staff service

author: Taylor W
title: Great
text: Everything was perfect, thanks to Gaurav

author: Tyler Q
title: Amazing
text: Shout out to Abhi Ram, he was super helpful

author: Ella Y
title: Holiday
text: A clean and beautiful hotel. Very central location. The staff are friendly and helpful. Thanks to Gaurav for their support.

author: Lily H
title: Lovely and comfortable stay
text: Grove Guest House feels like a real find. Wonderful breakfast, I slept like a log and Hazel is a warm and welcoming host. This is a real family home full of art and photos and history.  I hope to come back and stay again.

author: Brooke P
title: The best guest house that always welcomes you gently
text:
I have been with Globe Guest House for the past eight years whenever I have been to London.
Owner Hazel is also an artist who creates wonderful works while also working diligently in the community.
They are very kind and you can spend a relaxing time as if you were home in London.
Is it okay to serve such a luxurious breakfast in overpriced London? So much so that I am worried.
Forest Gate Station on the nearest Elizabeth line also has a co-op by the station, and some shops allow you to take out biryani and other items until midnight, so you can source food even after an opera performance.
I would love to keep it as my secret hideaway, but I hope many people will know how wonderful it is.

author: Harper G
title: Hazel's house 😄
text: I've stayed with Hazel many times for a number of years. She runs a lovely guest home. Quirky but that's what makes it special as opposed to a generic branded hotel room...which btw you would pay more for. Easy access to Zone 1 along the lizzy line. Rooms are clean and its very quiet at night save for the trains nearby...which is basically London lol. Free WiFi, friendly atmosphere and a warm welcome.

author: Mia W
title: Great place
text:
An exceptional stay from start to finish. Guest House exceeded expectations in every aspect — excellent service, welcoming and attentive staff, beautifully maintained facilities, and a comfortable, well-appointed room. The attention to detail and commitment to guest experience were truly impressive.

The location was ideal, making it easy to explore the surrounding area, while still offering a relaxing and peaceful atmosphere. The hospitality of the team made the stay especially memorable, and every interaction felt professional and genuinely warm.

I would highly recommend Guest House to anyone looking for comfort, quality, and outstanding customer service. I look forward to returning in the future.

author: Daniel K
title: Home from Home
text: Hazel's guest house is truly a home from home. I am always welcomed with Hazel's typical warm and friendly hospitality, which makes every stay comfortable and relaxing. The rooms are clean and very cosy and nothing is too much trouble.

author: Paige C
title: Home from home
text: A comfortable stay in a B&b that reminded me of home. The host Hazel was friendly and welcoming.

author: Molly I
title: Amazing
text: Only a few minutes walk away from tube station with the Elizabeth line. Very friendly host and guests. Interesting things to look at in every room and they're very functional too. Great value for money and nice fresh sheets. Hazel is wonderful and definitely worth the visit. 😁

author: Camille Y
title: Disappointed
text: The guest house was below expectations and could use a lot of improvement. The room did not feel very clean, and some facilities were not properly maintained. Service was slow, and communication from the staff was limited during the stay.

author: Holly E
title: Great Place to Stay for a Short, Busy Trip to London
text: This was my first trip to the UK and London, and I'm so glad that I stayed at the Grove Guest House. The house is very close to the Forest Gate train station and the accommodation was comfortable. Hazel was friendly, helpful, and a highlight of my trip. I loved the feeling of community both in the house and in the Forest Gate area.

author: Ella U
title: Home away from home
text: If I could give six stars I would! Hazel has the wonderful gift of being able to make you feel like you are at home even when you are halfway across the world. Both the handles on my suitcase had snapped during my travels, and when she saw me carrying it up the stairs in my arms she took the time to help me create a makeshift handle out of materials she had around the house. She also went out of her way to accommodate a last minute change of schedule for my departure which was a lifesaver. If I ever return to London I know where I will be staying!

author: Paige C
title: Comfortable and home-like
text: A very comfortable stay with a friendly host. The house and the rooms feel like you’re staying at home, full of quirky character and warmth.

author: James I
title: My Home Base in London
text: I travel to London every week for business, and I was getting tired of staying in those awful Central London hotels and being hit with ridiculous prices. By great luck, I found this place — and Hazel. The place is warm, cozy, and feels just like home. Hazel is always charming and welcomes you with open arms. She’s very attentive to her guests’ needs and preferences. I absolutely love this place — Hazel feels like family to me now

author: Mia W
title: Excellent and positive vibes
text: Great location with easy access to the station. Very close to Stratford and offers excellent hospitality. The atmosphere feels like home, and the rooms are spacious and comfortable. Great value for money with clean, quiet accommodations. Absolutely love this place!

author: Holly K
title: Great place, great people
text: Grove Guesthouse is a great place to stay when in London. I always use GGH as it is so welcoming, friendly and accommodating. It is perfect for my needs with the rooms comfortable and clean along with a superb breakfast that is enhanced by interesting and engaging conversation.

author: Samuel A
title: Another great stay at Grove!
text:
Once again, the Grove Guest House was the ideal place for me to stay during a trip to the capital. The facility to negotiate arrival times is always helpful, and as always, the room is clean, comfortable and homely. Breakfast is always enjoyed - a nice English breakfast to start the day - and the morning conversation with whoever is staying is friendly and fun. I'm always happy to be able to walk there in just 5 minutes from Forest Gate station, and be in the west end in less than half an hour via the Elizabeth Line. I always come with an itinerary of things to see and do, but Hazel still suggests interesting local things to see! 
Almost reluctant to write such a glowing review - if the place gets too popular, I might find it's booked up next time I need it! Seriously though, Grove is the ideal accommodation for me whenever I'm in London.

author: Andrea P
title: Really lovely and relaxing stay
text: Hazel couldn't be a more perfect and welcoming host, and she was really accommodating of my check in time and made me feel so comfortable as soon as I walked in to the place. The house has a lot of character in the best way, and the stay rate was really reasonable and affordable. I will definitely stay here again soon.

author: Jack K
title: Highly recommend!!
text:
I had an amazing stay here at the start of July! Hazel was incredibly friendly and welcoming and her house is absolutely full of personality. I stayed for 6 nights and felt at home the whole time, plus Hazel’s breakfasts were delicious!

Staying alone as a young female, I was a bit nervous, but Hazel gave me plenty of tips for navigating London and staying safe. The Guest House is also only a five minute walk from Forest Gate Station, which was super convenient as I was commuting into Central London each morning.

Definitely stay here if you get the chance!

author: Samuel A
title: Another great stay at Grove Guest House!
text: Another stay at Grove Guest House and another comfortable and enjoyable experience. I was able to drop my case at a convenient time,  which is helpful after a long train trip from Devon. The room I had this time was smaller than previously, but it was clean, tidy and  very comfortable. The welcome is always friendly and the breakfast is just ideal to set me up for a good day around London.

author: Daisy J
title: Overnight Stop
text:
Another super all too short visit to Grove Guest House.  Ideal for Elizabeth Line into Central London. 
Hazel is an awesome host providing super comfy beds and great food.  Friendly fellow travellers (and the host) to chat with over the dining table.  Always sad to leave 😭

author: Sophia M
title: A unique gem
text: Hazel is a gem . London can be quite cold and lonely not with this hotel ! I don’t like chains I want to see and live where I am . Grove guest house is that . Neighbour is quiet or in a heavy sleeper either or . Room is clean and big with a lovely little garden to relax in . The gem of this is the owner who I adore ! I couldn’t stay for breakfast but I will be back

author: Morgan E
title: Too hot
text: Too hot, too hot, too hot. Gets way too hot, only 19C outside but outside it is boiling.

author: Gavin N
title: Great location!
text: We stayed here for two nights and although the room was hot we had a great stay! The room was clean, the bed was comfy and it was a good location. Breakfast was tasty especially the hash browns and eggs!  A great location if you’re off to Wembley to watch a concert.

author: Ian J
title: Great service
text: Great service Michelle was a welcoming face in the mornings and couldnt do enough to help 5* would  recommened.

author: Sydney N
title: Michelle
text: Michelle was a great hotel manager was a great server with a smile couldednt do enoth to help

author: Emma V
title: Perfect
text: Amazing service lovely breakfast and really friendly staff

author: Katie S
title: Nice hotel in Bethnal Green
text:
I really enjoyed staying at Travellodge. 
The room was clean and service was good. 
Nice and charming part of London. Nice pubs and near London underground, central line. Also near Victoria park and All Point East festival
 Not to busy

author: Zoe E
title: Don’t EVER stay
text:
If I could give 0 stars, I would. We booked this Travelodge after experiencing issues with our previous hotel, and initially everything seemed perfectly fine.

Unfortunately, the following morning I noticed insects crawling in the bed and discovered what appeared to be a significant bed bug infestation. My sister experienced the same issue with her bed. When we went downstairs to report it, two other guests were also complaining about the exact same problem.

This was extremely upsetting and completely unacceptable from a hygiene and cleanliness perspective. Based on our experience, I would strongly advise others to avoid staying at this Travelodge.

author: Zachary V
title: Heat heat heat
text: Outside temoerature 21 to 24. Inside hotel in the hallways around 45, in the room around 30-35. Windows cannot be open fully, so only 1 table fan is cooling the room, but not succesfully. My chocolate melted in the room within 20min. Dont go in summer months, my recomendation.

author: Charlotte E
title: FIND ANOTHER HOTEL
text: I don't recommend it. The room was like an oven. We went to reception and spoke to a blonde woman who told us that's just how it was, that there were no more fans. We had to open the window to sleep, but we had to close it because every night people gathered below the window singing and shouting, as well as smoking marijuana, and the smell of it wafted into the room. We can't forget the noise of the trains passing every two minutes all night long. IT'S IMPOSSIBLE TO REST. The bathroom is like a toy; the shower barely works, and what little water comes out creates a puddle on the floor. They only give you one towel, and you have to make do with that for the duration of your stay. The worst part is that check-in isn't until 3:00 PM sharp. Don't even think about asking five minutes before, because they'll just tell you to wait. FIND ANOTHER HOTEL.

author: Erin G
title: Cafe bar thank you
text: Michelle is  amazing very good at the job  5 stars joe

author: Pierre E
title: Welcome
text:
A lovely welcome from Michelle & Ilham .
We were early for our check in so spent a relaxing hour in the cafe / restaurant.

author: Louis V
title: Warm and friendly staff
text: I frequently use this hotel as it is very affordable and close to tube and only 2 stops from City of London (financial centre). I found the staff particularly warm and friendly, particularly Donette and Sherrie who always give a warm welcome and always sort any issues straight away.

author: Paige Y
title: Horrendous night
text: Had an absolutely awful stay yesterday! Partner and I booked a room for the night - we checked in around 10pm and was told at the desk there’s no AC in our room (which sparked immediate panic) but there’s a fan…the whole building was stifling! The walk through the hallway was unbearable, you could hardly breathe. We opened the door to our room and the same exact heat hit us. The window was cracked, the small plastic fan was blowing around hot air, it was horrid :( felt like we were suffocating. We were so confused as it was such a lovely cool night, so not sure why the building was so hot. We tossed and turned in our sleep (hardly slept) woke up with stuffy, dry, blocked noses. Additionally, the sink was blocked so when we brushed our teeth it was quite unpleasant…There was a shower curtain that served no purpose so the floor was soaked. The outside of the building is covered in graffiti and stinks of urine. What makes this worse is we have a group of around 16 people booked to stay there in a few weeks for our wedding, and I fear without AC we’re going to struggle, and it’s going to ruin our weekend :( who wants to be sweating profusely while getting ready for their wedding? :( Very sad and stressed.

author: Lauren G
title: Three night stay
text: Excellent room and good location for east London and local tubes.  Can’t fault the hotel except for the very annoying policy of Travelodge charging £3.50 a day for wifi which is offered free in almost every other hotel, coffee shop, restaurant and bar on the planet.

author: Evie H
title: Staff are nice and helpful
text: Staff were all nice and helpful, Karen and Sarah and also the chef. Breakfast has lots of choices. The rooms and the restaurant were clean. If the hotel can manage the rooms from one booking to be close to each other would be even better (at least on the same floor)

author: Taylor C
title: Birthday surprise
text:
Hotel was well organised and relatively clean . 
Breakfast was plentiful with  good choices . 
All  in all a pleasant stay..
Karen was our restaurant attendant and was very helpful and informative about the local area..

author: Zachary X
title: Excellent positive helpful staff
text: Rooms were clean and comfortable, Staff were so helpful and friendly. We were a big group and Sherrie & Donnette were excellent, going out of their way to help us check in quickly and make sure we had everthing we needed- lovely stay- thanks everyone!

author: Luca E
title: Don't stay in summer, especially if booking a family room
text: If you are staying in the summer with children I would advise you to book alternative accommodation. Family rooms all on floor 6. They are uncomfortably hot, to the point no one got much sleep. Hotel had no ice for drinks. Rooms are clean. But I would not stay again.  Can't comment on the lower floors.

author: Oliver Q
title: My regular solution for stays in London.
text:
I've often been staying at this hotel :
(1) Convenient location, near a Central Line station. Shops, including a supermarket, are very close, as well as a few places one can eat out at. (2) The staff is highly professional, dedicated, kind, and (if needed, as was my case during the covid pandemic) helpful -esp. reception & breakfast (3) the rooms are very clean, well looked after, and have all the essentials. If you are lucky to get one overlooking the Green, it makes a nice way of starting the day. (4) the price is reasonable.

author: Thomas Y
title: Good reception service!
text: The team are reception, Donnette and Sherie was very caring and understanding, good personalities and overall good service, all I would say is wow level 6 is so so hot, maybe more windows etc?

author: Evie T
title: Perfect location prescruise terrible room and service
text:
Location and the pancakes were the only positives. $400 a night was high even for NYC especially for what service we received. Worst part is location did not resolve issues on the 1st 2nd and 3rd attempts never responded to our survey does not return emails nor FB messenger about our various issues. Here are some of the issues. Sent Items
Follow up urgently requested Stay at Holiday Inn Express Manhattan Midtown West
  Fully understand it was a crazy week with FIFA and the Knicks parade so I took it upon myself to bus the breakfast disposable plates cups and utensils multiple times to free up space for other guests and ask for as little as possible while staying there. 

Our bathroom was updated although it was a large learning curve to use the shower ...  the rest of the room was furnished from the 70s

Here is the email my Sister sent the owner/manager. They never responded to me her nor Holiday Inn Express Corporate.

Good evening R****
I completed a survey and asked that you call me. I did provide some specific information in my survey but not every item was addressed because of character limits. I called today and you were not available, so I am emailing you information about my stay on June 17, 2026.
I had 2 rooms. The confirmation #'s were: ******* and  *****
1. I waited in line for 42 minutes to check in. This was unacceptable. There was no customer service skills. There was not a Hello, welcome, sorry for the wait-nothing!
2. I had requested 2 rooms next to or near each other since we were with my 89 yo mother who requires assistance. We did not even get rooms on the same floor.
3. I went to the room that I was given the keys for. I opened the first room only to find it occupied. THIS IS NOT ACCEPTABLE.
4. I went back to the front desk and had to wait in line again. 
5. I spoke to the male check-in person and told him someone was occupying the room he assigned me. He looked at the other front desk person. Neither of them apologized for this terrible error. It took them another 12 minutes for them to figure out a room that I could have.
6. When we finally got to our room the AC was very cold. There was not a way to regulate the temperature or the fan.
7. We called the front desk and asked that a blanket be delivered. It took 4 hours and 4 requests to finally get a blanket.
8. My mom wanted to sit outside on the bench in front of the hotel, since the room was too cold. 3 different rats were walking by the bench and on the wall. They were close to going into the hotel door. I have lived in a city so I understand there are rats but there should not be so many in the only spot to sit outside.
9. I wanted to take a shower. I could not figure out how to use the shower. There were not any directions in our bathroom. I called the front desk several times so they could tell me how to use the shower. No one answered.  One of the calls I was on hold for 45 minutes. I finally got changed back into clothes and went down to the front desk. I asked if they had been busy or was the phone not working. They said that they never heard the phone ring. I told them I had been calling and had been on hold the previous 45 minutes. They did show me how to use the shower.
10. We wanted to relax and watch TV. The TV said-NO Signal. Then one channel would come in and out intermittently. I called the front desk to see if there was something I could do to make the TV work. They said they could send someone to fix it. We declined since we were already in our PJ's. 
11. Generally, we had to call the front desk several times before anyone would answer the phone.
12. Garbage and dirty linen carts were put into the elevators with guests.
13. Generally, the Holiday Inn staff needed a major improvement in their customer service skills this includes supervisors. When a staff person walks into an elevator with you, they should at least say "Hello", "Good evening", "Good morning". This did not happen There were not any smiles or nods. There were housekeepers, maintenance workers, housekeeping supervisor who came into elevators who did not say "good morning" after we said it to them.
14. Breakfast area had signs with misspelling. This makes the hotel look unprofessional. The breakfast staff were not readily available. It took 3 requests to get the coffee machine filled and working. There was no apology, no comment of we are working on it etc.
Unfortunately, this was probably one of the worst hotel experiences I have had.
I expect that I will be compensated for this poor service/poor experience. I am requesting 50% of each room rate returned to me by August 31. I believe this is a fair request. 
Please feel free to email me and/or call me.
Thank you for your time and consideration,
RZH

author: Sophia B
title: STAR – BE VERY CAREFUL WITH YOUR CREDIT CARD
text:
⭐️ 1 STAR – BE VERY CAREFUL WITH YOUR CREDIT CARD

I strongly recommend that travelers think twice before staying at this hotel.

I had already paid for my reservation through Expedia. At check-in, the hotel asked for my credit card for a security deposit/incidental authorization, which I understood would be released after check-out.

Instead, my credit card was actually charged.

After I contacted Expedia and the hotel, I was told that the refund would be processed. Expedia even confirmed in writing that the hotel’s front office supervisor would process the refund and that I should receive the money within 3–7 business days.

More than 15 days later, I still have not received my money.

I provided the requested bank/credit card documentation to Expedia, and I have continued to cooperate with every request. I was even asked for a separate hotel receipt that was never provided to me.

The most frustrating part is that I have documentation showing the charge, documentation showing that the reservation was already paid through Expedia, and written communication confirming that a refund was supposed to be processed.

This is not about a small inconvenience. This is about taking money from a customer’s credit card and then making the customer spend weeks trying to get it back.

If you are staying here, PLEASE check your credit card statement carefully after checkout and make sure that any security deposit or incidental charge is actually released.

I hope the hotel finally does the right thing and returns my money. Until then, based on my personal experience, I cannot recommend this hotel.

Travelers deserve transparency, honesty, and their money back when they are owed a refu

author: Sara X
title: Close to Times Square and activities
text: We had a wonderful family stay. The cleanliness was great, the breakfast in the morning was complete, and the coffee was good for hotel coffee. The most positive aspect is my distance from this hotel to Times Square. We were able to go rest between two activities with the children. The room was not very big but well-equipped. A microwave was missing, however.

author: James K
title: Good option nearer to Times Square & Penn Station
text: It was a very short trip and identified this property because of its location : close to Times Square and NYC Penn station. The hotel seems to be designed for guests looking for a good sleep in the night with the day & evening spent outside. The room had a comfortable bed and a good bathroom with a shower. Keeping even two strollers was challenging. Downstairs make shift breakfast area gets heavily crowded but the spread is reasonably good.

author: Matthew P
title: Horrible Loud Dirty Stay Consider Yourself Warned
text:
I was really disappointed with this hotel. After booking, I called ahead and specifically requested a quiet room away from the street. When we arrived, we were still given a room facing the street. When I asked to be moved, the front desk said the hotel was fully booked, but I later checked online and there were still rooms available.

Another major issue was the cleanliness. There were a noticeable amount of flies in the front desk and dining area, which was very off-putting. The breakfast was also underwhelming—mostly reheated items like sausage, biscuits, bagels, yogurt, and oatmeal, with nothing particularly fresh or appealing.

The room itself was very small. While it looked clean at first glance, the carpeted floors throughout the property were dirty. Noise was also a big problem; you could clearly hear doors slamming in the mornings from guests and housekeeping, and there is a club across the street that plays loud music all night.

Even the window shades did very little to block out light, making it difficult to get a good night’s sleep. Overall, this stay did not meet expectations, and I would not recommend it for anyone looking for rest or comfort.

author: Samuel P
title: Cannot recommend this Hotel
text:
strongly encourage future guests to carefully review every receipt, folio, credit card charge, cash payment, and security deposit associated with their stay. Based on my experience, I would be very cautious when making cash payments and would insist on complete documentation for every transaction.

During my stay, I paid $1,100 in cash and the remaining balance by credit card. However, after checkout I discovered that I had been charged an additional $325.86 on my credit card. The only reason I discovered this charge was because I carefully reviewed my credit card statement after leaving the hotel. If I had not checked my statement, I would never have known about it.
What is particularly concerning is that the final folios and checkout documents did not clearly reflect all of the cash payments that had been made. I have receipts showing the payments, yet the records initially did not match what was actually paid.

Isn't that strange?

The additional $325.86 charge was not something that was clearly explained to me at checkout. I only discovered it later when reviewing my account. Corrections were only made after repeated complaints and follow-up communications.
I am also still trying to recover a $100 security deposit that was paid in cash. I was told the matter would be resolved, but I am still waiting for that money to be returned.
What made the situation even worse was the customer service. Instead of receiving assistance, I experienced rude, dismissive, and unprofessional treatment while trying to understand my account and resolve the issue.
Because I was unable to obtain a satisfactory resolution directly from the property, I have been forced to escalate the matter to IHG Corporate.
My advice to future guests is simple: keep every receipt, verify every charge, review your credit card statements after checkout, and carefully compare them with your final folios. Based on my experience with the billing issues, lack of transparency, and poor customer service, I cannot recommend this property.

author: Miguel N
title: Building site! Please read and see photos before booking
text:
Very disappointing stay at the Holiday Inn Express Midtown West Manhattan.

What made the experience particularly frustrating was that there was absolutely no prior warning when booking that major construction work was taking place directly outside the hotel entrance. For 4 days of our trip, guests were effectively walking through a building site. Tonight I was literally stepping over freshly laid tiles while workmen were drilling beside guests entering and leaving the hotel. I have genuinely never experienced anything like it at a hotel and it raises the question as to why the hotel remained open during such extensive works.

The drilling started around 8:30am every morning and, being on the 3rd floor, it regularly woke us up.

To make matters worse, breakfast had been moved from the lobby area into the gym. This created a bizarre situation where guests were eating breakfast beside toilets. It felt chaotic and completely unsuitable as a dining area.

The rooms are also tired

Unfortunately, the staff were generally very uncommunicative throughout the stay. Most interactions felt like an inconvenience, with questions often met by little more than a grunt or groan rather than any real customer service.

Overall, the lack of communication before and during the stay was extremely poor. Had guests been properly informed in advance about the scale of the disruption, many would likely have chosen alternative accommodation.

See photos if you don’t believe me.

I was trying to put an official complaint into holiday inn but as usual their complaint system is just a crystal maze of complexity.

Sadly you’ll not see me back here and warn others of booking certainly in the short term without checking.

author: David R
title: Average
text: As a top location, in 15 minutes walk you are in time square, as average rooms, daily service quite large with two huge half beds that I do not understand what they are for, windows with drafts that if you come in winter I do not know??? breakfast is the sore note, a narrow room and not equipped for a hotel that has so many people, as for food no comment, I can not compare with other hotels in America but if what they serve consider food have a good courage

author: Nora H
title: RUN AWAY...REALLY
text:
First room under the entrance of the hotel on the 2nd floor, music at the door of the hotel that is useless! 6:30 till 12:30! No interest.  When you have just arrived you wish to sleep and not hear this incessant music that prevents you from sleeping. No double glazing, plastic window (no no it's not glass). Deplorable air conditioning that makes a terrible noise and takes well 1 hour to gain 1 degree! When we wake up at 6:30, we'll... 14.5°C. We ask to change rooms, the reception must be so used that it asks us no questions and no reluctance, nor excuse for the inconvenience caused... we will also answer you mouth full of pizza...
New room higher, 7th floor..no better except the view (on the 2nd floor, it will be seen on the scaffolding, again, it can be forgivable). Family room no better! Air conditioning eaten literally, wake up at night by the cold furniture eaten, headboard colored, toilet leaking (a technician came but it did not change anything), dirty carpet, dirty bed base (photos). The housekeepers come when they want or not...window no better.
Slow elevators possible...
Breakfast taken most of the time in the room, very limited places, other room announced not at all equipped for breakfast but to store departure suitcases.  No supermarket as advertised in the description, fitness room but not used so no reviews. 
On the other hand, very well placed (10 minutes from Times Square and 2 blocks from shops making burgers, pizzas, sandwiches and supermarket-style Franprix in France), and a Target not far (monoprice style)-useful when you go home in the evening rather than going to the restaurant.
I would obviously not recommend this "hotel" which looks more like a hostel than a hotel. Very noisy despite quies balls and noise cancelling headphones.Pass your way, flee even if you do not want to taint your stay.

author: Morgan T
title: Room was cold
text: I recently stayed at this hotel during a short holiday in New York City in February 2026. While the location was ideal for sightseeing, my overall experience was quite disappointing. My room was located on the underground floor, which made it feel less than ideal. The lifts were painfully slow, causing unnecessary delays. The biggest issue was the room itself — it was freezing cold, and there was no heating available, making it uncomfortable to stay in. Unfortunately, this significantly impacted my stay. On the plus side, the hotel’s location is convenient.

author: Zoe G
title: Meh, wouldn’t return
text: The room was small with minimal space for luggage. Only 1 chair for a family of 4. The bed was comfortable (albeit a double, when a queen would’ve been better). The toilet ran constantly and the in room fridge was VERY noisy. The room had a bath, but the plug didn’t work, so it was useless. Even on the 9th floor we could hear lots of street noise almost every day around 4am. We were near the lift and definitely recommend requesting to stay away from the lift. Higher floors are better but be prepared to use the stairs because the lifts are very slow and crammed at certain times of the day. Breakfast was a joke. Seating was limited, choices were minimal (and we tried many times of the day and it was always the same). We ended up going around the corner to NASA cafe for breakfast to avoid the stress in the morning (highly recommend NASA cafe, btw). The lobby is so small that it was always packed with people which must be a fire hazard. The cleaner (Rocio) did a great job and my kids loved how their stuffies were lined up with care on their freshly made bed. We also had one kitchen staff help us locate some more almond milk. Otherwise, this was definitely not up to the normal Holiday Inn standards. I can’t say I would recommend staying in this holiday inn, nor would we return. The location was ok, but I’d recommend looking elsewhere.

author: Evan D
title: I hate this hotel
text: They put me in a room that was underground and the window is blocked by a shed. I booked a king. They confirmed a king and then gave me two doubles.  And the price was $400 a night. DO NOT STAY HERE!!!!

author: Lily C
title: Slightly above meh. Clean and conveniently located for a quick theater trip to the city. I
text: Fine for a quick theater trip to the city. Breakfast and elevator situation were adequate only because it was an off night. It would be awful if the hotel were fully booked. I actually walked past the hotel because there is no external sign due to construction scaffolding and it just looked like an apartment lobby. Mini fridge in room was a plus.

author: Hugo X
title: Brilliant stay in NYC for New Year
text: Great Hotel in brilliant location. Walking distance to Times Square and most of the main sights. Room was small but had 2 comfy double beds, a lovely walk in shower in the bathroom and all toiletries were provided. Housekeeping came daily with clean towels and all of the staff were friendly and helpful. The breakfast had a great choice however it was very busy and a bit manic but the staff provide trays so you can bring it back up to your room as the seating area is quite limited. We visited over new year and it was freezing but the rooms are lovely and warm with adjustable heating. The restaurant area is ideal for eating takeaways of an evening if you’re too tired to go out after a busy day and I would recommend downloading the door dash app for quick delivery. I even ordered a personalised birthday cake for my daughter which was delivered in 20 minutes! We would definitely return to this hotel as we didn’t really have any complaints. Yes it’s busy at breakfast, yes the rooms are a bit dated and yes the elevators are a bit slow but it’s in a great spot in the hustle and bustle of New York City so if that is all people can complain about then you’re never going to please them! If you’ve booked to stay then here you will have a great time and if you haven’t booked yet then don’t be put off by the negative reviews it really is a great place to stay.

author: Pierre O
title: avoid
text:
Only positives would be location, beds and some reception staff. Fairly central, access to subway and buses and shops. Beds comfy. Most reception staff friendly.
However, very loud work being done on the building at the time. Had to change rooms because the sofa bed was placed so it couldn’t even fit, which apparently is the same with all sofa bed rooms. Got a room right next to the elevator which makes noise all through the night. Coffee machine in room doesn’t function. Fitness room said to have weights/weight machines online which it didn’t. Somehow had no access to drinking water for half the week??? Breakfast way too overcrowded - too small of an area to fit the amount of guests. Sign said ‘more seating this way’ which was false. Food at breakfast mostly uninspiring and limited, and found myself living off sweaty warm cinnamon buns every day and rationing juice that ran out by 8:00am. Staff arrogant and stressed (unsurprisingly) when working in the breakfast area. Had housekeeping for one day before refusing it for the rest of the week, after seeing my clothes and luggage dumped on my bed (in photo). Cleaning staff seen around the building rude. Elevators awfully slow and small, seeing a queue of 10 people waiting in the lobby. Had to walk 7 flights of stairs many times. Overall, this hotel will shock you with its lack of common sense and basic amenities. Only stay here if it’s for one night and it’s the last option. Waste of money when considering what else is on offer in Manhattan and other boroughs.

author: Amelia J
title: Great location but not perfect.
text:
This hotel is central enough to visit Manhattan easily. 

The rooms are decent and the bedding is also good. 

On the other hand, only 2 elevators for so many rooms, and which are also extremely slow when they are not out of order, is annoying. 
Most of the time we had to climb to the eighth floor by the steps. 

In addition, the breakfast room is far too small compared to the number of rooms, which causes total disorder every morning, with long waits, guests staying up and even some leaving without having breakfast. 

Too bad because the rest is okay.

author: Thomas E
title: Holiday almost ruined
text: they gave us a room in the basement, from the window you could see people's feet, impossible in the morning to sleep from the noise of the street and also from the corridor outside the room used by the staff of the tree to bring to the reception floor material vario.Colazione poor with few product and the thing that penalized us most 'the lack of seats, the breakfast room and' undersized for the number of guests, we waited every morning more than half an hour just to sede.Personale unkind, we asked for a change of room and they responded badly. Absolutely below the standards of Holiday Inn hotels, at the same price you will find better

author: Louis A
title: Doesn't really meet the Holiday Inn Express standards of what we are accustomed to
text: First time New York City as we are catching a cruise and staying only one night at this hotel but wished we found something different. The hotel is a refurbished building of something but definitely not designed to be a Holiday Inn Express. Two old nasty elevators that only hold about six people and are very loud. Our room was situated next to the elevator but didn't expect to hear the elevator pulleys running 24/7 as if we were actually sleeping in the Elevator Shaft. Came downstairs to have breakfast the next morning and the fuse selections that were offered were completely wiped out.  Even if there was food to eat all of the tables were filthy and you wouldn't want to sit at them to try to eat your food since nobody was maintaining the dining area. In other words the free breakfast is a joke. You might as well find something off property if you want something good to eat.

author: Lily M
title: Good, clean, friendly hotel ideal for business stay
text:
Good for a short business stay. My room was good, comfortable, very clean, quite large for a NY hotel. I was on the ground floor and it was quite noisy, but that doesn't bother me - made it closer to the free coffee machine. View was over a building site, but for a business trip that's no problem. Good desk and chair for working. Plenty of bars, restaurants etc in close walking distance. Other reviews say that the breakfast is overcrowded but that's just because tour groups come and stay in large numbers here, so when they breakfast, they all breakfast. Friendly helpful staff.
So, good for a business trip, but not somewhere you'd bring your partner for a romantic week.

author: Ana K
title: Very good hotel
text:
Very decent hotel. quality bedding, clean room, clean bathroom, daily cleaning.
We are very happy with our family stay. Quality Welcoming, possibility to leave your luggage in concierge on the last day for free.
Breakfast quality. Nothing negative to say.
Located 10 minutes walk maximum from times square. We will return without hesitation. Very good Price quality ratio

author: Emma R
title: Awesome
text: Awesome great location.   Nice staff

author: Sara C
title: Good experience
text: The hotel was very good, the receptionists were friendly and offered a very good service.  Breakfast was good and the gym as well.

author: Nathan P
title: Unprofessional service and a complete theft of $1,400.
text: Do not book here. I prepaid 100% of my 4-night stay ($1,400) via Expedia, but my flight to NYC was delayed. I called the hotel multiple times to inform them, but nobody answered the phone and there was no voicemail setup. I then sent an official message through Expedia letting them know I would arrive 12 hours late the next morning. When I arrived, they had cancelled my booking and refused to give me my room, claiming they never received a notification. Unprofessional service and a complete theft of $1,400. Avoid at all costs.

author: Elena R
title: Parking
text: Parking is very expensive at this hotel

author: Lauren F
title: Excellent home base
text:
Cleanliness- 10/10
Staff - 10/10
Location 10/10
Breakfast- exactly what you need to fuel the day exploring the city. Bonus points for being free, which saves funds for doing what one needs to do most - have fun in NYC.
Room- exactly what we needed with a super comfy bed. As other reviews have mentioned it’s not super large, but I’ve stayed in much, much smaller rooms in NYC (there’s only so much space on the island), and TBH, I’m not spending much time in my room anyways. 
Balcony - excellent view of the Chrysler Building and a wonderful amenity.

Looking forward to returning!

author: Holly C
title: Central and practical: a few flaws, but the advantages compensate.
text:
The room is comfortable—let's put it that way so as not to say small 😂—but the spaces are well utilized and there is everything you need. Above all, which is not a given in New York, you can stay four to a room, a significant advantage for a family or a small group. The bathroom is also rather small, while the shower is comfortable and pleasant.

Regarding cleanliness, initially more could have been done; after speaking with the maid, however, the situation improved significantly and in the following days we did not have any particular problems.

Breakfast chapter 🤦🏻: forget the nice and quiet breakfasts that are normally associated with a Hilton. There is actually no lack of choice, there is practically everything, but the environment is rather chaotic and after a few days, even though breakfast was included in the stay, we preferred to have breakfast elsewhere.

The real strong point, however, is the location: the hotel is central and very convenient for getting around and visiting Manhattan. In the end, being able to sleep four in the same room and being in such a strategic location compensates for many of the flaws encountered during the stay.

Overall it is not a perfect hotel, but it is practical, central, and functional. And in New York these aspects count for a lot.

author: Grace H
title: Great stay for sure!
text: Very convenient location to Grand Central. Hotel staff very helpful and friendly! I would definitely recommend this property and I would stay here again.

author: Mia F
title: Family Stay
text: Location walking distance to main spots like Times Square. Clean comfortable beds. Breakfast good on weekends. Great value for money. Staff lovely.

author: Pierre A
title: Just what we needed
text: Nice rooms, friendly staff, good location

author: Miguel P
title: Great time
text: It was a good experience and the hospitality was on point.

author: Amelia C
title: Central, solid city hotel
text:
Solid hotel, room was clean and comfortable. 
The breakfast is quite American, rather not for Europeans.  For a city trip, the hotel is centrally located and the rooms are completely okay!

author: Isabella U
title: Outstanding service and support during the hotel evacuation - and a great stay
text: I would like to congratulate Kelly and Joe, hotel general managers, for their outstanding leadership and support during the emergency evacuation on July 7 due to the threat of a building collapse across the street.  Kelly made a general announcement to evacuate (loud and clear in the room, which is good to note) that was calm and articulate but stressed the urgency of needing to leave right away while noting succinctly that it was not a fire but a dangerous problem with the building across the street. I thought that detail was very helpful -- probably reducing frenzied panic among the guests.  I later received an email from her providing a booking at another hotel at no cost (though I had found space with family).  They sent another email with information about how to retrieve our belongings the next morning, including Joe's mobile number and the cafe where they were based.  A cheerful policeman escorted me up an eerily empty 43rd street where we found the hotel's night guard bravely waiting in the hotel lobby (didn't get his name). Joe, (who was also friendly and efficient at check-in) was waiting there and accompanied me up in case my key didn't work. As he escorted us back to safety on 2nd Ave, he mentioned that he and Kelly were up until after 2 AM contacting and helping all the guests.  They were brave, organized, friendly, and helpful throughout this wild ride and I really appreciated it.   And, by the way, the hotel was clean (my top priority), with good Wi-Fi (my other top priority), and a had nice variety of breakfast options.  A 5-star stay even without the over-and-above support from the management staff during that very strange crisis.

author: Lauren C
title: Great service in an emergency
text: I had a reservation at the Hampton Inn Grand Central on the day the entire street and area was closed for an emergency situation when a building was possibly going to fall down across the street. I have to say the service from the hotel has been exceptional. They responded to my texts, even when they didnt have answers for everything. They had me at another hotel the same day. And as the emergency has gone on, they confirmed I can stay at the other hotel for my entire week. I am very happy with how the Hampton Inn has handled things the last couple days. The general manager has been working around the clock to do everything in their power to take care of their guests. I appreciate all the hard work and helpfulness of staff at both locations. Thank you for making sure I wasn't stranded in NYC with nowhere to stay.

author: Joseph X
title: Frost class team! First class hotel!
text: Amazing team Victoria at the front desk to Destiny working breakfast and cleaning up the mess I made with the waffle mix. Clean rooms the prefect place to enjoy NYC.

author: Caleb J
title: Great staff
text: Great location near grand central

author: Katie V
title: Amazing
text: Everyone was really kind and helpful when I asked questions and the hotel room was clean , breakfast was amazing and so was the service .

author: Pierre M
title: Exceptional Customer Service from Victoria
text: Victoria provided exceptional customer service from the moment I called the hotel to the time I checked in. She patiently answered all of my parking questions and, when she noticed I had accidentally booked the wrong date, she immediately guided me through the process to fix it. As a Hilton Diamond member, I also appreciated that she understood and honored my Diamond benefits, which not every associate does. She was professional, knowledgeable, kind, and truly went above and beyond. Thank you, Victoria, for making my stay so much easier. You are a wonderful asset to the Hampton Inn team!

author: Abigail M
title: Favorite midtown east location
text: Always clean and comfortable.  I stay here frequently for work. Never a reason to look anywhere else.

author: Joseph B
title: Great team!
text: Outstanding staff and the rooms were nice!  The staff were outstanding - Victoria, Dante and Sayid

author: William Q
title: A great choice for families in Manhattan
text: The staff was super helpful and friendly. The location was excellent, a short walk from Grand Central Station. The room was clean and comfortable, the shower was roomy, and the AC was powerful. The included breakfast was very good with many choices. We would definitely stay here again.

author: Aaron N
title: It’s ok
text: It’s ok. The room is kind of small and had no real view, but the room and the hotel were clean and up to date. The breakfast area was the only common area and it was small but it worked. Space between the front door, front desk, and elevator was small and understaffed but it functioned. The room’s bathroom door was semi-transparent in a not really revealing way, and its only function seemed to be so that if one person uses the bathroom at night, the other person has the bed illuminated. Several subway lines were nearby, and plenty of food and other options nearby. No guest laundry and we didn’t try the exercise facility.

author: Giulia N
title: Hotel away from the hustle and bustle but still very convenient
text: Clean hotel with free breakfast. Great location away from the crowd. Close to the South Ferry and Bowling Green Subway stations. Walkable to the financial district and WTC.

author: Manon H
title: 2 nights
text: Great experience, all the commodities of a Hampton, friendly staff, specially Daniel at the Front Desk. Breakfast staff also friendly and responsive. Really good location.

author: Pierre B
title: A mediocre Wall Street hotel
text: The location is good, and breakfast is surprisingly acceptable. The rooms are small, power outlets are few, and the wifi is the worst I have seen in a hotel in many years.

author: James K
title: Much better than the reviews, overall nice!
text: Stayed 3 nights on business. I was concerned due to mixed reviews. But, the room was clean, quiet and comfortable. The breakfast was standard for any Hampton Inn. The staff was EXCELLENT, maybe the friendliest front desk staff I have come across in a long time. The parking was a block away but explained well. Yes, the rooms are small, as are msg hotel rooms in NYC. But other than that I have no complaints, and I would definitely stay there again. There are absolutely fancier hotels with bigger rooms and more amenities...at double or triple the price. Plus, the walkability to the wonderfully modernized South Street Seaport area was great. Actually I was surprised just how much was walkable, even at night for food, coffee houses, etc...Great job!

author: Louis X
title: Good experience
text: I stayed here back in 2017 - this hotel was like a normal Hampton inn it was clean and the staff was friendly. If I ever go back to NYC I would stay here. Though the rooms are small they were clean.  Easy walk to the financial district to sightsee the Statue of Liberty. Get your walking shoes on. Parking we had to pay for that. Was near the 9/11 memorial and that was one thing we wanted to be nearby.

author: Abigail M
title: No Air Conditioning
text: Very hot. Please be advised that this hotel centrally controls AC, and it is not available in April. You will be sleeping in a hot room. When we complained, they suggested opening the windows, despite the fact that it’s extremely loud outside at all hours of the night downtown, and the windows only open three inches. This isn’t flagged prominently on their website or anywhere else, so beware when booking.

author: Andrea M
title: LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!
text: I want to start out by saying that I absolutely enjoyed my stay here at this property. The views, the floors, the hospitality was unmatched. When I checked in, the guy at the front desk, Joel/Joe, was so kind! He was even kind enough to give me a warm cookie on the check in! If you go there ask for him because he is the reason i will be booking here again in the future! You and your property rock!!!! 10/10!

author: Liam E
title: Okay Stay, But Eerie Location & Heating Issues
text:
Chose this hotel primarily for the proximity to Brooklyn, and because it was a good price for a last minute trip. 

For context, i’m 23F. Wasn’t really a fan of the area though, i’m not super familiar with the Financial District and it got super eerie at night.
