I know FiDi is very different from midtown but I’ve stayed at multiple hotels in NYC and this was the first time i’ve felt unsafe walking from the subway station to the hotel. Not unsafe in a “there’s sketchy people outside”  way but more in a way of “if something were to happen to me no one would notice, if I were to scream no one would hear me.” Although I was with my boyfriend, as a 23 year old female that’s still really important to me when traveling.

A lot of people were commenting about how small the rooms were, and how the king bed takes up the whole room, but for NYC it was a standard room, actually more space than hotels i’ve stayed at in Manhattan. So space wasn’t an issue, and anyone complaining about space is clearly new to the city.

When we first checked in we chose a room on the 7th floor facing Pearl St. No initial problems with the room until we went to turn the heat on. It was about 40 degrees outside during our stay so the room was fairly cold. The heat wasn’t working so I contacted the front desk and got someone to fix it. We left for dinner, came back, and the room was back to absolutely freezing. Spoke to the front desk again and they moved us to a different room down on the 6th floor, also Pearl St view. The heat worked, but something is wrong with their system because it was either freezing cold or super hot. No in between whatsoever.

Definitely on the lower end of hotel breakfasts. Really nothing special and not worth it. But you can’t go wrong with just fruit and apple juice.

Overall I wouldn’t stay here again, but at no fault of the staff. They were very nice, friendly, and helpful. They were ultimately doing their best with the situation they were given. Shoutout to Q and the new male trainee.

author: Oscar A
title: Best in NYC !!!!
text:
Excellent service at reception!!! Very comfortable facilities..warm and welcoming atmosphere 
Quiet hotel..good choice for breakfast..we guarded the luggage before check in and after check out..
They speak Spanish.
Well located hotel in quiet area
Anyway...what more can you ask for!!
Thanks for everything!! We feel WELCOME

author: Paige M
title: Happy UK 🇬🇧 Travellers
text:
This hotel is ideally situated for access to stated island ferry, trains from South ferry (1 train )to uptown and various locations round battery park area. Checked in and was greeted by Daniella, who I'd corresponded with regarding questions on our booking. Nice to put a face to a name. All staff are great. Very helpful with route knowledge and recommendations for food, drink, and attractions. We were offered from 706 a corner king room on pre check in via the Hilton app which was really nice. Thanks for the proseco and welcome card.

Will certainly recommend this hotel and would return due to its location and friendly staff

author: Ella E
title: New York is magical especially at the holiday season!
text: Great location in a small street near Park wall street battery of the 9/11 memorial and the famous brookling bridge! Lots of bars restaurants and shops nearby! Ideal for a first stay in New York. To be repeated without hesitation!

author: Charlotte E
title: It was OK
text:
The hotel was OK
Very small rooms which were a little dated. The shower had awful pressure - took me ages to wash my hair. 
The air conditioning / heater is really loud and the windows are single glazed so not a peaceful stay. 
We were never told if you want your room cleaned you have to ask! I only heard someone else being told this. That was a shame! 
I can see what people mean about the breakfast room, it is small but has a nice selection - no issues. 
We had an issue on the last night - our heating broke and they didn’t offer us a new room and were unable to fix it. We kept calling down for an engineer but were told they would be with us in a minute 90 minute later. Our window didn’t close fully so we were really cold. I wouldn’t rate the hotel really

author: David B
title: Pleasant visit during a busy time
text: Enjoyed our first stay at this Hampton Inn. Our stay coincided with the annual New York bike ride and although we were not participating in the event, most of our fellow guests were riding. This did not interfere with our ability to enjoy the hotel and the neighborhood. Would certainly stay here again. Thank you

author: Daniel S
title: 5 Star Customer Service!
text: Wow, after boycotting Hampton Inn for 25 years due to a very bad experience in Baltimore, the team at the downtown financial district Hampton Inn (Lisa, Quiriat, Daniela and Ambrose) were so pleasant and accommodating. We were so pleased with their customer service from checking in our bag prior to check-in, the check-in process, directing us to the affiliated parking garage, breakfast the next morning, etc. Bravo! Definitely will consider Hampton Inn locations in the future, certainly look forward to a return visit to the downtown financial district Hampton Inn on my next NYC visit.

author: Giulia T
title: Severely Lacking Customer Service Skills
text: Purchased non-refundable tickets for the Statute of Liberty tour on the day we were flying out. The front desk staff would not hold our bags for a couple of hours so that we could go on this tour as we had already checked out. We lost out on the price of the tickets and the experience due to this poor customer service. The hotel/room were the size and expectations for a NY hotel room. The front desk employees need to work on their customer service skills.

author: Ian Y
title: Very basic Hampton Inn
text:
Basic hotel with no frills. Rooms sizes are what you would expect in New York City tho they were bigger than the Courtyard nearby

The hotel is to the other side of the HGI property but does not come with the same views. Convenient location  to SIF, and the subway lines. Walking distance to south street seaport area and 9/11 memorial

I was on the 6th floor in a room next to the mechanical room so I kept hearing this noise that sounded like a clothes dryer. There was also a rumble that would turn on every so often. However with the AC going , none of it disturbed my sleep.

Breakfast was basic - lacked a good fruit offering. One day had omelets, the other just had scrambled eggs. There is a market a block away that offered hot and cold foods , snacks, drink etc that was really convenient

There was a safe but no microwave or refrigerator in the room. There was also a lack of hooks in the bathroom.

I would probably stay here again for a short work trip if needed, but would prefer the HGI property next door instead.

author: William Z
title: Quick college visit
text: My son & I stayed for 1 night while on a campus visit to Pace University.  The good: location was great, we could walk to everywhere we needed to go.  The staff was super friendly &helpful. The bad: our requested room was not ready so we settled on an "internal" room, so no blame to the property there but it did overlook the internal shaft of the building.  It was also right next to the elevator & the ice machine = noisy.  The room was fine, very basic, no fridge or microwave.  Was supposed to be a king bed but seemed barely a queen, there were no double bed rooms available.  The temperature also did not get below 74 no matter how low I set the thermostat. Overall it was an OK stay for 1 night, but I am probably going to look at other properties if we stay in the area again.

author: Chloe A
title: Good end to a busy day
text: Very comfy and clean. Very nice bed. Location is good. Right down the street from a parking garage so that was very convenient. The outer door is locked after hours so it's well protected.  The breakfast was very good as well. Overall I was pleased and I would stay again.

author: David T
title: Nice stay
text: Pleasantly surprised! Friendly front desk. Complimentary breakfast. Stayed in suite w king bed & sofa bed. There’s a wall between bed & sofa bed area. We had to walk around the building for a cab & it took us a while to hail one. I would stay here again

author: Hannah O
title: Good value and location for central London
text: Stayed for 2 nights on a theatre/ sightseeing trip for my wife and I. Paid extra for early check in and room with a view. Check in was smooth and friendly. We had a room on 12th floor of the new tower with a view of the London eye. We really liked the location of this hotel for Waterloo underground ( 5 mins walk) and same to Big Ben. Staff were friendly and the evening meal and breakfast were good with fair amount of choice. Bed was super comfy and room aircon worked really well. Only gripe was the room size. It was REALLY small ( we had difficulty passing each other between the bed and walls ! ) VERY  compact wardrobe space and no drawers to speak of to store clothes / pads etc. If we had been staying longer with more luggage this may have been more of an issue & I may have opted for the County Hall Prem Inn 100 yards away where I remember much bigger rooms. Overall though it was good for our needs this trip and good value.

author: Ana I
title: Decent but …
text:
Hotel very well located, clean, helpful staff.   Breakfast quite decent.  On the other hand, the pizzas at dinner leave something to be desired … no taste and the crust very dry … disappointed 
Cost of the rooms quite high, especially to have a room with a view of a wall …

author: Aiden Z
title: Andrew and Paula
text:
We booked this hotel as it was central to most of our plans while staying in London. 
Check in was smooth with no issues as was the check out. 
We found all of the staff extremely friendly, attentive and helpful during our stay. From breakfast staff, bar staff, reception staff and cleaning staff all extremely polite.
The hotel was very clean with tea, coffee ,milk and sugar at reception to replenish the room as required. 
We would recommend anyone to stay at this hotel for its great location and friendly staff.
Thank you to all the staff at the hotel for a lovely stay.

author: Carlos R
title: Very comfortable
text:
Comfortable and clean hotel. The subway is 5 minutes away, and BIG BEN is 10 minutes away. 
We spent 3 very pleasant nights there after long days of exploring London.

author: Sean N
title: Amazing stay!!
text:
Stayed at this hotel for the weekend with my friends and it was great. The service was amazing and the room was very clean and up to standards. The location is perfect for what ever you’re doing as it’s so central. I would highly recommend staying and I will be definitely be back!!
Also big thank you to the hotel for our treats.

author: Amelia W
title: Would book with them again!
text: Everyone was so welcoming and accommodating. The food at the restaurant was delicious as well. We all really enjoyed that each room had an air con unit. Would book again!

author: Brooke O
title: Only stayed here for Air Conditioning
text: I only chose Premier Inn Waterloo as it had Air conditioning which made it possible for me to visit friends in London during an unbearable heatwave.But the room felt like being in a box. The tiny window looked out on a tiled white wall with gloomy light filtering down from somewhere high up -I could not see the sky. Bizarrely there was a connecting door to a neighbouring room and I could hear their tv, conversations and hairdryer. It was the usual Premier Inn offer in terms of furniture and layout, but crammed into too small a space. To be honest it was claustrophobic and should only be offered if the hotel was full. I was too exhausted from travelling and the heat to make a fuss. But I won't stay here again unless it's during a heatwave.

author: Manon I
title: Excellent Stay at Premier Inn London Waterloo
text:
Excellent Stay at Premier Inn London Waterloo

We had a wonderful stay at Premier Inn London Waterloo and would especially like to recognise Emilia the hotel manager for her exceptional dedication and passion.

Emilia clearly takes great pride in her work and leads her team with a friendly, positive, and professional approach. Her commitment and energy are evident, and she creates a welcoming atmosphere for both guests and her team. It is clear that she genuinely cares about delivering a great guest experience.

We would also like to highlight the excellent breakfast service and food quality. The breakfast team were friendly, attentive, and efficient, and the food was fresh, well prepared, and delicious. It was honestly the best English breakfast we have had across the Premier Inn hotel chain.

A big thank you to Emilia and the entire team for making our stay so enjoyable. Your dedication and passion really make a difference keep up the great work. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend Premier Inn London Waterloo.

author: Sean Z
title: Great experience
text: Very accommodating staff from reception to restaurant. Lovely room and delicious food. Lovely view from the room-London Eye.

author: Joseph Y
title: Great value for money!!!
text: Great located hotel near some really nice spots like London eye, Big Ben and Westminster Abbey and waterloo station. Very friendly staff! Breakfast situation was also good!

author: Amelia T
title: Lowering standards.
text:
Premier Inn used to be good. Not any more, we book a standard double room and was allocated room 1003. If you get offered this room do not accept. So small nothing like the website pictures. I’m considering writing to advertising standards agency.
I used to enjoy breakfast at premier inn, now overpriced and overcooked. Every single item very dry.

author: Amelia V
title: A wonderful stay thanks to the amazing staff
text:
Aquí tienes una respuesta en inglés, natural y agradecida:

We were very happy with our stay at the hotel. The room was comfortable and the air conditioning worked perfectly.

But the best thing about our stay was definitely the staff. Everyone was incredibly kind, friendly and helpful during the five days we spent there with our family. We especially appreciated how well we were treated at both breakfast and dinner.

Thank you very much to the whole team for making our family holiday so enjoyable. We felt very welcome and would be very happy to come back!

author: Jessica W
title: Not as nice as I thought it would be
text: Our room did not look like anything in these pictures. The room. Was very outdated.  There was no phone or fridge.  The bathtub walls were very high and hard to get out of.  The restaurant had ok food. The breakfast was good the first day but the food is the same everyday.  Also a lot of rhe food seems to be frozen and not fresh.  The staff were very nice and helpful.

author: Laura U
title: Disappointing
text:
Great location and friendly staff. 
Sadly, hotel is very poor - No fridge, no telephone to ring to the reception, no storage, tiny rooms and even smaller bathroom. The rooms are only cleaned on request. The bed, famously advertised as being comfortable are small for two adult’s sharing.

author: Diego V
title: Excellent option in London
text: Great location, steps from London Eye. Nice bed. Really nice and friendly staff. Great breakfast. A lot of nice restaurants near by.

author: Megan I
title: A stone's throw from the London Eye and Big Ben.
text: We booked this hotel for 5 nights and I must say that we had a good stay. The room was large and quiet, the bathroom a bit small, but with a spacious shower, the bed comfortable. There was a small window that, however, did not open, probably for safety reasons since we were on the eighth floor. Our requests were promptly fulfilled and the staff proved to be very friendly and helpful. We chose the continental breakfast option and I must say that there was a good assortment of products. For the amount paid we could have enjoyed a four-star hotel elsewhere, but considering London prices and the hotel's location, I feel like recommending it.

author: Katie M
title: Lovely stay and great view!
text:
We stayed in room 1401 and we had a lovely view of the houses of Parliament and also the London eye.

The staff were amazing and really helpful and friendly. The hotel was clean and tidy. They also had a luggage room that was really handy.

It is about 3 minute walk from Waterloo Station and we found it a great location for going to most places in London. If you do not mind walking then most things are about 30 minutes walk. 

We did not eat at the hotel but we did have breakfast, which was your normal standard for a premier inn. They did have a fairly big restaurant so getting a table was easy and we did not have to reserve a time.

Overall great place and location and we would come back. I would also pay to for a room with a view again.

author: Anna N
title: Small great hotel
text: Close to the Waterloo metro, with all the amenities, great breakfast, great room. Highly recommended family room for visiting the city.

author: Paige N
title: Excellent Premier Inn - Lovely staff
text:
The best premier inn I’ve stayed in. Clean comfortable and quiet as usual but Still in pretty good standard of repair in hallway / carpets / decor etc compared
To others I’ve stayed in. But mainly the best because the staff were so lovely helpful and friendly and in a very hot London the air conditioning was working brilliantly so lovely and cool.

author: Isabella T
title: Lovely stay
text:
Our 3rd stay at this hotel,  
Staff friendly and polite very helpful.
we have been coming to London for the last 4 years for my daughter's birthday.
We stayed at Premier in Leicester Square and last 3 times at Premier Inn Waterloo west Minster Bridge.

Unfortunately we looked to to book for next year and the prices are ridiculous. So might have look else where.

author: Oliver O
title: Excellent
text:
Everything was brilliant, we only stayed 1 night but you could use this as a base for exploring London and stay longer. Brilliant transport links directly outside or do as we did and walk along the river. 
Safz on reception was brilliant, really helpful with local knowledge 👍

author: Zoe B
title: Fantastic staff
text: Anna and Deanne were absolutely lovely. The hotel is reasonable walking distance to the US embassy and dog friendly which is fantastic. The rooms were nice and cool and quiet despite proximity to the trains. There's a Waitrose and Tesco express just downstairs and you can easily catch trains, busses, and the underground.

author: Nathan P
title: Thank you, Aysha!!!
text: A massive to thank you to Aysha on reception! So amazingly helpful, professional and friendly. I would give you 10 stars if TripAdvisor allowed!

author: Chloe J
title: Great stay
text: Safz has been a huge help during our stay

author: Lucas S
title: Hospitality
text: The hospitality in the hotel was my favorite part. Safz was so kind and attentive:)

author: Ruby M
title: Great
text: Close to the US embassy which was helpful. Deanne was super lovely and helpful, she made the check in quick and easy. Thanks!

author: Antoine U
title: Noisy rooms
text:
All the twin rooms at the Vauxhall travelodge are below ground so are constantly vibrating from the underground.
3 terrible night's sleep.
Should be told before booking and discounted

author: Lea S
title: August break London Vauxhall Travelodge
text: Great clean hotel, amazing staff, close to tube and easy access to central London! Would stay again!

author: Thomas Q
title: Great stay and lovely staff
text: I had a really pleasant stay. The reception staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming and helpful throughout my visit. Check-in was smooth and easy, and they were always happy to help with any questions. The room was clean and comfortable, and the location was also very convenient. Really appreciated the warm service from the front desk. Would definitely recommend!

author: Evan K
title: No hot food and bread at breakfast. No WIFI.
text:
Stayed for one night working away on business. Room was good but that was about it. No draught beer available in the evening. WIFI didn't work although it was pre paid for. Worst of all arrived for breakfast again pre paid for to find no hot food or bread available at 9am with an hour of service to go!!!!!!!!. Doubt I'll be staying at Travelodges again to be honest.

The Fire Doors are non compliant. You can guess what I do for a living.

author: Gavin V
title: Vauxhall break
text: Central hotel, close to underground and buses, plenty of places to eat round about and able to walk to South Bank towards London Eye.  Room really clean, topped up when needed and staff really friendly

author: Amelia R
title: Great Staff
text: We all really enjoyed our stay at the Travelodge in Vauxhall. Special mention to Nargis in the restaurant. She was friendly, welcoming and so attentive. A real credit to the Travelodge. Would definitely stay again.

author: Oliver G
title: Don’t bother
text:
Stayed here for a concert as quick to tube station; that’s the only advantage. 

- filthy; carpets full of dust ; pubic hairs all over the bathroom; shower cable split in half, bed not made up and had what looked like yellow stains on it.. thick of dust around every seal by windows and mirror. 
- fan in bathroom: kept bringing in the smell of cannabis.. but didn’t take any moisture out the bathroom 
- air con- yeah decent but it’s air con 
- was given “quiet room” but I was facing full traffic so even though I couldn’t sleep I couldn’t anyway because of the said traffic 
- lights were hit and miss.. flickering all the time 
- bed wasn’t made up either just awful 

Did report it to some woman, but they didn’t follow up.. I went to go down again and they said I didn’t go up and make a complaint. 
So tried again, no one took notice no matter the amount of times I told someone. 

Not impressed at all.

author: Lucia B
title: Well located no thrills hotel
text: Location is good you have the bus station and tube stations right there. I wouldn't normally review a place like this as I don't have much good to say. I am writing this review just to highlight Romario a breakfast server. Every day he was respectful and welcoming. There was another black man on reception/breakfast who's name I don't recall who was very friendly and delivered the service you would hope for in any restaurant or hotel.

author: Paolo T
title: Great experience
text: Great service. I wasn't expecting the hotel to have such amazing staff. The girl Nargis in the restaurant was exceptional.  Very attentive and friendly, an asset to the hotel. Food was lovely, room comfortable. I would definitely stay again

author: Taylor T
title: Trainspotting…
text:
I could literally look into the trains next to the hotel and I presume had I left the curtains open they could see me.

My room had the bar marquee below me so I got to listen to their music all night instead of relaxing.

Otherwise my room was nice and the highpoint was the free kitkat.

Aircon was great but not quiet enough to sleep. 

Existentially I don’t know why my employer is making me endure this but at least the bed was comfy

author: Pierre C
title: Good location, friendly service staff
text:
We stayed in this hotel for 6 nights. 
This is a basic hotel in a good location, being right opposite the Vauxhall metro station, bus stops and rail service. 
It’s a quieter part of central London which suits us with easy bus access to the more touristy areas.
Room is clean but not run down. Mostly DIY style eg you need to ask for housecleaning or change of towels. Service staff are friendly. In particular Claire Aysha has been super friendly and helpful from the time we checked in. That makes the stay more human and pleasant. 
All in all we had a good time during our stay here in Travelodge

author: Marco W
title: Great experience
text: Great service. All staff very helpful and very welcoming. I have enjoyed bar during my stay and food is very good quality. The room very clean, I will definitely come back again

author: Matthew F
title: Far too noisy
text: With the constant train noise and construction noise coming from buildings at both sides sleep and relaxation was impossible.  Trains and tube appear to run from around 5.30am to around Midnight and the noise is unbearable. Breakfast was reasonably priced for a buffet but choices were limited and the coffee was awful. Find somewhere else if you want to sleep.

author: Jessica M
title: Solo trip to London
text:
This hotel location was absolutely spot on, so central and conveniently located next to a large bus station along with the underground/train station. 

The staff were super friendly and welcoming and the cleaners were polite upon interaction too.

I didn’t have the breakfast as I was only staying the one night, but the food options and prices looked very reasonable considering the location. The 24 hour pizza service looked amazing!

The room wasn’t too small or too big it was just right, it was clean and had all I needed. The bed was super comfortable and there were spare pillows if needed, the TV was a good size and had plenty of channels to choose from and the bathroom was a good size. The only slight negatives I’d mention is there was no mini fridge, only 2 plugs within the room and if you want a hair dryer you need to go down to reception they’re not already supplied in the room. Nevertheless these weren’t major issues and didn’t impact my stay at all.

I’ll definitely be back!

author: Brooke S
title: Excellent hotel with outstanding staff service
text: Great location for accessing restaurants & train transport. Great room size & very clean. Access to Hannam was very relaxing. Staff were amazing & provided excellent service & recommendations. Very nice breakfast & honesty bar in the evening.

author: Diego B
title: Nice hotel
text:
Hotel located in an excellent position, 
Comfortable and elegant rooms.
Excellent breakfast.
Fantastic and very kind staff.
A must-visit

author: Chloe X
title: Super!
text:
We stayed on the top floor in a family room with our two kids. The room was perfect for us. Spacious and clean. Very quiet so we all slept very well, which is nothing but a small miracle with our kids.  Very nice hotel with very kind and helpful employees. Kids loved the breakfast :)  
Easy parking near the hotel. Definitely recommend this hotel!  (Thank you for the lovely stay!)

author: Julien U
title: A Warm Welcome and Thoughtful Touches
text: We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Fabric. Upon arrival, we were greeted by very friendly and helpful staff who introduced us to the thoughtful extra touches, such as the beverage centre, that help make this hotel special. The lobby is a warm and welcoming space, and we enjoyed relaxing there with a glass of wine before heading to dinner. The rooms are beautifully designed, comfortable, and quiet. The breakfast options were fresh and delicious, with a great variety to choose from.

author: Charlotte J
title: Highly recommended
text: Excellent welcome, spacious room. Attentive staff and a real desire to make our stay at the hotel pleasant. We will return with great pleasure. Thank you

author: Jack D
title: Absolutely recommended.
text:
I was there with my two almost adult daughters to celebrate their birthday. The hotel team offered congratulations and we received a drink on the house. The Hotel Fabric is highly recommended. It is very family-run, absolutely clean, and beautifully furnished. The beds are very comfortable and the breakfast has a large selection.
We will come back.

author: Emma P
title: Memorable first wedding anniversary, thank you!
text:
Stayed here for a long weekend for our first wedding anniversary, fantastic hotel, fantastic staff, couldn't be more helpful, room was immaculate, all the little special anniversary extras that I bought for my wife were perfectly executed by the team.
Location is fantastic, lots of restaurants and cafes within short walking distance, along with metro stations that get you around perfectly.
Will absolutely stay here again if we ever come back to Paris!! Thank you

author: Carlos M
title: Wonderful hotel in nice Oberkampf
text: Very good hotel in one of Paris' nicest areas. I really appreciated this hotel. The staff were very nice and caring, nice rooms (albeit quite small) very good breakfast. Nice lobby with free coffee etc. I love the area. Lots of interesting little shops good restaurants and cafes. Far from the tourist trails but still easy to get to famous sites by Metro or taxi.

author: Matthew S
title: Beautiful Parisian atmosphere
text:
After 4 years we returned to this "jewel" hotel of industrial archaeology. Its location is excellent: near the Le Marais district, in a quiet and peaceful area, well served by public transport. Designer furnishings characterize both the common areas and the rooms. There is attention to every detail and this makes the stay pleasant. 
The staff is friendly and very helpful. 
Fantastic hotel to recommend.

author: Connor O
title: We’ll be back.
text: Lovely hotel. Not too big with exceptionally helpful staff. Great location right next to three metro stations and walking distance from La Marais. Very clean and a great selection at breakfast.

author: Andrea H
title: Brilliant
text:
Just a top top boutique hotel in a fab location.
Stayed here before a few times.
Really lovely staff!

author: Megan R
title: Stay at Hotel Fabric! You won’t be disappointed!!!
text:
Wonderful experience! Location is perfect if you prefer to be outside of the tourist craziness but close enough to go visit everywhere in Paris easily. Unique building, an old fabric company.  The room is beautiful and incredibly clean, large for Paris standards. Coffee and tea available complimentary all day and an honor bar with great prices in the evening. Every day they make sure to stock your room with fresh cold water and the room has great A/C. An added bonus is a complimentary hammam session daily, really relaxing after a long day walking around Paris. The staff is amazing and always happy to do the little things to make sure your stay is perfect. Claire and Isaac, at the front desk, were especially wonderful but really so is the entire staff. 

Wonderful experience! The location is perfect if you prefer to be outside of the tourist craziness, but close enough to go visit everywhere in Paris easily. Unique building, an old fabric company. The room is beautiful and incredibly clean, large for Paris standards. Coffee and tea available complimentary all day and an honor bar with great prices in the evening. Every day, they make sure to stock your room with fresh cold water and the room has great A/C. An added bonus is a complimentary hammam session daily, really relaxing after a long day walking around Paris. The staff is amazing and always happy to do the little things to make sure your stay is perfect. Claire and Isaac, at the front desk, were particularly wonderful, but all the staff is too.

author: Dylan V
title: Boutique Hotel Perfectly Located for Local Flavor
text: Based on previous reviews I booked Hôtel Fabric for our family stay in Paris for 3 days. We were not disappointed. From the moment we checked in, we felt at home being welcomed with sincere interest in our stay, a complete rundown of all the surrounding areas, restaurants they recommend and every service they were happy to provide. Our rooms were beautifully decorated, modern & well appointed. Beds were comfortable and the most fluffy pillows of anywhere we stayed in France (this was a big deal for us after weeks of flat pillows). Each person we came in contact with was happy to help us with whatever we needed- an iron, dinner reservations and car reservations to the airport. The location was a perfect starting point for all of our adventures and was wonderfully quiet for a good night’s sleep. We will for sure stay here again on our next trip to Paris.

author: Chloe J
title: Very impressed with everything
text: Very impressed with everything about Hotel Fabric. Beautifully designed, thoughtful to guests (free tea, coffee and water all day and an honesty bar in the evenings), friendly staff, well-equipped rooms, chilled lounge area, bonus steam room and small gym...everything was thought of. The location is brilliant if you want somewhere with lots of vibrant restaurants and bars but also a chilled vibe. Easy transport into the centre, or elsewhere, and a great area to discover. We would love to go back to Hotel Fabric and highly recommend it.

author: Ruby X
title: Excellent stay
text: Excellent stay spent at the Hotel Fabric. We had taken a rather tiring trip and the reception welcomed us in the best way possible. Hotel decorated with taste, very clean and serving a very appreciable continental breakfast to start the day. Furthermore, the entire team is very attentive and very thoughtful. Thank you for your welcome, we are keeping this hotel for our next visits to Paris (which benefits from a prime location for getting around central Paris without constraints).

author: Jessica I
title: Very thoughtful touch and comfortable stay
text:
I just stayed for one night for work, but it was great and very comfortable. 
Very lovely staffs who made my stay even
More comfortable. Little a bath bomb addition was just very thoughtful touch and exactly what I needed after long and hot day.

author: Miguel C
title: Great hotel, great neighborhood
text: We had a wonderful, too-short, stay at Hotel Fabric. Seeking respite from the unprecedented heat wave, we abandoned our non-air-conditioned apartment rental and sought out cooler hotels--cooler temperatures in "cool" places.  Hotel Fabric delivered both. Due to our last-minute booking needs, we stayed in 5 different hotels  over a two-week period, four of them 4-star hotels, all of them in desirable neighborhoods. Hotel Fabric was the best of the bunch. The hotel is beautiful, offering great accommodation, beautiful shared areas, an incredibly helpful staff, and a great breakfast. And we loved the location: quiet, but right in the middle of a great neighborhood we can't wait to return to. Thanks, we'll be back.

author: Megan O
title: Second stay, still just as charmed!
text:
Second stay at Hotel Fabric in less than a year, and once again an excellent experience!

The hotel offers a great value for money. We really love its modern, warm, and architectural ambiance. The rooms are comfortable, the air conditioning is effective, and the shower has a very good water flow.

The breakfast is excellent, and the Honesty Bar is truly great: friendly, simple, and pleasant after a day in Paris.

The hotel is also very well located, near the metro and good restaurants. The welcome was impeccable from start to finish.

In short, an excellent hotel in Paris. We would return without hesitation!

author: Miguel G
title: Great experience
text: I highly recommend this Hotel. Situated in the center of Paris, a boutique hotel near great restaurants and the staff are so kind and available for anything that can make your stay comfortable. The room and amenities are of the highest standards… I shall return no doubt!

author: Daniel D
title: ALWAYS COME HOME A LITTLE ....
text: The perfect and quiet location on the edge of Le Marais and Oberkampf is an absolute added value of the hotel Fabric. The decor is chosen with taste and originality. The staff is also very professional in all areas. One feels really welcome .... almost like home.

author: Sydney Y
title: Great Place to Stay
text: Services were beyond excellent. Staff was kind, helpful and professional. Rooms clean, comfortable, location perfect. I highly recommend this facility

author: Marco Y
title: Amazing stay
text:
Amazing location atmosphere and staff
We really enjoyed our stay 
We will definitely stay here if we come to Italy again

author: Brooke F
title: Beautiful hotel
text: The service and communication were excellent! David was so kind and helpful. The hotel was clean and comfortable and in a great location. We will be back!

author: Ruby K
title: Wonderful respite.
text: Hotel Manfredi was a wonderful escape from the heat and hustle of Rome.  My family enjoyed our time and felt as though the staff took great care to get to know us.  Both the breakfast staff in the morning and the desk staff at night helped fulfill or special requests for wine and food as well as make us last minute restaurant reservations  when we were tired from traveling all day.  It was a great vacation and you all are a big part of that. Grazie!

author: Chloe I
title: Lovely boutique hotel!
text: This is a beautiful boutique hotel with an outstanding staff! We arrived and we're warmly welcomed and showered to our room which was tiny but beautiful. Unfortunately the bed was hard as a rock. Incredible breakfast and staff making cappuccino 💖 great location to walk about Rome! It was a pleasure to stay there.

author: Lucy X
title: Great hotel in a great location
text:
A perfectly lovely little hotel in an amazing location with helpful and friendly efficient staff 
Perfectly situated for shopping and sightseeing 
Highly recommend

author: Erin N
title: Hotel
text:
Wonderful hotel, excellent location and amazing service.
The staff is really helpful and kind.
Thanks to Mariela for the amazing service at the hotel restaurant.

author: Charlotte F
title: Like being at home.
text:
Exquisite treatment, punctual in everything, helpful, everything very clean and welcoming...

The service was very good, especially from the waitresses in the cafeteria...

I remember Roberta and her colleagues....

A delightful hotel... I would go back... I recommend it.

author: Chloe P
title: The best hotel in Rome
text:
Luxurious
Great staff!

Best location in Rome
Our tenth (!!) stay with them.

author: Holly F
title: Fantastic stay in Rome
text:
The staff at Hotel Manfredi Suite is amazing. Each and every one of them is attentive and genuinely caring. This was my third stay there with my husband. We really feel like we are at home with family. Thank you Giovanni, Davide, the two Roberta’s, Andrea, Marco, Francesco, and everyone else I did not mention. You are all appreciated for your professionalism. 
The cleanliness is top in every room, including hallways and dining spaces. The beds are comfortable with quality bedding. Quite sleeps facing the courtyard. 
Location was great. Easy walking distance to all locations and on the prettiest street in Rome. 
Will surely be returning next visit to Rome.

author: Rosie I
title: A little treasure
text:
The hotel is tucked away in via Margutta, just metres from the Spanish Steps, an ideal site for exploring old Rome on foot. The room was quiet and the reception and breakfast staff friendly and helpful. Although the rooms are small (not unusual in this part of the world) they are lavishly decorated, spotlessly clean and very comfortable.
The full breakfast  was excellent. Overall it was a lovely experience.

author: Owen F
title: Impeccable
text: Absolutely positive experience. The location of the facility is excellent, ideal for comfortably exploring the city. One of the many strengths is the staff. A special commendation goes to the breakfast room staff (the two ladies, Roberta), who are super kind and welcoming, with quality food. The reception welcome is also impeccable, as is the work of the cleaning staff, who keep the rooms in optimal condition. Sabrina and Barbara (the twins)

author: Katie Q
title: Friendliness and elegance
text: We spent 3 days in total relaxation and comfort. Clean hotel 2 minutes walk from the Spanish Steps. Friendly and helpful staff. Great breakfast and varied. Totally recommended.

author: Miguel L
title: Loved Manfredi and its location
text: Location is perfect and the hotel is lovely.  Staff are friendly and very helpful. Nice, clean, quiet room.

author: Giulia U
title: Great experience
text: The staff was very kind. Spacious and clean rooms. Location of the hotel in the center. Special thanks to the bar staff

author: Pierre T
title: Authentic and classy experience in a beautiful area of Rome
text:
We stayed in the Margutta Suite - perfect for families, one bedroom with additional sitting room and a lovely bathroom. 
The hotel is situated on one of the most beautiful streets of Rome, within easy walking distance of the Spanish steps and Trevi. We were given excellent recommendations for dinner by Dalia for restaurants - Pizza Re was amazing! 
The breakfast was especially memorable for the delicious homemade cakes, it was a truly authentic experience and very memorable.

author: Holly F
title: Excellent stay in Rome
text: Very nice structure perfect location in the center, kind courtesy of all the staff, excellent breakfast with a wide choice for all gusto.Super courteous the very kind waitresses who serve breakfast in the morning. I returned with pleasure to this property for the second time and will definitely return in a future trip to Rome.

author: Lucia T
title: Fantastic stay for three!
text:
We had a wonderful 4 night stay at this hotel! The location was wonderful, right in the heart of an area with so many options for shopping and eating! Took us 5 minutes to walk to Piazza Espana and the metro there! The street was just behind the busy Via del Babuino, but quiet while so convenient!

The staff was so wonderful and warm. Each morning we we’re welcome to breakfast with an amazing spread, cheerful, and attentive servers who were happy to make your favorite coffee drink! And in the evenings, Marco went out of his way to give us recommendations for restaurants and call to make reservations for us…give us help for traveling routes, and when my husband came back after twisting his ankle – right away, he insisted on getting ice for us. You could not find a sweeter guy.

We would definitely recommend a stay here and a lovely room amongst the kindest people!

(oh, and if you are fans of the movie, Roman Holiday, Gregory Peck‘s apartment was located just down the street!)

author: Rosie L
title: A wonderful stay in a great hotel.
text: An impeccable small hotel beautifully decorated with quality fittings. The staff are all extremely helpful and a good breakfast is provided.

author: Maria M
title: Wonderful Christmas Time Visit!
text:
Wonderful experience from beginning to end!  My adult daughter and I stayed 9 nights, including Christmas Eve & Day. This was my 3rd time to Rome, and my daughter's first. I wanted it to be special especially since it was over Christmas.  The staff was extremely welcoming and helpful with all our request, and our many questions. They were professional, prompt, accurate.  We felt extremely safe, and always looked forward to returning to hotel after full days of siteseeing.  Our room was always tended to while we were out and it was so nice to return to  comfortable beds!  
We loved the location - quiet & so many resturants and shops right out the door. 
The intercontinental breakfast was outstanding every morning and the breakfast staff was always accommodating with any special requests. They always remembered I had Cappachino & my daughter Cafe Americano with soy milk!  
I would absolutely recommend the hotel to anyone who wants a more intimate and personal experience where it feels like staying with family!

author: Pierre O
title: We had fun.
text:
We were two couples. Charming hotel, nice rooms, excellent air conditioning. 
M

author: Ethan H
title: Thanks
text:
Excelent hotel, freindly  and wonderful   service, very well treated by  Sara 

Thanks and good luck Sara.

author: Antoine A
title: Great position
text:
We stayed here for 2 nights before getting on our cruise. The hotel is in a great position, walking distance to lots of tourist attractions,  restaurants and shops.
Room was clean and comfortable.  Breakfast was very good with a great selection. 
Staff friendly and helpful. The on site bar was a great place to have a quiet drink before turning in for the night. 
Enjoyed our stay

author: Leo H
title: Good but could be better
text: The staff was generally kind and helpful and the place was generally clean. Breakfast offerings were good. Location was good for the tourist sights. However, there was no shelving or counter space or extra hooks in the bathroom, only shower gel offered (no conditioner or shampoo), only half of the spa area was working, the spa and fitness area smelled like cigarette smoke where I think the staffer doing the laundry smoked inside.

author: Sofia U
title: I am not joking.
text: I am a doorman; I know what is clean and what is not. I know how to deal with 100 people living in a building in Esquilino (different ethnicities, ages, and social classes). This place is nothing. It is nothing and it is disgusting how they treat you. I am Serbian; do not treat me poorly. Do not treat me differently just because I am not Italian. The place is zero. The socket is zero. Everything is zero and the price is $$$. Don't joke with me, don't do it.

author: Oliver V
title: Lovely Hotel and Area
text:
We stayed at this hotel for a week (room only) and had a really pleasant experience from start to finish. We arrived very late in the evening, and the gentleman at reception was incredibly kind and helpful, giving us great advice on where we could find something to eat at that hour.
Our room was spotless, well-presented, and very comfortable. The bed in particular was excellent, and we slept really well throughout our stay.
The hotel is in a fantastic central location, with the Colosseum and Trevi Fountain just a short walk away. There are also plenty of lovely bars and restaurants nearby, which made it easy to enjoy the local area.
One evening, we had a drink in the bar while watching football, and the bartender was very friendly and welcoming, which added to the relaxed atmosphere.
Overall, this is a lovely hotel in a great location, with friendly staff and comfortable rooms. I would highly recommend it and would happily stay here again.

author: Daniel C
title: Unpleasant stay
text:
Disappointing stay overall. Room cleanliness was below expectations and I had to wait around 44 minutes for towels despite calling reception multiple times. Basic service should not require repeated follow-ups or long delays.

I travel frequently and this did not meet basic hospitality standards.

The only positive part of my stay was Joan Mae, who was consistently kind, professional, and genuinely helpful.

Overall, the service and cleanliness were not acceptable for the standard expected.

author: Adam V
title: Look Elsewhere!
text: We booked here for four nights as we were on a sightseeing holiday to Rome. Whilst the central location is great as it is within walking distance to all of the must see places, I would recommend looking elsewhere. As with the last reviewer, I agree that cleaning (and timely room cleaning) is sincerely lacking as is customer service. On arrival, we were greeted by two unwelcoming staff who told us our room wasn’t ready (this was mid afternoon and others were also told the same). Our cases were put into a room so we could leave them. We would have preferred to wash up/ change first but agreed to do so. On arrival back at the hotel that evening (very tired) we were given our cases and checked into our room. The rug on the floor had a noticeable stain which immediately put me off. As it was late, we said that we would mention it to reception the following day. The next day, we were out until late and arrived back to find that the room had been cleaned (towels changed and bed made) but the bins were not emptied. After a shower, I went to dry my hair only to find the plugs would not work with my travel adaptor. Also, my partner wanted to use the sauna but had been told it was not on. My partner went to reception who sent a man to check (he agreed the cleaning was below par and tried the sockets to no avail). I personally then went down to speak about the rug and bins etc only to be treated rudely by the male on reception (Euginio). I asked to speak to the manager but was told she wasn’t in and I could speak to her at 9:30am the following day. I explained this may not be possible as we were out early on a trip but was dismissed by him. The following day, we got back only to find that the room still had not been cleaned (this was approximately 3.30pmish) so I went to speak to the manager who I was told was ‘somewhere in the building’ before eventually meeting with her. She too was quite abrupt but suggested I try a new adaptor in the sockets which she provided and which did indeed work. She accompanied me to the room to check and I noticed the dirty rug had been removed. She said she had been into the room whilst we were out to check it after my complaint. I explained that we had paid to come and enjoy our trip and that this was clearly not enjoyable. She did apologise but all in all I would not agree with the ratings nor would I return. A local travel company we booked through pointed us in the direction of this property and I will be feeding this experience back to them too.

author: Laura J
title: I do not recommend
text:
I do not recommend this hotel. There is a
Bad cleaning service and customer care. We booked for three nights (24 to 27 May) and our room was not cleaned once and the air conditioning was uncooled. We arrived day 24 at night and the room was ok, but the air conditioning did not cool. The next day, we complained at the reception and the girl said that she was going to ask to resolve. We returned at night, tired and, besides the air conditioning had not been repaired, the room had not been cleaned. The next day (26), we talked again with the receptionist who apologized to us and said q would arrange for the cleaning. We arrived at night tired and the room again without cleaning, a total disgrace!

author: Mathis A
title: Perfectly situated Lovely hotel in the city center
text:
Our 1st visit to Rome and decided to stay in Leonardo Boutique hotel Monti. We absolute did not regret. A lovely boutique hotel situated in the city Center of Rome at walking distance to many hot spots, like Trevi Fontain, Colosseum, Piazza Venezzia, and many more. The hotel has wonderful decorated rooms, with great bed, nice shower and it is very quite. The breakfast is a wide choice of delicacies, bread and many more. The staff is very kind and friendly and helpful. There are many restaurants within 5 minutes walk around the hotel, perfect.
For my wife and I it was also our Silver wedding anniversary and we were granted a late check out by ms Joan Mae, the very kind receptionist who also checked us in. After returning to our room after a whole day sightseeing, our room was surprising decorated with some nice balloons, a little present and a lovely greetings card. So sweet!!
Thank you so much Leonardo team for making our stay that we will remember for ever. We look forward to return again.

Bye bye from a thankful Linda & Ronald

author: Grace Q
title: How do you get Bacon wrong!
text:
Convenient location especially if your using the Italian trains to roam the country. Not too far from the train station to wheel your suitcase; But also only a short walk from most big attractions. The only exception being Vatican, which is a 50 min walk. The beds have foam toppers and are very comfy. 
The good - Beds, location and coffee pods provided in room. Close to Opera house.
The not so good - General ambience of the hotel is somehow wrong (lighting, soft furnishings etc). Breakfast is a bit rubbish with coffee from machine only (black americano is only option if you like your coffee hot), bacon inedible (not sure how you get bacon wrong!)  Only one lift available. Some staff rude. Always seemed to have cleaning and maintenance staff walking around.
Would we stay again - No

author: Lucy U
title: Rome 2026
text: Excellent location.Friendly ,helpful staff on reception and in dining area. We had everything we needed. Great breakfast.Walking distance to Colisseum and Santa Maria Maggiore.Good restaurants on Via Palermo, Via Genova and Boschetto.

author: Jack E
title: Disappointing.
text: The staff at the hotel were welcoming and helpful. However, no air conditioning was available (city of Rome rules, apparently) so the room was unbearably hot. Conversely, the next morning, the shower was cold!! Not worth the £250 I paid.

author: Lucas J
title: Hotel staff , jobs worth
text: Overall had a fabulous trip to Rome . Was a special 60th birthday present and went with my daughter . I was very disappointed on arrival at the hotel . We arrived 2 hours before our room was ready and in order to be able to change and get ready for some  sightseeing we had to pay £30 for the room to access 2 hours early . After travelling from 2.30 am in the morning I was very disappointed at this . Also , on the Saturday morning there was no hot water for our shower. Apparently when we checked out I asked about this and there was a power cut but no one informed us . Rome over all is fantastic but would not return to this hotel .

author: Benjamin B
title: Fabulous
text: It is a very well located hotel, excellent facilities and very attentive staff, especially Sara at the front desk

author: Nathan W
title: Great stay and great team! Highly recommend it.
text:
Stayed for only 2 nights after arriving a day late. Reception team were very friendly and welcoming. Room was very tidy, clean and well serviced. Breakfast was amazing, great range and way to start the day. Also in a great position to get to all things. Loved our stay, highly reccomend it
Only things we would have liked was control of the temp in our room and hot coffee in the morning but there was a place just on the corner we got our coffee fix.

author: Laura C
title: Good hotel with good location
text:
The hotel is great with good standard, and location, the rooms are large and have good beds, the bathroom is huge and it is really great.
Food, however, is what pulls down. Here they can get better. The selection is good enough but the quality can be improved.

author: Nathan Y
title: Beautiful hotel
text:
We stayed for 3 nights at the end of February, check in was fast and the reception staff were very helpful. All the staff we come across were very friendly. 

We had a room for 3 which consisted of a large king size bed and a small single bed. The room was large, beautifully decorated and had a bathroom with a shower and bath. There were complimentary toiletries, robes, slippers and plenty of towels. There was a coffee machine and water in the room. 

The hotel is located in Monti which has an abundance of restaurants, cafes and shops nearby. There are some nice restaurants opposite the hotel. It’s a 10 minute walk away from Termini and the colosseum. We walked everywhere in Rome and the hotel was in a great location. Repubblica metro station is a 5 minute walk away with trains going to the Vatican. 

The hotel has a lovely bar area and court yard. There is also a sauna etc which we didn’t use. On check out the hotel held our bags so we could go out for the day. 

I would 100% recommend this hotel if you are staying in Rome and would definitely return.

author: Lucy J
title: Lovely stay
text:
We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful hotel. The location is absolutely perfect — just a short walk to the Colosseum and the Trevi Fountain, with plenty of lovely local cafés nearby, making it easy to explore and enjoy the area.

The customer service was excellent throughout our visit — friendly, welcoming, and always happy to help. We stayed in Room 310, which was lovely, comfortable, and well-presented.

One small suggestion for improvement: the area outside the shower cubicle tray could use a deeper clean, as it appeared worn with some limescale build-up and minor mould. Addressing this would make the experience even better.

Overall, a fantastic stay in a great location — we would happily return!

author: Grace K
title: Some strong positives but let down overall
text:
On the positive side, the staff were lovely on check-in and the location is excellent for exploring Rome, with plenty of great restaurants and bars nearby. The room itself was very nice – clean and comfortable, with a really comfortable bed, good shower pressure, and an empty fridge which was useful. Overall, the room felt well presented and welcoming.

However, there were two significant issues that affected our stay.

Firstly, the room door did not lock properly unless it was pulled firmly. One day we returned to find that housekeeping had left it unlocked, meaning anyone could have accessed the room. We reported this, but it was not fixed during our stay, which was concerning from a security perspective.

Secondly, the hotel advertises air conditioning. Ours would not switch on, resulting in a sleepless night. We raised this at reception and were initially told someone would fix it. Later, we were told it was working according to their system and were asked to return to the room to check again. It still was not functioning. We were then told that air conditioning cannot be used in winter in Rome due to a city-wide rule. We were shown a website in Italian as “proof,” but after translating it ourselves, it referred to limits on heating, not air conditioning. This was frustrating and felt misleading. If air conditioning is not available seasonally, that should be made clear at the time of booking.

Because of the lack of air conditioning, we had to sleep with the window open, which meant significant noise from the street throughout the night.

In summary, the location and room quality were very good, and some staff were welcoming. However, the unresolved security issue and the handling of the air conditioning situation were disappointing and impacted our experience. For those reasons, we would not choose to stay again.

author: Mia G
title: FABULOUS HOTEL!
text: Fabulous hotel! Clean, comfortable, updated rooms with nice beds and linens. Air conditioning in August during their heatwave was SO nice to have!! Shower was big with nice water pressure. Staff was very friendly. Breakfasts were delicious and the afternoon refreshments were a nice little treat. Location was good. Several restaurant choices in the area within walking distance and a convenience store for snacks and essentials is literally right next door! We will most definitely stay here again if we ever get back to Paris!

author: Pierre Q
title: A must stay!!!
text: Wow!! This is the best hotel we’ve stayed at in Paris. The staff is helpful, courteous and welcoming. Our room was very spacious, comfortable and quiet. The gym was much larger than the pictures show (please find the pictures attached). The daily snacks and drinks provided were a lovely added touch. It’s down the street from many places to eat, shop and you have a pharmacy across the street. This hotel made our week trip perfect.

author: Megan V
title: Fantastic stay
text:
I can only write very positive words regarding 123 Sebastopol.
Truly fantastic, very kind and helpful staff, well-kept and clean environment. 
Top!
Thanks a lot and see you soon.....

author: Katie I
title: Wonderful Hotel
text: An excellent hotel. The movie themed decor is clever, not ovedone. The hotel and our bedroom was very clean. The staff is courteous and efficient. The breakfast is abundantl, Lewis at the front desk was particularly helpful with restaurant reservations . There are some extra touches which are very nice. They the stock the  in room mini bar for free with non alcoholic drinks and put in drinking glasses so they chill! The free afternoon through evening drink and snack offering is abundant. This is an amazing hotel for a better than expected price. The location is right across the street from the metro .

author: Erin W
title: Paris made comfortable.
text: We arrived early after a long flight from Australia and were warmly greeted and immediately felt at home. The front desk staff were a wealth of knowledge and always happy to help. We stayed 7 nights, all excellent. Our room and the entire hotel was very clean. The room aircon was a saviour during the week long Paris heatwave. Breakfast was plentiful, varied and most delicious. French pastries too. The breakfast staff were personable and always helpful. Nothing was too much trouble. The hotel is in such an excellent position, with easy access to the Metro / RER and walking distance to many good restaurants. We have already recommended the hotel to our friends as we would stay again. Repeating the words we said as we left, the hotel contributed to our fabulous week in Paris. We highly recommend staying at 123 Sebastopol.

author: Erin G
title: A Hidden Gem Near Le Marais: Quiet, Stylish, and Welcoming
text: Fantastic stay near the trendy Le Marais district, just a short taxi ride to the city center. The staff were super kind, helpful, and fluent in English. Our room was spotless, the beds were very comfortable, and the double-door entry design kept our first-floor room completely private and quiet. We stayed one night for our wedding anniversary before heading back to NY, and the romantic room decorations were a thoughtful, perfect touch.

author: James H
title: Wonderful
text:
Excellent location. The staff is amazing, I truly recommend it and I’ll definitely come back! 

Hanna

author: Louis Y
title: Great hotel experience!
text: The hotel was great! Clean and comfortable. The staff was very helpful, inviting, and friendly. The free snacks everyday and free drinks in your room was very much appreciated. The morning breakfast was as good, if not better, then most restraunts. I will definitely use Astotel again.

author: Poppy V
title: Good, practical, and well-kept hotel.
text:
A good, well-kept hotel: well-laid-out room, good air conditioning and quiet (overlooking the inner courtyard), decent bathroom (even if in room 515 the shower head could use a repair for proper use).
Good quality breakfast. 
Two pluses: the free minibar restocked every day with soft drinks and the all-you-can-eat afternoon tea every afternoon in the dining area. 
A fun hotel with its cinema theme to recommend, as well as its reception and breakfast staff.
Very good value for money

author: Chloe Z
title: Amazing stay ❤️❤️❤️
text: Amazing Hôtel!!!! The staff is so nice especially Louis ❤️❤️❤️❤️ we really enjoyed our stay 😍

author: Leo D
title: Great trip to Paris
text: Great and lovely hospitality

author: Paige B
title: Great experience!
text: I had an amazing experience staying here with my sister. Friendly staff, felt incredibly safe in the area and at the hotel itself (can’t get in through the lobby door without your room key). You can also go into any of their other hotel locations for water, snacks or coffee between 2pm and 2am. I didn’t use this but it’s definitely a big pro during this heatwave.

author: Amelia X
title: Excellent service, spacious family room and a great stay in Paris!
text:
We had a wonderful five-night stay at Hotel 123 Sébastopol with our family of four. Like so many other reviews mention, the service here really is excellent. You can tell the hotel prides itself on customer service, and everyone we encountered was friendly, welcoming and genuinely helpful.

A special mention has to go to Dost, who we had the pleasure of seeing most mornings at breakfast. What an incredibly kind and gentle man. He was always there to help us with breakfast, coffees and anything else we needed, and those little interactions each morning really added to our stay.

The hotel itself has great movie-themed decor and felt very fresh and well maintained. Everything was extremely clean, which is always important to us when travelling.

We stayed in a Superior Family Suite, and it was perfect for a family with two kids. Having a separate bedroom for them with their own beds was fantastic — they loved having their own space, and we certainly appreciated having the extra room as well! It made a big difference over five nights compared with everyone being together in a standard hotel room.

The location was very central and made getting around Paris easy, especially with two Metro stations nearby. We actually didn’t discover some of the nicer streets and areas within a 5–10 minute walk of the hotel until our last day, so it’s definitely worth exploring the surrounding neighbourhood a little more than we initially did.

Overall, Hotel 123 Sébastopol was a great choice for our family. Clean, comfortable, spacious, centrally located and, above all, staffed by people who clearly care about their guests. The excellent service is what really stood out and what we’ll remember most from our stay.

Merci to the entire team — and especially Dost — for making us feel so welcome in Paris!

author: Freya E
title: Perfect location
text: This is the hotel with outstanding geographical location. The hotel staff were very friendly, helpful. A big plus is something as unusual as a free minibar in the hotel room filled with non-alcoholic drinks. Another plus at the edge is the hotel for serving a free buffet in the lobby daily between 14:00-02:00 with hot and cold to drink (non-alcoholic) sweets, fruit and sweets. Incredibly generous and nicely done. The rooms are, by Paris standards, large. Clean! I'm more than happy to return!

author: Louis L
title: Excellent location and service
text:
We had a wonderful stay at Hotel 123 Sébastopol and would happily recommend it to anyone visiting Paris.

From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcome. There is such a warm and friendly atmosphere that staying here felt a little like coming home. The service is excellent, and the team really goes out of their way to make your stay special.

A special thank you to Juan-Luis, Debora, Dost, Ion, and Mourad, who made our stay such a great one. Their kindness, hospitality, and personal attention made all the difference.

The location is another big plus—perfect for discovering Paris and enjoying everything the city has to offer. And after a day of exploring, it was always a pleasure to come back to the hotel.

If you’re looking for a hotel where you can experience Paris while also truly enjoying the place you’re staying, Hotel 123 Sébastopol is a fantastic choice. We would definitely stay here again!

author: Katie K
title: This is a review and a very good review 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
text:
A welcome, an atmosphere, a decor
Everything was perfect 
Delicious breakfast 🥐
The tea room and its lovely terrace 
A very nice surprise 🍰
Thank you for these good times spent at your place 
It deserves an Oscar 🎬 !!!!!!
Christine and Rafaele

author: Alice T
title: Great stay and service beyond expectations
text:
Thank you for the great stay and kind, helpful people! The family suite was perfect for our needs with a family of 4, and everything with the location and amenities worked out as we hoped. 
I want to call out Chahd and the housekeeping team for their amazing support recovering and sending me a lost item. It had immense sentimental value, and I was distraught at having lost it. I emailed the hotel in what I thought was a long shot recovery. It was amazing and relieving to hear back quickly from Chahd and to have an honest and helpful team work hard to get the item back to me, mailing it to another country. It would have been easy for someone along the way to take it or simply to not have bothered to help. I was entirely at their mercy, and I'll forever be grateful. Thank you!!

author: Oliver I
title: City break
text:
Very friendly and attentive staff, excellent sense of customer service.

I recommend it!

author: George F
title: Perfect place to stay in Paris
text: Really had a great time in Paris and what a treat it was to stay at this hotel. Amazing service and perfect location. 10/10 to this hotel and special thanks to Mr. Dost for making our special morning coffee. Loved it will visit again soon.

author: Liam J
title: Relaxing hotel
text:
What a great experience we had at this hotel. From the moment we entered the building it was like stepping into another world. The atmosphere was so peaceful and a lot of attention to detail has gone into the style and hotel decorations to make this hotel stand out from the others. 
Every staff member that we encountered went above and beyond to make sure that our stay was as perfect as possible.  I would definitely recommend this hotel to others

author: Kyle D
title: Terrible security
text: Terrible security. We had to hand our key in when we left the hotel and when we returned it was a different member of staff on reception who did not check who we were- we just said a room number and he handed us the key. Anyone could walk in and say a room number and they just hand over the key without even checking the name! Glad we only stayed one night. Also charged 2,50€ for a tiny bottle of water and did not offer any tap water. Bright light outside the hotel made it hard to sleep.  Shame as location was ideal for us.

author: Samuel Y
title: Good hotel
text: Very good experience, warm staff, spotless and very quiet room

author: Ian Q
title: I didn't mind it at all!
text: Hotel very close to the station, practically across the street, very convenient. We were on the 6th floor, in a dormer room, characteristic. Small, but nothing was missing; courteous staff, lobby with amenities. If it happens, I will go back!

author: Miguel F
title: Luke Combs Concert Paris
text: We have nothing bad to say about the hotel at all, All staff were so helpfull, the local ammenities to the hotel was exceptional, only minutes from the hotel, Breakfast is well worth the Euro's, Would reccommend this hotel for any sort of travel break

author: Zoe L
title: Perfect!
text:
Superb hotel, decorated with care, our room was very pleasant with a small balcony with a view of the Gare de Lyon.
The location is perfect! The subway next door with lines 1 and 14 + RER is super convenient!
The professional staff and the breakfast were top-notch!
Of course I recommend it without hesitation!

author: Zoe R
title: I highly recommend it.
text:
Good. Very clean. Comfortable bed. 
Very decent breakfast buffet. 
Very well located near the Gare de Lyon and not very noisy. 
I highly recommend.

author: Grace R
title: If you don't speak French, consider different hotel!
text: When I booked this hotel, I was making sure that personnel are speaking English. That is very important for me because I don't speak French (English is also not my first language). The problem at this hotel was that receptionist (her name is Vida - I hope I memorized her name correctly) played that she doesn't understand English when I was asking for the room key. This situation was extremely unfriendly and on this moment, I felt very unsafety. I have to say that this was only one case for our whole stay in Paris that someone didn't want to understand English. Mostly people in Paris are very friendly and welling to help even their English sometimes is not great :-) and only the one receptionist in the Palym Hotel was not like that and i would say her behavior was very unprofessional. I would say that the hotel should push more pressure for their staff to not behave that way if they want to have international guest.

author: Alice J
title: Great hotel
text: Great hotel, ideal for Gare Lyon. The staff were all friendly and helpful. The hotel is spotlessly clean. Our room was on the top floor, massive bed, good air conditioning, spacious room and very comfortable and clean.

author: Tyler S
title: Simple
text: Well located and ideal for a solo trip as the room is small. Being a 3-star hotel, this is reflected in the staff/welcome... do not expect kindness. Could there be excessive hours? Or perhaps an understaffing that forces inexperienced extras unfamiliar with the hotel industry and its codes.

author: Lea I
title: Paris Gare de Lyon
text:
We had a great stay at this hotel, a warm welcome and very professional, the room is very comfortable. This hotel has a location very close to Gare de Lyon on foot which was convenient for us and our suitcases.
We will come back and recommend this hotel.

author: Mason D
title: Warm and well located hotel
text:
Very good stay at Hotel Palym, very well located, close to the Gare de Lyon.
The welcome is remarkable from the whole team (Mathew, Vida...) and especially Florian, who advised us good restaurant addresses throughout the stay, with attentive listening and professionalism.
Thank you very much. We will come back and recommend.

author: Zachary Y
title: Perfect location to visit Paris
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Palym during our weekend in Paris and enjoyed it very much.

The location is really convenient: just a few minutes walk from the Gare de Lyon and the Gare de Lyon metro, perfect for moving quickly around the city. It is also very close to Place de la Bastille, a lively area full of restaurants and clubs.

The staff was always friendly, helpful and kind.
The property is very clean and well maintained.

We recommend it especially to those arriving by train and looking for a practical and well-connected base to visit Paris without wasting time on the move.

author: Brooke S
title: Perfect.
text: The staff is welcoming, professional and stylish. A hotel in a great location, opposite the Gare de Lyon, in a quiet little street, Excellent advice for brasserie restaurants nearby. The breakfast is excellent. The rooms are very nice and very comfortable with all the modern equipment, especially for recharging computer and telephone equipment.

author: Michael G
title: Unkind and unaccommodating
text: Bad weather caused cancellations of flights and trains across Northern Europe in the first week of January 2026, requiring me to rebook my entire trip. The Palym was the ONLY hotel that would not rebook to a later date. My hotels in Amsterdam and Milan kindly understood the circumstances beyond my control and rebooked me to later dates. Not this place. At the Palym, I was meet with rudeness and obstinance. So, in a situation that was beyond my control, the Palym chose to exploit the circumstances and steal the €114. No integrity.

author: Morgan Y
title: To my come back in France I choose Palym
text: I stayed one night after a long to travel from Colombia to France. The hotel is freshly renovated. The room was a bit smaller as I had two luggage but for the time I was staying that was fine. The staff is very nice and the room was clean and modern. The hotel is very very close from Gare de Lyon station you can see it from the hotel. I recommend it.

author: Sophia D
title: Excellent hotel
text:
Conveniently located hotel close to Gare de Lyon and Metro.
Great breakfast with a wide choice of sweet (good choice of jams brioches etc..) and savory (bacon eggs scrambled cheeses various.. )
Courtesy and helpfulness of the staff..
Clean and warm rooms..
Recommended!! ****

author: Marco R
title: Convenient position
text:
We stayed one night here en route to Italy. 
Getting the RER from Gare de Nord to Gare de Lyon was very simple even with luggage and the hotel was close enough to walk. 
The hotel itself is very small and room was small but this is normal for Paris.
It’s relatively close to a whole bunch of restaurants and easy to negotiate the city. 
This is a hotel I would be happy to stay in again

author: Pablo J
title: Friendly staff makes the difference
text: Hoping to extend my thanks to Florian at the front desk who was exceptional in his friendliness, helpfulness and approchability. He certainly was a key factor in making our stay very pleasant.

author: Alice B
title: Great location, good price, impressive hotel. Loved it.
text: Chose this hotel because of its proximity to Gare de Lyon. Everything about was ideal. Friendly, helpful staff. A huge bed in good room which had everything we needed. Decorated very nicely; personally, I really liked the paintings. I'll find out more about the artist. Given how hot Paris was, the air on in the room was most welcome. In the streets outside there are lots of typical Parisian brasseries and very good bakers.  We used them readily. There was a very pleasant and cool lounge area and breakfast was available too. Overall, a very good hotel in a good location and at a good price. We intend to use it again later in the year. Cannot fault anything at all.

author: Lucy O
title: Very good value for money
text:
Book for 1 night in this hotel! Price not excessive for the Gare de Lyon sector.
Very clean room, nothing to say.
Functional air conditioning and very appreciable by this heatwave.
Friendly and friendly staff

author: Rosie U
title: Great budget option if happy to travel into Rome.
text:
Great little hotel. We had booked 2 x rooms and pre requested adjoining if possible but at check in we’re told the rooms were next to each other. On getting to the room we found both were double beds but reception were quick to send someone up to turn one room into single beds. 
The rooms were newly renovated and clean. Lacking in a USB port. One room had a massive walk in shower but my room was a small bath with a hand shower and no way of attaching to the wall so I used the other room. Disappointed that the coffee facility in the rooms were paper cups but I’m sure they would not have minded if I’d raked proper cups from breakfast. 
The hotel is a 20 min train from Romes main Termini and then a 10 min walk. 1.50 euro. 
The hotel has a small restaurant where we had daily buffet breakfast. Lovely and fresh food options, home made cakes and biscuits and the staff were happy to make me a fresh coffee rather than from the available machine. We visited the water park one day and this was only 15 minutes away via Uber.

author: Lucas X
title: Good hotel
text: Good hotel, very friendly and helpful staff.

author: Oscar I
title: Would not recommend. Left early.
text:
I booked my hotel through the Chase travel portal. The price was great esp during high season and a lot of other hotels much more expensive. 

The good:
- Able to put three people in a room for a reasonable price. This seems uncommon in Italy. 
- breakfast nice, continental style. Coffee machine the bomb
- free street parking around the block. Surprisingly safe. 
- nice family style neighborhood pizza/restaurant called 6zero9 down the street
- reasonable walking distance and access to Cornelia station with access to metro 
- did not charge us for city tax for last day when we decided to check out early.
- cleaning lady came daily to clean room. 

The bad
- breakfast is not free if room booked through Chase (which is seen as Expedia on hotel side)  -8 euro pp
- a/c not working pretty miserable as room seemed to generate heat. Mosquitos come if you leave door open to ventilate. No ETA on A/C fix. 
- shower made entire bathroom floor wet.
- toilet super high off the ground. A really weird set up. 
- poor lighting - bring a headlamp! Lights also generated a lot of heat. 
- mini fridge does not generate cold. It is more of a cooler that generates more heat. 
- no luggage rack 

Would not recommend. Poor experience.

author: Paolo Z
title: It should be removed from the IHG portfolio
text:
Terrible Experience – Completely Unacceptable for an IHG Property

We genuinely do not understand how this hotel qualifies as an IHG property. It fails to meet even the most basic standards of comfort and customer service.

First, the location is directly on one of the busiest streets imaginable. Motorcycles, trucks, and cars are constantly racing by—it honestly sounds like a war zone, with what feels like a nonstop Harley-Davidson parade. 

At check-in, the front desk associate (Steven) was friendly, but gave us no warning about the major issue awaiting us. When we entered our room, it was extremely small and very basic. Worse yet, the temperature inside was 30°C (87°F). We opened the balcony door hoping for relief, only to be hit with overwhelming street noise and mosquitoes—there is no screen.
