We called the front desk about how to operate the air conditioning, only to be told that the system had been broken all day, no technician was coming, and there was nothing that could be done. Because of the noise, we could barely hear the conversation and had to go downstairs in person.

There, we found multiple other frustrated guests in the same situation—rooms were unbearably hot with no solution. One couple had just arrived from a long flight from Korea with a ticket at 7am the next morning to visit the Coliseum, and two women was from the U.S.—all IHG members, all completely dissatisfied.

We requested a refund so we could move to another hotel, but were told that only the manager and the booking department (who would not be present until the next morning) could approve it. We then spent two hours of our vacation contacting IHG customer care, only to be told the same thing—nothing could be done until the next day.

Ironically, the lobby and bar had working air conditioning (standalone units), which made the situation even more frustrating.

So to summarize:

-The hotel had a known, property-wide air conditioning failure on a hot, humid day.
-There was no management onsite to handle the situation
-Guests were left in unsafe, unlivable conditions with no immediate solution

Ultimately, we had no choice but to find another hotel late at night. Fortunately, just behind this property we found the Ergife Palace Hotel, located in a quiet oasis with a huge pool, palm trees, spacious rooms, and a luxury breakfast buffet—all for €50 less than what we paid here. We didn't get to rest until midnight.

Even with functioning air conditioning, this hotel does not meet IHG standards due to its location, room quality, and overall guest experience. The complete lack of accountability and support only reinforces this. The next morning, we did go back to speak to a manager for our refund, he apologized and asked us to send him an email regarding the situation in order to process our request. We did as he instructed, but we have not heard from him as of now, nor have seen a refund on our credit statement. 

This property should not represent the IHG brand. Members deserve far better than being misled into staying at a substandard hotel like this.

author: Benjamin U
title: Avoid
text: Slow, small rooms, unrelyable. I recommend: do not go there

author: Poppy W
title: Worst ever hotel experience
text: Our stay at the Garner Rome Aurelia was literally the WORST and most bizarre hotel experience of my lifetime.  No exaggeration.  From the simple inability to benefit from my Diamond Elite status benefits, to the incredibly incompetent and sour puss checking, the lack of air conditioning, and then the incredibly rude and almost comical checkout from Riccardo who accused me of not paying the bill even though I showed evidence of payment through the Chase travel portal.  And then harassed me because I left my room key in the room for check out.  The hotel rooms and bathroom are also tiny and it’s on a noisy busy road outside the main attractions of Rome.  AVOID at all cost.

author: Chloe R
title: Major organizational problems
text: Unfortunately, the room is very noisy due to a faulty ventilation system. The absence of mosquito nets causes a real discomfort due to the numerous mosquitoes present in the room. Very long check-in and check-out times. The staff seems new or poorly trained in normal hotel management activities. Unfortunately, a terrible experience.

author: Isla Q
title: Nice hotel and even nicer staff!!!
text: My daughter and I stayed here for 3 nights. It is outside the central location but you can easily get a taxi to get into central Rome. Very friendly staff. Room was very spacious and comfortable. There are USB ports near the bed which is very convenient. They have good breakfast. They offer laundry services as well. There is a restaurant as well in the property that you can order food from anytime. There are some restaurants in the walking distance. Also there is a minimart nearby for buying any snacks or water bottles. One thing I want to mention is getting a taxi to the central Rome is very easy and the hotel can arrange that. But sometimes the taxi back could be a struggle as some drivers seem to avoid it as they have to move away from the central location. One day I was able to get a taxi easily and the 2nd day, it was hard. Again it could be just my experience. Besides this, we had a great time at this place. I would stay here again.

author: Liam Q
title: Exceptional Hotel
text: I have been a IHG member for over 25 years. This is the best IHG property I have stayed in. This is an authentic Roman experience. The quality of the hotel, rooms and staff is exceptional. The bus and metro are very close. The many restaurants nearby are excellent. 15 minutes via bus to the Vatican and 30 minutes to the other attractions in town. NOT a tourist area. Very authentic Rome. Highly recommend this property.

author: William A
title: Pray Hard for a Quiet Room
text:
Super noisy room by the busy street with poor noise insulation treatment to the glass door and the windows. It is just the guest's bad luck to stay at the hotel and there is nothing the hotel can do. Asked to change the room after a sleepless first night, the hotel changed the room from the first floor to the second floor, still next to the busy street!!! Unbelievable!
Just bad.

author: Morgan R
title: Lovely hotel fabulous staff
text: Fabulous hotel. Stayed for 4 nights. Lovely room lucky to get a balcony. Breakfast was of good quality always being replenished nice and fresh. About a 10 minute walk to the metro which was easy to navigate.What made our stay was the staff always helpful and nothing was a problem. Especially Alex behind the bar who made us feel like long lost friends. Would definitely stay again.

author: Lucy E
title: Simple hotel on the aurelia
text:
I stayed one night for a business trip in Rome : it 'a very simple hotel , decent room , only blackout curtains and having the house in front of a short distance would have been useful also white curtains for the day , bathroom with broken shower door, clogged shower so it fills up while you wash, as often happens.Comfortable bed , wifi without problems , simple breakfast but well assorted between sweet and salty.The only drawback you eat a kind of outdoor dehor that in these first days of October is a bit 'cold and not pleasant while having breakfast .
Very friendly staff both at reception and in the breakfast room.
Despite hotels on the very busy Via Aurelia , excellent windows and therefore the quiet room .

author: Ian N
title: When in Rome
text: Nicely placed outside of Vatican City. An hours walk to the Vatican. However it’s a 10 minute walk to the Metro. Loading a 24hr card at €8:50. Approx £6/7. Gets you tube hopping around the city and outskirts at will. Very clean and welcoming hotel with friendly staff. Lovely outside terrace. Free WiFi. And towel and bedding changes each day. Only drawback is no English speaking channels in the 50+ choices as it’s all Italian.  I would say. A room with a balcony is a must. As we saw a room without and they’re a touch small. We did have a small issue. Which the staff resolved. Very quickly and to our satisfaction. Well stocked breakfast. Ignore the comments of where it’s located. For those writing this. May need to look at where they live. Overall. I would stay here again. When in Rome. It’s away from the hustle and bustle of Vatican City. Only negative is that it’s a pricey taxi fare from the airport. Varying from €120 to €240. So maybe a transfer if alone or in a couple would be better.

author: Olivia L
title: Great mini break!
text:
Stayed for 3 nights 2-5th June. The hotel was lovely, our room was on the top floor and was modern, bright and spotlessly clean. All of the hotel staff were super friendly and happy to assist. A special mention to Loredana at the bar/restaurant who was always smiling and nothing was too much trouble for her. She made our stay extra special. 
The hotel is a little further from the main attractions than we anticipated, it’s approximately a 1hr walk to the Vatican but the hotel will call a taxi and there are buses/underground close by. Once in the city you can walk to the attractions but they are not all close together. Would recommend using the hop on/hop off open top bus companies that are everywhere to get to each point.

author: Alice J
title: The Smooth hotel Rome
text:
Excellent hotel 
Very high standard of cleanliness and all staff very helpful, curtious and totally professional all times
A very warm and pleasant hotel in which to stay
Will use again when back in Rome 
Good public transportation systems around Rome from the hotel

author: Sean B
title: Good Hotel near Metro station
text:
Good bits- near to metro station- line A- easy to get around Rome. Hotel itself is very clean, excellent breakfast and bar, friendly staff, great service. 
Bad bits- snagging issues, wire sticking out of floor board, no skirting board, buzzing from fuse box, no air conditioning, had to have window open during day and night, got bitten by mosquitos and kept awake by traffic noise. 
The area is a bit unkempt, rubbish everywhere, traffic noise. 
There are a couple of good restaurants 6Zero1 and Ferro Ghisa at the cross roads.

author: Holly B
title: 4 nights stay, part of Jet2.com city break. Unsatisfactory shower facility.
text:
The room was clean and staff were friendly. Breakfast was good. However, the shower head just dribbled , water almost not running and no tap diversion to fill the bath was possible. I mentioned it to the reception at the first morning but I was told that the hotel was full, to expect some drop in water pressure! 
I have never experienced such poor excuse when the shower did not work well

author: Carlos A
title: Lovely hotel
text:
The hotel is great!
Friendly staff
The lobby/restaurant are is clean 
Room was a good size and was clean.
Great price too for 2 nights and with breakfast included. 
The breakfast selection was good.
I had a positive experience and would book it again.

author: Sophia Q
title: I'll go back dark
text:
Courtesy availability and attention to the customer make the stay a moment of relaxation cozy environment and fully renovated rooms
The staff is always available from breakfast to dinner to add if not included in the package with reasonable prices 
Excellent cleanliness of the rooms

author: Ella V
title: Good hotel ( few issues )
text:
Excellent friendly staff throughout the stay 
Clean rooms  brilliant . 

Only down fall was no wifi ( kept kicking u off) or not working and a fridge in the room that over heated ( reported first day ) no one came . I had to remove from the sealed unit as I was smelling burning and the drinks were boiled .. and then stopped completely ( reported again) no one came . 
Was given ice from bar when asked so that was ok . As a cold drink in your room at the end of the day is usually very pleasant .

author: Pablo C
title: A litte smelly
text:
A good hotel. Close to the stations with good service. 

Unfortunately the only downside was the sewage smell that lingered. We were on the 6th floor,  and it was worst outside in the corridor but our room smelled musty.

Can't fault the cleanliness as the room was spotless and the view was amazing.

As others have noted there was a sporadic rumble caused by the nearby metro. 

Good value just a shame about the smell!

author: Sofia Y
title: Lovely Hotel Near Stations, Minor Smell Issue
text: A really lovely hotel that we enjoyed a lot. It's super close to the stations and the service was genuinely helpful throughout our stay. The only downside was a sewage smell that lingered around the place. We stayed on the 6th floor and it was worst out in the corridor, though our room did smell a bit musty too. That said, I can't fault the cleanliness at all because the room was absolutely spotless and the view was amazing. Like other guests have mentioned, there was a sporadic rumble from the nearby metro that you could hear now and then. Honestly it's very good value for money and the location can't be beaten, just a real shame about that smell because otherwise it would have been a completly perfect trip. We'd still happily come back and would recommend it to anyone visiting Paris on a budget.

author: Aaron N
title: Always happy to return
text: I have been coming to this establishment for many years. Especially in the summer, I appreciate the air conditioning and mini-fridge. The location is unbeatable and the staff (from reception to cleaning staff) are super nice and always helpful. The small balcony made drying my swimwear easy. Facing the front, you even have a view of Sacré-Cœur. (But I prefer the quieter rooms in the back)

author: Pierre O
title: It was not a privilege to stay in a privilege double room.
text:
Upon arrival(having been travelling since 3am) we had to wait a further hour and a half for our rooms to be ready even though check in is 2pm. 
The privilege double room was a lot smaller than expected. The room was quite dark and some lights were not working. The hair dryer was not working and the shower head left a lot to be desired(standing in a shower of rain would have had better results) 
The area for the hotel is VERY noisy so bring earplugs if you want to actually sleep. The pillows are uncomfortable and lumpy.
The breakfast was minimal to say the least, we ventured down for a look one morning with the hopes of having a nice buffet. We were told the pancakes/crepes were finished and the rest of the buffet could fit easily on a kitchen sideboard( for €14pp there were very few options,we went elsewhere) 
Simple things like toilet paper is also an issue as we were expected to use less than half a roll between two adults from one room refresh to the other(they didn’t leave any if there was half a roll left in the room) and we had to keep asking for it when we arrived back from sight seeing each day.
Also the room manager walked in on my daughter while she was in the room, he was doing room checks but rather than wait for a reply he simply opened the door and stuck his head in to see was the room cleaned! 
My daughter was very distraught as she could have been changing or showering when he opened the door! 
Having the train station across the road is good for sight seeing.

author: Hannah G
title: Perfect!
text: We come here often, next to the Gare de l'Est, beautiful hotel, beautiful room and bathroom, everything very clean! Beautiful common areas and a very good breakfast. Efficient and friendly staff.....that is why we keep coming back!!

author: Charlotte L
title: Bustling location which we love
text: Excellent location, helpful staff. Nice to have a lift. Breakfast okay, more fun to visit local brasseries. Most rooms hear/feel some metro noise, which we found soothing. We will almost certainly be back.

author: Diego V
title: Well located but…
text: It’s well located, steps from Gare de l’Est but someone came knocking at our door at 11 pm and opened our door claimimg “security reasons”. He did the same to someone across the hall too. Not clear what he meant

author: Emma B
title: Just what we needed
text:
I visited with my son and only stayed 1 night as we were just going to a concert. 
We arrived before our check in time and paid extra for early check in because we were shattered. The lovely lady on reception (whose name I have forgotten) was absolutely wonderful. I paid for privilege but was upgraded to club. Our room was 511 and faced the back so we didn’t hear any street noise just sirens every now and again. You can still hear the slight rumbles from the metro but didn’t bother us at all. We checked out at 12pm and they allowed me to store my luggage so we could pop to a couple of shops before heading home. Great that the rooms had fridges so we could store some bottles of water. 
I can’t comment on the breakfast as we didn’t have any but it smelt great. 
The only negative I do have is on the day of check out the bathroom had a bad smell of sewage which was off putting. 
Location of the hotel is great especially for public transport. 
If we come back to Paris we will stay again.

author: Juan S
title: Outstanding Customer Service by Fallon!
text:
I had a wonderful stay at Libertel Gare de l’Est Français, and I especially want to highlight the exceptional service from the front desk staff member named Fallon (apologies if I’m spelling that incorrectly). She was incredibly welcoming from the moment we arrived and consistently went above and beyond throughout our stay.

I saw her helping guests at the desk, assisting in the kitchen when things got busy, and even tidying up outside the hotel. She always took the time to answer our questions with patience and kindness. Her dedication truly made our stay memorable.

The hotel itself was very nice, comfortable, and in a great location, but Fallon’s outstanding customer service is what really stood out!

author: Sophia X
title: Good Location
text: We had a pretty good stay. The hotel was clean and the staff was helpful and nice. The rooms were small but clean. This hotel is in a great location. There's a bus stop right in front, the metro is a few feet away AND one of the high speed train stations is only 500 ft away. With that being said, it is a loud area and you can hear that from your room. It's also located in the 10th arr. so it's about 15-20 minutes away from the major tourist sites . If it's your first time visiting Paris it may present a challenge when going sightseeing. Overall it was an good stay.

author: Grace P
title: So uneven.
text:
We spent 3 nights in this hotel located a few steps from Gare de l'Est:

Positive:
Breakfast
Cleanliness of place and room
Bedroom and bathroom layout
Bedding quality

Negative:
Noise! Room 310 (street side), awakened very suddenly before 6:00 am by a horrible jackhammer sound following work in the building adjacent to the hotel. You can't keep an eye out for it, since the work never stopped. Request for change of room accepted, the 501 (facing the back of the hotel) is assigned to us but is logically not ready. We drop off our things at the luggage storage and leave for a day visit. Returning in the evening, no possibility to collect our luggage since we are told the door of the luggage store is totally blocked. The hotel does not have any toiletries and so we have to buy the minimum in a nearby supermarket. The receptionist tells us that we will be compensated for this incident (nice words since nothing has been done to date). We will only be able to pick up our luggage the next day at 10:00, when we notice the lock of the luggage completely blown up.
Room 501 is beautifully furnished and of beautiful surface for Paris. The concern is that it adjoins a pushy elevator that makes thud every time it goes up (like a person banging on a hammer on the other side of the wall). 

In summary: 3 bad nights in a beautiful hotel!

author: Henry R
title: Awful breakfasts.
text: We booked two rooms, from April 21 to 24. The hotel clean and the rooms also clean and presentable. The review of the breakfasts, HORRIBLE!!!!. They did not respond, and breakfasts very very very scarce.

author: Adam J
title: Good professional stay
text: Hotel near the Gare de l'Est de Paris, close to all amenities. Welcoming and pleasant staff, comfortable room, spacious enough bathroom.

author: Alexander G
title: Hotel very nice
text: Very nice hotel. Modern and spacious. The rooms are very comfortable and the breakfast hearty for a rate of 14 euros. We have been here twice and will be back with great pleasure.

author: Diego Y
title: Super well located for using public transport. Trade and markets very close
text: Great location to get to and from to visit sites and sightseeing

author: Jack P
title: Very satisfied
text: It is a hotel in front of the train station very clean with a neat decoration and quality service

author: Brooke U
title: Overpriced breakfast , poor hospitality but good room
text: Very good location close to the station and reasonable price which is ideal, metro very close by which is great for travelling around. The hotel itself is very clean and comfortable the rooms are well designed and have everything you need. Bed very comfortable. The only thing I will say is that the staff don’t greet you when you come and go, they do not really interact or acknowledge you which is quite poor and feels unwelcoming. Breakfast is very overpriced we were quite shocked at the cost and the lack of selection. We were not able to choose where we sat and ended up being moved into a tiny cramped corner. There wasn’t much selection for the cost and the food was cold within seconds of being on my plate. We chose to eat out after this as it is not worth it at all. We were downstairs at 8.30 and there was minimal food. Also found the host quite overbearing and unpolite. Unsure if we came on a bad day but it felt uncomfortable. Over all would stay again because the rooms were great, I just feel the hospitality and breakfast could be improved.

author: Juan T
title: All right.
text: Great location when you leave from East Station. Charming staff, especially Fannon. And the breakfast man.

author: David S
title: Recommended
text: Friendly staff, nice room!

author: Liam I
title: Excellent price/location/quality ratio
text: Very nice hotel, friendly and efficient staff.  Room was small but very well organized and very clean. The breakfast lady was extremely nice and helpful!

author: Luke I
title: Convenient
text: Perfect location, near Penn Station and a 15-minute walk from Times Square. Clean room and comfortable bed, with air conditioning and a large TV. Breakfast from 6 to 10, with little choice and some mix-ups. One day they couldn't find the cutlery and another day the delivery hadn't arrived, so no breakfast. Well... A little more cleanliness in the dining room wouldn't hurt. Chairs and carpet that give you the creeps.

author: Aiden E
title: Great location
text:
Great location
Attention they have withdrawn a larger amount than due after check out.Be careful.

author: Sophia H
title: Very good hotel for day use.
text: We went to this hotel for day use. Pleasant welcome and quick check-in at the reception, where we were informed that we could stay until 9 PM (instead of 8 PM as indicated on the website we used). Clean and comfortable room, and especially very quiet. High-performance Wi-Fi. We were able to rest well before heading to our flight. Note that the hotel is ideally located near Penn Station, the Empire State Building, and a 15-minute walk from Times Square.

author: Mathis O
title: Stay at the top
text:
Ideal location, between The Edge and Empire State. Room not large but very functional, bedding at the top, bathroom too. Hearty sweet and sufficiently renewed salty breakfast.
Perfect Wifi connection.
Excellent value for money.

author: Claire G
title: A Charming Stay at a Great Location
text: First of all, I loved the attention Adriana gave me while answering all my pre-stay questions through the Hilton app. I truly appreciate that level of care! Upon arrival, I was delighted to learn that breakfast was included. My room was lovely and spacious, and the location is perfect as it is close to everything. It was an excellent experience, and the entire front desk team was very friendly.

author: Gavin E
title: Liar and malhonete
text: We arrived at this hotel on Sunday evening we had to pay a $250 deposit which will be refunded to us afterwards if no breakage or consumption of the mini bar etc ... we had a pleasant stay in its entirety just a cockroach below in our shower on Thursday morning. Why dishonest because on Thursday evening returning from our day I asked the receptionist to h we had to return the card of our room the next Friday day of departure knowing that our flight was at 8:30 pm. The receptionist tells us 3pm we express our surprise and tell him that my husband will be able to take a nap before departure because then the journey is long to return so perfect. On Friday morning 8am we were ready so we went to lunch and then walk until 12pm. My husband went back to the room to get some sleep and I came home at 2:30pm to empty the room on time. Arriving at the hotel my card no longer worked to go upstairs and there I ask a young woman not kind at all from the reception who tells me that the Check out was at 11am, I tell her that her colleague the day before had told us 3pm this one tells me no it is 11am so 25$ of the extra half hour. Of course I told her that it was out of the question because I had asked the day before not to get there and she did not want to know anything. Another colleague takes over and tells me that she called her manager who tells her to bill $50 instead of the basic amount I also refuse and asks that her colleague who misinformed me to come forward she tells me that he is off. After several minutes or I refuse payment the person tells me on Google trad that he validated so that we do not get charged so we leave confident except that arrived in France I receive a message from Revolut telling me that the hotel bills me the $50 he keeps of the basic deposit so here is the malhonete of the hotel he tells us no billing knowing that we go back to France and then bills us while it is bad information given by a receptionist. I suspect the fact that they give bad information to charge more to customers do not get fooled as I may have been.

author: Benjamin O
title: No warm water
text: Freezing water, tap and shower cold the entire 4 days I’ve been here. Run around answers and  “solutions” of letting the water run for 10 mins which does NOT work and no one has time for.

author: Kyle W
title: Fine for a Short Stay
text: This was a standard Hampton Inn located close to Penn Station. We got in late, so needed to grab a room just for the overnight. The room was very small, but neat and clean. Nicely decorated lobby, and a friendly staff made for a satisfactory short stay.

author: Samuel Y
title: Hotel in absolute TOP location
text:
We booked the room in Feb.2026 for four. It's a bit narrow but functional for four. Very positive to highlight is the top location in which the hotel is located!!!!
A few minutes walk to many attractions and Penn Station. It is also just opposite a great and clean supermarket.
Breakfast is ok and available from 06:00 for early explorers.
The staff at the reception and breakfast room was always available and always eager for concerns and also very friendly! What we didn't know, that you have to deposit with your credit card!
The room was always clean and the cleaning staff was always friendly and attentive to any request and always had a little smile ready!

Unfortunately, there is also a deduction of points;
The hotel is already very old. It urgently needs renovation, especially the rooms look very worn out!
We had a musty smell in the room but couldn't tell if it came from the air conditioning or the bathroom!
Also the furniture in the reception area and also in the breakfast room were sat through and partly heavily worn!

On the whole, the hotel is fine and we would still book it again!

author: Molly S
title: Positive experience thanks to a clean and comfortable room.
text: Clean and comfortable room. The heating is sometimes noisy. I changed rooms as soon as I arrived at night. Passage of the housekeeping service every day. Cool lobby and breakfast room, deserving of a good renovation to be worthy of a Hilton chain hotel. Close to line 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 Q etc which is very convenient. Presence of sdf right in front of the hotel which denotes a bit.

author: Jack G
title: Wonderful Time
text:
We have just got back from 4 nights staying here. Booked due being near to Penn Station. Location was great! 

We had a 2 x double bed room that overlooked the front of the hotel. Yes it was noisy but it is in the middle of the city! 

The room was clean and warm. Comfortable and exactly what we needed and expected for the money. 

Breakfast was included which was great and enough to fuel us for the day. It did get busier in the dining area after 8am so get there earlier if you prefer it quieter. The make your own waffles were a hit! 

All the staff we met were kind and helpful. We came back to a clean, made up room each day.

The only downside (on just one day) was the lift seemed to be out of order. Only one (of the two) was working so it caused  big delays in trying to get in as it was too full each time. 
We walked down but from the 11th floor it was a lot! My mum struggled with this. She couldn’t climb up either so we just had to wait.

Apart from that we thoroughly enjoyed our time in New York and would definitely stay there again in the future. I would also recommend it to my friends and family.

author: Louis L
title: Quoted $150/night, charged nearly $900. Misled at check‑in and dismissed when I raised the issue.
text:
I stayed at the Hampton Inn Madison Square Garden on a business trip with a group of high school exchange students. I originally booked two rooms, but upon arrival I realized the rooms were much smaller than expected. Because of this, I asked about adding a third room to better accommodate my group.

At check‑in, the front desk staff member verbally quoted me a rate of approximately $150 per night for the additional room. I clarified and repeated the numbers back to her to make sure we both understood the rate... especially since she appeared distracted, talking on the phone and with another employee during the process. Based on that information, I agreed to book the third room.

However, when I later saw the final bill, the charges for that third room totaled close to $890, which was nowhere near the price I was quoted. I was never told that the nightly rates fluctuated drastically from day to day, and this lack of communication directly affected my decision to book the extra room.

When I contacted Hilton Guest Assistance, every response focused solely on explaining how their rate structure can change nightly... something I already understood. What was not addressed was the actual issue: I was misquoted the rate at check‑in, and that misinformation led me to make a decision I would not have made otherwise.

As someone who travels frequently with students and books multiple rooms at Hilton/Hampton properties each year, this experience has caused me to seriously question the brand’s transparency and reliability. Being provided correct information at check‑in should be a basic expectation, and Hilton’s unwillingness to acknowledge the misquote or offer a meaningful resolution was extremely disappointing.

I hope the hotel takes this feedback seriously. Guests deserve accurate, distraction‑free communication. Especially when making decisions that significantly affect their stay and budget.

author: Zoe Q
title: Excellent stay
text: We arrived around 12:30pm and were able to check in early.  Room w/1 king bed surprisingly large for being a hotel in NYC.  Breakfast area was very busy, but the staff did a great job keeping things well stocked.  We had a 4pm train departure on our check out date and our small roller bag was able to be kept in a secure area while we explored the city.  Very friendly staff!!  Would absolutely stay here again.

author: Grace Y
title: Birthday in NYC
text:
The staff are helpful, kind, hardworking!! The breakfast was warm and good each morning. There was plenty of options and lots of coffee! 
There was only one small elevator that worked for 18 floors! We often had to take the stairs up and down many flights! 
Our room was clean! The hotel needs a decor update in a big way! It is located so near Madison square garden and Bryant Park!

author: Joseph T
title: Quietest Room
text: Hotel is basic, in need of a refurb, however room was spotless, shower was hot and towels were fluffy, breakfast was nice and plenty choice if your up for 6 am, it is paper plates and bowls and plastic knives and forks, but it’s fine for what it is, staff very friendly, best of all never heard a thing through night you would not know you were in the heart of NY, perfect location for everything, Penn Station and Madison Square Gardens are down street and to the left, Statue of Liberty at top  of Street a couple blocks away, highly recommend the restaurant on same street as hotel Friedmans, went for dinner and breakfast food was great

author: Giulia P
title: Just the basics.
text: The hotel is very outdated. Furniture is worn and unappealing in lobby and breakfast room. Rooms are very basic. Bed was clean and comfortable and staff was excellent but don’t expect anything else.

author: Leo A
title: Wonderful stay
text: Hotel is clean. Staff are friendly. Free breakfast was great, different choices each day. Location was close to subway stop. Highly recommend.

author: Alice E
title: No bells and whistles but CLEAN
text: Had to get on and leave a review because some of the reviews made me second guess staying here. We arrived Tuesday before Thanksgiving and stayed through Sunday. We booked 2 rooms. Our girls room, the AC was making a loud squeaking noise when we got to the room. I called front desk and they had maintenance come up right away to fix the issue. Which was great! We had zero issues with the hotel. It’s exactly what we expected at a Hampton Inn. We travel all over due to daughters doing travel sports. So this isn’t our first or last stay at a Hampton Inn. No bells and whistles, but CLEAN and the staff was always very kind as we came in and out. We loved the location of the hotel. We were able to get everywhere we wanted and it’s close to a subway station. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Grace Q
title: Probably wouldn’t stay here again
text: Although this place wasn’t terrible, it didn’t make us want to book it anytime again soon or record to others. We usually stay in higher end places when we come to New York, but we were looking for something relatively reasonable/close to Madison Square, Gardens. We were just there for the night for a concert and wanted to a place to lay our heads. We have stayed at a number of Hampton Inns over the years when travelling with our kid’s  sports teams and have had much better experiences. The lobby and breakfast area were very tired with torn upholstery in both areas. The rooms themselves were clean. The beds and pillows were comfortable enough Amenities were fine. I felt like the heating/AC system was something out of the 1970s. It woke us up fairly often throughout the night. The breakfast was decent as well. One thing that upset us was that our bags that we dropped off were literally just left in the lobby for anyone to take. They were backpacks. There was a tag on them, but nobody was watching them. We had our computers in them. We were under the impression they were going to be securely stored. We also didn’t find the staff overly friendly or helpful. We had to go to the front desk at least three times to find out if our room was ready.

author: Alice A
title: Never again
text:
Hotrl in great location.stop. the rest is to forget.
Rude staff, worn furniture, old and dirty carpets, dirty sheets and towels, breakfast from discount.Rooms with large beds but so small that you can not even open your suitcases, tiny closet.Out of the hotel at night stretches of homeless camped because the area is a bit 'decentralized.
If you go to New York look for a 4 star hotel because if the 3 stars are like that you will ruin your holiday.

author: Miguel T
title: The best thing is the location
text: A fairly basic hotel, but it delivers for the price-quality ratio. I booked it for one night to be close to the station to take the train early in the morning. The staff is friendly.

author: Elena L
title: Memorable stay
text: Very convenient and central location.  Quite environment. Nice and cozy. Affordable with value for money. Absolutely very clean. The staffs, specially Mr Marco, Ms Ida and Mr Jovani were very nice and helpful. Thank you for making our days memorable in Roma.

author: Daisy H
title: Awful customer service
text: Don’t do it! I reserved a room for 5 days. After reading many reviews about people arriving and having non-working A/C, I needed to confirm that our room would have a working A/C unit as we would be traveling with people (with medical issues) & medications that could not withstand certain temps. I sent 2 emails with no response and then tried to call the hotel. A woman answered & said “this is not for confirmations, lady”, I explained what I was trying to verify & was hung up on. Tried to call back more than 15 times throughout the day & was hung up on every time.

author: Harry C
title: Great experience
text: Location really good, easy to explore the city. Atmosphere cozy and the staff is so friendly. Room was small but just enough for sleeping. Value for the money is excellent. I am sure to come back also next time. Thank you🩷

author: Nora K
title: A train brought me to safety.
text: Rome is definitely among the most beautiful cities in the world, and I love spending weekends there. This time, however, I was just passing through, and I needed a place to spend Sunday night while waiting to catch the train the next morning. I will start with the positive aspects: the proximity to Termini Station. The facility is really just 50 meters from the entrance of the train terminal. There were no issues with check-in, despite the late hour; after all, I had made sure to inform the hotel several times by phone about my arrival around midnight. Unfortunately, the list of pros ends miserably here. The rest was a nightmare. I had booked a single room for about €100, so I did not expect much. But certainly, I did not deserve to stay in the staff room. Of course, those who work in hospitality will always have my esteem and respect, but the dignity of the customer must still be respected. The small room assigned to me faced DIRECTLY onto the small breakfast room: something between absurd and embarrassing. The small thin wooden door, of course, could never have shielded the room, and so I had the honor of having breakfast with all the hotel guests. But, unfortunately, much worse had happened during the night: I simply found myself in the water. The bidet's drain was not working, and the water simply flooded the bathroom and part of the room. Some of my clothes got wet. At 2 in the morning, I contacted the night porter, who, upon arriving in the room, could do nothing but assess the situation, and nothing more. And so I fell asleep in a semi-flooded room. After the hotel guests "unintentionally invited" me to breakfast, I crossed the threshold and joined them. Just enough time to enjoy a rather unappetizing brioche and a piece of tart, then I decided to finish breakfast with a coffee and a cappuccino. Unfortunately, when I returned from the machine to my little table, I found it cleared of the saucer and cutlery, and already occupied by two other guests. I tried to ask the waiter for an explanation, who simply invited me to take another table. The disbelief was great, but fortunately I had a train waiting for me not far away. I managed to wash my teeth and face (fortunately the sink's drain was different from that of the bidet), I put the pajamas back in the suitcase and fled. I have never been so happy to check out. At the time of paying the tourist tax, I took advantage of the presence of what I believe was the owner of the establishment to inform her of the "small" inconvenience with the bathroom (I limited myself, out of pity, to just that). She had already been informed by the night porter. Unfortunately, a sudden phone call did not allow her to apologize properly. Fortunately, I had a train waiting for me. I have elaborated on this story, but the experience was truly traumatic, even though it was very brief. I sincerely hope that the other rooms are normal (I saw that the keys, unlike mine, were magnetic), but in case you need a single room, only accept it following a good offer: personally, I would not agree to relive this stay even if they offered me 50 euros. I find it hard to believe that I had to pay for that "room."

author: Evie A
title: Avoid, horrible!
text:
Accommodation conditions are well below the standards expected for a business trip:

- extremely small room, of about 5 m2 at most, unsuitable for a working stay  
- bed of about 70 cm allocated under the pretext of a “single” reservation, which is misleading and unacceptable in terms of comfort  
- bedroom door defective, visibly forced and unstable, moving during the night, which poses a real security problem  
- very inadequate overall cleanliness: heavy dust, bedding and pillows in a state of hygiene worrying  
- ageing, poorly maintained establishment  
Concerning services:
- very poor quality breakfast, with almost no offer  
- unacceptable hygienic conditions, including pastries placed in cartons on a staircase  
Finally, the immediate surroundings of the hotel are particularly noisy and dangerous. The neighborhood did not seem safe to me, with the visible presence of drug addicts around the area, which is very worrying, especially for a single woman on a business trip.
