author: Evie E
title: Disappointing hotel experience
text:
I stayed at this hotel, the first week in April and was a very disappointing experience. 
The AC in the room didn't work, the safe was broken, there was no coffee making facilities, not even a kettle. The bar was not in use and clearly had not been for a long time. The photographs on their web site are old pictures, I would say at least 5 years, probably more like 10. The hotel does not misrepresent themselves and certainly does not deserve '3 Stars'. I reported this to my booking agent (Expedia) but did not get a reply.

author: Poppy Z
title: Excellent value for money
text: We had a great time. The location, two blocks from Termini Station, is ideal for being able to move by public transport throughout the center. The area is full of hotels and restaurants and in the evening there is no security problem. The staff is very friendly and we could leave our luggage even after check out time (they have a reserved and locked area). Cleanliness, both general and rooms, is excellent. Very good and plentiful breakfast, both sweet and savory. Competitive price

author: Olivia Y
title: AVOID
text:
Don't stay here! I can't believe this is a 3 star hotel. Sleep is impossible as the air-conditioning was not switched on and the room was boiling hot. If you open the window it is so noisy all night you can't sleep anyway. I love a firm mattress but these beds were like slabs of concrete. My daughter went to open the bathroom door and the handle literally fell off in her hand and another shelf in the bathroom was hanging by a thread. 
We barely slept for the three nights we were there and with the exception of one lovely gentleman,  the reception staff especially the lady were rude and dismissive with no customer service skills whatsoever.  
Breakfast is really basic and not worth getting up for. The only positive thing I can say is that it is in a good location,  close to the station. I have stayed in 1 star hotels that were significantly better than this. 
If you want to enjoy rome after a good night's sleep avoid at all costs!

author: Evie A
title: Roman holidays
text: Great in everything! Fair price, a stone's throw from the station and the center. He immediately gave us a map and explained how to get around the city. Great cleaning, daily clean sheets and towels! TV, comfortable bed, bathroom as well, quiet. Great breakfast buffet, luggage storage until the train leaves! Recommended absolutely!

author: Julien Z
title: Medium hotel
text: A moderate hotel with very poor sound insulation we heard the neighbors taking a bath and putting a pistolet. The morning underneath the medium poor quality eggs and bayas were crushing. The lady at the reception when we left and we completed the payment not a thank you said. The only positive was the cleanliness and location.

author: Oliver G
title: Comfortable, well located and with great service
text:
This is the second time we stayed in this hotel. The first time, we had a much better room and not facing the street, which was excellent. On this second stay, the room was facing the street, which is sometimes quite busy and can make some noise.

The Marco, from the reception, is simply loving and always makes the stay much more cozy. Gives great restaurant suggestions and makes all the difference in the experience.

Breakfast is simple and reasonable, not very large, but perfectly serves the purpose.

As a point to improve, I would say only the possibility of a room not facing the street and a little larger bathroom.

We loved the stay and will undoubtedly come back to stay here. The location is excellent: only 5 minutes walk from Termini station, with direct buses to and from the airport. We were always walking to the Coliseum and Fontana di Trevi, and there are many good restaurants around.

Price quality is excellent and we highly recommend.

author: Giulia B
title: Well located
text:
Hotel near Termini station and restaurants, friendly and helpful reception staff, clean, delicious breakfast.
The negative the position of the room in the vicinity of the restaurent.

author: Oliver G
title: Friendly staff, good price, great location
text: The staff was great, shout out to Marco, at reception, who made us feel at home. The breakfast staff was also very friendly and helpful. The rooms were decent and always very clean. We had two rooms booked for Christmas !week, and our party was made up of six, including children. People who complained/gave a bad review booked a 3 star hotel and expected 5 star facilities. The location is great as it is well served by public transport, especially considering how chaotic transport in Rome is.

author: Morgan E
title: Fantastic stay
text:
A hotel worth choosing for it's location, cleanliness, good breakfast and most of all the nice staff. Marco, who is very friendly, at reception goes out of his way to help out.
We will definitely go there again.

author: Antoine F
title: Wonderful staff, great value & location
text:
I was welcomed with a bright smile, a  few jokes and, on top of that, I was allowed to drop my bag in the room at 10:15 am as it was already vacant & cleaned. I found this very generous.
The hotel is conveniently located 1min away from the train station Roma Termini and you can walk easily into the city centre.
The room was cute (single bed) and had heating, hairdryer and a fridge. The bathroom was nicely decorated with mosaic tiles and the shower was hot & powerful. I enjoyed the view from the room into a bustling street in the morning.
The breakfast was good with cold cuts, cheese, pastries and lots of coffee.
I found the entire building well maintained and very clean. Most importantly, the staff was super friendly and always ready for a little chat!

author: Wyatt Y
title: Bad customer experience
text: I have booked this hotel for our stay and our flight was canceled while we were on the plane, the hotel did not offer us any compensarion or option to change dates or any interest in our sitation, they just denied our request. Do not book this hotel, very bad customer relation experience.

author: Owen G
title: Kindness is not his virtue...
text: All employees of the reception without the virtue of kindness. Anything you ask, they make you look "nothing." You ask for ice and they don't have it. The refrigerator in the room did not cool and warn. I also found it more expensive to book by the hotel website than by booking. The only good thing is that it's 2 blocks from termini. DON'T EXPECT A SMILE or to be helped.

author: Katie L
title: Simple but cheap and very well placed
text:
was simple, basic but very well placed: A stone's throw from the train station ( convenient when coming from the airport ) and within easy walking distance of many places to visit.
An establishment that offered very high prices per night (March) for a (tiny) single room (no need for more )
The host is very nice.
Very lively area with lots of restaurant, cafe ... around.
Very good wifi

Disliked · The floor was not well swept (dusty underfoot )
Soundproofing (interior and exterior) is lacking but nothing very embarrassing
Very basic (but sufficient) breakfast

author: Diego Z
title: Well placed, but extremely noisy!!!!
text: Well placed, clean, simple and hearty breakfast. For the rest, I had a single room with street view. An ordeal! Mattress collapsed with a spring that had failed.I had to turn the mattress over to try to sleep, but it was barely lost. Room poorly soundproofed, no blackout curtains so it is daytime in the room (even at night). Busy and extremely noisy street (restaurants close at 1am, then those are drunks screaming. At 2am it is the sweeper, at 4am the garbage collectors, at 6am the deliveries). A horror!

author: Luca A
title: Little Caterina
text:
Our room was located on the first floor far from the reception (so I did not see the rest of the property), I can say that the location was excellent for moving towards the main attractions of Rome.
The room was very small for three people, but clean.

author: Evan T
title: Nearby hotel in the centre of Rome! Obs no elevator!
text: Nearby hotel in the centre of Rome! We were placed elsewhere than the hotel that we booked! The hotel communicated well with us so it went well and found out to the other hotel! The hotel was nice but no elevator and had to walk many stairs! Rooms were nice and big! Nice staff!

author: Juan S
title: Bad experience
text:
Maybe I was particularly unlucky, but my experience was this: 

1) On January 9th I book a room for 2 nights in February. The reservation, guaranteed by Mastercard circuit card, was successful.
2) Five days before departure I receive notification that the card was not charged and I am required to change my Card.
3) I immediately change my card but a few hours later I receive another notification similar to the first: the property can not charge me the cost of the reservation.
4) Since both cards are fully functional, covered by liquidity and with adequate ceilings (I used them both for other purchases on the same days), I try to contact the structure and here the problems arise: on the phone they do not answer (I called at different times and on different days), on the Booking chat they do not respond to my many messages in which I request to be contacted to understand if maybe I can provide a transfer.
5) Four days before departure I receive a notification that my reservation has been cancelled, all without ever having received a shred of response from the structure. So I found myself having to look for another one in a hurry and it was particularly stressful. Obviously I successfully booked the new structure with the Card that did not work for them.

And that's it. All documentable, so I challenge these Gentlemen to contest this review.

author: Marco O
title: Very bad experience
text: Dont book with them. They double charge and they dont reply through booking.com or through calls. Very bad experience.

author: Lily V
title: DISAPPOINTING
text:
Professionalism is not at home.
We made a reservation on Booking in July for an apartment for 9 people, 2 days after the date of alleged charge of the stay (15 days before departure) we are reported that there was a problem with the charge with the credit card, after several attempts to call the structure for more information obviously without any answer and have entered another credit card, the email with CANCELLED BOOKING arrived.
The property could not be contacted for more information and Booking assistance could not do anything.
Subsequently I saw that the structure has done it several times symptom of very little seriousness.

author: Harper M
title: very noisy - poor value
text: The room i was given is on the first floor, almost directly looking out on to a busy interchange. The traffic sounds were very loud and I was woken up in the middle of the night every night. It was difficult to communicate with staff as there is no phone in the room and the reception is only open between 11am and 6pm. When I asked to change rooms, the staff did little to help, offering me a similar room on a higher floor but I would have needed to return to the hotel immediately to do so. Since I was out at that time, I had to stay in the original room I was given. The room itself was fine but it is overpriced for what it is.

author: Zoe O
title: Tritone Top House
text:
The pictures online are not the accommodation that you get. We had termites in our kitchen, which i just couldn't use then. The wooden beams we so dusty with cobwebs hanging into the room and the floors, especially underneath the bed looked like they had never been cleaned. 
The garden area was really untidy and full of rubbish. 
The area was great, right near the Spanish Steps and 7 minute walk from the Trevi Fountain. Location was the only good thing about this property.

author: Lauren L
title: Absolutely wonderful + Location is 10/10!!
text: My husband and I absolutely loved staying here! We stayed in the apartments that were right down the street from the Spanish Steps and we absolutely loved being so close to everything. We were able to walk EVERYWHERE! the room was quaint and clean, everyone we met was kind and accommodating and we truly could not have asked for anything more. It was exactly what I had hoped it would be and I am so glad it was where we stayed to start off our Italy vacation!

author: Luke W
title: Lovely stay!
text:
Just returned from a perfect 2 night stay at Tritone Top House. 

First time travelling alone with two young children and found the location was excellent. There is so much right on the doorstep of this hotel from beautiful cobbled streets awash with restaurants and shops to the Trevi Fountain, Spanish Steps and Pantheon just a few minutes walk away.

The hotel is less than 5 minutes walk to the Metro Station and the hop on / off bus stops.

Tritone Top House is on the 3rd floor of an old traditional building that can be reached by stairs or a small lift. The inside entrance to the hotel did feel a little unloved but as you reach upstairs reception you realise there is nothing to fear.

Check-in was seamless, we were greeted by a lovely lady (sorry I didn’t catch your name) who checked us in and offered a safe place to leave our bags until our room was ready a short time after. We were extremely grateful for an early check in after a very early start. 

Our room was clean and modern and the beds comfy.  There was a small drinks fridge with reasonably priced minibar options and a selection of biscuits and pastries for purchase. 
There was also a kettle and complimentary tea & coffee.

The Shower did take a few minutes to warm up & then the temperature could be a little temperamental but this didn’t cause us any issues. Just a heads up really not to jump straight in!

A folder containing useful information for your stay and the tips on local area was a helpful a guide.

Whilst this hotel doesn’t have a 24hour reception we had no issues in communicating with the hotel prior to and during our stay. The Reception office was open from 11am until late afternoon so bear this in mind before you arrive and you shouldn’t have any issues.

We will definitely be back to visit the beautiful city of Rome again one day (soon I hope!) and I would definitely consider another stay here.

author: William M
title: Grateful family with two young adults.
text: Location, location, location.  After reading recent reviews, I was a little gun shy.  Couldn’t disagree more with the negative comments.  The place is exactly as advertised.  Cozy and convenient.  Our check-in was seamless and she was so kind.  Worked perfect for our family-which includes two young adults.  Close to metro (use it…save some steps for dinner!) and many major destinations.  Market across the street.  Everything you would need for a stop in Roma.

author: Oliver H
title: Absolutely unacceptable – avoid this hotel at all costs!
text:
Absolutely unacceptable – avoid this hotel at all costs!

We had a confirmed reservation at Tritone Top House in Rome made two months in advance through Booking.com. Just four days before our arrival, the hotel cancelled our reservation without any explanation and without any fault on our side. This left us completely stranded.

We tried to contact the hotel immediately – they did not answer our calls, ignored our emails, and even Booking.com was unable to reach them. While Booking.com tried to help, they couldn’t resolve the situation, and it became clear that the hotel was entirely to blame.

We were forced to find last-minute accommodation in Rome at significantly higher prices, which was both stressful and extremely disappointing.

I strongly DO NOT recommend this hotel to anyone. If you don’t want to risk being left without a place to stay just days before your trip, stay far away from Tritone Top House. Their behavior is unprofessional, unreliable, and completely unacceptable

author: Grace W
title: Extremely Disappointed – Canceled My Reservation Without Options
text:
Extremely Disappointed – Canceled My Reservation Without Options

I had a terrible experience with this hotel. I booked my stay well in advance, but to my surprise, they canceled my reservation without giving me the option to pay or rebook. This left me without accommodation during my vacation, causing unnecessary stress and inconvenience.

To make things worse, I tried calling multiple times, but no one ever answered. I also sent several emails, but never received a response. The lack of communication and customer service was completely unacceptable. Instead of offering a solution, they simply informed me that my reservation was no longer valid, without any alternatives.

This is not the way to treat guests who plan and trust a hotel for their stay. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone looking for reliable service. Be cautious when booking, as they may cancel your stay without warning and provide no support whatsoever.

author: Carlos Y
title: Very good apartment
text:
Good location close to the Trevi Fountain.
The rooms are spacious, the kitchen functional to cook and prepare good dishes (maybe just missing bowls for breakfast). The bathrooms are well equipped, the only downside is that hot water takes time to heat up in the shower. 
In the rooms the glazing is a simple glazing, it is quite noisy it is better to provide earplugs for the night so as not to hear traffic.

The staff is very nice and very accommodating. 
We were very well received, we will be back with pleasure!

author: George G
title: Average

author: Manon C
title: Location, location, location
text: I booked this hotel because it was close to many of the tourist spots. Initially, I thought it would be a typical hotel, but when I arrived, I found it was located in a building with various businesses, occupying the third floor. I was concerned because I had several pieces of luggage and didn't see an elevator. A lady helped me carry my luggage to the first floor, where she showed me the smallest elevator I've ever seen. It could only hold one piece of luggage and one person at a time. If you're claustrophobic, I suggest avoiding the elevator. Despite this, my room was clean, and the service was great.

author: George R
title: You get what you pay for.
text: This hotel is the worst. It can’t even really be considered a hotel, as they told us they only have 5 rooms. They only have staff available to assist you between 11am and 6pm. The air conditioning in our room and what seemed like the entire hallway wasn’t working all night and I couldn’t get ahold of someone until 8:30am. Their “emergency number” listed on the contact sheet is an email address, not a phone number. I emailed them 3 times after hours and didn’t hear back until the next day. We had to change rooms because there was construction in the room above us at 7am. The first room was also extremely dirty, every wall had dirt/marks all over them. It also was an interior 3rd floor courtyard room and very claustrophobic and hard to get to. The second room was better cleaned. I would never stay here again.

author: Charlotte Y
title: Fine experience. Just at a different building!
text: Fine room, great AC, nice and clean. As others have noted, the checkin is challenging. Particularly in that the room we booked is 10 minutes away from the shown location - be card so as not to need an checkin after dark… unlikely to find the place and get checked in.

author: George Z
title: Loved this place...accessibility to main attractions, room to spread out in our unit!
text:
The only small challenge we had was with the check-in process.  The reception area is on the third floor, but there is no signage to guide you to the specific place.  You actually go to the third floor and take the door that leads you along this outdoor patio/catwalk type of area to another door.  This door leads to the small reception office.  We stayed in the "apartment" that was a short walk up the hill from the reception area.  It was next to this cute, little patisserie that offered up wonderful espresso beverages and pastries.  The receptionist gave us a tip by sharing the location of a nearby "Todi's" which is a supermarket.  It is much less expensive than the market that is directly across the street from the unit.  The Spanish Steps are literally a couple of blocks away and we walked to all of the other sites as well including Trastevere and the Colosseum (we are in our 50's and in relatively decent shape....no mobility issues for us).

The apartment itself was nice and offered more room to spread out than your traditional European hotel room.  It had a separate bedroom, a kitchenette, a living area and outdoor patio space to enjoy an evening glass of wine or a morning espresso or mimosa...  The bathroom is attached to the bedroom so if you are traveling with your kids, they will need to cut through your room to access it.  Not a bid deal for us as our kids are older.  

If you have ever wanted to be one of those people to get to walk through one of those mystery doors on the street to access  your lodging, choose this place!  It was super fun and convenient for us!  We would visit again!

author: Taylor T
title: Miserable experience, hotel took our money and refused to make tiny adjustment
text: We were excited for our first family trip to Rome, coming up in August 2024. In late May 2024 I booked a room for 4 nights via Orbitz. Right after that I finalized flights, and found that the room booking was off by one calendar day. Within 2 hours of booking I attempted to adjust, and Orbitz chatbot canceled the booking instead and displayed I would get no refund! Quite shocked at the unintended outcome, I immediately tried to contact Tritone Top House. The do not answer their phone. I emailed, they did not respond, not even a courtesy reply! Orbitz has responded that they contacted Tritone Top House and advocated for some flexibility, especially considering that a correction was requested within 2 hours of booking, and the booking is 2 and a half months away. Tritone Top House refused to issue refund, or even undo the cancellation and reinstate our stay! This shows a miserable lack of consideration, and terrible customer service. Seems all they want is to make a quick buck!

author: Tyler G
title: Perfect location in the heart of Rome
text:
I recommend this place, I will return, for the convenience of getting around on foot during the Roman trip.

A well-preserved penthouse with open views, spacious and well-kept. Perfect balcony for an outdoor aperitif.

Everything perfect, well done, thank you very much, we will gladly return.

author: Benjamin G
title: Perfect central london stay
text: Perfect hotel for Hyde Park. Quiet street,  air conditioning and comfy beds. The staff are so lovely and were even kind enough to provide complementary breakfast!

author: Oliver P
title: All right.
text:
We first got room 51, which is definitely not recommended. It needs a solid upgrade. The room was not properly cleaned etc. in addition. 
However, after a little while and we got to switch to another room in a slightly newer part. Totally curant room for short stay. Small rooms, cleaned fine (but could be even more thorough) and newer aircon here.
Most of the people we talked to who work there were very nice and therefore land at 3. 
Location attracts very much.

author: Oliver F
title: Will definitely stay again
text:
I was a little apprehensive before arriving because I’d read some mixed reviews, but our experience couldn’t have been better. We originally booked a room with two single beds, but the hotel kindly upgraded us to a much larger room with two double beds and a single bed, which was perfect for our family and gave us plenty of space for our pushchair.

The room and bathroom were both spotless, the air conditioning worked brilliantly, and the beds were very comfortable. The staff were so friendly, welcoming and helpful from the moment we arrived.

For a 3-star hotel, we thought it was excellent value for money. We had a really enjoyable stay and would happily book here again.

We stayed here because my husband had an appointment on the other side of Hyde Park and it was a really good location close to everything we walked up to Oxford Street

author: Caleb E
title: Great
text: Very central to everything. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful.

author: Elena R
title: It’s a cheap deal for a reason , and it still won’t be cheap enough - avoid
text:
Whilst the room was cheap - sub £100 for the night (single room), it isn’t cheap enough to make that worthwhile. 

Tiniest room and shower cubical I’ve ever seen and everything felt cheap and nasty. Wires visible leading to the air con unit , paint work touched up by Stevie Wonder, as paint was all over the spot lights and sockets. Just bad. Curtains are as thin as tracing paper. No matter how cheap it might be, stay elsewhere - avoid

author: Julien O
title: Unwelcoming staff, small room, and some rooms are in the basement. Low-quality breakfast and not available before 7:30 AM.
text: A low-quality hotel with unwelcoming staff.

author: Megan I
title: Birthday celebration
text:
Celebrated my birthday there
Fantastic vibes , great food, live music 
Thanks to Michael for looking after us

author: Lea Y
title: A safe haven.
text:
I used this hotel for one night between rental accommodation and was warmly greeted and allowed to leave my luggage before check-in. When I came back Dilip upgraded me out of kindness and the room was warm and pleasant.
Next morning as I travelled across London I realised to my horror id left my passport in the room. Panicked, I called Dilip and he immediately checked and secured said passport for my return, exhausted and grateful.
I would heartily recommend this place to everyone. Top marks.

author: Anna U
title: Perfect stay
text: I booked a room here to watch my son run the London marathon. It’s in a quietly tucked away position and was exactly what we needed. A spotless, cosy room with delightful people on the reception desk. You take a chance booking any hotel and I am glad we chose this one. I would definitely return.

author: Marco S
title: Not for couples!
text:
The total location is good but that’s where it ends. Well the staff were nice too. 

The place is dates, mould in the shower, various lights not working, tv (no free view), run down!!

author: Samuel Y
title: 10/10 will come again
text: Great, friendly, tentative staff. Affordable, nice rooms. Overall the hotel staff team enhanced our enjoyment of our trip.

author: Lucy F
title: Close to Hyde Park
text: I have stayed at Elysee twice a year since 2007. Both with friends and family. I think the service is top notch and the towels are big and soft. The hotel is only a 2 minute walk from Lancaster Gate tube station. I/we will definitely be back. Tom Vestøl, Norway.

author: Megan U
title: Great hotel with lovely staff
text:
We stayed at the Elysee Hotel for 2 nights last weekend and had a really great time.  We had booked 4 single rooms and a twin room but were lucky enough to get upgrades on 3 of the rooms, which was much appreciated.  The single rooms are small, even by London standards, but I cannot fault them. They had everything we needed, including air con, hairdryer, tea and coffee making facilities, tv and of course a private bathroom.
The rooms were clean and the staff were fantastic, with special thanks to Dilip and Katerina who were friendly and helpful throughout our stay and let us drop our cases in the rooms which were already ready even though we were 3 hours early. Much appreciated xx They do have a storage area for cases in the reception area which we used at the end of our stay.
The location of the hotel is amazing. Everything you want is within a 3 minute walk of the hotel. 
There are 2 cafes within a minutes walk, but they were busy and we couldn't get the 6 of us in as you can't pre-book, so we went to the Mitre pub which is directly across the road from the Elysee and had lovely breakfasts with lots of space on both mornings. The Mitre was busy with a great atmosphere in the evenings. 
There are restaurants on the same road as the hotel - an Italian (which we visited and can highly recommend) and a Chinese and may be others but I didn't look at all the many shops etc.
There is also a Nisa 2 minutes up the road for drinks and snacks at reasonable prices.
The Lancaster Gate tube station is about a 3 minute walk, with another great pub on the way which has outside seating and heaters which was nice. The red Central line tube takes you all the way to Stratford which is ideal if you are going to the Abba Voyage concert as we were. (On arrival at Stratford double back on yourself up the main staircase and turn left to the DLR. It's then one stop to Pudding Mill Lane which drops you right outside the Abba Arena).
The Elysee is a fantastic place to stay and was perfect for us as we wanted our own rooms (rather than some of us having to sleep on sofa beds in an Air BNB) and we got them at a very reasonable price. I can't fault the hotel and I would definitely stay there again.

author: Erin U
title: Nice pleasant stay
text: I stayed here for one night, the hotel is clean, pleasant rooms are small but have everything you need, would quite happily stay here again.

author: Olivia E
title: Great hotel
text: I will recommend this hotel to everyone, the rooms was clean, the staff are very nice and the service is great, the breakfast was good. it was a grate stay for us!

author: Emma Y
title: 5* Stay, great staff.
text: Me and my partner stayed here for 3 nights this week. From the moment we walked into this hotel Dilip gave us a warm welcome. There was somewhere to store our cases before check in opened and after we had checked out giving us extra time to explore London without the worry of lugging our cases around. Dilip gave us a couple of choices for our room. On our departure day it was torrential rain so I asked Dilip if he could help me with some bin bags to cover my large teddies and bags which was no trouble and found me some immediately. Always greeted guests with a smile. Hotel changed towels daily. Good housekeeping hotel was very close to Hyde Park and a short walk to Paddington station. 15 minute walk to Oxford street. Very pleased with our stay. 5*

author: Zachary T
title: Typically English.
text:
Small hotel with reduced rates. Its advantage is the close positioning of a subway line allowing direct access to the hyper center (to bond street). Hyde Park is right next door too. Finally, Paddington is not far either, in case of arrival by this exit, which is directly linked to holy pancras. 
The rooms are English so small. No coffee machine but a kettle and sticks are provided. 
The mattresses are very closed, the night was not the most pleasant. 
Sound insulation is also insufficient. 
The heating works well, with air conditioning. 
Key lock without contact. 
Recommended for limited rate.

author: Zoe P
title: Perfect location and friendly staff
text:
My mother and I stayed for 2 nights and would recommend this hotel, the location is perfect and only a Short walk from Paddington with shops, cafes and pubs close by
The only reason I’ve only given 4 stars is due to the quality of the breakfast which wasn’t great but was cheap!
We would definitely stay again!
Thank you

author: Daisy L
title: Would not recommend
text: Good location,friendly staff,decor very shabby and worn,room tiny,needs painting & new carpet,in general needs a good revamp,no bar or dining area,

author: Connor U
title: Second time in this hotel
text: We chose to stay again in this hotel where we felt very good last year .We once again enjoyed the hospitality and kindness of the reception staff , who are always ready to help .The room was large for London .The room and the bathroom were cleaned every day  , the sheets and towels were in very good condition , the window closed pefectly and had opaque curtains .It was a very plesant  stay - we will come back !

author: Ryan Q
title: Very central
text:
Boede has 5 days for a city break in beautiful Paris 
The room and bathroom were large and bright 
Rent and good furniture 
The bed was super comfortable and we slept well 
The purchased breakfast gave a good start to the day 
Can highly recommend the hotel for a city break

author: Lily L
title: Bom hotel, com excelente localização.
text: We stayed at the Hotel de Suez between May 4th and 8th, 2026. I've been to Paris many times in recent years. The location of this hotel on Boulevard Saint Michel is certainly one of its strong points. It's close to iconic Parisian landmarks like Notre Dame Cathedral and others. The area is well served by the metro, with lines 4 and 10 providing easy access. The room is a suitable size for a couple. The reception staff provides reasonable service. Overall, the hotel adequately meets the needs of a couple.

author: Isabella P
title: Avoid if you value sleep or service
text:
While the location is "okay" because it’s near the Latin Quarter and Saint-Germain-des-Prés, it is situated on a busy, noisy boulevard. Unfortunately, any convenience was completely overshadowed by a frustrating and poorly managed stay.

We booked eight months in advance for our anniversary, specifically requesting a quiet room on a high floor. Instead, we were placed on the second floor, directly over a noisy bus stop. The room was unbearably warm, and we were informed the AC isn't turned on until June. Despite complaining several times, a fan was only finally provided on our third night (out of four). To make matters worse, the fan was loud and it sounded like industrial equipment.

Management completely ignored multiple emails regarding our experience. On our last day, we were told we could finally move, but when we arrived back at the hotel, the staff claimed no rooms were available. After I pushed back, they initially tried to give us a twin-bed interior room that was even worse than the first.

It was only when my wife and I stood our ground in the reception and with a few other guests present that the staff "suddenly" found a key for a room on the 5th floor—a room that had clearly been available the entire time. While this room was finally away from the street noise, it was still tiny—so cramped that the bathroom uses a sliding door because there is no space for a normal one. It remained uncomfortably hot, and we had to move the fan from the previous room ourselves.

At over €200 a night, the service was unhelpful and the rooms are small with uncomfortable bedding. I would not recommend this hotel.

author: Sophia G
title: Excellent Location and Cozy
text:
From the reception to the departure everything was excellent! The best croissants of my life, hot, crispy, deliciously dried! In addition, the copper's sympathy cheered our mornings, striving to speak Portuguese with us!
Great shower and bathroom that had towel heater and soft towels.
We were in three adults and we stayed comfortably installed!
The only detail that could be revised is that the mattress of the double bed was a bit deep on one side, but did not affect us. 
We were very satisfied with the stay that provided us with water with and without gas and kettle.

author: Charlotte N
title: Nice but noisy hotel
text:
We stayed at this hotel for several days. Our room was clean but facing road. Very difficult to fall asleep with the noise of cars and especially the sound of sirens (police, ambulance, fire...). 
We also need to review the hallway light that goes under the door and illuminates the room at night, as does the thermostat that illuminates the room far too much. The maid is not as discreet in the morning because not everyone gets up at 7am!
On the other hand nothing to complain about the welcome.

author: Nathan D
title: Lovely hotel
text:
The hotel has a fantastic location — close to major sightseeing spots, Cluny-La Sorbonne station, the RER train (with an elevator located on Rue Xavier Privas), and plenty of restaurants and bars.
It has an elevator large enough to comfortably fit a person and a suitcase. My room was more spacious than expected, modern, and well-maintained. The bed was very comfortable, and the air conditioning worked perfectly.
Check-in was quick and easy, and the receptionist was friendly and welcoming.
I would definitely stay here again

author: Samuel I
title: Great location and very clean
text:
The hotel is in a perfect location, very close to Notre Dame to the right and The Luxembourg Gardens to the left. The area itself seems safe and heading past the Luxembourg Gardens there is a lovely restaurant vibe in the evening.
The hotel is compact, the rooms are small but extremely clean and functional with a modern bathroom. We had a lovely little balcony which opened onto the street yet heard no noise on a night. The mattress was very firm.
The receptionists were very polite and friendly.
I would stay again and I would definitely recommend.

author: Sean J
title: Surprised the expectations
text: Small but cosy hotel. The room (with carpet) of great size for 3 people. Quality clothing. In the room, there is a fridge, kettle (coffee and tea available), hairdryer (could be better, because if used at higher speed, it stops working), also has a chair and an auxiliary table. The location is excellent: you can walk to the Luxembourg Garden, to Notre Dame, metro station 5 minutes away, markets (Carrefour express and monoprix very close), restaurants and cafes as well. There's breakfast at the hotel, but I didn't use it. Natural water and gas available 24 hours and it is also possible to use the microwave available in the kitchen if necessary. Daily Room Service.

author: Marco E
title: Small on size big on location
text:
We recently spent 3 nights in Paris and chose the Hotel De Suez. When choosing holiday destinations and accommodation I always look at reviews to get an idea of what a place is like and it has served me well for many years. So my review. It is a compact traditional style Parisienne hotel which has been modernized. We had a family room which was clean and functional but small...no cat swinging contests here. There was at times a bit of a drain wiff in the bathroom but opening the window sorted this, as I remember from many years ago Paris drains were always a problem seems they still are. We didn't have breakfast as we have GF requirements so can't comment on that. Location this was the winner for us, very close to Notre Dame, underground stations, bus tour stations, cafes and restaurants the Louver the Luxembourg gardens. We were more than happy with the location.  So in this case location location location was what it was about. 
A few side notes the bed was a bit hard for my liking. The lift is interesting it fits you and your suit case! The staff were friendly and helpful I would probably recommend more for a couples getaway. Paris is all about being out and about you just need somewhere to get your head down.o

author: Michael M
title: Excellent hotel, great price!
text: This hotel is in the heart of Paris, on Boul Mich, and we couldn't have chosen a better location. Front desk managers were A+ for friendliness and assistance, rooms were extra-clean and beds were comfy. Soundproof, so we slept well after long days exploring the city. Breakfast at 13 euros was just right - fruits, proteins, delicious pastries and more; a relaxed vibe. We had a beautiful view of the boulevard from our 5th floor balcony. You cannot go wrong with this hotel. We'll be back!

author: Abigail O
title: Room with balcony
text:
Very nice hotel, location is good, public transport in the area. The neighborhood is pleasant with many nice restaurants within walking distance.
Room was good, we had a small balcony, ideal! (Room 406)
If you are tall (>180) the shower is too small, that is the only minus

author: Maria Z
title: Great Mid Range Hotel In Latin Quarter
text: This is a great moderately priced hotel in the middle of the Latin Quarter, close to everything you want to see in Central Paris. Yes room are a little small, but updated and clean, great bathroom. Small but modern elevator, on site reception, and we found the bus stop right in front of hotel has a couple of perfect routes to get you around Central Paris, Metro Station a block and 1/2 away. Would recommend !!

author: Chloe X
title: Simple with good location
text:
Well located. 
As it is on a busy avenue, the boarding and disembarkation of luggage needs to be carried out in a corner. 
Cordial attention. 
Water with and without gas is available at the reception. 
Renovated and satisfying bathroom. 
Small room, bad mattress, bad pillows.

author: Claire Q
title: Great location
text: Lovely hotel with a fantastic location in the Latin Quarter. Great breakfast where nothing is missing. The rooms and and, but our air conditioning unfortunately did not work, but we did not say it, so little our own fault. Overall a great hotel but a location that says save two

author: Aiden E
title: A little gem of a hotel!
text: What a pleasant surprise! Our triple room was more spacious than expected and was perfect for our family of 3. Room was updated and well-cared for. The best part was location! 10 min walk to Notre Dame and train to airport was a few minutes away. Bus links were also great. Yes, room facing street was louder, but we travel with a white noise machine and I slept great; beds were very comfortable.  I got a great pre-paid rate directly from the hotel website, so check out their website. I would definitely seek out staying here again, and thought it offered great value.

author: James M
title: Right place for a romantic trip to Paris
text: very nice hotel in an extremely central area of Paris. perfect for a couple. friendly and helpful staff. all rooms are always well maintained and clean. very close to points of interest and served very well from the point of view of public transport. super recommended!

author: Wyatt C
title: A great hotel in the Quartier Latin
text: Very well located hotel, excellent service, very varied and rich breakfast. Very clean bathrooms, room with wonderful cleaning smell. The elevator is small but nothing to interfere with the stay. I stay with my daughter every two months. There is water with gas and natural for customers. I highly recommend!!!!

author: Charlotte F
title: Recommended!
text:
Renovated hotel, in a great location, the Latin Quarter, close to several metro and RER stops (odéon, saint-michel, luxembourg...etc..) 10 minutes walk from Notre-Dame and Saint Chapelle.
The rooms, in size, are in Parisian standards, always clean, daily towel change and bathroom with electric heating, excellent shower.
The staff very friendly and helpful, they kept us luggage after check out.
The elevator is very small but renovated too, as well as the small breakfast room. They also give the opportunity to use the microwave and a water dispenser, which is very convenient when you have small children in tow. 
If I return to Paris I will definitely choose them again.

author: Zoe R
title: Suez Hotel: a good choice!
text: Extremely cozy! Perfect welcome! Comfortable facilities. Very good breakfast. Well located in the Latin quartier. It really exceeded my expectations in terms of hospitality, cleanliness and location. Everything perfect!

author: Maria E
title: Great Latin Quarter/Sorbonne location - comfortable rooms - affordable prices!
text: First time at this hotel (other faves couldn't accommodate our dates). We were pleasantly surprised at this hotel's accommodations. Its location is perfectly situated for evenings spent in the Latin Quarter (for dinner or an evening show at our fave jazz club) or walking along the Seine or in the Luxembourg Gardens. Further there are three Metro lines within blocks so you can easily get nearly anywhere in Paris or out to the airports readily. Easy check-in. Friendly front-desk staff present 24/7. Our room was on the first floor, just a short walk up a circular staircase; it was spacious with clothes rack and counterspace and luggage rack. Our bed was comfortable anad the room temperature pleasant. The shower was roomy with the water temp easily controlled; the liquid soap and shampoo were foamy and pleasantly aromatic. Lobby dining area where breakfast (for a fee) is available; they also have an icy water fountain to refill your water bottles. Certainly will consider staying here on a future visit to Paris.

author: Antoine R
title: Very clean
text: Very clean, high quality products in the room, very good location.

author: Harper H
title: Cheerful, artistic, and very friendly
text:
Very friendly, clean, cozy, trendy, cheerful, and artistic hotel
This will be our favorite hotel in the coziest neighborhood of Paris. We are not staying anymore. On a little jump from the Moulin Rouge and 300 meters from Boris Boulangerie from Miraculous Ladybug

author: Liam K
title: Fantastic hotel
text: 5+ stars! Impeccable customer service, incredible location in the heart of Montmarte, friendly, helpful staff and beautiful rooms. So many little touches that made this a unique experience and a hotel to come back to. Merci!

author: Jack S
title: Great value for money. Staff makes
text: There are plenty of good things about the hotel. Staff is the most important one, great smiles and great service. The hotel is nice, simple, efficient. Rooms are small same with bathrooms. It did work for us but bigger people will not fit in the shower, at least not in our room. This is a typical refurbished old building, so the feeling is different from a typical chain hotel. We loved it and many people will find it an exceptional value for money. But know what to expect

author: Joseph D
title: Cozy, small, clean hotel
text:
Perfect hotel for exploring the Montmartre area. The room was small, but well-equipped. View into a small courtyard, but very quiet at night.
Staff was very friendly and accommodating. When checking in, I also received a map to explore the neighborhood. I did that, and it was very interesting and worth seeing.
The hotel is located in a quiet area; walking home at night (alone as a woman) was no problem at all.
I enjoyed it thoroughly and will likely come back again.

author: Ryan O
title: Wonderful stay in Montmatre
text:
Great location, close to plenty shops, attractions, restaurants. Lovely view out of our window
Staff were extremely inviting and helpful.

author: Isabella R
title: Perfect and charming hotel!🩷
text:
Our stay was simply fabulous.   The staff was very friendly and cordial.  The hotel is beautiful and clean. Very close to specific places for us and the location was very quiet.
We loved it!

author: Lucia I
title: Top hotel in Montmartre
text:
A highly recommended hotel with very friendly and helpful staff. There is a very pleasant atmosphere throughout the entire building. Our room was quite small, but very tastefully and functionally furnished. The small private courtyard is beautiful! 
The perfect starting point for activities in Montmartre. 
Metro stations are within walking distance in just a few minutes.

author: Benjamin R
title: Wonderful stay in Paris
text: Our stay was amazing. This is my favourite hotel in Paris. Staff are wonderful and area is great. Air con is also perfect!!!

author: Carlos V
title: Paris diaries
text: Very cool and enjoyable stay, thanks to the beautiful staff with their hospitality who made our stay so pleasing and welcoming. The property itself is so pretty and in the centre of town making it very comfortable to travel around. Made our stay very memorable and fun with personalised attention. Thank you so much!!

author: Lucy C
title: Great location
text:
Perfect location on quiet street but in the heart of Montmartre.
Staff super friendly and helpful and English excellent.
Great to have free water and soft drinks plus cake etc during the day really nice touch.
Rooms not huge but clean and has everything you need.
Will be back 😁😁

author: Isabella K
title: Wonderful hotel in Montmartre
text:
We have taken many city trips as a family in recent years and have therefore seen many hotels. The Hotel des Arts was definitely one of the best! 
Everything was just right: The hotel is lovingly designed; every room seems to be a work of art in itself (we had two rooms on the fifth floor). The staff was very friendly and helpful. The honesty bar with free water (essential during the current heat wave) and snacks was brilliant, but also invited you to wind down the evening with a (paid) drink.

The location in Montmartre is simply perfect! It is one of the most beautiful neighborhoods in Paris; in the immediate vicinity are many shops, brasseries, and restaurants. Also within walking distance are Sacré-Cœur, the Moulin Rouge, well-known spots from "Amélie," as well as several metro stations. 

If we come back to Paris, we would book the Hotel des Arts again immediately!

author: Tyler E
title: Paris Hotel
text: Very good experience, very kind team

author: Liam G
title: Warm, welcoming, and walkable
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Hotel des Arts. The staff were helpful and there is a lot of attention to detail. The location is excellent for exploring Montmartre.

author: Henry E
title: Perfect Hotel for a Weekend Away
text: Excellent hotel, nice staff in a relatively quiet area considering how central it is!

author: Katie H
title: Boutique hotel experience in the heart of Montmartre
text:
Very convenient location in Montmartre. 
Staff very friendly and accommodating. 
Clean hotel with special attention to detail.

author: Marco N
title: Wonderful!
text: Superb! Pre check in information was so helpful in planning our trip. All the staff were great. Check in smooth and our bags had been’magiced’ up to our room whilst we checked in. Housekeeping was great. A wonderful stay and we will be back.

author: Nathan L
title: Beautiful Hotel! Staff amazing!
text: I highly recommend the Hotel des Arts Montmartre for anyone visiting Paris. The location was absolutely incredible. The hotel is gorgeous, quaint, calming, but yet right in the middle of cafe's, restaurants, shops, surrounded by beautiful scenery.  The staff are incredible!  They are so welcoming, friendly, professional and thoughtful.  The upgraded our room and offered us complimentary champagne.  We so appreciated it.  We arrived with our family and the staff was sincerely happy to see us. Thank you to all the staff of this beautiful hotel. We loved every minute of it, and cant wait to return.

author: Lauren X
title: Excellent!!
text:
The most impressive part of this hotel is the staff. They are absolutely wonderful… so welcoming, patient, and helpful. 
The place is immaculate. There is a lovely breakfast bar for a price (didn’t know that) which turns into an “honesty”
wine bar in the evening. The best!! Also located in a great neighborhood.

author: Molly Z
title: Excellent hotel
text:
Excellent welcome, friendly and attentive staff. Very clean hotel and room.
I recommend it

author: Tyler U
title: I had a great stay in the hotel
text:
Very attentive and pleasant staff, specially Dery and Karina who were true darlings. 
Very nice room with an incredible view of New York. I will most definitely come back. Thank you

author: David T
title: Excellent!
text: Excellent service at Noel at the bar

author: William L
title: Great hotel in LES
text: They upgraded me to the sickest room with a full floor balcony overlooking the city. Dery and Chris are the goats. Will come back soon.

author: Pablo H
title: Excellent Lower East Side Stay
text: Dery and Jessica were exceptionally helpful, offered us cold waters after we dragged luggage up from the train, they were both very accommodating to our requests throughout our stay. Excellent location, high volume of restaurants within a 20 minute walking radius, easy to access, close to the F Train. Room itself was very nice with decent space, CA king bed, nice bathroom, even though we were on a lower floor, lots of light and no smells from the balcony. Will absolutely book here again our next stay.

author: Oliver U
title: New Favorite Hotel!!
text:
We stayed here over the weekend for my son’s birthday and had such an incredible time! The staff truly went above and beyond to make our stay so special. They decorated our room with balloons, a birthday banner, and the sweetest handwritten note. He was SO excited and immediately felt like a VIP. They even accommodated his very specific request for apple juice during wine hour!! Thank you, Dery, for making him feel so special and for going the extra mile!!

The location honestly cannot be beat. It was the perfect landing spot after a busy day in NYC.  We loved being able to walk everywhere and easily pop back in when we needed a break. 

The whole experience felt so warm and personal. From the thoughtful birthday surprise to the incredibly friendly staff, they really made our weekend memorable. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Isabella X
title: Stay here!!
text: We love staying at Hotel on Rivington! Jessica and Karina were able to get us early check in and make us feel welcomed. It is always a pleasure staying here when we are in town playing shows. Check out Porch Couch, and Check In with Jessica and Karina!

author: Hannah G
title: Excellent stay! Highly recommended!
text: My family and I stayed at the Hotel On Rivington for 6 days. Excellent location, well-equipped hotel facilities, but what really caught our attention and positively impressed us was the friendliness and efficiency of the staff. Very helpful and polite, the team led by Gabriel deserves praise! We will definitely be back very soon!

author: Morgan O
title: Hotel on Rivington has officially become our favorite hotel in NYC!
text:
Hotel on Rivington has officially become our favorite hotel in NYC!

This was our second stay, and we will absolutely be back. The location is fantastic, the hotel has a great Lower East Side vibe, and for the room, views, and experience you get, I genuinely think it’s one of the best values in the city.

But what really keeps us coming back is the hospitality.

Chris is THE MAN. He’s become our main point of contact and consistently goes above and beyond to make sure we’re taken care of. He even made sure we got back into our favorite room this trip, which meant a lot to us. Any minor issue or request we had was handled immediately and with genuine care.

Huge shoutout as well to Karina, Gemma, Dery, Jessica, and Sarah. Chris and the entire team went out of their way to make sure everything we wanted happened and that we felt completely at home.

That level of personal hospitality is becoming harder and harder to find, especially in NYC, and it’s exactly why Hotel on Rivington will continue to be our first choice every time we come back to Manhattan.

Amazing rooms, killer location, great value, and most importantly, an incredible team.

Highly, highly recommended. Thanks again, Chris and crew — we’ll see you next time!

— Aramis & LT

author: Diego N
title: Phenomenal
text: Gemma and the whole front desk staff were so great and made an excellent lunch recommendation, me and my friends enjoyed our stay and can’t wait to go back to try the other Thai restaurant that was recommended. Wine hour was great way to get the night started.

author: Anna U
title: Respite from a renovation .
text: Hotel on Rivington is a great hotel. Room had east, north and west exposure so it was a great view looking at the beautiful New York skyline. Shower had terrific pressure and bed was comfy and room was quite comfortable . Front desk agents were diligent and helpful. Jessica was always quick with a hello. Getting an iron from houseman was quick as lightning. Highly recommend the Rivington.

author: Oscar B
title: Friendly bright and relaxing
text: A lovely relaxing stay - a large bright room - very welcoming complimentary wine in the evenings, and great coffee each morning- a great location for me visiting family in the Grand Street area of Lower East Side - let’s not forget Karina and Noel on the Reception Desk - they were were great fun, helpful and personable - very important when away from home - Geoff, Liverpool UK

author: Joseph M
title: I love New York
text: I enjoyed my stay, very welcoming and good vibes! Chris at the front was a beast💪🏾 will be back for sure

author: Jessica A
title: Wonderful experience
text: Chris and Karina are the best. Extremely helpful and welcoming. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Louis S
title: Clean! Noel & Gooden are super helpful. Great spot would come back!
text: Great location. Noel and Gooden are amazing, professional and attentive. Very knowledgeable and kind. Would gladly come back here any time I’m New York and would recommend my friends to this centrally located, clean and nice spot.

author: Olivia G
title: Service Level Unmatched!
text: I just checked into my room and had to immediately review Hotel on Rivington. I travel a great deal and I must say the check in experience was unmatched! Special shoutout to Karina and Sarah. They made sure I was comfortable while my room was getting ready. Everything was clean and comfortable and the atmosphere was so calming. I will definitely be staying here again when I come back to NYC. Not to mention the room is beautiful clean with a balcony and stellar view.

author: Noah G
title: Hip spot
text: Visiting family on the lower east side.   The location is great - made me feel like I was in my 20’s again!   The Wine social in the afternoon was nice also.   We will be back.   Dery and Sara were very helpful

author: Leo M
title: Exceptional Service & A Wonderful Stay
text:
I had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this place.
Location: Excellent and convenient, with easy access to nearby attractions and restaurants.
Atmosphere: Warm, welcoming, and relaxing throughout my stay.
Rooms: Spacious, comfortable, and well-maintained.
Value: Great value for the quality of service and accommodations.
Cleanliness: Everything was spotless and exceeded my expectations.
Noise Level: Quiet and peaceful, making it easy to relax and get a good night's sleep.
Service: Outstanding. Dery and Chris provided immaculate service and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. They were friendly, attentive, and truly made my stay memorable.
Amenities: Great amenities that added to the overall experience. Everything I needed was available and well maintained.
Overall, I had an excellent experience and would definitely stay here again.

author: Alice G
title: 10/10 Experience
text: Such a wonderful hotel! I had an incredible experience and didn’t want to leave. The staff was lovely, the room is gorgeous, and the hotel location is great! I definitely recommend!

author: Giulia G
title: Great choice for Lower East Side
text: Lovely hotel in the heart of the Lower East Side, very convenient to subway and bus lines.  Driving in NYC can be stressful, but if you arrive by private car there is a municipal lot right around the corner that allows overnight parking for $50 (standard local price).   Room was spacious, clean, and quiet, and the hotel staff was outstanding and very responsive to requests.  The exercise room is limited but walking around NYC is a great alternative daily workout.

author: Megan T
title: A+ experience
text: I had a long week in New York and when I arrived at Hotel on Rivington, they made everything feel very comfortable and relaxing. Jessica at the Front Desk was so kind to find me a room that I would like and take care of me. Because of Jessica's hospitality, I decided to stay a few extra nights. Highly recommend coming here as the whole staff was top notch. Including the manager who was with Jessica.

author: Chloe G
title: NASTY HOTEL!!!!!
text:
Horrible hotel! Look at the pictures and read the reviews carefully before booking. The actual room was NOTHING like what was shown in the pictures.
The hotel was dirty, and the bathroom was unbelievably small. The toilet was only about 6 inches from the wall, making it nearly impossible to sit. The shower was so small that a normal-sized person could barely use it.
Our bathroom didn’t even have water, and there was a towel on the floor with what appeared to be human feces on it. 🤢
As soon as we saw the room, we asked for our money back, but they refused. We ended up leaving and paying for another hotel that was much nicer, clean, and had air conditioning.
Don’t waste your money! Before making a reservation, ask them to send you REAL pictures of the exact room you’ll be staying in. The pictures online are extremely misleading.

author: Charlie Y
title: The worst hotel I have ever booked in my life.
text:
The worst hotel I have ever booked in my life. The photos are completely misleading and look nothing like the actual property. The location is okay, but everything else was absolutely unacceptable.

The reception area is old, cluttered, and full of construction materials and debris. The elevator is unbelievably tiny — barely large enough for one person at a time.

But the worst part was the room and bathroom. The room is extremely small, dark, and absolutely impossible for two people to stay comfortably. There is NO AIR CONDITIONING, which is unacceptable during the European summer.

The bathroom is even worse. It is so ridiculously small that you can barely fit inside. It is practically impossible to sit on the toilet properly because there is simply no space. The shower area is absurdly cramped, making the entire bathroom almost unusable.

To make matters worse, we found a dirty towel lying on the floor when we entered the room.

We walked in and walked right back out within five minutes. I have traveled and stayed in many hotels, and I have honestly never seen anything this bad. The property is completely misrepresented by the photos, and the reality is shocking. I would absolutely NOT recommend this hotel.

author: Dylan R
title: Unsafe living conditions in central Paris - stay away from!
text: Unsafe living conditions in Central Paris. Building has sewer issues that owner knows about it but decides to do nothing about it hence their response was - wait 5 minute your toilet will clear itself ( it didn’t , got worse) . No replacement rooms available either when requested one. Sneaky people don’t leave hotel before you’ve got your refund in your hands otherwise you’ll have to go through your bank . Careful this hotel will ruin your holiday .

author: Michael B
title: The booking was charged twice on our card!
text: Don't fall in the blow. They charged the reservation on our card twice and do not return the amount. They report that two reservations were made, but we did not. We warned that the charge was wrong before even the card released the amount and still continued the charge!

author: Ruby X
title: Poor quality, hazardous and quite frankly, false advertising.
text:
I checked in to the hotel Eiffel Kensington the 6th of may with my partner to celebrate my birthday in Paris. On check in we were greeted by a friendly gentleman who gave us our keys and directed us towards our room. on the desk was a sign saying the wifi wasn't working, unfortunately no compensation was given for this. when we left the elevator we emerged into a pitch black corridor where I almost tripped on a mop bucket haphazardly left by the stairs. once we got into room 14  the bedroom was clean but poorly decorated and the bed was small with 2 thin pillows, we asked for more pillows but were informed that the hotel was full so they didn't have any spare. they did have a spare adapter for us which was very friendly. once we went into the bathroom we discovered the toilet seat did not fully open which means we had to have it touching us to stay open. the shower was poorly positioned with the holder causing the water to soak the ceiling which was clearly rotting and coming away. the skirting board in the bedroom had painters tape where they had clearly forgotten to take it off, we found painters tape in the hallway as well. we were given no information about breakfast or the hotel facilities. 
Your website paints a very unrealistic portrait of your hotel, advertising luxury rooms and a high quality establishment "we are not settling for less when balancing maximum quality". you also advertise wifi multiple times as benefit of staying at your hotel "Surf with ease and stay connected to the digital world with our free, high-speed Wi-Fi. Emerse yourself in an ocean of information, communicate effortlessly, or post those picture-perfect moments without a hitch—an entire digital spectrum is at your disposal with our cutting-edge connectivity solutions." "and, of course, gratis WiFi, satisfying your strive for modern warmth while staying true to authentic Parisian charm." "Offering the luxury of affordability combined with indispensable intricacies including an ensuite bathroom, television, and WiFi access, Eiffel Kensington Hotel sets the stage for an indulgent sojourn in the heart of Paris." which should be a standard in todays world. 
I have attempted to contact the hotel directly about these issues and unfortunately not heard anything back, as someone who works in a hotel myself I am reluctant to pot reviews on trip advisor but felt that people needed to know that this hotel is definitely not worth the money and it certainly not the luxury budget friendly accommodation they advertise themselves as. 
I will definitely not be staying here again.

author: Sydney H
title: An attic on the roofs
text: We leave the elevator on the 6th floor, a door opens onto a passageway on the roof, to lead to an attic, into which we enter through a step below. No exterior lighting. Low ceilings, out-of-age wallpapers. It's a scandal to be able to rent this out as a bedroom

author: Adam A
title: Disgusting stay
text:
Where does one begin. I booked this around November time as a present. Arrived to the hotel I almost got sick. It was so disgusting. The lobby was tiny and the smell of mild would knock you out! There was food all over the floor as the breakfast area was on the lobby desk area. I had previously paid city tax on booking.com, and the man at the desk was extremely pushy on me giving him 100 euro in cash as city tax so I proceeded to give him this cash. I did not want to because once I seen the lobby I knew well the room was going to be horrible. He told us we can leave our bags and come back and check in at 5pm. He left our bags in the restaurant also where people would be eating. I’m unsure if I’d call it a restaurant. He gave us the key to our room around 6 pm after us waiting the whole hour. He was extremely rude. Nobody was even checking out if our room. Our first check in time was meant to be 2 pm. As we walked up to our room the stairs were all broken, luckily we didn’t fall. I entered the room in disgust, I will attach photos below. The room smelt like someone was after smoking a full box of cigarettes, the bed was white sheets full of dirt. There was no plugs in the room. I was so disgusted I went downstairs asked for my 100 euro back he refused. I told them I’m not staying here. They told me if I leave they will refund me, it’s many months on now and they still have not. There was mild all over the room which is dangerous for breathing. I have never in my life seen a “hotel” like this. It is absolutely sick they can offer this to people to stay. This completely ruined my holiday. We had to leave here. As a college student paying for 2 hotels was not ideal but what could I do. 
I had rang the hotel manager many times after this and he laughed. This is scamming people. I do believe booking.com is so wrong for having this up and it’s entirely their fault. It’s disgusting behaviour from booking.com they were no help they said they can’t do anything. They shouldn’t have a place like this up on the first place.

author: Daniel H
title: Elwira
text:
Hotel Kensington location fabulous 5 min from Eiffel tower.  Staff are very friendly and helpful ! Best experience with them especially lady Katherine she saved my trip and Paris experience so a big thank you! She is the best.
If it's to a hotel I would recommend a little update on the room I was starting in for the price I think. I know Paris is expensive but still. Part from that it was clean , cleaning services great, breakfast every day not to bad ,fresh. Location very important you can get bus,metro,train literally 5 minutes from the hotel.
So in overall IAM very happy 😊 thank you

author: Jack S
title: Great location
text: Unbeatable location of the hotel, value for money, everything very clean. The treatment of Meziane and Victor was excellent.

author: Miguel J
title: cheated
text: Sunday I checked in and paid in advance for a room for two people for two nights, breakfast included for two days (Monday and Tuesday), plus taxes per person for both days. I paid in cash in advance, according to hotel rates, but I did not receive a receipt. On Monday, when I left, I was charged for breakfasts that they claim they did not charge me, which is impossible because everything had already been charged in advance. I am complaining, because I feel surprised by this extra and ripped off by the person who welcomed me on Sunday, August 30, 2025.

author: Rosie H
title: Dirty room; poor bathroom
text:
One word: mediocre 
We must flee this establishment which should no longer be allowed!
Breakfast is a scam

author: Carlos X
title: Good location, have to tough it out sometimes 👀
text: We weren’t allowed to check in until 3:25 despite check in being at 2pm. There was only one proper curtain so during the night it was possible to see into our room. Floor was filthy. Great location though!!!

author: Oliver N
title: Great hotel, close to major landmark.
text:
If you’re looking for something that is close to the Eiffel Tower has convenient immunities around the hotel and friendly staff this is definitely the right place.

We were only staying one night and we’re very much unprepared to the point where I even managed to book the room a whole year in advance. Luckily, the reception staff were extremely helpful and kind and managed to get sorted really quickly. As I said, we were a little unprepared so didn’t even bring adequate charging facilities for our phones again, the reception staff are really helpful and they helped us out by charging our phones.

The room was clean but small, but to be honest, we had no intention of spending too much time in the room, so it was ideal for a one night stay.

Highly recommended

author: Claire W
title: Poor customer service, room quality was not good.
text:
We stayed at this hotel and our room had no power other than in the bathroom. They did not offer to switch rooms, only said they would call the repair person the next day. They did not offer any compensation for the inconvenience, or offer an alternate room and refuse to return emails or calls to find a resolution. 

Location was great! Close to the Effle tower and many restaurants and attractions. Location did have a lift to get to upper floor.

author: Freya O
title: Fabulous location!
text:
The staff were very friendly and accomodating, especially the lady working during the day. Room is in line with expectations. We stayed on the 6th floor and there were no views of the tower and the room was small, and no aircon made it stuffy at times. The room was clean and the lift was very useful in getting our bags up! 

Location was excellent with great restaurants around!

author: Evan R
title: Pittoresque hotel in a good location
text: We stayed here for 4 nights. The staff was very friendly, the room clean and sufficiently large. Of course, the view of the Eiffel Tower was magnificent. Ok the bathroom was a bit "worn out" but also clean.  All in all, it was completely sufficient for our needs (we were traveling almost all day, so for overnight stays and short breaks between trips ). Personally, I found the elevator a bit creepy (extremely small and the display didn't work at all) but it worked.  So we would book here again.
