author: Erin Q
title: Very good value for money and hotel conveniently located
text: Very good value for money. The lady at the reception is very nice and welcoming. Besides, it's nice to know that there's someone at the 24-hour front desk when you get home a little late. Conveniently located hotel that contributed to the quality of our stay!

author: Andrea J
title: Perfect for our short stay in Paris
text: Nicest most helpful staff. Fabulous location. Room clean. Beautiful view. Tiny elevator and tricky narrow steps to get to room. Room small but cozy. Shower in bath a bit of a leg up to get into. Fresh clean towels. Very comfortable bed. Nice basic breakfast. Supermarket two minutes away.

author: Chloe H
title: Very nice.
text: It was very nice Katerina from the reception served us very much everything was near restaurants cafes stations we were very pleased with our stay and from the experience in the hotel we had very nice is close to Eiffel

author: William L
title: Top!
text: Very good location, perfect reception, no complaints about the establishment, value for money at the top, cleanliness of the accommodation ok, very good breakfast, quiet and peaceful location, quality bedding, I highly recommend!!

author: Marta H
title: Great hotel in Monti area
text: First visit to Rome and the location was perfect; Monti is a short walk from pretty much everything you would wish to see in Rome. The area was quiet and felt safe. Room was spacious and had everything you would need. Great that the mini bar is initially complimentary; the room was clean and as expected. Breakfast was good and set you up for the day. Would return if in Rome

author: Mia O
title: Great experience
text: Great location, the staff is very friendly, the room is excellent

author: Lucas G
title: There is no better hotel. 100% recommended
text:
This hotel could not be better in practically anything.
The location is excellent, less than a 20-minute walk from any important monument (Colosseum, Trevi Fountain...) and also very close to Termini station.
This is not the most remarkable thing about the hotel. The room is excellent, spacious, the air conditioning works perfectly, the bed is impressively comfortable, and the cleaning service does an excellent job of leaving everything spotless.
Without a doubt, what is worth highlighting is the kindness of the receptionists and waiters. They understand Spanish practically to perfection with excellent, very friendly service, and with a smile always on their faces, they have resolved any question for us instantly.
I recommend booking the breakfast service to be served by good old Giacomo and his waiters. And you have to order their delicious themed cappuccinos, no matter what!
Thank you very much!

author: Paige Q
title: Rome stay
text:
Really enjoyed my stay here close to everything staff very friendly every morning the manager at breakfast would make a coffee with a different picture displayed which is a great touch really felt welcomed to be in rome thank you
 Tom and emily

author: Matthew W
title: Beautiful Hotel 💥
text:
Fantastic hotel with a perfect location! The breakfast was amazing, and the service was absolutely divine  A1! ✨❤️

Thank you, Rome, for making me feel right at home. 🇮🇹❤️ Special thanks to Cuacomo, Maria Angela & Paulo for the wonderful breakfast service. You were amazing! 🥰

Grazie, Roma! 🇮🇹✨

author: Pablo L
title: Everything was phenomenal.
text: An oasis of cool in a burning Rome near almost everything on foot, modern, clean, comfortable, and the staff is very friendly, thanks to Giacomo for his espresso macchiatos and his friendliness.

author: Daisy G
title: Fantastic hotel - right in the heart of rome
text:
Location - right in the center of Rome, 10-20min min walk to Colosseum, Spanish Steps, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon etc.

Atmosphere - Quiet, modern, elegant

Rooms - Very clean, modern, perfect temperature (excellent A/C and we stayed during a 40 degree heatwave)

Value - Excellent, ~£170 per night in the center of Rome felt like excellent value

Staff are friendly and welcoming
Breakfast was delicious and varied
Fully stocked bar on site 

Honestly perfect, we’ll easily stay here again next time we visit Rome

author: Lily B
title: Highly recommended hotel
text: A truly wonderful hotel. Friendly, personalised service and very welcoming. Rooms were very clean, lovely complimentary toiletries and mini bar on arrival. Breakfast was a wide selection of fresh food and pastries every day with good coffee from the bar. I would highly recommend. You feel you are getting an upmarket service for a reasonable price.

author: Marta C
title: Comfortable and central
text: Modern and comfortable hotel in the center of Rome, between the Viminale and the Bank of Italy. Large and modern room, beautiful bar terrace open in the evening, kind and friendly staff, excellent and varied breakfast, with lots of fresh fruit.

author: Emma R
title: A lovely 4 nights break with my wife
text:
I booked this hotel as a package with BA for a few days away with my wife. 
This is our third visit to Rome, previously staying both times in the white hotel, via in arcione (fantastic hotel) I chose Rome life over the white hotel simply because I got more products for less £££s and the quality was the same. 
We arrived at termini station and walked to the hotel. It takes 15mins dragging luggage 🥵🥵and 10 mins without. And was very easy to find Rome life hotel. 
Check in was smooth although we didn’t realise we needed a credit card to guarantee against the stay although fully paid.  This was an oversight on our behalf and was sorted with a call back home. The receptionist was understanding and gave us as much time as we needed to get the relevant details. 
We were shown to the room and all the services and amenities pointed out on route by our very nice porter. 
The room a superior double number 505 was spacious, clean, bright and air conditioned. The room was on the fifth floor and faced the main road that the hotel entrance was on. Sleep was very good, we slept with windows closed and AC on, the only time we heard any noise was when Spain scored a goal in the World Cup final 🏆
We had breakfast most mornings and found the selection was perfect, it had something for everyone. 
I was slightly concerned when I booked this hotel about its  location as it was a little further from trevi than we had previously stayed. It quickly became apparent that I didn’t need to worry about location. It was probably a better location than our previous stays in Rome. Everything is so close, we walked (slowly) as it was hot hot 🥵 colosseum 15mins, Spanish steps 15-20mins, trevi 10mins and pantheon 20mins. 
Checkout was super simple and the reception staff sorted bag storage for us while we maxed out our time in a very special city. 
I asked my wife if she would stay here again and without hesitation she said yes. Looks like we will be back again soon 😄

author: Hannah F
title: Excellent way to start your vacation
text: I stayed here for three nights with my daughter and it was an excellent start to our Italian vacation. Giacomo made breakfast the highlight of my day with his warm greetings and excellent cappuccino! The rooftop bar is also very nice and front desk was always super helpful!

author: Evie N
title: 4 nights in Rome
text: The hotel is located in a prime position close to many of the main attractions. The atmosphere of the hotel was laid-back and very enjoyable. The rooms were super clean and well maintained throughout our four nights stay. The staff especially Jacques in the breakfast area were very accommodating and every front counter attendant was super helpful when asked any question about what to do or how to get there. I would definitely recommend a stay at Rome life hotel if heading to Rome.

author: Kyle V
title: One of the best hotels in central Rome. I recommend
text: Best location in the centre, 15 minutes walk to the Coliseum 15 minutes to the Trevi Fountain. In the hot June, the air conditioning worked fine, the water was pressurized, the rooms were small, but not cramped for two. Breakfast is super, and the bartender's cappuccino is the best in Italy. I recommend the hotel to my friends who came with the same experience. Special thanks to the hotel team for their friendly attitude, help in everything from hailing a taxi and city recommendations. There are many shops nearby, and the small center is a 10- to 15-minute walk away.

author: Chloe I
title: A fantastic 4 night short stay with my better half...
text:
This was our 2nd visit to Rome and it was long overdue. This hotel certainly did not disappoint. It's location is in a small relatively quiet street however it has 2 excellent restaurants directly across both serving excellent food. The majority of Rome's major attractions are within reasonable walking distance with shopping and ample restaurants nearby. 

The hotel itself is fantastic, all of the staff are very welcoming and the breakfasts offer a fantastic selection of items. Special mention must go to Giacolla who makes the most wonderful cappuccino, the best I have ever had in fact and oversees everything. 

The rooms are spacious, clean and tidy as is the other areas of the hotel. There is also a rooftop bar and a happy hour between 4 and 7pm offering a selection of cocktails for 10 euros.

author: Kyle N
title: Fine, average hotel
text:
Excellent hotel, is quite central, close to a number of attractions. 
Staff recption varying wbt helpfulness; nice young lady received us and gave tips wbt environment, a gentleman v d reception was not very helpful when we said the 2nd day that the WIFI did not work in our room. He was supposed to come help in our room, but never showed up! Then the remainder our 4 days no WIFI had! 
Breakfast was very good; extensive and fresh! And delicious coffee from the bar! (Special thanks to the host Giacuomo; he is super customer friendly really a winner!)
Also a big compliment to the ladies v d cleaning; everything was clean and neatly made up, every day!

author: Matthew P
title: The perfect place to discover Rome and celebrate special moments,
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Rome Life, via Palermo 10, for a week in the month of December with our family, and the experience was exceptional from beginning to end.

From our arrival, we were received with enormous kindness and professionalism. We want to especially highlight Angela, at the front desk, who made us feel welcome from the first moment and was always willing to help us. The attention from all the staff was impeccable, always cordial, attentive, and oriented toward us enjoying our stay to the fullest.

The hotel is very beautiful, elegant, and cozy, with an ideal atmosphere for resting after touring the city. In addition, the food was excellent and exceeded our expectations.

One of the great benefits of this hotel is its excellent location. During our stay, we were able to easily travel to many of the main historical and cultural attractions of Rome, including the Roman Colosseum, the Trevi Fountain, the Pantheon, and many other iconic places. This made our experience in the city even more comfortable and pleasant.

What really made our visit special was the support we received to celebrate our wedding anniversary. Days before traveling, I had coordinated a surprise for my wife with the hotel, and the team took care of all the details with great dedication and enthusiasm. When we returned from visiting some of the wonderful historical sites of Rome, we found a beautiful surprise prepared in our room. It was a gesture that deeply moved us and turned a special occasion into an unforgettable memory.

We sincerely thank Angela and the entire Hotel Rome Life team for their hospitality, their attention to detail, and for making our stay so memorable. Without a doubt, we would stay here again and we recommend it to those looking for a hotel with a prime location, excellent facilities, and truly exceptional service in the heart of Rome. Thank you for making our celebration so special!

author: Laura I
title: Service and location are great
text: Great place, amazing rooftop bar, great service at breakfast ( loved Giacolla he was a great host) The location was very central on a small, kind of cozy, street.

author: Kyle Q
title: Comfort and location.
text:
Hotel very well located and with excellent service.
Comfortable rooms.
Giácomo is your team were perfect.

author: Isla A
title: A+ Experience
text: Experience was fantastic. Cleaning staff was exceptional. Breakfast varied and delicious. Front desk workers helpful and drop dead gorgeous. Excellent experience!

author: Chloe P
title: Great Experience
text: Hotel was a great overall experience , entire staff is friendly and helpful, rooms are clean and tidy, and the continental breakfast is everything you can want with Giacomo making the best cappuccino you’ll ever have

author: Lucas J
title: SERVICE AND FACILITIES OF BARELY 2 STARS (IF THAT) AT A PRICE OF ALMOST 5 STARS
text: The price of this hotel is practically double that of any other hotel in Rome of the same category, features, and location, but it should actually be less than half that of those hotels; in other words, it is not worth even a quarter of the price they charge. It is a supposedly 4-star hotel, but its service and facilities do not even reach those of a 3-star hotel. They charged us no less than 250 euros per night (1,000 euros for the 4 nights we stayed), and the service and room they assigned us are not worth more than 50 euros per night. We booked it assuming that cost with the intention of having a wonderful stay as a couple in supposedly exceptional facilities, and they were indeed exceptional, but in a totally negative sense, as I will proceed to explain in detail so that no other person has to endure their extremely low quality of service at a luxury price: Small room with small "views" of a road through a window (obviously without a balcony, much less a terrace). Very scarce breakfast, very little variety (two or three plates of cold cuts and cheeses, bread, scrambled eggs, boiled eggs, and little else), only one type of milk (cow's milk and whole, of course), three small bowls of fruit (almost always empty), and on top of that, the products would run out and they wouldn't replenish them if you didn't ask. Each of the 4 days when we arrived for breakfast, all the product trays were practically empty (the dining room was full of people), and if you didn't ask, they wouldn't replenish (at 250 euros a day, I repeat). We even felt embarrassed for them because of that restriction of products. Paper napkins, and cheap ones at that, and no tablecloths on the tables; directly on the table. Restaurant without any type of air conditioning (we didn't dine there even once because the temperature was 37 degrees), without any special atmosphere—well, neither special nor not special, just no atmosphere at all. Zero delicacy in the treatment by the staff, robotic-style attention, 2-star hotel service or less. Upon arrival, we asked the receptionist if he could give us a room with a view, just as we had requested by email days before; his response was that the room was already assigned and that he did not assign them. They gave us a room with a "view" of a road through a window. In addition to the above, we were also unable to have shared views from the supposed rooftop terrace because it was closed (they told us it was due to construction). As a final touch, on the last day we left our luggage in their storage room for a few hours, and when I went to pick it up, the receptionist, instead of handing me the luggage, gave me the key to the storage room where it was located and told me to go get it myself and lock it back up—"wonderful" 4-star service at 250 euros a night!!! We booked this trip through "Viajes El Corte Inglés," an agency we have been customers of for years, but we are considering not booking with them again if they do not better filter their choice of hotels, as they should not market establishments like this one. Finally, I beg everyone who reads this to share it so that it gets maximum exposure and no other person has to suffer these terrible facilities and service at 250 euros a night.

author: Hannah A
title: First time in Rome
text: Our first time in Rome and this was the perfect place for us. Staff are friendly and helpful. We spent mornings sightseeing and the hot afternoons by their beautiful pool.

author: Grace R
title: Elegant city stay
text:
Beautiful hotel in a lovely area up the hill from Trastavere. Ten minute walk down (uber back up if you can’t face the steps)
In the heat the pool was a life saver as was the air con. Slept well, great breakfast buffet and friendly staff.

author: Hannah O
title: Birthday party
text:
I organized my husband's 60th birthday party on July 25, 2026. Perfect location, the staff proved to be kind and welcoming from the very first moment, satisfying our initial requests. The evening was a success on all fronts; the staff followed us in every little detail and the guests felt pampered, complimenting us on the choice made and on how the evening was unfolding. Heartfelt thanks to Antonino and Alessandro.  I highly recommend that you rely on their professionalism.
Ileana

author: Mason K
title: Very disappointed
text: We visited the hotel pool today. It was 97 in Rome. My son booked us in to get into the pool. We were charged €35 each to use the pool facilities he knows my son my husband did not want to go in the pool nor did his 12 year-old daughter. We went back up to the person in charge and asked if he could refund us the €35 as they were not going to use the pool he said no even though I told him that we did not know at the time they would not be swimming. We had lunch there bought drinks and had coffee and spent over €120 plus the €35 each 210 euro to get in and they couldn’t see it to give us back the €70 we probably could have booked in and stayed the night and got in bed and breakfast included very disappointed with the customer service of this beautiful Hotel

author: Daniel S
title: Perfect hotel for Rome
text: A friendly, comfortable and clean hotel. Within easy reach of the city centre and with the benefit of a lovely clean swimming pool to relax in. Also within 10 minutes walk of great restaurants and bars. Highly recommended!

author: Amelia P
title: Fantastic hotel!
text:
We have been to the Grand Hotel del Gianicolo six times and we really like it: well-maintained, good service, beautiful grounds, great pool, abundant breakfast, and a delicious restaurant!
WE WILL COME BACK ♥️

author: Lucas B
title: Beautiful hotel with quiet location.
text: Quiet and beautiful location. 10 minutes walk to the bustling Trastavere area. Clean and tidy. Beautiful garden to sit in and have a drink. Very nice staff.

author: Olivia G
title: Wonderful hotel, a gem above the city
text: We stayed 3 nights over Easter weekend. This is a beautiful hotel in an excellent location. With a short walk down hill to Trastevere, it is an ideal place to start exploring Rome. A short walk 2 min walk to Janiculum Hill you can view the most spectacular views over the city and watch the midday cannon fire....Staff were very attentive. Breakfast was ample, with bacon eggs, mushrooms, cold meats and cheese, and a selection of pastries. After our days out meeting our friends from Rome we returned to a pristine room every day. We will return to this beautiful hotel and plan to next year

author: Sophia F
title: Lovely quaint place
text:
Stayed here with my wife and child fo Easter weekend to meet up with our Italian friends as a base to see the sights of Rome. 
It is a lovely building set in the peaceful area of Rome so perfect for us,only downside was the pool was out of order, but with everything we had to see and do in our short stay.
Breakfast was lovely and freshly and topped up at regular intervals,the bar was nice and peaceful at night so we could relax after a long day.
We had a alarm going off on the one night during or stay which woke us all but other than that was good,we would stay again next year but it seems to be going up in price

author: Alexander A
title: My Roman Home away from Home
text: For approximately 30 years, I have been traveling to Rome on business, and for nearly all of that time I have stayed at the Grand Hotel del Gianicolo. In fact, I would not stay elsewhere in Rome. The Hotel Gianicolo is beautiful, pristine, and immaculately clean. Its entire staff - especially its Manager, Signore Sergio, whom I known for 30 years - are outstanding, kind, and always ready to assist. The Hotel is located atop the Janiculum Hill, one of the most idyllic and peaceful parks in all of Rome. I highly recommend my Roman "home away from home" to anyone planning a trip to the Eternal City. Charles T. Murr, author

author: Sean Z
title: Pleasant Reality
text:
Relaxing structure 
in Extraordinary Position .
Staff helpful and friendly , 
Immense for Courtesy 
the Reception. 
Rich and varied breakfast.

author: Tyler Z
title: Great experience
text: Great location, friendly and helpful staff, comfortable room, hearty breakfast... we will definitely be back!

author: Joseph H
title: Amazing experience Amazing hotel
text: Fabulous stay .amazing location. Wonderful staff. Beautiful pool.Great room. The staff went above &beyond for us . I was ill & they directed me to a local free doctor surgery.  It was a very good stay & I will return

author: Chloe N
title: Book a relaxing Pool day to escape the heat
text:
With a busy few days of sight seeing around Rome and temperatures reaching 38 degrees we decided we (especially the kids) needed some downtime somewhere we could relax and cool off. Having booked a central hotel which was great in terms of location but didn’t have a pool we discovered we could pay to use the pool at a nearby hotel. Super friendly staff, delicious food in the restaurant, a good selection of drinks and most importantly a huge pool with plenty of sunbeds this ensured a very enjoyable day of relaxing and escaping the crowds.
Cost was €50 pp (cheaper Monday-Friday) and this includes sunbeds, towels and swimming caps which had to worn in the pool.
Highly recommend.

author: Ian M
title: Swimming pool
text:
Came here for day visit for their pool and bar facilities. 

Great pool, very private 

However, have to wear a swim cap and use one of their towels. 

Cost 80 euro combined for me and my missus to have access to pool each, 2 towels, 2 swim caps and 2 sun beds.

Drinks and food expensive

author: George E
title: great hotel in a perfect location, absolutely reasonable price
text: I can't comprehend some reviews about the supposedly not so good service in any way. Maybe it's on some of them too; as you call into the forest, it resounds out. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. I would also like to highlight Alessandro from the pool bar. The location is a dream: just a few minutes walk to trastevere and to Garibaldi monument bus stops in front of and very close to the hotel. Breakfast may be a tiny shortcoming (moaning at the highest level). In the immediate vicinity is a bar. Pool is an absolute must at current 38 degrees. We will definitely be back!

author: Benjamin Q
title: Rome With An Old Time Flair !
text:
We have arrived back from our two month trip to Italy and Malta in April and May.  We stayed here for our Rome portion of the trip - 4 nights.  First the property is not modern,  but it is very well kept and very clean.  Only one elevator that really can hold just one person and their luggage at a time.  The room we stayed in was spacious, clean  and the bathroom was very nice and is updated.  Our room was on the third floor and  the windows opened out to the courtyard with shutters so you could get fresh air and have an a nice view. There is some traffic in the area, but it appeared from our walks to be mostly residential.  There is a restaurant in the property and it is amazing and the wait staff were fantastic and very friendly!  The food they prepared was delicious and the portions are plentiful with a lovely presentation. We are from the USA and an appetizer and one course was more than enough to make a complete meal with one of their good wines.   Reasonably priced.  I recommend you try their Carbonara!  We ate their two nights.  They also provide a free breakfast in the morning at the same place which is amazing and a great start to your day. The automatic coffee machine could produce various types of coffees and the meats and cheeses were my favorite!   They have a pool but it was to early in the season for us to use it, but it looked like a great place to hang out and relax.  Also, spend sometime in their bar area… made me feel like I was back in the 20’s/30’s.

The main use of transportation for us was Uber Black - get the app on your phone. All high end vehicles that took us to and from all the places we wanted to see.  I recommend highly a trip the Jewish Ghetto and make sure you order the fried and Roman style artichokes at one of the various outdoor cafes. I also recommend that you book a small private tour to see the Vatican Museum and the Sistine Chapel.  We had 5 persons in our group. We were able by passed the lines and saw parts of the Vatican that others did not see. Worth the cost, just be ready to be overwhelmed by all of the art!     All in all this was a great property from which to start our trip.   Staff was very friendly and very helpful with our questions we did have of them.  If I ever return to Rome this will be my go to place to stay!  Five stars and 10/10.

author: Tyler W
title: Great garden, nice service.
text: Very nice service. Great garden. Pool. We were greeted in a very pleasant way. It is wonderful to sit out in the garden and new sun and a coffee. Alternatively by the pool. Shielded and nice. Roof terrace with views without serving. We'll be back. Really recommended

author: Taylor H
text: This hotel is all about its great location. It is on the hillside above Trastevere, with the most amazing view of Rome from both sides. Incredibly calm, full of greenery, and, of course, the smell of spring. The hotel itself is quite old, but it has a lovely garden and the staff (especially the younger ones) were very helpful. Rooms are clean and medium-sized, with comfortable beds. However, as I said, it is a little worn-out in general. The breakfast room is cute, and the items are quite good for a four-star hotel. But the memory I will keep from my stay there will be the walks around the hotel area, in an amazing neighborhood.

author: Lea L
title: The photos sell a dream. The reality, however, is in the building across the street.
text:
Enticed by the stunning photos on the official website, we booked directly with the hotel. The first surprise upon arrival: a truly impressive lobby, worthy of a 4-star rating. We think we made the right choice.

Then comes the moment to go to our room… in the building across the street.

Result: a tiny room, a bathroom the size of an airplane cabin, no desk, no minibar. An Ibis without the Ibis sign.

When we pointed out the glaring difference from what was presented online, the reception's response was curt: "We do not have another room to offer you."

No solution. No commercial gesture. The photos sell a dream. The reality, however, is in the building across the street.

author: Joseph J
title: Don’t book here. Go somewhere else
text:
Update #2 (May 24, 2026)

One of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had. Thankfully, I documented everything with photos and videos.

The AC is not working during a current heat wave in Paris. The room smells unpleasant due to dirty carpets, and we even found spiders in the room. I spoke with three different front desk staff members and explained the situation multiple times. Their solution was to offer a fan, but the room still feels unbearably hot with almost no ventilation. On top of that, I had to use the fridge at the hotel’s concierge desk just to store my personal food because the fridge in our room was not functioning properly. This was incredibly inconvenient and unacceptable for a hotel advertising basic amenities.

We bought cheese and butter for dinner and lunch, but because the fridge in the room was not working, the items melted and became unusable.

I have already escalated this situation to my bank and shared documentation of the conditions and service failures. I am also considering sharing my experience publicly across platforms including Reddit, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram because guests deserve transparency before booking here.

This hotel was recently acquired by new management, and there appears to be a major decline in both service quality and maintenance standards. Based on my experience, the new management seems unprepared to operate a hospitality property at the level advertised online. (I doubt this management is European or American). 

UPDATE (May 20, 2026)

1. The AC is not working. According to the night concierge, the cooling systems across the building have been disabled.
2. The WiFi/internet was also not functioning properly.
3. We were informed that some safety cameras in the building were affected due to the internet outage, which raised additional safety concerns.

It is extremely misleading to advertise AC and WiFi as available amenities when both services were either unavailable or unreliable during our stay, especially during a heat wave. I am currently speaking with Expedia regarding a refund for the sleepless and uncomfortable nights we experienced.

author: Antoine Z
title: Not recommendable
text:
Hotel is recommendable
Room with a dirty rocket
Breakfast. Poor in food
Unprofessional and unpleasant staff
Invoice not provided, had to call the front desk to obtain the invoice
One must cross a street to go have breakfast
Avoid for the price

author: Evie A
title: Parisian hotel perfect for couples or business travelers
text:
We were at the New Hotel République/Maison Gabriel on post trip to Réunion.

Again I loved it. First on vacation and not for work. We chose the room with the balcony. We LOVED it and definitely it was worth the price paid 🤩

The bathroom is huge!

I recommend this hotel both for the business traveler that I am or as a couple!

RoomsRoom with balcony a must! Huge bathroom for Paris

Activities nearbyBakery, renowned restaurant, Place de la République, metro, Canal St Martin, etc

author: Tyler F
title: Beautiful hotel just steps from Republique and Le Marais
text:
Position:
Great location, 5 minutes from Republique metro station, from which you can take several lines to every corner of the city. Quiet area, well frequented, residential and full of bars, boulangeries, supermarkets, pharmacies and various shops. In a quarter of an hour walk you can reach the lively Le Marais district, great for evening walks.

Rooms:
Cozy rooms, very comfortable beds and presence of a small refrigerator. I really enjoyed the high quality personal hygiene products and the presence of a professional hairdryer. Our room had a nice little balcony. Reception h24, convenient check out at 12 and daily cleaning of the rooms.

General comments:
It was a pleasant stay, recommended hotel.

author: Diego U
title: Definitely NOT Four Stars
text: Location was great but the room left much to be desired - mysterious liquid stains, dirty towel, ripped linens. It isn’t soundproof and lacked many amenities listed online. I told the front desk I had several issues twice and they said to wait until Monday (two days) to speak to someone. Manager gave me an email to send my photos to and no reply. Unacceptable and disappointing for a four star hotel.

author: Antoine S
title: Is there such a thing as an ideal hotel? Maybe yes, with the Hotel Gabriel 💖
text: I regularly visit the Hotel Gabriel for my business trips, and if I never wanted to go elsewhere, it is because the Hotel Gabriel offers a Welcoming always qualitative, in a sumptuous setting. The hotel team is always amazingly kind and with great care, the rooms are sublime and very comfortable, it is a constant pleasure to come and stay!

author: Emma I
title: Absolutely wonderful small hotel perfectly located
text:
this was our first trip to Paris and when considering places to stay I wanted to tick the following boxes.
1 - Not too central but within easy walking distance of the places we wanted to visit.
2 - Not so large that it was going to be filled with too many people coming and going
3 - Ideally somewhere with a bit of personality
The Hotel Gabriel delivered wonderfully on all these things and so much more. Our room was perfect. Tastefully decorated and perfectly comfortable.
Every staff member was friendly and welcoming and helpful with anything we needed.
The breakfast provided was excellent and the perfect start to each long day of walking ahead.
The street the hotel was on was tucked away behind some large busy streets full of bars and restaurants but there was little to no noise in our room at night.
On the last day we left our suitcases at the hotel after checkout from 11am until 5:30 pm when we were heading to the airport, which allowed us to do another full day of sight seeing, which was a huge help.
I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough. It was perfectly lowkey and understated but run like clockwork.

author: Caleb E
title: Fantastic Boutique Paris Hotel
text:
Our AAA travel advisor recommended the Hotel Gabriel and, as always, it was a great recommendation. 
Very clean, very quiet and well-appointed room.  Great lighting, air conditioning and breakfast. 
The front desk manager with whom we had the most contact (Maya) spoke fluent English and could not have been more pleasant and helpful in planning our local excursions utilizing the metro, trains, taxis, or walking. 
We will undoubtedly select the Hotel Gabriel for our next Paris visit.

author: Harper T
title: Calm, comfort and kindness
text:
We stayed 7 nights at Hotel Gabriel. Everything was done for us to have a great stay. The staff is kind, extremely kind and professional. The Gabriel is very comfortable, quiet and relaxing.
Its geographical location makes it easy to visit Paris.
I recommend this hotel , we will be back! for sure! Thanks again.

author: Abigail N
title: Beautiful Paris of the belle époque! Yeah, good!
text:
Everything was perfect and good quality.
Ideally located in the top of the marsh 
Deco kitsch at will, it looks like the Paris of the belle époque 
I highly recommend!!

author: Oliver Q
title: Great Hotel, Great Team, Highly Pleasant Family Stay
text: Very pleasant stay at the Gabriel thanks to its top team! The hotel is quiet despite its excellent location very near "République". Breakfast is fine too. Highly recommended.

author: Zoe N
title: A Perfect Parisian Stay Awaits at Hotel Gabriel!
text: The Hotel Gabriel perfectly complemented our interests in a hotel: impeccably clean; marvelously situated in a quiet yet highly accessible street close to two metro stops and numerous shops and restaurants; expertly managed by a capable team of knowledgeable and helpful staff; wonderfully comfortable accommodations with 21st century amenities;  a reliable elevator, and a lovely breakfast offering delights for all tastes and diets! I wholeheartedly recommend this hotel!

author: Lily D
title: Lovely hotel in the 11th arrondissement
text: We booked this hotel based on reviews. This was the first time I stayed in the 11 ieme arrondissement and I was very pleased. The hotel is in a quiet street just off the Avenue de la republic close to two metro stations. The initial welcome was confusing as the concierge gave us the wrong keys but after that mix up everything went smoothly. The rooms are small but have all the necessary amenities. The shower was excellent though water kept coming out of the bathroom. The morning breakfast was included and was sumptuous. The staff was friendly. The elevator is small but functional. I wished the room was a little bigger.  I was staying alone but I think it would be too small for two people. The housecleaning staff was excellent. I enjoyed our stay in this neighborhood which had many lovely cafes and restaurants and felt very safe. The canal st Martin was very close by and I could easily walk across to many of the famous sites of Paris.

author: Ella A
title: Fab stay fab hotel
text:
Excellent stay in a lovely hotel. Great location for either the Metro or to walk to the central attractions. 
Nice surrounding area( I recommend La Little for a drink).
Florence was very helpful and friendly. 
Breakfast was lovely and plenty of choice.
Would definitely stay again.

author: Zachary V
title: Beautiful Boutique Hotel in Ideal location
text: I was very happy with my stay at HG in Paris. The hotel is decorated in a beautiful Parisian warm style. The rooms aren’t large but they think of all the details to make the room comfortable and efficient. The staff is friendly and helpful. The location is ideal and very close to the metro.

author: Nathan W
title: Brilliant hotel
text: Brilliant hotel stay, great location, super friendly staff who went out of their way to accomodate our bikes and helped with parking. Very quiet rooms, super clean and perfect temperature. Highly recommend!!

author: Amelia D
title: Hotel Gabriel Paris
text: Everything perfect, have nothing to oppose. Location is top and in a non-dangerous area (which was important to us). The excellent service is particularly worth highlighting.

author: Daisy Z
title: A small comfortable hotel with easy access
text: I chose this hotel for its proximity to the Marais district. Its a very small quaint hotel, though maybe one can find ones even closer to the marais. Initially the room i booked for single occupancy was way too small but they upgraded me to a much nicer room. Special  shout out to Daira, Dushka and Elise all very helpful and they helped me with an early check-in after a very long flight from India. The breakfast is adequate and filling and most importantly as a solo traveller I felt very safe in this hotel and the neighbourhood. Cabs found my location easily and that was a plus point.

author: Mathis O
title: Great stay
text: We had a wonderful time at this hotel great staff , nice rooms great area of Paris.Breakfast very good breakfast staff excellent.Easy to get to metro and plenty of good priced bars in area . Plus easy to get to and quick from Gare du Nord.Will definitely stay again

author: Sean J
title: Excellent
text:
Excellent 3-star hotel a stone's throw from the station.
During breakfast the staff proved to be very kind, in particular Giulia..
Excellent service, we had a good time and we will return..

author: Louis E
title: Disappointing
text:
Little cooperation in handling the problem
The stay on 08/12 was regularly completed and paid €86 directly to the hotel.
The problem concerns a second Trivago booking for 08/23, worth €65, which was never used due to an error in the booking procedure.
I asked the hotel for simple cooperation to allow Trivago to evaluate the refund, but the property stated that it could not intervene, referring me back to Trivago/Orbe Travel.
I understand that the booking was managed through an intermediary, but I would have expected more willingness to seek a solution for the customer, especially considering that the room for 08/23 was never used.
Regular stay, but management of the problem decidedly unsatisfactory

author: Erin L
title: Clean, Safe room exactly next to the train station
text:
This place is exactly across the street from Rome Termini Station. Booked it because we had an 8am train and didn't want to deal with any commute. 
Found this. The older reviews were lackluster but newer ones much more positive. Figured, at worst it's just 1 night. 

What we got was a quirky,  old fashioned hotel but everything was spotless and modern. The decor in the room was like my grandmother's place from the 1940s... but new. Very unique and nice. 
Loads of dining nearby. We left early in the morning so didn't take the breakfast option. Obviously, no opinion on that regard
The price point was a little high compared to some other areas in the city but you have ultimate convenience to the rail system, a clean, safe hotel and helpful staff... perfect for late train arrival or early departure. I could see using it as a base for a couple days but for longer stays, I think I'd choose something away from the train station

author: Abigail M
title: Extremely kind and efficient staff
text:
I forgot a blouse in the closet, the hotel staff found it and helped me send it to my home. A big thank you! 
 The hotel has an excellent location, the room was a bit dated but comfortable, and the air conditioning was working perfectly.  Receptionists were really kind and efficient.

author: Alice V
title: Not really...
text:
Leave it alone unless you want to spend "little" (very relatively) and have an absolute need to be close to Termini.
Friendly staff, excellent location... sufficient breakfast.
EVERYTHING else is negative; the rooms are not old, they are completely in need of renovation: rust in the bathroom, destroyed floors, phone in the room not connected, bidet with a blocked stopper, balcony blocked (overlooking a busy street with noise all night), shower in the tub without even a $10 curtain, shower gel bottle completely empty upon arrival... etc. etc...
A maze of rooms, I imagine all like mine; I understand that it is difficult to renovate them all and it is more convenient for them to "get by" since they still earn from tours, etc... but they must do at least a MINIMUM of maintenance; otherwise, it is hard to understand how they can remain open. Also because it costs less than other hotels in the area, but it is still too expensive for the conditions in which they leave it.

author: Abigail E
title: Excellent and economical
text: The breakfast is very good...it is the ideal location to go anywhere either by walking or by transportation...anywhere police and army you have nothing to fear ...a crowd of people that makes you feel safe...when I go again Rome again there I will go

author: Mason K
title: BB
text:
You can say that the hotel itself is fairly acceptable... Just a few inaccuracies in cleaning.
After returning to the room we had been allowed to meet our peers; even after avoiding the disturbance of the peace, a very large man on night duty threatened us because we could not stay in more than two in the room.
So the service was indecent and undesirable.

author: Lily A
title: If you come for a trip you can rest assured
text:
I came here on a trip with the school for 4 days
The location of the hotel is quite convenient pk is literally in front of the Roma Termini station so you have metro and train very close
The good breakfast there were the classic breakfast foods like brioche, rusks, nutella, jam, bread (also to toast) etc
Dinner was not at the hotel but in a partner restaurant, all quite good
Rooms were all two except one three
In the evening you could stay with friends in the hotel until 23:20 pk c was curfew
The beds were really comfortable
Youtube was also on the TV

author: Alice Q
title: Great location across from Rome’s main train station
text:
Great location across from Rome’s main train station
I had a very pleasant stay at Hotel Siracusa. The location is excellent right across from Rome’s main train station which makes it very convenient for arrivals and day trips. The hotel is on Via Marsala and it is easy to find because there are signs inside the station pointing in that direction.
The staff were friendly and welcoming. A special thank you to Christina, Sara, and Simone for their helpful service. I was also impressed that the head of housekeeping stopped by my room to check if everything was comfortable. That personal touch was appreciated.
The beds were comfortable and the Wi Fi was fast and reliable.
Overall a comfortable stay in a very convenient location.

author: Michael N
title: A prison for minors
text:
If you are looking for a place to stay in Rome with your school, my advice is simple: avoid this hotel carefully.

I was here during an educational trip and the experience was so surreal that it almost seems like a joke, except that unfortunately it was all true.

Let's start from the rooms, just to warm up: doors that don't close, dirty bathtubs, and sockets disconnected from the wall that seemed to be on the verge of exiting permanently at the first attempt to charge the phone. A small daily obstacle course that they evidently consider normal maintenance here.

But the real show was the behavior of the staff.

From 23:00 a security gentleman started walking around the corridors treating us as if we were organising an international rave, telling us to immediately return to the rooms because – he said – we were making too much noise. Reality? We were just talking among classmates, which is quite normal on an educational trip. All accompanied by threats of “irreversible measures” in case we dared to go overboard.

The best part comes later: around 2 am the same gentleman started yelling in the corridors to silence, succeeding in the extraordinary feat of waking up the whole floor. The only person who was really messing up... was him.  
The next night, so as not to miss anything, he thought it best to break directly into the rooms. Yes, I did.

Reception chapter: practically non-existent professionalism. Between rude attitudes and total disregard for guests, the most memorable moment was when, after a very long and tiring day, we were waiting for the keys to go up to the room. The blonde receptionist on duty watched as she quietly continued a personal phone call to arrange an aperitif with a friend, ignoring us completely despite our polite calls. We in front of the counter waiting, she serenely talking about spritz. Clear priorities.

But the real gem, the one that deserves a special mention, concerns bail.

At the end of their stay, they tried to be smart and try to hold her back, without any valid reason. A rather clumsy attempt to pocket money they weren't owed. Fortunately, we didn't let ourselves be fooled and insisted until it was returned to us, but the attempt remains embarrassing to say the least.  
So a very serious tip: if you are staying here, be very careful about bail and do not let your feet on the head.

In summary: poorly maintained rooms, rude staff, security that creates more disturbance than guests and questionable attempts to withhold money that is not due.  

Not recommended for anyone, especially schoolchildren.

The only positive note? The breakfast.  
And I'd say that says it all.

author: Aaron R
title: Ideal solution for parking
text:
Hotel dated but clean, small rooms with little functional furniture. Small but clean bathroom (apart from a few black stripes in the joints of the shower tiles). Sweet and savoury breakfast sufficiently varied.
Given the location right in front of Termini station, I recommend it to spend 1, maximum 2 nights.
No more because as isolated as the rooms are, you can hear the sounds of Roman nightlife.
All in all, we had a good time and will definitely be back.

author: Isla T
title: No, go.
text: bad experience. Rooms with cracks and doors with broken handles. Dirty blankets and pillows. Smells like fry with the window open

author: Zachary P
title: Great location - rude security guard!
text:
This was a school trip visit with 40 students & 4 staff. the hotel is in a brilliant location - great for the train station and the city centre. It felt a safe location and lots of little shops/cafes etc for the student's to use. 

The breakfast had lots of choice and great luggage storage for the day we needed. 

The staff didn't look like they enjoying their job and weren't friendly or particularly  helpful. 

The evening security guard was rude, loud and officious. He spoke to the students in a very inappropriate manner and kept waking up staff - that couldn't hear any noise. He could have been a huge asset to the hotel & staff leading trips but abused his position. If the hotel are to welcome school parties they need to work on their offer and put the rooms of students together rather than spreading them round the hotel.

author: Ella V
title: Decent stay in Rome
text: My partner and I were worried about staying here after reading the summer reviews but we had a good stay here. Staff were friendly, breakfast had variety. The room was clean. Yes the hotel and rooms are dated but for a few nights it meets the needs of travellers. It is right near the main station and centre of Rome so it is noisy which is to be expected. If you want quiet don't stay in the centre of Rome. Overall we were happy with our stay

author: Alexander T
title: Bad experience
text: Lousy hotel. It pays a lot for what it really is. Dismal attention. The facilities are sloppy, they treat you as if you are doing a favor, the elevator is a danger because it looks like it will fall and trembles while it is in motion.

author: Noah B
title: Ready to visit Rome
text: Clean hotel courteous staff strategic location with all the means available, buffet breakfast ok with Mrs. Carla ready to assist in case of need 👍👋

author: Katie G
title: Well located, comfortable
text:
I was there from June 28th to July 2nd in the middle of a heat wave. Excellent service, very friendly. Luggage storage service.
I recommend 100% 
If I return to Rome I will repeat with them

author: Jack M
title: Location. That’s it.
text:
So firstly the positives. The Hotel is across the street from Termini Station.  The staff are friendly and helpful.

We had a family room on the fourth floor at the rear. That helped to minimise street noise. Then there was the hotel noise. The rooms have these big heavy wooden doors and a key with a heavy keyring. If the doors are not carefully closed they bang loudly. This happened several times especially late at night.

The Aircon in our room was poor and the room was like a sauna. The furnishings are old and scruffy. There is no shower screw or curtain. So it was difficult to shower without flooding the bathroom and seeping through to the bedroom.

All in all a disappointment.

author: Sara Z
title: Okay for  a place to rest your head but nothing more
text: Great location next to the Rome train station, and okay for a place to spend a few nights if you don't intend on spending much time on premises. The breakfast offered was a pleasant surprise. Front desk service was very helpful when asking to store our luggage for the day.

author: Sara D
title: Fabulous location & great Hotel
text:
Best location in Rome 

This hotel deserves a great review as the staff are amazing & nothing is too much trouble.
The room is excellent and roomy, with a beautiful view & very quiet.
The shower is small but good water pressure & the bed very comfortable.
Only criticism is the lack of tea and coffee making facilities but the staff brought us a kettle & with a small fridge in the room, we whipped across the road to Termini where there's a supermarket and bought a box of tea bags & milk, all for under 3euros.
For the very reasonable tariff here, for 3 nights in this amazing city, we think it deserves a nine out of ten.

author: Molly V
title: Everything
text:
Our Stay at the Hotel 

We had a wonderful experience at the hotel from the moment we arrived. The hotel completely met all of our expectations and provided everything we needed for a comfortable, enjoyable, and relaxing stay. The atmosphere, service, and overall experience were excellent, and we would absolutely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Rome.

Matteo’s Outstanding Service 

However, Matteo truly took our experience to another level. He is an incredibly kind, warm, attentive, and service-oriented person. He took care of us exceptionally well and always made us feel welcomed and valued.

No matter what we asked, Matteo was always happy to help. He gave us detailed and thoughtful answers, went above and beyond to assist us, and made sure we had everything we needed.

What stood out to us the most was his genuine warmth, friendliness, and care for the guests. His positive attitude and kindness made our stay so much more enjoyable.

Even though the hotel already exceeded our expectations, Matteo made the experience twice as special. His service truly made a difference, and we are very grateful for everything he did for us.

We would absolutely recommend this hotel to everyone we know, and Matteo is definitely one of the main reasons why. He is a wonderful representative of the hotel and deserves all the appreciation and recognition for his outstanding service. ❤️

author: Pablo H
title: A spectacular experience at the Trilussa Palace Hotel
text:
Our stay at the Trilussa Palace Hotel in Rome has been simply spectacular. From the first day we felt at home thanks to the very warm, friendly, and professional treatment from all the staff. The service received was a ten, always with a smile and willing to help us at all times.
I am Davinia, the Spanish woman who was using a crutch, and Javier from 613.

I want to especially highlight my dear Faviola, for her friendliness, affection, and attention during our entire stay. People like her make a trip become an unforgettable memory. I also want to thank the front desk manager, who, after we explained what had happened to us with Logitravel, gifted us a spa day; everyone at the front desk is unique and so good, whose professionalism, kindness, and dedication have been exceptional.

The rooms are comfortable and clean, the location is excellent for visiting Rome, and the hotel's atmosphere is quiet and welcoming. It is no coincidence that the hotel has thousands of positive reviews and a very high rating among travelers.

Without a doubt, we will return to this hotel when we go back to Rome. Thank you for making our vacation so special. I recommend the Trilussa Palace Hotel to anyone who wants to enjoy an unforgettable stay in the Eternal City.

Thank you, Faviola, thank you to the front desk manager, and thank you to the entire Trilussa Palace Hotel team for your extraordinary attention!

author: Charlie E
title: Friendly, attentive, clean and cool!
text:
Lovely stay and would recommend. What really stood out for us was the customer service. Responses to emails ahead of the trip were very prompt and professional, and the warm welcome we received when we arrived really set the tone for a positive and comfortable stay - management should be proud of their staff as you cannot underestimate the importance of making guests feel at ease and welcome as soon as they arrive. 

We arrived a few hours before check in and appreciated being allowed to leave our bags in a storage room - being offered bottled water before we headed off for a little explore was a kind touch. It’s v hot in Rome atm and we were grateful to receive a message to let us know our room was ready (earlier than expected) and our bags were waiting for us in our room. We also appreciated the ice bucket delivery to our room, and a complementary bottle of fizz. 

In terms of the hotel itself - its very clean, great location (there’s a super market and mini market close by, and restaurants a short walk), quiet (we had a room with a balcony and couldn’t hear traffic when windows were closed) and great air con. 

Overall a lovely stay - the highlight being the staff and their approach. Keep doing what you’re doing - it works and is appreciated! Thank you!

author: Noah L
title: JUST AMAZING
text:
We stayed at Trulissa Palace Hotel in Rome from the 8th–10th and honestly, it was amazing. We were a little sceptical after seeing some of the negative reviews, but it completely exceeded our expectations and we genuinely couldn’t fault our stay.

From the second we arrived, the staff were so lovely, welcoming and helpful. Every time we had a question, they were more than happy to help and were always so informative. The hotel itself was absolutely spotless — genuinely, there wasn’t a single bit of dirt anywhere. Everything was so clean and well looked after.

We stayed in what I believe was one of the more basic rooms, but even that was exceptional. We had a balcony, a mini bar and everything we could have needed was provided. One night, our TV stopped working at around 12–1am, and they immediately sent someone up to help us. He had a little look around and managed to get it working again, which we really appreciated considering how late it was.

We also booked the spa, which you get at a discounted price as a hotel guest (up to 30%, I believe). Unfortunately, we completely overslept and missed the time we had booked, but they were so understanding and more than happy to let us go in a different slot instead. Everyone was just genuinely so kind and accommodating.

Breakfast was included with our stay and there was such a huge variety, so there was loads to choose from. The rooftop bar was also amazing. We unfortunately didn’t get the chance to eat up there, but we went up for a quick drink and it was lovely.

The location was also perfect. It was so close to the centre and there were loads of transport options nearby — buses, trains, bikes, electric scooters, pretty much everything you could need. It made getting around Rome so easy.

Overall, we genuinely loved our stay here. The hotel was beautiful and spotless, the location was great and the staff were honestly some of the nicest and most helpful we’ve come across. We were so impressed, especially considering we had been a little put off by some of the reviews beforehand. I would 100% recommend staying here and would definitely come back! ♡

author: Pablo V
title: A magical place
text:
Returning to the Trilussa Palace is always a sure thing. I already know this property very well and, precisely for this reason, I can say that every time it manages to confirm my expectations and make me feel at home. The spas remain one of my favorite corners: a well-kept, elegant environment, perfect for indulging in a moment of true relaxation. It is precisely that type of place where you know you can completely disconnect and enjoy a few hours of tranquility. A special thanks goes to Lorena, who once again proved to be exceptional. Her kindness, professionalism, and attention to the customer truly make the difference. It is nice to find people who, with their way of working and welcoming you, contribute to making every return even more pleasant. If I keep choosing the Trilussa Palace and returning there, there is a reason: quality, atmosphere, and above all, an attention to the guest that is not at all taken for granted.

A guarantee, as always.

author: Dylan I
title: Excellent stay in the heart of Trastevere!
text:
We stayed 2 nights at the Trilussa Palace Hotel choosing the Cinema Studio family room and we had a really great time.

The room was super clean, the bed very comfortable, and we also appreciated the possibility of choosing between different types of pillows. The bathroom was also very nice, covered in marble with an antique style, with a multi-jet shower that also gives a sort of back massage.

The strong point of the room, however, is definitely the projector: it really feels like being at the cinema, but directly from the bed! My wife, my daughter, and I enjoyed a movie all together and it was a very nice thing, especially after a day spent walking around Rome.

Breakfast was also excellent. I chose the pancakes, prepared on the spot, and they were really good.

Reception staff always kind and very helpful. The location was also very convenient for us: we are in Trastevere and right outside the hotel there are tram connections that allow you to easily reach many of the most visited areas of Rome.

I would return very gladly and we will certainly keep it in mind for our next visits to Rome.

Highly recommended!

author: Aiden Q
title: Wonderful stay
text: Excellent Staff very friendly and always helpful. I would highly recommend staying at this hotel and eat at the restaurant and definitely use the Spa.

author: Sofia X
title: Perfect
text: Excellent hotel. A perfect team, very professional and pleasant. The spas are incredible! It was perfect

author: Taylor E
title: Spotless, Quiet Room Despite Busy Street
text: Our room was spotless, and even though it faced a busy, noisy street, it was surprisingly quiet and relaxing inside. The air conditioning worked perfectly, and we appreciated having coffee and tea-making facilities as well as a minibar in the room. The staff were amzing throughout our stay, always friendly, welcoming, and ready to help with directions or recommendations. The location was very unique, with tram and bus stops just down the street, making it easy to explore the city. There was also a huge market opposite the hotel on Sunday morning, which was great for browsing. The rooftop bar offered beautiful views and was a lovely place to unwind after a day out. We had a fantastic stay and would definitely choose this hotel again on our next visit.

author: Sofia E
title: Excellent Hotel
text: Our room was very clean and although it faced the busy noisy  street it was very quiet and relaxing. The A/C worked perfectly, there is coffee and tee making facilities and a mini bar. The staff are amazing and so helpful. Great location, tram and bus stop just down the street and  a huge market opposite on a Sunday morning. Great views from the roof top bar. Will definitely stay here again on our next visit to Rome.

author: Amelia C
title: Great hotel in Trastevere
text: We booked this hotel based on advice from colleagues who stayed there several months ago. I must say that the staff, specifically Alessandro at the front desk and Fabiana at the breakfast bar, are the epitome of great customer service ! Alessandro provided us with a wealth of information on places to eat nearby. We had a horrible experience at the rooftop restaurant ( see review of the 8th floor rooftop restaurant) and took our complaint to Alessandro who immediately called a manager. We spoke with Marco and Carolina and discussed the horrible customer service we experienced. Aside from the rooftop restaurant, this restaurant does provide an excellent experience for tourists.

author: Katie S
title: Great hotel in an excellent location
text: We stayed at this hotel for 6 days,The staff were incredibly helpful, friendly, and always ready to assist with anything we needed. The room was spotless, very clean, and exceptionally quiet, allowing us to relax and sleep comfortably every night. The location is one of the best in Rome, with easy access to all major attractions and excellent public transportation connections. Getting around the city by bus was very convenient and hassle-free. Overall, a fantastic experience, and we would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

author: Harry N
title: GUESTS OF THE HOUSE

author: Leo A
title: Excellent and very cozy ante stay in Rome
text: The hotel is excellent and exceeded our expectations for a couple trip. The rooms are cosy, comfortable and extremely clean. Another strength is the location, close to the restaurants and bars of the bustling square of Trastevere, the train station and the bus and bus stops. author: George M
title: Family vacation
text: We were looking for a hotel just outside the city center so we could leave the car but also reach most places of interest within a half-hour walk. And indeed, we found the ideal solution here. Then we also had a great time. Friendly and professional staff. Spacious and clean room. Excellent breakfast.

author: Erin Z
title: Wonderful staff and Hotel and Spa
text:
Great Staff, nice hotel. 
Paolo ( bar) Alessandro ( chef) Carolina, Matteo, Andrea, Lorena, and others were all lovely and I made sure to tell them that! In particular they calmed me when I left my phone in a Taxi! - and they got it back for me immediately. The hotel beds are Wonderful, for good sleeps. A lovely holiday.

author: Mason Y
title: Relaxation assured
text: Fantastic place, relaxation assured, friendly and helpful staff at all hours, recommended for couple or group of friends, experience to try again

author: Kyle R
title: The best Roman experience
text:
Staying at Hotel Trilussa in the heart of Trastevere was a simply extraordinary experience. From the first moment you can feel a unique atmosphere: a simple and authentic environment, but at the same time refined and of a high level, able to make you feel immediately at home.

The room turned out to be impeccable: cozy, extremely clean and surprisingly spacious. The bathroom, spacious and attention to detail, reflects an aesthetic and functional research that is rarely found even in higher category facilities.

The reception service was professional, attentive and always available, with a really high quality standard. Special praise to the director, always present, attentive to the needs of guests and able to transmit a true culture of hospitality.

The “Moon” Spa is an authentic flagship: elegant, spacious and of the highest standard, with impeccable cleanliness that helps to make the experience even more exclusive and relaxing.

The location is simply perfect: strategic, central and convenient to reach all the main attractions of Rome, making your stay even more pleasant and stress-free.

In conclusion, a more than positive experience from every point of view. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to experience Rome with comfort, style and authenticity. Officially a four star, but as far as I am concerned, without any doubt, a true five star. Thank you for making your stay so memorable.

author: Ella Z
title: Beautiful experience at Trilussa Palace
text: I was with my husband at the spa moon of the Trilussa Palace Hotel...I'm already a customer of this hotel, both for the spa and for the restaurant...what to say...the Trilussa Palace is never denied...the spa moon is fantastic, and so is the pool!! Well equipped with everything you need, and in addition you are delighted with tarallini, prosecco and free soft drinks... at the restaurant, really nice and elegant, you eat excellently... excellent quality food and impeccable service... what to say... I highly recommend everyone to go.

author: Caleb I
title: Wonderful hotel
text: My partner and I had a lovely 4 days in Rome and the Trilissa Palace Hotel was just perfect for our stay. Bonus for having a sushi restaurant right next door where we ate every evening. The Spa's at the hotel were gorgeous, we booked 2 different ones whilst we were there. Breakfast was lovely, plenty to choose from. Wonderful helpful staff who went out there way. Would def return and highly recommend.

author: Michael A

author: Juan A
title: Le meilleur hôtel de Paris !

author: Harper L
title: Review dated 06/28/2026
text:
Very warm welcome from the staff.

Very good breakfast.

title: Excellent location.
text:

Othello and Ingrid were the best! 🫰🏼✨ Thank you very much for everything! Othello gave us a little map and recommended some great places!

author: Zoe M
title: Friendly concierge
text: The room is small but aren't they all in Paris? It was as on the foto's, so we came prepared. special thanks to the super friendly concierge who gave us a lot of perfect tips according to what we had planned for the day. Our compliments. This is what hospitality is about!

author: Megan M
title: 10/10 stay
text:
We had a wonderful stay at Eiffel Villa Garibaldi and couldn’t be happier with our experience. The hotel was beautiful, clean, and the staff were incredibly welcoming.

A special thank you to Othello at the front desk, who went above and beyond to make our trip memorable. He was so helpful in recommending attractions to visit and great places to eat around the city. Thanks to his suggestions, we were able to enjoy some amazing experiences in Paris. He also kindly upgraded our room due to availability, which was such a thoughtful and appreciated gesture.

The service was exceptional from start to finish, and everyone made us feel right at home. We absolutely loved our stay and would highly recommend Eiffel Villa Garibaldi to anyone visiting Paris. Thank you, Othello, and the entire team for making our trip so special! 10/10! 🌟

author: Morgan V
title: Excellent experience

Her warmth and professionalism turned a simple overnight stay into a lovely experience. She is a real credit to the hotel, and honestly, we would happily stay here again because of how welcome she made us feel. Thank you for making our time in Paris so memorable.

author: Noah F

author: Mia S
title: Very good hotel
text: Pleasant welcome. The rooms are clean and functional. The breakfast is varied. No street noise at night.

author: Leo L
title: Lovely pit stop for exploring the city
text: This was our 3rd time visiting Paris and the first time trying this hotel as we were showing our friends around the city so wanted somewhere on a budget so this was perfect. Location good as close to the metro and can walk to the Eiffel Tower easily. Close to shops and bakeries and restaurants too. Nice touch that you can take a hot drink out for the day and one to bed and a snack! Staff were super friendly and kind and really wanted to get to know you and help too, which we’ve never had before staying in Paris! Only downside was the rooms are tiny and very claustrophobic, the floors were very sticky and dirty so our feet were pretty black and socks too. The shower is super small and the room is just very basic and hardly any storage to put your clothes so pretty much to lived out the suitcase which was hard when the room was so small. Also the walls are paper thin so we didn’t fall to sleep u til about 3am every night as the doors were crashing and you could hear everything. So we were very tired on this trip due to lack of sleep. However we had a lovely welcome and the bed had balloons and rose petals and a bottle of wine which was a lovely way to start the trip

author: Alice E
title: Do not recommend- they will not resolve problems
text:
We were told we had received a complimentary upgrade from our original booking at Regina Giovanni, but unfortunately this did not feel like an upgrade at all.

The room itself was very basic, and to make matters worse, the electricity kept cutting in and out throughout our stay. I genuinely don’t understand how this was considered an upgrade.

From the early hours of the morning, we were woken by constant drilling and construction work taking place immediately next to our room. The noise continued for hours, making it impossible to sleep or relax. We left the hotel exhausted and with headaches.

If major building works are taking place, guests should either be informed before arrival or allocated rooms well away from the noise. It is unacceptable to charge guests for a stay where they cannot even get a full night’s sleep.

To make matters worse, they have still not responded to my emails regarding the experience. 

Overall, the experience was extremely disappointing. Between the basic room, the unreliable electricity, and the excessive construction noise, I would not recommend staying here until these issues have been resolved.

author: Ana A

author: Tyler V
title: Birthday mini break
text:
Golden Tulip Rome

Overall, the Golden Tulip Rome is an okay hotel with some good points and some things to be aware of. The front bar and restaurant area is quite nice — a 300ml beer costs around £8 and cocktails are about £12.

We originally booked a superior room, which should be on the top floors and about 5.5 metres wide. Instead, we were given a standard room that measured only 4.2 metres. Luckily, I had a tape measure with me, and once we pointed it out, they changed our room.

The hotel is in a decent location — roughly a 20-minute walk to most of the popular sites. There’s also a bus stop just 2 minutes away, with rides costing €1.33.

Everything was going smoothly until 10 minutes before we were due to leave, when my partner’s handbag was stolen right outside the hotel. Please be extremely careful — people are clearly watching and waiting. My partner went inside to pay for a coffee, someone shouted to distract me, and another person grabbed the bag. It all happened in about 10 seconds.

The holiday overall was still good, but the theft definitely left a mark.

A few extra notes:

Hotel spa is not free — it costs €42 per person, and honestly isn’t worth it. We found a better spa just around the corner.

Breakfast was disappointing if you're English and like a fry-up. The hot options were basically cold hotdog sausages, bacon, and scrambled eggs. On the positive side, the pancakes with real honey were nice.

I’d recommend maybe staying a bit closer to the Trevi Fountain if you want more bars and restaurants nearby.

author: Katie P
title: Lovely Stay in the Heart of Rome
text:
The location was excellent — just a few minutes away from Termini Station, yet in a nice and quiet neighborhood. We stayed for three nights and walked everywhere without needing to take a bus or metro.

The staff was very pleasant, especially the older gentleman at the reception on the night of our departure — he was extremely kind and helpful.

The breakfast was excellent — varied, fresh, and a great start to the day.

Fontana di Trevi, the Pantheon, and the Spanish Steps were all within walking distance.

The only downside was the poor sound insulation — I could hear noises from the neighboring rooms, which woke me up every night.

Also, the hotel could improve its marketing and social media presence — it actually looks much nicer in person than it does online.

Overall, a lovely stay and great value for money.

author: Noah K
title: Bad experience.
text: Bad experience, I booked, through the booking platform, for day October 3, two rooms for 4 people (for a hefty expense of 440 euros for one night only!). As a result of the national strike for the just and honourable cause pro FLOTILLA , our train has been cancelled. While Trenitalia has provided for the refund, this structure not only charged me the full amount but proved rigid to any possible date shift, despite trying to make a request already two days before arrival... To speculate on such a situation is shameful, they pocketed the money without having done anything. On booking I was denied the opportunity to review the property, despite I was in possession of the booking code and pin... shameful.

author: Charlie F
title: Not where we would stay next time!
text:
At best, I would say this hotel is mediocre in all ways!  
Perhaps they have become too dependent on the various tour companies using their hotel to accommodate clients.  
Although the rooms were clean,  they are in need of some fresh paint.  Walks are very marked up and dirty.  Beds felt like we were sleeping on a cot.  Not very comfortable.  There was a disco somewhere nearby which made it difficult to fall asleep because of the very loud bass thumping. 
Front desk staff were very courteous but not the same was to be said about anyone else.  The bar manager was very rude to us and to his fellow staff.  I can speak and understand Italian!!!!!! 
Rooftop is lovely and should be promoted better. Perhaps, more engaging staff up there would help in doing so.

author: Ella H
title: Just very dates hotel, downstairs is better but the rooms & we had two of them, dated& ill equipped for modern traveller
text:
The Golden tulip Mmmmmmmm.
4 * NO WAY.

Reception good, smart Navy suits or jackets, Yellow ties very polite, location excellent.
Food very good.

Rooms SHOCKING, 1st room, 6th floor, old wooden panelled dark, depressing, little light, one big window but roller in front not working & outside of that close walls felt like being in a basement.
Fridge in room great idea, very small on the wall style, one thin bottle wine only (not enough for my lady)
Prices fair.
Shower & bathroom ok but never enough space for two of you to see all your toiletries & remember they say 4 * (DEFO NO)

AC horrendous, just not working & 6th floor with temp outside at 34 degrees, it was painful
(Reception says AC controlled at reception which is crazy!! they changed it & nothing.
So we were moved to another room floor 4.
We had u packed as you do, so after a long day travelling we then had to pack up again & move.
Ok, keep the lady happy we done it she was not impressed at all.
Next room smaller but could feel some AC when I went in, we unpacked & went to eat.
On return AC seemed less affective so I called reception & they adjusted OUR room only to max, still not AC, just coolish not cold, never experienced this in my many years travelling.
Bed was ok, hard mattress really but it will do, turned on tv HAHAHA, it was a 25 inch screen, looked like a small painting on the wall, ridiculous size.
I settled with my Moretti & a catch up on my phone & on the ceiling the worst of all shocks, MOULD & not a little a full corner 1 metre plus BLACK, never have I seen this before & I stay in 4&5 star hotels (Fav is Marriot) always true 5*.
Next bathroom, we’ll shower was ok, but the door opens directly on the bed, no extra room, w tractor didn’t work & the loo was so far in the corner you had to tilt to have a P, they had squeezed a bidet next to it (WHY!)
Can’t get to loo roll, no space, steamed up & then they put in an oval sink that takes up so much space & leaves you space each side for a toothbrush & paste (BEYOND BELEIF) £150 a night for this???!!!!!
We had Tea/Coffee facilities & better light but more thought needed.
Last two days of 5 night stay the main lift broke down, engineers were there but no repairs done, still not working when we left.
The 2nd lift which is beautiful, old fashioned open so you can see the floors passing was great but max 2 persons, as you can imagine 6 floors, max 2 breakfast, leaving etc NIGHTMARE.
So it was Shankses Pony (Walking) 4 flights stairs for 2 days, not good.

Finally the downstairs breakfast room😳😳😳😳😳😳😳 like a dungeon, little light, 2-3*  absolutely max for room, breakfast boring, good bacon, scrambled eggs everyday, anaemic sausages, I added cheese to make something different.  4* NO WAY.
Horrible experience & we didn’t use it for 3 of our 5 days it was depressing.

On leaving I let the manager know (24hrs before) he said I would have an answer before we left, but we never.
I showed pictures of the mould etc, they all agreed that’s terrible & said we will give you 10% off your drinks bill £200, I said absolutely NOT.
I threatened to walk out & they can contact me in London & they said ok, 20% agsin I said no way.
I said would you take your ladies on holiday experience this & accept £40 off £800 hotel charge.
They were very jittery & I got £90 removed from the bill.
Still not good enough.

SHOCKING EXPERIENCE.
2rooms multiple problems (NOT ACCEPTABLE)
ABOID AT ALL COSTS.

We went to Venice for a few days after & Hotel Continental (Centre Venice) £200 a night 5* & magical, amazing selection for breakfast, great rooms, real AC, by the water (well most are😁) lovely staff,  if you haven't been it’s a must do.
Very romantic, no cars, bikes, mobility scooters😁 & if yiu want away from tourists just go for a walk around the back lanes, great cuisine, water buses 25 euros all day, the Amazing St Marks square, beautiful architecture & much more & it has its own international airport (Marco Polo)

Hope this helps.

I generally don’t moan but The Yellow Tulip needs the biggest refurbished urgently.

Safe travels.

Phil Thompson

text: Great location for anyone coming by train to Kings X. A five minute walk (if that!). Dump your bags and go! Comfy beds, clean and welcoming. A nice vibe. Safe and secure.
