author: Mia L
title: Excellent customer service
text: Excellent customer service. Reception staff, friendly and accommodating. Excellent location. Highly recommend.

author: Dylan K
title: Convenient location, but very disappointing overall
text:
The location at Kings Cross is excellent, with easy access to public transport and the rest of London. Unfortunately, that was probably the best part of our stay.

We paid £550 for three nights for a room without a window. It felt more like a prison cell than a hotel room. The room itself was clean and functional, but the lack of a window made the experience considerably less pleasant.

The breakfast was extremely disappointing. The selection was very limited and the quality was poor, especially considering the £12 price. There was no cheese, cold cuts or other proper toppings, and the hot food was also of very low quality. After 45 years of travelling extensively for work, this was honestly one of the poorest hotel breakfasts I have experienced.

London is an expensive city, but charging £3 for a small bottle of water from a vending machine at the hotel is simply outrageous. That is an excessive price for a basic necessity and leaves a very poor impression.

The staff were fine and the basic room standard was acceptable, but for £550 for three nights I expected considerably more. The location is great, but unfortunately that alone is not enough to make this a hotel I would choose again.

author: Brooke I
title: Budget-friendly accommodation and safe for children.

author: Anna F

author: Katie L
title: Lift Debacle
text:
My husband and I stayed at this hotel from 23rd June to 27th June.
The lifts weren’t working and we had to carry  our bags up  the stairs to the 4th floor.
I watched incoming guests constantly coming in and pressing the buttons to the lifts when they weren’t working.
No sign was put on the lifts to advise guests they weren’t working, I would have thought this would have been a minimum.
This was a constant issue during our stay, working then not working lifts
but the worst was yet to come.
On the Friday my husband went down to get some coffee and didn’t return.
He was stuck in one of the lifts! 
The emergency button wasn’t working, so he had to call out until a passing guest heard him and alerted  hotel staff.
He was stuck in there for 2 hours in a heatwave.
Management had called the lift engineer, but didn’t know when he would get there.
I called the Fire Brigade and they eventually got him out.
Lift engineer eventually turned up and said “ they were working yesterday “, a very helpful comment.
No one from the Hotel contacted us during the rest of our stay to check on my husband’s well being.

Lifts in hotels should have a working emergency button.

author: Lea C
title: Very nice for the price
text: The location is really good, near train and underground stations, bus stops. There were some homeless people in the evening/morning in the neighborhood but they didn't do anything and left quickly. The reception area is nice and there was always some staff, we never had to wait. We could leave our bags in a safe room since we arrived early and could easily pick it up later in the evening when we arrived back at the hotel. The room was clean and nice. The mattress and pillows were extra comfortable, really helped to relax after a tiring day. The bathroom was good and the shower felt amazing. The window of our room looked at the reception area, inside the building, I haven't seen this anywhere before. It was fun looking down and seeing the people there, and I don't know why but it gave us a feeling of security, that we didn't have to look at the street outside. There's a Costa café at the entrance, we had breakfast and some coffee there. It is a nice option if you want a hotel at a good location for a good price. It's not a luxury hotel, but it was more than enough for us, we spent the day with different programs and just used the room for sleep, but the room was nice and helped us get the rest we needed after a tiring day.

author: Luke V
title: Super happy but unfortunately our last time😢
text: 2nd time for us and like the first it was great! Super comfortable bed, very kind team welcome, top-notch breakfast, clean room, and a wonderful memory! We also came for Christmas and we ate a lot at the restaurant, it was great! Unfortunately we won't be able to come back: our son is now 16 years old and it is mandatory to get him a room, which doubles the budget. We are so disappointed! I just looked for Christmas 2026 and it inevitably doubles the price. We loved coming here. Too bad... this rule is really a shame, we cannot afford to double the accommodation budget 😢😢😢😢

author: Giulia S
title: Convenient with great staff
text:
Stayed for one night on recommendation.

Great location as just 2-3 minute walk from kings cross (turn left out of main KX exit, immediate left again into York Way - its then  approx 200yards on right although sign difficult to see as vertical up side of building behind trees)
staff very friendly & helpful considering they were short staffed & rushed off their feet working across multiple  departments (reception, luggage, coffee shop)

We checked in early & the staff were kind enough to store our luggage while we went off exploring (same on check out day until we were ready to catch train)

Room was ok - mostly clean. Big carpet  stain outside bathroom door & some glue or nail varnish stain along dressing table 
Bathroom & bed both clean & tidy
We had a room that faced the road & side of kings cross station -so expected a sleepless night as a result, but train & road noise calmed down after 1pm'ish - all good.

Staff made up for stains! thank you

author: Hannah C
location: Newcastle upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom
title: Weekend break in London
text: We had a great experience at the Premier Inn at Kings Cross. Really convenient and good services. We will definitely stay again.

author: Sophia Y
title: London city break
text: Great hotel for a city break opposite Tower of London. Room was comfortable and very clean. We didn't eat at the hotel but the bar was nice for a nightcap.Located 10 min walk from Monument underground so easy to travel into the West End for theatres and restaurants. Central location but on a quiet street so no traffic noise or disturbance at night. Will definitely stay there again and added another duck (Edwin) to our collection

author: Louis Y
title: Great Location
text: Nestled in the heart of the business district and conveniently underground, this hotel offers a perfect retreat to experience London.  The breakfast is delicious and the staff is incredibly helpful.

author: Charlie K
title: A comfortable central London stay
text: Apex City hotel exceeded my expetations.   The staff were amazing and the hotel very comfortable and clean.  The restaurant and food were excellent and I am looking forward to going back there in October.

author: Sydney A
title: Weekend stay in London
text: We enjoyed a wonderful stay at Apex hotel London on a recent trip. We would highly recommend ! Wonderful staff, great location, lovely food.

author: Ella M
title: Fabulous
text: We had fabulous service from start to finish.  The staff were professional, friendly and helpful in every department.  The rooms were an amazing size for London, modern and clean with great amenities.  We really enjoyed the breakfast.  It was served hot and it was a lovely atmosphere even though the hotel was very busy.

author: Miguel X
title: Lovely stay in London
text: We had a lovely stay in the Apex London City, a new hotel for us as we usually stay at the Apex Temple location. The location of this hotel is great for anyone looking to stay near the eastern side of the city. Tower Bridge and the Tower of London are a stones throw, white chapel and st Katherine’s dock nearby, and the rest of London accessible via the Tower Hill tube station. Staff were lovely, the room spotless and breakfasts lovely. Just allow for extra time at weekend breakfast as it took a while for the food to arrive. Otherwise a perfect stay, and I’m sure we will return.

author: Pablo C
title: Good experience in the Apex Hotel
text:
Very friendly staf. Very helpful 
Very very good breakfast 
Nice and comfortable rooms 
Well located nearby the Tower Bridge

author: Chloe E
title: Excellent anniversary celebration
text: Highly recommend this hotel made to feel welcome from the minute we arrived. Very kind room upgrade as we were celebrating our wedding anniversary nice touches in thd room too. We will definitely be back next time in London!

author: Sydney G
title: Hotel acogedor en Londres
text:
We had a wonderful stay at this large, modern hotel. Our stylish room was perfect for us as a couple—comfortable, elegant, and well-equipped.

Since we were only spending a few nights in London, we wanted a hotel in a convenient location, and this one was ideal. It's within walking distance of the Tower of London and close to Tower Hill Underground Station, making it easy to explore the city.

The breakfast was delicious, with both buffet and à la carte options. I chose the Eggs Benedict, and it was an excellent choice.

The entire reception team was friendly and helpful, but we'd especially like to thank Tina. She gave us fantastic tips on how to make the most of our short stay in London, which really enhanced our trip.

author: Abigail Z
title: A nice hotel - I would definitely stay again
text: This is a nice, clean and comfortable hotel, I would recommend the hotel and I would stay here again.   It's a perfect location for convenience stores, restaurants, small parks and it's a 5/10 minute walk to Tower Bridge and river boats.

author: Julien I
title: Lovely London
text: This is a lovely quiet hotel off a side street in the London Financial District near the Tower of London. Check in was easy. The room was very small with little storage for two people but it was clean and well maintained with a nice bathroom. The dining room breakfasts were a highlight, delicious and well prepared. The staff in the dining room, shout out to Manager Robert, were so friendly and accommodating. We have already recommended this hotel. We would return here again. There is a lovely bar called Bar One on the corner. Best Pad Thai ever…and the Sky Garden is nearby which you must reserve well in advance, a highlight of our trip. The Abba Voyage was spectacular and worth the journey to get there. All in all, a wonderful package.

author: Poppy J
title: Best place to stay
text: The amazing hospitality and professionalism of the staff made our stay unforgettable. Thank you very much!

author: Morgan A
title: Great Location
text: A great location close to many sights and a 2 block walk to the metro station to get to other parts of the city. Would stay here again.

author: Laura S
title: Not as good as it was
text:
I have stayed at the hotel previously and enjoyed it enormously. My most recent stay was a huge disappointment. The staff on check in were not knowledgable about the hotel and provided incorrect information. Check out was slow and there were long queues.

The room was adequate but the air conditioning was poor and the mattresses felt old and offered little support. 

Breakfast was very busy. Tables were left uncleared, the buffet wasn’t restocked often and you needed to request items numerous times. 

The hotel is certainly not what it was. I heard other previous guests saying the same. Such a shame.

author: Thomas M
title: Excellent Hotel in London
text: Excellent hotel, with a very good location, excellent connectivity and services around the hotel. Highly recommended!

author: Mia L
title: Good place to stay as a tourist
text: Modern looking and well maintained hotel and rooms. Junior suite worth it for the extra space, we upgraded for another 83 per night. Lots of space to put your belongings. Fluffy towels and good shower pressure. Decent toilet paper, scratchy Kleenex. Slow response time to requests when you call Reception, 30-60 minutes. Housekeeping first day not done, learned we had to put out a sign asking for it, then no issues. Air conditioning inconsistent. Kept blinds closed to help as it seemed to struggle. Didn't stay at temperature we set it, and turned off in the middle of the night; we asked and were told this was automatic and could be turned off. We did and it wasn't an issue in the night after that but sometimes came back to room and it wasn't on.

author: Gavin O

author: Abigail P

author: Ana I

We liked being not in the busiest, most touristy sections of London but near enough to Tower Hill Metro so we could easily go wherever we wanted. Room was very spacious. Grandson loved his roomy sofa bed and having his own TV.

author: Matthew R
title: Good hotel & great  service
text: Lovely hotel - nice room well prepared by Olga in housekeeping - we had a lovely breakfast each morning and ate at the hotel one evening Food & service was great and a thanks to Jay for several well made and very enjoyable cocktails - would happily stay again

author: Lea B
title: Very disappointing experience
text:
I had a very frustrating experience with Eiffel Seine Hotel.

I originally booked a room for 2 nights (28th–30th) for 2 adults and 1 child. On the 3rd of the month, our plans changed because a friend was joining us, meaning we would become 3 adults and 1 child. I contacted the hotel to ask whether they could accommodate the additional adult or, if not, move us to a suitable room. They told me there was no availability.

I therefore requested cancellation in the same email and understood the booking to be cancelled. I subsequently made a new booking through Booking.com at another hotel that could accommodate our group.

Then, around the 22nd/23rd, I received an email about hotel services. Unfortunately, I did not properly notice the hotel name and assumed it was related to my new hotel. I ended up ordering flowers costing around €80.

On the 26th, I was surprised to see that Eiffel Seine Hotel had charged my card €315 for the deposit. I immediately contacted them and explained that I had requested cancellation. I also followed their cancellation link to make sure the reservation was cancelled and contacted my bank regarding the charge.

To their credit, the hotel eventually agreed to refund the €315 deposit. However, they refused to refund the approximately €80 charged for the flowers, stating that the order had already been made and could not be cancelled. Initially, I disputed this, but eventually my wife suggested we simply accept the flowers and collect them.

What makes this experience particularly disappointing is the lack of clear communication and the confusion surrounding the cancellation and hotel-service emails. From a customer's perspective, after requesting cancellation and believing the reservation was no longer active, receiving a €315 charge days later is extremely frustrating. The subsequent situation with the flowers only added to an already unpleasant experience.

Overall, this has been a very poor customer-service experience. While I appreciate that the hotel agreed to refund the deposit, the whole process was unnecessarily stressful and confusing. I would strongly recommend that the hotel make its cancellation process and service-related communications much clearer to avoid putting guests in this situation.

Very disappointing experience and, unfortunately, not a hotel I would choose again.

author: Paolo E
title: Love Hotel Eiffel Seine!!  You will too.
text:
Location great!!  Across the street from metro; walking distance to Eiffel and Seine River.  All staff so nice.  Jon Claude at reception is so helpful, and will schedule tours, call taxi, recommend restaurants, etc.  We had the patio room #12 (patio is open for all guests, but it felt like our own little patio since our room had direct access, and seemed other guests were not aware of it, as the patio is somewhat hidden).  Rooms clean and cozy.  No fridge, the only downside.
At night, the surrounding area could get very busy as the hotel is situated on a busy "touristy" street.  If you want the full vibe of bustling Paris at night, then this is perfect spot for you.  There are restaurants literally out the front door (Subway sandwich shop next door, if craving some American flavor).   Loved Lily the cat hanging out in the lobby, really so cute!!   Highly recommend Hotel Eiffel Seine

author: Morgan X
title: Weekend city break

author: Sofia Q
title: Nice but speak to your male receptionist please!!
text:
We enjoyed our stay, but a distasteful end due to the male covering reception (Sunday 16th Aug 2026).

On leaving, the man behind reception said we had to pay €10 to leave our luggage before our flight, however he would allow us to do this for free if we all left 5* reviews on Google as a ‘trade off’. I don’t think this sits right with me at all.
When we arrived back to have a peaceful sit down for 15 mins before our taxi to CDG, he was watching the film 300 at full blast, which is rated 15 and had bad language. He didn’t look up once and as we left, he didn’t both to acknowledge or say thanks/bye.
He needs speaking to by management as he let the hotel down massively. 
I am guessing he will delete this review…

author: Andrea M
title: A perfect stay for my daughter’s 18th birthday
text:
My daughter and I stayed at Hotel Eiffel Seine to celebrate her 18th birthday, and we could not have chosen a better place.

The hotel is in an excellent location, and our room was clean, comfortable and welcoming. The staff were absolutely delightful — warm, friendly, helpful and genuinely attentive.

What made our stay truly special was the thoughtful birthday surprise they prepared for my daughter. The balloons, lovely card and two champagne glasses waiting for us in the room were such a wonderful touch. Their attention to detail made this important occasion even more memorable for both of us.

Everything was perfect, and we honestly cannot think of a single negative thing to mention. Thank you to the entire team for making our Paris experience so special. We would happily return and wholeheartedly recommend Hotel Eiffel Seine!

author: Olivia U
title: I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT!
text:
The hotel is 500m from the Eiffel Tower. It is right across from the Bir-Hakeim metro station. The room is impeccably clean! The bed is comfortable, a joy! Nice bathroom. The safe is convenient, as is the small fridge. There is also a kettle with a large selection of coffee and tea. The customer is pampered! The elevator (typical Parisian) is a bit small. Varied breakfast. 
Small downside: the gentleman at the front desk is welcoming, however he insisted TOO much that we scan the Tripadvisor QR code displayed on his desk, on the day of our arrival AND on the day of our departure.

author: Ella E
title: Stay here if you can!!
text: This property is a fabulous small, Parisian Inn. Location is fantastic. The property is well-kept and the staff is first rate.

author: Evan G
title: Nice hotel close to Eiffel Tower
text:
Excellent location, right next to the metro and very close to the Eiffel Tower and Seine river. 
Very friendly staff, small rooms, but everything works and they have air conditioning.

author: Katie O
title: Quick stop in Paris.
text: Very nice place, perfect location.  Good airco.

author: Lauren N
title: Lovevely location
text: The experience was very nice good location, good good staff good spirit. Jean-Claude has been great to us. I recommend this place 10 out of 10.

author: Henry I
title: Such a bright spot in Paris!
text: What a treat! Rented a family room with my spouse and three children and it exceeded our expectations.  Located a few minutes walk from the Eiffel Tower, the metro (one minute walk) and a great market, this hotel made our five days in Paris spectacular. The family suite is two bright and spacious (for Paris) rooms connected by a hallway. Beds are comfortable and one bathroom had a TUB! The hotel breakfasts were AMAZING, scrambled eggs, pancakes, speciality coffees, a selections of cheeses, breads, meats, jams- and more! Staff was warm and super helpful. The strong AC saved our trip and our happiness.  I can’t wait to come back!

author: Adam F
title: Great Location, Great Staff - I would definitely stay here again
text: The location was great for visiting the Eiffel Tower and the surrounding area. It was very close to a couple of Metro Stations too which made it really easy to get around Paris and visit other places. The Staff were really helpful both prior to our visit and when we were there. The Rooms were very clean, my only issue is the shower - they only have a shower hook at around waist height, which means when you have long hair it makes it really difficult to wash it without some assistance. Also my husband struggles to put one of his arms above his head so he also struggled to wash his upper body and hair - apparently this is a "European" thing according to the staff. (this could be remedied really easily with a second hook further up the wall to give you a choice of position). There are quite a few restaurants and bars within a 10 minute walk of the hotel, so the choice for dinner was really good. Overall I think this hotel is great I would definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to stay near the Seine & Eiffel Tower, we would stay here again if we visited.

author: Noah N
title: Never again
text:
We stayed at the Hilton Garden Inn Central New York and, unfortunately, wish we had chosen somewhere else.

We are a family of four — two adults and two children — and the room was unbelievably small and cramped. When we first walked in, I genuinely wondered where the rest of the room had gone! There was barely enough space to move around, and we were constantly knocking our feet and legs against the side of the bed and chair because there simply wasn’t enough room.

I have travelled and stayed in plenty of hotels, but I have never stayed in such a small hotel room. Thankfully, we were out most of the day and evening, because spending much time in the room as a family would have been extremely uncomfortable. I asked reception whether there were any larger rooms available, but was simply told, “This is New York.” That really wasn’t a helpful response.

The elevators were another major issue. We only used them once during our four-day stay, to get our luggage up to the room, and after that we used the stairs because the wait was so bad. We were only on the 6th floor, so it was manageable.

However, on checkout morning, we had three large suitcases and three hand-luggage bags. We waited around 25 minutes trying to get an elevator, but couldn’t get on once. The elevators would bypass our floor, and when they did stop, they were already completely full. There are three elevators in the hotel, yet only two appeared to be working at a time, which is ridiculous for such a large hotel.

Eventually, after waiting around 25 minutes, we had no choice but to drag three large suitcases and all our hand luggage down six flights of stairs. It certainly wasn’t the end to our stay that we had hoped for.

Overall, we were extremely disappointed and definitely would not recommend this hotel for families. Perhaps it would be more suitable for a solo traveller who doesn’t need much space, but for a family of four, the room was simply not adequate.

Unfortunately, the hotel did not live up to our expectations or how it was advertised, and we would choose somewhere else if visiting New York again.

author: Luca A
title: Most Hospital Worker Breana !!
text: Breana was the absolute sweetest worker!! She helped me solve my issue with my missing luggage and also gave me some recommendations on places to shop and the best food in town! I really appreciate her kindness and hospitality!!

author: Brooke P
title: Excellent hospitality
text:
Business travel can be stressful, but this Hilton made the entire experience feel effortless. From arrival through the rest of my stay, everything was handled in a way that allowed me to focus on the purpose of my trip rather than the logistics around it.

Herbie deserves special recognition. His professionalism, attentiveness, and genuine willingness to help made a noticeable difference. He anticipated needs, handled things smoothly, and created the kind of experience that makes a guest feel valued rather than simply accommodated.

That level of service is what people remember. Because of Herbie and the overall experience, this Hilton will be an easy choice for future business trips.

author: Wyatt I
title: My Stay in Hilton Central Park
text: I was greeted by a very warm and welcoming host with free points! Herbie was his name. He actually helped us get a deal to travel to other Hilton locations as well. From then on, I knew my stay would be amazing. Would recommend!

author: Grace Q
title: Had a blast!
text: Herbie was absolutely fantastic! He was friendly, professional, and made us feel genuinely welcome. He went above and beyond to make our experience great. Hilton is lucky to have him!

author: Ella G
title: Broken Plumbing, Unsecured Room, and Elevator Failures
text:
I was extremely disappointed with my stay and would not recommend this hotel.

Upon arrival, I discovered that the plumbing underneath the bathroom sink was broken and literally being held together with duct tape. Every time the faucet was used, water leaked onto the floor.

I reported the issue, but it took maintenance approximately four hours to address it. Even more concerning, when I returned to my room during that time, I found that my door had been left unlocked, leaving my personal belongings and valuables completely unattended. This was an unacceptable security issue.

To make matters worse, on August 18th, the elevator malfunctioned. The situation became serious enough that the local fire department had to respond and use tools, including hatchets, to open the elevator doors.

Between the poor condition of the room, the delayed maintenance response, the security concern with my room being left unlocked, and the elevator malfunction, this stay fell far below reasonable expectations for guest safety and basic hotel maintenance.

I would not stay here again and cannot recommend this property.

author: Daisy Y
title: AC broke multiple times and hotel engineer argued with me
text: AC broke 3 days of the 4 day stay. The night engineer tried to tell me that it wasn’t broken and that I didn’t know how to work a thermostat. This was on his 4th time to the room in one night. On day 3, the hotel sent someone new who fixed it. Why couldnt they have done this the second time it broke? Also, key scanner in elevators never worked. Wait times on elevators were excessive in the morning and evenings. Luckily we were on a low floor and could take the stairs. The only good thing about this hotel is the location.  I complained and was told I would get a points credit but that never happened.

author: Dylan P
text: Such a fabulous hotel and Kierra at the front desk was so so lovely and helpful!!

author: Julien A
title: Oversold and out of tact
text:
I cannot review the hotel experience, as we did not actually get our room. We booked through HotelTonight after our flight was cancelled, but when we arrived at the hotel we were told that not only did they not have our reservation, but that the hotel was oversold. We were also told that they do not receive reservations from HotelTonight until the next day, so I am not sure why they are even listed on the app. I would never recommend booking this hotel through a last-minute platform, given the delay in reservations coming through, and also their tendency to oversell. Reception told me that someone else had just had the same problem right before me, so clearly they have an overselling problem. Additionally, since they did not have my reservation in the system, they could not cancel it for me and I had to spend half an hour on the phone with HotelTonight to get the reservation cancelled and refunded.

That is only part of my poor rating. My bigger issue is that after I had this conversation at the front desk, I was still standing in the lobby (with my 12 year old) trying to figure out where we were going to stay that night when I overheard the front desk receptionist complaining loudly about me to another staff member. I acknowledge that I might not have had the most pleasant reaction to being told that I was homeless in NYC and also had to call HotelTonight support, but at least have the decency to complain about me in a back room. Complaining loudly about a customer IN THE LOBBY where there are other customers and while the person you are complaining about is still there is the worst brand of customer service. 

The interaction she was reacting to was me saying "so never stay here" before walking away. It was barely even worth complaining about. However, as a customer, it's not my job to be nice about being stranded. But when your job is in the hospitality industry, have some tact. Complain about me all you want, but do it somewhere else. She said her name was Jen, btw, but I am not sure I believe her given the rest of the situation.

author: Andrea I
title: Disappointed for Hilton

author: Lauren J
title: Good location, good price, and a nice stay in NYC
text:
The Hilton Garden Inn New York/Central Park South - Midtown West (what a mouthful) is a great option for family accommodations in the heart of Midtown Manhattan.  We loved the location on 54th Street (across from the old Studio 54), which put you blocks away from many of NY's most famous attractions, including Times Square, Broadway shows, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, and so much more.  

Upon arrival, you’ll find yourself in a small lobby.  The day we arrived the air conditioning wasn't working and it was warm, but the impact was mostly on the staff.  It's small and felt quite busy most of the times we were in there.

Our room was nice and comfortable, with views mainly of the buildings along 54th street. We had two double beds and a relatively good amount of space, at least based on previous times we've been to NYC.  

The best part? By NY standards, the price was relatively reasonable given the location and accommodations.  We'd definitely stay here again.

author: Gavin X
title: Great recommendations!

author: David K

Other than that, the overnighter need to be more approachable.

author: Lauren F

My boyfriend and I had a wonderful stay at the Hilton Garden Inn Central Park South. From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed and well taken care of. Breanna was incredibly kind and attentive, and her positive attitude made a great first impression.

She was friendly, professional, and went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed. It’s rare to come across someone who makes guests feel so comfortable and appreciated.

Thank you, Breanna, for making our stay even more special. Your hospitality didn’t go unnoticed, and it’s one of the reasons we’ll happily stay here again!

author: Ana T
title: Worst hotel
text: I had to give 1* rating as it wont allow negative or nil. Absolutely appalling hotel. Serious issues with the non existent air conditioning, the revolting sewer stench from the bathroom, the disgusting treatment by one particular member of staff and the overall experience was unquestionably the worst I have had the misfortune to experience.  I cannot begin to even describe the awful stay we had so just do yourself a favour and avoid at all costs.

author: Nora A
title: awful don’t stay here!
text:
Location good to tube 
Hotel looked good 
Room was nice and fancy however the aircon did not work at all shower flooded bathroom no window to open 
Value for stay was shockingly overpriced 
Staff was rude and unhelpful and kept lying to us 
Noisy through the hallway 
Fair clean

author: Isla O
title: Overnight London stay for the London Olympia.
text: I'll start by saying I love this hotel. We've stayed here 3 times now and will return, however this weekend was challenging. When we checked and went into our room we very quickly realised that the air conditioning wasn't working. Our room was a small double with no windows to let any air in so you can imagine it was like a sauna especially during this heatwave. We asked reception if there was a problem and they confirmed that the air conditioning was not working but they could bring up a portable air con and a fan and we agreed. What we received was a wobbly fan but no air con unit. When we asked why we were told "we don't have one!". After about 30 minutes and after getting hotter and hotter we went back to reception to have another conversation. We were shown 4 other much larger rooms which were at least more airy but no air conditioning. Eventually we settled on a much nicer room, 2 fans and a free breakfast! It was a very very hot night but the reception staff really did do everything they could and actually I felt quite sorry for the staff who remained pleasant and professional despite very challenging circumstances. The barman looked like he was literally going to wilt. I'm sure this was a one off unfortunate situation and it would not stop us returning but I do wish we'd been given an opportunity to know about this before we checked in.  The rooms incidentally are beautifully decorated and furnished, lovely Elemis toiletries and the entire hotel smells devine. Great location with a lovely Italian Restaurant across the green. Perhaps though we'll come back in the winter months just to be sure! 😉

author: Dylan G
title: Bad
text:
Very disappointed with my stay, especially for a 4-star hotel.
The rooms are clearly run-down and badly in need of renovation. I stayed at this hotel about ten years ago, and the difference is shocking. You can really see how much the hotel has deteriorated over the years.
With the extreme heat at the moment, the air conditioning doesn’t even work, making the room extremely uncomfortable. And despite this, they still have the nerve to ask guests for deposits as if everything were perfectly acceptable.
I called reception to ask for a fan and had to wait 50 minutes. For a 4-star hotel, this level of service is simply unacceptable.
It’s honestly disappointing to see how far this hotel has fallen. This is the last time I will waste my money here. Definitely not worth the price or the supposed 4-star standard. I would not recommend staying here.

author: Nora Y
title: Could be better!
text:
Stayed for one night for work. The shared areas are gorgeous and very well looked after, and the hotel generally has a lovely feel to it.

The room looked beautiful, but unfortunately wasn’t quite as good as expected. The air conditioning was technically on, but the room was still absolutely boiling, and as the windows face an interior atrium they couldn’t be opened. I ended up sleeping on top of the covers. The bathroom also had quite a strong drain smell.

The king-size bed was actually two single beds zipped together. The bed itself was comfortable, although there were no sockets next to it, which was a bit inconvenient. The towels weren’t the softest, but they were absolutely enormous — and you can’t beat a towel you can properly wrap yourself in!

On the plus side, the WiFi was fast, the shower was good and breakfast was nice, although I wasn’t a huge fan of the sausages.

Overall, a lovely-looking hotel with beautiful communal areas, but the room had a few issues that stopped it from being a particularly comfortable stay.

author: Gavin T
title: Disappointing “4*” budget hotel
text:
Book here if you want a budget hotel experience at double the price. My birthday stay was extremely disappointing for a supposed 4★ hotel.

I will start with the positives, it had a beautiful aesthetic & was: close to Eventim Apollo, convenient after seeing Dave Chappelle. Otherwise, not worth the price.

No room service despite the website advertising it with a full menu. After five calls, I was told they don’t serve food at all except breakfast — even the restaurant had nothing available.

Phones never answered. Reception and all internal numbers ignored calls; I had to ring the hotel via Google just to reach someone.

Rude, unprofessional staff. When I asked about birthday amenities, I was met with “what are you even talking about”.

Maintenance issues. My lights flickered the entire stay. The electrician arrived hours late while I was resting and couldn’t fix it.

Poor breakfast quality — runny eggs, bland sausages, half‑cooked bacon, empty juice dispensers, long queues. Holiday Inn standard at best.

Overall, not a true 4★ experience. You can get a genuinely luxurious 4★ stay abroad (Morocco, etc.) for less — with room service, restaurants, pools, and a spa.

Not to mention AC was not working in most rooms so the hallways were cluttered with fans.

author: Michael A
title: A hotel so bad I set up TripAdvisor purely to submit this
text:
First let me start with I'm a week after checking out (early because it was so poor) and I still have been unable to get a single response to emails or even get anyone to answer the phone.

On arrival, no working air-con, no working TV, shower smells backed up.   The room I was in has no window that can open due to the atrium and little to no natural light. Despite reporting it no action taken had to sleep with a wet towel on me and got about an hour's sleep.

Next morning reported again at the desk came back to find nothing resolved - the only addition a lidless bottle of bleach left in the bathroom.  Again slept with a wet towel on slept for about 30 mins as heat unbearable.

Checked out a day early reporting the room as unsuitable for use asked for refund was told to take it up with Booking.com (who are now pointing me back at the hotel)

Have made numerous attempts via email and phone to resolve this but all go unanswered.

Despite giving them warning via email of this review and that I will be raising a chargeback on credit card if they fail to respond again.  Nothing.

As they seem to at least respond to their reviews on here I hope they contact me with some attempt at resolution

author: Emma O
title: Do not stay at this hotel!!!
text: Do not book to stay at this hotel! I came to stay with my 2 teenage daughters. We were going to the harry styles concert and thought this would be a great hotel for local places we wanted to visit. On checking in we were informed that the room had only been set up for 2 people and not 3 but not to worry because while we were out that the room would be made up for 3 people. On arriving back at the hotel around 12.15 am we realised the room was still only for 2 people. We went to reception and we told someone would be up with another bed in 5-10 we waited over half an hour. They brought up no bedding and we were told they would be straight back with it. We waiting another half an hour for the bedding this was at 1.30am now!!! The next morning the receptionist was really rude to me. They hadn’t given me breakfast vouchers and I had to wait in a really long queue at reception again. my 2 daughters couldn’t even get up for breakfast as they were so tired given the late night. The aircon in the room wasn’t working it was so hot. There were cracked tiles on the bathroom floor that I cut my toe on there was peeling paint on the ceiling in the room looked like there had been a leek that they hadn’t fixed. I’ve sent an email to explain my concerns and I’ve heard nothing back at all. The hotel offered me 20% discount which I thought was unacceptable. All in all a terrible stay and I would never stay here again.

author: Gavin X
title: Room air conditioning no function
text:
I understand that the air conditioning is not functioning in any of the rooms. However, this issue has existed since I checked in, and simply apologising for the inconvenience is not an adequate solution.

The lack of air conditioning has made my stay very uncomfortable, especially given the current weather. I would appreciate it if you could explain what action the hotel is taking to resolve this issue and when it is expected to be fixed.

If the problem cannot be resolved during my stay, I would like to discuss appropriate compensation, as the room was not provided with the advertised facilities.

author: Caleb M
title: Worst experiance ever
text:
This has been, without question, the worst hotel experience I have ever had in London. I travel to London at least three times a year, and for this trip my parents and I decided to stay at the Dorsett Shepherd's Bush for a change. It turned out to be the biggest mistake of our holiday.

The most serious issue was that the air conditioning in our room did not work. When I reported it at around 10:00 pm, I was simply told there were no technicians available and that someone would come the following morning. For a hotel that claims to be a four-star property, this is completely unacceptable. Are guests seriously expected to spend the entire night in an unbearably hot room? The only solution offered was a single small fan for three adults, which was nowhere near adequate.
I suffer from migraines that are triggered by heat, and ever since checking into this hotel I have had a constant migraine. What was meant to be a relaxing holiday has instead been ruined because of the hotel's failure to provide a basic amenity that every guest expects.

The poor service didn't stop there. Every day we had to call reception to request simple items such as moisturiser, tea and coffee that should have been replaced during housekeeping. Every time we were told, "Yes, we'll send them up," yet they never sent until we went up to the reception and waited till they sent it.  The lack of urgency, communication and basic customer service was astonishing.

What makes this even more disappointing is that this stay was planned well in advance and paid for in full months before our arrival. If the hotel already knew there were ongoing issues with the air conditioning, the least they could have done was inform guests before arrival and give them the opportunity to cancel or change their booking. Instead, we were left to discover the problem ourselves after checking in. There was no apology, no meaningful attempt to resolve the situation, no compensation and no offer of a refund for the inconvenience.
We had originally considered booking one of the hotel's suites, and I am incredibly relieved that we didn't.

I genuinely cannot understand how this hotel maintains a four-star rating when it struggles to provide even the most basic expectations of a hotel stay. Air conditioning, prompt maintenance and responsive customer service are not luxuries—they are essentials.

I would never stay here again, and I certainly would not recommend this hotel to anyone. If you're looking for a comfortable, stress-free stay in London, I strongly suggest choosing another hotel. This experience completely ruined what should have been an enjoyable holiday.

author: Noah X
title: Good and relatively central hotel with direct public transport connection bus/train
text:
Good location of the hotel, quickly in the center by public transport, also possible on foot. 
Room nicely designed, kitchenette in my opinion superfluous, rather a larger room with a refrigerator. Room overall relatively large, but unfortunately windows could not be opened and air conditioning was mediocre. Breakfast ok, with clear potential for improvement. 

Shower and carpet. The carpet was stained, the bathroom was completely covered in limescale and a bit filthy.
The first room had not been cleaned, so we had to change again.

author: Anna N
title: No air conditioning, health risk, and no follow-through on promised refund
text:
We stayed at the Dorsett Hotel London (Shepherd's Bush) from 26–29 June. On arrival, the air conditioning wasn't working and the room had no window either, making it unbearably hot. I have a heart condition, and staying in these conditions was genuinely unsafe for me, not just uncomfortable.

The hotel had no alternative rooms available. Unable to sleep and concerned about my health, we had no choice but to check out between 2am and 3am on 27 June, cutting our stay short.

To the hotel's credit, the night duty manager acknowledged the issue and told us a full refund had been authorised and was being sent back to our booking agent. However, despite multiple phone calls and emails over the following weeks asking the hotel to simply confirm this in writing, we received no response. This made it very difficult to resolve the refund with our booking agent, who needed the hotel's confirmation to process anything.

The room itself, air conditioning aside, was fine, if not a little unclean — this review is specifically about the lack of a working cooling system, the safety implications of that for someone with a health condition, and the hotel's failure to follow up on a refund their own staff verbally agreed to.

If you're booking here in warmer months, I'd strongly recommend confirming directly with the hotel that air conditioning is genuinely working in your specific room before you travel.

author: Juan R
title: AIRCOND NOT WORKING
text:
Dorsett Shepherds Bush London 
Air conditioning  not working, window can’t open, so the room is very hot and uncomfortable, even thought they prepared fans . I was informed that the air conditioning has been out of order for more than two weeks and it seems that all rooms having the same problem, some get refunded and change to others hotel, unfortunately all nearby hotels have been fully booked. We never received any notice before we check in. We have to continue suffering with the situation until end of the month . So disappointed and will not recommend and will not come back again.

author: Chloe F
title: Disappointing
text:
Disappointing. The room was comfy, bed comfortable but the shower drain stank of rot and it was incredibly hot in the room with no access to fresh air. We had specifically asked at reception if the air con was working and were categorically told it was, although not as efficient as usual. They offered to bring fans up to the room. We asked for 2. They were never delivered to the room and we stayed for 2 nights. The room was stifling. 
Breakfast was included but we felt it was poor considering how much we paid for the break. Other guests were touching food items such as bread with their bare hands which was very off putting. We felt the quality of the food was not great.
Having said that, staff were polite and helpful, apart from the air con farce. We wouldn’t revisit

author: Lily A
title: Poor standards and disappointing
text:
Sadly disappointed and wanted to avoid writing a review but they have ignored 4 attempts to discuss our experience. 

We recently stayed at the Dorsett Hotel Shepherds Bush for a visit to Wimbledon. 

I don’t usually complain and like to resolve things privately but we experienced a number of issues that were frankly disappointing having spent so much for our stay. 

Firstly, on arrival we were met with exceptionally long queues at reception, with only one member of staff, Twinkle, appearing to manage check-ins, enquiries and other reception duties. Whilst she worked extremely hard and remained professional throughout, it was clear that the reception was significantly understaffed. Many members walked by as people queued and become irritable. I also noticed a number of guests making complaints and changing rooms.

Unfortunately, the issues continued with our accommodation. We initially had to move rooms because the air conditioning in our first room was not functioning properly. In both Room 122 and Room 208, the bathrooms had a noticeable smell of mould, which was unpleasant and not what we would expect from a hotel of this standard.

In addition, our room was not serviced during our stay despite us specifically asking a cleaner to return later as there was no “Please Make Up Room” sign available to hang on the door. We therefore returned to an uncleaned room with no fresh towels or replenished amenities - it was late in the evening so we just went to bed.

The breakfast offering was also extremely disappointing in terms of both quality and overall experience, falling well below expectations. The tables were not attended to and the food was either over cooked (bacon all stuck together) or undercooked (sausages looked microwaved).

Finally, I was disappointed to find that a service charge had been added to my card unnecessarily and without explanation, this was subsequently removed but clearly unnecessary and left a bitter taste due to our experience. 

We were unable to raise these matters during our stay as we were extremely short of time before departing and, unfortunately, the reception queue was once again very lengthy, making it impractical to wait to speak to someone before leaving.

Taken individually, some of these issues may have been manageable, however the cumulative effect significantly impacted our stay and did not represent the standard of accommodation and service we had paid for or expected.

Again I would reiterate that I would have dealt with this privately but have been repeatedly ignored.

author: Evie E
title: Awful customer service and hidden fee
text: On arrival we were informed air conditioning was broken and that we couldn't open our window in the room. This was after it took them 30 minutes to find my reservation. I was then told I needed to pay £50(!) "room holding fee" incase I caused any damage?? I have never had to do that before anywhere else! I was told that would be refunded 48hrs after I checked out. It's almost a month later and I'm still waiting I'm also still waiting on my 50% refund I was told I would be receiving due to the air conditioning malfunction. I have emailed and received no response.

author: Paolo O
title: It's a nice hotel, but I had a sleepless night because of the air conditioning problem.
text: I think it's a very good hotel. But it was the last day of the June heat wave. I was surprised at what he said after checking in. The air conditioner is out of order. He said he would bring the fan with him soon, but he repeatedly urged him to do so before he checked out, but he never did. But I stayed on the ground floor, and they said it was hot and hot, but the next morning I heard that the person who stayed for five nights was sweating just being in the room and there was nothing we could do about it. That heat on the first floor was even better. It was the night I vowed never to stay again.

author: Michael M
title: Air conditioning is non existent! Housekeeping is very lacking!
text: I chose this hotel for the location for an event I was attending and because it advertised that it was air conditioned.  Well that certainly was not the case.  We arrive early in the morning and used the luggage service.  When we came back after touring for the day at 6 pm we were told the a/c was weak and they would give us a fan.  Or we could get a refund and go somewhere else.  Like that was an actual option???? The a/c was non existent!  The fan helped a little while sleeping but not moving around the room.  Also, housekeeping did not service our room the first day.  Not at all!  Then we found out that some rooms were given portable a/c units.  We were never told that was an option. One was given to us but it did NOT work.  The amount of money I paid was a ripoff.

author: Abigail C
title: Great Customer Service with BAD room experience
text: I want to commend the Front Office Manager Victoria for going above and beyond during our recent stay. We experienced a slight issue with our room, and the manager resolved it promptly and professionally.

author: Charlotte K
title: Pleasant big chain hotel
text:
Quite pleasant.  I thought it had a pool when I booked, but there were other facilities (I just didn't have the opportunity to use them).
Plenty of good places to eat nearby
I was there on business.

author: Jack W
title: Wonderful Hotel
text: I have stayed here several times while working in London and stayed at the weekend with my partner and children as a family for the first time.  The customer service at this hotel if you are in the Hilton Honours programme is top notch.  It's one of the best Hiltons I have stayed at for this acknowledgement. The hotel manages to balance a business stay perfectly with a family stay and I absolutely love it.   The fitness suite with sauna/steam is fantastic benefit.  If you end up choosing to stay, or are upgraded to executive level rooms with lounge access, then you are in for a treat.   The breakfast is also superb with many options available and very well presented.  I have nothing but praise for how this particular Hilton hotel is being ran.  Canary Wharf is often overlooked by visitors to London but it should be right up there!   It's so easy to get to from Central London (tube, DLR and Thames Uber boat) and it has a vibrant and safe feeling neighborhood with so many dining/drinking options.

author: Giulia K
title: Very good
text: A great family friendly place to stay. Excellent food. Great staff and meet individual needs

author: Harper A
title: Simply Fabulous
text:
We moved from another hotel to here .
Sadly it was only for one night .
The staff especially Anna in front office and concierge Robin went above and beyond to do everything to help us.
The standard of this hotel was exceptional . We hope to go back soon .
Thank you so much

author: Nathan E
title: Disappointing room.
text:
We were celebrating my husbands birthday and aur wedding anniversary so requested an upgraded room when we booked. On arrival the room was not ready and the receptionist could not say when it would be ready. We could either wait or take a different room. As were were quite tired after the journey we took the basic room.  It was a good size and clean but a very small double bed and a view over an unfinished multi storey car park.  This was very disappointing.
Breakfast was good and staff in this area were very helpful. Children's area for dining is an excellent idea.

author: Maria K
title: Hilton canary wharf
text: The hotel is close to the city center. Shopping is easy. We stayed for a week. Our first room had a construction view. We told the reception and they helped us. It's a good value for money place where you can stay safely with your family.

author: Isla J
title: Great! With a minor disappointment
text:
The location was good and when the staff found out it was my partner’s birthday they went the extra mile with a free breakfast on the day of our departure. The room was excellent, clean, well maintained and air conditioned. The reception staff were fabulous, as was Daniel (one of the bar staff) who looked after us on our first night there.  So why only 4 stars? Well - on our second night at the hotel we visited the hotel
bar again and when I got my receipt there was a £3 service charge for pouring the drinks. We tip staff in cash, and I don’t support service charges for bar staff pouring drinks I am paying for without telling me first. When we challenged the charge we were initially offered a free drink but a different member of staff rudely interjected and said no free drink but the £3 would be removed from my next round at the bar. That individual was not the bar manager. This meant I had to buy another round of drinks to get my optional service charge refunded? Absolutely not. I asked to speak to the bar manager and was promptly re offered the free drinks. A totally unnecessary situation that could have been easily avoided. Would I use and recommend this hotel again - yes absolutely but just disappointed in the silliness that occurred.

author: Isabella N
title: My experience was fairly good
text:
Thank you for the warm welcome from the reception staff, especially the duty manager and Ms. Shani. 
Just one note: when we requested our room be cleaned and tidied while we were out, we returned three hours later and the room hadn't been cleaned. This caused us dissatisfaction and frustration because we had requested it and it wasn't done.

author: Mathis K
title: Good to be back at Hilton Canary Wharf!
text: Another lovely return to the Hilton Canary Wharf.  Great room and excellent Executive Lounge Service. Our HH LT Diamond Status was well recognised at the hotel. Special thanks to Mara (Front Desk) and Ben (Executive Lounge) for being so helpful and making our stay more enjoyable. See you soon. Kevin and Richard

author: Adam S
title: Hilton’s Crown Jewel in London
text: Location, building, staff, food, service all was excellent , felt at home, my Hilton diamond status respected and enjoyed every moment of my 5 day visit. Canary Wharf is very well connected these days and was not in the centre of London but didn’t matter! Cheers Hilton !

author: Ethan L
title: A hotel that has sadly lost the standards I once associated with the Hilton brand
text:
We recently stayed for five nights in a King Junior Suite with Executive Lounge access as a family of three (including our 12-year-old daughter). I have stayed in Hilton properties for many years and, in the past, Hilton breakfasts and overall standards have been something of a benchmark for me. In fact, I have stayed at this hotel before and previously enjoyed a much better experience.

Unfortunately, this visit left me genuinely disappointed. I will start with the positives because there were certainly some.

The King Junior Suite was spacious and worked well for a family. The sofa bed for our daughter was already prepared, bottled water was replenished daily, and the room included tea and coffee facilities, a fridge, bathrobes and slippers. Housekeeping also did a good job of replenishing the in-room amenities each day.

We also enjoyed the Executive Lounge itself. Complimentary hot and cold drinks and biscuits were available throughout the day, with alcoholic drinks served in the evening between 6pm and 8pm. The lounge was a pleasant environment to relax in.

One member of staff also deserves special recognition: the chef preparing freshly cooked eggs at breakfast. He occasionally forgot an order, but he was always cheerful, welcoming and genuinely helpful. Nothing ever seemed too much trouble despite what looked like a considerable workload. He was easily the standout member of the breakfast team.

Unfortunately, that's where the positives largely end.

Although the suite was a good size, the bathroom felt tired and dated. More surprising was the shower, which featured a very basic shower head more akin to what you would expect in a Premier Inn or Travelodge than a Hilton charging premium prices.

The king-size bed was also seriously uncomfortable, and the pillows were equally disappointing. We mentioned this to Reception during our stay, who kindly arranged for a mattress topper and discussed alternative pillows. Whilst I appreciated the effort, it didn't materially improve the comfort of the bed.

Our room was also immediately beside the DLR. To be fair, there wasn't much actual train noise, but there was a noticeable rumble and vibration every time a train passed. As services continue until late in the evening and restart early each morning, lighter sleepers should be aware of this.

The biggest disappointment by far, however, was breakfast.

The selection itself was excellent. There was a comprehensive range of both hot and cold options and, on paper, enough choice to satisfy almost everyone.

The problem wasn't the choice, it was the execution.

On every single morning of our five-day stay we were seated at tables where the chairs still had food debris left by previous guests. Every day we had to ask for them to be cleaned before we could sit down. On our final morning there was also food debris on the floor around our table which had still not been cleared.

The hot breakfast offering was consistently only lukewarm rather than properly hot. During the entire stay I also never observed temperature checks being carried out on the buffet, which did little to inspire confidence.

Service throughout breakfast felt passive rather than attentive. Used plates and cutlery were frequently left on tables after guests had finished eating, to the extent that I found myself taking our crockery to the staff station because nobody was clearing it away. Meanwhile, staff often appeared to be standing together chatting rather than actively looking after the dining room.

By our final morning, both my wife and I decided not to eat breakfast at all. The repeated cleanliness issues had simply left us no longer comfortable doing so, and we settled for a coffee instead.

On that final morning I asked to speak to a manager.

I explained the repeated cleanliness issues, the lukewarm food, the lack of table clearing and my overall disappointment with what I felt had become a very poor breakfast experience. I also expressed concern that the breakfast manager who had initially greeted us presented an appearance that, in my opinion, fell below the professional standards I associate with the Hilton brand. The manager I spoke with listened, acknowledged my concerns and assured me he would either bring me his business card or leave one at Reception for me to collect at check-out. Unfortunately, when we checked out, there was no business card.

Reception asked whether we had enjoyed our stay. I replied that we had not particularly. The response was simply, "Oh right."

There was no enquiry about what had gone wrong, no attempt to understand our experience and no effort whatsoever to recover the situation. When I asked about the promised business card, I was told there wasn't one waiting. I then requested the manager's details myself and was eventually given a business card by another member of staff, but again there was no curiosity about why we were leaving disappointed.

One final point prospective guests should be aware of concerns the Executive Lounge.

We only discovered after arrival that our 12-year-old daughter was not permitted access during the evening drinks service between 6pm and 8pm. Hotels are, of course, entitled to set whatever policies they choose, but this restriction was not made clear when booking. Had I known beforehand, I would not have paid the premium for Executive Lounge access. The explanation that alcohol was being served also seemed inconsistent given that children are permitted in the main restaurant where alcohol is served throughout the day.

Overall, this wasn't one major failure. It was a series of small but repeated shortcomings: cleanliness, food temperature, inattentive service, an uncomfortable bed, a dated bathroom and, perhaps most disappointing of all, a complete lack of interest when genuine concerns were raised.

Having stayed in Hilton hotels for many years, I simply no longer recognise the standards I experienced during this visit. There are good people working here, and there are certainly positives, but the attention to detail and guest experience that I once associated with Hilton were sadly missing.

I genuinely hope this hotel can rediscover those standards because it has the potential to be far better than the experience we had.

author: Sophia R
title: 5 star quality service
text:
The team member who made our stay in the executive suite/hotel was Paulette. She was an absolute delight from continuous hard work and dedication to the shift, her customers service was first class she gave us plenty of insight on what to do in Canary Wharf as well as keeping us updated on the specific pop up’s that were upcoming during our stay. 

Thank you so much for everything, we look forward to coming back again soon!

author: Giulia G
title: Nice
text:
One night stay. Chosen for its proximity by public transport to the o2 arena...door to door in 30 minutes which is fab. We've stayed at the Intercontinental o2 arena recently so a bit of a comparison.
Staff all very pleasant and helpful. Comfy bed. Rooms and common areas are beginning to look rather dated and in need of refurb. View of waste ground a bit off putting. Executive lounge no longer offers breakfast and evening food offering has definitely deteriorated compared to our last visit. As a whole exec lounge kind of lacks an element of luxury compared to other lounges we've used over the years, small details lacking.
This is however a somewhat nit picking review and comparing to the Intercontinental which offers a more luxurious feel and is next door to the o2 (but does not offer the same choice of transport and area facilities).

author: Holly W
title: Fantastic stay
text: Just back from a three night stay. Fantastic time spent at this hotel. Impressive in all ways. Room size cleanliness and freindly colleagues. Thanks to paulette for her knowledge giving my wife and i the know all on the 02 arena and its designer outlets giving my wife the chance to buy clothes at a great saving. Paulette is an asset to the hilton brand and everthing hospitality stands for.

author: Lucy O
title: 5 star satisfaction review
text:
In general it was awesome! room is clean (although its old) but still very pleasant and well presentable far better than the hiltons we stayed at Milan and Switzerland recently, staff are friendly special mention to Paulette at the executive lounge she is very friendly and approachable, offer her willingness to help anything she could. A simple gesture of a good customer relation care.good location and reasonable rate. The food is great every breakfast and as well as at the executive lounge. Well done to kitchen staff!
and to the of Hilton Team at canary Wharf from the reception to housekeeping department with smiling faces and willingness to help.
You all deserved a heartfelt compliment from me and my family , I was an incredible experience coming here from Texas. We thank you for your service.

author: Manon U
title: Lovely enjoyable stay
text: My husband’s birthday, we were looked after extremely well and all the staff are courteous, polite and helpful. There is nothing to fault.

author: William X
title: Clean and friendly
text: My stay here has been great! The rooms are clean and spacious. I especially like the breakfast buffet. The staff have been very accommodating and Swapna at the restaurant/bar was so friendly and helped make my stay welcoming and hydrated!

author: Thomas N
title: Hilton London Canary Warf - amazing stay
text: Our stay at the Hilton Canary Warf was awesome. Great hospitality and service. Paulette went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed in terms of recommendations for things to do outside of our business trip.

author: Katie D
title: Great place
text: Lovely time at this place. London was hot and work was tiring. This place has AC and a great comfortable atmosphere.
