author: Taylor K
title: Horrible !
text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but our stay at Madison LES Hotel was disappointing enough that I feel other travellers should be aware.

The biggest issue was that the room we received did not match what we expected based on the booking. We were given a very small ground-floor room that felt cramped and lacked privacy. The window faced the hotel's smoking area, so we had to keep the blinds closed most of the time because people were constantly outside. This also allowed cigarette smoke to drift into the room occasionally.

The room was not properly prepared for guests. Basic necessities such as a dustbin, tissues, and toilet paper were missing, and even after informing the front desk, these items were not promptly provided. The bathroom also showed signs of poor cleaning, which was disappointing.

The breakfast service was another major issue. We arrived at the advertised opening time of 6:00 a.m. before leaving for the day's sightseeing, only to find that breakfast was not ready. This delayed our plans and should not happen when specific breakfast hours are advertised.

Customer service was inconsistent. Most of our interactions with the front desk left us feeling that our concerns were not important, and despite raising several issues during our stay, very little was done to address them. The only exception was the night-shift staff member, who was polite, professional, and genuinely tried to help.

The hotel's luggage storage policy was also unexpected. While there was luggage storage available, we were informed at the front desk that additional charges applied in our situation. The timing restrictions and charges were not something we had anticipated before arriving, which added unnecessary frustration.

The hotel was also quite noisy because of the reception area, street traffic, and nearby trains. Combined with the room location, it was difficult to get proper rest.

Overall, the experience did not represent good value for money. Paying a little more for a hotel with better customer service, cleaner rooms, and a room that matches what is advertised would have been well worth it. Based on our experience, I would not stay at Madison LES Hotel again.

author: Hugo I
title: Horrible experience
text:
I had a very disappointing stay at Madison LES Hotel and genuinely regret booking this property.
The staff were generally arrogant, unwelcoming, and seemed uncomfortable communicating in English. The front desk staff, in particular, were inconsiderate and came across with an "I don't care" attitude whenever we asked for assistance.
One of the biggest frustrations was their baggage policy. We arrived a little before check-in and were told they would not hold our luggage unless we paid **$6 per bag**, with absolutely no exceptions. This was the first hotel I've stayed at that refused to store luggage for arriving guests without an additional charge. It made me question the point of booking the hotel if they cannot provide such a basic hospitality service.
Although we were eventually given our room earlier than the official check-in time, we were assigned a tiny ground-floor room that looked nothing like the standard room shown in the photos. The room was extremely small, and the window could not be opened because it faced a smoking area with no privacy.
The cleanliness was unacceptable. The toilet had visible stains (photos attached), and there was no dustbin, tissues, or toilet paper in the room. Even after requesting these basic items, they were not provided, forcing us to throw rubbish on the floor. There was also no complimentary bottled water—everything had to be purchased separately.
The hotel was also very noisy. The front desk area generated constant noise, and trains passing outside could be heard throughout the stay, making it difficult to rest.
The location was another disappointment. There was very little of interest nearby, and the area felt deserted at night.
Breakfast was another letdown. It was not ready at the advertised opening time of 6:00 a.m., so we had to return to our room and wait.
What was most disappointing was that even after informing the staff about these issues, no action was taken. They appeared completely unconcerned and showed no urgency in resolving the problems or improving our experience.
To be fair, the only positive interaction we had was with the night-shift staff member. He was professional, courteous, and genuinely willing to help. Unfortunately, by the time we met him, we were already exhausted and had dealt with several issues that had left us with a very poor impression of the hotel. It's unfortunate that the same level of professionalism and customer service was not shown by the rest of the front desk staff.
While this hotel may be a few dollars cheaper than other options, it is absolutely worth spending a little more for a better-quality hotel. The small saving is simply not worth the poor service, lack of cleanliness, excessive noise, missing basic amenities, and disappointing overall experience.
I would strongly recommend avoiding this hotel and choosing another property nearby, even if it costs a little more. The difference in price is likely to be far outweighed by a much better overall stay.

author: Thomas P
title: Skip this place, unhygenic and poor attitute
text:
Our stay at Madison LES Hotel was one of the most disappointing hotel experiences I have had, and I regret choosing this property.

From the moment we arrived, we felt that our concerns were not taken seriously. The front desk staff were not welcoming and showed very little interest in helping us. Communication was difficult, and our requests were often met with an indifferent attitude rather than genuine customer service.

The room we received was very different from what had been advertised during the booking process. We were assigned a tiny ground-floor room that was directly next to the hotel's smoking area. Because people were frequently standing outside smoking, we could not keep the blinds open for natural light without completely sacrificing our privacy, and cigarette smoke occasionally entered the room.

The room itself lacked basic amenities. There was no dustbin, tissues, or toilet paper when we checked in, and despite informing the front desk, these items were still not provided. The bathroom also had visible cleanliness issues, which was very disappointing.

Another frustrating experience was breakfast. We arrived at the advertised opening time of 6:00 a.m., only to find that it was not ready. Since we had planned our day around the published breakfast schedule, this caused unnecessary inconvenience.

The hotel's baggage policy was also disappointing. We were asked to pay $6 per bag to store our luggage, and there was no flexibility despite our circumstances. This was something we had never encountered at any other hotel during our travels.

The hotel was also much noisier than expected. Being on the ground floor meant we could constantly hear activity from the reception area as well as noise from the street and nearby trains, making it difficult to relax.

What disappointed me the most was that we reported these issues during our stay, yet nothing was done to improve the situation. A simple effort to address our concerns would have made a significant difference.

I do want to acknowledge that the night-shift staff member was courteous, professional, and willing to help. Unfortunately, by then, our overall experience had already been negatively affected.

Although this hotel may appear to offer a lower price than nearby options, I would strongly recommend spending a little more for a property that provides better service, cleaner rooms, and a more comfortable stay. Based on my experience, I would not choose Madison LES Hotel again.

author: Emma E
title: HORRIBLE!!!
text: Horrible stay. Started badly with the rudest, most unhelpful receptionist I've ever come across. Rooms are tiny and need attention. Rock hard bed, exposed wiring, damp dirty spots on walls and window frames and outdated bathrooms. Ripped carpet in the hallway. Breakfast was as basic as you can get, cereal, toast or yoghurt. The noise from the trains was constant. Roof terrace was filthy. Location wasnt very safe or tourist friendly.  We were told by a local police officer not to walk around after dark as we were close to the projects. Take a cab or uber but dont ask at reception for help or guidance because they wont help help especially if they are eating their lunch while on duty, they just waive you away. Would never reco.mend this place.

author: Sara K
title: Very Nice
text:
We stayed here for 5 days during the World Cup. Overall, I found the room very nice. As I was travelling with a friend, we had two double beds (one each) & the room was very spacious. Check in was simple & quick. The hotel is right next to the train tracks on Manhattan Bridge, but in all honesty, you'd hardly notice it. It was so loud outside that you'd forgive a bit of noise coming through, but it barely did. The air con worked perfectly & the room was always lovely & cool. We did not use the room service provided so cannot comment on that one. Beds were comfy. 

The bad parts were cleanliness in the bathroom. The shower looked as if it needed a deep scrub & there were dirty marks all around, but the shower itself was nice & powerful. Plenty of towels & loo roll to keep us happy. Not the hotel, but the surrounding area was a little smelly at times. Lots of bin bags left out in the sun with temps of 30+c was a challenge, but not the hotels fault. Overall 4.5/5 from me.

author: Louis H
title: Don’t Recommend
text: The location was not so great and the rooms are small but you get what you paid for. My major complaint would this establishment would be the noise and lack of customer service. Honestly customer service was non existent during this stay. Anything that we needed we had to request. Like simple trash bags for the rooms or an ice bucket. The staff are-ridiculously loud making it hard to simply relax. Between loud check-ins, staff members moving around furniture or whatever it was not a pleasant stay. There was no food, no vending machines and many things weren’t even working. Will never be staying here again.

author: William K
title: Correct.
text: Well located outside the center, with the subway very close. Convenience store next door.  Staff was not very friendly, unfortunately.  Except for the boy who was nice.  However, the rooms for four are tiny.  No space to place the suitcases on the floor and no storage.  We can barely move around in the room.  On the other hand, the rooftop is nice for the incredible view at night.

author: Evie M
title: Horrible
text:
We had a very poor welcome — barely a hello, and no explanations about anything. The hotel is in a good location, especially for people who already know New York a bit. The subway isn’t far, which is probably the only positive point.

I’ve never experienced a breakfast like this before — everything was frozen, and the coffee was watery and tasteless. On the second day, we tried to have breakfast, but the dining room was completely dark. A man was sitting in the hallway looking at his phone… he got up and asked us to wait five minutes so he could prepare breakfast. The next morning, a staff member was running around the dining room touching everything for no apparent reason, cleaning the floor while we were eating — stirring up dust. Unbelievable!

Honestly, this is a hotel to avoid! It was our fifth trip to New York, and by far our worst hotel experience.

author: Pierre U
title: I would stay there again if I returned to NY
text:
is super located, easy access to metro and buses 
quiet area, it helps you a lot breakfast, very comfortable beds and as a tip order Taxi Service there we got cheaper than the uber to go to the airport

author: Ryan G
title: Small and convenient.
text: Rooms are small even for two people, with a small table, for a coffee maker not much more.  I guess for the location, the price is right.  Rooms are clean, bathrooms are efficient.  You can hear the low rumble of the subway on the Manhattan Bridge all day.

author: Chloe K
title: Great hotel for the price
text: I thought it was overall a very good experience. The bed and pillows were very comfortable, and the room was clean. The breakfast isn't anything fancy, but it's better than paying for breakfast elsewhere.

author: Erin M
title: Kelsung the Unsung Hero!
text: Kelsung is amazing! I had a very late arrival and he made the entire process quick, smooth, and efficient . Very sweet as well!

author: Noah J
title: Confirmed and switched
text:
Confirmed reservation from March but they moved us elsewhere to a apartment building under construction.  
We were told the room would be bigger. It was newly done but shoddily.  Even the elevator controls on our floor were slipping down (not mounted correctly). The bed was a Murphy bed which had a single mattress which was hard like a box spring.  No tv or coffeemaker in the room. Lighting was from ceiling can lights.  When asked as we checked out how our stay was, I told him that it was very uncomfortable.  Suggested that they add another mattress and some floor lamps.   
When we checked in, reception asked us if we had been called about this switching.  We had not.  More communication.  Obviously can’t comment on the hotel itself.  No way I would ever use this hotel again.

author: Julien T
title: A budget alternative especially if you sleep soundly despite noise
text:
It's hard to write a review of a rural motel in a big city, because something feels just slightly off. If this place is the only way you can afford to stay in Manhattan, then go, you'll be fine. Also, if the only food options you need are in Chinatown, you'll be fine. If you want to be near family or friends in Chinatown or this part of the Lower East Side, you'll be fine.
There's a bus that takes you to the outer edge of the financial district, though if your company puts you up here, you need to give that some thought.
There's a price for the low price. The neighborhood is bleak with very limited food options, which makes sense as it's not a neighborhood of early risers or people who can afford to each out much. There's one good general restaurant nearby, and it seemed to always be packed. If you walk down Madison, you'll find police HQ with a thinly-stocked Starbucks nearby and a grocery store.
The Lower East Side subway station requires stairs, so bear that in mind if you have a lot of luggage. If you go to a Broadway show, you'll probably want to take a cab back, so that might be considered a hidden cost. The other hidden cost might be the time it takes to find food options.
The bridge is not an issue, but the subway train that rattles and rumbles on it is definitely noticeable. Sleep quality is poor. But this is New York and if this is the place you can afford, you'll be fine for the time you're here.
I found the staff very helpful, which is one reason I gave this four and not three stars. But I understand the very divided reviews. You can see the same sight in different ways. If you stayed in this hotel 60 miles outside of Fresno, or on the wind-swept, forlorn coast of Washington State, you'd feel everything was normal. Perhaps the presence of such an affordable hotel just feels odd in Manhattan.

author: Camille W
title: Good location
text: Hotel 5 minutes from the metro station. Room really very very small but clean. Breakfast can be improved as it is very limited in choice. The hotel does not offer restaurant service but is close enough to Chinatown where you can find a bit of everything

author: Joseph E
title: TO FLEE
text:
I’ll start with the only positive: the hotel is well located (near the metro about 5min walk).

The hotel looks like a MOTEL. The staff is anything but pleasant we feel to disturb them. Don't smile and don't think about hello. 
We were given a room glued to the subway so impossible to sleep. We asked to change rooms we had a smaller room. Very poorly soundproofed. The cleaning of the rooms are done very quickly (just the bed made and towels changed) no sheets changed all the stay the toilet is not made all the stay nor shower. The housekeeping staff had nothing to do with it, but they are hotel guidelines. Dirty sheets and blankets not to mention yellow ears.
Room badly insulated we had cold on our head and heating in front of us, everything to get sick. 
Breakfast advertised as excellent is the same throughout the stay: wholemeal bread; frozen waffles; industrial banana muffin. Tea + coffee and yogurt. Sometimes apples and oranges.
No protein. No change, so I might as well tell you it disgusts quickly. 
Go your way.

author: Emma W
title: One-Star Review of Madison LES Hotel
text:
My Family had an incredibly disappointing experience at the Madison LES Hotel, and I cannot recommend this place to anyone. From the moment we arrived, the customer service was shockingly rude and unhelpful.

When we checked in, we had a party of four adults and one child. The front desk lady informed us that because our reservation was for four, the child couldn’t stay. We were like, what?! Then she said the child could stay if we paid an additional $50 per night. Who says that? We ended up paying an extra $100 for the child, which was frustrating and unnecessary. They did upgrade us to a small suite and added a cot, but the room itself left much to be desired.

The bathroom was a major issue. The shower tiles were old and chipped, and it was nearly impossible to figure out how to get hot water. After several attempts, we had to call the front desk, and the instructions were absurd: "Turn left, turn right, and wait five minutes." Additionally, the sink in the bathroom was clogged and wouldn’t drain, which felt unsanitary and disgusting.

The hotel's "Continental breakfast" consisted of bread, fruit, and coffee—not much to write home about. When we asked the front desk lady for recommendations on what to do in the area, her response was, “Nothing.” It was like she couldn’t be bothered to engage with guests or offer any helpful advice.

To make matters worse, my father accidentally left his cane behind. When we called to ask if they could mail it to us, offering to pay the shipping costs, they outright refused, claiming they had no mailing service. It was an unnecessary display of poor customer service.

The only redeeming aspect was one gentleman who, upon our early arrival, offered us complimentary drinks. However, even this small gesture was undercut by the same front desk lady, who limited us to water only.

Overall, this was one of the worst hospitality experiences I’ve ever had. The facilities are outdated and poorly maintained, and the service is appallingly rude. I have no idea how this hotel maintains its four-star rating. Save yourself the trouble and stay elsewhere.

author: Connor G
title: EXCELLENT LOCATION
text: Hotel in the Brooklyn neighborhood, just steps from the East River and the F subway line. Small but very comfortable room, especially the bed. Breakfast included in the stay, not very rich and varied. Staff not very talkative and helpful. Good price if booked in advance, great for location.

author: Evie J
title: Very good value for money
text: Good bedding, clean. Well maintained. Small and noisy room because train passing over the manhattan bridge day and night. But otherwise excellent value for money. Overnight stay at 250€ for 4 with breakfast in Manhattan = unbeatable price. Bravo

author: Zoe B
title: If you’re just there to sleep it will work for you.
text: Good location by the Manhattan bridge with a nice view of the Brooklyn bridge at night. A good price since it’s very expensive to stay in NYC, however the rooms are small and bed is short. The breakfast was without protein no eggs or hot food. Subway is close.

author: Ryan E
title: Exceptional Stay with Outstanding VIP Service
text:
Our stay at Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile was fantastic from start to finish. The service throughout the property was top-notch, but the standout highlight was Jeanne from the VIP team. Her professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail elevated our entire experience. She went above and beyond to make sure every aspect of our visit was seamless and memorable, exemplifying true world-class hospitality.
The hotel’s location is unbeatable for navigating Paris. Being directly connected to the transit hub with seamless access to the Metro and RER train lines made exploring the city and getting to major sights completely effortless.
The lounge is another major highlight—exceptionally well-run, offering a relaxing atmosphere, great food and drink selections throughout the day, and breathtaking views over the city. It served as the perfect retreat after a long day of sightseeing.
Between the prime connectivity, fantastic lounge, and exceptional care from Jeanne and the team, this hotel exceeded all expectations. We will definitely return on our next trip to Paris!

author: Lucas T
title: Excellent service at clean Paris hotel
text: Excelllent service - nice professional hotel. Clean room and bathrooms. Biggest negatives are that the rooms are a little small and the hotel has a very business/conference feel

author: Zachary V
title: Paris trip 8/16/26 to  8/22/26
text:
Disappointed by How Our Family Emergency Was Handled

We arrived on August 16, 2026, as a group of four. We booked our reservation through Amex and reserved connecting family rooms. Breakfast was included for all four of us.

Unfortunately, we had a family emergency during our stay—my mother-in-law passed away unexpectedly. As a result, my husband and daughter had to leave immediately. We canceled one of our rooms, while my son and I stayed for the remainder of the trip.

After canceling the second room, we were told that our reservation had to be recreated and that breakfast was no longer included. This was very disappointing because our original reservation clearly included breakfast. I was never informed that canceling one room would result in losing our breakfast package.

I do not feel this was handled fairly or with much compassion, especially considering the circumstances our family was going through. I am also a World of Hyatt member, but unfortunately, I did not feel that this was taken into consideration. The manager was not friendly or understanding during a very difficult time for our family.

I understand that reservation changes may sometimes be necessary, but I believe the hotel could have handled this situation with much more care, flexibility, and compassion.

author: Mathis L
title: Definitely worth upgrading to the Eiffel Tower view and Club Access.
text: Stayed in the Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile for 3 nights with my wife and youngest daughter,  and had an outstanding experience.  We shared a room and while cosy, it was spotlessly clean and housekeeping were fabulous.  Some lovely little touches that make it an elevated experience.  The view was outstanding - we had opted for an Eiffel Tower view which from our room on Floor 31 was simply amazing!  The girls loved looking at it day and night out of the window, and was such a wonderful backdrop.  We also had gone for a Club room,  and this included access to the Regency Club which we couldn't recommend more highly.  A great breakfast service that set us up well,  and a wonderful place to stop by and spend some time in with drinks and snacks for a break from the sightseeing.  The staff there particularly were fabulous and always so efficient, helpful but not overbearing.  Thank you!

author: Katie Q
title: At this reasonable price point, HRP deserves 5 stars
text: Small rooms and clean, you may be competing with tour groups and flight crews to get to your elevator.  Breakfast was quite nice, with eggs made to order.  Staff are generally very good.  I appreciated the option for vegetables/broccoli at breakfast (though for some reason the broccoli was not tasty).  Great views of the Eiffel Tower.  The 17th Arrondissement is nice but a bit away from the main drag (other than Arc de Triomphe) so there may be increased cost for Ubers or one may take the metro.  Would return to this hotel.

author: Abigail U
title: Merci Hyatt Regency Paris
text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Hyatt Paris. The hotel was a little out of the way from main attractions but the subway was right up the street and not too hard to navigate with a little help from the hotel staff. There were several restaurants or bistros that were walkable in the neighborhood as well. The hotel staff were great and the room was clean and comfortable. We enjoyed a very elaborate breakfast each morning. I recommend going up top to the sky bar. The drinks are pricey but the view of the Eiffel Tower can’t be beat

author: Benjamin O
title: Awesome 🌟
text: The hotel's hospitality and atmosphere are perfect, with the best view of the Eiffel Tower, and thanks to Mr. Areesh, we had our best Breakfast experience in Paris. ☺️

author: Oscar R
title: Not for Families that are traveling with 2 little ones
text: Nice hotel but should be adults only because there is no accommodation for families traveling with 2 little ones. They will make you get an extra room if your traveling with more than one baby. Good luck if you have twins. We literally had to get a second room just because of the room size policy or show us the exit door. After months of planning and traveling from so far this really stings Hyatt. I've stayed at so many hyatts and this is a new one for me. Thanks for an unpleasant stay. Checked in into two rooms only to use one because we never needed the second room. Thanks

author: Ryan R
title: A short but very pleasant stay
text: A short but very pleasant stay with a stunning view of Paris and the Eiffel Tower, on the 25th floor (thanks for the upgrade!). This is the second time I have booked here, and I really do not regret it. Plus, it is only a 15-minute walk from the Arc de Triomphe and the legendary avenues of Paris.

author: Alexander A
title: Breakfast is glorious here, not "central" but has good sights nearby and has indoor access to the subway.
text:
Fantastic hotel, location was nice, staff was excellent.  Lots of airline staff to be seen.

Breakfast and the view is worth the stay alone!

author: Ethan A
title: Good value hotel near public transport
text: Rooms are clean and comfortable, some with great views of the city and Eiffel Tower. Located above a convention center, the hotel is close to a metro station and although it's not central to most of the usual tourist sights it is pretty easy to get around.

author: Jack P
title: Great experience at Hyatt Regency Etoile
text: The staff and experience are both top notch. The room and lounge are great and the location cannot be beat. I would highly recommend.

author: Isabella Z
title: Easy access to metro
text: Good location with easy access to metro. However, the hotel staff should work more efficiently when there are many tourists awaiting in the lobby.

author: Charlie D
title: Beautiful Hotel with Spectacular Eiffel Tower Views
text:
We were very pleased with our stay at the Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile.  The location was excellent, and the hotel itself is beautiful.  We also really enjoyed the breakfast, which offered a great selection.  

The highlight o four stay was the spectacular view from our room.  We had a direct view of the Eiffel Tower, and seeing it illuminated and sparkling at night was absolutely breathtaking.  It was truly worth the cost of the room just for that view!

The hotel staff throughout the property could have been a little more welcoming and friendly.  However, we had a wonderful experience at the 34th-floor bar.  The views were amazing, and the staff there were exceptionally friendly, accommodating and attentive.  

One minor inconvenience was the taxis waiting outside the hotel.  hile there were plenty of taxis available, the drivers did not seem interested in taking us on shorter trips and appeared to prefer longer fares, such as airport transportation.  We ended up using Uber most of the time, which worked very well.    

Overall, we had a wonderful stay at the Hyatt Regency Paris Etoile and would definitely recommend it.  The beautiful hotel, convenient location, excellent  breakfast and especially the incredible Eiffel Tower views made our visit to Paris very memorable!

author: Pierre A
title: A pearl in Paris to enjoy
text: Hostel well located and of. Easy access to RER transport, subways, buses, and trains. Beautiful views on the 34th floor for breakfast and from the rooms. Both the Eiffel Tower and Montmartre. As WofH Globalist members, we were disappointed by the little recognition received. But the hotel is still recommendable. The food category at Le Club on the 34th floor has improved.

author: Connor I
title: Returned for another great experience
text: Excellent hotel with equally excellent staff, a most enjoyable experience. We first stayed here 27 years ago when it was the Concorde Lafayette and had a fantastic time; this time around did not at all disappoint.

author: Oscar N
title: Very nice hotel in Paris
text: This is the tallest hotel building in Paris. Location is good, though somewhat far from major tourist attractions but still within 30 minutes of subway Metro rides. Hotel is well maintained although room size is a little smaller than we expected. Staff is attentive and helpful. Breakfast offers good varieties. Will consider coming back next time.

author: Evie B
title: All the best location and facilities
text: Overall cleaner than other hotels in Paris and superior service. The location is very good and easy access to major tourist attractions. Best of the hotels we visited during our trip (Pullman Tower Eiffel, Novotel Paris La Défense).

author: Dylan F
title: That view alone is worth the stay
text:
A solid, well-run business hotel with one truly standout feature: the view. Being up in the tower, you get a phenomenal panorama over the whole of Paris — the kind of view you could genuinely sit and watch for hours, city lights and all. If you can, ask for a high floor; it makes the stay.

Beyond that, everything does exactly what it should. Breakfast was excellent and varied, with plenty of choice to start the day properly, and the staff were consistently friendly and helpful throughout. The rooms were clean, functional, and comfortable — nothing flashy, but exactly what you want from a reliable business hotel.

Not a boutique experience, and it doesn't try to be one — but for a stay in Paris with an unbeatable skyline view, this is hard to beat. Highly recommended.

author: Chloe M
title: 1st Parisian trip
text: Excellent location and the room has an outstanding view of the Eifel tower and the Arc du Triomph, the bedding was very comfortable.

author: Alice X
title: Does not deserve its 3 stars
text:
The business rooms are adjacent to the elevator, so avoid them; you get the impression that other travelers are walking through your room (that said, I had been warned about this situation upon booking...). Soundproofing is almost nonexistent.
The shower and toilet are in the room, without any separating door, except for a curtain.
The room is tiny (ship cabin) and overlooks the back, which is dilapidated.
Average breakfast (no fruit salad, few different breads, butter and yogurts are not kept cold), the room is very cramped.
Staff friendliness varies depending on the person. The "breakfast manager" on her smartphone next to the customers.

What remains is the excellent location and the air conditioning, which is essential in summer.
Not worth the price, and certainly not its 3 stars.

author: Pierre O
title: Decent stay, nothing more.
text: Decent stay overall. The hotel is well located and the staff is rather welcoming, but some points need improvement: room a bit aging (TV among others) and soundproofing could be better. The value for money remains decent without being exceptional. A suitable stay for a short stopover.

author: Jessica A
title: Very good
text: Very good for everything. Just a slight, somewhat unpleasant smell of stagnant water upon waking, but otherwise everything was great!

author: Emma V
title: Very disappointing
text: I am not in the habit of leaving negative reviews, but the services here were too disappointing: a king-size bed was advertised when it was actually 2 beds pushed together; very, very low water pressure in the shower; a dusty coffee maker; the lady at the front desk was not friendly, and the gentleman in the evening did not deign to respond to our greeting... the only advantage of this hotel is the location, which is in the center of several beautiful places in Paris.

author: Michael W
title: simply great
text: very clean. comfortable in everyway. location perfect for a stay in paris. functioning lift. a return stay will occur in the future.

author: Olivia N
title: Fabulous
text:
Everything was perfect: welcome, room, cleanliness.
The hotel is located in the heart of Paris, in the Marais. Personally, I really like this neighborhood. 
I will return to this hotel with immense pleasure!

author: Mia N
title: TOO GREAT TO DO AGAIN!!
text:
So awesome!!! 
I love this hotel for its family-friendly atmosphere!!! 
Staff is very kind and always helpful. Stephane and Aurélie are great people; I asked for extra towels and they brought them to me within 5 minutes!!

author: Dylan B
title: Excellent
text: A delightful discovery. The hotel could not be better situated - moments away from the Marais, Norte Dame, Rivoli, but on a peaceful and very quiet side street. The rooms are extremely comfortable and in discreet good taste that one associates with traditional small hotels jn Paris. Every member of the team was welcoming, attentive and professional. I shall happily be returning.

author: Sofia C
title: Fantastic location….solid choice
text: My personal experience was very positive, I was hesitant as pretty mixed reviews and everywhere in this area of Paris is fairly expensive.  I chose to be in this location as I had only 2 nights and wanted to be within close walking distance to the Marais bars.  The location is perfect and felt very safe.  The staff were professional/hospitable.  The room was a very good size (deluxe room) with a modern bathroom, kettle and generally in a reasonable condition.  It is arguably expensive for what it is until you factor in the location then it is I think worth the money.  If you do not need to be in this location (e.g  out after the metro stops) then you obviously get better value to stay in a different location.

author: Lucas N
title: Good location is the only good thing here,
text: Stayed three nights here. Pros: Great location. Plenty of restaurants and cafes near. Quiet neighborhood. Room was small but clean. Cons: Reception staff was unfriendly bordering on rude.Rooms are small and not good for just sitting. The amenities were almost non existent. Had our daughter and granddaughter stop by for a visit and they wouldn’t let us sit in the empty breakfast. I wouldn’t stay here unless you really needed to.

author: Noah Q
title: Room and hotel was nothing like advertised
text: I chose this hotel because it advertised that it had an inner quiet courtyard with the deluxe room. Also because it advertised as clean and modern. Nothing could be further than the truth. The hotel didn’t have an inner courtyard at all!!  Our room faced a noisy street. The room and the hotel were not clean. When I complained to the front desk they said there was nothing they could do, told me to leave them alone they were too busy to talk with me and told me I could leave the hotel.

author: Adam N
title: Good
text: Small room, ideal for sleeping and short stays. Bathroom was fine, shower a bit small. All was good!

author: Juan C
title: Decent hotel, good reception from the staff, very good location.
text:
The comfort of the room matched the reservation. Very good bedding.
Decent breakfast for the price asked.
Two small remarks: At times, there were odors of sewage coming from the shower apparently.
 And the wifi code noted on the information card is incomplete, missing at the end of the digits an exclamation point, a detail that the night guard indicated to us upon our request. After that, it was fine.

author: Sophia P
title: Great
text: The room was just what we needed for our short stay.  The hotel had had what we needed.  Is was close to many restaurants shops. We didn’t expect to experience.

author: Zoe J
title: Great location but disappointing hotel
text:
Great location, great staff BUT poor hotel and insensitive owner.
We stayed for 3 nights in a ‘superior’ room. Small, but that is to be expected in Paris. 2nd day the shower AND bedroom flooded because of a blocked drain. We were moved to a lesser (tiny) room with a window overlooking the elevator shaft. Following morning there was no hot water for any hotel guests. Third night we were moved back to a superior room. We asked for some financial gesture that recognised our poor experience, but the (remote) owner  offered nothing more than the difference in room prices. During our stay we also saw other guests checking out early and seeking reimbursement. So disappointing.

author: Mia G
title: Value for money
text: We only stayed one night. The room is small, but quality value for money is good. The bed was comfortable. The bathroom was fine. Good pressure for the shower. The location of the hotel is right in the center of Paris at the disposal of all attractions. I recommend staying there.

author: Maria I
title: Top location, rooms unfortunately disappointing, breakfast super
text: The hotel has a very good location to explore and discover Paris on foot. It is easy to find and is located on a side road. The check-in was friendly and straightforward. My room with balcony was on the 5th floor. The elevator could accommodate a 1 person with small luggage and worked. The room was very small, the equipment simple/primitive, the room neighbor could hear very well, the balcony could not actually be used because there was no seating - the view was nice though. An unpleasant smell constantly streamed from the bathroom as a mixture of cleaning agent and moisture problem in the walls. For the room, I see a 3-star category as unjustified. Nevertheless, it must be emphasized positively that the breakfast was rich and fresh. Also, the room was thoroughly cleaned daily. It's just a pity the condition of the room didn't convince. For a short visit to Paris and with little demand for equipment I recommend the hotel - but it is not for people who want peace to sleep and are sensitive to cleaning products.

author: David O
title: Meets expectations
text: Attentive and discreet stay, day or night, ensuring luggage and vehicle reservation with great friendliness.

author: Lea W
title: Excellent hotel
text: Excellent experience for our 3rd stay at Hotel Andrea: warm and attentive welcome from the whole team, great room comfort, very good breakfast, and hotel ideally located in Paris, in a quiet street and a very nice area. We will come back, and we recommend!

author: Molly I
title: Perfect stay
text: Charming hotel, ideally located. The rooms were clean (the 204 and the 603) and the staff adorable.

author: Antoine W
title: Great hotel
text:
From the moment we arrived early the staff were very friendly and helpful! They kept our luggage safe until we could check in later in the day. They have a spot for you to change after your flights and prepare for the day. 
The room was clean, well equipped and in good shape. We had a triple which worked out great with teenagers. I would 100% recommend this hotel to others. Lots of food and easy stops to walk to in the area. And an easy walk from the train and bus stop too.

author: Grace P
title: 5 stars all around
text:
Perfect location for a trip to Rome. It was a 5 minute walk from the train station and had amazing restaurants at the corner of the street with amazing food and good prices. Trevi fountain, Spanish steps, the colosseum and many more historical sites were a 20-30 minute walk. The hotel itself was VERY clean and the bed was very comfortable which I appreciated after a long travel day. The staff was so friendly and nice, allowed a early check in since my room was ready when I got there at noon and securely held my bags for me so I could explore the city after check out and before my flight. I will for sure be back 

Small cons: very poor water pressure but that’s everywhere in Italy (didn’t bother me for a quick shower) and the rooms can get a little noisy with outside traffic but nothing crazy that altered my stay.

author: Owen E
title: Great location, wonderful staff!
text: I booked this place based on its proximity to Roma Termini, and it was perfect from that perspective.  But it is also a sweet little hotel with staff who really want to be helpful (and are!).  The hotel even provides for some local experiences without additional fees, and we took the night tour around the Colosseum - it was fantastic!  Also, the breakfast was amazing.  I would book again if going to Rome, and highly recommend.

author: Freya F
title: 5 star staff
text:
We stayed here for one night and found it to be an excellent choice. The location is ideal, just a short walk from the train station and within easy reach of many of Rome’s attractions.

From the moment we arrived, we received a warm and friendly welcome from the young lady on reception, who kindly upgraded us to a spacious room overlooking the Baths of Diocletian. The room was spotless, comfortable, and well equipped with everything we needed for our stay.

Breakfast was very good, with plenty of choice, and the member of staff looking after the breakfast service was welcoming and attentive.

This would have been a five-star review. Unfortunately, on our return to the hotel in the evening, we had an unpleasant encounter with two men in the street outside, We fully appreciate that this had nothing to do with the hotel and was completely beyond its control, so it does not reflect the quality of the accommodation or the excellent service we received throughout our stay.

Overall, we would happily recommend this hotel for its location, comfortable rooms, and outstanding staff.

author: Paige G
title: Great experience and excellent assistance with the luggage
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Diocleziano and the experience was fantastic. The rooms are extremely comfortable, spotless in terms of cleanliness, and a noteworthy detail, they are very well soundproofed, which guarantees excellent rest after walking all day around the city.
The attention from the staff was very good and attentive at all times. One gesture that we greatly appreciated was that, on the day of our departure, they allowed us to securely store our luggage in a restroom so we could take one last leisurely stroll before leaving the city for good.
Without a doubt, a hotel highly recommended for its comfort, service, and attentiveness to the guest. A place to return!

author: Rosie Q
title: Okay for a night
text: I needed a hotel near Termini station for one night. I was able to check in early, which was a major bonus as I had been traveling for many hours. The shower was quite poor, with limited hot water, and the showerhead was crusty and clogged with mineral deposits. Decor is a bit outdated but everything was very clean. Comfortable bed and good air conditioning. Quite expensive for what it is.

author: Kyle Q
title: Comfortable hotel in an excellent location!!
text: Very comfortable hotel close to the main local and non-local transport (Termini station, bus terminal, metro). Located near Piazza della Repubblica in the heart of Rome. Friendly and welcoming staff, also offering free excursions organized by the establishment.

author: Chloe Z
title: Hotel Diocleziano great place to stay in Rome
text: Hotel Diocleziano was a great place to stay in Rome. It is in a safe and convenient location, very close to the train station, and has many good restaurants within a few mins walk. The staff was very helpful and friendly. The room was clean, comfortable and updated. I would definitely stay there again and recommend it.

author: Manon L
title: The good and the bad
text: The good - the location is exceptional for those using trains and the metro as it's only a couple minutes walk. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The not so good - the shower was VERY tiny, even for someone slender and not much prep area in the washroom. The breakfast was also lackluster with few options and a toaster you need a degree to work, but the young lady taking care of everything was exceptional.

author: Paolo Q
title: To be repeated! Like at home
text: Comfortable hotel for business appointments. Run very well: from receptionist Lisette (very kind and professional), to breakfast TOP (David welcoming, prepared and always attentive) to exceptional cleanliness. Advice for work and relaxation

author: Holly U
title: Lovely 5 night stay
text: A small hotel, in a quiet street, close to both metro lines and the train station. Modern yet full of character. Breakfast was excellent, cereal, fresh fruit, yogurt, nuts, cold meat platter, cheese platter, hot selection and tasty bread, cakes and pastries. The staff were exceptional, caring, helpful and friendly. We were upgraded to a superior room, spotless, huge double bed, storage and walk in shower. Lift, small gym and sauna available.

author: Lily E
title: 4+ hotel, outstanding stay.
text: Very convenient to the train station, buses and subways. The staff is five star, friendly and helpful. There’s plenty of restaurants in the general walking area. A small convenience store on the corner. The room was a good size for me and was very quiet. I actually left my window open at night. Memorable view from the window of a museum courtyard next to the hotel. I really, really enjoyed the breakfast. My only criticism was the street leading from the train station to the hotel smells like a dirty urinal. I stayed six nights and was very pleased.

author: Isabella H
title: Diocleziano Rome hotel
text:
We stayed at the Diocleziano Rome hotel from April 10–12, 2026. We arrived at the hotel around 11 a.m. and after a short wait, we were checked in. On the day of departure, after checking out, we left our luggage at the hotel and were able to enjoy the Roman atmosphere until the evening.
Almost everything was excellent.
We had a large and nice room with good sound insulation and a big, but in my opinion not soft enough, bed. I didn’t like the view from my window — it faced the wall of the building opposite.
Every morning we had nice breakfasts with a buffet. There was a wide selection of appetizers, main courses, desserts, fruits, and more. They made excellent coffee for us.
The hotel’s location is very convenient, as most attractions were within a 20–30 minute walk. We walked to the Vatican through traditional small picturesque streets, which took about 1 hour. The train station is nearby (just a 5–7 minute walk), so we saved a significant amount of money on transportation.
Overall, I would like to thank all the staff for their hospitality and high level of service.

author: George H
title: Air-conditioning Issues at Hotel
text: The hotel advertised air-conditioned rooms. However, air-conditioning is only turned on during certain times of the year and the decision to turn it on is made by the hotel.....not by the guest. This is not disclosed until guests complain. Websites and other promotional materials should be more transparent about the air-conditioning limitations. When I mentioned to staff, they responded apathetically and indignently.

author: Wyatt C
title: Great hotel with good value for money
text: Hotels near the train station. Great reception. Spacious rooms well appointed and clean. Varied breakfast both sweet and savory and very kind waiters. It has a mini gym and sauna. Recommended

author: Emma Q
title: Recommended. Great structure
text: Very comfortable hotel, very clean and good maintenance. Efficient, professional and particularly attentive to customer needs. Very good overall management of the hotel. Fully satisfied!!!

author: Alexander D
title: Very acceptable.
text: Location was great, room was fine and clean, a bit dated in the bathroom.  Staff was super friendly and helpful.  Thanks

author: Kyle B
title: Very good
text: Impeccable. The staff was very kind. Maximum comfort.  We are fine you are fine We recommend. ............

author: Andrea G
title: GOOD HOTEL, BUT STILL IMPROVEABLE - Three and a half pellets -
text:
The Diocletian Hotel is a good structure, but it can still improve.
Well located in a quiet side street in Termini area (5 minutes walk from the station), it has a slightly small exterior, like the lobby, although the common areas also extend to the other side, from the lobby, where there is a small sitting area and, to follow, the fitness room.
Very good reception with friendly and helpful staff, quality, these, then, found at breakfast and also at check-out.
Not appreciated, however, the request to pay the room price immediately.
All you had to do was ask for a credit card as collateral and settle on departure.
Room 207, on the second floor, not very large, but clean, well lit, well furnished and equipped with the necessary accessories that a 4-star must have.
Just a relief on the TV: 
a little small and positioned too low.
Bed a bit hard, but good quality of sleep (the room overlooked an inner courtyard, as I had requested).
Bathroom proportionate in size to the room, clean, well lit and with a nice walk-in shower that could hold, simultaneously, even two people.
Do not present courtesy products, but good quality dispencer.
Absent the bathrobes.
Wi-Fi good, free and well working.
Breakfast served a nice room on the ground floor, assisted by friendly and helpful staff.
There are no “machines” and hot drinks are made and served at the moment.
Present both sweet and savory, in sufficient quantity and quality, although, perhaps, on something, you can improve.
Competitive price ( € 103.00 for the double) which, however, rises to 118.00 due to a 15.00 euro tourist tax ( € 7.50 per person) demanded by the City of Rome.
A “ gabella” of medieval origin, truly incommentable.
Value for money, I would say good.
Pier Luigi Menga (Naples)

author: Marco B
title: Well located, welcoming hotel
text: The hotel is just a short walk from the train station and easy to find. We arrived quite late but were warmly welcomed by the staff on duty, they even provided recommendations for a couple of nearby restaurants so we didn’t have to trail about for food. Everything was clean and cared for and our standard room was a good size for the 2 of us. I would not hesitate to use this hotel again.

author: Sofia S
title: Great location
text: The location is so good! It is right by Notre Dame and there are so many restaurants around. The room was small but that is expected. The staff was nice.

author: Henry R
title: Impossible to sleep
text: Impossible to sleep due to the unbearable noise from the street. The receptionist was rude and unfriendly to the customers. Not worth returning

author: Morgan P
title: Noisy hotel
text: Very clean hotel but on a very noisy street.Bars,clubs noisy till 4am.My mistake.Spoiled weekend as everyone tired, o sleep.

author: Marco U
title: I slept in a dormitory with 3 single beds. The shower was 50 cm wide. No electrical outlet available.
text: Small and very mediocre comfort.

author: Mia S
title: Perfect location, great value for money
text:
Cozy, small hotel in the heart of the 5th.
Everything is nearby, the Metro/RER is almost at the door, Notre Dame, the Seine 😍
One can reach everything conveniently on foot.
The staff is very friendly and the rooms are clean.
When I am in Paris, I stay here; I can recommend it.

author: Hugo D
title: Short getaway to Paris.
text: Ideally located in the heart of the Latin Quarter, the hotel is ideal for a short stay. Yes it has the disadvantages of its advantages because the neighborhood is active until very late at night. Breakfast is very hearty.

author: Holly D
title: An old "dame"
text: Is very small hotel in an old worn building. Very small room. The cleaning could be better. The location out to a small street with div cafes of course gives a little noise.

author: Mia S
title: Perfect Place
text:
The Hotel is located in the heart of the Quartier Latin , just around the corner from Notre Dame .
It is easy to reach by Train and Metro , lots of Restaurants around and many historical spots 
Just great for a Paris visit 
The employees are always friendly and helpful
For me it is the perfect place to stay in Paris

author: Lucy W
title: Definitely coming back!
text: Great boutique hotel! Small, but functional. Friendly front desk staff, prime location, good wifi. Breakfast was light, but decent. Great price, lots to do in the area.

author: Mia Q
title: Convenient and suitable.
text: Great location. For the price of the rooms I think it would have to be renovated compared to other establishments in the same category.

author: Mia D
title: Small room in a beautiful area
text: The hotel is beautifully situated in a charming part of Paris. The service is very friendly and excellent. The room was clean but far too small. The temperature control wasn't great. We stayed at the back of the hotel, where you couldn't hear the street, though you could hear the electrical appliances there. The breakfast was reasonable. I missed the fresh baguette. I find it relatively expensive, but you're mainly paying for the city center. Overall, it's a reasonable hotel for a short stay.

author: Brooke D
title: Small hotel to recommend near Notre Dame de Paris
text:
Very nice hotel near Place Saint Michel and Notre Dame
The neighborhood is very lively and pleasant, it is very well connected by public transport.The staff is kind and attentive to each guest.
Everything is very clean 
Breakfast is very hearty.

author: Oliver G
title: Perfect.
text: We stayed in the second floor, okay a little noise, but nothing dangerous, really slept well. All the staff were wonderful! Very clean and nice. Their coffee was amazing, at least for my Finnish taste buds:)  We did not meet a single "snotty" Frenchman, everyone was genuinely nice and helpful! THANK YOU, PARIS! Miss you! Lady C

author: Ella A
title: Great location for this nice hotel
text:
Nice hotel with very friendly staff. Spacious bedroom. Great location to walk everywhere or take the train or metro.
Restaurants galore to choose from, we especially loved the Symposium directly across the street and Au Bon Couscous.

author: Abigail R
title: Good place  at Paris!
text: Excellent location! The hotel staff (restaurant, reception) are very helpful and care about the well-being of their guests!

author: Manon L
title: Perfect location for most of the sights.
text: A very simple and neat hotel. Clean and neat. The location is almost perfect with short distance to Notre Dame, all communication and it is fine to walk to several sights. Lots of cafes and dining in the area. Endel noise from the street at night because people have to have fun on the go.

author: Michael F
title: Hotel full of charm but in an extremely noisy area
text: We were very well received and it is extremely appreciative , as they had reserved the only room at the back for us for more calm , but the huge ventilation of the restaurant right next to the window discouraged us to take it! We went to the 6th floor but as we sleep with the windows ajar it is extremely noisy until late at night because surrounded by clubs and restaurants! In short, it’s Paris! If you go to bed at 3 am this is a hotel for you!!! 😂

author: Grace D
title: Great location, great value in the heart of the Latin Quarter
text: Friendly, comfortable and brilliantly located, there is much to recommend Hotel du Mont Blanc. It is literally 2 minutes walk from the miraculously restored Notre Dame, there’s a metro just around the corner and as many nearby bars and restaurants you could wish for. Don’t expect big-hotel luxury - our room was smallish but perfectly adequate and quiet, an the beds were very comfortable. Location and value are the big plus points for this nice little hotel. I can thoroughly recommend it.

author: Sydney C
title: Bad!
text:
I had an unforgettable WORST experience while traveling to Paris from February 8–11.

Firstly, the photos do not accurately represent the actual rooms, which was highly disappointing. My room was extremely small and felt more like a bathroom with a bed in it. When I asked the reception why my room did not match the photos, the response was simply, “Because you have a single room,” which was unhelpful and unsatisfactory.

Secondly, the bed linens were of poor quality, the pillows were uncomfortable, and the blanket was provided without a cover.

Thirdly, the noise levels were unacceptable—you can hear everything, including your neighbors, the elevator, and even water running continuously in the bathroom.

Fourthly, the ventilation was poor, and cigarette smoke from neighboring rooms easily seeped in. Unfortunately, I had the worst experience, as my neighbors were smoking early in the morning (7–9 AM).

Fifthly, the reception staff repeatedly asked me which room I was staying in, which came across as unprofessional and intrusive.

Lastly, the price does not reflect the quality of the stay. Given these issues, I strongly do not recommend this hotel.

author: Charlotte F
title: Central and condor
text: Hotel located in the Latin Quarter behind Notre Dame, convenient as a potion because in a moment you are on the metro to CdG and walk from here you reach anything you want to see them in Paris, for lovers of long walks, otherwise there are buses or metro vicinsiism.

author: Andrea S
title: Expect to wait... and wait... and wait...
text: Probably the worst pub I've been to in London. The bar staff haven't a clue, especially the Polish guy. The staff are apparently told to prioritise "hotel" guests, so he ignored all the people waiting at the bar to slowly and methodically sign in 3 separate groups while we waited, without explanation. He was like a robot on snail mode. With around 30 angry and confused people waiting, with more joining, we could see it would take ages to get served so we left. Another great pub ruined because the owner has his priorities wrong.

author: Molly D
title: A good budget hotel that's actively being worked on and improved
text:
The hotel was fine and absolutely what I would expect for what we paid. There's no "reception", you go into the pub and talk to a member of staff at the bar. We waited about 5 minutes as there was only one member of staff on but that wasn't too much of a problem. 

The room was up two flights of stairs and there didn't appear to be a lift. The ground floor was also actively being worked on by builders so I'm not sure whether this is planned for the future. 

The room itself was a good size for what we needed and the bed was comfortable. There was a small fridge and some unopened bottles of milk to go with the small boxes of cereal they provided. There was a window in the ceiling which could be opened and closed. There didn't seem to be a heating system or an AC system in the room but they did supply a fan.

The ensuite bathroom had a good shower. There was a window in the ceiling which didn't have curtains or a blind to cover It and so it did get incredibly hot in there. 

Towels were provided and these were changed to clean ones whilst we were out. They also restocked the cereal.

The location was pretty quiet - we didn't really hear anything even with the window open. Lots of small corner shops nearby to grab food/drink if needed. The Seven Sisters tube station was a 5-10 minute walk away.

Parking was directly in front of the pub/hotel but there weren't many spaces. We had no problem leaving the car there whilst we stayed.

Check out was very easy as all we had to do was drop the keys in a box as we left.

It's clear that they're actively working to improve the hotel. If you're looking for a budget hotel and aren't planning on spending hours of your day in the room, it's a good choice.

author: Tyler C
title: Highs and lows
text: So it is totally depending on what your looking for , the plus points , the price and location to Seven Sisters tube station were very good , inside the pub which is attached to the hotel was fine , large screen sports , reasonably priced drinks , clean and today , outside seating at rear , the bed was comfy , the bathroom fine , kettle and a fridge in room , now the negatives , scruffy and untidy at front of hotel , the rooms are a work in progress and you walk through a building site , rooms very basic , some may find the area a little not what they are used to but we had no issues at all , so if your looking for somewhere to get your head down cheaply in an accessible area to football grounds and concerts and a beer before or after it works , the staff were nice too … but if you want more than the basics probably not for you

author: Ana H
title: Rubbish
text:
Had a room booked for tomorrow, had a email at 7pm to say it was cancelled. Called 3 times, no answer, finally got through to be told to call in the morning as no one available.
When I explained I couldn’t call in the morning as we need to know if this was a mistake or the room had been cancelled, he said il call the manager- phone me back in 3 minutes….
Well that was 1/2 hour ago and they are just not picking up the phone now.
Brilliant customer service……not!!!

author: Gavin D
title: Book if you want a very warm room
text:
Wouldn't stay here again 
The room felt like a sauna 
Only very small window in bathroom 
Team unfortunately didn't understand myself very well.

author: Sydney A
title: They won't ever get back my money
text:
We booked this hotel for a family stay in December 2025, but the room we were given was completely unacceptable and nothing like what was advertised on Booking.com.
The room was dirty, damp, mouldy, smelled strongly of smoke, and appeared to be a former smoking room. The walls and carpet were affected by moisture and mould, there was constant engine noise outside, the room was extremely small and dark, and it faced a ground-floor side yard. The window could barely be opened.
Because of the conditions, we could not stay there with our family and left immediately.
At reception, the staff acknowledged the issue and promised us a refund because the hotel could not provide a suitable alternative room. We were told the manager only needed to send a short written confirmation to Booking.com.
That was more than six months ago.

Since then, I have sent over 90 (!) emails, called the hotel around 20 times, and even Booking.com has tried repeatedly to contact them (around 30 times) without success. The manager has remained unreachable and the refund of around £300 has still not been processed.

The most disappointing part is not only the condition of the room, but the complete lack of communication and accountability afterwards.
It is sad to see that there are still places where a hotel can be operated in such an uncivilized and unprofessional way.

I would strongly advise future guests to think carefully before booking here!
