author: Nathan C
title: First bad review I have ever placed in trip advisor.
text: Room was dirty. Damp in room and wall paper hanging off walls. Bare wires showing. Bathroom mouldy.  No fire signage.  Definitely unsafe property

author: William J
title: Would use again
text: Clean, comfortable good value. Diverse area plenty of cafes and restaurants. Fridge and light breakfast in room.

author: Ruby F
title: Amazing hotel for the  price
text: Great area, yeah it has its faults like not looking perfect, or not getting cleaned every single day. But the rooms are nice, its close to local stores and the underground station, it has a nice bar. It gives you a fridge, some cereal and a tv, most areas this cheap wouldnt have done that. They were firendly and offerd help when we needed it, so overall wonderfull experience

author: Andrea N
title: Worst hotel in London?
text:
Absolutely awful place. Dingy pub but v new modern rooms. BUT- One if our party had a room with no windows at all, another room the door to the cupboard bathroom was only held on by one hinge so swung dangerously and would not shut
‘ a choice if breakfast items’ was boxes of cornflakes serviced with milk from an old noisy fridge in the room. The Velux window was covered in paper ( no blind). But the worst thing.. a night club operating v v loud music until 2am right next to tbe rooms. With noisy customers hanging about until 3am.
Complaints to the owners have bern ignored

author: Paolo E
title: Nothing bad to say. Great value and location
text:
No complaints at all. 
Clean modern hallways 
Clean modern room
Good amenities including free cereal and milk for breakfast 
Coffee and tea making faculties 
Fridge. 
Two bath towels and shower gel supplied 
Nice comfy bed and pillows 
Nice supermarket across the road if there’s things you need

author: Oscar X
title: Bad!
text:
The pictures online didn’t match the room.
The room was small and no service was included not even the smallest one like shampoos…
The wardrobe wasn’t comfortable so we kept our clothes in the suitcase… the bathroom was one of the most uncomfortable things we have ever experienced!
Nothing didn’t match the pictures we saw the day we booked this place.
Poor reception… everything poor like the place where it’s located.

Sorry for that but it was necessary, people should know what services will be provided to them… so none… do not expect nothing. 

We were fooled!

author: George I
title: Very poor communication and service
text: Beware! They do not indicate that their reception closes at 11pm on booking sites, so they WILL leave you stranded and then refuse to refund you! This happened to me after booking this hotel through a booking site that they had set up. They called me 20 minutes before reception closed and then made no effort to call me back and refused any refund when I got in touch about this.

author: Diego E
title: Basic and convenient location but a very poor standard
text:
Stayed at the Fountain for three nights. Due to home football match, accommodation was scare in the Tottenham area. This location was suitable for our needs. 
However, there is very little positive I could say for the property. It’s not a hotel as such; bedrooms attached to a large pub. No reception and no point of contact other than the bartender. Room on the first floor was small and cramped. Bed was very close to the ground and a small double at that. Bathroom had poor shower head, leaking/dripping tap and a blocked sink plug! On one morning there was no hot (or even warm) water. The cold shower definitely wakes one up!!
On the second day the room was not made up and no fresh towels supplied. 
Stairways was steep with high risers on the steps. Corridors were very narrow; how this place gets a fire license from the local authority is baffling. 
Not recommended only as an absolute last resort.

author: Nathan I
title: Good hotel
text: We stayed whilst visiting Drumsheds. The pub downstairs was really nice and the drinks prices were reasonable. The staff were nice and friendly and the room was good. Cereal and milk provided for breakfast and plenty of towels etc. There was even a small kitchen to heat food up. Plenty of shops and takeaways close too. Would definitely stay here again.

author: Megan Z
title: Cheap Stay in London
text: We had a cheap stay in London. The hotel was oK. The rooms were a bit small, but clean and comfortable and we had a good sleep. It was cleaned every day. Although there was a pub in the house, our room was very  quiet and there were no noises. The front desk was inside the pub we didn't go. The surrounding was a bit dirty, but it was only 10 minutes walk to the next underground station and then the trip to the city center was quick. It was good, that there were cheap places to eat nearby and a supermarket nearby.

author: Daniel E
title: dirty and unsafe
text:
Location: dirty and extremely unsafe. This place doesn't deserve to be called a hotel. Avoid it at all costs!

I booked this hotel for three nights. The neighborhood is horrible, and the room and bathroom were filthy. There were yellow stains on the shower floor, and the bed sheets and towels looked very old. Fortunately, I brought my own bed sheets and towels.
But that’s not all. Around 2 AM, I was jolted awake by the sound of someone throwing stones at my window and shouting, ‘Open the door! I brought you cake.' I was just shocked. Then, they broke in by smashing the glass on the front door, yelling in the corridor where my room was located right behind my door. I was utterly terrified and stayed behind my door and trying not to make any noise, waiting for the intruder to leave.
The place itself is far from ideal, but I hadn’t planned to complain until this horrifying incident occurred. This is the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had. I was unsure if the person would return, which added to my distress.
I have attached photos of the broken door taken the morning after the incident. It's unbelievable that the property management did not react until two days later with a short message saying "sorry about the inconvenience," as if such a life-threatening issue hadn't happened at all!
This place doesn't deserve to be called a hotel! 
It is unbelievable that neither the hotel and nor the famous platform through which I booked are  helping with my request for refund! After multiple calls and messages, still no refund whatsoever!

author: Luca O
title: Good location but lack of hygiene
text:
😊
- welcoming staff
- hotel quite well located in relation to central London and Stansted airport
- Metro approximately 5 minutes from the hotel
- supermarket right in front of the hotel open from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m.
- room equipped with quite a few sockets including USB sockets so no need for a UK socket adapter
- common kitchen area at the hotel
- cheap hotel for London
☹️
- very small room (not a problem in our case since we are really only there to sleep)
- very small bathroom, it's hard to dry yourself when you get out of the shower!
- the cleanliness of the hotel needs to be reviewed, we have the impression that it sticks to the tables...there is a pub just below which is not very clean either!)
- condition of the shower (aging and water adjustment is impossible)
- the kettle is unusable because there is too much limescale and as if it was burnt at the bottom)
- small fridge in the room, practical but super frosty...and it makes quite a bit of noise for its size!
- the room overlooks a busy street and no double glazing (dirty window frames)
- radiator running and impossible to adjust so it's too hot in the room!
- bathroom linen is provided but for 2 people just 2 towels...it's a bit tight, 2 towels each would have been necessary!
- breakfast = small packet of cereals + milk)
- wifi access is not reliable

author: Ian I
title: Great Little Stay
text:
We stayed here for one night as we were going to a party nearby.

I thought this little hotel was great.
Check in is done at the bar in the pub, the gentleman was very friendly and walked us up to our room 

Room was great.
Very clean, basic but had great temperature control, TV, bathroom was nice and clean with an actual large bottle of nice shower gel provided 

The breakfast/tea and coffee facilities are really good 
The provide a large amount, rather than just a stingy little serving 
Just a nice little touch 

The room was safe, secure and quiet 
Granted we didn't get back till 2am
But then slept like a log.

They give you outside and inside key 
So after hours access was a piece of cake 
And they do a key drop box if you have to leave in a hurry 

I mean I genuinely can't really find any real fault 
No bedside tables, but I used a shoebox from a pair of shoes I had bought!

But that's really just a minor thing and didn't really make a big difference

Overall I'd definitely recommend

author: Alice D
title: Very pleasantly surprised
text:
When we checked in was really surprised at how nice the hotel was, was bit bright and airy 

Checked into the room and it’s fantastic really - must be one of the newer ones as bathroom was great, room small but looked new inside. 

Bed comfy, about a ten minute walk from Seven Sisters underground
There was milk, tea coffee, cereal, a fridge, big tv, walk in shower, LeD mirror etc

I actually really enjoyed this room

The Mexican restaurant in the hotel downstairs was great also. Food tasty and cheap for London

author: Pierre K
title: Good price central London
text: Clean and comfortable good location

author: Gavin T
title: Aconchego in London
text: The lack of a small fridge/fridge bar was felt. Small and simple, but cosy room. Wonderful staff, very polite, friendly and inquisitive.

author: Michael D
title: Don't eat the breakfast
text: I had no complaints regarding the check in service nor the room. However, I was mortified that the breakfast items were covered in fruit flies. The first member of staff i approached spoke no English and passed me on to someone else. When she checked she said it may because people left uncovered. However the plate had no cover. While I was there they did not remove and bin the food. I spoke to front desk and all they done was apologised. I'm seriously concerned about their FSMS.

author: Daniel F
title: No issues at all
text:
Absolutely fantastic, great location , rooms clean and comfortable, buffet breakfast basic but good.
Rooms clean and staff helpful, would stay again xx

author: Diego V
title: Great stay great air conditioning!
text: Lovely hotel. Great AirCon! Stayed for one night and really liked it. Room 206. Front desk welcome was lovely, continental breakfast was basic but perfect. Very convenient to Paddington. Shower was great. Would def stay again!

author: Sean H
title: Picturesque hotel
text: Excellent 👌 hotel, the rooms are super spacious. Linens and beds of very good quality. The people at the front desk are super friendly and attentive! Very good location, although in London distances are long.

author: Elena R
title: Don’t recommend the Days Inn Hyde Park
text: I would agree with the comments made by others for this hotel on the poor standard of guest services. I had made an advance booking with special requests six weeks in advance and was checked in by Komnious at Reception. Komnious was extremely rude to me from the outset and profusely lied to me on the availability of double rooms at the hotel. I paid for a double room and he wanted to check me in into a single room on the fourth floor. After I pointed out the availability of rooms on the hotel’s own website and elsewhere, the duty manager seemed to assist by checking me into a family room. However, trying to get late check-out from the hotel was chaotic and I kept on getting calls from Reception asking me when I would check-out of the room. There was no hot water in the shower and the most shocking experience of all was when the cleaner walked into my room while I was sleeping having ignored the “do not disturb” sign affixed outside my door. This was a blatant breach of my privacy and it is clear to me that the unprofessional staff at Reception were fully responsible for the cleaner walking into my room amounting to deliberate harassment of the guest. I am absolutely appalled by my guest experiences at this hotel and I believe I was targeted as I was a single female guest. The single rooms I had seen were shabby and outdated and it is clear the hotel has a problem with the supply of hot water in some rooms. And when you call Reception to ask for something they will pretend they cannot hear you. This was a really grim guest experience from a hotel of horrors. Don’t waste your money booking this hotel as noted by others who have left reviews on here and have had similar experiences to my own. The general manager also lacked integrity when investigating my complaint. A complete disgrace.

author: Manon M
title: Great Place to Stay
text: Very clean, conveniently located and staff are all very nice and helpful. There’s a lot of restaurants, other food outlets and convenience stores plus just very close to Paddington Station which allows for easy access to tourist destinations.👍

author: Molly J
title: Poor
text:
The location was in an average part of London, not the best.
The atmosphere was pretty quiet and dull. Not much to do.
The rooms where small with not much space to get to the bath room
The value is not great and very expensive for not much.
The cleanliness was alright and pretty dated.
The service was great and they helped us.

author: Sydney K
title: Value hotel 2 blocks from Paddington Station
text: Location is great and room is a decent size.  AC works well too which is a plus in the summer.  Furnishings are a bit tired - could def use an update - but proximity to Paddington station and Hyde Park was great.

author: Sara D
title: Excellent hotel for the price range.
text: Excellent hotel for this price range. Rooms look well kept and were very clean. Air conditioning was a great bonus during this hot weather as were the two beds provided instead of the double we had originally booked for. Staff on the reception desk were very friendly and accommodating.  The location is ideal for anything around the Paddington/ Hyde park area with plenty of bars and restaurants nearby. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Poppy J
title: Very helpful staff!
text: Hi, I would like to say some words about the staff. I travel a lot, but I must say that such open, gentle and helpful guys like Rasan and especially Komninos you can meet really rarely. They found for us enough time and helped effectively with our problem. I can recommend them to everybody!

author: Daniel B
title: A bit of a strange one!
text: Booked online a week prior, found on booking.com but booked direct for a 10% discount, at £158 for a Saturday night in London. I put my card details in when booking, as the rate was non refundable. Then the day before arrival I had a WhatsApp message and email asking me to check in, and asked for my card details again. We arrived at the hotel around 6.30pm, it was easy to find and very close to Paddington station. Upon arrival I was asked for ID (driving licence or passport) which I have never been asked for at a hotel in the UK, including London. Luckily I had my driving licence on me, but don't always. They took a photocopy of this. Then I was asked to pay, so I had to input my card for the third time. The guy on reception said 'oh when I go on holiday, I am expected to pay for the room' which I thought was strange, as I had put my card details in twice already I thought they would take it automatically! Anyway, bit of a strange check in but there we go. We were given the keys to room 112 which I assumed would be 1st floor, but no, we were sent out of a back door into a little outdoor area which had a window in the floor overlooking the dining room, then our room was straight ahead. We stepped straight in, it was very dark and I thought it didn't have a window, it did but it just overlooked the little outdoor area but no natural light, it felt like we were in a motel rather than a hotel. The room was very small but functional, a double bed and a single. Very dated with old pine furniture. There were little spotlights above the bed which acted as a bedside lamp and when we switched those on, the amount of dust flying about was bad! The top of the cupboard under the TV was also thick with dust. The tea/coffee tray was very basic, no decaf available (I did ask at reception) and no sweeteners. As we were only there to sleep, we just got on with it. The beds were comfy (although the single was fraying around the base and this was trailing along the floor) and we slept well. Around 6.30am I had another WhatsApp message and email asking what time I was checking out! We left at 9am. All in all, a bit of a weird stay. Good location but probably could have found something a bit better for the price.

author: Megan L
title: London 2026
text:
Very good hotel and very good vacation.
Staff attentive and present when we need help.
Very good week!

author: Camille V
title: London get away
text: Easy checkin and area has many restaurants. Underground is very close

author: Leo A
title: Very pleasant
text: This was my 1st time at this hotel and I was delighted with all aspects of my 3 night stay.  Within a 3 minute walk of Paddington station, it's exceptionally handy for rail/bus/tube connections.  Located in  a traditional London style white terrace of other small hotels, it's a bit of a tardis behind the main entrance door. My 1st floor single room was plainly but smartly presented with evidence the friendly housekeeping staff are on top of their game.  My bed was actually a wide single, so no falling out when turning over!  The bathroom was surprisingly big and the shower very easy to operate.  The air con worked very quietly and quickly heated up the room when required.  There were always staff on the reception desk every time I passed.  I found the area safe and pleasant to be around.  Traffic noise, mainly motorbikes, is noticeable at times, but not overnight.  Compared to what Travelodge and Premier Inn were charging midweek, I considered I got very good value for money.  I would certainly consider staying here again.

author: Nora N
title: Won’t be coming back
text:
Very outdated, tired rooms and common areas. 
Poor breakfast options - very basic with cheap brands and not a lot of choice for gluten free requirements. 
Bed very small “double” ( plus a single) not suitable for two older adults but quite comfortable.
Very convenient location for Paddington station.

author: Joseph N
title: Excellent value for the money - and quiet
text: I spent two separate stays here over the same weekend  - one night and then a gap and then two nights - and can throughly recommend this hotel. First off, if you ask for a quiet room they give you one. And they are quiet. The rooms are small but clean and there’s plenty of hot water. And finally, as others have noted, the service is super friendly. All in all, a great bargain for £127 a night. I will be definitely be back.

author: Lucy Z
title: This hotel is great, the warm experienced staff makes the difference.
text: While my wife and children have stayed there often. My first visit with them. The experience was wonderful. Warm experienced staff makes the greatest of difference. Quick room cleaning and professional but friendly approach. And, on enquiring, they told me management was nice to them, so they are happy too. Highly recommend. S Basu.

author: Chloe E
title: Acceptable accommodation for a few days stay.
text:
I'll start with the goods points. The hotel is clean and tidy. The room we stayed in is on the small size for twin beds but since we were out and about during the day, it's not so important.  Clothes cupboard is compact and cramped. Can't hang many clothes.  The breakfast, being on the lower ground floor,  is very basic. No cooked breakfast not even a croissant.  
On our arrival at the hotel on 9th November we were greeted by friendly & helpful staff at the front desk. The cleaning ladies or girls I should say were positively sour. They won't acknowledge your presence or bid good morning in the lift. Thumbs down to them. They always looked unhappy & unfriendly.  Other staff members =  were polite.
The only good point is that the hotel is central, near Paddington Station and close to shops and supermarkets. That's all. Not really worth 3 stars.

author: Mason V
title: Excellent hotel
text: Excellent location, everything can be reached on foot and close to boarding points for everything, including the airport, friendly and helpful staff, both at the reception and in the breakfast room, clean rooms, soundproof window, no noise could be heard even though the street is always crowded, the breakfast room perhaps a little small to accommodate everyone, it may happen that you have to wait for a table but the very fast staff does everything to reduce waiting times, three ladies truly impeccable and very nice, everything perfect and I would return without thinking about it, much better than many 4-star hotels, I would only suggest maybe putting something in the shower because the marble on the floor with soap tends to make you slip and be dangerous

author: Mia O
title: Exceeded our expectations and more
text:
Absolutely superb location 
Wonderful room and fabulous warm and friendly staff

author: Sofia S
title: Nice hotel convenient to the sights and water bus.
text: This is a nice hotel very centrally located in Venice with great access to San Marco Square and the water bus. The hotel staff were very friendly and helpful. Bed was comfortable and the water pressure was great - good supply of hot water. Despite being on a major walking area, the room was quiet. air conditioning worked very well which was essential in July. Breakfast was fine but I will say that you really don't need to pay the price for the breakfast - there are plenty of restaurants or bakeries around where you can eat for less money. The only drawback was that the room was quite small - no room to really put the suitcases other than on the floor and no desk. Although the hotel is on a canal you really can't see it from your room.

author: Luke P
title: Great
text: Room was nice, good Air conditioning, staff great. No Netflix in Italy except Rome

author: Laura P
title: Experience of Rome.
text:
The hotel was in a great location, close to the main Termini Train Station and in walking distance.

The room was cleaned every day and was comfortable. The downside was all the TV channels were in Italion, but that is part of the experience. The lift was abit clostrophobic, mamimum of 2 people with cases were allowed in it.

The breakfast menu gave you a cooked menu, cold meat and cheese section and a variety of cereals to choose from. Nearby street cafes provided evening meals and drinks.

The Termini train station has a good selection of restaurants to choose from.

I would recommend the San Marco hotel. Staff were helpful and spoke good english.

Rome has a lot to offer. Do your home work, find out where you want to see and what tours you wish to participate in and hopefully you will have as good a time as I did.

Enjoy a great city.

author: Noah R
title: Comfortable Stay with Great Service at Hotel San Marco Rome
text:
We had a very pleasant stay at Hotel San Marco in Rome. The location was convenient for exploring the city, with easy access to transportation and nearby attractions.
The staff was friendly, professional, and always willing to help, which made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, providing everything we needed for a relaxing stay after long days of sightseeing.
The breakfast was also very good, with a nice selection to start the day before heading out to explore the city.
We especially appreciated the smooth and organized experience throughout our visit—it made our trip to Rome even more enjoyable.
Overall, Hotel San Marco is a great choice for travelers looking for a comfortable and well-located place to stay in Rome. We would definitely recommend it!

author: Harper S
title: Great stay that didn’t dissapoint
text: Excellent hotel. Location, cleanliness, interior - all exceeded expectations

author: Katie F
title: You could be moved! its not a good hotel!
text: Stayed here for 4 nights, or we were supposed to!!!  They moved us like many other people to a 2 star hotel who had very rude staff and an awful room covered in mould.  When asking for compensation we were brushed off. When asking for compensation from TUI who we had booked with we were told to contact the hotel who we did not get answers from. This hotel made our trip a nightmare. AVOID!!!

author: Henry X
title: I do not recommend
text:
If you book there you are not sure you will stay there in full. We had booked for 4 nights and arrived at the reception we are told an overbooking problem for the 1st night. And that we will be relocated to the Piemonte Hotel 1 block away.... this is unacceptable we had booked months in advance.
The next day we had our room, the bed was very uncomfortable, we felt the springs...
Breakfast from 7am to 10am is very plentiful, however if you go down at 8am there will be practically nothing, or even dishes... 
Moreover the rooms are very poorly soundproofed, our neighbor made phone calls until 10pm and we heard all his conversations.

author: Gavin V
title: AVOID this hotel - they do not honour your booking
text:
We booked this hotel for 6 of us about 10 months ago as a package with Easyjet holidays.  When we turned up at the hotel we were told that they were overbooked and therefore we could not stop there. We were escorted to another hotel (Archimedes) about 2 blocks away - which was awful.
It appears that the Hotel San Marco has quite a reputation of doing this to its guests who think that they have a room with them judging by other reviews.
Save yourself the stress and unpleasantness and avoid booking this hotel.

author: Harper P
title: Great Location Hotel
text:
We arrived at 11am on our first day ever in Rome and immediately went to this hotel unfortunately they told us they were over booked and we had to go to another hotel and we could walk three blocks or they’ll get us a taxi since we had luggage we got a taxi the hotel we stayed in  for the one night was hotel Milani and it was lovely beds were comfortable and the room was huge as the staff member upgraded us to a superior Room. Next morning staff from hotel San Marco arrived and took our luggage back to our original hotel and we are here for 6 more nights Room is fine staff are lovely, but there is no facilities in room no tea or coffee no cups are allowed in rooms or any glasses either must be a safety issue or to keep rooms clean breakfast is really good and loads to choose from.
I find the mattress very uncomfortable my back is sore when I wake but that’s fine 
Overall this hotel is clean and great value for money and it’s beside termini train station so great location 
I might book hotel milani next time I’m here just for the comfort and the gorgeous smell in the hotel

author: Noah L
title: Awful.....do not book!
text:
Dire experience!

Pros:
the location as it is very close to the main train station station.
My husband said the breakfast was good.
The water pressure for the shower was good.

Cons:
The reception staff are beyond unhelpful! We were 3 couples all booked in.....1 couple went to there room to find someone else in it....took a while to get sorted. 1 couple were told there was no space as they had overbooked so they would have to go to another hotel......the other hotel was disgusting.....dirty room, dirty unchanged sheets.....they asked for another room but were told no! They were forced to book somewhere else and the san marco staff don't seem to be able to apologies or issue a refund. Apparently over booking is a common occurrence!
Our room was OK but needed some serious modifications such as: removal of mouldy grout, cleaning of black mould around the window, working air conditioning, towel storage to not be under the sink where it is mouldy and damp, new mattresses with protectors.....ours were both very old, horribly stained with deep depressions in them. My husbands was changed for one that was too small for the bed!
The bar served warm wine
The large amount of student groups who were noisy and made if feel like a hostel
The saftey and tv lights in the main bedroom were always on making it difficult to sleep.

We travel to rome frequently and this was awful.....do not recommend.

author: Thomas F
title: Good.
text: We had a wonderful holiday in this beautiful city and chose this hotel for its ideal central location. The room was nice and the breakfast excellent.

author: Hannah Q
title: The bad service
text: The hotel is not bad, actually, but the service is bad!!! I've been to many hotels before, and everyone happily gave the fork and knife if I needed it. They tell me they don't give anything here, despite having a breakfast room and a bar. I'm really shocked and angry about this shoot. One thing that made me even angrier was having to pay 200 euros to get the kettle, which they will then return to you. Pay for the kettle? This is nonsense!

author: Hannah V
title: Hotel very good
text: The hotel surprised us for very well.  Clean and spacious rooms.Very complete toilet with change of towels used every day. Wonderful breakfast buffet. The only hit is the small, slow elevator. But in our case being on the second floor we were not affected.  Great area, quiet and close to the bus and metro station

author: Marta G
title: Simple but with everything you need to travel: friendly, good breakfast, cleanliness, WIFI and good location
text: We have been on a study tour and would like to point out that the care received has been good. It has a very complete breakfast service, the daily cleaning is adequate and the rooms are modest but have flat TV, WIFI, air conditioning and heat pump. It is also very well located (a few minutes walk from Castro Pretorio metro stop).

author: Henry E
title: Do NOT Recommend
text:
Do NOT stay here - you can do better for the price elsewhere!
I stayed at the place in late September - early October. I had a single room that was about the size of a small college or university dormitory. I had to step over my luggage to get to and from the bed. The bed itself had a very think mattress and the sub layer felt like a sheet of warped plywood. My back was sore every morning and it took time and Advil to somewhat remedy it.
I was on the 6th floor and although they did have an elevator, beware that it is very slow (long wait times) and can only hold maybe one person with their luggage.
The hall on my floor had motion activated ceiling lights. They delayed to the extent that they would not go on until I was part of the way down a very dark hall.
The hotel itself could use a little facelift, especially in the hallways as it is dated. The are it is located is showing signs of aging and I would not feel comfortable being out alone the area at night.
One morning I waited in line to get an answer to a typical 'tourist' type question. The person at the desk was nothing less than surly as if she didn't like her job (no greeting, no smile, a very terse answer). I noticed this as she answered my question and the person in front of me. This is the hospitality industry, right?
I had cause to do a follow up on an issue after I had left. I sent three emails to the Manager over 10 days and received NO response, not even an acknowledgement of receipt. UNBELIEVABLE!
I paid 190 Euro for that tiny room. VERY overpriced.
I do NOT recommend this hotel and believe you can find better in that district or elsewhere.

author: Lucy E
title: Renovation recommended
text: From Price quality ratio just fine. The hotel has obviously not been renovated for several decades. The bathroom stinks massively, presumably due to the outdated piping. Unfortunately, we also had a room directly opposite the elevator, so every stop of the cabin was acknowledged with a loud "ding-dong", day and night. The Noise level to the road was not as bad as feared. The breakfast is not the standard of a mid-range hotel (supposedly 3 stars !!) There are no fresh bread rolls as you know them from other buffets. The cappuccino from the vending machine was at most lukewarm, if not cold. No Italian salami in Rome! The only two positive aspects were the central location (3 minutes walk to metro) and the cleanliness. The cleaning staff was really hardworking and did their best. The reception staff seemed annoyed, possibly due to the late season. All in all not really recommended.

author: Lucy L
title: Breakfast was so good we were getting fat
text: Very friendly people with check in. Elevator was very small and we waited as long as 30 minutes sometimes (4 nights). TV had so many channels,  including FNN, CNN, Bloomberg. Bed was soft and we loved it. Bathroom had a shower step into bathtub. Liquid soap on wall and hair dryer included. Breakfast was very good. Coffee, latte, chocolate, juice. Breads, fruits, large sweets section, Scrambled eggs, bacon, ham, sausage and much more. Cereals and dried fruits with sweet sauce.

author: Abigail E
title: Wonderful time! Loved Hotel Royal San Marco. Staff is the best. Gave us directions and were very helpful
text: Hotel was wonderful! It is in the perfect location Right next to the Collisseum and Roman Forum and short walk to the Trevie Fountain . The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Room are clean and quiet. Many restaurants right outside the door! Perfect place to stay in the hear of room!

author: Erin P
title: DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL
text:
Do not book this hotel.  I booked through Booking.com and the full amount has been taken from my credit card and my booking confirmed with a receipt received.

I received this message from them and confirmation that they have cancelled my booking:
Our account has been compromised as a result of a cyberattack. Your reservation will therefore be cancelled, as it was made using a rate that was not authorized by our property and was generated following fraudulent access to our account.
Please do not click on any links you may receive.
We apologize for the inconvenience.
Kind regards.
Hotel Milton Roma

I am now left in a situation with flights paid for and no accommodation.  Terrible customer service and makes me wonder if they have had more demand and decided to put the room rates up.

author: Charlie Q
title: SCAM
text:
I was notified that the cancellation was due to an alleged cyberattack and the generation of an 'unauthorized rate due to fraudulent access'. As a consumer, I am completely unrelated to any security breaches, IT problems, or operational vulnerabilities in your system.
Under European consumer law, a confirmed booking constitutes a binding contract, and economic activity risks must be assumed by the provider, never by the customer.

With less than a month to go before the trip, in the peak of high season, the cancellation of this booking leaves me in an extremely vulnerable situation, without accommodation in an overcrowded city and with almost no viable options on the market for the price originally contracted.

The property has rooms available, so the refusal to honor the contract constitutes a clear breach of consumer rights. 

Furthermore, I would like to inform you that I have previously attempted to contact you via message, but have received no response to date.

author: William P
title: Excellent hotel to know Rome!
text: Hotel with an excellent location, almost in the centre of Rome, with a metro exit to the door as well as bus and tram stops. A 15-minute walk from the Coliseum! Very varied breakfast and friendly employees. There is a bar on a very nice small terrace. Very spacious room.

author: Samuel L
title: Included breakfast was quite good!
text: I stayed with my family at this hotel in two rooms because there were five of us; the hotel is quite central and very conveniently located near the subway station, the rooms were clean and the other areas as well. The included breakfast was the best and quite varied; the aspect they should improve is the quality of the shampoo and adding hair conditioner.

author: Benjamin A
title: Would definitely come back!
text: Great location. Great service in the hotel restaurant from Ehsan!

author: Maria H
title: Can’t fault, location/cleanliness/service ✅✅✅
text: Great location, Metro right outside front door and some tasty non touristy food options available near by. Very good breakfast with lots of hot and cold options and a very friendly barman in the evenings. Room was clean but small but only used it to sleep.

author: Thomas U
text: Responsive and very noisy, when the neighbor showers it sounds like a big water leak in the room. The tram outside howls and makes the house shake from early morning. Even the AC is out of order.

author: Chloe N
title: Stay somewhere else!!
text:
Do not spoil your trip to the ancient and beautiful City of Rome by staying in this hotel! plagued by plumbing problems and a bad attitude by management  ( even though the reception staff are lovely!)
If you want a room that has hot water and where everything else works as it should in a four star hotel, choose a different one. Dysfunctional management.

author: Daisy C
text: I had the opportunity to stay with my family at the Milton Hotel until April 27th of this year. The staff are kind, helpful, and polite. However, there is a serious management problem. My wife and I went THREE DAYS without hot water! A very kind employee (who spends the entire morning alone trying to resolve everything) called a technician urgently. He said that the shower wouldn't heat up more than 42 degrees because the municipal authorities had reduced the water pressure. Of course, we were left with cold water. The next day, we complained again to another lone employee. We had an appointment and were promised it would be fixed. Cold water again! On the other hand, in two other rooms belonging to our family members, the shower worked perfectly. If the hotel had competent management, even at an elementary level, it would instruct employees to change guests' rooms immediately upon receiving a complaint of this severity. We were left with cold water. Nobody changed our room!  I do not recommend the Hotel Milton in Rome to anyone and we will never stay there again. Not even if they change the manager and hire someone with a minimum of professional competence – which the current one certainly does not possess. Aleksandar Jovanović

author: David U
title: Good location
text:
The hotel is comfortable, the staff very helpful. 
We stayed in a clean, quiet and spacious double room.
I would only recommend to equip the closet with some coat rack suitable for hanging trousers.
The common areas are pleasant.
The breakfast room is well organized and offers a nice variety that can satisfy even the tastes of international customers.
In addition to the on-site restaurant, many bars can be found nearby.
The hotel is a short walk from the metro and many other bus and tram lines.

author: Hugo E
title: Very nice location, nice potential but not up to a 4*!
text:
Ideal central location, good bedding, good breakfast, very nice common areas (hall, corridor, bar). 
Communication with the hotel before very difficult stay (time of several days to have a response). 
We had to change rooms because it was impossible to sleep because of the noise from outside in the rooms facing the street (windows closed): no sound insulation, I felt like I was on the boulevard! No insulation between rooms either. 
Small details that "disturb" when you choose a 4*: empty shower gel bottle (and not possible to fill it after 6pm because more staff able to do it ...), foul smell of sewer, forget towel, ... 
A breakfast room in which we are more than fifty one morning from Marathon to 7am: one coffee machine for all! 
But the worst is the room “manager” at breakfast: a very aggressive lady who yelled at us as we brought tables side by side because we were many (we had asked a waiter for permission beforehand though). His young colleague kindly came to tell him that he had given us permission. She showed her anger with violence, casting hateful glances at us, clearing our tables by slamming bowls and plates under our noses to show us her anger and her desire that we leave the room. We can understand things if they are explained politely, but the lack of courtesy of this lady is unacceptable.

author: Hannah W
title: Presence of bedbug
text:
Stayed from 8 to 12 March. We found a living bedbug in our room. Despite the physical evidence (insect caught in a glass and supporting photos), the hotel's response was unacceptable:

​Scientific denial: I was initially told that the bug came from the open window (bedbugs don't fly...) and that it was my fault. 

​Insulting charge: The manager insinuated during our exchange that we could have introduced the bug ourselves as a "strategy" to get a refund.

​Disclaimer: The hotel has admitted in writing the presence of the bug but refuses full refund, offering only one night out of four, while our entire stay was ruined by anxiety, lack of sleep and fear of contaminating our luggage.

​A 3-minute video made by the staff does not replace a health expertise. 

If you care about your hygiene and respect for the customer, go your way. Report to the health authorities in Rome (ASL Roma 1).

author: Pierre Q
title: Nice hotel with good location.
text: Nice hotel with good location. Walking distance to Colosseum and other attractions in Roma. Small but tidy room. Good breakfast, but crowded in the breakfast room during rush hour.

author: Harper P
title: Medium
text: First the positives: the hotel is very well placed, public transport metro, bus and tram are in front of the entrance. Breakfast varied, both savory and sweet. The hotel is very clean. The negative: our room on the street side (311) was very poorly soundproofed, we had the impression to sleep the window open above a busy intersection, in the noise of cars and tram that creaks all night. It is imperative to request a room on the courtyard side. The rooms deserve to be renovated, ours had a leak in the shower tray that flooded the bathroom and flushing that was dripping (plic ploc)

author: Mia G
title: To avoid!
text:
I booked two rooms and it was one of the worst decisions of my life! Upon arrival I was made a little theater for choosing a double room with my partner and, in front of others in my group and other guests, I was asked over and over again if it was a mistake and if we wanted single beds. Anyway they made us stay on the first floor, a floor under renovation as evidenced by debris, renovation carpets in the corridors and casino since the early hours of the morning. The mess also happens in the middle of the night due to continuous leakage of water from the nearby rooms (then confirmed by receptionists, it was as if someone was in the shower next to the bed), continuous flushing and moving furniture from the upstairs rooms (zero soundproofing). Dirty room, in the closet there was the garbage of previous guests that we removed next to the safe, and an old and already started toilet paper roll upstairs that I did not dare to touch, so we did not even use the closet, from the bathroom ventilation (placed above the toilet) continuous dust swabs descended. We try to put on a bad face but, after a sleepless night causes noise, in the morning I ask for help at reception. Not only did they not support me for a room change, but they did not deal with finding a solution for cleaning (which remained unchanged) and noise from the other rooms. Only after a sleepless second night and an email from Booking, they promised to move to a new room towards evening. When I return to the hotel after dinner they gave me the keys to the new room and only entering the room I discover that we moved from a double to a room with two single beds, without any request or shared information from them. 
I think this is the worst experience of my life.
Non-existent director, despite my requests for support he has not once revealed himself to apologize and find a solution.
It's shameful, a hotel that they should resize the stars they have. I feel cheated.

author: Sara S
title: ADVICE... A COURTEOUS AND FAMILIAR 4 STAR!! TOP.
text: We found this hotel by chance... and chance wanted to reward us. 360 degree availability... in everything: from breakfast to ceck-in/out!!!  Maximum availability by all the staff, both in being able to leave luggage in advance and both leave it after check out (it is never obvious as a thing). Great breakfast and great price. A special thanks to the cute girl of breakfast / bar that unfortunately we did not ask the name: helpful, nice, sunny and professional at the same time! He cheered us up breakfast with hearts on cappuccinos and coffees (so he understands which group it is)! Do not underestimate the location of the hotel... 5 meters from the Manzoni stop.

author: Daisy L
title: To avoid
text: Avoid it. My flight was cancelled and they asked me as cancellation compensation the sum of 499 euros knowing that I only stayed there 3 nights. They didn't want to hear anything. Not even a package. I paid a reservation almost the amount of my room for my stay. Shame, we are doubly victimized.

author: Evie E
title: Horror Story.
text: This Hotel turned out to be the biggest rip-off of my life. We booked through the hotel’s website and I was charged 3 times for the same room without receiving notification of the first two bookings for over a month. When I learned of the additional bookings and attempted to correct the problem I was told basically “too bad, not refundable.” Repeated emails and phone calls yielded no results only uncaring disregard.  I was charged a total of $3000 dollars for 3 nights for a room that was not even the upgraded room I paid for. Reeked of bleach. Water on the floor in dangerous places from the AC. They even resold the rooms they charged me for as I overheard another guest ask to switch rooms and be told that they were sold out. The place would have had some charm if the staff had been a bit friendlier.

author: Lucy I
title: Perfect weekend
text:
Hotel in a strategic position, just 10 minutes by taxi from the station, spotless rooms, comfortable and extremely courteous staff.
The food is also excellent, with a choice of different traditional Roman dishes for lunch or dinner and a great selection of desserts for breakfast.

author: Maria M
title: Hotel should never have 4 stars
text:
Very bad
The worst 4-star hotel I've ever been to.
Reception had only one attentive night attendant all the others barely answered what we asked. Badly educated coffee workers.
The rooms are very small, noisy, no acoustic sealing, they were smoking cigarettes, they were not putting toilet paper, paper clothes, glasses and water back, on the first day the shampoo dispenser was broken and they were only going to fix it on the last day. I had to buy a conditioner because I didn't.
Breakfast varied but things were old.
This hotel could never be a 4 star.

author: Laura N
title: Highly Recommend
text: Highly recommend for location, cleanliness, and professional staff. Brandon  and the whole Lex Hotel Team were professional, kind, and responsive.

author: Antoine U
title: Overall a great stay
text: The hotel is in a great spot, just a short walk to the subway station. Check-in was fast and Ana was very polite. My room was small, but it was very clean and the bed was comfortable. However, there was no mini-fridge. Overall it was an affordable place to sleep if you do not need luxury. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Oscar S
title: Five-Star Service from Steven
text: Steven at the front desk made our stay even better. From the moment we arrived, he greeted us with genuine kindness, warmth, and a welcoming smile. He was professional, attentive, and always willing to help with anything we needed. It’s rare to meet someone who makes you feel so valued as a guest. Thank you.

author: Erin L
title: Great stay
text: Everything was super clean, the staff was incredibly friendly, and the breakfast was  just right to start your day . Plus, you can't beat the location if you're in town to see the sights.

author: Daniel N
title: Would stay again!
text: This was our first time booking a hotel in New York so we picked this for our convenience and the price. We have been to a couple of hotels and the first person you interact with defines the whole experience for me and my family. We checked into the hotel, Ana greeted us with a very warm welcome, accommodating us with our luggage’s and was very helpful in answering all our questions. Our room was clean, the noise level wasn’t too bad except sometimes during the night but that was mostly outside. During our leave, Ana helped us to order a taxi to our airport and it arrived on time. Overall it was a wonderful experience and we would definitely check back here on our next trip to New York!

author: Henry F
title: Great Stay!
text:
I had an absolutely wonderful stay at this hotel! This is my third time there and from the moment I arrive, the staff has made me feel genuinely welcome. Everyone was friendly and professional.

The room was spotless, comfortable, and well-maintained. My stay was perfect and it made me feel like a valued guest.

author: Anna B
title: Memorable stay
text: Nice area, helpful staff, clean room. Will definitely be back

author: Aiden K
title: Dark and dingy
text: This place is bare bones, you will not want to spend any time in the room. I booked a two queen junior suite through TA and was put in a room the size of a closet with one queen bed.  The lobby, halls and rooms are dark and creepy.  The carpeting is worn and stained.  There was a weird electrical box on the nightstand and it was filthy.  I checked out early and both TA and the hotel refused to credit me the second night.  I do not understand the good reviews for this hotel.

author: Freya A
title: How rare to stay in and rate an NYC hotel
text:
Construction work led us to stay in this NYC hotel.

Our room and its bathroom were surprisingly large. Each was well-appointed and quite clean. And the room faced the back and was quiet.

A small continental breakfast is supplied in the lobby. Freshness and cleanliness were high: seating was limited. 

Accessibility seems high in this modern space.

The location is two blocks from two subway stops and quite near Baruch College and Madison Suare Park, not the Garden where the Knicks play.

I would stay here again.

author: Ruby P
title: Very good hotel
text:
The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming throughout my visit, always ready to help with anything I needed. The location is very convenient, making it easy to get around the city and explore nearby attractions.

I especially enjoyed the rooftop, which is a great place to relax and take in the views. My Superior Room was quiet, comfortable, and provided a peaceful retreat after a busy day in the city.

Overall, a wonderful experience with excellent service, a great location, and comfortable accommodations. I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend Lex Hotel to anyone visiting New York City.

author: Alice K
title: Great place with awesome staff!
text: I had a great experience! Steven was always there to answer my questions and help with any requests. His recommendations were really helpful, thanks Steven!!

author: Pierre P
title: Ok …. But expected more
text: Based on the reviews, I was expecting a little higher quality. Dark drab entrance, staff at check-in were friendly. Carpet floor in room had a large patch in the older carpet. Sheet had a stain.  Bathroom was decent.  Cleaning service did a good job. Shower went cold for my wife.  I took a shower after her and it was fine. Picked hotel based on reviews and location.  Not sure I would stay there again.

author: Hugo C
title: Very nice hotel
text: We stayed for two nights last week. This hotel was right next the venue Baruch Performing Arts that we were attending. We enjoyed our stay very much. Bed was very comfortable and they brought us extra pillows. Stephen at the hotel desk was very helpful and polite. The room was extremely clean! Parking garage was close and convenient. Would definitely stay again. Plus, Alex was also very helpful also.

author: Holly E
title: Comfort and location
text: A tidy modern hotel in a great location, with a very helpful staff and a sweet rooftop terrace.

author: Molly I
title: I loved the Lex Hotel NYC: cute, well located, excellent staff, rich breakfast and beautiful rooftop. I'd come back 💙
text: I loved the Lex Hotel NYC: cute, well located, excellent staff, rich breakfast and beautiful rooftop. I'd come back 💙

author: Alexander X
title: Excellent stay in a perfect location
text:
Great location and very friendly staff
	•	Excellent stay in a perfect location
	•	Highly recommended hotel in NYC
	•	Lovely stay with amazing staff
	•	Perfect location and clean rooms

author: Lucas J
title: Lex Hotel- great location, great facilities for a city break!
text:
Located in a fabulous spot in the city for both walking and subway access. The hotel is clean, tidy and staff were always helpful and informative. The breakfast was a great start to the day with fresh muffins, croissants, pastries, cereal and fruit. Tea and coffee, orange juice and milk too! Plenty to set you up for the day! The rooms were clean and fresh, everything you need for a city break. The showers were lovely and hot and a great variety of toiletries to use for a short break. There is a safe in the room free of charge. Rooms can be cleaned daily or on request and tea and coffee brought to your room whenever you would like. 
There is a luggage storage for those early  arrivals and later departures, accessed only by reception. The hotel felt very safe and of a good standard. There are delis next door, a Starbucks 50 metres away, subway, and a wing stop within 10 metres of the front door. Overall an excellent stay. Would I stay again? Absolutely!

author: Katie T
title: Great stay
text: Had a great stay at The Lex Hotel! The staff were super friendly and incredibly helpful with all of our questions. I loved the continuous coffee service sent right to my room — such a nice touch. The location is also fantastic and made getting around NYC really easy. Would definitely stay here again.

author: Aaron N
title: Great experience
text: We stayed here while my mom was in the hospital and Odalis was so kind to us - he let us use a room while I was having a panic attack and it was such a huge help. Thank you, Odalis, for your compassion and kindness.

author: Luke V
title: Great hotel
text: My stay at the Lex Hotel NYC was excellent from start to finish. The hotel is in a great location. Close to public transportation, restaurants, and major attractions. The room was clean, modern, and well-maintained, with comfortable bedding that made it easy to relax after long days exploring the city. The staff was friendly, professional, and always willing to help with directions or recommendations.

author: Jack Y
title: Good location
text: Good location by the tube station… good clean hotel and good atmosphere . Would recommend .

author: Luke Q
title: Disappointing experience
text:
In July 2026, I stayed at this hotel and, unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing.

My voucher was for a room with two beds, as there were three people in my family. However, when we entered the room, there was only one bed.

I contacted the hotel to try to resolve the situation, but I was told that the hotel was fully booked and that a room with two beds would only become available on Monday. This was a Friday.

As a result, the three of us had to sleep in one bed for four nights.

To make matters worse, we even had difficulty getting enough towels. Despite asking the manager to provide at least one additional towel, we continued to have only two towels for three people.

It was an extremely uncomfortable situation and completely different from what we had booked and paid for.

And now, as if that experience wasn’t disappointing enough, I am dealing with another issue regarding the refund of the price difference that should have been returned to me.

Unfortunately, after everything that happened, I do not recommend this hotel. 

I 
Ah! It’s always good to mention that one of the elevators may not be working, and that the stairs will be used frequently during the stay, especially in the mornings.

author: Owen T
title: Hotel in a super location
text: Very nice hotel, spacious room, close to Canal Street and West Broadway, subway at the bottom of the hotel, I highly recommend.

author: Sydney W
title: Horrendous Experience
text:
HORRENDOUS EXPERIENCE. i had a reservation that the hotel could not honor because they did not have a room available for me. Wouldn't it be more professional to reach out to me BEFOREHAND to tell me this BEFORE accepting my money?! I'm STILL waiting on a full refund. 

The staff is extremely dismissive, unprofessional and rude. The hotel itself is dingy, old, dirty, and in bad condition.

author: Connor X
title: Pretty Good, Room for Improvement
text: A good value hotel by NYC standards, helped by its non-descript but convenient location on top of Canal Street subway - so only 15 mins from mid or downtown.  Rooms are fine, big enough and well kept. Bad points are the lukewarm showers, seemingly perennially broken lift (although there is at least another working), the poor soundproofing - we had a front facing room and it is not for light sleepers what with the noise of the traffic.

author: Kyle X
title: Horrible time. Was SCAMMED. STAY AWAY
text: NOT A SAFE PLACE TO STAY. We were 100% SCAMMED staying here. If you smoke ANYTHING stay away. We were fully profiled and charged a $300 smoking fee having NEVER smoked in the room. The gave us some fabricated report starting they had “air quality” detector that went off 2 hours after we checked in, but NEVER again during the duration of our stay. Who smokes in the room once RIGHT as they receive it and then never again?? It doesn’t make sense because it didn’t happen. They WILL scam you with ZERO recourse. STAY AWAY!!!!!

author: Paige C
title: NYC Escape
text:
A moderate, clean hotel, located in the Soho area, very close to Little Italy and Chinatown.
Not too expensive for NYC and very safe, police cars patrol a lot.

author: Isabella L
title: A work in progress
text:
I stayed the week the hotel was sold to its new owners and often that can mean unmotivated staff and generally a poor experience but this hotel was the exception. The staff were lovely, the room spotless and the location right by a subway station on the A,C and E so easy to get anywhere. It’s very close to the bridges so a lot of traffic but no noise issues in the room.
I’m told the new owners have “big plans”, I’m looking forward to returning to see what changes they make to make it even better.

author: Sophia I
title: EXCELLENT OPTION
text:
Excellent location, the metro is next to the main door of the hotel. Walking you can reach the Piers walking where you find a spectacular view, all that part is beautiful. On the other hand although it is 10 minutes from Soho walking, there are parts you meet people on the way not very nice. 
The rooms are clean and comfortable.

author: Sophia I
title: Perfect NYC Location
text: Very nice hotel, very coinvent location for lower Manhattan. Area is not touristy at all, lots of attractions close by - walk to Soho, walk to Canal St, walk to Little Italy, and direct access to subway to take you uptown.

author: Evie E
title: Horrible experience
text: I cant believe how gross this place was.  Way too much for a tiny, dirty room.  Im really shocked at how much this place has deteriorated in such a short time

author: Thomas X
title: So Cold!
text:
This stay was far more stressful than it should have been. From the moment I stepped outside my room, the entire property felt locked in an intense cold spell. The ground had that unmistakable hardened, glossy look that comes with prolonged freezing temperatures, making every step feel uncertain and risky.

Moving around the hotel required slow, careful movements, as if the surface might betray you at any moment. Walkways and stairs looked deceptively normal at first, but the moment you stepped on them, it was clear how slick and unforgiving they were. The cold had clearly taken over, and nothing seemed to have been done to counteract it.

author: Mia R
title: Excellent property very close to all of the shopping of Soho and Tribeca.
text:
We enjoyed this property for 3 nights before moving to Midtown for a few nights. The best thing about this hotel was the location. Its phenomenal. This property is steps away from all of the shopping of Soho and has a Subway station a few feet from the main entrance. 

The hotel has a small Lobby with a small store for drinks and snacks. The rooms are not huge including the room with two Queen beds. This is typical for anywhere in Manhattan. That said, we managed with a family of Four. 

Los Tacos No. 1, Lucia’s Pizza of Soho, and Bubby’s (Breakfast) are all awesome dining options steps from the lobby.

author: Chloe H
title: Two different experiences
text: I booked this hotel for two different nights. I had two different experiences. First night I was on the 2nd floor facing York St-no issues. Second night I was in the 5th floor facing York St. I kept checking to see if the windows were closed because the street noise was so bad. About 12:45am the garbage trucks started and that went on for about 20 minutes. Four am I could hear people on the sidewalk talking. Didn't get much sleep that night

author: Nathan J
title: Not able to check in so can’t comment on rooms but horrible customer service
text:
Booked this hotel through a third party booking site for a stay for the Ryder Cup, arrived at 6pm to be told the reservation had been cancelled by Hilton two weeks after I made the booking. I understand that problems with bookings occur and that the hotel could not check us in due to being fully booked.  My review is based on the poor customer service at the front desk who delivered this information with no empathy or sympathy whatsoever. Every request for assistance was met with a “no” or an eye roll and a huff (even when I asked to borrow a pen).
We were left with nowhere to stay on a busy weekend and got no help, they refused every request to provide us with evidence of the cancellation so we could get our money back. 
Sorted the issue ourselves via Hilton’s customer service line - they booked us into Hilton Garden Inn Midtown Park Ave who were amazing - see separate review

author: Michael M
title: Good foothold
text:
In the area of the twin towers there is this structure in the tribal neighborhood, convenient because of the subway stops but a little out of respect to the center of Manhattan, they give us the
Room with wall view and it is a shame because you are in NYC even though tribeca is a neighborhood where you can not have a nice view, average clean hotel, nothing great, not impeccable cleanliness, elevator a bit slow , very uncomfortable pillows and sometimes we were not given towels .. otherwise hotel ok to lean on and visit the city

author: Lucy Z
title: Convenient Location, Clean Hotel
text: Good location and a decent size room for NYC.  The hotel is clean and our room and bed were in good condition.  The only complaint was 1 of two elevators were not working, so we found ourselves walking up / down the stairs to our room on the third floor to avoid a long wait for the elevator.

author: Ella D
title: Very good
text: Great value for money personal very kind spotless room recommend it and is also in front of the metro station also equipped with gym

author: Aaron J
title: Functional Hotel
text: Hotel was very clean, however there were many things that could have improved. The elevators should have key scans to keep non-guests from the hotel. The elevator, singular, was very slow considering there were only 6 floors. The beds were doubles in the two bed room, which is small for two people to share a bed. On the bright side, valet parking was easy, the hotel was in a convenient location, and the staff was very helpful. We would return to this location again!

author: Ella D
title: Great location & neighborhood, totally adequate hotel
text: Absolutely fine mid level hotel with a few challenges and a huge plus. First of all, 2 peloton bikes in the gym is awesome! Well maintained and not crowded. On the down side, our room was small (expected in NYC) and terribly dark. Huge need for light in the closet or close to it. Also 1 elevator was out of operation the whole time we were there and someone told me they had been there close to a week and it had been out the whole time. However it's clean, great location, and helpful staff.

author: Sophia E
title: More like poor youth hostel quality
text: The website looks promising but in reality the hotel is very dated and dirty. The room we stayed in was actually very poor. Located directly on the street side. During our stay it was very hot and the air conditioning wasn't working properly. The only solution was to open the windows at night but there was so much noise from the street (restaurant across the street cleaning up in the middle of the night shuffeling tables around and a homeless guy residing in a tent directly outside the hotel who made a lot of noise) we couldn't sleep well. The room was really small too making it a challenge to move around. Very small bathroom. Broken soap dispensers. Toilet that didn't flush very well with a reservoir that took ages to fill back up. Door closers that shut the door with a loud bang. Breakfast is very simple and below average. This is more like youth hostel quality. Not recommended.

author: Evie C
title: Lamentable
text:
Very disappointing experience, mainly because of the receptionist's attitude. Upon my arrival, I was not assigned the room category I had paid for. When I pointed it out, the receptionist had the nerve to tell me that, given the price paid, "I should be happy." Such a remark from an employee is simply unacceptable.

I immediately contacted the reservation center. With proof in hand (photos upon arrival), they refunded me 30% of the stay, thus confirming that the room did not correspond at all to my reservation.

On the second day, I had to change rooms because I had booked twin beds. The receptionist refused to make things easier for me, claiming that it was "not the same room type." In the end, they made me move to a twin room that was identical in every way to the previous one, with the exception of the two beds. A blatant lack of professionalism and goodwill.

author: Chloe A
title: Address to remember
text:
We stayed 4 nights in this hotel last week, in 2 different rooms, nothing to complain about.
recently renovated room and bathroom with taste, very clean, air-conditioned. The breakfast is quite good (savory, sweet, yogurts, compotes, fruits,...). The staff is helpful and smiling. The hotel is 500 m from the subway station. The most notable aspect during this heatwave is the availability of a refrigerated water fountain, an espresso machine, a slushie maker, and a small fresh juice fountain at the reception. The only small remark would be about the price when booking several nights; the price is not discounted or a bit cheaper.

author: Andrea Z
title: A nightmare with entire hotel air condition broken down for five days
text:
Checked in on 24 May, found that air con not working.  Called reception and no one pick up the phone.  Went down and the receptionist said air con in some rooms broken down.  Another guest said it has been 3 nights since she checked in and it was still not fixed. The receptionist said someone will fixed it 8am tomorrow. 
Second day another receptionist said no one is coming to fix the air con.  I asked if we can change to a room with air con.  He said cannot because the rooms are occupied and full.  I said you are still selling room online.   Then he said the manager will come back at 8am.  Then later said 10am, then said today is bank holiday and not coming back. You can check out and get refund. 
In the afternoon, asked another receptionist, she said actually the entire hotel had no air con.  It’s hopeless and now 1:47am, still unable to sleep.  Totally lost of enjoyment.

author: Henry B
title: Good - would stay again
text: I would stay again.  I slept really well - nice bed.  The rooms are typical Paris (basic and small).  Great location as well.  The only negative would be the guy who works reception - such a miserable, surly and awful human being.  He should do himself (and customers) a favour and find another job.

author: Amelia U
title: It’s ok
text:
The hotel is located 10 minutes from the mainline station and 2 minutes from metro. 

Despite being in a side street there is considerable overnight noise as the glazing is singular. Room smelt damp/drain on arrival. The walls are thin and shake when someone shuts a door on the same floor. The rooms are small and the bathrooms tiny. Breakfast at €14 a person. Didn’t try it, you’re are surrounded by bakeries and restaurants. Cleaning ok, cup not washed or replaced for three days. Booked via Eurostar so cannot comment on overall value.

author: Holly M
title: Nice little cozy hotel
text:
Nice cozy hotel.The room was small as expected but there was what was supposed to be, among other things, a electric stove and that was filled up every day with tea and coffee.A lot of options for electric connection.We had toilet with shower and bathtub.
Cleaning daily.
Close to public transportation.
All friendly and helpful

author: George D
title: Christmas getaway
text:
The decor is a little dated, the room was compacted. But very very clean , The bed was so comfy making for a brilliant night sleep. 
The hotel is 10 minute walk from the train station. The staff were very friendly.  Despite being at the front of the hotel the nosie leave was ok didn't disturb our sleep.

author: Giulia V
title: Excellent experience
text:
I stayed at the Hotel Paris Lafayette last week as part of a business trip and was able to test one of their new rooms / studios. A very nice surprise! The room is spacious, well appointed and perfectly equipped: kitchenette with fridge, Nespresso machine with capsules, and a large very nice bathroom. The bedding is really excellent. I was on the courtyard side, which guarantees absolute calm — ideal for resting after a long day of work.

A very comfortable stay, I highly recommend!

author: Oscar H
title: Good.
text:
We stayed at this hotel during our stay in Paris. 
Warm and suitable hotel for a short stay in the capital. 
Breakfast served in the morning is good. The bed is comfortable but the shower a little narrow. 
Small downside regarding the room, the air conditioning was out of order when we came, during the heatwave the heat was stifling. 
The positive is that the fish metro station is located 2 steps from the hotel. A positive point to quickly start the visits.

author: George F
title: Terrible.
text:
We changed three times room for non-working air conditioners.
They even proposed to leave the structure and find us, possibly, another hotel!!!!!
After changing , therefore, several times the room promised that we would compensate for breakfast for the inconvenience caused.
They literally made fun of us, indeed, when we tried to get explanations, we were literally mocked.
Obviously, we never got compensation, despite several emails of protest.
Not recommended

author: Ruby Z
title: Hotel with character
text: Nice, boutique hotel, walking distance from/to Gare du Nord. Clean room, comfortable bed and decent bathroom. Friendly, hotel staff. Lots of amenities nearby - supermarkets, cafes, restaurants, ice-cream shops etc.

author: Mia D
title: Satisfied
text: Perfect, courteous, available spotless rooms and convenient x reach the center. Recommended if I return to Paris I would stay there again.

author: Sofia T
title: Good value great location
text:
I don’t know how this has bad reviews. We’ve just checked in and staff very welcoming and gave us a drink. Yes rooms are small, but welcome to Europe. I’m guessing Americans would be surprised by they’re used to US rooms but if you’re in a historic beautiful European capital then yes, some of the budget hotels are in old buildings with small rooms and no AC.

For the price we think this place is lovely, well situated and close to lots of Paris must see destinations.

author: Isabella K
title: What a dump of a place
text: Booked in for 4 nights, no wifi no air condtioning. When I reported it to the front desk, they went through the motions of trying to turn on the air conditioner and then suggested I use the fan already in the room. They offered a refund and after providing a copy of the invoice and an email of complaint, I have been following up and been assured that my refund will be processed. At the time of writing, still no sign of my refund. Shocking experience.

author: Oscar R
title: Not even good enough for a pidgeon
text: Broken air-con in a heat wave. Opened the window for some air and it was very noisy and a pigeon came in. Pigeon left very quickly, smart pigeon! Room was very, very tiny. Reasonably clean. Poor wifi. Breakfast was ok.

author: Holly D
title: no wifi no air condtioning
text:
shocking experience
put in a complaint for refund no reply or response
no air conditioning 4 nights
no wifi
breakfast not organized or ready at 7am
staff arguing with clients in reception

author: Isla K
title: Pictures are far from representing the room
text:
The studio room was nothing like the pictures. It was not much more than a basic room with a bit more space on the floor - no seating except a very basic and hard chair. The aircon was defect, and the hotel knew about it without saying anything. They did offer a fan when I mentioned it, but it's a huge difference between aircon and a fan in 34 degrees. 

The bed was however good, and the room was clean. Staff was attentive enough, but I'm far from impressed overall and will not recommend this hotel

author: Daisy K
title: To avoid
text:
To avoid... air conditioning out of order day of great heatwave, no one answers the phone, direction absent ..
Small room, thermal strainer...
Barely deserves a star.
Pass your way

author: Elena B
title: A tragedy
text: Worst hotel ever experienced. The 3 stars are light years away, 1 would already be an exaggeration. Cleanliness does not know what it is: dirty sheets, pillows, curtains and towels, in addition to hair everywhere (even on the walls!) and stained breakfast dishes (in addition to the quality of the products worthy of a hostel, as evidenced by the almond milk in the picture, with color and smell strange and unpleasant). You have to expressly request the change of sheets and towels, but apparently they do not listen to such requests as we found the same stained sheet that we had asked to change. The stay started badly from the arrival in the room because, despite the booking was for a triple room, we were provided with a double room and a single forcing a person to sleep alone (according to the girl at the reception should have been two communicating rooms but it was not so and, after asking for explanations, she apologized saying she spoke bad English and expressed herself badly, and then speak perfect English shortly after on the phone). As if that was not enough, the air conditioning was not working and to receive a fan we had to wait several hours. Other guests we spoke to complained about the same issues.
