author: Erin K
title: seeks a vibrant base in the heart of Manhattan.
text:
citizenM New York Times Square is a very trendy hotel in a prime location, just off Times Square. The room was very small, but smartly decorated and equipped with everything you need for a city trip. The hotel is quite pricey, but unfortunately that seems to be fairly normal in New York.
What really makes this hotel special is the amazing rooftop bar with stunning views of the city. The staff was very friendly and helpful. An ideal choice for those seeking a modern, vibrant base in the heart of Manhattan.

author: Wyatt W
title: Go to!
text: Top-notch hotel despite the size of the rooms, but which is largely compensated for by its geographical location (150m from Times Square), the rooms are very well equipped and offer all the necessary comfort and modernity. Very welcoming staff, quick, simple, and efficient check-in!

author: Aaron I
title: Ok, but not our style
text: When you check in, a human asks you to please use a kiosk pad. The human standing there will offer help if you need it. We hung out in the area they call the “living room” a few times, and always saw people waiting to check in so I doubt many get early check in. As a gold Marriott member we did not but we did receive late check out.  The young woman we asked seemed to forget who she was helping and neglected to get back to us to confirm our request so we did have to follow up twice. Rooms were reminiscent of European size. There’s a drawer beneath the bed with extra pillows so if you take them out, you can fit a carryon inside to lay flat. If you have two people, there are two slim closets so it is possible to stand another luggage inside. We were not troubled by the lack of floor space for luggage, we made do but the funky smell of the shower curtain with a lack of ventilation in the small bathroom area was off putting.  If they hope to save energy, the button for the curtains on the wall and the iPad caused us to often mistakenly lower the blackout curtains and turn off all lights so unfortunately they didn’t save energy on us. The iPad controlled the lights, tv and shades. We opted to have one person sleep along the wall and one access to get out of the bed easily. You could sleep with both heads towards the window and then both have to scoot out of the bed. The breakfast was a 4/5 for us. Better than a Hampton level. Rooms are a little cramped and not much human interaction if you’re a regular traveler and  in your 40s or 50s.  I called the hotel a few times before our stay but never got through to a human. It was an anniversary stay but no special acknowledgement. Gym has some free weights, ellipticals, and treadmills. Overall, it was a fine stay but likely more comfortable for single travelers. Ok stay, great location if you want to be in the middle of Times Square. Personally, I like staying up towards 56th St even if going to see Broadway shows. Remember, every 10 city streets (not avenues) Is about 1/2 mile. Good luck with your research and stay!

author: Ella K
title: Ok, but unlikely to stay here again.
text:
Major complaints:  They have a tiny ironing room on the second floor with one iron!  I understand not having them in the rooms - sets off the fire alarms.  But we intentionally did not pack a travel iron because we were led to believe it would not be an issue. Surprise! 
Secondly, the room barely got comfortably cool. Cut the unit down to 64. Doubt it got below 72, and the rooms in NYC are tiny! Day temps were high 80s, low temps 68-70. No excuse not to be able get comfortable on a room facing North!
Look at some of the recent three star reviews for elaboration and other room complaints. 
  I will say the proximity to mostly everything in Manhattan from the museums to the shows to shopping can't be beat. If you are a walker and have time, you can literal walk down south to the WTC and up north to top of Central Park, which has the major museums on either side of it.

author: Charlie E
title: Form over human function - Not good for couples
text:
I live a modern and minimalist lifestyle, so while I appreciate the concept, the execution and communication are poor in terms of what you expect and what you get. 

I expect a king-size bed with two sides accessible by each person, not a waist-high bed that you have to climb over and climb over your partner, especially when she has rheumatoid issues. I asked for a handicap room, but none were available until the next night, and it was too much bother to pack up and move.

I expect you to be able to drop garbage into the garbage can, not have to do a hand hook shot to get into the bin under the desk. Looks sleek there, but not functional.

I expect wall switches to have signs/symbols that indicate how they work. For future guests, you have to toggle the switches three times to get full lights.

I expect an actual bathroom wall and door, not a shower curtain separating me and my wife from the toilet and shower. Yes, we're a couple, but nobody wants to hear anyone else's business. Related, I expect a wall light for the bathroom, not an iPad control console to turn on the light at night. Seriously?

I expect drawerS. Not one giant drawer for two people, which also happens to be filled with extra pillows, and those have to be stored somewhere else.

I could go on, but the bottom line is that this room is form over function. Beautiful and modern, great location, friendly staff, but humans didn't design the rooms or sleep in it. More like a banker who wanted to pack in as many rooms into a floor and fit in a king bed. Maybe it's okay for one person younger than 40, but for couples and everyone who wants an intuitive room design, pass.

author: Lucia G
title: Modern hotel right in the middle of Times Square with a perfect location
text: First-class location, friendly service, modern rooms with additional iPad control in the room, very good value for money, nice rooftop bar, clean hotel, and definitely recommended.

author: Ian C
title: Too trendy for this old guy
text: Trendy hotel in Times Square just not for the old guy. I prefer more in suite amenities like coffee in the room. Shower slippery with nothing to hold to (like I said, old guy). The upstairs bar has a great vibe. The location is terrific and yes, the bed is amazing. Marvellous just not my taste.

author: Juan H
title: A peaceful base just off Time Square
text: A tranquil haven after the hustle and bustle of tourist life in the city.  Friendly, helpful staff, a cool vibe and a great lobby for chilling in or having a night cap.  We didn’t hear a peep from the city once inside. The bedroom was small but had all we needed and, as we didn’t spend much time in there aside from sleeping and getting ready, it was great value for money. A subway line to the airport was just outside the front door, as were numerous bakeries, restaurants, bars and shops.

author: Ryan G
title: Excellent choice for a solo traveler
text:
First and foremost, the rooms are too small for two people (and we are not “big and tall”); especially, if you are used to your spacious home, but for a single traveler it is perfect! I travel to NYC frequently without my husband and I wouldn’t hesitate a minute to stay at this welcoming, efficient and modern hotel. 

The advantages are: 

Fabulous location far enough from Times Square not to hear and see all the hustle and bustle, two metro entrances steps away from the door, excellent Hell’s Kitchen restaurants nearby, and two minutes walk to the nearby Whole Foods supermarket. 

Very efficient room equipped with modern technology controls via iPad (easy to adjust the lights and open/close blinds) , small shower/toilet combo, but with excellent waterfall shower, nice design of the lobby with plenty of space to work and eat (we had a great sushi takeout enjoyed there on a rainy evening), welcoming service, fast elevators, free water (still and sparkling) in the dining area… 

We had a great stay and I will definitely be returning on my solo trips.

author: Sean X
title: Small Rooms but efficient
text:
This Marriott brand has perfected getting the most out of a small space.  The room reminds a bit of a cruise cabin but maybe even smaller.  As a solo traveler, it was fine.  Exceptionally clean, comfortable, nice shower and room controls handled by a handy tablet.  The bed is king, however, it is perfectly set against the window and if I had wife in the bed, one of us would have to climb over the other if they needed to get up.  

If you need to be in Times Square, this is a great location as it is just off Broadway on 50th street.  I was attending a conference at the Marriott Marquis and it was an easy walk.  

The staff is great and the lobby area has plenty of work spaces if you need them.  I did not eat at the hotel.

author: Amelia X
title: CRITICAL WARNING: Security Breach & Internal Theft
text:
I am writing this to warn future guests about a devastating security failure and a complete lack of basic Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) at citizenM New York Times Square.

At 11:30 AM, I realized I had left my 14k gold peridot earrings in my room. I immediately alerted the front desk. Instead of following logical security protocols to allow me to retrieve my property, I was blocked and told to wait because "housekeeping would bring them down."

That 10-minute window created by the staff’s refusal to let me back into my room provided a clear opportunity for internal theft. Ten minutes later, the jewelry had "miraculously" vanished. When I complained, the response was dismissive. I have since filed an NYPD police report.

Update on Corporate Accountability:
I escalated this to Marriott Corporate, who claimed they were "investigating" the matter. Since that initial claim, there have been zero updates and total silence. It is clear that neither the hotel nor Marriott corporate takes guest security or internal integrity seriously.

The failure to secure a room once a guest has flagged a high-value item is unacceptable. This was not a mistake; it was a breach of trust enabled by hotel policy. Stay elsewhere if you value your belongings.

author: Isabella U
title: Great solution in Times square area
text:
We stayed at this hotel in times square area for a week towards the end of April. 
Excellent location, convenient to move both on foot and by metro, with several local and services in the area; very nice style of the hotel and rooms, with modern furnishings and solutions. Our room was not particularly large but had everything you need, to highlight however that shower and toilet are in fact in the room, closed by a glass solution. Excellent cleaning as well as service, with reception always open and friendly and helpful staff. Hotel therefore that I would recommend, also in terms of price quality compared to comparable accommodations.

author: Ryan N
title: A great hotel for your money in NYC!
text:
I’ve stayed at a lot of hotels in NYC and this is one of the best, esp for a solo traveler — excellent location within a couple of blocks of multiple subway lines, short walk to MoMA, Central Park and Broadway theaters.  And easy to get to / from Penn Station.  Given the location to Times Square I was worried about noise, but it is actually very quiet (and I was on a lower floor).  

Because they really only have one configuration of rooms, there are also virtually no kids and no school groups which is extremely appealing to me.

There is a good mix of restaurants in the neighborhood, but also easy to get to areas with more cafe culture.  There is also a little Whole Foods with tons of to-go options half a block away.

The common areas are vibrant - and the staff are super friendly.

If you haven’t stayed at CitizenM before, the rooms are small but extremely efficient and well laid out.  Only thing I’m not a fan of is that there is not coffee in the rooms - but that is a tiny gripe.

author: Isla W
title: No Support When It Matters
text: Cancelled a reservation only because the hotel failed to confirm payment and my bank issued a legitimate security warning. Despite repeated contact and clear intent to keep the booking, reinstatement was refused. I was charged despite the reservation being cancelled, and then offered a more expensive, downgraded (single‑occupancy) booking as an alternative. Zero accountability, zero customer service.

author: Evie T
title: Hotel well placed but malfunctions
text:
We stayed at this hotel 10 years ago. I had a great memory of it. In 2026, my opinion is more mixed.
We had already booked a room on the upper floor. We were on the 15th floor, for me it's not that high floor. Then the maintenance and cleanliness of the room leaves much to be desired. Aging room, broken shelf, stained sheets, forgotten towels and cleaning is very late. Breakfast is okay but identical every day. The elevators malfunction, 1 is broken down and the other 2 are overloaded. We sometimes waited for more than 5 minutes. We came home one afternoon and found the maid in our room in the middle of a personal phone conversation instead of making the room. As for all the staff, they remain courteous but no more.
In short, this hotel remains well located for a stay in New York but it has lost quality. You get the impression there's a captain missing.

author: George K
title: Clean , tech forward rooms
text:
I really liked this hotel as far as lobby bar and rooftop bar. Lobby is attractive and appreciated the games available- upstairs bar had great outdoor space - views of the Hudson. The staff are all upbeat, energetic and helpful. Check in is easy and I actually liked the iPad in the room to control everything. 
My personal issue is the room , it is small but I knew that going in . It was more that the bed is on a platform and fills 1/3 of room and no space to get off the bed if you’re the second in the bed ( next to window ) without going over the first person - so you need to be agile or you’re waking up your partner . Also the room is stark white with LED lights overhead so both things made me feel a little off / unsettled. I’m sensitive to surroundings. I won’t be staying here again.

author: Caleb D
title: Ideal situation for a very good hotel in an incredible town
text:
We did not know Citizen M but itw as a good surprise. The first impression is special as you have to settle everything with an IPad (light, night light, television, climatization, curtains, blinds).
When you understand how it works it’s perfect. The only thing is the bed which is along the window. If you are a couple you can be woke up during the night if your husband / wife has to get up to go to the bathroom. I found a way to sleep quietly, I moved the pillows in order tu put our heads near the window so we could get up without disturbing your spouse. The bed was big enough to allow that.
The room was clear and we could put our suitcases with no problem. 
The hotel is very well situated near a tube station (unfortunately without a lift or escalator, so if you have heavy suitcases you have to go up wearing them…, near a bus station and many theatres. You can find restaurants in the neighborhood if you do not want to walk a lot in the evening.
Moreover, you can have breakfast included in the price of the room which is not frequent in the USA. The breakfast was nice with bread, croissants, fruit, juices and coffees.
The staff was nice and very helpful. We did not want to check in and check out alone with a PC and we could do it with the enployee at the reception.
We had a lot of pleasure in Citizen M and when we come back to New York we will return there.

author: Noah Z
title: Ideal in Times Square
text:
Excellent hotel close to Broadway and two minutes from Times Square.
Very comfortable hotel even if the rooms are small. Absolutely charming staff. Perfect breakfast in the form of varied buffet.
We have already made several CitizenM, really to recommend in the center of NYC.
Its central layout is an obvious asset, ultra trendy and comfortable lobby.
We are a fan!

author: Holly Q
title: Fantastic stay!
text:
The location of this hotel is really convenient, within easy reach of Times Square and the main meeting points for tourist activities. 
The staff is formidable, really friendly and helpful, the breakfast is rich and varied and the cleanliness of the rooms is impeccable. 
The rooms are not so small to be in New York and the thing I really liked, is that you can adjust the temperature to your liking. 
Great idea to have a tablet that allows you to manage the room.
Accommodation really recommended, the best, so far, where I stayed in the big apple.

author: Paige B
title: Perfect City Break Stay
text: Our expectations were low because it was so reasonably priced, but we were genuinely so happy with our stay. Clean, compact room with amazing iPad tech controls, a massive comfy bed, the best hotel hairdryer I’ve used and a shower you never want to leave. Staff were super friendly and even treated my fiancé to birthday drinks at the bar. Beautiful decor, great rooftop (sadly but understandably outdoors was closed due to snow storm), perfect Times Square location near subways. Ideal place to relax after busy NYC days. Thank you CitizenM ☺️

author: Isla N
title: Tiny rooms and they lie about bed size
text: Hotel advertises KING beds but they only have queens. You have my email. They refused to compensate me or move me because they do not have king beds. Flat out lying and extremely rude hotel staff and manager by the name of Daisy.

author: Ruby F
title: Best hotel inManhattan  I etc - Gulbye manager Janine the best
text: An absolute gem of a hotel! The location is unbeatable, making it super easy to explore the area. The room was modern, sparkling clean, and the bed was extremely comfortable. What truly made our stay special was the warm and attentive staff—they went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Highly recommended and would definitely stay here again! Thanks Ibeth, Gulbye y Janine

author: Molly M
title: Great experience from Adam the sales rep at the West time square location
text: This is for Adam the hotel package rep at gone Times central West location. Talk about an asset to the company, not only did he throughly explain the packages to me, He showed me the value of purchasing a package more than anything. Such a knowledgeable representative🙏.

author: Ana O
title: NY for lovers
text:
Great experience 
I Beth was an amazing host!
Located in the middle of all theaters

author: Holly T
title: Amazing experience!
text: This hotel is very clean, big, and full of wonderful staff! Checking into our hotel Jose is wonderful, he recommended places to eat, entertainment, and overall how to get around, very helpful and accommodating, I will definitely be coming back I 100% recommend this hotel!

author: James Q
title: First time experience in New York
text: Jose was nice and helpful with travel recommendations, he told us a lot of places to eat at and places to see and how to get around New York.

author: Freya H
title: I love it!
text: Love it! Absolutely beautiful. Welcoming staff.

author: Nathan Z
title: Great Services
text: Edgar was great and helpful with the assistance.

author: Zachary V
title: Great stay in the city for a couple of nights.
text: We had a great stay. We were allowed to check in about 10:00 AM which is earlier than the normal time which was great as we had a redeye and arrived early in the morning.  Michele was very accommodating Saturday evening when we found out our flights had been canceled and had to get another night. She was friendly and sympathetic, and was able to let us stay in the same room for the extra night.  We like the location close to Times Square. The hotel was clean and comfortable and centrally located.

author: Ian W
title: The best management!!
text: We came in from Ohio and were so excited to start our nyc vacation. Solo with my three kids and my aging mother, I attempted to check in and they said Expedia had cancelled by reservation nearly 3 months ago unbeknownst to me. I had just paid the total for the stay last week. Needless to say, I was baffled. My car was on the side of Times square waiting to be parked. As an attempt to figure out what to do while driving in downtown manhattan alone, I was on the line with chase travel for an hour with little  help besides a full refund and “ sorry about this”. When I got back to the hotel, I had nowhere to stay, Expedia said hotel was sold out as did chase travel. The lovely and amazing team at Hilton garden inn ( Tyera and Ibeth) was able to find us 2 king rooms. I was so grateful. We would have been is a tough situation without their kindness and understanding.

author: Thomas D
title: Outstanding Service from Ibeth, Daisy & Brian! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text:
I want to take a moment to recognize Ibeth and Manager Daisy for something that goes beyond good customer service — they made me feel genuinely cared for as a guest.

As a Hilton member, I had a few issues with my reservation. What could have easily become a frustrating experience was handled with patience, efficiency, and, most importantly, a human touch. The Finance issue was also resolved immediately by Brian, and I truly appreciated his prompt assistance.

Ibeth truly stood out. You can tell when someone simply does their job and when someone genuinely loves what they do. Ibeth has that special quality. She is incredibly professional, attentive, warm, and polished in every detail. From her impeccable personal presentation to the way she communicates and follows through, she represents hospitality at its best.

What impressed me most was that her professionalism never felt scripted. It felt authentic. I felt valued, listened to, and, most importantly, I felt at home. That feeling is rare, and it is something a guest remembers long after the stay is over.

Manager Daisy also deserves recognition for her leadership and for supporting a team capable of delivering this level of service.

Ibeth is truly a Colombian pride. 🇨🇴 Hilton is fortunate to have someone who brings not only professionalism to her work, but also genuine heart and passion.

With customer service like this, I will absolutely return to this hotel and recommend it without hesitation. Thank you, Ibeth, Daisy, and Brian, for turning what could have been a difficult situation into an experience I will remember for all the right reasons.

Exceptional hospitality is not just about solving a problem — it is about how you make a person feel while you are solving it.
Thanks Ibeth🤗

author: Mason E
title: Excellent service
text:
Excellent service from the moment you arrive they make you feel super good, congratulations on having an employee like Ms. IBETH at the front desk 10 out of 10.
The room was very nice, clean, and cozy with a good view; I have no complaints.

author: Lucia I
title: The BEST front desk service
text: After a stressful time with flight cancellations and rebooking of accommodation, Ibeth, from the front desk staff, went above and beyond my expectations in terms of her helpfulness with rebooking my hotel. I had  accidentally booked an extra night through Expedia with the wrong hotel. She spent the evening helping to unwind the transaction and ensure the correct booking was made on my behalf. I have never experienced such amazing service. She is THE BEST.

author: Juan L
title: Amazing
text: Very helpful and accomodatibg

author: Wyatt G
title: Great hotel, lousy restaurant
text: Great location!  I have to give a shout out to Ibeth, night receptionist. She was amazing, made me feel so good about my choice of hotel. I would stay clear of the restaurant, service is completely nonexistent and people working there appear to be working under duress.

author: Ryan B
title: Great Hotel Stay!
text:
Great Location! Staff was quick to bring more
Towels when asked!! Great views, quick elevators!

author: Sydney H
title: Adventure in New York!
text: Great experience, Burgers and Lobster...Much! Team: Jamal, Mike, and Herbie Hankcock  are fun!

author: Freya J
title: Great location and fantastic service
text: Perfect location right next to Times Square

author: Grace H
title: Delightful
text: José recommended a super delightful breakfast spot that was legitimately the best!!! We mentioned the available hours we had to explore and he told us where to go. Spot on!!!!

author: Owen K
title: You need to get to the Hilton Garden Inn Times Square
text:
This has been a wonderful experience for this Hilton Rewards Member.
I have a special shout for Jose Ortiz here at the Hilton Garden Inn Times Square who has been an extremely helpful, engaging friendly to me and excellent brand ambassador for Hilton!!!
Not only did he hook me up with  a Hilton vacation package but also gave me a fabulous restaurant recommendation (Did I mention that I’m a foodie so this recommendation is more than appreciated!)
 I will definitely be back!

author: Antoine L
title: Incredible and affordable
text:
I think it was a very good experience with incredible service. Our door wouldn't open anymore because of a technical problem, but they were there the whole time and found a solution quickly. View of the Eiffel Tower, very close to many monuments, I recommend you go there if you are on vacation. The price is very affordable and the room is large enough. 
Thank you very much for this service!

author: Emma O
title: Very good address!
text:
The location of the hotel and the fact that the reception is open 24/7 were essential criteria for choosing this establishment. I was not disappointed.
Hotel located opposite the RER B Port Royal station, very good when traveling alone to the Stade de France...
Great welcome and service, a very attentive team that does its best to take requests into account and make the stay as pleasant as possible.
Continental breakfast with very good products.
Single room sufficient for staying a few nights for those who do not plan to spend their day at the hotel, otherwise it may seem a little small.
No air conditioning in the hotel but fans in the rooms.

A big thank you to the team for their welcome and for this stay!

author: Nathan V
title: Great experience
text: From the reception, to the kitchens for breakfast, to the maintenance of the rooms, the staff was helpful, smiling, and competent.  The room was very clean.

author: Paige A
title: Suffocating heat
text:
The hotel's location is certainly its strong point: convenient for reaching the main attractions and well-served.
Unfortunately, however, our experience was not positive. The room was really very small and the bathroom was extremely cramped, so much so that even the simplest movements were difficult.
The absence of air conditioning, especially during the hottest days, made the stay uncomfortable. Usually at night, so much so that we spent 2 sleepless nights, only a fan was present, which unfortunately simply moved hot air without offering any real relief. If they cannot install motors for air conditioning, they should organize themselves with other machines that allow one to be comfortable in the room.
Another aspect that we would have liked to know before booking is that, to reach some rooms, the elevator only goes up to the fifth floor: the last floor must be walked with suitcases. It is a detail that may seem secondary, but that would be useful to specify during the booking phase.
For the location it certainly deserves appreciation, but, considering the overall comfort of the room and the services offered, personally I would not choose to stay in this hotel again.

author: Carlos L
title: Centrally located hotel and very cool views
text: Very well-connected hotel, the room was very clean and the staff was very friendly.

author: Connor L
title: Good. The area is exhausting, but you are out and about most of the time anyway.

The room was very clean, and the breakfast was completely sufficient. But there was not a very large buffet selection. Unfortunately, it gets very warm in the room during hot temperatures. There is no air conditioning. I would book this hotel again if I am in Paris once more.

author: Alice K

View of the rooftops of Paris and the Pantheon.
Very warm welcome, staff (both day and night) attentive and extremely kind.

All very well.

author: Anna U

author: Katie Z

author: Marta N

author: Henry M
title: Great hotel to stay!

Hotel Beauvoir is a very nice hotel with absolut friendly staff and in a great location (close to puplic transport, Jardin du Luxembourg etc).
The room was simple but clean with a comfortable bed.

author: Harry N
title: Always a nice experience after multiple stays
text: A nice hotel in the center of Paris, management is very friendly and helpful, it is extremely clean and comfortable. Very nice value considering the location, the proximity to the RER B is a plus. A favorite.

author: Lauren N
title: Excellent!
text: Excellent stay, place in an excellent spot and extremely comfortable.

author: Amelia A
title: Hotel Review
text:
Friendly staff they were very helpful. It is an affordable hotel in a great location. You are right next to Rer Port Royal and a 5 minute walk to the Luxembourg Gardens. Please pack light though and only purchase dry foods. There is no fridge and not much space. 

Everything is cleaned daily.

text: It was very clean hotel, staff were so welcoming and polite. Very close to the metro literally just outside the hotel so convenient if u get the metro pass.

author: Chloe A

author: Abigail Y
title: HOTEL STAY
text:
I had an excellent stay at First Hotel Paris Tour Eiffel, defined by both comfort and exceptional service. Prior to my arrival, the hotel was highly responsive and accommodating regarding my personal needs, which immediately set a reassuring tone for my visit.
From check-in through each day of my stay, the staff consistently delivered a level of professionalism and warmth that is truly uncommon. Every interaction—whether at reception or in the breakfast room—was marked by genuine courtesy and attentiveness.
The room was impeccably clean and well maintained, with efficient air conditioning and fresh, well-prepared breakfast offerings each morning. The hotel’s location is also a standout feature, with convenient metro access directly across the street, making it effortless to navigate the city.
While the rooms reflect the typical, more compact Parisian style, the overall experience is elevated by the hotel’s thoughtful service and prime location. I would gladly return and confidently recommend this hotel to anyone seeking a comfortable and well-managed stay in Paris.

author: William B
title: Paris with family
text: We had an amazing experience at this hotel. WiFi could be a little better but nothing to ruin our trip. Perfect

author: Jack R
title: Good overall
text:
Was a nice hotel beautiful decor in waiting rooms friendly helpful staff with a smile 
Positioned in a good area city centre not to far if hiring a uber
cafes & bakery close by for yr morning 🥐 & ☕️.
Room bed was very comfy & they have windows so u can open for sunny fresh air

author: Mia I
title: Short trip to Paris
text: Good hotel well placed for Eiffel tower

author: Isabella R
title: Lovely hotel. Good location
text:
Lovely hotel. Clean and comfortable.  Had everything you needed. Lovely breakfast.  Very friendly and accommodating staff.
They recommended a great restaurant. Piou. A 2 minute walk from hotel. Great food. Great atmosphere.  Good value too

author: Claire L
title: Convinient small hotel
text: Nice hotel to stay with a friendly staff. Hotel rooms smaller than expected and in a pictures. Even they were small they were very convinient when you only sleep there.

author: Carlos I
title: wonderful
text: Wonderful stay, small but clean room, very friendly staff. I highly recommend,Thank you!

author: Paolo O
title: Super experience
text: The staffs, including the manager were accomodating, friendly, offer help even before and after your stay. The breakfast tastes good and you'll have many options to choose from, whether you're in a hurry or not, you'll surely be full. The location was excellent. The Eiffel Tower can be reached either through the Metro or by foot, and one can have a good picture and memory of it through the window of the hotel. The Metro is just in front so if you have other locations to go, transportation will not be a problem.

author: Liam A
title: Had quite a nice stay
text:
Nice stay at this hotel. The location is very convenient, as there is a metro right outside, which makes it perfect for travelling around the city. The noise levels from this weren’t too bad. You can hear it, and the lift going up and down in the hotel was a bit noisy too, but they were the kind of noises you quickly adjust to and ignore, so they weren’t an issue at all.

We had an Eiffel Tower view room, and the view was really lovely. The tower is over to the left and only about 10 minutes away by metro, or a 20 minute walk. The rooms aren’t huge, but they’re all you need, and they were very clean and tidy too.

My only complaint would be that the room really smelled like toilet water. I almost spoke to someone about it as it was starting to get unbearable, but we weren’t staying for long so I just had to spray perfume regularly. I’m not sure if it was just our room or if there is a wider issue throughout the hotel.

The staff were so lovely, and I appreciated them putting our bags in our room for us while we were out exploring.

We didn’t look around the area near the hotel too much, but there’s a lovely bakery next door.

Overall, I’d consider returning if the smell issue is fixed, because otherwise the hotel was perfect for a city break. Thank you!

author: Luca E
title: Great stay!
text:
I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel and would definitely recommend it. The staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help with any questions. My room was spotless, very clean, and extremely comfortable. The bed in particular was amazing and ensured a great night’s sleep.

One of the biggest advantages of this hotel is its location. There is a metro station right next to the hotel, which made commuting around the city very easy and convenient. Additionally, having a bakery and a pharmacy right nearby was a huge plus and made everything even more accessible.

Overall, my experience was wonderful. I truly enjoyed my stay and would gladly come back again in the future.

author: Juan D
title: A truly wonderful experience!
text:
We stayed at the First Hotel for Valentine's Day weekend. We booked for the view of the Eiffel Tower. And we weren't disappointed: the view is magnificent, the staff very friendly and helpful, and the cleanliness was impeccable.
We also liked the location: not too close to the city center to be chaotic, but not too far to get there. Plus, it's right in front of the metro station. A truly wonderful experience!

author: Ryan P
title: A four star but not up to scratch
text:
Really small bathroom, bathroom sink impossible to use, little cleaning.
The only nice thing is that from the balcony you can see the Eiffel Tower. In general, from a four-star hotel I would expect a greater order and a more accurate cleaning. The carpeting in the room is really unhygienic and in the narrow spaces of the corridor it would be useful to avoid parking the trolleys of the service staff

author: Abigail R
title: A Beautiful Stay
text: I stayed ar this hotel for a trio to Paris with my daughter on her 17th birthday. It was such a lovely stay they were so accommodating and made my daughter feel special such a blessing to have really nice staff members who made us feel welcomed. 7

author: Alice F
title: Great stay, wonderful staff who exemplified great customer service. Thank you!
text:
A well located hotel (opposite a metro line which we never heard but made travelling around incredibly way) with fantastic staff who turned a good stay into an excellent stay. The hotel rooms are of a good size for a short stay,  comfortable etc, good WI-FI, good facilities. 

We were able to leave our bags to explore before we checked in (as we arrived early) and after check out (but before our departure) so we could explore the city some more. The team couldn't have been more accommodating. Every single member of staff we came into contact with was great. Attentive, polite, friendly, knowledgeable. We would happily stay here again as a family of 4. Breakfast was good, there was a comfortable lounge/ area where we sat, on a couple of occasions but that stand out was how great the staff are. Thank you!

author: Connor D
title: What can I say...
text:
Warm but worrying welcome, indeed the receptionist warned us to be very careful in Rome and in the surroundings of the hotel, that many people are strange.
Moreover, the hotel is strange... a boutique hotel should offer its decoration items for sale... but here no items for sale, and besides no decor!
The rooms are large but you will hear everything that happens in the other rooms, as well as on the street. Knowing that there are many strange people around the hotel, the noise coming from the street is constant, night and day.
If you go there anyway, take shampoo and soap because those provided by the hotel are only in name, here again they are strange products.

author: Daisy H
title: Great value near Termini
text:
Stayed at Yes Hotel on a recent Rome trip and had a lovely experience. The room was cozy, clean, and comfortable, everything you need without unnecessary frills. Perfect base for exploring the city.

Location is a big plus: about a 5-minute walk to Roma Termini train station, which made arrivals, departures, and day trips incredibly easy.

Breakfast is available as an add-on for an extra 9 euro and worth it — good spread, tasty options, and a nice way to start the day before heading out.

One small heads-up: the walls are a bit thin, so if you're a light sleeper, pack earplugs or request a quieter room when booking. Otherwise, friendly staff, easy check-in, and solid value for money. Would happily stay again.

author: Laura T
title: Great location and value
text:
A short walk from the Uniqlo at Termini, makes for an excellent sight seeing hub. Jeannetta was the most helpful concierge I have ever encountered. She gave us our choice of room, suggested restaurants and put us at ease.
The area can seem sketchy for inexperienced travellers, but the hotel is clean, safe and comfortable.
The rooms were perfect for our needs. We were not in Rome to sit in a room. The a/c was actually among the best we experienced.

author: Harper O
title: Great Stay
text: My wife and I celebrated our silver wedding anniversary with a four day accommodation in the yes hotel boutique-Rome which was truly first class and everything we wanted. A truly enjoyable stay accompanied with very friendly and helpful staff like jonas but special mention to Juliet who was absolutely wonderful and feel as if shes become a good friend which we will definitely hope to see again in the near future xx

author: Jack Q

The staff is very polite and nice.

Yes I would absolutely recommend.

author: Lauren T
title: Great Hotel

The hotel is spotless and the room are well equipped and beds comfy, and in a great location close to Termini station so we could access the hop on hop off busses with ease. Julieta also helped us when we forgot to take our passport on a trip and immediately sent a picture of it. Her recommendation of the Bramble restaurant was also perfect. All in all a great stay

author: Chloe N
title: Very comfortable

author: Laura T
title: Excellent hotel!
text: I have loved this hotel! The staff is very efficient, proactive, and friendly. The hotel's location is very good and the room we stayed in was very comfortable. We will stay at this hotel again if we return to Rome.

author: Nora V
title: Tremendous hotel with a very kind staff
text: When I come to Rome, this is the hotel that I stay.  Well maintained hotel located close to the train station.  The rooms are modern and the air conditioning is terrific. This is a smoke free hotel and it is very safe. The area is full of restaurants and there are lots of things to do.  The hotel is very clean and the cleaning staff do an incredible job. The front desk staff goes above and beyond, they are very welcoming and friendly.

author: Holly E
title: Wonderful city break
text: We stayed at Yes Boutique Hotel end of July for four nights and had a fantastic stay, please do not judge the hotel from the outside as it doesn't do it justice, we stayed in room 216 on second floor and on reading previous reviews from the hotel about bathroom shower we were unsure what we were arriving to but honestly it was a large walk in shower and had every thing you needed for a city break the room had no outlook as it faced out to a court yard which didnt look good but we were there in 40 degree heat so windows shutters and blinds were kept closed for the air conditioning which was an asset. The room had a small fridge which was handy for storing water and fresh juice but not much else, the bed was big and due to heat only a top sheet cover which again was ample, if you were in the uk I think you would describe it as a premier inn but in better condition. The hotel did serve breakfast and had a bar we didnt use either so cant comment  on them reception is open 24hrs and the lady who checked us in gave us all the information we needed for trips etc, the hotel is 5min from main train station which had shops and a massive food court which was amazing, we would definitely use the hotel again if we we were ever to return.

author: Aaron Z
title: Excellent!

author: Oscar V
title: Close to Roma terminal

author: Aiden H
title: Kind Staff, Great Location, and a Comfortable Stay
text:
We stayed here both before and after our Mediterranean cruise and would happily stay here again. The staff was consistently kind and welcoming, and the location was excellent. Being within walking distance of Roma Termini made it incredibly convenient for arriving from the airport, exploring Rome, and catching the train to Civitavecchia for our cruise.

The room was comfortable, and the hotel was a great home base for our time in Rome.

The only downside for us was the shower. The bathroom itself was compact, which we expected, but the shower was exceptionally small. While I was able to manage, it was a tight fit, and my wife had a much more difficult time. Fortunately, the handheld showerhead made it much easier to use. It wasn't enough to detract from an otherwise wonderful stay, but it's something larger travelers may want to keep in mind.

author: Ian B
title: Great stay - would definitely recommend!
text: Great location. Staff are lovely and so helpful and the rooms are lovely and clean with great air conditioning!

author: Michael N
title: A Very welcoming hotel
text:
Lovely friendly hotel very helpful staff,gave advice about the sites and restaurants in Rome.
The hotel was spotless.

author: Lucy N
title: Exceptional Stay with Outstanding Staff
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (10/10)

We had an excellent stay at Yes Hotel in Rome during the first week of June, and I highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city.

From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel welcome. They took their time to explain everything, gave us useful information about the surrounding area, and provided clear directions on how to get to the main attractions. Their kindness and professionalism really stood out.

Not only was the reception staff exceptional, but the housekeeping team was also wonderful. Everyone greeted us with a genuine smile and made us feel comfortable throughout our stay. If I remember correctly, one of the receptionists was named Isabella, and she was especially friendly and helpful.

The room was beautiful, cozy, spotless, and very comfortable. The hotel's location is another major advantage. It is close to the metro and train station, making it easy to get around Rome and visit all the main sights.

Overall, everything exceeded our expectations. I will definitely recommend Yes Hotel to my family and friends if they ever visit Rome. This hotel truly deserves 5 stars and a perfect 10/10!

author: James E
title: Inconsistent staff service, good room.
text: Inconsistent staff hospitality and attention, when we first checked in, they were trying to scam us from the city tax! One of our kids was under 10, you dont have to pay a tax for under ten, but they claimed under 4 was free! Seemed deliberate… The room and atmosphere was good overall. I recommend this hotel to people without kids, as it is not a big room.

author: Marco H
title: Highly Recommend
text:
A fantastic find in Rome!

The hotel location is excellent, just a short walk from Termini Station, making it ideal for exploring the city and for easy transfers to and from the airport.

The rooms are clean, spacious and tastefully decorated. We stayed in the quadruple room, which had a king size bed and two full size single beds, perfect for a family of four with two teenagers.

The staff were friendly and welcoming throughout our stay. A special mention goes to the lovely receptionist, who remained cheerful and unfazed even when our group of 15 arrived several hours early with a mountain of luggage!

I have stayed in three hotels in Rome over the past two years and the Yes Hotel offers the best overall combination of value, location and room quality. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

author: Noah P
title: Short stay in Rome
text: Honestly such a lovely little hotel. Well located, lovely rooms and the staff are amazing. Nice cheap breakfast and plenty around you as well. Would highly recommend.

author: Sophia T
title: Room problems, double costs, and no accommodation
text: After changing rooms twice due to smoke and crawling insects, no other 3-bed room could be offered to us; we were supposed to be split up. The air conditioning reached 57 dB. We refused and preferred to change hotels, and now we are not getting our money back. Booking is now fighting on our side; there is no accommodation from the hotel, they want to keep all the money even though we are not sleeping there, resulting in double costs for us and one day out of 4 in Rome lost. So if something goes wrong at this hotel, you are on your own.

author: Lauren A
title: Never again – absolutely no recommendation! Animals in the room!
text:
Our stay as a family at this hotel was a complete disappointment and unfortunately significantly impacted our Rome vacation.

The biggest problem was the broken air conditioning – and that with an outside temperature of 38 degrees in Rome. Even more absurd, however, was that the air conditioning could not even be controlled by the guests themselves. If you wanted to turn it on or off or even just change the temperature, you had to write to a person via WhatsApp every single time, since the reception is not staffed in the evening. I have never experienced anything like this in any hotel.

In addition, the air conditioning was extremely loud at night at about 60 dB. Getting a restful night's sleep was completely out of the question. The constant humming was unbearable and hardly let us get any rest.

Immediately after our arrival, we had to change rooms because the first room smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. Unfortunately, the new room was hardly any better. Instead of a professional solution, a manager came with a handyman who talked to him in the bathroom with the door closed and discussed something in there. The entire appearance seemed completely unprofessional and untrustworthy.

In general, the hotel makes a very run-down impression. The bathroom in particular was in poor condition. Doors and door frames were damaged, the trash can was heavily rusted and extremely unhygienic. There were stains everywhere, which reinforced the impression of a lack of cleanliness.

It was particularly disgusting that several animals crawled out of the door frame and then ran across the entire bathroom floor. One does not expect something like this even in a simple hotel. Several videos were recorded of this. 

Even worse, however, was how problems were handled. The person at the front desk explained to us multiple times that they were not responsible for anything and could neither make decisions nor solve problems. Supposedly, only management would take care of it – but they were simply unreachable. Even after over 24 hours, we had received no feedback or support whatsoever.

Even the first room change due to the strong smell of cigarettes was only possible after a long discussion. Even after that, no one felt responsible for fixing the numerous defects or taking care of the guests. On the contrary: The treatment of the guests was consistently unfriendly, unhelpful, and completely without any accommodation.

Ultimately, we felt forced to leave the hotel early at our own expense, as the conditions were no longer acceptable for us. Despite the significant defects, there was no accommodation whatsoever, neither in the form of a solution nor compensation or even a sincere apology. Ice-cold, explicit refusal of a hotel refund. The staff was practically unreachable, and if someone was on-site, no one could or would take responsibility.

Overall, this was one of the worst hotel experiences we have ever had. Defective and uncontrollable air conditioning, unbearable noise, lack of cleanliness, animals in the bathroom, management that was practically unreachable, and a completely missing service mentality – we absolutely cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Julien M
title: 100% would recommend.
text:
Stayed at Hotel Marisa for 4 nights up to 14th July 2026. Location was ideal only a couple of minutes walk from the Termini train station in Rome. It's about 30 minutes walk from the main attractions in Rome but it was very hot so we used the Metro, which you can pick up at the Termini. 

We stayed in the annex building which was about a 300m walk through the streets to the back of the building. There is a very small lift to the 4th floor that looks a bit ropey but is also a bit like the ones you see in old movies. The room was very clean and most importantly of all had excellent air con (vital for the summer months). Wifi was good. The towels were changed every day.

We only had breakfast 1 of the mornings and that was nice, good value for 10€ a nice selection of fruit pastries, cereals, bread eggs & bacon.

Staff were really friendly and helpful.

author: Lily S
title: Hotel well located but very simple.
text:
Very simple hotel with very small rooms, very small bed and very small dark bath area. 

The pillows were very low and the average bed, which is worth it is the location in front of the TERMINI metro and train station, a supermarket in front and still can make many sights walking.

author: Andrea U
title: Wonderful 3-night stay
text: We have spent 3 nights at Marisa hotel, it is a charming hotel with perfect location near Termini. The rooms are spacey, well air-conditioned and windows are excellently preventing the noises from the street. We had breakfast, it has a good variety of food and the staff, especially Julio, is very friendly.

author: Isla B
title: Nice hotel in Rome; great location
text: The hotel was in a very convenient location near the train station - easy to find and easy to get to.  Aso, plenty of good restaurants in the area. We spent our time in Rome walking to all the attractions from the hotel. The room was clean and nice, and we also took advantage of a free hotel provided tour around the city (tour guide was very informative and friendly). Our room was spacious for 4 people, though one note is that the shower itself was very small.

author: Kyle H
title: Excellent

Friendly and professional staff.
I recommend it.

author: Camille C
title: Thank you

author: Ethan K
title: A splendid stay; one feels at home!
text: I stayed at Hotel Marisa for a few days and was pleasantly surprised by the warm welcome. The staff is uniquely kind, always smiling and very helpful with any advice about the area. The room was spotless, cozy, and equipped with all the necessary comforts for relaxation. Kudos for the breakfast: varied, abundant, and with very fresh pastries. The location is convenient for getting around, and the atmosphere is truly relaxing. I will definitely return! I highly recommend it to everyone.

author: Ethan O

author: Erin R
title: Rome at its best
text: Hotel Marisa was perfect for our 4 day stay in Rome.  Being centrally situated opposite the main train, bus and metro terminus, access was easy.  There are many different restaurants and cafes within walking distance, all offering delicious cuisine.  Staff are friendly and rooms clean and comfortable.

author: Evie V
title: Unfortunate
text:
I don’t usually leave bad reviews, but unfortunately our experience here was disappointing.
When we arrived, we were told our room was actually in a different building a few minutes away from the main hotel. Normally this wouldn’t have been a huge issue, but we were travelling with a baby and a lot of extra luggage. I specifically booked this hotel because of the convenience of it being directly across from the train station, so it would have been nice to know ahead of time that we would be staying elsewhere.
The shower was also a problem. The floor doesn’t properly keep the water contained, so after only a couple of minutes the bathroom floor floods and you have to stop using the water. When we went downstairs to speak with staff, the response felt dismissive. There wasn’t much of an apology, and we were simply told someone could come look at it the next morning.
We also had family staying in the main building who mentioned the walls were extremely thin, so if you are hoping for a quiet night’s sleep, this may not be the best choice.
Overall, there were just too many inconveniences for us to comfortably recommend staying here.

author: Charlie Q
title: Overall experience

Daily breakfast OK, the kitchen Staff/servers were very helpful & super friendly & better than the front desk.
