author: Harper R
title: A guarantee in Rome
text: I have been several times to Hotel Marisa in Roma Termini and every stay is better than the past. The staff at the Reception and in the breakfast room is knowledgeable, friendly and welcoming, the rooms are comfortable and well appointed and the hotel in general is really a guarantee, both for short stays and holidays. I'll keep coming back!

author: Pablo P
title: Awful
text: I booked my room for the wrong year, my mistake, completely I understand that, as we were informed upon arrival. The front desk staff did assist in finding another room for us with ease. That is where the good stopped. They have almost a year to rebook these rooms and are refusing to refund me. The shower was leaky and had mold spots and the beds were terribly uncomfortable. Also the lack of control of the heating and cooling in the room. Upon arrival there were two people at the front desk neither of whom offered to help us entering or getting our luggage in they just stared while me and the seventy years olds I was with struggled. Breakfast was adequate at best. It is convenient to the main train station

author: Jack Q
title: Excellent Hotel in the center of Rome
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Marisa two nights, including one night with our Golden Retriever. 

We were assigned, at our request, the Family Room located on the ground floor. 

The rooms are very large, clean and comfortable, pet-friendly hotel (no small thing!) and very kind and helpful reception staff. 

The hotel is a 3-minute walk from the Roma Termini Station exit in Via Marsala.

The hotel does not have its own private parking but in front of it there is the Ferrovie dello Stato parking lot which is accessible even to those who do not travel by train, the cost is 30 € per day. 

Breakfast must be booked the night before for the next morning as the room is not particularly large... The buffet is not particularly rich but what is presnete is good.

Being very close to Roma Termini railway station, the hotel is perfectly connected to other areas of Rome thanks to tram, bus and metro A/B connections

---
Also, I would like to thank Mr. Matteo of the reception for the extreme kindness and promptness in solving problems even after the stay ended. We realized that the fee for the dog had been charged twice, once pointed out and recognized the error Mr. Matteo proceeded to cancel the extra amount despite being back in Naples

author: Diego I
title: Great breakfast staff, great location but noisy
text:
We booked the hotel for the location, and it was a great location, but it’s extremely noisy at night. We knew from the reviews that other people have struggled with the noise level, but having stayed in the middle of the Las Vegas Strip, we don’t usually mind a bit of noise but this was next level. We were kept awake until gone midnight (by other people’s rooms) and were woken up by 5am by the traffic, trains and emergency services. Having said all this, it’s not necessarily the hotel’s fault but the sound proofing could be better. 

Aside from this, you get what you pay for. The room and bathroom was fine. Not quite as modern as it looks in the pictures but nice enough. Despite advertising air conditioning in every room, we were told by reception that Rome don’t put their air conditioning on until the summer but we had to spend at least two hours with the windows open cooling the room down so we could sleep and because of the noise level outside, we couldn’t sleep with the windows open. Again, this isn’t the hotel’s fault but it would have been good to know on arrival or when booking. 

Based on previous reviews, we decided to opt for breakfast and we weren’t disappointed. There’s a good variety of food and drinks but these don’t change daily. The staff at breakfast, especially Guilliano, were amazing and definitely made our stay! If my review was just on Guilliano’s hospitality, it would be 5 star every time! He definitely boosted my rating. 

The reception staff were welcoming and helpful. On check in, they informed us that we had to book a slot for breakfast each morning, which was a good system. They also told us about the great free workshops that are offered. They didn’t tell us about the roof terrace that the hotel has - we only found out about this from another guest on check out. We were really lucky that the weather was nice whilst we were in Rome and we definitely would have utilised it if we had known. 

Overall, I would say this hotel is in a great location for exploring room and is fine for one or two nights - definitely pack ear plugs - and definitely choose breakfast!

author: Juan A
title: Great experience
text: Enjoyed my stay. The staff were very friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout my visit. The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, which made the stay very pleasant. Everything was well organised, and I appreciated the helpful service and overall atmosphere. I would happily stay here again.

author: Nora Q
title: Great London Location
text:
Hotel was a great Central location within walking distance from Euston, St Pancras and King's Cross stations and underground. Easily able to leave cases at hotel for free. Staff were really nice during stay. Room was clean and spacious. Had everything we needed and would expect. 
Breakfast and night meal was lovely, no issues. 
Saw ironboard and irons available incase anyone needed them during their stay.
Only issue I had was I like the option of taking the stairs. This hotel the main room stairs go up through the back of the restaurant. Which I understand wanting to keep strangers out the hotel as you need a card to use the lifts. But it made using the stairs abit of a pain as they only went to reception area.
Will be using this hotel again. Overall great experience.

author: Alexander I
title: Could do better
text:
Although the reception worked well and the staff on arrival were accommodating it became increasingly obvious that either the place was short staffed or there was some major management issues at play during breakfast.
Over three day stay there was a general lack of plates, bowls, cups, cutlery, clean tables, coffee and milk. The staff in the breakfast room just didn't seem to care and there was certainly a lack of urgency in the service overall.
Even on our arrival at the hotel trying to get lunch was difficult with a non working coffee machine and getting charged extra for crisps which it actually stated on the menu as included. 
We have stayed at other Premier Inns and never experienced such awful service.
The positives were that the room was a decent size and the bed really comfy - note this was nothing to do with the staff.

author: Alice X
title: Nelson and the staff are great!
text:
We stayed for 4nights this week and I wanted to praise the staff we’ve met, from the bar to the restaurant and the housekeepers who came to refresh our room! You were all so accommodating and happy, especially Nelson who we met during breakfast! It was such a busy morning with obvious staffing/kitchen issues but Nelson was so kind and helpful even when some disgruntled guest were complaining about no plates/bowls/mugs and how slow food was replenished. It was not directly the staff’s fault, and through so many complaints Nelson still smiled, welcomed families and children with enthusiasm and really is an asset to the hotel!
If only other guests were as kind as the staff, when there were obvious issues that they were trying hard to work through! 
And honestly… waiting a few extra minutes for an egg and a sausage shouldn’t upset people as much as it does!! 
Thanks Nelson and all the staff, keep doing what you’re doing!

author: Miguel I
title: Good, Bad and Ugly
text: The people that work in this hotel are super friendly, easy to approach and nothing is too much. Met by Redae who quickly had us checked in and on our way to our room to rest, he also ensured we had a table booked for our tea.  Service for our food was also amazing Jannat seemed to be so busy but was attentive and again willing to help. The hotel however is very dated, you roll together in the beds, the bathroom is all stained and dated and the room had a strange musty smell, but you get used to that quite quickly.

author: Michael V
title: A lovely stay
text: Another lovely stay at premier inn. Receptionist was so very friendly and helpful, the room was clean, fresh, comfortable, and quiet. We had a very good night thank you. Highly recommended.

author: Lea A
title: Do not buy a Meal Deal - terrible experience at dinner and breakfast
text:
Even though we had paid for the meal deal, we were not told that it is still compulsory to make a reservation for dinner beforehand. We were not told this.

At 6pm, my son went ahead of us to the restaurant and was told that they could only accommodate us at 7pm. He said he would ask his parents if that was ok. 5 minutes later when he returned, he was told that the earliest was now 8pm. We got there hungry at 8pm and waited about 40 minutes for someone to take our order. Then we waited an even longer time for our food to arrive. This was despite asking the waiter about 10 times to please bring our food. We were told that there were 2 large groups ahead of us. Our dinner finally arrived at about 10pm. This left us no time to explore London, as we were leaving the following morning for Wales. 

The staff was apologetic. They asked if we had prepaid for our meal. When we said yes, they said that in that case all they could do was offer us free desert. My wife took one. 

Breakfast was complete chaos. When I arrived, there were empty tables available, but they were all full of dirty dishes from the previous guests. There was 1 lady cleaning the tables, but as soon as 1 table was cleaned, it was grabbed by 1 of the many guests trying to get a table. Had there been more staff available to clean the tables, this would not have happened. 

There were not enough plates or bowels available. Every time a staff member would bring a few clean plates (usually 4 at a time), it was immediately grabbed by whichever guest was closest. One lady said she had come 4 times to the food section, and each time there were no plates or bowels available. 
One staff member was clever enough to bring me a paper cup, as there were no coffee cups available. It was total chaos because the very few staff that were there, could simply not cope with so many people.  

We will never ever return to a Premier Inn hotel. You totally messed up our 1 night in London.

author: Erin W
title: Clean
text: Romm is spacious and big -love it with my wife

author: Oliver D
title: Good location hotel
text: Nice hotel, good facsilities  helpfull staff, right location for all westend shows. Good sized rooms and plenty of lifts.

author: Ella D
title: Not the best Premier Plus rooms we have been in
text: The Premier Plus roms are located on Floor 6. Perhasp the water pump up to that floor wasn't powerful enough but the shower strenght was poor to start with but after 3-4 minutes settled down into a "good" strength. The "Ultimate" wi fi was inconsistent and usually took 3 -4 attempts to get online each day. Otherwise, fine.

author: Samuel U
title: Superb hotel
text:
Really great stay at this hotel; I recommend it 200%.
Super well located right next to the train station and the subway, 20 minutes on foot from the center, perfect bedding, very practical and clean room, top-notch breakfast, super easy check-in and friendly staff, possibility to leave luggage for free upon departure and arrival! 
In short, if we have to return to London, we would return there!

author: Samuel C
title: CHANGE THE CARPET TO HARDWOOD
text:
1. Great Location
2. Great in house bar/lounge
3. Small City Hotel Rooms
4.  Rooms are not Large same as number 3
5. Set for a transition not for a long stay
6. PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE CHANGE THE CARPET TO HARDWOOD!! It looks so dated and run down.
7. Alexandra (I am sorry if I miss the name) is the amazing human with others at this hotel.
It is a transition hotel for the traveler who just wants to sleep and go.
But also grab a great beer and chat.

author: Emma B
title: Good stay
text:
Very good!
- Hotel near the train station and public transportation. Quiet, well soundproofed.
- Clean, air-conditioned, well-equipped, and quiet room.
- Decent breakfast but the staff lacks speed, few dishes available. Long wait times.
- Very pleasant staff

author: Henry E
title: Nice
text: Wonderful service by the receptionist

author: Laura J
title: Weekend theatre break
text:
Booked this hotel to stay whilst in London for some theatre shows. We travelled in by train to Euston and had a nice 10 min stroll to the hotel from there. We had booked early check in to make the most of our stay and so check in was very fast and efficient. You need to take the lift from the entrance up to the first floor to check in. The room was exactly what we had booked, large bed and two singles to accommodate our group of 2 adults and 2 teens. The whole of the hotel was very clean and tidy and smelt fresh. We enjoyed the booked breakfast, especially with the teenagers qualifying for the free breakfast, take note of the advised  busy times, these were accurate and there is more people around the food and drink areas, we waited longer for the pastries to be restocked. The only criticism with the restaurant was their menu times. We arrived at 4:20pm to order from the daytime menu, which stated availability until 5pm, the member of staff who greeted us also said available until 5pm but when ordering at the bar, was told we couldn’t order from that full menu, this meant we had to change some of our choices. 
Overall, a great stay, and would definitely book again.

author: Rosie X
title: Good experience
text:
I aways use Premier Inns when I go away
The staff are  helpful the rooms are clean and the breakfast are always good 
But who ever put the new shower door on didn't fit it right its upside down and the wrong way round putting the handle in the shower please check the rooms  making sure the work men have done their job properly

author: Grace K
title: Top-notch staff
text: We had a very good stay at the Premier Inn Saint Pancras. The hotel is very well located if you arrive by Eurostar. The rooms are clean and spacious. The bedding is comfortable and you can get a family room for 4 if you are traveling with family. A big thank you to Precious, Ameh, Nestor, Bill, Denisa, and Aster for their welcome and their availability and for their kindness when we needed something or for the breakfast service. Without them our stay would have been less pleasant. Thanks again!

author: Evan X
title: Location & Affordability in central London
text: Located only 200 meters from St Pancras train station, this is an excellent hotel to begin your journey in London.  Super friendly staff, notably Fahim and others, who willingly assist you with an early check-in, though many of the staff are over-tasked with too many duties.  Very clean, comfortable, quiet rooms in the rear of hotel.  Continental self-serve breakfast is well stocked.  Best of all is the room price in a very expensive London town.

author: Daisy R
title: A perfect stay.
text:
À great location. Early check in which was much appreciated. friendly available staff and a great room. Great beds and a fantastic breakfast. Then made use of the baggage drop.
It all made a perfect stay.

author: Charlotte A
title: Hotel review
text: atmosphere was lovely, staff members Jannat & Bilal were amazing & helpful, would visit again.

author: Katie A
title: Very nice abd cleab hotel, staff very kind, easy access to city center with bus
text: Hotel rooms was very big, comfy bed, very clean, free access to Spa center, available parking and very good assortiments for breakfast

author: Liam A
location: National Capital Territory of Delhi, India
title: Modern hotel with a great bar
text:
If you want bigger rooms with great service, stay here. We were offered complimentary drinks at the bar and the bartender made great drinks. We had issues with the room AC and the staff promptly upgrade a triple room with 2 rooms.
Location is good with local restaurants and supermarket nearby.

author: Ethan S
title: Perfect stay.
text:
The structure is definitely huge, but despite this, it is not overwhelming and is actually welcoming and hospitable.  Just 10 minutes by taxi from Piazza Navona, so the location is convenient. 

Spacious, clean, and comfortable rooms. We took one with a balcony, and the outdoor space is very large and pleasant, 
despite the view not being the best because it overlooks an abandoned area. 

Very good food (varied breakfast of decent quality), excellent bar with cold dishes and tasty snacks, well-maintained and quality restaurant. 

Brand new spa area, well-equipped and perfect for a relaxing break. 

Indoor parking, covered, included in the price, is spacious and easily accessible. 

The highlight: the staff is extremely courteous, available, professional, and well-prepared. Both at the reception and in the dining area. Truly everyone is impeccable. 

Pets are allowed and especially welcomed without any additional charge. 

Highly recommended.

author: Evie F
title: Great for business in the EUR area.
text: Unexpectedly elegant, spacious rooms, quiet large bathroom, and truly professional staff. Breakfast is also good. A little far from the metro.

author: Andrea Q
title: I felt important!
text:
The 5-star rating is thanks to the staff who, from check-in to check-out, were extremely kind and made me feel important. Large and spacious structure, fantastic room in terms of size and functionality. They granted me an upgrade and I found fresh fruit and wine in my room. Complete breakfast that can satisfy everyone; a gem that is rarely seen anymore: a coffee machine like in a café with a barista included!!! 
Strategic location for my tastes, parking included. I will definitely return next time. Congratulations to everyone.

author: Manon M
title: A hotel with an unforgivable lack.
text: The hotel is very convenient for those arriving by car: it is easily accessible and has free parking. I stayed for 4 days; the room was comfortable and welcoming, as was the spacious and functional bathroom. No noticeable noise from other rooms and a quiet area. Adequate breakfast, as well as the restaurant. The staff was exceptionally kind beyond expectations. It would have been perfect, a full 5-star experience, but neither the restaurant nor the breakfast room provided disposable paper placemats on the tables; there was a paper napkin with the cutlery, but not even a measly paper placemat, the kind that costs 2 cents: therefore, anything (the cutlery while in use, but also part of the food) had to be placed directly on the table, which is absolutely unhygienic. In all the years I have traveled to hotels for work, I have never encountered, not even in a diner, a place without a paper placemat: this is not a luxury but an absolutely basic hygiene issue. In a 4-star hotel, this is an unforgivable lack.

author: Ethan I
title: Could be improved
text: Modern and well-maintained hotel. The common areas are spacious and clean. I had the opportunity to attend it during a conference and I found it quite good. The conference room is very spacious and the public restrooms are well maintained. Overall a good facility, perhaps a bit below the four stars assigned. For the rest, nothing else to say.

author: Morgan C
title: Very clean.  Amazing staff
text: Stayed in April 2026.  Very clean, room was spacious and the bed was comfy.  Not sure about the large light up mirror at the end of the bed that felt a bit kinky.   The staff on reception were super friendly and very helpful.  Namely Alexandra and Daniella.   Honest value for the area.

author: Sara Y
title: Roman weekend
text:
We spent a weekend in this hotel. I state that I travel often and I am particularly attentive to detail.

The junior suite was equipped with the right amenities and well cleaned. The only negative note is the bathtub with integrated shower: a solution that is now outdated and impractical, especially for access.

Breakfast varied and hearty, both sweet and savory. However, the total lack of attention to those who follow a vegetarian diet or have specific needs is surprising: no alternatives such as vegetable cheeses (like Philadelphia), coconut or almond milk, chia seeds and vegetable yogurt.

Overall the stay was pleasant, but for a structure of this level you expect more attention to detail and more inclusiveness in the offer.

author: George J
title: Relaxation
text:
Wonderful hotel, fantastic staff, great menu and especially cleanliness.
I highly recommend the rooms are gorgeous

author: Sean R
title: Excellent
text:
With immense pleasure I wish to dedicate these words to Alessandro from the reception of the Precise House Mantegna Roma.

His attention was felt from the first contact, already at the time of booking: an authentic kindness, never built, that made me feel welcomed even before arriving.

Live confirmed everything and even more. He is delicate in manner, attentive, professional, but above all deeply empathetic. He has a rare ability to understand who is in front of him, to make you comfortable naturally. And to this sensitivity he combines a jovial, bright trait, which makes the welcome even more pleasant and true.

It is not just efficiency or courtesy: it is presence, it is care, it is humanity. In a sector where automation is often at risk, Alessandro represents a precious and increasingly rare value.
It is the kind of meeting that remains, and that makes the difference in a living room. Sincere congratulations for the heart and professionalism he puts into his work.
Thank you very much.

author: Molly H
title: Perfect.
text: Live up to expectations.... cozy and comfortable rooms, international breakfast of excellent quality and wide choice. Friendly staff... special mention for the kindness of the cute Giulia.

author: Rosie O
title: Love Roma
text: The hotel is lovely inside. The staff are helpful and friendly. Areas close by for the essentials. I enjoyed everywhere I went.

author: Ian G
title: Excellent holiday
text: The hotel was very nice and quiet. The breakfast was hot and delicious. The staff was super friendly. Very clean room and accommodations. Daniela was extremely helpful and nice. She made us feel like family. Thank you for a wonderful stay.

author: Sophia A
title: Great stay in
text: Great stay in this hotel located in a residential area in the south of Rome. Very attentive and smiling staff. Clean rooms and rich and varied breakfast. Connected to the center by bus 160 (stop at the hotel entrance ). In the area various good quality restaurants.

author: Wyatt L
title: ALL PERFECT
text: We stayed in Rome in this really crazy hotel. In addition to being super modern, you are greeted by a spectacular scent already upon arrival in the lobby. The staff is very polite and always available. The rooms are spacious, spotless and with every detail taken care of. I highly recommend, really nice staff.

author: Louis L
title: Very good
text: Elegant and well-kept environment, courteous and efficient staff, excellent breakfast: fresh and fragrant desserts. Pampered and satisfied, helpful staff. Thank you Daniela

author: George P
title: Immaculate in Rome
text:
The hotel is very large and very modern 
the clean rooms and
spacious equipped with every comfort 
breakfast is abundant with sweet and savory variety 
all excellent and quality 
kindness and courtesy are the main components of this hotel but not obvious
All top.

author: Molly B
title: Perfect stay for the family
text: My wife and I had such a great stay here. Extremely accommodating especially for our bringing our small child. We had many requests and front desk did it with a smile and professionalism. Rooms were clean and perfect! Also HIGHLY recommend the breakfast.

author: Marco S
title: Fabulous
text:
Our stay was fabulous and amazing , the location was very convenient , the staff was very friendly and helpful. Everything was perfect , defenitely will come back again and recommend to my friends . 
Thank you 💛

author: Henry E
title: Charming and Clean Hotel in a Great Rome Location
text: This was a very clean and charming hotel in the Trastevere part of Rome. The hotel staff was extremely helpful and kind. The area has many smaller and medium sized restaurants and is well located on the west side of the Tiber river. A less crowded area, but very charming and full of great restaurants. The hotel was very clean, great A/C, a wonderful staff and a fair price.

author: Joseph T
title: An amazing place in the heart of Trastevere!
text: Residenza San Calisto is simply living the authentic experience in Trastevere: charming, warm, welcoming! Super clean, super well located, and the staff is extremely helpful! Their recommendations are amazing for restaurants, activities... don't forget to check their wine cellar! A treasure!;)

author: Nora A
title: 100% recommended
text:
​The Residencia San Calixto is a gem in the heart of Trastevere that combines comfort, historic charm, and exquisite service. Located in a serene square in the middle of Trastevere, it offers the perfect balance between rest and proximity to the city's main points of interest.
Highlights:
- Strategic location: quiet area
- Ten out of ten service: An impeccable, attentive, and welcoming team that makes you feel at home from the moment you arrive. 
​- Comfort and charm: Impeccable and clean rooms. 

​Five-star accommodation that I will undoubtedly return to. 100% recommended!

author: Jessica Q
title: Lovely stay that I'll happily repeat
text: I traveled to Trastevere with my family to attend an academic conference. The staff were so warm and welcoming. They communicated with me a few days before departure to prepare me for checkin, which made traveling into Trastevere so easy. The room was spacious, quiet, clean, and cool, especially considering the heat wave the city was experience. The staff cleaned are room everyday! I know others mentioned it, but the intentionality of maintaining a clean welcoming space was so amazing after a long, hot day walking around. We were even greeted with complimentary wine! This was especially nice since our schedules didn't allow us to make it to Fabullus. The location is ideal for walking to so many major attractions. The restaurants, cafes, and piazzas nearby were fun to explore as well. We will happily stay here again! Thank you all for a lovely stay.

author: Sydney I
title: Solo holiday at Trastevere
text: Hotel is at great location with lots of good bars and restaurants nearby. Rooms are well maintained and clean. Air conditioning was working fine and is must during mid summer. Helpful staff helped me to find thing to do that were suited personally for me.

author: Leo Y
title: Excellent
text: Great location, very helpful host and very happy with the room.

author: Aaron J
title: Hidden gem in Trastevere
text: I would definitely recommend staying at this hotel! The staff were friendly from the beginning. We were going to be arriving late and they made sure we had all the info needed for a self check in. As far as location, you couldn’t be in a better spot. Trastevere has so many good restaurants all within walking distance from the hotel. You’re not too far from the big sites either. A huge plus having stayed in July was the air conditioning. It worked great and kept our room cool which was a welcome respite from the heat outside. I would totally stay here again next time I’m in Rome!

author: Isla R
title: Great Stay!
text: Alessia was incredibly friendly and helpful throughout our entire stay. We enjoyed our time and would definitely stay here again! The location is perfect for exploring Trastavere!

author: Mathis D
title: Brilliant hotel
text: Very beautiful hotel in the heart of Travestere but away from the crowds and noise. The hotel staff couldn’t do enough for us and were very responsive even during their out of office hours. If we go back to Rome, we’ll definitely be staying here again.

author: Ethan M
title: Great classic hotel and very well located in Trastevere. Our little family loved it and the staff was attentive.
text: Great classic hotel and very well located in Trastevere. Our little family loved it and the staff was attentive.

author: Sofia I
title: Great Stay
text: Had a wonderful stay at Residenza San Callisto.  The staff were all very kind, genuine, and accommodating and the hotel itself is spacious (our 2nd story room was) and comfortable.  It’s more of a BnB so not a true chain hotel, but it makes the experience much better that way.  It’s also in a fantastic location within Trestavere.

author: Nora W
title: Excellent base for family trip, but would also stay with friends
text: Excellent base for family trip to Rome. We were there for 3 nights in the middle of Italian holiday. The room was spotless and the beds were really comfortable. Our kids are 13 and 11 and the bunks were perfect and would accommodate adults too. Plenty of space, including a wardrobe and changing area with plug sockets as you enter the room, meaning we werent on top of each other getting ready. The location was perfect, near bars and restaurants and lovely atmosphere at night. Despite this, our room was so quiet and we all slept great. Our room overlooked the internal courtyard area so was quite dark on first impressions, but actually we were glad of it to escape the heat of the day. The air con worked really well too. We loved it and will stay again, its a find. I shpuld also add that we felt really safe in the neighbourhood with our kids too.

author: Louis P
title: Great stay
text: Wonderful stay a little off the beaten path in Trastavere, beautiful room,  great daily room service and within walking distance to anything you want to see.  Highly recommend!

author: Rosie X
title: Great stay in Trastevere
text: Really nice and cozy little hotel in Trastevere, perfect location, walking distance to almost everything. Highly recommended.

author: Erin P
title: Residenza San Calisto Review!
text: My family and I had a wonderful stay. The room was clean and comfortable. We loved having a wash machine as well. The staff could not have been nicer and incredibly helpful as well, especially helping us with taxis and drivers. I would highly recommend staying at Residenza San Calisto. It’s in an awesome location too, next to a lot of restaurants, shops, and cool architecture.

author: Jessica V
title: Very nice and convenient.
text: Location was super convenient.  Friendly service. Comfortable room.

author: Antoine U
title: Wonderful boutique hotel in the heart of Trastevere
text: From the moment of our booking the hotel started communicating about our arrival time and had recommendations for airport transportation. The hotel only has a limited number of rooms. It is super clean and very nicely furnished. There is also a very relaxing common area. The neighborhood has many restaurants and coffee/lunch places. We walked to the Colosseum (30 min walk) from the hotel. The hotel staff is welcoming and friendly. I would definitely highly recommend staying here.

author: Olivia B
title: We will be back for a perfect stay!
text: We had a Great stay!  Locaion was perfect and suprising quiet for being in the center of Trastevere.  The beds were very comfortable and the staff were so very nice.  We have stayed multiple times in the Trastevere area and this is by far our new favorite hotel.

author: Aiden H
title: Can’t wait to come back!
text: This little gem was a real treat. I highly recommend. Super clean and lots of attention to detail. The hotel is so cute, cozy and homey. The staff is fabulous and very responsive. The location is wonderful, right in the middle of Trastevere close to lots of restaurants, bars and still within walking distance to all the must see attractions in Rome. Great job Alessia and thank you for all your help.

author: Megan A
title: Excellent spot in Trastevere
text: Excellent stay at Residenza San Calisto. Fantastic location, comfortable accommodations and wonderful staff. Would highly recommend for anyone who wants to stay in Trastevere!

author: Daniel M
title: Small, basic and clean
text:
Me and my daughter stayed in room 503 for 2 nights. Like all city rooms it’s small but this is pretty small. The balcony window is nicer the lift wasn’t working for 2-3 days so that was a mountain to go up and down a few times a day. Inc with luggage 
We didn’t have breakfast, but there is a Starbucks and Mac Ds just down the road. Really good location near the metro. 
They asked me before our stay if it was for a special occasion and it was my daughter’s 16th birthday: nothing extra was done so not sure why they asked. Other hotels have put something nice on previously.
Air con worked, hairdryer was good. Tv just bbc news or CNN news for English channels. 

There was drinks in the lobby area but no prices or information: 
I wanted some extra milk, they didn’t understand and I tried to ask them about the metro tickets - but not helpful again. 
Bonus was they looked after our luggage on the day of leaving. 
It’s clean, basic an near a metro

author: Grace J
title: Would not recommend! Way better options in the neighborhood.
text:
The location of this hotel is great. Very central and close to everything (Gare du Nord, Pigalle, Mont Martre, le Marais, etc)
But thats about it. It’s just a bedroom in a boring street (with a club next door) The reception is ok, but the cleaning team is horrible. They started to make noise at 7:30. Loud phonecalls in the hallway, discussions amongst eachother, knocking on the door 2x times while the ‘do not disturb’ sign is up, vacuuming in the early morning in front of your door, not cleaning the towels while dirty, etc.

author: Mathis E
title: A real favorite in Paris!
text:
I recently stayed at the 9Hotel Opéra for the second time, and it was high time I shared my feedback. Both stays were simply excellent, and this hotel continues to surprise me with the consistent quality of its services.

Upon arrival, you feel warmly welcomed. Mood is elegant, cozy and modern — a true haven in the heart of Paris. The rooms are spotlessly clean, well appointed, and above all, the bed is extremely comfortable. We sleep like at home, or better!:)

Breakfast is another highlight: varied, tasty, with fresh and quality products. Whether you prefer a pastry, fresh fruit or something more hearty, everything is perfectly prepared.

But what really makes this hotel unique is the team. Each staff member is welcoming, professional and attentive. I would like to thank Hanane, the Head of Reception, and Séverine, the Director, for their kindness, availability and warm Welcoming. Their attention to detail and true passion for hospitality are felt at every interaction. We don't just feel like a customer, we really feel like guests.

After two such successful stays, I can say without hesitation that the 9Hotel Opéra has become my favorite address in Paris. Whether for business or personal travel, I recommend this hotel with your eyes closed. I can’t wait to come back! See you soon! Ines

author: Marta Y
title: Staff Entered My Room While I Was Naked — Hotel Called It an “Inconvenience”
text:
I stayed at 9Hotel Opéra in Paris and experienced a violation of personal privacy and safety that no guest should ever endure. On the morning of checkout, despite the “Do Not Disturb” sign being clearly displayed, a hotel staff member knocked on my door asking if I needed cleaning. I informed them — explicitly — that no one was to access my room until I checked out at noon.

Less than an hour later (with DND sign still in place), that same employee unlocked and entered my room WITHOUT CONSENT. I was naked, just about to step into the shower. I screamed for them to leave, vulnerable, shocked and outraged.

I reported the incident immediately to the front desk and later had a call with the General Manager. During the call, she expressed how fearful and uneasy my experience made her feel as a woman who also travels alone. She thanked me for contacting the hotel directly before posting publicly — saying that having my report allowed her to act on documentation from a guest, rather than reacting to a public relations crisis.

She assured me the hotel would terminate the third-party cleaning company and replace them with an all-female internal team. While this is a positive systemic step, it does not address the direct harm I experienced.

I requested a full refund of my $1,700 stay — not to be punitive, but because this was a fundamental breach of safety and consent. Instead, I was issued a $400 refund — roughly the cost of one night and breakfast. That kind of refund might be reasonable for a malfunctioning air conditioner or disruptive construction — but not for a violation of personal safety and consent.

Despite their verbal assurances, the hotel reframed my experience as an “inconvenience” and went silent after I followed up.

I tried to resolve this quietly, respectfully, and directly with the hotel. They had every opportunity to make this right. They chose not to. I am sharing this so future SOLO FEMALE travelers can make a safer choice than 9Hotel Opéra.

author: Michael B
title: Ruined Paris trip

The toilet door does not lock, the door is covered in dust. The tiles are moldy. I would never recommend it at all. My short trip to Paris was ruined.

author: Evie M
title: Do not stay at this hotel
text:
My wife took our daughter(50) and our two granddaughters (19 & 16) to New York and decided after much research to stay at this hotel.  This is written by her…
I decided to take our daughter and granddaughters to New York and decided to stay at the Empire Hotel.  I can say that the lobby is beautiful and checking in was easy and the staff friendly.   I had booked two rooms. 
When my one granddaughter and I checked into our room on the third floor, we were caught off guard by the quality of the room.  I had done so much research and was very disappointed by the lack of quality this hotel advertises.
There is probably a reason why no pictures of the bathroom were on their website.  The vanity cabinet was damaged along the bottom and the handle not securely fastened.  The bathroom door handle and the bottom was damaged by swelling.  This could be from the lack of a bathroom fan. There was mold on the floor of the shower.  Even the toilet paper holder was falling apart.  The hand shower did not work at all.
There were no blinds on the windows and as a result the room could not be darkened for sleep.  The lamps were filthy with one having a broken socket and the bulb just hanging over.   The furniture was dirty and not inviting to sit on.  
The mini fridge was so disgusting that we would not even put our water bottles in it.  
Wallpaper was peeling off in several areas.  Carpeting was ripped in several spots.  
And to top it off, the so called landmark hotel has part of its sign burnt out. 
Although some of this may seem trivial, I cannot express how disappointed I am with this experience.  This hotel charges premium prices and as such people should expect premium rooms.  I travel the world and have stayed in many hotels.  I am not exaggerating when I say this is the worst hotel that I have stayed at.  
I cannot and will not suggest this hotel to anyone going to NYC.

author: Lea T
title: Good location
text:
This is my third time to stay at this Holiday Inn. The location is ideal, being close to various subway stations and safe to walk around the neighborhood. The staff is always helpful. Ravina was attentive and helped me make airport transportation arrangements. 

The hotel has competitive rates, especially if you reshop the booking several times before your travel. (I reduced my initial booking by 30% by going back and rechecking the rate before my trip.) 

The rooms are small, but sufficient for my solo travels. The rooms are clean and have a wonderful air-conditioning system. There's a small area to hang clothes, an iron/ironing board and a safe. You can find a microwave and ice machine on the 4th and 19th floors (I think those are the right floors). There are no refrigerators in the rooms.

The hotel is also near the Fairway grocery store (corner of 26th & 6th). It's a great place to purchase water, fruit, picnic supplies including a salad bar and to-go sushi. One block South (25th & 6th) is a CVS. And if you're looking for a great brunch place, try the Grey Dog on 26th just past 6th. (They take reservations or you can walk up and not have too long of a wait.)
In short, I recommend this hotel for its service, affordability, and location.

author: Erin G
title: Perfect NYC Location. Highly Recommend.
text: I picked this location for its proximity to Penn station where I was arriving into New York but it proved to be the perfect homebase for my long weekend in New York City. Everything I wanted to do was easily walkable or within easy reach of public transportation. Hotel was clean and quaint and staff was super friendly.

author: Megan K
title: Really disappointing two day stay with terrible service
text:
I booked an IHG property due to brand loyalty and status and kind of expected that IHG feel, unfortunately it couldn’t be further away from my expectation. The ‘upgrade’ was to the 17th floor which gave me a view of the adjacent building about 8’ away from my window, rusting fire escape staircase and full view of ‘the neighbours across the alleyway’. Arrived late on the Friday night after a long trip from Europe so went to bed fairly quickly. The following morning I went to have breakfast in the restaurant which I had paid for at the time of booking and asked to have 2 fried eggs sunny side up. This was t possible, they couldn’t make fried eggs. I showed them the menu which clearly stated ‘eggs, any style’ but was told it wasn’t possible. Then went to reception and showed them the menu, they came to the restaurant with me and was told that if I wanted 2 fried eggs I’d have to pay an additional $5.50 and then they might be able to do fried eggs… ordering off the menu was clearly not an option. 

I had meetings until around 1400 that day and on my return I found that the room had not been made up. Had a shower in the very dated bathroom and heard a constant knocking on the door. I went to the door to find the cleaning lady and asked if I could finish my shower, she said she would be back in 10-20 mins. I finished the shower and waited but she never returned. Eventually later in the early evening went to reception and asked if the room could be made up but was told that the cleaning team had long gone home. Eventually after emailing the general manager someone from the maintenance team made the room and gave me some new towels but this was well after 1900. Next morning (I had been given a checkout time of 1200) there was a constant knocking at the door at 1030 to find the cleaning lady asking if I wanted the room done and when I was checking out. I said don’t worry I’m checking out in a few hours. At 1115 again a constant knocking to find someone from housekeeping asking why I was still in the room. I explained I had a 1200 checkout. 10 minutes later the reception phoned asking why I had not yet checked out, again I explained that I had a 1200 checkout. 

The whole experience is so not IHG but then was told by another international guest that my expectations were way too high for a holiday inn especially in New York, he said they were way overpriced and often really tired hotels and terrible service. Avoid this hotel if you can. 

There is no chance of me frequenting this hotel or for that matter any IHG property. Today I’m in the Hilton in New Haven and what a difference. I have top status with both Hilton and Marriott so won’t be booking an IHG property again. Platinum Elite Ambassador means nothing clearly.

text: Currently looks like outdoor building work be carried out.  Reception  staff are excellent and friendly (as is everyone on in NYC). Rooms are small, bathroom a tight squeeze. However we did have to chase for clean towels as the maids seem to be overworks with such a daily turnaround. No fridge, free safe and opening windows. Restaurant? author: Sara Y
title: Great stay with great staff!
text:
Our recent stay at the Holiday Inn Manhattan 6th Ave Chelsea was exceptional, and we couldn't be more pleased with the entire experience! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel right at home, and we want to give a special shoutout to Rovina for going above and beyond.

Rovina was a huge help with our reservations and any requests we had, and she made sure our teenagers felt welcome and comfortable. Her dedication to superior customer service was evident—whether she was assisting guests or training new staff, she worked tirelessly with a smile on her face. Rovina truly exemplifies the kind of service that makes a stay memorable. She is a standout, and we believe she deserves to be recognized and promoted for her hard work and outstanding attitude.

The entire team, including housekeeping and the front desk staff, and even the employee painting the 25th/26th floor stairway, were friendly and professional, making our time at the hotel even more enjoyable. We also appreciate the location—it’s perfect for exploring Manhattan, with so many great attractions nearby.

If you're considering breakfast at the hotel, we can vouch that it’s good! All in all, we love staying here and look forward to our next visit. Highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, convenience, and fantastic service!

location was perfect we could walked to everyhting we needed to get to.

author: Freya J
title: Poor Choice
text:
Lesson learned. Make sure you know what company you're using to book at Hotel 3232 NYC. 
We booked a room for 2 nights and was quoted $735. When we checked out, the statement from Hotel 3232 totaled $557, however, our CC was charged 735.

According to Hotel 3232, the reservation was made through Booking.Com, a Priceline affiliate. 

In speaking with Priceline, they said we had to talk to Booking.com who is impossible to reach a human. 

Looking at the confirmation email of the reservation, we see it came from confirmations@travel.guestreservations.com, not booking.com, unless it is a shell company of Priceline/booking. 

So be aware, the reservation we made ended up be a scam in my opinion. 

Hotel 3232 is listed as a 3 star boutique hotel. The only redeeming qualities we encountered were the friendly staff and the location to where we had to go for appointments. Other than that, the hotel needs a lot of work. The AC system in the rooms are basically window units. The rooms are small by any standard used. And don't be fooled by the balcony. Our supreme queen room had a balcony 3 ft deep that you wouldn't in your rightind sit on. outside

author: Pablo U
title: Smooth From Start to Finish
text: This stay was smooth and dependable. The staff stayed welcoming throughout, and the complimentary breakfast added a nice touch each morning. Combined with the convenient location, it made for a very enjoyable NYC visit.

author: Katie O
title: Still One of My Go To Stays in NYC
text: From the moment I arrived to checkout every step was seamless. The rooms were spotlessly clean and the bed was comfortable. The location was perfect for a NYC stay, just a short walk from Central Park and Fifth Avenue. The staff were friendly and helpful, always ready with a smile. The hotel amenities, including the gym and complimentary breakfast, made my visit extra pleasant. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Charlie I
title: A Reliable Midtown Stay I Keep Choosing
text: The location made getting around easy, and the staff maintained the same friendly and attentive approach I remembered. The room safe instructions were not immediately clear, but staff helped quickly.

author: Pablo I
title: A Stay That Just Felt Right
text: Efficient stay. Meets expectations for a short visit. Strong on cleanliness and location. Minor delays but nothing that impacted the overall experience significantly.

author: Amelia U
title: Still One of My Go To Stays in NYC
text: Returning here felt like an easy decision. The experience was smooth again, and everything from the room comfort to the amenities met expectations. It continues to be a dependable option for a Midtown visit. The fitness center had a short wait for equipment during peak hours, but it was manageable.

author: Marco T
title: Not sure how this rates 4 stars average
text: I am surprised this hotel rates as high as it does. It is basic and needs attention to alot of details, we had 2 joining rooms and the lock was missing on one door, the air con was not very efficient and the staff were not attentive or appearing to want to help with questions and queries to sort things. I would not book here again

author: Daniel J
title: Rude staff , AC not working in the whole facility
text:
Rude staff especially the person by the front desk instead of welcoming the guests he was giving nasty attitude .
 The AC was not working in the main lobby and my room I had to checkout hour after I checked in and the person at the front desk refused to give me a checkout receipt . I would never stay in this property and I recommend no one should either.

author: Hannah C
title: Simple, Practical, and Well Equipped
text: A well rounded stay with strong amenities. Everything felt comfortable and easy, and the overall value was solid. It worked well for a short Midtown visit.

author: Dylan C
title: Simple and Reliable NYC Stay
text:
A very comfortable and well located stay. The staff were friendly, and the amenities such as breakfast and the fitness center made the experience feel complete. It worked well as a base for exploring the city.
The fitness center had limited equipment during peak hours, but it was still usable.

author: Amelia J
title: WARING.   HAIR AND DIRT ON THE SHEETS
text: This hotel is nasty of nasty, the king of nasty. We unfortunately booked four nights and every night we had filth on the floor that the maid didn’t even touch, hair on the sheets and pillows. We were on tours and we got back five 6 o’clock at night and they said it was too late to have anybody come and do anything about it. They also had an attitude at the front desk when we would call. We go on vacation they have a nice cleanly time, and this place gives me the creeps and I hope I don’t catch a disease here. They even sent new blankets one of the nights and those were full affair. Also, we asked for the manager to call us and they never called. DON’T STAY HERE. The manager’s name was Joanna and she refused to call us. The guy at the front desk says if you don’t like it, call the health department and we will. I advise everyone else to make that phone call too, so they’re forced to clean up their act here, the hygiene here really sucks

author: Owen Y
title: From Uncertain to Impressed
text: I arrived unsure but left genuinely impressed. The cleanliness stood out immediately, and the friendly staff made the experience even better. The central location made exploring effortless, and the overall comfort made it hard to leave. This stay turned into one of my best in months.

author: Amelia N
title: A Well Rounded and Enjoyable NYC Stay
text: A well rounded stay with strong amenities. The staff were attentive, and the location made getting around very convenient. The added touches breakfast made it feel like good value overall.

author: Lucy D
title: Be careful — hotel does not respond to guests
text:
The communication from the hotel was extremely poor. I made multiple attempts to contact them by email, via the Hotels.com messaging portal, and through the hotel’s own website, but none of my messages were answered. I also called the hotel directly and was told someone would call me back — this never happened.
I was trying to discuss whether my non‑refundable booking could be amended or delayed, not cancelled outright. Had the hotel responded, this may have been resolved, but the complete lack of communication meant I had no option and ultimately lost the full cost of my stay. The frustration wasn’t the non‑refundable policy itself, but the hotel’s refusal to engage at all.

author: Erin Z
title: Effortless NYC Stay in a Prime Location
text: From arrival to checkout, the experience felt smooth and well managed. The staff were friendly, and getting around Midtown was simple thanks to the central location. It made the whole stay feel effortless and enjoyable. I would definitely return.

author: Alice B
title: Spotless Comfort from Start to Finish
text: Cleanliness was the highlight of this stay. Everything felt carefully maintained, from the spotless room to the polished common areas. It created a calm and comfortable environment that made the visit very enjoyable. I would happily return.

author: Grace T
title: Excellent stay in central London
text: We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The location is excellent, making it an ideal base for discovering London. The apartment was spacious, clean, comfortable and very well  equipped.

author: Sara P
title: Our first stay in London & love apartment living
text: So nice! So much room! Well appointed!

author: Morgan Z
title: Pretty bad
text: Really loud building works going on outside! Working late so nothing being mentioned of this was not helpful. The apartment was boiling hot and hairdryer didnt work.

author: Paolo N
title: Not recommended during summer until they add AC
text: It was worse experience, first: the room view  does not look as they post on the social media. There was heat wave for 3 days during our stay, on our day 1 check in, me and my wife with our 3 year old kid couldn’t take a nap after having a flight trip. They gave us 2 fans after requesting but the room was already hot so fan air was like air fryer. We left after 3 hours of check in. Suggestion: as the weather is changing, becoming warmer! Add room AC so the guests, specially with kids and the tourists who come from abroad they can rest after long journey and after having a beautiful tour of your city/country.

author: Evan P
title: BEWARE NO AC..not good for Summer
text:
I would **not recommend Marlin Apartments London Bridge – Empire Square**, especially during the summer. We traveled as a family with my 10-year-old daughter and my active parents in their 60s, and this stay became so uncomfortable that we decided to leave early.

The biggest issue is **NO AIR CONDITIONING**, and this was not made nearly clear enough when we booked. In summer heat, that is not a small detail. The apartment became unbearably hot day and night. We contacted the property several times and were given THREE fans, but even with all three running, we were still sweating inside the apartment. We asked about switching rooms and were told they could not move us.

What made the experience worse was the response when we explained that the heat was aggravating my mother's health issues. There seemed to be very little concern or urgency, and we were offered no meaningful solution beyond the fans. We also tried to address the situation financially, but no one seemed willing to take responsibility or offer a refund despite the conditions making the accommodation unsuitable for our family.

On top of the heat, **the floor was dirty**, which added to the disappointment considering what we paid.

We had planned to stay longer, but the discomfort became too much and we are **leaving early**. Losing money was preferable to spending another miserable night unable to sleep comfortably.

Guests should not have to dig through details to discover that a property has no air conditioning, especially during the summer. This needs to be displayed prominently before payment because it absolutely can determine whether a property is suitable for a family, older travelers, children, or anyone sensitive to heat.

The location may be convenient, but for us that did not come close to making up for the experience. **I would never book this property again and strongly recommend that summer travelers think very carefully before staying here.**

author: Mason H
title: Wonderful
text: Perfect and very well communicated, We passed a very nice days in it. We enjoyed London a lot. It's near a lot of places.  Near of Borough Market.

author: Pierre W
title: Good location
text: Very good size apartment for a family of 4. Nice location. The only downside is the room is very warm and the fan is not working and they can’t provide us a new fan.

author: Leo B
title: Everything you need
text: Lovely 1 bedroom apartment with everything you need for staying away from home. Even included a dishwasher and a washing machine. I didnt use the washing machine as only stayed one night but used the dishwasher which saved time. Convenient location and Tesco Express is literally next door to the main entrance. Would definitely stay again and for longer.

author: Carlos L
title: Avoid at all costs
text:
A nightmare. To be avoided at all costs. I don't understand how they have such a good rating. 325 eur a night to be facing due west (my only request was anything but west) there is NO AC (ok it wasn't written that there is AC but it's good to reiterate) so it is 36 (I have my thermometer) inside. Air doesn't come in since the bedroom window only opens a few cm from the top. In the living room you can open... But 2nd problem we are under an air corridor, there is a kind of huge background noise like a mega AC from the lucky ones who live opposite. It is in the immediate vicinity of a hospital with sirens non-stop day and night. Plus a bell tower that does its bell tower job every hour. The rest of the neighborhood looks like a garbage collector strike day in the north side of Marseille.
The sofa bed, which is the reason for my choice, does not deserve to be called a bed. Or a sofa. The mattress is a crepe where you can feel every spring, even for a 40kg child who never complains about sleeping poorly. Finally, there are about 50 switches that operate, or don't, the electrical elements. Still haven't found the one for the stovetop... I tried to move up my return ticket because we are having such a bad time. 1350 eur for 4 nights was the sacrifice of the trip for a nice place... on paper only.

author: William T
title: Marlin Ap
text: Sharika received us very well! With much hospitality!

author: Olivia X
title: Spotless apartment in perfect location for accessing centre of London.
text:
Location was brilliant, 10min bus ride to Tower Bridge.  We didn't use the tube due to the heat. 
There is a Tesco express next door, perfect for cooking in your apartment. 
The apartment was spotless and lovely setting away from the hustle and bustle of London.
Friendly staff aswell. Easy check in and out. 
The only issue we did have was the temp was in 30s whilst we were there and the apartment had no air con. We had a fan which helped a bit, but aircon would of be much better.  Other than that it was perfect for us. 
Also the surrounding area nice with local park.

author: Amelia R
title: Disappointing experience Marlin Apartments London Bridge - Empire Square
text: Booking pictures and cost (330£ per night)  indicated that I had probably booked the pent house, but instead was given a 2nd floor apartment. So please double confirm with these people before you book. Secondly, it doesnt have Air conditioning and was really warm inside the apartment and wasnt able to sleep. Lastly this is nothing like a 4 star apartment, but would say it meets a 3 star. No milk provisions which is required for a 4star stay. No climate control and bathroom is basic. TV is a small LED unit

author: Ethan X
title: Pleasant
text: Good location, 2 tubes within 10min walk. Near borough market. Easy process with checking in and out. Room was spacious and clean

author: Lauren I
title: Nice Accommodations but NO A/C
text:
This was our first visit to London and traveling as a family of five. Finding accommodations for this size was a more challenging. For example, we spent a few days in Paris before arriving in London and had to book two separate rooms. The size of the “apartment” was great and we had a two room apartment that included a large living room and kitchen. 

The accommodations were very clean and, as stated above, very spacious. It included a washer/dryer that was very helpful. As an all-in-one unit, it worked okay but you have to run very small loads and two dry cycles to completely dry the clothes. 

The main issue I had was nowhere on the website or description of the accommodations did it state that air conditioning wasn’t available. During our visit in late June 2026, there was a record heat wave and the rooms were unbearable at times. We were told at check-in that A/C wasn’t available but two fans were in the room. In order to cool down, we sat in the air conditioned lobby for a bit before going up to the rooms. 

My other criticism is that I felt nickel and dimed when checking into the rooms. I requested two twin beds in one of the rooms since we had a family of five. A couple of days before checking in, I received a call confirming the request but stating it would be another £30 for that. I agreed and not a huge deal. When checking in, we asked for a room on a lower floor and was told there was a room available but it included a “furnished patio deck” so it would be an additional £80 during our visit. Okay, fine. The rooms came with 8 sets of towels but since we were staying for 7 days asked if we could get extra towels. Sure, but it would be an extra £XX for that. No housekeeping service during our stay but we could ask for that for another £XX. Going back to the lack of A/C, could we get an extra fan. Yes, but it’s ordinarily an extra £XX but we’ll give you an extra one at no charge since it’s so hot out. After we checked in and walking away, the receptionist (who was very nice) called us back and said she noticed the request for the two twin beds and the room she put us in with the furnished patio didn’t have that so she can put us back in the original room we had, which also had a patio deck. Okay, great. I said the person who called and set that up for me said it was £30 extra for that room and since we’re going back to that original room I shouldn’t be charged the extra £80. She said the person who called should have charged us for the patio but she agreed to refund £50. As a side note, the patio was nice but it wasn’t furnished but it was good to have during the evening to help cool down. It also had a slight view of the London Eye. 

Overall, it was a nice facility and a pretty central location. The lack of A/C was my only issue and given the heat wave it was a problem. The website should have made that clearly known and I would have selected different accommodations if I had known. Otherwise, very nice accommodations and location. The Borough Market, a short 10 minute walk, was great.

author: Harper V
title: Avoid this property. There are better options nearby
text:
⚠️ WARNING: Listing does not match reality

Booked and checked in same day (June 22). I immediately requested to cancel reservation and refund.
🔴 FALSE ADVERTISING
Listing photos show views that do not exist. What you actually get is a room facing a busy street — no view, no quiet, noisy and dull
🔴 NO AIR CONDITIONING — NOT DISCLOSED
AC is not advertised, but critically, the absence of it is not disclosed either. In warm weather you are forced to keep the window open onto a noisy street. Sleep is near impossible. US travel portals should be required to flag this explicitly — it is a basic amenity travellers assume is present unless told otherwise.
🔴 STAFF COMPLETELY UNHELPFUL
I raised concerns immediately at check-in. Staff were uncooperative and refused to process a refund despite multiple requests escalated through the travel portal.

Here is what makes this particularly unreasonable: the property claimed to be fully booked. If that is true, they could have resold the room immediately — so there was no financial reason to deny a same-day refund to a guest who flagged issues immediately upon arrival. Instead they chose to trap a customer behind a non-refundable policy rather than do the right thing.

Save yourself the stress — there are better options in the area. Also it's not cheap. Unless you need kitchen and more room this place is not at all worth  it especially in summer.

I travel frequently and this is 1st time property denied refund for unused room, in hours of reservation made in spite of multipal requests. Expedia could have given better support as well

author: Lucy A
title: Helpful and friendly team
text: This is my second stay here and once again the experience has been excellent. The hotel kindly allowed us to park our car a little earlier, which was very helpful. A special thanks to Leia, who was very patient and took the time to explain everything clearly to us. Great service and much appreciated!

author: Wyatt X
title: Wonderful experience in Marlin Apartments
text: My experience has been wonderful. My apartment was very clean and it had everything I needed. I have been two weeks and they cleaned my flat two times. The personal in reception has been wonderful as well, specially María. She helped me a lot when I arrived there. Thanks for everything. I will go again!!

author: Nathan E
title: When in London. stay there!
text:
Awesome as always. Spacious and beautiful view.
The staff is VERY accomodating.
Today Sherika even helped me with shipping back all my boxes I had for a business event. 
Why would I stay  anywhere else when in London?

author: Adam Z
title: Excellent All Round
text:
Excellent location, place to stay and service. We had a wonderful experience from start to finish! 
The two bedroom apartment had everything you could need. Thank you!

author: Sofia O
title: My stay
text:
Nice size appartments  in handy location  to the tube and easy walking distance  to tower bridge.
Appartment we had was verry  warm with no air conditioning  so only option  is to open the windows  which let's the city noise in.
No housekeeping  service which for the money would have been nice at least once ( we did 5 nights)as only had two bath towels and 1 and a half loo rolls ,1 tea towel no tissues  or kitchen towel.
Overall minor things but these  items were in the other appartments  we stayed in in Edinburgh, york,sailsbury  and manchester

author: Lucy U
title: Fairfield -medicore
text: Given the hotel advertised " fully renovated," I expected more updated  furniture and facility. On the positive, the location is located to many forms of transportation and complementary breakfast was helpful. In terms of price quality I would recommend AC hotel which is around the corner, nicer facility or another marriot.

author: Leo F
title: Just bad….
text: I jut had a pretty terrible stay there. The staff is not competent and has no say or way to make things right. They are just employees and there are no managers on premise to make things right. No water, no housekeeping… just poor service. Not to mention the small breakfast area insanely overcrowded. I don’t recommend at all

author: Sean P
title: Avoid this hotel
text:
Terrible service and dishonest billing!
Avoid this hotel. On my arrival, my room was registered as "Not Ready" in the app until midnight, forcing me into an extreme late check-in and ruining my first day. On check-out, the front desk verbally approved a 1-hour late check-out extension. Relying on their word, I checked out at 5 PM, but they turns around and charged my credit card an extra $140.05 USD without my consent, writing a deceptive note on my folio.  
The staff completely ignores messages on the Marriott app, and management refuses to take accountability for the promises made by their own team. Sub-par service and predatory billing practices. Absolute disgrace to the brand.

author: Molly T
title: A good hotel
text: A very good hotel, out of the times square madness.

author: Oliver P
title: Location and practicality
text:
I chose the location (for the region), because it belongs to the Marriott network and because it seems practical and cost-effective.
At first I was a little upset because the bathroom in the room was locked (which was resolved by the arrival of an employee) and the difficulty in making the wi-fi work.
But it has its good points and others not so much.
Strengths: breakfast, staff service, bed comfort, acoustic insulation and location.
Points to improve: shower is weak, could have more lockers or place for luggage in the room
