author: Holly P
title: Pleasant Stay
text: The staff at this hotel was wonderful!  Breakfast was really good.  Many options.  The room was small but it worked fine for a weekend.  The room was very clean and bed was comfortable.  Easy walk to Wall Street or Fulton Street train station.

author: Chloe Y
title: Very disappointing experience regarding billing and customer service handling. I do not recommend this hotel.
text:
First of all, the staff service was excellent, including housekeeping, front desk, and kitchen staff. Everyone was very kind and professional.

However, my experience with billing was terrible. I booked a King bed room for 2 people for 4 nights, from May 21, 2026 to May 25, 2026. Over the phone, I was told that the total would be only $897.58 and that I would pay it at checkout. I was also told that during check-in they would only charge me $20 temporarily, which would later be refunded at checkout when the final payment of $897.58 was processed.

This was completely false. At check-in, they charged me $977.58, which included the $897.58 plus an additional $80 ($20 per day). Then, on the day of checkout, they charged my card again without my permission. I never authorized them to store or reuse my card information. The card was only used to tap at the register during check-in for the $80 charge.

When I went to the front desk to ask about it, they told me the system was undergoing changes and asked me to wait until Wednesday, May 27, 2026, to email the company so they could refund my $160. Today is Wednesday, May 27, 2026, and I still have not received my money back.

Before going to the front desk, I also tried calling multiple times, but the calls kept disconnecting because of the same “system changes.”

Very disappointing experience regarding billing and customer service handling. I do not recommend this hotel.

author: Gavin I
title: 3 Night Stay
text:
Good location 10 walk to subway , room small but did the job , staff friendly breakfast basic - we only went 1 of 3 mornings . Lots of places around to grab food . 
Only negative is I am still waiting in the security hold to come back , it’s been almost 3 weeks and still not released - it’s not my bank either as I have checked . It’s only $20 per night so $60 all up but still annoying .

author: Ian D
title: ALL PERFECT
text:
EVERYTHING IS PERFECT! 
Comfortable and beautiful Hotel in Financial Discrict. Friendly staff, delicious breakfast also to take away for lunch (this was very useful in an expensive city like New York).
Rooms cleaned perfectly at every our return from a moon day. The last day we were made to leave our bags for one last ride in New York. Everything perfect, I hope to visit you again. Thank you again!

author: James Z
title: Fairfield Inn New York Manhattan/Financial District - Great Staff, Good Value for Seaport/FiDi
text:
I have had mixed feelings about this property over the years. Upside: Very convenient location and good value for both work and play in Seaport/FiDi with the bonus of a complimentary buffet breakfast. (Unlike the adjacent AC Hotel which, sadly, no longer comps breakfast at any Bonvoy tier). Downside: Particularly small rooms and periodically indifferent guest relations. However, my recent stay was a total success thanks to the genuinely warm welcome by Yanesh and his extraordinary willingness and effort to assist throughout my visit. So, shout out to YANESH! Thank you, Yanesh!
Of note: the remodeled dining area has hugely improved the look and feel of the space. However, the new seating layout can cause somewhat cramped dining conditions during the busy period. Breakfast service staff continue to be very kind and accommodating.

author: David L
title: Financial District in New York Cit
text:
Stayed at Fairfield Inn Financial District in New York City recently. Overall, it was an average experience.

The location is convenient for downtown access, and the staff was generally helpful. The room was clean, but on the smaller side, which is expected for the area. Amenities were decent, though nothing particularly stood out, and the breakfast area can get crowded during peak times.

Good for a short stay if you need something simple and well-located, but there’s room for improvement in overall comfort and experience.

author: Mason A
title: Excellent in every way
text:
Excellent in everything!
Good location, good price, good amenities. They cleaned my room every day, very safe neighborhood and the staff were wonderful and very kind!
Top staying for visiting this beautiful city.

author: Luke E
title: Too bad...
text: Rather average stay (bland breakfast, rather poor in terms of diversity) and unpleasant surprise: deposit of 200 dollars deposited on arrival and still not returned 15 days later without explanation.

author: Poppy M
title: Small and expensive
text: The hotel website said it was totally renovated.  I found the room very tiny.  Room 506 had a view of the wall of the hotel next door.   Expensive for what I got.  $475 w/taxes.  The linens seemed very clean and the breakfast 4 out of 10.   Scrambled eggs were probably from a package, bacon was good, other items were ok.  Had a waffle iron for fresh waffles.

author: Oliver K
title: Fantastic
text:
Excellent staff, both at breakfast and reception. 
Free breakfast very varied and quality. 
Perfect situation. A few steps from Wall Street

author: Harper J
title: Worsened from last stay
text:
The hotel's location is good close to Fulton/ Cortlandt subway stations and World Trade Center. Rooms are spacious enough for one person and they did serviced it whenever requested. That being said, having been to this property before, I was quite disappointed by how SHOCKINGLY limited the breakfast options were. No variety/nor service at all and even packed without enough room where to sit at times. 
Additionally found the elevators quite slow, uncomfortable and even dirty as shown on the images. Don’t think I’ll be returning to this property.

author: Marco H
title: Avoid it if you can....it's not a hotel but a hostel
text:
Bad hotel . Ugly, cold room, drafts from the windows. Very bad view ( walls other buildings ) . Bathroom without heating. A nightmare.
Very bad breakfast. Small room with difficulty finding a place. Tto packaged from canteen. Sweet and salty really minimal. Tables with nothing. 
In Italy it would be a 2 star max. Just enter and see the entrance to understand the level.
Not bad area but to go downtown it takes 30 minutes by metro. Very close to Brookling Bridge.

author: Juan Q
title: Not ideal for Titanium
text:
Stayed here during a work trip.  The staff was great, but as a Titanium on the verge of Ambassador level, I was astounded I was not upgraded.  My room was tiny with zero view and fridge did not work.  Because I was also on such a low floor, the city noise was insane.  Mya was excellent at the front desk and should be commended.

Location for access to Pier 16 and Financial district was excellent.  Just was hoping to get better treatment with my status!

author: Mason D
title: Great Cost Benefit for Manhattan
text: The hotel is well located, with a subway station about 5 minutes walk. Be careful with relatively new and comfortable facilities. Like everything else in Manhattan, the rooms are small. But it did not compromise comfort. The bathroom was good, shower too. Good breakfast, considering the American standard, and changed some items over time. Baked eggs, bacon, cheddar cheese, yoghurt, cereals, bagels and breads, toaster, automatic waffle, Nutella and jelly, banana and Apple. Milk and coffee. Water is available in the lobby all day long. Okay. The breakfast space was small, but we were able to accommodate each day. Careful staff. The hotel has more than 30 floors and two elevators. The elevators are fast and modern, but we had the luck of one of them being in maintenance. In the two days when it was in maintenance, we had an excessive delay to go down or up to the room and as we were on the 19th floor, we couldn't go down stairs. But when it was solved, we had no more problems. We like the hotel. Good cost benefit for Manhattan.

author: Liam M
title: Exceptional Views and Prime Location in the Heart of Times Square
text:
The Marriott New York Manhattan offers an excellent experience with its prime location in the heart of Times Square. The hotel’s impressive tower provides easy access to many of New York City’s most iconic attractions, all within walking distance — including the Brooklyn Bridge and other major landmarks.

My room was on a high floor and featured spectacular panoramic views of the city. Watching the New Year’s Eve fireworks from my window was truly a memorable highlight.

Breakfast options could be improved, and some areas of the hotel décor feel a bit dated, but overall, the comfort, service, and unbeatable location make it a wonderful place to stay in New York City.

author: Luke O
title: Really recommend this place as a great base for exploring NY
text: We had a great four night stay here. I travelled as a single parent with two teenagers and felt safe staying here. Good neighbourhood that is busy and felt safe even at night. The location was fantastic and the hotel sits between two subway stops perfect for getting around. The beds were really comfortable and there was a blackout blind on the window so we got great sleep and the room was very quiet even though it faced the street. The beds were really comfortable. The bathroom was rather small but adequate with good products included. Our safe wasn’t attached to anything so that could have done with being screwed into the wardrobe. The free wifi was great. There’s a lovely outdoor sitting area on the top floor perfect for chilling. It’s a nice, clean hotel, with a good standard that provides comfortable accommodation in an amazing location - what more do you need. Highly recommend as a great base for exploring.

author: Paolo D
title: Jonathan saved the day!!!
text:
Jonathan was at the front desk when we checked in and checked out, and our interactions with him consistently reflected a high level of professionalism. Upon checking out today, Jonathan was attentive and accommodating when we needed to leave our bags while we went to grab a bite.
The highlight of our stay, however, was his instrumental help in retrieving my daughter’s necklace after it fell into a crack in the cement floor at the front entrance. His quick action turned my panic into immediate relief.

Thank you, Jonathan, for your kindness, attentiveness, and outstanding service! You truly made a difference.

author: Maria M
title: Superb experience
text: We had Jonathan as main contact and he took care of us flawlessly. In an unfriendly city like NYC, having this kind of service is overly appreciated. Hotel location is also great and public transportation will take you anywhere in the city

author: Aaron R
title: High end hotel in the middle of Manhattan
text: We stayed 3 nights and because this hotel is located close to everything we wanted to see, we parked our car a block away and walked or took the subway everywhere. Lots of restaurants, shops and museums. The Tenement Museum was our favorite.

author: Molly Z
title: Dave and Wanda
text: Great location, close to restaurants, subway, taxi's ..etc. Clean well kept older hotel with great air conditioning. Friendly staff and descent location.

author: Pierre P
title: Great Experience & Great Location
text: Loved staying in Chelsea...this is a great location! Eight minute walk from the train station--and street lined with florists. Clean room, albeit a bit small. Rooftop bar. Free coffee service. Helpful, friendly staff. Would def stay there again.

author: Lea H
title: Great location in the Flower District.
text: I thoroughly enjoyed the refreshing fragrance of the plants and flowers every day. This hotel is within walking distance to lots of attractions, Penn Station and Madison Square Gardens. Quite a variety of dining options are within a few feet of the hotel, which also has its own rooftop restaurant.

author: Elena Z
title: Exceptional Hospitality — Johnathan and Prabesh Made Our Stay!
text:
Exceptional Hospitality — Johnathan and Prabesh Made Our Stay!

I’m staying at the Cambria with my daughter and grandchildren, and I felt compelled to write this review because of two exceptional members of the front desk staff: Johnathan and Prabesh.

From the moment we arrived, they have been incredibly friendly, helpful, down-to-earth, and genuinely kind. And I don’t mean simply doing their jobs well. They have gone out of their way to help us with everything from finding pizza and giving us directions to suggesting things to keep the kids busy and entertained.

Traveling in New York City with grandchildren can certainly keep you on your toes, and having two people at the front desk who actually take an interest in making your stay easier makes an enormous difference.

What impressed me most is that nothing about their helpfulness felt forced or rehearsed. They were simply genuinely nice people who wanted us to enjoy our stay.

In a city as busy as New York, that kind of personal attention and hospitality really stands out. The Cambria is very fortunate to have Johnathan and Prabesh representing their hotel.

Thank you both for making our family’s stay so much easier and more enjoyable. You are a wonderful example of what hospitality should be!

author: Julien U
title: Overall wonderful experience
text: The room and location were great. Juan was so amazing this morning he helped me charge my phone before my travel this morning. I will be back! Great price and location and service.

author: Liam A
title: beware of parking lady
text: The location is great, close to MSG. We went to the roof top bar it was great! The room was reasonably priced, comfortable and clean. All of the staff was friendly and helpful, except for the short, chunky, rude Hispanic woman who was yelling at my husband about pulling the car to the front of the hotel to pick me up with the luggage. Apparently, her boss was coming, and she did not want us to park there for minutes. We threw the luggage in the back and left, such a bad way to end a nice time. We never saw the boss-wish I had.

author: Henry E
title: The Rush tour visit to NYC.
text: The location was excellent — right in the center of everything we wanted to see and within walking distance of Madison Square Garden for the Rush tour. The atmosphere was perfectly fine, typical for a city hotel. The rooms were very small, and the bathroom was so tight that moving around was tricky. Still, the hotel offered good value for the price. Noise levels were generally alright. Service is where this hotel truly shined. Chelsea at the front desk was absolutely OUTSTANDING. She remembered us, including my wife’s service dog Tucker. She showed him extra care and greeted us by name every time we passed through the lobby, and made us feel genuinely welcome.  Her warmth felt sincere and never overbearing. Chelsea was every bit as good as the Rush concert — and that’s saying something. The morning breakfast that most hotels offer consisted of different coffees and teas, but not even a bagel could be seen. Overall our stay was average except for Chelsea that really made it stand out from other hotels

author: Ruby C
title: Great experience
text:
Great place to stay when visiting nyc
Fab location! Would recommend!

author: Ethan L
title: Beautiful service!
text: Room 1806 was wonderful for a city view. My check in experience was amazing with Chelsea and Brian! They treated me like family the moment I walked in. During the busy day that the World Cup was happening, they remained professional and friendly through and through. Whatever I needed, they were on it with swiftness and grace! Later during my stay Juan had exactly the energy I needed after a long night out with family. I came in late and Juan greeted me like a long time friend which I appreciated. You have an amazing team here with this property.

author: Elena V
title: Terrible never again
text: They canceled my room never told me they said they emailed me and checked my spam never received anything. They were able to put me up in a new room, but the bathroom was unsafe because all the bathroom handles in the shower were broken

author: Ruby K
title: Chelsea and Brian - Two Gems of Hospitality!
text: Chelsea and Brian were exceptional hosts. They went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed. They were genuinely concerned when we lost a jacket. They located it and other staff were also helpful. Their pleasant attitudes were refreshing. In a city that a t can seem rushed, they both were calm and relaxed yet very attentive to our needs.

author: Chloe W
title: Wonderful stay in Chelsea!
text:
I recently stayed at the Cambria Hotel & Suites in Chelsea for a few nights and honestly couldn't have asked for a better experience. From check-in, the staff were warm and welcoming, and Johnathan in particular went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. He was so helpful and made the whole arrival process feel effortless.
To top it off, we were upgraded to a suite on arrival, which was such a lovely surprise. The extra space made a huge difference, and the room itself was spotless, modern, and really well designed. You could tell a lot of thought went into the little details, from the layout to the amenities.
The location is fantastic too, right in the heart of Chelsea, close to great restaurants, shops, and easy access to the subway, so getting around the city was a breeze.
All in all, this was one of the best hotel experiences I've had in New York. Big thanks to Johnathan and the rest of the team for making our stay so memorable. Would absolutely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting the city!

author: Sara B
title: Great stay with beautiful views
text: Nice, clean room with a gorgeous view. The front desk staff was welcoming, friendly, and very helpful. Highly recommended!

author: Antoine P
title: Great stay!
text: Perfect location, near subway and walkable to many places. The two queens room was large for four people. There is coffee available in the lobby at mornings. The rooftop was perfect. I could easily stay here again.

author: Andrea K
title: Great location, friendly staff, needs care
text: Overall, the hotel has a great location. It’s close to all of the subway lines and major attractions. The staff is friendly and responsive. It was a positive stay. However, the cleanliness could be improved. The glass was pushed back on the counter in the room and it was clear it wasn’t cleaned. The bathroom was also tired and the room door and cabinet door weren’t aligned and were hard to close. It would benefit from some TLC. Overall, however, a good stay.

author: Mason F
title: Positive experience.
text:
Great staff at convenient location. Updated ADA King room.  Good breakfast place at end of block.
Discounted parking 2 blocks away.

author: Isabella R
title: Showing it's age...but still good overall.
text:
I've stayed here multiple times since it opened and you can tell it's one of the original hubs: the carpets in rooms and corridors are looking a bit worse for wear and the chair in my room was quite stained.  Also paint on skirting boards in my room was quite scuffed and flaking off where people have bashed into it with their shoes over the years.
However, you can't beat the location and the staff are always amazing: that's why I keep coming back!

author: Camille P
title: Great London base
text: Great location with easy access to bus routes, tube, restaurants, Covent Garden, Leicester sq etc. Super helpful staff and a really great, fresh, plentiful continental breakfast. Rooms may be simple, with no coffee/tea facilities but 24hr machine available in lounge.

author: Adam U
title: Friendly and Central location.
text: Picked this hotel due to its location, as it is very central.  Staff extremely helpful and friendly. Loved the electronic signs to say DND and dont clean room etc. Rooms small but contain all you need. (Except drink making facilities which are available 24/7 in bar)

author: Mathis W
title: Our stay at Premier Inn Hub
text: Amazing stay and perfect location. Staff and management we’re Fantastic.

author: Elena X
title: Birthday get away
text: Great location clean and friendly staff could not be more helpful

author: Aiden E
title: Fantastic location
text: Can’t fault it in anyway, tidy rooms with a good shower and a tv, 24hr bar and free tea and coffee all day and night would recommend and stay again, staff very friendly, it’s a small room but I knew that and it doesn’t bother me as it’s just a base and a place to sleep. Handy luggage storage under the bed also was a plus!

author: Thomas H
title: Perfect location
text: Perfect central location for Palace Theatre, Covent Garden, Trafalgar Square and restaurants. Helpful and friendly staff. Will stay again.

author: Juan V
title: Amazing place, the hub Covent Garden.
text: The service, rooms and  location was incredible. Great place and Zara , Harold and Christina were superb.  Super friendly and nothing a problem. They are an asset to your company. We shall be back. Keith spouncer xx

author: Sophia K
title: Avoid!
text: Never again, never! €334 a night without breakfast, without housekeeping or clean towels, you have to ask for them before noon, if only one knew... No information in the room about this, no information, no safe, no refrigerator, no storage, a mini closet for 6 dresses. Unpleasant staff. We went there at the opening 11 years ago, it was very good, the service has deteriorated considerably. It was a surprise for my daughter for her midwifery degree. And to top it all off, they charged me more than what was agreed upon on BOOKING. Too bad, it ruined our stay, I regret booking with my eyes closed, I had a good memory of this hotel. For the same price you can get much better…

author: Matthew K
title: Great location, great place to stay
text: Great location; welcoming and attentive staff; clean, comfortable,  air-conditioned room; good selection of delicious breakfast items.

author: Nathan L
title: Loved the Hub by Premier Covent Garden!
text: We LOVED our stay at The Hub by Premier Covent Garden.  Location was fantastic. Close to cafes, pubs, restaurants and shopping. Our room was amazing. Couldn't have been happier with our choice of hotel in London, it was absolutely perfect!  Staff was so happy, friendly and professional. Breakfast was delicious.  Great choices. Thank you to all the staff for making our stay the best!  Can't wait to return!

author: Jessica N
title: One of the most disappointing hotel stays I’ve had. I regret booking this hotel.
text:
Very disappointing stay. I would not recommend this hotel.

The only positive thing about this hotel is its location. Unfortunately, everything else was below expectations.

* The staff were unfriendly, unhelpful, and appeared poorly trained.
* Housekeeping was only done if we specifically requested it. Even then, the room was not cleaned properly—the floor wasn’t vacuumed and the overall cleaning was poor.
* The room had a tiny window with almost no natural light, making it feel dark and uncomfortable.
* There was a lot of noise in the hallways, making it difficult to relax or sleep.
* Water did not drain properly in the shower, leaving water pooled on the bathroom floor.
* The bathroom sink faucet had a faulty aerator, causing water to splash everywhere whenever it was used. It was a small issue, but incredibly annoying because it happened every single day.

Overall, the location is the only reason to consider this hotel. The hotel itself did not meet even basic expectations, and I would not stay here again.

author: Lucas J
title: Fab london hub
text: Absolutely everything about this hub is fantastic,  staff location cleanliness. Would never go anywhere else thoroughly recommend.

author: Harper G
title: Perfect location!
text: This Premier Hub is in the perfect location if sightseeing in Central London is what you plan to do. You are able to easily catch the tube or bus  nearby or call an Uber to the front door.  Theaters, restaurants and bars are on the street or  in walking distance and are nice and affordable to boot. All central London attractions are in walking distance.  The rooms are small but provide all you need, beds are very comfortable. All of the staff were excellent, very helpful!  Great value for the money!

author: Owen G
title: An enjoyable stay
text: The staff are polite, friendly and helpful. The room was clean, comfortable and roomy enough. A control panel in the bed head allows adjustment of lighting, air conditioning, etc. The breakfast bar is easy to use, with a nice selection of items for Continental breakfast. The location is reflected in the price, but the hotel is right in the centre of Covent Garden, very convenient for theatres, National Gallery and other attractions. I’d be happy to stay there again.

author: Erin A
title: Birthday visit
text: Excellent location , short walk to theatres , food, bars, shopping and a bonus great air conditioning!

author: Emma I
title: Not worth the cost
text:
Not worth the cost. Rooms are tiny, but the price is that of a much bigger and better room elsewhere.

Staff were lovely and I got a great night's sleep. But I can get that elsewhere for £275.

author: Samuel R
title: Good for solo travelling otherwise not much privacy.
text:
The room was hygienic and comfy. 
However the bathroom is a thin glass box with a vaguely clouded privacy screen. And so there is very minimal privacy both visually and audibly. 
There is also very little soundproofing so we woke up several times to random thumps on the ceiling. 
The highlight was the aircon which even though it was very slow it did eventually cool down the room.

author: Taylor K
title: Bit Disappointed!
text:
This wasn't a pleasant stay 😔 
Luckily only stayed one night. 
Firstly there was no tea/coffee making facilities in the room ! Now we've stayed at plenty Premier Inns and they all had these . There was tea/coffee available 24/7 from ground floor (we were on 5th) but first thing in the morning you want a cuppa when getting ready for your day, and last thing at night getting ready for bed ...
Secondly.. funny now when we're telling friends , but the bed was so high! Not easy getting in and out of bed as a couple! Could of done with a ladder 😂.. socket's were on other side of bed on the wall so had to scramble to get on the bed to reach them ! Now this probably wouldn't have been a problem to 2 spring chickens , but we're in our mid to late sixties with a few joint problems so not ideal really ... 
Everything else was great, nice big TV, bathroom lovely and clean and staff lovely.

author: Mason F
title: The only place to stay in London
text:
Our 3rd stay. Perfect room. Air conditioning ideal for the heat wave
Great breakfast 
Brilliant attentive staff
Will be returning for our 4 stay
Thanks guys x👍😊
Ooops central location bunny hops from Trafalgar Square

author: Freya O
title: Good hotel for Javits Center cons
text: Great location, very helpful front desk (shout out to Jessy), and large room.  Walls were a bit thin, but otherwise solid.  I chose it because it was close to the Javits Center and a reasonable price, bonus was having diverse restaurants within a block because I'm lazy and don't like going on an adventure for food.

author: Evan M
title: Basic, comfortable, spacious
text: My Daughter and I had a fantastic stay here. Jessy greeted us and immediately made us feel welcome. We were very early for check in so she checked our bags and offered to call us when our room was ready. Overall the hotel needs some updating but the room was clean and spacious and the bed was comfortable. We were on the 3rd floor so there was a good bit of noise from the street but that is to be expected and it didn't disturb us at night. The hotel is in a pretty decent location. It is about 10 minutes walk from Times Square away from the majority the crowds. Easy walking distance to the subway. If you are looking for all the amenities and luxury this wouldn't be the place for you. It was a great place for my daughter and I to sleep at night. I can't say enough great things about Jessy. She really made us feel at home and she went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed and more. Thanks Jessy and we hope to see you again!

author: Jack F
title: ANYC 2026
text:
Nice and comfortable hotel with super spacious rooms and super close to everything we were going out to see.  We were able to walk to everything we were in the city for without much issue (aside from the weather but that’s out of everyone’s control).

Also huge shoutout to Jessy at the front desk for being super personable and working with all of my group’s requests.

author: Kyle W
title: Home away from home
text: Truss has become our home away from home. After our first stay last year for anime nyc we decided to to come back not only due to great rates and how close it was to javits but also because Jessy at the front desk has become of our family away from home. Helpful, insightful, kinda and true. The staff will do their best to help and accommodate you during your stay. Not to mention provide city tips and tricks while you’re staying. We can wait to come back next year and stay at truss but also see Jessy !

author: Ryan R
title: Would Stay Here Again
text: Truss hotel exceeded our expectations and Jessy made it even better! She was so friendly and helpful to talk to every time we’d come and go. Would definitely recommend this hotel, clean and updated rooms. Great location too!

author: Sydney K
title: A Wonderful Stay at Truss Hotel Times Square ❤️
text:
We had a truly wonderful stay at Truss Hotel Times Square and honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.
From the moment we arrived, the hotel had such a warm, welcoming and almost family like atmosphere. Every single member of the staff was incredibly kind, friendly and helpful. From the security team and housekeeping staff to the front desk, everyone made us feel genuinely welcome and cared for. It is rare to find a hotel where the entire team is so consistently warm and attentive.
Our room was beautiful, comfortable and very well maintained. It was spacious, cozy and had everything we needed to feel at home after busy days in New York. The cleanliness was excellent, and we especially appreciated how comfortable and peaceful the room felt despite being in such a lively part of Manhattan.
A very special thank you goes to Jessy at the front desk, who truly deserves a mention. She was absolutely wonderful , warm, professional, attentive and always willing to help. She made us feel like valued guests rather than just another reservation. Her kindness and genuine smile made such a difference to our stay. Jessy is a real asset to the hotel and someone we will definitely remember.
Overall, Truss Hotel Times Square exceeded our expectations. The location is fantastic, the rooms are lovely, but what really makes this hotel special is the people. The entire team creates an atmosphere that feels personal, welcoming and genuinely caring.
We would happily stay here again and would absolutely recommend Truss Hotel Times Square to anyone looking for a beautiful hotel with wonderful people and a true feeling of hospitality.
Thank you to the entire Truss team and especially Jessy for making our stay so memorable! ❤️

author: Anna S
title: thank you jessy <3
text: this hotel is such a gem in manhattan! it’s walkable distance to ktown and penn station, and overall the location is a good area! the rooms are very lux and thank you to jessica (jessy) for such a pleasant experience and great customer service that she made us feel so welcomed and comfortable during our stay, even going so far as to upgrade our room for free! she is such a wonderful person and i would gladly come back again! much love from north carolina!!

author: Hannah P
title: I will be back!!
text:
Jessy was so amazing and greeted us every time we came and went! She was so personable and kind!
I absolutely loved my stay here and will definitely be coming back because of Jessy and her hospitality!:)

author: Pablo X
title: Great experience at Truss Hotel at Times Square
text: Jessy was great. She was so friendly and kind and remembered my name all throughout the trip. She was very helpful and joyfull!

author: Mason U
title: Great customer service
text: My family and I stayed there and had a great experience. Jessy at the front desk is super nice  and  augmented to our positive experience with our visit to the city. She’s warm, sweet, friendly and her customer service skills are second to none. She seems nurturing and a naturally genuine person. I thought everyone at the front desk including the ladies who made the rooms were courteous, welcoming , and definitely know how to take care of their guests. I highly recommend staying there!

author: Freya O
title: Amazing staff and spacious rooms
text: We went for the weekend to a concert and it was my first time in NY, the facilities were very clean, and spacious, the staff so helpful on everything I need and Jessica help us a lot with directions, she have  such a great personality. 100% recommend this hotel, we are def going back again for the holidays !!

author: Harper V
title: Jessy is the  girl!!
text: Jessy was the best! From the second we arrived she was welcoming, knowledgeable and the true definition of GREAT hospitality and service. Jesse went above and beyond our expectations from where to shop eat and transportation! Huge kudos to her!!

author: Hannah P
title: Completely satisfied
text:
We had a wonderful stay at this hotel and were completely satisfied. From the first moment on, we felt warmly welcomed and in the best of hands. The entire team was friendly, professional, and always helpful.

We would like to give a very special compliment to the receptionist, Jessy. She was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and took care of our requests with great dedication. Thanks to her warm manner and her helpfulness, we felt especially comfortable during our entire stay. Such excellent service is not a matter of course and made our stay even more pleasant.

We can recommend this hotel without reservation and would love to come back anytime. Many thanks to the entire team – and especially to Jessy – for the great hospitality!

Ilona and Raymund

author: Lucas C
title: Great service & location.
text: Bright, clean, spacious room, perfectly located for Penn Station, Times Square, Central Park and all the other key attractions. The highlight though, was the service received by Jessy on the front desk. Friendly, smiling, always greeting me by name. Happy to advise on dining options (and her recommendation was spot on!) and just genuinely helpful. I had a couple of requests, and she was on to it right away. I’d highly recommend Truss.

author: Ana S
title: Great staff ! Thank you for being so kind Jessy !
text: This is the first time I stayed at the Truss hotel. I was immediately welcomed by Jessy and received the upmost service. She was very knowledgeable about the policies and the details of the hotel. I made a great choice booking with truss and Jessy sealed it with her hospitality and guidance ❤️

author: Liam M
title: First time visiting NYC
text:
The location is great. Times Square and Central Park are walking distance from the hotel. The atmosphere is fantastic. The rooms are kept very clean and this hotel provides daily housekeeping. It was great to return back to a nice clean room. Jessica (aka Jessi) has been extremely helpful and amiable. She greets me by my name when exiting or returning to the hotel and made great restaurant recommendations. Thank you Jessi for making our stay in New York welcoming and special. 

-Jacqui

author: Erin W
title: Overall great stay
text: My daughter and I stayed here for one night to see a Broadway show. Overall great stay! Only issue was the loud bang that the AC made each time it turned off. Woke us up throughout the night.

author: Lucy J
title: Beware of Fake Reviews. A true 2 Star Hotel that matches with its hospitality
text:
I was completely misled by the overwhelmingly positive reviews of Truss Hotel NYC.

The photos online appear to be heavily filtered and do not accurately represent the condition of the rooms. In reality, the rooms felt outdated and worn. The bathroom was particularly disappointing, with moldy grout, broken tiles in the shower, and an overall lack of maintenance.

The walls were paper thin. I could clearly hear the television from the room next door, making it difficult to relax or sleep. The hallways were dimly lit and had a gloomy, almost creepy atmosphere that made the property feel neglected rather than boutique.

What surprised me most was the lack of hospitality. We arrived at 3:15 PM, just 45 minutes before the advertised 4:00 PM check-in. I politely asked whether a room might be available a little early since I was traveling with an infant. The front desk agent immediately shut down the request with zero empathy or attempt to help.

I then asked if I could leave a single piece of luggage while waiting at a nearby coffee shop and was told there would be a $2 charge to store it. In all my years of travel, I have never encountered a hotel charging guests to hold one bag before check-in.

Once we finally received our room, I requested a crib for my baby. It took approximately three hours to arrive despite multiple requests.

Overall, the property felt tired, poorly maintained, and far less welcoming than the reviews suggest. Between the condition of the room, the noise issues, and the disappointing customer service, I would not stay here again. The glowing reviews honestly left me questioning their authenticity.

Save your money and look elsewhere.

author: Antoine I
title: Great!
text: Awesome would stay again! Nice for a 1st visit

author: Daniel A
title: Quiet & clean space. Splendid staff!
text: As soon as I arrived, the front desk clerk Jessy gave me a warm welcome. She was very clear on the rules & was pleasant & polite while going over them. The room was clean & there were no issues. The hotel was quiet as well! I forgot a very meaningful gift when I left and Jessy went out of her way to hold it for me until I was able to get it!

author: Tyler I
title: Rome Art Hotel 2026
text: The hotel is in a central location making it easy to get around Rome.  On our first day Joseph was wonderful.  Getting us checked in early, recommending places to eat and helping with transportation.  The “bell hops” went over and beyond with help.  The breakfast was a wide variety of foods.  The breakfast was ran by Juliette, who was friendly, attentive and a hard worker.  The room and bathroom were clean, the bed comfortable and the towels fluffy.  Staying here helped make our vacation in Rome memorable.

author: Wyatt L
title: Great spot
text: Great location very central. Knowledgeable staff for sightseeing advice. Nice rooms.

author: William D
title: Do not stay here
text:
My wife and I stayed at Rome Art Hotel for our honeymoon and left within an hour of check-in. The room had a strong cigarette smoke odor, visible dirt on walls and curtains, worn fixtures, and carpet—not the hardwood floors shown on every photo of their website. Our allergies worsened noticeably during the short time we were there, and the thermostat never worked despite waiting an hour. The front desk manager was polite but unable to issue a refund, so we were forced to book another hotel at our own expense on our honeymoon night.

We submitted a formal written complaint to hotel management detailing all of the above and requesting a refund. We never received a response.

The property does not reflect what is advertised. If you’re booking for a special occasion, I’d encourage you to look elsewhere

author: Amelia I
title: Good hotel.
text: The welcome and room were pleasant, and the location in the center of Rome was perfect. We had dinner one evening at the hotel restaurant, which was charming and served very good food.

author: Julien R
title: Changing from a 4-star to a 3-star hotel
text: We had made a reservation for hotel arts rome we were referred from one 4 to the hotel trevi where you do not correspond quality price do not spend on this hotel that you throw money

author: Sofia N
title: Certainly not 4 stars!
text: Location is great but that is the only up of the place. The reception is tight with hardly any room to sit and wait. The staff is not rude, but not especially pleasant either. Our room was ok but very basic and smelled of bad drainage from the toilet. The lift is tiny and doesn’t go to all the floors. Breakfast is in the building across the street accessible by 3 flights of stairs. Food is not great and you will be better off eating out in the nearby places. The hotel is bed and breakfast standard not 4 stars as it suggested! No toilet in the reception and no facilities on the site.

author: Zachary W
title: Perfect location for a short stay trip
text:
The hotel is in such a brilliant location, in very close proximity to the Trevi Fountain and the Spanish steps less than 10 minute walk and the Colosseum, Pantheon and Palatine Hill are only 15-20 minute walk away. We walked pretty much everywhere with the exception of visiting the Vatican due to being 45+ minute walk and our early morning booking. 
Overall, the room was clean, had everything we’d need. It is a small/narrow building so the rooms aren’t very spacious, just be aware if you’re travelling with multiple cases. We were on floor 5 and found it to be very warm, we couldn’t get the AC to work so had the windows open which just meant the noise from the street was much louder but that’s just Rome! You’re in the middle of the city, it’s what you’d expect. 
I wouldn’t recommend the breakfast option, there’s plenty of bakeries, cafes and restaurants nearby. We had one experience on our first morning of the hotel breakfast, where we had to leave the building to go to another building. Once there, none of the tables were clean, the breakfast room is incredibly tight anyways so you had very little room to sit, you had to squeeze by to let others past, and we found the breakfast options were pretty poor. Also the coffee machine wasn’t working. As we left a member of staff did apologise so maybe we just had our experience on a bad day for them 
Overall, a nice hotel to stay for a short trip

author: David Z
title: Perfect stay
text:
It was very good, location, cleanliness of the rooms and very friendly reception and always support in any situation.
Thank you

author: Giulia E
title: Fantastic Location
text:
After reading reviews I was very sceptical, and when, on checking in, we were told that a colleague would escort us to our room in another building across the road, my heart sank
However the room was small but very acceptable, with a well equipped bathroom with good walk in shower
Beds were made and fresh good sized towels daily
It was more like an apartment as no hotel lobby to relax or bar
However in Rome we were out and about so didn’t miss these facilities 
Location was perfect, lots of eating places around and close to a number of main attractions 
We were room only so can’t comment on breakfast 
I would definitely stay again and I according to my loved ones are “quite fussy”

author: Morgan J
title: Waiting on a reply from the hotel regarding my left bag of Jo Malone perfume
text:
After having a lovely two day trip to the art hotel in Rome with no complaints at all really. We didn’t actually stay in the hotel we were put in an apartment block next door which was fine. We had a lovely big room which was spotlessly clean and all staff lovely and very helpful. I now have to complain that none of my messages on email and Instagram have been answered and when I try to ring the reception it just says it can not connect me. I have left my brand new Jo Malone perfume still in the bag in the room on the table in room when we checked out on Sunday morning around 10.15. When I discovered I had left the perfume yesterday after unpacking my case I sent an email straight away and an Instagram message and also tried to ring the 24 hour reception but also with no joy. I have sent several follow up messages but still have had no reply, just a simple acknowledgement would be nice and obviously to check if my perfume has been put to one side by the wonderful room cleaning team 
Mrs Victoria shea

author: Anna Z
title: Excellent location
text:
There's room for 4. Reasonable breakfast.
Spacious room. Comfortable beds. Large room.  Excellent bathroom

author: Abigail V
title: Images do not correspond to truth
text: An experience to forget. As soon as I arrived at the hotel I discovered that the room I had booked did not exist. I'm told the images on the site don't match the actual rooms. I paid more to have a simple triple.. I don't comment.

author: Aiden K
title: Awful receptionist!!
text:
Arrived on Thursday morning and I I must say the receptionist who greeted us was very nice and friendly. Although he did tell us that we were not in fact staying at this hotel after all, but instead at the Trevi Hotel Collection on top of the street. Fortunately this other hotel was nearby, clean, very friendly accommodating staff, and in hindsight I’m so glad we stayed in the alternative hotel, although I’m aware they come under the same group.
When I was getting my airport transfer this morning, (sunday 1st) , I had to make my way back to the Rome Art Hotel. This was at 6.20am. Note that I had my 9 year old son with me , just wakened. I was greeted with a different receptionist, having a full arguement with my bus transfer driver. He was shouting non stop. The driver thankfully remained calm. The receptionist was so so angry and shouting. I felt so uncomfortable and uneasy , as did my son , first thing in the morning. He eventually spoke to me to tell me this was my driver. He asked for my room key, but before letting me even explain the scenario of being changed to an alternative hotel days ago, he got so agitated that I was not a resident of this hotel and had no room key. He proceeded to shout. I told him he was being so rude and he continued to be so argumentative , that he was not rude and followed me outside the door. Extremely unprofessional. I left that hotel feeling so embarrassed and thankful I was not staying in that particular hotel after all. Awful that he thinks he can act this way as a staff member. 

All staff at the Trevi Hotel Collection were fantastic!! So make sure to book that hotel rather than the Rome Art Hotel.

author: Liam C
title: We would definitely return
text:
The hotel was perfect for our requirements. We travelled as a family of 4 and the room we were given was very spacious, 2 double beds with plenty of room to spare. The location was great, a short walk from the trevi and other attractions. If you walked in any direction from the hotel you were sure to find something! 
 
The room was clean on arrival and cleaned everyday. We loved opening the windows and watching everything going on outside. 

The gentleman at reception was warm and welcoming and there was someone who helped us take our bags to our room on arrival. 

I would recommend this hotel to anyone going to Rome, it’s a great base for exploring.

author: Pierre M
title: Perfect location
text: Nice and quiet hotel close to all sights. Hotel is located in beautiful old building , with modern rooms. Friendly staff, friendly staff.

author: Luke Y
title: Super
text: Fantastic hotel cleanliness kindness service great optimal location I recommend it to everyone, if you want to do a weekend in Rome

author: William B
title: Great location and great staff
text: Excellent structure from the point of view of both logistics and staff. Clean, tidy, friendly and helpful staff.

author: Miguel F
title: Rome is great
text: Hotel was nice and clean. Rooms where big location was great. Breakfast was not great. If I went there again I would skip that .the first day we went to a pizza place under the building. Alfredos they ripped us off. avoid this place .they go by some other name .don't think the Hotel are anything to do with them. But they should tell ther guests to avoid. Giving rome a bad name.

author: Ella E
title: Great staff, especially Roberto.
text:
Perfect location, close to all historical attractions. 
We didn't have a meal at the hotel but I have to say that the hotel is very clean and organized at a very high level. Very serviceful staff and especially a specific receptionist named Robert, he worked the day and was available to all our requests and questions, always with a smile and a lot of help.

author: Marta N
title: Very pleased.
text:
Respond to your needs!!
The service was perfect, they were very patient and helpful and caring, especially Roberto!!! 
The room was a little small for three girls but it was just enough, the location of the hotel was perfect, right in the center. 
Just a few minutes walk from the fountain , from the Colosseum , from the Pantheon , from the Spanish stairs and from the corner of Corsu , short of all the major tourist sites 
A huge branch of Spora right under the hotel which is perfect for anyone who loves makeup 
Full of restaurants and cafes in the area one or two crossings away 
Perfect hotel, excellent service and excellent location.
Really recommend !!

author: Oliver F
title: family stay in Aldgate
text: I always love Premier Inn, you know you are going to get a comfy sleep and a fabulous breakfast. it was well located, easy to check in, and delivered everything we expected.

author: Laura N
title: good
text:
A hotel with a very good value for money. The breakfast was good overall, although I found it a shame that there was no cheese such as Emmental or individual pots of yogurt. Apart from that, everything was fine.

But I am writing this review especially for IDA from Bar & Block. I really hope she remembers me, because she truly saved my day from becoming extremely frustrating.

I was travelling with my daughter, who has coeliac disease, which makes food a particularly complicated issue when we travel. When you have a child with dietary restrictions, you prepare everything carefully in advance. I choose hotels and restaurants where my daughter can feel comfortable and enjoy her holiday without constantly being reminded that she cannot eat like everyone else.

Before coming, I had even emailed the hotel to make sure there would be gluten-free bread available at breakfast. I was reassured that everything would be fine and that I had nothing to worry about.

Then, on the third day, I was told that there was no gluten-free bread left because the other guests had taken it all the day before.

I was extremely upset. Not simply because of the bread, but because I had done everything I could in advance, I had trusted the hotel, and yet I still found myself in this situation.

And then IDA stepped in.

She took the time to listen to me, to really understand the situation and, most importantly, to put herself in my shoes. She showed incredible empathy and did everything she could to find a solution to a problem that, I would like to point out, was not her responsibility.

She works in service, but she ended up solving a problem that should have been anticipated and managed beforehand. And that is exactly when I realised that Ida has something special: she understands customers, the reality of the job and, above all, the human side of things.

You might think that it is “just a problem with bread”. But for a little girl who is already labelled as “different” because of her illness, having to be reminded during her holiday that she cannot eat like everyone else is not a small thing.

Ida changed that. She made me smile again and saved what could have been a very disappointing day.

Honestly, Ida, perhaps your place is not only in customer service. You clearly have the qualities for management, leadership or strategy, because you understand what really happens on the ground and what the customer actually experiences.

So, once again: THANK YOU, IDA ❤️  5 stars for IDA

As I told you in my slightly broken English: you are the boss! 👑
The whole staff is also very friendly
From Fetta
(Feta, like the cheese 😂)

author: James I
title: nice hotel for families
text:
Clean and nice hotel. Close to bus and subway. 
A stone's throw from Brick Lane.
Great breakfast. 
Attention, restaurant prices are high.

author: Marta T
title: Good stay, as expected
text:
Area felt safe and quiet yet less than 5min walk to tube (on 2 major lines). Well priced for central London.

Room was clean and beds very comfortable. Typical premier inn, so as expected really. Air con in room was very welcome but switches off during day when not there. Staff polite and efficient on the whole. 1 lift out of order and 1 with key card security not working which was inconvenient at times but we were on a low floor so could use the stairs when needed.

Breakfast tasted good and hot food was plentiful but staff struggled to keep up with demand for cold food, particularly pastries and yogurt (couldn’t always get what we wanted and had to scrape the yogurt to get any. Area around pastries/breads and coffee machines was very cramped so lay out maybe needs a re think

author: Matthew S
title: Allergy family stay
text: Couldn’t not shout out 2 standout members of staff, Ron at check in who sorted our family room early for us to get our children unpacked and ready and Ida (apologies if I spelt your name wrong) at breakfast who very greatfully overheard us speak about our daughters allergies to a member of staff at breakfast who was not very understanding (to say the least!), Ida came over and took care of everything. She made our daughter safe and feel so special. As parents to a child with severe allergies this meant the world to us. Thank you!

author: Katie M
title: Drop in quality of services and breakfast
text:
2nd time in this hotel and the quality has dropped significantly. Starting with our arrival where we were waiting at the counter and we were made to understand in a tense way that we have to do it on the machine all by ourselves
Only one elevator in service and noisy air conditioning, we had. Booked the premier plus room 
The highlight is the breakfast, undersized for the number of guests, so there is a wait regardless of the time and a lack of food given the number of guests, service is totally overwhelmed and mediocre quality of the breakfast...

author: Emma O
title: Great hotel
text: I stay at this hotel every week. All the staff are great but I wanted to give a big shout out to Sadie and Alina. Fantastic on reception.

author: Ryan E
title: Great location and stay
text: Alina was extremely helpful at check in.

author: Ella A
title: Value for money but a few disappointments
text:
The breakfast was good. The location is good as Algate station is only a short walk away. 

I have sleep apnea and need to use a CPAP machine. There was no accessible socket beside my bed. When I asked reception if there was an extension lead that I could borrow, I was told no so I had to go and purchase one at my own expense. 

The bathtub was not draining properly so when showering, there was 2 inches of water around our feet. 

The air dryer exploded in my daughters hand while she was using it. She was unharmed but got a very bad fright. 

We wife cut her finger on a razor and asked at reception if she could have a plaster from the first aid kit and was told there was none.

author: Paige N
title: Amazing room!
text: The room is absolutely lovely and the staff super helpful! Ron made sure all our friends were on the same floor and even let us check in early. Amazing experience!

author: Lucia J
title: Great hotel and staff
text: We really enjoyed our stay. A special mention to Ron who went above and beyond to make our stay really enjoyable.

author: George Z
title: Great time
text: Perfect location few minutes from tube. Great facilities close by. Hotel clean, staff helpful. Recommend if you are not after luxury somewhere clean and tidy as a base for hols.

author: Harper N
title: D and D
text: Stayed with family in July had a great time hotel comfortable staff helpful and pleasant; rooms clean breakfast plentyful a very enjoyable stay indeed oh and yes thank you for the chocolate and flowers on our retirement stay.God Bless

author: Jack P
title: In general, it is a highly recommended hotel to stay at during your vacation.
text: In general, it is a highly recommended hotel to stay at during your vacation, although they should have international TV.

author: Grace D
title: Great stay
text:
We have stayed at this hotel for three nights. It was not our first time, as we had stayed there twice some years ago.

The hotel is comfortable and has everything you could need. However, we noticed that the hotel is starting to show its age, as some things in the room were broken, such as a chair and the toilet flush. On the other hand, some areas had been renovated, including the TV and the bathroom.

As for breakfast, it was as perfect as always, with a great variety of options available in the buffet.

I recommend this hotel because it has a convenient location, close to Aldgate East Underground Station and only a 15-minute walk from Liverpool Street Station.

author: Carlos H
title: Great location and lovely stay in London!
text:
I had a great stay at this hotel. The location is excellent, just a few minutes' walk from the tube station, bus stops, and bike-sharing stations. The neighborhood itself is beautiful, well-served, and very convenient, especially for anyone arriving at Liverpool Street Station from Stansted Airport.

The hotel was clean, and the room was quite spacious, featuring a bathtub. The staff was always courteous and helpful. Breakfast was good, though as an Italian traveler, I would have appreciated a few more sweet options like cakes, along with fresh bread and a selection of cold cuts and cheeses. A few small room additions would also make the stay even better, such as an in-room safe, extra blanket options, and of course, a bidet.

Overall, I am very happy with my choice and would definitely stay here again on my next trip to London. Great value for money and an incredible location!

author: Molly W
title: Much better than first glance
text: I was pleasantly surprised by this hotel. On first impression, you could see  the wear. However, after being in my room for a while, I realize several wonderful things about this hotel. The bed was possibly the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in. The shower had ample water, flow and water pressure, among the best showers I have ever had in a hotel. The towels were large and very plush. I was shocked to receive something so nice in a hotel. After I got used to the keycard being in the slot by the door, I found that I had wonderful air conditioning where I could cool off after hot days walking around the . The breakfast was also wonderful. I was fortunate to have delicious and plentiful food every day.

author: Megan Q
title: Business visits
text: I have been coming to this hotel for the last 5 Years on my work trips to London and they have never failed to excel. The restaurant staff are very friendly and helpful, the breakfast staff know me by name and I always get a warm welcome. The receptionist, some I know well, always greet me with a smile . Rabena has been very helpful on my recent visit.

author: Oscar N
title: Good experience overall
text:
Very pleasant hotel. Excellent location for the purpose of the visit. My room was spacious and spotless. Had a fab nights sleep.

Only a couple of cons. Firstly can you put bedside USB ports in all rooms instead of just superior rooms. Your budget friendly competitor provides these. Also swap your tea bags from PG Tips to Yorkshire Tea. It’s far better taste quality and I don’t know anyone who likes PG Tips.

We ate in the restaurant attached to the hotel and while to food was delicious we found the staff (evening) to be a bit rude. Everything seemed an inconvenience to them

author: Benjamin H
title: Exceptional accommodation in the center of London (The City).
text: Highlighting the very central location from where there was very good subway access to anywhere in London, spacious rooms, the staff very friendly, and highlighting the great comfort of the mattress and pillows, something that is not found in just any hotel and after a whole day of walking it is greatly appreciated to find such a comfortable bed.

author: Manon J
title: Amazing experience
text: Amazing service and a wonderful experience! Nikola was extremely helpful, kind, and attentive throughout our stay. The atmosphere was lovely, and the entire team was friendly, welcoming, and very professional. Highly recommended—we would definitely stay here again!

author: Gavin N
title: Superb!
text: Great location for all amenities and a superb room! I had a good view of planes overhead and being a plane spotter this was great! No faults from us. Comfy mattress and pillows and although the room was warm we coped with the fan provided. Thanks for a great stay!

author: Wyatt C
title: Great stay
text:
Stayed at this hotel during our last visit to London. Great value, clean and in a good spot to explore London. Room was quiet and comfortable during our stay. When we arrived there was no problem storing our bags until our check in time this was a great bonus as we could make the most of our time. Only downside was that there was no AC in this hotel and as it is so hot during the summertime. ( As lots of hotels in London are.) But a fan was provided in the room. 
Nearest tube stations are Moorgate and old street. We found the bus stop right outside the easiest way to get to where we wanted to go. We would definitely use this hotel again.

author: Nathan W
title: NIKOLA
text: Good service thank you nikola

author: Holly I
title: Amazing Travelodge
text:
Staff were amazing, especially Nikola who was so accommodating and understanding of any issues raised. She works round the clock to ensure good service!

Location was very ideal as you can cycle round most of London with hireable bikes nearby.

Room was standard as most Travelodge’s, kept clean and room of a good size.

Overall good value for money!

Only issue was the fire alarm going off a few times, with one at 4:30AM.

author: Ryan V
title: Pizza Girl Sadness the Day!
text:
I travel with an autistic twelve year old who is very particular about what he eats. He had the pizza here and loved it, so naturally he wanted it for breakfast. 

The staff weren't expecting this twist during their breakfast rush but they do two you when they check in they serve pizza 24 hours...so they honored our request. Particularly Nikola went in the kitchen to make my son his pizza and he was so very happy with it! 

Thank you Nikola for going above and being and helping us. If he doesn't eat he gets hangry in the extreme and we were about to go sight seeing for the day and her willingness to help us literally prevented this day from starting out as a nightmare. 

Also she made us cappuccino which was soooo good!!!! Just the thing I needed to face the day!!! Thank you Nikola for your help and effort!!

author: Lily C
title: Amazing helpful staff especially NIKOLA 🙌🏻
text: This is  a special shout out to Nikola @ travel lodge city central road . She has the perfect welcoming smile which should be in hospitality business . Kind and super helpful . Overall staff is great and friendly . Will always come to this place when around . Keep up the good work guys 🙌🏻

author: Harper N
title: Great hotel, good value for money.
text: Pleasantly surprised and satisfied with my stay at this hotel, good value for money and breakfast included! Which, by the way, is very good and offers quite a few things. The restaurant is good too; it also offers click and collect to eat in our room. As for the latter, the room is decent, sufficient for passing through and sleeping. A small drawback is that you hear a lot from outside the hallway when people allow themselves to slam their room doors; sometimes slight odors in the bathroom, but it is very slight. We were welcomed very well; there is the possibility of leaving your luggage if the room is not ready.

author: Adam L
title: WARNING: Bed bugs, ruined clothes, no AC, and zero response! AVOID THIS HOTEL!
text: deeply regret staying at this hotel. I saw previous reviews warning about bed bugs but unfortunately didn't take them seriously enough—now I am suffering from the exact same nightmare.I was severely bitten during my stay and I am still constantly scratching myself days later. My health has been seriously compromised. Because of this infestation, I had to wash all of my brand-new, expensive clothing at 60 degrees, which has completely ruined my clothes.When I confronted the staff, they just said "sorry", but a simple sorry doesn't fix your health or your ruined belongings. To make matters worse, I submitted an official complaint through their "Contact Us" form, and they haven't even bothered to respond. It is incredibly disrespectful how they play with people's health and completely ignore their customers afterwards. This hotel seriously needs to be shut down by environmental health.Aside from the bed bugs, DO NOT stay here during the summer or warm periods. There is no air conditioning at all. They only provide an outdated, old-fashioned fan, turning the room into an absolute sauna. Furthermore, the breakfast is extremely basic and looks nothing like the photos online.While the on-site staff were polite, that means absolutely nothing when your health is ruined, your vacation is destroyed, and management completely ignores you. Do not make the same mistake I did. Save your health, your money, and your clothes: DO NOT BOOK HERE!

author: Molly L
title: Good stay

author: Paige G
title: Travelodge breakfast

author: Lily H
title: Good meal good staff specially Kim
text: Kim is so nice, good meal good staff

author: Lauren K
title: London central city road
text: We had an amazing stay here, location is great and stuff are amazing. An extra shout out to Kim, who work the morning breakfast she was super friendly and went above and beyond to help would definitely stay again

author: Lea O
title: One night stay in august
text: Stayed here for one night after watching a show. Very friendly staff and a clean room. No ac though but they did supply a fan and open window.

author: Evie W
title: Dreadfully hot
text:
No air con, tiny window that didn’t open. Over 30° in my room all night. 
Won’t stay here again, well maybe in the depths of winter.  shame because it’s a good location for the Barbican.

author: Kyle N
title: Lovely food very helpful
text: Really friendly, good food great service

author: Aaron L
title: Not the Dream you expect
text: have stayed at the Dream Meatpacking 4 different times, wouldn't stay at this location. It was cheap and we had a flight disruption but the rooms are in very rough shape, ours smelt like someone had been smoking in there for 20 years. We ended up checking out early, they offered us to switch rooms. Lobby is nice, all the amenities were closed which is probably why the room was relatively cheap but still don't think it justified the price we paid, i would have put this in a 2 star hotel category for our stay. Bellman are very nice and others working too, however the billing was all messed up took 2-3 calls to figure it out because we were overcharged.

author: Ella P
title: Not too dreamy
text:
Best feature in the room was a nice working ac. The room itself was very small, and when I asked why there was no Globalist upgrade, I was politely told I should have asked for one. The room was very cute, although not sure if all lights worked. Bathroom and closet were tiny, no room to even place toiletry bag in the bathroom.
It was kind of noisy in the room all night, and not the street kind of noise...Bathroom has a loud fan that will not turn off at all. There was also similar type of noise coming from elsewhere, so sleeping wasnt so dreamy.
Lastly, breakfast was awful. Everything was bad, beverages, food, appearance. Mosquitos and flies circling your table in the restaraunt was an added nice touch.

author: Tyler Z
title: Dreams could use a revamp
text: Staff was very nice at check-in and check-out. Carpets are old and dirty. Room smelled musty. Bathroom was clean. This hotel could use a revamp.

author: Michael R
title: Convenient location
text: Stayed at this hotel overnight for the united airlines half marathon in March 2026 and enjoyed our short stay. The later check out time made it so I could stop at the room and shower before checking out after completing my half marathon (I was in an early corral which made this possible). The attached bar was great and will define let stay here again next time I run the race as it was very short walk from the finish line and close to the subway to get to the start. Room was small and kinda of an odd layout but no issues for an overnight trip.
