author: Pablo Z
title: Good hotel. Give it a go!
text: It’s a great hotel. The reviews here are a tad off, and personally, I have to say I disagree with the consensus listed below. In my view, the hotel is fine. They take great care of their guests. The experience is top notch. Also, the location is great. The hotel rooms are fine. I genuinely have nothing to complain about. I’d suggest the hotel.

author: Nora G
title: Worst stay ever, by far.
text:
Never going to stay at another Hyatt Hotel after this one.  Our room wasn't ready when we tried to check in.  Check in time was 3pm and we showed up after 4pm but the room still wasn't ready.  Tried calling to see if our room was ready and got no answer, transferred, put on hold, and hung up on.  Finally did get checked in around 5:30pm and got no comps despite the room not being ready, being an honors member and the piss poor servi
ce .  The tiny, dirty, musty rooms made us not even want to come back to the hotel room to unwind after a long day, or even sleep for that matter.  The only amenity that was available to us was two bottles of water.  The rooftop lounge that they touted was closed.  The only positive thing that we experienced at this hotel was the Bell Hop who was super nice and had been at that hotel since the 80's when it was a Ramada.

author: Poppy F
title: Super cute hotel in perfect location.
text: Super cute hotel in perfect location. Clean, nice room, comfy bed, great bath products. Shared a room with my daughter and we went to a broadway show - fantastic weekend. Will be back in the future!

author: Lucia D
title: We would ome back
text:
The hotel felt safe, the location was excellent, the bed was comfortable, and the room was very clean.  

The rooftop bar was closed which was disappointing but mainly we were happy and would return for another stay.

author: Evan R
title: Dream Hotel was cozy
text: Nice experience at this hotel. Very clean and loved the decor. Service was great. I was disappointed that the rooftop bar and The Rickey were closed. Those amenities were a huge factor in choosing this location. Excellent location in the theater district.

author: Joseph J
title: Convenient and clean
text: Good hotel for midtown. Right next to yellow line and easy walk to Central Park. Tons of restaurants and sights around. Very solid choice.

author: Jessica Q
title: Treated like Family
text: The hotel was so lovely, and the Prosecco happy hour was a sweet touch! At the front desk, Rimma welcomed us like family with a huge smile and waters. My spouse needed a fridge for insulin, and one was delivered to our room within minutes. Loved breakfast next door.

author: Claire M
title: Dream Midtown Rocks!
text: The staff is great! Especially David R. at the front desk, he did everything just right and couldn't have been kinder. He went above and beyond! Sean our Bellman was so helpful and like David a pleasure to interact with! Edwin our Doorman also so helpful and  attentive. The suite was quiet, clean, comfortable and oh so roomy. Dream Midtown is in a great location near so many great restaurants and bars. It is walking distance to Central Park, Broadway and Columbus Circle! It was a great stay! The Rickey and Serafina were fun and fabulous and on site.

author: Emma Q
title: Great Stay 4th of July Weekend
text:
We had a great stay at Dream Midtown. Our suite was very large, and having two bathrooms was a huge plus. The room had plenty of space, including two TVs, a couch, a table to eat at, a refrigerator, and comfortable beds.

The staff was very friendly and helpful. We had an issue with our air conditioner, and they fixed it immediately—we didn’t have to wait at all. We also brought our bikes with us, and it was a non-issue, which made coming and going really easy.

The hotel also has a nice dedicated area in front for loading and unloading, so getting our luggage and bikes in and out of the car was very simple. We were even able to find free street parking nearby, which was a great bonus.

I had seen some reviews mention that the decor felt outdated, but that wasn’t really our impression. The hotel definitely has a specific boutique style, with wallpaper, patterns, and colorful details, so it may not be for someone looking for a very plain or minimalist hotel room. To us, it felt more like part of the hotel’s personality than a negative.

The location was very convenient, close to Central Park, near lots of things to do, and with the subway right around the corner. Overall, it was a great stay and we would definitely recommend it.

author: Claire J
title: Great staff
text: We have stayed twice at Dreams Midtown and both times the staff went above and beyond, helping us with every need that came up.  Very warm and professional.

author: Andrea K
title: Great location but that’s it
text: The hotel is a great location and our room was a decent size and was clean. Unfortunately the staff was not very responsive to concerns including two nights of cigarette smoke inundating our non smoking room

author: Claire A
title: Horrible stay
text:
Room view was laughable
Brunch hours were inaccurate
Furniture is falling apart; bed was peeling 
Room upgrade was not initially offered for Globalist, and when it was, it was not an worthwhile upgrade
Construction everywhere
Rooftop closed.
Laundry carts in the way of the elevator.
No gym onsite, requires walk off property.
Bar closes early and not open everyday.
No invoice sent at check out.
Wrong bill sent and then wrong refund initially applied.

author: Evie I
title: Keep Dreaming
text: If you expect to enjoy The Dream Midtown, keep dreaming.  The room was really junky and cheap.  Chipped plastic coated furniture.  The TV was tiny.  The towels were cheap.  The bed was fine. No issues with the bed.  But the room felt like a $59/night motel.

author: Hugo Z
title: Rooftop closed
text: Very disappointing that the rooftop was closed. They should offer the lounge game area open to everyone to compensate for the rooftop not being open.

author: Marta Q
title: NY Knicks Parade stay
text:
I came here for a two night stay to celebrate the NY Knicks parade. So many hotels to choose from but chose Dream Midtown because of the location near Central Park and Broadway. 
Everything about this place is excellent!  Room was perfect, just the right size. Everything seemed brand new, which I really wasn’t expecting. Bed was very comfortable and noise level was very low. 

I also appreciate the staff at the Dream Midtown. The person who checked me in was named Mike. When I came back to front desk the next day, he actually remembered my name and greeted me fondly!  Mike made me feel really special. For a staff member to remember my name, after so many customers checked in, it shows me to me how much he is vested in making sure my stay is excellent!

I highly recommend Dream Midtown!!

Thank you!!!

author: Louis Y
title: Great stay at the Dream Midtown
text: The staff is always friendly. Mike, Mina, Kevin, and Ed were amazing. The location is great if you want to go around NYC as it is centrally located and it has a subway stop close by. Great service all around. The rooms are a little dated and small but clean. Most NYC hotel rooms run small so not unexpected.

author: Alexander S
title: worse hotel
text: worse hotel l had ever been my entire life it’s outdated need major renovation from bathrooms to all rooms NO air condition unit works, spider on our bed and in the bathroom 2 more, the manager was careless, this was done through Super.com by cheating us as it’s 4 star hotel in fact it’s 1 star hotel.

author: Andrea E
title: Worst hotel
text: The absolute worst hotel! Do not stay here! They will charge you for a nightly excursion for every day you are there but not tell you and will not send you an invoice. I did not book the reservation, the person I was with did. They needed a card down for incidentals but told me I would be refunded (which I did) However a week after we checked out I was charged $175 with no information telling me about the charge. I contacted the hotel with no response. Two months I have been trying to get my money back and when I FINALLY got a response from Alfrie, and they don’t care, they will not help you and will not take accountability for their staff’s mistakes. This hotel will scam you for your money

author: Poppy R
title: No deposit refunds - don't stay!
text:
Very poor. They took a large deposit on arrival and never refunded it. I asked them for the receipt of the deposit, and they assured I would receive the money back. I emailed multiple times and have had no help. 
I do not recommend

author: Holly K
title: Very good stay
text: It is a 3-star hotel with an unbeatable location, the rooms are simple, but it is clean and we didn't have any problems during our stay. I would definitely stay at this hotel again. The hotels located in this area are exorbitantly priced and this hotel is great value for money. Do not pay attention to the reviews you read here.

author: Alice T
title: Dishonest Service
text: Had room booked and paid for Saturday night. Was told upon arrival room was not available, and was not given a refund as it was a non refundable reservation . Very unethical and lousy customer service .

author: Henry F
title: WORST HOTEL EVER
text:
We are extremely dissatisfied with our stay. When we checked in, we were on a floor where the Wi-Fi didn’t work. We changed floors, and the Wi-Fi worked at first, but then stopped working after a while. Yesterday at 3 AM, while we were sleeping, some men forced the door and it opened. We had locked the door, but if it weren’t for the upper latch, the door would have opened completely. We tried calling the front desk, but the phone didn’t work either. Overall, terrible service. We’re extremely disappointed.
The receptionist looked skeptical of our story, but he called a young man over to help us. This just shows how terrible the hotel’s security is!!!

author: Poppy C
title: Just Awful!!! Stay elsewhere.
text:
The Gallivant Hotel - extremely disappointing!!! WOULD not recommended to travellers. During our stay we experienced:
* No hot water on three separate days
* Broken beds and furniture in the room
* Our hotel room door that did not close properly and was left open to the hotel corridor
* There was a clear burnout of one of the GPO’s which was evident on the wall around the socket, which gave us much cause for concern
* No screen on shower
* Housekeeping was sub-par and we were never provided with enough towels for us all
* Bugs evident in the bathroom
* Overall room conditions were below even basic hostel standards.

We did raise our concerns with the manager on the 3rd night of no hot water and they did switch our room the following night (to a slightly better room), the night manager also agreed to compensate us one of our nights stay. However, this never came to fruition.

While the location is great, this hotel is NOT worth the price you pay!!!

author: Ruby S
title: Top
text: Reading other reviews I was a bit scared, but in the end we had a very good experience. We only came back to sleep, but the location is fantastic, you are practically in Times Square!!! Comfortable bed and they always restocked the coffee pods in our room. At the front desk some were a bit more reserved, but others were kind. If I really have to make a complaint, it's the 4 dollars you have to pay to leave your luggage on the day of departure if you have an evening flight. For the rest, I highly recommend it.

author: Manon C
title: terrible stay
text:
I had a terrible stay at The Gallivant Times Square. To start, the hotel lacks its own parking facility and directed me to an off-site garage. When I arrived, they refused to take my car, stating the garage was completely full.
Things got even worse when I checked into the room. The room and bathroom were unbelievably tiny. Even the bed was micro-sized—barely suitable for a child. I am a short person, yet I had to sleep curled up in a fetal position just to fit on the bed.
To top it all off, I woke up early with a severe headache due to a strong, overpowering smell of pesticides that filled not just my room, but the entire hotel.
Overall, this stay was uncomfortable, frustrating, and unhealthful. I strongly advise against staying here.

author: Henry S
title: Super bad experience
text: my stay was from July 14th to the 18th! Be careful with this hotel, they make charges to your credit card without your consent, they made 8 unrecognized charges to us and we are just reviewing it with the bank and we are reporting all the charges because they make them the day you check out and they appear up to 2 or 3 days later on your statement even when they give you your receipt with a zero balance!

author: Jack B
title: Be warned
text:
Beware…the customer service needs lots of work.  We are currently staying here and our room is ‘premium’ and was said to have a fridge but none hers.  We’ve asked front desk numerous times to which they say they have said they will talk to manager and we’re still waiting.  We are trying to be patient but It’s 98 degrees out and we have some stuff that needs to be refrigerated.

Pro:  hotel is in good location

author: Poppy N
title: Excellent experience!
text: We had a great experience at the Gallivant Hotel! At check in, the person who served us was very friendly and attentive! We stayed on a floor on top where the room was impeccable and had everything we needed. The fact that the hotel has a free drinking water dispenser also helped a lot in our daily life. The hotel staff was always very friendly, the location of the hotel is also very privileged because it is very close to Times Square. At the level of quality-price we are sure that it was money very well spent, and if someday we return, the probability of staying at Gallivant again is very high!

author: Owen P
title: Meanest and horrible hotel
text:
Pro of hotel:  close to time square 

Cons:  hotel room too  small 
No electric kettle in room 
WiFi  your luck if you get it 
No  drinking water bottles  provided 
Hotel don’t  have any food or breakfast 
Reception staff  too rude 
Horrible small bathroom  where we have to bath horizontally  no space 
Basic amenities not there

author: Harper E
title: For the price, the location and the family room setup, I would stay here again
text:
Stayed here at the beginning of June and overall had a good experience.

The rooms are definitely showing their age and could do with some refurbishment, but it didn't really hamper our stay. We booked a family room with bunk beds, which seem surprisingly difficult to find in New York, so the hotel has a great niche for families with older children. I have two teenagers who understandably didn't want to share a double bed, so the bunk bed setup worked perfectly for us.

The room and bathroom were clean enough for our needs. To be honest, when you're visiting New York, you're hardly in your room anyway! One slight disappointment was that our Premium Family Room was advertised as including a fridge and safe, but we had neither. After reporting it, I was told they would be delivered to the room, but they never appeared. It was all a bit strange – almost like something out of Fawlty Towers!

On our last day, one of the lifts broke down, which wasn't ideal when trying to get luggage downstairs. Another issue was the room doors, which tend to slam shut quite loudly. When guests arrive back late at night and let their doors bang closed, it can be quite disruptive. Installing soft closers would make a big difference.

That said, the reception area is lovely, the staff were friendly and helpful, and the location is excellent. Turn right when you come out of the hotel and Times Square is literally a two-minute walk from the hotel, making it a fantastic base for exploring the city.  Turn left and you have loads of places to eat think it may be hell's kitchen area.

For the price, the location and the family room setup, I would stay here again. I also had no issues receiving my deposit back after checkout.

author: Ian O
title: It was an okay stay
text: Our stay here was fine only a couple of complaints like the first day we checked in there was no hot water and it happened again on the last day which put us an hour behind on our last day but they did get it fixed both times. The blind on the window didn't come down completely so there was pretty big gap for light coming through in the morning. There was a lot of street noise but not much they can do about that, I suggest bringing earplugs. At check in we did opt in for an upgrade to a deluxe room for an extra $10 a night but I think this is falsely sold as an upgrade because our room was very similar to a basic room. Your stay here won't be perfect but if all your looking for is somewhere to sleep then its perfectly fine.

author: Sofia V
title: Amazing stay - no idea what people’s problem with this hotel. I would stay here again
text:
Amazing hotel and great value for money. I honestly don’t know what people’s issue with this hotel is. 

The room was very clean and no issues, had everything I needed. Bed was comfy and clean along with the floors. I only had the room cleaned once during my visit and they did a great job 

The staff are very friendly shout out to Aziz. Everyone was lovely and friendly that I dealt with. However if you give kindness and respect out you get it back. The lobby is busy and the front of house have to deal with a lot of ppl

Couldn’t get a better location

My security deposit I paid $100 a night for 5 nights $500. They took off my taxes and charity donation (it’s $1 per night if you can afford NYC Times Square location you can afford $1 a night for a charity). I checked out on Saturday my security deposit was back into my bank account the following day a Sunday. 

Would stay here again when I come back.

author: Anna D
location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain
title: Watch Your Credit Card Charges Carefully
text:
Our experience at The Gallivant Times Square was extremely disappointing and stressful.

At check-in, we were charged a $500 security deposit, which we understood and accepted. However, during our stay, the hotel charged us an additional smoking fee after claiming that the smoking detector in our room had been triggered.

The major issue is that we do not smoke. After insisting that this was incorrect, hotel staff checked their own system and confirmed that the detector in that room had been malfunctioning for multiple previous stays. According to what we were shown, previous guests had also been charged because of this defective detector. This raises serious concerns about how this issue was handled before it was identified.

We were told by hotel staff that this smoking-related charge would be refunded, along with compensation related to the inconvenience caused.

However, it has now been over a month, and despite multiple attempts to contact the hotel through our travel agency, we are still waiting for the refund of the smoking charge.

What is even more concerning is that additional charges were made to our credit card after check-out, without any clear explanation at the time. We have had to involve both our travel agency and our bank to investigate these transactions.

The lack of transparency, poor communication, and unresolved charges have made this one of the worst hotel experiences we have had. We strongly advise future guests to carefully review all credit card charges during and after their stay.

author: Nora Q
text:
I so wish I could give this hotel a 4/5 star absolutely nothing wrong with our stay staff we’re great, rooms were great, the noise was not too bad you are in time square I really don’t know what people expect. The room was clean bed was clean toilet was clean. Atmosphere was okay, doesn’t have somewhere to eat in the building but you was 3 seconds down the road and there’s places open till 4 in the morning. No problems yes it’s outdated but of paint work chipped here and there but nothing to complain about it’s a room to sleep in. 

My problem is since the end of our trip I have been trying to get the deposit back which I have shown them has come out of my account, if it was only £50 I don’t think I’d be as pushy, but £222 ($300) being taken out and at the time being told that it will be refunded 5/7 days after check out and having to email everyday showing bank statement after bank statement, the cheap close to everything hotel is just not worth the aftermath. I have been trying for days to get my money back and unfortunately without sounding like a total Karen will have to take it further as it’s a lot of money to just suddenly not get back after being told I would.

author: Alexander I
title: Not good
text:
it was not very good , they need to keep up with their renovations and it’s not well taken care of. This could have been better on so many levels but again didint expect any better with it after looking at reviews , don’t let the photos get to you because they’re really old . The location is great tho , love how close it is to Times Square, OUR ROOM DIDINT LOCK BTW !!! this is very unsafe especially traveling with children and if you want to feel safe in a hotel go to Marriott . 
The bathroom had these stains that looked like dead bugs on the ceiling which was terrifying while showering , would never stay again .

author: Marta X
title: Thanks to the staff for being the best part of this hotel
text:
We stayed for 4 nights. 

Great location. Staff were amazing, the housekeeping were so friendly and helpful and other staff were fab so cannot fault them. 

We are well travelled and not massively fussy but these rooms were really not great. We did an upgrade to a queen room - don’t bother. The bed and room is tiny, so much we doubted it was even a queen. Dirty and old rubbish furniture and decor which was falling apart. Our room stank of damp. Felt like one of those places where you don’t really want to put anything down on a surface. For 2 days we only had cold water and were told the boiler was being fixed and WiFi didn’t work for most of the stay. No water fountains so had to risk water from the dirty taps or go buy bottled water which we chose to do instead. Multiple people were arguing about swapping rooms throughout our stay and apparently being told there was no options so we didn’t bother and just stayed out unless we were sleeping. 

They charge you 100 dollars per night as a deposit which they then say takes 5 days to clear upon departure so we are holding our breath on whether that’s returned but also have the extra money ready as we were never informed of this prior to the stay. Also it’s horrifically loud due to the location so unless you’re a deep sleeper or going to be so busy you can’t stay awake don’t bother, it didn’t really bother us in comparison to the other issues. 

Personally wouldn’t recommend this hotel unless you’re used to hostels

author: Harry F
title: Unexpected welcome
text:
Although the hotel is conveniently located to most tourist attractions I would not return or recommend to families.  
The rooms are very small, the beds a small doubles and there is only one single wardrobe. It’s a challenge to find space to open your suitcase. 
The elevator situation is terrible, we took the stairs down from floor 24 on a few occasions as one elevator was out of action. The elevators are also used by the staff, which also slows down the flow. 

Outside of the hotel had to be the biggest surprise. There are public benches which appear to be the home of several homeless drug addicts, who sit there day and night in various states of consciousness.

author: Luca B
title: Very good for the proximity!
text: Easy to access, comfortable and clean room. Paid parking very close by. The reception is supervised by a guard at all times, so even if the neighborhood seems less secure, it is well protected.

author: Isla L
title: Excellent, ideal hotel
text: Exceptional hotel, helpful and friendly team, adequate and clean rooms

author: Erin P
title: Do not stay here
text: I don't know where to start. First the area in front of the hotel is open to the public so there are drunks and people smoking weed all the time. Then the front door was broken for a couple days as well as one of two elevators. Then the elevators, there are only two elevators and that are shared between staff and guest which is unfortunate for all parties. The staff is delayed and the guys have to be in the elevator with leaking trash bags. The room seemed fine at first if a bit small but there was a corner of the room that smelled like urine the entire stay, the cleaning crew only does a very basic once over and the comforter and sheets are often dirty, I felt sick in the room and often had to go outside to feel better. The front of the hotel is a designated public area which I understand but at all hours there are teens, adults, and homeless people passed out, drinking, or vomiting on or around the benches. There was also apparently a leak downstairs so they had to come into our room on two different occasions to work on the shower and then we were told not to use it for some time. I'm sure there is a lot I am forgetting, but we rented here because my daughter had to come to NYC and this was close to where she had to go for her activity next time I'll book somewhere else even if it's further away. I would not recommend this place at all.

author: Caleb Z
title: Great room. No issues
text: Very Nice Stay! I used my IHG cardmember free night award for this stay and was happy to find availability in the heart of NYC. Room was small but we don’t spend a lot of time in the room. It was clean and appeared to be recently renovated. Elevators are an issue in most NYC hotels so just be patient and not a big deal. Location is great for exploring NYC.

author: Aaron D
title: Friendly Faces
text: A very convenient location so we were able to walk to many of the sites that we wanted to visit. We was located a few miles from Time Square. The Empire State building was right outside our window. There were plenty places to eat even a restaurant in the building bThe beds were very comfortable and the staff very friendly and helpful.

author: Chloe U
title: Just okay
text: It was was an ok place nothing fancy but alright fpo

author: Ethan Z
title: Beautiful and confortable hotel with great location.
text: We loved this place. The rooms are super clean, the bed confortable, perfect temperature in the common areas and room. We found NO WAITING on the elevators (maybe a minute) and everyone has been super kind. Special shoutout to Rocky and Henry!

author: Ella H
title: Good location
text:
The lobby is small with only two lifts, this is expected with the footprint of the structure.
Staff friendly, room clean.
Latitude restaurant nice.
I did not like people not staying at hotel hanging outside of lobby, drinking alcohol and a strong smell of weed.

author: Alexander L
title: Disappointing stay due to rude staff and poor security — plus unexpected credit card charge
text:
I stayed at the Holiday Inn New York City - Times Square on May 17-18, 2026, after booking and paying in full through Chase Rewards. While the location is convenient for Times Square, the overall experience was very poor.
The hotel has 35 floors but only 2 elevators. Expect to wait 10-15 minutes for an elevator, especially when checking out, or be prepared to take the stairs.
On Saturday, May 16, around 4:00 PM, during check-in, I approached a security guard with a simple question. He became visibly upset, got in my face, and responded aggressively. This set a bad tone for the stay. Later, a homeless woman entered the elevator and was actually more polite and friendly than several staff members I encountered.
The area outside the hotel has many homeless individuals, and while security tries to manage it, guests should be aware of the environment.
To make matters worse, even though I paid the room in full with rewards, a $184.02 charge appeared on my credit card. This appears to be an incidental authorization hold that has not yet been released, but it has been over 2 weeks.
I was planning to leave a negative review based on the service and facilities alone, but the billing issue has made the experience even more frustrating. I would not recommend this property based on my stay.

author: Michael Y
title: Quality Stay
text: Great location. Clean rooms. Friendly service.

author: Molly U
title: Read The Review
text:
We stayed at the Holiday Inn Times Square in April 2026 as a family of three (two adults and one teenager). We chose the hotel primarily for its location, which is undeniably excellent—very central and convenient for accessing Times Square and most areas of Manhattan.

However, our first impression on arrival was not particularly positive. The outside of the hotel often had groups of people sitting around smoking and drinking, which didn’t create the most welcoming atmosphere. Inside, the reception area is very small, dated, and quite cramped. Unlike many hotels where the lobby feels spacious and impressive, this one felt busy and limited, with just a small check-in desk, a vending machine, a cash machine, and lifts.

We stayed for four nights in a room with two double beds, though these were more like three-quarter size rather than full doubles. The room itself was extremely compact, and overall the hotel feels quite dated. The carpets, furnishings, blinds, and air conditioning unit all seemed in need of updating.

Space was a real issue. With luggage, it became quite difficult to move around, and storage was minimal. The wardrobe could only hold a handful of items, and there was nowhere practical to store suitcases once unpacked. The in-room safe also didn’t feel particularly secure as it wasn’t fixed in place.

Tea and coffee facilities were very basic, and in our case, they were missing on arrival—we had to request them. We also had an issue with a broken bathroom door that wouldn’t close properly, which took three days to fix.

On a more positive note, the hotel restaurant, Latitude, was excellent. The food quality was very good, the service was outstanding, and the happy hour was a nice bonus. Breakfast, which was included, was quite basic—scrambled eggs, chicken or turkey sausages, and bacon, with limited pastries, coffee, and orange juice. It was functional but lacked variety (no beans, mushrooms, or tomatoes, for example).

We were on the 28th floor, and while lift wait times are often mentioned as a concern, we only experienced a couple of longer waits—overall, it was manageable.

In summary, the hotel is okay at best. The location is its biggest strength, but the property itself feels tired, with small, dated rooms and underwhelming facilities. It doesn’t quite meet the standard you might expect from a Holiday Inn. With some renovation and improvements, it could be much better—but as it stands, it’s more about convenience than comfort.

author: Ian L
title: Amazing view if you’re lucky to get a high room
text:
We arrived at the hotel, the reception is really tired and cramped. We had an issue checking in but staff were quick to resolve and we had the most amazing room view on floor 34!! We never closed our blinds. We could see SUMMIT and the Empire State Building clearly.

We were 2 adults and 2 teenage boys the room was small, two double beds, very little storage but we only slept there and it was adequate and clean. 

The people sat outside are not an issue and didn’t bother us, with very little seats available in the area I can see why they congregate there. 

Times Square area is very very busy and having been twice now I wouldn’t stay in this area again. There are far better neighbourhoods to stay in. Where the hotel is located it didn’t seem the best neighbourhood especially after we read reports on incidents very close by. 

Subway station is a short walk and so easy to use.

4 start review is mainly for the view and room cleanliness

author: Chloe B
title: Great hotel! Great location
text:
Stayed here in December 6 adults! 
Hotel was fab! Great location! 
Staff wa slow it and security was always on the door no matter the time!! 
Rooms was alright there was 3 adults to a double room which was fine when cases are organised and sorted! 
Would definitely stay here again, would recommend it! 
Stones throw from everything!! 
Rooms was always cleaned and yes the lifts was busy but it’s to be expected at busy times… 
Everything is on your door step with shops, cafes, food and we even loved beer aurthority just up the road!!

author: Ella R
title: Far location
text:
Brilliant location for every thing a tourist could need
We were a family of 4 and although the room was a tad small we only used it to sleep in! 
We read the reviews on lifts and the ample signs stating when to avoid the lifts and never encountered any issues as were out early
The wet few days meant no unwanted gatherings out the front of the hotel but there was always a security presence!

Thank you for a great 4 days

author: Megan X
title: SHAMBOLIC, PATHETIC & SCARY EXPERIENCE !!
text: Pathetic, Shambolic, Scary Experience. The front of the hotel is crowded by drug addicts with strong smell of weed and drugs on the forecourt as well as in the lobby of the hotel - very scary experience. I thought the worst was over but not. My room had very strong smell of weed and drugs, it appeared the previous guests were having drug and weed sessions in that room. Me and my wife could not stand that, I have allergy and could not stop sneezing. The interesting and shocking bit is that the old fellow who checked us in already knew about the state of of that room because when we came down and complained he said I know it is not the best of the rooms, we tell guests not to smoke in the room but they don't listen. The person said he could not do anything as they were fully booked and had no other room. He said that he will credit 40k points which will be good to book 1 night in this hotel as compensation. It was an absolute nightmare as me and my wife had to spend a great part of the night on the nearby streets searching for a hotel. I complained to IHG Guest relations when the points were not credited to my account even after a month. Onlyafter my complaint the points were credited to my account. Guess what I was lied by the gentleman as when I looked on the IHG website the points needed to book the same room I had booked was 66,000. I felt lied and cheated. I escalated my complaint but got the answer from John in Guest Relations that the request to make good for the points difference has been declined by GM of Holiday Inn Time Square. John said he could not do anything. When I requested John to give me the name and email of the GM, IHG group, he simply refused and said I can't this is a policy. No regard for Reward Members, buraucracy rules at IHG. Extremely dissappointed. Stay away from this property - you are pre -warned.

author: Dylan U
title: Everything better than we thought
text:
We had wonderful 4 days in New York 
The Holiday Inn we can only recommend and the breakfast at Tick tock is the best. Great ambience and great waiters.
Will definitely come back
Manfred and Ingrid

author: Harry V
title: Good Hotel at price in New York
text: Great location with easy access to public transport. Rooms were clean and of a decent size. The front desk and support staff were always helpful — we received an electric kettle on request and extra towels whenever needed. A couple of minor points: the ice dispenser near our room could be noisy at times, and elevators can have a short wait during busy morning hours. There were also some homeless individuals outside the hotel, which can feel a bit unsettling initially, but security and front desk staff are always present, so it didn’t cause any issues. Overall, a  good stay for the price.

author: Holly L
title: Good location and clean
text: Good location and easy check in/out. The room was small but comfortable and the bathroom was spacious. The place was clean, the bed was comfortable, and staff was friendly. There was some people loitering in front but security did a great job of moving them along and keeping the entry courtyard clear.

author: Laura O
title: BEDBUGS! AVOID STAYING HERE
text:
Do not stay at the Holiday Inn New York Times Square. I woke up covered in painful bed bug bites and found dead bugs in the room — I have photo evidence. The staff and manager were rude, dismissive, and completely unprofessional, refusing to move me at first and offering no medical help even after I told them I have an allergy. When I was finally moved, the new room was filthy with visible bed bug stains.

They later lied, claiming pest control “found nothing,” yet refused to tell me when they supposedly inspected — because I have proof housekeeping changed the sheets before they arrived. This hotel knowingly left me in an infested, unsafe room and tried to cover it up. I was only refunded one night out of four. Absolutely vile experience. This place should be shut down. Avoid at all costs.

author: James U
title: A true Gem in Monti District
text: We had a wonderful stay at this hotel! The location was fantastic, so close to everything. The room was spotless, and the service was excellent. Even though they were fully booked, they kindly accommodated an early check-in, which really made our day easier. The breakfast was a highligh. We will definitely be back.

author: Daniel G
title: Rome hotel of choice
text:
Stayed here for a long weekend in Rome.  Third visit in the past few years and hotel of choice when visiting this wonderful city. Small, quirky, boutique hotel within a converted traditional Roman apartment building.

Great location, 5 minute walk from Rome Termini train/ bus station. Very handy when getting train/ bus transfers from airport to the city. Next to the St Mary Major church and handy for the main attractions like The Colosseum and Forum (10-15 minute walk).

Hotel rooms are clean, modern and comfortable.  Staff are friendly and professional. Buffet breakfast is included, which is a nice touch.  Decent value given the location and quality of accommodation.

Recommended. Will return. Only has about twenty rooms, so book early!

author: Antoine X
title: Would stay again ‘When in Rome’
text: Beautiful room and location of hotel. The staff were helpful, friendly and professional. The free buffet breakfast was delicious. Cute elevator! No complaints would stay again. Good value for the money.

author: Chloe B
title: Birthday holiday with friends and wife!
text: A fantastic hotel with beautiful design. The rooms are large and beautiful. Had a room with a view of the city. The staff were very nice and service-oriented, did everything for us and for our friend who had a birthday! The breakfast was very good, coffee available 24/7. Very clean and fresh hotel. If you have to find something negative, it is the rock-hard beds, but the pillows were very comfortable. Free drinks in the minibar upon arrival. We will be happy to return!

author: Daniel K
title: Delightful Hotel
text: This quirky hotel was almost invisible from the street, but once inside you were pleasantly surprised.  Great location in Rome, but also quiet and homely.  Staff were friendly and helpful and breakfast was a further delight.  Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.  Lovely establishment.

author: Charlie A
title: Wonderful stay!!!!
text: Reserved 2 rooms and they were fantastic! The service we received months in advance and during our stay were better than ive ever received. Even from a concierge at a larger hotel. From arranging transportation to questions about the area were always responded to in a timely basis. The breakfast was phenomenal. I loved that i could be in my beautiful room with the st Mary maggiore basilica outside my window in seconds after check in after arrival with no long lines, and long hallways. Big hotel luxuries in a much more friendly environment. Would love to stay here again....

author: Lucas D
title: Wonderful stay.
text: A delightful hotel welcoming with old world charm but then modern and well presented. Pleasant staff. Room was modest but small and had a wonderful view to the square and church. Breakfast was completely satisfy with good options - especially the jam croissants. Excellent location. Good value. Highly recommended.

author: Caleb A
title: A lovely stay at a wonderful little hotel, with professional, friendly & helpful staff.
text: We stayed in Rome for a short break and had three nights here-so glad I booked this wonderful hotel. Great location, friendly, professional staff who were so helpful, clean, spacious rooms and great choice at breakfast. Would definitely recommend this hotel.

author: Grace R
title: Grreat hotel in a convenient location, exceptional staff
text:
We loved the Princeps Boutique Hotel. We had a corner junior suite with 2 windows and a view of Piazza dell'Esquilino. We watched the swallows above the rooftops every morning. The room was beautiful and had a very nice washroom with shower. The breakfasts were a substantial buffet with a lot of choices.  The location was near Santa Maria Maggiore with lots of good restaurants in the area.

Best of all were the staff. Two of the desk staff Cristiana & Lea helped us when a taxi driver overcharged us "by mistake" 100 euros. (They called the taxi company & helped us get a refund.) Tip: don't use the taxi stand a short distance from this hotel, have the hotel desk staff call a reliable taxi driver they know for you instead.)

author: Laura C
title: Beautiful Building
text: This hotel was a quick walk form the train station and was in a beautiful big old building.   The room was really well appointed with lots of space and windows that opened.  The bed was comfy and the pillows were really nice.   There is not really any common area but that was fine.  Breakfast was good although it would have been nicer if it started at 0700 but on the day I had an early start they gave me a lovely bagged breakfast.    I really enjoyed my stay here and would recommend it.

author: Samuel E
title: Cozy hotel and exemplary hospitality
text: Cozy hotel, exemplary hospitality, delicious breakfast, 24 hours with coffee machine, tea and water released! Careful, polite and solicitory receptionists! In addition to great location, close to Termini station, to great restaurants and sights!

author: Mia T
title: Upper Fine Boutique Hotel in the Centre of Rome
text: Very nice boutique hotel with 20 rooms, in the center of Rome, Monty neighborhood. Just a 5 minute walk to Termini main train station and 10 minute walk to the Colossium, simply Very good location... Very clean, helpful and warm service, lovely breakfast and all day free tea, coffee and drinks (including snacks ussaully)... highly recommend

author: Aiden R
title: Nice hotel, great location
text: Hotel in a very convenient location, close to Termini but in a quiet area (behind the Basilica of..). It is located on the 4th floor of a beautiful building and the tree itself is very nice and well organized. Very spacious, quiet and comfortable rooms, with a nice bathroom. Breakfast very varied as choice (sweet, savory) and remarkable quality.

author: Nora C
title: Great location
text: This hotel is a great option for your trip to Rome. Located in an Italian old building facing Santa Maria Maggiore’s Basilica, it is a good place to stay being close to stores and restaurants, the train station and other amenities, without all the congestion and noise of the historical center of this city. The room has a modern look and offers the necessary amenities for your stay. We even got a nice welcome gift (drinks and food). The place is quiet, and they offer a very good breakfast. The staff is nice and helpful. The only reason I did not give them four stars, is because the room is pretty small if you have several pieces of luggage. The price is reasonable compared to other hotels in the area. We will pick this hotel again.

author: Owen M
title: Very clean/safe and great staff!
text: Clean, safe, located near many historical places and friendly and knowledgeable staff.  We just returned from my trip from Italy and want to commend you on an excellent facility and staff.   I would highly recommend this place.   i was part of a group of 17 for a religious study trip and front desk attendant, Rustam, was very helpful and personable.   He not only helped us with our specific needs in traveling for a first time overseas as a type 1 diabetic, but also a dinner location suggestion and a shuttle back to the airport.   we also enjoyed his humor!   Oh, and the breakfast was really good with coffee available at almost all times.   Our room looked at over the beautiful church decorated for Christmas.   Would not hesitate to use them again.

author: Hugo O
title: Almost perfect
text: Entire staff was very good. Breakfast was extremely good. Overall a great stay in a central location. We walked to the Forum and Coliseum. I wish we had understood better about rooms with the front facing view. That's partly on us. It was still very quiet and rooms are well looked after. The only negative was that there was only 2 electrical plugs and for 2 people with phones and cameras, charging was awkward. Still it was a fine experience. Good value considering Rome is expensive.

author: Daisy F
title: Great location, nice room
text: We really enjoyed our stay at his hotel. It was our fourth time in Rome recently and this is one our favorite places to stay. They offer a small buffet breakfast each morning and unlimited water and coffee in the breakfast area all day. It's small and quiet. We stayed in junior suite room with stunning views of Santa Maria Maggiore across the street. The room was clean and comfortable. The staff was kind and helpful. They arranged a private transfer from the airport to the hotel upon request. Most attractions are within easy walking distance. Lots of good restaurants nearby. We would definitely stay here again!

author: Nathan X
title: Great hotel, great location.
text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Princeps Boutique Hotel. The location is excellent, close to everything and perfect for exploring Rome. The hotel was spotless and had everything we needed. Although the rooms are compact, they’re very well designed and comfortable. Breakfast was great, with plenty of choice and fresh options.
The best part, however, was the staff. They were incredibly friendly and helpful, nothing was too much trouble. After a long flight and an early arrival, they even offered us breakfast before check-in, which was such a thoughtful touch. Truly amazing service and hospitality.
Highly recommend!

author: Oscar S
title: A quality stay!
text: We had the pleasure of staying here on a recent trip to Rome. It's a small hotel on the 4th floor of the building and the service was amazing. The front desk staff was super helpful with dinner reservations, travel advice and even helped me to order flowers for my wife as we were celebrating our 30th. The breakfast was tasty and the selection was great. There is an automated coffee maker that is accessible all day long if you like a late day espresso. It's a 5 min walk from the train station and we had a lovely view of the the Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore. The rooms were clean, nicely updated, the bed was comfortable but our room was not huge. Counter space was at a premium and space was tight with two suitcases in the room. There was a good sized closet with a safe and a mini fridge to keep you wine cold. In terms of location, we thought we could have been a little more centrally located but there are lots of restaurant options nearby. It was a 15 min walk to the Coliseum  and a little futher to Piazza Navona, the Pantheon and Trevi Fountain. A little too far to walk to St Peter's for us.

author: William I
title: Amazing customer service - Simone
text:
WOW.  If I could give this a 10 star review I would.  Let’s start with pre-arrival.  I chatted with Simone and she arranged a private driver to pick us up at the airport.  The check in process was great and we were able to get in early with no extra charge.  

The room was wonderful.  Very comfy beds.  The breakfast was amazing and included.  Wide selection of foods.  

Then Simone arranged for a private driver to take us to the ship.  She also helped negotiate a refund when there was a small snafu with a driver.  

Finally, after we checked out, she helped me with a private driver from ship to airport and to me that was above and beyond.  

Hotel is in great location.  Half a mile walk to Coliseum.  

Can’t go wrong with this boutique hotel.

author: Hannah T
title: Good choice
text:
A very conveniently located hotel, right in the heart of Manhattan, with easy access to all the major attractions and to the neighbourhoods that are best explored on foot if you really want to get a feel of New York.

The rooms were extremely small and somewhat basic in terms of amenities, although generally clean — as long as you don’t look too closely under the mattresses! The staff, however, were friendly and helpful throughout our stay.

The breakfast was perfectly decent, without being anything particularly special, but the service from the waiters was very good and welcoming.

Overall, I would say it is a very good option if you want to stay downtown, have breakfast included, and be within walking distance of many of the city’s main sights. A practical and pleasant choice, particularly for those who value location above spacious rooms and luxury amenities.
One point worth mentioning is the elevators. There are only two elevators serving all 32 floors, which can result in significant waiting times, particularly during peak hours. In the morning, especially, there can be quite a queue, making it difficult to get down to the lobby for breakfast. This is something to keep in mind, particularly if you are on one of the upper floors.

author: Henry A
title: Great hotel!
text: Adrien was very helful. The room was very clean and came with complimentary snacks.

author: Rosie X
title: Brilliant!
text: Claire and Adunni looked after us so well. Great stay. Lovely rooms.

author: Harper B
title: Excellent hotel
text: Excellent hotel.Location ideal for subway to reach all areas. Rooms clean and comfortable with city view.Staff very professional and customer focused. Would definitely stay again.

author: Megan T
title: Noisy Rooms, Poor Service, and Disappointing Amenities
text:
I requested a quiet room away from the elevators and even arrived early to confirm it. When I returned, a different front desk representative had assigned us a room directly next to the elevators. When I called to ask for a change, I was told the hotel was fully booked and, disappointingly, the staff blamed me for the issue instead of trying to help.

The room was extremely noisy. We could hear people talking loudly in the hallways at 1 a.m., as well as trucks and construction noise throughout the night. Sleep was nearly impossible.

The room itself was small and poorly designed, with a very narrow desk and virtually no comfortable seating. The only chair provided was uncomfortable, making it difficult to sit and relax in the room. The shampoo and other toiletries were also noticeably low quality.

The hotel has only three small, slow elevators, which were often crowded and resulted in long waits.

The breakfast and coffee were also disappointing, with limited options and poor quality.

Overall, between the poor customer service, excessive noise, uncomfortable room, low-quality amenities, and disappointing breakfast, this was a frustrating and unpleasant stay.

author: Camille D
title: Good stay!!
text: The location was perfect! Nice breakfast, but the staff were so friendly and welcoming. When we checked in, they gave us a choice of soda and a snack!

author: Lucas S
title: Great visit to NYC
text: Madusha did a great job.... great visit, everything was as expected

author: Ella D
title: Happy at the Hampton
text:
Everything was great! We were greeted, given our room early and always treated so good. Joseph, Eddie, Rakhib and Rebecca made sure we were always taken care of. Definitely felt as though the employees went above and beyond to ensure we had a great stay! Free Breakfast was nice too:) 
If considering a hotel in a great location, this is a top choice.

author: Benjamin B
title: Great time!
text: Totally forgot to write a review for this place but went in Feb 2024. My first time in NY but my wife has been a few times and said the room size is good for a NY apartment. Staff weee helpful and friendly and breakfast was good. Beds were comfortable etc. Wpuld defo come back.

author: Luca R
title: Weekend in the city
text:
Great time, rooms were very nice.
Location is fantastic.

author: Connor S
title: 10/10 Stay
text: Location was amazing close to Every where I loved it and it includes breakfast which I loved you can make your own waffles staff are amazing such as Claire that I met during my stay I loved it 100% recommend for Everyone and very diverse and welcoming 🤍

author: Luke L
title: Superb stay in NYC
text:
Excellent stay in this hotel 2 minutes' walk from Manhattan, in a quiet area. The stay was perfect, we were on the 11th floor, breakfast is included in the rate, and coffee is unlimited. 
Thanks to Claire for her kindness during our checkout at the end of the stay.

author: Tyler G
title: Friendly stay in town
text: Friendly staff, comfortable atmosphere, and thankful (particularly the kids) for the morning free breakfast. Rebecca was a friendly surprise who provided me some travel pro tips as well.

author: Joseph N
title: The best place to be at a great price
text: Great hotel, great location family friendly and not far from here you need to go! Thanks to the whole team and Karen for the stay amd being made to feel welcome in the greatest country on Earth

author: Aiden H
title: Guest Experience
text: Hampton Inn Central is a fantastic hotel. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. This is the only hotel we stay in when in NYC. It is clean, welcoming, and convenient. A special shout out to Adrian, Brian, and Joseph for going above and beyond to help make our stay even better!

author: Noah M
title: Amazing!!
text:
The hotel is amazing! We come back here every time we visit New York.

The rooms are comfortable, the food is great, the location is perfect, and the staff is wonderful.

Claire is incredibly kind and absolutely lovely!

author: Paolo A
title: Great time
text:
Karen and Gin were both amazing. 
Gin checked me in seamlessly and Karen was helpful with the presentation!

author: Evie H
title: See You Soon...!!!
text:
We enjoyed our stay in each of the 3 rooms... 1 room was changed at my request & the front desk accommodated it... Brian, Noa, Joseph & Karen were all cordial and engaging & helpful...!!!
Best,
Williams

author: Mathis N
title: Super for New York
text: Super nice hotel in a central location, great for visiting everything on foot. Very kind staff, thanks a lot to Claire and the reception staff!! Breakfast super stocked with everything necessary, the drink station open all day is excellent

author: Alexander O
title: Best Vacation Ever
text: Best vacations ever (and I’ve been in so many cities in the US). The hotel was clean, the staff so friendly and helpful. Huge thanks to Claire for helping us plan our next trip to NY. She was very kind and friendly and explained everything to us so well that we were convinced instantly.

author: Sophia E
title: Non-Existent Housekeeping
text: We stayed for 5 nights leaving by 9.30am each morning to visit our daughter who lives nearby. Although we left the sign out requesting that the room be serviced this was only done on the first night and then bins were not emptied and no tea/coffee provided.  There are several hotels which are equally conveniently placed which will have our business when we return in just over a month.

author: Isla U
title: Good hotel but needs minor improvements
text: I didn’t book early check-in and arrived a bit early but Demz checked me in and the rest of the staff are friendly. The room needs some maintenance and cleaning. One of the bathroom spotlights wasn’t working, the soap dispenser in the shower didn’t work and had hand wash written on the side so no idea if it was soap or not, the shower curtain had stains on it as well. The location is very good apart from my room was next to some bars next door so can be a bit noisy which I know isn’t the hotels fault. Not the best Travelodge I have stayed at but the room was a decent price.

author: Harper N
title: Bala deserves a raise she was so kind and informative
text: Very good and very close to where we got of, we ended up getting early checking from Bala she was so complimentary and very kind

author: Kyle I
title: Stay away in a heatwave!!!
text: The hotel is not equipped with any cooling system so if the temperature is in the mid 20C steer away. Else a nice clean hotel.

author: Poppy Z
title: Excellent customer service
text: Amazing customer service from Lisa and Christelle. Thank you both for making our stay so great.

author: Ella V
title: loved my stay at travelodge !!
text:
we were greeted by lovely receptionists Lisa and Christelle who made us feel welcome after our long flight from China
the hotel was also kept very clean

author: Olivia T
title: AMAZING PLACE & WORKERS
text:
I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience at Travelodge. After travelling for over 14 hours from China, we arrived absolutely exhausted, only to find out that our Booking.com apartment had been cancelled on us.

We were really stressed and didn’t know what to do, but Lisa and Christelle were absolutely amazing. They went above and beyond and actually took time out of their own shift to help us find rooms at the Travelodge. They were so kind, patient and understanding, especially considering how exhausted and overwhelmed we were after such a long journey.

Their kindness genuinely made such a difference to us. They didn’t just treat us like customers — they took the time to actually help us when we really needed it, and we are so grateful.

A huge thank you to Lisa and Christelle for making what could have been a very stressful situation into such a positive experience. Travelodge are lucky to have such lovely members of staff. 5 stars definitely don’t feel like enough! ❤️

author: Rosie R
title: Hotel booking
text:
The hotel was fully booked, but Lisa and Christelle went above and beyond to help us find alternative places nearby that still had rooms available — even at around 2:30am! 🥹

They genuinely didn’t have to go the extra mile, but they showed such kindness, patience and care when we needed it most. Their customer service was exceptional and truly made a stressful situation so much easier.

10/10 service! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Thank you so much, Lisa and Christelle! 🤍

author: Poppy Z
title: helpful and kind staff
text: Lisa and Christelle were the kindest people, after a long and difficult journey to London and problem with our original accommodation they were the first people who actually took the time to stop and help us. They were so polite and helpful in finding us solution, we were beyond grateful for their help.

author: Joseph T
title: London trip
text:
Very convenient location so close to Thameslink and DLR railway.
It was exceptionally hot when we visited and there was a fan in the room which we were grateful for. The rooms are basic but comfortable - tea and coffee which is always very acceptable. Toilet could have been cleaner but nothing to complain about.
Breakfast was really delicious and Rasa and German went the extra mile to ensure our experience was excellent - they are a real asset to your team as very pleasant and hard working.

author: Sydney R
title: Evening meal in Travel Lodge
text: We ordered our evening meal and it was freshly cooked and reasonably priced. Service was excellent. Husna was very friendly and attentive. The dining area was clean and nicely decorated.

author: Paolo X
title: Travelogical
text:
Stayed in the Greenwich High Road branch (careful there are two in Greenwich) for an overnight in London. I do this weekly, and have lodged in dozens of Travelodges (Travelodgeii? Travelodgus?), Ibises, and Premier Inns across the Capital. This is always one of the best, perfectly located for the station and relatively quiet, also a brief hornpipe to the historical sites. 

On this occasion the pre-selected room wasn’t ready (had been cleaned but not checked) on arrival at 16:00. But Assistant Manager Demz handled it professionally, and delivered genuinely hospitable service. 

Definitely a good find.

author: Zoe E
title: Staff member recognition
text: I don’t do trip advisor but would just like to give a big thank you to your staff member Bala for going above and beyond on our stay.

author: Poppy Y
title: Give Demz a promotion!
text: Demz is amazing. She went out of her way when I said to her that I had accidentally left my car key in my room. She went out of her way, after her shift ended to ensure I could go to the room to lift the key. This is the kind of service that makes me want to book again with Travelodge. If there's a senior manager who is looking for someone who is willing to go out of their way, Demz did that today. Thank you so much ♥️

author: Alice S
title: Uncomfortable stay. Look elsewhere.
text: No air con. Over 80. Very difficult to sleep.  Harassed in the am by a woman in reception for walking into breakfast area at 7:35 am to grab an empty cup.  I have paid for breakfast but it was not open yet I guess.  Just wanted an empty cup.

author: Marta O
title: A pleasant stay!
text:
A nice hotel, great location, clean, pleasant staff. Accessible room was very spacious, clean and tidy, and well maintained.
Tea tray was standard for a chain hotel.
The lift, upper corridors and our room were quite warm…. windows could be opened a bit in the room and a fan was supplied so comfortable throughout our stay. 
The wet-room was great, toiletries provided.
The beds were comfy, extra pillows in required. The sheets on the beds were adequate for the time of the year, but quilts were also available in the room if needed. 
The breakfast was the norm for a chain hotel…. Buffet style cooked breakfast which was warm, and cold variety also available….. cereals/fruits/pastries etc. The eating area was clean and tidy.
The staff were pleasant. I would recommend a stay at this hotel, and would definitely return. 

1 night stay, in twin accessible room. Aug 6 2026. (Room 512)

Thanks for a great stay 😊

author: David K
title: in a good position, with kind staff but too hot during summer
text: without air conditioner and without possibility to open window. No cleaning, internet free only 30 mins. other things are ok

author: Carlos H
title: Renata was great at her job 😎
text:
Good room for the price although the hotel was very hot. Some walls in the upper areas could do with some paint. 
Main point of the review was to thank Renata who went above and beyond to help me out with storing my bag. Would have been a struggle otherwise with the heat so thanks for being great at your job Renata 😎

author: Thomas K
title: Breakfast and kind woman.
text: I just remembered when we stayed here. Great experience! There was this very nice woman at breakfast. I think she was called Rasa German or something? Very kind woman. She was super kind, and very gentle with our children. Would come again. For the 3rd time :)

author: Rosie S
title: Great stay!!
text: Amazing experience, staff were extremely friendly and accommodating. Thank you!!

author: Marta F
title: This is a real scam !!
text:
My stay had already been fully paid through Booking.com, yet my card was charged a second time under the pretext of a “security deposit” or pre-authorization.
It has now been four weeks since my check-out, and I still have not received my money back.
What is even more concerning is the contradictory information I have received. First, I was told that a refund had been processed. Later, I was told it was only a released pre-authorization. My bank has confirmed that it has received neither a refund nor any released authorization.
I have filed a formal complaint with Booking.com and disputed the charge with my bank. Despite sending several emails and follow-ups, I still have not received any response from the manager, Shakira Luqman, nor any meaningful attempt to resolve this issue.
I strongly recommend that anyone staying here carefully checks their bank statements after check-out. Until this issue is resolved and my money is returned, I cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Hugo W
title: Don’t be cheated
text:
Beware of the hidden fees.

I booked two rooms at Soho 54 Hotel through Expedia for a 3-night family trip to New York because the advertised rates looked much cheaper than many other hotels in the area.

What I didn’t realise until after booking was that the hotel charges a mandatory “resort fee” of USD 40.16 per room, per night. For two rooms over three nights, that came to over USD 240 in additional charges.

The most frustrating part is that this fee was not prominently disclosed during the booking process. It only appeared afterwards in the confirmation email under “Additional Property Fees”. By the time you discover it, you’ve already paid.

To make matters worse, the so-called “resort fee” covers basic amenities that most travellers would reasonably expect to be included in the room rate anyway, such as Wi-Fi, bottled water, coffee and gym access. There is nothing remotely “resort-like” about this property.

The hotel itself was equally disappointing. The online photos create a much better impression than reality. The bathrooms were tired and outdated, the carpets looked worn, and the Wi-Fi was unreliable despite being one of the items supposedly covered by the resort fee. Other than the air conditioning working properly, very little justified the overall cost.

What appeared to be a bargain turned out to be anything but. Once all the mandatory fees were added, the value for money simply wasn’t there.

This hotel feels like a classic bait-and-switch: attract guests with a low headline price, then recover the difference through mandatory fees.

My advice: don’t be fooled by the headline room rate. Check every hidden charge carefully and compare the true total cost with other hotels before booking. There are far better options in New York for the same money.

author: Daisy G
title: Total scam - beware of hidden fees!!!
text: Total scam. I booked through a portal and there were hefty hidden "facility fees" ON TOP of what I paid at checkout. I never would have booked this hotel if I had known the true cost. I'm actually embarrassed and disturbed at how much I ended up paying to spend 3 nights here. What a joke.

author: William A
title: Fine for the price
text:
Pros - very affable and competent staff.  fast elevators. comfortable beds

Cons - well worn hotel

Nice location walkable to SoHo, TriBeCa, Little Italy, Chinatown.  near subway

author: Harper J
title: Nice hotel but loud.
text:
Hotel is ok. Staff is nice. TV is spotty. The only buttons on the remote that work are the power, the volume, and the down channel button. 
But the big thing is the traffic noise. This block of Watts street is at the holland tunnel. Traffic is very busy here and VERY loud. 
Horns honking until 11:00 pm every night. Hard to sleep even on our upper floor.

author: Thomas L
title: Black Mold in Ventilation, Unclean Rooms, Poor Customer Service
text: The hotel is unbelievably dirty from the carpet to mold in the rooms to mold in the ventilation system. It was so bad that we documented it with the New York Department of Public Health who issued them a warning letter. When we contacted the Better Business Bureau to request a refund for one night (we didn't even stay because we checked out within hours due to mold in the room), the hotel denied our request saying that it was "dust." Given that we sent pictures to the New York Department of Health and their response, it was clearly not dust.  All of this is even more disappointing as it was our 12th stay in the hotel. Obviously, we won't be back, and we suggest staying any other place in the city.

author: Dylan B
title: Worn out and weary, won’t be back
text:
The location was excellent. You could get to where you needed to be in minutes by walking or subway. The free water is a nice touch, as well as hot chocolate and coffee all
day.

However,  the hotel is extremely rundown. l'm shocked that it has four stars on TripAdvisor. There was significant mildew in our shower/ bathtub, ripped/dingy carpet, stained curtains, wallpaper peeling off everywhere, gathered dust behind the nightstand, worn and battered furniture, beat up hallways, towels and sheets were clean but almost see through, etc. I'd prefer to pay a few hundred dollars more and stay in a place less worn.

author: Pablo A
title: Great team! Decent location. Quiet rooms.
text:
Soho54 has been my go-to hotel when visiting New York for work. It's located two blocks away from my office and works very well for my needs. Is it the fanciest? No but the team at the front desk is the reason I keep coming back. Sean and Ty at the front desk are awesome. Great attitude and willingness to help. It's nice knowing I'll be greeted with their smiles after a long day. 
The hotel is shockingly quiet. Colleagues often stay at properties nearby and they always complain about the noise. I've never had a noise issue at Soho54 and thats after no less than 5 stays. 
My office is relocating to Midtown so I won't have the chance to stay there anymore but that's why I'm writing -- thank you Soho54 for making my time away from my family doable. 
To Sean and Ty (sorry if I misspelled your names) thank you for everything -- I'm relieved that we were finally able to squash our beef about who's the greatest basketball player of all time. It was a struggle but we got there! MJ all day, baby! :)

author: Wyatt R
title: Overpriced, old and tired
text: This is an overpriced hotel badly in need of remodeling. The carpeting is threadbare and stained, the elevators are dented, etc. Worst of all is the $35/night facility fee for, among other things,  "free local calls" and a 24-hour business center, like its 1995. Also there are no "Neutrogena' bath products; the bath products are made by the"Hotel Emporium" company. Rather than "a view of the city", my room had a view of the very close building next door, which had no curtains, so that I had to keep my shades closed the entire time. There were no recycling bins and the bath products were not placed in refillable dispensers. Two good things about this hotel are the location and the employees, most of whom are very nice and helpful. Still, I would not stay here again.

author: Holly K
title: Would recommend and stay again
text: Came with family and stayed in a room for one night. Staff were friendly and welcoming. My room was on the top (18th floor) with a fantastic view over looking the Empire State building and surrounding area. Room was clean, bed comfortable and show had decent water pressure. There were also some decent food options nearby and subway link less than 5mins walk away too. Would recommend and stay there again if travelling back to New York.

author: Nathan R
title: Great location, Nothing else is great
text:
Great location, but the rooms and whole building are pretty dated. My room has a view of a wall about 6 feet away.

When I arrived, I was told there was no Wi-Fi in half the hotel and they didn’t know when it would be back. I asked for a room with Wi-Fi, shouldn’t have bothered since it is slower than airplane Wi-Fi and constantly drops. Great for a business trip…

My bathroom rack is barely hanging on the wall, towels are tattered and not white anymore, stains on the wallpaper in my room. Not impressed.

author: Ella D
title: Good solution in New York
text: Good hotel good quality, average clean you can safely leave in luggage, added value free bottles of water and free coffee is a few minutes from the subway, friendly staff

author: Joseph W
title: Not worth it despite good location
text:
Good:  Bed was clean and comfortable.  Shower was nice.
Bad:  We had a king room with a terrace, it was expensive, over 500 for the night. The furniture looked like it was bought at a thrift shop in 1976, including carpet. No fridge.  No ice machine that I could see. If you looked closely, everything metal had rust on it.  There is no restaurant or bar, although I guess there was one at one time. No one told us the wi-fi password. The famous “terrace” has worn out porch furniture that has been in one too many rain storms.  Our own terrace had two old metal chairs and a wobbly metal table. Place smelled like weed.

author: Manon T
title: Gaslit, treated poorly and deeply unimpressed
text:
We had booked 3 rooms for 3 nights, 2 Kings and one 1-bedroom king suite. 

On arrival at nearly 4pm the king rooms were still not available for check in despite check in being at 3pm.  The exterior of the building is shabby and the lobby was small, dark and more like a hostel than a hotel.

The 1-bedroom king suite was ready for check in so we paid for that room (nearly $600 a night) and got the key. We had booked this room as we were 3 colleagues and the living room gave us a base to work from in between scheduled meetings.

The suite was on the 19th floor and only on elevator was working for the whole building so it took a few minutes to get the elevator to arrive.

When we got to the room we were shocked as it bore no resemblance to the description or photos for the room we booked.  The room we were given was a small queen double room, with a single seater sofa. There was absolutely no sign of the living room, the 3 seater sofa, the mini kitchen or the spacious living area all detailed in the room description and in the room photos.  Also the bed was a queen not a king. The room itself was noisy, old, grubby and had a stained bare floor and peeling privacy plastic on the windows of the shower. 

We assumed that we had been allocated an incorrect room so had to go back to lobby to ask to be moved to the right room category.

At reception we were at first gaslit by reception staff who tried to say we were 'mistaken' about the description of the room category we had booked, that this was indeed a 'one bed suite' and that we were in the right room.  They said website pictures 'could not be trusted' as they could be of 'any room' not specific to the category type.  

We had to pull up the very clear room description from our booking confirmation and the specific attached room category pictures and show them these before the reception staff admitted that the room we had been allocated did not at all match the description of what was booked.  I also pointed out that in absolutely no world was this a room worth $600 a night.

The reception team said they had no other available options so offered an immediate penalty free cancellation for the room.  They refused however to let us cancel the other 2 rooms without a 1-night penalty per room even though all 3 rooms were part of the same booking and we were clearly travelling as a group.  Very poor.

One of our party decided to just stay the night rather than lose the cost as a penalty. The other one and I both left, which cost us $250 for a penalty for her room which was a disgrace.

The one who stayed for that fist night was given a shabby room that stank of cigarette smoke despite it supposedly being a non smoking property. 

Would never ever stay here again and 100% do not recommend to anyone.
