author: Anna D
title: Would definitely stay there again. A landmark if I ever return to New York
text: Good hotel. Good location close to metro. Friendly and helpful reception staff. 24-hour service of bottled water, hot tea, chocolate and coffee with refreshment area and microwave. Daily cleaning with change of towels and sheets.

author: Molly C
title: Average for the price!
text: The pillows were the flattest I have ever felt.  My neck and back hurt for days afterward. I'm not sure if it was the pillows alone or the bed as well. At any rate, they offered complementary water in the lobby, hot tea, coffee and coco just off the lobby.  They also had a microwave present in the area which my daughter used the first night after we arrived as they have no restaurant in the hotel. The staff are friendly and helpful.  They have free luggage storage which we utilized. The area around the hotel is very safe to walk around day or night.  Several train stops are near by.  The main reason I gave them an AVERAGE was the price.  I paid over $1800 for 4 nights.

author: Adam A
title: Good Location
text:
The hotel is quite old but very clean, checking in and out was very easy and the staff were friendly and helpful.
 The location is very good a lot of places within walking distance many resturants and bars in the area.
There is complimentary coffee, tea and water available 247 which we appreciated

author: Ruby E
title: Disgusting treatment by Soho54.
text: Terrible experience with Soho54. When the hotel put my credit card through for approval on the day of arrival I could not accept the push notification from my bank because my phone was off during my flight. My card declined.The hotel let our room go and we were left without accommodation. The hotel manager was so unhelpful and uncaring. I was disgusted with the treatment! We were allowed stay the first night only instead of 4. The room was grubby and in need of repair and decoration. I would never recommend this hotel.

author: Hannah O
title: Perfect location but sleep would be nice.
text:
The area was safe to walk around even at night. The trains were located within a 5-8 min walk. They offered complementary water in the lobby and coffee, tea & hot chocolate just off the lobby 24/7. 
The negatives were the price however, our trip was kind of booked last minute and it’s Christmas time. The beds/pillows were uncomfortable which made it difficult to sleep and there is no refrigerator in the rooms. 
While there are several cafes, diners and shops within walking distance the hotel itself does not have a restaurant.

author: Ruby S
title: Horrible
text: I never leave reviews. This is hands down the worst hotel I’ve ever stayed . Absolutely unacceptable. The room smelled like urine, there is mold everywhere. Bathrooms are worse than an hostel. The hallways are disgusting and all the employees seem high or drunk. The manager wasn’t helpful and simply didn’t care that the experience was horrible . And It was $750 per  night. Dreadful experience . Rate It negative 100. Wouldn’t wish It on my worst enemy, so gross! Stay a way

author: Mathis M
title: Cardinal Hotel St. Peter
text:
Overall, a superb hotel with a pool.
Very appreciated in this hot weather!
A truly top-notch team, whether at the front desk, the restaurant, or housekeeping; they are all super friendly!
Hotel is a 2-minute walk from the bus and also a 10-minute walk from the subway,
Ideal for the sightseeing trips we were able to take, and there are many! 
Close to the Vatican, Colosseum, Pantheon, and others…
I recommend it.

author: Marta C
title: Does not deserve 4 stars
text:
Don't deserve 4 stars!
The size of the pool is misleading compared to the photos. Once we arrive we are told the obligation to wear a swim cap to access it (without prior information although we had booked 4 months before) and the purchase of the cap is at our expense.

Staff not understanding and closed to discussion when we expressed disappointment with this obligation

Outdated room that requires a great refreshment, cleaning being very limited

Breakfast worthy of a summer camp refectory, to flee!

author: David X
title: Pleasant stay
text: Elegant and clean facility. Professional and efficient staff. Especially the dining room staff at the restaurant. Kind, polite, and well-groomed. Even the hour of relaxation in the pool was made pleasant by the staff

author: James P
title: Clean, comfortable and friendly.
text: We spent most of out time out of the hotel but it was nice to come back to and take a quick dip in the pool. They should have told us upfront that we had to pay for the caps which we didn't need on day 1. Not impressed with that, no notices put up.

author: Sydney Y
title: Enjoyed it!!!
text: Lovely hotel for good price. Slightly dated but makes one totally well with very friendly staff and pool. It was during our stay up to 38 degrees celcius, fantastic working e air conditioning in the room, ground floor. If you do not expect super luxury and needs absolute must.

author: David K
title: Summer family stay
text:
I felt the need to come on and review this hotel after reading so many negative reviews before arrival. I found myself already apologising to the family that it might not be very good. We travel frequently worldwide and TripAdvisor reviews had me stressing early doors!

Thankfully upon arrival we found quite the opposite of the reviews, hotel was great, our room was absolutely HUGE, family room for a 14 year old and 11 year old. Clean, well equipped. Staff extremely friendly and helpful (aside one awfully ignorant and rude lifeguard). Breakfast selection is great from meats and salads to toast/breads, egg, sausage and bacon etc. The pool has plenty of beds around and a pool bar with a great selection of drinks and ice creams.

The hotel is absolutely suffice as a base while exploring the city! It has a conference hotel feel to it rather than long stay 2 week hotel with children's entertainment etc but then it's nit advertised at thaf either. Would I come again? 100%

author: Juan V
title: Excellent hotel !!!!!
text: Excellent location, very close to Vatican. Great facilities and brilliant members of staff!!! I’ll recommend this hotel to anyone interested to visit Rome!!!

author: Laura D
title: Good place to stay
text: We were traveling with a US Choir in Italy.  This was our last and most lengthy stop.   The Hotel Cardinal is a lovely place with AC and a pool and a wonderful, attentive staff.   The room we were given was definitely at step down from the other ones in Lugano and Florence, but it was nice and clean.   The floor plan of the room made it very cramped, and there was little storage, but no other complaints.   Excellent large and well appointed bathroom.    Walls are not thick, so we could hear our neighbors.

author: Sydney P
title: Skip it!!
text: This place looks nothing like the photos.  It is considerably run down and needs major TLC.  It’s not maintained, dirty, rooms are not clean and outdated, food is awful! It’s hard to mess up a scrambled egg but I could not eat a bite.  Pool area dirty, a guy sitting there playing music kept stopping and changing songs.  The rooftop bar is a joke.  The place looks abandoned up there.  No jacuzzis are working.  The area is bad.  The bed is hard as a rock.  It says no smoking- there is smoking everywhere.  We were there one night waiting on cruise pick up which is the only reason to go here.

author: Elena M
title: Keep Valuables in Safe
text:
This review for me is so hard to write because my AirPods Pro was missing from our room.

I use my AirPods to help me to sleep in hotel for the noise cancellation and always have them charged in plain sight while I am gone. When I got back last night, they are gone. I soon used my “Find My” app and know they were 4 miles away (and still are as I am writing). I quickly went down to report to the manager on duty but his attitude was cold and unhelpful.

So - make sure to keep anything valuable in the safe if for some reason one has to stay here (I am here because it is a group tour.) I feel foolish to have to leave this type of review since I never have things stolen before - but now I have.

Pro: water pressure is very good.

Cons:
Bath towels are frayed. 
The room smelled as someone had smoked. The mugs and glasses are not consistently cleaned or collected. 
Very weak/almost none WiFi.

author: Ian S
title: Awful hotel
text: This hotel is awful. I do not know where to begin. The room had stains on the wall, curtains, bedside table. The paint on the towel warmer was chipped all over. The breakfast was standard, nothing special. The bed is old and you sort of feel the springs. And you need binoculars to see St. Peter's Dom. This hotel is far away from the center. I think two stars is generous. No where need four stars.

author: Daniel E
title: 4 stars...declining!!!
text:
If you want to spend a few days in Rome and be scammed, come here.
Hotel not even 2 stars.
Afternoon and evening staff were rude, and at the time of booking on-site (with advance payment), they omitted an important detail, not specifying that our room was connected to that of other guests and separated by a simple door. 
All of this without warning us beforehand.
From one room to another, everything could be heard, even the quietest conversations, making it impossible to rest both day and night… 
After immediately bringing this to the attention of the reception and requesting a room change, we were told it was not possible because the hotel was fully booked... obviously, they lied to me because Booking still showed availability for rooms on the same nights we stayed. 
In the morning, we requested room service, and no one responded. Finally, after several attempts, they answered, bringing all the wrong items to the room and cold milk. 
All balconies are interconnected... zero privacy.
Regarding room service, on the first day, they charged me an extra fee of 5 euros, and the next day, they asked me over the phone for an extra fee of 12 euros... 
As soon as I pointed out that I had paid 5 euros the day before, they made a very bad impression.
Dirt everywhere, the shower mat was full of accumulated dirt, limescale in the kettle and on the sanitary fixtures, an extremely uncomfortable bed, light filtering through the windows with broken blackout curtains...
Centralized air conditioning with no ability to turn it on or adjust it independently, so every time you have to call the front desk... I have never seen anything like this... not even in three-star hotels...
The staff at the front desk ignores every request and is extremely indifferent, in addition to providing false information and being very, very rude. 
If you want to spend a few days in Rome, do not go. 
It is hell, and you will be scammed here.

author: Lucas I
title: Does not deserve 4 stars!
text: Clearly does not deserve 3 stars. Even though the bedding is comfortable and the staff is pleasant overall, the facilities mostly need refreshing. The bathroom is outdated, with a yellowed plastic non-slip bath mat in the bathtub, a plastic trash can whose lid no longer stays on, and a calcified faucet. The breakfast is not varied at all and does not measure up to some 3-star French chains. The condition of the pool leaves much to be desired (see the photos). Although located 3 km from the center of Rome and easily accessible by public transport, we hoped for a much better standard. One must be wary of photos......

author: Ana W
title: Rome within reach
text:
Nice location close to the center of Rome. Quiet and green street.
Pleasant room with good bedding.
Charming French-speaking staff.
Buffet breakfast with a nice variety of sweet and savory products. 
Hearty dinner with a second serving for big eaters.

author: Aaron C
title: Discover
text: We enjoyed all the services of the hotel and restaurant

author: Dylan U
title: Nice hotel but....some gaps to review
text: Nice hotel, but does not deserve everywhere its 4 stars. The staff is excellent. The room and bathroom clean. The bedding was very good, comfortable. But then, on the soundproof side it's the disaster, do not take the rooms that have a common door, you hear everything you have sex with the neighbors. Our room was the 437, run away from it. It all depends on the occupants of the 436. Customers respect nothing speak loudly, slam the doors etc. We were a group of about twenty, meals taken in a room reserved for us, simple cuisine, you are entitled to pasta every day as a starter, then main course, salad and dessert, side dessert bof, we would like more ice cream, fruit. For breakfast, very good we have a choice, coffees are good with machines. The location of the hotel is not close to the center, for us it was the agency bus for our excursions, but we can take the bus that takes us in 30 minutes to the center. Be careful inquire for payment inside the buses, the controllers are often there and the fines too!

author: Jack R
title: Excellent value for money
text: Structure located in a strategic position, with welcoming and professional staff. The room was quiet and well air-conditioned.

author: Evan Y
title: Perfect for a short trip and for the sightseeing tour.
text: Great value for money. Hotel is old, but everything is very well maintained. Staff nice and friendly. Room very quiet.

author: George Y
title: Hotels
text:
Everything perfect, staff, room and view.
Hotel located in the center a few steps from the Vatican.
Cleanliness of the room and courtesy of the staff unique. Would definitely stay there again.

author: Charlie V
title: Amazing Stay
text: This hotel has everything you need. Lovely breakfast, friendly and welcoming staff and a short distance to all of the important landmarks

author: Daniel Q
title: Another fabulous stay
text:
This is my absolute favorite hotel!! I have stayed 3 times and this was my first time booking a balcony suite. Definitely worth the money. 
Kevin and Christina both went out of their way to be extremely kind. They both remembered what I had done the previous day and always asked how I was doing. This is the best hotel in NYC. I always feel like I am at home here.

author: Elena X
title: New York
text: This hotel was a fantastic hotel. The bar area is lovely and the staff are so hard working. They help you whenever they can. Some tasty breakfasts with great company. The beds were really comfy and the location was excellent.

author: Michael D
title: GREAT HOTEL!!
text:
The Westgate is a lovely hotel and a great choice for anyone visiting New York City. Having been to New York before, I knew how important a good location is, and being just a five-minute walk from Grand Central Terminal made getting around the city incredibly easy.
I took my girlfriend on her first trip to New York, and the hotel really helped make the experience special. Our room was cleaned every day, and all of the staff were friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. I genuinely couldn’t fault the place.
As a bonus for Spider-Man fans, the hotel is right next to the building used as Norman Osborn’s (the Green Goblin’s) residence in the movies, which was a nice surprise.
I would happily stay here again and would highly recommend it to anyone planning a trip to NYC.

author: Luke Z
title: Not what we expected from Westgate
text: We were allowed to check in early but that's all that was good. Our rooms floor is dirty, our room has only one light by the bed so it's dark. Our view is of a alley or something, our shower has brown stains on the wall, our toilet paper dispenser is broken, we can hear everything our neighbors say, even just coughing, and our bed isn't very comfortable. Elevators are scary shaking and don't appear safe. Ice machine is 3 floor away and there's no restaurant as advertised. For the money this is not what I expected as an owner at Westgate. I have no chairs or night stand so my wife and I just sat on the bed. Finally got the front desk to send staff person to check light switch but it didn't work so he brought a lamp from another room.

author: Maria I
title: Hotel very well located, but a narrow, dark, and noisy room
text:
We spent four nights with three people in a room supposedly "Luxury Accommodation with 2 Queen-Size Beds." We have positive impressions from this stay and some negative ones.

On the positive side, the room was very clean and well-maintained every day. The staff was courteous and efficient. The location of the hotel is very good for visiting Manhattan. 

Unfortunately, the room was very narrow (difficult to store belongings) and dark (minimal lighting and windows that face directly onto the walls of the inner courtyard). 

Above all, the level of noise disturbances was very significant. The door does not reach the floor and allows sounds from the hallway to pass through (along with a stream of light that illuminates the room all night). Moreover, our room was separated from the neighboring room by a non-soundproofed locked door, which gives the impression of sharing the same room: one can follow the neighbors' conversations, hear them unpacking their suitcases, etc. This was particularly unpleasant. In addition, there was a noisy refrigerator placed right next to the headboards, as well as the loud clapping of the air conditioning that stops every 30 minutes (we therefore turned it off and got very hot, as opening the window would have exposed us to the noise of an air conditioning extractor located right next to it).

The value for money in Manhattan remains acceptable if one is willing to endure these inconveniences.

author: Harper D
title: Reception could do better.
text:
Clean hotel with particularly kind and welcoming staff at the entrance. The service in general was good, and I really appreciated the café located at the bottom of the hotel.
On the other hand, I was disappointed with the experience at the reception. I had paid for a room upgrade and requested a room on the upper floors, but I was assigned a room on the 5th floor with a direct view of the trash bins, which was really unpleasant.
I also requested a late check-out after a 7-night stay, but it was denied without any real solution offered. It's a shame because with a little more listening and flexibility from the front desk, the experience could have been much better.

author: Amelia I
title: Worst hotel stay in years
text: I was shocked by how uncomfortable my room was and how my room and the gym weren’t well cleaned. In addition  the service was poor.

author: Rosie E
title: Kevin at the Westgate is appreciated.
text:
I am happy to give an excellent review to the Westgate New York Grand Central Station Hotel, with a specific shout out to Kevin at the front desk.  We needed a hotel near the U.N. and booked at the Westgate.  It is our first time here.  We took an overnight/red eye flight from Los Angeles and arrived very early Sunday morning.  Too early to check in.

The Westgate staff were extremely nice.  They checked our bags, directed us to bathrooms, and had a nice lobby.  We got cleaned up, went out for a few hours and came back around 1:00.  The room we had booked was not ready yet.  (We were still earlier than the normal check in time.)

Kevin, seeing how tired my daughter and I were (the overnight flight) upgraded our room, got is in immediately, and made sure we were comfortable.   This was a big deal to my daughter and I because we were so tired from the overnight flight and very little sleep.  We really appreciated Kevin's kindness.

The hotel is very nice.  The room is excellent, comfortable, and with a magnificent view of the city.  The staff is very professional and the hotel has style.  

Thank you very much.

author: Jack P
title: Loved it!
text:
Absolutely loved it here. 
Spacious rooms. 
Luxurious surroundings
There’s a bus stop right outside the front door, which after long days of exploring, was so welcome. We never waited more than a couple of minutes for a bus and we could track them online. 
Attentive staff. 
Will stay here agin. Loved it.

author: Amelia N
title: Don't serve food unfortunately , spent too many dollars on food!
text: Lovely staff and hotel,  went for 4 nights for daughters 18th. Will never forget the quality time we had together ❤️

author: Megan A
title: Great hotel, good location, helpful friendly staff, comfortable rooms, easy to reach and locate.
text:
Just got back from 5 nights at the Westgate, what a fantastic hotel this is. Just a 5 minute walk from Grand Central and an Iconic view of the Chrysler Building from the front door. Situated within walking distance from all the must see sights, but far enough away from the mayhem of Times Square.
From check in to check out, the helpful friendly team were on hand to assist. A well laid out lobby and bar area with plenty of comfy seating for a rest after your day of adventure is most welcoming.
We had a family room which was more than enough, with comfortable beds, coffee machine, Good sized fridge, loads of storage space so you don’t have to Ninja warrior over your cases. TV, iron, Free safe, hairdryer and daily maid service.
There are plenty of places to eat within a five minute walk,( The Sandwicherie, is a must for breakfast).
All the staff are amazing but a special mention goes to Matthew the doorman. Matthew kept me company whenever I stepped out, funny, knowledgeable and friendly, a credit to the hotel.
All in all a great stay and we will definitely be back, thanks guys.

author: Daniel Y
title: Amazing hotel and staff… recommend 100%
text:
Just I come back from our holiday in New York and I can say this hotel is the best ever place to stay and having a nice and relax time. It was the second time accommodate and I don’t regret one seconds …..Everything is clean daily very good location so close to most of the attraction in Manhattan. I will recommend  to everyone. 
Ps. this was the second time visiting this hotel. I was so impressed last time.

author: Noah S
title: Clean, boutique, a gem!
text:
My husband and I stay here when we come to New York City. My daughter travels with us and receives different hotels paid for by her company- 5 star. I will always choose Westgate Resorts Grand over any other hotel. I've experienced the other 5 stars and The Westgate is hands down the best in every way. That's if you like concierge treatment, personal attention, a valet/door man that greets you and brings your things in as you are entering, smiles from all the staff, a seamless check in, a boutique atmosphere, a top notch bar, extremely clean lobby with a lounge. 
The style is upscale with art and designer feel. The room was exquisitely designed, again very boutique. Very clean. The bathroom was well stocked with high end toiletries and towels. Extremely clean. 
My daughter said our hotel ( The Westgate Grand New York City) was better all around than a couple of 5 stars very well known in the city ( that I won't name.) I experienced those hotels and was very disappointed. 
Stay at The Westgate Grand New York. You WILL NOT regret it. 
That's the only place we'll go when we return to New York.

author: Adam P
title: Visit New York
text:
Very convenient hotel with public transport and place in quiet area. Very pleasant historic building with nice reception and bar. Very friendly staff and rooms with comfortable but small size bed. We have been upstairs.  Clean hotel but we had a problem on arrival with hair in the sheets and towels still folded. They changed all the underwear twice more because there was always hair present.  So we think it is attributable to laundry service. 
Other details such as cleaning air filters, window frames and other finishes not up to the rating stars . Very welcome coffee maker and free water at reception.

author: Caleb S
title: Clean, easy, accessible
text: Stayed here for one night on a business trip. Check-in was smooth, and I got upgraded to a room with a balcony for free which was nice. Room itself was clean well cared for, if a bit small (but that's NYC in general). I was towards the back of the hotel, but still heard some road noise (again, not sure you can escape this staying in Manhattan). Good location close to multiple subway stops.

author: Hannah Z
title: THIEVES
text:
THIEVES. Their staff steals precious items from your room and they have zero customer service. 

DO NOT STAY HERE. Front desk constantly lies and there is no resort amenities yet they charge a resort fee.

author: Miguel C
title: Stayed with wife
text: Had a bad experience with the personal including the manager. Also rooms are a lot smaller than what think. You can get way better rooms just down the street and with better service.

author: Oliver A
title: Clean Welcoming and Full of Charm
text:
We had a great stay and truly enjoyed this hidden gem. The recent renovation gives the hotel a fresh feel while still keeping the charm that makes it special. The rooms are small but adorable and perfectly comfortable for two people. The bathroom was surprisingly large for a NYC hotel and had plenty of vanity space, which was a huge plus. The room itself was very clean, cozy, and well maintained.

The hotel feels welcoming from the moment you walk in. The lobby is beautiful, and the entire staff was friendly and attentive. Jose the doorman deserves special recognition. He was incredibly reassuring and helpful, and his kindness truly stood out and made our stay even better.

Because this is a city location, you will hear normal street noise like sirens and horns. That is just part of city life. We used a sound machine and found that it helped a lot, and choosing a higher floor may also make a difference. I would definitely recommend bringing a sound machine if you are a light sleeper.

The bed and pillows were very comfortable, and overall the hotel felt clean, inviting, and thoughtfully designed. I loved the charm it has and would happily stay here again.

author: Jessica G
title: Great stay
text:
We had a great time in New York and this is largely thanks to this hotel.
The location is ideal, close to the center and the subway. You can do a lot of activities on foot.
The rooms are spacious and the beds are giant and comfortable.
The teams are very professional and with little care.
We were happy to return to the hotel after our long days of sightseeing and walking.
Thank you for your stay.

author: Thomas O
title: Grubby Liittle Hole
text: Very disappointed with this hotel. On arrival the room can only be described as grubby. There was a wooden encasement around the bed but inside the perimeter there was all sorts of rubbish like pens , plastic forks etc . There was a layer of dust on the pictures . The iron was faulty and the coffee machine was not working . We immediately complained and they cleaned the perimeter of the bed and replaced the iron but the coffee machine was out of use for the duration of the stay.  The room itself was tiny and dark and I certainly would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

author: Connor I
title: Very well located.
text: Small rooms, beautiful terrace, it is one block from the subway.

author: Ryan A
title: First Time in New York
text: The room was nice, we had are own bathroom which was nice, clean and comfortable the only thing didn’t have microwave or fridge to stored left overs are your drinks.

author: Morgan G
title: Wonderful hotel-hostel in east midtown
text: Location was excellent in E Midtown.  Close to the E and 6 trains, which got us everywhere we wanted to go, otherwise very walkable.  Definitely a hotel/hostel hybrid, rooms are small with a bunk bed (full sized), shared bathrooms on each floor, but with housekeeping and a front desk staff (both very helpful and friendly).  Rooms and bathrooms were clean and comfortable.  Truly did not have any issues with noise.  And don't miss out on the Rooftop patio, is was perfect, great views, comfortable, great way to end the night.

author: Nora P
title: Long and pleasant stay in room with private bathroom
text: Great location, clean room, comfortable and functional (pod queen). Careful employees. No inconvenience. Good cost benefit.

author: Grace S
title: Very small but clean rooms good for spending the entire day out in NYC
text:
We originally booked a bunk bedroom with a shared hallway bathroom, which I was originally unaware of. We found this out when we arrived, but were able to upgrade to a queen bed and private bathroom for about $20. Also, whenever you check in, there is a roughly $30 charge that you have to pay. The rooms are very small, and the bathroom is even smaller and cramped. There's also, strangely, a window that looks into the bathroom from the bedroom. The bathroom door is also only a thin sliding door so make sure you are very comfortable with the person you are sharing the room with. 
The room is clean, and the check-in process was fairly smooth.

author: Caleb D
title: Pod 51 - Amazing customer service
text: Pod 51 is great, I always stay there when I visit my home town - NYC. Benny is extremely helpful and always provide great customer service.

author: Pablo D
title: Good Times at the POD.
text: The Pod is fun, modern spirit, wonderful staff, immaculate and well situated. I’ve used the Pod with groups and as a solo traveler and with family, it’s always a pleasure. The cafe in the lobby and the pocket park across the street are treats.

author: Kyle H
title: 10/10 experience
text: I stayed at Pod 51 for a solo birthday trip to NYC. When I arrived, check-in was easy staff were friendly, and my room was clean. Its location is walking distance from the popular sightseeing areas and near the subways. If you take the airtrain from the airport you get off at Lexington it’s only about a 10 minute walk to the hotel.  If needed, they will hold your luggage so you can continue exploring the city before your flight with no cost.

author: Lucy Q
title: Great option for families in New York
text: The location is great, the rooms are clean, quiet and air conditioned.  The shared baths are also clean and perfectly acceptable.  This kind of hotel is common in Scandinavia as a reasonable option for families and budget travelers.  It  was perfect for us.

author: Chloe E
title: Top location! Perfect for solo travelers on a budget.
text: This was my second stay at Pod 51 so I knew what to expect. Check-in was quite smooth and my room was available right when I arrived at around 11:00. I stayed in a full pod, and while the bed is perfectly acceptable, be warned that the toilet and shower are quite small–I'm 6'3" and had to crouch to get my hair wet in the shower. That said, all of it is made up for by the location, just two blocks from the 6 train at Lexington & 51st, and E/F at Lexington & 53rd. For dining options, there are several restaurants to fit all tastes near the hotel, and while there is a small café in the lobby of the hotel, I recommend going to a bodega for a perfectly palatable, inexpensive breakfast. Overall this will continue to be a go-to hotel for me whenever I visit NYC!

author: Adam S
title: You have it down to the essentials minus fhe frills.
text: The hierarchy of accomodations -- room with bed and sink, or with sink and toilet or with sink and toilet and shower is good business and saves me a lot of cash.

author: Liam N
title: Pod 51 is a YES!
text:
This last visit to Pod 51 was my second stay here.  I find the location perfect for my visits.  The subway is two blocks away.   This is great for getting to any part of the city. 

The streets feel safe at night when I walk to & from my adventures.

Essa Bagel is right around the corner.  Grenacre Park is caddy corner to the hotel; I love to grab some food, sit outside & enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, with the waterfall in the background.

The roof top patio is also a favorite for me, especially at night.

The rooms are simple, basic & clean.  And it’s definitely affordable.  I’ve stayed in both a room w/ a shower as well as a room without a shower.  The staff keeps the shared bathrooms clean.  My shower less room did have a sink in it, which I liked.

I appreciate the small coffee shop in the lobby; a trip in pj’s to grab my morning coffee is perfect.

The staff is friendly and helpful.  That said, a BIG shoutout to Benny, who is great.  His welcoming smile, courteous personality & willingness to assist is refreshing!

I’ll be back!

author: Aiden T
title: Great place to stay
text: Small rooms as advertised, but has everything you need. Rooftop patio and other common areas are lovely. All staff we met were warm, welcoming and helpful. We plan to stay again.

author: Wyatt J
title: Nice, quaint, great location, just a few things to be aware of
text: It was a great getaway and very cute place. The room was tiny (as expected) but comfortable and well designed. The rooftop was great - what a beautiful way to start the day.  Note, we were charged a $20 facility fee (?) each day that was unexpected.  That's the only downside (and you hear slamming doors a lot, but that was not so bad).

author: Evie H
title: Price differs from the reservation
text: We stayed at the POD 51 for 5 nights in June 2026. Decent room, nothing more. The problem is not the room itself but the price!! We booked on booking.com at a price that we found reasonable for the room level and the location. But when we arrived on site, the amount that was demanded was $700 more versus the expected amount. We explained to them that the amount was not the same as the booked amount, but they did not want to hear anything... We therefore agreed to pay this price because it is not easy to find a hotel at the last minute. But if you book at this hotel, PAY VERY CLOSE ATTENTION TO THE PRICE YOU EXPECT TO PAY!!!!

author: Mathis C
title: Solid, clean, basic hotel
text: Hotel was exactly as billed. Just the basics, clean, nice common areas, everyone was very friendly and helpful. It is not a destination hotel, but is great for just a bed and a shower.

author: Hannah M
title: Great spot for a short stay
text: This is was first time staying here and it was great for one person for 2-3 days.  It’s located near several great options for dining, coffee and a nice little park across the street to hand out and eat lunch. As to be expected in NY, the room is small but again this isn’t a problem for a solo traveler.

author: David C
title: Decent, but not as good as other Pod location
text:
I have stayed at Pod Brooklyn several times in the past and have always been pleased with the experience.  On this trip, I opted for Pod 51 as the advertised rates were actually a little better than Pod Brooklyn.  

First of all, the advertised rates are misleading, because you also pay a fee that covers, the hotel says, things like early check-in and check-out for all guests.  Second, the building is quite a bit older and in not as great condition as its Brooklyn counterpart.  And finally, in Brooklyn every room I have had had en suite facilities, but in Pod 51 there was a shared bathroom down the hall from the room.

The positives for this hotel are its proximity to Midtown, its budget-friendly rates, the quiet roof terrace, and the excellent restaurant and bar on the ground floor.  All things considered, I would probably give it another try on a future trip.

author: Ryan E
title: Good Experience. To do it again
text: Everything went as planned. My room was ready in the morning when I arrived and that was highly appreciated. Staff was nice and rooftop very beautiful. The bed was comfortable, had a tv, hairdryer. Everything was clean. Good experience. I would do it again

author: James S
title: could use some work
text: bathrooms were disgusting and tiny. our battery to our door broke while we were there and we had to be moved rooms. honestly the price should be cheaper for what you’re getting. At the rate it is i’d rather just spend a couple extra hundred and stay at a nice place with a bigger cleaner room. The difference wasn’t much from a holiday inn or a best western. Also side note why the hell was there a window in the bathroom, like i’m trying to do my business and shower in peace but giant window kinda feels exposing and they could use curtains. The shower in our new room was also so tiny it was insane. I would call myself an average sized person and struggled to shower comfortably and my tiny friend even struggled too.

author: Ruby C
title: A good experience with this hotel
text: My family and I had a great experience at this hotel. We had heard that the Times Square area is very noisy, yet we didn't hear a thing from our room. The room was small but cozy and kept clean by the excellent housekeeping staff. We also had a positive experience with Maria at the front desk; she welcomed us to New York with open arms. If we ever return, we would stay here again.

author: Connor U
title: Horror hotel! RUN
text: If I could give it minus 100 stars, I would 🤬. Upon arriving at the lobby, the seats were damaged, dirty, and torn; the bathroom had an unbearable smell of urine; the rooms were dirty with unpainted, scratched walls; the bathroom had mold; the curtains were torn; the walls had spiderwebs; the TV was stuck almost to your bed; the beds squeaked like in a horror movie. I went to cancel my reservation and they accepted it, only for me to receive an email 2 days later informing me that they will not refund me! They stole $278 from me. New York City should shut down this so-called hotel, if it could even be called that. DO NOT waste your money there; it is the worst in New York. Look at photos from former guests and you will realize what I am talking about. I left so scared that I did not manage to take photos.

author: Manon K
title: Ranging not got my secity depoist back.
text: Never got my security depoist back emailed 11 times ian kelly stayed there from 30th june to 1st july room1007 disabled rung told i never stayed there not record my resverstion gave no correct booking no rachel took depoist not been returned. Noe 24th august

author: Nathan P
title: AVOID IT AT ALL COSTS
text:
5/5 location, but not worth the money as it is clearly not a 4 star hotel. Extremely noisy room opposite the busiest road in Times Square due to a single-pane window. The loud sounds passed easily through the thin glass and tiny air gaps. I could not sleep at all even if the staff gave me free ear plugs. Filthy and very run down lift, corridor and room. Scuffs on the walls, torn blinds and gum on the couch. The AC worked the first 2 days of our stay but we had to turn it off because it was also noisy. Spacious shower but covered in mold. No tea, coffee or fridge. Worst of all, MARIA, the hotel staff at the front desk gave us the rudest welcome to New York. She should look for another job because it is obvious she is not happy working there. She should also learn how to treat customers from her colleagues Jaz, Rachel and Richy.
I would not recommend this hotel and suggest to avoid it at all costs. There is plenty of accommodation in this busy city.

author: Charlie D
text:
It is very frustrating to see that, two years after our terrible experience at this hotel, the same problems continue to occur with complete impunity.
In addition to the appalling standards of cleanliness and maintenance, the most serious issue is the fact that money is being charged to guests’ credit cards without their authorization / consent.
What is difficult to understand is how, despite the large number of complaints and reports from different guests, nothing seems to be done about it. It is shocking that such practices can apparently continue without any effective action being taken.

author: Pablo J
title: Filthy Room, Broken AC, Charged Even Though We Did Not Stay
text:
This was one of the worst hotel experiences my family has had.
The room had peeling and damaged paint, visible moisture and water-damage marks, heavily soiled air vents, rusted bathroom hardware, deteriorated surfaces, and generally filthy conditions. The air conditioning was not working. The thermostat showed approximately 80°F even though it was set to 57°F, and the room did not cool.
We booked what was supposed to be suitable hotel accommodation for our family, but the room we were given was nothing like a reasonable family hotel room. It was dirty, deteriorated, and not properly functional. We did not stay overnight, yet we were still charged for the full reservation.
We documented everything with photographs and video, left the property, and paid for another hotel.
The hotel later refused to authorize a full refund. Hotwire, which listed and sold this accommodation, also refused to provide a full refund and relied on the hotel’s decision despite receiving our photographs.
This was not a minor housekeeping issue or simply an older room. We paid for a clean, functional, and usable hotel room, but that service was not provided.
Despite the photographs, video evidence, and the fact that we did not stay overnight, neither the hotel nor Hotwire took responsibility or provided a full refund.
I strongly recommend that travelers, especially families, carefully review recent guest photographs before booking this property.

author: Gavin A
title: Thieves!
text: I stayed in February, and it is already August and they still haven't refunded my 300USD deposit, what thieves! Scammers! I have sent more than 20 messages to the guest support email and they do not respond; I call and they transfer me to lines that do not answer. Expenses and more expenses, it is incredible that this happens and nothing is done.

author: Mia X
title: Good location, old facility, lovely staff.
text: I had to book this hotel due to a last minute change with my plans with the friends that I was going to meet at New York. To be honest, I did not have much options to begin with. Location is GREAT if you want to stay close to Times Square. The facility is old, rooms are ok, AC units are noisy. Basically, an option if you want to be on a budget. The first night that I stayed, I had to use earplugs due to noise of AC unit. It was 57 desibel, no kidding. Ms. Maria and Isiah were so kind at the front desk. Ms. Maria personally helped me to change my room. She gave me advice for a sushi place. She literally treats people like she is hosting them at her home. Bottom line, a good location, old facility, really nice staff.

author: Hannah G
title: Hotel will not refund me the security deposit
text: Writing a review since this may be the only way to get a call back from the hotel. I stayed at the hotel April 28th 2026. Upon checkin my card was charged ~$220 USD and was assured this would be refunded a few days post checkout. It is now July 17th and I have not received the refund. I have called numerous times and the general manager phone line is always busy and the mail box is full and I am not able to leave a message. No one is able to transfer me or get this issue resolved. My booking ID was LKG26823. This needs to be resolved asap as I am out of options due to the companies lack of professionalism and urgency.

author: Lily C
text: Location was 10 of 10…Maria and Denis the front desk hosts was very very helpful and welcoming absolutely made my stay Great. Far as the rooms u get what u pay for in NYC…

author: Aiden G
title: Easy check in and out. Friendly and store our luggage for free. Asked for a fan and they provided it quickly
text: Best location I could personally ask for.  The price is always affordable.  Have been to NYC twice and stayed there both times.  Its in the middle of Times Square and close to the Subways. Safe location located beside the Hershey store.

author: Jessica V
title: Oyo hotel
text: Maria at the front desk was amazing and so helpful! She was the best!

author: Hannah B
title: Not a 4 star Hotel
text: The room was very small, with metal bed frames, a cramped toilet, and a clogged shower. While the location was great, the overall stay didn't justify the price. Overall, I don't think the hotel was worth the price or deserved its 4-star rating.

author: Olivia F
title: Do not stay at this hotel especially if require accessibility
text:
We had to immediately check out as the room was inaccessible and unsafe. We were told we would be refunded in about a week but then the hotel is refusing to refund my $1500 for service they did not provide. This put huge damper on our trip as I had to book a safe hotel last minute pay another $2500 that was meant to be money we spent while on the trip. Move luggage and my mom in her wheelchair to new hotel. 

The "accessible"room
- bed unstable and unsafe. My mom nearly fell due to the bed legs unstable and bed wobbles all over the place.
- not enough space between the bed and the wall to safely transfer to bed.
- elevator and hallway to room too narrow to safely maneuver wheelchair. Couldn't fit the wheelchair and a carryon in the elevator. 
- AC did not work. Window doesn't open. Room very hot. 
- bathroom dirty and rusted.

Hotel staff did not apologize or offer someone to fix AC or  bed. Said all rooms same therefore we had to check out due to safety risk. Hotel has been difficult to contact and rude. They claim that they reviewed my concerns and it doesn't meet the requirements for a refund but no one had heard my concerns they didn't contact me. They then claimed they would re-escalate and have them contact me about my concerns and of course they have not. This hotel does not care for the safety of their disabled guests. They fraudulently claim accessibility and have no interest in safety concerns and are scamming us out of $1500 and cost us so much more to amend our trip.

author: Erin I
title: Extremely Disappointing Experience — Great Staff, Terrible Corporate Support
text:
⭐ Extremely Disappointing Experience — Great Staff, Terrible Corporate Support
My stay at the OYO Times Square Hotel was one of the most frustrating and stressful travel experiences I’ve ever had — and the only reason it wasn’t worse is because of the in‑house staff, who were the only people who showed genuine care.

Despite booking through Monster Reservations and paying in full, the hotel still charged me an additional $819 at check‑in for a balance that did not exist. This unexpected charge wiped out the money I needed for deposits at my next hotels and left me unsure whether I’d even have a place to stay for the rest of my trip.

What made this situation even more infuriating was the response from corporate. The corporate representative I was connected with showed no concern, offered no solutions, and was completely dismissive of the financial and logistical hardship their mistake caused. Their attitude made it clear that guest well‑being was not a priority.

In contrast, the in‑house team was outstanding.
Jaz, Danny, and Lou Lou were the only people who treated me with respect and urgency. They listened, escalated the issue, and genuinely tried to help — even though corporate refused to take responsibility. Their professionalism and compassion were the only bright spots in an otherwise unacceptable experience.

Unfortunately, the room conditions were just as bad as the billing issues.
Room 223 had:

A non‑working TV

A broken AC

Window coverings that didn’t function

I was moved to Room 523, which was even worse — and unsafe for wheelchair users.
That room had:

A raised threshold that made entering dangerous

A TV that didn’t work

AC that didn’t work

Window coverings that didn’t work

A phone that didn’t work

Only one working outlet

I had to leave my wheelchair in the hallway and physically drag it inside because the doorway was so poorly designed. No guest — especially someone with mobility needs — should ever be put in that position.

Between the unauthorized $819 charge, the unsafe room conditions, and the dismissive corporate response, this hotel caused unnecessary stress, financial strain, and physical risk.

The only reason this review isn’t even worse is because of the incredible in‑house staff.
Jaz, Danny, Nicole, and Lou Lou deserve recognition for doing everything they could in a situation that corporate leadership clearly didn’t care about.

Until OYO fixes its corporate communication, billing practices, and room maintenance, I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone.

author: James M
title: New York luxury hotel
text: We decided to stay at this hotel since my family took a trip to New York we had a wonderful time great services and the rooms are so beautiful with great views from the skyline. Customer service was wonderful everyone was very productive and helpful.

author: Taylor D
title: Avoid
text: Terrible noise and smell. Tiny room. Not clean. Avoid.

author: Rosie P
title: Unauthorized Charge and No Response from Hotel
text:
After my stay, the hotel charged my credit card with almost $250 without any explanation or justification. I have been contacting the hotel for MONTHS to request details about this charge, but all my attempts have been ignored. They don’t respond to chargeback procedure as well. 

I cannot recommend this hotel. Watch out!

author: Aaron V
title: No not come here
text: They do not answer the phone. Horrible customer service. Could not cancel reservation.

author: Charlotte E
title: Budget friendly for sure but not a good option
text: I booked this hotel on Expedia and I looked for the least inexpensive option in Manhattan. The pictures on their website are very deceiving. I definitely understand why it is considered a budget hotel, but cleanliness and quality of the room are horrible. I stayed only a few hours to sleep. I checked in at 11pm and left at 5am....... I could not wait to leave that room.

author: Benjamin H
title: Lovely, clean, convenient, great Security
text: Our room was very clean, nice, and quiet. My son left his stuffed puppy and, currently, security staff (Irvin, Danny, JB, Alex and Erik) have found it and packed it to send back to us! Very grateful for their help and my son looks forward to receiving his long lost pup. We hope to return to this lovely place one day!

author: Mathis J
title: Perfect Base for a Broadway Trip
text:
If you're headed to the Theater District, it's hard to beat the Edison. The location is unbeatable - we were steps from everything we needed, and the staff was genuinely helpful throughout our stay. Oh, and every time we walked through the lobby, Frank Sinatra was playing. Honestly, perfect.

Is it a grand luxury hotel? No. The hallway from the door to the bed has serious backrooms energy (we laughed every time), the bathroom is cozy to say the least, and the open shower concept means the entire bathroom becomes a splash zone. Housekeeping kept up admirably with the chaos and we were never short on towels.

A mini fridge would have been nice, but this is Manhattan - I get it. Every square inch counts.

For the price and location, the Edison delivers exactly what you need for a NYC trip. We'd absolutely stay again.

author: Caleb E
title: Excellent stay !
text: The Staff and management at the hotel were fantastic ! Completly attentive and freindly. The bed was quite comfortable and the food at the restaurant was top draw ! This was my second trip in the past three months and i will be going back in the fall.

author: Daniel H
title: Perfect place to stay when exploring New York with your family
text: Overall very nice hotel, very authentic and comfortable. Spacious clean rooms with stunning views. Perfect location in the heart of Manhattan. Plenty of breakfast options.

author: Ella V
title: A Must Stay-Hotel Edison Time Square!!
text:
If you ever are in New York City, Hotel Edison is a truly MUST STAY !!!!!
    Michael and I have just had the most magical stay at this Incredible Theater District/Time Square Historical Hotel!!
  Exquisite Art Deco styling, outstanding professional and friendly staff, beautifully appointed rooms with views of this amazing city, top notch security, very knowledgeable  and extremely helpful concierge  are only the beginning of what Hotel Edison offers-the moment the Doorman opens the door for you and welcomed you in!
    So, with out any doubt…. Make your next stay in New York at this very special hotel!!!’  You will be over the moon happy you chose Hotel Edison.   This is forever on- the only place we will stay in NY!!
❤️❤️

author: William M
title: A Wonderful Stay at Hotel Edison
text:
We are having a really wonderful stay at Hotel Edison. The location is great, and the hotel is very welcoming.

I especially want to thank **Ms. Shonda and Mr. Scott**. They have both been incredibly kind and helpful to us.
 
All of the staff are efficient and warm, from Marco at the entrance, to the security team, to the staff at the front desk, and the staff on each floor. Everyone we have met has been professional and humble. The hotel is clean and secure, and the lobby has a unique atmosphere that gives you exactly the feeling you hope to have when you arrive in Manhattan.

We are pleased with our stay.

author: Hugo D
title: Great place to stay!!!!
text: Hotel is in great location.  Rooms are very clean and comfortable.  Staff is very friendly and helpful.  Fehat Begolli is one of the best to help and make sure you are taken care of!!

author: Sofia S
title: Great visit.
text: Excellent hotel - great value and great location near Times Square and multiple subway stops. The staff were fantastic particularly Kezia who I emailed in advance to support with a booking query. The hotel gives you a voucher each morning for breakfast as part of the resort fee - there is a place just down the road which offers the best value to use this at and set us up well for the day. The hotel also did a wine and cheese evening with live music and this was fab.

author: Aaron B
title: Fair hotel
text:
The hotel is well located and has good accommodations. We had a pleasant experience, the maids, doormen... very kind. In particular, Ferrat Sehul was very attentive and gave us several tips.
What can improve overall is attention to the available rooms. We had to ask to exchange it because the first one was smaller than what we had paid for.

author: David E
title: Great customer service upon Check-In
text: I simply want to share with you that my Check-In experience with LATOYA at Hotel Edison in NYC was simply perfect. Pleasant, accommodating, conversational and all with a lovely smile. I do not take such customer service for granted - because not all hotels have such arrival hospitality (and I have travelled throughout the world). Thank you, LATOYA for starting our family trip on the right foot!

author: Holly K
title: My new go to place!
text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Hotel Edison! The staff was incredibly accommodating, even though I had to take an early flight and did not want to tote my luggage around, they went above and beyond to help me check in early, which was a huge relief!

author: Kyle V
title: Great!
text:
My stay was excellent. My family had a great time. The housekeeping department was wonderful and the security team helped resolve my lost items issue. The names of the individuals that worked on resolving my lost and found claim are Danny, JB, Alex, Irvin and Erik.

Thank you

author: Brooke M
title: Fun experience
text:
Great location, clean, hospitality was excellent.
Restaurant recommendations were great.free wine, cheese & crackers social every Tuesday, Thursday and Friday @ 5:00pm.  Fun experience.
Walking distance to theaters.
Vouchers for breakfast three places to choose from.
Would definitely recommend.

author: Charlie Y
title: Perfect Location for Broadway Shows!
text: Hotel Edison was the perfect choice for our Broadway-focused family vacation!   It was such a treat to just walk a quick block or two back to the hotel after seeing a show.   The room was very clean and had plenty of space for our family of four.  Prior the trip, we contacted Guest Services with a question and Kezia responded quickly and professionally.   Also, as one member of our family has celiac, we appreciated having the gluten-friendly Friedman's restaurant on the bottom floor of the hotel.    We'll be back!

author: Connor E
title: Location, Location, Location
text: Great location since we took in two Broadway shows.  We were able to walk almost everywhere we needed.  Otherwise we took the subway.  There are several subway stops around. The staff was efficient and polite.  The room was clean and a good size for our needs.  We were given vouchers for a complimentary grab and go breakfast or for a discounted sit down meal.  Friedman's located on site is a gluten free paradise.  The Rum House, also located on site has a great happy hour.  We would definitely return next time in NYC.  Great value for a really cool art deco hotel!

author: William Z
title: Nice hotel, close to Broadway shows
text: Nice, clean, super friendly staff!

author: William M
title: Great location. Times Square was just around the corner
text:
The hotel is not brand new so there is an ambiance of old New York. Beautifully decorated walls. Lots of elevators so no waiting to get to your room or down to the lobby. We liked the free or low cost breakfasts, 
Every day we got off on a good start to see the city.
The first room was a king size bed but the room and the bathroom was very small. We asked for an upgrade and got a better room with a veranda

author: Harry H
title: Perfect location in NYC
text:
Perfect location in NYC to explore all that New York has to offer 
Excellent accommodation and great breakfast included in price

author: Lucas W
title: We loved it and the location can not wait to come again
text: We loved it very clean nice housekeepers wonderful security

author: Hugo O
title: Another great stay
text: We have stayed at the Edison before so when we needed a place for one night, it was at the top of our list. We booked a standard room with two beds. Room was clean and beds were comfortable. Nice view of the theater across the street. Fehat was charming and helpful as always when checking our luggage for us so that we could explore the city unencumbered. Love the Edison. Will be back.

author: Holly A
title: Great location. We enjoyed our stay.
text:
The location is great if you want to be near Times Square.
The staff are friendly.
We stayed 8 nights.
Our room was old (but we knew that from other reviews) but it was clean and very functional.
The daily service of the room was great.
Very secure building.
2 lounge chairs, king bed, plenty of storage, large bathroom with a bath.
Safe. Desk and chair. Good WiFi 
Good air-conditioning.
Good views out the window.
The odd siren, otherwise it was quiet.
We requested a fridge and they brought one to our room.
Plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby. McDonald's is on the corner.
Various subway (train) options to get around town.
Easy walk to Bryant Park.
Easy walk to Hudson Yards and the High Line.
Aldi is not far if you want to pick up some snacks and drinks.

author: Leo D
title: Disappointment
text: Excellent location right next to Times Square. Room on a high floor (48) with a nice view of the city, comfortable beds. Otherwise, the room is old, the bathroom is old with damaged tiles, the furniture is old and damaged, the TV shows one channel out of ten, and there is a lack of a refrigerator (the door that once housed it is now empty). When we asked to change to a better room, we were told that they are all like that. In short, a disappointment.

author: Sydney N
title: Wonderful hospitality and genuinely caring staff
text: A very pleasant stay with a great location and welcoming atmosphere. When my flight was cancelled, Marlene was exceptionally kind and supportive, after I explained the situation, she personally spoke with her manager and helped arrange a considerable discount for an early check-in, which I truly appreciated. Christopher was also very courteous and took the time to assist me despite his busy schedule. Their genuine care and kindness made a stressful situation much easier. It was a memorable experience.

author: Isabella C
title: Cannot fault this hotel 10/10
text:
My first stay at the Millennium hotel; was pre warned about the renovations going on, but to be honest, with the exception of the 44th street entrance being closed, it didn't make the slightest bit of difference. 
The check in process was  seamless and the customer service, excellent.
Location was amazing 
I was given a corner room with a Times Square view, which was completely unexpected, but it was just perfect. The air conditioning was fantastic, the room size was fabulous, especially for a room in the heart of Times Sqaure, the bed was super comfy, I honestly can't fault this place. 
If I had to pull things apart, I'd say it is quite tired looking but I assume the renovation will correct this, but for the price, it was EXCELLENT.
I managed to talk to George (Rooms Manager) who went above and beyond to answer my question and help me out.
I shan't hesitate to stay here the next time I'm in the city, it's a 10/10 for me.

author: Amelia Z
title: Great value and great people
text: Best place to stay in the city for price, value, view and their people. Thank you manager Lenny and Kyce for taking care of us and answering all of our questions. Your attention to detail and memory of us was appreciated. See you again soon!

author: Lucy X
title: Can do better!
text: Does not look like what’s advertised. Only saving grace is that it is next to Times Square. Says it’s a 4 star hotel - I have been in far better 3 stars. Decor is dated. No tea/coffee facilities in room. Fridge leg in room was broken so swivelled every time the fridge door was opened. Bad stains on carpet in room - enquired about this and reception said it was clean but stains could not be removed.  Staff are nice. Needs a major overhaul, take some of the undoubted profits being made here and invest in an update and at least start with basics - like carpet and fridge!! Got a notification a few days before we went to stay at the hotel that there was some renovations going on. Too late to book anywhere else. We did stay in the Riu hotel which is a little further away from broadway. No comparison, way better vibe and decor, and it’s looks like what is advertised.

author: David R
title: Honeymoon…2026!!..
text: Daniel, the manager and his staff are da BOMB-DIG!!..It’s our Honeymoon-and they upgraded our room and gave us complimentary chocolates!!..in addition he went out of his way to recommend broadway shows and other sites.  Gave us his card and made us feel welcome and our trip is better because of Daniel, his bubbles, fairy dust and his staff!!..WooHoo!!..💎🎸🌹💕🤩

author: Hannah I
title: 14 years...same hotel 😊
text:
We've been booking this hotel since 2014!
Whenever we are in NYC, The Millennium Hotel is our choice. We have tried three other hotels in close proximity, but always found ourselves attracted back to the Millennium. 
It is perfectly located salp bang in the middle of Times Square, your moments away from all the hustle and bustle of NYC. Once your in your room you can't hear all the noise, so you can enjoy some peace and quite. I prefer the sounds of NYC, so always had my window open. 
The staff are exceptional a special mention to Elena Metta, she has been at this place for many many years and always a pleasure to see her when were visiting. She will always go out of her way and make sure your stay is as comfortable as possible. 
The hotel has a art deco feel and is well maintained, the room are very spacious and beds are extra comfortable. 
You get fresh towels daily and good supply of toiletries, so no need to pack your shampoo or shower gels. 
Check is seamless and rooms are usually always ready on arrival, so no waiting about. 
It's central, close to all the attractions and friendly.
Hope to see you again!!

author: Ian R
title: $30 daily fee to be ignored over and over again
text: I am on my third night of a five night’s stay and the only good thing I can say is that the front desk staff is lovely. I have had no internet connection since day one. This also means I have no working television. That’s fine but I REALLY need the internet as I am on a work trip. I have called three times and gone to the front desk once to remedy this situation. Each time I am told someone will “be right up”. After four requests in three days no one has shown up. I do not have the “Do not disturb” sign on my door. They are quite simply just blowing me off. The $30 a day resort fee is just insulting at this point. I stayed here several years ago and liked it, but this, along with no coffee, no refrigerator, and a very dated room makes this the last visit for me. Not only this, bit the elevator lines are insane. THREE elevators are not functioning in a hotel with over 50 floors $150 for 5 nights in a room with no connectivity and no one responding however, is my final straw.

author: Lauren P
title: Hotel in NYC
text: Very good hotel in New York for sleeping, the location is very good

author: Julien X
title: A Disappointment. Broken Promise. Communication Cut Off
text: This hotel is advertised as a four-star property, but my experience was anything but. Our first room had goo backing up from the bathtub drain, a toilet that wouldn’t flush, black mold on the bathroom walls, and brown stains under the sink. We were moved to a second room, where the toilet still didn’t flush properly, and the thermostat was broken—we walked into a 78-degree room. The front desk staff was also incredibly rude. After I posted my original review, the manager asked me to remove it and promised to reimburse me for two nights. I removed it in good faith. Nearly a month later, only one night has been reimbursed, and my calls and emails have gone unanswered after one night was reimbursed. That’s not what was promised to me. I gave the hotel every opportunity to make this right, but the lack of follow-through has been just as disappointing as the stay itself. I cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Isabella X
title: Very dated hotel but I suppose good enough to stay in
text: Location was amazing, down the street from Times Square. Very dated on the inside. People working there were not overly friendly. On our 2nd day, housekeeping didn't come until very late afternoon. Rooms are extremely dated and in need of several repairs. Side table, TV stand and desk all very dated with iron burn marks and beat up furniture with scratches. It was relatively clean but not overly. No fridge in room. Closet missing doors. Shower grab handle about ready to fall off, barely hanging on. Bed didn't have a fitted sheet on it, just a sheet over the mattress. Shower needed a deep clean. Could have used more towels and washcloths. Cheap hotel but good enough I suppose. Needs to be updated SO badly. Elevators were slow and you had to wait quite a while for one to arrive.

author: Kyle E
title: Great Find!
text:
The only thing we didn't like was that they charge for early check-in. Other than that, it was great.

Tons of counter space and a fairly large hotel room. We were even able to have a room connecting to the other room in our group. It was wonderful! I asked for rooms next to each other without even thinking connected rooms would be possible. So convenient.

The location is amazing. Right across from the Museum of Broadway, which we try to visit once a year or so. Very close to TKTS and in the theatre district. I love the look of the elevators and lobby, too. Not very spacious for a lobby with that many elevators, but looks good. The lobby and rooms were clean and for the space we got the price was reasonable.

The staff was friendly even when breaking the news about the charge for early check-in.

We had a fairly high room, but never had issues with the elevators. We were always able to get in and out without an issue, which was so refreshing.

author: Sean E
title: Perfect base in NYC
text:
Our second time stopping in the millennium. Our first was in 2018 when we got married. 

It was great to revisit the millennium. We opted for the city view option which offered great views of the empire state building. The room was clean and spacious. 

Staff were friendly and accommodating when needed. A perfect base with subway within a minutes walk plus the best pub in NYC opposite.
What more could you want. We will be back in may 27.

author: Camille N
title: Daniel is the Best Human Being Ever
text:
Daniel is, without a doubt, the best hotel host I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting. From the moment we arrived, his energy, charisma, and incredible sense of humor made us feel completely at home. He has a unique style that turns every interaction into a memorable experience—you can tell he genuinely loves what he does.

If every hotel had a Daniel, hospitality would be on another level. He is a true asset to the Millennium Times Square, and anyone lucky enough to meet him is in for an amazing experience. Thank you, Daniel, for being absolutely incredible—you are simply the best! Highly, highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Lucy Z
title: Thank you, Daniel, for making my visit to New York City so enjoyable. I will definitely be returning and recommending th
text:

author: Carlos D
title: Good location and cost benefit.
text:
It's very worth it. The highlight of the hotel is the excellent location. Second part the cost benefit, because of all the hotels we searched well located in Manhattan, was the most considered. It is a few steps from Times Square and several subway and train lines. 
We arrived at Newark Airport and left by JFK, always using the train / subway and it was quite quiet, even with large luggage (not in peak time). You can generate a good savings, because Uber gets more expensive.
We were very well received at the reception by Daniel. Being an older hotel, it has a relatively large room for the current sizes.
Bed pretty comfortable.
If you wish, the hotel will take a free refrigerator/fridge bar to your room if available during the day.

The only negative thing, but that by the qualities does not matter much is the age of the hotel, old furniture and other things.
But that doesn't bother the experience any hour.

author: Lauren T
title: Think Twice Before Booking Here
text:
I wanted to provide an update following my original review because, unfortunately, my experience with the Millennium Hotel Broadway didn’t end when I checked out.

After my stay, I sent multiple emails to Guest Relations regarding the numerous issues we encountered, including being moved to another room because of significant maintenance and cleanliness problems only to be put in a second room with a broken thermostat and what looked like black mold in the bathroom with a rather large brown stain under the sink. I was repeatedly told that someone would contact me to discuss the matter. We left on June 28th, and no one has made any effort to reach out or resolve my concerns.

What is even more disappointing is that this reflects the same level of customer service we experienced during our stay. The woman working at the front desk when we sought assistance was rude, dismissive, and made us feel like we were inconveniencing her simply by asking for help. While one employee over the phone was kind and courteous, that level of professionalism was the exception rather than the rule.

Mistakes and maintenance issues can happen at any hotel. What separates a quality hotel from a poor one is how those issues are handled. Unfortunately, the Millennium Hotel has failed on both counts. Not only were the accommodations far below what I expected from a hotel advertised at this level, but the complete lack of follow-up after multiple promises to contact me has demonstrated that customer satisfaction is simply not a priority.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I also believe future guests deserve to know what they may experience—not only during their stay, but afterward if something goes wrong. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this hotel and would encourage travelers to consider other options that value both their guests and their reputation.

author: Sean O
title: Unexpected Best experience
text:

After such a difficult journey, Daniel’s warm hospitality was exactly what we needed. He made us feel comfortable, relaxed, and excited to begin our stay in New York. It is rare to meet someone who genuinely cares about making guests feel welcome, but Daniel went above and beyond to ensure we had a great start to our trip.

Customer service like this deserves recognition. Daniel is a true asset to the hotel, and his dedication to creating a positive experience for guests is exceptional. Thank you, Daniel, for making us happy the moment we arrived and for turning a stressful travel day into a wonderful welcome. We will always remember your kindness and the fantastic first impression you gave us of both the hotel and New York people.

author: Morgan H
title: Clean, comfortable room, friendly staff, great central location

The desk, housekeeping, and maintenance staff are all very friendly and professional.
The location is also perfect. It’s on a quiet street in a charming, safe neighborhood with a great range of restaurants of all types and prices. You can walk to almost anywhere in Manhattan and there are buses, subways, and trains nearby.
Really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend.

author: Amelia L
title: Not a 4 star hotel
text:
We stayed at The Park Central hotel at the end of July ‘26 for 8 nights. 

The good bits;
Location - The hotel is in a perfect location to explore the city. Close to everything and a subway station on the corner of the street. 

Fantastic bar man - John works in the hotel bar and deserves a special mention. He gave us some very helpful advice about the city, was always smiling and welcoming. 

The bad bits;
Not a 4 star hotel - Inside the lobby and bar, the hotel portrays a 4 star look. Once you get into the rooms, they are in need of decoration. The latch on the window in our room wasn’t secure (luckily we were 17 floors up) and came loose every time the main door closed. Windows were dirty too. Not what I would expect from a 4 star hotel.

Reception staff - Well they weren’t rude but I wouldn’t exactly call them welcoming! They told you the information you needed to know and any questions beyond that felt like an inconvenience. 

Room service - This is non existent. Coffee and tea making facilities are available in the room upon request. I asked for a kettle THREE TIMES before it was delivered to the room. Being British, it was lucky we had brought our own tea bags as nothing was offered. The cups provided were paper and I had to get my own plastic spoon from the shop in the lobby. 

The lifts - There were just 2 lifts serving all floors. To go from the 17th floor, you’d stop multiple times on the way down and people around the 5th floor were finding that by the time it reached them, they were too full. They were not adequate for the size of the hotel.
 
Security deposit - This was my BIGGEST bug bear. I had seen online that it was a $500 security deposit. I was told at check in it was $100 per night then charged $700. We checked out on the 1st of August. The security deposit was left pending on my credit card until the 24th of August despite being told it would be released upon checkout and then told within 14 days when I queried it after 7 days.

Conclusion - If you are looking for a roof over your head and a bed to sleep on in a good location whilst staying in the city, it fits the bill. If you are looking for a 4 star hotel, it does not.

title: Park Central. Why stay anywhere else?
text: Park Central is probobly my favorite place to stay on Manhattan . From the moment I step onto the lobby , I’m greeted with helpful , cheerful people.  Carolyn , at the front desk, always remembers me by name, and makes sure that I have all the accommodations that I need.. Carlolym is always quick to make sure  my special requests are met and has great suggestions of  pkaces to go and things to do . . that’s why I choose Park Central again and again, the Customer Service!

author: Mia L
title: Great memorable stay
text: I was nervous about staying here when checking the reviews about bogus smoking fines. As we do vape but wouldn’t do it in the hotel room anyway. Well we needn’t have worried as all was fine. All staff were friendly and helpful. The room was spotlessly clean and well maintained. Rooms cleaned daily with fresh towels. Great location. Lifts very fast and efficient. The only reason I have dropped one star is because there is no kettle so you have to purchase your morning coffee which involves having to get dressed and go out (I don’t function without a cuppa) also we asked to have a fridge delivered to our room and were told they don’t have fridges at all in the hotel. Anyway this didn’t ruin our trip. Go to o donoghues Irish bar for a very friendly atmosphere and happy hour 4-7 mon-fri for $4 pints!

author: Ana Y
title: Nancy and Gina are why I keep coming back
text: I've been coming to Park Central for five or six years, and I keep returning because of the people. Gina in the coffee area remembers me every single visit and genuinely asks how I've been, and we always end up chatting for a few minutes. She has this rare ability to make every guest feel like they actually matter. Her energy and smile set the tone for my entire stay. And Nancy in the lounge goes above and beyond. On a visit about a year ago when I was having a rough day, she offered me a hug. Who does that? This past week I stopped her to thank her again. These two make Park Central feel personal, not transactional. They're the reason I'll keep booking here.

author: Erin Z
title: Truely Amazing
text:
