I was taken by surprise wondering how did they know? Lucky guess I was told. I cannot begin to express how happy my daughter was and how thankful I am to Ms Betty and the staff at Park Central for their amazing work and dedication. It truly felt like home away from home. 

Thank you from my family and myself we will surely be returning again soon, this time for my birthday.

author: Tyler H
title: Good hotel, great location but bad breakfast
text:
The hotel’s location is amazing. It’s close to Central Park, to Times Square and 5th Ave. The rooms are clean. I am thankful for Meena (the room attendant) especially!
The only thing that we didn’t like - it’s hotel breakfast, very much below standards. Don’t waste your money on it. You can find coffee and breakfast near the hotel which is cheaper and far better quality.

Enjoy your stay!

author: Poppy N
title: Romantic Birthday Weekend
text: We truly enjoyed our stay at the Sanctuary Hotel in New York. We travelled there to see Bruno Mars at Metlife Stadium on August 22nd 2026. It was about ~20-25 minutes walk from Penn Station and was located right in the thick of Times Square. Upon arrival, check-in was smooth and pleasant. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. When we arrived, our room was beautifully decorated with a happy birthday sign and colorful balloons which was included in our prepaid birthday package. We also had a large piece of strawberry cheesecake and a chilled bottle of champagne waiting for us. I was very satisfied with this purchase. My boyfriend loved it and it really made him feel special on his birthday. We definitely took advantage of the $25 dollars a day food/beverage credit at the Haven rooftop and let me tell you the food was fabulous! We ate there on Friday and Saturday night and both times were amazing! The staff was super friendly and the manager stopped by several times to make sure we were enjoying our meal. I would definitely stay at Sanctuary again :)

author: Lauren J
title: Amazing Experience.
text:
I stayed here last week with my Mother, She yearly comes to visit me in New York and we always stay in different hotels. The Sanctuary Hotel was our favorite so far. The location is perfect, and the Hotel has a very Classy and clean look. 
All the staff is extremely friendly and helpful. 
Jhona is so so sweet, she checked us in and her warm genuine energy made us immediately feel super welcome.
I truly recommend this Hotel.

author: Evie T
title: Clean, great location, few hiccups
text:
Nice hotel I would stay at again. Great location close to Times Square and theaters, super easy walk from Penn Station. Room was clean and staff was very polite. Didn’t notice much noise (on the 5th floor). 

A few complaints: our one window was frosted over & facing an alley (? I think, it was hard to see through it!) so no sunlight whatsoever in the room. Pitch black in the morning!

Check in took a pretty long time. Partially because a few of the parties in front of us had issues with their reservations and partially because they only had one person checking people in at first, even though it was check in time. 

The $25 credit toward food is a little useless if you’re staying one night like I did. By the time we finally managed to check in, we didn’t want to linger around the hotel any longer, we wanted to get out there! And the places we could use it at the hotel didn’t stay open late, and we couldn’t use the money the next morning. I’m sure a lot of people don’t end up spending it. Not sure what the other $15 of the destination fee is meant to cover because they don’t provide any unique amenities or anything to make them stand out among the other hotels around. 

We got this hotel for a great deal and for that price, I’d definitely stay again - but I wouldn’t spend more on it.

author: Carlos G
title: Will definitely be back
text: This is the second time that we have stayed at The Sanctuary Hotel New York. They are wonderful!! The hotel is beautiful, the staff are extremely friendly and accommodating. The housekeeping staff did a wonderful job keeping our room clean and tidy and keeping us stocked with fresh linens. We got the small room but it was perfect as we only needed it to sleep. This hotel is extremely nice for the price. We can go to New York without breaking the bank and stay in a beautiful hotel that is at the center of everything.

author: Hugo R
title: Clean, comfortable, friendly, but very loud
text:
It was clean, the staff was friendly, the bed was comfortable, room was decorated nice, and the shower water was hot. 
The location could be good if you want to be basically right in Times Square. But if you want more quiet, this is not it. 
This was our first time in NYC so I didn't realize this about the location. 
The problem I had was the noise from our room. They put us on the 2nd floor street view and it was extremely loud. I know this is NYC, but it was so loud I couldn't sleep at all the first night. It felt like I was sleeping outside. I have a video taken by the closed window and it sounds like I'm outside on the street. 
We asked to be moved to a quieter room and the 2nd night they were able to accommodate. We were on the same side of the street, but on level 7. You could still hear street noise, but it was bearable. 
I would not stay here again mostly for this reason and I didn't love the location.

author: Sofia G
title: Ideal location - enjoyed 2 rooftop restaurants/bars
text: Ideal location with easy walk to everything.  We took advantage of the $25 per day amenity to experience the two rooftop restaurants enjoying cocktails at the Haven and Sushi at the Sushi Lab. Rooms were small, but no issues as we spent most of our time enjoying the city.  Employees were helpful and friendly.  Would stay here again.

author: Tyler O
title: Sanctuary hotel- better than expected
text:
Firstly, I am writing whilst I am still here but thought I didn’t want to wait just in case it helps anyone decide. 
This hotel is perfect. 10/10.
The location is perfect. Only 90 seconds from Times Square BUT the rooms dot get the noise of Times Square.
The staff are amazingly helpful and always happy to help. 
Check in was quick and unlike some travellers I knew about fees and deposits as I researched it so it did not come as a surprise. 

The rooms are adequately sized and perfectly suitable for a couple and is decent decorated and clean. 

Good shower with towels changed , shampoo conditioner and free to use safe in the room. Tv works also.
There is a stocked fridge in the room with space for your own stuff too.
I’m not sure on pricing of the mini bar though.
Air con is ice cold too which is a total bonus.

The hotel came with breakfast included and honestly I was pleasantly surprised. 
Croissants, toasts fruit … and then eggs sausage , hash browns and tea coffee juice etc. 
just what I needed after a boozy night before. 

I have not been to rooftop bar yet ( weather not been on our side but we do plan to spend some time there ) 

Overall I would come back here and if I had to pay I bit extra for this hotel I would pay the extra over another hotel. 
I will add another in a week or so when I check out .

Well done sanctuary

author: Lucia K
title: Excellent find!
text: Excellent! Exceptional! This hotel is less than a block away from Times Square, but it was quiet, very clean, tidy, calm, and professional. While I'm sure most of the other guests were theater tourists like us, it has a very homey and personal feel. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and modern. The staff was exceptionally kind and helpful. The Haven restaurant had great food at a fair price. I will definitely stay here again and recommend to others.

author: Ryan B
title: Return visit as good as before
text:
This was our second visit to The Sanctuary – we came for a week two years ago and decided to return for two weeks this time. We had really enjoyed the Sanctuary on our first visit and saw no reason to try anywhere else. Perfectly situated for Times Square and with Broadway and three nearby subway stations, sight seeing couldn’t have been easier.
We had rooms on the 9th floor this trip and although next to the lift and just yards away from the stairs access to the Haven, we did not find it too noisy at all.
All the staff were again really friendly and Esmee on reception was particularly helpful. We found the housekeeping staff all very pleasant and efficient, as were the staff at breakfast.
On our last visit, the breakfast was just continental but whilst that was fine, with plenty of choice, the addition of the cooked breakfast items was particularly enjoyed by my husband and provided even more choices.
It was really hot this visit for the whole two weeks we were there and the air conditioning was a godsend and we didn’t find it too noisy at all.  It certainly helped me sleep, as without it, sleep would certainly have been impossible.
We have read both the good and bad reviews about the hotel but whilst we appreciate some come down to personal preferences, we can only speak as we find and we found the staff and services provided to be excellent. 
We are considering a return trip to see NYC in the lead up to Christmas and The Sanctuary will certainly be at the top of our list when we are booking.

author: Mathis X
title: Absolutely impossible and disappointing.
text: We booked a supposed deluxe room here from 07/01 to 07/08.  The room faces the street directly and is incredibly loud. You can hear every noise from the street, especially the loading and unloading of the delivery trucks. Today, 07/04/2026 (250 years of the USA), is the kicker. Unfortunately, the only elevator to the 6th. floor is out of order. BUT we kindly offer the stairs. Rarely seen so little commitment. I believe this hotel will never see us again. Rated with one star is still 5 too many. You should be ashamed!

author: Laura U
title: Excellent hotel, especially for young people on short stays.
text: Excellent location, service, cleanliness, and very friendly and attentive staff. However, the room is very small with little space, and although the decoration is nice, the colors are dark. Ideal for short stays. As older adults with mobility difficulties, it would have been better to have more space in the room.

author: William A
title: Ideal location
text:
Stayed here for five days,staff very helpful n pleasant,breakfast was good,and filled when low,you could have bagels,toast,yoghurt fruit or sausage,scrambled eggs n bacon.orange juice n coffee of course.
Our room was a ideal size,all clean n tidy,thought the curtain across shower area was weird thought door would be better,we were on the 8th floor,no view out of window just brick wall but it didn't bother us. The air con was noisy though,you couldn't have on during night as too noisy !. That i found was the only downside.times square literally on door step five minutes if that.they was a bar couple of doors away which was good too.
Would stay here again.

author: Nora B
title: Underwhelming
text:
First time staying in NYC and was very excited about stay from all the reviews. Not sure where all the positive reviews came from?
Pro’s: nice check-in, friendly staff, great location!, surprisingly quiet. 
Con’s: room EXTREMELY small/compact, destination fee upon arrival with $25 credit that can be used at restaurants (tricky to use, watch times and place) NOT FREE breakfast, can use $25 credit but definitely not worth $25!  By the time we found breakfast, we were told rooftop until 11am, but it was downstairs only until 10am. There was about 1/4 c eggs left, overdone hash browns, some bread, bananas and yogurt. I heard another guest say “that was sad”. My thoughts exactly!  Rooftop lounge was sad also, hotel room tight, rundown, drawer stayed open on bedside table, bed frame torn in multiple places, window was view of brick wall, bathroom and shower is apart of room except for a curtain that can be drawn. 
Lighting in hallways dark and ominous, red everywhere. (See pics)

author: Maria X
title: Location, location, location!!
text: The hotel was a little tired and I paid too much by booking early - which was disappointing. But… location, location, location. It is 1 min from Time Square which meant access to Broadway theatre was so simple. I never had to walk further than 5 mins and i went to 5 shows! I walked around at night and never felt unsafe. It was perfect for a woman travelling alone and going to shows, but too expensive for what it was. Staff were friendly and helpful.

author: Erin W
title: Great hotel, great location, great staff!
text:
Great hotel with great staff. We couldn’t fault our stay. Every member of staff was faultless. The roof top bar was great and breakfast was good to have. It was basic but nice enough to not have to go out and find breakfast. Our room was really spacious, which shocked me looking at reviews. It was a King Deluxe. The street was loud but it’s Manhattan. 
We surprised my in laws by turning up on their trip and the hotel were brilliant in helping us know when they had arrived. We will definitely stay again. 
Only one slight grumble was the aircon was slightly loud, and we needed it in that heatwave, but that wouldn’t affect my staying here. 
The location is great, especially if someone’s first time. 
Thanks to all the staff 😀

author: Connor J
title: Great Place to Stay!
text: Wonderful staff, extremely helpful and friendly. (A shout out to Emily in the Roof Top Bar/Restaurant; the Doormen and persons at the welcome desk.) The location couldn’t be beat,  located near Time Square and in the Theatre District. Great restaurants near by. We had a wonderful four night stay!

author: Sofia R
title: Great hotel in great location!
text: Just returned from a 4 night stay at the hotel and couldn't fault it! Friendly and helpful staff, found room as described, clean and comfortable. Used the rooftop terrace for breakfast and evening meal, lots of choice and both meals were good. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others!

author: Sophia P
title: Amazing Boutique Hotel Near Times Square
text: I was able to spend an amazing evening here on my own and I loved it. The staff was so kind despite the chaotic energy of New York City. The rooms are cozy but luxurious. I love the transparent shower as well, it was so intimate and I imagine the perfect room for a romantic getaway. Also, they have great food on-site. Very cute space, and surprisingly quiet inside the room considering the loud sporadic nature of Times Square.

author: Nora Z
title: Great location and amazing staff as always!
text: Another amazing stay at the Sanctuary NYC! This was our 7th stay and we will never stay anywhere else. We love the location, right in the middle of all of the Broadway hustle, and the staff is always so welcoming. The rooms are always clean and well kept and we always have a clean bathroom which is a huge plus in my book as we've stayed in other hotels where it seemed like the bathroom hadn't been cleaned fully in a decade. I can never say enough about the staff. Every person we talk to is so nice and are always willing to go that extra step to help us get what we need.

author: Liam O
title: Family trip to NYC! 👌🙌
text:
Had 5 nights in April 2026 and the hotel was great.
Breakfast was good and the location is fantastic, right next to Times Square but without the noise! 
Staff were brilliant and the rooms were serviced daily and very clean and comfortable. 
Bar staff were also fantastic, very attentive and made us very welcome, service was great.
Reception staff had great local knowledge and were very happy to help and advise regarding travel and things to see.
Overall we had a fantastic experience and will be returning next year.
Sanctuary Hotel is great and New York ROCKS!! 😎👌🙌

author: Claire S
title: Great weekend!
text:
Took my daughter to NYC for the weekend to celebrate her birthday, and we couldn’t have asked for a better welcome! 🎉🗽

As soon as we arrived, we were greeted and checked in by Raquel. She was so nice, welcoming, and incredibly helpful. She gave us some great tips on what to do, where to go, and the best way to hit some of the top spots around the city.

Her kindness and helpfulness really helped make our weekend extra special. Thank you, Raquel, for starting our NYC birthday adventure off on such a great note! ❤️

author: Lucy E
title: DO NOT BOOK HERE! THEY PROMISED ME A REFUND AND ARE AVOIDING ME NOW!
text:
DO NOT STAY! Currently FIGHTING to get my money back that they TOLD ME I would get back during my early check out. My room was God awful and did not match the pictures. The wall was peeling, smoke detector was ripped out so I could see rats in open wall. Room smelled like a sewer. Sheets had stains on them. I upgraded to a premium in hopes to avoid problem. As soon as I walked in the shower water was brown and the air conditioner was broken. They sent an engineer to my room and he said I would need a new room entirely. I went to the front desk and told them I just wanted my money back and to leave, they said "we have everything noted on your account and it wont be a problem, just go through air bnb." It has now been 14 days and they have ignored all communications from Air BnB in regard to my refund request. DO NOT STAY HERE! Not only do the photos not match the actual rooms and my stay was horrible, but they are avoiding the refund THEY confirmed for me before leaving. Avoid them.
UPDATE: IT HAS BEEN OVER A MONTH AND THEY HAVE DENIED ALL CHARGE DISPUTES!

author: Daisy R
title: DO NOT STAY, THIS HOTEL IS A HELL HOLE
text:
To put it mildly, this hotel might be the biggest hotel scam I have ever seen. Two reasons:

1. We booked through Priceline and spent roughly $3,000 for 6 nights. Every picture made the hotel look beautiful and newly renovated. When we checked in, we got a room looking something like it was out of a horror movie. I asked the front desk and they told us that only one out of the 18 floors or so was renovated and those were the highest price rooms. Nowhere in the booking did it reference that only 5% of the rooms looked like they did in the picture. Ours has old carpets, brown stains in the bathroom, peeling wallpaper etc. 
2. Our hotel came with free breakfast. It was noted in the booking confirmation that I got and when we checked in, the person that checked us in told us it came with breakfast included. Day one, no issues. Day two, we got told it was only for 2 people vs the 4 we had booked. We went to front desk, showed them our Priceline reservation and she gave us a card (which we still have) that says "breakfast for 4". Days 3-6 we asked for 4 and were told it was only for 2 again so we gave up and fed the kids at a coffee shop. When we checked out, we were told we were good to go. I noticed we were charged an extra $180 so I contacted the hotel. They told me we had been charged $30 per day for breakfast. I sent them proof it had been paid for and they "passed it onto accounting". In the last 6 weeks, they won't respond, they won't return calls after leaving a voicemail, and they won't pick up the phone. We have been forced to seek legal action against the hotel and have now made formal complaints to the DWP and DWCP to push for a resolution. 

DO NOT STAY HERE. They have the proof yet still do nothing about it. Their customer service is lousy, their hotel is disgusting and the staff are rude and nasty. I have stayed at maybe 2,500 hotels in my lifetime and this is 100% the worst experience I have ever had.

author: Ella Z
title: Great experience that made my heart happy
text: The hotel is clean and the stuff are very nice and helpful I had the chance to be supported by Racquel that guided me not only for the utilities at the hotel but also where I can visit around and handed me a brochure with all the nice places even made the exception so I can get my room before the check in time taking in consideration the long trip I had

author: Zachary N
title: Great Birthday Stay
text:
Very good customer service. 
Especially Raquel at the front desk, my guardian angel hostess Leía, and the doorman Gene. Made my daughter’s birthday trip memorable!

author: Chloe Z
title: Excellent hotel
text:
Everything was beautiful. Especially the location. 4 blocks from Times Square Garden and 4 from Central Park and 2 from Fifth Ave.

Spacious room. Modern bathroom. Quality amenities as well as bedding and towels. Friendly staff. Highly recommended.

author: Amelia E
title: Unbeatable location
text:
The best part: location
The worst part: elevators always full

Decent hotel for the price for being in NY and with that location, just 300 meters from Times Square and 500 meters from Central Park.
Watch out because they are renovating it from top to bottom and the higher floors are very nice, both the rooms and the hallways, but the lower ones are quite old.
The worst part comes when you have to take the elevator: in the lobby, endless lines because they only have 2 elevators in operation for such a large hotel. And when you take it on your floor, you see full elevators pass by one after another until you can get on one... they should improve that.

author: Ryan G
title: Nice experience at The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel
text: I read terrible reviews of this hotel... and it turned out to be wonderful! Yes, it is a simple and old hotel but it has a lot of charm, everything worked perfectly, my room looked old but it was incredibly comfortable and clean and you really heard few noises, those of the other guests but nothing shrill, I slept like a baby. The employees were super friendly and helpful and the person who did my cleaning was a sweetheart... I felt like in the movies and I wasn't convinced about the breakfast but it was really a little treat for the mornings to have coffee, a croissant, and fruit. I had free water which I refilled in the bottle they gave me. I forgot to take photos of the room but I did take one of the view from the room which, although it faced a roof, I didn't mind, on the contrary, I liked it a lot because I felt like a New Yorker. Definitely the best location and a nice experience, I recommend it

author: Camille C
title: The Manhattan Hotel is a great Manhattan hotel!
text:
As a loyal IHG customer, I was pleased to see that this hotel is becoming the latest Crowne Plaza in the brand. It was a wonderful experience for our overnight in Manhattan. 

The location of the hotel is ideal for being close many key sights in midtown and the theatre district. You are close to many of the most popular theatres, and to Radio City Music Hall and Rockefeller Center.

The lobby has a modern, clean feel to it and check-in was a breeze. The staff was never less than engaging and ready to be of assistance. 

We understood that the hotel is still in its renovations process, making way for it to be a Crowne Plaza. So we had some concerns about the state of the hotel, rooms, noise, etc. Let me state that there were no negatives for us. In fact, our room was AMAZING! We had selected a larger King Room and we were extremely impressed by it. 

I would venture to guess that it was one of the renovated rooms. It was very modern, comfortable, and we had a great view from the 20th floor. 

I was so impressed with this hotel, I plan to book it again for our next visit to Manhattan. I mean, where better to stay while in Manhattan than in The Manhattan? ;-)

author: Owen O
title: August 2026
text: I have just returned from a five night stay in New York at this hotel,after reading some of the reviews we were a bit worried about staying here,we shouldn’t have been.Yes they are in the middle of a refurb and our rooms were a bit dated,but they were clean,comfy beds,air conditioned which was very much needed.The location was great and surprisingly quite quiet on an evening.The staff were all very nice,Raquel on reception was lovely and for about $10 I could get a cup of tea and pastry from the place down in reception where I was served by Salwa who was a very lovely lady.Myself and family would gladly stay here again and thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

author: Luca R
title: My choice!
text: In my opinion, this is the best Moxy Hotel I have visited globally. It embodies the full Moxy experience, but what really elevates it from good to great is the exceptional staff. I’d like to give a special shout-out to Giovanny, who enhanced my stay with a fantastic restaurant recommendation. This hotel is my first choice whenever I’m in Manhattan.

author: Matthew L
title: Good
text: Me and my father stayed for a night and our experience was good, the beds were comfortable and we like how close it is to everything

author: Matthew L
title: Birthday Weekend
text: The staff was extremely friendly from the receptionist to the hospitality staff. My room was clean and comfortable.

author: Matthew V
title: We love The Manhattan!
text: Raquel was wonderful! Very personable and friendly as we checked in to the hotel. She even upgraded our room. The room was beautiful with a stunning view. The location of the hotel was perfect for being central to all the shows and great restaurants. Raquel also gave us a list of recommendations which was very helpful. My wife and I always stay here when we come to NYC for work. We highly recommend it and can’t wait for our next visit.

author: Lucy I
title: A wonderful, comfortable stay!
text:
Brilliant stay with The Manhattan Times Square. Excellent location - a very short walk from the heart of Times Square but far enough away from the crowds and noise but you still get the atmosphere!

We were very warmly welcomed by Racquel. She was so friendly and informative. It was a brilliant way you be welcomed to the hotel.

We stayed on floor 20 which is one of the newly renovated floors. Lovely modern decor, the room was lovely, very big and bright a clean. Beds were huge and very comfortable. The bathroom was very nice. Huge shower! 

The breakfast option was nice. A selection of hot drinks and fruit juices, pastries, cereal, fruit and yoghurts. It literally is a grab and go. Nowhere to sit for breakfast but this suited us.

Overall we had a great stay and would definitely stay here again - It would have to be in one of the renovated rooms though!

author: Michael U
title: Wrong star rating
text: This is not a four star hotel more like a no star, the worst hotel I have ever been to, dirty rooms,  decor from hundred years ago, nothing works including the lifts. Staff okay but hands are tied with the rooms so smelly.

author: Noah T
title: A Hostel Not A Hotel
text:
Avoid this hotel at all costs, we arrived having booked a BA holiday for my daughters 18th to no room!!!! along with a queue of other people in the same situation.

They thought it acceptable to put us into one room and then Change for another 5 nights. Shockingly rude, miserable staff (probably fed up of the complaints) so many people complaining. 

We had 3 rooms in total and all were dirty, broken mirrors. One had a bed absolutely wet through with urine and hasn’t been made.

Another had a carpet covered in dirty toilet paper with a kicked in door.

British Airways were incredible and moved us immediately, we have reported this hotel and only hope BA remove from their product list.

author: Megan A
title: Loved NYC...not this hotel
text:
The hotel is not as advertised in the slightest - regardless of the fact they tell you there is ongoing refurbishment they are not transparent about the state of the accommodation.

Unless you book a premium room - of which apparently there aren't that many - expect to be spending your time in a throw back to the 1970s. Paper thin doors and walls, patchwork carpets, curtains that don't fit the filthy windows, dripping taps, air con that is either on, off or broken and can only be activated by maintenance coming to your room and doing it manually, doors that lock you in bathrooms...the list goes on! 

The bed was actually ok, not sure how a larger person would feel though as I think the springs were probably on their way through!

If you need separate beds you must make a special request, which they can't guarantee they will be able to honour.

The hotel was busy when we stayed and with only 2 of the 4 lifts in the building working the queues were often long.

Ice machines and water stations on most floors didn't work. I advised staff of this and was just told to use a different floor - the machines on our floor still weren't fixed 5 days after reporting!

Staff obviously have to deal with a lot of complaints and you can tell in the way they respond - no amount of complaining is going to get you anywhere. You want a better room...pay for it. They simply don't seem to care.

Location is ok, very close to Times Square, Central Park and in walking distance to TOTR & ESB. Multiple subway stations.

Can be noisy in a evening but we walked a lot during the day so were out like a light the minute our heads hit the pillow!

Security deposit is $50 per room per night, they keep $229 on checkout, they were very vague about this amount until I asked specifically.

Well definitely be back but most definitely would not stay here again and would not recommend.

author: Elena O
title: Terrible
text: Only good thing about this hotel is the location staff are rude n not helpful all need to be sacked especially the so called kitchen the breakfast is an insult a brown paper bag is what you get.Rooms are very old n dated n badly in need of renovating my room the floor was so wet from the air conditioning leaking n the bath had a cracked in it n it was like walking on a water bed.I would not recommend staying here at all

author: Ella N
title: Perfect!
text:
wealthy of information from Racquel!!!?!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Great work!! Racquel is simply wonderful

author: Jack L
title: Awful
text: An awful hotel. Deceptive website. Dirty rooms. No shower gel in rooms. No tea or coffee making facilities. No drinking water after hours due to ‘short staffing’. Repeated failure of key fobs. No flexibility on check in and out times. Breakfast is a stale croissant and mouldy banana in a paper bag. Stay somewhere else. Customer service is dreadful

author: Owen X
title: “Staff Assured Refund — Hotel Reversed Course After ATC Cancellation”
text: booked a Junior Suite at The Shoreham Hotel for August 7-10, 2026. My trip was cancelled due to an ATC power outage that grounded JetBlue flight B6 286 on August 7 — a federally documented event completely beyond my control. Gabriel at the front desk assured me a refund would be processed given the extraordinary circumstances. However, when my booking platform Hopper contacted the hotel for written authorization, the hotel reversed course and declined to authorize the refund. Over $900 lost for a stay that never happened due to a government-caused disruption. Hopper has confirmed they will process the refund immediately upon written authorization from the hotel. I have always believed that how a business handles adversity defines their character. Unfortunately The Shoreham’s handling of this situation does not reflect the standard expected of a luxury Midtown boutique hotel. I am still hopeful management will do the right thing and honor the commitment made by their staff.

author: Molly H
title: Okay hotel with everything you want walking distance
text:
I had no issues with my actual stay at the hotel but upon checkout I was told I would get my $240.55 refunded back as that was a holding fee. I have tried to email but the email bounced back so I don’t have a proper email address that works to get in contact with this hotel. Could someone please contact me.
I checked out the hotel on 16th of July and today is now 27th of July and a refund still has not come into my account

author: Paige I
title: Avoid-bad experience
text:
Unrenovated room, old 1970s carpet, stained. Sofa as old as the carpet, afraid to sit on it. 

In addition, they charged me for the room twice plus a deposit amount, so I have to finish my trip with $1000 less in my budget.

The only positive point is the location.

author: Lauren S
title: Awful filthy hotel
text: First room was dirty, carpet and sheets felt damp, bed bugs, rusty tub, stained carpet. Told front desk and got a second room and it had filthy bedding with bed bugs and hairs. Hotel refused to refund us even though we didn’t stay there. We checked out immediately. Claim it’s Expedia policy.

author: Emma S
title: A home away from home
text: OMG. Speed by as quickly as you can from this little view of hell as you can.  This is clearly a home away from home only if yours is Yucca Flats AFTER the blast. The rugs are thread bare (not that you would ever walk barefoot here), the bathroom was filthy. Not dirty. FILTHY. One air conditioner had partly separated itself from its' mounts and a second just didn't work. One TV couldn't find the internet so IT didn't work. I would not have sat on the stained couch in the living room if you PAID me. The beds were comfortable about the same time the Romans slept on them just before their trek to conquer Greece in 146 BC. .

author: Amelia J
title: Manhattan's worst hotel.
text: Worst cost benefit I've ever seen. The breakfast is sold here on the booking as of the hotel and with beautiful photos but nothing but a bad snack kit for travel. Also, the staff member who delivers the snack is always late, a disrespect. The room has stains on the carpet, defects on the support table. It's old and smells old. Vc pays more than 2,000 reais in one day and the experience is awful!!!

author: William H
title: Horrible hotel
text: What a horrible hotel, some of the staff were helpful but at least one was very dismissive and quite rude. I booked an upgraded premium room but the one I received was smaller and worse than my colleagues who had a basic room. There was blood and so many stains on the floor. Sone days missing towels. The room had not been vacuumed for a long time, probably no point as the carpet and decor needed ripping out. There was an iron but no ironing board. The window didn’t close so you couldn’t sleep due to the road noise. The air conditioning was so loud it was like a ship coming in to dock. Infact if it was on you could hear it down the hallway. The bed made horrible noises if you even sat on it let alone tried to sleep. There was no fridge, no coffee machine no facility to make hot drinks at all and certainly nothing complimentary such as bottled water. The bathroom ceiling was coming down and two of the lights didn’t work nor did one of the power sockets. The location was the only positive about the hotel and that is fixed and not within the hotels control. Everything that was on their control was very badly maintained or not working. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. I would strongly recommend you stay away.

author: Joseph Q
title: Not What We Booked – Building Work and Zero Hospitality
text:
We had just travelled for six hours from Washington and arrived expecting to check into the hotel, only to find the reception area was a complete building site. There was constant drilling, renovation work taking place around guests, and no one available at reception.

After waiting around 30 minutes just to be acknowledged, we were eventually met by a very rude member of staff who showed no concern whatsoever for the inconvenience. There was barely any apology for the delay, no acknowledgement that guests had not been informed about the extensive renovation work, and no attempt to make the situation right. The manager appeared completely indifferent to the fact that guests were being kept waiting while having to endure the noise, dust and disruption of ongoing building work in the reception area.

This was totally unacceptable and far below the standard of hospitality you would expect from any hotel. If major renovation work is taking place, guests should be informed in advance and appropriate arrangements should be made to minimise the disruption. Instead, we were met with poor organisation, poor communication and an attitude that suggested our experience simply didn't matter. A very disappointing first impression.

author: Amelia I
title: Very well located.
text:
Hotel very well located near 5th Avenue and close to all tourist sites. Subway nearby.
Very quiet and clean with plenty of storage in the room. Professional and patient staff.

author: Claire N
title: Outstanding Hospitality and a Comfortable Stay
text:
The Shoreham has become my go-to hotel whenever I'm in town. As a returning guest, I always know I'll be welcomed with exceptional service, spotless accommodations, and a comfortable stay.

The entire staff is warm, professional, and attentive, making every visit a great experience. I'd especially like to recognize Hotel Manager Gabrielle, who was an absolute pleasure. Gabrielle went above and beyond to ensure our stay was memorable, and the genuine hospitality and attention to detail truly set the hotel apart.

I highly recommend The Shoreham to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable hotel with outstanding service. I can't wait for my next visit!

author: Michael B
title: MASSIVE FEES, Dirty
text:
This hotel charges massive, unproven smoking fees for faulty smoke detector alerts.
Huge disappointment.

author: Daisy E
title: Avoid this hotel
text:
Avoid this hotel.

We arrived late at night, checked in, paid the security deposit, and went upstairs expecting at least a clean room. Instead, we found the dirtiest hotel room I have ever seen. The carpet was covered in stains and visible dirt, the bathroom had yellow stains throughout, the blinds and windows were filthy, and the window did not even close properly, letting cold air into the room. The room looked neglected and poorly maintained.

We immediately returned to reception because there was no way we were staying there. The receptionist mentioned another room, so I asked if I could quickly see it first to make sure it was actually clean. I was told, "We don't tour rooms." After seeing the first room, I wasn't willing to blindly accept another.

We contacted Booking.com, who initially told us a refund should be possible. The reception staff also told us the manager would most likely approve it the next morning, so we left the hotel after about 15 minutes. The next day, the refund was denied, and they even held my security deposit for almost a month despite us never staying in the room.

While at reception, I overheard staff saying they "wouldn't be in business if they gave refunds like that." In my opinion, they would be in much better business if they cleaned their rooms instead. Booking.com was ultimately unable to help despite what we had been told. This was by far the worst hotel experience of our trip. Save yourself the stress and book somewhere else.

author: Morgan N
title: Poor Customer Service
text: I am having great difficulty obtaining an invoice for the charges paid during my stay. I have already sent four emails to this hotel and my request is being completely ignored. I would really appreciate some assistance with my issue, as I am very disappointed with the failure to respond to my request despite the multiple emails I have sent.

author: Brooke O
title: Location, location, location!!!
text:
We chose the hotel for its location, price, and because others return the deposit within 4 to 6 weeks after you check out (read the fine print). When they ask for more than $700 in deposit, despite the fact that the entire stay is already paid, I do not believe I should help the financial business of another. 
The hotel presents itself as 4 stars. What can I say? The room was acceptable, although the carpet has not been cleaned or replaced in a long time. The bathroom is a very good size, with excellent hot water. 
It lacks a lobby or any upscale details.
Location, location, location is all that matters in NY, and it delivers 100%.

author: William X
title: Do not rent from this hotel.
text: The hotel did not return our deposit as required after we checked out without any problems. It's a disgrace that this happened! Do not rent from this hotel.

author: Lucia U
title: UNPLEASANT
text: Disappointing. The hotel needs a significant renovation. Carpet was ick, WiFi is spotty at best, air conditioner  was like having a leaf blower in the room that never shut off, pillows are terrible. It was deafening. TV volume had to be on level 79 just to barely hear it, and that's not an exaggeration. Personal note: There is a stupidly placed ledge right above your head in the bed. You may realize that the hard way when getting up. If your not careful you'll crack your skull on it, which happened to me. We needed a bag with some ice and the front desk said "Sorry I can't help you. Call 911 if you need it" (manager did later apologize).  Price was decent but now we know why.

author: Lauren H
title: Not good value
text: This is not a good value, as the room is basic with no amenities: no clock, no paper & pen, no refrigerator, no coffee maker, no toiletries, etc.  The shampoo and soap are attached to the wall, and mine were low.  It annoys me that their ad shows a woman in a terry cloth robe, as if they provide it; they definitely do not.  There's no lobby to speak of.  I might as well have stayed in a Motel 6 (except for the price).  You can do better.

author: Pablo R
title: Health and Safety Hazards, Dishonest Management
text:
On September 26th – 27th 2025, we were scheduled to stay at the Shoreham Hotel. On arrival, we found the room had not been cleaned, and was filthy. These presented serious health and sanitation concerns, and the promise to provide a refund was not honored. Issues included:

•	Used floss on the carpet
•	3 foot long BLOOD STAIN ON THE CURTAINS
•	Water splashed all over the bathroom
•	Filthy and unclean shower
•	Filthy, stained, frayed carpet, clearly not vacuumed, with used floss outside the bathroom, and serious tripping and safety hazards from wrinkles
•	Filthy windows, with debris and bugs on the windowsill
•	What we suspect (though admittedly can't confirm) were rodent droppings ON THE BED

We immediately went to the front desk and spoke with the manager, Hector. Hector informed us that they would be unable to move us to another room as they were completely booked. The most important part is that he verbally agreed to refund us in full for both nights of our stay, and accordingly, we moved to a hotel that could accommodate us. 

I have called the Shoreham hotel more than 20 times over the last eight months. Most calls went unanswered, and each time a voicemail was left. No return calls. I finally got a hold of Hector, who pretended he didn’t remember at first, and after weeks of calls from me, he finally “remembered” and agreed to “re-process” the refund. That was in December. The refund has not come through. 

Needless to say, I strongly discourage staying at this hotel (laughable they consider themselves four stars). I will be filing with the BBB, the NYC Consumer Compliant Division, and the NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection.

author: Marta S
title: Great hotel
text: Great service and great crew in the hotel, specially flor, who helped and gave us great service. Highly recommend!

author: Alexander T
title: Convenient and comfortable stay
text:
Location very convenient, walkable to many sightseeing spots and a min to metro station 
Comfortable and clean room with self service bar at reception for drinks and snacks

author: Daniel O
title: I recommend this hotel
text: Very good value for money, very varied breakfast.

author: Miguel C
title: High-quality hotel in a perfect location
text:
Very nice staff, simple and uncomplicated check-in with luggage storage for early arrivals. 
Room, clean and reasonably sized. Complimentary soft drinks in the minibar. Open bar from 2 PM. 
Hotel centrally located, subway right around the corner, many bars and restaurants. Everything perfect.

author: Abigail G
title: Highly recommended.
text:
Its location is perfect for tourism, in a strategic place. The staff is very attentive to cleanliness and they have a service until 2:00 A.M. for drinks and some snacks available to guests.
The rooms are very spacious and are in good condition, just a few adjustments like the sink drain, which was somewhat clogged, or a small lamp with a burnt-out light bulb…
Highly recommended for location and value for money.

author: Wyatt A
title: Beautiful experience, very delighted.
text:
I recommend it 100%.
Modern, clean, and quiet hotel, a very beautiful, friendly place. 
Pleasant and spacious rooms with every comfort.
Super welcoming staff, available for any request. 
Hearty breakfasts.

author: Molly Y
title: Very good stay.
text:
Second stay at this hotel and still just as satisfied.
The welcome is warm, the staff is lovely, and the hotel's location is perfect.
Special mention for the delicious and generous breakfast.
A very good address where I return with pleasure and which I recommend without hesitation.

author: Lauren C
title: One of my best experiences in Paris.
text:
I recommend this hotel 1000%.
Staff available, warm, and courteous. 
Well located in the 9th arrondissement for a shopping enthusiast like me, I rarely needed to take a taxi, brasseries all around the hotel to eat according to one's tastes...

author: Morgan Y
title: Merci Hotel 34B - Astotel
text:
I cant say enough great things about Hotel 34B! This hotel knows the meaning of customer hospitality and service, and at a very reasonable price. It was a home away from home, and a warm hug at the end of a long day. 
My teenage daughter and I travelled to Paris for the first time in January from Australia.  I was perplexed by the number of hotel options in Paris and locations best suited for moving about the sites. This hotel caught my eye because I studied art and I loved the quirky but tastefully Paris themed decor, as well as the affordability and location.
Hotel 34B covered everything a base needed when visiting the sites of Paris. In close  proximity from the hotel you had unlimited restaurants, brasseries and bars, a supermarket only 30m away, and a coin laundry in the next street (Don't be fooled by the 24/7 sign on the coin laundry it closes at 10pm on the dot). We almost left Paris without our clothes). We did take Ubers back to the hotel if we were out late, never the train.
The metro and buses are minutes away from the hotel.  A ten minute walk to the Paris Opera, Galleries Lafayette and 30 mins to Montmartre, the Louvre and Seine. Very easy to get around and busy. Lovely areas to wander close by.
Every morning a lovely selection of food filled us up for the day and when we returned back there was always drinks and basic snack on offer at no extra charge, so you were never looking for a drink after a long day out. Our mini bar was stocked each night with a selection of drinks included in the room cost. We didn't return until quite late every evening and for the most part welcomed on arrival. 
There was an older gentlemen who was not so friendly, but in general the staff were more than accommodating and friendly. Id also like to give a big shout out to the staff at breakfast who were very polite and helpful everyday. 
If I had anything negative to say - the carpets on the floor looked very run down and probably cheapened the look of a terrific hotel. 
I want to say thank you for making our Paris visit so perfect. xo

title: All of our expectations were perfectly met at this hotel.
text:
The hotel is conveniently located near many attractions and offers all necessary metro stations very close by. There are 3 supermarkets in the immediate vicinity.
The room was clean, well and functionally furnished, and very quiet. The bed was very comfortable and back-friendly.
The breakfast was very extensive, delicious, and was constantly replenished.
The staff was very friendly, competent, and helpful in all areas (housekeeping, breakfast, reception).

author: Amelia H
title: Perfect hotel very well located in Paris but on a quiet street and the staff is very friendly
text: One night with two friends in a room with three single beds and two shower rooms

author: Alexander A
title: Excellent experience
text:
Everything perfect!
Buffet breakfast suitable for all tastes, sweet, savory, and varied.
Very kind and helpful staff
Perfect room cleanliness.
Very comfortable beds.
Large and quiet rooms.
In our two double rooms, there was parquet flooring.
Toilet in the same room as the sink and shower. Something uncommon in Paris and very appreciated.
Nearby there is life until late at night and many places to eat.
Well served by buses and metro.

author: Harry I
title: Excellent hotel both for its location and for the services offered.
text: Located a few steps from the subway, it allows you to reach all the main attractions of the city with extreme ease. Clean, comfortable, quiet, reception always open, and courteous and helpful staff. International breakfast, free drinks in the room minibar, snacks and non-alcoholic drinks available in the hotel lobby from 2:00 PM. Our room was not large, but well-maintained and adequately equipped. Highly recommended.

author: Isabella Q
title: A good deal in Paris
text:
Very pleasant staff, clean room.
Very good value for money

author: Amelia U
title: Very good hotel
text:
Very good family stay with a room for 3 people. 
Very convenient for reaching points of interest with the subway very close by. I will come back.

author: Sophia P
title: Highly recommended
text: Very clean rooms, noise level is totally ok, all emloyees were very kind. Location is very good, near to metro, around were a lot of restoraunts and caffes. In the room we had a mini bar, and every day we were given us a 5 different drins for free. Highly recommended!

author: Gavin V
title: Very good and recommended. We will be back!
text:
Wheelchair-accessible room very good. The left handle is missing from the toilet.
Breakfast very delicious and varied. Attentive and nice staff.

author: Charlie K
title: Great experience
text: Pleasant surprise, spacious rooms and extraordinary location

author: George C
title: Very good value for money
text: Everything was perfect. Very well-located hotel, 2 steps from the subway. Room facing the courtyard, well soundproofed, clean. Varied and hearty breakfast. Unlimited drinks in the afternoon, which is very much appreciated. Excellent value for money.

author: Poppy O
title: Fantastic family friendly hotel
text:
A very nice hotel, which provides a point of relaxation in the middle of the busy streets of Paris. The room we had was wonderful for a family, with 1 room for the kids and 1 for me. Very clean hotel with very nice and helpful staff. You practically hear nothing from the street, when you keep your windows shut. And with the airconditioning it is also very comfortable in summer. 
With the metro closeby and the complementary drinks and snacks in the afternoon, it makes a very good and affordable base to explore Paris from.

author: Sophia C
title: Exceeded our expectations. Big shout out to staff member Victor.
text: As a baseline what I need from a hotel is a clean bright room, a very comfortable bed to cater for older bones, a good breakfast with variety, ( the buffet breakfast was excellent & always restocked)  good location and importantly friendly helpful staff. 44b Astotel delivered on all fronts. Additionally, the decor in the lobby and lounge rooms downstairs was funky, yet elegant with huge skylights, making it a great space to retreat from the hot summer sun. The minibar in our bedroom was free & refilled daily. There were multiple types of croissants, snacks, and hot & soft drinks, free and  available most of the day to help yourself to, and people seemed to treat this extra with respect. The aircon everywhere was excellent. Lovely crisp cotton sheets were much appreciated in those hot nights. The staff chatted and were helpful with any queries. Victor, in charge of the dining area, was so kind and friendly, making breakfast time a real treat. I admit to being picky, I notice the detail, and I can say, hand on heart that this hotel was  5/5 in every respect and good value for money as we booked months in advance. I can thoroughly recommend this hotel. If you want to eat delicious authentic French dinner , visit Bistrot Rougemont, just 3 mins walk away, and the excellent reviews were all justified.

author: Lily V
title: Stayed Twice, Would Choose It Again!
text:
We had a really great experience at this hotel, so much so that we chose to stay here twice in a row during our trips to Manhattan. The value for money is excellent, especially considering the location, which is very convenient for exploring the city and getting around easily.

The service was impeccable, with friendly and attentive staff who were always happy to help. We had a very positive experience on both occasions, and if we return to Manhattan in the future, I would definitely choose this hotel again without hesitation.

Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Camille N
title: Great Location, Poor Service
text: Will definitely be looking at other options when traveling to NYC.  We had to make multiple calls for repairs in the room, one being a leaking shower door than never got fixed.  Since we stayed for 7 days we ordered groceries.  When they were delivered we had to go down to meet the delivery person (he couldn't come up as we're accustomed to).  Plus, a lady working in the lobby said we couldn’t use the luggage cart to bring up the many bags and case of water.  Unacceptable!  They had several carts available for use.  The cleaning lady was persistent daily for wanting to clean the room.  We were on vacation and didn’t want the pressure to leave the room.  Putting out the door sign did not help.  The sleeper sofa in the 1 Bedroom was surprisingly comfortable.   I strongly recommend bringing a charging station.  We could not use the outlet in the living room while sleeping on sleeper sofa as the light switch at the entrance controlled this outlet.  Also, the bedroom lacks lighting.  There is no light anywhere near the closet so finding things in the closet/luggage was challenging.  Also, be prepared to pay a resort fee of 54.51 USD per night.

author: Ana H
title: My best NYC hotel visit ever!
text: This place is fantastic! You can’t beat the location, Carnegie Hall, right across the street and a 10 minute walk to go see shows. We stayed in a room with one bedroom and two bathrooms and overall probably about 500 ft.². The only thing I wish the room had was a toaster!  I am 100% sure I will be staying there again on my next trip to New York City!!

author: Harry W
title: Great location, awful room & experience.
text:
The hotel needs to be updated. 
The reception area is nice and the seating area on floor 26 is nice. 
Other than that the hotel is majorly run down. 
For such a big hotel the elevator situation was terrible. 

The room we stayed in is not a suite and should not be sold as such. It is a small cramped, dark and dingy room. 

We stayed in room 226. It is the worst hotel room we have ever encountered. 
There is no proper window in the room.
There is no proper lighting in the room,  just 3 lamps. Without a window (it is half 3 quarter coated glass) this makes the room incredibly dark and dingy. 
No proper light in the bathroom so you can’t see in the mirror. 
When we arrived as a family of 4, we had expected 2 x double beds. This was probably a mistake on booking (through an agent). We had one bed and a sofa bed and the sofa bed that was not made up. 
We had to wait for it to be made and it was like a concrete block. So hard and uncomfortable. No proper duvet. The lady who made the bed was going to leave one pillow on the bed. After travelling for 12 hours this wasn’t a great start to our trip. 
We only had 2 big towels and 2 hand towels for 4 guests. 

We were only staying a few days before heading elsewhere so I didn’t have the energy to move rooms or hotels. I checked online and the hotel was full so no chance of a room move. 

The hotel should not be selling this room. The carpet was dirty, the blind didn’t fully come down, it wasn’t up to a cleanliness standard I would expect. 

The reception staff were all lovely and really helpful. Cannot fault the staff. It’s not their fault the owners / management have the hotel in the state it is in. 

We had to ask for clean towels, toilet rolls etc. 

The location is great but I wouldn’t book here. 

The images the hotel use seem to be from a long time ago. It is not like that now. 

We can only go off our room and experience. 

Avoid room 226 at all costs. Higher rooms you have the issue of getting up and down with one lift in operation or using the staff lift. It takes forever for lifts to come. 

At least we had the choice to use the staircase for our room. On saving grace. 

My daughter cried after being in the rock hard sofa bed so my husband slept on that instead. It is not OK to give that to guests.

author: Poppy M
title: 4 star amazing hotel with balcony options!
text: Excellent hotel! Great staff, reasonably priced valet parking, breakfast and I upgraded to a junior suite with a Balcony! Great location for theater and concerts. Just stayed at a supposedly 4 star hotel that had ZERO of the advertised necessities like no food at all (not even coffee), no parking at all, a broken down version of its former self. The Manhatten Club is walking distance from theaters, concerts and museums. Can’t always afford that junior balcony suite but a regular room is well priced for this clear 4 star winner (Only a handful of hotels reach 5 stars in NYC and cost at least 2-3x as much). Will return and highly recommend.

Elevator not working for a whole week.

author: Nathan H

author: Kyle S

author: Camille B
title: Horrible staff
text:
I rarely leave 1-star reviews, but our stay at The Manhattan Club was incredibly frustrating from start to finish.
First, only a single elevator was working during our entire stay. For a hotel of this size, the wait times were ridiculous and completely unacceptable. To make matters worse, there was absolutely no transparency regarding their laundry service pricing.
The biggest issue came at checkout. We were charged directly without being provided an itemized invoice. When we noticed the discrepancies and approached management to get clarification and address our experience, they completely dismissed us. Instead of listening to a guest's legitimate concerns, the manager simply backed up their employees, refused to take accountability, and offered absolutely zero compensation for the massive inconveniences.
The lack of basic communication, hidden charges, and defensive management show a complete disregard for customer service. I will not be staying here again.

author: Ana D
title: Aggressive staff mindset and insular service
text:
I booked a stay at this property through Agoda, under the impression that it operated with standard, consumer-focused hospitality protocols. Unfortunately, my experience revealed a stark contrast to typical hotel chains. This property operates heavily as an independent timeshare vacation club—a business model that, based on my research into past regulatory actions and numerous owner complaints regarding its operations, seems to prioritize its rigid internal protocols over standard guest hospitality and flexibility.

During my stay, an unsettling incident occurred in the lobby while I was on a phone call. A security officer named Jesse directed an aggressive, unprovoked tone across the space. His primary intention was to demand that I remove myself from the armside of a chair, but he did so while making repeated, highly inappropriate glances at my attire that left me deeply uncomfortable. When I abruptly ended my call and approached him to clarify what the issue was, he appeared to realize his error. Instead of offering a polite correction, he instantly shifted into a loud, self-defending, and hostile manner, claiming my positioning was compromising the furniture.

The subsequent handling of this complaint by their administration only highlighted an insular corporate mindset. I received a standard template email from the front office assistant director, Andrew, but after providing my feedback, there was an absolute lack of ownership or direct follow-up from him. Instead, a representative named Sabina later called me. Rather than engaging in genuine conflict resolution or listening to my perspective as the aggrieved guest, she essentially read from a rigid script like a parrot, repeatedly insisting that the matter had already been "investigated and satisfactorily resolved" internally. Furthermore, she consistently addressed me by the wrong name despite being corrected multiple times, and failed to follow through on her explicit promise to send me her direct contact details. From my perspective, the customer relations process here exists solely to protect the property's staff from accountability rather than ensuring guest peace of mind.

I wouldn’t even start commenting on their elevator situation ( prepare for over 5 min wait for the single operated elevator), musty and moldy bathroom which I complained about but no follow through …. Given its old property there is lack of sound proofing so prepare for a rough night/s for those like me light sleepers..

I highly advise independent travelers booking through third-party platforms to look elsewhere.

author: Emma S
title: There is a chill in the air
text: An exceptional hotel. Period. Room was terrific, staff is attentive and responsive. One exception: like many (maybe most) NYC buildings it has central heat/air. There is no switch to change from one to the other. In my case a cold snap made the room uncomfortably cold because management had switched the building over to air. Yes, you can shut off the air but you will still be at the mercy of ambient air temperature. There may be no fix but management should at least inform the guest at the time of booking to pack a sweater. It would be the polite thing to do.

author: Leo B
title: The Manhatten Club, NYC
text: This property is very well located, convenient to several busway stations just a few blocks from Broadway and central park, Rooms are spacious and the hotel staff are very friendly and professional.

author: Evie J
title: I strongly recommend
text: Manhattan Club is located in a very good location in New York City. Three roads from Central Park and very close to transportation nodes. Also 10 minutes walk from Time Square. The cleanliness was daily and impeccable. The building is old but very well kept.

author: Charlotte P
title: Cold at Manhattan Club
text:
We reserved a room at the Manhattan Club via RCI.  Unfortunately, our room's temperature was in the mid 60s.  After playing with heat/air controls in the room, we called the front desk.  We were told that the hotel put their system into "neutral" mode which meant no heat nor cooling.  Apparently, this older building had some rooms that were too hot and some too cold.  So, they could not offer any heat or cooling in any room.  The outside temperature was in the 40s that night.  We had to check out and find another hotel (also an old building but one with heat and air).  Although when calling and stopping by the front desk, we were told nothing could be done, when we checked out they did offer to move us to another room.

I do not understand how RCI would list the Manhattan Club as a Gold Crown resort with no heat/cooling.  Calling RCI was also useless.

author: Anna G
title: Great location in Manhattan.
text: in addition to the great location, there is a bar on the 26th floor, the rooms are like an efficiency apartment, the bellhops are very helpful, transportation can be arranged for a fee. The rooms were clean and our room was quiet. The only downside is the additional “service” fees that the resort charges when you check in.

author: Alice R
title: Fantastic stay!
text: We stayed in a one bedroomed suite which was lovely and spacious.  We were joined on this trip with our adult daughter and her boyfriend, they slept on the sofa bed and said it was very comfy.  Our bed was extremely comfortable, and there was plenty of storage space both in the bedroom and the living area to get properly unpacked.  The rooms were well maintained and clean, housekeeping did a great job each day refreshing the rooms.  The little kitchen area was very handy. The hotel is well located but the real bonus about this hotel is the staff.  Every single member of staff went out of their way to be helpful and friendly, nothing was too much trouble for them.  The only slight issue was the lifts, we often had to wait a long time, and being on the 21st floor taking the stairs wasn't really an option.  Having ice machines on more floors could help  alleviate some of the pressure on the lifts.  Overall a fantastic stay and I would highly recommend it

author: Hannah V
title: Dissapointed
text: Its a very nice hotel which is very close to central park. Rooms nice clean basic. Having a huge issue with their deposit system paid $400/ £373 which i still have not been received back yet. Spoken to a few others who stayed there and said theyve had a similar issue. Ive spoken to the bank and they said its up to the hotel to release it. Also emailed the hotel who werent much help. I wouldnt stay here again unfortunetly as its a hefty fee to pay and not to receive back quickly

author: Benjamin X
title: Fantastic location, spacious clean rooms, friendly staff
text: Great stay at The Manhattan Club. Fantastic location, walkable to Times Square, Madison Ave, Central Park, 5th Ave. Spacious large and very clean rooms. We loved the 2 bathroom set up in the 1 bedroom suite - so convenient. Esteban was especially kind and helpful - a very special mention for his excellent service. We also found the club lounge very convenient for a coffee stop and meeting place with family. All the staff were very friendly and helpful from housekeeping to the front desk and bell hops.

author: Giulia G
title: fabulous hotel and room!
text:
absolutely loved this hotel!  perfect location, clean and really friendly staff.  i decided to upgrade to a one-bedroom suite and it was well worth it.  enjoyed having 2 bathrooms, the most comfortable bed, a living room and small kitchen area with refrigerator, dishwasher, coffee maker and microwave.

the hotel is an 11 minute walk to the theater district and a 5 minute walk to the subway.  they also over concierge parking, which in nyc is almost unheard of.  the staff was super nice and there were no lines to check in or check out.  we also enjoyed the bar on the 26th floor.

my ding of a star was that they are in the middle of renovations, so the elevators weren't always available, or they were super crowded.  because of this, you had to factor in time to get in and out of the building.  we ended up taking the service elevator a lot because it was less crowded.

i would definitely stay here again.  i will have a tough time staying anywhere else i loved it here so much.  it is a little pricy but if you want a hotel in close proximity to the heart of the city with clean, spacious rooms and friendly staff, this is the place.
