author: Alice G
title: Friendly hotel in a good location
text:
This is a small hotel with a terrific staff and prime location.   The building is over 100 years old, but I believe it was converted to a hotel about 30 years ago and renovated more recently.   Unfortunately, when it was last renovated, they forgot to hire an electrician!

There were but a few electrical outlets poorly located around the room, including one inaccessible outlet behind the bed.  At the desk there was a lamp, cordless phone and coffee maker all competing for one well-worn outlet.  Even after disconnecting the cordless phone, I had to unplug the coffee maker to plug in my laptop, or unplug the lamp to make coffee, etc. etc.   Being able to plug in only two devices near the desk, may have worked years ago, but in 2026, it’s simply inadequate.

I mentioned this to the lovely young lady at Reception and she very politely offered to have an extension cord or power strip sent to my room.   That didn’t happen.   I mentioned it again the next morning and she again made the same offer, but again that didn’t happen.   I gave up at that point. 

There were two USB charging outlets in the desk lamp base.   The USB-A worked, but the USB-C didn’t.  None of the lamps had AC outlets, as you find in most hotels nowadays.  None.

So, if I stay here again, I’ll remember to pack an extension cord.

author: Caleb J
title: Awesome stay in Midtown Manhattan
text:
Really good experience at this hotel.  You can’t beat the location.  One block from Grand Central Station, about a ten minute walk to Fifth Avenue and shopping, and a twenty minute walk to Times Square.  There is a market in Grand Central on the ground floor and many quick casual restaurants in the basement of the station.  Four subway lines converge on Grand Central Station and from there you easily explore Manhattan.

We paid extra for the junior suite and found it was worth the money.  Bathroom was recently renovated and extremely spacious with double sinks and a large shower.  Room also had a small sitting area.  

Hotel is only ten stories tall, so don’t expect a view from your room.  Our room was at the back of the hotel, so very quiet at night and minimal traffic noise.  They do have live music at the attached Wheeltapper pub patio but it was done by 9 or 10 pm and we slept well.

Staff was friendly and they do have a turn down service at night where they leave a few treats.

Overall, would happily stay here again.

author: Nora Y
title: 5 stars and the rest!
text: Can’t recommend this hotel enough.  Staff truly looked after us on our 6 night stay in  New York.  They are hardworking, always friendly and knowledgeable.  Everything from the moment we arrived to the minute we left was just perfect.  Baggage drops/storage for earlier check-ins/late departures; advice and support of how best to navigate the city and sights to visit.  Excellent location - round the corner from Grand Central Station and with excellent food and beverage shops within very short walking distances in all directions.  Delicious cocktails at the hotel bar.  Genuinely excellent service making our whole experience the absolute best.  Thank you team Fitzpatrick!

author: Morgan E
title: A Wonderful Stay
text:
We stayed at the Fitzpatrick Grand Central Hotel for a five-night stay and, after staying at many different NYC hotels over the years, we feel we have finally found the hotel we will return to for our visits to the city. The rooms and bathrooms are large and comfortable. Housekeeping came each day to clean our rooms and replace towels. The desk staff was helpful and personable. The on-site Wheeltapper Restaurant is a pub with an Irish American menu and served breakfast, lunch, and dinner in indoor and outdoor seating areas.  

There were a few issues we noted. The Wheeltapper does not open until 7:30 a.m. which was too late some mornings, but we found a French Pastry shop two blocks away that served breakfast. The hotel rooms are being remodeled starting with the ninth floor down. When I booked our rooms, I saw photos on the hotel website of walk-in showers in the junior suite. As older travelers, we prefer this option. Our room on the second floor has not been remodeled and had a tub with two steps up to climb in. This was a safety issue for us. Ironically, there was a grab bar, but it was on the left end of the tub where the faucets are. Adding a grab bar at the right end of the tub would have made our entries and exits feel safer. Rooms on the second floor are directly over the Wheeltapper Pub, so we could hear music. It did not go past 10:00 p.m. but we will request a higher floor in the future.

Our future plans will include stays at the Fitzpatrick. It is comfortable, clean, and conveniently located near Grand Central Station.

author: Noah X
title: A great place to stay in New York
text:
I have honestly lost track of the amount of times we have stayed at this hotel and we honestly would not stay anywhere else in New York. 
The staff are all lovely and will always go above and beyond to talk to you or help you and they are a true credit to the management team. I can not name you all but Andrea, Jeff, Chrystal, Garfield, Sybil, Nicole and Bilau you are a true credit to this hotel. 
The hotel is in the perfect place to explore all of New York. Right near Grand Central Station. Hotel bar is amazing and was a great place to watch the World Cup and relax with a drink and a meal. 
We will be back in November to see you all for Thanksgiving.

author: Chloe E
title: great value for proce
text:
a great hotel at a perfect location.
the staff is freindly and I always go back to it.
highly recommend.

author: Lauren Y
title: Not the best
text:
Let me start by saying the staff were super friendly and helpful and some of the staff were Irish which gave an authentic experience. 
We paid quite a bit for 3 nights in a basic room. We have stayed previously in much nicer hotels in New York. Rooms are on the larger side for New York however extremely dated. The Fitzpatrick hotel group took over the building in the late 90’s and I don’t think rooms or internal areas have been updated since. Our door didn’t feel very secure and didn’t appear to fit well.  We had someone try to enter our room in the middle of the night but we had the chain across. Our friend next door reported the same thing happened to her door the same night. 
The air con was very old and noisy but effective. The bed and mattress are old and not comfortable for 2 sharing. Room includes coffee and creamer and a safe. The window overlooked the front of the hotel. Window was dirty and curtains very dated. Expect to hear cars beeping, truck deliveries etc. windows are not double or triple glazed and you will hear noise. We were originally going to have rooms on the second floor but preferred to wait an hour for rooms higher up,in the hope of reducing traffic noise.
Bathrooms have been updated. The shower is over the bath, hairdryer is provided, with shampoo, conditioner and body wash but no body cream or hand cream. 
The hotel is in a noisy busy area and while close to Grand Central station is quite a trek away from Times Square.  There are cafes and shops close by. 
In my opinion there are nicer hotels in a better location and we would not return to the Fitzpatrick Grand Central.

author: Nora K
title: Great Hotel
text: Had an amazing stay at this hotel. The food and drinks are outstanding and the staff amongst the most friendly and efficient you will meet. A huge thank you to Garfield who is simply the best-of-the-best. I look forward to my return next year 😔

author: Noah R
title: Love This Hotel!
text:
This was my first time staying at this hotel and it won’t be my last!
I travel with my sister and the room was so clean and the staff were so friendly.
We ate breakfast in the restaurant and were amazed at the beautiful patio space they had! The Fitzpatrick Grand Central felt like home!

author: Marco V
title: Soft beds and noisy ac, but overall good.
text: Arrive late at night, got assigned a room and was very disappointed, we had arrived from Las Vegas and before that San Francisco and both hotels and rooms were great. Wife went down and asked to be moved, Hotel was full so no joy, sort of excepted that is what it is, went out the next day and when we came back in early evening, I asked again, the Irish gentleman ( sorry did not get his name ) on reception changed our room and what a difference, happy wife again 👍. Used the bar was full up but luckily got a table outside when the Knicks game was on, great atmosphere, had food one night when a storm hit and the food was surprisingly good, not what I was expecting for a pub. Overall 7/10 dropped scores as bed was soft, like really soft, ac was very noisy. But thank you to the gentleman who changed our room, you made our day.

author: Isabella L
title: Extremely Tired and Dated
text:
Just on the way home after 4 nights here . This may have once been a nice hotel in the 90’s, but unfortunately no investment has been put into it in a long time and it shows. 
Everything is dated and not in an old worldly way but in a neglect way.  
On arrival there was not even bottled water in our room, and left only once during our stay of 4 nights. 
Beds are comfortable and we did sleep ok  but I felt the rooms are grubby, carpets, curtains, with the loudest oldest air con units I’ve ever experienced. They activate every 10/15 mins and are loud enough to wake you up each time. Towek ring even came off the wall when we were there. 
Had room service one night and food was good. 
I would not stay at this hotel again.

author: Samuel C
title: Gross
text:
Hotel is tiny and disgusting. Stains all over carpet. Water in shower is brown. Dated chipped furniture. Nasty AC units.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

author: Sofia L
title: A great hotel in a perfect city location
text:
It’s always a challenge when booking a hotel from the UK to know exactly what you’re getting but I’m absolutely delighted with finding the Fitzpatrick Grand Central. 

The upgrade to a King Suite was very welcome - spacious, quiet and comfortable with a gleaming bathroom with an excellent walk-in shower. 

The hotel is on only nine floors, which gives it a reassuringly intimate feel with none of the manic bustle of some of the bigger Manhattan hotels. 

The Wheeltapper bar is excellent (and is open for breakfast) and the live music at the weekend is a hoot. 

The location is perfect for Grand Central Station and Midtown generally. 

I really can’t recommend this hotel highly enough and a huge thank you to the front desk staff but Brendan in particular for making this feel like a real home from home.

author: Miguel I
title: Amazing
text:
We’re a bit late writing this review as we’ve been caught up in engagement excitement!! So nearly 2 months later here we go🤣
Me and John stayed in the Fitzpatrick hotel over the Easter bank holiday and we could not recommend it anymore. When we checked in we made the staff aware that Johns bag was missing from the airport and they would be in contact if they found it. Straight away the hotel staff rang the helpline and gave the claim number to see if there was any update (unfortunately no update as of yet). The next morning we woke up at the crack of dawn due to jet lag and reception rang again looking for an update. With no good news, we went about our day! The staff tried to reassure us that this happens all the time and we would get it sorted. We arrived back to the hotel at lunch time, when I went up for a rest and John went to the bar to drown his sorrows. Little did I know my engagement ring was in that bag!!!! He told the staff and they pulled all the strings and managed to get us an upgrade to a suite! When he text me to tell me to pack my bags I thought he was joking🤣 eventually after moving to the most amazing room, the bag showed up (thanks be to god and thanks to the amazing staff that kept on ringing!) That evening he popped the question and now it will be the most memorable trip we have ever had. I’d like to specially thank Brendan Foley our fellow Irish man, Jeff Rivera, and my girl Nicole in the bar. I’ve never stayed someone where the staff are genuinely such nice people. I would come back to this hotel just to see them again! Thank you for everything!

author: Ruby S
title: Thank You
text:
Stayed here for a week
Great location, Room Great, Staff Great, Restaurant food lovely 
Could not fault anything 
Wishing the Hotel the very best 👌

author: Kyle V
title: Fabulous location!
text:
We recently returned from a 7 night stay at Fitzpatrick’s Grand Central Terminal. We had stayed there before and were delighted to stay again. 
The location is perfect! It feels a very safe area. It is a two minute walk to Grand Central Terminal. A short, easy walk to many places that we wanted to visit - Times Square, Rockefeller, 5th Ave, Central Park, Bryant Park etc. 
What makes this hotel so special are truly the wonderful staff! It really makes a difference. I have to give a shoutout to Andrea. She is lovely and always checking to make sure our stay was great. Brendan is wonderful and always in a great mood. He was always helpful and interested in our plans. He gave great recommendations for different places too. Garfield, Jeff & Sara were so pleasant also. The manager, Patrick always stopped by to say hello and check that our stay was going well. He was so pleasant, not just to us, but to his staff also. 
Our room was lovely and very quiet. The towels were fluffy and the bed linens were a fabulous quality. 
Can’t wait to stay again!

author: Rosie N
title: Great weekend
text: Not only is the hotel in a convenient area, but the staff was incredibly warm and welcoming (especially the manager Jeff).  This is our third time staying here - and we'll be back!

author: Sofia I
title: Family’s first visit to city. Hotel and staff made it special
text:
We loved our stay. My wife and I brought our young kids for their first time to the city. It was a great location and home base for sightseeing.

What I really wanted to mention was how great the staff was to our kids. You definitely don’t see a bunch of kids in this part of mid city so I wasn’t sure how kid friendly it was going to be. But during check in our kids were greeted with hot chocolate and Fitzpatrick teddy bears. It was a really special way to start the trip. My youngest daughter promptly left hers on the ferry and was devastated. Jeff at the front desk grabbed her another one and saved the day. That small act of kindness helped cement the whole trip as special and fun.

author: Henry U
title: Wonderful from start to finish!
text:
We have just returned from a 4 night stay in the most wonderful Fitzpatricks ar Grand Central. The hotels location is second to none and the staff could not have been more pleasant. 
The room was spacious with stunning views and the attention to detail throughout Is impressive.
 The staff with particular regard to both Brendan and Sophie were very kind to us both and treated us to a breathtaking room upgrade and some treats for our birthdays making our stay even more special.  
Thanks to all at Fitzpatricks we cannot wait to return again and would not hesitate in recommending it to anyone.

author: Nora R
title: A wonderful hotel.
text:
We stayed in Fitzpatricks in March 26. A very nice and clean hotel.Beds were so comfy and very clean.The staff couldn’t do enough for us like directions etc.Felt so homely. Thank you. We had a fabulous time and can’t wait to get back. 
Paddy and Robyn.

author: Lucas B
title: Love the staff above all
text:
The best experience was with the staff. Everyone was kind and helpful but 3 people stood out. One was the evening receptionist ( unfortunately I don’t remember her name), who went above and beyond to make me happy and has a fantastic personality. The other two people were Mohamed and Said  who greet you at the door and make an amazing team. These two guys are worth booking a room there again. 

The location is awesome too, in the theatre district, and you can pretty much walk everywhere. Everything I needed last minute was on that block. 2 minute walk to snacks, pharmacy, street cart right in front of the hotel if you need a midnight coffee or refreshment, lots of restaurants and bars and very diverse crowd. 

The bed was very comfortable, clean linens, fresh towels, complementary water and overall homey, relaxed atmosphere. 

I would come to this hotel again next time I’m in town.

author: Sophia I
title: Very Nice!
text:
Location was great, hotel was very nice, room was compact but comfortable.
We did request ice & a few glasses/cups from front desk but they never arrived

author: Lucy D
title: Great 1 night stay
text:
Great 1 night stay. Check in was easy. The room was clean and the beds were really soft. Rooms are smaller but clean. The bathroom shower was excellent with fantastic hot water!  
A couple of opportunities were that there was no mini fridge to store cold drinks or leftovers.  Even though our room door was locked and secured with deadbolt it did not feel as secure as other hotel doors. The hotel is modern and renovated however I feel like newer room doors should have been part of what should have been replaced.
Jeff the doorman at the entrance was exceptional and super accommodating and friendly. 
Overall we enjoyed the experience

author: Chloe J
title: Excellent Service and Great Location At Ameritania Times Square
text: I had a great stay at Ameritania at Times Square. The hotel is in a very convenient location, and the staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. A special thank you to Javal, Jeff, and Mohamed for helping us with our luggage and arranging a car to the airport. They made everything so much easier and stress-free, especially when we had a lot of bags. I really appreciate their kindness and excellent service. I would definitely recommend this hotel and would be happy to stay here again!

author: Oliver Y
title: Fabulous stay in the heart of Times Square/Theater district
text: Staff were very attentive and housekeeping was excellent and room was very clean. Jeff at the front was very kind and helpful with our heavy bags too!!

author: Amelia L
title: Suitable for a family stay
text:
Very well-located hotel.
The hotel employee named Mohamed was truly top-notch, welcoming, very attentive, and super pleasant.

author: Daniel H
title: Value for Preiss in Midtown the best
text: This is the best hotel in Midtown for the Price. No question. Excellent accommodations, friendly staff—all at the most reasonable price that anyone could imagine in New York. Close to Subway connections. Nightlife is vibrant without being noisy. Rooms were nicely furnished, and had completeamenities.  I will stay here every time. I’m in New York.

author: Sophia K
title: Great place
text: Clean hotel. Quiet.  near theatres and Central Park

author: Andrea T
title: Vacation
text:
Positive experience. Many little touches, starting with Jalal's kindness.
Hotel located in a convenient position to reach the various tourist destinations.
I would definitely return.

author: Rosie W
title: 3 Day NYC Stay
text: Had a great stay! The hotel was in an amazing location, very clean, and we felt safe and comfortable the entire time. The staff were all so friendly and helpful, and a special shoutout to Jeff for making our stay even better! Would definitely recommend and stay here again😊

author: Erin O
title: Great Service
text: Flawless. Will definitely be back.

author: Isla B

I recommend 
Pleasant hotel

author: Abigail E
title: Jeff was good help
text: Jeff good helpful Thankyou cheers

author: Ruby V
title: A centrally located, clean hotel.
text: Centrally located, clean, room size is quite adequate, staff are friendly and helpful, and there's free coffee service every morning. The rooms are cleaned daily. Water is being released. On the negative side; the air conditioner is very noisy, we arrived early and when we asked if the room was available, they demanded a $100 fee, which I think is ridiculous. You can pay if it's available, otherwise don't.

author: Dylan Z
title: Great location - Great service.
text: Great location. Great service. Great value. Only slight query was the noise of the aircon in my room but at least it worked.

author: Julien W
title: The staff
text: The staff is really nice, Keenan was really nice 👍🏽

author: Charlie U
title: Great hotel and excellent staff!
text: Our son recently moved to Hell's Kitchen and this hotel was the perfect place to stay! Excellent location halfway between Central Park and Times Square. Walkable to lots of subway stations. The room was very clean and the beds were comfortable. Surprisingly it was very quiet as well. The staff was excellent- every person I talked to was super friendly and helpful. Especially Siham and Keenan at the front desk who were very helpful when we arrived with our bags early and they were able to accommodate an early checkin for us. I highly recommend this hotel and we will definitely stay again on our next visit.

author: Charlotte E
title: Everything perfect!!
text: Everything was absolutely perfect! The hotel was beautiful, comfortable, and the service was excellent. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, especially Jalal and Mohamed, who were both so lovely and helpful. They really made our stay even more enjoyable. We would definitely come back! ❤️

author: George H
title: Wonderful
text: The staff that greet you at the door were wonderful. And assisted me navigating the city and the different venues.

author: Emma G
title: Great
text: Jalal was very helpful great location and hotel

author: Luca A
title: Great Location, Comfortable Room, and Helpful Staff
text:
We stayed at this hotel with our family in a double queen room with a sofa, and overall we had a very pleasant experience.

The room was quite spacious and comfortable. It was clear that the room had been recently renovated, with fresh, modern furniture and a nice overall feel. Having two queen beds and a sofa gave our family plenty of space.

The hotel also has a breakfast room with an à la carte menu. We had breakfast there a couple of times, and I especially appreciated being able to get Starbucks coffee every morning before heading out for a day of walking around New York. There is also a small market inside the hotel with a microwave, which is very convenient if you need to warm up some food.

The location is excellent. It’s about a 10–15 minute walk to Rockefeller Center, Times Square, and Central Park, and there are plenty of grocery stores, restaurants, and other places to eat nearby.

The staff were always polite and helpful, and the daily housekeeping service was very good and made our stay even more comfortable.

Overall, we were very happy with our stay and would definitely consider staying here again when visiting New York.

author: Emma R
title: Great Stay and great services
text:
We had a great living experience in this hotel! Very quiet neighborhood and good quality of services. 

Special thanks to Carlos and Claudia! They are very kind people who had provided great support and advice during our visit. 

It will definitely be a right decision if you choose to stay in Residence Inn Manhattan/Midtown East, NYC.

author: Oscar Z
title: Great location, but vibe is not friendly.
text: Great location and rooms have 2 queen beds, which is hard to find in NYC. However, front desk staff are not friendly and the selection of books on display in the lounge area leans very right wing/conservative/religious ( Sarah Palin, Glenn Beck, Jerome Corsi, Billy Graham, etc). I’ve never seen this type of overt political statement in a large chain hotel. Seems like a weird thing to do in this polarized political climate.

author: Camille O
title: A Best Bargain
text: Clean, efficient and basic.  Very large rooms with good beds, decent pillows, desk and a mini fridge.  Excellent price for the location and the quality of accommodation.  Breakfast offering was pretty poor, but you are in Manhattan with lots of options.  dedicated car service back to the airport was a very good deal.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  I wouldn't make this a romantic retreat, but for a quick business meeting in the area or a visit to MSK Rockefeller Outpatient Cancer Center you cannot beat it.

author: Harper M
title: Amazing Experience + Staff
text: Oksana and Michael are absolutely amazing! It is always such a joy to book with them and they make the process as smooth as possible. Great location and room as well

author: Daisy W
title: Dreadful admin. illegally holding onto money
text: Hotel is fine, but their administration is either a complete mess or there is something more sinister going on. we and another couple handed over our credit card on arrival, and after we left and they took out the cost of our stay, they have hung onto $2000 without any explanation and have now stopped responding to emails. We have contacted the police. Dreadful customer service.

author: Oliver M
title: Best hotel experience ever
text: The service I received was sensational. Big ups to Adwoa for all her support and care throughout my stay. This was my first experience living at a Marriott hotel and she really made my experience very memorable. Her friendly interactions and kind aura definitely played a role in how much I relished the experience. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Manhattan :)

author: Ella P
title: Mostly good...
text: First impression was great, the room looked fantastic. Unfortunately, an unfixable maitenance problem neccesitated a room swap late in the evening. Front desk insisted that no rooms are available. Fortunately, after speaking to a manager, the new room magically appeared. She definitely saved the stay. The buffet breakfast was surprisingly ok. Definitely different from your average sad breakfast offerings by Courtyard hotels,

author: Aiden F
title: Favorite out of all the hotels I’ve stayed in NYC
text:
The location was excellent, across the street from a subway station.  But the best was the wonderful and kind service provided by the front desk staff.  Hats off to those ladies. I’m sorry I don’t remember their names, but they made our stay truly special.  They gave us a warm welcome and even checked us in despite our early arrival.  The room was large with a great view.  Very clean room, with staff providing extra towels without us even asking.  It was also quiet despite facing the street.  

Can’t speak about the amenities as I did not use them. But the few times I passed by the lounge, all was clean and quiet. Staff was friendly and professional.  

Highly recommended. You won’t regret staying at this hotel.  Great value for the cost with a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

author: Giulia P
title: Checks off all the boxes
text:
This hotel checked off all the boxes for a family of four (kids age 17 and 24) coming to the city for an overnight stay to catch some theater. The staff at the front desk were super friendly, and offered us water and told us to enjoy the show when we left a few hours later. The room itself was on the 31st floor, facing south with a great view of the iconic Chrysler Building. The room was the largest Manhattan hotel room I have ever stayed in, over the course of decades of staying in different places. There were two queen beds and a very comfortable foldout couch for one, so plenty of room for four people. Unlike most hotels with sofabeds which offer little support and thin mattresses with the coils coming out, this mattress was firm and comparable to the regular beds. The common areas, gym and restaurant were on the 12th floor. There is everything you need within walking distance, including a drug store right downstairs and the famous Essabagel across the street.  Plenty of dining options at different price points without the hoards of people in other neighborhoods. The theater district, Times Square, and Lincoln Center are all about a half hour walk away. 
Hint: cheap parking at garage at 206 E 59th street a short walk away.

author: Jack D
title: Nice hotel
text: Hotel is recently remodeled. Work is going on in Bistro but it’s open. Very hand to subway. Everything was clean and nice.

author: Evan Z
title: 2/10. Would not recommend
text:
I recently stayed at the Courtyard Midtown East and unfortunately the experience was disappointing overall.
The cleanliness of the room was the biggest issue. The bathroom clearly hadn’t been cleaned thoroughly — there were random hairs left behind, painted over water damaged ceilings, noticeable soap scum buildup, and visible stains in the shower. It immediately made the space feel unhygienic and poorly maintained. For a hotel in this price range and location, I expected much better attention to detail.
The room itself also showed signs of wear. The door had several scratches and scuffs, which added to the overall feeling that the property isn’t being kept up very well.
The beds were another letdown. They were very average hotel beds with little support, and the pillows were extremely flat and uncomfortable. It made it difficult to get a good night’s sleep after long days in the city.
Overall, the stay felt mediocre at best. With the rates charged in Midtown, I expected a cleaner, better maintained room and a more comfortable bed. Unfortunately, this stay did not meet those expectations

author: Lucas B
title: Breakfast included is a scam
text:
Breakfast included doesn't mean included it is extra for every item so no buffet or a simple yogurt. The people working there are rude and they need training. 
1 cereal, 2 muffins, 2 apple juices and 1 coffee was $32 extra! Don't get the breakfast included. It's a scam!

author: Aiden L
title: Staff need customer service training
text: The rudest most obnoxious, sarcastic front desk staff I have ever met.  Sneering, arguing back and mocking.  Total disgrace.  Also a rip off.  Rooms are from the 1960s and toilet was filthy when checked in.  The carpets are sticky.

author: Aiden Z
title: Don’t get double charged
text: This hotel double charged me for my room and won’t refund my money.  This hotel does not operate at the Marriott standard.  Please make sure to check your bill and buyer beware!

author: Miguel P
title: Disappointed
text: We recently stayed at this Marriott location for my daughter's birthday.  The location and size of the rooms was excellent.    The hotel management at check in fell extremely short in service.    At check in I was asked for a cc for incidentals.   Later that afternoon I realized they had charged me again for two rooms that were pre paid.   This was reversed but the hotel could not provide me proof that the transaction was cancelled and said that it could take up to two weeks for the funds to be returned.   They also could not provide proof that I could present to the bank to expedite the release of funds.   This caused extreme distress as the significant amount of those funds was to be used for meals, transportation and essential needs.   It has been 10 days and the funds have not been released

author: Abigail P
title: Excellent customer service from staff!
text: Outstanding customer service from front desk (including Michael!) and maintenance staff for a minor temp issue in my room. Staff outstanding. Great stay!

author: Lea L
title: Best hotel I’ve stayed at for school trip. Easy to book / organize, amazing staff, great rooms. Loved my time here!
text: Best hotel experience I have had while on a school trip. Great experience booking and Aixa and Julissa were hosts, a very friendly welcome. They even had a Virginia Tech label on the luggage rack which goes to show the care and attention. I think this will be our go to hotel for years to come!

author: Sara Z
title: Left my heart in the city, my book and disappointment in the hotel.
text:
An absolutely wonderful hotel in the inside, as well as with beautifully cleaned and comfortable, cozy rooms equipped facility, whose personnel I honestly, deeply sorry to admit it, must say is not exactly characterized neither by the utmost kindness nor, especially, by the greatest, most admirable organization.

After, of course, making the very serious and silly mistake of forgetting the book I was studying for a university exam I am preparing in the room I was staying with my parents on holiday last August, I received the promise by the staff some weeks later that they would very kindly put it aside for me, since they had luckily succeeded in locating it.
A family friend, now on holiday in NYC, would indeed do us the huge favour of stopping by at the hotel to collect the book, which he did, but found himself losing time in front of an utterly perplexed personnel at the reception who had no idea where the book was kept.
Needless to say, we felt so outraged by such an irresponsible and disrespectful behaviour and now hoping they will be able to find the book again. But in the meanwhile, we feel very sorry for our friend, who lost some time during his holiday wishing to help but utterly ignored by the highest example of negligence and indifference.

author: Camille F
title: Extremely Disappointing Experience at Courtyard by Marriott Manhattan Midtown
text:
My wife and I stayed for one night at the Courtyard by Marriott Manhattan Midtown to celebrate our first wedding anniversary. We had booked a king-size bed room in advance. Upon arrival, we were greeted by Michael, a friendly gentleman with a warm smile who checked us in and mentioned that we had received an upgrade. It was a great start, and we appreciated his professionalism.

However, when we entered our room, we discovered that it had two queen beds, not the king-size room we had booked. Since this was a special occasion and comfort was important to us, I went back to the front desk to clarify. Michael was no longer there, and another lady at the reception informed us—rather abruptly—that there were no king rooms available and that we would have to “take it or leave it.” There was no apology or explanation, which felt unprofessional and dismissive.

I requested to speak with a manager, not to make a scene but to resolve the issue calmly. The assistant manager, Charissa K, arrived and reiterated that no king rooms were available, explaining that platinum and gold members were the hotel’s priority. I expressed my disappointment, explaining that we had specifically booked a king room for comfort.

The most shocking part of the conversation was when Charissa told us that because we booked through a friends and family discount, the employee whose code we used “could get fired” if we made an issue. We were taken aback by this comment—it felt like a threat and completely inappropriate for a hospitality professional.

We left feeling disappointed and disrespected. What was supposed to be a memorable anniversary turned into an unpleasant experience. This was our first and last stay at Courtyard by Marriott Manhattan Midtown.

Not recommended.

author: Daniel K
title: Odain and Odessa were the best!!
text: We had the most pleasant time at this hotel. It was close to everything we wanted to see and if it wasn't, then it was close to a subway stop that got us there. The rooms were clean and cozy and the staff had lots of great suggestions for us to visit. Odain, Kyle and Odessa were the stars of the show! They greeted us with a smile every time we came in and literally took care of us like we were family. I have never felt so comfortable in a place that wasn't my home! They were there literally all hours of the day and talking to them was a real highlight of our trip. Quiet, great atmosphere, great value, and location. all around 11/10 stay at this hotel!

author: Erin V
title: Convenient, clean hotel in the heart of midtown. Train stations nearby.
text: Convenient hotel location in heart of midtown. Clean, small room but very functional with a great view. Nice to stay on a higher floor. They make great use of the spaces. Near both Penn and Grand Central Stations. Great places to eat nearby.

author: Sara S
title: Great business location
text: The Courtyard 5th Ave has been our organizations go-to for several years.  Staff has been very accommodating and the mid-town location is perfect.

author: Katie D
title: Great Midtown Location
text:
Got a great price for two nights so went with it. All staff we encountered were pleasant. The free coffee and water bottle filler on the Mezzanine floor are a nice touch. 
Rooms - room was clean and comfortable...also small which is to be expected in NYC.  Bathroom is in dire need of updating. 
Location was great - right in Midtown, across the street from the NY Public Library. Grand Central, Bryant Park, Times Sq. all an easy walk away. 
Would stay there again if the price is right.

author: Chloe E
title: Great Location - Great for Solo No Frills Traveler
text:
I'm loyal to Marriott properties, unless there's a reason to look elsewhere... notable hotel, location, etc.  They have a great website that makes it easy to find what you are looking for.  Preferred a hotel in this area and noticed that they had a good price and didn't have an added nightly amenity fee (these added fees are becoming maddening... just charge what you need to charge, incorporate this "fee" in the room price).   They can't charge the fee as they don't have a restaurant.  This hotel has no amenities, other than a pretty good coffee/latte/etc. machine on the mezzanine that actually wasn't bad.  However, this is NYC, there are a ton of places within a couple of blocks. 

So, consider it a no frills place... just a room.  However, the location was great for me.  The rooms are small, but the bed, shower, fine.  As I was traveling solo,  it was perfect...  wouldn't recommend for a family.   I loved this pick!

author: Dylan Q
title: Loyal Marriott Member Left Shocked by Poor Service
text:
Stayed one night at Courtyard Fifth Avenue — never again. Only one elevator worked, so every trip up or down meant long lines and chaos. The lobby was dirty, staff were disengaged, and checking my bag took 20 minutes.

As a longtime Marriott member, I reached out twice afterward. The response? They asked if I wanted to transfer my points for use outside Marriott — basically saying, “Goodbye, loyal guest.”

This place is an embarrassment to the Marriott brand.

author: Henry X
title: Great Location But Could Use Some Upgrades
text:
This Courtyard hotel is located in a perfect mid-town spot to explore NYC.  But overall the property is showing its age and could use a refresh.
Pros: 
Friendly service
Very clean room and common areas despite the age of the property
Easy walking distance to a ton of attractions and mid-town businesses
Priced better than many of their competitors in the same area
Access to guestrooms via the elevator requires a room key
Cons:
No amenities beyond a water and coffee machine on the Mezzanine level
Rooms / decor are out of date and rooms are small (typical for NYC)
Bed was very uncomfortable
No breakfast offered like other Courtyard hotels
Overall this hotel is middle of the road and worth it if the price is right versus other properties and mid-town is your desired location.  If you are looking for a hotel with full amenities (bar, restaurant, room service, etc.) I would recommend looking elsewhere.

author: Owen L
title: Stranded by Marriott: Poor Communication and Broken Guarantees
text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience at this Marriott Courtyard. Despite speaking with a staff member (Veronica) the morning of my reservation to request cancellation, I was not informed that I needed to arrive before noon to keep my room. Later that night, I arrived and was told my reservation had been cancelled due to a declined credit card—even though I had proof my card was charged and never received any email requesting updated payment.
The staff offered no alternative accommodations or assistance, leaving me stranded in New York City at 10pm with no place to stay. I had to pay for two expensive Uber rides just to get home and back for my business meeting the next morning. Marriott refused to honor their “Ultimate Reservation Guarantee” for elite members, and I had to fight just to get a partial refund.
Overall, this location failed to communicate important policies, did not follow through on their guarantees, and left me with unnecessary stress and costs. I would not recommend staying here.

author: Liam O
title: The hotel bellboy was great.
text:
I had a meeting with the hotel reservation person beforehand, so I was able to check in very smoothly and stay 5 nights comfortably. The location is excellent 👍
And coffee and water are always available, which is very helpful. I had nothing to do with the front desk staff at all, but Mr. Bellboy was supremely always kind. When I asked him about the laundromat, he did his best to find out. He was also pleasant in greeting me.

author: Antoine B
title: Location! Location! Location! Great staff, comfy beds and quiet and safe area.
text: Location - location - location is why I chose this hotel. The bag drop was awesome, we used it on arrival and departure. The staff were great. Beds are comfortable and the floor is quiet. We had no issues with the elevator- but there are just two of them. We enjoyed our stay and we will be back.

author: Freya H
title: Perfect location in the heart of Manhattan
text:
It is certainly not the cheapest hotel in the world, and given the cost you might expect something more. The room wasn't huge, and a modernized one wouldn't come bad. In particular, the air conditioning at one time was so noisy that I thought a truck had entered the room and I had to get up in the middle of the night to turn it off.
Despite some flaws, however, the hotel is in such a great location that it would probably be my choice again for a next trip to New York. Located a stone's throw from delightful Bryant Park and the public library, it is close to many of Manhattan's top attractions.
Other plus points are the kindness of the staff and the coffee machine (free) located in the mezzanine, perfect for recharging energy before long walks through the city.

author: Grace U
title: Location Location Loaction.  True NYC need
text: Hotel is all about location as it’s central to all and transportation was super easy. The staff was amazing huge shout out to Frank who helped us with all our needs rides, travel tips and recommendations.  Front desk even put a fridge in our room and we loved the coffee station on the mezzanine level open 24/7. This is truly a great location for all things Broadway as it’s across from Bryant park and was a 10 min bus ride from Central Park.

author: Paige V
title: Poor experience
text: Central location but that's about it! The check in was poor, no recognition for Titanium or elite status. Points that were part of the reservation code were not deposited. Follow up led no where. Customer service at the hotel is non existent!

author: Giulia D
title: Pleasant stay
text: Amazing location, clean rooms good housekeeping staff. 24 hrs hot water. Both lifts are working so no waiting for lift as mentioned in earlier reviews. The coffee maker in lobby provides 24 hours tasty coffee. The gym had basic equipments which was sufficient. Overall great stay in midtown Manhattan.

author: Erin O
title: Doesn‘t meet the Courtyard standard
text:
1 Elevator was only available for the entire hotel.
Sometimes was this elevator also not available 
You have to wait between 10 and 20 min for the elevator 
The rooms are pretty tiny. For 2 persons was ‚t enough space
Closet was also very tiny.
This was the worst courtyard I‘ve ever had

author: Antoine Q
title: Do not stay here
text:
Do not stay here, not sure how it is a Marriott. Rooms are old and dated. Staff awful, left before noon with housekeeping just starting on floor and returned at 5 with room untouched. Tried to call on hotel phone but busy, called front desk and was told I was being transferred to manager and almost 10 min later still in hold.
 2nd Elevator was supposed to be back up before stay but still broken and waits were crazy long.

author: George Z
title: We Stay Here Because of Location
text: Good room size, temperature control, mattress comfort. We stay here because of perfect location for us and the loyalty program.  But I hate hate HATE the standard Marriott showers because all the tubs are round on the bottom like a canoe--no flat surface to stand on. No reading lights for reading in bed.  In this property one of two elevators was out of service so very long waits.  No valet parking so you have to drive yourself to a garage two blocks away, although it is discounted with validated ticket.  Overall I don't think this is a property that Marriott should be proud of.  On the good side, the concierge was amiable and efficient in temporarily storing our luggage.

author: Ella Q
title: At least there were not bed bugs….I hope
text: Staff was unpleasant and rude even at checkin, one elevator was broken (and had been for months), valet/bell captain would take bags to the second floor to load the elevator skipping in front of guest waiting in the lobby. This left the lobby full of angry guest waiting for the only working elevator that was rendered inaccessible by staff. This was not a one off situation it was the routine. I had a child get sick in the evening and require additional linens and towels. I called 3x and finally went to the lobby to be told it was shift change after waiting over an hour. I am a long time titanium Bonvoy member and enjoy most every experience I have with them. This was probably the worst I have had in over 20 years. Will not go back, 100% avoid. It gives the brand a bad name.

author: Ethan K
title: SKIP IT
text:
Skip it!!

Stayed there one time before last summer. Slowest elevators ever. One got stuck with someone in it.

We got there this time and only 1 working elevator for 30 floors of people. Not even a freight elevator so the staff use the same one!! We waited 15 minutes for it when we were leaving at 9 AM only to watch it bypass us twice. We had to walk down and the stairwell was full.

Skip this place for somewhere that cares about their customers.

author: Louis G
title: Find Another Option.
text: Stay away from here.   My stay was 10/15 - 10/19/24.  The building has 30 Floors, 1 working elevator.  The staff used the elevator the most, so you would wait for 15 - 20 minutes for an elevator.  No ice bucket or fridge in the room, had to buy one and schlep ice.  Called the front desk and asked about it, the man said he would check with the manager and hung up on me.  I needed a 5 am car to the airport and was told $68 however, was charged over $90.  Not worth over $430/night.   More like $99/night.  Beds were comfortable.

author: James E
title: Bad
text:
Let's start with the key point: this hotel cannot be a three-star. 
Dirty carpet in both the hallways and the rooms, very small bathrooms with toilets that clog every other minute, water that tastes like iron, minimal and basic breakfast service. 
These are just the general negative details.
In my specific case, one evening the shower knob came off in my hand… 
The only point in its favor is the strategic location near the park and near the metro 1 
I will not return.

author: Chloe L
title: wonderful
text: Such a great hotel for couples who want a cozy place to stay at in Central Park. Jennifer at front desk was really helpful and great customer service. Definitely recommended. P/S: Thanks again, Jennifer for all your help!

author: Connor J
title: Fleabag - should be shut down at once.
text: Filthy and smelly room, with a huge indention in the bed, showing someone had been lying there and yet the room was sold to me as a new clean room. Not enough clean towels provided. No housekeeping provided unless requested - that was never disclosed, I overheard that in the elevator from another guest! Room lights went out when I was showering. TV failed due to rain - explained to me by the front desk as "TV fails in rain as it is a satellite dish as the manager is too cheap to provide cable"; the noisy through window air conditioner had a filter that had never been changed = I had to turn it off. Windows didn't open - the one that did slid shut on its own. Room phone to front desk not operational. The electricity shorted out unexpectedly, leaving me with no light, no power - nothing! And to charge me for one night with all of this, is a disgrace.  Finally, beg bug bites noted by physician the next day. This all will be reported to the City of New York's Dept of Health as well as the Dept of Consumer Affairs!

author: Wyatt W
title: This property should be condemned
text: Terrible, horrible, shameful !  The great location doesn't compensate for the disgusting condition of the property.  The A/C window unit roared like a DC3,  the carpet in the hallway had bleach stains throughout , the carpet in the room was so bad I wore shoes the entire stay; would not dare put bare feet on the floor!  The excuse for pillows are lumps of compressed foam. The windows are filthy making the purple room seem even darker and smaller. The wait for the elevator exceeded 10 minutes most of the time since there is only one elevator to service 14 floors AND the housekeeping team (there is no daily housekeeping service and the mops and vacuums remain on the narrow halls all the time).  If you can ignore the subpar rooms, furniture and outlets that are broken and don't function, the rattle of the AC, awful breakfasts and wait time to exit the building then the surrounding neighborhood is pretty great.  Have fortitude and low standards to endure the hotel itself.

author: Amelia Y
title: Total mess of a hotel and way over priced
text:
Terrible messy hotel.
Arrived to find it was undergoing refurbishment. Mess in corridors and in the room. Bathroom had lumps of plaster falling off the walls onto the floor.
We left immediately and were told a refund would be given. Three weeks later no refund. They’re ignoring calls and emails.

author: Abigail T
title: 90 second Check in..
text: I’m a Hilton Diamond only because I hate the front desk check in process. But since they have lost their damn minds with their outrageous prices and points needed for NY, here I am. You check in before, approach desk, Jennifer does a little razzle dazzle on the computer, tells me about breakfast and hands you the keys. Take note Holiday Inn.

author: Michael S
title: Diamond Member and this is how we are treated
text:
First of all I am a diamond member. My wife used to work for Laquinta. We stayed at Times Square location. This one by far is the worst customer service this there is.

Issues:
-Flight was delayed called front desk maybe 35 times to let them know we are coming in around 1 am because flight is delayed no answer whatsoever. I even called the Wyndham customer service line they say nobody is answering.

-Nobody answered emails so we were in limbo.

-Had two reservations because of points they keep checking us out everyday. It’s annoying had to go down stairs

-No water in Bfast all Laquintas or Wyndham have this.

-front desk in the afternoon different instructions- on demand cleaning of room, every two days, or not cleaning at stay which one is it.

- we brought bed bug spray.

- Building needs remodeling

- room is executive suite and we payed for it and it was size of a closet.

- July 23 front desk was rude. Don’t know anything about we inquired especially with reservation.

- tried to buy drinks nobody was at front desk there was a sign that said be back shortly.

- WiFi at this cost sucks bad

- Differnt information like they don’t work with each other or same place. Poor communication with one another

-front desk needs training. Do you know how hard it is to get a diamond member?

- we probably stayed at 100 laquintas and wyndhams and this by far was the worst.

-we ignored the reviews and gave it a benefit of a doubt but guess what the reviews are right this laquinta sucks

- Front Desk needs a tutorial on Customer service and good
Manners. I know this is NY but it’s not an excuse we paid top dollar and expect more. I am a GM and I make sure my people know what customer service is.

Only good thing here is location to central and ladies who clean rooms and serve bfast are nice and courteous.

author: Diego J
title: Terrible place
text:
I arrived and my room was
They left it uncleaned and did not go to clean it later, in addition to not having the air conditioning working well.

author: Amelia Q
title: Central Park West overpriced, decrepit, foul smelling dungeon
text: Decrepit, foul smelling, overpriced hotel - felt like staying in a dungeon. Do not book a room here despite the appealing location! This place is appalling and I have pictures to prove it. Looks nothing like photos on website

author: Juan I
title: Room that looks like a captive
text: It is unbelievable that the Whyndham network puts its name in this horrible hotel, of the tiny, inappropriate rooms, with broken furniture (the drawers in the chamber do not close, the closet is ridiculously nonexistent from so small. They say that the hotel speaks English and Spanish, but the attendant welcomed me speaking a super fast English and didn't care if I was understanding or not (I think her name is Jennifer, if yeah I also understood). We just came from Orlando and we stayed in a hotel of the windham chain there and it is another level of service, quality, dimensions, even without great luxuries, but we are talking about a comfortable hotel with great cost. But this here, only gave us disappointment and desire to know New York all day, pq it is impossible to feel well in a room that more looks like a captivity. dark, no ventilation. only save the location and the beds with good mattresses, but that occupy almost all the space of the room. I don't tell anyone or even a diary.

author: Megan R
title: If you have the opportunity to stay here, I recommend skipping it.
text: It is the worst hotel in NYC for what they charge... the room in my apartment is larger than the room they gave me, the bed was pushed against the wall because it fit, the air conditioning is very old and makes a terrible noise that prevents you from sleeping, there are rats in the building (you can hear their squeaks at night), the breakfast is very meager, and the elevator is super slow; it seems more like a service elevator because it is used more by the staff than by the guests. The only good thing is its location, close to a subway and facing Central Park.

author: Paige C
title: Don't do it
text: Stay somewhere else! Despite a lovely staff, this hotel is a disaster. Zero maintenance, nothing works (AC - blows hot, showers falling apart with screws either missing or loose, TVs not working).. the carpets are filthy. And the worst part is - if you look at the responses (clearly auto generated because it says the same thing to each negative review) they clearly do not care and are doing NOTHING about any of the issues. Hotels like this are what give NYC a bad reputation. I have spent plenty of time in budget hotels both in NYC and globally and this was the worst by far.

author: Oscar J
title: Look to stay somewhere else!
text: Very bad experience, and I am usually very forgiving. Broken items in the room, I had to play handyman and do some repairs just to be comfortable and have proper use of the room. Old and dilapidated rooms that need total renovation. The Wyndham name looks bad being associated with this property. Being on a street with brownstones in the $5-10 million range, this property should be on a higher level.

author: Sean C
title: Threatened With Police and Reservation Cancel
text:
I never actually stayed at this hotel because of the way I was treated by the front desk staff.

I arrived around noon on June 20, 2026, fully aware that check-in was not until 3:00 PM. I simply wanted to leave my luggage and wait until my room was available. While in the lobby, I attempted to purchase a soft drink and was met with an unnecessarily rude and confrontational attitude from the front desk employee.

When I expressed concern about the way I was being spoken to, the situation escalated rather than being handled professionally. The employee became argumentative, threatened to call the police because I was not yet a checked-in guest, and claimed I was trespassing despite having a valid reservation and being in the reception area.

I then asked to speak with a manager and requested the employee’s name so I could document the incident. She refused to provide her name and instead stated that she was canceling my reservation. I was told to contact Booking.com regarding any refund.

As a result, I left the property and booked another hotel.

I understand that disagreements can happen, and I acknowledge that the conversation became tense. However, threatening a guest with police involvement, refusing to identify yourself, refusing to provide access to management, and canceling a reservation after a guest requests a manager are not acceptable customer service practices.

This was a very disappointing start to a trip to New York with my mother and, based on this experience, I cannot recommend this property.

author: Benjamin V
title: Upon arrival, no room available nor assigned, despite booking in advance and having confirmation number and card charged
text:
I booked the room 3 weeks in advance.  Got a
confirmation number, even the day of the stay my card was charged.  When I got to the hotel for check in,  the front employee told me that I had no room,  that Wyndham overbooked, that no rooms were available to accommodate my family. She did not offered any assistance to find a new stay.  Just like that I arrived to NYC and despite planning in advance had no place stay.  It’s shameful how they treat their customers.  No notification in advance to make other plans.
A lady in front of us went through the same.  It is outrageous.  Beware!

author: Aiden N
title: Very poor security. A dump.
text: Had to leave my bag because could not check in early.  In info taken, my bag was to be left in an open area just inside the unsecured front door.  Bag area was surrounded by three tall windows looking out onto the sidewalk.  When I returned at 8 (after a show and dinner) no one at the front desk.  Where my bag was completely un secured or supervised.  Waited and then called the hotel number twice.  Rang for a long time. No answer or ability to leave a message.  Finally someone appeared and checked me in.  Maintenance issues - door to lobby bathroom didn’t close properly and security lock on my room door didn’t work although an alternate method of securing the door was provided.  The only good thing was the location if you are going to Lincoln Center.

author: Lea K
title: Worst Experience - Do not Stay Here!
text: Worst Experience ever! Do not stay here. Rude staff when she decided to come to check us in after 30+ minutes of waiting. Disgusting rooms. Dirty. No parking! Left after 20 minutes after seeing room and dealing with horrible staff. Do better La Quinta!!!

author: Antoine I
title: It was good
text: For the price it was good. The breakfast was meh. Clean and the people at the desk were friendly and helpful.  Plenty of places to eat and grab a drink. Neighborhood was safe and comfortable

author: Molly X
title: Terrible hotel, rats outside and inside the hotel and rooms, don't throw your money away.
text: Don't go to this hotel is a complete disaster, the worst experience of our lives, the rats walk in the rooms, they ate our daughter's clothes and purse too, I have photos and videos of what happened to us, over 300 dollars a night to not sleep anything, because when the light goes out to sleep they start tearing the wall those who are not inside the room and squealing, we exposed our integrity and our health for staying there, the breakfast is appalling without taste and without variety. Please believe my words it was the worst experience we've ever had, and we've been around the world thank God, if you want advice from a friend don't go there it's serious.

author: Jessica Q
title: Traumatic experience
text: If they were negative numbers, I definitely give them minus five. Worst service ever! I need to explain that we travel around the world for a year and never receive at a hotel reception a treat like this. A psycho to service people. Her name is Jennifer. Beware!

author: Marco L
title: Ok just don’t over expect
text: We stayed at the hotel for a concert at Madison Square Garden. It is convenient for a two block walk to the arena. The hotel is old and hasn’t been renovated recently, the bathroom is primitive and rooms are small. But, it is clean and the beds are fine and the price is good for manhattan. The hotel is fine but just do not over expect. Not much of a lobby or staff but I rarely hang out in lobbies or need anything anyway.

author: James X
title: Great stay
text: Room was clean and quiet overnight. Staff were friendly upon check-in and check-out. Would definitely stay here again.

author: Grace T
title: Decent value hotel
text: Went with 3 teenage girls and the size of the room was good for 5 people.  It was very clean.  Two complaints were that hot water frequently ran out and the elevator was extremely slow.  Staff were nice.

author: Freya K
title: Perfect for what we wanted
text: We were delighted with this hotel. It is about one block away from the Empire State Building and close to the underground. It has a small rooftop terrace service food and drink and you could see the building lit up. It was beautiful. Every staff member we met was friendly and helpful. We would definitely choose it again.

author: Henry K
title: Decent Midtown Hotel
text: This hotel was perfectly adequate. Rooms were clean and staff were nice enough. Lobby is a bit lackluster, but we weren’t there to hang out in it! Very conveniently located to MSG and Penn Station.

author: Maria J
title: Very good
text: Everything was very good, very clean, and centrally located to reach any place in Manhattan. There are places to eat nearby, an excellent alternative to explore everything, and it is small but sufficient if you are just going to wander. It does not offer breakfast services, only a coffee space and a vending machine.

author: Mia E
title: This was the worst hotel I have ever stayed at
text:
Here’s the updated version with that interaction added:

This was the worst hotel I have ever stayed at. The front desk staff and the doormen were extremely rude and showed no concern for their guests.

One incident really stood out. Right in front of us, the doorman said to the front desk agent, “Why did you tell them we could store their luggage?” He said it with a very rude attitude. The front desk agent just laughed and replied, “Because if I didn’t mention it, they would ask.” The doorman then reluctantly opened the luggage storage door. It made us feel like we were inconveniencing them just by asking for a basic service.

The room itself was acceptable, but if you stay on one of the upper floors, you have to wait almost five minutes for the hot water to reach your room.

What disappointed me the most was the customer service. Our flight was canceled on Monday, and we asked to extend our stay by one more night. We had already stayed there for three nights, but the front desk agent made no effort to help us or offer any type of discount. He simply told us, “That’s the price,” or that we could look online if we wanted a different rate. There was no empathy or willingness to assist.

Because of the rude and unprofessional staff, I will never stay here again, and I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone. Do yourself a favor and stay at another hotel.

author: David K
title: The Hotel At Fifth Avenue Review
text:
Mission & Concept
★★★✰✰
The Hotel at Fifth Avenue focuses on location and practicality rather than creating a distinctive hotel experience. While it serves well as a central base for exploring Manhattan, it lacks a strong identity or standout feature that sets it apart from competing hotels in the area. Its main appeal is its convenient location, but it lacks some of the character and atmosphere that would make guests genuinely look forward to returning to the hotel after a day in the city.

Cleanliness & Condition 
★✰✰✰✰
The hotel was generally clean, and housekeeping maintained the room well throughout our stay. However, the overall condition of the property was disappointing. The room often felt too warm, the windows were constantly fogged up, and ventilation appeared to be poor. Several facilities also seemed to be in need of repair. One elevator was out of service, the remaining elevators appeared worn, and the air conditioning was extremely loud. We also noticed that the room door did not seal properly, leaving a visible gap that affected both privacy and the overall impression of the room.

Sleep & Rest
★★✰✰✰
The quality of sleep was negatively affected by the room climate, the loud air conditioning, and the overall noise level. As a result, it was sometimes difficult to fully relax and recover, which became frustrating during our stay.

Functionality & Comfort
★★✰✰✰
Functionality and comfort were affected by several operational issues during our stay. One elevator was out of service, while the remaining elevator appeared to be in poor condition. We were also disappointed that luggage storage was only available until around 5:00 AM on the day of departure, which limited flexibility for later travel plans. While these issues did not significantly impact our stay, they reduced the overall level of convenience we expected.

Service & Attitude
★★★★✰
The staff was generally friendly and professional, and we did not experience any major service-related issues during our stay. Housekeeping was reliable, and our room was cleaned consistently throughout our visit. That being said, we made only limited use of the hotel's services, so our experience with the staff was relatively brief. Based on the interactions we had, however, we were satisfied with the overall level of service provided.

Location & Context
★★★★✰
The location was good and generally well suited for exploring Manhattan. A subway station was located nearby, and there were plenty of restaurants, cafés, and shopping options within walking distance. While the location was not necessarily a standout feature of the hotel, it was convenient and provided easy access to many of the places we wanted to visit. Overall, it met our expectations and contributed positively to our stay.

Value for money
★★★✰✰
Considering the points mentioned above, the price was acceptable overall, but at times it felt somewhat high for the level of comfort and quality provided. Given some of the issues we experienced, we would have expected either a lower rate or a more polished overall experience.While we did not feel that the hotel was poor value, we believe it would be more attractively priced at a slightly lower rate, particularly during peak travel seasons.

Overall rating
★★★✰✰
Overall, we would rate The Hotel at Fifth Avenue 3 out of 5 stars. While the hotel offered a decent location, friendly staff, and generally clean accommodations, several issues throughout our stay negatively affected our overall impression.
 None of the problems we encountered were severe on their own, but together they made the experience less comfortable than expected. The room climate, loud air conditioning, maintenance issues, and operational limitations were the main concerns. For this reason, we do not currently plan to return. However, we believe many of these issues are solvable and hope improvements will be made in the future. Overall, we consider 3 stars to be a fair rating based on our experience and wish the hotel success in continuing to improve.

author: Alice S
title: NYC
text: Arrived 2.50pm on the day off checking in and was told to wait 10mins , for the sake of 10mins they could have let us have our key & get on our merry way. The room is pretty tiny, no view what so ever ( room 607 ) but it was very clean and tidy. The WiFi is pretty nonexistent, the lifts are useless, only saving grace is the roof bar …. The location is fantastic…

author: Luke Z
title: Very old and very poor maintenance
text: This hotel is terrible.  The wall paper is stapled to the wall, there are large gaps in the closet that have studs showing.  There are spider webs and construction dust.  The smell in the room is moldy.  The beds are old and ripped on the sides.  The beds were creaking whenever we moved.  The sofa bed was so thin that when you sit on it,  you can feel the springs.  The noise in the room from moving on the sofa bed was loud.   The material on the couch was dirty and stained and smelling.

author: Juan X
title: Convenient, clean and friendly faces
text: The Hotel at the Fifth is close to a lot of the big sites to see. Very friendly and helpful. Our room was clean. We had five people in a room and it was a bit small with all of our suitcases but we managed. The elevator sometimes had a mind of its own on and at times had a long wait. We offered took the stairs to the 4th floor.  No refrigerator or microwave in our room and the pull out couch was very springy, not comfortable at all. We redesigned it to be sleep able. The maid services were great and the concierge saved us by getting an Uber big enough to accommodate 5 people and a lot of luggage. Absolutely amazing!!! We would definitely stay here again.

author: Mason Z
title: Really nice staff but the rooms are very old and outdated
text: The location is excellent, staff are very helpful and friendly, and it’s clean. The only thing disappointing is the old outdated interior  and heating. The view from windows is facing the neighbouring house brick wall and the room is a lot smaller than advertised and a constant fan noise or generator coming from outside or inside  can disturb your sleep. For the location and  price deal it’s worth it if you don’t intend to hang around and just use as a base.

author: Pablo A
title: Thank you for your hospitality
text:
We had an excellent stay. The entire hotel team was very friendly. The location is perfect and the room was very comfortable, especially the bed.

author: Paige B
title: Paint it BROWN
text: Old decrepit crumbling hotel on a busy street.  everything in this hotel is brown. very depressing.

author: Olivia X
title: Decent Stay Undermined by Hot Water and Missing Basics
text:
The room was generally clean and well-maintained, but it felt a bit sterile—there was no scent or welcoming atmosphere. In comparison, I’ve stayed at a Pestana hotel before where the room had a subtle lavender fragrance that made the experience feel more elevated and inviting.

Check-in and check-out were smooth and efficient, which I appreciated. However, the hot water was a consistent issue—I had to let it run for 5–10 minutes before it even got warm, which was frustrating and shouldn’t be something guests have to deal with.

There were also a few details that could be improved. It wasn’t clearly stated on the website or booking platform that there’s an additional charge for a microwave, and there was no water provided in the room—not even a complimentary bottle, which is a pretty basic expectation.

While the price was reasonable for the location and timing, these issues took away from the overall experience. With better attention to these details, this could be a much more enjoyable stay, but as it stands, I wouldn’t strongly recommend it.

author: Charlotte U
title: Great Stay!!!!
text: As usual I have no complaints. had a great time staying here on my trip to NYC. perfect location, nice rooms, and a very friendly staff especially the nice man I talked hockey with. I've stayed here dozens of times and am always pleased.

author: Antoine U
